```text
1	// Package audit writes the immutable who-did-what trail required for
2	// government accountability and DPDP breach forensics (blueprint §12, §16).
3	// Entries are insert-only; the STATE_AUDITOR role reads them via the
4	// platformops module.
5	package audit
6	
7	import (
8		"context"
9		"log/slog"
10		"time"
11	
12		"github.com/google/uuid"
13		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
14	
15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
16	)
17	
18	const collection = "audit_logs"
19	
20	// Entry is one audit record.
21	type Entry struct {
22		ID           string         `bson:"_id"            json:"id"`
23		ActorPartyID string         `bson:"actor_party_id" json:"actor_party_id"`
24		ActorRole    string         `bson:"actor_role,omitempty" json:"actor_role,omitempty"`
25		Action       string         `bson:"action"         json:"action"` // e.g. "http.POST /api/v1/collection/pours" or "support.pii_lookup"
26		TargetType   string         `bson:"target_type,omitempty" json:"target_type,omitempty"`
27		TargetID     string         `bson:"target_id,omitempty"   json:"target_id,omitempty"`
28		Status       int            `bson:"status,omitempty"      json:"status,omitempty"`
29		IP           string         `bson:"ip,omitempty"          json:"ip,omitempty"`
30		RequestID    string         `bson:"request_id,omitempty"  json:"request_id,omitempty"`
31		Meta         map[string]any `bson:"meta,omitempty"        json:"meta,omitempty"`
32		TS           time.Time      `bson:"ts"             json:"ts"`
33	}
34	
35	// Recorder persists audit entries asynchronously so auditing never adds
36	// latency to the request path.
37	type Recorder struct {
38		coll *mongo.Collection
39		log  *slog.Logger
40	}
41	
42	// NewRecorder binds the recorder to the database.
43	func NewRecorder(db *mongo.Database, log *slog.Logger) *Recorder {
44		return &Recorder{coll: db.Collection(collection), log: log}
45	}
46	
47	// Record fills identity fields from the request context and persists the
48	// entry in the background (fire-and-forget with its own timeout).
49	func (r *Recorder) Record(ctx context.Context, e Entry) {
50		if a, ok := auth.ActorFrom(ctx); ok {
51			if e.ActorPartyID == "" {
52				e.ActorPartyID = a.PartyID
53			}
54			if e.ActorRole == "" {
55				e.ActorRole = a.RoleCode
56			}
57		}
58		e.ID = uuid.NewString()
59		e.TS = time.Now().UTC()
60	
61		go func() {
62			writeCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
63			defer cancel()
64			if _, err := r.coll.InsertOne(writeCtx, e); err != nil {
65				r.log.Error("audit write failed", slog.String("action", e.Action), slog.Any("err", err))
66			}
67		}()
68	}
69
```

```text
32	// update — never an account deletion (blueprint §4.1).

42		RevokedAt *time.Time `bson:"revoked_at,omitempty" json:"revoked_at,omitempty"`

47	// UsableAt reports whether the assignment is active and inside its validity
48	// window at instant t.
49	func (ra RoleAssignment) UsableAt(t time.Time) bool {
50		if ra.Status != RoleAssignmentActive {
51			return false
52		}
53		if t.Before(ra.ValidFrom) {
54			return false
55		}
56		if ra.ValidTo != nil && t.After(*ra.ValidTo) {
57			return false
58		}
59		return true
60	}
```

```text
4	
5	// Org-unit types — the cooperative backbone RBAC is scoped to (blueprint §5.1).
6	// FEDERATION → MILK_UNION → {BMC, PROCESSING_PLANT, DCS}.
7	const (
8		OrgTypeFederation      = "FEDERATION"       // PCDF / Parag (state apex, tier 3)
9		OrgTypeMilkUnion       = "MILK_UNION"       // district Sangh (tier 2)
10		OrgTypeProcessingPlant = "PROCESSING_PLANT" // PCDF plant
11		OrgTypeBMC             = "BMC"              // bulk milk cooler / chilling centre
12		OrgTypeDCS             = "DCS"              // village samiti (tier 1)
13	)
14	
15	// AllOrgTypes is the closed set of org-unit types.
16	var AllOrgTypes = []string{
17		OrgTypeFederation, OrgTypeMilkUnion, OrgTypeProcessingPlant, OrgTypeBMC, OrgTypeDCS,
18	}
19	
20	// ValidOrgParent encodes the allowed hierarchy edges.
21	var ValidOrgParent = map[string][]string{
22		OrgTypeFederation:      {},                       // root
23		OrgTypeMilkUnion:       {OrgTypeFederation},      // union under federation
24		OrgTypeProcessingPlant: {OrgTypeMilkUnion, OrgTypeFederation},
25		OrgTypeBMC:             {OrgTypeMilkUnion},
26		OrgTypeDCS:             {OrgTypeMilkUnion, OrgTypeBMC},
27	}
28	
29	// OrgUnit is a node in the cooperative hierarchy. Path holds the IDs of all
30	// ancestors from the root down to (and excluding) this node — kept denormalised
31	// so "is X inside Y's scope" is a single indexed array-containment check, with
32	// no recursive queries on the hot path.
33	type OrgUnit struct {
34		ID        string    `bson:"_id"        json:"id"`
35		Type      string    `bson:"type"       json:"type"`
36		Name      string    `bson:"name"       json:"name"`
37		Code      string    `bson:"code"       json:"code"` // human-readable, e.g. "DCS-01842"
38		ParentID  string    `bson:"parent_id,omitempty"  json:"parent_id,omitempty"`
39		Path      []string  `bson:"path"       json:"path"`
40		District  string    `bson:"district,omitempty"   json:"district,omitempty"`
41		State     string    `bson:"state,omitempty"      json:"state,omitempty"`
42		GeoLat    float64   `bson:"geo_lat,omitempty"    json:"geo_lat,omitempty"`
43		GeoLng    float64   `bson:"geo_lng,omitempty"    json:"geo_lng,omitempty"`
44		Active    bool      `bson:"active"     json:"active"`
45		CreatedAt time.Time `bson:"created_at" json:"created_at"`
46		UpdatedAt time.Time `bson:"updated_at" json:"updated_at"`
47	}
48	
49	// IsValidOrgType reports whether t is a known org-unit type.
50	func IsValidOrgType(t string) bool {
51		for _, v := range AllOrgTypes {
52			if v == t {
53				return true
54			}
55		}
56		return false
57	}
58
```

```text
1	// Package audit writes the immutable who-did-what trail required for
2	// government accountability and DPDP breach forensics (blueprint §12, §16).
3	// Entries are insert-only; the STATE_AUDITOR role reads them via the
4	// platformops module.
5	package audit
6	
7	import (
8		"context"
9		"log/slog"
10		"time"
11	
12		"github.com/google/uuid"
13		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
14	
15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
16	)
17	
18	const collection = "audit_logs"
19	
20	// Entry is one audit record.
21	type Entry struct {
22		ID           string         `bson:"_id"            json:"id"`
23		ActorPartyID string         `bson:"actor_party_id" json:"actor_party_id"`
24		ActorRole    string         `bson:"actor_role,omitempty" json:"actor_role,omitempty"`
25		Action       string         `bson:"action"         json:"action"` // e.g. "http.POST /api/v1/collection/pours" or "support.pii_lookup"
26		TargetType   string         `bson:"target_type,omitempty" json:"target_type,omitempty"`
27		TargetID     string         `bson:"target_id,omitempty"   json:"target_id,omitempty"`
28		Status       int            `bson:"status,omitempty"      json:"status,omitempty"`
29		IP           string         `bson:"ip,omitempty"          json:"ip,omitempty"`
30		RequestID    string         `bson:"request_id,omitempty"  json:"request_id,omitempty"`
31		Meta         map[string]any `bson:"meta,omitempty"        json:"meta,omitempty"`
32		TS           time.Time      `bson:"ts"             json:"ts"`
33	}
34	
35	// Recorder persists audit entries asynchronously so auditing never adds
36	// latency to the request path.
37	type Recorder struct {
38		coll *mongo.Collection
39		log  *slog.Logger
40	}
41	
42	// NewRecorder binds the recorder to the database.
43	func NewRecorder(db *mongo.Database, log *slog.Logger) *Recorder {
44		return &Recorder{coll: db.Collection(collection), log: log}
45	}
46	
47	// Record fills identity fields from the request context and persists the
48	// entry in the background (fire-and-forget with its own timeout).
49	func (r *Recorder) Record(ctx context.Context, e Entry) {
50		if a, ok := auth.ActorFrom(ctx); ok {
51			if e.ActorPartyID == "" {
52				e.ActorPartyID = a.PartyID
53			}
54			if e.ActorRole == "" {
55				e.ActorRole = a.RoleCode
56			}
57		}
58		e.ID = uuid.NewString()
59		e.TS = time.Now().UTC()
60	
61		go func() {
62			writeCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
63			defer cancel()
64			if _, err := r.coll.InsertOne(writeCtx, e); err != nil {
65				r.log.Error("audit write failed", slog.String("action", e.Action), slog.Any("err", err))
66			}
67		}()
68	}
69
```

 `./internal/platform/flags/service.go`

```text
1	// Package flags implements capability gating (blueprint principle #6):
2	// future-scheme features ship dormant behind flags — e.g. collar telemetry —
3	// so a new government scheme is a flag flip, not a schema migration.
4	package flags
5	
6	import (
7		"context"
8		"sync"
9		"time"
10	
11		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
12		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
13		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo/options"
14	)
15	
16	const collection = "feature_flags"
17	
18	// Well-known flag keys.
19	const (
20		FlagCollarTelemetry  = "collar_telemetry_enabled" // dormant until a collar scheme lands (§9)
21		FlagPhotoOCR         = "photo_ocr_enabled"        // legacy-analyzer bridge (§8.2)
22		FlagONDC             = "ondc_enabled"             // optional commerce network (§11)
23		FlagConsumerCommerce = "consumer_commerce_enabled"
24	)
25	
26	// Flag is the stored document.
27	type Flag struct {
28		Key         string    `bson:"_id"         json:"key"`
29		Enabled     bool      `bson:"enabled"     json:"enabled"`
30		Description string    `bson:"description,omitempty" json:"description,omitempty"`
31		UpdatedBy   string    `bson:"updated_by,omitempty"  json:"updated_by,omitempty"`
32		UpdatedAt   time.Time `bson:"updated_at"  json:"updated_at"`
33	}
34	
35	type cached struct {
36		enabled bool
37		at      time.Time
38	}
39	
40	// Service reads flags with a short in-memory cache (hot path: every gated
41	// request) and writes through on change.
42	type Service struct {
43		coll *mongo.Collection
44		ttl  time.Duration
45	
46		mu    sync.RWMutex
47		cache map[string]cached
48	}
49	
50	// NewService binds the flag service to the database.
51	func NewService(db *mongo.Database) *Service {
52		return &Service{
53			coll:  db.Collection(collection),
54			ttl:   30 * time.Second,
55			cache: make(map[string]cached),
56		}
57	}
58	
59	// Enabled returns the flag value (missing flag = false, fail-closed).
60	func (s *Service) Enabled(ctx context.Context, key string) bool {
61		s.mu.RLock()
62		c, ok := s.cache[key]
63		s.mu.RUnlock()
64		if ok && time.Since(c.at) < s.ttl {
65			return c.enabled
66		}
67	
68		var f Flag
69		err := s.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: key}}).Decode(&f)
70		enabled := err == nil && f.Enabled
71	
72		s.mu.Lock()
73		s.cache[key] = cached{enabled: enabled, at: time.Now()}
74		s.mu.Unlock()
75		return enabled
76	}
77	
78	// Set upserts a flag and invalidates the cache entry immediately.
79	func (s *Service) Set(ctx context.Context, key string, enabled bool, updatedBy string) error {
80		_, err := s.coll.UpdateOne(ctx,
81			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: key}},
82			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
83				{Key: "enabled", Value: enabled},
84				{Key: "updated_by", Value: updatedBy},
85				{Key: "updated_at", Value: time.Now().UTC()},
86			}}},
87			options.Update().SetUpsert(true),
88		)
89		if err != nil {
90			return err
91		}
92		s.mu.Lock()
93		s.cache[key] = cached{enabled: enabled, at: time.Now()}
94		s.mu.Unlock()
95		return nil
96	}
97	
98	// All lists every flag (admin console).
99	func (s *Service) All(ctx context.Context) ([]Flag, error) {
100		cur, err := s.coll.Find(ctx, bson.D{})
101		if err != nil {
102			return nil, err
103		}
104		var out []Flag
105		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
106			return nil, err
107		}
108		return out, nil
109	}
110	
111	// EnsureDefaults inserts missing flags without touching existing values.
112	func (s *Service) EnsureDefaults(ctx context.Context, defaults map[string]Flag) error {
113		for key, f := range defaults {
114			f.Key = key
115			if f.UpdatedAt.IsZero() {
116				f.UpdatedAt = time.Now().UTC()
117			}
118			_, err := s.coll.UpdateOne(ctx,
119				bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: key}},
120				bson.D{{Key: "$setOnInsert", Value: f}},
121				options.Update().SetUpsert(true),
122			)
123			if err != nil {
124				return err
125			}
126		}
127		return nil
128	}
129
```

```text
1	// Package orgscope answers the RBAC question "is this resource inside the
2	// caller's organisational scope?" in O(1) DB reads. Org units denormalise
3	// their ancestor chain into Path, so scope checking is a set-membership test
4	// — no recursive tree walks on the hot path.
5	package orgscope
6	
7	import (
8		"context"
9		"errors"
10		"sync"
11		"time"
12	
13		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
14		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
15	
16		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
17		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
18		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
19	)
20	
21	const collection = "org_units"
22	
23	type cachedOrg struct {
24		org domain.OrgUnit
25		at  time.Time
26	}
27	
28	// Resolver caches org units briefly (the tree changes rarely, reads are hot).
29	type Resolver struct {
30		coll *mongo.Collection
31		ttl  time.Duration
32	
33		mu    sync.RWMutex
34		cache map[string]cachedOrg
35	}
36	
37	// NewResolver binds the resolver to the database.
38	func NewResolver(db *mongo.Database) *Resolver {
39		return &Resolver{
40			coll:  db.Collection(collection),
41			ttl:   60 * time.Second,
42			cache: make(map[string]cachedOrg),
43		}
44	}
45	
46	// Get returns an org unit by ID (cached).
47	func (r *Resolver) Get(ctx context.Context, id string) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
48		r.mu.RLock()
49		c, ok := r.cache[id]
50		r.mu.RUnlock()
51		if ok && time.Since(c.at) < r.ttl {
52			org := c.org
53			return &org, nil
54		}
55	
56		var org domain.OrgUnit
57		err := r.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&org)
58		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
59			return nil, httpx.NotFound("org unit " + id)
60		}
61		if err != nil {
62			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
63		}
64	
65		r.mu.Lock()
66		r.cache[id] = cachedOrg{org: org, at: time.Now()}
67		r.mu.Unlock()
68		return &org, nil
69	}
70	
71	// Invalidate drops a cached entry (call after updates).
72	func (r *Resolver) Invalidate(id string) {
73		r.mu.Lock()
74		delete(r.cache, id)
75		r.mu.Unlock()
76	}
77	
78	// InScope reports whether target sits at-or-below scope in the hierarchy:
79	// true when scope == target, or scope appears in target's ancestor Path.
80	func (r *Resolver) InScope(ctx context.Context, scopeOrgID, targetOrgID string) (bool, error) {
81		if scopeOrgID == targetOrgID {
82			return true, nil
83		}
84		target, err := r.Get(ctx, targetOrgID)
85		if err != nil {
86			return false, err
87		}
88		for _, ancestor := range target.Path {
89			if ancestor == scopeOrgID {
90				return true, nil
91			}
92		}
93		return false, nil
94	}
95	
96	// RequireInScope enforces the actor's org scope over a target org unit.
97	// SUPER_ADMIN and STATE_AUDITOR (read-wide roles rooted at the federation)
98	// pass automatically; everyone else needs ancestry.
99	func (r *Resolver) RequireInScope(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, targetOrgID string) error {
100		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSuperAdmin || actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleStateAuditor {
101			return nil
102		}
103		if actor.OrgUnitID == "" {
104			return httpx.Forbidden("role token with org scope required")
105		}
106		ok, err := r.InScope(ctx, actor.OrgUnitID, targetOrgID)
107		if err != nil {
108			return err
109		}
110		if !ok {
111			return httpx.Forbidden("resource is outside your organisational scope")
112		}
113		return nil
114	}
115
```
</details></tool-use>

```text
1	package domain
2	
3	import (
4		"fmt"
5		"time"
6	)
7	
8	// FSSAI limits for liquid milk (blueprint §8.3). Aflatoxin M1 is heat-stable
9	// and survives pasteurisation, so it MUST be gated upstream (BMC + plant),
10	// never only at the finished product.
11	const (
12		FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg = 0.5  // AFM1 ≤ 0.5 µg/kg
13		FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl          = 10.0 // coliform ≤ 10 CFU/ml
14		FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg       = 0.1  // antibiotic MRL example
15	)
16	
17	// QC test names.
18	const (
19		TestAflatoxinM1  = "AFLATOXIN_M1"           // µg/kg
20		TestColiform     = "COLIFORM"               // CFU/ml
21		TestTPC          = "TPC"                    // CFU/ml, graded — recorded, not hard-gated here
22		TestAntibiotic   = "ANTIBIOTIC_TETRACYCLINE" // mg/kg
23		TestPhosphatase  = "PHOSPHATASE"            // 0 = negative (pass post-pasteurisation), 1 = positive
24		TestFat          = "FAT"                    // %
25		TestSNF          = "SNF"                    // %
26	)
27	
28	// QC stages.
29	const (
30		QCStageBMCRapid = "BMC_RAPID" // strip/rapid tests at the chilling centre
31		QCStagePlantLab = "PLANT_LAB" // full lab: ELISA/HPLC, culture, LC-MS/MS
32	)
33	
34	// QC subject types.
35	const (
36		QCSubjectDCSConsignment  = "DCS_CONSIGNMENT"
37		QCSubjectBMCLot          = "BMC_LOT"
38		QCSubjectProcessingBatch = "PROCESSING_BATCH"
39	)
40	
41	// QCTest is a single measurement inside a QC result.
42	type QCTest struct {
43		Name  string  `bson:"name"  json:"name"`
44		Value float64 `bson:"value" json:"value"`
45		Unit  string  `bson:"unit"  json:"unit"`
46		Pass  bool    `bson:"pass"  json:"pass"`
47	}
48	
49	// QCResult is the recorded outcome of testing one subject at one stage.
50	// OverallPass drives the safety gate; a certificate is attached to provenance
51	// on pass, a block + quarantine on fail.
52	type QCResult struct {
53		ID                string    `bson:"_id"          json:"id"`
54		SubjectType       string    `bson:"subject_type" json:"subject_type"`
55		SubjectID         string    `bson:"subject_id"   json:"subject_id"`
56		Stage             string    `bson:"stage"        json:"stage"`
57		Tests             []QCTest  `bson:"tests"        json:"tests"`
58		OverallPass       bool      `bson:"overall_pass" json:"overall_pass"`
59		FailureReasons    []string  `bson:"failure_reasons,omitempty" json:"failure_reasons,omitempty"`
60		AnalystPartyID    string    `bson:"analyst_party_id" json:"analyst_party_id"`
61		LabRef            string    `bson:"lab_ref,omitempty"            json:"lab_ref,omitempty"`
62		CertificateNumber string    `bson:"certificate_number,omitempty" json:"certificate_number,omitempty"`
63		RecordedAt        time.Time `bson:"recorded_at"  json:"recorded_at"`
64		ProvenanceSeq     int64     `bson:"provenance_seq,omitempty" json:"provenance_seq,omitempty"`
65	}
66	
67	// EvaluateQCTests applies the FSSAI gate to a set of tests: it fills each
68	// test's Pass verdict and returns the overall verdict plus human-readable
69	// failure reasons. Unknown test names are recorded but do not gate.
70	func EvaluateQCTests(tests []QCTest) (overallPass bool, failures []string, evaluated []QCTest) {
71		overallPass = true
72		evaluated = make([]QCTest, 0, len(tests))
73		for _, t := range tests {
74			pass := true
75			switch t.Name {
76			case TestAflatoxinM1:
77				if t.Value > FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg {
78					pass = false
79					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
80						"AFLATOXIN_M1 %.3f µg/kg exceeds FSSAI limit %.1f µg/kg", t.Value, FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg))
81				}
82			case TestColiform:
83				if t.Value > FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl {
84					pass = false
85					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
86						"COLIFORM %.1f CFU/ml exceeds FSSAI limit %.0f CFU/ml", t.Value, FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl))
87				}
88			case TestAntibiotic:
89				if t.Value > FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg {
90					pass = false
91					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
92						"ANTIBIOTIC_TETRACYCLINE %.3f mg/kg exceeds MRL %.1f mg/kg", t.Value, FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg))
93				}
94			case TestPhosphatase:
95				if t.Value != 0 {
96					pass = false
97					failures = append(failures, "PHOSPHATASE positive — pasteurisation check failed (must be negative)")
98				}
99			}
100			t.Pass = pass
101			if !pass {
102				overallPass = false
103			}
104			evaluated = append(evaluated, t)
105		}
106		return overallPass, failures, evaluated
107	}
108
```

```text
27		TargetID     string         `bson:"target_id,omitempty"   json:"target_id,omitempty"`
28		Status       int            `bson:"status,omitempty"      json:"status,omitempty"`
29		IP           string         `bson:"ip,omitempty"          json:"ip,omitempty"`
30		RequestID    string         `bson:"request_id,omitempty"  json:"request_id,omitempty"`
31		Meta         map[string]any `bson:"meta,omitempty"        json:"meta,omitempty"`
32		TS           time.Time      `bson:"ts"             json:"ts"`
33	}
34	
35	// Recorder persists audit entries asynchronously so auditing never adds
36	// latency to the request path.
37	type Recorder struct {
38		coll *mongo.Collection
39		log  *slog.Logger
40	}
41	
42	// NewRecorder binds the recorder to the database.
43	func NewRecorder(db *mongo.Database, log *slog.Logger) *Recorder {
44		return &Recorder{coll: db.Collection(collection), log: log}
45	}
46	
47	// Record fills identity fields from the request context and persists the
48	// entry in the background (fire-and-forget with its own timeout).
49	func (r *Recorder) Record(ctx context.Context, e Entry) {
50		if a, ok := auth.ActorFrom(ctx); ok {
51			if e.ActorPartyID == "" {
52				e.ActorPartyID = a.PartyID
53			}
54			if e.ActorRole == "" {
55				e.ActorRole = a.RoleCode
56			}
57		}
58		e.ID = uuid.NewString()
59		e.TS = time.Now().UTC()
60	
61		go func() {
62			writeCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
63			defer cancel()
64			if _, err := r.coll.InsertOne(writeCtx, e); err != nil {
65				r.log.Error("audit write failed", slog.String("action", e.Action), slog.Any("err", err))
66			}
67		}()
68	}
69
```

```text
1	// Package httpapi assembles the HTTP surface: global middleware, operational
2	// endpoints (health/readiness/metrics/version), and the /api/v1 tree where
3	// every domain module mounts its routes.
4	package httpapi
5	
6	import (
7		"context"
8		"net/http"
9		"time"
10	
11		"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
12		chimw "github.com/go-chi/chi/v5/middleware"
13		"github.com/prometheus/client_golang/prometheus/promhttp"
14	
15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
16		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
17		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/middleware"
18	)
19	
20	// Version is stamped via -ldflags at release build time.
21	var Version = "0.1.0-dev"
22	
23	// New builds the fully wired HTTP handler.
24	func New(d *deps.Deps) http.Handler {
25		r := chi.NewRouter()
26	
27		// Order matters: recover innermost-last so panics in anything above are caught.
28		r.Use(chimw.RequestID)
29		r.Use(chimw.RealIP)
30		r.Use(middleware.Metrics)
31		r.Use(middleware.PerIPRateLimit(d.Cfg.RateLimitRPS, d.Cfg.RateLimitBurst))
32		r.Use(chimw.Recoverer)
33		r.Use(chimw.Timeout(30 * time.Second))
34	
35		// Operational endpoints — outside /api/v1, never authenticated.
36		r.Get("/healthz", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
37			httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{"status": "ok"})
38		})
39		r.Get("/readyz", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
40			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 2*time.Second)
41			defer cancel()
42			if err := d.DB.Client().Ping(ctx, nil); err != nil {
43				httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Internal(err))
44				return
45			}
46			httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{"status": "ready"})
47		})
48		r.Handle("/metrics", promhttp.Handler())
49		r.Get("/version", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
50			httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{"version": Version, "service": "saathi-backend"})
51		})
52	
53		r.Route("/api/v1", func(api chi.Router) {
54			api.Use(middleware.AuditMutations(d.Audit))
55			RegisterModules(api, d)
56		})
57	
58		return r
59	}
60
```

```text
1	package domain
2	
3	import (
4		"fmt"
5		"time"
6	)
7	
8	// FSSAI limits for liquid milk (blueprint §8.3). Aflatoxin M1 is heat-stable
9	// and survives pasteurisation, so it MUST be gated upstream (BMC + plant),
10	// never only at the finished product.
11	const (
12		FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg = 0.5  // AFM1 ≤ 0.5 µg/kg
13		FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl          = 10.0 // coliform ≤ 10 CFU/ml
14		FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg       = 0.1  // antibiotic MRL example
15	)
16	
17	// QC test names.
18	const (
19		TestAflatoxinM1  = "AFLATOXIN_M1"           // µg/kg
20		TestColiform     = "COLIFORM"               // CFU/ml
21		TestTPC          = "TPC"                    // CFU/ml, graded — recorded, not hard-gated here
22		TestAntibiotic   = "ANTIBIOTIC_TETRACYCLINE" // mg/kg
23		TestPhosphatase  = "PHOSPHATASE"            // 0 = negative (pass post-pasteurisation), 1 = positive
24		TestFat          = "FAT"                    // %
25		TestSNF          = "SNF"                    // %
26	)
27	
28	// QC stages.
29	const (
30		QCStageBMCRapid = "BMC_RAPID" // strip/rapid tests at the chilling centre
31		QCStagePlantLab = "PLANT_LAB" // full lab: ELISA/HPLC, culture, LC-MS/MS
32	)
33	
34	// QC subject types.
35	const (
36		QCSubjectDCSConsignment  = "DCS_CONSIGNMENT"
37		QCSubjectBMCLot          = "BMC_LOT"
38		QCSubjectProcessingBatch = "PROCESSING_BATCH"
39	)
40	
41	// QCTest is a single measurement inside a QC result.
42	type QCTest struct {
43		Name  string  `bson:"name"  json:"name"`
44		Value float64 `bson:"value" json:"value"`
45		Unit  string  `bson:"unit"  json:"unit"`
46		Pass  bool    `bson:"pass"  json:"pass"`
47	}
48	
49	// QCResult is the recorded outcome of testing one subject at one stage.
50	// OverallPass drives the safety gate; a certificate is attached to provenance
51	// on pass, a block + quarantine on fail.
52	type QCResult struct {
53		ID                string    `bson:"_id"          json:"id"`
54		SubjectType       string    `bson:"subject_type" json:"subject_type"`
55		SubjectID         string    `bson:"subject_id"   json:"subject_id"`
56		Stage             string    `bson:"stage"        json:"stage"`
57		Tests             []QCTest  `bson:"tests"        json:"tests"`
58		OverallPass       bool      `bson:"overall_pass" json:"overall_pass"`
59		FailureReasons    []string  `bson:"failure_reasons,omitempty" json:"failure_reasons,omitempty"`
60		AnalystPartyID    string    `bson:"analyst_party_id" json:"analyst_party_id"`
61		LabRef            string    `bson:"lab_ref,omitempty"            json:"lab_ref,omitempty"`
62		CertificateNumber string    `bson:"certificate_number,omitempty" json:"certificate_number,omitempty"`
63		RecordedAt        time.Time `bson:"recorded_at"  json:"recorded_at"`
64		ProvenanceSeq     int64     `bson:"provenance_seq,omitempty" json:"provenance_seq,omitempty"`
65	}
66	
67	// EvaluateQCTests applies the FSSAI gate to a set of tests: it fills each
68	// test's Pass verdict and returns the overall verdict plus human-readable
69	// failure reasons. Unknown test names are recorded but do not gate.
70	func EvaluateQCTests(tests []QCTest) (overallPass bool, failures []string, evaluated []QCTest) {
71		overallPass = true
72		evaluated = make([]QCTest, 0, len(tests))
73		for _, t := range tests {
74			pass := true
75			switch t.Name {
76			case TestAflatoxinM1:
77				if t.Value > FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg {
78					pass = false
79					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
80						"AFLATOXIN_M1 %.3f µg/kg exceeds FSSAI limit %.1f µg/kg", t.Value, FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg))
81				}
82			case TestColiform:
83				if t.Value > FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl {
84					pass = false
85					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
86						"COLIFORM %.1f CFU/ml exceeds FSSAI limit %.0f CFU/ml", t.Value, FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl))
87				}
88			case TestAntibiotic:
89				if t.Value > FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg {
90					pass = false
91					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
92						"ANTIBIOTIC_TETRACYCLINE %.3f mg/kg exceeds MRL %.1f mg/kg", t.Value, FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg))
93				}
94			case TestPhosphatase:
95				if t.Value != 0 {
96					pass = false
97					failures = append(failures, "PHOSPHATASE positive — pasteurisation check failed (must be negative)")
98				}
99			}
100			t.Pass = pass
101			if !pass {
102				overallPass = false
103			}
104			evaluated = append(evaluated, t)
105		}
106		return overallPass, failures, evaluated
107	}
108
```

```text
12		OrgTypeDCS             = "DCS"              // village samiti (tier 1)
13	)
14	
15	// AllOrgTypes is the closed set of org-unit types.

18	}
19	
20	// ValidOrgParent encodes the allowed hierarchy edges.
21	var ValidOrgParent = map[string][]string{

23		OrgTypeMilkUnion:       {OrgTypeFederation},      // union under federation
24		OrgTypeProcessingPlant: {OrgTypeMilkUnion, OrgTypeFederation},
25		OrgTypeBMC:             {OrgTypeMilkUnion},
26		OrgTypeDCS:             {OrgTypeMilkUnion, OrgTypeBMC},
27	}
28	
29	// OrgUnit is a node in the cooperative hierarchy. Path holds the IDs of all
30	// ancestors from the root down to (and excluding) this node — kept denormalised
31	// so "is X inside Y's scope" is a single indexed array-containment check, with
32	// no recursive queries on the hot path.
33	type OrgUnit struct {
34		ID        string    `bson:"_id"        json:"id"`

36		Name      string    `bson:"name"       json:"name"`

38		ParentID  string    `bson:"parent_id,omitempty"  json:"parent_id,omitempty"`
39		Path      []string  `bson:"path"       json:"path"`
40		District  string    `bson:"district,omitempty"   json:"district,omitempty"`
41		State     string    `bson:"state,omitempty"      json:"state,omitempty"`
42		GeoLat    float64   `bson:"geo_lat,omitempty"    json:"geo_lat,omitempty"`
43		GeoLng    float64   `bson:"geo_lng,omitempty"    json:"geo_lng,omitempty"`
44		Active    bool      `bson:"active"     json:"active"`
45		CreatedAt time.Time `bson:"created_at" json:"created_at"`
46		UpdatedAt time.Time `bson:"updated_at" json:"updated_at"`
47	}
48	
49	// IsValidOrgType reports whether t is a known org-unit type.
50	func IsValidOrgType(t string) bool {
51		for _, v := range AllOrgTypes {
52			if v == t {
53				return true
54			}
55		}
56		return false
57	}
```

```text
1	// Package config loads all runtime configuration from the environment.
2	// A local `.env` file is read first (dev convenience, never committed);
3	// real environment variables always win. There are NO in-code connection
4	// strings: the server refuses to boot without MONGO_URI.
5	package config
6	
7	import (
8		"bufio"
9		"fmt"
10		"os"
11		"strconv"
12		"strings"
13		"time"
14	)
15	
16	// Config is the fully resolved runtime configuration.
17	type Config struct {
18		Env      string // dev | prod
19		Port     int
20		LogLevel string
21	
22		MongoURI string
23		MongoDB  string
24	
25		JWTSecret       string
26		QRSigningSecret string
27		OTPHashSecret   string
28	
29		AccessTokenTTL  time.Duration
30		RefreshTokenTTL time.Duration
31		OTPTTL          time.Duration
32		OTPDevMode      bool // true → OTP echoed in API response instead of SMS (dev only)
33	
34		RateLimitRPS   float64
35		RateLimitBurst int
36	
37		SeedAdminPhone string
38	}
39	
40	// IsProd reports whether the server runs with production hardening.
41	func (c *Config) IsProd() bool { return c.Env == "prod" }
42	
43	// Load reads `.env` (if present) then the process environment, validates the
44	// result, and returns the Config. Missing MONGO_URI is a hard error.
45	func Load() (*Config, error) {
46		loadDotEnv(".env")
47	
48		cfg := &Config{
49			Env:             envStr("ENV", "dev"),
50			Port:            envInt("PORT", 8080),
51			LogLevel:        envStr("LOG_LEVEL", "info"),
52			MongoURI:        os.Getenv("MONGO_URI"),
53			MongoDB:         envStr("MONGO_DB", "saathi"),
54			JWTSecret:       envStr("JWT_SECRET", ""),
55			QRSigningSecret: envStr("QR_SIGNING_SECRET", ""),
56			OTPHashSecret:   envStr("OTP_HASH_SECRET", ""),
57			AccessTokenTTL:  time.Duration(envInt("ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES", 15)) * time.Minute,
58			RefreshTokenTTL: time.Duration(envInt("REFRESH_TOKEN_TTL_DAYS", 30)) * 24 * time.Hour,
59			OTPTTL:          time.Duration(envInt("OTP_TTL_MINUTES", 5)) * time.Minute,
60			OTPDevMode:      envBool("OTP_DEV_MODE", false),
61			RateLimitRPS:    envFloat("RATE_LIMIT_RPS", 50),
62			RateLimitBurst:  envInt("RATE_LIMIT_BURST", 100),
63			SeedAdminPhone:  envStr("SEED_ADMIN_PHONE", "9999999999"),
64		}
65	
66		if cfg.MongoURI == "" {
67			return nil, fmt.Errorf("MONGO_URI is required and must be set via environment (no in-code default); see .env.example")
68		}
69		if cfg.JWTSecret == "" {
70			return nil, fmt.Errorf("JWT_SECRET is required; see .env.example")
71		}
72		if cfg.QRSigningSecret == "" {
73			cfg.QRSigningSecret = cfg.JWTSecret + ":qr" // derived fallback for dev only
74		}
75		if cfg.OTPHashSecret == "" {
76			cfg.OTPHashSecret = cfg.JWTSecret + ":otp"
77		}
78	
79		if cfg.IsProd() {
80			if strings.Contains(cfg.JWTSecret, "dev-only") {
81				return nil, fmt.Errorf("refusing to start in prod with a dev-only JWT_SECRET")
82			}
83			if cfg.OTPDevMode {
84				return nil, fmt.Errorf("refusing to start in prod with OTP_DEV_MODE=true (OTPs would leak in API responses)")
85			}
86		}
87		return cfg, nil
88	}
89	
90	// loadDotEnv parses KEY=VALUE lines from path into the process environment,
91	// without overriding variables that are already set.
92	func loadDotEnv(path string) {
93		f, err := os.Open(path)
94		if err != nil {
95			return // optional file
96		}
97		defer f.Close()
98	
99		sc := bufio.NewScanner(f)
100		for sc.Scan() {
101			line := strings.TrimSpace(sc.Text())
102			if line == "" || strings.HasPrefix(line, "#") {
103				continue
104			}
105			key, val, ok := strings.Cut(line, "=")
106			if !ok {
107				continue
108			}
109			key = strings.TrimSpace(key)
110			val = strings.TrimSpace(val)
111			val = strings.Trim(val, `"'`)
112			if key != "" && os.Getenv(key) == "" {
113				os.Setenv(key, val)
114			}
115		}
116	}
117	
118	func envStr(key, def string) string {
119		if v := os.Getenv(key); v != "" {
120			return v
121		}
122		return def
123	}
124	
125	func envInt(key string, def int) int {
126		if v := os.Getenv(key); v != "" {
127			if n, err := strconv.Atoi(v); err == nil {
128				return n
129			}
130		}
131		return def
132	}
133	
134	func envFloat(key string, def float64) float64 {
135		if v := os.Getenv(key); v != "" {
136			if f, err := strconv.ParseFloat(v, 64); err == nil {
137				return f
138			}
139		}
140		return def
141	}
142	
143	func envBool(key string, def bool) bool {
144		if v := os.Getenv(key); v != "" {
145			if b, err := strconv.ParseBool(v); err == nil {
146				return b
147			}
148		}
149		return def
150	}
151
```

```text
1	// Package eventbus is the in-process pub/sub seam between modules
2	// (e.g. settlement executed → notifications module queues the SMS).
3	// It deliberately mirrors a message-broker API: when the platform splits
4	// into microservices, this interface is re-implemented over Kafka/NATS
5	// (blueprint §15) without touching module code.
6	package eventbus
7	
8	import (
9		"context"
10		"log/slog"
11		"sync"
12		"time"
13	)
14	
15	// Topics published across module seams.
16	const (
17		TopicPourRecorded       = "pour.recorded"
18		TopicInvoiceIssued      = "invoice.issued"
19		TopicGateBlocked        = "qc.gate_blocked"
20		TopicSettlementExecuted = "settlement.executed"
21		TopicPayoutCredited     = "payout.credited"
22		TopicMVUDispatched      = "mvu.dispatched"
23	)
24	
25	// Handler consumes a published event. Payload types are documented per topic
26	// by the publishing module.
27	type Handler func(ctx context.Context, topic string, payload any)
28	
29	// Bus is a minimal async pub/sub.
30	type Bus struct {
31		log *slog.Logger
32	
33		mu   sync.RWMutex
34		subs map[string][]Handler
35	}
36	
37	// New builds an empty bus.
38	func New(log *slog.Logger) *Bus {
39		return &Bus{log: log, subs: make(map[string][]Handler)}
40	}
41	
42	// Subscribe registers a handler for a topic. Call during module wiring only
43	// (not concurrently with Publish traffic).
44	func (b *Bus) Subscribe(topic string, h Handler) {
45		b.mu.Lock()
46		defer b.mu.Unlock()
47		b.subs[topic] = append(b.subs[topic], h)
48	}
49	
50	// Publish dispatches asynchronously: each handler runs on its own goroutine
51	// with a bounded context and panic isolation, so a slow or broken subscriber
52	// can never stall the request path.
53	func (b *Bus) Publish(topic string, payload any) {
54		b.mu.RLock()
55		handlers := b.subs[topic]
56		b.mu.RUnlock()
57	
58		for _, h := range handlers {
59			h := h
60			go func() {
61				ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 15*time.Second)
62				defer cancel()
63				defer func() {
64					if rec := recover(); rec != nil {
65						b.log.Error("eventbus handler panic",
66							slog.String("topic", topic), slog.Any("panic", rec))
67					}
68				}()
69				h(ctx, topic, payload)
70			}()
71		}
72	}
73
```
</details></tool-use>

```text
2	// government accountability and DPDP breach forensics (blueprint §12, §16).
3	// Entries are insert-only; the STATE_AUDITOR role reads them via the
4	// platformops module.
5	package audit
6	
7	import (
8		"context"
9		"log/slog"
10		"time"
11	
12		"github.com/google/uuid"
13		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
14	
15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
16	)
17	
18	const collection = "audit_logs"
19	
20	// Entry is one audit record.
21	type Entry struct {
22		ID           string         `bson:"_id"            json:"id"`
23		ActorPartyID string         `bson:"actor_party_id" json:"actor_party_id"`
24		ActorRole    string         `bson:"actor_role,omitempty" json:"actor_role,omitempty"`
25		Action       string         `bson:"action"         json:"action"` // e.g. "http.POST /api/v1/collection/pours" or "support.pii_lookup"
26		TargetType   string         `bson:"target_type,omitempty" json:"target_type,omitempty"`
27		TargetID     string         `bson:"target_id,omitempty"   json:"target_id,omitempty"`
28		Status       int            `bson:"status,omitempty"      json:"status,omitempty"`
29		IP           string         `bson:"ip,omitempty"          json:"ip,omitempty"`
30		RequestID    string         `bson:"request_id,omitempty"  json:"request_id,omitempty"`
31		Meta         map[string]any `bson:"meta,omitempty"        json:"meta,omitempty"`
32		TS           time.Time      `bson:"ts"             json:"ts"`
33	}
34	
35	// Recorder persists audit entries asynchronously so auditing never adds
36	// latency to the request path.
37	type Recorder struct {
38		coll *mongo.Collection
39		log  *slog.Logger
40	}
41	
42	// NewRecorder binds the recorder to the database.
43	func NewRecorder(db *mongo.Database, log *slog.Logger) *Recorder {
44		return &Recorder{coll: db.Collection(collection), log: log}
45	}
46	
47	// Record fills identity fields from the request context and persists the
48	// entry in the background (fire-and-forget with its own timeout).
49	func (r *Recorder) Record(ctx context.Context, e Entry) {
50		if a, ok := auth.ActorFrom(ctx); ok {
51			if e.ActorPartyID == "" {
52				e.ActorPartyID = a.PartyID
53			}
54			if e.ActorRole == "" {
55				e.ActorRole = a.RoleCode
56			}
57		}
58		e.ID = uuid.NewString()
59		e.TS = time.Now().UTC()
60	
61		go func() {
62			writeCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
63			defer cancel()
64			if _, err := r.coll.InsertOne(writeCtx, e); err != nil {
65				r.log.Error("audit write failed", slog.String("action", e.Action), slog.Any("err", err))
66			}
67		}()
68	}
69
```

```text
1	// Package eventbus is the in-process pub/sub seam between modules
2	// (e.g. settlement executed → notifications module queues the SMS).
3	// It deliberately mirrors a message-broker API: when the platform splits
4	// into microservices, this interface is re-implemented over Kafka/NATS
5	// (blueprint §15) without touching module code.
6	package eventbus
7	
8	import (
9		"context"
10		"log/slog"
11		"sync"
12		"time"
13	)
14	
15	// Topics published across module seams.
16	const (
17		TopicPourRecorded       = "pour.recorded"
18		TopicInvoiceIssued      = "invoice.issued"
19		TopicGateBlocked        = "qc.gate_blocked"
20		TopicSettlementExecuted = "settlement.executed"
21		TopicPayoutCredited     = "payout.credited"
22		TopicMVUDispatched      = "mvu.dispatched"
23	)
24	
25	// Handler consumes a published event. Payload types are documented per topic
26	// by the publishing module.
27	type Handler func(ctx context.Context, topic string, payload any)
28	
29	// Bus is a minimal async pub/sub.
30	type Bus struct {
31		log *slog.Logger
32	
33		mu   sync.RWMutex
34		subs map[string][]Handler
35	}
36	
37	// New builds an empty bus.
38	func New(log *slog.Logger) *Bus {
39		return &Bus{log: log, subs: make(map[string][]Handler)}
40	}
41	
42	// Subscribe registers a handler for a topic. Call during module wiring only
43	// (not concurrently with Publish traffic).
44	func (b *Bus) Subscribe(topic string, h Handler) {
45		b.mu.Lock()
46		defer b.mu.Unlock()
47		b.subs[topic] = append(b.subs[topic], h)
48	}
49	
50	// Publish dispatches asynchronously: each handler runs on its own goroutine
51	// with a bounded context and panic isolation, so a slow or broken subscriber
52	// can never stall the request path.
53	func (b *Bus) Publish(topic string, payload any) {
54		b.mu.RLock()
55		handlers := b.subs[topic]
56		b.mu.RUnlock()
57	
58		for _, h := range handlers {
59			h := h
60			go func() {
61				ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 15*time.Second)
62				defer cancel()
63				defer func() {
64					if rec := recover(); rec != nil {
65						b.log.Error("eventbus handler panic",
66							slog.String("topic", topic), slog.Any("panic", rec))
67					}
68				}()
69				h(ctx, topic, payload)
70			}()
71		}
72	}
73
```

```text
92	// CheckPlausibility validates fat/SNF/qty against physical bounds and returns
93	// the violated flags (empty slice = plausible).
94	func CheckPlausibility(fatPct, snfPct, qtyLitres float64) []string {
95		var flags []string
96		if fatPct < PlausibleFatMin || fatPct > PlausibleFatMax ||
97			snfPct < PlausibleSNFMin || snfPct > PlausibleSNFMax {
98			flags = append(flags, IntegrityFlagImplausibleValue)
99		}
100		if qtyLitres != 0 && (qtyLitres < PlausibleQtyMin || qtyLitres > PlausibleQtyMax) {
101			flags = append(flags, IntegrityFlagImplausibleValue)
102		}
103		return flags
104	}
```

```text
1	// Package provenance implements the append-only, hash-chained event ledger —
2	// the source of truth for milk traceability (blueprint §7). Every link in the
3	// pour→QR chain is an immutable Event whose SHA-256 hash covers the previous
4	// event's hash, so history cannot be quietly rewritten (tamper-evidence,
5	// FSSAI recall-grade audit).
6	//
7	// Corrections are NEW events referencing the superseded entity — nothing is
8	// ever updated or deleted in this collection.
9	package provenance
10	
11	import (
12		"context"
13		"crypto/sha256"
14		"encoding/hex"
15		"encoding/json"
16		"errors"
17		"fmt"
18		"strconv"
19		"strings"
20		"time"
21

23		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
24		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
25		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo/options"
26	)
27	
28	const collection = "provenance_events"
29	
30	// Ref is a directed edge to another entity in the trace graph
31	// (e.g. a consignment event referencing the pours it aggregates).
32	type Ref struct {
33		EntityType string `bson:"entity_type" json:"entity_type"`
34		EntityID   string `bson:"entity_id"   json:"entity_id"`
35		Relation   string `bson:"relation"    json:"relation"` // aggregates | supersedes | tested | yields | labels ...
36	}
37	
38	// ActorRef records who caused the event.
39	type ActorRef struct {
40		PartyID  string `bson:"party_id"  json:"party_id"`
41		RoleCode string `bson:"role_code" json:"role_code"`
42	}
43	
44	// Event is one immutable link in the ledger.
45	type Event struct {
46		ID         string         `bson:"_id"         json:"id"`
47		Seq        int64          `bson:"seq"         json:"seq"`
48		Type       string         `bson:"type"        json:"type"`
49		EntityType string         `bson:"entity_type" json:"entity_type"`
50		EntityID   string         `bson:"entity_id"   json:"entity_id"`
51		Refs       []Ref          `bson:"refs,omitempty"    json:"refs,omitempty"`
52		Actor      ActorRef       `bson:"actor"       json:"actor"`
53		OrgUnitID  string         `bson:"org_unit_id,omitempty" json:"org_unit_id,omitempty"`
54		Payload    map[string]any `bson:"payload,omitempty"     json:"payload,omitempty"`
55		TS         time.Time      `bson:"ts"          json:"ts"`
56		PrevHash   string         `bson:"prev_hash"   json:"prev_hash"`

58	}
```

```text
1	// Package httpapi assembles the HTTP surface: global middleware, operational
2	// endpoints (health/readiness/metrics/version), and the /api/v1 tree where
3	// every domain module mounts its routes.
4	package httpapi
5	
6	import (
7		"context"
8		"net/http"
9		"time"
10	
11		"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
12		chimw "github.com/go-chi/chi/v5/middleware"
13		"github.com/prometheus/client_golang/prometheus/promhttp"
14	
15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
16		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
17		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/middleware"
18	)
19	
20	// Version is stamped via -ldflags at release build time.
21	var Version = "0.1.0-dev"
22	
23	// New builds the fully wired HTTP handler.
24	func New(d *deps.Deps) http.Handler {
25		r := chi.NewRouter()
26	
27		// Order matters: recover innermost-last so panics in anything above are caught.
28		r.Use(chimw.RequestID)
29		r.Use(chimw.RealIP)
30		r.Use(middleware.Metrics)
31		r.Use(middleware.PerIPRateLimit(d.Cfg.RateLimitRPS, d.Cfg.RateLimitBurst))
32		r.Use(chimw.Recoverer)
33		r.Use(chimw.Timeout(30 * time.Second))
34	
35		// Operational endpoints — outside /api/v1, never authenticated.
36		r.Get("/healthz", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
37			httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{"status": "ok"})
38		})
39		r.Get("/readyz", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
40			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 2*time.Second)
41			defer cancel()
42			if err := d.DB.Client().Ping(ctx, nil); err != nil {
43				httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Internal(err))
44				return
45			}
46			httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{"status": "ready"})
47		})
48		r.Handle("/metrics", promhttp.Handler())
49		r.Get("/version", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
50			httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{"version": Version, "service": "saathi-backend"})
51		})
52	
53		r.Route("/api/v1", func(api chi.Router) {
54			api.Use(middleware.AuditMutations(d.Audit))
55			RegisterModules(api, d)
56		})
57	
58		return r
59	}
```

````md
# Saathi Backend — Technical Notes & Handoff

> **Audience:** the next engineer or LLM working on this repo. Read this file plus
> `SAATHI_Architecture_Framework_Parag.pdf` (the blueprint, source of truth) and you have the
> complete picture. Blueprint section references look like (§8.3).
>
> **Status:** P0 + P1 implemented end-to-end (identity → pour → invoice → logistics → safety
> gate → batch → QR → public trace → settlement), with P2 foundations (cattle/health, MVU,
> education, dormant collar path). Consumer commerce is **deliberately descoped** (dormant flag).

---

## 1. Stack & system design decision

| Decision | Choice | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Language | **Go 1.23+** | memory-safe/typed per §15; single static binary; trivial horizontal scaling for 1cr+ users |
| Database | **MongoDB** (env-configured URI only) | team decision; normalized ("scattered") collections with ID references, not embedded blobs |
| Architecture | **Modular monolith** with hard module seams | §6 prescribes event-driven microservices as end-state; at greenfield stage one deployable with 10 isolated modules + an in-process event bus gives the same boundaries with none of the ops tax. Each module = one future microservice. |
| HTTP | chi router, REST JSON under `/api/v1` | frontend lives in a separate repo; this is a pure API |
| Events | in-process pub/sub (`internal/platform/eventbus`) | mirrors a broker API; swap to Kafka/NATS (§15) without touching module code |
| Provenance | **hash-chained append-only event ledger in MongoDB** (§7.3 "ledger-style" option) | tamper-evident without running a graph DB; graph traversal implemented over `refs` edges; can be projected to Neo4j later |
| IDs | **UUID strings**, not ObjectIDs | offline-first devices (§3.1) must mint IDs locally with zero coordination; string IDs also travel cleanly through JSON. References still work exactly like ObjectID refs (`farmer_party_id`, `dcs_id`, …) |

### Scaling posture (1cr+ users)
- Stateless server → run N replicas behind a gateway/LB; per-IP rate limiting is per-replica by
  design (global fairness belongs to the WAF/gateway tier, §6).
- Every hot query path has a compound index (see `internal/platform/mongodb/indexes.go` — the
  single index catalog). No collection scans on request paths.
- In-memory caches with short TTLs for org-tree (60s) and feature flags (30s) — the two
  read-on-every-request lookups.
- Write bursts (twice-daily pour shifts, §16) are absorbed by: connection pool 200, idempotent
  ingest (unique `client_event_id`), and batch sync endpoint.
- Mongo can be sharded later (shard keys would be `dcs_id`/date for pours); the provenance
  ledger's global sequence is the one serialization point — at true national scale, switch
  `Append` to per-entity chains or a partitioned ledger (documented trade-off, §20-2).

## 2. Repository layout

```
cmd/server/          boot: config → logger → mongo → indexes → deps → router (graceful shutdown)
cmd/seed/            idempotent demo/dev data (org tree, parties per role, rate chart, animals)
internal/config/     env-only config (.env supported; MONGO_URI required, no in-code default)
internal/domain/     THE CONTRACT: pure entities/enums/invariants; no deps; modules depend on it
internal/platform/   shared services: httpx, auth (JWT/OTP/HMAC), middleware (authn/rbac/audit/
                     ratelimit/metrics), mongodb (client+index catalog), provenance (hash-chain
                     ledger), orgscope (path-based scope checks), flags, audit, eventbus, deps
internal/httpapi/    router assembly + module registration
internal/modules/    10 domain modules (identity, orgs, cattle, collection, logistics, plant,
                     quality, settlement, publictrace, platformops)
scripts/smoke.sh     end-to-end test of the entire loop over live HTTP + MongoDB
```

**Module contract** (enforced): `Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps)`; layering
`handler.go` (HTTP only) → `service.go` (business logic) → `repo.go` (Mongo only) + `models.go`
(DTOs). Modules never import each other; cross-module reactions go through the event bus;
collection names only via `mongodb.Coll*` consts.

## 3. Identity model (§4) — how auth works

1. `POST /api/v1/auth/otp/request {phone}` → 6-digit OTP (stored **HMAC-hashed**, TTL, max 5
   attempts). Dev mode (`OTP_DEV_MODE=true`) returns `dev_otp` in the response.
2. `POST /api/v1/auth/otp/verify` → finds-or-creates the **Party** (one phone = one human) →
   returns a **session JWT** + rotating **refresh token** (stored hashed).
3. `GET /api/v1/auth/roles` → the party's org-scoped **RoleAssignments** (23-role catalog §5.2).
4. `POST /api/v1/auth/role/select {role_assignment_id}` → **role JWT** pinned to
   role+org (this IS the role switcher; KYC tier gates apply, §4.2).
5. Protected routes: `middleware.Authenticate` (JWT) → `middleware.RequireRoles(...)`
   (SUPER_ADMIN passes all gates; every mutation is audit-logged) → `orgscope.RequireInScope`
   (path-array ancestry check, O(1)).

## 4. The core loop (what the smoke test drives)

```
analyzer reading (anti-tamper: geotag/device-time/OCR-confidence/plausibility §8.2)
→ pour (idempotent client_event_id; priced off org-scoped rate chart; SMS receipt) 
→ same-day invoice (unique farmer+dcs+date)
→ consignment (DCS day+shift aggregate = the pooling boundary §7.4)
→ route trip (pickup temp, cold-chain log, deliver to BMC)
→ BMC lot (pool consignments, chill temp) → QC BMC_RAPID   ── FSSAI gate §8.3
→ processing batch (only PASSED lots can enter)  → QC PLANT_LAB ── gate again
→ product lot (only COMPLETED batches) → QR (HMAC-signed, forgery-proof)
→ PUBLIC scan /api/v1/public/qr/{code} → honest samiti-SET provenance + QC certificate
→ settlement: initiate (Sacheev) → approve (DIFFERENT person — dual control §8.1) 
  → execute (mock licensed-PA) → farmer paid, UTR, SMS
```

Every hop appends a **provenance event** to the hash chain with `refs` edges; the public scan
returns `ledger.intact` from re-verifying the chain segment. Corrections (pour supersede) are
new events referencing the old — nothing is ever edited in place (§3.4).

**FSSAI limits enforced in software** (`internal/domain/quality.go`): AFM1 ≤ 0.5 µg/kg,
coliform ≤ 10 CFU/ml, tetracycline MRL 0.1 mg/kg, phosphatase must be negative. A failed subject
is BLOCKED and *every* forward path re-checks status (dispatch, batch creation, product lot, QR).

## 5. Hashing / crypto inventory

| What | Mechanism | Where |
|---|---|---|
| OTP codes | HMAC-SHA256(secret, phone, code) — DB never sees plaintext | `platform/auth/otp.go` |
| Refresh tokens | opaque 32-byte random, stored as HMAC digest, rotated on every refresh | identity module |
| Provenance chain | SHA-256 over (prev_hash, seq, type, entity, refs, actor, payload, ts) | `platform/provenance/ledger.go` |
| QR tokens | HMAC-SHA256 signature over (qr_code, product_lot_id, issued_at) | plant module + public verify |
| JWT | HS256, 15-min access, kind=session/role | `platform/auth/jwt.go` |
| Aadhaar | **never stored** — last-4 + mock Data-Vault ref only (§18-A) | identity/KYC |

## 6. What is mocked (clearly labelled in code) vs real

**Real:** everything in the loop above — auth, RBAC, org scoping, pricing, idempotent ingest,
gate logic, hash-chained ledger, trace, settlements state machine, audit trail, flags, metrics.

**Mocked (intentional — DPI integrations are Phase-gated, §13):** Aadhaar eKYC (always verifies,
stores masked ref), bank penny-drop (0.92 name-match), Bharat Pashudhan sync (marks SYNCED),
PFMS/DBT (ref generation only), licensed-PA payout execution (instant SUCCESS + mock UTR),
SMS provider (worker marks SENT). Each mock is a single clearly named function — replacing it
with the real connector does not touch the surrounding flow.

**Dormant (capability-gated, OFF):** collar telemetry (`collar_telemetry_enabled` §9), ONDC,
consumer commerce (descoped by product decision — only the public QR scan is consumer-facing).

## 7. How to run

```bash
# prerequisites: Go 1.23+, MongoDB running locally (or any URI)
cp .env.example .env             # then set MONGO_URI (env is the ONLY source)
make tidy                        # deps
make run                         # start API on :8080
make seed                        # demo org tree + parties + rate chart (idempotent)
make test                        # unit tests
make smoke                       # full E2E loop against a scratch DB (starts its own server)
# docker alternative:
make docker-up                   # mongo + api via compose
```

Demo phones (OTP_DEV_MODE returns the OTP in the response): super-admin 9999999999,
sacheev 9000000001, adhyaksh 9000000002, farmer 9000000011, rider 9000000021,
bmc-op 9000000031, plant-op 9000000041, lab 9000000042.

## 8. What to do next (ordered)

1. **Real DPI connectors** behind the existing mock seams: Aadhaar KUA/AUA, penny-drop PA,
   SMS/IVR DLT gateway, PFMS, Bharat Pashudhan. One module file each; contracts already shaped.
2. **Move OTP/SMS + notification worker to a real queue** (the outbox collection is already the
   queue table; today a manual worker endpoint drains it).
3. **Mongo replica set** in any real environment → then optionally wrap multi-doc updates
   (consignment↔pour, settlement↔invoices) in transactions; current design is safe without them
   (unique indexes + status guards) but transactions tighten crash windows.
4. **Object store** (S3-compatible, in-India §14) for analyzer photos/PoD — `photo_object_key`
   fields already exist; add a presigned-upload endpoint.
5. **Split-out path when scale demands:** each `internal/modules/*` maps 1:1 to a service;
   replace `eventbus` with Kafka/NATS; the `deps` container becomes per-service wiring.
6. **Compliance work items** (§18): DPIA + SDF confirmation, CERT-In log shipping (JSON logs
   ready), VAPT before go-live, Legal Metrology verification flow for analyzers/scales.
7. **Open blueprint decisions still open** (§20): NDDB AMCS federate-vs-build, provenance store
   final form at national scale, settlement authority final approval chain.

## 9. Conventions for future contributors (humans & LLMs)

- **Never** edit `internal/domain` semantics casually — modules and the frontend contract depend
  on it; additive changes only, statuses are closed sets.
- New endpoint? Follow the module layering; RBAC via `RequireRoles` + `RequireInScope`; return
  `httpx` envelopes; add the index for any new query shape to `indexes.go`; append provenance
  events for anything traceability-relevant; emit bus topics for cross-module effects.
- Provenance discipline: **no updates, no deletes** on `provenance_events` — corrections are new
  events with a `supersedes` ref.
- All secrets/URIs via env only. `.env` is gitignored; `.env.example` documents every variable.
- Tests: pure logic gets table-driven unit tests next to the code; the loop is guarded by
  `scripts/smoke.sh` — extend it when you extend the loop.
````

```text
2	// A local `.env` file is read first (dev convenience, never committed);

4	// strings: the server refuses to boot without MONGO_URI.

16	// Config is the fully resolved runtime configuration.

18		Env      string // dev | prod
19		Port     int
20		LogLevel string
21

24

33

36

38	}

40	// IsProd reports whether the server runs with production hardening.
41	func (c *Config) IsProd() bool { return c.Env == "prod" }
42	
43	// Load reads `.env` (if present) then the process environment, validates the
44	// result, and returns the Config. Missing MONGO_URI is a hard error.
45	func Load() (*Config, error) {
46		loadDotEnv(".env")
47	
48		cfg := &Config{
49			Env:             envStr("ENV", "dev"),
50			Port:            envInt("PORT", 8080),
51			LogLevel:        envStr("LOG_LEVEL", "info"),
52			MongoURI:        os.Getenv("MONGO_URI"),
53			MongoDB:         envStr("MONGO_DB", "saathi"),
54			JWTSecret:       envStr("JWT_SECRET", ""),
55			QRSigningSecret: envStr("QR_SIGNING_SECRET", ""),
56			OTPHashSecret:   envStr("OTP_HASH_SECRET", ""),
57			AccessTokenTTL:  time.Duration(envInt("ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES", 15)) * time.Minute,
58			RefreshTokenTTL: time.Duration(envInt("REFRESH_TOKEN_TTL_DAYS", 30)) * 24 * time.Hour,
59			OTPTTL:          time.Duration(envInt("OTP_TTL_MINUTES", 5)) * time.Minute,
60			OTPDevMode:      envBool("OTP_DEV_MODE", false),
61			RateLimitRPS:    envFloat("RATE_LIMIT_RPS", 50),
62			RateLimitBurst:  envInt("RATE_LIMIT_BURST", 100),
63			SeedAdminPhone:  envStr("SEED_ADMIN_PHONE", "9999999999"),
64		}
65	
66		if cfg.MongoURI == "" {
67			return nil, fmt.Errorf("MONGO_URI is required and must be set via environment (no in-code default); see .env.example")
68		}
69		if cfg.JWTSecret == "" {
70			return nil, fmt.Errorf("JWT_SECRET is required; see .env.example")
71		}
72		if cfg.QRSigningSecret == "" {
73			cfg.QRSigningSecret = cfg.JWTSecret + ":qr" // derived fallback for dev only
74		}
75		if cfg.OTPHashSecret == "" {
76			cfg.OTPHashSecret = cfg.JWTSecret + ":otp"
77		}
78	
79		if cfg.IsProd() {
80			if strings.Contains(cfg.JWTSecret, "dev-only") {
81				return nil, fmt.Errorf("refusing to start in prod with a dev-only JWT_SECRET")
82			}
83			if cfg.OTPDevMode {
84				return nil, fmt.Errorf("refusing to start in prod with OTP_DEV_MODE=true (OTPs would leak in API responses)")
85			}
86		}
87		return cfg, nil
88	}
89	
90	// loadDotEnv parses KEY=VALUE lines from path into the process environment,
91	// without overriding variables that are already set.
92	func loadDotEnv(path string) {
93		f, err := os.Open(path)
94		if err != nil {
95			return // optional file
96		}
97		defer f.Close()
98	
99		sc := bufio.NewScanner(f)
100		for sc.Scan() {
101			line := strings.TrimSpace(sc.Text())
102			if line == "" || strings.HasPrefix(line, "#") {
103				continue
104			}
105			key, val, ok := strings.Cut(line, "=")
106			if !ok {
107				continue
108			}
109			key = strings.TrimSpace(key)
110			val = strings.TrimSpace(val)
111			val = strings.Trim(val, `"'`)
112			if key != "" && os.Getenv(key) == "" {
113				os.Setenv(key, val)
114			}
115		}
116	}
117	
118	func envStr(key, def string) string {
119		if v := os.Getenv(key); v != "" {
120			return v
121		}
122		return def
123	}
124	
125	func envInt(key string, def int) int {
126		if v := os.Getenv(key); v != "" {
127			if n, err := strconv.Atoi(v); err == nil {
128				return n
129			}
130		}
131		return def
132	}
133	
134	func envFloat(key string, def float64) float64 {
135		if v := os.Getenv(key); v != "" {
136			if f, err := strconv.ParseFloat(v, 64); err == nil {
137				return f
138			}
139		}
140		return def
141	}
142	
143	func envBool(key string, def bool) bool {
144		if v := os.Getenv(key); v != "" {
145			if b, err := strconv.ParseBool(v); err == nil {
146				return b
147			}
148		}
149		return def
150	}
151
```

```text
1	// Package audit writes the immutable who-did-what trail required for
2	// government accountability and DPDP breach forensics (blueprint §12, §16).
3	// Entries are insert-only; the STATE_AUDITOR role reads them via the
4	// platformops module.
5	package audit
6	
7	import (
8		"context"
9		"log/slog"
10		"time"
11	
12		"github.com/google/uuid"

18	const collection = "audit_logs"

20	// Entry is one audit record.
21	type Entry struct {
22		ID           string         `bson:"_id"            json:"id"`
23		ActorPartyID string         `bson:"actor_party_id" json:"actor_party_id"`
24		ActorRole    string         `bson:"actor_role,omitempty" json:"actor_role,omitempty"`
25		Action       string         `bson:"action"         json:"action"` // e.g. "http.POST /api/v1/collection/pours" or "support.pii_lookup"
26		TargetType   string         `bson:"target_type,omitempty" json:"target_type,omitempty"`
27		TargetID     string         `bson:"target_id,omitempty"   json:"target_id,omitempty"`
28		Status       int            `bson:"status,omitempty"      json:"status,omitempty"`
29		IP           string         `bson:"ip,omitempty"          json:"ip,omitempty"`
30		RequestID    string         `bson:"request_id,omitempty"  json:"request_id,omitempty"`
31		Meta         map[string]any `bson:"meta,omitempty"        json:"meta,omitempty"`
32		TS           time.Time      `bson:"ts"             json:"ts"`
33	}
34	
35	// Recorder persists audit entries asynchronously so auditing never adds
36	// latency to the request path.
37	type Recorder struct {
38		coll *mongo.Collection
39		log  *slog.Logger
40	}
41	
42	// NewRecorder binds the recorder to the database.
43	func NewRecorder(db *mongo.Database, log *slog.Logger) *Recorder {
44		return &Recorder{coll: db.Collection(collection), log: log}
45	}
46	
47	// Record fills identity fields from the request context and persists the
48	// entry in the background (fire-and-forget with its own timeout).
49	func (r *Recorder) Record(ctx context.Context, e Entry) {
50		if a, ok := auth.ActorFrom(ctx); ok {
51			if e.ActorPartyID == "" {
52				e.ActorPartyID = a.PartyID
53			}
54			if e.ActorRole == "" {
55				e.ActorRole = a.RoleCode
56			}
57		}
58		e.ID = uuid.NewString()
59		e.TS = time.Now().UTC()
60	
61		go func() {
62			writeCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
63			defer cancel()
64			if _, err := r.coll.InsertOne(writeCtx, e); err != nil {
65				r.log.Error("audit write failed", slog.String("action", e.Action), slog.Any("err", err))
66			}
67		}()
68	}
```

```text
1	package domain
2	
3	import (
4		"fmt"
5		"time"
6	)
7	
8	// FSSAI limits for liquid milk (blueprint §8.3). Aflatoxin M1 is heat-stable
9	// and survives pasteurisation, so it MUST be gated upstream (BMC + plant),
10	// never only at the finished product.
11	const (
12		FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg = 0.5  // AFM1 ≤ 0.5 µg/kg
13		FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl          = 10.0 // coliform ≤ 10 CFU/ml
14		FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg       = 0.1  // antibiotic MRL example
15	)
16	
17	// QC test names.
18	const (
19		TestAflatoxinM1  = "AFLATOXIN_M1"           // µg/kg
20		TestColiform     = "COLIFORM"               // CFU/ml
21		TestTPC          = "TPC"                    // CFU/ml, graded — recorded, not hard-gated here
22		TestAntibiotic   = "ANTIBIOTIC_TETRACYCLINE" // mg/kg
23		TestPhosphatase  = "PHOSPHATASE"            // 0 = negative (pass post-pasteurisation), 1 = positive
24		TestFat          = "FAT"                    // %
25		TestSNF          = "SNF"                    // %
26	)
27	
28	// QC stages.
29	const (
30		QCStageBMCRapid = "BMC_RAPID" // strip/rapid tests at the chilling centre
31		QCStagePlantLab = "PLANT_LAB" // full lab: ELISA/HPLC, culture, LC-MS/MS
32	)
33	
34	// QC subject types.
35	const (
36		QCSubjectDCSConsignment  = "DCS_CONSIGNMENT"
37		QCSubjectBMCLot          = "BMC_LOT"
38		QCSubjectProcessingBatch = "PROCESSING_BATCH"
39	)
40	
41	// QCTest is a single measurement inside a QC result.
42	type QCTest struct {
43		Name  string  `bson:"name"  json:"name"`
44		Value float64 `bson:"value" json:"value"`
45		Unit  string  `bson:"unit"  json:"unit"`
46		Pass  bool    `bson:"pass"  json:"pass"`
47	}
48	
49	// QCResult is the recorded outcome of testing one subject at one stage.
50	// OverallPass drives the safety gate; a certificate is attached to provenance
51	// on pass, a block + quarantine on fail.
52	type QCResult struct {
53		ID                string    `bson:"_id"          json:"id"`
54		SubjectType       string    `bson:"subject_type" json:"subject_type"`
55		SubjectID         string    `bson:"subject_id"   json:"subject_id"`
56		Stage             string    `bson:"stage"        json:"stage"`
57		Tests             []QCTest  `bson:"tests"        json:"tests"`
58		OverallPass       bool      `bson:"overall_pass" json:"overall_pass"`
59		FailureReasons    []string  `bson:"failure_reasons,omitempty" json:"failure_reasons,omitempty"`
60		AnalystPartyID    string    `bson:"analyst_party_id" json:"analyst_party_id"`
61		LabRef            string    `bson:"lab_ref,omitempty"            json:"lab_ref,omitempty"`
62		CertificateNumber string    `bson:"certificate_number,omitempty" json:"certificate_number,omitempty"`
63		RecordedAt        time.Time `bson:"recorded_at"  json:"recorded_at"`
64		ProvenanceSeq     int64     `bson:"provenance_seq,omitempty" json:"provenance_seq,omitempty"`
65	}
66	
67	// EvaluateQCTests applies the FSSAI gate to a set of tests: it fills each
68	// test's Pass verdict and returns the overall verdict plus human-readable
69	// failure reasons. Unknown test names are recorded but do not gate.
70	func EvaluateQCTests(tests []QCTest) (overallPass bool, failures []string, evaluated []QCTest) {
71		overallPass = true
72		evaluated = make([]QCTest, 0, len(tests))
73		for _, t := range tests {
74			pass := true
75			switch t.Name {
76			case TestAflatoxinM1:
77				if t.Value > FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg {
78					pass = false
79					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
80						"AFLATOXIN_M1 %.3f µg/kg exceeds FSSAI limit %.1f µg/kg", t.Value, FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg))
81				}
82			case TestColiform:
83				if t.Value > FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl {
84					pass = false
85					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
86						"COLIFORM %.1f CFU/ml exceeds FSSAI limit %.0f CFU/ml", t.Value, FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl))
87				}
88			case TestAntibiotic:
89				if t.Value > FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg {
90					pass = false
91					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
92						"ANTIBIOTIC_TETRACYCLINE %.3f mg/kg exceeds MRL %.1f mg/kg", t.Value, FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg))
93				}
94			case TestPhosphatase:
95				if t.Value != 0 {
96					pass = false
97					failures = append(failures, "PHOSPHATASE positive — pasteurisation check failed (must be negative)")
98				}
99			}
100			t.Pass = pass
101			if !pass {
102				overallPass = false
103			}
104			evaluated = append(evaluated, t)
105		}
106		return overallPass, failures, evaluated
107	}
108
```

```text
43				httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Internal(err))
```

```go
// Package orgs implements the cooperative-hierarchy module (blueprint §5.1):
// the FEDERATION → MILK_UNION → {PROCESSING_PLANT, BMC, DCS} org-unit tree.
// It owns org-unit creation and edits (PCDF/state admins), directory reads
// for any authenticated party, subtree reads for oversight roles, and the
// membership roster (active role assignments joined with parties).
package orgs

import (
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"

	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/middleware"
)

// Register mounts the orgs module under /orgs on the /api/v1 subtree.
func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
	repo := newRepository(d.DB)
	svc := newService(repo, d.Orgs)
	h := newHandler(svc)

	r.Route("/orgs", func(r chi.Router) {
		r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))

		// Hierarchy writes — state-apex administrators only.
		r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
			r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSuperAdmin, domain.RolePCDFAdmin))
			r.Post("/", h.create)
			r.Patch("/{id}", h.update)
		})

		// Directory reads — any authenticated party (session or role token).
		r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
			r.Use(middleware.RequireSession)
			r.Get("/", h.list)
			r.Get("/{id}", h.get)
			r.Get("/{id}/children", h.children)
		})

		// Subtree read — oversight roles, scope-checked in the service.
		r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
			r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(
				domain.RoleSuperAdmin,
				domain.RolePCDFAdmin,
				domain.RoleMissionOfficial,
				domain.RoleUnionPresident,
				domain.RoleStateAuditor,
			))
			r.Get("/{id}/tree", h.tree)
		})

		// Membership roster — org staff roles, scope-checked in the service.
		r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
			r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(
				domain.RoleSamitiSacheev,
				domain.RoleSamitiAdhyaksh,
				domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor,
				domain.RoleUnionPresident,
				domain.RolePCDFAdmin,
				domain.RoleSuperAdmin,
			))
			r.Get("/{id}/members", h.members)
		})
	})
}

```

```go
package orgs

import "time"

// CreateOrgRequest is the body of POST /orgs.
type CreateOrgRequest struct {
	Type     string   `json:"type"`
	Name     string   `json:"name"`
	Code     string   `json:"code"`
	ParentID string   `json:"parent_id,omitempty"`
	District string   `json:"district,omitempty"`
	State    string   `json:"state,omitempty"`
	GeoLat   *float64 `json:"geo_lat,omitempty"`
	GeoLng   *float64 `json:"geo_lng,omitempty"`
}

// UpdateOrgRequest is the body of PATCH /orgs/{id}. Pointer fields
// distinguish "absent" from "set to zero value". Type and ParentID are
// decoded solely to reject hierarchy moves, which are unsupported in v1.
type UpdateOrgRequest struct {
	Name     *string  `json:"name"`
	District *string  `json:"district"`
	Active   *bool    `json:"active"`
	GeoLat   *float64 `json:"geo_lat"`
	GeoLng   *float64 `json:"geo_lng"`
	Type     *string  `json:"type"`
	ParentID *string  `json:"parent_id"`
}

// Member is one row of GET /orgs/{id}/members: an ACTIVE role assignment at
// the org joined in memory with its party's identity fields.
type Member struct {
	PartyID          string     `json:"party_id"`
	Phone            string     `json:"phone,omitempty"`
	FullName         string     `json:"full_name,omitempty"`
	KYCTier          string     `json:"kyc_tier,omitempty"`
	RoleCode         string     `json:"role_code"`
	RoleAssignmentID string     `json:"role_assignment_id"`
	ValidFrom        time.Time  `json:"valid_from"`
	ValidTo          *time.Time `json:"valid_to,omitempty"`
}

// ListMeta echoes pagination inputs plus the number of items returned.
type ListMeta struct {
	Limit  int64 `json:"limit"`
	Offset int64 `json:"offset"`
	Count  int   `json:"count"`
}

// TreeMeta describes a subtree response. Truncated is true when the subtree
// hit the node cap and the flat list is incomplete.
type TreeMeta struct {
	Count     int  `json:"count"`
	Truncated bool `json:"truncated"`
}
```

```go
type CreateDBTRequestInput struct {
```

```go
package orgs

import (
	"context"
	"errors"

	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo/options"

	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/mongodb"
)

// repository is the module's only MongoDB access point. It reads the
// role_assignments and parties collections (allowed by spec for the members
// roster) but writes only org_units.
type repository struct {
	orgs        *mongo.Collection
	assignments *mongo.Collection
	parties     *mongo.Collection
}

func newRepository(db *mongo.Database) *repository {
	return &repository{
		orgs:        db.Collection(mongodb.CollOrgUnits),
		assignments: db.Collection(mongodb.CollRoleAssignments),
		parties:     db.Collection(mongodb.CollParties),
	}
}

// insertOrg inserts a new org unit. The raw driver error is returned so the
// service can map a duplicate-key violation on code to a Conflict.
func (r *repository) insertOrg(ctx context.Context, org *domain.OrgUnit) error {
	_, err := r.orgs.InsertOne(ctx, org)
	return err
}

// getOrg fetches one org unit by ID.
func (r *repository) getOrg(ctx context.Context, id string) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
	var org domain.OrgUnit
	err := r.orgs.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&org)
	if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
		return nil, httpx.NotFound("org unit " + id)
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return &org, nil
}

// countByType counts org units of the given type (federation-uniqueness check).
func (r *repository) countByType(ctx context.Context, orgType string) (int64, error) {
	n, err := r.orgs.CountDocuments(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "type", Value: orgType}})
	if err != nil {
		return 0, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return n, nil
}

// updateOrg applies a $set patch and returns the updated document.
func (r *repository) updateOrg(ctx context.Context, id string, set bson.D) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
	var org domain.OrgUnit
	err := r.orgs.FindOneAndUpdate(ctx,
		bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}},
		bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: set}},
		options.FindOneAndUpdate().SetReturnDocument(options.After),
	).Decode(&org)
	if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
		return nil, httpx.NotFound("org unit " + id)
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return &org, nil
}

// listChildren pages the direct children of an org unit (parent_id index).
func (r *repository) listChildren(ctx context.Context, parentID string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.OrgUnit, error) {
	return r.findOrgs(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "parent_id", Value: parentID}},
		options.Find().
			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "code", Value: 1}}).
			SetSkip(page.Offset).
			SetLimit(page.Limit))
}

// listOrgs pages org units matching an arbitrary filter (type/district).
func (r *repository) listOrgs(ctx context.Context, filter bson.D, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.OrgUnit, error) {
	return r.findOrgs(ctx, filter,
		options.Find().
			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "code", Value: 1}}).
			SetSkip(page.Offset).
			SetLimit(page.Limit))
}

// listDescendants returns every org unit whose ancestor Path contains rootID
// (path index, array containment), capped at limit nodes.
func (r *repository) listDescendants(ctx context.Context, rootID string, limit int64) ([]domain.OrgUnit, error) {
	return r.findOrgs(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "path", Value: rootID}},
		options.Find().
			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "code", Value: 1}}).
			SetLimit(limit))
}

func (r *repository) findOrgs(ctx context.Context, filter bson.D, opts *options.FindOptions) ([]domain.OrgUnit, error) {
	cur, err := r.orgs.Find(ctx, filter, opts)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	units := []domain.OrgUnit{}
	if err := cur.All(ctx, &units); err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return units, nil
}

// listActiveAssignments pages the ACTIVE role assignments at one org unit
// (org_unit_id + role_code + status index).
func (r *repository) listActiveAssignments(ctx context.Context, orgID string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.RoleAssignment, error) {
	cur, err := r.assignments.Find(ctx,
		bson.D{
			{Key: "org_unit_id", Value: orgID},
			{Key: "status", Value: domain.RoleAssignmentActive},
		},
		options.Find().
			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "role_code", Value: 1}, {Key: "created_at", Value: 1}}).
			SetSkip(page.Offset).
			SetLimit(page.Limit))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	assignments := []domain.RoleAssignment{}
	if err := cur.All(ctx, &assignments); err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return assignments, nil
}

// partiesByIDs fetches the given parties keyed by ID for the in-memory join.
func (r *repository) partiesByIDs(ctx context.Context, ids []string) (map[string]domain.Party, error) {
	byID := make(map[string]domain.Party, len(ids))
	if len(ids) == 0 {
		return byID, nil
	}
	cur, err := r.parties.Find(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: ids}}}})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	var parties []domain.Party
	if err := cur.All(ctx, &parties); err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	for _, p := range parties {
		byID[p.ID] = p
	}
	return byID, nil
}
```
