```text
package middleware

import (
	"net/http"

	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
)

// RequireRoles allows only ROLE-kind tokens whose role is in the allow-list.
// SUPER_ADMIN passes every gate (break-glass admin — all its calls are
// audited by the audit middleware).
func RequireRoles(roles ...string) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
	allowed := make(map[string]struct{}, len(roles))
	for _, r := range roles {
		allowed[r] = struct{}{}
	}
	return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
		return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			actor, ok := auth.ActorFrom(r.Context())
			if !ok {
				httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Unauthorized("authentication required"))
				return
			}
			if actor.Kind != auth.TokenKindRole {
				httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Forbidden("a role token is required — select a role first (POST /api/v1/auth/role/select)"))
				return
			}
			if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSuperAdmin {
				next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
				return
			}
			if _, ok := allowed[actor.RoleCode]; !ok {
				httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Forbidden("role "+actor.RoleCode+" is not permitted for this action"))
				return
			}
			next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
		})
	}
}

// RequireSession allows any authenticated party (session or role token) —
// used for identity endpoints like "list my roles".
func RequireSession(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if _, ok := auth.ActorFrom(r.Context()); !ok {
			httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Unauthorized("authentication required"))
			return
		}
		next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
	})
}
// Package middleware carries the cross-cutting HTTP concerns: token
// authentication, role enforcement, audit capture, per-IP rate limiting,
// Prometheus metrics.
package middleware

import (
	"net/http"
	"strings"

	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
)

// Authenticate verifies the Bearer token and installs the Actor on the
// request context. Requests without a valid token are rejected — public
// routes simply don't mount this middleware.
func Authenticate(jwtm *auth.JWTManager) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
		return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			header := r.Header.Get("Authorization")
			token, ok := strings.CutPrefix(header, "Bearer ")
			if !ok || token == "" {
				httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Unauthorized("missing bearer token"))
				return
			}
			claims, err := jwtm.Parse(token)
			if err != nil {
				httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Unauthorized("invalid or expired token"))
				return
			}
			actor := auth.Actor{
				PartyID:          claims.PartyID,
				Phone:            claims.Phone,
				KYCTier:          claims.KYCTier,
				Kind:             claims.Kind,
				RoleAssignmentID: claims.RoleAssignmentID,
				RoleCode:         claims.RoleCode,
				OrgUnitID:        claims.OrgUnitID,
				OrgType:          claims.OrgType,
			}
			next.ServeHTTP(w, r.WithContext(auth.WithActor(r.Context(), actor)))
		})
	}
}
```

```text
// Package config loads all runtime configuration from the environment.
// A local `.env` file is read first (dev convenience, never committed);
// real environment variables always win. There are NO in-code connection
// strings: the server refuses to boot without MONGO_URI.
package config

import (
	"bufio"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

// Config is the fully resolved runtime configuration.
type Config struct {
	Env      string // dev | prod
	Port     int
	LogLevel string

	MongoURI string
	MongoDB  string

	JWTSecret       string
	QRSigningSecret string
	OTPHashSecret   string

	AccessTokenTTL  time.Duration
	RefreshTokenTTL time.Duration
	OTPTTL          time.Duration
	OTPDevMode      bool // true → OTP echoed in API response instead of SMS (dev only)

	RateLimitRPS   float64
	RateLimitBurst int

	SeedAdminPhone string
}

// IsProd reports whether the server runs with production hardening.
func (c *Config) IsProd() bool { return c.Env == "prod" }

// Load reads `.env` (if present) then the process environment, validates the
// result, and returns the Config. Missing MONGO_URI is a hard error.
func Load() (*Config, error) {
	loadDotEnv(".env")

	cfg := &Config{
		Env:             envStr("ENV", "dev"),
		Port:            envInt("PORT", 8080),
		LogLevel:        envStr("LOG_LEVEL", "info"),
		MongoURI:        os.Getenv("MONGO_URI"),
		MongoDB:         envStr("MONGO_DB", "saathi"),
		JWTSecret:       envStr("JWT_SECRET", ""),
		QRSigningSecret: envStr("QR_SIGNING_SECRET", ""),
		OTPHashSecret:   envStr("OTP_HASH_SECRET", ""),
		AccessTokenTTL:  time.Duration(envInt("ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES", 15)) * time.Minute,
		RefreshTokenTTL: time.Duration(envInt("REFRESH_TOKEN_TTL_DAYS", 30)) * 24 * time.Hour,
		OTPTTL:          time.Duration(envInt("OTP_TTL_MINUTES", 5)) * time.Minute,
		OTPDevMode:      envBool("OTP_DEV_MODE", false),
		RateLimitRPS:    envFloat("RATE_LIMIT_RPS", 50),
		RateLimitBurst:  envInt("RATE_LIMIT_BURST", 100),
		SeedAdminPhone:  envStr("SEED_ADMIN_PHONE", "9999999999"),
	}

	if cfg.MongoURI == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("MONGO_URI is required and must be set via environment (no in-code default); see .env.example")
	}
	if cfg.JWTSecret == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("JWT_SECRET is required; see .env.example")
	}
	if cfg.QRSigningSecret == "" {
		cfg.QRSigningSecret = cfg.JWTSecret + ":qr" // derived fallback for dev only
	}
	if cfg.OTPHashSecret == "" {
		cfg.OTPHashSecret = cfg.JWTSecret + ":otp"
	}

	if cfg.IsProd() {
		if strings.Contains(cfg.JWTSecret, "dev-only") {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("refusing to start in prod with a dev-only JWT_SECRET")
		}
		if cfg.OTPDevMode {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("refusing to start in prod with OTP_DEV_MODE=true (OTPs would leak in API responses)")
		}
	}
	return cfg, nil
}

// loadDotEnv parses KEY=VALUE lines from path into the process environment,
// without overriding variables that are already set.
func loadDotEnv(path string) {
	f, err := os.Open(path)
	if err != nil {
		return // optional file
	}
	defer f.Close()

	sc := bufio.NewScanner(f)
	for sc.Scan() {
		line := strings.TrimSpace(sc.Text())
		if line == "" || strings.HasPrefix(line, "#") {
			continue
		}
		key, val, ok := strings.Cut(line, "=")
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		key = strings.TrimSpace(key)
		val = strings.TrimSpace(val)
		val = strings.Trim(val, `"'`)
		if key != "" && os.Getenv(key) == "" {
			os.Setenv(key, val)
		}
	}
}

func envStr(key, def string) string {
	if v := os.Getenv(key); v != "" {
		return v
```

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# scripts/smoke.sh — end-to-end test of the ENTIRE Saathi loop over real HTTP.
#
# Self-contained: drops the scratch DB, builds + starts its own server on :8091
# against MONGO_DB=saathi_smoke, seeds, drives the full pour→QR→settlement loop
# plus the negative gates, and always kills the server on exit.
#
# Requires: bash, curl, python3, mongosh, go. No jq.
set -euo pipefail

export PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH"

REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
cd "$REPO_ROOT"

PORT=8091
HOST="http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}"
BASE="${HOST}/api/v1"
SMOKE_DB="saathi_smoke"
SERVER_PID=""
SERVER_LOG="$(mktemp -t saathi-smoke-server.XXXXXX.log)"

STATUS=""
BODY=""
CURRENT_STEP="setup"

# ── plumbing ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

log()  { echo "$*" >&2; }
pass() { log "PASS  step $CURRENT_STEP — $*"; }

fail() {
  log "FAIL  step $CURRENT_STEP — $*"
  log "----- offending response (HTTP ${STATUS:-n/a}) -----"
  log "${BODY:-<empty body>}"
  log "---------------------------------------------------"
  exit 1
}

cleanup() {
  local code=$?
  if [[ -n "$SERVER_PID" ]] && kill -0 "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null; then
    kill "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
    wait "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
  if [[ $code -ne 0 ]]; then
    log ""
    log "===== last 40 lines of server log ($SERVER_LOG) ====="
    tail -n 40 "$SERVER_LOG" >&2 || true
  fi
  exit $code
}
trap cleanup EXIT

step() { CURRENT_STEP="$1"; shift; log ""; log "── step $CURRENT_STEP: $* ──"; }

# req METHOD PATH TOKEN [JSON_BODY] → sets STATUS + BODY
req() {
  local method="$1" path="$2" token="${3:-}" data="${4:-}"
  local args=(-sS -X "$method" "${BASE}${path}" -H 'Content-Type: application/json')
  [[ -n "$token" ]] && args+=(-H "Authorization: Bearer $token")
  [[ -n "$data" ]] && args+=(--data "$data")
  local out
  out="$(curl "${args[@]}" -w $'\n%{http_code}')" || fail "curl error on $method $path"
  STATUS="${out##*$'\n'}"
  BODY="${out%$'\n'*}"
}

# raw_req METHOD URL → operational endpoints outside /api/v1
raw_req() {
  local method="$1" url="$2"
  local out
  out="$(curl -sS -X "$method" "$url" -w $'\n%{http_code}')" || fail "curl error on $url"
  STATUS="${out##*$'\n'}"
  BODY="${out%$'\n'*}"
}

expect_status() {
  local want="$1" what="$2"
  [[ "$STATUS" == "$want" ]] || fail "$what: expected HTTP $want, got HTTP $STATUS"
}

# jval 'PYTHON_EXPR' — evaluate over parsed BODY (as d); prints result
jval() {
  printf '%s' "$BODY" | python3 -c "
import json, sys
d = json.load(sys.stdin)
print($1)
" 2>/dev/null || fail "could not extract: $1"
}

# jassert 'PYTHON_BOOL_EXPR' 'description'
jassert() {
  local expr="$1" what="$2"
  local res
  res="$(printf '%s' "$BODY" | python3 -c "
import json, sys
d = json.load(sys.stdin)
print('OK' if ($expr) else 'NO')
" 2>/dev/null)" || fail "$what (assertion crashed: $expr)"
  [[ "$res" == "OK" ]] || fail "$what (assertion false: $expr)"
}

py_uuid() { python3 -c 'import uuid; print(uuid.uuid4())'; }

err_code() { jval "d['error']['code']"; }

# ── auth helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# login PHONE → prints session token
login() {
  local phone="$1"
  req POST /auth/otp/request "" "{\"phone\":\"$phone\"}"
  expect_status 200 "otp request for $phone"
  local otp
  otp="$(jval "d['data']['dev_otp']")"
  [[ -n "$otp" ]] || fail "no dev_otp in response for $phone (OTP_DEV_MODE off?)"
  req POST /auth/otp/verify "" "{\"phone\":\"$phone\",\"otp\":\"$otp\"}"
  expect_status 200 "otp verify for $phone"
  jval "d['data']['access_token']"
}

# role_token SESSION_TOKEN ROLE_CODE → prints role token
role_token() {
  local session="$1" role="$2"
  req GET /auth/roles "$session"
  expect_status 200 "list roles"
  local raid
  raid="$(jval "[a['id'] for a in d['data'] if a['role_code']=='$role'][0]")"
  [[ -n "$raid" ]] || fail "no $role assignment found"
  req POST /auth/role/select "$session" "{\"role_assignment_id\":\"$raid\"}"
  expect_status 200 "role select $role"
  jval "d['data']['access_token']"
}

# ── fixture constants (cmd/seed) ────────────────────────────────────────────

DCS="org-dcs-kasmandi-kalan"
BMC="org-bmc-malihabad"
PLANT="org-plant-lucknow-01"
UNION="org-union-lucknow"
FARMER_MAHESH="party-farmer-mahesh"
FARMER_GEETA="party-farmer-geeta"
ANIMAL="animal-gomti"
TODAY="$(TZ=Asia/Kolkata date +%F)"
EXPIRY="$(TZ=Asia/Kolkata date -v+3d +%F 2>/dev/null || TZ=Asia/Kolkata date -d '+3 days' +%F)"

# ── environment bring-up ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

log "smoke: repo=$REPO_ROOT  port=$PORT  db=$SMOKE_DB  today(IST)=$TODAY"

log "smoke: dropping $SMOKE_DB"
mongosh --quiet --eval "db.getSiblingDB(\"$SMOKE_DB\").dropDatabase()" >/dev/null

log "smoke: building server binary"
go build -o bin/saathi-server ./cmd/server

log "smoke: starting server (log: $SERVER_LOG)"
MONGO_DB="$SMOKE_DB" OTP_DEV_MODE=true PORT="$PORT" ./bin/saathi-server >"$SERVER_LOG" 2>&1 &
SERVER_PID=$!

log "smoke: waiting for /readyz"
ready=""
for _ in $(seq 1 60); do
  if curl -sf "${HOST}/readyz" >/dev/null 2>&1; then ready=1; break; fi
  kill -0 "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null || { BODY="$(tail -n 20 "$SERVER_LOG")"; fail "server process died during startup"; }
  sleep 0.5
done
[[ -n "$ready" ]] || { BODY="$(tail -n 20 "$SERVER_LOG")"; fail "server did not become ready in 30s"; }

log "smoke: seeding $SMOKE_DB"
MONGO_DB="$SMOKE_DB" go run ./cmd/seed >/dev/null

# ═══ 1. operational endpoints ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
step 1 "healthz / readyz / version"
raw_req GET "$HOST/healthz";  expect_status 200 "healthz";  jassert "d['status']=='ok'" "healthz status ok"
raw_req GET "$HOST/readyz";   expect_status 200 "readyz";   jassert "d['status']=='ready'" "readyz status ready"
raw_req GET "$HOST/version";  expect_status 200 "version";  jassert "d['service']=='saathi-backend' and len(d['version'])>0" "version body"
pass "healthz/readyz/version all OK"

# ═══ 2. sacheev login + role select ═════════════════════════════════════════
step 2 "sacheev login + role select"
SACHEEV_SESSION="$(login 9000000001)"
SACHEEV="$(role_token "$SACHEEV_SESSION" SAMITI_SACHEEV)"
[[ -n "$SACHEEV" ]] || fail "empty sacheev role token"
pass "sacheev holds a SAMITI_SACHEEV role token"

# ═══ 3. analyzer reading ════════════════════════════════════════════════════
step 3 "analyzer reading (ANALYZER_DIRECT, fat 6.5 / snf 9.0 / qty 10.5)"
NOW_UTC="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
req POST /collection/readings "$SACHEEV" "{
  \"dcs_id\": \"$DCS\",
  \"mode\": \"ANALYZER_DIRECT\",
  \"fat_pct\": 6.5, \"snf_pct\": 9.0, \"quantity_litres\": 10.5,
  \"device_id\": \"smoke-analyzer-01\",
  \"geo_lat\": 26.9124, \"geo_lng\": 80.9430,
  \"device_timestamp\": \"$NOW_UTC\"
}"
expect_status 201 "create reading"
READING_ID="$(jval "d['data']['id']")"
jassert "d['data']['plausibility_ok'] is True" "reading is plausible"
pass "reading $READING_ID recorded"

# ═══ 4. pour for Mahesh with exact pricing ══════════════════════════════════
step 4 "pour for farmer Mahesh (rate 52.75, amount 553.88)"
CEID_MAHESH="$(py_uuid)"
POUR_MAHESH_JSON="{
  \"client_event_id\": \"$CEID_MAHESH\",
  \"farmer_party_id\": \"$FARMER_MAHESH\",
  \"dcs_id\": \"$DCS\", \"shift\": \"MORNING\",
  \"quantity_litres\": 10.5, \"fat_pct\": 6.5, \"snf_pct\": 9.0,
  \"animal_id\": \"$ANIMAL\",
  \"analyzer_reading_id\": \"$READING_ID\",
  \"source\": \"ANALYZER_DIRECT\"
}"
req POST /collection/pours "$SACHEEV" "$POUR_MAHESH_JSON"
expect_status 201 "create pour"
POUR_MAHESH_ID="$(jval "d['data']['pour']['id']")"
jassert "abs(d['data']['pour']['rate_per_litre'] - 52.75) < 0.005" "rate == 52.75 (8.0 + 5.5*6.5 + 1.0*9.0)"
jassert "abs(d['data']['pour']['amount'] - 553.88) < 0.005" "amount == 553.88 (52.75 * 10.5)"
jassert "not d['data'].get('idempotent_replay', False)" "fresh insert, not replay"
pass "pour $POUR_MAHESH_ID priced rate=52.75 amount=553.88"

# ═══ 5. same pour replay → idempotent ═══════════════════════════════════════
step 5 "SAME pour replay → idempotent (offline-first)"
req POST /collection/pours "$SACHEEV" "$POUR_MAHESH_JSON"
expect_status 200 "replayed pour"
jassert "d['data']['idempotent_replay'] is True" "idempotent_replay true"
jassert "d['data']['pour']['id'] == '$POUR_MAHESH_ID'" "same pour returned"
pass "replay returned 200 + idempotent_replay=true, same pour id"

# ═══ 6. batch-sync: Geeta new + Mahesh duplicate ════════════════════════════
step 6 "batch-sync (created / created / duplicate)"
CEID_GEETA1="$(py_uuid)"
CEID_GEETA2="$(py_uuid)"
req POST /collection/pours/batch-sync "$SACHEEV" "{
  \"pours\": [
    {\"client_event_id\": \"$CEID_GEETA1\", \"farmer_party_id\": \"$FARMER_GEETA\", \"dcs_id\": \"$DCS\",
     \"shift\": \"MORNING\", \"quantity_litres\": 8.0, \"fat_pct\": 7.0, \"snf_pct\": 9.1, \"source\": \"ANALYZER_DIRECT\"},
    {\"client_event_id\": \"$CEID_GEETA2\", \"farmer_party_id\": \"$FARMER_GEETA\", \"dcs_id\": \"$DCS\",
     \"shift\": \"MORNING\", \"quantity_litres\": 4.5, \"fat_pct\": 6.8, \"snf_pct\": 8.9, \"source\": \"ANALYZER_DIRECT\"},
    $POUR_MAHESH_JSON
  ]
}"
expect_status 200 "batch sync"
jassert "[r['status'] for r in d['data']] == ['created','created','duplicate']" "statuses created/created/duplicate"
pass "batch-sync outcomes: created, created, duplicate"

# ═══ 7. negative: farmer cannot record pours ════════════════════════════════
step 7 "negative: FARMER role token POST pour → 403"
FARMER_SESSION="$(login 9000000011)"
FARMER="$(role_token "$FARMER_SESSION" FARMER)"
req POST /collection/pours "$FARMER" "{
  \"client_event_id\": \"$(py_uuid)\", \"farmer_party_id\": \"$FARMER_MAHESH\",
  \"dcs_id\": \"$DCS\", \"shift\": \"MORNING\",
  \"quantity_litres\": 5, \"fat_pct\": 6.0, \"snf_pct\": 8.8, \"source\": \"MANUAL\"
}"
expect_status 403 "farmer pour attempt"
pass "farmer POST /collection/pours refused with 403"

# ═══ 8. negative: implausible pour ══════════════════════════════════════════
step 8 "negative: implausible pour (fat 25.0) → 422"
req POST /collection/pours "$SACHEEV" "{
  \"client_event_id\": \"$(py_uuid)\", \"farmer_party_id\": \"$FARMER_MAHESH\",
  \"dcs_id\": \"$DCS\", \"shift\": \"MORNING\",
  \"quantity_litres\": 5, \"fat_pct\": 25.0, \"snf_pct\": 9.0, \"source\": \"ANALYZER_DIRECT\"
}"
expect_status 422 "implausible pour"
[[ "$(err_code)" == "IMPLAUSIBLE_VALUES" ]] || fail "expected IMPLAUSIBLE_VALUES, got $(err_code)"
pass "implausible pour rejected 422 IMPLAUSIBLE_VALUES"

# ═══ 9. invoices ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
step 9 "invoice generate (created>=2) + farmer sees own invoice"
req POST /collection/invoices/generate "$SACHEEV" "{\"dcs_id\": \"$DCS\", \"date\": \"$TODAY\"}"
expect_status 200 "generate invoices"
jassert "d['data']['created'] >= 2" "created >= 2 invoices"
MAHESH_INVOICE_ID="$(jval "[i['id'] for i in d['data']['invoices'] if i['farmer_party_id']=='$FARMER_MAHESH'][0]")"
req GET "/collection/invoices?date=$TODAY" "$FARMER"
expect_status 200 "farmer lists invoices"
jassert "any(i['id']=='$MAHESH_INVOICE_ID' for i in d['data'])" "farmer sees own invoice"
jassert "all(i['farmer_party_id']=='$FARMER_MAHESH' for i in d['data'])" "farmer sees ONLY own invoices"
pass "invoices generated ($MAHESH_INVOICE_ID visible to Mahesh)"

# ═══ 10. consignment create + dispatch ══════════════════════════════════════
step 10 "consignment create + dispatch (sacheev)"
req POST /logistics/consignments "$SACHEEV" "{\"dcs_id\": \"$DCS\", \"date\": \"$TODAY\", \"shift\": \"MORNING\"}"
expect_status 201 "create consignment"
CONSIGNMENT_ID="$(jval "d['data']['id']")"
jassert "d['data']['status']=='OPEN' and len(d['data']['pour_ids'])>=3" "OPEN consignment pooling >=3 pours"
req POST "/logistics/consignments/$CONSIGNMENT_ID/dispatch" "$SACHEEV"
expect_status 200 "dispatch consignment"
jassert "d['data']['status']=='DISPATCHED'" "consignment DISPATCHED"
pass "consignment $CONSIGNMENT_ID OPEN→DISPATCHED"

# ═══ 11. rider trip: pickup → cold chain → deliver ══════════════════════════
step 11 "rider trip: create → pickup 4.2°C → cold-chain → deliver to BMC"
RIDER_SESSION="$(login 9000000021)"
RIDER="$(role_token "$RIDER_SESSION" VAN_RIDER)"
req POST /logistics/trips "$RIDER" "{
  \"route_name\": \"Smoke Route A\", \"union_id\": \"$UNION\",
  \"date\": \"$TODAY\", \"shift\": \"MORNING\",
  \"stops\": [{\"dcs_id\": \"$DCS\", \"consignment_id\": \"$CONSIGNMENT_ID\"}]
}"
expect_status 201 "create trip"
TRIP_ID="$(jval "d['data']['id']")"
jassert "d['data']['status']=='PLANNED'" "trip PLANNED"
req POST "/logistics/trips/$TRIP_ID/stops/$CONSIGNMENT_ID/pickup" "$RIDER" '{"temp_c": 4.2}'
expect_status 200 "pickup"
jassert "d['data']['status']=='IN_PROGRESS'" "trip IN_PROGRESS after pickup"
jassert "abs(d['data']['stops'][0]['temp_c'] - 4.2) < 0.001" "pickup temp recorded"
req POST "/logistics/trips/$TRIP_ID/cold-chain" "$RIDER" '{"temp_c": 4.4, "geo_lat": 26.93, "geo_lng": 80.95}'
expect_status 200 "cold-chain log"
jassert "len(d['data']['cold_chain'])>=1" "cold-chain entry stored"
req POST "/logistics/trips/$TRIP_ID/deliver" "$RIDER" "{\"bmc_id\": \"$BMC\"}"
expect_status 200 "deliver"
jassert "d['data']['status']=='DELIVERED' and d['data']['delivered_to_bmc_id']=='$BMC'" "trip DELIVERED to BMC"
pass "trip $TRIP_ID PLANNED→IN_PROGRESS→DELIVERED"

# ═══ 12. BMC lot create + close ═════════════════════════════════════════════
step 12 "bmc-op: lot create from delivered consignment + close at 3.8°C"
BMCOP_SESSION="$(login 9000000031)"
BMCOP="$(role_token "$BMCOP_SESSION" BMC_OPERATOR)"
req POST /plant/bmc-lots "$BMCOP" "{
  \"bmc_id\": \"$BMC\", \"date\": \"$TODAY\", \"shift\": \"MORNING\",
  \"consignment_ids\": [\"$CONSIGNMENT_ID\"]
}"
expect_status 201 "create bmc lot"
LOT_ID="$(jval "d['data']['id']")"
jassert "d['data']['status']=='OPEN'" "lot OPEN"
req POST "/plant/bmc-lots/$LOT_ID/close" "$BMCOP" '{"chilling_temp_c": 3.8}'
expect_status 200 "close lot"
jassert "d['data']['status']=='QC_PENDING' and abs(d['data']['chilling_temp_c']-3.8)<0.001" "lot QC_PENDING at 3.8°C"
pass "bmc lot $LOT_ID OPEN→QC_PENDING"

# ═══ 13. QC pass + dispatch lot ═════════════════════════════════════════════
step 13 "bmc-op QC BMC_RAPID PASS (AFM1 0.3, coliform 5) → PASSED → dispatch"
req POST /quality/qc-results "$BMCOP" "{
  \"subject_type\": \"BMC_LOT\", \"subject_id\": \"$LOT_ID\", \"stage\": \"BMC_RAPID\",
  \"tests\": [
    {\"name\": \"AFLATOXIN_M1\", \"value\": 0.3, \"unit\": \"µg/kg\"},
    {\"name\": \"COLIFORM\", \"value\": 5, \"unit\": \"CFU/ml\"}
  ]
}"
expect_status 201 "record BMC_RAPID QC"
jassert "d['data']['overall_pass'] is True and len(d['data']['certificate_number'])>0" "QC passed with certificate"
req GET "/plant/bmc-lots?bmc_id=$BMC&date=$TODAY" "$BMCOP"
expect_status 200 "list lots"
jassert "[l['status'] for l in d['data'] if l['id']=='$LOT_ID'] == ['PASSED']" "lot status PASSED"
req POST "/plant/bmc-lots/$LOT_ID/dispatch" "$BMCOP"
expect_status 200 "dispatch lot"
jassert "d['data']['status']=='DISPATCHED'" "lot DISPATCHED"
pass "lot $LOT_ID QC PASSED → DISPATCHED"

# ═══ 14. negative gate: full second path → BLOCKED lot ══════════════════════
step 14 "negative gate: 2nd path (evening) → QC fail AFM1 0.9 → BLOCKED → dispatch 422 → batch 422"
# second pour (evening shift keeps the consignment unique-index happy)
CEID_EVE="$(py_uuid)"
req POST /collection/pours "$SACHEEV" "{
  \"client_event_id\": \"$CEID_EVE\", \"farmer_party_id\": \"$FARMER_MAHESH\",
  \"dcs_id\": \"$DCS\", \"shift\": \"EVENING\",
  \"quantity_litres\": 9.0, \"fat_pct\": 6.2, \"snf_pct\": 8.9, \"source\": \"ANALYZER_DIRECT\"
}"
expect_status 201 "evening pour"
req POST /logistics/consignments "$SACHEEV" "{\"dcs_id\": \"$DCS\", \"date\": \"$TODAY\", \"shift\": \"EVENING\"}"
expect_status 201 "evening consignment"
CONSIGNMENT2_ID="$(jval "d['data']['id']")"
req POST "/logistics/consignments/$CONSIGNMENT2_ID/dispatch" "$SACHEEV"
expect_status 200 "dispatch evening consignment"
req POST /logistics/trips "$RIDER" "{
  \"route_name\": \"Smoke Route B\", \"union_id\": \"$UNION\",
  \"date\": \"$TODAY\", \"shift\": \"EVENING\",
  \"stops\": [{\"dcs_id\": \"$DCS\", \"consignment_id\": \"$CONSIGNMENT2_ID\"}]
}"
expect_status 201 "evening trip"
TRIP2_ID="$(jval "d['data']['id']")"
req POST "/logistics/trips/$TRIP2_ID/stops/$CONSIGNMENT2_ID/pickup" "$RIDER" '{"temp_c": 4.0}'
expect_status 200 "evening pickup"
req POST "/logistics/trips/$TRIP2_ID/deliver" "$RIDER" "{\"bmc_id\": \"$BMC\"}"
expect_status 200 "evening deliver"
req POST /plant/bmc-lots "$BMCOP" "{
  \"bmc_id\": \"$BMC\", \"date\": \"$TODAY\", \"shift\": \"EVENING\",
  \"consignment_ids\": [\"$CONSIGNMENT2_ID\"]
}"
expect_status 201 "evening bmc lot"
LOT2_ID="$(jval "d['data']['id']")"
req POST "/plant/bmc-lots/$LOT2_ID/close" "$BMCOP" '{"chilling_temp_c": 3.9}'
expect_status 200 "close evening lot"
req POST /quality/qc-results "$BMCOP" "{
  \"subject_type\": \"BMC_LOT\", \"subject_id\": \"$LOT2_ID\", \"stage\": \"BMC_RAPID\",
  \"tests\": [{\"name\": \"AFLATOXIN_M1\", \"value\": 0.9, \"unit\": \"µg/kg\"}]
}"
expect_status 201 "record failing QC"
jassert "d['data']['overall_pass'] is False and len(d['data']['failure_reasons'])>=1" "QC failed with reasons"
req GET "/plant/bmc-lots?bmc_id=$BMC&date=$TODAY" "$BMCOP"
expect_status 200 "list lots after block"
jassert "[l['status'] for l in d['data'] if l['id']=='$LOT2_ID'] == ['BLOCKED']" "lot2 BLOCKED"
# dispatch of blocked lot must refuse
req POST "/plant/bmc-lots/$LOT2_ID/dispatch" "$BMCOP"
expect_status 422 "dispatch of BLOCKED lot"
[[ "$(err_code)" == "SAFETY_GATE_BLOCKED" ]] || fail "expected SAFETY_GATE_BLOCKED on dispatch, got $(err_code)"
# batching the blocked lot must refuse too
PLANTOP_SESSION="$(login 9000000041)"
PLANTOP="$(role_token "$PLANTOP_SESSION" PLANT_OPERATOR)"
req POST /plant/batches "$PLANTOP" "{
  \"plant_id\": \"$PLANT\", \"bmc_lot_ids\": [\"$LOT2_ID\"], \"product_type\": \"TONED_MILK\"
}"
expect_status 422 "batch with BLOCKED lot"
[[ "$(err_code)" == "SAFETY_GATE_BLOCKED" ]] || fail "expected SAFETY_GATE_BLOCKED on batch, got $(err_code)"
pass "blocked lot $LOT2_ID can neither dispatch nor enter a batch (both 422 SAFETY_GATE_BLOCKED)"

# ═══ 15. plant batch: create → lab QC pass → complete ═══════════════════════
step 15 "plant batch from PASSED+DISPATCHED lot → PLANT_LAB pass → COMPLETED"
req POST /plant/batches "$PLANTOP" "{
  \"plant_id\": \"$PLANT\", \"bmc_lot_ids\": [\"$LOT_ID\"], \"product_type\": \"TONED_MILK\"
}"
expect_status 201 "create batch"
BATCH_ID="$(jval "d['data']['id']")"
BATCH_NUMBER="$(jval "d['data']['batch_number']")"
jassert "d['data']['status']=='QC_PENDING'" "batch QC_PENDING"
LAB_SESSION="$(login 9000000042)"
LAB="$(role_token "$LAB_SESSION" PLANT_LAB_ANALYST)"
req POST /quality/qc-results "$LAB" "{
  \"subject_type\": \"PROCESSING_BATCH\", \"subject_id\": \"$BATCH_ID\", \"stage\": \"PLANT_LAB\",
  \"tests\": [
    {\"name\": \"AFLATOXIN_M1\", \"value\": 0.2, \"unit\": \"µg/kg\"},
    {\"name\": \"COLIFORM\", \"value\": 3, \"unit\": \"CFU/ml\"},
    {\"name\": \"PHOSPHATASE\", \"value\": 0, \"unit\": \"0=negative\"}
  ]
}"
expect_status 201 "record PLANT_LAB QC"
jassert "d['data']['overall_pass'] is True" "plant lab QC passed"
req GET "/plant/batches/$BATCH_ID" "$PLANTOP"
expect_status 200 "get batch"
jassert "d['data']['status']=='PASSED'" "batch PASSED"
req POST "/plant/batches/$BATCH_ID/complete" "$PLANTOP"
expect_status 200 "complete batch"
jassert "d['data']['status']=='COMPLETED'" "batch COMPLETED"
pass "batch $BATCH_NUMBER QC_PENDING→PASSED→COMPLETED"

# ═══ 16. product lot + QR ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
step 16 "product lot (PARAG-TM-500, expiry +3d) → QR issue"
req POST /plant/product-lots "$PLANTOP" "{
  \"batch_id\": \"$BATCH_ID\", \"sku\": \"PARAG-TM-500\",
  \"product_name\": \"Parag Toned Milk\", \"units\": 2000, \"unit_size\": \"500ml\",
  \"mrp\": 27.0, \"expiry_date\": \"$EXPIRY\"
}"
expect_status 201 "create product lot"
PRODUCT_LOT_ID="$(jval "d['data']['id']")"
jassert "d['data']['status']=='ACTIVE'" "product lot ACTIVE"
req POST /plant/qrs "$PLANTOP" "{\"product_lot_id\": \"$PRODUCT_LOT_ID\"}"
expect_status 201 "issue QR"
QR_CODE="$(jval "d['data']['qr_code']")"
[[ -n "$QR_CODE" ]] || fail "no qr_code in issue response"
pass "product lot $PRODUCT_LOT_ID labelled with QR $QR_CODE"

# ═══ 17. PUBLIC scan without any token ══════════════════════════════════════
step 17 "public QR scan (no token): samiti set + certificate + intact ledger"
STATUS=""; BODY=""
out="$(curl -sS "${BASE}/public/qr/${QR_CODE}" -w $'\n%{http_code}')" || fail "curl error on public scan"
STATUS="${out##*$'\n'}"; BODY="${out%$'\n'*}"
expect_status 200 "public scan"
jassert "'DCS-01842' in [s['code'] for s in d['data']['sourcing']['samitis']]" "sourcing.samitis contains DCS-01842"
jassert "len(d['data']['quality']['certificate_number'])>0" "quality.certificate_number present"
jassert "d['data']['ledger']['intact'] is True" "ledger.intact true"
jassert "d['data']['product']['sku']=='PARAG-TM-500'" "product SKU on scan"
pass "public scan shows honest provenance + intact chain"

# ═══ 18. public ledger verify ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
step 18 "public ledger verify from=1 → intact"
req GET "/public/ledger/verify?from=1&to=100000" ""
expect_status 200 "ledger verify"
jassert "d['data']['intact'] is True and d['data']['from']==1 and d['data']['to']>=10" "full chain intact"
pass "hash chain verified intact from=1 to=$(jval "d['data']['to']")"

# ═══ 19. settlement: initiate → dual control → execute ══════════════════════
step 19 "settlement: initiate → (self-approve 403) → adhyaksh approve → execute → farmer paid"
req POST /settlements "$SACHEEV" "{\"dcs_id\": \"$DCS\", \"date\": \"$TODAY\"}"
expect_status 201 "initiate settlement"
SETTLEMENT_ID="$(jval "d['data']['id']")"
jassert "d['data']['status']=='PENDING_APPROVAL' and len(d['data']['invoice_ids'])>=2" "batch PENDING_APPROVAL with >=2 invoices"
# dual control: initiator (sacheev) must NOT be able to approve own batch
req POST "/settlements/$SETTLEMENT_ID/approve" "$SACHEEV"
expect_status 403 "sacheev approving own batch"
ADHYAKSH_SESSION="$(login 9000000002)"
ADHYAKSH="$(role_token "$ADHYAKSH_SESSION" SAMITI_ADHYAKSH)"
req POST "/settlements/$SETTLEMENT_ID/approve" "$ADHYAKSH"
expect_status 200 "adhyaksh approve"
jassert "d['data']['status']=='APPROVED'" "batch APPROVED"
req POST "/settlements/$SETTLEMENT_ID/execute" "$ADHYAKSH"
expect_status 200 "execute settlement"
jassert "d['data']['batch']['status']=='EXECUTED' and len(d['data']['payout_instructions'])>=2" "EXECUTED with payouts"
jassert "all(p['status']=='SUCCESS' and p['utr'] for p in d['data']['payout_instructions'])" "all payouts SUCCESS with UTR"
# farmer sees the payout + PAID invoice
req GET /settlements/payouts "$FARMER"
expect_status 200 "farmer payout history"
jassert "any(p['farmer_party_id']=='$FARMER_MAHESH' and p['status']=='SUCCESS' for p in d['data'])" "farmer payout visible"
req GET "/collection/invoices/$MAHESH_INVOICE_ID" "$FARMER"
expect_status 200 "farmer fetches invoice"
jassert "d['data']['status']=='PAID'" "invoice PAID"
pass "settlement $SETTLEMENT_ID dual-controlled and executed; Mahesh paid, invoice PAID"

# ═══ 20. platformops: worker, audit, flags, dormant telemetry ═══════════════
step 20 "platformops: SMS worker, audit logs, flags, dormant collar telemetry"
ADMIN_SESSION="$(login 9999999999)"
ADMIN="$(role_token "$ADMIN_SESSION" SUPER_ADMIN)"
req POST /notifications/worker/run "$ADMIN"
expect_status 200 "run notifications worker"
jassert "d['data']['sent'] > 0" "worker sent > 0 SMS"
WORKER_SENT="$(jval "d['data']['sent']")"
req GET "/audit/logs?limit=5" "$ADMIN"
expect_status 200 "list audit logs"
jassert "d['meta']['total'] > 0 and len(d['data']) > 0" "audit entries exist"
req GET /admin/flags "$ADMIN"
expect_status 200 "list flags"
jassert "[f['enabled'] for f in d['data'] if f['key']=='collar_telemetry_enabled'] == [False]" "collar_telemetry_enabled is false"
req POST /cattle/telemetry "$ADMIN" '{"pashu_aadhaar": "356729481027", "metrics": {"temp_c": 38.6, "steps": 4211}}'
expect_status 403 "telemetry while flag off"
[[ "$(err_code)" == "FEATURE_DISABLED" ]] || fail "expected FEATURE_DISABLED, got $(err_code)"
pass "worker sent=$WORKER_SENT; audit trail live; collar flag off; telemetry 403 FEATURE_DISABLED"

log ""
log "SMOKE PASSED — all 20 steps green (db=$SMOKE_DB, port=$PORT)"
```

```text
11	// part must fail verification.
12	func TestVerifyQRToken(t *testing.T) {

14		const payload = "[REDACTED:generic-api-key]|lot-42"
15		validToken := payload + "." + auth.HMACHash(secret, payload)

17		tests := []struct {

19			token string
20			want  bool
21		}{
22			{
23				name:  "valid token verifies",
24				token: validToken,
25				want:  true,
26			},
27			{
28				name:  "tampered payload fails",
29				token: "[REDACTED:generic-api-key]|lot-43." + auth.HMACHash(secret, payload),
30				want:  false,
31			},
32			{
33				name:  "tampered signature fails",
34				token: payload + "." + auth.HMACHash("wrong-secret", payload),
35				want:  false,
36			},
```

```text
1	// Package provenance implements the append-only, hash-chained event ledger —
2	// the source of truth for milk traceability (blueprint §7). Every link in the
3	// pour→QR chain is an immutable Event whose SHA-256 hash covers the previous
4	// event's hash, so history cannot be quietly rewritten (tamper-evidence,
5	// FSSAI recall-grade audit).
6	//
7	// Corrections are NEW events referencing the superseded entity — nothing is
8	// ever updated or deleted in this collection.
9	package provenance
10	
11	import (
12		"context"
13		"crypto/sha256"
14		"encoding/hex"
15		"encoding/json"
16		"errors"
17		"fmt"
18		"strconv"
19		"strings"
20		"time"
21	
22		"github.com/google/uuid"
23		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
24		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
25		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo/options"
26	)
27	
28	const collection = "provenance_events"
29	
30	// Ref is a directed edge to another entity in the trace graph
31	// (e.g. a consignment event referencing the pours it aggregates).
32	type Ref struct {
33		EntityType string `bson:"entity_type" json:"entity_type"`
34		EntityID   string `bson:"entity_id"   json:"entity_id"`
35		Relation   string `bson:"relation"    json:"relation"` // aggregates | supersedes | tested | yields | labels ...
36	}
37	
38	// ActorRef records who caused the event.
39	type ActorRef struct {
40		PartyID  string `bson:"party_id"  json:"party_id"`
41		RoleCode string `bson:"role_code" json:"role_code"`
42	}
43	
44	// Event is one immutable link in the ledger.
45	type Event struct {
46		ID         string         `bson:"_id"         json:"id"`
47		Seq        int64          `bson:"seq"         json:"seq"`
48		Type       string         `bson:"type"        json:"type"`
49		EntityType string         `bson:"entity_type" json:"entity_type"`
50		EntityID   string         `bson:"entity_id"   json:"entity_id"`
51		Refs       []Ref          `bson:"refs,omitempty"    json:"refs,omitempty"`
52		Actor      ActorRef       `bson:"actor"       json:"actor"`
53		OrgUnitID  string         `bson:"org_unit_id,omitempty" json:"org_unit_id,omitempty"`
54		Payload    map[string]any `bson:"payload,omitempty"     json:"payload,omitempty"`
55		TS         time.Time      `bson:"ts"          json:"ts"`
56		PrevHash   string         `bson:"prev_hash"   json:"prev_hash"`
57		Hash       string         `bson:"hash"        json:"hash"`
58	}
59	
60	// AppendInput describes a new event to chain.
61	type AppendInput struct {
62		Type       string
63		EntityType string
64		EntityID   string
65		Refs       []Ref
66		Actor      ActorRef
67		OrgUnitID  string
68		Payload    map[string]any
69	}
70	
71	// Ledger appends to and reads the hash chain.
72	type Ledger struct {
73		coll *mongo.Collection
74	}
75	
76	// NewLedger binds the ledger to the database.
77	func NewLedger(db *mongo.Database) *Ledger {
78		return &Ledger{coll: db.Collection(collection)}
79	}
80	
81	// genesisHash anchors the chain before the first event.
82	const genesisHash = "GENESIS"
83	
84	// Append chains a new event. Concurrency-safe without transactions: it reads
85	// the current head, computes seq+hash optimistically, and relies on the
86	// unique index on `seq` — a duplicate-key collision means another writer won
87	// the slot, so we re-read and retry.
88	func (l *Ledger) Append(ctx context.Context, in AppendInput) (*Event, error) {
89		const maxRetries = 12
90		for attempt := 0; attempt < maxRetries; attempt++ {
91			seq, prevHash, err := l.head(ctx)
92			if err != nil {
93				return nil, err
94			}
95			ev := &Event{
96				ID:         uuid.NewString(),
97				Seq:        seq + 1,
98				Type:       in.Type,
99				EntityType: in.EntityType,
100				EntityID:   in.EntityID,
101				Refs:       in.Refs,
102				Actor:      in.Actor,
103				OrgUnitID:  in.OrgUnitID,
104				Payload:    in.Payload,
105				TS:         time.Now().UTC(),
106				PrevHash:   prevHash,
107			}
108			ev.Hash = computeHash(ev)
109	
110			if _, err := l.coll.InsertOne(ctx, ev); err != nil {
111				if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(err) {
112					continue // lost the seq race — retry against the new head
113				}
114				return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance append: %w", err)
115			}
116			return ev, nil
117		}
118		return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance append: gave up after %d seq collisions", 12)
119	}
120	
121	// head returns the latest (seq, hash), or (0, GENESIS) for an empty chain.
122	func (l *Ledger) head(ctx context.Context) (int64, string, error) {
123		var last Event
124		err := l.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{},
125			options.FindOne().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: -1}}),
126		).Decode(&last)
127		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
128			return 0, genesisHash, nil
129		}
130		if err != nil {
131			return 0, "", fmt.Errorf("provenance head: %w", err)
132		}
133		return last.Seq, last.Hash, nil
134	}
135	
136	// computeHash covers everything that matters: position, linkage, content.
137	// Payload is canonicalised via encoding/json (map keys are sorted), so the
138	// digest is deterministic.
139	func computeHash(ev *Event) string {
140		payloadJSON, _ := json.Marshal(ev.Payload)
141		refParts := make([]string, 0, len(ev.Refs))
142		for _, r := range ev.Refs {
143			refParts = append(refParts, r.EntityType+":"+r.EntityID+":"+r.Relation)
144		}
145		material := strings.Join([]string{
146			ev.PrevHash,
147			strconv.FormatInt(ev.Seq, 10),
148			ev.Type,
149			ev.EntityType,
150			ev.EntityID,
151			strings.Join(refParts, ","),
152			ev.Actor.PartyID,
153			ev.Actor.RoleCode,
154			ev.OrgUnitID,
155			string(payloadJSON),
156			ev.TS.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
157		}, "|")
158		sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(material))
159		return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
160	}
161	
162	// EventsForEntity returns an entity's own timeline in chain order.
163	func (l *Ledger) EventsForEntity(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string) ([]Event, error) {
164		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
165			bson.D{{Key: "entity_type", Value: entityType}, {Key: "entity_id", Value: entityID}},
166			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}),
167		)
168		if err != nil {
169			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance events for %s/%s: %w", entityType, entityID, err)
170		}
171		var out []Event
172		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
173			return nil, err
174		}
175		return out, nil
176	}
177	
178	// Trace walks the provenance graph UPSTREAM from an entity: its events, plus
179	// (recursively) the events of everything those events reference. This is how
180	// a consumer QR resolves back to the contributing samiti set, and how a failed
181	// aflatoxin test walks back to source DCSes (blueprint §8.3).
182	func (l *Ledger) Trace(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, maxDepth int) ([]Event, error) {
183		if maxDepth <= 0 {
184			maxDepth = 10
185		}
186		const hardEventCap = 2000
187	
188		type node struct{ etype, eid string }
189		visited := map[node]bool{}
190		frontier := []node{{entityType, entityID}}
191		var all []Event
192	
193		for depth := 0; depth < maxDepth && len(frontier) > 0; depth++ {
194			var next []node
195			for _, n := range frontier {
196				if visited[n] {
197					continue
198				}
199				visited[n] = true
200				evs, err := l.EventsForEntity(ctx, n.etype, n.eid)
201				if err != nil {
202					return nil, err
203				}
204				for _, ev := range evs {
205					all = append(all, ev)
206					if len(all) >= hardEventCap {
207						return all, nil
208					}
209					for _, ref := range ev.Refs {
210						nn := node{ref.EntityType, ref.EntityID}
211						if !visited[nn] {
212							next = append(next, nn)
213						}
214					}
215				}
216			}
217			frontier = next
218		}
219		return all, nil
220	}
221	
222	// DownstreamRefs finds events that reference the given entity — used to walk
223	// FORWARD (e.g. "which batches consumed this blocked BMC lot?").
224	func (l *Ledger) DownstreamRefs(ctx context.Context, entityID string) ([]Event, error) {
225		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
226			bson.D{{Key: "refs.entity_id", Value: entityID}},
227			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}),
228		)
229		if err != nil {
230			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance downstream of %s: %w", entityID, err)
231		}
232		var out []Event
233		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
234			return nil, err
235		}
236		return out, nil
237	}
238	
239	// VerifyChain re-derives every hash in [fromSeq, toSeq] and checks linkage.
240	// Returns (true, 0) when intact, or (false, seq) of the first broken link.
241	func (l *Ledger) VerifyChain(ctx context.Context, fromSeq, toSeq int64) (bool, int64, error) {
242		filter := bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$gte", Value: fromSeq}, {Key: "$lte", Value: toSeq}}}}
243		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}))
244		if err != nil {
245			return false, 0, fmt.Errorf("provenance verify: %w", err)
246		}
247		defer cur.Close(ctx)
248	
249		prevHash := ""
250		prevSeq := int64(0)
251		first := true
252		for cur.Next(ctx) {
253			var ev Event
254			if err := cur.Decode(&ev); err != nil {
255				return false, 0, err
256			}
257			if computeHash(&ev) != ev.Hash {
258				return false, ev.Seq, nil // content tampered
259			}
260			if !first {
261				if ev.Seq != prevSeq+1 || ev.PrevHash != prevHash {
262					return false, ev.Seq, nil // linkage broken
263				}
264			}
265			prevHash, prevSeq, first = ev.Hash, ev.Seq, false
266		}
267		return true, 0, cur.Err()
268	}
269	
270	// LatestSeq returns the current chain head sequence (0 = empty).
271	func (l *Ledger) LatestSeq(ctx context.Context) (int64, error) {
272		seq, _, err := l.head(ctx)
273		return seq, err
274	}
```

```text
1	package httpx
2	
3	import (
4		"encoding/json"
5		"errors"
6		"log/slog"
7		"net/http"
8	)
9	
10	// envelope is the uniform success shape: {"data": ..., "meta": {...}?}.
11	type envelope struct {
12		Data any `json:"data"`
13		Meta any `json:"meta,omitempty"`
14	}
15	
16	type errEnvelope struct {
17		Error *AppError `json:"error"`
18	}
19	
20	// JSON writes a success response wrapped in the standard envelope.
21	func JSON(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, data any) {
22		writeJSON(w, status, envelope{Data: data})
23	}
24	
25	// JSONMeta writes a success response with list metadata (pagination etc.).
26	func JSONMeta(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, data, meta any) {
27		writeJSON(w, status, envelope{Data: data, Meta: meta})
28	}
29	
30	// Error writes the standard error envelope. Unexpected (non-AppError) errors
31	// become an opaque 500 and the cause is logged with the request context.
32	func Error(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, err error) {
33		var ae *AppError
34		if !errors.As(err, &ae) {
35			ae = Internal(err)
36		}
37		if ae.Status >= 500 {
38			slog.ErrorContext(r.Context(), "request failed",
39				slog.String("method", r.Method),
40				slog.String("path", r.URL.Path),
41				slog.String("code", ae.Code),
42				slog.Any("cause", ae.CauseOrSelf()),
43			)
44		}
45		writeJSON(w, ae.Status, errEnvelope{Error: ae})
46	}
47	
48	// CauseOrSelf returns the wrapped cause if present, else the error itself.
49	func (e *AppError) CauseOrSelf() error {
50		if e.cause != nil {
51			return e.cause
52		}
53		return e
54	}
55	
56	func writeJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, v any) {
57		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
58		w.WriteHeader(status)
59		_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(v)
60	}
```

```text
1	// Package httpx is the HTTP toolkit shared by every module: typed errors,
2	// uniform JSON envelopes, strict request decoding, pagination.
3	package httpx
4	
5	import (
6		"fmt"
7		"net/http"
8	)
9	
10	// AppError is the single error type handlers return. It carries the HTTP
11	// status plus a stable machine-readable code the frontend can switch on.
12	type AppError struct {
13		Status  int    `json:"-"`
14		Code    string `json:"code"`
15		Message string `json:"message"`
16		Details any    `json:"details,omitempty"`
17	
18		cause error // wrapped internal error — logged server-side, never serialised
19	}
20	
21	func (e *AppError) Error() string {
22		return fmt.Sprintf("%d %s: %s", e.Status, e.Code, e.Message)
23	}
24	
25	// WithDetails returns a copy carrying extra structured context.
26	func (e *AppError) WithDetails(d any) *AppError {
27		cp := *e
28		cp.Details = d
29		return &cp
30	}
31	
32	func newErr(status int, code, msg string) *AppError {
33		return &AppError{Status: status, Code: code, Message: msg}
34	}
35	
36	// Constructors — use these instead of raw errors in handlers/services.
37	
38	func BadRequest(code, msg string) *AppError { return newErr(http.StatusBadRequest, code, msg) }
39	
40	func Unauthorized(msg string) *AppError { return newErr(http.StatusUnauthorized, "UNAUTHORIZED", msg) }
41	
42	func Forbidden(msg string) *AppError { return newErr(http.StatusForbidden, "FORBIDDEN", msg) }
43	
44	func NotFound(resource string) *AppError {
45		return newErr(http.StatusNotFound, "NOT_FOUND", resource+" not found")
46	}
47	
48	func Conflict(code, msg string) *AppError { return newErr(http.StatusConflict, code, msg) }
49	
50	func Unprocessable(code, msg string) *AppError {
51		return newErr(http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, code, msg)
52	}
53	
54	func TooManyRequests(msg string) *AppError {
55		return newErr(http.StatusTooManyRequests, "RATE_LIMITED", msg)
56	}
57	
58	// Internal wraps an unexpected error. The cause is logged server-side but
59	// never leaked to the client.
60	func Internal(err error) *AppError {
61		e := newErr(http.StatusInternalServerError, "INTERNAL", "internal server error")
62		e.cause = err
63		return e
64	}
65	
66	func (e *AppError) Unwrap() error { return e.cause }
67
```

```text
1	package httpx
2	
3	import (
4		"encoding/json"
5		"errors"
6		"fmt"
7		"io"
8		"net/http"
9		"strconv"
10	)
11	
12	// maxBodyBytes caps request bodies at 1 MiB — pours, readings and admin
13	// payloads are all tiny; photo evidence goes to the object store, not the API.
14	const maxBodyBytes = 1 << 20
15	
16	// DecodeJSON strictly decodes the request body into dst. It enforces the
17	// size cap and exactly one JSON value.
18	func DecodeJSON(r *http.Request, dst any) error {
19		r.Body = http.MaxBytesReader(nil, r.Body, maxBodyBytes)
20		dec := json.NewDecoder(r.Body)
21		if err := dec.Decode(dst); err != nil {
22			var maxErr *http.MaxBytesError
23			switch {
24			case errors.As(err, &maxErr):
25				return BadRequest("BODY_TOO_LARGE", fmt.Sprintf("request body exceeds %d bytes", maxBodyBytes))
26			case errors.Is(err, io.EOF):
27				return BadRequest("EMPTY_BODY", "request body is required")
28			default:
29				return BadRequest("MALFORMED_JSON", "request body is not valid JSON: "+err.Error())
30			}
31		}
32		if dec.More() {
33			return BadRequest("MALFORMED_JSON", "request body must contain a single JSON value")
34		}
35		return nil
36	}
37	
38	// Page holds validated pagination parameters.
39	type Page struct {
40		Limit  int64 `json:"limit"`
41		Offset int64 `json:"offset"`
42	}
43	
44	// ParsePage reads ?limit= and ?offset= with sane bounds (default 50, max 200).
45	func ParsePage(r *http.Request) Page {
46		p := Page{Limit: 50, Offset: 0}
47		if v := r.URL.Query().Get("limit"); v != "" {
48			if n, err := strconv.ParseInt(v, 10, 64); err == nil && n > 0 {
49				p.Limit = min(n, 200)
50			}
51		}
52		if v := r.URL.Query().Get("offset"); v != "" {
53			if n, err := strconv.ParseInt(v, 10, 64); err == nil && n >= 0 {
54				p.Offset = n
55			}
56		}
57		return p
58	}
59
```

```text
29	type RateChart struct {

42	// PricePour computes (ratePerLitre, amount) for a pour, rounded to paise.
43	func (rc RateChart) PricePour(fatPct, snfPct, qtyLitres float64) (rate, amount float64) {
44		rate = rc.BaseRatePerLitre + fatPct*rc.FatRatePerPoint + snfPct*rc.SNFRatePerPoint
45		rate = math.Round(rate*100) / 100
46		amount = math.Round(rate*qtyLitres*100) / 100
47		return rate, amount

92	// CheckPlausibility validates fat/SNF/qty against physical bounds and returns
93	// the violated flags (empty slice = plausible).
94	func CheckPlausibility(fatPct, snfPct, qtyLitres float64) []string {
95		var flags []string
96		if fatPct < PlausibleFatMin || fatPct > PlausibleFatMax ||
97			snfPct < PlausibleSNFMin || snfPct > PlausibleSNFMax {
98			flags = append(flags, IntegrityFlagImplausibleValue)
99		}
100		if qtyLitres != 0 && (qtyLitres < PlausibleQtyMin || qtyLitres > PlausibleQtyMax) {
101			flags = append(flags, IntegrityFlagImplausibleValue)
102		}
103		return flags
104	}
```

```text
1	// Package httpapi assembles the HTTP surface: global middleware, operational
2	// endpoints (health/readiness/metrics/version), and the /api/v1 tree where
3	// every domain module mounts its routes.
4	package httpapi
5	
6	import (
7		"context"
8		"net/http"
9		"time"
10	
11		"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
12		chimw "github.com/go-chi/chi/v5/middleware"
13		"github.com/prometheus/client_golang/prometheus/promhttp"
14	
15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
16		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
17		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/middleware"
18	)
19	
20	// Version is stamped via -ldflags at release build time.
21	var Version = "0.1.0-dev"
22	
23	// New builds the fully wired HTTP handler.
24	func New(d *deps.Deps) http.Handler {
25		r := chi.NewRouter()
26	
27		// Order matters: recover innermost-last so panics in anything above are caught.
28		r.Use(chimw.RequestID)
29		r.Use(chimw.RealIP)
30		r.Use(middleware.Metrics)
31		r.Use(middleware.PerIPRateLimit(d.Cfg.RateLimitRPS, d.Cfg.RateLimitBurst))
32		r.Use(chimw.Recoverer)
33		r.Use(chimw.Timeout(30 * time.Second))
34	
35		// Operational endpoints — outside /api/v1, never authenticated.
36		r.Get("/healthz", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
37			httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{"status": "ok"})
38		})
39		r.Get("/readyz", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
40			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 2*time.Second)
41			defer cancel()
42			if err := d.DB.Client().Ping(ctx, nil); err != nil {
43				httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Internal(err))
44				return
45			}
46			httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{"status": "ready"})
47		})
48		r.Handle("/metrics", promhttp.Handler())
49		r.Get("/version", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
50			httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{"version": Version, "service": "saathi-backend"})
51		})
52	
53		r.Route("/api/v1", func(api chi.Router) {
54			api.Use(middleware.AuditMutations(d.Audit))
55			RegisterModules(api, d)
56		})
57	
58		return r
59	}
60
```

```text
19	// RegisterModules mounts every domain module under /api/v1.
20	//
21	// Module contract: each package under internal/modules/<name> exposes
22	//
23	//	func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps)
24	//
25	// and mounts its own subtree with its own auth/RBAC middleware. Modules are
26	// the future microservice seams — they may import domain and platform
27	// packages, but NEVER each other; cross-module reactions go through the
28	// event bus.
29	func RegisterModules(api chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {

35		cattle.Register(api, d)
36		collection.Register(api, d)
37		logistics.Register(api, d)
38		plant.Register(api, d)
39		quality.Register(api, d)
40		settlement.Register(api, d)
```

```text
1	// Package provenance implements the append-only, hash-chained event ledger —
2	// the source of truth for milk traceability (blueprint §7). Every link in the
3	// pour→QR chain is an immutable Event whose SHA-256 hash covers the previous
4	// event's hash, so history cannot be quietly rewritten (tamper-evidence,
5	// FSSAI recall-grade audit).
6	//
7	// Corrections are NEW events referencing the superseded entity — nothing is
8	// ever updated or deleted in this collection.
9	package provenance
10	
11	import (
12		"context"
13		"crypto/sha256"
14		"encoding/hex"
15		"encoding/json"
16		"errors"
17		"fmt"
18		"strconv"
19		"strings"
20		"time"
21	
22		"github.com/google/uuid"
23		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
24		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
25		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo/options"
26	)
27	
28	const collection = "provenance_events"
29	
30	// Ref is a directed edge to another entity in the trace graph
31	// (e.g. a consignment event referencing the pours it aggregates).
32	type Ref struct {
33		EntityType string `bson:"entity_type" json:"entity_type"`
34		EntityID   string `bson:"entity_id"   json:"entity_id"`
35		Relation   string `bson:"relation"    json:"relation"` // aggregates | supersedes | tested | yields | labels ...
36	}
37	
38	// ActorRef records who caused the event.
39	type ActorRef struct {
40		PartyID  string `bson:"party_id"  json:"party_id"`
41		RoleCode string `bson:"role_code" json:"role_code"`
42	}
43	
44	// Event is one immutable link in the ledger.
45	type Event struct {
46		ID         string         `bson:"_id"         json:"id"`
47		Seq        int64          `bson:"seq"         json:"seq"`
48		Type       string         `bson:"type"        json:"type"`
49		EntityType string         `bson:"entity_type" json:"entity_type"`
50		EntityID   string         `bson:"entity_id"   json:"entity_id"`
51		Refs       []Ref          `bson:"refs,omitempty"    json:"refs,omitempty"`
52		Actor      ActorRef       `bson:"actor"       json:"actor"`
53		OrgUnitID  string         `bson:"org_unit_id,omitempty" json:"org_unit_id,omitempty"`
54		Payload    map[string]any `bson:"payload,omitempty"     json:"payload,omitempty"`
55		TS         time.Time      `bson:"ts"          json:"ts"`
56		PrevHash   string         `bson:"prev_hash"   json:"prev_hash"`
57		Hash       string         `bson:"hash"        json:"hash"`
58	}
59	
60	// AppendInput describes a new event to chain.
61	type AppendInput struct {
62		Type       string
63		EntityType string
64		EntityID   string
65		Refs       []Ref
66		Actor      ActorRef
67		OrgUnitID  string
68		Payload    map[string]any
69	}
70	
71	// Ledger appends to and reads the hash chain.
72	type Ledger struct {
73		coll *mongo.Collection
74	}
75	
76	// NewLedger binds the ledger to the database.
77	func NewLedger(db *mongo.Database) *Ledger {
78		return &Ledger{coll: db.Collection(collection)}
79	}
80	
81	// genesisHash anchors the chain before the first event.
82	const genesisHash = "GENESIS"
83	
84	// Append chains a new event. Concurrency-safe without transactions: it reads
85	// the current head, computes seq+hash optimistically, and relies on the
86	// unique index on `seq` — a duplicate-key collision means another writer won
87	// the slot, so we re-read and retry.
88	func (l *Ledger) Append(ctx context.Context, in AppendInput) (*Event, error) {
89		const maxRetries = 12
90		for attempt := 0; attempt < maxRetries; attempt++ {
91			seq, prevHash, err := l.head(ctx)
92			if err != nil {
93				return nil, err
94			}
95			ev := &Event{
96				ID:         uuid.NewString(),
97				Seq:        seq + 1,
98				Type:       in.Type,
99				EntityType: in.EntityType,
100				EntityID:   in.EntityID,
101				Refs:       in.Refs,
102				Actor:      in.Actor,
103				OrgUnitID:  in.OrgUnitID,
104				Payload:    in.Payload,
105				// Millisecond precision: BSON datetimes store ms, so the persisted
106				// TS must equal the hashed TS or re-verification would break.
107				TS:       time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Millisecond),
108				PrevHash: prevHash,
109			}
110			ev.Hash = computeHash(ev)
111	
112			if _, err := l.coll.InsertOne(ctx, ev); err != nil {
113				if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(err) {
114					continue // lost the seq race — retry against the new head
115				}
116				return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance append: %w", err)
117			}
118			return ev, nil
119		}
120		return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance append: gave up after %d seq collisions", 12)
121	}
122	
123	// head returns the latest (seq, hash), or (0, GENESIS) for an empty chain.
124	func (l *Ledger) head(ctx context.Context) (int64, string, error) {
125		var last Event
126		err := l.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{},
127			options.FindOne().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: -1}}),
128		).Decode(&last)
129		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
130			return 0, genesisHash, nil
131		}
132		if err != nil {
133			return 0, "", fmt.Errorf("provenance head: %w", err)
134		}
135		return last.Seq, last.Hash, nil
136	}
137	
138	// computeHash covers everything that matters: position, linkage, content.
139	// Payload is canonicalised via encoding/json (map keys are sorted) and the
140	// timestamp to millisecond precision (BSON datetime resolution), so the
141	// digest is deterministic across a MongoDB round trip.
142	func computeHash(ev *Event) string {
143		payloadJSON, _ := json.Marshal(ev.Payload)
144		refParts := make([]string, 0, len(ev.Refs))
145		for _, r := range ev.Refs {
146			refParts = append(refParts, r.EntityType+":"+r.EntityID+":"+r.Relation)
147		}
148		material := strings.Join([]string{
149			ev.PrevHash,
150			strconv.FormatInt(ev.Seq, 10),
151			ev.Type,
152			ev.EntityType,
153			ev.EntityID,
154			strings.Join(refParts, ","),
155			ev.Actor.PartyID,
156			ev.Actor.RoleCode,
157			ev.OrgUnitID,
158			string(payloadJSON),
159			ev.TS.UTC().Truncate(time.Millisecond).Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
160		}, "|")
161		sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(material))
162		return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
163	}
164	
165	// EventsForEntity returns an entity's own timeline in chain order.
166	func (l *Ledger) EventsForEntity(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string) ([]Event, error) {
167		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
168			bson.D{{Key: "entity_type", Value: entityType}, {Key: "entity_id", Value: entityID}},
169			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}),
170		)
171		if err != nil {
172			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance events for %s/%s: %w", entityType, entityID, err)
173		}
174		var out []Event
175		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
176			return nil, err
177		}
178		return out, nil
179	}
180	
181	// Trace walks the provenance graph UPSTREAM from an entity: its events, plus
182	// (recursively) the events of everything those events reference. This is how
183	// a consumer QR resolves back to the contributing samiti set, and how a failed
184	// aflatoxin test walks back to source DCSes (blueprint §8.3).
185	func (l *Ledger) Trace(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, maxDepth int) ([]Event, error) {
186		if maxDepth <= 0 {
187			maxDepth = 10
188		}
189		const hardEventCap = 2000
190	
191		type node struct{ etype, eid string }
192		visited := map[node]bool{}
193		frontier := []node{{entityType, entityID}}
194		var all []Event
195	
196		for depth := 0; depth < maxDepth && len(frontier) > 0; depth++ {
197			var next []node
198			for _, n := range frontier {
199				if visited[n] {
200					continue
201				}
202				visited[n] = true
203				evs, err := l.EventsForEntity(ctx, n.etype, n.eid)
204				if err != nil {
205					return nil, err
206				}
207				for _, ev := range evs {
208					all = append(all, ev)
209					if len(all) >= hardEventCap {
210						return all, nil
211					}
212					for _, ref := range ev.Refs {
213						nn := node{ref.EntityType, ref.EntityID}
214						if !visited[nn] {
215							next = append(next, nn)
216						}
217					}
218				}
219			}
220			frontier = next
221		}
222		return all, nil
223	}
224	
225	// DownstreamRefs finds events that reference the given entity — used to walk
226	// FORWARD (e.g. "which batches consumed this blocked BMC lot?").
227	func (l *Ledger) DownstreamRefs(ctx context.Context, entityID string) ([]Event, error) {
228		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
229			bson.D{{Key: "refs.entity_id", Value: entityID}},
230			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}),
231		)
232		if err != nil {
233			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance downstream of %s: %w", entityID, err)
234		}
235		var out []Event
236		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
237			return nil, err
238		}
239		return out, nil
240	}
241	
242	// VerifyChain re-derives every hash in [fromSeq, toSeq] and checks linkage.
243	// Returns (true, 0) when intact, or (false, seq) of the first broken link.
244	func (l *Ledger) VerifyChain(ctx context.Context, fromSeq, toSeq int64) (bool, int64, error) {
245		filter := bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$gte", Value: fromSeq}, {Key: "$lte", Value: toSeq}}}}
246		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}))
247		if err != nil {
248			return false, 0, fmt.Errorf("provenance verify: %w", err)
249		}
250		defer cur.Close(ctx)
251	
252		prevHash := ""
253		prevSeq := int64(0)
254		first := true
255		for cur.Next(ctx) {
256			var ev Event
257			if err := cur.Decode(&ev); err != nil {
258				return false, 0, err
259			}
260			if computeHash(&ev) != ev.Hash {
261				return false, ev.Seq, nil // content tampered
262			}
263			if !first {
264				if ev.Seq != prevSeq+1 || ev.PrevHash != prevHash {
265					return false, ev.Seq, nil // linkage broken
266				}
267			}
268			prevHash, prevSeq, first = ev.Hash, ev.Seq, false
269		}
270		return true, 0, cur.Err()
271	}
272	
273	// LatestSeq returns the current chain head sequence (0 = empty).
274	func (l *Ledger) LatestSeq(ctx context.Context) (int64, error) {
275		seq, _, err := l.head(ctx)
276		return seq, err
277	}
```

```text
1	// Package provenance implements the append-only, hash-chained event ledger —
2	// the source of truth for milk traceability (blueprint §7). Every link in the
3	// pour→QR chain is an immutable Event whose SHA-256 hash covers the previous
4	// event's hash, so history cannot be quietly rewritten (tamper-evidence,
5	// FSSAI recall-grade audit).
6	//
7	// Corrections are NEW events referencing the superseded entity — nothing is
8	// ever updated or deleted in this collection.
9	package provenance
10	
11	import (
12		"context"
13		"crypto/sha256"
14		"encoding/hex"
15		"encoding/json"
16		"errors"
17		"fmt"
18		"strconv"
19		"strings"
20		"time"
21	
22		"github.com/google/uuid"
23		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
24		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
25		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo/options"
26	)
27	
28	const collection = "provenance_events"
29	
30	// Ref is a directed edge to another entity in the trace graph
31	// (e.g. a consignment event referencing the pours it aggregates).
32	type Ref struct {
33		EntityType string `bson:"entity_type" json:"entity_type"`
34		EntityID   string `bson:"entity_id"   json:"entity_id"`
35		Relation   string `bson:"relation"    json:"relation"` // aggregates | supersedes | tested | yields | labels ...
36	}
37	
38	// ActorRef records who caused the event.
39	type ActorRef struct {
40		PartyID  string `bson:"party_id"  json:"party_id"`
41		RoleCode string `bson:"role_code" json:"role_code"`
42	}
43	
44	// Event is one immutable link in the ledger.
45	type Event struct {
46		ID         string         `bson:"_id"         json:"id"`
47		Seq        int64          `bson:"seq"         json:"seq"`
48		Type       string         `bson:"type"        json:"type"`
49		EntityType string         `bson:"entity_type" json:"entity_type"`
50		EntityID   string         `bson:"entity_id"   json:"entity_id"`
51		Refs       []Ref          `bson:"refs,omitempty"    json:"refs,omitempty"`
52		Actor      ActorRef       `bson:"actor"       json:"actor"`
53		OrgUnitID  string         `bson:"org_unit_id,omitempty" json:"org_unit_id,omitempty"`
54		Payload    map[string]any `bson:"payload,omitempty"     json:"payload,omitempty"`
55		TS         time.Time      `bson:"ts"          json:"ts"`
56		PrevHash   string         `bson:"prev_hash"   json:"prev_hash"`
57		Hash       string         `bson:"hash"        json:"hash"`
58	}
59	
60	// AppendInput describes a new event to chain.
61	type AppendInput struct {
62		Type       string
63		EntityType string
64		EntityID   string
65		Refs       []Ref
66		Actor      ActorRef
67		OrgUnitID  string
68		Payload    map[string]any
69	}
70	
71	// Ledger appends to and reads the hash chain.
72	type Ledger struct {
73		coll *mongo.Collection
74	}
75	
76	// NewLedger binds the ledger to the database.
77	func NewLedger(db *mongo.Database) *Ledger {
78		return &Ledger{coll: db.Collection(collection)}
79	}
80	
81	// genesisHash anchors the chain before the first event.
82	const genesisHash = "GENESIS"
83	
84	// Append chains a new event. Concurrency-safe without transactions: it reads
85	// the current head, computes seq+hash optimistically, and relies on the
86	// unique index on `seq` — a duplicate-key collision means another writer won
87	// the slot, so we re-read and retry.
88	func (l *Ledger) Append(ctx context.Context, in AppendInput) (*Event, error) {
89		const maxRetries = 12
90		for attempt := 0; attempt < maxRetries; attempt++ {
91			seq, prevHash, err := l.head(ctx)
92			if err != nil {
93				return nil, err
94			}
95			ev := &Event{
96				ID:         uuid.NewString(),
97				Seq:        seq + 1,
98				Type:       in.Type,
99				EntityType: in.EntityType,
100				EntityID:   in.EntityID,
101				Refs:       in.Refs,
102				Actor:      in.Actor,
103				OrgUnitID:  in.OrgUnitID,
104				Payload:    in.Payload,
105				// Millisecond precision: BSON datetimes store ms, so the persisted
106				// TS must equal the hashed TS or re-verification would break.
107				TS:       time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Millisecond),
108				PrevHash: prevHash,
109			}
110			ev.Hash = computeHash(ev)
111	
112			if _, err := l.coll.InsertOne(ctx, ev); err != nil {
113				if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(err) {
114					continue // lost the seq race — retry against the new head
115				}
116				return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance append: %w", err)
117			}
118			return ev, nil
119		}
120		return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance append: gave up after %d seq collisions", 12)
121	}
122	
123	// head returns the latest (seq, hash), or (0, GENESIS) for an empty chain.
124	func (l *Ledger) head(ctx context.Context) (int64, string, error) {
125		var last Event
126		err := l.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{},
127			options.FindOne().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: -1}}),
128		).Decode(&last)
129		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
130			return 0, genesisHash, nil
131		}
132		if err != nil {
133			return 0, "", fmt.Errorf("provenance head: %w", err)
134		}
135		return last.Seq, last.Hash, nil
136	}
137	
138	// computeHash covers everything that matters: position, linkage, content.
139	// Payload is canonicalised via encoding/json (map keys are sorted) and the
140	// timestamp to millisecond precision (BSON datetime resolution), so the
141	// digest is deterministic across a MongoDB round trip.
142	func computeHash(ev *Event) string {
143		payloadJSON, _ := json.Marshal(ev.Payload)
144		refParts := make([]string, 0, len(ev.Refs))
145		for _, r := range ev.Refs {
146			refParts = append(refParts, r.EntityType+":"+r.EntityID+":"+r.Relation)
147		}
148		material := strings.Join([]string{
149			ev.PrevHash,
150			strconv.FormatInt(ev.Seq, 10),
151			ev.Type,
152			ev.EntityType,
153			ev.EntityID,
154			strings.Join(refParts, ","),
155			ev.Actor.PartyID,
156			ev.Actor.RoleCode,
157			ev.OrgUnitID,
158			string(payloadJSON),
159			ev.TS.UTC().Truncate(time.Millisecond).Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
160		}, "|")
161		sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(material))
162		return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
163	}
164	
165	// EventsForEntity returns an entity's own timeline in chain order.
166	func (l *Ledger) EventsForEntity(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string) ([]Event, error) {
167		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
168			bson.D{{Key: "entity_type", Value: entityType}, {Key: "entity_id", Value: entityID}},
169			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}),
170		)
171		if err != nil {
172			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance events for %s/%s: %w", entityType, entityID, err)
173		}
174		var out []Event
175		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
176			return nil, err
177		}
178		return out, nil
179	}
180	
181	// Trace walks the provenance graph UPSTREAM from an entity: its events, plus
182	// (recursively) the events of everything those events reference. This is how
183	// a consumer QR resolves back to the contributing samiti set, and how a failed
184	// aflatoxin test walks back to source DCSes (blueprint §8.3).
185	func (l *Ledger) Trace(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, maxDepth int) ([]Event, error) {
186		if maxDepth <= 0 {
187			maxDepth = 10
188		}
189		const hardEventCap = 2000
190	
191		type node struct{ etype, eid string }
192		visited := map[node]bool{}
193		frontier := []node{{entityType, entityID}}
194		var all []Event
195	
196		for depth := 0; depth < maxDepth && len(frontier) > 0; depth++ {
197			var next []node
198			for _, n := range frontier {
199				if visited[n] {
200					continue
201				}
202				visited[n] = true
203				evs, err := l.EventsForEntity(ctx, n.etype, n.eid)
204				if err != nil {
205					return nil, err
206				}
207				for _, ev := range evs {
208					all = append(all, ev)
209					if len(all) >= hardEventCap {
210						return all, nil
211					}
212					for _, ref := range ev.Refs {
213						nn := node{ref.EntityType, ref.EntityID}
214						if !visited[nn] {
215							next = append(next, nn)
216						}
217					}
218				}
219			}
220			frontier = next
221		}
222		return all, nil
223	}
224	
225	// DownstreamRefs finds events that reference the given entity — used to walk
226	// FORWARD (e.g. "which batches consumed this blocked BMC lot?").
227	func (l *Ledger) DownstreamRefs(ctx context.Context, entityID string) ([]Event, error) {
228		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
229			bson.D{{Key: "refs.entity_id", Value: entityID}},
230			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}),
231		)
232		if err != nil {
233			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance downstream of %s: %w", entityID, err)
234		}
235		var out []Event
236		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
237			return nil, err
238		}
239		return out, nil
240	}
241	
242	// VerifyChain re-derives every hash in [fromSeq, toSeq] and checks linkage.
243	// Returns (true, 0) when intact, or (false, seq) of the first broken link.
244	func (l *Ledger) VerifyChain(ctx context.Context, fromSeq, toSeq int64) (bool, int64, error) {
245		filter := bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$gte", Value: fromSeq}, {Key: "$lte", Value: toSeq}}}}
246		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}))
247		if err != nil {
248			return false, 0, fmt.Errorf("provenance verify: %w", err)
249		}
250		defer cur.Close(ctx)
251	
252		prevHash := ""
253		prevSeq := int64(0)
254		first := true
255		for cur.Next(ctx) {
256			var ev Event
257			if err := cur.Decode(&ev); err != nil {
258				return false, 0, err
259			}
260			if computeHash(&ev) != ev.Hash {
261				return false, ev.Seq, nil // content tampered
262			}
263			if !first {
264				if ev.Seq != prevSeq+1 || ev.PrevHash != prevHash {
265					return false, ev.Seq, nil // linkage broken
266				}
267			}
268			prevHash, prevSeq, first = ev.Hash, ev.Seq, false
269		}
270		return true, 0, cur.Err()
271	}
272	
273	// LatestSeq returns the current chain head sequence (0 = empty).
274	func (l *Ledger) LatestSeq(ctx context.Context) (int64, error) {
275		seq, _, err := l.head(ctx)
276		return seq, err
277	}
```

```text
// Package middleware carries the cross-cutting HTTP concerns: token
// authentication, role enforcement, audit capture, per-IP rate limiting,
// Prometheus metrics.
package middleware

import (
	"net/http"
	"strings"

	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
)

// Authenticate verifies the Bearer token and installs the Actor on the
// request context. Requests without a valid token are rejected — public
// routes simply don't mount this middleware.
func Authenticate(jwtm *auth.JWTManager) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
		return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			header := r.Header.Get("Authorization")
			token, ok := strings.CutPrefix(header, "Bearer ")
			if !ok || token == "" {
				httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Unauthorized("missing bearer token"))
				return
			}
			claims, err := jwtm.Parse(token)
			if err != nil {
				httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Unauthorized("invalid or expired token"))
				return
			}
			actor := auth.Actor{
				PartyID:          claims.PartyID,
				Phone:            claims.Phone,
				KYCTier:          claims.KYCTier,
				Kind:             claims.Kind,
				RoleAssignmentID: claims.RoleAssignmentID,
				RoleCode:         claims.RoleCode,
				OrgUnitID:        claims.OrgUnitID,
				OrgType:          claims.OrgType,
			}
			next.ServeHTTP(w, r.WithContext(auth.WithActor(r.Context(), actor)))
		})
	}
}
package middleware

import (
	"net/http"

	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
)

// RequireRoles allows only ROLE-kind tokens whose role is in the allow-list.
// SUPER_ADMIN passes every gate (break-glass admin — all its calls are
// audited by the audit middleware).
func RequireRoles(roles ...string) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
	allowed := make(map[string]struct{}, len(roles))
	for _, r := range roles {
		allowed[r] = struct{}{}
	}
	return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
		return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			actor, ok := auth.ActorFrom(r.Context())
			if !ok {
				httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Unauthorized("authentication required"))
				return
			}
			if actor.Kind != auth.TokenKindRole {
				httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Forbidden("a role token is required — select a role first (POST /api/v1/auth/role/select)"))
				return
			}
			if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSuperAdmin {
				next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
				return
			}
			if _, ok := allowed[actor.RoleCode]; !ok {
				httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Forbidden("role "+actor.RoleCode+" is not permitted for this action"))
				return
			}
			next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
		})
	}
}

// RequireSession allows any authenticated party (session or role token) —
// used for identity endpoints like "list my roles".
func RequireSession(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if _, ok := auth.ActorFrom(r.Context()); !ok {
			httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Unauthorized("authentication required"))
			return
		}
		next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
	})
}
// Package auth owns tokens and credentials: JWT issue/verify, OTP generation
// and HMAC hashing, opaque refresh tokens. Nothing secret is ever stored in
// plaintext — OTPs and refresh tokens live in the DB only as HMAC-SHA256
// digests.
package auth

import (
	"fmt"
	"time"

	"github.com/golang-jwt/jwt/v5"
	"github.com/google/uuid"

	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
)

// Token kinds. A SESSION token proves "this phone logged in"; a ROLE token
// additionally pins one active role assignment + org scope (the role switcher
// simply issues a fresh ROLE token).
const (
	TokenKindSession = "session"
	TokenKindRole    = "role"
)

// Claims is the JWT payload.
type Claims struct {
	PartyID          string `json:"pid"`
	Phone            string `json:"phn"`
	KYCTier          string `json:"kyc"`
	Kind             string `json:"knd"`
	RoleAssignmentID string `json:"rid,omitempty"`
	RoleCode         string `json:"rol,omitempty"`
	OrgUnitID        string `json:"org,omitempty"`
	OrgType          string `json:"ogt,omitempty"`
	jwt.RegisteredClaims
}

// JWTManager issues and parses access tokens.
type JWTManager struct {
	secret []byte
	ttl    time.Duration
}

// NewJWTManager builds a manager with the shared HS256 secret and access TTL.
func NewJWTManager(secret string, ttl time.Duration) *JWTManager {
	return &JWTManager{secret: []byte(secret), ttl: ttl}
}

// IssueSessionToken returns a SESSION-kind access token for a logged-in party.
func (m *JWTManager) IssueSessionToken(p domain.Party) (string, error) {
	return m.sign(Claims{
		PartyID: p.ID,
		Phone:   p.Phone,
		KYCTier: p.KYCTier,
		Kind:    TokenKindSession,
	})
}

// IssueRoleToken returns a ROLE-kind access token pinned to one assignment.
func (m *JWTManager) IssueRoleToken(p domain.Party, ra domain.RoleAssignment, orgType string) (string, error) {
	return m.sign(Claims{
		PartyID:          p.ID,
		Phone:            p.Phone,
		KYCTier:          p.KYCTier,
		Kind:             TokenKindRole,
		RoleAssignmentID: ra.ID,
		RoleCode:         ra.RoleCode,
		OrgUnitID:        ra.OrgUnitID,
		OrgType:          orgType,
	})
}

func (m *JWTManager) sign(c Claims) (string, error) {
	now := time.Now()
	c.RegisteredClaims = jwt.RegisteredClaims{
		Issuer:    "saathi-backend",
		Subject:   c.PartyID,
		IssuedAt:  jwt.NewNumericDate(now),
		ExpiresAt: jwt.NewNumericDate(now.Add(m.ttl)),
		ID:        uuid.NewString(),
	}
	return jwt.NewWithClaims(jwt.SigningMethodHS256, c).SignedString(m.secret)
}

// Parse validates signature+expiry and returns the claims.
func (m *JWTManager) Parse(token string) (*Claims, error) {
	parsed, err := jwt.ParseWithClaims(token, &Claims{},
		func(t *jwt.Token) (any, error) { return m.secret, nil },
		jwt.WithValidMethods([]string{jwt.SigningMethodHS256.Alg()}),
		jwt.WithIssuer("saathi-backend"),
	)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("parse token: %w", err)
	}
	claims, ok := parsed.Claims.(*Claims)
	if !ok || !parsed.Valid {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid token claims")
	}
	return claims, nil
}
package auth

import "context"

// Actor is the authenticated caller extracted from a verified token and
// stored on the request context by the auth middleware.
type Actor struct {
	PartyID          string
	Phone            string
	KYCTier          string
	Kind             string // session | role
	RoleAssignmentID string
	RoleCode         string
	OrgUnitID        string
	OrgType          string
}

// HasRole reports whether the actor operates under one of the given roles.
func (a Actor) HasRole(roles ...string) bool {
	for _, r := range roles {
		if a.RoleCode == r {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

type actorCtxKey struct{}

// WithActor stores the actor on the context.
func WithActor(ctx context.Context, a Actor) context.Context {
	return context.WithValue(ctx, actorCtxKey{}, a)
}

// ActorFrom retrieves the actor, if any.
func ActorFrom(ctx context.Context) (Actor, bool) {
	a, ok := ctx.Value(actorCtxKey{}).(Actor)
	return a, ok
}
package auth

import (
	"crypto/hmac"
	"crypto/rand"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"crypto/subtle"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/hex"
	"fmt"
	"math/big"
)

// GenerateNumericOTP returns a cryptographically random n-digit code.
func GenerateNumericOTP(n int) (string, error) {
	if n <= 0 || n > 10 {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("otp length out of range: %d", n)
	}
	max := big.NewInt(1)
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		max.Mul(max, big.NewInt(10))
	}
	v, err := rand.Int(rand.Reader, max)
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("otp entropy: %w", err)
	}
	return fmt.Sprintf("%0*d", n, v), nil
}

// HMACHash returns hex(HMAC-SHA256(secret, parts joined by '|')). Used for
// OTP codes (keyed to the phone) and refresh tokens, so a DB leak alone
// reveals no usable credentials.
func HMACHash(secret string, parts ...string) string {
	mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte(secret))
	for i, p := range parts {
		if i > 0 {
			mac.Write([]byte{'|'})
		}
		mac.Write([]byte(p))
	}
	return hex.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))
}

// ConstantTimeEqual compares two hex digests without timing leaks.
func ConstantTimeEqual(a, b string) bool {
	return subtle.ConstantTimeCompare([]byte(a), []byte(b)) == 1
}

// RandomToken returns a URL-safe random token with nBytes of entropy —
// used for opaque refresh tokens.
func RandomToken(nBytes int) (string, error) {
	buf := make([]byte, nBytes)
	if _, err := rand.Read(buf); err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("token entropy: %w", err)
	}
	return base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString(buf), nil
}
```
