1	// Package provenance implements the append-only, hash-chained event ledger —
2	// the source of truth for milk traceability (blueprint §7). Every link in the
3	// pour→QR chain is an immutable Event whose SHA-256 hash covers the previous
4	// event's hash, so history cannot be quietly rewritten (tamper-evidence,
5	// FSSAI recall-grade audit).
6	//
7	// Corrections are NEW events referencing the superseded entity — nothing is
8	// ever updated or deleted in this collection.
9	package provenance
10	
11	import (
12		"context"
13		"crypto/sha256"
14		"encoding/hex"
15		"encoding/json"
16		"errors"
17		"fmt"
18		"strconv"

30	// Ref is a directed edge to another entity in the trace graph
31	// (e.g. a consignment event referencing the pours it aggregates).
32	type Ref struct {
33		EntityType string `bson:"entity_type" json:"entity_type"`
34		EntityID   string `bson:"entity_id"   json:"entity_id"`
35		Relation   string `bson:"relation"    json:"relation"` // aggregates | supersedes | tested | yields | labels ...

44	// Event is one immutable link in the ledger.
45	type Event struct {
46		ID         string         `bson:"_id"         json:"id"`
47		Seq        int64          `bson:"seq"         json:"seq"`
48		Type       string         `bson:"type"        json:"type"`
49		EntityType string         `bson:"entity_type" json:"entity_type"`
50		EntityID   string         `bson:"entity_id"   json:"entity_id"`
51		Refs       []Ref          `bson:"refs,omitempty"    json:"refs,omitempty"`
52		Actor      ActorRef       `bson:"actor"       json:"actor"`
53		OrgUnitID  string         `bson:"org_unit_id,omitempty" json:"org_unit_id,omitempty"`
54		Payload    map[string]any `bson:"payload,omitempty"     json:"payload,omitempty"`
55		TS         time.Time      `bson:"ts"          json:"ts"`
56		PrevHash   string         `bson:"prev_hash"   json:"prev_hash"`
57		Hash       string         `bson:"hash"        json:"hash"`
58	}
59	
60	// AppendInput describes a new event to chain.
61	type AppendInput struct {
62		Type       string
63		EntityType string
64		EntityID   string
65		Refs       []Ref
66		Actor      ActorRef
67		OrgUnitID  string
68		Payload    map[string]any
69	}

71	// Ledger appends to and reads the hash chain.
72	type Ledger struct {
73		coll *mongo.Collection
74	}
75	
76	// NewLedger binds the ledger to the database.
77	func NewLedger(db *mongo.Database) *Ledger {
78		return &Ledger{coll: db.Collection(collection)}
79	}
80	
81	// genesisHash anchors the chain before the first event.
82	const genesisHash = "GENESIS"
83	
84	// Append chains a new event. Concurrency-safe without transactions: it reads
85	// the current head, computes seq+hash optimistically, and relies on the
86	// unique index on `seq` — a duplicate-key collision means another writer won
87	// the slot, so we re-read and retry.
88	func (l *Ledger) Append(ctx context.Context, in AppendInput) (*Event, error) {
89		const maxRetries = 12
90		for attempt := 0; attempt < maxRetries; attempt++ {
91			seq, prevHash, err := l.head(ctx)
92			if err != nil {
93				return nil, err
94			}
95			ev := &Event{
96				ID:         uuid.NewString(),
97				Seq:        seq + 1,
98				Type:       in.Type,
99				EntityType: in.EntityType,
100				EntityID:   in.EntityID,
101				Refs:       in.Refs,
102				Actor:      in.Actor,
103				OrgUnitID:  in.OrgUnitID,
104				Payload:    in.Payload,
105				// Millisecond precision: BSON datetimes store ms, so the persisted
106				// TS must equal the hashed TS or re-verification would break.
107				TS:       time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Millisecond),
108				PrevHash: prevHash,
109			}
110			ev.Hash = computeHash(ev)
111	
112			if _, err := l.coll.InsertOne(ctx, ev); err != nil {
113				if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(err) {
114					continue // lost the seq race — retry against the new head
115				}
116				return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance append: %w", err)
117			}
118			return ev, nil
119		}
120		return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance append: gave up after %d seq collisions", 12)
121	}
122	
123	// head returns the latest (seq, hash), or (0, GENESIS) for an empty chain.
124	func (l *Ledger) head(ctx context.Context) (int64, string, error) {
125		var last Event
126		err := l.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{},
127			options.FindOne().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: -1}}),
128		).Decode(&last)
129		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
130			return 0, genesisHash, nil
131		}
132		if err != nil {
133			return 0, "", fmt.Errorf("provenance head: %w", err)
134		}
135		return last.Seq, last.Hash, nil
136	}
137	
138	// computeHash covers everything that matters: position, linkage, content.
139	// Payload is canonicalised via encoding/json (map keys are sorted) and the
140	// timestamp to millisecond precision (BSON datetime resolution), so the
141	// digest is deterministic across a MongoDB round trip.
142	func computeHash(ev *Event) string {
143		payloadJSON, _ := json.Marshal(ev.Payload)
144		refParts := make([]string, 0, len(ev.Refs))
145		for _, r := range ev.Refs {
146			refParts = append(refParts, r.EntityType+":"+r.EntityID+":"+r.Relation)
147		}
148		material := strings.Join([]string{
149			ev.PrevHash,
150			strconv.FormatInt(ev.Seq, 10),
151			ev.Type,
152			ev.EntityType,
153			ev.EntityID,
154			strings.Join(refParts, ","),
155			ev.Actor.PartyID,
156			ev.Actor.RoleCode,
157			ev.OrgUnitID,
158			string(payloadJSON),
159			ev.TS.UTC().Truncate(time.Millisecond).Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
160		}, "|")
161		sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(material))
162		return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
163	}

184	// aflatoxin test walks back to source DCSes (blueprint §8.3).
185	func (l *Ledger) Trace(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, maxDepth int) ([]Event, error) {
186		if maxDepth <= 0 {
187			maxDepth = 10

191		type node struct{ etype, eid string }
192		visited := map[node]bool{}
193		frontier := []node{{entityType, entityID}}

197			var next []node

204				if err != nil {

214						if !visited[nn] {

223	}

235		var out []Event
236		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
237			return nil, err
238		}
239		return out, nil
240	}
241	
242	// VerifyChain re-derives every hash in [fromSeq, toSeq] and checks linkage.
243	// Returns (true, 0) when intact, or (false, seq) of the first broken link.
244	func (l *Ledger) VerifyChain(ctx context.Context, fromSeq, toSeq int64) (bool, int64, error) {
245		filter := bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$gte", Value: fromSeq}, {Key: "$lte", Value: toSeq}}}}
246		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}))
247		if err != nil {
248			return false, 0, fmt.Errorf("provenance verify: %w", err)
249		}
250		defer cur.Close(ctx)
251	
252		prevHash := ""
253		prevSeq := int64(0)
254		first := true
255		for cur.Next(ctx) {
256			var ev Event
257			if err := cur.Decode(&ev); err != nil {
258				return false, 0, err
259			}
260			if computeHash(&ev) != ev.Hash {
261				return false, ev.Seq, nil // content tampered
262			}
263			if !first {
264				if ev.Seq != prevSeq+1 || ev.PrevHash != prevHash {
265					return false, ev.Seq, nil // linkage broken
266				}
267			}
268			prevHash, prevSeq, first = ev.Hash, ev.Seq, false
269		}
270		return true, 0, cur.Err()
271	}
272	
273	// LatestSeq returns the current chain head sequence (0 = empty).
274	func (l *Ledger) LatestSeq(ctx context.Context) (int64, error) {
275		seq, _, err := l.head(ctx)
276		return seq, err
277	}
278

9	// and survives pasteurisation, so it MUST be gated upstream (BMC + plant),

11	const (
12		FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg = 0.5  // AFM1 ≤ 0.5 µg/kg
13		FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl          = 10.0 // coliform ≤ 10 CFU/ml
14		FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg       = 0.1  // antibiotic MRL example
15	)
16	
17	// QC test names.
18	const (
19		TestAflatoxinM1  = "AFLATOXIN_M1"           // µg/kg
20		TestColiform     = "COLIFORM"               // CFU/ml
21		TestTPC          = "TPC"                    // CFU/ml, graded — recorded, not hard-gated here
22		TestAntibiotic   = "ANTIBIOTIC_TETRACYCLINE" // mg/kg
23		TestPhosphatase  = "PHOSPHATASE"            // 0 = negative (pass post-pasteurisation), 1 = positive
24		TestFat          = "FAT"                    // %
25		TestSNF          = "SNF"                    // %
26	)
27	
28	// QC stages.
29	const (
30		QCStageBMCRapid = "BMC_RAPID" // strip/rapid tests at the chilling centre
31		QCStagePlantLab = "PLANT_LAB" // full lab: ELISA/HPLC, culture, LC-MS/MS
32	)
33	
34	// QC subject types.
35	const (
36		QCSubjectDCSConsignment  = "DCS_CONSIGNMENT"
37		QCSubjectBMCLot          = "BMC_LOT"
38		QCSubjectProcessingBatch = "PROCESSING_BATCH"
39	)
40	
41	// QCTest is a single measurement inside a QC result.
42	type QCTest struct {
43		Name  string  `bson:"name"  json:"name"`
44		Value float64 `bson:"value" json:"value"`
45		Unit  string  `bson:"unit"  json:"unit"`
46		Pass  bool    `bson:"pass"  json:"pass"`
47	}
48	
49	// QCResult is the recorded outcome of testing one subject at one stage.
50	// OverallPass drives the safety gate; a certificate is attached to provenance
51	// on pass, a block + quarantine on fail.
52	type QCResult struct {
53		ID                string    `bson:"_id"          json:"id"`
54		SubjectType       string    `bson:"subject_type" json:"subject_type"`
55		SubjectID         string    `bson:"subject_id"   json:"subject_id"`
56		Stage             string    `bson:"stage"        json:"stage"`
57		Tests             []QCTest  `bson:"tests"        json:"tests"`
58		OverallPass       bool      `bson:"overall_pass" json:"overall_pass"`
59		FailureReasons    []string  `bson:"failure_reasons,omitempty" json:"failure_reasons,omitempty"`
60		AnalystPartyID    string    `bson:"analyst_party_id" json:"analyst_party_id"`
61		LabRef            string    `bson:"lab_ref,omitempty"            json:"lab_ref,omitempty"`
62		CertificateNumber string    `bson:"certificate_number,omitempty" json:"certificate_number,omitempty"`
63		RecordedAt        time.Time `bson:"recorded_at"  json:"recorded_at"`
64		ProvenanceSeq     int64     `bson:"provenance_seq,omitempty" json:"provenance_seq,omitempty"`
65	}
66	
67	// EvaluateQCTests applies the FSSAI gate to a set of tests: it fills each
68	// test's Pass verdict and returns the overall verdict plus human-readable
69	// failure reasons. Unknown test names are recorded but do not gate.
70	func EvaluateQCTests(tests []QCTest) (overallPass bool, failures []string, evaluated []QCTest) {
71		overallPass = true
72		evaluated = make([]QCTest, 0, len(tests))
73		for _, t := range tests {
74			pass := true
75			switch t.Name {
76			case TestAflatoxinM1:
77				if t.Value > FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg {
78					pass = false
79					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
80						"AFLATOXIN_M1 %.3f µg/kg exceeds FSSAI limit %.1f µg/kg", t.Value, FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg))
81				}
82			case TestColiform:
83				if t.Value > FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl {
84					pass = false
85					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
86						"COLIFORM %.1f CFU/ml exceeds FSSAI limit %.0f CFU/ml", t.Value, FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl))
87				}
88			case TestAntibiotic:
89				if t.Value > FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg {
90					pass = false
91					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
92						"ANTIBIOTIC_TETRACYCLINE %.3f mg/kg exceeds MRL %.1f mg/kg", t.Value, FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg))
93				}
94			case TestPhosphatase:
95				if t.Value != 0 {
96					pass = false
97					failures = append(failures, "PHOSPHATASE positive — pasteurisation check failed (must be negative)")
98				}
99			}
100			t.Pass = pass
101			if !pass {
102				overallPass = false
103			}
104			evaluated = append(evaluated, t)
105		}
106		return overallPass, failures, evaluated
107	}
108

1	package middleware
2	
3	import (
4		"net/http"
5	
6		chimw "github.com/go-chi/chi/v5/middleware"
7	
8		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/audit"
9	)
10	
11	// AuditMutations records every state-changing request (non-GET/HEAD/OPTIONS)
12	// into the immutable audit trail: actor, action, status, IP, request ID.
13	// Runs after the handler so the final status code is captured; the write
14	// itself is async and adds no request latency.
15	func AuditMutations(rec *audit.Recorder) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
16		return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
17			return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
18				if r.Method == http.MethodGet || r.Method == http.MethodHead || r.Method == http.MethodOptions {
19					next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
20					return
21				}
22				ww := chimw.NewWrapResponseWriter(w, r.ProtoMajor)
23				next.ServeHTTP(ww, r)
24	
25				rec.Record(r.Context(), audit.Entry{
26					Action:    "http." + r.Method + " " + r.URL.Path,
27					Status:    ww.Status(),
28					IP:        r.RemoteAddr,
29					RequestID: chimw.GetReqID(r.Context()),
30				})
31			})
32		}
33	}
34

1	// Package middleware carries the cross-cutting HTTP concerns: token
2	// authentication, role enforcement, audit capture, per-IP rate limiting,
3	// Prometheus metrics.
4	package middleware
5	
6	import (
7		"net/http"
8		"strings"
9	
10		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
11		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
12	)
13	
14	// Authenticate verifies the Bearer token and installs the Actor on the
15	// request context. Requests without a valid token are rejected — public
16	// routes simply don't mount this middleware.
17	func Authenticate(jwtm *auth.JWTManager) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
18		return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
19			return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
20				header := r.Header.Get("Authorization")
21				token, ok := strings.CutPrefix(header, "Bearer ")
22				if !ok || token == "" {
23					httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Unauthorized("missing bearer token"))
24					return
25				}
26				claims, err := jwtm.Parse(token)
27				if err != nil {
28					httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Unauthorized("invalid or expired token"))
29					return
30				}
31				actor := auth.Actor{
32					PartyID:          claims.PartyID,
33					Phone:            claims.Phone,
34					KYCTier:          claims.KYCTier,
35					Kind:             claims.Kind,
36					RoleAssignmentID: claims.RoleAssignmentID,
37					RoleCode:         claims.RoleCode,
38					OrgUnitID:        claims.OrgUnitID,
39					OrgType:          claims.OrgType,
40				}
41				next.ServeHTTP(w, r.WithContext(auth.WithActor(r.Context(), actor)))
42			})
43		}
44	}
45

1	package middleware
2	
3	import (
4		"net/http"
5	
6		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
7		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
8		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
9	)
10	
11	// RequireRoles allows only ROLE-kind tokens whose role is in the allow-list.
12	// SUPER_ADMIN passes every gate (break-glass admin — all its calls are
13	// audited by the audit middleware).
14	func RequireRoles(roles ...string) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
15		allowed := make(map[string]struct{}, len(roles))
16		for _, r := range roles {
17			allowed[r] = struct{}{}
18		}
19		return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
20			return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
21				actor, ok := auth.ActorFrom(r.Context())
22				if !ok {
23					httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Unauthorized("authentication required"))
24					return
25				}
26				if actor.Kind != auth.TokenKindRole {
27					httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Forbidden("a role token is required — select a role first (POST /api/v1/auth/role/select)"))
28					return
29				}
30				if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSuperAdmin {
31					next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
32					return
33				}
34				if _, ok := allowed[actor.RoleCode]; !ok {
35					httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Forbidden("role "+actor.RoleCode+" is not permitted for this action"))
36					return
37				}
38				next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
39			})
40		}
41	}
42	
43	// RequireSession allows any authenticated party (session or role token) —
44	// used for identity endpoints like "list my roles".
45	func RequireSession(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
46		return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
47			if _, ok := auth.ActorFrom(r.Context()); !ok {
48				httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Unauthorized("authentication required"))
49				return
50			}
51			next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
52		})
53	}
54

52	// CreateRateChart stores a new pricing chart for an org unit and deactivates
53	// the org's previously active charts (the new chart supersedes them).
54	func (s *service) CreateRateChart(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateRateChartRequest) (*domain.RateChart, error) {
55		if req.OrgUnitID == "" || req.Name == "" {
56			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "org_unit_id and name are required")
57		}
58		if req.BaseRatePerLitre < 0 || req.FatRatePerPoint < 0 || req.SNFRatePerPoint < 0 {
59			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "rates must not be negative")
60		}
61		if req.BaseRatePerLitre+req.FatRatePerPoint+req.SNFRatePerPoint == 0 {
62			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "at least one rate component must be positive")
63		}
64		if _, err := s.d.Orgs.Get(ctx, req.OrgUnitID); err != nil {
65			return nil, err
66		}
67		if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.OrgUnitID); err != nil {
68			return nil, err
69		}
70	
71		now := time.Now().UTC()
72		effectiveFrom := now
73		if req.EffectiveFrom != nil {
74			effectiveFrom = req.EffectiveFrom.UTC()
75		}
76		if err := s.repo.deactivateActiveCharts(ctx, req.OrgUnitID); err != nil {
77			return nil, err
78		}
79		chart := &domain.RateChart{
80			ID:               uuid.NewString(),
81			OrgUnitID:        req.OrgUnitID,
82			Name:             req.Name,
83			BaseRatePerLitre: req.BaseRatePerLitre,
84			FatRatePerPoint:  req.FatRatePerPoint,
85			SNFRatePerPoint:  req.SNFRatePerPoint,
86			EffectiveFrom:    effectiveFrom,
87			Active:           true,
88			CreatedBy:        actor.PartyID,
89			CreatedAt:        now,
90		}
91		if err := s.repo.insertRateChart(ctx, chart); err != nil {
92			return nil, err
93		}
94		return chart, nil
95	}
96	
97	// ResolveActiveChart finds the rate chart pricing a DCS's pours: among active
98	// charts already effective on the DCS itself or any of its ancestors, the
99	// nearest org wins; ties break to the latest effective_from. Returns
100	// httpx.NotFound when no chart covers the DCS.
101	func (s *service) ResolveActiveChart(ctx context.Context, dcsID string) (*domain.RateChart, error) {
102		dcs, err := s.d.Orgs.Get(ctx, dcsID)
103		if err != nil {
104			return nil, err
105		}
106		if dcs.Type != domain.OrgTypeDCS {
107			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_DCS", "org unit "+dcsID+" is not a DCS")
108		}
109	
110		// Distance 0 = the DCS itself; Path is root→parent, so walk it backwards.
111		distance := map[string]int{dcs.ID: 0}
112		orgIDs := []string{dcs.ID}
113		for i := len(dcs.Path) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
114			distance[dcs.Path[i]] = len(dcs.Path) - i
115			orgIDs = append(orgIDs, dcs.Path[i])
116		}
117	
118		charts, err := s.repo.activeChartsForOrgs(ctx, orgIDs, time.Now().UTC())
119		if err != nil {
120			return nil, err
121		}
122		var best *domain.RateChart
123		for i := range charts {
124			c := &charts[i]
125			if best == nil {
126				best = c
127				continue
128			}
129			dc, db := distance[c.OrgUnitID], distance[best.OrgUnitID]
130			if dc < db || (dc == db && c.EffectiveFrom.After(best.EffectiveFrom)) {
131				best = c
132			}
133		}
134		if best == nil {
135			return nil, httpx.NotFound("active rate chart for DCS " + dcsID)
136		}
137		return best, nil
138	}

140	// --- analyzer readings ---
141	
142	// deriveIntegrityFlags computes the anti-tamper flags of a reading from its
143	// capture envelope (blueprint §8.2). Plausibility flags are appended
144	// separately by the caller.
145	func deriveIntegrityFlags(mode string, ocrConfidence float64, hasGeotag bool, deviceTimestamp, serverNow time.Time) []string {
146		var out []string
147		if mode == domain.ReadingModeManual {
148			out = append(out, domain.IntegrityFlagManualEntry)
149		}
150		if mode == domain.ReadingModePhotoOCR && ocrConfidence < lowOCRConfidenceThreshold {
151			out = append(out, domain.IntegrityFlagLowOCRConfidence)
152		}
153		if !hasGeotag {
154			out = append(out, domain.IntegrityFlagMissingGeotag)
155		}
156		if !deviceTimestamp.IsZero() {
157			skew := serverNow.Sub(deviceTimestamp)
158			if skew < 0 {
159				skew = -skew
160			}
161			if skew > maxClockSkew {
162				out = append(out, domain.IntegrityFlagClockSkew)
163			}
164		}
165		return out
166	}

168	// CreateReading stores one analyzer measurement. Suspicious readings are
169	// flagged, never rejected — the anomaly trail is the deterrent (§8.2).
170	func (s *service) CreateReading(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateReadingRequest) (*domain.AnalyzerReading, error) {
171		if req.DCSID == "" {
172			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "dcs_id is required")
173		}
174		switch req.Mode {
175		case domain.ReadingModeDirect, domain.ReadingModePhotoOCR, domain.ReadingModeManual:
176		default:
177			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "mode must be ANALYZER_DIRECT, PHOTO_OCR or MANUAL")
178		}
179		if req.FatPct <= 0 || req.SNFPct <= 0 {
180			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "fat_pct and snf_pct are required")
181		}
182		if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.DCSID); err != nil {
183			return nil, err
184		}
185		if req.Mode == domain.ReadingModePhotoOCR {
186			if !s.d.Flags.Enabled(ctx, flags.FlagPhotoOCR) {
187				featureErr := httpx.Forbidden("photo-OCR ingestion is disabled on this deployment")
188				featureErr.Code = "FEATURE_DISABLED"
189				return nil, featureErr
190			}
191			if req.PhotoObjectKey == "" {
192				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "photo_object_key is required for PHOTO_OCR (evidence retention, §8.2)")
193			}
194		}
195	
196		now := time.Now().UTC()
197		var deviceTS time.Time
198		if req.DeviceTimestamp != nil {
199			deviceTS = req.DeviceTimestamp.UTC()
200		}
201		hasGeo := req.GeoLat != nil && req.GeoLng != nil
202		integrityFlags := deriveIntegrityFlags(req.Mode, req.OCRConfidence, hasGeo, deviceTS, now)
203		plausibilityFlags := domain.CheckPlausibility(req.FatPct, req.SNFPct, req.QuantityLitres)
204		integrityFlags = append(integrityFlags, plausibilityFlags...)
205	
206		reading := &domain.AnalyzerReading{
207			ID:               uuid.NewString(),
208			DCSID:            req.DCSID,
209			DeviceID:         req.DeviceID,
210			Mode:             req.Mode,
211			FatPct:           req.FatPct,
212			SNFPct:           req.SNFPct,
213			CLR:              req.CLR,
214			WaterPct:         req.WaterPct,
215			QuantityLitres:   req.QuantityLitres,
216			PhotoObjectKey:   req.PhotoObjectKey,
217			OCRConfidence:    req.OCRConfidence,
218			DeviceTimestamp:  deviceTS,
219			ServerReceivedAt: now,
220			IntegrityFlags:   integrityFlags,
221			PlausibilityOK:   len(plausibilityFlags) == 0,
222			RecordedBy:       actor.PartyID,
223			CreatedAt:        now,
224		}
225		if hasGeo {
226			reading.GeoLat, reading.GeoLng = *req.GeoLat, *req.GeoLng
227		}
228		if err := s.repo.insertReading(ctx, reading); err != nil {
229			return nil, err
230		}
231	
232		if _, err := s.d.Ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
233			Type:       domain.EventReadingRecorded,
234			EntityType: domain.EntityAnalyzerReading,
235			EntityID:   reading.ID,
236			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
237			OrgUnitID:  reading.DCSID,
238			Payload: map[string]any{
239				"mode":            reading.Mode,
240				"integrity_flags": reading.IntegrityFlags,
241			},
242		}); err != nil {
243			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("append reading provenance: %w", err))
244		}
245		return reading, nil
246	}

248	// ListReadings pages a DCS's readings for anomaly review, optionally
249	// restricted to one IST day.
250	func (s *service) ListReadings(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, dcsID, date string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.AnalyzerReading, error) {
251		if dcsID == "" {
252			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "dcs_id is required")
253		}
254		if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, dcsID); err != nil {
255			return nil, err
256		}
257		var dayStart, dayEnd *time.Time
258		if date != "" {
259			start, end, err := istDayRange(date)
260			if err != nil {
261				return nil, err
262			}
263			dayStart, dayEnd = &start, &end
264		}
265		return s.repo.listReadings(ctx, dcsID, dayStart, dayEnd, page)
266	}

268	// --- pours ---
269	
270	// CreatePour records one farmer's pour with same-day pricing. Replays of the
271	// same client_event_id return the stored pour with idempotentReplay=true —
272	// offline sync retries are harmless (§3.1).
273	func (s *service) CreatePour(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreatePourRequest) (pour *domain.MilkPour, idempotentReplay bool, err error) {
274		if req.ClientEventID == "" || req.FarmerPartyID == "" || req.DCSID == "" {
275			return nil, false, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "client_event_id, farmer_party_id and dcs_id are required")
276		}
277		if req.Shift != domain.ShiftMorning && req.Shift != domain.ShiftEvening {
278			return nil, false, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "shift must be MORNING or EVENING")
279		}
280		if req.QuantityLitres <= 0 {
281			return nil, false, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "quantity_litres must be positive")
282		}
283		switch req.Source {
284		case domain.ReadingModeDirect, domain.ReadingModePhotoOCR, domain.ReadingModeManual:
285		default:
286			return nil, false, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "source must be ANALYZER_DIRECT, PHOTO_OCR or MANUAL")
287		}
288		if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.DCSID); err != nil {
289			return nil, false, err
290		}
291	
292		now := time.Now().UTC()
293		member, err := s.repo.farmerIsActiveMember(ctx, req.FarmerPartyID, req.DCSID, now)
294		if err != nil {
295			return nil, false, err
296		}
297		if !member {
298			return nil, false, httpx.Unprocessable("FARMER_NOT_MEMBER",
299				"farmer does not hold an active FARMER assignment at this DCS")
300		}
301	
302		// HARD plausibility gate: receipts must be trustworthy, so implausible
303		// values are rejected here (unlike readings, which are merely flagged).
304		if violations := domain.CheckPlausibility(req.FatPct, req.SNFPct, req.QuantityLitres); len(violations) > 0 {
305			return nil, false, httpx.Unprocessable("IMPLAUSIBLE_VALUES",
306				"fat/SNF/quantity outside physically plausible bounds")
307		}
308	
309		chart, err := s.resolveChartForPricing(ctx, req.DCSID)
310		if err != nil {
311			return nil, false, err
312		}
313		rate, amount := chart.PricePour(req.FatPct, req.SNFPct, req.QuantityLitres)
314	
315		pouredAt := now
316		if req.PouredAt != nil {
317			pouredAt = req.PouredAt.UTC()
318		}
319		p := &domain.MilkPour{
320			ID:                uuid.NewString(),
321			ClientEventID:     req.ClientEventID,
322			FarmerPartyID:     req.FarmerPartyID,
323			AnimalID:          req.AnimalID,
324			DCSID:             req.DCSID,
325			Shift:             req.Shift,
326			PourDate:          domain.DateKeyIST(pouredAt),
327			QuantityLitres:    req.QuantityLitres,
328			FatPct:            req.FatPct,
329			SNFPct:            req.SNFPct,
330			CLR:               req.CLR,
331			RatePerLitre:      rate,
332			Amount:            amount,
333			RateChartID:       chart.ID,
334			AnalyzerReadingID: req.AnalyzerReadingID,
335			Source:            req.Source,
336			Status:            domain.PourStatusRecorded,
337			PouredAt:          pouredAt,
338			RecordedBy:        actor.PartyID,
339			DeviceID:          req.DeviceID,
340			CreatedAt:         now,
341		}
342		if req.GeoLat != nil && req.GeoLng != nil {
343			p.GeoLat, p.GeoLng = *req.GeoLat, *req.GeoLng
344		}
345	
346		duplicate, err := s.repo.insertPour(ctx, p)
347		if err != nil {
348			return nil, false, err
349		}
350		if duplicate {
351			existing, err := s.repo.pourByClientEventID(ctx, req.ClientEventID)
352			if err != nil {
353				return nil, false, err
354			}
355			return existing, true, nil
356		}
357	
358		if err := s.recordPourProvenance(ctx, actor, p); err != nil {
359			return nil, false, err
360		}
361		s.d.Bus.Publish(eventbus.TopicPourRecorded, *p)
362		s.queueFarmerSMS(ctx, p.FarmerPartyID, domain.TemplatePourReceipt, map[string]string{
363			"qty":    fmt.Sprintf("%.2f", p.QuantityLitres),
364			"rate":   fmt.Sprintf("%.2f", p.RatePerLitre),
365			"amount": fmt.Sprintf("%.2f", p.Amount),
366		})
367		return p, false, nil
368	}
369	
370	// recordPourProvenance appends EventPourRecorded and stamps the ledger seq
371	// onto the pour.
372	func (s *service) recordPourProvenance(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, p *domain.MilkPour) error {
373		refs := []provenance.Ref{
374			{EntityType: domain.EntityParty, EntityID: p.FarmerPartyID, Relation: "produced_by"},
375		}
376		if p.AnimalID != "" {
377			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{EntityType: domain.EntityAnimal, EntityID: p.AnimalID, Relation: "from_animal"})
378		}
379		if p.AnalyzerReadingID != "" {
380			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{EntityType: domain.EntityAnalyzerReading, EntityID: p.AnalyzerReadingID, Relation: "measured_by"})
381		}
382		ev, err := s.d.Ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
383			Type:       domain.EventPourRecorded,
384			EntityType: domain.EntityMilkPour,
385			EntityID:   p.ID,
386			Refs:       refs,
387			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
388			OrgUnitID:  p.DCSID,
389			Payload: map[string]any{
390				"quantity_litres": p.QuantityLitres,
391				"rate_per_litre":  p.RatePerLitre,
392				"amount":          p.Amount,
393			},
394		})
395		if err != nil {
396			return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("append pour provenance: %w", err))
397		}
398		if err := s.repo.setPourProvenanceSeq(ctx, p.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
399			return err
400		}
401		p.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
402		return nil
403	}

405	// resolveChartForPricing wraps ResolveActiveChart, converting "no chart" into
406	// a 422 — the pour payload itself is fine, the DCS just cannot price it yet.
407	func (s *service) resolveChartForPricing(ctx context.Context, dcsID string) (*domain.RateChart, error) {
408		chart, err := s.ResolveActiveChart(ctx, dcsID)
409		if err != nil {
410			var appErr *httpx.AppError
411			if errors.As(err, &appErr) && appErr.Status == http.StatusNotFound {
412				return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("NO_ACTIVE_RATE_CHART",
413					"no active rate chart covers this DCS — pours cannot be priced")
414			}
415			return nil, err
416		}
417		return chart, nil
418	}

420	// BatchSyncPours replays up to 500 offline-captured pours. Items succeed or
421	// fail independently — the batch never aborts (offline reconnect path, §3.1).
422	func (s *service) BatchSyncPours(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req BatchSyncRequest) ([]BatchSyncItemResult, error) {
423		if len(req.Pours) == 0 {
424			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "pours must not be empty")
425		}
426		if len(req.Pours) > maxBatchSyncItems {
427			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION",
428				fmt.Sprintf("pours must not exceed %d items per batch", maxBatchSyncItems))
429		}
430		results := make([]BatchSyncItemResult, 0, len(req.Pours))
431		for _, item := range req.Pours {
432			res := BatchSyncItemResult{ClientEventID: item.ClientEventID}
433			pour, replay, err := s.CreatePour(ctx, actor, item)
434			switch {
435			case err != nil:
436				res.Status = BatchItemError
437				var appErr *httpx.AppError
438				if errors.As(err, &appErr) {
439					res.Error = appErr.Code + ": " + appErr.Message
440				} else {
441					res.Error = "INTERNAL: internal server error"
442				}
443			case replay:
444				res.Status = BatchItemDuplicate
445				res.PourID = pour.ID
446			default:
447				res.Status = BatchItemCreated
448				res.PourID = pour.ID
449			}
450			results = append(results, res)
451		}
452		return results, nil
453	}

455	// SupersedePour applies an append-only correction (§3.4): the old pour is
456	// marked SUPERSEDED (the document stays), and a new repriced pour referencing
457	// it is recorded.
458	func (s *service) SupersedePour(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, pourID string, req SupersedePourRequest) (*domain.MilkPour, error) {
459		if req.Reason == "" {
460			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "reason is required")
461		}
462		old, err := s.repo.pourByID(ctx, pourID)
463		if err != nil {
464			return nil, err
465		}
466		if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, old.DCSID); err != nil {
467			return nil, err
468		}
469		if old.Status != domain.PourStatusRecorded {
470			return nil, httpx.Conflict("POUR_NOT_CORRECTABLE",
471				"pour is already "+old.Status+" and cannot be superseded")
472		}
473		invoiced, err := s.repo.pourIsInvoiced(ctx, pourID)
474		if err != nil {
475			return nil, err
476		}
477		if invoiced {
478			return nil, httpx.Conflict("POUR_INVOICED",
479				"pour is aggregated by an invoice — correct it through settlement instead")
480		}
481	
482		qty, fat, snf := old.QuantityLitres, old.FatPct, old.SNFPct
483		if req.Corrected.QuantityLitres != nil {
484			qty = *req.Corrected.QuantityLitres
485		}
486		if req.Corrected.FatPct != nil {
487			fat = *req.Corrected.FatPct
488		}
489		if req.Corrected.SNFPct != nil {
490			snf = *req.Corrected.SNFPct
491		}
492		if qty <= 0 {
493			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "corrected quantity_litres must be positive")
494		}
495		if violations := domain.CheckPlausibility(fat, snf, qty); len(violations) > 0 {
496			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("IMPLAUSIBLE_VALUES",
497				"corrected fat/SNF/quantity outside physically plausible bounds")
498		}
499	
500		chart, err := s.resolveChartForPricing(ctx, old.DCSID)
501		if err != nil {
502			return nil, err
503		}
504		rate, amount := chart.PricePour(fat, snf, qty)
505	
506		// Optimistic guard: only one correction can win the RECORDED→SUPERSEDED flip.
507		flipped, err := s.repo.markPourSuperseded(ctx, old.ID)
508		if err != nil {
509			return nil, err
510		}
511		if !flipped {
512			return nil, httpx.Conflict("POUR_NOT_CORRECTABLE", "pour was superseded concurrently")
513		}
514	
515		now := time.Now().UTC()
516		corrected := &domain.MilkPour{
517			ID:                uuid.NewString(),
518			FarmerPartyID:     old.FarmerPartyID,
519			AnimalID:          old.AnimalID,
520			DCSID:             old.DCSID,
521			Shift:             old.Shift,
522			PourDate:          old.PourDate, // correction stays on the original settlement day
523			QuantityLitres:    qty,
524			FatPct:            fat,
525			SNFPct:            snf,
526			CLR:               old.CLR,
527			RatePerLitre:      rate,
528			Amount:            amount,
529			RateChartID:       chart.ID,
530			AnalyzerReadingID: old.AnalyzerReadingID,
531			Source:            old.Source,
532			Status:            domain.PourStatusRecorded,
533			SupersedesPourID:  old.ID,
534			PouredAt:          old.PouredAt,
535			RecordedBy:        actor.PartyID,
536			DeviceID:          old.DeviceID,
537			GeoLat:            old.GeoLat,
538			GeoLng:            old.GeoLng,
539			CreatedAt:         now,
540		}
541		corrected.ClientEventID = old.ClientEventID + "::corr::" + corrected.ID[0:8]
542		if duplicate, err := s.repo.insertPour(ctx, corrected); err != nil {
543			return nil, err
544		} else if duplicate {
545			return nil, httpx.Conflict("POUR_NOT_CORRECTABLE", "correction collided with a concurrent one")
546		}
547	
548		ev, err := s.d.Ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
549			Type:       domain.EventPourSuperseded,
550			EntityType: domain.EntityMilkPour,
551			EntityID:   corrected.ID,
552			Refs: []provenance.Ref{
553				{EntityType: domain.EntityMilkPour, EntityID: old.ID, Relation: "supersedes"},
554			},
555			Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
556			OrgUnitID: corrected.DCSID,
557			Payload:   map[string]any{"reason": req.Reason},
558		})
559		if err != nil {
560			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("append supersede provenance: %w", err))
561		}
562		if err := s.repo.setPourProvenanceSeq(ctx, corrected.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
563			return nil, err
564		}
565		corrected.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
566		return corrected, nil
567	}

569	// ListPours pages pours. FARMER callers are always pinned to their own
570	// pours; staff roles must name a DCS inside their scope.
571	func (s *service) ListPours(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, filter pourListFilter, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.MilkPour, error) {
572		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleFarmer {
573			filter.FarmerPartyID = actor.PartyID // farmers only ever see their own pours
574		} else {
575			if filter.DCSID == "" {
576				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "dcs_id is required")
577			}
578			if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, filter.DCSID); err != nil {
579				return nil, err
580			}
581		}
582		if filter.Date != "" {
583			if err := validateDateKey(filter.Date); err != nil {
584				return nil, err
585			}
586		}
587		if filter.Shift != "" && filter.Shift != domain.ShiftMorning && filter.Shift != domain.ShiftEvening {
588			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "shift must be MORNING or EVENING")
589		}
590		return s.repo.listPours(ctx, filter, page)
591	}
592	
593	// --- invoices ---
594	
595	// GenerateInvoices groups the day's un-invoiced RECORDED pours by farmer and
596	// issues one invoice each — the same-day payment artefact (§8.1). The unique
597	// farmer+DCS+day index is the true duplicate guard; racing generators simply
598	// count the loser as "existing".
599	func (s *service) GenerateInvoices(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req GenerateInvoicesRequest) (*GenerateInvoicesResponse, error) {
600		if req.DCSID == "" {
601			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "dcs_id is required")
602		}
603		now := time.Now().UTC()
604		dateKey := req.Date
605		if dateKey == "" {
606			dateKey = domain.DateKeyIST(now)
607		} else if err := validateDateKey(dateKey); err != nil {
608			return nil, err
609		}
610		dcs, err := s.d.Orgs.Get(ctx, req.DCSID)
611		if err != nil {
612			return nil, err
613		}
614		if dcs.Type != domain.OrgTypeDCS {
615			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_DCS", "org unit "+req.DCSID+" is not a DCS")
616		}
617		if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.DCSID); err != nil {
618			return nil, err
619		}
620	
621		pours, err := s.repo.recordedPoursForDay(ctx, req.DCSID, dateKey)
622		if err != nil {
623			return nil, err
624		}
625		alreadyInvoiced, err := s.repo.invoicedPourIDs(ctx, req.DCSID, dateKey)
626		if err != nil {
627			return nil, err
628		}
629	
630		byFarmer := make(map[string][]domain.MilkPour)
631		for _, p := range pours {
632			if alreadyInvoiced[p.ID] {
633				continue
634			}
635			byFarmer[p.FarmerPartyID] = append(byFarmer[p.FarmerPartyID], p)
636		}
637		farmerIDs := make([]string, 0, len(byFarmer))
638		for id := range byFarmer {
639			farmerIDs = append(farmerIDs, id)
640		}
641		sort.Strings(farmerIDs)
642	
643		resp := &GenerateInvoicesResponse{Invoices: []domain.Invoice{}}
644		counterKey := "invoice:" + dcs.Code + ":" + dateKey
645		for _, farmerID := range farmerIDs {
646			group := byFarmer[farmerID]
647			seq, err := s.repo.nextInvoiceSeq(ctx, counterKey)
648			if err != nil {
649				return nil, err
650			}
651			inv := &domain.Invoice{
652				ID:            uuid.NewString(),
653				InvoiceNumber: domain.InvoiceNumberFor(dcs.Code, dateKey, seq),
654				FarmerPartyID: farmerID,
655				DCSID:         req.DCSID,
656				InvoiceDate:   dateKey,
657				Status:        domain.InvoiceStatusIssued,
658				IssuedAt:      now,
659			}
660			for _, p := range group {
661				inv.PourIDs = append(inv.PourIDs, p.ID)
662				inv.TotalQuantityLitres += p.QuantityLitres
663				inv.TotalAmount += p.Amount
664			}
665			inv.TotalQuantityLitres = math.Round(inv.TotalQuantityLitres*100) / 100
666			inv.TotalAmount = math.Round(inv.TotalAmount*100) / 100
667	
668			duplicate, err := s.repo.insertInvoice(ctx, inv)
669			if err != nil {
670				return nil, err
671			}
672			if duplicate {
673				resp.Existing++
674				continue
675			}
676	
677			refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, len(inv.PourIDs))
678			for _, pid := range inv.PourIDs {
679				refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{EntityType: domain.EntityMilkPour, EntityID: pid, Relation: "aggregates"})
680			}
681			ev, err := s.d.Ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
682				Type:       domain.EventInvoiceIssued,
683				EntityType: domain.EntityInvoice,
684				EntityID:   inv.ID,
685				Refs:       refs,
686				Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
687				OrgUnitID:  inv.DCSID,
688				Payload: map[string]any{
689					"invoice_number":        inv.InvoiceNumber,
690					"total_quantity_litres": inv.TotalQuantityLitres,
691					"total_amount":          inv.TotalAmount,
692				},
693			})
694			if err != nil {
695				return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("append invoice provenance: %w", err))
696			}
697			if err := s.repo.setInvoiceProvenanceSeq(ctx, inv.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
698				return nil, err
699			}
700			inv.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
701	
702			s.d.Bus.Publish(eventbus.TopicInvoiceIssued, *inv)
703			s.queueFarmerSMS(ctx, inv.FarmerPartyID, domain.TemplateInvoiceIssued, map[string]string{
704				"invoice_number": inv.InvoiceNumber,
705				"qty":            fmt.Sprintf("%.2f", inv.TotalQuantityLitres),
706				"amount":         fmt.Sprintf("%.2f", inv.TotalAmount),
707				"date":           inv.InvoiceDate,
708			})
709			resp.Created++
710			resp.Invoices = append(resp.Invoices, *inv)
711		}
712		return resp, nil
713	}
714	
715	// ListInvoices pages invoices. FARMER callers are always pinned to their own
716	// invoices; staff roles must name a DCS inside their scope.
717	func (s *service) ListInvoices(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, filter invoiceListFilter, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.Invoice, error) {
718		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleFarmer {
719			filter.FarmerPartyID = actor.PartyID // farmers only ever see their own invoices
720		} else {
721			if filter.DCSID == "" {
722				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "dcs_id is required")
723			}
724			if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, filter.DCSID); err != nil {
725				return nil, err
726			}
727		}
728		if filter.Date != "" {
729			if err := validateDateKey(filter.Date); err != nil {
730				return nil, err
731			}
732		}
733		if filter.Status != "" {
734			switch filter.Status {
735			case domain.InvoiceStatusIssued, domain.InvoiceStatusSettlementPending,
736				domain.InvoiceStatusPaid, domain.InvoiceStatusHold:
737			default:
738				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "unknown invoice status "+filter.Status)
739			}
740		}
741		return s.repo.listInvoices(ctx, filter, page)
742	}
743	
744	// GetInvoice returns one invoice: a farmer may fetch their own, staff roles
745	// need the invoice's DCS inside their scope.
746	func (s *service) GetInvoice(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id string) (*domain.Invoice, error) {
747		inv, err := s.repo.invoiceByID(ctx, id)
748		if err != nil {
749			return nil, err
750		}
751		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleFarmer {
752			if inv.FarmerPartyID != actor.PartyID {
753				return nil, httpx.Forbidden("farmers may only view their own invoices")
754			}
755			return inv, nil
756		}
757		if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, inv.DCSID); err != nil {
758			return nil, err
759		}
760		return inv, nil
761	}
762	
763	// --- helpers ---
764	
765	// queueFarmerSMS writes an outbox notification for the farmer. Failures are
766	// logged, never fatal — the receipt must not block the pour (§8.1).
767	func (s *service) queueFarmerSMS(ctx context.Context, farmerPartyID, templateKey string, params map[string]string) {
768		farmer, err := s.repo.getParty(ctx, farmerPartyID)
769		if err != nil {
770			s.log.Warn("collection: farmer lookup for SMS failed",
771				slog.String("farmer_party_id", farmerPartyID), slog.Any("err", err))
772			return
773		}
774		language := farmer.PreferredLanguage
775		if language == "" {
776			language = defaultLanguage
777		}
778		n := &domain.Notification{
779			ID:          uuid.NewString(),
780			PartyID:     farmer.ID,
781			Phone:       farmer.Phone,
782			Channel:     domain.ChannelSMS,
783			TemplateKey: templateKey,
784			Language:    language,
785			Params:      params,
786			Status:      domain.NotificationQueued,
787			QueuedAt:    time.Now().UTC(),
788		}
789		if err := s.repo.queueNotification(ctx, n); err != nil {
790			s.log.Warn("collection: notification queue failed",
791				slog.String("template", templateKey), slog.Any("err", err))
792		}
793	}
794	
795	// validateDateKey checks a YYYY-MM-DD day key.
796	func validateDateKey(date string) error {
797		if _, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", date); err != nil {
798			return httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "date must be YYYY-MM-DD")
799		}
800		return nil
801	}
802	
803	// istDayRange converts a YYYY-MM-DD key into the [start, end) UTC window of
804	// that IST calendar day.
805	func istDayRange(date string) (start, end time.Time, err error) {
806		ist := time.FixedZone("IST", 5*3600+1800)
807		day, parseErr := time.ParseInLocation("2006-01-02", date, ist)
808		if parseErr != nil {
809			return time.Time{}, time.Time{}, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "date must be YYYY-MM-DD")
810		}
811		return day.UTC(), day.Add(24 * time.Hour).UTC(), nil
812	}

// Package orgscope answers the RBAC question "is this resource inside the
// caller's organisational scope?" in O(1) DB reads. Org units denormalise
// their ancestor chain into Path, so scope checking is a set-membership test
// — no recursive tree walks on the hot path.
package orgscope

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"

	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
)

const collection = "org_units"

type cachedOrg struct {
	org domain.OrgUnit
	at  time.Time
}

// Resolver caches org units briefly (the tree changes rarely, reads are hot).
type Resolver struct {
	coll *mongo.Collection
	ttl  time.Duration

	mu    sync.RWMutex
	cache map[string]cachedOrg
}

// NewResolver binds the resolver to the database.
func NewResolver(db *mongo.Database) *Resolver {
	return &Resolver{
		coll:  db.Collection(collection),
		ttl:   60 * time.Second,
		cache: make(map[string]cachedOrg),
	}
}

// Get returns an org unit by ID (cached).
func (r *Resolver) Get(ctx context.Context, id string) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
	r.mu.RLock()
	c, ok := r.cache[id]
	r.mu.RUnlock()
	if ok && time.Since(c.at) < r.ttl {
		org := c.org
		return &org, nil
	}

	var org domain.OrgUnit
	err := r.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&org)
	if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
		return nil, httpx.NotFound("org unit " + id)
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}

	r.mu.Lock()
	r.cache[id] = cachedOrg{org: org, at: time.Now()}
	r.mu.Unlock()
	return &org, nil
}

// Invalidate drops a cached entry (call after updates).
func (r *Resolver) Invalidate(id string) {
	r.mu.Lock()
	delete(r.cache, id)
	r.mu.Unlock()
}

// InScope reports whether target sits at-or-below scope in the hierarchy:
// true when scope == target, or scope appears in target's ancestor Path.
func (r *Resolver) InScope(ctx context.Context, scopeOrgID, targetOrgID string) (bool, error) {
	if scopeOrgID == targetOrgID {
		return true, nil
	}
	target, err := r.Get(ctx, targetOrgID)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	for _, ancestor := range target.Path {
		if ancestor == scopeOrgID {
			return true, nil
		}
	}
	return false, nil
}

// RequireInScope enforces the actor's org scope over a target org unit.
// SUPER_ADMIN and STATE_AUDITOR (read-wide roles rooted at the federation)
// pass automatically; everyone else needs ancestry.
func (r *Resolver) RequireInScope(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, targetOrgID string) error {
	if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSuperAdmin || actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleStateAuditor {
		return nil
	}
	if actor.OrgUnitID == "" {
		return httpx.Forbidden("role token with org scope required")
	}
	ok, err := r.InScope(ctx, actor.OrgUnitID, targetOrgID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if !ok {
		return httpx.Forbidden("resource is outside your organisational scope")
	}
	return nil
}
// Package httpapi assembles the HTTP surface: global middleware, operational
// endpoints (health/readiness/metrics/version), and the /api/v1 tree where
// every domain module mounts its routes.
package httpapi

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"
	"time"

	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	chimw "github.com/go-chi/chi/v5/middleware"
	"github.com/prometheus/client_golang/prometheus/promhttp"

	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/middleware"
)

// Version is stamped via -ldflags at release build time.
var Version = "0.1.0-dev"

// New builds the fully wired HTTP handler.
func New(d *deps.Deps) http.Handler {
	r := chi.NewRouter()

	// Order matters: recover innermost-last so panics in anything above are caught.
	r.Use(chimw.RequestID)
	r.Use(chimw.RealIP)
	r.Use(middleware.Metrics)
	r.Use(middleware.PerIPRateLimit(d.Cfg.RateLimitRPS, d.Cfg.RateLimitBurst))
	r.Use(chimw.Recoverer)
	r.Use(chimw.Timeout(30 * time.Second))

	// Operational endpoints — outside /api/v1, never authenticated.
	r.Get("/healthz", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{"status": "ok"})
	})
	r.Get("/readyz", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 2*time.Second)
		defer cancel()
		if err := d.DB.Client().Ping(ctx, nil); err != nil {
			httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Internal(err))
			return
		}
		httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{"status": "ready"})
	})
	r.Handle("/metrics", promhttp.Handler())
	r.Get("/version", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{"version": Version, "service": "saathi-backend"})
	})

	r.Route("/api/v1", func(api chi.Router) {
		api.Use(middleware.AuditMutations(d.Audit))
		RegisterModules(api, d)
	})

	return r
}
package httpapi

import (
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"

	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/modules/cattle"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/modules/collection"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/modules/identity"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/modules/logistics"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/modules/orgs"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/modules/plant"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/modules/platformops"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/modules/publictrace"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/modules/quality"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/modules/settlement"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
)

// RegisterModules mounts every domain module under /api/v1.
//
// Module contract: each package under internal/modules/<name> exposes
//
//	func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps)
//
// and mounts its own subtree with its own auth/RBAC middleware. Modules are
// the future microservice seams — they may import domain and platform
// packages, but NEVER each other; cross-module reactions go through the
// event bus.
func RegisterModules(api chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
	// publictrace first — it mounts /public without auth.
	publictrace.Register(api, d)

	identity.Register(api, d)
	orgs.Register(api, d)
	cattle.Register(api, d)
	collection.Register(api, d)
	logistics.Register(api, d)
	plant.Register(api, d)
	quality.Register(api, d)
	settlement.Register(api, d)
	platformops.Register(api, d)
}
package middleware

import (
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"golang.org/x/time/rate"

	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
)

// PerIPRateLimit applies a token-bucket limit per client IP. In-memory by
// design: each API replica defends itself; global fairness belongs to the
// gateway/WAF tier in production (blueprint §6).
func PerIPRateLimit(rps float64, burst int) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
	type bucket struct {
		lim  *rate.Limiter
		seen time.Time
	}
	var (
		mu      sync.Mutex
		buckets = make(map[string]*bucket)
	)

	// Janitor: drop buckets idle >10 min so the map can't grow unbounded.
	go func() {
		for range time.Tick(5 * time.Minute) {
			mu.Lock()
			for ip, b := range buckets {
				if time.Since(b.seen) > 10*time.Minute {
					delete(buckets, ip)
				}
			}
			mu.Unlock()
		}
	}()

	return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
		return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			ip, _, err := net.SplitHostPort(r.RemoteAddr)
			if err != nil {
				ip = r.RemoteAddr
			}
			mu.Lock()
			b, ok := buckets[ip]
			if !ok {
				b = &bucket{lim: rate.NewLimiter(rate.Limit(rps), burst)}
				buckets[ip] = b
			}
			b.seen = time.Now()
			mu.Unlock()

			if !b.lim.Allow() {
				httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.TooManyRequests("too many requests — slow down"))
				return
			}
			next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
		})
	}
}

96				{Key: "stage", Value: domain.QCStagePlantLab},
97				{Key: "overall_pass", Value: true},
98			},
99			options.FindOne().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "recorded_at", Value: -1}}),
100		).Decode(&qc)
101		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
102			return nil, nil
103		}
104		if err != nil {
105			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
106		}
107		return &qc, nil
108	}
109	
110	// consignmentsByIDs loads consignment documents by ID — the fallback source
111	// of contributing-DCS ids and collection dates when the ledger events did not
112	// carry them in org_unit_id/payload. Input is bounded by the trace event cap.
113	func (r *repo) consignmentsByIDs(ctx context.Context, ids []string) ([]domain.DCSConsignment, error) {
114		if len(ids) == 0 {
115			return nil, nil
116		}
117		cur, err := r.consignments.Find(ctx,
118			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: ids}}}},
119		)
120		if err != nil {
121			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
122		}
123		var out []domain.DCSConsignment
124		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
125			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
126		}
127		return out, nil
128	}
129

127		lotID := uuid.NewString()

570	// --- QR issuance ---
571	
572	// qrAlphabet is the 32-character human-safe set for short codes: A–Z and 2–9
573	// minus the confusables 0/O and 1/I. 32 divides 256, so a byte modulo the
574	// alphabet length is unbiased.
575	const qrAlphabet = "ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789"
576	
577	// qrCodeLength is the number of random characters after the "PRG-" prefix
578	// (32^8 ≈ 1.1 trillion codes — collisions are retried on the unique index).
579	const qrCodeLength = 8
580	
581	// newQRCode mints a short public code like "[REDACTED:generic-api-key]" from crypto/rand.
582	func newQRCode() (string, error) {
583		buf := make([]byte, qrCodeLength)
584		if _, err := rand.Read(buf); err != nil {
585			return "", err
586		}
587		code := make([]byte, qrCodeLength)
588		for i, b := range buf {
589			code[i] = qrAlphabet[int(b)%len(qrAlphabet)]
590		}
591		return "PRG-" + string(code), nil
592	}
593	
594	// signQRToken builds the forgery-proof token printed inside the QR:
595	// base64url(qr_code|product_lot_id|issued_unix) + "." + hex(HMAC-SHA256).
596	// The consumer app resolves the payload; the signature proves it was minted
597	// by this server, so IDs cannot be guessed onto counterfeit packs.
598	func signQRToken(secret, qrCode, productLotID string, issuedAt time.Time) string {
599		payload := qrCode + "|" + productLotID + "|" + strconv.FormatInt(issuedAt.Unix(), 10)
600		mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte(secret))
601		mac.Write([]byte(payload))
602		return base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(payload)) + "." + hex.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))
603	}
604	
605	// parseQRToken verifies and unpacks a signed QR token.
606	func parseQRToken(secret, token string) (qrCode, productLotID string, issuedAt time.Time, err error) {
607		payloadB64, sigHex, found := strings.Cut(token, ".")
608		if !found {
609			return "", "", time.Time{}, errors.New("qr token: missing signature separator")
610		}
611		payloadBytes, err := base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString(payloadB64)
612		if err != nil {
613			return "", "", time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("qr token: bad payload encoding: %w", err)
614		}
615		sig, err := hex.DecodeString(sigHex)
616		if err != nil {
617			return "", "", time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("qr token: bad signature encoding: %w", err)
618		}
619		mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte(secret))
620		mac.Write(payloadBytes)
621		if !hmac.Equal(sig, mac.Sum(nil)) {
622			return "", "", time.Time{}, errors.New("qr token: signature mismatch")
623		}
624		parts := strings.Split(string(payloadBytes), "|")
625		if len(parts) != 3 {
626			return "", "", time.Time{}, errors.New("qr token: malformed payload")
627		}
628		unix, err := strconv.ParseInt(parts[2], 10, 64)
629		if err != nil {
630			return "", "", time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("qr token: bad timestamp: %w", err)
631		}
632		return parts[0], parts[1], time.Unix(unix, 0).UTC(), nil
633	}
634	
635	// IssueQR mints one signed QR for an ACTIVE product lot whose batch is
636	// COMPLETED — the gate is re-checked at mint time so recalled or blocked
637	// product can never be freshly labelled.
638	func (s *Service) IssueQR(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, productLotID string) (*domain.BatchQR, error) {
639		lot, err := s.getProductLot(ctx, productLotID)
640		if err != nil {
641			return nil, err
642		}
643		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, lot.PlantID); err != nil {
644			return nil, err
645		}
646		batch, err := s.getBatch(ctx, lot.BatchID)
647		if err != nil {
648			return nil, err
649		}
650		if !canIssueQR(lot.Status, batch.Status) {
651			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked,
652				"QR issuance refused: product lot must be ACTIVE and its batch COMPLETED").
653				WithDetails(map[string]any{
654					"product_lot_status": lot.Status,
655					"batch_status":       batch.Status,
656					"recall_reason":      lot.RecallReason,
657				})
658		}
659	
660		now := time.Now().UTC()
661		var qr *domain.BatchQR
662		const maxMintAttempts = 5
663		for attempt := 0; attempt < maxMintAttempts; attempt++ {
664			code, err := newQRCode()
665			if err != nil {
666				return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
667			}
668			candidate := &domain.BatchQR{
669				ID:           uuid.NewString(),
670				QRCode:       code,
671				ProductLotID: lot.ID,
672				SignedToken:  signQRToken(s.qrSecret, code, lot.ID, now),
673				IssuedBy:     actor.PartyID,
674				ScanCount:    0,
675				IssuedAt:     now,
676			}
677			insertErr := s.repo.InsertQR(ctx, candidate)
678			if insertErr == nil {
679				qr = candidate
680				break
681			}
682			if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(insertErr) {
683				continue // short-code collision — regenerate
684			}
685			return nil, httpx.Internal(insertErr)
686		}
687		if qr == nil {
688			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("qr mint: %d consecutive short-code collisions", maxMintAttempts))
689		}
690	
691		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
692			Type:       domain.EventQRIssued,
693			EntityType: domain.EntityBatchQR,
694			EntityID:   qr.ID,
695			Refs: []provenance.Ref{
696				{EntityType: domain.EntityProductLot, EntityID: lot.ID, Relation: "labels"},
697			},
698			Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
699			OrgUnitID: lot.PlantID,
700			Payload:   map[string]any{"qr_code": qr.QRCode},
701		})
702		if err != nil {
703			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
704		}
705		if err := s.repo.SetQRProvenanceSeq(ctx, qr.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
706			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
707		}
708		qr.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
709		return qr, nil
710	}

766	// dedupe removes duplicate IDs preserving first-seen order.
767	func dedupe(ids []string) []string {
768		seen := make(map[string]bool, len(ids))
769		out := make([]string, 0, len(ids))
770		for _, id := range ids {
771			if id == "" || seen[id] {
772				continue
773			}
774			seen[id] = true
775			out = append(out, id)
776		}
777		return out
778	}
779	
780	// missingIDs lists requested consignment IDs absent from the fetched set.
781	func missingIDs(wanted []string, got []domain.DCSConsignment) []string {
782		have := make(map[string]bool, len(got))
783		for _, c := range got {
784			have[c.ID] = true
785		}
786		var missing []string
787		for _, id := range wanted {
788			if !have[id] {
789				missing = append(missing, id)
790			}
791		}
792		return missing
793	}
794	
795	// missingLotIDs lists requested BMC lot IDs absent from the fetched set.
796	func missingLotIDs(wanted []string, got []domain.BMCLot) []string {
797		have := make(map[string]bool, len(got))
798		for _, l := range got {

802		for _, id := range wanted {
803			if !have[id] {
804				missing = append(missing, id)
805			}
806		}

808	}

74	// VerifyQRToken checks a stored signed token in the format QR issuance
75	// (plant module signQRToken) mints: "base64url(qr_code|product_lot_id|
76	// issued_unix)" + "." + hex(HMAC-SHA256(secret, decoded payload)). The HMAC
77	// is computed over the DECODED payload bytes — exactly what issuance signed.
78	// The comparison is constant-time so a forger learns nothing from response
79	// timing.
80	func VerifyQRToken(secret, token string) bool {
81		payloadB64, signature, found := strings.Cut(token, ".")
82		if !found || payloadB64 == "" || signature == "" {
83			return false // malformed: no payload/signature split
84		}
85		payload, err := base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString(payloadB64)
86		if err != nil || len(payload) == 0 {
87			return false // malformed: payload is not valid base64url
88		}
89		expected := auth.HMACHash(secret, string(payload))
90		return auth.ConstantTimeEqual(expected, signature)
91	}

196	func (s *Service) buildSourcing(ctx context.Context, events []provenance.Event) (*SourcingInfo, error) {
197		dcsIDs := map[string]struct{}{}
198		dates := map[string]struct{}{}

201		for _, ev := range events {
202			if ev.EntityType != domain.EntityConsignment {
203				continue
204			}
205			consignmentIDs[ev.EntityID] = struct{}{}
206			if ev.OrgUnitID != "" {
207				dcsIDs[ev.OrgUnitID] = struct{}{}
208			} else if v, ok := ev.Payload["dcs_id"].(string); ok && v != "" {
209				dcsIDs[v] = struct{}{}

217		// docs themselves (still samiti-level — pour ids are never surfaced).
218		if len(consignmentIDs) > 0 && (len(dcsIDs) == 0 || len(dates) == 0) {
219			docs, err := s.repo.consignmentsByIDs(ctx, sortedKeys(consignmentIDs))
220			if err != nil {
221				return nil, err
222			}
223			for _, c := range docs {
224				if c.DCSID != "" {
225					dcsIDs[c.DCSID] = struct{}{}
226				}
227				if c.Date != "" {
228					dates[c.Date] = struct{}{}
229				}
230			}
231		}
232	
233		samitis := make([]SamitiInfo, 0, len(dcsIDs))
234		districts := map[string]struct{}{}
235		for _, id := range sortedKeys(dcsIDs) {
236			org, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, id)
237			if err != nil {

243			samitis = append(samitis, SamitiInfo{Name: org.Name, Code: org.Code, District: org.District})
244			if org.District != "" {
245				districts[org.District] = struct{}{}
246			}
247		}
248		sort.Slice(samitis, func(i, j int) bool { return samitis[i].Name < samitis[j].Name })
249	
250		collectionDates := sortedKeys(dates)
251		return &SourcingInfo{
252			Message:         sourcingMessage(collectionDates, len(samitis), sortedKeys(districts)),
253			Samitis:         samitis,
254			CollectionDates: collectionDates,
255		}, nil

271		if len(districts) > 0 {
272			b.WriteString(" in " + strings.Join(districts, ", "))
273		}
274		return b.String()
275	}
276	
277	// verifyTracedRange re-hashes the ledger over the [min,max] seq window of the
278	// traced events (tamper-evidence baked into every scan). Windows wider than
279	// scanVerifySpanCap are verified partially — the most recent tail — and
280	// flagged as such.
281	func (s *Service) verifyTracedRange(ctx context.Context, events []provenance.Event) (*LedgerInfo, error) {
282		if len(events) == 0 {
283			return &LedgerInfo{Events: 0, Intact: true, VerifiedRange: [2]int64{0, 0}}, nil
284		}
285		minSeq, maxSeq := events[0].Seq, events[0].Seq
286		for _, ev := range events[1:] {
287			if ev.Seq < minSeq {
288				minSeq = ev.Seq
289			}
290			if ev.Seq > maxSeq {
291				maxSeq = ev.Seq
292			}
293		}
294		from, partial := minSeq, false
295		if maxSeq-minSeq+1 > scanVerifySpanCap {
296			from, partial = maxSeq-scanVerifySpanCap+1, true
297		}
298		intact, _, err := s.ledger.VerifyChain(ctx, from, maxSeq)
299		if err != nil {
300			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
301		}
302		return &LedgerInfo{
303			Events:        len(events),
304			Intact:        intact,
305			VerifiedRange: [2]int64{from, maxSeq},
306			Partial:       partial,
307		}, nil
308	}
309	
310	// VerifyLedger runs the public tamper-evidence check over [from,to]. Both
311	// bounds are optional: `to` defaults to the chain head, `from` to the start
312	// of the last publicVerifySpanCap events. Spans over the cap are rejected.
313	func (s *Service) VerifyLedger(ctx context.Context, fromRaw, toRaw string) (*LedgerVerifyResponse, error) {
314		latest, err := s.ledger.LatestSeq(ctx)
315		if err != nil {
316			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
317		}
318		if latest == 0 {
319			return &LedgerVerifyResponse{Intact: true, From: 0, To: 0}, nil // empty chain is trivially intact
320		}
321	
322		to := latest
323		if toRaw != "" {
324			n, err := strconv.ParseInt(toRaw, 10, 64)
325			if err != nil || n < 1 {
326				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_RANGE", "'to' must be a positive sequence number")
327			}
328			to = min(n, latest)
329		}
330		from := max(int64(1), to-publicVerifySpanCap+1)
331		if fromRaw != "" {
332			n, err := strconv.ParseInt(fromRaw, 10, 64)
333			if err != nil || n < 1 {
334				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_RANGE", "'from' must be a positive sequence number")
335			}
336			from = n
337		}
338		if from > to {
339			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_RANGE", "'from' must not exceed 'to'")
340		}
341		if to-from+1 > publicVerifySpanCap {
342			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("SPAN_TOO_WIDE",
343				fmt.Sprintf("verification span is capped at %d events per request", publicVerifySpanCap))
344		}
345	
346		intact, brokenAt, err := s.ledger.VerifyChain(ctx, from, to)
347		if err != nil {
348			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
349		}
350		resp := &LedgerVerifyResponse{Intact: intact, From: from, To: to}
351		if !intact {
352			resp.BrokenAtSeq = &brokenAt
353		}
354		return resp, nil
355	}
356	
357	// TraceGraph returns the full event graph around one entity: upstream via
358	// the recursive ref walk, downstream via reverse-ref lookup — the recall /
359	// root-cause tool (§8.3).
360	func (s *Service) TraceGraph(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string) (*TraceGraphResponse, error) {
361		if err := validateEntityType(entityType); err != nil {
362			return nil, err
363		}
364		upstream, err := s.ledger.Trace(ctx, entityType, entityID, traceDepth)
365		if err != nil {
366			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
367		}
368		downstream, err := s.ledger.DownstreamRefs(ctx, entityID)
369		if err != nil {
370			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
371		}
372		if len(downstream) > downstreamEventCap {
373			downstream = downstream[len(downstream)-downstreamEventCap:]
374		}
375		if len(upstream) == 0 && len(downstream) == 0 {
376			return nil, httpx.NotFound("provenance for entity")
377		}
378		if upstream == nil {
379			upstream = []provenance.Event{}
380		}
381		if downstream == nil {
382			downstream = []provenance.Event{}
383		}
384		return &TraceGraphResponse{Upstream: upstream, Downstream: downstream}, nil
385	}
386	
387	// Timeline returns one entity's own events in chain order, paginated.
388	// The second return value is the total event count before paging.
389	func (s *Service) Timeline(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, page httpx.Page) ([]provenance.Event, int, error) {
390		if err := validateEntityType(entityType); err != nil {
391			return nil, 0, err
392		}
393		events, err := s.ledger.EventsForEntity(ctx, entityType, entityID)
394		if err != nil {
395			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
396		}
397		if len(events) == 0 {
398			return nil, 0, httpx.NotFound("provenance for entity")
399		}
400		total := len(events)
401		start := min(page.Offset, int64(total))
402		end := min(start+page.Limit, int64(total))
403		return events[start:end], total, nil
404	}
405	
406	// validateEntityType rejects entity types outside the domain.Entity* catalog.
407	func validateEntityType(entityType string) error {
408		if _, ok := validEntityTypes[entityType]; !ok {
409			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_ENTITY_TYPE",
410				"unknown entity type "+entityType+" — use one of the provenance entity type constants")
411		}
412		return nil
413	}
414	
415	// sortedKeys returns a set's keys in deterministic (lexicographic) order.
416	func sortedKeys(set map[string]struct{}) []string {
417		out := make([]string, 0, len(set))
418		for k := range set {
419			out = append(out, k)
420		}
421		sort.Strings(out)
422		return out
423	}
424

1	// Package audit writes the immutable who-did-what trail required for
2	// government accountability and DPDP breach forensics (blueprint §12, §16).
3	// Entries are insert-only; the STATE_AUDITOR role reads them via the
4	// platformops module.
5	package audit
6	
7	import (
8		"context"
9		"log/slog"
10		"time"
11	
12		"github.com/google/uuid"
13		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
14	
15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
16	)
17	
18	const collection = "audit_logs"
19	
20	// Entry is one audit record.
21	type Entry struct {
22		ID           string         `bson:"_id"            json:"id"`
23		ActorPartyID string         `bson:"actor_party_id" json:"actor_party_id"`
24		ActorRole    string         `bson:"actor_role,omitempty" json:"actor_role,omitempty"`
25		Action       string         `bson:"action"         json:"action"` // e.g. "http.POST /api/v1/collection/pours" or "support.pii_lookup"
26		TargetType   string         `bson:"target_type,omitempty" json:"target_type,omitempty"`
27		TargetID     string         `bson:"target_id,omitempty"   json:"target_id,omitempty"`
28		Status       int            `bson:"status,omitempty"      json:"status,omitempty"`
29		IP           string         `bson:"ip,omitempty"          json:"ip,omitempty"`
30		RequestID    string         `bson:"request_id,omitempty"  json:"request_id,omitempty"`
31		Meta         map[string]any `bson:"meta,omitempty"        json:"meta,omitempty"`
32		TS           time.Time      `bson:"ts"             json:"ts"`
33	}
34	
35	// Recorder persists audit entries asynchronously so auditing never adds
36	// latency to the request path.
37	type Recorder struct {
38		coll *mongo.Collection
39		log  *slog.Logger
40	}
41	
42	// NewRecorder binds the recorder to the database.
43	func NewRecorder(db *mongo.Database, log *slog.Logger) *Recorder {
44		return &Recorder{coll: db.Collection(collection), log: log}
45	}
46	
47	// Record fills identity fields from the request context and persists the
48	// entry in the background (fire-and-forget with its own timeout).
49	func (r *Recorder) Record(ctx context.Context, e Entry) {
50		if a, ok := auth.ActorFrom(ctx); ok {
51			if e.ActorPartyID == "" {
52				e.ActorPartyID = a.PartyID
53			}
54			if e.ActorRole == "" {
55				e.ActorRole = a.RoleCode
56			}
57		}
58		e.ID = uuid.NewString()
59		e.TS = time.Now().UTC()
60	
61		go func() {
62			writeCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
63			defer cancel()
64			if _, err := r.coll.InsertOne(writeCtx, e); err != nil {
65				r.log.Error("audit write failed", slog.String("action", e.Action), slog.Any("err", err))
66			}
67		}()
68	}
