35	// ---- pure guardrail checks (unit-tested without a database) ----
36	
37	// validateApproval enforces the dual-control guardrail (§8.1/§18-B): the
38	// approving party MUST differ from the initiator — checked FIRST and on the
39	// party identity itself, so not even SUPER_ADMIN's role bypass can approve a
40	// batch it initiated. Then the batch must still be awaiting approval.
41	func validateApproval(b domain.SettlementBatch, approverPartyID string) error {
42		if b.InitiatedBy == approverPartyID {
43			return httpx.Forbidden("dual-control violation: the settlement initiator cannot approve their own batch (§8.1/§18-B)").
44				WithDetails(map[string]string{"reason": "DUAL_CONTROL_VIOLATION"})
45		}
46		if b.Status != domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval {
47			return httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch is "+b.Status+", expected "+domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval)
48		}
49		return nil
50	}
51	
52	// validateExecution allows execution only for an APPROVED batch — executing
53	// before a human approval is a guardrail breach, not a race.
54	func validateExecution(b domain.SettlementBatch) error {
55		if b.Status != domain.SettlementStatusApproved {
56			return httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch is "+b.Status+", must be "+domain.SettlementStatusApproved+" before execution")
57		}
58		return nil
59	}

61	// mockUTR builds a mock bank transaction reference: "UTRMOCK" + 12 hex chars.
62	func mockUTR() string {
63		return "UTRMOCK" + strings.ToUpper(strings.ReplaceAll(uuid.NewString(), "-", "")[:12])
64	}

78	// Initiate collects a DCS day's ISSUED invoices into a new settlement batch
79	// and parks it PENDING_APPROVAL. The INITIATED status is momentary by design
80	// (§8.1): computation and initiation are one Saathi action; nothing proceeds
81	// until a different human approves.
82	func (s *service) Initiate(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, in InitiateSettlementRequest) (*domain.SettlementBatch, error) {
83		if in.DCSID == "" {
84			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_FIELD", "dcs_id is required")
85		}
86		now := time.Now().UTC()
87		date := in.Date
88		if date == "" {
89			date = domain.DateKeyIST(now)
90		} else if _, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", date); err != nil {
91			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_DATE", "date must be YYYY-MM-DD")
92		}
93		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, in.DCSID); err != nil {
94			return nil, err
95		}
96	
97		candidates, err := s.repo.issuedInvoices(ctx, in.DCSID, date)
98		if err != nil {
99			return nil, err
100		}
101		if len(candidates) == 0 {
102			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("NO_INVOICES", "no ISSUED invoices for DCS "+in.DCSID+" on "+date)
103		}
104	
105		// Claim optimistically: the status guard on the update means each invoice
106		// lands in exactly one batch even under concurrent initiations.
107		batchID := uuid.NewString()
108		ids := make([]string, 0, len(candidates))
109		for _, inv := range candidates {
110			ids = append(ids, inv.ID)
111		}
112		if _, err := s.repo.claimInvoices(ctx, ids, batchID); err != nil {
113			return nil, err
114		}
115		claimed, err := s.repo.invoicesByBatch(ctx, batchID)
116		if err != nil {
117			return nil, err
118		}
119		if len(claimed) == 0 {
120			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("NO_INVOICES", "invoices were claimed by a concurrent settlement for DCS "+in.DCSID+" on "+date)
121		}
122	
123		batch := &domain.SettlementBatch{
124			ID:          batchID,
125			DCSID:       in.DCSID,
126			Date:        date,
127			Status:      domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval, // INITIATED → PENDING_APPROVAL immediately
128			InitiatedBy: actor.PartyID,
129			CreatedAt:   now,
130		}
131		for _, inv := range claimed {
132			batch.InvoiceIDs = append(batch.InvoiceIDs, inv.ID)
133			batch.TotalAmount += inv.TotalAmount
134		}
135		if err := s.repo.insertBatch(ctx, batch); err != nil {
136			// Best-effort release so the claimed invoices are not stranded.
137			if relErr := s.repo.releaseInvoices(ctx, batchID); relErr != nil {
138				s.log.Error("settlement: release after failed insert", slog.String("batch_id", batchID), slog.Any("err", relErr))
139			}
140			return nil, err
141		}
142	
143		refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, min(len(claimed), initiateRefsCap))
144		for i, inv := range claimed {
145			if i >= initiateRefsCap {
146				break
147			}
148			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{EntityType: domain.EntityInvoice, EntityID: inv.ID, Relation: "settles"})
149		}
150		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
151			Type:       domain.EventSettlementInitiated,
152			EntityType: domain.EntitySettlement,
153			EntityID:   batch.ID,
154			Refs:       refs,
155			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
156			OrgUnitID:  batch.DCSID,
157			Payload: map[string]any{
158				"dcs_id":        batch.DCSID,
159				"date":          batch.Date,
160				"invoice_count": len(claimed),
161				"total_amount":  batch.TotalAmount,
162			},
163		})
164		if err != nil {
165			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
166		}
167		if err := s.repo.setBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx, batch.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
168			return nil, err
169		}
170		batch.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
171		return batch, nil
172	}

174	// Approve applies the human dual-control sign-off: PENDING_APPROVAL→APPROVED.
175	func (s *service) Approve(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, batchID string) (*domain.SettlementBatch, error) {
176		batch, err := s.repo.batchByID(ctx, batchID)
177		if err != nil {
178			return nil, err
179		}
180		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, batch.DCSID); err != nil {
181			return nil, err
182		}
183		if err := validateApproval(*batch, actor.PartyID); err != nil {
184			return nil, err
185		}
186	
187		now := time.Now().UTC()
188		ok, err := s.repo.transitionBatch(ctx, batch.ID, domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval, bson.D{
189			{Key: "status", Value: domain.SettlementStatusApproved},
190			{Key: "approved_by", Value: actor.PartyID},
191			{Key: "approved_at", Value: now},
192		})
193		if err != nil {
194			return nil, err
195		}
196		if !ok {
197			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch already left "+domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval)
198		}
199		batch.Status = domain.SettlementStatusApproved
200		batch.ApprovedBy = actor.PartyID
201		batch.ApprovedAt = &now
202	
203		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
204			Type:       domain.EventSettlementApproved,
205			EntityType: domain.EntitySettlement,
206			EntityID:   batch.ID,
207			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
208			OrgUnitID:  batch.DCSID,
209			Payload: map[string]any{
210				"approved_by":  actor.PartyID,
211				"total_amount": batch.TotalAmount,
212			},
213		})
214		if err != nil {
215			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
216		}
217		if err := s.repo.setBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx, batch.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
218			return nil, err
219		}
220		batch.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
221		return batch, nil
222	}

226	func (s *service) Reject(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, batchID, reason string) (*domain.SettlementBatch, error) {
227		if strings.TrimSpace(reason) == "" {
228			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_FIELD", "reason is required")
229		}

231		if err != nil {
232			return nil, err
233		}
234		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, batch.DCSID); err != nil {
235			return nil, err
236		}
237		if batch.Status != domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval {
238			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch is "+batch.Status+", expected "+domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval)
239		}
240	
241		ok, err := s.repo.transitionBatch(ctx, batch.ID, domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval, bson.D{
242			{Key: "status", Value: domain.SettlementStatusRejected},
243			{Key: "rejected_by", Value: actor.PartyID},

251		}

261	// Execute hands the APPROVED batch to the payment-aggregator adapter and
262	// records the resulting payouts.
263	//
264	// MOCK LICENSED-PA ADAPTER — this is a stand-in for the real integration.
265	// In production (§18-B) execution goes through an RBI-licensed Payment
266	// Aggregator operating a nodal/escrow account: Saathi submits the payout
267	// file, the PA moves the money, and UTRs come back asynchronously via
268	// webhook. Saathi itself never touches funds. The mock credits every payout
269	// instantly with a synthetic UTR so the downstream flow (invoice→PAID,
270	// provenance, farmer SMS) is exercised end to end.
271	func (s *service) Execute(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, batchID string) (*SettlementDetail, error) {
272		batch, err := s.repo.batchByID(ctx, batchID)
273		if err != nil {
274			return nil, err
275		}
276		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, batch.DCSID); err != nil {
277			return nil, err
278		}
279		if err := validateExecution(*batch); err != nil {
280			return nil, err
281		}
282	
283		// Guarded APPROVED→EXECUTING claims execution for this caller only.
284		ok, err := s.repo.transitionBatch(ctx, batch.ID, domain.SettlementStatusApproved, bson.D{
285			{Key: "status", Value: domain.SettlementStatusExecuting},
286		})
287		if err != nil {
288			return nil, err
289		}
290		if !ok {
291			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch is already being executed")
292		}
293	
294		invoices, err := s.repo.invoicesByBatch(ctx, batch.ID)
295		if err != nil {
296			return nil, err
297		}
298	
299		now := time.Now().UTC()
300		payouts := make([]domain.PayoutInstruction, 0, len(invoices))
301		for _, inv := range invoices {
302			masked, err := s.repo.latestBankMasked(ctx, inv.FarmerPartyID)
303			if err != nil {
304				return nil, err
305			}
306			creditedAt := now
307			payout := &domain.PayoutInstruction{
308				ID:                uuid.NewString(),
309				SettlementBatchID: batch.ID,
310				InvoiceID:         inv.ID,
311				FarmerPartyID:     inv.FarmerPartyID,
312				Amount:            inv.TotalAmount,
313				BankAccountMasked: masked,
314				UTR:               mockUTR(),
315				Status:            domain.PayoutStatusSuccess,
316				CreditedAt:        &creditedAt,
317				CreatedAt:         now,
318			}
319			exists, err := s.repo.insertPayout(ctx, payout)
320			if err != nil {
321				return nil, err
322			}
323			if exists {
324				// Retry of an interrupted run — reuse the payout already credited.
325				existing, err := s.repo.payoutByInvoice(ctx, inv.ID)
326				if err != nil {
327					return nil, err
328				}
329				payout = existing
330			}
331			payouts = append(payouts, *payout)
332		}

334		if err := s.repo.markInvoicesPaid(ctx, batch.ID); err != nil {
335			return nil, err

338		paRef := mockPARef()

340			{Key: "status", Value: domain.SettlementStatusExecuted},
341			{Key: "pa_ref", Value: paRef},
342			{Key: "executed_at", Value: now},
343		})

345			return nil, err
346		}
347		if !ok {
348			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch left EXECUTING unexpectedly")
349		}
350		batch.Status = domain.SettlementStatusExecuted
351		batch.PARef = paRef
352		batch.ExecutedAt = &now
353	
354		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
355			Type:       domain.EventSettlementExecuted,
356			EntityType: domain.EntitySettlement,
357			EntityID:   batch.ID,
358			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
359			OrgUnitID:  batch.DCSID,
360			Payload: map[string]any{
361				"pa_ref":       paRef,
362				"payout_count": len(payouts),
363				"total_amount": batch.TotalAmount,

365		})
366		if err != nil {

368		}

379				Type:       domain.EventPayoutCredited,

381				EntityID:   p.InvoiceID,
382				Refs: []provenance.Ref{
383					{EntityType: domain.EntitySettlement, EntityID: batch.ID, Relation: "paid_by"},
384				},
385				Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
386				OrgUnitID: batch.DCSID,
387				Payload:   map[string]any{"utr": p.UTR, "amount": p.Amount},
388			}); err != nil {
389				s.log.Error("settlement: payout.credited ledger append", slog.String("invoice_id", p.InvoiceID), slog.Any("err", err))
390			}
391	
392			phone, err := s.repo.partyPhone(ctx, p.FarmerPartyID)
393			if err != nil {
394				s.log.Error("settlement: farmer phone lookup for payout SMS", slog.String("farmer_party_id", p.FarmerPartyID), slog.Any("err", err))
395				continue
396			}
397			s.bus.Publish(eventbus.TopicPayoutCredited, PayoutCreditedEvent{
398				FarmerPartyID: p.FarmerPartyID,
399				Phone:         phone,
400				Amount:        p.Amount,
401				UTR:           p.UTR,
402			})
403		}
404	
405		return &SettlementDetail{Batch: *batch, Payouts: payouts}, nil
406	}
407	
408	// List pages settlement batches. Callers with a DCS-scoped token default to
409	// their own DCS; wider roles must name a dcs_id (SUPER_ADMIN and
410	// STATE_AUDITOR may list unscoped).
411	func (s *service) List(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, dcsID, date, status string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.SettlementBatch, int64, error) {
412		if dcsID == "" {
413			switch {
414			case actor.OrgType == domain.OrgTypeDCS:
415				dcsID = actor.OrgUnitID
416			case actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSuperAdmin || actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleStateAuditor:
417				// federation-wide read roles may list across DCSes
418			default:
419				return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_FIELD", "dcs_id is required for your scope")
420			}
421		}
422		filter := bson.D{}
423		if dcsID != "" {
424			if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, dcsID); err != nil {
425				return nil, 0, err
426			}
427			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "dcs_id", Value: dcsID})
428		}
429		if date != "" {
430			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "date", Value: date})
431		}
432		if status != "" {
433			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "status", Value: status})
434		}
435		return s.repo.listBatches(ctx, filter, page)
436	}
437	
438	// Detail returns one batch plus its payout instructions.
439	func (s *service) Detail(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, batchID string) (*SettlementDetail, error) {
440		batch, err := s.repo.batchByID(ctx, batchID)
441		if err != nil {
442			return nil, err
443		}
444		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, batch.DCSID); err != nil {
445			return nil, err
446		}
447		payouts, err := s.repo.payoutsByBatch(ctx, batch.ID)
448		if err != nil {
449			return nil, err
450		}
451		return &SettlementDetail{Batch: *batch, Payouts: payouts}, nil
452	}

454	// PayoutHistory pages payout instructions for one farmer, newest first.
455	// A FARMER token is always forced to its own party — "my payment history".
456	func (s *service) PayoutHistory(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, farmerPartyID string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.PayoutInstruction, int64, error) {
457		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleFarmer {
458			farmerPartyID = actor.PartyID
459		}
460		if farmerPartyID == "" {
461			return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_FIELD", "farmer_party_id is required")
462		}
463		return s.repo.payoutsByFarmer(ctx, farmerPartyID, page)
464	}
465	
466	// ---- DBT subsidy rail (§13) — strictly separate from milk payments ----
467	
468	// CreateDBT submits a scheme subsidy request to the (mocked) PFMS rail.
469	// Saathi only tracks the request; the subsidy is disbursed by PFMS/DBT,
470	// never by Saathi and never through the milk-payment rail.
471	func (s *service) CreateDBT(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, in CreateDBTRequestInput) (*domain.DBTRequest, error) {
472		if in.SchemeCode == "" || in.FarmerPartyID == "" {
473			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_FIELD", "scheme_code and farmer_party_id are required")
474		}
475		if in.Amount <= 0 {
476			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_AMOUNT", "amount must be positive")
477		}
478		if _, err := s.repo.partyPhone(ctx, in.FarmerPartyID); err != nil {
479			return nil, err // farmer must exist
480		}
481	
482		// MOCK PFMS — real integration files the beneficiary+amount with PFMS
483		// and receives an acknowledgement reference (§13).
484		req := &domain.DBTRequest{
485			ID:            uuid.NewString(),
486			SchemeCode:    in.SchemeCode,
487			FarmerPartyID: in.FarmerPartyID,
488			Amount:        in.Amount,
489			PFMSRef:       mockPFMSRef(),
490			Status:        domain.DBTStatusSubmitted,
491			SubmittedBy:   actor.PartyID,
492			CreatedAt:     time.Now().UTC(),
493		}
494		if err := s.repo.insertDBT(ctx, req); err != nil {
495			return nil, err
496		}
497		return req, nil
498	}
499	
500	// UpdateDBTStatus records the DBT rail's progress for a request. CREDITED
501	// stamps credited_at; CREDITED/REJECTED are terminal.
502	func (s *service) UpdateDBTStatus(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id, status string) (*domain.DBTRequest, error) {
503		switch status {
504		case domain.DBTStatusAccepted, domain.DBTStatusCredited, domain.DBTStatusRejected:
505		default:
506			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_STATUS", "status must be one of ACCEPTED, CREDITED, REJECTED")
507		}
508		req, err := s.repo.dbtByID(ctx, id)
509		if err != nil {
510			return nil, err
511		}
512		if req.Status == domain.DBTStatusCredited || req.Status == domain.DBTStatusRejected {
513			return nil, httpx.Conflict("TERMINAL_STATUS", "dbt request is already "+req.Status)
514		}
515	
516		var creditedAt *time.Time
517		if status == domain.DBTStatusCredited {
518			now := time.Now().UTC()
519			creditedAt = &now
520		}
521		ok, err := s.repo.transitionDBT(ctx, req.ID, req.Status, status, creditedAt)
522		if err != nil {
523			return nil, err
524		}
525		if !ok {
526			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "dbt request changed concurrently, retry")
527		}
528		req.Status = status
529		req.CreditedAt = creditedAt
530		_ = actor // status updates carry no extra actor fields today
531		return req, nil
532	}
533	
534	// ListDBT pages DBT requests. A FARMER token is always forced to its own
535	// party.
536	func (s *service) ListDBT(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, farmerPartyID, status string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.DBTRequest, int64, error) {
537		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleFarmer {
538			farmerPartyID = actor.PartyID
539		}
540		filter := bson.D{}
541		if farmerPartyID != "" {
542			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "farmer_party_id", Value: farmerPartyID})
543		}
544		if status != "" {
545			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "status", Value: status})
546		}
547		return s.repo.listDBT(ctx, filter, page)
548	}

149	// upsertPartyByPhone atomically finds or creates the party for a phone —
150	// race-safe under the unique phone index (one phone = one Party, §4.1).
151	func (r *repository) upsertPartyByPhone(ctx context.Context, phone string, now time.Time) (*domain.Party, error) {
152		update := bson.D{{Key: "$setOnInsert", Value: bson.D{
153			{Key: "_id", Value: uuid.NewString()},
154			{Key: "phone", Value: phone},
155			{Key: "kyc_tier", Value: domain.KYCTierMinimal},
156			{Key: "status", Value: domain.PartyStatusActive},
157			{Key: "created_at", Value: now},
158			{Key: "updated_at", Value: now},
159		}}}
160		opts := options.FindOneAndUpdate().SetUpsert(true).SetReturnDocument(options.After)
161		var p domain.Party
162		if err := r.parties.FindOneAndUpdate(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "phone", Value: phone}}, update, opts).Decode(&p); err != nil {
163			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
164		}
165		return &p, nil

361			return httpx.Internal(err)
362		}
363		return nil
364	}

366	// latestKYCRecord returns the party's most recent KYC record.
367	func (r *repository) latestKYCRecord(ctx context.Context, partyID string) (*domain.KYCRecord, error) {
368		opts := options.FindOne().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "created_at", Value: -1}})
369		var rec domain.KYCRecord
370		err := r.kycRecords.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "party_id", Value: partyID}}, opts).Decode(&rec)
371		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
372			return nil, httpx.NotFound("kyc record")
373		}
374		if err != nil {
375			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
376		}
377		return &rec, nil
378	}

381	// existing KYC record and returns the updated record.
382	func (r *repository) updateKYCRecordBank(ctx context.Context, id, accountMasked, ifsc string, nameMatch float64, now time.Time) (*domain.KYCRecord, error) {
383		update := bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
384			{Key: "bank_account_masked", Value: accountMasked},
385			{Key: "bank_ifsc", Value: ifsc},
386			{Key: "bank_verified", Value: true},
387			{Key: "bank_name_match", Value: nameMatch},
388			{Key: "updated_at", Value: now},
389		}}}
390		opts := options.FindOneAndUpdate().SetReturnDocument(options.After)
391		var rec domain.KYCRecord
392		err := r.kycRecords.FindOneAndUpdate(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}, update, opts).Decode(&rec)
393		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
394			return nil, httpx.NotFound("kyc record")
395		}
396		if err != nil {
397			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
398		}
399		return &rec, nil
400	}

413		cur, err := r.kycRecords.Find(ctx, filter, opts)

419			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
420		}
421		return out, total, nil

67	// claimInvoices atomically flips still-ISSUED invoices to SETTLEMENT_PENDING
68	// under the given batch. The status guard makes concurrent initiations safe
69	// without transactions: each invoice is claimed by exactly one batch.

1	package collection

10	)
11	
12	// handler is the HTTP edge of the collection module: decode, call service,
13	// respond. No business logic, no MongoDB.
14	type handler struct {
15		svc *service
16	}
17	
18	// requestActor returns the authenticated actor (guaranteed present by the
19	// Authenticate middleware on every route of this module).
20	func requestActor(r *http.Request) auth.Actor {
21		actor, _ := auth.ActorFrom(r.Context())
22		return actor
23	}
24	
25	// createRateChart handles POST /collection/rate-charts.
26	func (h *handler) createRateChart(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
27		var req CreateRateChartRequest
28		if err := httpx.DecodeJSON(r, &req); err != nil {
29			httpx.Error(w, r, err)
30			return
31		}
32		chart, err := h.svc.CreateRateChart(r.Context(), requestActor(r), req)
33		if err != nil {
34			httpx.Error(w, r, err)
35			return
36		}
37		httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusCreated, chart)
38	}
39	
40	// getActiveRateChart handles GET /collection/rate-charts/active?dcs_id=.
41	func (h *handler) getActiveRateChart(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
42		dcsID := r.URL.Query().Get("dcs_id")
43		if dcsID == "" {
44			httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "dcs_id query parameter is required"))
45			return
46		}
47		chart, err := h.svc.ResolveActiveChart(r.Context(), dcsID)
48		if err != nil {
49			httpx.Error(w, r, err)
50			return
51		}
52		httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, chart)
53	}
54	
55	// createReading handles POST /collection/readings.
56	func (h *handler) createReading(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
57		var req CreateReadingRequest
58		if err := httpx.DecodeJSON(r, &req); err != nil {
59			httpx.Error(w, r, err)
60			return
61		}
62		reading, err := h.svc.CreateReading(r.Context(), requestActor(r), req)
63		if err != nil {
64			httpx.Error(w, r, err)
65			return
66		}
67		httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusCreated, reading)
68	}
69	
70	// listReadings handles GET /collection/readings?dcs_id=&date=.
71	func (h *handler) listReadings(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
72		page := httpx.ParsePage(r)
73		readings, err := h.svc.ListReadings(r.Context(), requestActor(r),
74			r.URL.Query().Get("dcs_id"), r.URL.Query().Get("date"), page)
75		if err != nil {
76			httpx.Error(w, r, err)
77			return
78		}
79		httpx.JSONMeta(w, http.StatusOK, readings, page)
80	}
81	
82	// createPour handles POST /collection/pours.
83	func (h *handler) createPour(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
84		var req CreatePourRequest
85		if err := httpx.DecodeJSON(r, &req); err != nil {
86			httpx.Error(w, r, err)
87			return
88		}
89		pour, replay, err := h.svc.CreatePour(r.Context(), requestActor(r), req)
90		if err != nil {
91			httpx.Error(w, r, err)
92			return
93		}
94		if replay {
95			httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, PourResponse{Pour: *pour, IdempotentReplay: true})
96			return
97		}
98		httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusCreated, PourResponse{Pour: *pour})
99	}
100	
101	// batchSyncPours handles POST /collection/pours/batch-sync.
102	func (h *handler) batchSyncPours(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
103		var req BatchSyncRequest
104		if err := httpx.DecodeJSON(r, &req); err != nil {
105			httpx.Error(w, r, err)

package identity

import (
	"regexp"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
)

// Request-shape validation patterns. Formats only — business rules live in
// the service layer.
var (
	phoneRegexp       = regexp.MustCompile(`^[6-9][0-9]{9}$`)      // 10-digit Indian mobile
	otpRegexp         = regexp.MustCompile(`^[0-9]{6}$`)           // 6-digit numeric OTP
	aadhaarRegexp     = regexp.MustCompile(`^[0-9]{12}$`)          // 12-digit Aadhaar number
	bankAccountRegexp = regexp.MustCompile(`^[0-9]{9,18}$`)        // NPCI-range account number
	ifscRegexp        = regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Z]{4}0[A-Z0-9]{6}$`) // RBI IFSC format
)

// otpRequestRequest asks for a login OTP on a phone number.
type otpRequestRequest struct {
	Phone string `json:"phone"`
}

func (r otpRequestRequest) validate() error {
	if !phoneRegexp.MatchString(r.Phone) {
		return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_PHONE", "phone must be a 10-digit Indian mobile number")
	}
	return nil
}

// otpRequestResponse acknowledges the queued OTP. DevOTP is populated ONLY
// when cfg.OTPDevMode is on (never in prod — config refuses to boot).
type otpRequestResponse struct {
	Phone     string    `json:"phone"`
	ExpiresAt time.Time `json:"expires_at"`
	DevOTP    string    `json:"dev_otp,omitempty"`
}

// otpVerifyRequest exchanges phone+OTP for tokens.
type otpVerifyRequest struct {
	Phone string `json:"phone"`
	OTP   string `json:"otp"`
}

func (r otpVerifyRequest) validate() error {
	if !phoneRegexp.MatchString(r.Phone) {
		return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_PHONE", "phone must be a 10-digit Indian mobile number")
	}
	if !otpRegexp.MatchString(r.OTP) {
		return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_OTP", "otp must be a 6-digit numeric code")
	}
	return nil
}

// authTokensResponse is returned by login and refresh: a SESSION-kind access
// token, an opaque rotating refresh token, and the party record.
type authTokensResponse struct {
	AccessToken  string        `json:"access_token"`
	RefreshToken string        `json:"refresh_token"`
	Party        *domain.Party `json:"party"`
}

// refreshRequest rotates a refresh token.
type refreshRequest struct {
	RefreshToken string `json:"refresh_token"`
}

func (r refreshRequest) validate() error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(r.RefreshToken) == "" {
		return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_REFRESH_TOKEN", "refresh_token is required")
	}
	return nil
}

// logoutRequest revokes a refresh token.
type logoutRequest struct {
	RefreshToken string `json:"refresh_token"`
}

func (r logoutRequest) validate() error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(r.RefreshToken) == "" {
		return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_REFRESH_TOKEN", "refresh_token is required")
	}
	return nil
}

// assignmentWithOrg is a role assignment enriched with the org unit's
// display fields so the role-switcher UI needs no second call.
type assignmentWithOrg struct {
	domain.RoleAssignment
	OrgName string `json:"org_name,omitempty"`
	OrgType string `json:"org_type,omitempty"`
	OrgCode string `json:"org_code,omitempty"`
}

// roleSelectRequest picks one active assignment to operate under.
type roleSelectRequest struct {
	RoleAssignmentID string `json:"role_assignment_id"`
}

func (r roleSelectRequest) validate() error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(r.RoleAssignmentID) == "" {
		return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_ROLE_ASSIGNMENT_ID", "role_assignment_id is required")
	}
	return nil
}

// roleSelectResponse carries the fresh ROLE-kind access token.
type roleSelectResponse struct {
	AccessToken string `json:"access_token"`
	RoleCode    string `json:"role_code"`
	OrgUnitID   string `json:"org_unit_id"`
	OrgType     string `json:"org_type"`
}

// kycSummary is the masked, client-safe digest of the latest KYC record.
type kycSummary struct {
	Tier              string     `json:"tier"`
	Status            string     `json:"status"`
	AadhaarLast4      string     `json:"aadhaar_last4,omitempty"`
	BankAccountMasked string     `json:"bank_account_masked,omitempty"`
	BankIFSC          string     `json:"bank_ifsc,omitempty"`
	BankVerified      bool       `json:"bank_verified"`
	VerifiedAt        *time.Time `json:"verified_at,omitempty"`
}

// meResponse is the "who am I" aggregate: party, usable assignments, latest
// KYC summary.
type meResponse struct {
	Party       *domain.Party       `json:"party"`
	Assignments []assignmentWithOrg `json:"assignments"`
	KYC         *kycSummary         `json:"kyc,omitempty"`
}

// patchMeRequest updates the caller's own profile fields.
type patchMeRequest struct {
	FullName          *string `json:"full_name,omitempty"`
	PreferredLanguage *string `json:"preferred_language,omitempty"`
}

func (r patchMeRequest) validate() error {
	if r.FullName == nil && r.PreferredLanguage == nil {
		return httpx.BadRequest("EMPTY_PATCH", "provide at least one of full_name, preferred_language")
	}
	if r.FullName != nil {
		name := strings.TrimSpace(*r.FullName)
		if name == "" || len(name) > 120 {
			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_FULL_NAME", "full_name must be 1-120 characters")
		}
	}
	if r.PreferredLanguage != nil {
		lang := strings.TrimSpace(*r.PreferredLanguage)
		if lang == "" || len(lang) > 16 {
			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_LANGUAGE", "preferred_language must be 1-16 characters (e.g. \"hi\", \"en\")")
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// aadhaarKYCRequest runs the (mock) Aadhaar eKYC flow. The full number is
// used transiently and NEVER stored (blueprint §18-A).
type aadhaarKYCRequest struct {
	AadhaarNumber string `json:"aadhaar_number"`
	Consent       bool   `json:"consent"`
	RequestedTier string `json:"requested_tier"` // FARMER | STANDARD
}

func (r aadhaarKYCRequest) validate() error {
	if !aadhaarRegexp.MatchString(r.AadhaarNumber) {
		return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_AADHAAR", "aadhaar_number must be 12 digits")
	}
	if !r.Consent {
		return httpx.BadRequest("CONSENT_REQUIRED", "explicit consent is required for Aadhaar eKYC (DPDP)")
	}
	if r.RequestedTier != domain.KYCTierFarmer && r.RequestedTier != domain.KYCTierStandard {
		return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_TIER", "requested_tier must be FARMER or STANDARD")
	}
	return nil
}

// aadhaarKYCResponse returns the created record and the party's (possibly
// upgraded) KYC tier.
type aadhaarKYCResponse struct {
	Record  *domain.KYCRecord `json:"record"`
	KYCTier string            `json:"kyc_tier"`
}

// bankKYCRequest runs the (mock) penny-drop bank verification. Only the
// masked account tail and IFSC are ever persisted.
type bankKYCRequest struct {
	AccountNumber string `json:"account_number"`
	IFSC          string `json:"ifsc"`
}

func (r bankKYCRequest) validate() error {
	if !bankAccountRegexp.MatchString(r.AccountNumber) {
		return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_ACCOUNT", "account_number must be 9-18 digits")
	}
	if !ifscRegexp.MatchString(r.IFSC) {
		return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_IFSC", "ifsc must match the RBI IFSC format (e.g. SBIN0001234)")
	}
	return nil
}

// createAssignmentRequest grants a role to a party inside an org unit. The
// target party is addressed by party_id or phone (party_id wins when both
// are present).
type createAssignmentRequest struct {
	PartyID   string     `json:"party_id,omitempty"`
	Phone     string     `json:"phone,omitempty"`
	RoleCode  string     `json:"role_code"`
	OrgUnitID string     `json:"org_unit_id"`
	ValidFrom *time.Time `json:"valid_from,omitempty"`
	ValidTo   *time.Time `json:"valid_to,omitempty"`
}

func (r createAssignmentRequest) validate() error {
	if r.PartyID == "" && r.Phone == "" {
		return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_PARTY", "one of party_id or phone is required")
	}
	if r.PartyID == "" && !phoneRegexp.MatchString(r.Phone) {
		return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_PHONE", "phone must be a 10-digit Indian mobile number")
	}
	if !domain.IsValidRole(r.RoleCode) {
		return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_ROLE", "role_code is not in the role catalog")
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(r.OrgUnitID) == "" {
		return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_ORG_UNIT", "org_unit_id is required")
	}
	if r.ValidFrom != nil && r.ValidTo != nil && !r.ValidTo.After(*r.ValidFrom) {
		return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_VALIDITY_WINDOW", "valid_to must be after valid_from")
	}
	return nil
}

// listMeta is the pagination meta block for list endpoints.
type listMeta struct {
	Limit  int64 `json:"limit"`
	Offset int64 `json:"offset"`
	Total  int64 `json:"total"`
}
package identity

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"time"

	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo/options"

	"github.com/google/uuid"

	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/mongodb"
)

// otpChallenge is the persisted OTP challenge. Only the HMAC digest of the
// code is stored — a DB leak alone reveals no usable credential.
type otpChallenge struct {
	ID        string    `bson:"_id"`
	Phone     string    `bson:"phone"`
	CodeHash  string    `bson:"code_hash"`
	ExpiresAt time.Time `bson:"expires_at"`
	Attempts  int       `bson:"attempts"`
}

// refreshTokenDoc is the persisted refresh-token digest. The opaque token
// itself is only ever held by the client.
type refreshTokenDoc struct {
	ID        string    `bson:"_id"`
	TokenHash string    `bson:"token_hash"`
	PartyID   string    `bson:"party_id"`
	ExpiresAt time.Time `bson:"expires_at"`
	CreatedAt time.Time `bson:"created_at"`
}

// repository is the MongoDB gateway for the identity module. Pure data
// access — no business rules.
type repository struct {
	parties       *mongo.Collection
	challenges    *mongo.Collection
	tokens        *mongo.Collection
	assignments   *mongo.Collection
	kycRecords    *mongo.Collection
	consents      *mongo.Collection
	notifications *mongo.Collection
}

// newRepository binds the repository to the module's collections.
func newRepository(db *mongo.Database) *repository {
	return &repository{
		parties:       db.Collection(mongodb.CollParties),
		challenges:    db.Collection(mongodb.CollOTPChallenges),
		tokens:        db.Collection(mongodb.CollRefreshTokens),
		assignments:   db.Collection(mongodb.CollRoleAssignments),
		kycRecords:    db.Collection(mongodb.CollKYCRecords),
		consents:      db.Collection(mongodb.CollConsents),
		notifications: db.Collection(mongodb.CollNotifications),
	}
}

// --- OTP challenges ---

// insertOTPChallenge stores a fresh challenge.
func (r *repository) insertOTPChallenge(ctx context.Context, ch otpChallenge) error {
	if _, err := r.challenges.InsertOne(ctx, ch); err != nil {
		return httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return nil
}

// latestOTPChallenge returns the most recent unexpired challenge for phone.
func (r *repository) latestOTPChallenge(ctx context.Context, phone string, now time.Time) (*otpChallenge, error) {
	filter := bson.D{
		{Key: "phone", Value: phone},
		{Key: "expires_at", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$gt", Value: now}}},
	}
	opts := options.FindOne().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "expires_at", Value: -1}})
	var ch otpChallenge
	err := r.challenges.FindOne(ctx, filter, opts).Decode(&ch)
	if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
		return nil, httpx.NotFound("otp challenge")
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return &ch, nil
}

// incrementOTPAttempts counts one failed verification attempt.
func (r *repository) incrementOTPAttempts(ctx context.Context, id string) error {
	_, err := r.challenges.UpdateByID(ctx, id, bson.D{
		{Key: "$inc", Value: bson.D{{Key: "attempts", Value: 1}}},
	})
	if err != nil {
		return httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return nil
}

// deleteOTPChallenges removes every challenge for a phone (post-login burn).
func (r *repository) deleteOTPChallenges(ctx context.Context, phone string) error {
	if _, err := r.challenges.DeleteMany(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "phone", Value: phone}}); err != nil {
		return httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return nil
}

// --- Notifications (outbox) ---

// insertNotification queues an outbox message for the platformops sender.
func (r *repository) insertNotification(ctx context.Context, n domain.Notification) error {
	if _, err := r.notifications.InsertOne(ctx, n); err != nil {
		return httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return nil
}

// --- Parties ---

// findPartyByPhone loads a party by its unique phone number.
func (r *repository) findPartyByPhone(ctx context.Context, phone string) (*domain.Party, error) {
	var p domain.Party
	err := r.parties.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "phone", Value: phone}}).Decode(&p)
	if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
		return nil, httpx.NotFound("party")
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return &p, nil
}

// findPartyByID loads a party by ID.
func (r *repository) findPartyByID(ctx context.Context, id string) (*domain.Party, error) {
	var p domain.Party
	err := r.parties.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&p)
	if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
		return nil, httpx.NotFound("party")
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return &p, nil
}

// upsertPartyByPhone atomically finds or creates the party for a phone —
// race-safe under the unique phone index (one phone = one Party, §4.1).
func (r *repository) upsertPartyByPhone(ctx context.Context, phone string, now time.Time) (*domain.Party, error) {
	update := bson.D{{Key: "$setOnInsert", Value: bson.D{
		{Key: "_id", Value: uuid.NewString()},
		{Key: "phone", Value: phone},
		{Key: "kyc_tier", Value: domain.KYCTierMinimal},
		{Key: "status", Value: domain.PartyStatusActive},
		{Key: "created_at", Value: now},
		{Key: "updated_at", Value: now},
	}}}
	opts := options.FindOneAndUpdate().SetUpsert(true).SetReturnDocument(options.After)
	var p domain.Party
	if err := r.parties.FindOneAndUpdate(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "phone", Value: phone}}, update, opts).Decode(&p); err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return &p, nil
}

// updatePartyProfile sets the provided profile fields and returns the
// updated party.
func (r *repository) updatePartyProfile(ctx context.Context, id string, fullName, preferredLanguage *string, now time.Time) (*domain.Party, error) {
	set := bson.D{{Key: "updated_at", Value: now}}
	if fullName != nil {
		set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "full_name", Value: *fullName})
	}
	if preferredLanguage != nil {
		set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "preferred_language", Value: *preferredLanguage})
	}
	opts := options.FindOneAndUpdate().SetReturnDocument(options.After)
	var p domain.Party
	err := r.parties.FindOneAndUpdate(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}, bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: set}}, opts).Decode(&p)
	if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
		return nil, httpx.NotFound("party")
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return &p, nil
}

// updatePartyKYCTier sets the party's KYC tier.
func (r *repository) updatePartyKYCTier(ctx context.Context, id, tier string, now time.Time) error {
	_, err := r.parties.UpdateByID(ctx, id, bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
		{Key: "kyc_tier", Value: tier},
		{Key: "updated_at", Value: now},
	}}})
	if err != nil {
		return httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return nil
}

// --- Refresh tokens ---

// insertRefreshToken stores a refresh-token digest.
func (r *repository) insertRefreshToken(ctx context.Context, doc refreshTokenDoc) error {
	if _, err := r.tokens.InsertOne(ctx, doc); err != nil {
		return httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return nil
}

// findRefreshToken loads a refresh-token doc by digest.
func (r *repository) findRefreshToken(ctx context.Context, tokenHash string) (*refreshTokenDoc, error) {
	var doc refreshTokenDoc
	err := r.tokens.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "token_hash", Value: tokenHash}}).Decode(&doc)
	if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
		return nil, httpx.NotFound("refresh token")
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return &doc, nil
}

// deleteRefreshToken removes a token by digest and reports how many docs
// went away — 0 means a concurrent rotation already consumed it.
func (r *repository) deleteRefreshToken(ctx context.Context, tokenHash string) (int64, error) {
	res, err := r.tokens.DeleteOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "token_hash", Value: tokenHash}})
	if err != nil {
		return 0, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return res.DeletedCount, nil
}

// deleteRefreshTokenForParty removes a token only if it belongs to partyID
// (logout can never revoke someone else's session).
func (r *repository) deleteRefreshTokenForParty(ctx context.Context, tokenHash, partyID string) error {
	_, err := r.tokens.DeleteOne(ctx, bson.D{
		{Key: "token_hash", Value: tokenHash},
		{Key: "party_id", Value: partyID},
	})
	if err != nil {
		return httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return nil
}

// --- Role assignments ---

// listActiveAssignments returns a party's ACTIVE assignments (validity-window
// filtering happens in the service via UsableAt).
func (r *repository) listActiveAssignments(ctx context.Context, partyID string) ([]domain.RoleAssignment, error) {
	filter := bson.D{
		{Key: "party_id", Value: partyID},
		{Key: "status", Value: domain.RoleAssignmentActive},
	}
	cur, err := r.assignments.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "created_at", Value: -1}}))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	out := make([]domain.RoleAssignment, 0)
	if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return out, nil
}

// findAssignmentByID loads one role assignment.
func (r *repository) findAssignmentByID(ctx context.Context, id string) (*domain.RoleAssignment, error) {
	var ra domain.RoleAssignment
	err := r.assignments.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&ra)
	if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
		return nil, httpx.NotFound("role assignment")
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return &ra, nil
}

// activeAssignmentExists reports whether the party already holds an ACTIVE
// assignment of roleCode in orgUnitID (grant idempotency guard).
func (r *repository) activeAssignmentExists(ctx context.Context, partyID, roleCode, orgUnitID string) (bool, error) {
	filter := bson.D{
		{Key: "party_id", Value: partyID},
		{Key: "role_code", Value: roleCode},
		{Key: "org_unit_id", Value: orgUnitID},
		{Key: "status", Value: domain.RoleAssignmentActive},
	}
	n, err := r.assignments.CountDocuments(ctx, filter, options.Count().SetLimit(1))
	if err != nil {
		return false, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return n > 0, nil
}

// insertAssignment stores a new role assignment.
func (r *repository) insertAssignment(ctx context.Context, ra domain.RoleAssignment) error {
	if _, err := r.assignments.InsertOne(ctx, ra); err != nil {
		return httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return nil
}

// revokeAssignment flips an ACTIVE assignment to REVOKED (the doc is never
// deleted — §4.1) and returns the updated record. Matching on status makes
// concurrent revokes lose cleanly.
func (r *repository) revokeAssignment(ctx context.Context, id, revokedBy string, at time.Time) (*domain.RoleAssignment, error) {
	filter := bson.D{
		{Key: "_id", Value: id},
		{Key: "status", Value: domain.RoleAssignmentActive},
	}
	update := bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
		{Key: "status", Value: domain.RoleAssignmentRevoked},
		{Key: "revoked_at", Value: at},
		{Key: "revoked_by", Value: revokedBy},
	}}}
	opts := options.FindOneAndUpdate().SetReturnDocument(options.After)
	var ra domain.RoleAssignment
	err := r.assignments.FindOneAndUpdate(ctx, filter, update, opts).Decode(&ra)
	if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
		return nil, httpx.NotFound("active role assignment")
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return &ra, nil
}

// listAssignments pages assignments inside one org unit, optionally filtered
// by role code.
func (r *repository) listAssignments(ctx context.Context, orgUnitID, roleCode string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.RoleAssignment, int64, error) {
	filter := bson.D{{Key: "org_unit_id", Value: orgUnitID}}
	if roleCode != "" {
		filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "role_code", Value: roleCode})
	}
	total, err := r.assignments.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	opts := options.Find().
		SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "created_at", Value: -1}}).
		SetSkip(page.Offset).
		SetLimit(page.Limit)
	cur, err := r.assignments.Find(ctx, filter, opts)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	out := make([]domain.RoleAssignment, 0)
	if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
		return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return out, total, nil
}

// --- KYC records & consents ---

// insertKYCRecord stores a new KYC record.
func (r *repository) insertKYCRecord(ctx context.Context, rec domain.KYCRecord) error {
	if _, err := r.kycRecords.InsertOne(ctx, rec); err != nil {
		return httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return nil
}

// latestKYCRecord returns the party's most recent KYC record.
func (r *repository) latestKYCRecord(ctx context.Context, partyID string) (*domain.KYCRecord, error) {
	opts := options.FindOne().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "created_at", Value: -1}})
	var rec domain.KYCRecord
	err := r.kycRecords.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "party_id", Value: partyID}}, opts).Decode(&rec)
	if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
		return nil, httpx.NotFound("kyc record")
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return &rec, nil
}

// updateKYCRecordBank sets the (masked) bank verification fields on an
// existing KYC record and returns the updated record.
func (r *repository) updateKYCRecordBank(ctx context.Context, id, accountMasked, ifsc string, nameMatch float64, now time.Time) (*domain.KYCRecord, error) {
	update := bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
		{Key: "bank_account_masked", Value: accountMasked},
		{Key: "bank_ifsc", Value: ifsc},
		{Key: "bank_verified", Value: true},
		{Key: "bank_name_match", Value: nameMatch},
		{Key: "updated_at", Value: now},
	}}}
	opts := options.FindOneAndUpdate().SetReturnDocument(options.After)
	var rec domain.KYCRecord
	err := r.kycRecords.FindOneAndUpdate(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}, update, opts).Decode(&rec)
	if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
		return nil, httpx.NotFound("kyc record")
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return &rec, nil
}

// listKYCRecords pages the party's KYC records, newest first.
func (r *repository) listKYCRecords(ctx context.Context, partyID string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.KYCRecord, int64, error) {
	filter := bson.D{{Key: "party_id", Value: partyID}}
	total, err := r.kycRecords.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	opts := options.Find().
		SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "created_at", Value: -1}}).
		SetSkip(page.Offset).
		SetLimit(page.Limit)
	cur, err := r.kycRecords.Find(ctx, filter, opts)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	out := make([]domain.KYCRecord, 0)
	if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
		return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return out, total, nil
}

// insertConsent stores a DPDP consent artefact.
func (r *repository) insertConsent(ctx context.Context, c domain.Consent) error {
	if _, err := r.consents.InsertOne(ctx, c); err != nil {
		return httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return nil
}

16	
17	// repository is all MongoDB access for the quality module. It owns qc_results
18	// and — as the safety-gate verdict writer (blueprint §8.3) — performs the
19	// documented cross-collection status write onto bmc_lots and
20	// processing_batches. No other module may flip those gate statuses.
21	type repository struct {
22		results  *mongo.Collection
23		bmcLots  *mongo.Collection
24		batches  *mongo.Collection
25		counters *mongo.Collection
26	}
27	
28	// newRepository binds the repository to its collections.
29	func newRepository(db *mongo.Database) *repository {
30		return &repository{
31			results:  db.Collection(mongodb.CollQCResults),
32			bmcLots:  db.Collection(mongodb.CollBMCLots),
33			batches:  db.Collection(mongodb.CollBatches),
34			counters: db.Collection(mongodb.CollCounters),
35		}
36	}
37	
38	// insertResult stores a new QC result document.
39	func (r *repository) insertResult(ctx context.Context, res *domain.QCResult) error {
40		if _, err := r.results.InsertOne(ctx, res); err != nil {
41			return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("insert qc result: %w", err))
42		}
43		return nil
44	}
45	
46	// setResultProvenanceSeq stamps the ledger sequence onto a stored result.
47	func (r *repository) setResultProvenanceSeq(ctx context.Context, resultID string, seq int64) error {
48		_, err := r.results.UpdateOne(ctx,
49			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: resultID}},
50			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "provenance_seq", Value: seq}}}},
51		)
52		if err != nil {
53			return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("set qc result provenance seq: %w", err))
54		}
55		return nil
56	}
57

59	func (r *repository) findResultByID(ctx context.Context, resultID string) (*domain.QCResult, error) {

63			return nil, httpx.NotFound("qc result")
64		}
65		if err != nil {
66			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("find qc result: %w", err))

83		if err != nil {
84			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("count qc results: %w", err))
85		}
86	
87		cur, err := r.results.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
88			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "recorded_at", Value: -1}}).
89			SetSkip(page.Offset).
90			SetLimit(page.Limit),
91		)
92		if err != nil {
93			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("list qc results: %w", err))
94		}

98		}
99		return results, total, nil
100	}

103	func (r *repository) findBMCLot(ctx context.Context, lotID string) (*domain.BMCLot, error) {

105		err := r.bmcLots.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: lotID}}).Decode(&lot)
106		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {

108		}
109		if err != nil {
110			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("find bmc lot: %w", err))
111		}
112		return &lot, nil
113	}

116	func (r *repository) findBatch(ctx context.Context, batchID string) (*domain.ProcessingBatch, error) {
117		var batch domain.ProcessingBatch
118		err := r.batches.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: batchID}}).Decode(&batch)
119		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
120			return nil, httpx.NotFound("processing batch")
121		}
122		if err != nil {
123			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("find processing batch: %w", err))
124		}
125		return &batch, nil
126	}
127	
128	// gateBMCLot applies the gate verdict to a BMC lot still in QC_PENDING.
129	// Returns false when the lot was already gated by a concurrent writer.
130	func (r *repository) gateBMCLot(ctx context.Context, lotID, resultID, newStatus, blockReason string) (bool, error) {
131		return gateSubjectDoc(ctx, r.bmcLots, lotID, domain.BMCLotStatusQCPending, resultID, newStatus, blockReason)
132	}
133	
134	// gateBatch applies the gate verdict to a processing batch still in QC_PENDING.
135	// Returns false when the batch was already gated by a concurrent writer.
136	func (r *repository) gateBatch(ctx context.Context, batchID, resultID, newStatus, blockReason string) (bool, error) {
137		return gateSubjectDoc(ctx, r.batches, batchID, domain.BatchStatusQCPending, resultID, newStatus, blockReason)
138	}
139	
140	// gateSubjectDoc is the shared conditional gate write: the filter pins the
141	// subject to QC_PENDING so a lost race cannot double-apply a verdict — the
142	// optimistic pattern that replaces transactions on a standalone server.
143	func gateSubjectDoc(ctx context.Context, coll *mongo.Collection, subjectID, pendingStatus, resultID, newStatus, blockReason string) (bool, error) {
144		set := bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: newStatus}}
145		if blockReason != "" {
146			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "block_reason", Value: blockReason})
147		}
148		res, err := coll.UpdateOne(ctx,
149			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: subjectID}, {Key: "status", Value: pendingStatus}},
150			bson.D{
151				{Key: "$set", Value: set},
152				{Key: "$push", Value: bson.D{{Key: "qc_result_ids", Value: resultID}}},
153			},
154		)
155		if err != nil {
156			return false, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("gate %s subject %s: %w", coll.Name(), subjectID, err))
157		}
158		return res.MatchedCount == 1, nil
159	}
160	
161	// nextCertificateSeq atomically increments and returns the per-stage QC
162	// certificate counter (counters collection, upsert-on-first-use).
163	func (r *repository) nextCertificateSeq(ctx context.Context, stage string) (int64, error) {
164		var doc struct {
165			Seq int64 `bson:"seq"`
166		}
167		err := r.counters.FindOneAndUpdate(ctx,
168			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: "qc_certificate:" + stage}},
169			bson.D{{Key: "$inc", Value: bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: int64(1)}}}},
170			options.FindOneAndUpdate().SetUpsert(true).SetReturnDocument(options.After),
171		).Decode(&doc)
172		if err != nil {
173			return 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("next qc certificate seq: %w", err))
174		}
175		return doc.Seq, nil
176	}

1	package plant
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"time"
6	
7		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
8		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
9		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo/options"
10	
11		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
12		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
13		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/mongodb"
14	)
15	
16	// Repo is the plant module's MongoDB access layer. All state transitions use
17	// optimistic filters on the expected status — no transactions (standalone
18	// server), so a lost race simply matches zero documents and the service
19	// reports a conflict instead of corrupting state.
20	type Repo struct {
21		consignments *mongo.Collection
22		bmcLots      *mongo.Collection
23		batches      *mongo.Collection
24		productLots  *mongo.Collection
25		qrs          *mongo.Collection
26		counters     *mongo.Collection
27	}
28	
29	// NewRepo binds the repo to the shared database.
30	func NewRepo(db *mongo.Database) *Repo {
31		return &Repo{
32			consignments: db.Collection(mongodb.CollConsignments),
33			bmcLots:      db.Collection(mongodb.CollBMCLots),
34			batches:      db.Collection(mongodb.CollBatches),
35			productLots:  db.Collection(mongodb.CollProductLots),
36			qrs:          db.Collection(mongodb.CollBatchQRs),
37			counters:     db.Collection(mongodb.CollCounters),
38		}
39	}
40	
41	// --- consignments (read + claim; owned by the logistics module otherwise) ---
42	
43	// ConsignmentsByIDs loads the given consignments (missing IDs simply absent).
44	func (r *Repo) ConsignmentsByIDs(ctx context.Context, ids []string) ([]domain.DCSConsignment, error) {
45		cur, err := r.consignments.Find(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: ids}}}})
46		if err != nil {
47			return nil, err
48		}
49		out := []domain.DCSConsignment{}
50		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
51			return nil, err
52		}
53		return out, nil
54	}
55	
56	// ClaimConsignments atomically flips DELIVERED consignments to ACCEPTED and
57	// stamps the pooling lot ID. Returns how many were actually claimed — fewer
58	// than requested means another lot raced us on at least one consignment.
59	func (r *Repo) ClaimConsignments(ctx context.Context, ids []string, bmcLotID string) (int64, error) {
60		res, err := r.consignments.UpdateMany(ctx,
61			bson.D{
62				{Key: "_id", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: ids}}},
63				{Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusDelivered},
64			},
65			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
66				{Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusAccepted},
67				{Key: "bmc_lot_id", Value: bmcLotID},
68			}}},
69		)
70		if err != nil {
71			return 0, err
72		}
73		return res.ModifiedCount, nil
74	}
75	
76	// ReleaseConsignments undoes a partial claim (compensating action for a lost
77	// race): everything stamped with this lot ID goes back to DELIVERED.
78	func (r *Repo) ReleaseConsignments(ctx context.Context, bmcLotID string) error {
79		_, err := r.consignments.UpdateMany(ctx,
80			bson.D{{Key: "bmc_lot_id", Value: bmcLotID}},
81			bson.D{
82				{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusDelivered}}},
83				{Key: "$unset", Value: bson.D{{Key: "bmc_lot_id", Value: ""}}},
84			},
85		)
86		return err
87	}
88	
89	// --- BMC lots ---
90	
91	// InsertBMCLot stores a new lot.
92	func (r *Repo) InsertBMCLot(ctx context.Context, lot *domain.BMCLot) error {
93		_, err := r.bmcLots.InsertOne(ctx, lot)
94		return err
95	}
96	
97	// BMCLotByID loads one lot (mongo.ErrNoDocuments when absent).
98	func (r *Repo) BMCLotByID(ctx context.Context, id string) (*domain.BMCLot, error) {
99		var lot domain.BMCLot
100		if err := r.bmcLots.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&lot); err != nil {
101			return nil, err
102		}
103		return &lot, nil
104	}
105	
106	// BMCLotsByIDs loads the given lots (missing IDs simply absent).
107	func (r *Repo) BMCLotsByIDs(ctx context.Context, ids []string) ([]domain.BMCLot, error) {
108		cur, err := r.bmcLots.Find(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: ids}}}})
109		if err != nil {
110			return nil, err
111		}
112		out := []domain.BMCLot{}
113		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
114			return nil, err
115		}
116		return out, nil
117	}
118	
119	// CloseBMCLot transitions OPEN→QC_PENDING with the chilling temperature.
120	// Returns false when the lot was not OPEN (already closed, or raced).
121	func (r *Repo) CloseBMCLot(ctx context.Context, id string, tempC float64, closedAt time.Time) (bool, error) {
122		res, err := r.bmcLots.UpdateOne(ctx,
123			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}, {Key: "status", Value: domain.BMCLotStatusOpen}},
124			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
125				{Key: "status", Value: domain.BMCLotStatusQCPending},
126				{Key: "chilling_temp_c", Value: tempC},
127				{Key: "closed_at", Value: closedAt},
128			}}},
129		)
130		if err != nil {
131			return false, err
132		}
133		return res.MatchedCount > 0, nil
134	}
135	
136	// DispatchBMCLot transitions PASSED→DISPATCHED. The status filter IS the
137	// safety gate at the datastore level: a BLOCKED or QC_PENDING lot can never
138	// match this update.
139	func (r *Repo) DispatchBMCLot(ctx context.Context, id string, dispatchedAt time.Time) (bool, error) {
140		res, err := r.bmcLots.UpdateOne(ctx,
141			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}, {Key: "status", Value: domain.BMCLotStatusPassed}},
142			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
143				{Key: "status", Value: domain.BMCLotStatusDispatched},
144				{Key: "dispatched_at", Value: dispatchedAt},
145			}}},
146		)
147		if err != nil {
148			return false, err
149		}
150		return res.MatchedCount > 0, nil
151	}
152	
153	// BMCLotListFilter narrows the BMC lot listing.
154	type BMCLotListFilter struct {
155		BMCID  string
156		Date   string
157		Status string
158	}
159	
160	// ListBMCLots returns a page of lots plus the total match count.
161	func (r *Repo) ListBMCLots(ctx context.Context, f BMCLotListFilter, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.BMCLot, int64, error) {
162		filter := bson.D{}
163		if f.BMCID != "" {
164			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "bmc_id", Value: f.BMCID})
165		}
166		if f.Date != "" {
167			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "date", Value: f.Date})
168		}
169		if f.Status != "" {
170			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "status", Value: f.Status})
171		}
172		total, err := r.bmcLots.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
173		if err != nil {
174			return nil, 0, err
175		}
176		cur, err := r.bmcLots.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
177			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "date", Value: -1}, {Key: "created_at", Value: -1}}).
178			SetSkip(page.Offset).SetLimit(page.Limit))
179		if err != nil {
180			return nil, 0, err
181		}
182		out := []domain.BMCLot{}
183		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
184			return nil, 0, err
185		}
186		return out, total, nil
187	}
188	
189	// --- processing batches ---
190	
191	// NextSequence atomically increments and returns the named counter — the
192	// transaction-free way to mint gapless human-readable numbers.
193	func (r *Repo) NextSequence(ctx context.Context, key string) (int64, error) {
194		var doc struct {
195			Seq int64 `bson:"seq"`
196		}
197		err := r.counters.FindOneAndUpdate(ctx,
198			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: key}},
199			bson.D{{Key: "$inc", Value: bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: int64(1)}}}},
200			options.FindOneAndUpdate().SetUpsert(true).SetReturnDocument(options.After),
201		).Decode(&doc)
202		if err != nil {
203			return 0, err
204		}
205		return doc.Seq, nil
206	}
207	
208	// InsertBatch stores a new processing batch.
209	func (r *Repo) InsertBatch(ctx context.Context, b *domain.ProcessingBatch) error {
210		_, err := r.batches.InsertOne(ctx, b)
211		return err
212	}
213	
214	// BatchByID loads one batch (mongo.ErrNoDocuments when absent).
215	func (r *Repo) BatchByID(ctx context.Context, id string) (*domain.ProcessingBatch, error) {
216		var b domain.ProcessingBatch
217		if err := r.batches.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&b); err != nil {
218			return nil, err
219		}
220		return &b, nil
221	}
222	
223	// CompleteBatch transitions PASSED→COMPLETED. The status filter enforces the
224	// gate: an unpassed batch can never match.
225	func (r *Repo) CompleteBatch(ctx context.Context, id string, completedAt time.Time) (bool, error) {
226		res, err := r.batches.UpdateOne(ctx,
227			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}, {Key: "status", Value: domain.BatchStatusPassed}},
228			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
229				{Key: "status", Value: domain.BatchStatusCompleted},
230				{Key: "completed_at", Value: completedAt},
231			}}},
232		)
233		if err != nil {
234			return false, err
235		}
236		return res.MatchedCount > 0, nil
237	}
238	
239	// BatchListFilter narrows the batch listing.
240	type BatchListFilter struct {
241		PlantID string
242		Status  string
243	}
244	
245	// ListBatches returns a page of batches plus the total match count.
246	func (r *Repo) ListBatches(ctx context.Context, f BatchListFilter, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.ProcessingBatch, int64, error) {
247		filter := bson.D{}
248		if f.PlantID != "" {
249			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "plant_id", Value: f.PlantID})
250		}
251		if f.Status != "" {
252			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "status", Value: f.Status})
253		}
254		total, err := r.batches.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
255		if err != nil {
256			return nil, 0, err
257		}
258		cur, err := r.batches.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
259			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "started_at", Value: -1}}).
260			SetSkip(page.Offset).SetLimit(page.Limit))
261		if err != nil {
262			return nil, 0, err
263		}
264		out := []domain.ProcessingBatch{}
265		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
266			return nil, 0, err
267		}
268		return out, total, nil
269	}
270	
271	// --- product lots ---
272	
273	// InsertProductLot stores a new product lot.
274	func (r *Repo) InsertProductLot(ctx context.Context, p *domain.ProductLot) error {
275		_, err := r.productLots.InsertOne(ctx, p)
276		return err
277	}
278	
279	// ProductLotByID loads one product lot (mongo.ErrNoDocuments when absent).
280	func (r *Repo) ProductLotByID(ctx context.Context, id string) (*domain.ProductLot, error) {
281		var p domain.ProductLot
282		if err := r.productLots.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&p); err != nil {
283			return nil, err
284		}
285		return &p, nil
286	}
287	
288	// RecallProductLot flips any not-yet-recalled lot to RECALLED with the reason.
289	// Returns false when the lot was already recalled (idempotency guard).
290	func (r *Repo) RecallProductLot(ctx context.Context, id, reason string) (bool, error) {
291		res, err := r.productLots.UpdateOne(ctx,
292			bson.D{
293				{Key: "_id", Value: id},
294				{Key: "status", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$ne", Value: domain.ProductLotStatusRecalled}}},
295			},
296			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
297				{Key: "status", Value: domain.ProductLotStatusRecalled},
298				{Key: "recall_reason", Value: reason},
299			}}},
300		)
301		if err != nil {
302			return false, err
303		}
304		return res.MatchedCount > 0, nil
305	}
306	
307	// --- batch QRs ---
308	
309	// InsertQR stores a freshly minted QR. A duplicate-key error means the random
310	// short code collided — the service regenerates and retries.
311	func (r *Repo) InsertQR(ctx context.Context, qr *domain.BatchQR) error {
312		_, err := r.qrs.InsertOne(ctx, qr)
313		return err
314	}
315	
316	// QRListFilter narrows the QR listing.
317	type QRListFilter struct {
318		ProductLotID string
319	}
320	
321	// ListQRs returns a page of QRs plus the total match count.
322	func (r *Repo) ListQRs(ctx context.Context, f QRListFilter, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.BatchQR, int64, error) {
323		filter := bson.D{}
324		if f.ProductLotID != "" {
325			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "product_lot_id", Value: f.ProductLotID})
326		}
327		total, err := r.qrs.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
328		if err != nil {
329			return nil, 0, err
330		}
331		cur, err := r.qrs.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
332			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "issued_at", Value: -1}}).
333			SetSkip(page.Offset).SetLimit(page.Limit))
334		if err != nil {
335			return nil, 0, err
336		}
337		out := []domain.BatchQR{}
338		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
339			return nil, 0, err
340		}
341		return out, total, nil
342	}
343

345

348		return r.setProvenanceSeq(ctx, r.bmcLots, id, seq)
349	}

352	func (r *Repo) SetBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx context.Context, id string, seq int64) error {
353		return r.setProvenanceSeq(ctx, r.batches, id, seq)
354	}
355	
356	// SetProductLotProvenanceSeq stamps the ledger sequence onto a product lot.
357	func (r *Repo) SetProductLotProvenanceSeq(ctx context.Context, id string, seq int64) error {
358		return r.setProvenanceSeq(ctx, r.productLots, id, seq)
359	}
360	
361	// SetQRProvenanceSeq stamps the ledger sequence onto a QR document.
362	func (r *Repo) SetQRProvenanceSeq(ctx context.Context, id string, seq int64) error {

1	package settlement
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"errors"
6		"time"
7	
8		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
9		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
10		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo/options"
11	
12		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
13		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
14		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/mongodb"
15	)
16	
17	// internalFetchCap bounds internal (non-paginated) reads so a pathological
18	// day can never pull an unbounded set into memory. A DCS day is a few
19	// hundred invoices at most.
20	const internalFetchCap = 5000
21	
22	// repo owns every MongoDB access for the settlement module. No business
23	// logic lives here — only reads, guarded writes and error mapping.
24	type repo struct {
25		batches  *mongo.Collection
26		payouts  *mongo.Collection
27		invoices *mongo.Collection
28		kyc      *mongo.Collection
29		parties  *mongo.Collection
30		dbt      *mongo.Collection
31	}
32	
33	// newRepo binds the repo to the shared database handle.
34	func newRepo(db *mongo.Database) *repo {
35		return &repo{
36			batches:  db.Collection(mongodb.CollSettlements),
37			payouts:  db.Collection(mongodb.CollPayouts),
38			invoices: db.Collection(mongodb.CollInvoices),
39			kyc:      db.Collection(mongodb.CollKYCRecords),
40			parties:  db.Collection(mongodb.CollParties),
41			dbt:      db.Collection(mongodb.CollDBTRequests),
42		}
43	}
44	
45	// ---- invoices (read + settlement-lifecycle status flips only) ----
46	
47	// issuedInvoices returns the day's ISSUED invoices for a DCS.
48	func (rp *repo) issuedInvoices(ctx context.Context, dcsID, date string) ([]domain.Invoice, error) {
49		cur, err := rp.invoices.Find(ctx,
50			bson.D{
51				{Key: "dcs_id", Value: dcsID},
52				{Key: "invoice_date", Value: date},
53				{Key: "status", Value: domain.InvoiceStatusIssued},
54			},
55			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "invoice_number", Value: 1}}).SetLimit(internalFetchCap),
56		)
57		if err != nil {
58			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
59		}
60		var out []domain.Invoice
61		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
62			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
63		}
64		return out, nil
65	}
66	
67	// claimInvoices atomically flips still-ISSUED invoices to SETTLEMENT_PENDING
68	// under the given batch. The status guard makes concurrent initiations safe
69	// without transactions: each invoice is claimed by exactly one batch.
70	func (rp *repo) claimInvoices(ctx context.Context, invoiceIDs []string, batchID string) (int64, error) {
71		res, err := rp.invoices.UpdateMany(ctx,
72			bson.D{
73				{Key: "_id", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: invoiceIDs}}},
74				{Key: "status", Value: domain.InvoiceStatusIssued},
75			},
76			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
77				{Key: "status", Value: domain.InvoiceStatusSettlementPending},
78				{Key: "settlement_batch_id", Value: batchID},
79			}}},
80		)
81		if err != nil {
82			return 0, httpx.Internal(err)
83		}
84		return res.ModifiedCount, nil
85	}
86	
87	// invoicesByBatch returns every invoice claimed by a settlement batch.
88	func (rp *repo) invoicesByBatch(ctx context.Context, batchID string) ([]domain.Invoice, error) {
89		cur, err := rp.invoices.Find(ctx,
90			bson.D{{Key: "settlement_batch_id", Value: batchID}},
91			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "invoice_number", Value: 1}}).SetLimit(internalFetchCap),
92		)
93		if err != nil {
94			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
95		}
96		var out []domain.Invoice
97		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
98			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
99		}
100		return out, nil
101	}
102	
103	// releaseInvoices puts a rejected batch's invoices back to ISSUED and clears
104	// the batch linkage, so a fresh initiation can pick them up.
105	func (rp *repo) releaseInvoices(ctx context.Context, batchID string) error {
106		_, err := rp.invoices.UpdateMany(ctx,
107			bson.D{
108				{Key: "settlement_batch_id", Value: batchID},
109				{Key: "status", Value: domain.InvoiceStatusSettlementPending},
110			},
111			bson.D{
112				{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: domain.InvoiceStatusIssued}}},
113				{Key: "$unset", Value: bson.D{{Key: "settlement_batch_id", Value: ""}}},
114			},
115		)
116		if err != nil {
117			return httpx.Internal(err)
118		}
119		return nil
120	}
121	
122	// markInvoicesPaid flips all of a batch's invoices to PAID after execution.
123	func (rp *repo) markInvoicesPaid(ctx context.Context, batchID string) error {
124		_, err := rp.invoices.UpdateMany(ctx,
125			bson.D{{Key: "settlement_batch_id", Value: batchID}},
126			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: domain.InvoiceStatusPaid}}}},
127		)
128		if err != nil {
129			return httpx.Internal(err)
130		}
131		return nil
132	}
133	
134	// ---- settlement batches ----
135	
136	// insertBatch persists a new settlement batch.
137	func (rp *repo) insertBatch(ctx context.Context, b *domain.SettlementBatch) error {
138		if _, err := rp.batches.InsertOne(ctx, b); err != nil {
139			return httpx.Internal(err)
140		}
141		return nil
142	}
143	
144	// batchByID loads one settlement batch.
145	func (rp *repo) batchByID(ctx context.Context, id string) (*domain.SettlementBatch, error) {
146		var b domain.SettlementBatch
147		err := rp.batches.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&b)
148		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
149			return nil, httpx.NotFound("settlement batch " + id)
150		}
151		if err != nil {
152			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
153		}
154		return &b, nil
155	}
156	
157	// transitionBatch performs a status-guarded update (optimistic concurrency —
158	// no transactions on a standalone server). Returns false when the batch was
159	// not in fromStatus, i.e. another actor won the transition.
160	func (rp *repo) transitionBatch(ctx context.Context, id, fromStatus string, set bson.D) (bool, error) {
161		res, err := rp.batches.UpdateOne(ctx,
162			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}, {Key: "status", Value: fromStatus}},
163			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: set}},
164		)
165		if err != nil {
166			return false, httpx.Internal(err)
167		}
168		return res.MatchedCount > 0, nil
169	}
170	
171	// setBatchProvenanceSeq stamps the batch with its latest ledger sequence.
172	func (rp *repo) setBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx context.Context, id string, seq int64) error {
173		_, err := rp.batches.UpdateOne(ctx,
174			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}},
175			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "provenance_seq", Value: seq}}}},
176		)
177		if err != nil {
178			return httpx.Internal(err)
179		}
180		return nil
181	}
182	
183	// listBatches pages settlement batches, newest day first.
184	func (rp *repo) listBatches(ctx context.Context, filter bson.D, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.SettlementBatch, int64, error) {
185		total, err := rp.batches.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
186		if err != nil {
187			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
188		}
189		cur, err := rp.batches.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
190			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "date", Value: -1}, {Key: "created_at", Value: -1}}).
191			SetSkip(page.Offset).SetLimit(page.Limit),
192		)
193		if err != nil {
194			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
195		}
196		var out []domain.SettlementBatch
197		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
198			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
199		}
200		return out, total, nil
201	}
202	
203	// ---- payout instructions ----
204	
205	// insertPayout persists one payout. The unique index on invoice_id makes an
206	// execution retry harmless: alreadyExists=true means this invoice was paid
207	// in a previous (possibly interrupted) run.
208	func (rp *repo) insertPayout(ctx context.Context, p *domain.PayoutInstruction) (alreadyExists bool, err error) {
209		if _, err := rp.payouts.InsertOne(ctx, p); err != nil {
210			if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(err) {
211				return true, nil
212			}
213			return false, httpx.Internal(err)
214		}
215		return false, nil
216	}
217	
218	// payoutByInvoice fetches the payout already recorded for an invoice.
219	func (rp *repo) payoutByInvoice(ctx context.Context, invoiceID string) (*domain.PayoutInstruction, error) {
220		var p domain.PayoutInstruction
221		err := rp.payouts.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "invoice_id", Value: invoiceID}}).Decode(&p)
222		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
223			return nil, httpx.NotFound("payout for invoice " + invoiceID)
224		}
225		if err != nil {
226			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
227		}
228		return &p, nil
229	}

231	// payoutsByBatch returns a batch's payout instructions.
232	func (rp *repo) payoutsByBatch(ctx context.Context, batchID string) ([]domain.PayoutInstruction, error) {
233		cur, err := rp.payouts.Find(ctx,
234			bson.D{{Key: "settlement_batch_id", Value: batchID}},
235			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "created_at", Value: 1}}).SetLimit(internalFetchCap),
236		)
237		if err != nil {
238			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
239		}
240		var out []domain.PayoutInstruction
241		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
242			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
243		}
244		return out, nil
245	}
246	
247	// payoutsByFarmer pages one farmer's payment history, newest first.
248	func (rp *repo) payoutsByFarmer(ctx context.Context, farmerPartyID string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.PayoutInstruction, int64, error) {
249		filter := bson.D{{Key: "farmer_party_id", Value: farmerPartyID}}
250		total, err := rp.payouts.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
251		if err != nil {
252			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
253		}
254		cur, err := rp.payouts.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
255			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "created_at", Value: -1}}).
256			SetSkip(page.Offset).SetLimit(page.Limit),
257		)
258		if err != nil {
259			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
260		}
261		var out []domain.PayoutInstruction
262		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
263			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
264		}
265		return out, total, nil
266	}
267	
268	// ---- lookups in adjacent collections (read-only, per module spec) ----
269	
270	// latestBankMasked returns the masked bank account from the farmer's most
271	// recent KYC record carrying one, or "" when none exists.
272	func (rp *repo) latestBankMasked(ctx context.Context, partyID string) (string, error) {
273		var rec domain.KYCRecord
274		err := rp.kyc.FindOne(ctx,
275			bson.D{
276				{Key: "party_id", Value: partyID},
277				{Key: "bank_account_masked", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$exists", Value: true}, {Key: "$ne", Value: ""}}},
278			},
279			options.FindOne().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "created_at", Value: -1}}),
280		).Decode(&rec)
281		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
282			return "", nil
283		}
284		if err != nil {
285			return "", httpx.Internal(err)
286		}
287		return rec.BankAccountMasked, nil
288	}

290	// partyPhone resolves a party's phone number (for the payout SMS event).
291	func (rp *repo) partyPhone(ctx context.Context, partyID string) (string, error) {
292		var p domain.Party
293		err := rp.parties.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: partyID}}).Decode(&p)
294		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
295			return "", httpx.NotFound("party " + partyID)
296		}
297		if err != nil {
298			return "", httpx.Internal(err)
299		}
300		return p.Phone, nil
301	}
302	
303	// ---- DBT requests ----
304	
305	// insertDBT persists a new subsidy request.
306	func (rp *repo) insertDBT(ctx context.Context, r *domain.DBTRequest) error {
307		if _, err := rp.dbt.InsertOne(ctx, r); err != nil {
308			return httpx.Internal(err)
309		}
310		return nil
311	}
312	
313	// dbtByID loads one DBT request.
314	func (rp *repo) dbtByID(ctx context.Context, id string) (*domain.DBTRequest, error) {
315		var d domain.DBTRequest
316		err := rp.dbt.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&d)
317		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
318			return nil, httpx.NotFound("dbt request " + id)
319		}
320		if err != nil {
321			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
322		}
323		return &d, nil
324	}
325	
326	// transitionDBT performs a status-guarded DBT update; false = lost the race
327	// or the request already left fromStatus.
328	func (rp *repo) transitionDBT(ctx context.Context, id, fromStatus, toStatus string, creditedAt *time.Time) (bool, error) {
329		set := bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: toStatus}}
330		if creditedAt != nil {
331			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "credited_at", Value: creditedAt})
332		}
333		res, err := rp.dbt.UpdateOne(ctx,
334			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}, {Key: "status", Value: fromStatus}},
335			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: set}},
336		)
337		if err != nil {
338			return false, httpx.Internal(err)
339		}
340		return res.MatchedCount > 0, nil
341	}
342	
343	// listDBT pages DBT requests, newest first.
344	func (rp *repo) listDBT(ctx context.Context, filter bson.D, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.DBTRequest, int64, error) {
345		total, err := rp.dbt.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
346		if err != nil {
347			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
348		}
349		cur, err := rp.dbt.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
350			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "created_at", Value: -1}}).
351			SetSkip(page.Offset).SetLimit(page.Limit),
352		)
353		if err != nil {
354			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
355		}
356		var out []domain.DBTRequest
357		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
358			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
359		}
360		return out, total, nil
361	}

16	// Repo is the plant module's MongoDB access layer. All state transitions use
17	// optimistic filters on the expected status — no transactions (standalone
18	// server), so a lost race simply matches zero documents and the service
19	// reports a conflict instead of corrupting state.
20	type Repo struct {
21		consignments *mongo.Collection
22		bmcLots      *mongo.Collection
23		batches      *mongo.Collection
