1	package logistics
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"errors"
6		"fmt"
7		"math"
8		"time"
9	
10		"github.com/google/uuid"
11		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
12	
13		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
14		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
16		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/orgscope"
17		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/provenance"
18	)
19	
20	const (
21		// canCapacityLitres is the standard milk-can volume used to size a
22		// consignment: can_count = ceil(total litres / 40).
23		canCapacityLitres = 40.0
24	
25		// maxPourRefs caps how many pour references a consignment.created
26		// provenance event carries; beyond it the pour count lives in the
27		// payload only, keeping ledger events bounded.
28		maxPourRefs = 300
29	
30		// maxTripStops bounds a planned route so trip documents stay small.
31		maxTripStops = 100
32	
33		// Physical sanity bounds for a hand-held transit thermometer reading.
34		minPlausibleTempC = -30.0
35		maxPlausibleTempC = 70.0
36	)
37	
38	// service holds all logistics business logic: consignment aggregation,
39	// the consignment/trip state machines, and provenance emission.
40	type service struct {
41		repo   *repo
42		orgs   *orgscope.Resolver
43		ledger *provenance.Ledger
44	}
45	
46	// newService wires the service to its collaborators.
47	func newService(repo *repo, orgs *orgscope.Resolver, ledger *provenance.Ledger) *service {
48		return &service{repo: repo, orgs: orgs, ledger: ledger}
49	}
50	
51	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
52	// Consignments
53	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
54	
55	// createConsignment pools one DCS date+shift's RECORDED pours into an OPEN
56	// consignment: pour IDs, total litres, quantity-weighted fat/SNF averages and
57	// the can count. The unique dcs+date+shift index makes creation idempotent-ish
58	// (a replay returns CONSIGNMENT_EXISTS).
59	func (s *service) createConsignment(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req createConsignmentRequest) (*domain.DCSConsignment, error) {
60		if req.DCSID == "" {
61			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_DCS_ID", "dcs_id is required")
62		}
63		if err := validateShift(req.Shift); err != nil {
64			return nil, err
65		}
66		now := time.Now().UTC()
67		date, err := resolveDate(req.Date, now)
68		if err != nil {
69			return nil, err
70		}
71		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.DCSID); err != nil {
72			return nil, err
73		}
74		org, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.DCSID)
75		if err != nil {
76			return nil, err
77		}
78		if org.Type != domain.OrgTypeDCS {
79			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_DCS", "org unit "+req.DCSID+" is not a DCS")
80		}
81	
82		rows, err := s.repo.findRecordedPours(ctx, req.DCSID, date, req.Shift)
83		if err != nil {
84			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
85		}
86		if len(rows) == 0 {
87			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("NO_POURS_TO_CONSIGN",
88				fmt.Sprintf("no RECORDED pours for DCS %s on %s %s", req.DCSID, date, req.Shift))
89		}
90		pourIDs, totalQty, avgFat, avgSNF := aggregatePours(rows)
91	
92		consignment := &domain.DCSConsignment{
93			ID:                  uuid.NewString(),
94			DCSID:               req.DCSID,
95			Date:                date,
96			Shift:               req.Shift,
97			PourIDs:             pourIDs,
98			TotalQuantityLitres: totalQty,
99			CanCount:            int(math.Ceil(totalQty / canCapacityLitres)),
100			AvgFatPct:           avgFat,
101			AvgSNFPct:           avgSNF,
102			Status:              domain.ConsignmentStatusOpen,
103			CreatedBy:           actor.PartyID,
104			CreatedAt:           now,
105		}
106		if err := s.repo.insertConsignment(ctx, consignment); err != nil {
107			if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(err) {
108				return nil, httpx.Conflict("CONSIGNMENT_EXISTS",
109					fmt.Sprintf("a consignment for DCS %s on %s %s already exists", req.DCSID, date, req.Shift))
110			}
111			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
112		}
113	
114		// Provenance: the pooling-boundary event. Pour refs are capped so the
115		// event stays bounded — past the cap the payload's pour_count is the
116		// authoritative tally (the doc's pour_ids keeps the full set).
117		refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, min(len(pourIDs), maxPourRefs))
118		for i, id := range pourIDs {
119			if i >= maxPourRefs {
120				break
121			}
122			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{EntityType: domain.EntityMilkPour, EntityID: id, Relation: "aggregates"})
123		}
124		event, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
125			Type:       domain.EventConsignmentCreated,
126			EntityType: domain.EntityConsignment,
127			EntityID:   consignment.ID,
128			Refs:       refs,
129			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
130			OrgUnitID:  consignment.DCSID,
131			Payload: map[string]any{
132				"pour_count":            len(pourIDs),
133				"total_quantity_litres": totalQty,
134				"can_count":             consignment.CanCount,
135				"date":                  date,
136				"shift":                 req.Shift,
137			},
138		})
139		if err != nil {
140			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
141		}
142		if err := s.repo.setConsignmentProvenanceSeq(ctx, consignment.ID, event.Seq); err != nil {
143			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
144		}
145		consignment.ProvenanceSeq = event.Seq
146		return consignment, nil
147	}
148	
149	// dispatchConsignment seals an OPEN consignment for pickup (OPEN→DISPATCHED).
150	func (s *service) dispatchConsignment(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id string) (*domain.DCSConsignment, error) {
151		consignment, err := s.loadConsignment(ctx, id)
152		if err != nil {
153			return nil, err
154		}
155		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, consignment.DCSID); err != nil {
156			return nil, err
157		}
158		if consignment.Status != domain.ConsignmentStatusOpen {
159			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_CONSIGNMENT_STATE",
160				"consignment is "+consignment.Status+"; only OPEN consignments can be dispatched")
161		}
162		now := time.Now().UTC()
163		matched, err := s.repo.markConsignmentDispatched(ctx, id, now)
164		if err != nil {
165			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
166		}
167		if !matched { // lost a state race since the read above
168			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_CONSIGNMENT_STATE",
169				"consignment was modified concurrently; reload and retry")
170		}
171		event, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
172			Type:       domain.EventConsignmentDispatched,
173			EntityType: domain.EntityConsignment,
174			EntityID:   consignment.ID,
175			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
176			OrgUnitID:  consignment.DCSID,
177		})
178		if err != nil {
179			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
180		}
181		if err := s.repo.setConsignmentProvenanceSeq(ctx, consignment.ID, event.Seq); err != nil {
182			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
183		}
184		consignment.Status = domain.ConsignmentStatusDispatch
185		consignment.DispatchedAt = &now
186		consignment.ProvenanceSeq = event.Seq
187		return consignment, nil
188	}
189	
190	// listConsignments returns a scoped page of consignments. DCS-scoped actors
191	// default to their own society; wide read roles (SUPER_ADMIN, STATE_AUDITOR)
192	// may list unfiltered; everyone else must name a dcs_id inside their scope.
193	func (s *service) listConsignments(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, q consignmentListQuery, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.DCSConsignment, int64, error) {
194		dcsID := q.DCSID
195		if dcsID == "" {
196			switch {
197			case actor.OrgType == domain.OrgTypeDCS && actor.OrgUnitID != "":
198				dcsID = actor.OrgUnitID
199			case actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSuperAdmin || actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleStateAuditor:
200				// federation-wide read roles may scan unfiltered (still paged)
201			default:
202				return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("DCS_ID_REQUIRED", "dcs_id query parameter is required for your role")
203			}
204		}
205		if dcsID != "" {
206			if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, dcsID); err != nil {
207				return nil, 0, err
208			}
209		}
210		if q.Date != "" {
211			if _, err := resolveDate(q.Date, time.Time{}); err != nil {
212				return nil, 0, err
213			}
214		}
215		if q.Status != "" && !isConsignmentStatus(q.Status) {
216			return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_STATUS", "unknown consignment status "+q.Status)
217		}
218		items, total, err := s.repo.listConsignments(ctx, dcsID, q.Date, q.Status, page)
219		if err != nil {
220			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
221		}
222		return items, total, nil
223	}
224	
225	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
226	// Route trips
227	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
228	
229	// createTrip plans a van run: every stop's consignment must already be
230	// DISPATCHED and must belong to that stop's DCS. The rider defaults to the
231	// actor when a VAN_RIDER plans their own route.
232	func (s *service) createTrip(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req createTripRequest) (*domain.RouteTrip, error) {
233		if req.RouteName == "" {
234			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_ROUTE_NAME", "route_name is required")
235		}
236		if req.UnionID == "" {
237			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_UNION_ID", "union_id is required")
238		}
239		if err := validateShift(req.Shift); err != nil {
240			return nil, err
241		}
242		if len(req.Stops) == 0 {
243			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NO_STOPS", "at least one stop is required")
244		}
245		if len(req.Stops) > maxTripStops {
246			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("TOO_MANY_STOPS", fmt.Sprintf("a trip may have at most %d stops", maxTripStops))
247		}
248		now := time.Now().UTC()
249		date, err := resolveDate(req.Date, now)
250		if err != nil {
251			return nil, err
252		}
253		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.UnionID); err != nil {
254			return nil, err
255		}
256		union, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.UnionID)
257		if err != nil {
258			return nil, err
259		}
260		if union.Type != domain.OrgTypeMilkUnion {
261			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_UNION", "org unit "+req.UnionID+" is not a MILK_UNION")
262		}
263	
264		riderPartyID := req.VanRiderPartyID
265		if riderPartyID == "" {
266			if actor.RoleCode != domain.RoleVanRider {
267				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("RIDER_REQUIRED", "van_rider_party_id is required unless a VAN_RIDER plans their own trip")
268			}
269			riderPartyID = actor.PartyID
270		}
271	
272		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(req.Stops))
273		stops := make([]domain.RouteStop, 0, len(req.Stops))
274		for _, stop := range req.Stops {
275			if stop.DCSID == "" || stop.ConsignmentID == "" {
276				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_STOP", "every stop needs dcs_id and consignment_id")
277			}
278			if _, dup := seen[stop.ConsignmentID]; dup {
279				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("DUPLICATE_STOP", "consignment "+stop.ConsignmentID+" appears in more than one stop")
280			}
281			seen[stop.ConsignmentID] = struct{}{}
282	
283			consignment, err := s.loadConsignment(ctx, stop.ConsignmentID)
284			if err != nil {
285				return nil, err
286			}
287			if aerr := validateStopConsignment(consignment, stop.DCSID); aerr != nil {
288				return nil, aerr
289			}
290			stops = append(stops, domain.RouteStop{DCSID: stop.DCSID, ConsignmentID: stop.ConsignmentID})
291		}
292	
293		trip := &domain.RouteTrip{
294			ID:              uuid.NewString(),
295			RouteName:       req.RouteName,
296			UnionID:         req.UnionID,
297			VanRiderPartyID: riderPartyID,
298			Date:            date,
299			Shift:           req.Shift,
300			Stops:           stops,
301			Status:          domain.TripStatusPlanned,
302			CreatedAt:       now,
303		}
304		if err := s.repo.insertTrip(ctx, trip); err != nil {
305			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
306		}
307		return trip, nil
308	}
309	
310	// pickupStop records the trip's rider collecting one consignment: the stop is
311	// stamped with time+temperature, the consignment moves DISPATCHED→PICKED_UP,
312	// and the trip moves to IN_PROGRESS on its first pickup.
313	func (s *service) pickupStop(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, tripID, consignmentID string, req pickupRequest) (*domain.RouteTrip, error) {
314		if err := validateTemp(req.TempC); err != nil {
315			return nil, err
316		}
317		trip, err := s.loadTrip(ctx, tripID)
318		if err != nil {
319			return nil, err
320		}
321		if aerr := validatePickup(trip, actor.PartyID, consignmentID); aerr != nil {
322			return nil, aerr
323		}
324	
325		// Guard the consignment transition atomically; only a DISPATCHED
326		// consignment can board the van.
327		matched, err := s.repo.markConsignmentPickedUp(ctx, consignmentID, trip.ID)
328		if err != nil {
329			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
330		}
331		if !matched {
332			consignment, err := s.loadConsignment(ctx, consignmentID)
333			if err != nil {
334				return nil, err
335			}
336			return nil, httpx.Conflict("CONSIGNMENT_NOT_DISPATCHED",
337				"consignment is "+consignment.Status+"; only DISPATCHED consignments can be picked up")
338		}
339	
340		now := time.Now().UTC()
341		if err := s.repo.markStopPickedUp(ctx, trip.ID, consignmentID, now, *req.TempC, req.Notes); err != nil {
342			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
343		}
344	
345		event, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
346			Type:       domain.EventConsignmentPickedUp,
347			EntityType: domain.EntityConsignment,
348			EntityID:   consignmentID,
349			Refs: []provenance.Ref{
350				{EntityType: domain.EntityRouteTrip, EntityID: trip.ID, Relation: "carried_by"},
351			},
352			Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
353			OrgUnitID: trip.UnionID,
354			Payload:   map[string]any{"temp_c": *req.TempC},
355		})
356		if err != nil {
357			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
358		}
359		if err := s.repo.setConsignmentProvenanceSeq(ctx, consignmentID, event.Seq); err != nil {
360			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
361		}
362	
363		trip.Status = domain.TripStatusInProgress
364		if i := findStop(trip, consignmentID); i >= 0 {
365			trip.Stops[i].PickedUpAt = &now
366			trip.Stops[i].TempC = *req.TempC
367			trip.Stops[i].Notes = req.Notes
368		}
369		return trip, nil
370	}
371	
372	// logColdChain appends one in-transit temperature sample to the trip —
373	// tamper-evidence for the perishable load between village and BMC.
374	func (s *service) logColdChain(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, tripID string, req coldChainRequest) (*domain.RouteTrip, error) {
375		if err := validateTemp(req.TempC); err != nil {
376			return nil, err
377		}
378		trip, err := s.loadTrip(ctx, tripID)
379		if err != nil {
380			return nil, err
381		}
382		if aerr := validateColdChain(trip, actor.PartyID); aerr != nil {
383			return nil, aerr
384		}
385		entry := domain.ColdChainEntry{
386			TS:     time.Now().UTC(),
387			TempC:  *req.TempC,
388			GeoLat: req.GeoLat,
389			GeoLng: req.GeoLng,
390		}
391		if err := s.repo.pushColdChain(ctx, trip.ID, entry); err != nil {
392			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
393		}
394		event, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
395			Type:       domain.EventColdChainLogged,
396			EntityType: domain.EntityRouteTrip,
397			EntityID:   trip.ID,
398			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
399			OrgUnitID:  trip.UnionID,
400			Payload:    map[string]any{"temp_c": *req.TempC},
401		})
402		if err != nil {
403			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
404		}
405		if err := s.repo.setTripProvenanceSeq(ctx, trip.ID, event.Seq); err != nil {
406			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
407		}
408		trip.ColdChain = append(trip.ColdChain, entry)
409		trip.ProvenanceSeq = event.Seq
410		return trip, nil
411	}
412	
413	// deliverTrip hands the whole load to a BMC: every stop must be picked up,
414	// the trip moves IN_PROGRESS→DELIVERED and its consignments PICKED_UP→DELIVERED.
415	func (s *service) deliverTrip(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, tripID string, req deliverRequest) (*domain.RouteTrip, error) {
416		if req.BMCID == "" {
417			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_BMC_ID", "bmc_id is required")
418		}
419		trip, err := s.loadTrip(ctx, tripID)
420		if err != nil {
421			return nil, err
422		}
423		if aerr := validateDeliver(trip, actor.PartyID); aerr != nil {
424			return nil, aerr
425		}
426		bmc, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.BMCID)
427		if err != nil {
428			return nil, err
429		}
430		if bmc.Type != domain.OrgTypeBMC {
431			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_BMC", "org unit "+req.BMCID+" is not a BMC")
432		}
433	
434		now := time.Now().UTC()
435		matched, err := s.repo.markTripDelivered(ctx, trip.ID, req.BMCID, now)
436		if err != nil {
437			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
438		}
439		if !matched { // lost a state race since the read above
440			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_TRIP_STATE", "trip was modified concurrently; reload and retry")
441		}
442	
443		consignmentIDs := make([]string, 0, len(trip.Stops))
444		refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, len(trip.Stops))
445		for _, stop := range trip.Stops {
446			consignmentIDs = append(consignmentIDs, stop.ConsignmentID)
447			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{
448				EntityType: domain.EntityConsignment, EntityID: stop.ConsignmentID, Relation: "delivered",
449			})
450		}
451		if err := s.repo.markConsignmentsDelivered(ctx, consignmentIDs); err != nil {
452			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
453		}
454	
455		event, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
456			Type:       domain.EventTripDelivered,
457			EntityType: domain.EntityRouteTrip,
458			EntityID:   trip.ID,
459			Refs:       refs,
460			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
461			OrgUnitID:  trip.UnionID,
462			Payload:    map[string]any{"bmc_id": req.BMCID},
463		})
464		if err != nil {
465			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
466		}
467		if err := s.repo.setTripProvenanceSeq(ctx, trip.ID, event.Seq); err != nil {
468			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
469		}
470	
471		trip.Status = domain.TripStatusDelivered
472		trip.DeliveredToBMCID = req.BMCID
473		trip.DeliveredAt = &now
474		trip.ProvenanceSeq = event.Seq
475		return trip, nil
476	}
477	
478	// listTrips returns a scoped page of trips: riders are forced onto their own
479	// trips; supervisors/presidents default to (and are checked against) their
480	// union scope.
481	func (s *service) listTrips(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, q tripListQuery, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.RouteTrip, int64, error) {
482		unionID := q.UnionID
483		riderPartyID := q.VanRiderPartyID
484		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleVanRider {
485			riderPartyID = actor.PartyID // riders only ever see their own trips
486		} else {
487			if unionID == "" &&
488				actor.RoleCode != domain.RoleSuperAdmin && actor.RoleCode != domain.RoleStateAuditor {
489				unionID = actor.OrgUnitID // supervisors/presidents default to their union
490			}
491			if unionID != "" {
492				if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, unionID); err != nil {
493					return nil, 0, err
494				}
495			}
496		}
497		if q.Date != "" {
498			if _, err := resolveDate(q.Date, time.Time{}); err != nil {
499				return nil, 0, err
500			}
501		}
502		items, total, err := s.repo.listTrips(ctx, unionID, q.Date, riderPartyID, page)
503		if err != nil {
504			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
505		}
506		return items, total, nil
507	}

509	// getTrip returns one trip: a rider only their own, everyone else within
510	// union scope.
511	func (s *service) getTrip(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, tripID string) (*domain.RouteTrip, error) {
512		trip, err := s.loadTrip(ctx, tripID)
513		if err != nil {
514			return nil, err
515		}
516		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleVanRider {
517			if trip.VanRiderPartyID != actor.PartyID {
518				return nil, httpx.Forbidden("this trip is assigned to another van rider")
519			}
520			return trip, nil
521		}
522		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, trip.UnionID); err != nil {
523			return nil, err
524		}
525		return trip, nil
526	}

556	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
557	// Pure guards & helpers (unit-tested in service_test.go)
558	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
559	
560	// aggregatePours reduces pour rows to (ids, total litres, quantity-weighted
561	// average fat %, quantity-weighted average SNF %), rounded to 2 decimals.
562	func aggregatePours(rows []pourRow) (pourIDs []string, totalQty, avgFat, avgSNF float64) {
563		var fatWeighted, snfWeighted float64
564		pourIDs = make([]string, 0, len(rows))
565		for _, row := range rows {
566			pourIDs = append(pourIDs, row.ID)
567			totalQty += row.QuantityLitres
568			fatWeighted += row.FatPct * row.QuantityLitres
569			snfWeighted += row.SNFPct * row.QuantityLitres
570		}
571		if totalQty > 0 {
572			avgFat = round2(fatWeighted / totalQty)
573			avgSNF = round2(snfWeighted / totalQty)
574		}
575		return pourIDs, round2(totalQty), avgFat, avgSNF
576	}
577	
578	// round2 rounds to 2 decimal places (litres / percentage precision).
579	func round2(v float64) float64 { return math.Round(v*100) / 100 }
580	
581	// validateShift accepts only the two collection shifts.
582	func validateShift(shift string) *httpx.AppError {
583		if shift != domain.ShiftMorning && shift != domain.ShiftEvening {
584			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_SHIFT", "shift must be MORNING or EVENING")
585		}
586		return nil
587	}
588	
589	// resolveDate defaults an empty date to the IST day key of now, otherwise
590	// validates the YYYY-MM-DD form.
591	func resolveDate(date string, now time.Time) (string, error) {
592		if date == "" {
593			return domain.DateKeyIST(now), nil
594		}
595		if _, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", date); err != nil {
596			return "", httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_DATE", "date must be YYYY-MM-DD")
597		}
598		return date, nil
599	}
600	
601	// validateTemp requires a temperature and rejects physically implausible ones.
602	func validateTemp(tempC *float64) *httpx.AppError {
603		if tempC == nil {
604			return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_TEMP", "temp_c is required")
605		}
606		if *tempC < minPlausibleTempC || *tempC > maxPlausibleTempC {
607			return httpx.BadRequest("IMPLAUSIBLE_TEMP",
608				fmt.Sprintf("temp_c must be between %.0f and %.0f °C", minPlausibleTempC, maxPlausibleTempC))
609		}
610		return nil
611	}
612	
613	// isConsignmentStatus reports whether s is a known consignment status.
614	func isConsignmentStatus(s string) bool {
615		switch s {
616		case domain.ConsignmentStatusOpen, domain.ConsignmentStatusDispatch,
617			domain.ConsignmentStatusPickedUp, domain.ConsignmentStatusDelivered,
618			domain.ConsignmentStatusAccepted, domain.ConsignmentStatusRejected:
619			return true
620		}
621		return false
622	}
623	
624	// findStop returns the index of the stop carrying consignmentID, or -1.
625	func findStop(trip *domain.RouteTrip, consignmentID string) int {
626		for i := range trip.Stops {
627			if trip.Stops[i].ConsignmentID == consignmentID {
628				return i
629			}
630		}
631		return -1
632	}
633	
634	// requireTripRider enforces that only the trip's assigned van rider acts on it.
635	func requireTripRider(trip *domain.RouteTrip, riderPartyID string) *httpx.AppError {
636		if trip.VanRiderPartyID != riderPartyID {
637			return httpx.Forbidden("this trip is assigned to another van rider")
638		}
639		return nil
640	}
641	
642	// validateStopConsignment guards trip planning: the stop's consignment must
643	// be DISPATCHED (state machine) and must belong to the stop's DCS.
644	func validateStopConsignment(consignment *domain.DCSConsignment, stopDCSID string) *httpx.AppError {
645		if consignment.Status != domain.ConsignmentStatusDispatch {
646			return httpx.Conflict("CONSIGNMENT_NOT_DISPATCHED",
647				"consignment "+consignment.ID+" is "+consignment.Status+"; only DISPATCHED consignments can be planned onto a trip")
648		}
649		if consignment.DCSID != stopDCSID {
650			return httpx.Unprocessable("CONSIGNMENT_DCS_MISMATCH",
651				"consignment "+consignment.ID+" belongs to DCS "+consignment.DCSID+", not the stop's DCS "+stopDCSID)
652		}
653		return nil
654	}
655	
656	// validatePickup guards the pickup transition: right rider, trip not yet
657	// delivered, stop exists, stop not already picked.
658	func validatePickup(trip *domain.RouteTrip, riderPartyID, consignmentID string) *httpx.AppError {
659		if err := requireTripRider(trip, riderPartyID); err != nil {
660			return err
661		}
662		if trip.Status == domain.TripStatusDelivered {
663			return httpx.Conflict("TRIP_ALREADY_DELIVERED", "trip is DELIVERED; no further pickups are possible")
664		}
665		i := findStop(trip, consignmentID)
666		if i < 0 {
667			return httpx.NotFound("stop for consignment " + consignmentID)
668		}
669		if trip.Stops[i].PickedUpAt != nil {
670			return httpx.Conflict("STOP_ALREADY_PICKED", "consignment "+consignmentID+" was already picked up on this trip")
671		}
672		return nil
673	}
674	
675	// validateColdChain guards cold-chain logging: right rider, trip still moving.
676	func validateColdChain(trip *domain.RouteTrip, riderPartyID string) *httpx.AppError {
677		if err := requireTripRider(trip, riderPartyID); err != nil {
678			return err
679		}
680		if trip.Status == domain.TripStatusDelivered {
681			return httpx.Conflict("TRIP_ALREADY_DELIVERED", "trip is DELIVERED; cold-chain logging is closed")
682		}
683		return nil
684	}
685	
686	// validateDeliver guards delivery: right rider, not already delivered, and
687	// every stop picked up (partial loads cannot be handed to a BMC).
688	func validateDeliver(trip *domain.RouteTrip, riderPartyID string) *httpx.AppError {
689		if err := requireTripRider(trip, riderPartyID); err != nil {
690			return err
691		}
692		if trip.Status == domain.TripStatusDelivered {
693			return httpx.Conflict("TRIP_ALREADY_DELIVERED", "trip is already DELIVERED")
694		}
695		var unpicked []string
696		for _, stop := range trip.Stops {
697			if stop.PickedUpAt == nil {
698				unpicked = append(unpicked, stop.ConsignmentID)
699			}
700		}
701		if len(unpicked) > 0 {
702			return httpx.Unprocessable("STOPS_NOT_PICKED", "every stop must be picked up before delivery").
703				WithDetails(map[string]any{"unpicked_consignment_ids": unpicked})
704		}
705		return nil
706	}

37	// InsertAnimal persists a new animal. The unique index on pashu_aadhaar
38	// (mongodb.EnsureIndexes) turns a duplicate registration into ANIMAL_EXISTS.
39	func (r *repository) InsertAnimal(ctx context.Context, a *domain.Animal) error {
40		if _, err := r.animals.InsertOne(ctx, a); err != nil {
41			if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(err) {
42				return httpx.Conflict("ANIMAL_EXISTS", "an animal with this pashu_aadhaar is already registered")
43			}
44			return httpx.Internal(err)

157	// DispatchMVUCase moves a case REQUESTED → DISPATCHED, recording the vet
158	// and/or driver. The status guard in the filter is the optimistic lock (no
159	// transactions on a standalone server): a false return means the case was
160	// not in REQUESTED state — e.g. a concurrent dispatch won the race.
161	func (r *repository) DispatchMVUCase(ctx context.Context, id, vetPartyID, driverPartyID string) (bool, error) {
162		set := bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: domain.MVUCaseDispatched}}
163		if vetPartyID != "" {
164			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "vet_party_id", Value: vetPartyID})
165		}
166		if driverPartyID != "" {
167			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "driver_party_id", Value: driverPartyID})
168		}
169		res, err := r.mvuCases.UpdateOne(ctx,
170			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}, {Key: "status", Value: domain.MVUCaseRequested}},
171			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: set}})
172		if err != nil {
173			return false, httpx.Internal(err)
174		}
175		return res.MatchedCount == 1, nil
176	}
177	
178	// CloseMVUCase moves a DISPATCHED (or ARRIVED) case to CLOSED with the visit
179	// log. Same optimistic status-guard pattern as DispatchMVUCase.
180	func (r *repository) CloseMVUCase(ctx context.Context, id, visitNotes string, healthEventIDs []string, closedAt time.Time) (bool, error) {
181		set := bson.D{
182			{Key: "status", Value: domain.MVUCaseClosed},
183			{Key: "visit_notes", Value: visitNotes},
184			{Key: "closed_at", Value: closedAt},
185		}
186		if len(healthEventIDs) > 0 {
187			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "health_event_ids", Value: healthEventIDs})
188		}
189		res, err := r.mvuCases.UpdateOne(ctx,
190			bson.D{
191				{Key: "_id", Value: id},
192				{Key: "status", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: []string{
193					domain.MVUCaseDispatched, domain.MVUCaseArrived,
194				}}}},
195			},
196			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: set}})
197		if err != nil {
198			return false, httpx.Internal(err)
199		}
200		return res.MatchedCount == 1, nil
201	}

152	// claimQueuedNotification atomically claims the oldest QUEUED document
153	// (QUEUED→SENT, sent_at, provider_ref) and returns it, or nil when the queue
154	// is drained. FindOneAndUpdate makes the claim race-safe across concurrent
155	// worker runs — never find-then-update.
156	func (r *repository) claimQueuedNotification(ctx context.Context, providerRef string, now time.Time) (*StoredNotification, error) {

162				{Key: "sent_at", Value: now},
163				{Key: "provider_ref", Value: providerRef},
164			}}},
165			options.FindOneAndUpdate().
166				SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "queued_at", Value: 1}}).
167				SetReturnDocument(options.After),
168		).Decode(&n)
169		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
170			return nil, nil
171		}

```text
// Package settlement implements the same-day payment rail under the
// blueprint §8.1/§18-B guardrail: Saathi computes and initiates a batch,
// a DIFFERENT authorised human approves it (dual control), and a licensed
// Payment Aggregator (mocked here) executes the payouts. Scheme subsidies
// ride the strictly separate PFMS/DBT rail (§13) — never the milk-payment
// rail, and never the reverse.
package settlement

import (
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"

	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/middleware"
)

// Register wires the settlement module and mounts /settlements and /dbt
// under the /api/v1 subtree it receives.
func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
	svc := &service{
		repo:   newRepo(d.DB),
		ledger: d.Ledger,
		orgs:   d.Orgs,
		bus:    d.Bus,
		log:    d.Log,
	}
	h := &handler{svc: svc}

	// Read access to batches: village signatories plus union/state oversight.
	readRoles := middleware.RequireRoles(
		domain.RoleSamitiSacheev,
		domain.RoleSamitiAdhyaksh,
		domain.RoleUnionPresident,
		domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor,
		domain.RoleStateAuditor,
	)

	r.Route("/settlements", func(sr chi.Router) {
		sr.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))

		// Initiate: the Sacheev runs the collection console (§8.1 step 1).
		sr.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSamitiSacheev)).
			Post("/", h.initiate)

		// Approve / reject: a different authorised signatory (dual control is
		// additionally enforced on party identity inside the service).
		sr.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSamitiAdhyaksh, domain.RoleUnionPresident)).
			Post("/{id}/approve", h.approve)
		sr.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSamitiAdhyaksh, domain.RoleUnionPresident)).
			Post("/{id}/reject", h.reject)

		// Execute: hand the approved batch to the (mock) licensed PA.
		sr.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSamitiSacheev, domain.RoleSamitiAdhyaksh)).
			Post("/{id}/execute", h.execute)

		sr.With(readRoles).Get("/", h.list)

		// Farmer payment history — FARMER tokens are forced to their own party.
		sr.With(middleware.RequireRoles(
			domain.RoleFarmer,
			domain.RoleSamitiSacheev,
			domain.RoleSamitiAdhyaksh,
			domain.RoleUnionPresident,
			domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor,
			domain.RoleStateAuditor,
		)).Get("/payouts", h.payouts)

		sr.With(readRoles).Get("/{id}", h.detail)
	})

	r.Route("/dbt", func(dr chi.Router) {
		dr.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))

		dr.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleMissionOfficial, domain.RolePCDFAdmin)).
			Post("/requests", h.createDBT)
		dr.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleMissionOfficial, domain.RolePCDFAdmin)).
			Post("/requests/{id}/status", h.updateDBTStatus)

		dr.With(middleware.RequireRoles(
			domain.RoleMissionOfficial,
			domain.RolePCDFAdmin,
			domain.RoleStateAuditor,
			domain.RoleFarmer, // forced to own requests in the service
		)).Get("/requests", h.listDBT)
	})
}
package settlement

import (
	"context"
	"log/slog"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"

	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/eventbus"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/orgscope"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/provenance"
)

// initiateRefsCap bounds how many invoice refs the settlement.initiated
// ledger event carries (per module spec: cap 300).
const initiateRefsCap = 300

// service holds all settlement business logic: the §8.1/§18-B payment
// guardrail (compute+initiate → dual-control approve → licensed-PA execute)
// and the strictly separate DBT subsidy rail (§13).
type service struct {
	repo   *repo
	ledger *provenance.Ledger
	orgs   *orgscope.Resolver
	bus    *eventbus.Bus
	log    *slog.Logger
}

// ---- pure guardrail checks (unit-tested without a database) ----

// validateApproval enforces the dual-control guardrail (§8.1/§18-B): the
// approving party MUST differ from the initiator — checked FIRST and on the
// party identity itself, so not even SUPER_ADMIN's role bypass can approve a
// batch it initiated. Then the batch must still be awaiting approval.
func validateApproval(b domain.SettlementBatch, approverPartyID string) error {
	if b.InitiatedBy == approverPartyID {
		return httpx.Forbidden("dual-control violation: the settlement initiator cannot approve their own batch (§8.1/§18-B)").
			WithDetails(map[string]string{"reason": "DUAL_CONTROL_VIOLATION"})
	}
	if b.Status != domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval {
		return httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch is "+b.Status+", expected "+domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval)
	}
	return nil
}

// validateExecution allows execution only for an APPROVED batch — executing
// before a human approval is a guardrail breach, not a race.
func validateExecution(b domain.SettlementBatch) error {
	if b.Status != domain.SettlementStatusApproved {
		return httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch is "+b.Status+", must be "+domain.SettlementStatusApproved+" before execution")
	}
	return nil
}

// mockUTR builds a mock bank transaction reference: "UTRMOCK" + 12 hex chars.
func mockUTR() string {
	return "UTRMOCK" + strings.ToUpper(strings.ReplaceAll(uuid.NewString(), "-", "")[:12])
}

// mockPARef builds a mock payment-aggregator batch reference.
func mockPARef() string {
	return "PA-MOCK-" + uuid.NewString()[:8]
}

// mockPFMSRef builds a mock PFMS acknowledgement reference (§13).
func mockPFMSRef() string {
	return "PFMS-MOCK-" + uuid.NewString()[:8]
}

// ---- settlement lifecycle ----

// Initiate collects a DCS day's ISSUED invoices into a new settlement batch
// and parks it PENDING_APPROVAL. The INITIATED status is momentary by design
// (§8.1): computation and initiation are one Saathi action; nothing proceeds
// until a different human approves.
func (s *service) Initiate(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, in InitiateSettlementRequest) (*domain.SettlementBatch, error) {
	if in.DCSID == "" {
		return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_FIELD", "dcs_id is required")
	}
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	date := in.Date
	if date == "" {
		date = domain.DateKeyIST(now)
	} else if _, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", date); err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_DATE", "date must be YYYY-MM-DD")
	}
	if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, in.DCSID); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	candidates, err := s.repo.issuedInvoices(ctx, in.DCSID, date)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if len(candidates) == 0 {
		return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("NO_INVOICES", "no ISSUED invoices for DCS "+in.DCSID+" on "+date)
	}

	// Claim optimistically: the status guard on the update means each invoice
	// lands in exactly one batch even under concurrent initiations.
	batchID := uuid.NewString()
	ids := make([]string, 0, len(candidates))
	for _, inv := range candidates {
		ids = append(ids, inv.ID)
	}
	if _, err := s.repo.claimInvoices(ctx, ids, batchID); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	claimed, err := s.repo.invoicesByBatch(ctx, batchID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if len(claimed) == 0 {
		return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("NO_INVOICES", "invoices were claimed by a concurrent settlement for DCS "+in.DCSID+" on "+date)
	}

	batch := &domain.SettlementBatch{
		ID:          batchID,
		DCSID:       in.DCSID,
		Date:        date,
		Status:      domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval, // INITIATED → PENDING_APPROVAL immediately
		InitiatedBy: actor.PartyID,
		CreatedAt:   now,
	}
	for _, inv := range claimed {
		batch.InvoiceIDs = append(batch.InvoiceIDs, inv.ID)
		batch.TotalAmount += inv.TotalAmount
	}
	if err := s.repo.insertBatch(ctx, batch); err != nil {
		// Best-effort release so the claimed invoices are not stranded.
		if relErr := s.repo.releaseInvoices(ctx, batchID); relErr != nil {
			s.log.Error("settlement: release after failed insert", slog.String("batch_id", batchID), slog.Any("err", relErr))
		}
		return nil, err
	}

	refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, min(len(claimed), initiateRefsCap))
	for i, inv := range claimed {
		if i >= initiateRefsCap {
			break
		}
		refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{EntityType: domain.EntityInvoice, EntityID: inv.ID, Relation: "settles"})
	}
	ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
		Type:       domain.EventSettlementInitiated,
		EntityType: domain.EntitySettlement,
		EntityID:   batch.ID,
		Refs:       refs,
		Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
		OrgUnitID:  batch.DCSID,
		Payload: map[string]any{
			"dcs_id":        batch.DCSID,
			"date":          batch.Date,
			"invoice_count": len(claimed),
			"total_amount":  batch.TotalAmount,
		},
	})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	if err := s.repo.setBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx, batch.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	batch.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
	return batch, nil
}

// Approve applies the human dual-control sign-off: PENDING_APPROVAL→APPROVED.
func (s *service) Approve(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, batchID string) (*domain.SettlementBatch, error) {
	batch, err := s.repo.batchByID(ctx, batchID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, batch.DCSID); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := validateApproval(*batch, actor.PartyID); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	now := time.Now().UTC()
	ok, err := s.repo.transitionBatch(ctx, batch.ID, domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval, bson.D{
		{Key: "status", Value: domain.SettlementStatusApproved},
		{Key: "approved_by", Value: actor.PartyID},
		{Key: "approved_at", Value: now},
	})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if !ok {
		return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch already left "+domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval)
	}
	batch.Status = domain.SettlementStatusApproved
	batch.ApprovedBy = actor.PartyID
	batch.ApprovedAt = &now

	ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
		Type:       domain.EventSettlementApproved,
		EntityType: domain.EntitySettlement,
		EntityID:   batch.ID,
		Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
		OrgUnitID:  batch.DCSID,
		Payload: map[string]any{
			"approved_by":  actor.PartyID,
			"total_amount": batch.TotalAmount,
		},
	})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	if err := s.repo.setBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx, batch.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	batch.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
	return batch, nil
}

// Reject declines a pending batch and returns its invoices to ISSUED so they
// can be re-settled.
func (s *service) Reject(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, batchID, reason string) (*domain.SettlementBatch, error) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(reason) == "" {
		return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_FIELD", "reason is required")
	}
	batch, err := s.repo.batchByID(ctx, batchID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, batch.DCSID); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if batch.Status != domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval {
		return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch is "+batch.Status+", expected "+domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval)
	}

	ok, err := s.repo.transitionBatch(ctx, batch.ID, domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval, bson.D{
		{Key: "status", Value: domain.SettlementStatusRejected},
		{Key: "rejected_by", Value: actor.PartyID},
		{Key: "reject_reason", Value: reason},
	})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if !ok {
		return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch already left "+domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval)
	}
	if err := s.repo.releaseInvoices(ctx, batch.ID); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	batch.Status = domain.SettlementStatusRejected
	batch.RejectedBy = actor.PartyID
	batch.RejectReason = reason
	return batch, nil
}

// Execute hands the APPROVED batch to the payment-aggregator adapter and
// records the resulting payouts.
//
// MOCK LICENSED-PA ADAPTER — this is a stand-in for the real integration.
// In production (§18-B) execution goes through an RBI-licensed Payment
// Aggregator operating a nodal/escrow account: Saathi submits the payout
// file, the PA moves the money, and UTRs come back asynchronously via
// webhook. Saathi itself never touches funds. The mock credits every payout
// instantly with a synthetic UTR so the downstream flow (invoice→PAID,
// provenance, farmer SMS) is exercised end to end.
func (s *service) Execute(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, batchID string) (*SettlementDetail, error) {
	batch, err := s.repo.batchByID(ctx, batchID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, batch.DCSID); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := validateExecution(*batch); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	// Guarded APPROVED→EXECUTING claims execution for this caller only.
	ok, err := s.repo.transitionBatch(ctx, batch.ID, domain.SettlementStatusApproved, bson.D{
		{Key: "status", Value: domain.SettlementStatusExecuting},
	})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if !ok {
		return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch is already being executed")
	}

	invoices, err := s.repo.invoicesByBatch(ctx, batch.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	now := time.Now().UTC()
	payouts := make([]domain.PayoutInstruction, 0, len(invoices))
	for _, inv := range invoices {
		masked, err := s.repo.latestBankMasked(ctx, inv.FarmerPartyID)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		creditedAt := now
		payout := &domain.PayoutInstruction{
			ID:                uuid.NewString(),
			SettlementBatchID: batch.ID,
			InvoiceID:         inv.ID,
			FarmerPartyID:     inv.FarmerPartyID,
			Amount:            inv.TotalAmount,
			BankAccountMasked: masked,
			UTR:               mockUTR(),
			Status:            domain.PayoutStatusSuccess,
			CreditedAt:        &creditedAt,
			CreatedAt:         now,
		}
		exists, err := s.repo.insertPayout(ctx, payout)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if exists {
			// Retry of an interrupted run — reuse the payout already credited.
			existing, err := s.repo.payoutByInvoice(ctx, inv.ID)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			payout = existing
		}
		payouts = append(payouts, *payout)
	}

	if err := s.repo.markInvoicesPaid(ctx, batch.ID); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	paRef := mockPARef()
	ok, err = s.repo.transitionBatch(ctx, batch.ID, domain.SettlementStatusExecuting, bson.D{
		{Key: "status", Value: domain.SettlementStatusExecuted},
		{Key: "pa_ref", Value: paRef},
		{Key: "executed_at", Value: now},
	})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if !ok {
		return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch left EXECUTING unexpectedly")
	}
	batch.Status = domain.SettlementStatusExecuted
	batch.PARef = paRef
	batch.ExecutedAt = &now

	ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
		Type:       domain.EventSettlementExecuted,
		EntityType: domain.EntitySettlement,
		EntityID:   batch.ID,
		Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
		OrgUnitID:  batch.DCSID,
		Payload: map[string]any{
			"pa_ref":       paRef,
			"payout_count": len(payouts),
			"total_amount": batch.TotalAmount,
		},
	})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	if err := s.repo.setBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx, batch.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	batch.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq

	// One payout.credited ledger event per invoice, then the SMS fan-out.
	// Per-payout ledger/lookup failures are logged, not fatal: the money
	// outcome is already anchored by settlement.executed above.
	for _, p := range payouts {
		if _, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
			Type:       domain.EventPayoutCredited,
			EntityType: domain.EntityInvoice,
			EntityID:   p.InvoiceID,
			Refs: []provenance.Ref{
				{EntityType: domain.EntitySettlement, EntityID: batch.ID, Relation: "paid_by"},
			},
			Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
			OrgUnitID: batch.DCSID,
			Payload:   map[string]any{"utr": p.UTR, "amount": p.Amount},
		}); err != nil {
			s.log.Error("settlement: payout.credited ledger append", slog.String("invoice_id", p.InvoiceID), slog.Any("err", err))
		}

		phone, err := s.repo.partyPhone(ctx, p.FarmerPartyID)
		if err != nil {
			s.log.Error("settlement: farmer phone lookup for payout SMS", slog.String("farmer_party_id", p.FarmerPartyID), slog.Any("err", err))
			continue
		}
		s.bus.Publish(eventbus.TopicPayoutCredited, PayoutCreditedEvent{
			FarmerPartyID: p.FarmerPartyID,
			Phone:         phone,
			Amount:        p.Amount,
			UTR:           p.UTR,
		})
	}

	return &SettlementDetail{Batch: *batch, Payouts: payouts}, nil
}

// List pages settlement batches. Callers with a DCS-scoped token default to
// their own DCS; wider roles must name a dcs_id (SUPER_ADMIN and
// STATE_AUDITOR may list unscoped).
func (s *service) List(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, dcsID, date, status string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.SettlementBatch, int64, error) {
	if dcsID == "" {
		switch {
		case actor.OrgType == domain.OrgTypeDCS:
			dcsID = actor.OrgUnitID
		case actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSuperAdmin || actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleStateAuditor:
			// federation-wide read roles may list across DCSes
		default:
			return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_FIELD", "dcs_id is required for your scope")
		}
	}
	filter := bson.D{}
	if dcsID != "" {
		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, dcsID); err != nil {
			return nil, 0, err
		}
		filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "dcs_id", Value: dcsID})
	}
	if date != "" {
		filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "date", Value: date})
	}
	if status != "" {
		filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "status", Value: status})
	}
	return s.repo.listBatches(ctx, filter, page)
}

// Detail returns one batch plus its payout instructions.
func (s *service) Detail(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, batchID string) (*SettlementDetail, error) {
	batch, err := s.repo.batchByID(ctx, batchID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, batch.DCSID); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	payouts, err := s.repo.payoutsByBatch(ctx, batch.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &SettlementDetail{Batch: *batch, Payouts: payouts}, nil
}

// PayoutHistory pages payout instructions for one farmer, newest first.
// A FARMER token is always forced to its own party — "my payment history".
func (s *service) PayoutHistory(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, farmerPartyID string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.PayoutInstruction, int64, error) {
	if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleFarmer {
		farmerPartyID = actor.PartyID
	}
	if farmerPartyID == "" {
		return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_FIELD", "farmer_party_id is required")
	}
	return s.repo.payoutsByFarmer(ctx, farmerPartyID, page)
}

// ---- DBT subsidy rail (§13) — strictly separate from milk payments ----

// CreateDBT submits a scheme subsidy request to the (mocked) PFMS rail.
// Saathi only tracks the request; the subsidy is disbursed by PFMS/DBT,
// never by Saathi and never through the milk-payment rail.
func (s *service) CreateDBT(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, in CreateDBTRequestInput) (*domain.DBTRequest, error) {
	if in.SchemeCode == "" || in.FarmerPartyID == "" {
		return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_FIELD", "scheme_code and farmer_party_id are required")
	}
	if in.Amount <= 0 {
		return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_AMOUNT", "amount must be positive")
	}
	if _, err := s.repo.partyPhone(ctx, in.FarmerPartyID); err != nil {
		return nil, err // farmer must exist
	}

	// MOCK PFMS — real integration files the beneficiary+amount with PFMS
	// and receives an acknowledgement reference (§13).
	req := &domain.DBTRequest{
		ID:            uuid.NewString(),
		SchemeCode:    in.SchemeCode,
		FarmerPartyID: in.FarmerPartyID,
		Amount:        in.Amount,
		PFMSRef:       mockPFMSRef(),
		Status:        domain.DBTStatusSubmitted,
		SubmittedBy:   actor.PartyID,
		CreatedAt:     time.Now().UTC(),
	}
	if err := s.repo.insertDBT(ctx, req); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return req, nil
}

// UpdateDBTStatus records the DBT rail's progress for a request. CREDITED
// stamps credited_at; CREDITED/REJECTED are terminal.
func (s *service) UpdateDBTStatus(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id, status string) (*domain.DBTRequest, error) {
	switch status {
	case domain.DBTStatusAccepted, domain.DBTStatusCredited, domain.DBTStatusRejected:
	default:
		return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_STATUS", "status must be one of ACCEPTED, CREDITED, REJECTED")
	}
	req, err := s.repo.dbtByID(ctx, id)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if req.Status == domain.DBTStatusCredited || req.Status == domain.DBTStatusRejected {
		return nil, httpx.Conflict("TERMINAL_STATUS", "dbt request is already "+req.Status)
	}

	var creditedAt *time.Time
	if status == domain.DBTStatusCredited {
		now := time.Now().UTC()
		creditedAt = &now
	}
	ok, err := s.repo.transitionDBT(ctx, req.ID, req.Status, status, creditedAt)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if !ok {
		return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "dbt request changed concurrently, retry")
	}
	req.Status = status
	req.CreditedAt = creditedAt
	_ = actor // status updates carry no extra actor fields today
	return req, nil
}

// ListDBT pages DBT requests. A FARMER token is always forced to its own
// party.
func (s *service) ListDBT(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, farmerPartyID, status string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.DBTRequest, int64, error) {
	if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleFarmer {
		farmerPartyID = actor.PartyID
	}
	filter := bson.D{}
	if farmerPartyID != "" {
		filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "farmer_party_id", Value: farmerPartyID})
	}
	if status != "" {
		filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "status", Value: status})
	}
	return s.repo.listDBT(ctx, filter, page)
}

97	// ResolveActiveChart finds the rate chart pricing a DCS's pours: among active
98	// charts already effective on the DCS itself or any of its ancestors, the
99	// nearest org wins; ties break to the latest effective_from. Returns
100	// httpx.NotFound when no chart covers the DCS.
101	func (s *service) ResolveActiveChart(ctx context.Context, dcsID string) (*domain.RateChart, error) {
102		dcs, err := s.d.Orgs.Get(ctx, dcsID)
103		if err != nil {
104			return nil, err
105		}
106		if dcs.Type != domain.OrgTypeDCS {
107			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_DCS", "org unit "+dcsID+" is not a DCS")
108		}
109	
110		// Distance 0 = the DCS itself; Path is root→parent, so walk it backwards.
111		distance := map[string]int{dcs.ID: 0}
112		orgIDs := []string{dcs.ID}
113		for i := len(dcs.Path) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
114			distance[dcs.Path[i]] = len(dcs.Path) - i
115			orgIDs = append(orgIDs, dcs.Path[i])
116		}
117	
118		charts, err := s.repo.activeChartsForOrgs(ctx, orgIDs, time.Now().UTC())
119		if err != nil {
120			return nil, err
121		}
122		var best *domain.RateChart
123		for i := range charts {
124			c := &charts[i]
125			if best == nil {
126				best = c
127				continue
128			}
129			dc, db := distance[c.OrgUnitID], distance[best.OrgUnitID]
130			if dc < db || (dc == db && c.EffectiveFrom.After(best.EffectiveFrom)) {
131				best = c
132			}
133		}
134		if best == nil {
135			return nil, httpx.NotFound("active rate chart for DCS " + dcsID)
136		}
137		return best, nil
138	}

142	// deriveIntegrityFlags computes the anti-tamper flags of a reading from its
143	// capture envelope (blueprint §8.2). Plausibility flags are appended
144	// separately by the caller.
145	func deriveIntegrityFlags(mode string, ocrConfidence float64, hasGeotag bool, deviceTimestamp, serverNow time.Time) []string {
146		var out []string
147		if mode == domain.ReadingModeManual {
148			out = append(out, domain.IntegrityFlagManualEntry)
149		}
150		if mode == domain.ReadingModePhotoOCR && ocrConfidence < lowOCRConfidenceThreshold {
151			out = append(out, domain.IntegrityFlagLowOCRConfidence)
152		}
153		if !hasGeotag {
154			out = append(out, domain.IntegrityFlagMissingGeotag)
155		}
156		if !deviceTimestamp.IsZero() {
157			skew := serverNow.Sub(deviceTimestamp)
158			if skew < 0 {
159				skew = -skew
160			}
161			if skew > maxClockSkew {
162				out = append(out, domain.IntegrityFlagClockSkew)
163			}
164		}
165		return out
166	}

190			}
191			if req.PhotoObjectKey == "" {
192				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "photo_object_key is required for PHOTO_OCR (evidence retention, §8.2)")
193			}
194		}
195	
196		now := time.Now().UTC()
197		var deviceTS time.Time
198		if req.DeviceTimestamp != nil {
199			deviceTS = req.DeviceTimestamp.UTC()
200		}
201		hasGeo := req.GeoLat != nil && req.GeoLng != nil
202		integrityFlags := deriveIntegrityFlags(req.Mode, req.OCRConfidence, hasGeo, deviceTS, now)
203		plausibilityFlags := domain.CheckPlausibility(req.FatPct, req.SNFPct, req.QuantityLitres)
204		integrityFlags = append(integrityFlags, plausibilityFlags...)
205	
206		reading := &domain.AnalyzerReading{
207			ID:               uuid.NewString(),
208			DCSID:            req.DCSID,
209			DeviceID:         req.DeviceID,
210			Mode:             req.Mode,
211			FatPct:           req.FatPct,
212			SNFPct:           req.SNFPct,
213			CLR:              req.CLR,
214			WaterPct:         req.WaterPct,
215			QuantityLitres:   req.QuantityLitres,
216			PhotoObjectKey:   req.PhotoObjectKey,
217			OCRConfidence:    req.OCRConfidence,
218			DeviceTimestamp:  deviceTS,
219			ServerReceivedAt: now,
220			IntegrityFlags:   integrityFlags,
221			PlausibilityOK:   len(plausibilityFlags) == 0,
222			RecordedBy:       actor.PartyID,
223			CreatedAt:        now,
224		}
225		if hasGeo {
226			reading.GeoLat, reading.GeoLng = *req.GeoLat, *req.GeoLng
227		}
228		if err := s.repo.insertReading(ctx, reading); err != nil {
229			return nil, err
230		}
231	
232		if _, err := s.d.Ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
233			Type:       domain.EventReadingRecorded,
234			EntityType: domain.EntityAnalyzerReading,
235			EntityID:   reading.ID,
236			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
237			OrgUnitID:  reading.DCSID,
238			Payload: map[string]any{
239				"mode":            reading.Mode,
240				"integrity_flags": reading.IntegrityFlags,
241			},
242		}); err != nil {
243			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("append reading provenance: %w", err))
244		}
245		return reading, nil
246	}

249	// restricted to one IST day.
250	func (s *service) ListReadings(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, dcsID, date string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.AnalyzerReading, error) {
251		if dcsID == "" {
252			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "dcs_id is required")
253		}

255			return nil, err
256		}
257		var dayStart, dayEnd *time.Time
258		if date != "" {

260			if err != nil {

262			}

268	// --- pours ---
269	
270	// CreatePour records one farmer's pour with same-day pricing. Replays of the
271	// same client_event_id return the stored pour with idempotentReplay=true —
272	// offline sync retries are harmless (§3.1).
273	func (s *service) CreatePour(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreatePourRequest) (pour *domain.MilkPour, idempotentReplay bool, err error) {
274		if req.ClientEventID == "" || req.FarmerPartyID == "" || req.DCSID == "" {
275			return nil, false, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "client_event_id, farmer_party_id and dcs_id are required")
276		}
277		if req.Shift != domain.ShiftMorning && req.Shift != domain.ShiftEvening {
278			return nil, false, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "shift must be MORNING or EVENING")
279		}
280		if req.QuantityLitres <= 0 {
281			return nil, false, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "quantity_litres must be positive")
282		}
283		switch req.Source {
284		case domain.ReadingModeDirect, domain.ReadingModePhotoOCR, domain.ReadingModeManual:
285		default:
286			return nil, false, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "source must be ANALYZER_DIRECT, PHOTO_OCR or MANUAL")
287		}
288		if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.DCSID); err != nil {
289			return nil, false, err
290		}
291	
292		now := time.Now().UTC()
293		member, err := s.repo.farmerIsActiveMember(ctx, req.FarmerPartyID, req.DCSID, now)
294		if err != nil {
295			return nil, false, err
296		}
297		if !member {
298			return nil, false, httpx.Unprocessable("FARMER_NOT_MEMBER",
299				"farmer does not hold an active FARMER assignment at this DCS")
300		}
301	
302		// HARD plausibility gate: receipts must be trustworthy, so implausible
303		// values are rejected here (unlike readings, which are merely flagged).
304		if violations := domain.CheckPlausibility(req.FatPct, req.SNFPct, req.QuantityLitres); len(violations) > 0 {
305			return nil, false, httpx.Unprocessable("IMPLAUSIBLE_VALUES",
306				"fat/SNF/quantity outside physically plausible bounds")
307		}
308	
309		chart, err := s.resolveChartForPricing(ctx, req.DCSID)
310		if err != nil {
311			return nil, false, err
312		}
313		rate, amount := chart.PricePour(req.FatPct, req.SNFPct, req.QuantityLitres)
314	
315		pouredAt := now
316		if req.PouredAt != nil {
317			pouredAt = req.PouredAt.UTC()
318		}
319		p := &domain.MilkPour{
320			ID:                uuid.NewString(),
321			ClientEventID:     req.ClientEventID,
322			FarmerPartyID:     req.FarmerPartyID,
323			AnimalID:          req.AnimalID,
324			DCSID:             req.DCSID,
325			Shift:             req.Shift,
326			PourDate:          domain.DateKeyIST(pouredAt),
327			QuantityLitres:    req.QuantityLitres,
328			FatPct:            req.FatPct,
329			SNFPct:            req.SNFPct,
330			CLR:               req.CLR,
331			RatePerLitre:      rate,
332			Amount:            amount,
333			RateChartID:       chart.ID,
334			AnalyzerReadingID: req.AnalyzerReadingID,
335			Source:            req.Source,
336			Status:            domain.PourStatusRecorded,
337			PouredAt:          pouredAt,
338			RecordedBy:        actor.PartyID,
339			DeviceID:          req.DeviceID,
340			CreatedAt:         now,
341		}
342		if req.GeoLat != nil && req.GeoLng != nil {
343			p.GeoLat, p.GeoLng = *req.GeoLat, *req.GeoLng
344		}
345	
346		duplicate, err := s.repo.insertPour(ctx, p)
347		if err != nil {
348			return nil, false, err
349		}
350		if duplicate {
351			existing, err := s.repo.pourByClientEventID(ctx, req.ClientEventID)
352			if err != nil {
353				return nil, false, err
354			}
355			return existing, true, nil
356		}
357	
358		if err := s.recordPourProvenance(ctx, actor, p); err != nil {
359			return nil, false, err
360		}
361		s.d.Bus.Publish(eventbus.TopicPourRecorded, *p)
362		s.queueFarmerSMS(ctx, p.FarmerPartyID, domain.TemplatePourReceipt, map[string]string{
363			"qty":    fmt.Sprintf("%.2f", p.QuantityLitres),
364			"rate":   fmt.Sprintf("%.2f", p.RatePerLitre),
365			"amount": fmt.Sprintf("%.2f", p.Amount),
366		})
367		return p, false, nil
368	}
369	
370	// recordPourProvenance appends EventPourRecorded and stamps the ledger seq
371	// onto the pour.
372	func (s *service) recordPourProvenance(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, p *domain.MilkPour) error {
373		refs := []provenance.Ref{
374			{EntityType: domain.EntityParty, EntityID: p.FarmerPartyID, Relation: "produced_by"},
375		}
376		if p.AnimalID != "" {
377			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{EntityType: domain.EntityAnimal, EntityID: p.AnimalID, Relation: "from_animal"})
378		}
379		if p.AnalyzerReadingID != "" {
380			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{EntityType: domain.EntityAnalyzerReading, EntityID: p.AnalyzerReadingID, Relation: "measured_by"})
381		}
382		ev, err := s.d.Ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
383			Type:       domain.EventPourRecorded,
384			EntityType: domain.EntityMilkPour,
385			EntityID:   p.ID,
386			Refs:       refs,
387			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
388			OrgUnitID:  p.DCSID,
389			Payload: map[string]any{
390				"quantity_litres": p.QuantityLitres,
391				"rate_per_litre":  p.RatePerLitre,
392				"amount":          p.Amount,
393			},
394		})
395		if err != nil {
396			return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("append pour provenance: %w", err))
397		}
398		if err := s.repo.setPourProvenanceSeq(ctx, p.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
399			return err
400		}
401		p.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
402		return nil
403	}

405	// resolveChartForPricing wraps ResolveActiveChart, converting "no chart" into
406	// a 422 — the pour payload itself is fine, the DCS just cannot price it yet.
407	func (s *service) resolveChartForPricing(ctx context.Context, dcsID string) (*domain.RateChart, error) {
408		chart, err := s.ResolveActiveChart(ctx, dcsID)
409		if err != nil {
410			var appErr *httpx.AppError
411			if errors.As(err, &appErr) && appErr.Status == http.StatusNotFound {
412				return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("NO_ACTIVE_RATE_CHART",
413					"no active rate chart covers this DCS — pours cannot be priced")
414			}
415			return nil, err
416		}
417		return chart, nil
418	}
419	
420	// BatchSyncPours replays up to 500 offline-captured pours. Items succeed or
421	// fail independently — the batch never aborts (offline reconnect path, §3.1).
422	func (s *service) BatchSyncPours(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req BatchSyncRequest) ([]BatchSyncItemResult, error) {
423		if len(req.Pours) == 0 {
424			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "pours must not be empty")
425		}
426		if len(req.Pours) > maxBatchSyncItems {
427			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION",
428				fmt.Sprintf("pours must not exceed %d items per batch", maxBatchSyncItems))
429		}
430		results := make([]BatchSyncItemResult, 0, len(req.Pours))
431		for _, item := range req.Pours {
432			res := BatchSyncItemResult{ClientEventID: item.ClientEventID}
433			pour, replay, err := s.CreatePour(ctx, actor, item)
434			switch {
435			case err != nil:
436				res.Status = BatchItemError
437				var appErr *httpx.AppError
438				if errors.As(err, &appErr) {
439					res.Error = appErr.Code + ": " + appErr.Message
440				} else {
441					res.Error = "INTERNAL: internal server error"
442				}
443			case replay:
444				res.Status = BatchItemDuplicate
445				res.PourID = pour.ID
446			default:
447				res.Status = BatchItemCreated
448				res.PourID = pour.ID
449			}
450			results = append(results, res)
451		}
452		return results, nil
453	}
454	
455	// SupersedePour applies an append-only correction (§3.4): the old pour is
456	// marked SUPERSEDED (the document stays), and a new repriced pour referencing
457	// it is recorded.
458	func (s *service) SupersedePour(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, pourID string, req SupersedePourRequest) (*domain.MilkPour, error) {
459		if req.Reason == "" {
460			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "reason is required")
461		}
462		old, err := s.repo.pourByID(ctx, pourID)
463		if err != nil {
464			return nil, err
465		}
466		if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, old.DCSID); err != nil {
467			return nil, err
468		}
469		if old.Status != domain.PourStatusRecorded {
470			return nil, httpx.Conflict("POUR_NOT_CORRECTABLE",
471				"pour is already "+old.Status+" and cannot be superseded")
472		}
473		invoiced, err := s.repo.pourIsInvoiced(ctx, pourID)
474		if err != nil {
475			return nil, err
476		}
477		if invoiced {
478			return nil, httpx.Conflict("POUR_INVOICED",
479				"pour is aggregated by an invoice — correct it through settlement instead")
480		}
481	
482		qty, fat, snf := old.QuantityLitres, old.FatPct, old.SNFPct
483		if req.Corrected.QuantityLitres != nil {
484			qty = *req.Corrected.QuantityLitres
485		}
486		if req.Corrected.FatPct != nil {
487			fat = *req.Corrected.FatPct
488		}
489		if req.Corrected.SNFPct != nil {
490			snf = *req.Corrected.SNFPct
491		}
492		if qty <= 0 {
493			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "corrected quantity_litres must be positive")
494		}
495		if violations := domain.CheckPlausibility(fat, snf, qty); len(violations) > 0 {
496			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("IMPLAUSIBLE_VALUES",
497				"corrected fat/SNF/quantity outside physically plausible bounds")
498		}
499	
500		chart, err := s.resolveChartForPricing(ctx, old.DCSID)
501		if err != nil {
502			return nil, err
503		}
504		rate, amount := chart.PricePour(fat, snf, qty)
505	
506		// Optimistic guard: only one correction can win the RECORDED→SUPERSEDED flip.
507		flipped, err := s.repo.markPourSuperseded(ctx, old.ID)
508		if err != nil {
509			return nil, err
510		}
511		if !flipped {
512			return nil, httpx.Conflict("POUR_NOT_CORRECTABLE", "pour was superseded concurrently")
513		}
514	
515		now := time.Now().UTC()
516		corrected := &domain.MilkPour{
517			ID:                uuid.NewString(),
518			FarmerPartyID:     old.FarmerPartyID,
519			AnimalID:          old.AnimalID,
520			DCSID:             old.DCSID,
521			Shift:             old.Shift,
522			PourDate:          old.PourDate, // correction stays on the original settlement day
523			QuantityLitres:    qty,
524			FatPct:            fat,
525			SNFPct:            snf,
526			CLR:               old.CLR,
527			RatePerLitre:      rate,
528			Amount:            amount,
529			RateChartID:       chart.ID,
530			AnalyzerReadingID: old.AnalyzerReadingID,
531			Source:            old.Source,
532			Status:            domain.PourStatusRecorded,
533			SupersedesPourID:  old.ID,
534			PouredAt:          old.PouredAt,
535			RecordedBy:        actor.PartyID,
536			DeviceID:          old.DeviceID,
537			GeoLat:            old.GeoLat,
538			GeoLng:            old.GeoLng,
539			CreatedAt:         now,
540		}
541		corrected.ClientEventID = old.ClientEventID + "::corr::" + corrected.ID[0:8]
542		if duplicate, err := s.repo.insertPour(ctx, corrected); err != nil {
543			return nil, err
544		} else if duplicate {
545			return nil, httpx.Conflict("POUR_NOT_CORRECTABLE", "correction collided with a concurrent one")
546		}
547	
548		ev, err := s.d.Ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
549			Type:       domain.EventPourSuperseded,
550			EntityType: domain.EntityMilkPour,
551			EntityID:   corrected.ID,
552			Refs: []provenance.Ref{
553				{EntityType: domain.EntityMilkPour, EntityID: old.ID, Relation: "supersedes"},
554			},
555			Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
556			OrgUnitID: corrected.DCSID,
557			Payload:   map[string]any{"reason": req.Reason},
558		})
559		if err != nil {
560			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("append supersede provenance: %w", err))
561		}
562		if err := s.repo.setPourProvenanceSeq(ctx, corrected.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
563			return nil, err
564		}
565		corrected.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
566		return corrected, nil
567	}

569	// ListPours pages pours. FARMER callers are always pinned to their own
570	// pours; staff roles must name a DCS inside their scope.
571	func (s *service) ListPours(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, filter pourListFilter, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.MilkPour, error) {
572		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleFarmer {
573			filter.FarmerPartyID = actor.PartyID // farmers only ever see their own pours
574		} else {
575			if filter.DCSID == "" {
576				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "dcs_id is required")
577			}
578			if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, filter.DCSID); err != nil {
579				return nil, err
580			}
581		}
582		if filter.Date != "" {
583			if err := validateDateKey(filter.Date); err != nil {
584				return nil, err
585			}
586		}
587		if filter.Shift != "" && filter.Shift != domain.ShiftMorning && filter.Shift != domain.ShiftEvening {
588			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "shift must be MORNING or EVENING")
589		}
590		return s.repo.listPours(ctx, filter, page)
591	}

593	// --- invoices ---
594	
595	// GenerateInvoices groups the day's un-invoiced RECORDED pours by farmer and
596	// issues one invoice each — the same-day payment artefact (§8.1). The unique
597	// farmer+DCS+day index is the true duplicate guard; racing generators simply
598	// count the loser as "existing".
599	func (s *service) GenerateInvoices(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req GenerateInvoicesRequest) (*GenerateInvoicesResponse, error) {
600		if req.DCSID == "" {
601			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "dcs_id is required")
602		}
603		now := time.Now().UTC()
604		dateKey := req.Date
605		if dateKey == "" {
606			dateKey = domain.DateKeyIST(now)
607		} else if err := validateDateKey(dateKey); err != nil {
608			return nil, err
609		}
610		dcs, err := s.d.Orgs.Get(ctx, req.DCSID)
611		if err != nil {
612			return nil, err
613		}
614		if dcs.Type != domain.OrgTypeDCS {
615			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_DCS", "org unit "+req.DCSID+" is not a DCS")
616		}
617		if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.DCSID); err != nil {
618			return nil, err
619		}
620	
621		pours, err := s.repo.recordedPoursForDay(ctx, req.DCSID, dateKey)
622		if err != nil {
623			return nil, err
624		}
625		alreadyInvoiced, err := s.repo.invoicedPourIDs(ctx, req.DCSID, dateKey)
626		if err != nil {
627			return nil, err
628		}
629	
630		byFarmer := make(map[string][]domain.MilkPour)
631		for _, p := range pours {
632			if alreadyInvoiced[p.ID] {
633				continue
634			}
635			byFarmer[p.FarmerPartyID] = append(byFarmer[p.FarmerPartyID], p)
636		}
637		farmerIDs := make([]string, 0, len(byFarmer))
638		for id := range byFarmer {
639			farmerIDs = append(farmerIDs, id)
640		}
641		sort.Strings(farmerIDs)
642	
643		resp := &GenerateInvoicesResponse{Invoices: []domain.Invoice{}}
644		counterKey := "invoice:" + dcs.Code + ":" + dateKey
645		for _, farmerID := range farmerIDs {
646			group := byFarmer[farmerID]
647			seq, err := s.repo.nextInvoiceSeq(ctx, counterKey)
648			if err != nil {
649				return nil, err
650			}
651			inv := &domain.Invoice{
652				ID:            uuid.NewString(),
653				InvoiceNumber: domain.InvoiceNumberFor(dcs.Code, dateKey, seq),
654				FarmerPartyID: farmerID,
655				DCSID:         req.DCSID,
656				InvoiceDate:   dateKey,
657				Status:        domain.InvoiceStatusIssued,
658				IssuedAt:      now,
659			}
660			for _, p := range group {
661				inv.PourIDs = append(inv.PourIDs, p.ID)
662				inv.TotalQuantityLitres += p.QuantityLitres
663				inv.TotalAmount += p.Amount
664			}
665			inv.TotalQuantityLitres = math.Round(inv.TotalQuantityLitres*100) / 100
666			inv.TotalAmount = math.Round(inv.TotalAmount*100) / 100
667	
668			duplicate, err := s.repo.insertInvoice(ctx, inv)
669			if err != nil {
670				return nil, err
671			}
672			if duplicate {
673				resp.Existing++
674				continue
675			}
676	
677			refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, len(inv.PourIDs))
678			for _, pid := range inv.PourIDs {
679				refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{EntityType: domain.EntityMilkPour, EntityID: pid, Relation: "aggregates"})
680			}
681			ev, err := s.d.Ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
682				Type:       domain.EventInvoiceIssued,
683				EntityType: domain.EntityInvoice,
684				EntityID:   inv.ID,
685				Refs:       refs,
686				Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
687				OrgUnitID:  inv.DCSID,
688				Payload: map[string]any{
689					"invoice_number":        inv.InvoiceNumber,
690					"total_quantity_litres": inv.TotalQuantityLitres,
691					"total_amount":          inv.TotalAmount,
692				},
693			})
694			if err != nil {
695				return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("append invoice provenance: %w", err))
696			}
697			if err := s.repo.setInvoiceProvenanceSeq(ctx, inv.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
698				return nil, err
699			}
700			inv.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
701	
702			s.d.Bus.Publish(eventbus.TopicInvoiceIssued, *inv)
703			s.queueFarmerSMS(ctx, inv.FarmerPartyID, domain.TemplateInvoiceIssued, map[string]string{
704				"invoice_number": inv.InvoiceNumber,
705				"qty":            fmt.Sprintf("%.2f", inv.TotalQuantityLitres),
706				"amount":         fmt.Sprintf("%.2f", inv.TotalAmount),
707				"date":           inv.InvoiceDate,
708			})
709			resp.Created++
710			resp.Invoices = append(resp.Invoices, *inv)
711		}
712		return resp, nil
713	}
714	
715	// ListInvoices pages invoices. FARMER callers are always pinned to their own
716	// invoices; staff roles must name a DCS inside their scope.
717	func (s *service) ListInvoices(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, filter invoiceListFilter, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.Invoice, error) {
718		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleFarmer {
719			filter.FarmerPartyID = actor.PartyID // farmers only ever see their own invoices
720		} else {
721			if filter.DCSID == "" {
722				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "dcs_id is required")
723			}
724			if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, filter.DCSID); err != nil {
725				return nil, err
726			}
727		}
728		if filter.Date != "" {
729			if err := validateDateKey(filter.Date); err != nil {
730				return nil, err
731			}
732		}
733		if filter.Status != "" {
734			switch filter.Status {
735			case domain.InvoiceStatusIssued, domain.InvoiceStatusSettlementPending,
736				domain.InvoiceStatusPaid, domain.InvoiceStatusHold:
737			default:
738				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "unknown invoice status "+filter.Status)
739			}
740		}
741		return s.repo.listInvoices(ctx, filter, page)
742	}
743	
744	// GetInvoice returns one invoice: a farmer may fetch their own, staff roles
745	// need the invoice's DCS inside their scope.
746	func (s *service) GetInvoice(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id string) (*domain.Invoice, error) {
747		inv, err := s.repo.invoiceByID(ctx, id)
748		if err != nil {
749			return nil, err
750		}
751		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleFarmer {
752			if inv.FarmerPartyID != actor.PartyID {
753				return nil, httpx.Forbidden("farmers may only view their own invoices")
754			}
755			return inv, nil
756		}
757		if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, inv.DCSID); err != nil {
758			return nil, err
759		}
760		return inv, nil
761	}
762	
763	// --- helpers ---
764	
765	// queueFarmerSMS writes an outbox notification for the farmer. Failures are
766	// logged, never fatal — the receipt must not block the pour (§8.1).
767	func (s *service) queueFarmerSMS(ctx context.Context, farmerPartyID, templateKey string, params map[string]string) {
768		farmer, err := s.repo.getParty(ctx, farmerPartyID)
769		if err != nil {
770			s.log.Warn("collection: farmer lookup for SMS failed",
771				slog.String("farmer_party_id", farmerPartyID), slog.Any("err", err))
772			return
773		}
774		language := farmer.PreferredLanguage
775		if language == "" {
776			language = defaultLanguage
777		}
778		n := &domain.Notification{
779			ID:          uuid.NewString(),
780			PartyID:     farmer.ID,
781			Phone:       farmer.Phone,
782			Channel:     domain.ChannelSMS,
783			TemplateKey: templateKey,
784			Language:    language,
785			Params:      params,
786			Status:      domain.NotificationQueued,
787			QueuedAt:    time.Now().UTC(),
788		}
789		if err := s.repo.queueNotification(ctx, n); err != nil {
790			s.log.Warn("collection: notification queue failed",
791				slog.String("template", templateKey), slog.Any("err", err))
792		}
793	}
794	
795	// validateDateKey checks a YYYY-MM-DD day key.
796	func validateDateKey(date string) error {
797		if _, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", date); err != nil {
798			return httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "date must be YYYY-MM-DD")
799		}
800		return nil
801	}
802	
803	// istDayRange converts a YYYY-MM-DD key into the [start, end) UTC window of
804	// that IST calendar day.
805	func istDayRange(date string) (start, end time.Time, err error) {
806		ist := time.FixedZone("IST", 5*3600+1800)
807		day, parseErr := time.ParseInLocation("2006-01-02", date, ist)
808		if parseErr != nil {
809			return time.Time{}, time.Time{}, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "date must be YYYY-MM-DD")
810		}
811		return day.UTC(), day.Add(24 * time.Hour).UTC(), nil
812	}

1	package middleware
2	
3	import (
4		"net"
5		"net/http"
6		"sync"
7		"time"
8	
9		"golang.org/x/time/rate"
10	
11		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
12	)
13	
14	// PerIPRateLimit applies a token-bucket limit per client IP. In-memory by
15	// design: each API replica defends itself; global fairness belongs to the
16	// gateway/WAF tier in production (blueprint §6).
17	func PerIPRateLimit(rps float64, burst int) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
18		type bucket struct {
19			lim  *rate.Limiter
20			seen time.Time
21		}
22		var (
23			mu      sync.Mutex
24			buckets = make(map[string]*bucket)
25		)
26	
27		// Janitor: drop buckets idle >10 min so the map can't grow unbounded.
28		go func() {
29			for range time.Tick(5 * time.Minute) {
30				mu.Lock()
31				for ip, b := range buckets {
32					if time.Since(b.seen) > 10*time.Minute {
33						delete(buckets, ip)
34					}
35				}
36				mu.Unlock()
37			}
38		}()
39	
40		return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
41			return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
42				ip, _, err := net.SplitHostPort(r.RemoteAddr)
43				if err != nil {
44					ip = r.RemoteAddr
45				}
46				mu.Lock()
47				b, ok := buckets[ip]
48				if !ok {
49					b = &bucket{lim: rate.NewLimiter(rate.Limit(rps), burst)}
50					buckets[ip] = b
51				}
52				b.seen = time.Now()
53				mu.Unlock()
54	
55				if !b.lim.Allow() {
56					httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.TooManyRequests("too many requests — slow down"))
57					return
58				}
59				next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
60			})
61		}
62	}
63
