10		"github.com/prometheus/client_golang/prometheus"
11		"github.com/prometheus/client_golang/prometheus/promauto"
12	)
13	
14	var (
15		httpRequestsTotal = promauto.NewCounterVec(prometheus.CounterOpts{
16			Name: "saathi_http_requests_total",
17			Help: "HTTP requests by method, route pattern and status.",
18		}, []string{"method", "route", "status"})
19	
20		httpRequestDuration = promauto.NewHistogramVec(prometheus.HistogramOpts{
21			Name:    "saathi_http_request_duration_seconds",
22			Help:    "HTTP request latency by method and route pattern.",
23			Buckets: []float64{.005, .01, .025, .05, .1, .25, .5, 1, 2.5, 5},
24		}, []string{"method", "route"})
25	)
26	
27	// Metrics records request count + latency labelled by the chi route PATTERN
28	// (e.g. /api/v1/collection/pours/{id}), not the raw path — bounded label
29	// cardinality, dashboard-friendly.
30	func Metrics(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
31		return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
32			start := time.Now()
33			ww := chimw.NewWrapResponseWriter(w, r.ProtoMajor)
34			next.ServeHTTP(ww, r)
35	
36			route := "unmatched"
37			if rc := chi.RouteContext(r.Context()); rc != nil {
38				if p := rc.RoutePattern(); p != "" {
39					route = p
40				}
41			}
42			httpRequestsTotal.WithLabelValues(r.Method, route, strconv.Itoa(ww.Status())).Inc()
43			httpRequestDuration.WithLabelValues(r.Method, route).Observe(time.Since(start).Seconds())
44		})
45	}

248		for _, a := range assignments {

270	// provenance, farmer SMS) is exercised end to end.
271	func (s *service) Execute(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, batchID string) (*SettlementDetail, error) {
272		batch, err := s.repo.batchByID(ctx, batchID)
273		if err != nil {
274			return nil, err
275		}
276		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, batch.DCSID); err != nil {
277			return nil, err
278		}
279		if err := validateExecution(*batch); err != nil {
280			return nil, err
281		}
282	
283		// Guarded APPROVED→EXECUTING claims execution for this caller only.
284		ok, err := s.repo.transitionBatch(ctx, batch.ID, domain.SettlementStatusApproved, bson.D{
285			{Key: "status", Value: domain.SettlementStatusExecuting},
286		})
287		if err != nil {
288			return nil, err
289		}
290		if !ok {
291			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch is already being executed")
292		}
293	
294		invoices, err := s.repo.invoicesByBatch(ctx, batch.ID)
295		if err != nil {
296			return nil, err
297		}
298	
299		now := time.Now().UTC()
300		payouts := make([]domain.PayoutInstruction, 0, len(invoices))
301		for _, inv := range invoices {
302			masked, err := s.repo.latestBankMasked(ctx, inv.FarmerPartyID)
303			if err != nil {
304				return nil, err
305			}
306			creditedAt := now
307			payout := &domain.PayoutInstruction{
308				ID:                uuid.NewString(),
309				SettlementBatchID: batch.ID,
310				InvoiceID:         inv.ID,
311				FarmerPartyID:     inv.FarmerPartyID,
312				Amount:            inv.TotalAmount,
313				BankAccountMasked: masked,
314				UTR:               mockUTR(),
315				Status:            domain.PayoutStatusSuccess,
316				CreditedAt:        &creditedAt,
317				CreatedAt:         now,
318			}
319			exists, err := s.repo.insertPayout(ctx, payout)
320			if err != nil {
321				return nil, err
322			}
323			if exists {
324				// Retry of an interrupted run — reuse the payout already credited.
325				existing, err := s.repo.payoutByInvoice(ctx, inv.ID)
326				if err != nil {
327					return nil, err
328				}
329				payout = existing
330			}
331			payouts = append(payouts, *payout)
332		}
333	
334		if err := s.repo.markInvoicesPaid(ctx, batch.ID); err != nil {
335			return nil, err
336		}
337	
338		paRef := mockPARef()
339		ok, err = s.repo.transitionBatch(ctx, batch.ID, domain.SettlementStatusExecuting, bson.D{
340			{Key: "status", Value: domain.SettlementStatusExecuted},
341			{Key: "pa_ref", Value: paRef},
342			{Key: "executed_at", Value: now},
343		})
344		if err != nil {
345			return nil, err
346		}
347		if !ok {
348			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch left EXECUTING unexpectedly")
349		}
350		batch.Status = domain.SettlementStatusExecuted
351		batch.PARef = paRef
352		batch.ExecutedAt = &now
353	
354		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
355			Type:       domain.EventSettlementExecuted,
356			EntityType: domain.EntitySettlement,
357			EntityID:   batch.ID,
358			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
359			OrgUnitID:  batch.DCSID,
360			Payload: map[string]any{
361				"pa_ref":       paRef,
362				"payout_count": len(payouts),
363				"total_amount": batch.TotalAmount,
364			},
365		})
366		if err != nil {
367			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
368		}
369		if err := s.repo.setBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx, batch.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
370			return nil, err
371		}
372		batch.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
373	
374		// One payout.credited ledger event per invoice, then the SMS fan-out.
375		// Per-payout ledger/lookup failures are logged, not fatal: the money
376		// outcome is already anchored by settlement.executed above.
377		for _, p := range payouts {
378			if _, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
379				Type:       domain.EventPayoutCredited,
380				EntityType: domain.EntityInvoice,
381				EntityID:   p.InvoiceID,
382				Refs: []provenance.Ref{
383					{EntityType: domain.EntitySettlement, EntityID: batch.ID, Relation: "paid_by"},
384				},
385				Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
386				OrgUnitID: batch.DCSID,
387				Payload:   map[string]any{"utr": p.UTR, "amount": p.Amount},
388			}); err != nil {
389				s.log.Error("settlement: payout.credited ledger append", slog.String("invoice_id", p.InvoiceID), slog.Any("err", err))
390			}
391	
392			phone, err := s.repo.partyPhone(ctx, p.FarmerPartyID)
393			if err != nil {
394				s.log.Error("settlement: farmer phone lookup for payout SMS", slog.String("farmer_party_id", p.FarmerPartyID), slog.Any("err", err))
395				continue
396			}
397			s.bus.Publish(eventbus.TopicPayoutCredited, PayoutCreditedEvent{
398				FarmerPartyID: p.FarmerPartyID,
399				Phone:         phone,
400				Amount:        p.Amount,
401				UTR:           p.UTR,
402			})
403		}
404	
405		return &SettlementDetail{Batch: *batch, Payouts: payouts}, nil
406	}

16	// ScanQR handles GET /public/qr/{qr_code} — the consumer scan.

18		qrCode := chi.URLParam(r, "qr_code")

26			return
27		}
28		httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, resp)
29	}

166	// parseTimeParam accepts RFC3339 or plain YYYY-MM-DD (empty → nil). Date-only
167	// values mean UTC midnight; with endOfDay they cover the whole day, so
168	// ?to=2026-07-06 is inclusive of the 6th.
169	func parseTimeParam(value string, endOfDay bool) (*time.Time, error) {
170		if value == "" {
171			return nil, nil
172		}
173		if t, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, value); err == nil {
174			t = t.UTC()
175			return &t, nil
176		}
177		t, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", value)
178		if err != nil {
179			return nil, err
180		}
181		if endOfDay {
182			t = t.Add(24*time.Hour - time.Nanosecond)
183		}
184		t = t.UTC()
185		return &t, nil
186	}

1	package logistics
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"errors"
6		"fmt"
7		"math"
8		"time"
9	
10		"github.com/google/uuid"
11		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
12	
13		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
14		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
16		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/orgscope"
17		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/provenance"
18	)
19	
20	const (
21		// canCapacityLitres is the standard milk-can volume used to size a
22		// consignment: can_count = ceil(total litres / 40).
23		canCapacityLitres = 40.0
24	
25		// maxPourRefs caps how many pour references a consignment.created
26		// provenance event carries; beyond it the pour count lives in the
27		// payload only, keeping ledger events bounded.
28		maxPourRefs = 300
29	
30		// maxTripStops bounds a planned route so trip documents stay small.
31		maxTripStops = 100
32	
33		// Physical sanity bounds for a hand-held transit thermometer reading.
34		minPlausibleTempC = -30.0
35		maxPlausibleTempC = 70.0
36	)
37	
38	// service holds all logistics business logic: consignment aggregation,
39	// the consignment/trip state machines, and provenance emission.
40	type service struct {
41		repo   *repo
42		orgs   *orgscope.Resolver
43		ledger *provenance.Ledger
44	}
45	
46	// newService wires the service to its collaborators.
47	func newService(repo *repo, orgs *orgscope.Resolver, ledger *provenance.Ledger) *service {
48		return &service{repo: repo, orgs: orgs, ledger: ledger}
49	}
50	
51	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
52	// Consignments
53	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
54	
55	// createConsignment pools one DCS date+shift's RECORDED pours into an OPEN
56	// consignment: pour IDs, total litres, quantity-weighted fat/SNF averages and
57	// the can count. The unique dcs+date+shift index makes creation idempotent-ish
58	// (a replay returns CONSIGNMENT_EXISTS).
59	func (s *service) createConsignment(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req createConsignmentRequest) (*domain.DCSConsignment, error) {
60		if req.DCSID == "" {
61			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_DCS_ID", "dcs_id is required")
62		}
63		if err := validateShift(req.Shift); err != nil {
64			return nil, err
65		}
66		now := time.Now().UTC()
67		date, err := resolveDate(req.Date, now)
68		if err != nil {
69			return nil, err
70		}
71		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.DCSID); err != nil {
72			return nil, err
73		}
74		org, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.DCSID)
75		if err != nil {
76			return nil, err
77		}
78		if org.Type != domain.OrgTypeDCS {
79			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_DCS", "org unit "+req.DCSID+" is not a DCS")
80		}
81	
82		rows, err := s.repo.findRecordedPours(ctx, req.DCSID, date, req.Shift)
83		if err != nil {
84			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
85		}
86		if len(rows) == 0 {
87			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("NO_POURS_TO_CONSIGN",
88				fmt.Sprintf("no RECORDED pours for DCS %s on %s %s", req.DCSID, date, req.Shift))
89		}
90		pourIDs, totalQty, avgFat, avgSNF := aggregatePours(rows)
91	
92		consignment := &domain.DCSConsignment{
93			ID:                  uuid.NewString(),
94			DCSID:               req.DCSID,
95			Date:                date,
96			Shift:               req.Shift,
97			PourIDs:             pourIDs,
98			TotalQuantityLitres: totalQty,
99			CanCount:            int(math.Ceil(totalQty / canCapacityLitres)),
100			AvgFatPct:           avgFat,
101			AvgSNFPct:           avgSNF,
102			Status:              domain.ConsignmentStatusOpen,
103			CreatedBy:           actor.PartyID,
104			CreatedAt:           now,
105		}
106		if err := s.repo.insertConsignment(ctx, consignment); err != nil {
107			if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(err) {
108				return nil, httpx.Conflict("CONSIGNMENT_EXISTS",
109					fmt.Sprintf("a consignment for DCS %s on %s %s already exists", req.DCSID, date, req.Shift))
110			}
111			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
112		}
113	
114		// Provenance: the pooling-boundary event. Pour refs are capped so the
115		// event stays bounded — past the cap the payload's pour_count is the
116		// authoritative tally (the doc's pour_ids keeps the full set).
117		refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, min(len(pourIDs), maxPourRefs))
118		for i, id := range pourIDs {
119			if i >= maxPourRefs {
120				break
121			}
122			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{EntityType: domain.EntityMilkPour, EntityID: id, Relation: "aggregates"})
123		}
124		event, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
125			Type:       domain.EventConsignmentCreated,
126			EntityType: domain.EntityConsignment,
127			EntityID:   consignment.ID,
128			Refs:       refs,
129			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
130			OrgUnitID:  consignment.DCSID,
131			Payload: map[string]any{
132				"pour_count":            len(pourIDs),
133				"total_quantity_litres": totalQty,
134				"can_count":             consignment.CanCount,
135				"date":                  date,
136				"shift":                 req.Shift,
137			},
138		})
139		if err != nil {
140			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
141		}
142		if err := s.repo.setConsignmentProvenanceSeq(ctx, consignment.ID, event.Seq); err != nil {
143			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
144		}
145		consignment.ProvenanceSeq = event.Seq
146		return consignment, nil
147	}
148	
149	// dispatchConsignment seals an OPEN consignment for pickup (OPEN→DISPATCHED).
150	func (s *service) dispatchConsignment(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id string) (*domain.DCSConsignment, error) {
151		consignment, err := s.loadConsignment(ctx, id)
152		if err != nil {
153			return nil, err
154		}
155		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, consignment.DCSID); err != nil {
156			return nil, err
157		}
158		if consignment.Status != domain.ConsignmentStatusOpen {
159			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_CONSIGNMENT_STATE",
160				"consignment is "+consignment.Status+"; only OPEN consignments can be dispatched")
161		}
162		now := time.Now().UTC()
163		matched, err := s.repo.markConsignmentDispatched(ctx, id, now)
164		if err != nil {
165			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
166		}
167		if !matched { // lost a state race since the read above
168			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_CONSIGNMENT_STATE",
169				"consignment was modified concurrently; reload and retry")
170		}
171		event, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
172			Type:       domain.EventConsignmentDispatched,
173			EntityType: domain.EntityConsignment,
174			EntityID:   consignment.ID,
175			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
176			OrgUnitID:  consignment.DCSID,
177		})
178		if err != nil {
179			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
180		}
181		if err := s.repo.setConsignmentProvenanceSeq(ctx, consignment.ID, event.Seq); err != nil {
182			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
183		}
184		consignment.Status = domain.ConsignmentStatusDispatch
185		consignment.DispatchedAt = &now
186		consignment.ProvenanceSeq = event.Seq
187		return consignment, nil
188	}
189	
190	// listConsignments returns a scoped page of consignments. DCS-scoped actors
191	// default to their own society; wide read roles (SUPER_ADMIN, STATE_AUDITOR)
192	// may list unfiltered; everyone else must name a dcs_id inside their scope.
193	func (s *service) listConsignments(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, q consignmentListQuery, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.DCSConsignment, int64, error) {
194		dcsID := q.DCSID
195		if dcsID == "" {
196			switch {
197			case actor.OrgType == domain.OrgTypeDCS && actor.OrgUnitID != "":
198				dcsID = actor.OrgUnitID
199			case actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSuperAdmin || actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleStateAuditor:
200				// federation-wide read roles may scan unfiltered (still paged)
201			default:
202				return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("DCS_ID_REQUIRED", "dcs_id query parameter is required for your role")
203			}
204		}
205		if dcsID != "" {
206			if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, dcsID); err != nil {
207				return nil, 0, err
208			}
209		}
210		if q.Date != "" {
211			if _, err := resolveDate(q.Date, time.Time{}); err != nil {
212				return nil, 0, err
213			}
214		}
215		if q.Status != "" && !isConsignmentStatus(q.Status) {
216			return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_STATUS", "unknown consignment status "+q.Status)
217		}
218		items, total, err := s.repo.listConsignments(ctx, dcsID, q.Date, q.Status, page)
219		if err != nil {
220			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
221		}
222		return items, total, nil
223	}
224	
225	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
226	// Route trips
227	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
228	
229	// createTrip plans a van run: every stop's consignment must already be
230	// DISPATCHED and must belong to that stop's DCS. The rider defaults to the
231	// actor when a VAN_RIDER plans their own route.
232	func (s *service) createTrip(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req createTripRequest) (*domain.RouteTrip, error) {
233		if req.RouteName == "" {
234			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_ROUTE_NAME", "route_name is required")
235		}
236		if req.UnionID == "" {
237			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_UNION_ID", "union_id is required")
238		}
239		if err := validateShift(req.Shift); err != nil {
240			return nil, err
241		}
242		if len(req.Stops) == 0 {
243			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NO_STOPS", "at least one stop is required")
244		}
245		if len(req.Stops) > maxTripStops {
246			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("TOO_MANY_STOPS", fmt.Sprintf("a trip may have at most %d stops", maxTripStops))
247		}
248		now := time.Now().UTC()
249		date, err := resolveDate(req.Date, now)
250		if err != nil {
251			return nil, err
252		}
253		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.UnionID); err != nil {
254			return nil, err
255		}
256		union, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.UnionID)
257		if err != nil {
258			return nil, err
259		}
260		if union.Type != domain.OrgTypeMilkUnion {
261			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_UNION", "org unit "+req.UnionID+" is not a MILK_UNION")
262		}
263	
264		riderPartyID := req.VanRiderPartyID
265		if riderPartyID == "" {
266			if actor.RoleCode != domain.RoleVanRider {
267				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("RIDER_REQUIRED", "van_rider_party_id is required unless a VAN_RIDER plans their own trip")
268			}
269			riderPartyID = actor.PartyID
270		}
271	
272		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(req.Stops))
273		stops := make([]domain.RouteStop, 0, len(req.Stops))
274		for _, stop := range req.Stops {
275			if stop.DCSID == "" || stop.ConsignmentID == "" {
276				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_STOP", "every stop needs dcs_id and consignment_id")
277			}
278			if _, dup := seen[stop.ConsignmentID]; dup {
279				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("DUPLICATE_STOP", "consignment "+stop.ConsignmentID+" appears in more than one stop")
280			}
281			seen[stop.ConsignmentID] = struct{}{}
282	
283			consignment, err := s.loadConsignment(ctx, stop.ConsignmentID)
284			if err != nil {
285				return nil, err
286			}
287			if aerr := validateStopConsignment(consignment, stop.DCSID); aerr != nil {
288				return nil, aerr
289			}
290			stops = append(stops, domain.RouteStop{DCSID: stop.DCSID, ConsignmentID: stop.ConsignmentID})
291		}
292	
293		trip := &domain.RouteTrip{
294			ID:              uuid.NewString(),
295			RouteName:       req.RouteName,
296			UnionID:         req.UnionID,
297			VanRiderPartyID: riderPartyID,
298			Date:            date,
299			Shift:           req.Shift,
300			Stops:           stops,
301			Status:          domain.TripStatusPlanned,
302			CreatedAt:       now,
303		}
304		if err := s.repo.insertTrip(ctx, trip); err != nil {
305			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
306		}
307		return trip, nil
308	}
309	
310	// pickupStop records the trip's rider collecting one consignment: the stop is
311	// stamped with time+temperature, the consignment moves DISPATCHED→PICKED_UP,
312	// and the trip moves to IN_PROGRESS on its first pickup.
313	func (s *service) pickupStop(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, tripID, consignmentID string, req pickupRequest) (*domain.RouteTrip, error) {
314		if err := validateTemp(req.TempC); err != nil {
315			return nil, err
316		}
317		trip, err := s.loadTrip(ctx, tripID)
318		if err != nil {
319			return nil, err
320		}
321		if aerr := validatePickup(trip, actor.PartyID, consignmentID); aerr != nil {
322			return nil, aerr
323		}
324	
325		// Guard the consignment transition atomically; only a DISPATCHED
326		// consignment can board the van.
327		matched, err := s.repo.markConsignmentPickedUp(ctx, consignmentID, trip.ID)
328		if err != nil {
329			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
330		}
331		if !matched {
332			consignment, err := s.loadConsignment(ctx, consignmentID)
333			if err != nil {
334				return nil, err
335			}
336			return nil, httpx.Conflict("CONSIGNMENT_NOT_DISPATCHED",
337				"consignment is "+consignment.Status+"; only DISPATCHED consignments can be picked up")
338		}
339	
340		now := time.Now().UTC()
341		if err := s.repo.markStopPickedUp(ctx, trip.ID, consignmentID, now, *req.TempC, req.Notes); err != nil {
342			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
343		}
344	
345		event, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
346			Type:       domain.EventConsignmentPickedUp,
347			EntityType: domain.EntityConsignment,
348			EntityID:   consignmentID,
349			Refs: []provenance.Ref{
350				{EntityType: domain.EntityRouteTrip, EntityID: trip.ID, Relation: "carried_by"},
351			},
352			Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
353			OrgUnitID: trip.UnionID,
354			Payload:   map[string]any{"temp_c": *req.TempC},
355		})
356		if err != nil {
357			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
358		}
359		if err := s.repo.setConsignmentProvenanceSeq(ctx, consignmentID, event.Seq); err != nil {
360			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
361		}
362	
363		trip.Status = domain.TripStatusInProgress
364		if i := findStop(trip, consignmentID); i >= 0 {
365			trip.Stops[i].PickedUpAt = &now
366			trip.Stops[i].TempC = *req.TempC
367			trip.Stops[i].Notes = req.Notes
368		}
369		return trip, nil
370	}
371	
372	// logColdChain appends one in-transit temperature sample to the trip —
373	// tamper-evidence for the perishable load between village and BMC.
374	func (s *service) logColdChain(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, tripID string, req coldChainRequest) (*domain.RouteTrip, error) {
375		if err := validateTemp(req.TempC); err != nil {
376			return nil, err
377		}
378		trip, err := s.loadTrip(ctx, tripID)
379		if err != nil {
380			return nil, err
381		}
382		if aerr := validateColdChain(trip, actor.PartyID); aerr != nil {
383			return nil, aerr
384		}
385		entry := domain.ColdChainEntry{
386			TS:     time.Now().UTC(),
387			TempC:  *req.TempC,
388			GeoLat: req.GeoLat,
389			GeoLng: req.GeoLng,
390		}
391		if err := s.repo.pushColdChain(ctx, trip.ID, entry); err != nil {
392			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
393		}
394		event, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
395			Type:       domain.EventColdChainLogged,
396			EntityType: domain.EntityRouteTrip,
397			EntityID:   trip.ID,
398			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
399			OrgUnitID:  trip.UnionID,
400			Payload:    map[string]any{"temp_c": *req.TempC},
401		})
402		if err != nil {
403			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
404		}
405		if err := s.repo.setTripProvenanceSeq(ctx, trip.ID, event.Seq); err != nil {
406			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
407		}
408		trip.ColdChain = append(trip.ColdChain, entry)
409		trip.ProvenanceSeq = event.Seq
410		return trip, nil
411	}
412	
413	// deliverTrip hands the whole load to a BMC: every stop must be picked up,
414	// the trip moves IN_PROGRESS→DELIVERED and its consignments PICKED_UP→DELIVERED.
415	func (s *service) deliverTrip(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, tripID string, req deliverRequest) (*domain.RouteTrip, error) {
416		if req.BMCID == "" {
417			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_BMC_ID", "bmc_id is required")
418		}
419		trip, err := s.loadTrip(ctx, tripID)
420		if err != nil {
421			return nil, err
422		}
423		if aerr := validateDeliver(trip, actor.PartyID); aerr != nil {
424			return nil, aerr
425		}
426		bmc, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.BMCID)
427		if err != nil {
428			return nil, err
429		}
430		if bmc.Type != domain.OrgTypeBMC {
431			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_BMC", "org unit "+req.BMCID+" is not a BMC")
432		}
433	
434		now := time.Now().UTC()
435		matched, err := s.repo.markTripDelivered(ctx, trip.ID, req.BMCID, now)
436		if err != nil {
437			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
438		}
439		if !matched { // lost a state race since the read above
440			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_TRIP_STATE", "trip was modified concurrently; reload and retry")
441		}
442	
443		consignmentIDs := make([]string, 0, len(trip.Stops))
444		refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, len(trip.Stops))
445		for _, stop := range trip.Stops {
446			consignmentIDs = append(consignmentIDs, stop.ConsignmentID)
447			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{
448				EntityType: domain.EntityConsignment, EntityID: stop.ConsignmentID, Relation: "delivered",
449			})
450		}
451		if err := s.repo.markConsignmentsDelivered(ctx, consignmentIDs); err != nil {
452			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
453		}
454	
455		event, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
456			Type:       domain.EventTripDelivered,
457			EntityType: domain.EntityRouteTrip,
458			EntityID:   trip.ID,
459			Refs:       refs,
460			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
461			OrgUnitID:  trip.UnionID,
462			Payload:    map[string]any{"bmc_id": req.BMCID},
463		})
464		if err != nil {
465			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
466		}
467		if err := s.repo.setTripProvenanceSeq(ctx, trip.ID, event.Seq); err != nil {
468			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
469		}
470	
471		trip.Status = domain.TripStatusDelivered
472		trip.DeliveredToBMCID = req.BMCID
473		trip.DeliveredAt = &now
474		trip.ProvenanceSeq = event.Seq
475		return trip, nil
476	}

478	// listTrips returns a scoped page of trips: riders are forced onto their own
479	// trips; supervisors/presidents default to (and are checked against) their
480	// union scope.
481	func (s *service) listTrips(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, q tripListQuery, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.RouteTrip, int64, error) {
482		unionID := q.UnionID
483		riderPartyID := q.VanRiderPartyID
484		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleVanRider {
485			riderPartyID = actor.PartyID // riders only ever see their own trips
486		} else {
487			if unionID == "" &&
488				actor.RoleCode != domain.RoleSuperAdmin && actor.RoleCode != domain.RoleStateAuditor {
489				unionID = actor.OrgUnitID // supervisors/presidents default to their union
490			}
491			if unionID != "" {
492				if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, unionID); err != nil {
493					return nil, 0, err
494				}
495			}
496		}
497		if q.Date != "" {
498			if _, err := resolveDate(q.Date, time.Time{}); err != nil {
499				return nil, 0, err
500			}
501		}
502		items, total, err := s.repo.listTrips(ctx, unionID, q.Date, riderPartyID, page)
503		if err != nil {
504			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
505		}
506		return items, total, nil
507	}

509	// getTrip returns one trip: a rider only their own, everyone else within
510	// union scope.
511	func (s *service) getTrip(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, tripID string) (*domain.RouteTrip, error) {
512		trip, err := s.loadTrip(ctx, tripID)
513		if err != nil {
514			return nil, err
515		}
516		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleVanRider {
517			if trip.VanRiderPartyID != actor.PartyID {
518				return nil, httpx.Forbidden("this trip is assigned to another van rider")
519			}
520			return trip, nil
521		}
522		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, trip.UnionID); err != nil {
523			return nil, err
524		}
525		return trip, nil
526	}

556	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
557	// Pure guards & helpers (unit-tested in service_test.go)
558	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
559	
560	// aggregatePours reduces pour rows to (ids, total litres, quantity-weighted
561	// average fat %, quantity-weighted average SNF %), rounded to 2 decimals.
562	func aggregatePours(rows []pourRow) (pourIDs []string, totalQty, avgFat, avgSNF float64) {
563		var fatWeighted, snfWeighted float64
564		pourIDs = make([]string, 0, len(rows))
565		for _, row := range rows {
566			pourIDs = append(pourIDs, row.ID)
567			totalQty += row.QuantityLitres
568			fatWeighted += row.FatPct * row.QuantityLitres
569			snfWeighted += row.SNFPct * row.QuantityLitres
570		}
571		if totalQty > 0 {
572			avgFat = round2(fatWeighted / totalQty)
573			avgSNF = round2(snfWeighted / totalQty)
574		}
575		return pourIDs, round2(totalQty), avgFat, avgSNF
576	}
577	
578	// round2 rounds to 2 decimal places (litres / percentage precision).
579	func round2(v float64) float64 { return math.Round(v*100) / 100 }
580	
581	// validateShift accepts only the two collection shifts.
582	func validateShift(shift string) *httpx.AppError {
583		if shift != domain.ShiftMorning && shift != domain.ShiftEvening {
584			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_SHIFT", "shift must be MORNING or EVENING")
585		}
586		return nil
587	}
588	
589	// resolveDate defaults an empty date to the IST day key of now, otherwise
590	// validates the YYYY-MM-DD form.
591	func resolveDate(date string, now time.Time) (string, error) {
592		if date == "" {
593			return domain.DateKeyIST(now), nil
594		}
595		if _, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", date); err != nil {
596			return "", httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_DATE", "date must be YYYY-MM-DD")
597		}
598		return date, nil
599	}
600	
601	// validateTemp requires a temperature and rejects physically implausible ones.
602	func validateTemp(tempC *float64) *httpx.AppError {
603		if tempC == nil {
604			return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_TEMP", "temp_c is required")
605		}
606		if *tempC < minPlausibleTempC || *tempC > maxPlausibleTempC {
607			return httpx.BadRequest("IMPLAUSIBLE_TEMP",
608				fmt.Sprintf("temp_c must be between %.0f and %.0f °C", minPlausibleTempC, maxPlausibleTempC))
609		}
610		return nil
611	}
612	
613	// isConsignmentStatus reports whether s is a known consignment status.
614	func isConsignmentStatus(s string) bool {
615		switch s {
616		case domain.ConsignmentStatusOpen, domain.ConsignmentStatusDispatch,
617			domain.ConsignmentStatusPickedUp, domain.ConsignmentStatusDelivered,
618			domain.ConsignmentStatusAccepted, domain.ConsignmentStatusRejected:
619			return true
620		}
621		return false
622	}
623	
624	// findStop returns the index of the stop carrying consignmentID, or -1.
625	func findStop(trip *domain.RouteTrip, consignmentID string) int {
626		for i := range trip.Stops {
627			if trip.Stops[i].ConsignmentID == consignmentID {
628				return i
629			}
630		}
631		return -1
632	}
633	
634	// requireTripRider enforces that only the trip's assigned van rider acts on it.
635	func requireTripRider(trip *domain.RouteTrip, riderPartyID string) *httpx.AppError {
636		if trip.VanRiderPartyID != riderPartyID {
637			return httpx.Forbidden("this trip is assigned to another van rider")
638		}
639		return nil
640	}
641	
642	// validateStopConsignment guards trip planning: the stop's consignment must
643	// be DISPATCHED (state machine) and must belong to the stop's DCS.
644	func validateStopConsignment(consignment *domain.DCSConsignment, stopDCSID string) *httpx.AppError {
645		if consignment.Status != domain.ConsignmentStatusDispatch {
646			return httpx.Conflict("CONSIGNMENT_NOT_DISPATCHED",
647				"consignment "+consignment.ID+" is "+consignment.Status+"; only DISPATCHED consignments can be planned onto a trip")
648		}
649		if consignment.DCSID != stopDCSID {
650			return httpx.Unprocessable("CONSIGNMENT_DCS_MISMATCH",
651				"consignment "+consignment.ID+" belongs to DCS "+consignment.DCSID+", not the stop's DCS "+stopDCSID)
652		}
653		return nil
654	}
655	
656	// validatePickup guards the pickup transition: right rider, trip not yet
657	// delivered, stop exists, stop not already picked.
658	func validatePickup(trip *domain.RouteTrip, riderPartyID, consignmentID string) *httpx.AppError {
659		if err := requireTripRider(trip, riderPartyID); err != nil {
660			return err
661		}
662		if trip.Status == domain.TripStatusDelivered {
663			return httpx.Conflict("TRIP_ALREADY_DELIVERED", "trip is DELIVERED; no further pickups are possible")
664		}
665		i := findStop(trip, consignmentID)
666		if i < 0 {
667			return httpx.NotFound("stop for consignment " + consignmentID)
668		}
669		if trip.Stops[i].PickedUpAt != nil {
670			return httpx.Conflict("STOP_ALREADY_PICKED", "consignment "+consignmentID+" was already picked up on this trip")
671		}
672		return nil
673	}
674	
675	// validateColdChain guards cold-chain logging: right rider, trip still moving.
676	func validateColdChain(trip *domain.RouteTrip, riderPartyID string) *httpx.AppError {
677		if err := requireTripRider(trip, riderPartyID); err != nil {
678			return err
679		}
680		if trip.Status == domain.TripStatusDelivered {
681			return httpx.Conflict("TRIP_ALREADY_DELIVERED", "trip is DELIVERED; cold-chain logging is closed")
682		}
683		return nil
684	}
685	
686	// validateDeliver guards delivery: right rider, not already delivered, and
687	// every stop picked up (partial loads cannot be handed to a BMC).
688	func validateDeliver(trip *domain.RouteTrip, riderPartyID string) *httpx.AppError {
689		if err := requireTripRider(trip, riderPartyID); err != nil {
690			return err
691		}
692		if trip.Status == domain.TripStatusDelivered {
693			return httpx.Conflict("TRIP_ALREADY_DELIVERED", "trip is already DELIVERED")
694		}
695		var unpicked []string
696		for _, stop := range trip.Stops {
697			if stop.PickedUpAt == nil {
698				unpicked = append(unpicked, stop.ConsignmentID)
699			}
700		}
701		if len(unpicked) > 0 {
702			return httpx.Unprocessable("STOPS_NOT_PICKED", "every stop must be picked up before delivery").
703				WithDetails(map[string]any{"unpicked_consignment_ids": unpicked})
704		}
705		return nil
706	}

package settlement

import (

// handler is the HTTP edge of the settlement module: decode, validate shape,
// call the service, respond. No business logic, no MongoDB.
type handler struct {
	svc *service
}

// initiate handles POST /settlements.
func (h *handler) initiate(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	actor, _ := auth.ActorFrom(r.Context())
	var in InitiateSettlementRequest
	if err := httpx.DecodeJSON(r, &in); err != nil {
		httpx.Error(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	batch, err := h.svc.Initiate(r.Context(), actor, in)
	if err != nil {
		httpx.Error(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusCreated, batch)
}

// approve handles POST /settlements/{id}/approve.
func (h *handler) approve(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	actor, _ := auth.ActorFrom(r.Context())
	batch, err := h.svc.Approve(r.Context(), actor, chi.URLParam(r, "id"))
	if err != nil {
		httpx.Error(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, batch)
}

	actor, _ := auth.ActorFrom(r.Context())
	var in RejectSettlementRequest
	if err := httpx.DecodeJSON(r, &in); err != nil {
		httpx.Error(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	batch, err := h.svc.Reject(r.Context(), actor, chi.URLParam(r, "id"), in.Reason)
	if err != nil {
		httpx.Error(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, batch)
}

// execute handles POST /settlements/{id}/execute.
func (h *handler) execute(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	actor, _ := auth.ActorFrom(r.Context())
	detail, err := h.svc.Execute(r.Context(), actor, chi.URLParam(r, "id"))
	if err != nil {
		httpx.Error(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, detail)
}

// list handles GET /settlements.
func (h *handler) list(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	actor, _ := auth.ActorFrom(r.Context())
	q := r.URL.Query()
	page := httpx.ParsePage(r)
	batches, total, err := h.svc.List(r.Context(), actor, q.Get("dcs_id"), q.Get("date"), q.Get("status"), page)

package settlement

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"time"

	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo/options"

	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/mongodb"
)

// internalFetchCap bounds internal (non-paginated) reads so a pathological
// day can never pull an unbounded set into memory. A DCS day is a few
// hundred invoices at most.
const internalFetchCap = 5000

// repo owns every MongoDB access for the settlement module. No business
// logic lives here — only reads, guarded writes and error mapping.
type repo struct {
	batches  *mongo.Collection
	payouts  *mongo.Collection
	invoices *mongo.Collection
	kyc      *mongo.Collection
	parties  *mongo.Collection
	dbt      *mongo.Collection
}

// newRepo binds the repo to the shared database handle.
func newRepo(db *mongo.Database) *repo {
	return &repo{
		batches:  db.Collection(mongodb.CollSettlements),
		payouts:  db.Collection(mongodb.CollPayouts),
		invoices: db.Collection(mongodb.CollInvoices),
		kyc:      db.Collection(mongodb.CollKYCRecords),
		parties:  db.Collection(mongodb.CollParties),
		dbt:      db.Collection(mongodb.CollDBTRequests),
	}
}

// ---- invoices (read + settlement-lifecycle status flips only) ----

// issuedInvoices returns the day's ISSUED invoices for a DCS.
func (rp *repo) issuedInvoices(ctx context.Context, dcsID, date string) ([]domain.Invoice, error) {
	cur, err := rp.invoices.Find(ctx,
		bson.D{
			{Key: "dcs_id", Value: dcsID},
			{Key: "invoice_date", Value: date},
			{Key: "status", Value: domain.InvoiceStatusIssued},
		},
		options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "invoice_number", Value: 1}}).SetLimit(internalFetchCap),
	)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	var out []domain.Invoice
	if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return out, nil
}

// claimInvoices atomically flips still-ISSUED invoices to SETTLEMENT_PENDING
// under the given batch. The status guard makes concurrent initiations safe
// without transactions: each invoice is claimed by exactly one batch.
func (rp *repo) claimInvoices(ctx context.Context, invoiceIDs []string, batchID string) (int64, error) {
	res, err := rp.invoices.UpdateMany(ctx,
		bson.D{
			{Key: "_id", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: invoiceIDs}}},
			{Key: "status", Value: domain.InvoiceStatusIssued},
		},
		bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
			{Key: "status", Value: domain.InvoiceStatusSettlementPending},
			{Key: "settlement_batch_id", Value: batchID},
		}}},
	)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return res.ModifiedCount, nil
}

// invoicesByBatch returns every invoice claimed by a settlement batch.
func (rp *repo) invoicesByBatch(ctx context.Context, batchID string) ([]domain.Invoice, error) {
	cur, err := rp.invoices.Find(ctx,
		bson.D{{Key: "settlement_batch_id", Value: batchID}},
		options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "invoice_number", Value: 1}}).SetLimit(internalFetchCap),
	)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	var out []domain.Invoice
	if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return out, nil
}

// releaseInvoices puts a rejected batch's invoices back to ISSUED and clears
// the batch linkage, so a fresh initiation can pick them up.
func (rp *repo) releaseInvoices(ctx context.Context, batchID string) error {
	_, err := rp.invoices.UpdateMany(ctx,
		bson.D{
			{Key: "settlement_batch_id", Value: batchID},
			{Key: "status", Value: domain.InvoiceStatusSettlementPending},
		},
		bson.D{
			{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: domain.InvoiceStatusIssued}}},
			{Key: "$unset", Value: bson.D{{Key: "settlement_batch_id", Value: ""}}},
		},
	)
	if err != nil {
		return httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return nil
}

// markInvoicesPaid flips all of a batch's invoices to PAID after execution.
func (rp *repo) markInvoicesPaid(ctx context.Context, batchID string) error {
	_, err := rp.invoices.UpdateMany(ctx,
		bson.D{{Key: "settlement_batch_id", Value: batchID}},
		bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: domain.InvoiceStatusPaid}}}},
	)
	if err != nil {
		return httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return nil
}

// ---- settlement batches ----

// insertBatch persists a new settlement batch.
func (rp *repo) insertBatch(ctx context.Context, b *domain.SettlementBatch) error {
	if _, err := rp.batches.InsertOne(ctx, b); err != nil {
		return httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return nil
}

// batchByID loads one settlement batch.
func (rp *repo) batchByID(ctx context.Context, id string) (*domain.SettlementBatch, error) {
	var b domain.SettlementBatch
	err := rp.batches.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&b)
	if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
		return nil, httpx.NotFound("settlement batch " + id)
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return &b, nil
}

// transitionBatch performs a status-guarded update (optimistic concurrency —
// no transactions on a standalone server). Returns false when the batch was
// not in fromStatus, i.e. another actor won the transition.
func (rp *repo) transitionBatch(ctx context.Context, id, fromStatus string, set bson.D) (bool, error) {
	res, err := rp.batches.UpdateOne(ctx,
		bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}, {Key: "status", Value: fromStatus}},
		bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: set}},
	)
	if err != nil {
		return false, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return res.MatchedCount > 0, nil
}

// setBatchProvenanceSeq stamps the batch with its latest ledger sequence.
func (rp *repo) setBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx context.Context, id string, seq int64) error {
	_, err := rp.batches.UpdateOne(ctx,
		bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}},
		bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "provenance_seq", Value: seq}}}},
	)
	if err != nil {
		return httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return nil
}

// listBatches pages settlement batches, newest day first.
func (rp *repo) listBatches(ctx context.Context, filter bson.D, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.SettlementBatch, int64, error) {
	total, err := rp.batches.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	cur, err := rp.batches.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
		SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "date", Value: -1}, {Key: "created_at", Value: -1}}).
		SetSkip(page.Offset).SetLimit(page.Limit),
	)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	var out []domain.SettlementBatch
	if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
		return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return out, total, nil
}

// ---- payout instructions ----

// insertPayout persists one payout. The unique index on invoice_id makes an
// execution retry harmless: alreadyExists=true means this invoice was paid
// in a previous (possibly interrupted) run.
func (rp *repo) insertPayout(ctx context.Context, p *domain.PayoutInstruction) (alreadyExists bool, err error) {
	if _, err := rp.payouts.InsertOne(ctx, p); err != nil {
		if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(err) {
			return true, nil
		}
		return false, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return false, nil
}

// payoutByInvoice fetches the payout already recorded for an invoice.
func (rp *repo) payoutByInvoice(ctx context.Context, invoiceID string) (*domain.PayoutInstruction, error) {
	var p domain.PayoutInstruction
	err := rp.payouts.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "invoice_id", Value: invoiceID}}).Decode(&p)
	if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
		return nil, httpx.NotFound("payout for invoice " + invoiceID)
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return &p, nil
}

// payoutsByBatch returns a batch's payout instructions.
func (rp *repo) payoutsByBatch(ctx context.Context, batchID string) ([]domain.PayoutInstruction, error) {
	cur, err := rp.payouts.Find(ctx,
		bson.D{{Key: "settlement_batch_id", Value: batchID}},
		options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "created_at", Value: 1}}).SetLimit(internalFetchCap),
	)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	var out []domain.PayoutInstruction
	if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return out, nil
}

// payoutsByFarmer pages one farmer's payment history, newest first.
func (rp *repo) payoutsByFarmer(ctx context.Context, farmerPartyID string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.PayoutInstruction, int64, error) {
	filter := bson.D{{Key: "farmer_party_id", Value: farmerPartyID}}
	total, err := rp.payouts.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	cur, err := rp.payouts.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
		SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "created_at", Value: -1}}).
		SetSkip(page.Offset).SetLimit(page.Limit),
	)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	var out []domain.PayoutInstruction
	if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
		return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return out, total, nil
}

// ---- lookups in adjacent collections (read-only, per module spec) ----

// latestBankMasked returns the masked bank account from the farmer's most
// recent KYC record carrying one, or "" when none exists.
func (rp *repo) latestBankMasked(ctx context.Context, partyID string) (string, error) {
	var rec domain.KYCRecord
	err := rp.kyc.FindOne(ctx,
		bson.D{
			{Key: "party_id", Value: partyID},
			{Key: "bank_account_masked", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$exists", Value: true}, {Key: "$ne", Value: ""}}},
		},
		options.FindOne().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "created_at", Value: -1}}),
	).Decode(&rec)
	if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
		return "", nil
	}
	if err != nil {
		return "", httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return rec.BankAccountMasked, nil
}

// partyPhone resolves a party's phone number (for the payout SMS event).
func (rp *repo) partyPhone(ctx context.Context, partyID string) (string, error) {
	var p domain.Party
	err := rp.parties.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: partyID}}).Decode(&p)
	if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
		return "", httpx.NotFound("party " + partyID)
	}
	if err != nil {
		return "", httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return p.Phone, nil
}

// ---- DBT requests ----

// insertDBT persists a new subsidy request.
func (rp *repo) insertDBT(ctx context.Context, r *domain.DBTRequest) error {
	if _, err := rp.dbt.InsertOne(ctx, r); err != nil {
		return httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return nil
}

// dbtByID loads one DBT request.
func (rp *repo) dbtByID(ctx context.Context, id string) (*domain.DBTRequest, error) {
	var d domain.DBTRequest
	err := rp.dbt.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&d)
	if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
		return nil, httpx.NotFound("dbt request " + id)
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return &d, nil
}

// transitionDBT performs a status-guarded DBT update; false = lost the race
// or the request already left fromStatus.
func (rp *repo) transitionDBT(ctx context.Context, id, fromStatus, toStatus string, creditedAt *time.Time) (bool, error) {
	set := bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: toStatus}}
	if creditedAt != nil {
		set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "credited_at", Value: creditedAt})
	}
	res, err := rp.dbt.UpdateOne(ctx,
		bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}, {Key: "status", Value: fromStatus}},
		bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: set}},
	)
	if err != nil {
		return false, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return res.MatchedCount > 0, nil
}

// listDBT pages DBT requests, newest first.
func (rp *repo) listDBT(ctx context.Context, filter bson.D, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.DBTRequest, int64, error) {
	total, err := rp.dbt.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	cur, err := rp.dbt.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
		SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "created_at", Value: -1}}).
		SetSkip(page.Offset).SetLimit(page.Limit),
	)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	var out []domain.DBTRequest
	if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
		return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return out, total, nil
}

27	// codeSafetyGateBlocked is the stable error code every gate refusal carries —
28	// the frontend switches on it to show the quarantine screen (blueprint §8.3).
29	const codeSafetyGateBlocked = "SAFETY_GATE_BLOCKED"
30	
31	// Service holds the plant module's business logic: lot pooling, the safety
32	// gate, batch numbering, product lot packaging and QR minting.
33	type Service struct {
34		repo     *Repo
35		orgs     *orgscope.Resolver
36		ledger   *provenance.Ledger
37		qrSecret string
38	}
39	
40	// NewService wires the service from the shared dependency container.
41	func NewService(repo *Repo, d *deps.Deps) *Service {
42		return &Service{
43			repo:     repo,
44			orgs:     d.Orgs,
45			ledger:   d.Ledger,
46			qrSecret: d.Cfg.QRSigningSecret,
47		}
48	}
49	
50	// --- safety-gate predicates (§8.3) ---
51	//
52	// Pure functions so the refusal matrix is unit-testable without a database.
53	// Every mutation below ALSO re-checks the status inside the MongoDB update
54	// filter, so a concurrent QC block can never slip a bad lot through.
55	
56	// canDispatchBMCLot: only a lot with a passing BMC rapid test may leave on a
57	// tanker. BLOCKED, QC_PENDING and OPEN lots stay put.
58	func canDispatchBMCLot(status string) bool {
59		return status == domain.BMCLotStatusPassed
60	}
61	
62	// canPoolBMCLot: only a DISPATCHED lot (which by construction went
63	// OPEN→QC_PENDING→PASSED→DISPATCHED) may enter a processing batch.
64	func canPoolBMCLot(status string) bool {
65		return status == domain.BMCLotStatusDispatched
66	}
67	
68	// canCompleteBatch: only a batch the plant lab has PASSED may complete.
69	func canCompleteBatch(status string) bool {
70		return status == domain.BatchStatusPassed
71	}
72	
73	// canYieldProductLot: only a COMPLETED batch may be packaged into SKU lots.
74	func canYieldProductLot(batchStatus string) bool {
75		return batchStatus == domain.BatchStatusCompleted
76	}
77	
78	// canIssueQR: a QR may only label an ACTIVE product lot whose batch is
79	// COMPLETED — re-checked at mint time so a recall immediately stops printing.
80	func canIssueQR(lotStatus, batchStatus string) bool {
81		return lotStatus == domain.ProductLotStatusActive && batchStatus == domain.BatchStatusCompleted
82	}
83	
84	// --- BMC lots ---
85	
86	// CreateBMCLot pools DELIVERED consignments into a new OPEN lot at a BMC.
87	func (s *Service) CreateBMCLot(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateBMCLotRequest) (*domain.BMCLot, error) {
88		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.BMCID); err != nil {
89			return nil, err
90		}
91		org, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.BMCID)
92		if err != nil {
93			return nil, err
94		}
95		if org.Type != domain.OrgTypeBMC {
96			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_BMC", "org unit "+req.BMCID+" is not a BMC")
97		}
98	
99		now := time.Now().UTC()
100		date := req.Date
101		if date == "" {
102			date = domain.DateKeyIST(now)
103		}
104	
105		ids := dedupe(req.ConsignmentIDs)
106		consignments, err := s.repo.ConsignmentsByIDs(ctx, ids)
107		if err != nil {
108			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
109		}
110		if len(consignments) != len(ids) {
111			return nil, httpx.NotFound("consignment(s) " + strings.Join(missingIDs(ids, consignments), ", "))
112		}
113		var undelivered []string
114		for _, c := range consignments {
115			if c.Status != domain.ConsignmentStatusDelivered {
116				undelivered = append(undelivered, c.ID)
117			}
118		}
119		if len(undelivered) > 0 {
120			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("CONSIGNMENT_NOT_DELIVERED",
121				"only DELIVERED consignments can be pooled into a BMC lot").
122				WithDetails(map[string]any{"consignment_ids": undelivered})
123		}
124	
125		// Optimistic claim: flip DELIVERED→ACCEPTED stamped with the new lot ID.
126		// If another lot raced us on any consignment, release our claims and bail.
127		lotID := uuid.NewString()
128		claimed, err := s.repo.ClaimConsignments(ctx, ids, lotID)
129		if err != nil {
130			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
131		}
132		if claimed != int64(len(ids)) {
133			if relErr := s.repo.ReleaseConsignments(ctx, lotID); relErr != nil {
134				return nil, httpx.Internal(relErr)
135			}
136			return nil, httpx.Conflict("CONSIGNMENT_CLAIM_CONFLICT",
137				"one or more consignments were pooled by another lot — reload and retry")
138		}
139	
140		var totalLitres float64
141		var tripIDs []string
142		seenTrip := map[string]bool{}
143		for _, c := range consignments {
144			totalLitres += c.TotalQuantityLitres
145			if c.RouteTripID != "" && !seenTrip[c.RouteTripID] {
146				seenTrip[c.RouteTripID] = true
147				tripIDs = append(tripIDs, c.RouteTripID)
148			}
149		}
150	
151		lot := &domain.BMCLot{
152			ID:                  lotID,
153			BMCID:               req.BMCID,
154			Date:                date,
155			Shift:               req.Shift,
156			ConsignmentIDs:      ids,
157			RouteTripIDs:        tripIDs,
158			TotalQuantityLitres: totalLitres,
159			Status:              domain.BMCLotStatusOpen,
160			CreatedBy:           actor.PartyID,
161			CreatedAt:           now,
162		}
163		if err := s.repo.InsertBMCLot(ctx, lot); err != nil {
164			_ = s.repo.ReleaseConsignments(ctx, lotID)
165			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
166		}
167	
168		refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, len(ids))
169		for _, id := range ids {
170			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{
171				EntityType: domain.EntityConsignment, EntityID: id, Relation: "pools",
172			})
173		}
174		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
175			Type:       domain.EventBMCLotCreated,
176			EntityType: domain.EntityBMCLot,
177			EntityID:   lot.ID,
178			Refs:       refs,
179			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
180			OrgUnitID:  req.BMCID,
181			Payload: map[string]any{
182				"date": date, "shift": req.Shift, "total_quantity_litres": totalLitres,
183			},
184		})
185		if err != nil {
186			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
187		}
188		if err := s.repo.SetBMCLotProvenanceSeq(ctx, lot.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
189			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
190		}
191		lot.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
192		return lot, nil
193	}
194	
195	// CloseBMCLot transitions an OPEN lot to QC_PENDING with the chilling
196	// temperature. The quality module later flips QC_PENDING→PASSED/BLOCKED.
197	func (s *Service) CloseBMCLot(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id string, chillingTempC float64) (*domain.BMCLot, error) {
198		lot, err := s.getBMCLot(ctx, id)
199		if err != nil {
200			return nil, err
201		}
202		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, lot.BMCID); err != nil {
203			return nil, err
204		}
205		if lot.Status != domain.BMCLotStatusOpen {
206			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_NOT_OPEN",
207				"only an OPEN lot can be closed; lot is "+lot.Status)
208		}
209		now := time.Now().UTC()
210		ok, err := s.repo.CloseBMCLot(ctx, id, chillingTempC, now)
211		if err != nil {
212			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
213		}
214		if !ok {
215			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_NOT_OPEN",
216				"lot changed state concurrently — reload and retry")
217		}
218		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
219			Type:       domain.EventBMCLotClosed,
220			EntityType: domain.EntityBMCLot,
221			EntityID:   lot.ID,
222			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
223			OrgUnitID:  lot.BMCID,
224			Payload:    map[string]any{"chilling_temp_c": chillingTempC},
225		})
226		if err != nil {
227			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
228		}
229		if err := s.repo.SetBMCLotProvenanceSeq(ctx, lot.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
230			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
231		}
232		lot.Status = domain.BMCLotStatusQCPending
233		lot.ChillingTempC = chillingTempC
234		lot.ClosedAt = &now
235		lot.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
236		return lot, nil
237	}
238	
239	// DispatchBMCLot transitions PASSED→DISPATCHED. THE safety gate (§8.3): a
240	// BLOCKED or untested lot never leaves the chilling centre.
241	func (s *Service) DispatchBMCLot(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id string) (*domain.BMCLot, error) {
242		lot, err := s.getBMCLot(ctx, id)
243		if err != nil {
244			return nil, err
245		}
246		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, lot.BMCID); err != nil {
247			return nil, err
248		}
249		if lot.Status == domain.BMCLotStatusDispatched {
250			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_ALREADY_DISPATCHED", "lot is already dispatched")
251		}
252		if !canDispatchBMCLot(lot.Status) {
253			msg := "lot cannot be dispatched: safety gate not passed (status " + lot.Status + ")"
254			if lot.BlockReason != "" {
255				msg += " — " + lot.BlockReason
256			}
257			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked, msg).
258				WithDetails(map[string]any{"status": lot.Status, "block_reason": lot.BlockReason})
259		}
260		now := time.Now().UTC()
261		ok, err := s.repo.DispatchBMCLot(ctx, id, now)
262		if err != nil {
263			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
264		}
265		if !ok {
266			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_STATE_CHANGED",
267				"lot changed state concurrently — reload and retry")
268		}
269		lot.Status = domain.BMCLotStatusDispatched
270		lot.DispatchedAt = &now
271		return lot, nil
272	}

274	// ListBMCLots pages lots by BMC/date/status. A BMC operator may only list
275	// within their own scope; downstream readers (plant operator, supervisor,
276	// lab) see across BMCs — the plant receives tankers from sibling BMCs, so an
277	// ancestry check against the plant org would wrongly refuse them.
278	func (s *Service) ListBMCLots(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, f BMCLotListFilter, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.BMCLot, int64, error) {
279		if f.BMCID != "" && actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleBMCOperator {
280			if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, f.BMCID); err != nil {
281				return nil, 0, err
282			}
283		}
284		lots, total, err := s.repo.ListBMCLots(ctx, f, page)
285		if err != nil {
286			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
287		}
288		return lots, total, nil
289	}

291	// --- processing batches ---
292	
293	// CreateBatch pools DISPATCHED (gate-passed) BMC lots into one production
294	// run. The gate re-checks here belt-and-braces: aflatoxin M1 survives
295	// pasteurisation, so a blocked lot must never reach a vat (§8.3).
296	func (s *Service) CreateBatch(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateBatchRequest) (*domain.ProcessingBatch, error) {
297		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.PlantID); err != nil {
298			return nil, err
299		}
300		org, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.PlantID)
301		if err != nil {
302			return nil, err
303		}
304		if org.Type != domain.OrgTypeProcessingPlant {
305			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_PLANT", "org unit "+req.PlantID+" is not a processing plant")
306		}
307	
308		ids := dedupe(req.BMCLotIDs)
309		lots, err := s.repo.BMCLotsByIDs(ctx, ids)
310		if err != nil {
311			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
312		}
313		if len(lots) != len(ids) {
314			return nil, httpx.NotFound("BMC lot(s) " + strings.Join(missingLotIDs(ids, lots), ", "))
315		}
316		var offending []string
317		var inputLitres float64
318		for _, lot := range lots {
319			if !canPoolBMCLot(lot.Status) {
320				offending = append(offending, lot.ID)
321				continue
322			}
323			inputLitres += lot.TotalQuantityLitres
324		}
325		if len(offending) > 0 {
326			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked,
327				"one or more BMC lots have not cleared the safety gate (must be PASSED and DISPATCHED)").
328				WithDetails(map[string]any{"blocked_lot_ids": offending})
329		}
330	
331		now := time.Now().UTC()
332		dateKey := domain.DateKeyIST(now)
333		seq, err := s.repo.NextSequence(ctx, "batch_number:"+req.PlantID+":"+dateKey)
334		if err != nil {
335			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
336		}
337		batchNumber := fmt.Sprintf("BATCH-%s-%s-%04d",
338			org.Code, strings.ReplaceAll(dateKey, "-", ""), seq)
339	
340		// CREATED is a transient birth state: the plant lab must clear every
341		// batch, so it is persisted straight into QC_PENDING.
342		batch := &domain.ProcessingBatch{
343			ID:          uuid.NewString(),
344			PlantID:     req.PlantID,
345			BatchNumber: batchNumber,
346			BMCLotIDs:   ids,
347			ProductType: req.ProductType,
348			InputLitres: inputLitres,
349			Status:      domain.BatchStatusQCPending,
350			StartedAt:   now,
351			CreatedBy:   actor.PartyID,
352			CreatedAt:   now,
353		}
354		if err := s.repo.InsertBatch(ctx, batch); err != nil {
355			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
356		}
357	
358		refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, len(ids))
359		for _, id := range ids {
360			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{
361				EntityType: domain.EntityBMCLot, EntityID: id, Relation: "pools",
362			})
363		}
364		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
365			Type:       domain.EventBatchCreated,
366			EntityType: domain.EntityBatch,
367			EntityID:   batch.ID,
368			Refs:       refs,
369			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
370			OrgUnitID:  req.PlantID,
371			Payload: map[string]any{
372				"batch_number": batchNumber, "product_type": req.ProductType, "input_litres": inputLitres,
373			},
374		})
375		if err != nil {
376			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
377		}
378		if err := s.repo.SetBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx, batch.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
379			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
380		}
381		batch.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
382		return batch, nil
383	}
384	
385	// CompleteBatch transitions PASSED→COMPLETED — only a batch the plant lab
386	// cleared may finish and go on to yield product lots.
387	func (s *Service) CompleteBatch(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id string) (*domain.ProcessingBatch, error) {
388		batch, err := s.getBatch(ctx, id)
389		if err != nil {
390			return nil, err
391		}
392		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, batch.PlantID); err != nil {
393			return nil, err
394		}
395		if batch.Status == domain.BatchStatusCompleted {
396			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BATCH_ALREADY_COMPLETED", "batch is already completed")
397		}
398		if !canCompleteBatch(batch.Status) {
399			msg := "batch cannot complete: plant-lab QC not passed (status " + batch.Status + ")"
400			if batch.BlockReason != "" {
401				msg += " — " + batch.BlockReason
402			}
403			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked, msg).
404				WithDetails(map[string]any{"status": batch.Status, "block_reason": batch.BlockReason})
405		}
406		now := time.Now().UTC()
407		ok, err := s.repo.CompleteBatch(ctx, id, now)
408		if err != nil {
409			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
410		}
411		if !ok {
412			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BATCH_STATE_CHANGED",
413				"batch changed state concurrently — reload and retry")
414		}
415		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
416			Type:       domain.EventBatchCompleted,
417			EntityType: domain.EntityBatch,
418			EntityID:   batch.ID,
419			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
420			OrgUnitID:  batch.PlantID,
421			Payload:    map[string]any{"batch_number": batch.BatchNumber},
422		})
423		if err != nil {
424			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
425		}
426		if err := s.repo.SetBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx, batch.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
427			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
428		}
429		batch.Status = domain.BatchStatusCompleted
430		batch.CompletedAt = &now
431		batch.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
432		return batch, nil
433	}
434	
435	// GetBatch returns one batch (including its qc_result_ids) within scope.
436	func (s *Service) GetBatch(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id string) (*domain.ProcessingBatch, error) {
437		batch, err := s.getBatch(ctx, id)
438		if err != nil {

441		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, batch.PlantID); err != nil {
442			return nil, err

461	// --- product lots ---
462	
463	// CreateProductLot packages a COMPLETED batch into a SKU lot (gate re-check).
464	func (s *Service) CreateProductLot(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateProductLotRequest) (*domain.ProductLot, error) {
465		batch, err := s.getBatch(ctx, req.BatchID)
466		if err != nil {
467			return nil, err
468		}
469		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, batch.PlantID); err != nil {
470			return nil, err
471		}
472		if !canYieldProductLot(batch.Status) {
473			msg := "batch has not completed the safety gate (status " + batch.Status + ") — no product lots may be made"
474			if batch.BlockReason != "" {
475				msg += " — " + batch.BlockReason
476			}
477			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked, msg).
478				WithDetails(map[string]any{"batch_status": batch.Status, "block_reason": batch.BlockReason})
479		}
480	
481		now := time.Now().UTC()
482		mfgDate := req.MfgDate
483		if mfgDate == "" {
484			mfgDate = domain.DateKeyIST(now)
485		}
486		if req.ExpiryDate <= mfgDate {
487			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_EXPIRY", "expiry_date must be after mfg_date")
488		}
489	
490		lot := &domain.ProductLot{
491			ID:          uuid.NewString(),
492			BatchID:     batch.ID,
493			PlantID:     batch.PlantID,
494			SKU:         req.SKU,
495			ProductName: req.ProductName,
496			Units:       req.Units,
497			UnitSize:    req.UnitSize,
498			MRP:         req.MRP,
499			MfgDate:     mfgDate,
500			ExpiryDate:  req.ExpiryDate,
501			Status:      domain.ProductLotStatusActive,
502			CreatedAt:   now,
503		}
504		if err := s.repo.InsertProductLot(ctx, lot); err != nil {
505			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
506		}
507		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
508			Type:       domain.EventProductLotMade,
509			EntityType: domain.EntityProductLot,
510			EntityID:   lot.ID,
511			Refs: []provenance.Ref{
512				{EntityType: domain.EntityBatch, EntityID: batch.ID, Relation: "yields"},
513			},
514			Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
515			OrgUnitID: batch.PlantID,
516			Payload: map[string]any{
517				"sku": req.SKU, "units": req.Units, "unit_size": req.UnitSize,
518				"mfg_date": mfgDate, "expiry_date": req.ExpiryDate,
519			},
520		})
521		if err != nil {
522			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
523		}
524		if err := s.repo.SetProductLotProvenanceSeq(ctx, lot.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
525			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
526		}
527		lot.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
528		return lot, nil
529	}

531	// RecallProductLot pulls a lot from market (FSSAI recall path, §18-C).
532	func (s *Service) RecallProductLot(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id, reason string) (*domain.ProductLot, error) {
533		lot, err := s.getProductLot(ctx, id)
534		if err != nil {
535			return nil, err
536		}
537		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, lot.PlantID); err != nil {
538			return nil, err
539		}
540		if lot.Status == domain.ProductLotStatusRecalled {
541			return nil, httpx.Conflict("PRODUCT_LOT_ALREADY_RECALLED", "product lot is already recalled")
542		}
543		ok, err := s.repo.RecallProductLot(ctx, id, reason)
544		if err != nil {
545			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
546		}
547		if !ok {
548			return nil, httpx.Conflict("PRODUCT_LOT_ALREADY_RECALLED", "product lot is already recalled")
549		}
550		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
551			Type:       domain.EventProductRecalled,
552			EntityType: domain.EntityProductLot,
553			EntityID:   lot.ID,
554			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
555			OrgUnitID:  lot.PlantID,
556			Payload:    map[string]any{"reason": reason},
557		})
558		if err != nil {
559			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
560		}
561		if err := s.repo.SetProductLotProvenanceSeq(ctx, lot.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
562			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
563		}
564		lot.Status = domain.ProductLotStatusRecalled
565		lot.RecallReason = reason
566		lot.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
567		return lot, nil
568	}
569	
570	// --- QR issuance ---
571	
572	// qrAlphabet is the 32-character human-safe set for short codes: A–Z and 2–9
573	// minus the confusables 0/O and 1/I. 32 divides 256, so a byte modulo the
574	// alphabet length is unbiased.
575	const qrAlphabet = "ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789"
576	
577	// qrCodeLength is the number of random characters after the "PRG-" prefix
578	// (32^8 ≈ 1.1 trillion codes — collisions are retried on the unique index).
579	const qrCodeLength = 8
580	
581	// newQRCode mints a short public code like "[REDACTED:generic-api-key]" from crypto/rand.
582	func newQRCode() (string, error) {
583		buf := make([]byte, qrCodeLength)
584		if _, err := rand.Read(buf); err != nil {
585			return "", err
586		}
587		code := make([]byte, qrCodeLength)
588		for i, b := range buf {
589			code[i] = qrAlphabet[int(b)%len(qrAlphabet)]
590		}
591		return "PRG-" + string(code), nil
592	}
593	
594	// signQRToken builds the forgery-proof token printed inside the QR:
595	// base64url(qr_code|product_lot_id|issued_unix) + "." + hex(HMAC-SHA256).
596	// The consumer app resolves the payload; the signature proves it was minted
597	// by this server, so IDs cannot be guessed onto counterfeit packs.
598	func signQRToken(secret, qrCode, productLotID string, issuedAt time.Time) string {
599		payload := qrCode + "|" + productLotID + "|" + strconv.FormatInt(issuedAt.Unix(), 10)
600		mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte(secret))
601		mac.Write([]byte(payload))
602		return base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(payload)) + "." + hex.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))
603	}
604	
605	// parseQRToken verifies and unpacks a signed QR token.
606	func parseQRToken(secret, token string) (qrCode, productLotID string, issuedAt time.Time, err error) {
607		payloadB64, sigHex, found := strings.Cut(token, ".")
608		if !found {
609			return "", "", time.Time{}, errors.New("qr token: missing signature separator")
610		}
611		payloadBytes, err := base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString(payloadB64)
612		if err != nil {
613			return "", "", time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("qr token: bad payload encoding: %w", err)
614		}
615		sig, err := hex.DecodeString(sigHex)
616		if err != nil {
617			return "", "", time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("qr token: bad signature encoding: %w", err)
618		}
619		mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte(secret))
620		mac.Write(payloadBytes)
621		if !hmac.Equal(sig, mac.Sum(nil)) {
622			return "", "", time.Time{}, errors.New("qr token: signature mismatch")
623		}
624		parts := strings.Split(string(payloadBytes), "|")
625		if len(parts) != 3 {
626			return "", "", time.Time{}, errors.New("qr token: malformed payload")
627		}
628		unix, err := strconv.ParseInt(parts[2], 10, 64)
629		if err != nil {
630			return "", "", time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("qr token: bad timestamp: %w", err)
631		}
632		return parts[0], parts[1], time.Unix(unix, 0).UTC(), nil
633	}
634	
635	// IssueQR mints one signed QR for an ACTIVE product lot whose batch is
636	// COMPLETED — the gate is re-checked at mint time so recalled or blocked
637	// product can never be freshly labelled.
638	func (s *Service) IssueQR(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, productLotID string) (*domain.BatchQR, error) {
639		lot, err := s.getProductLot(ctx, productLotID)
640		if err != nil {
641			return nil, err
642		}
643		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, lot.PlantID); err != nil {
644			return nil, err
645		}
646		batch, err := s.getBatch(ctx, lot.BatchID)
647		if err != nil {
648			return nil, err
649		}
650		if !canIssueQR(lot.Status, batch.Status) {
651			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked,
652				"QR issuance refused: product lot must be ACTIVE and its batch COMPLETED").
653				WithDetails(map[string]any{
654					"product_lot_status": lot.Status,
655					"batch_status":       batch.Status,
656					"recall_reason":      lot.RecallReason,
657				})
658		}
659	
660		now := time.Now().UTC()
661		var qr *domain.BatchQR
662		const maxMintAttempts = 5
663		for attempt := 0; attempt < maxMintAttempts; attempt++ {
664			code, err := newQRCode()
665			if err != nil {
666				return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
667			}
668			candidate := &domain.BatchQR{
669				ID:           uuid.NewString(),
670				QRCode:       code,
671				ProductLotID: lot.ID,
672				SignedToken:  signQRToken(s.qrSecret, code, lot.ID, now),
673				IssuedBy:     actor.PartyID,
674				ScanCount:    0,
675				IssuedAt:     now,
676			}
677			insertErr := s.repo.InsertQR(ctx, candidate)
678			if insertErr == nil {
679				qr = candidate
680				break
681			}
682			if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(insertErr) {
683				continue // short-code collision — regenerate
684			}
685			return nil, httpx.Internal(insertErr)
686		}
687		if qr == nil {
688			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("qr mint: %d consecutive short-code collisions", maxMintAttempts))
689		}
690	
691		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
692			Type:       domain.EventQRIssued,
693			EntityType: domain.EntityBatchQR,
694			EntityID:   qr.ID,
695			Refs: []provenance.Ref{
696				{EntityType: domain.EntityProductLot, EntityID: lot.ID, Relation: "labels"},
697			},
698			Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
699			OrgUnitID: lot.PlantID,
700			Payload:   map[string]any{"qr_code": qr.QRCode},
701		})
702		if err != nil {
703			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
704		}
705		if err := s.repo.SetQRProvenanceSeq(ctx, qr.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
706			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
707		}
708		qr.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
709		return qr, nil
710	}

766	// dedupe removes duplicate IDs preserving first-seen order.
767	func dedupe(ids []string) []string {
768		seen := make(map[string]bool, len(ids))
769		out := make([]string, 0, len(ids))
770		for _, id := range ids {
771			if id == "" || seen[id] {
772				continue
773			}
774			seen[id] = true
775			out = append(out, id)
776		}
777		return out
778	}
779	
780	// missingIDs lists requested consignment IDs absent from the fetched set.
781	func missingIDs(wanted []string, got []domain.DCSConsignment) []string {
782		have := make(map[string]bool, len(got))
783		for _, c := range got {
784			have[c.ID] = true
785		}
786		var missing []string
787		for _, id := range wanted {
788			if !have[id] {
789				missing = append(missing, id)
790			}
791		}
792		return missing
793	}
794	
795	// missingLotIDs lists requested BMC lot IDs absent from the fetched set.
796	func missingLotIDs(wanted []string, got []domain.BMCLot) []string {
797		have := make(map[string]bool, len(got))
798		for _, l := range got {
799			have[l.ID] = true
800		}
801		var missing []string
802		for _, id := range wanted {
803			if !have[id] {
804				missing = append(missing, id)
805			}
806		}
807		return missing
808	}
