```text
// Package publictrace serves the two faces of milk traceability
// (blueprint §7, §8.4):
//
//   - /public — the consumer QR scan and public ledger tamper-check. These
//     routes are DELIBERATELY unauthenticated: a shopper points a phone at a
//     milk pack and must see its provenance with zero friction. This is not a
//     consumer-account backend (descoped) — the global per-IP rate limit is
//     the only throttle.
//   - /trace  — the official recall / root-cause tools: full upstream +
//     downstream event-graph walks for auditors, mission officials and lab
//     analysts (§8.3: a failed aflatoxin lot walks back to contributing
//     samitis and forward to affected batches and QRs).
//
// The consumer view is the HONEST provenance view (§7.4): pooled milk traces
// to the SET of contributing samitis, never to individual farmers.
package publictrace

import (
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"

	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/middleware"
)

// Register mounts the public QR/ledger routes and the authed trace tools.
func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
	service := NewService(d)
	handler := &Handler{service: service}

	// PUBLIC subtree — no Authenticate middleware by design (see package doc).
	r.Route("/public", func(pub chi.Router) {
		pub.Get("/qr/{qr_code}", handler.ScanQR)
		pub.Get("/ledger/verify", handler.VerifyLedger)
	})

	// Official trace tools — role-gated, read-only, cross-org by nature
	// (a recall walk necessarily spans DCS → BMC → plant boundaries, so no
	// per-resource org-scope check applies here; the role gate is the fence).
	r.Route("/trace", func(tr chi.Router) {
		tr.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
		tr.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(
			domain.RoleMissionOfficial,
			domain.RolePCDFAdmin,
			domain.RoleUnionPresident,
			domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor,
			domain.RolePlantLabAnalyst,
			domain.RoleStateAuditor,
		))
		tr.Get("/{entity_type}/{entity_id}", handler.TraceGraph)
		tr.Get("/{entity_type}/{entity_id}/timeline", handler.Timeline)
	})
}
package publictrace

import (
	"net/http"

	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"

	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
)

// Handler is the thin HTTP layer: extract params, call the service, respond.
type Handler struct {
	service *Service
}

// ScanQR handles GET /public/qr/{qr_code} — the consumer scan.
func (h *Handler) ScanQR(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	qrCode := chi.URLParam(r, "qr_code")
	if qrCode == "" {
		httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_QR_CODE", "qr_code path parameter is required"))
		return
	}
	resp, err := h.service.ScanQR(r.Context(), qrCode)
	if err != nil {
		httpx.Error(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, resp)
}

// VerifyLedger handles GET /public/ledger/verify?from=&to= — the public
// tamper-evidence check.
func (h *Handler) VerifyLedger(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	resp, err := h.service.VerifyLedger(r.Context(), r.URL.Query().Get("from"), r.URL.Query().Get("to"))
	if err != nil {
		httpx.Error(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, resp)
}

// TraceGraph handles GET /trace/{entity_type}/{entity_id} — the official
// upstream+downstream event-graph walk.
func (h *Handler) TraceGraph(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	resp, err := h.service.TraceGraph(r.Context(),
		chi.URLParam(r, "entity_type"), chi.URLParam(r, "entity_id"))
	if err != nil {
		httpx.Error(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, resp)
}

// Timeline handles GET /trace/{entity_type}/{entity_id}/timeline — one
// entity's own events in chain order.
func (h *Handler) Timeline(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	page := httpx.ParsePage(r)
	events, total, err := h.service.Timeline(r.Context(),
		chi.URLParam(r, "entity_type"), chi.URLParam(r, "entity_id"), page)
	if err != nil {
		httpx.Error(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	httpx.JSONMeta(w, http.StatusOK, events, map[string]any{
		"limit":  page.Limit,
		"offset": page.Offset,
		"total":  total,
	})
}
package publictrace

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/base64"
	"fmt"
	"log/slog"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/orgscope"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/provenance"
)

const (
	// traceDepth bounds the upstream graph walk (QR → lot → batch → BMC lots
	// → consignments comfortably fits; the ledger also hard-caps event count).
	traceDepth = 10
	// scanVerifySpanCap bounds how many ledger events one consumer scan
	// re-hashes; wider traced ranges are verified partially (most recent tail).
	scanVerifySpanCap = 5000
	// publicVerifySpanCap bounds the public /ledger/verify endpoint span.
	publicVerifySpanCap = 10000
	// downstreamEventCap keeps the official trace response bounded even for
	// heavily referenced entities.
	downstreamEventCap = 2000
)

// validEntityTypes is the closed set of traceable entity types (domain.Entity*).
var validEntityTypes = map[string]struct{}{
	domain.EntityMilkPour:        {},
	domain.EntityAnalyzerReading: {},
	domain.EntityInvoice:         {},
	domain.EntityConsignment:     {},
	domain.EntityRouteTrip:       {},
	domain.EntityBMCLot:          {},
	domain.EntityBatch:           {},
	domain.EntityProductLot:      {},
	domain.EntityBatchQR:         {},
	domain.EntityQCResult:        {},
	domain.EntitySettlement:      {},
	domain.EntityAnimal:          {},
	domain.EntityParty:           {},
}

// Service resolves consumer QR scans and official trace queries. All reads,
// no writes except the fire-and-forget scan counter — nothing here ever
// mutates provenance.
type Service struct {
	log      *slog.Logger
	repo     *repo
	ledger   *provenance.Ledger
	orgs     *orgscope.Resolver
	qrSecret string
}

// NewService wires the service from the shared dependency container.
func NewService(d *deps.Deps) *Service {
	return &Service{
		log:      d.Log,
		repo:     newRepo(d.DB),
		ledger:   d.Ledger,
		orgs:     d.Orgs,
		qrSecret: d.Cfg.QRSigningSecret,
	}
}

// VerifyQRToken checks a stored signed token in the format QR issuance
// (plant module signQRToken) mints: "base64url(qr_code|product_lot_id|
// issued_unix)" + "." + hex(HMAC-SHA256(secret, decoded payload)). The HMAC
// is computed over the DECODED payload bytes — exactly what issuance signed.
// The comparison is constant-time so a forger learns nothing from response
// timing.
func VerifyQRToken(secret, token string) bool {
	payloadB64, signature, found := strings.Cut(token, ".")
	if !found || payloadB64 == "" || signature == "" {
		return false // malformed: no payload/signature split
	}
	payload, err := base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString(payloadB64)
	if err != nil || len(payload) == 0 {
		return false // malformed: payload is not valid base64url
	}
	expected := auth.HMACHash(secret, string(payload))
	return auth.ConstantTimeEqual(expected, signature)
}

// ScanQR resolves one consumer QR scan into the honest provenance view
// (§7.4): product + plant + lab certificate + the SET of contributing
// samitis — never per-farmer data — plus a live tamper-evidence check.
func (s *Service) ScanQR(ctx context.Context, qrCode string) (*QRScanResponse, error) {
	qr, err := s.repo.qrByCode(ctx, qrCode)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	// Integrity gate: the stored token must carry a valid HMAC. A mismatch
	// means the QR record was tampered with or forged — surface it loudly.
	if !VerifyQRToken(s.qrSecret, qr.SignedToken) {
		s.log.Warn("QR signed-token integrity check failed — possible forgery",
			slog.String("qr_code", qrCode), slog.String("qr_id", qr.ID))
		return nil, httpx.Conflict("QR_INTEGRITY_FAILED",
			"this QR code failed integrity verification and may be counterfeit")
	}

	// Count the scan without ever blocking it: fire-and-forget increment.
	go func(qrID string) {
		bg, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
		defer cancel()
		if err := s.repo.incrementScanCount(bg, qrID); err != nil {
			s.log.Warn("scan_count increment failed", slog.String("qr_id", qrID), slog.Any("err", err))
		}
	}(qr.ID)

	lot, err := s.repo.productLotByID(ctx, qr.ProductLotID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	batch, err := s.repo.batchByID(ctx, lot.BatchID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	plant, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, batch.PlantID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	// Walk the provenance graph upstream from the product lot to the pooling
	// boundary: batch → BMC lots → consignments (§7.4).
	events, err := s.ledger.Trace(ctx, domain.EntityProductLot, lot.ID, traceDepth)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}

	sourcing, err := s.buildSourcing(ctx, events)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	ledgerInfo, err := s.verifyTracedRange(ctx, events)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	resp := &QRScanResponse{
		Product: ProductInfo{
			Name:       lot.ProductName,
			SKU:        lot.SKU,
			UnitSize:   lot.UnitSize,
			MfgDate:    lot.MfgDate,
			ExpiryDate: lot.ExpiryDate,
		},
		BatchNumber: batch.BatchNumber,
		Plant:       PlantInfo{Name: plant.Name, District: plant.District},
		Sourcing:    *sourcing,
		Ledger:      *ledgerInfo,
		ScanCount:   qr.ScanCount + 1, // reflect this scan; the $inc lands async
	}

	// PLANT_LAB pass certificate — omitted (not an error) when absent.
	qc, err := s.repo.latestPlantLabPass(ctx, batch.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if qc != nil {
		resp.Quality = &QualityInfo{
			CertificateNumber: qc.CertificateNumber,
			Stage:             qc.Stage,
			Tests:             qc.Tests,
			RecordedAt:        qc.RecordedAt,
		}
	}

	// A recalled lot still resolves with 200 — consumers must SEE the recall
	// notice, not hit a dead link.
	if lot.Status == domain.ProductLotStatusRecalled {
		resp.Recalled = true
		notice := "This product lot has been RECALLED. Do not consume — return it to the point of purchase."
		if lot.RecallReason != "" {
			notice += " Reason: " + lot.RecallReason
		}
		resp.RecallNotice = notice
	}
	return resp, nil
}

// buildSourcing derives the samiti-set view from traced consignment events:
// contributing DCS org ids from each event's org_unit_id/payload, collection
// dates from payloads, with the consignment documents as fallback when the
// events did not carry those fields.
func (s *Service) buildSourcing(ctx context.Context, events []provenance.Event) (*SourcingInfo, error) {
	dcsIDs := map[string]struct{}{}
	dates := map[string]struct{}{}
	consignmentIDs := map[string]struct{}{}

	for _, ev := range events {
		if ev.EntityType != domain.EntityConsignment {
			continue
		}
		consignmentIDs[ev.EntityID] = struct{}{}
		if ev.OrgUnitID != "" {
			dcsIDs[ev.OrgUnitID] = struct{}{}
		} else if v, ok := ev.Payload["dcs_id"].(string); ok && v != "" {
			dcsIDs[v] = struct{}{}
		}
		if v, ok := ev.Payload["date"].(string); ok && v != "" {
			dates[v] = struct{}{}
		}
	}

	// Fallback: if the events lacked DCS ids or dates, read the consignment
	// docs themselves (still samiti-level — pour ids are never surfaced).
	if len(consignmentIDs) > 0 && (len(dcsIDs) == 0 || len(dates) == 0) {
		docs, err := s.repo.consignmentsByIDs(ctx, sortedKeys(consignmentIDs))
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		for _, c := range docs {
			if c.DCSID != "" {
				dcsIDs[c.DCSID] = struct{}{}
			}
			if c.Date != "" {
				dates[c.Date] = struct{}{}
			}
		}
	}

	samitis := make([]SamitiInfo, 0, len(dcsIDs))
	districts := map[string]struct{}{}
	for _, id := range sortedKeys(dcsIDs) {
		org, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, id)
		if err != nil {
			// A missing org unit must not break a consumer scan — log and skip.
			s.log.Warn("QR scan: contributing DCS org not resolvable",
				slog.String("dcs_org_id", id), slog.Any("err", err))
			continue
		}
		samitis = append(samitis, SamitiInfo{Name: org.Name, Code: org.Code, District: org.District})
		if org.District != "" {
			districts[org.District] = struct{}{}
		}
	}
	sort.Slice(samitis, func(i, j int) bool { return samitis[i].Name < samitis[j].Name })

	collectionDates := sortedKeys(dates)
	return &SourcingInfo{
		Message:         sourcingMessage(collectionDates, len(samitis), sortedKeys(districts)),
		Samitis:         samitis,
		CollectionDates: collectionDates,
	}, nil
}

// sourcingMessage renders the consumer-facing pooled-provenance sentence,
// e.g. "Made from milk collected on 2026-07-05 from 3 samitis in Lucknow".
func sourcingMessage(dates []string, samitiCount int, districts []string) string {
	var b strings.Builder
	b.WriteString("Made from milk collected")
	if len(dates) > 0 {
		b.WriteString(" on " + strings.Join(dates, ", "))
	}
	noun := "samitis"
	if samitiCount == 1 {
		noun = "samiti"
	}
	fmt.Fprintf(&b, " from %d %s", samitiCount, noun)
	if len(districts) > 0 {
		b.WriteString(" in " + strings.Join(districts, ", "))
	}
	return b.String()
}

// verifyTracedRange re-hashes the ledger over the [min,max] seq window of the
// traced events (tamper-evidence baked into every scan). Windows wider than
// scanVerifySpanCap are verified partially — the most recent tail — and
// flagged as such.
func (s *Service) verifyTracedRange(ctx context.Context, events []provenance.Event) (*LedgerInfo, error) {
	if len(events) == 0 {
		return &LedgerInfo{Events: 0, Intact: true, VerifiedRange: [2]int64{0, 0}}, nil
	}
	minSeq, maxSeq := events[0].Seq, events[0].Seq
	for _, ev := range events[1:] {
		if ev.Seq < minSeq {
			minSeq = ev.Seq
		}
		if ev.Seq > maxSeq {
			maxSeq = ev.Seq
		}
	}
	from, partial := minSeq, false
	if maxSeq-minSeq+1 > scanVerifySpanCap {
		from, partial = maxSeq-scanVerifySpanCap+1, true
	}
	intact, _, err := s.ledger.VerifyChain(ctx, from, maxSeq)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return &LedgerInfo{
		Events:        len(events),
		Intact:        intact,
		VerifiedRange: [2]int64{from, maxSeq},
		Partial:       partial,
	}, nil
}

// VerifyLedger runs the public tamper-evidence check over [from,to]. Both
// bounds are optional: `to` defaults to the chain head, `from` to the start
// of the last publicVerifySpanCap events. Spans over the cap are rejected.
func (s *Service) VerifyLedger(ctx context.Context, fromRaw, toRaw string) (*LedgerVerifyResponse, error) {
	latest, err := s.ledger.LatestSeq(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	if latest == 0 {
		return &LedgerVerifyResponse{Intact: true, From: 0, To: 0}, nil // empty chain is trivially intact
	}

	to := latest
	if toRaw != "" {
		n, err := strconv.ParseInt(toRaw, 10, 64)
		if err != nil || n < 1 {
			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_RANGE", "'to' must be a positive sequence number")
		}
		to = min(n, latest)
	}
	from := max(int64(1), to-publicVerifySpanCap+1)
	if fromRaw != "" {
		n, err := strconv.ParseInt(fromRaw, 10, 64)
		if err != nil || n < 1 {
			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_RANGE", "'from' must be a positive sequence number")
		}
		from = n
	}
	if from > to {
		return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_RANGE", "'from' must not exceed 'to'")
	}
	if to-from+1 > publicVerifySpanCap {
		return nil, httpx.BadRequest("SPAN_TOO_WIDE",
			fmt.Sprintf("verification span is capped at %d events per request", publicVerifySpanCap))
	}

	intact, brokenAt, err := s.ledger.VerifyChain(ctx, from, to)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	resp := &LedgerVerifyResponse{Intact: intact, From: from, To: to}
	if !intact {
		resp.BrokenAtSeq = &brokenAt
	}
	return resp, nil
}

// TraceGraph returns the full event graph around one entity: upstream via
// the recursive ref walk, downstream via reverse-ref lookup — the recall /
// root-cause tool (§8.3).
func (s *Service) TraceGraph(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string) (*TraceGraphResponse, error) {
	if err := validateEntityType(entityType); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	upstream, err := s.ledger.Trace(ctx, entityType, entityID, traceDepth)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	downstream, err := s.ledger.DownstreamRefs(ctx, entityID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	if len(downstream) > downstreamEventCap {
		downstream = downstream[len(downstream)-downstreamEventCap:]
	}
	if len(upstream) == 0 && len(downstream) == 0 {
		return nil, httpx.NotFound("provenance for entity")
	}
	if upstream == nil {
		upstream = []provenance.Event{}
	}
	if downstream == nil {
		downstream = []provenance.Event{}
	}
	return &TraceGraphResponse{Upstream: upstream, Downstream: downstream}, nil
}

// Timeline returns one entity's own events in chain order, paginated.
// The second return value is the total event count before paging.
func (s *Service) Timeline(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, page httpx.Page) ([]provenance.Event, int, error) {
	if err := validateEntityType(entityType); err != nil {
		return nil, 0, err
	}
	events, err := s.ledger.EventsForEntity(ctx, entityType, entityID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	if len(events) == 0 {
		return nil, 0, httpx.NotFound("provenance for entity")
	}
	total := len(events)
	start := min(page.Offset, int64(total))
	end := min(start+page.Limit, int64(total))
	return events[start:end], total, nil
}

// validateEntityType rejects entity types outside the domain.Entity* catalog.
func validateEntityType(entityType string) error {
	if _, ok := validEntityTypes[entityType]; !ok {
		return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_ENTITY_TYPE",
			"unknown entity type "+entityType+" — use one of the provenance entity type constants")
	}
	return nil
}

// sortedKeys returns a set's keys in deterministic (lexicographic) order.
func sortedKeys(set map[string]struct{}) []string {
	out := make([]string, 0, len(set))
	for k := range set {
		out = append(out, k)
	}
	sort.Strings(out)
	return out
}
```

```text
1	// Package eventbus is the in-process pub/sub seam between modules
2	// (e.g. settlement executed → notifications module queues the SMS).
3	// It deliberately mirrors a message-broker API: when the platform splits
4	// into microservices, this interface is re-implemented over Kafka/NATS
5	// (blueprint §15) without touching module code.
6	package eventbus
7	
8	import (
9		"context"
10		"log/slog"
11		"sync"
12		"time"
13	)
14	
15	// Topics published across module seams.
16	const (
17		TopicPourRecorded       = "pour.recorded"
18		TopicInvoiceIssued      = "invoice.issued"
19		TopicGateBlocked        = "qc.gate_blocked"
20		TopicSettlementExecuted = "settlement.executed"
21		TopicPayoutCredited     = "payout.credited"
22		TopicMVUDispatched      = "mvu.dispatched"
23	)
24	
25	// Handler consumes a published event. Payload types are documented per topic
26	// by the publishing module.
27	type Handler func(ctx context.Context, topic string, payload any)
28	
29	// Bus is a minimal async pub/sub.
30	type Bus struct {
31		log *slog.Logger
32	
33		mu   sync.RWMutex
34		subs map[string][]Handler
35	}
36	
37	// New builds an empty bus.
38	func New(log *slog.Logger) *Bus {
39		return &Bus{log: log, subs: make(map[string][]Handler)}
40	}
41	
42	// Subscribe registers a handler for a topic. Call during module wiring only
43	// (not concurrently with Publish traffic).
44	func (b *Bus) Subscribe(topic string, h Handler) {
45		b.mu.Lock()
46		defer b.mu.Unlock()
47		b.subs[topic] = append(b.subs[topic], h)
48	}
49	
50	// Publish dispatches asynchronously: each handler runs on its own goroutine
51	// with a bounded context and panic isolation, so a slow or broken subscriber
52	// can never stall the request path.
53	func (b *Bus) Publish(topic string, payload any) {
54		b.mu.RLock()
55		handlers := b.subs[topic]
56		b.mu.RUnlock()
57	
58		for _, h := range handlers {
59			h := h
60			go func() {
61				ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 15*time.Second)
62				defer cancel()
63				defer func() {
64					if rec := recover(); rec != nil {
65						b.log.Error("eventbus handler panic",
66							slog.String("topic", topic), slog.Any("panic", rec))
67					}
68				}()
69				h(ctx, topic, payload)
70			}()
71		}
72	}
73
```

```text
21	// service holds the safety-gate business logic (blueprint §8.3): evaluate
22	// tests against FSSAI limits, write the verdict onto the subject, chain the
23	// provenance events, and broadcast blocks to downstream modules.
24	type service struct {
25		deps *deps.Deps
26		repo *repository
27	}
28	
29	// newService wires the service.
30	func newService(d *deps.Deps, repo *repository) *service {
31		return &service{deps: d, repo: repo}
32	}
33	
34	// gateSubject is what the gate needs to know about an eligible subject.
35	type gateSubject struct {
36		entityType string // provenance entity const for the subject
37		orgUnitID  string // owning org unit (BMC or plant) for scope + ledger
38		status     string
39	}
40	
41	// requiredRoleForStage returns the one role allowed to record results at a
42	// stage (BMC_RAPID↔BMC_OPERATOR, PLANT_LAB↔PLANT_LAB_ANALYST), and whether
43	// the stage is known at all.
44	func requiredRoleForStage(stage string) (string, bool) {
45		switch stage {
46		case domain.QCStageBMCRapid:
47			return domain.RoleBMCOperator, true
48		case domain.QCStagePlantLab:
49			return domain.RolePlantLabAnalyst, true
50		default:
51			return "", false
52		}
53	}
54	
55	// certificateNumber builds the human-readable QC certificate identifier from
56	// the per-stage counter, e.g. "QC-PLANT_LAB-000042".
57	func certificateNumber(stage string, seq int64) string {
58		return fmt.Sprintf("QC-%s-%06d", stage, seq)
59	}
60	
61	// recordQCResult evaluates the submitted tests against the FSSAI gate,
62	// persists the result, applies the PASSED/BLOCKED verdict to the subject and
63	// chains the provenance events. This is the only write path that moves a
64	// subject out of QC_PENDING.
65	func (s *service) recordQCResult(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req RecordQCResultRequest) (*domain.QCResult, error) {
66		// Stage×role pairing — RequireRoles admits both analyst roles, the exact
67		// pairing is enforced here.
68		requiredRole, ok := requiredRoleForStage(req.Stage)
69		if !ok {
70			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_STAGE", "stage must be "+domain.QCStageBMCRapid+" or "+domain.QCStagePlantLab)
71		}
72		if actor.RoleCode != requiredRole {
73			return nil, httpx.Forbidden("STAGE_ROLE_MISMATCH: stage " + req.Stage + " results may only be recorded by " + requiredRole)
74		}
75	
76		subject, err := s.loadGateSubject(ctx, req.SubjectType, req.SubjectID)
77		if err != nil {
78			return nil, err
79		}
80		if err := s.deps.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, subject.orgUnitID); err != nil {
81			return nil, err
82		}
83	
84		// Evaluate against the FSSAI limits (domain owns the rules).
85		overallPass, failures, evaluated := domain.EvaluateQCTests(toDomainTests(req.Tests))
86	
87		resultID := uuid.NewString()
88		now := time.Now().UTC()
89	
90		result := &domain.QCResult{
91			ID:             resultID,
92			SubjectType:    req.SubjectType,
93			SubjectID:      req.SubjectID,
94			Stage:          req.Stage,
95			Tests:          evaluated,
96			OverallPass:    overallPass,
97			AnalystPartyID: actor.PartyID,
98			LabRef:         req.LabRef,
99			RecordedAt:     now,
100		}
101	
102		blockReason := ""
103		if overallPass {
104			seq, err := s.repo.nextCertificateSeq(ctx, req.Stage)
105			if err != nil {
106				return nil, err
107			}
108			result.CertificateNumber = certificateNumber(req.Stage, seq)
109		} else {
110			result.FailureReasons = failures
111			blockReason = strings.Join(failures, "; ")
112		}
113	
114		// Claim the gate first: the conditional QC_PENDING filter makes concurrent
115		// double-records collide here instead of double-applying verdicts.
116		gated, err := s.applyGate(ctx, req.SubjectType, req.SubjectID, resultID, overallPass, blockReason)
117		if err != nil {
118			return nil, err
119		}
120		if !gated {
121			return nil, httpx.Conflict("SUBJECT_ALREADY_GATED", "subject is no longer awaiting QC — a verdict was already recorded")
122		}
123	
124		if err := s.repo.insertResult(ctx, result); err != nil {
125			return nil, err
126		}
127	
128		// Provenance: qc.recorded, then the gate verdict event (blueprint §7).
129		ledgerActor := provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode}
130		recorded, err := s.deps.Ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
131			Type:       domain.EventQCRecorded,
132			EntityType: domain.EntityQCResult,
133			EntityID:   resultID,
134			Refs: []provenance.Ref{
135				{EntityType: subject.entityType, EntityID: req.SubjectID, Relation: "tested"},
136			},
137			Actor:     ledgerActor,
138			OrgUnitID: subject.orgUnitID,
139			Payload: map[string]any{
140				"stage":        req.Stage,
141				"subject_type": req.SubjectType,
142				"overall_pass": overallPass,
143			},
144		})
145		if err != nil {
146			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
147		}
148	
149		gateEvent := provenance.AppendInput{
150			EntityType: domain.EntityQCResult,
151			EntityID:   resultID,
152			Actor:      ledgerActor,
153			OrgUnitID:  subject.orgUnitID,
154		}
155		if overallPass {
156			gateEvent.Type = domain.EventGatePassed
157			gateEvent.Refs = []provenance.Ref{
158				{EntityType: subject.entityType, EntityID: req.SubjectID, Relation: "certifies"},
159			}
160			gateEvent.Payload = map[string]any{"certificate_number": result.CertificateNumber}
161		} else {
162			gateEvent.Type = domain.EventGateBlocked
163			gateEvent.Refs = []provenance.Ref{
164				{EntityType: subject.entityType, EntityID: req.SubjectID, Relation: "blocks"},
165			}
166			gateEvent.Payload = map[string]any{"failure_reasons": failures}
167		}
168		if _, err := s.deps.Ledger.Append(ctx, gateEvent); err != nil {
169			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
170		}
171	
172		if err := s.repo.setResultProvenanceSeq(ctx, resultID, recorded.Seq); err != nil {
173			return nil, err
174		}
175		result.ProvenanceSeq = recorded.Seq
176	
177		// Broadcast the block so the plant module quarantines downstream — a
178		// blocked lot can never advance.
179		if !overallPass {
180			s.deps.Bus.Publish(eventbus.TopicGateBlocked, GateBlockedPayload{
181				SubjectType:    req.SubjectType,
182				SubjectID:      req.SubjectID,
183				QCResultID:     resultID,
184				Stage:          req.Stage,
185				FailureReasons: failures,
186			})
187		}
188		return result, nil
189	}

191	// loadGateSubject fetches a gate-eligible subject and verifies it is awaiting
192	// QC. Only BMC lots and processing batches carry the software safety gate.
193	func (s *service) loadGateSubject(ctx context.Context, subjectType, subjectID string) (gateSubject, error) {
194		switch subjectType {
195		case domain.QCSubjectBMCLot:
196			lot, err := s.repo.findBMCLot(ctx, subjectID)
197			if err != nil {
198				return gateSubject{}, err
199			}
200			if lot.Status != domain.BMCLotStatusQCPending {
201				return gateSubject{}, httpx.Conflict("SUBJECT_NOT_QC_PENDING", "bmc lot is in status "+lot.Status+" — only QC_PENDING subjects can be gated")
202			}
203			return gateSubject{entityType: domain.EntityBMCLot, orgUnitID: lot.BMCID, status: lot.Status}, nil
204	
205		case domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch:
206			batch, err := s.repo.findBatch(ctx, subjectID)
207			if err != nil {
208				return gateSubject{}, err
209			}
210			if batch.Status != domain.BatchStatusQCPending {
211				return gateSubject{}, httpx.Conflict("SUBJECT_NOT_QC_PENDING", "processing batch is in status "+batch.Status+" — only QC_PENDING subjects can be gated")
212			}
213			return gateSubject{entityType: domain.EntityBatch, orgUnitID: batch.PlantID, status: batch.Status}, nil
214	
215		case domain.QCSubjectDCSConsignment:
216			return gateSubject{}, httpx.Unprocessable("SUBJECT_NOT_GATE_ELIGIBLE", "DCS consignments are not gate subjects — gate at the BMC lot or processing batch")
217	
218		default:
219			return gateSubject{}, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_SUBJECT_TYPE", "subject_type must be one of "+domain.QCSubjectBMCLot+", "+domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch)
220		}
221	}

223	// applyGate routes the conditional verdict write to the subject's collection,
224	// mapping the verdict onto that subject kind's status constants.
225	func (s *service) applyGate(ctx context.Context, subjectType, subjectID, resultID string, pass bool, blockReason string) (bool, error) {
226		switch subjectType {
227		case domain.QCSubjectBMCLot:
228			status := domain.BMCLotStatusBlocked
229			if pass {
230				status = domain.BMCLotStatusPassed
231			}
232			return s.repo.gateBMCLot(ctx, subjectID, resultID, status, blockReason)
233		case domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch:
234			status := domain.BatchStatusBlocked
235			if pass {
236				status = domain.BatchStatusPassed
237			}
238			return s.repo.gateBatch(ctx, subjectID, resultID, status, blockReason)
239		default:
240			return false, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_SUBJECT_TYPE", "subject_type is not gate-eligible")
241		}
242	}

246	func (s *service) listQCResults(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, subjectType, subjectID string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.QCResult, int64, error) {
247		if subjectType != "" && !isValidSubjectType(subjectType) {
248			return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_SUBJECT_TYPE", "unknown subject_type "+subjectType)
249		}
250		if subjectID != "" && subjectType == "" {
251			return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_SUBJECT_TYPE", "subject_id requires subject_type")
252		}
253		if subjectID != "" {
254			if err := s.requireSubjectScope(ctx, actor, subjectType, subjectID); err != nil {
255				return nil, 0, err
256			}
257		}
258		return s.repo.listResults(ctx, subjectType, subjectID, page)
259	}
```

```text
570	// --- QR issuance ---
571	
572	// qrAlphabet is the 32-character human-safe set for short codes: A–Z and 2–9
573	// minus the confusables 0/O and 1/I. 32 divides 256, so a byte modulo the
574	// alphabet length is unbiased.
575	const qrAlphabet = "ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789"
576	
577	// qrCodeLength is the number of random characters after the "PRG-" prefix
578	// (32^8 ≈ 1.1 trillion codes — collisions are retried on the unique index).
579	const qrCodeLength = 8
580	
581	// newQRCode mints a short public code like "[REDACTED:generic-api-key]" from crypto/rand.
582	func newQRCode() (string, error) {
583		buf := make([]byte, qrCodeLength)
584		if _, err := rand.Read(buf); err != nil {
585			return "", err
586		}
587		code := make([]byte, qrCodeLength)
588		for i, b := range buf {
589			code[i] = qrAlphabet[int(b)%len(qrAlphabet)]
590		}
591		return "PRG-" + string(code), nil
592	}
593	
594	// signQRToken builds the forgery-proof token printed inside the QR:
595	// base64url(qr_code|product_lot_id|issued_unix) + "." + hex(HMAC-SHA256).
596	// The consumer app resolves the payload; the signature proves it was minted
597	// by this server, so IDs cannot be guessed onto counterfeit packs.
598	func signQRToken(secret, qrCode, productLotID string, issuedAt time.Time) string {
599		payload := qrCode + "|" + productLotID + "|" + strconv.FormatInt(issuedAt.Unix(), 10)
600		mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte(secret))
601		mac.Write([]byte(payload))
602		return base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(payload)) + "." + hex.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))
603	}
604	
605	// parseQRToken verifies and unpacks a signed QR token.
606	func parseQRToken(secret, token string) (qrCode, productLotID string, issuedAt time.Time, err error) {
607		payloadB64, sigHex, found := strings.Cut(token, ".")
608		if !found {
609			return "", "", time.Time{}, errors.New("qr token: missing signature separator")
610		}
611		payloadBytes, err := base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString(payloadB64)
612		if err != nil {
613			return "", "", time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("qr token: bad payload encoding: %w", err)
614		}
615		sig, err := hex.DecodeString(sigHex)
616		if err != nil {
617			return "", "", time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("qr token: bad signature encoding: %w", err)
618		}
619		mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte(secret))
620		mac.Write(payloadBytes)
621		if !hmac.Equal(sig, mac.Sum(nil)) {
622			return "", "", time.Time{}, errors.New("qr token: signature mismatch")
623		}
624		parts := strings.Split(string(payloadBytes), "|")
625		if len(parts) != 3 {
626			return "", "", time.Time{}, errors.New("qr token: malformed payload")
627		}
628		unix, err := strconv.ParseInt(parts[2], 10, 64)
629		if err != nil {
630			return "", "", time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("qr token: bad timestamp: %w", err)
631		}
632		return parts[0], parts[1], time.Unix(unix, 0).UTC(), nil
633	}

635	// IssueQR mints one signed QR for an ACTIVE product lot whose batch is
636	// COMPLETED — the gate is re-checked at mint time so recalled or blocked
637	// product can never be freshly labelled.
638	func (s *Service) IssueQR(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, productLotID string) (*domain.BatchQR, error) {
639		lot, err := s.getProductLot(ctx, productLotID)
640		if err != nil {
641			return nil, err
642		}
643		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, lot.PlantID); err != nil {
644			return nil, err
645		}
646		batch, err := s.getBatch(ctx, lot.BatchID)
647		if err != nil {
648			return nil, err
649		}

652				"QR issuance refused: product lot must be ACTIVE and its batch COMPLETED").
653				WithDetails(map[string]any{

655					"batch_status":       batch.Status,
656					"recall_reason":      lot.RecallReason,
657				})
658		}
659	
660		now := time.Now().UTC()
661		var qr *domain.BatchQR
662		const maxMintAttempts = 5
663		for attempt := 0; attempt < maxMintAttempts; attempt++ {
664			code, err := newQRCode()
665			if err != nil {
666				return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
667			}
668			candidate := &domain.BatchQR{

675				IssuedAt:     now,

677			insertErr := s.repo.InsertQR(ctx, candidate)

679				qr = candidate
680				break
681			}

684			}
685			return nil, httpx.Internal(insertErr)
686		}
687		if qr == nil {
688			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("qr mint: %d consecutive short-code collisions", maxMintAttempts))
689		}

691		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
692			Type:       domain.EventQRIssued,
```

```text
// Package orgs implements the cooperative-hierarchy module (blueprint §5.1):
// the FEDERATION → MILK_UNION → {PROCESSING_PLANT, BMC, DCS} org-unit tree.
// It owns org-unit creation and edits (PCDF/state admins), directory reads
// for any authenticated party, subtree reads for oversight roles, and the
// membership roster (active role assignments joined with parties).
package orgs

import (
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"

	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/middleware"
)

// Register mounts the orgs module under /orgs on the /api/v1 subtree.
func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
	repo := newRepository(d.DB)
	svc := newService(repo, d.Orgs)
	h := newHandler(svc)

	r.Route("/orgs", func(r chi.Router) {
		r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))

		// Hierarchy writes — state-apex administrators only.
		r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
			r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSuperAdmin, domain.RolePCDFAdmin))
			r.Post("/", h.create)
			r.Patch("/{id}", h.update)
		})

		// Directory reads — any authenticated party (session or role token).
		r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
			r.Use(middleware.RequireSession)
			r.Get("/", h.list)
			r.Get("/{id}", h.get)
			r.Get("/{id}/children", h.children)
		})

		// Subtree read — oversight roles, scope-checked in the service.
		r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
			r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(
				domain.RoleSuperAdmin,
				domain.RolePCDFAdmin,
				domain.RoleMissionOfficial,
				domain.RoleUnionPresident,
				domain.RoleStateAuditor,
			))
			r.Get("/{id}/tree", h.tree)
		})

		// Membership roster — org staff roles, scope-checked in the service.
		r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
			r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(
				domain.RoleSamitiSacheev,
				domain.RoleSamitiAdhyaksh,
				domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor,
				domain.RoleUnionPresident,
				domain.RolePCDFAdmin,
				domain.RoleSuperAdmin,
			))
			r.Get("/{id}/members", h.members)
		})
	})
}
package orgs

import (
	"context"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"

	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/orgscope"
)

// maxTreeNodes caps a subtree response (root included) so a federation-level
// tree read can never return an unbounded list.
const maxTreeNodes = 500

// service holds all business logic of the orgs module.
type service struct {
	repo  *repository
	scope *orgscope.Resolver
}

func newService(repo *repository, scope *orgscope.Resolver) *service {
	return &service{repo: repo, scope: scope}
}

// validateHierarchy checks whether an org unit of childType may be created
// under a parent of parentType ("" = no parent), per domain.ValidOrgParent.
// Pure function — unit-tested against the full type matrix.
func validateHierarchy(childType, parentType string) *httpx.AppError {
	if !domain.IsValidOrgType(childType) {
		return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_ORG_TYPE", "unknown org type "+childType)
	}
	allowed := domain.ValidOrgParent[childType]
	if len(allowed) == 0 { // hierarchy root
		if parentType != "" {
			return httpx.Unprocessable("ORG_PARENT_TYPE_INVALID",
				childType+" is the hierarchy root and cannot have a parent")
		}
		return nil
	}
	if parentType == "" {
		return httpx.BadRequest("ORG_PARENT_REQUIRED", childType+" requires a parent_id")
	}
	for _, t := range allowed {
		if t == parentType {
			return nil
		}
	}
	return httpx.Unprocessable("ORG_PARENT_TYPE_INVALID",
		childType+" cannot be created under a "+parentType)
}

// Create validates the hierarchy edge and inserts a new org unit
// (POST /orgs, blueprint §5.1).
func (s *service) Create(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateOrgRequest) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
	name := strings.TrimSpace(req.Name)
	if name == "" {
		return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_NAME", "name is required")
	}
	code := strings.TrimSpace(req.Code)
	if code == "" {
		return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_CODE", "code is required")
	}

	// Resolve the parent (if any) and validate the hierarchy edge.
	var parent *domain.OrgUnit
	if req.ParentID != "" {
		var err error
		parent, err = s.repo.getOrg(ctx, req.ParentID)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}
	parentType := ""
	if parent != nil {
		parentType = parent.Type
	}
	if aerr := validateHierarchy(req.Type, parentType); aerr != nil {
		return nil, aerr
	}

	// The federation is the unique root: reject a second one.
	if req.Type == domain.OrgTypeFederation {
		n, err := s.repo.countByType(ctx, domain.OrgTypeFederation)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if n > 0 {
			return nil, httpx.Conflict("FEDERATION_EXISTS", "a federation root org unit already exists")
		}
	}

	// The new unit must be created inside the caller's scope.
	if parent != nil {
		if err := s.scope.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, parent.ID); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}

	now := time.Now().UTC()
	org := &domain.OrgUnit{
		ID:        uuid.NewString(),
		Type:      req.Type,
		Name:      name,
		Code:      code,
		District:  strings.TrimSpace(req.District),
		State:     strings.TrimSpace(req.State),
		Path:      []string{},
		Active:    true,
		CreatedAt: now,
		UpdatedAt: now,
	}
	if parent != nil {
		org.ParentID = parent.ID
		org.Path = append(append([]string{}, parent.Path...), parent.ID)
	}
	if req.GeoLat != nil {
		org.GeoLat = *req.GeoLat
	}
	if req.GeoLng != nil {
		org.GeoLng = *req.GeoLng
	}

	if err := s.repo.insertOrg(ctx, org); err != nil {
		if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(err) {
			return nil, httpx.Conflict("ORG_CODE_EXISTS", "an org unit with code "+code+" already exists")
		}
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	s.scope.Invalidate(org.ID)
	return org, nil
}

// Update patches name/district/active/geo on an org unit (PATCH /orgs/{id}).
// Type or parent moves are rejected — restructuring the tree is out of scope
// for v1 because Path denormalisation across a subtree is not transactional.
func (s *service) Update(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id string, req UpdateOrgRequest) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
	if req.Type != nil || req.ParentID != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("ORG_MOVE_UNSUPPORTED",
			"changing an org unit's type or parent is not supported in v1")
	}
	if err := s.scope.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, id); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	set := bson.D{{Key: "updated_at", Value: time.Now().UTC()}}
	if req.Name != nil {
		name := strings.TrimSpace(*req.Name)
		if name == "" {
			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_NAME", "name cannot be empty")
		}
		set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "name", Value: name})
	}
	if req.District != nil {
		set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "district", Value: strings.TrimSpace(*req.District)})
	}
	if req.Active != nil {
		set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "active", Value: *req.Active})
	}
	if req.GeoLat != nil {
		set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "geo_lat", Value: *req.GeoLat})
	}
	if req.GeoLng != nil {
		set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "geo_lng", Value: *req.GeoLng})
	}
	if len(set) == 1 { // only updated_at
		return nil, httpx.BadRequest("EMPTY_UPDATE", "no updatable fields provided")
	}

	org, err := s.repo.updateOrg(ctx, id, set)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	s.scope.Invalidate(id)
	return org, nil
}

// Get returns one org unit (GET /orgs/{id}).
func (s *service) Get(ctx context.Context, id string) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
	return s.repo.getOrg(ctx, id)
}

// Children pages the direct children of an org unit (GET /orgs/{id}/children).
func (s *service) Children(ctx context.Context, id string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.OrgUnit, error) {
	if _, err := s.repo.getOrg(ctx, id); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return s.repo.listChildren(ctx, id, page)
}

// Tree returns the root plus its whole subtree as a flat list (each node
// carries parent_id; the client assembles), capped at maxTreeNodes.
func (s *service) Tree(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id string) ([]domain.OrgUnit, bool, error) {
	root, err := s.repo.getOrg(ctx, id)
```

```text
8	// FSSAI limits for liquid milk (blueprint §8.3). Aflatoxin M1 is heat-stable
9	// and survives pasteurisation, so it MUST be gated upstream (BMC + plant),
10	// never only at the finished product.
11	const (
12		FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg = 0.5  // AFM1 ≤ 0.5 µg/kg
13		FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl          = 10.0 // coliform ≤ 10 CFU/ml
14		FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg       = 0.1  // antibiotic MRL example
15	)
16	
17	// QC test names.
18	const (
19		TestAflatoxinM1  = "AFLATOXIN_M1"           // µg/kg
20		TestColiform     = "COLIFORM"               // CFU/ml
21		TestTPC          = "TPC"                    // CFU/ml, graded — recorded, not hard-gated here
22		TestAntibiotic   = "ANTIBIOTIC_TETRACYCLINE" // mg/kg
23		TestPhosphatase  = "PHOSPHATASE"            // 0 = negative (pass post-pasteurisation), 1 = positive
24		TestFat          = "FAT"                    // %
25		TestSNF          = "SNF"                    // %
26	)
27	
28	// QC stages.
29	const (
30		QCStageBMCRapid = "BMC_RAPID" // strip/rapid tests at the chilling centre
31		QCStagePlantLab = "PLANT_LAB" // full lab: ELISA/HPLC, culture, LC-MS/MS
32	)
33	
34	// QC subject types.
35	const (
36		QCSubjectDCSConsignment  = "DCS_CONSIGNMENT"
37		QCSubjectBMCLot          = "BMC_LOT"
38		QCSubjectProcessingBatch = "PROCESSING_BATCH"
39	)
40	
41	// QCTest is a single measurement inside a QC result.
42	type QCTest struct {
43		Name  string  `bson:"name"  json:"name"`
44		Value float64 `bson:"value" json:"value"`
45		Unit  string  `bson:"unit"  json:"unit"`
46		Pass  bool    `bson:"pass"  json:"pass"`
47	}
48	
49	// QCResult is the recorded outcome of testing one subject at one stage.
50	// OverallPass drives the safety gate; a certificate is attached to provenance
51	// on pass, a block + quarantine on fail.
52	type QCResult struct {
53		ID                string    `bson:"_id"          json:"id"`
54		SubjectType       string    `bson:"subject_type" json:"subject_type"`
55		SubjectID         string    `bson:"subject_id"   json:"subject_id"`
56		Stage             string    `bson:"stage"        json:"stage"`
57		Tests             []QCTest  `bson:"tests"        json:"tests"`
58		OverallPass       bool      `bson:"overall_pass" json:"overall_pass"`
59		FailureReasons    []string  `bson:"failure_reasons,omitempty" json:"failure_reasons,omitempty"`
60		AnalystPartyID    string    `bson:"analyst_party_id" json:"analyst_party_id"`
61		LabRef            string    `bson:"lab_ref,omitempty"            json:"lab_ref,omitempty"`
62		CertificateNumber string    `bson:"certificate_number,omitempty" json:"certificate_number,omitempty"`
63		RecordedAt        time.Time `bson:"recorded_at"  json:"recorded_at"`
64		ProvenanceSeq     int64     `bson:"provenance_seq,omitempty" json:"provenance_seq,omitempty"`
65	}
66	
67	// EvaluateQCTests applies the FSSAI gate to a set of tests: it fills each
68	// test's Pass verdict and returns the overall verdict plus human-readable
69	// failure reasons. Unknown test names are recorded but do not gate.
70	func EvaluateQCTests(tests []QCTest) (overallPass bool, failures []string, evaluated []QCTest) {
71		overallPass = true
72		evaluated = make([]QCTest, 0, len(tests))
73		for _, t := range tests {
74			pass := true
75			switch t.Name {
76			case TestAflatoxinM1:
77				if t.Value > FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg {
78					pass = false
79					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
80						"AFLATOXIN_M1 %.3f µg/kg exceeds FSSAI limit %.1f µg/kg", t.Value, FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg))
81				}
82			case TestColiform:
83				if t.Value > FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl {
84					pass = false
85					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
86						"COLIFORM %.1f CFU/ml exceeds FSSAI limit %.0f CFU/ml", t.Value, FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl))
87				}
88			case TestAntibiotic:
89				if t.Value > FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg {
90					pass = false
91					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
92						"ANTIBIOTIC_TETRACYCLINE %.3f mg/kg exceeds MRL %.1f mg/kg", t.Value, FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg))
93				}
94			case TestPhosphatase:
95				if t.Value != 0 {
96					pass = false
97					failures = append(failures, "PHOSPHATASE positive — pasteurisation check failed (must be negative)")
98				}
99			}
100			t.Pass = pass
101			if !pass {
102				overallPass = false
103			}
104			evaluated = append(evaluated, t)
105		}
106		return overallPass, failures, evaluated
107	}
108
```

```text
// List pages org units filtered by type and/or district (GET /orgs).
func (s *service) List(ctx context.Context, orgType, district string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.OrgUnit, error) {
	filter := bson.D{}
	if orgType != "" {
		if !domain.IsValidOrgType(orgType) {
			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_ORG_TYPE", "unknown org type "+orgType)
		}
		filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "type", Value: orgType})
	}
	if district != "" {
		filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "district", Value: district})
	}
	return s.repo.listOrgs(ctx, filter, page)
}

// Members pages the ACTIVE role assignments at an org unit joined in memory
// with party identity fields (GET /orgs/{id}/members) — two indexed queries,
// no $lookup.
func (s *service) Members(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id string, page httpx.Page) ([]Member, error) {
	if _, err := s.repo.getOrg(ctx, id); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := s.scope.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, id); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	assignments, err := s.repo.listActiveAssignments(ctx, id, page)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	partyIDs := make([]string, 0, len(assignments))
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(assignments))
	for _, a := range assignments {
		if _, dup := seen[a.PartyID]; !dup {
			seen[a.PartyID] = struct{}{}
			partyIDs = append(partyIDs, a.PartyID)
		}
	}
	parties, err := s.repo.partiesByIDs(ctx, partyIDs)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	members := make([]Member, 0, len(assignments))
	for _, a := range assignments {
		m := Member{
			PartyID:          a.PartyID,
			RoleCode:         a.RoleCode,
			RoleAssignmentID: a.ID,
			ValidFrom:        a.ValidFrom,
			ValidTo:          a.ValidTo,
		}
		if p, ok := parties[a.PartyID]; ok {
			m.Phone = p.Phone
			m.FullName = p.FullName
			m.KYCTier = p.KYCTier
		}
		members = append(members, m)
	}
	return members, nil
}
```

```text
204			Type:       domain.EventSettlementApproved,
205			EntityType: domain.EntitySettlement,
206			EntityID:   batch.ID,
207			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
208			OrgUnitID:  batch.DCSID,
209			Payload: map[string]any{
210				"approved_by":  actor.PartyID,
211				"total_amount": batch.TotalAmount,
212			},
213		})
214		if err != nil {
215			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
216		}
217		if err := s.repo.setBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx, batch.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
218			return nil, err
219		}
220		batch.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
221		return batch, nil
222	}
223	
224	// Reject declines a pending batch and returns its invoices to ISSUED so they
225	// can be re-settled.
226	func (s *service) Reject(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, batchID, reason string) (*domain.SettlementBatch, error) {
227		if strings.TrimSpace(reason) == "" {
228			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_FIELD", "reason is required")
229		}
230		batch, err := s.repo.batchByID(ctx, batchID)
231		if err != nil {
232			return nil, err
233		}
234		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, batch.DCSID); err != nil {
235			return nil, err
236		}
237		if batch.Status != domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval {
238			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch is "+batch.Status+", expected "+domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval)
239		}
240	
241		ok, err := s.repo.transitionBatch(ctx, batch.ID, domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval, bson.D{
242			{Key: "status", Value: domain.SettlementStatusRejected},
243			{Key: "rejected_by", Value: actor.PartyID},
244			{Key: "reject_reason", Value: reason},
245		})
246		if err != nil {
247			return nil, err
248		}
249		if !ok {
250			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch already left "+domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval)
251		}
252		if err := s.repo.releaseInvoices(ctx, batch.ID); err != nil {
253			return nil, err
254		}
255		batch.Status = domain.SettlementStatusRejected
256		batch.RejectedBy = actor.PartyID
257		batch.RejectReason = reason
258		return batch, nil
259	}
260	
261	// Execute hands the APPROVED batch to the payment-aggregator adapter and
262	// records the resulting payouts.
263	//
264	// MOCK LICENSED-PA ADAPTER — this is a stand-in for the real integration.
265	// In production (§18-B) execution goes through an RBI-licensed Payment
266	// Aggregator operating a nodal/escrow account: Saathi submits the payout
267	// file, the PA moves the money, and UTRs come back asynchronously via
268	// webhook. Saathi itself never touches funds. The mock credits every payout
269	// instantly with a synthetic UTR so the downstream flow (invoice→PAID,
270	// provenance, farmer SMS) is exercised end to end.
271	func (s *service) Execute(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, batchID string) (*SettlementDetail, error) {
272		batch, err := s.repo.batchByID(ctx, batchID)
273		if err != nil {
274			return nil, err
275		}
276		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, batch.DCSID); err != nil {
277			return nil, err
278		}
279		if err := validateExecution(*batch); err != nil {
280			return nil, err
281		}
282	
283		// Guarded APPROVED→EXECUTING claims execution for this caller only.
284		ok, err := s.repo.transitionBatch(ctx, batch.ID, domain.SettlementStatusApproved, bson.D{
285			{Key: "status", Value: domain.SettlementStatusExecuting},
286		})
287		if err != nil {
288			return nil, err
289		}
290		if !ok {
291			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch is already being executed")
292		}
293	
294		invoices, err := s.repo.invoicesByBatch(ctx, batch.ID)
295		if err != nil {
296			return nil, err
297		}
298	
299		now := time.Now().UTC()
300		payouts := make([]domain.PayoutInstruction, 0, len(invoices))
301		for _, inv := range invoices {
302			masked, err := s.repo.latestBankMasked(ctx, inv.FarmerPartyID)
303			if err != nil {
304				return nil, err
305			}
306			creditedAt := now
307			payout := &domain.PayoutInstruction{
308				ID:                uuid.NewString(),
309				SettlementBatchID: batch.ID,
310				InvoiceID:         inv.ID,
311				FarmerPartyID:     inv.FarmerPartyID,
312				Amount:            inv.TotalAmount,
313				BankAccountMasked: masked,
314				UTR:               mockUTR(),
315				Status:            domain.PayoutStatusSuccess,
316				CreditedAt:        &creditedAt,
317				CreatedAt:         now,
318			}
319			exists, err := s.repo.insertPayout(ctx, payout)
320			if err != nil {
321				return nil, err
322			}
323			if exists {
324				// Retry of an interrupted run — reuse the payout already credited.
325				existing, err := s.repo.payoutByInvoice(ctx, inv.ID)
326				if err != nil {
327					return nil, err
328				}
329				payout = existing
330			}
331			payouts = append(payouts, *payout)
332		}
333	
334		if err := s.repo.markInvoicesPaid(ctx, batch.ID); err != nil {
335			return nil, err
336		}
337	
338		paRef := mockPARef()
339		ok, err = s.repo.transitionBatch(ctx, batch.ID, domain.SettlementStatusExecuting, bson.D{
340			{Key: "status", Value: domain.SettlementStatusExecuted},
341			{Key: "pa_ref", Value: paRef},
342			{Key: "executed_at", Value: now},
343		})
344		if err != nil {
345			return nil, err
346		}
347		if !ok {
348			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch left EXECUTING unexpectedly")
349		}
350		batch.Status = domain.SettlementStatusExecuted
351		batch.PARef = paRef
352		batch.ExecutedAt = &now
353	
354		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
355			Type:       domain.EventSettlementExecuted,
356			EntityType: domain.EntitySettlement,
357			EntityID:   batch.ID,
358			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
359			OrgUnitID:  batch.DCSID,
360			Payload: map[string]any{
361				"pa_ref":       paRef,
362				"payout_count": len(payouts),
363				"total_amount": batch.TotalAmount,
364			},
365		})
366		if err != nil {
367			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
368		}
369		if err := s.repo.setBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx, batch.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
370			return nil, err
371		}
372		batch.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
373	
374		// One payout.credited ledger event per invoice, then the SMS fan-out.
375		// Per-payout ledger/lookup failures are logged, not fatal: the money
376		// outcome is already anchored by settlement.executed above.
377		for _, p := range payouts {
378			if _, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
379				Type:       domain.EventPayoutCredited,
380				EntityType: domain.EntityInvoice,
381				EntityID:   p.InvoiceID,
382				Refs: []provenance.Ref{
383					{EntityType: domain.EntitySettlement, EntityID: batch.ID, Relation: "paid_by"},
384				},
385				Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
386				OrgUnitID: batch.DCSID,
387				Payload:   map[string]any{"utr": p.UTR, "amount": p.Amount},
388			}); err != nil {
389				s.log.Error("settlement: payout.credited ledger append", slog.String("invoice_id", p.InvoiceID), slog.Any("err", err))
390			}
391	
392			phone, err := s.repo.partyPhone(ctx, p.FarmerPartyID)
393			if err != nil {
394				s.log.Error("settlement: farmer phone lookup for payout SMS", slog.String("farmer_party_id", p.FarmerPartyID), slog.Any("err", err))
395				continue
396			}
397			s.bus.Publish(eventbus.TopicPayoutCredited, PayoutCreditedEvent{
398				FarmerPartyID: p.FarmerPartyID,
399				Phone:         phone,
400				Amount:        p.Amount,
401				UTR:           p.UTR,
402			})
403		}
404	
405		return &SettlementDetail{Batch: *batch, Payouts: payouts}, nil
406	}
407

409	// their own DCS; wider roles must name a dcs_id (SUPER_ADMIN and
410	// STATE_AUDITOR may list unscoped).
411	func (s *service) List(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, dcsID, date, status string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.SettlementBatch, int64, error) {
412		if dcsID == "" {
413			switch {
414			case actor.OrgType == domain.OrgTypeDCS:
415				dcsID = actor.OrgUnitID
416			case actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSuperAdmin || actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleStateAuditor:
417				// federation-wide read roles may list across DCSes
418			default:
419				return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_FIELD", "dcs_id is required for your scope")
```

```text
// ListPours pages pours. FARMER callers are always pinned to their own
// pours; staff roles must name a DCS inside their scope.
func (s *service) ListPours(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, filter pourListFilter, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.MilkPour, error) {
	if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleFarmer {
		filter.FarmerPartyID = actor.PartyID // farmers only ever see their own pours
	} else {
		if filter.DCSID == "" {
			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "dcs_id is required")
		}
		if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, filter.DCSID); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}
	if filter.Date != "" {
		if err := validateDateKey(filter.Date); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}
	if filter.Shift != "" && filter.Shift != domain.ShiftMorning && filter.Shift != domain.ShiftEvening {
		return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "shift must be MORNING or EVENING")
	}
	return s.repo.listPours(ctx, filter, page)
}
```

```text
65			if strings.TrimSpace(t.Name) == "" {

71		}
72		return nil
```

```text
// Package platformops is the platform-operations module (blueprint §12): the
// SUPER_ADMIN feature-flag console, the STATE_AUDITOR read-only audit surface
// with its GIGW/DPDP immutable export, the notifications outbox with the mock
// SMS dispatch worker (real deployment: MSG91 / telecom DLT gateway, §13),
// and the SUPPORT_AGENT audited limited-PII lookup (§5.2 role 20).
//
// It also subscribes to cross-module bus topics — payout credited, safety
// gate blocked, MVU dispatched — and turns them into queued vernacular SMS.
package platformops

import (
	"context"
	"log/slog"

	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"

	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/eventbus"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/middleware"
)

// Register wires the platformops module and mounts /admin, /audit,
// /notifications and /support (the router hands us the /api/v1 subtree).
func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
	repo := newRepository(d.DB)
	svc := newService(d, repo)
	h := newHandler(svc)

	r.Route("/admin", func(r chi.Router) {
		r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))

		// PCDF_ADMIN may LIST flags; flipping one is SUPER_ADMIN only —
		// capability gating is a deliberate act (blueprint principle #6).
		r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSuperAdmin, domain.RolePCDFAdmin)).
			Get("/flags", h.listFlags)
		r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSuperAdmin)).
			Put("/flags/{key}", h.setFlag)
	})

	r.Route("/audit", func(r chi.Router) {
		r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
		r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleStateAuditor, domain.RoleSuperAdmin))

		// Read-only by design: there is deliberately NO write/delete API
		// surface for audit logs (§12) — entries land via deps.Audit only.
		r.Get("/logs", h.listAuditLogs)
		r.Get("/logs/export", h.exportAuditLogs)
	})

	r.Route("/notifications", func(r chi.Router) {
		r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))

		r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSuperAdmin, domain.RoleSupportAgent)).
			Get("/", h.listNotifications)
		r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSuperAdmin)).
			Post("/worker/run", h.runWorker)
	})

	r.Route("/support", func(r chi.Router) {
		r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
		r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSupportAgent, domain.RoleSuperAdmin))

		r.Get("/parties/lookup", h.lookupParty)
	})

	// Cross-module reactions arrive over the bus (modules never import each
	// other). The bus already runs each handler on its own goroutine with a
	// bounded context and panic recovery; the wrapper below adds an explicit
	// second belt at this module's boundary.
	d.Bus.Subscribe(eventbus.TopicPayoutCredited, safeHandler(d, svc.onPayoutCredited))
	d.Bus.Subscribe(eventbus.TopicGateBlocked, safeHandler(d, svc.onGateBlocked))
	d.Bus.Subscribe(eventbus.TopicMVUDispatched, safeHandler(d, svc.onMVUDispatched))
}

// safeHandler wraps a bus reaction so a programming error in notification
// fan-out can never disturb the publishing flow.
func safeHandler(d *deps.Deps, reaction func(ctx context.Context, payload any)) eventbus.Handler {
	return func(ctx context.Context, topic string, payload any) {
		defer func() {
			if rec := recover(); rec != nil {
				d.Log.Error("platformops bus handler panic",
					slog.String("topic", topic), slog.Any("panic", rec))
			}
		}()
		reaction(ctx, payload)
	}
}

// handler is the HTTP layer: decode, validate shape, call service, respond.
type handler struct {
	svc *service
}

// newHandler wires the handler.
func newHandler(svc *service) *handler {
	return &handler{svc: svc}
}

// listFlags handles GET /admin/flags.
func (h *handler) listFlags(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	all, err := h.svc.listFlags(r.Context())
	if err != nil {
		httpx.Error(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, all)
}

// setFlag handles PUT /admin/flags/{key}.
func (h *handler) setFlag(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	actor, ok := auth.ActorFrom(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Unauthorized("authentication required"))
		return
	}

	var req SetFlagRequest
	if err := httpx.DecodeJSON(r, &req); err != nil {
		httpx.Error(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	if req.Enabled == nil {
		httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_ENABLED", "enabled is required"))
		return
	}

	flag, err := h.svc.setFlag(r.Context(), actor, chi.URLParam(r, "key"), *req.Enabled)
	if err != nil {
		httpx.Error(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, flag)
}

// listAuditLogs handles GET /audit/logs?actor_party_id=&target_type=&action=&from=&to=.
func (h *handler) listAuditLogs(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	query := r.URL.Query()
	filter := auditLogFilter{
		ActorPartyID: query.Get("actor_party_id"),
		TargetType:   query.Get("target_type"),
		Action:       query.Get("action"),
	}

	from, err := parseTimeParam(query.Get("from"), false)
	if err != nil {
		httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_FROM", "from must be RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD"))
		return
	}
	to, err := parseTimeParam(query.Get("to"), true)
	if err != nil {
		httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_TO", "to must be RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD"))
		return
	}
	filter.From, filter.To = from, to

	page := httpx.ParsePage(r)
	entries, total, err := h.svc.listAuditLogs(r.Context(), filter, page)
	if err != nil {
		httpx.Error(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	httpx.JSONMeta(w, http.StatusOK, entries, listMeta{Limit: page.Limit, Offset: page.Offset, Total: total})
}

// exportAuditLogs handles GET /audit/logs/export?from=&to= — the capped JSON
// attachment for the GIGW/DPDP immutable audit export (§12).
func (h *handler) exportAuditLogs(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	query := r.URL.Query()
	from, err := parseTimeParam(query.Get("from"), false)
	if err != nil {
		httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_FROM", "from must be RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD"))
		return
	}
	to, err := parseTimeParam(query.Get("to"), true)
	if err != nil {
		httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_TO", "to must be RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD"))
		return
	}

	export, err := h.svc.exportAuditLogs(r.Context(), from, to)
	if err != nil {
		httpx.Error(w, r, err)
		return
	}

	filename := "audit-export-" + export.ExportedAt.Format("20060102-150405") + ".json"
	w.Header().Set("Content-Disposition", fmt.Sprintf("attachment; filename=%q", filename))
	httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, export)
}

// listNotifications handles GET /notifications?phone=&status=.
func (h *handler) listNotifications(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	query := r.URL.Query()
	phone := strings.TrimSpace(query.Get("phone"))
	status := query.Get("status")
	switch status {
	case "", domain.NotificationQueued, domain.NotificationSent, domain.NotificationFailed:
	default:
		httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_STATUS", "status must be QUEUED, SENT or FAILED"))
		return
	}

	page := httpx.ParsePage(r)
	notifications, total, err := h.svc.listNotifications(r.Context(), phone, status, page)
	if err != nil {
		httpx.Error(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	httpx.JSONMeta(w, http.StatusOK, notifications, listMeta{Limit: page.Limit, Offset: page.Offset, Total: total})
}

// runWorker handles POST /notifications/worker/run — the manual mock-SMS
// dispatch trigger (deterministic demo; production = cron/queue consumer).
func (h *handler) runWorker(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	result, err := h.svc.runWorker(r.Context())
	if err != nil {
		httpx.Error(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, result)
}

// lookupParty handles GET /support/parties/lookup?phone=.
func (h *handler) lookupParty(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	phone := strings.TrimSpace(r.URL.Query().Get("phone"))
	if phone == "" {
		httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_PHONE", "phone is required"))
		return
	}

	view, err := h.svc.lookupParty(r.Context(), phone)
	if err != nil {
		httpx.Error(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, view)
}

// parseTimeParam accepts RFC3339 or plain YYYY-MM-DD (empty → nil). Date-only
// values mean UTC midnight; with endOfDay they cover the whole day, so
// ?to=2026-07-06 is inclusive of the 6th.
func parseTimeParam(value string, endOfDay bool) (*time.Time, error) {
	if value == "" {
		return nil, nil
	}
	if t, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, value); err == nil {
		t = t.UTC()
		return &t, nil
	}
	t, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", value)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if endOfDay {
		t = t.Add(24*time.Hour - time.Nanosecond)
	}
	t = t.UTC()
	return &t, nil
}
```

```text
1	package httpx
2	
3	import (
4		"encoding/json"
5		"errors"
6		"fmt"
7		"io"
8		"net/http"
9		"strconv"
10	)
11	
12	// maxBodyBytes caps request bodies at 1 MiB — pours, readings and admin
13	// payloads are all tiny; photo evidence goes to the object store, not the API.
14	const maxBodyBytes = 1 << 20
15	
16	// DecodeJSON strictly decodes the request body into dst. It enforces the
17	// size cap and exactly one JSON value.
18	func DecodeJSON(r *http.Request, dst any) error {
19		r.Body = http.MaxBytesReader(nil, r.Body, maxBodyBytes)
20		dec := json.NewDecoder(r.Body)
21		if err := dec.Decode(dst); err != nil {
22			var maxErr *http.MaxBytesError
23			switch {
24			case errors.As(err, &maxErr):
25				return BadRequest("BODY_TOO_LARGE", fmt.Sprintf("request body exceeds %d bytes", maxBodyBytes))
26			case errors.Is(err, io.EOF):
27				return BadRequest("EMPTY_BODY", "request body is required")
28			default:
29				return BadRequest("MALFORMED_JSON", "request body is not valid JSON: "+err.Error())
30			}
31		}
32		if dec.More() {
33			return BadRequest("MALFORMED_JSON", "request body must contain a single JSON value")
34		}
35		return nil
36	}
37	
38	// Page holds validated pagination parameters.
39	type Page struct {
40		Limit  int64 `json:"limit"`
41		Offset int64 `json:"offset"`
42	}
43	
44	// ParsePage reads ?limit= and ?offset= with sane bounds (default 50, max 200).
45	func ParsePage(r *http.Request) Page {
46		p := Page{Limit: 50, Offset: 0}
47		if v := r.URL.Query().Get("limit"); v != "" {
48			if n, err := strconv.ParseInt(v, 10, 64); err == nil && n > 0 {
49				p.Limit = min(n, 200)
50			}
51		}
52		if v := r.URL.Query().Get("offset"); v != "" {
53			if n, err := strconv.ParseInt(v, 10, 64); err == nil && n >= 0 {
54				p.Offset = n
55			}
56		}
57		return p
58	}
59
```
