69			orgs:     d.Orgs,
70			qrSecret: d.Cfg.QRSigningSecret,
71		}
72	}
73	
74	// VerifyQRToken checks a stored signed token in the format QR issuance
75	// (plant module signQRToken) mints: "base64url(qr_code|product_lot_id|
76	// issued_unix)" + "." + hex(HMAC-SHA256(secret, decoded payload)). The HMAC
77	// is computed over the DECODED payload bytes — exactly what issuance signed.
78	// The comparison is constant-time so a forger learns nothing from response
79	// timing.
80	func VerifyQRToken(secret, token string) bool {
81		payloadB64, signature, found := strings.Cut(token, ".")
82		if !found || payloadB64 == "" || signature == "" {
83			return false // malformed: no payload/signature split
84		}
85		payload, err := base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString(payloadB64)
86		if err != nil || len(payload) == 0 {
87			return false // malformed: payload is not valid base64url
88		}
89		expected := auth.HMACHash(secret, string(payload))
90		return auth.ConstantTimeEqual(expected, signature)
91	}
92	
93	// ScanQR resolves one consumer QR scan into the honest provenance view
94	// (§7.4): product + plant + lab certificate + the SET of contributing
95	// samitis — never per-farmer data — plus a live tamper-evidence check.
96	func (s *Service) ScanQR(ctx context.Context, qrCode string) (*QRScanResponse, error) {
97		qr, err := s.repo.qrByCode(ctx, qrCode)
98		if err != nil {
99			return nil, err
100		}
101	
102		// Integrity gate: the stored token must carry a valid HMAC. A mismatch
103		// means the QR record was tampered with or forged — surface it loudly.
104		if !VerifyQRToken(s.qrSecret, qr.SignedToken) {
105			s.log.Warn("QR signed-token integrity check failed — possible forgery",
106				slog.String("qr_code", qrCode), slog.String("qr_id", qr.ID))
107			return nil, httpx.Conflict("QR_INTEGRITY_FAILED",
108				"this QR code failed integrity verification and may be counterfeit")
109		}
110	
111		// Count the scan without ever blocking it: fire-and-forget increment.
112		go func(qrID string) {
113			bg, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
114			defer cancel()
115			if err := s.repo.incrementScanCount(bg, qrID); err != nil {
116				s.log.Warn("scan_count increment failed", slog.String("qr_id", qrID), slog.Any("err", err))
117			}
118		}(qr.ID)
119	
120		lot, err := s.repo.productLotByID(ctx, qr.ProductLotID)
121		if err != nil {
122			return nil, err
123		}
124		batch, err := s.repo.batchByID(ctx, lot.BatchID)
125		if err != nil {
126			return nil, err
127		}
128		plant, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, batch.PlantID)
129		if err != nil {
130			return nil, err
131		}
132	
133		// Walk the provenance graph upstream from the product lot to the pooling
134		// boundary: batch → BMC lots → consignments (§7.4).
135		events, err := s.ledger.Trace(ctx, domain.EntityProductLot, lot.ID, traceDepth)
136		if err != nil {
137			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
138		}
139	
140		sourcing, err := s.buildSourcing(ctx, events)
141		if err != nil {
142			return nil, err
143		}
144	
145		ledgerInfo, err := s.verifyTracedRange(ctx, events)
146		if err != nil {
147			return nil, err
148		}
149	
150		resp := &QRScanResponse{
151			Product: ProductInfo{
152				Name:       lot.ProductName,
153				SKU:        lot.SKU,
154				UnitSize:   lot.UnitSize,
155				MfgDate:    lot.MfgDate,
156				ExpiryDate: lot.ExpiryDate,
157			},
158			BatchNumber: batch.BatchNumber,
159			Plant:       PlantInfo{Name: plant.Name, District: plant.District},
160			Sourcing:    *sourcing,
161			Ledger:      *ledgerInfo,
162			ScanCount:   qr.ScanCount + 1, // reflect this scan; the $inc lands async
163		}
164	
165		// PLANT_LAB pass certificate — omitted (not an error) when absent.
166		qc, err := s.repo.latestPlantLabPass(ctx, batch.ID)
167		if err != nil {
168			return nil, err
169		}
170		if qc != nil {
171			resp.Quality = &QualityInfo{
172				CertificateNumber: qc.CertificateNumber,
173				Stage:             qc.Stage,
174				Tests:             qc.Tests,
175				RecordedAt:        qc.RecordedAt,
176			}
177		}
178	
179		// A recalled lot still resolves with 200 — consumers must SEE the recall
180		// notice, not hit a dead link.
181		if lot.Status == domain.ProductLotStatusRecalled {
182			resp.Recalled = true
183			notice := "This product lot has been RECALLED. Do not consume — return it to the point of purchase."
184			if lot.RecallReason != "" {
185				notice += " Reason: " + lot.RecallReason
186			}
187			resp.RecallNotice = notice
188		}
189		return resp, nil
190	}
191	
192	// buildSourcing derives the samiti-set view from traced consignment events:
193	// contributing DCS org ids from each event's org_unit_id/payload, collection
194	// dates from payloads, with the consignment documents as fallback when the
195	// events did not carry those fields.
196	func (s *Service) buildSourcing(ctx context.Context, events []provenance.Event) (*SourcingInfo, error) {
197		dcsIDs := map[string]struct{}{}
198		dates := map[string]struct{}{}
199		consignmentIDs := map[string]struct{}{}
200	
201		for _, ev := range events {
202			if ev.EntityType != domain.EntityConsignment {
203				continue
204			}
205			consignmentIDs[ev.EntityID] = struct{}{}
206			if ev.OrgUnitID != "" {
207				dcsIDs[ev.OrgUnitID] = struct{}{}
208			} else if v, ok := ev.Payload["dcs_id"].(string); ok && v != "" {
209				dcsIDs[v] = struct{}{}
210			}
211			if v, ok := ev.Payload["date"].(string); ok && v != "" {
212				dates[v] = struct{}{}
213			}
214		}
215	
216		// Fallback: if the events lacked DCS ids or dates, read the consignment
217		// docs themselves (still samiti-level — pour ids are never surfaced).
218		if len(consignmentIDs) > 0 && (len(dcsIDs) == 0 || len(dates) == 0) {
219			docs, err := s.repo.consignmentsByIDs(ctx, sortedKeys(consignmentIDs))
220			if err != nil {
221				return nil, err
222			}
223			for _, c := range docs {
224				if c.DCSID != "" {
225					dcsIDs[c.DCSID] = struct{}{}
226				}
227				if c.Date != "" {
228					dates[c.Date] = struct{}{}
229				}
230			}
231		}
232	
233		samitis := make([]SamitiInfo, 0, len(dcsIDs))
234		districts := map[string]struct{}{}
235		for _, id := range sortedKeys(dcsIDs) {
236			org, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, id)
237			if err != nil {
238				// A missing org unit must not break a consumer scan — log and skip.
239				s.log.Warn("QR scan: contributing DCS org not resolvable",
240					slog.String("dcs_org_id", id), slog.Any("err", err))
241				continue
242			}
243			samitis = append(samitis, SamitiInfo{Name: org.Name, Code: org.Code, District: org.District})
244			if org.District != "" {
245				districts[org.District] = struct{}{}
246			}
247		}
248		sort.Slice(samitis, func(i, j int) bool { return samitis[i].Name < samitis[j].Name })
249	
250		collectionDates := sortedKeys(dates)
251		return &SourcingInfo{
252			Message:         sourcingMessage(collectionDates, len(samitis), sortedKeys(districts)),
253			Samitis:         samitis,
254			CollectionDates: collectionDates,
255		}, nil
256	}
257	
258	// sourcingMessage renders the consumer-facing pooled-provenance sentence,
259	// e.g. "Made from milk collected on 2026-07-05 from 3 samitis in Lucknow".
260	func sourcingMessage(dates []string, samitiCount int, districts []string) string {
261		var b strings.Builder
262		b.WriteString("Made from milk collected")
263		if len(dates) > 0 {
264			b.WriteString(" on " + strings.Join(dates, ", "))
265		}
266		noun := "samitis"
267		if samitiCount == 1 {
268			noun = "samiti"
269		}
270		fmt.Fprintf(&b, " from %d %s", samitiCount, noun)
271		if len(districts) > 0 {
272			b.WriteString(" in " + strings.Join(districts, ", "))
273		}
274		return b.String()
275	}
276	
277	// verifyTracedRange re-hashes the ledger over the [min,max] seq window of the
278	// traced events (tamper-evidence baked into every scan). Windows wider than
279	// scanVerifySpanCap are verified partially — the most recent tail — and
280	// flagged as such.
281	func (s *Service) verifyTracedRange(ctx context.Context, events []provenance.Event) (*LedgerInfo, error) {
282		if len(events) == 0 {
283			return &LedgerInfo{Events: 0, Intact: true, VerifiedRange: [2]int64{0, 0}}, nil
284		}
285		minSeq, maxSeq := events[0].Seq, events[0].Seq
286		for _, ev := range events[1:] {
287			if ev.Seq < minSeq {
288				minSeq = ev.Seq
289			}
290			if ev.Seq > maxSeq {
291				maxSeq = ev.Seq
292			}
293		}
294		from, partial := minSeq, false
295		if maxSeq-minSeq+1 > scanVerifySpanCap {
296			from, partial = maxSeq-scanVerifySpanCap+1, true
297		}
298		intact, _, err := s.ledger.VerifyChain(ctx, from, maxSeq)
299		if err != nil {
300			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
301		}
302		return &LedgerInfo{
303			Events:        len(events),
304			Intact:        intact,
305			VerifiedRange: [2]int64{from, maxSeq},
306			Partial:       partial,
307		}, nil
308	}
309	
310	// VerifyLedger runs the public tamper-evidence check over [from,to]. Both
311	// bounds are optional: `to` defaults to the chain head, `from` to the start
312	// of the last publicVerifySpanCap events. Spans over the cap are rejected.
313	func (s *Service) VerifyLedger(ctx context.Context, fromRaw, toRaw string) (*LedgerVerifyResponse, error) {
314		latest, err := s.ledger.LatestSeq(ctx)
315		if err != nil {
316			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
317		}
318		if latest == 0 {
319			return &LedgerVerifyResponse{Intact: true, From: 0, To: 0}, nil // empty chain is trivially intact
320		}
321	
322		to := latest
323		if toRaw != "" {
324			n, err := strconv.ParseInt(toRaw, 10, 64)
325			if err != nil || n < 1 {
326				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_RANGE", "'to' must be a positive sequence number")
327			}
328			to = min(n, latest)
329		}
330		from := max(int64(1), to-publicVerifySpanCap+1)
331		if fromRaw != "" {
332			n, err := strconv.ParseInt(fromRaw, 10, 64)
333			if err != nil || n < 1 {
334				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_RANGE", "'from' must be a positive sequence number")
335			}
336			from = n
337		}
338		if from > to {
339			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_RANGE", "'from' must not exceed 'to'")
340		}
341		if to-from+1 > publicVerifySpanCap {
342			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("SPAN_TOO_WIDE",
343				fmt.Sprintf("verification span is capped at %d events per request", publicVerifySpanCap))
344		}
345	
346		intact, brokenAt, err := s.ledger.VerifyChain(ctx, from, to)
347		if err != nil {
348			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
349		}
350		resp := &LedgerVerifyResponse{Intact: intact, From: from, To: to}
351		if !intact {
352			resp.BrokenAtSeq = &brokenAt
353		}
354		return resp, nil
355	}
356	
357	// TraceGraph returns the full event graph around one entity: upstream via
358	// the recursive ref walk, downstream via reverse-ref lookup — the recall /
359	// root-cause tool (§8.3).
360	func (s *Service) TraceGraph(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string) (*TraceGraphResponse, error) {
361		if err := validateEntityType(entityType); err != nil {
362			return nil, err
363		}
364		upstream, err := s.ledger.Trace(ctx, entityType, entityID, traceDepth)
365		if err != nil {
366			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
367		}
368		downstream, err := s.ledger.DownstreamRefs(ctx, entityID)
369		if err != nil {
370			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
371		}
372		if len(downstream) > downstreamEventCap {
373			downstream = downstream[len(downstream)-downstreamEventCap:]
374		}
375		if len(upstream) == 0 && len(downstream) == 0 {
376			return nil, httpx.NotFound("provenance for entity")
377		}
378		if upstream == nil {
379			upstream = []provenance.Event{}
380		}
381		if downstream == nil {
382			downstream = []provenance.Event{}
383		}
384		return &TraceGraphResponse{Upstream: upstream, Downstream: downstream}, nil
385	}
386	
387	// Timeline returns one entity's own events in chain order, paginated.
388	// The second return value is the total event count before paging.
389	func (s *Service) Timeline(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, page httpx.Page) ([]provenance.Event, int, error) {
390		if err := validateEntityType(entityType); err != nil {
391			return nil, 0, err
392		}
393		events, err := s.ledger.EventsForEntity(ctx, entityType, entityID)
394		if err != nil {
395			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
396		}
397		if len(events) == 0 {
398			return nil, 0, httpx.NotFound("provenance for entity")
399		}
400		total := len(events)
401		start := min(page.Offset, int64(total))
402		end := min(start+page.Limit, int64(total))
403		return events[start:end], total, nil
404	}
405	
406	// validateEntityType rejects entity types outside the domain.Entity* catalog.
407	func validateEntityType(entityType string) error {
408		if _, ok := validEntityTypes[entityType]; !ok {
409			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_ENTITY_TYPE",
410				"unknown entity type "+entityType+" — use one of the provenance entity type constants")
411		}
412		return nil
413	}
414	
415	// sortedKeys returns a set's keys in deterministic (lexicographic) order.
416	func sortedKeys(set map[string]struct{}) []string {
417		out := make([]string, 0, len(set))
418		for k := range set {
419			out = append(out, k)
420		}
421		sort.Strings(out)
422		return out
423	}

package platformops

import (

)

// exportMaxRows caps the immutable audit export (§12) — bounded by contract.
const exportMaxRows = 5000

// workerClaimCap bounds one mock-SMS worker run to 100 claims.
const workerClaimCap = 100

// settableFlagKeys is the closed set of PUT-able feature flags. Capability
// gating is a deliberate act, not a free-text store (blueprint principle #6):
// an unknown key is NotFound, never an implicit insert.
var settableFlagKeys = map[string]struct{}{
	flags.FlagCollarTelemetry:  {},
	flags.FlagPhotoOCR:         {},
	flags.FlagONDC:             {},
	flags.FlagConsumerCommerce: {},
}

// service holds all platformops business logic.
type service struct {
	deps *deps.Deps
	repo *repository
}

// newService wires the service.
func newService(d *deps.Deps, repo *repository) *service {
	return &service{deps: d, repo: repo}
}

// ---- Admin: feature flags (§12) ----

// listFlags returns every stored feature flag for the admin console.
func (s *service) listFlags(ctx context.Context) ([]flags.Flag, error) {
	all, err := s.deps.Flags.All(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("list feature flags: %w", err))
	}
	if all == nil {
		all = []flags.Flag{}
	}
	return all, nil
}

// setFlag flips one well-known feature flag and writes the explicit
// "admin.flag_set" audit entry.
func (s *service) setFlag(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, key string, enabled bool) (*SetFlagResponse, error) {
	if _, ok := settableFlagKeys[key]; !ok {
		return nil, httpx.NotFound("feature flag " + key)
	}
	if err := s.deps.Flags.Set(ctx, key, enabled, actor.PartyID); err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("set feature flag: %w", err))
	}
	s.deps.Audit.Record(ctx, audit.Entry{
		Action:     "admin.flag_set",
		TargetType: "FEATURE_FLAG",
		TargetID:   key,
		Meta:       map[string]any{"key": key, "enabled": enabled},
	})
	return &SetFlagResponse{Key: key, Enabled: enabled}, nil
}

// ---- Auditor: read-only audit-log surface (§12) ----

// listAuditLogs returns a page of audit entries, newest first.
func (s *service) listAuditLogs(ctx context.Context, f auditLogFilter, page httpx.Page) ([]audit.Entry, int64, error) {
	return s.repo.listAuditLogs(ctx, f, page)
}

// exportAuditLogs assembles the capped attachment body for the GIGW/DPDP
// immutable audit export.
func (s *service) exportAuditLogs(ctx context.Context, from, to *time.Time) (*AuditExport, error) {
	entries, err := s.repo.exportAuditLogs(ctx, auditLogFilter{From: from, To: to}, exportMaxRows)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &AuditExport{
		ExportedAt: time.Now().UTC(),
		From:       from,
		To:         to,
		Count:      len(entries),
		Entries:    entries,
	}, nil
}

// ---- Notifications outbox + mock SMS worker (§12, §13) ----

// listNotifications returns a page of outbox documents.
func (s *service) listNotifications(ctx context.Context, phone, status string, page httpx.Page) ([]StoredNotification, int64, error) {
	return s.repo.listNotifications(ctx, phone, status, page)
}

// runWorker is the MOCK SMS provider dispatch (real deployment: MSG91 /
// telecom DLT gateway, §13). It claims up to workerClaimCap QUEUED documents
// via a race-safe FindOneAndUpdate loop, stamps each SENT with a mock
// provider reference, and renders the English/Hindi lines into meta for
// visibility. The manual trigger keeps the demo deterministic; production
// runs this as a cron/queue consumer.
func (s *service) runWorker(ctx context.Context) (*WorkerRunResponse, error) {
	sent := 0
	for i := 0; i < workerClaimCap; i++ {
		providerRef := "SMS-MOCK-" + uuid.NewString()[0:8]
		claimed, err := s.repo.claimQueuedNotification(ctx, providerRef, time.Now().UTC())
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if claimed == nil {
			break // queue drained
		}
		sent++

		english, hindi := renderSMS(claimed.TemplateKey, claimed.Params)
		meta := map[string]any{
			"provider":    "SMS-MOCK",
			"rendered_en": english,
			"rendered_hi": hindi,
		}
		if err := s.repo.setNotificationMeta(ctx, claimed.ID, meta); err != nil {
			// The claim already succeeded — meta is cosmetic, log and move on.
			s.deps.Log.Error("platformops: stamp notification meta failed",
				slog.String("notification_id", claimed.ID), slog.Any("err", err))
		}
	}
	return &WorkerRunResponse{Sent: sent}, nil
}

// renderSMS produces one simple English and one Hindi line per template key —
// mock rendering for visibility; real templates live with the DLT-registered
// provider (§13). Missing params render as empty strings, never a panic.
func renderSMS(templateKey string, params map[string]string) (english, hindi string) {
	p := func(key string) string { return params[key] } // nil-map reads are safe

	switch templateKey {
	case domain.TemplatePayoutCredited:
		return fmt.Sprintf("Rs %s credited to your bank account. UTR %s. - Saathi", p("amount"), p("utr")),
			fmt.Sprintf("₹%s आपके बैंक खाते में जमा हुए। UTR %s। - साथी", p("amount"), p("utr"))
	case domain.TemplateSafetyBlock:
		return fmt.Sprintf("SAFETY ALERT: %s %s blocked at %s. Reasons: %s. Quarantine and inspect immediately. - Saathi",
				p("subject_type"), p("subject_id"), p("stage"), p("reasons")),
			fmt.Sprintf("सुरक्षा चेतावनी: %s %s को %s पर रोका गया। कारण: %s। तुरंत जांच करें। - साथी",
				p("subject_type"), p("subject_id"), p("stage"), p("reasons"))
	case domain.TemplateMVUDispatched:
		return fmt.Sprintf("MVU 1962 van dispatched for your animal (case %s). Please stay reachable. - Saathi", p("case_id")),
			fmt.Sprintf("आपके पशु के लिए 1962 एमवीयू वैन रवाना (केस %s)। कृपया संपर्क में रहें। - साथी", p("case_id"))
	case domain.TemplatePourReceipt:
		return fmt.Sprintf("%sL @ Rs %s = Rs %s credited to today's bill. - Saathi", p("quantity"), p("rate"), p("amount")),
			fmt.Sprintf("%s लीटर @ ₹%s = ₹%s आज के बिल में जुड़े। - साथी", p("quantity"), p("rate"), p("amount"))
	case domain.TemplateInvoiceIssued:
		return fmt.Sprintf("Invoice %s for Rs %s issued. - Saathi", p("invoice_number"), p("amount")),
			fmt.Sprintf("₹%s का बिल %s जारी हुआ। - साथी", p("amount"), p("invoice_number"))
	case domain.TemplateOTP:
		return fmt.Sprintf("Your Saathi OTP is %s. Do not share it with anyone.", p("otp")),
			fmt.Sprintf("आपका साथी OTP %s है। इसे किसी से साझा न करें।", p("otp"))
	default:
		return "Saathi update: " + templateKey, "साथी सूचना: " + templateKey
	}
}

// ---- Support: audited limited-PII lookup (§5.2 role 20) ----

// lookupParty resolves a phone to the limited support view. EVERY call —
// hit or miss — is recorded as "support.pii_lookup": PII access is audited,
// full stop.
func (s *service) lookupParty(ctx context.Context, phone string) (*PartyLookupResponse, error) {
	party, findErr := s.repo.findPartyByPhone(ctx, phone)

	entry := audit.Entry{
		Action:     "support.pii_lookup",
		TargetType: "PARTY",
		Meta:       map[string]any{"phone": phone, "found": findErr == nil},
	}
	if findErr == nil {
		entry.TargetID = party.ID
	}
	s.deps.Audit.Record(ctx, entry)

	if findErr != nil {
		return nil, findErr
	}

	assignments, err := s.repo.listActiveAssignmentsForParty(ctx, party.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	roles := []PartyRoleView{}
	for _, assignment := range assignments {
		if !assignment.UsableAt(now) {
			continue
		}
		orgName := ""
		if org, orgErr := s.deps.Orgs.Get(ctx, assignment.OrgUnitID); orgErr == nil {
			orgName = org.Name
		}
		roles = append(roles, PartyRoleView{
			RoleCode:  assignment.RoleCode,
			OrgUnitID: assignment.OrgUnitID,
			OrgName:   orgName,
		})
	}

	// Limited PII by construction: no KYC document numbers, no bank details.
	return &PartyLookupResponse{
		PartyID:  party.ID,
		FullName: party.FullName,
		KYCTier:  party.KYCTier,
		Status:   party.Status,
		Roles:    roles,
	}, nil
}

// ---- Event-bus reactions: cross-module SMS queuing ----

// decodeBusPayload structurally re-decodes a bus payload into this module's
// mirror struct — modules never import each other's types (module contract).
func decodeBusPayload(payload any, dst any) error {
	raw, err := json.Marshal(payload)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("marshal bus payload: %w", err)
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, dst); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("unmarshal bus payload: %w", err)
	}
	return nil
}

// onPayoutCredited queues the "₹ credited, UTR …" SMS to the farmer
// (blueprint §8.1 last step).
func (s *service) onPayoutCredited(ctx context.Context, payload any) {
	var event payoutCreditedEvent
	if err := decodeBusPayload(payload, &event); err != nil {
		s.deps.Log.Error("platformops: bad payout.credited payload", slog.Any("err", err))
		return
	}
	if event.FarmerPartyID == "" && event.Phone == "" {
		s.deps.Log.Error("platformops: payout.credited payload has no addressee")
		return
	}
	s.queueNotification(ctx, event.FarmerPartyID, event.Phone, domain.TemplatePayoutCredited, map[string]string{
		"amount": strconv.FormatFloat(event.Amount, 'f', 2, 64),
		"utr":    event.UTR,
	})
}

// onGateBlocked alerts the blocked subject's UNION_FIELD_SUPERVISOR(s): the
// subject's org unit is resolved from its document, walked up to the union
// ancestor, and every usable supervisor assignment there gets the safety SMS.
func (s *service) onGateBlocked(ctx context.Context, payload any) {
	var event gateBlockedEvent
	if err := decodeBusPayload(payload, &event); err != nil {
		s.deps.Log.Error("platformops: bad qc.gate_blocked payload", slog.Any("err", err))
		return
	}

	orgUnitID, err := s.repo.subjectOrgUnit(ctx, event.SubjectType, event.SubjectID)
	if err != nil {
		s.deps.Log.Error("platformops: gate_blocked org resolution failed", slog.Any("err", err))
		return
	}
	union, err := s.unionAncestor(ctx, orgUnitID)
	if err != nil {
		s.deps.Log.Error("platformops: gate_blocked union walk failed",
			slog.String("org_unit_id", orgUnitID), slog.Any("err", err))
		return
	}
	if union == nil {
		s.deps.Log.Error("platformops: gate_blocked org has no union ancestor",
			slog.String("org_unit_id", orgUnitID))
		return
	}

	supervisors, err := s.repo.listActiveRoleHolders(ctx, union.ID, domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor)
	if err != nil {
		s.deps.Log.Error("platformops: gate_blocked supervisor lookup failed", slog.Any("err", err))
		return
	}

	params := map[string]string{
		"subject_type": event.SubjectType,
		"subject_id":   event.SubjectID,
		"stage":        event.Stage,
		"reasons":      strings.Join(event.FailureReasons, ", "),
	}
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	notified := map[string]bool{}
	for _, assignment := range supervisors {
		if !assignment.UsableAt(now) || notified[assignment.PartyID] {
			continue
		}
		notified[assignment.PartyID] = true
		s.queueNotification(ctx, assignment.PartyID, "", domain.TemplateSafetyBlock, params)
	}
}

// onMVUDispatched queues the "MVU van on its way" SMS to the farmer (§10).
func (s *service) onMVUDispatched(ctx context.Context, payload any) {
	var event mvuDispatchedEvent
	if err := decodeBusPayload(payload, &event); err != nil {
		s.deps.Log.Error("platformops: bad mvu.dispatched payload", slog.Any("err", err))
		return
	}
	if event.FarmerPartyID == "" && event.Phone == "" {
		s.deps.Log.Error("platformops: mvu.dispatched payload has no addressee")
		return
	}
	caseID := event.CaseID
	if caseID == "" {
		caseID = event.MVUCaseID
	}
	params := map[string]string{"case_id": caseID}
	if event.ETA != "" {
		params["eta"] = event.ETA
	}
	s.queueNotification(ctx, event.FarmerPartyID, event.Phone, domain.TemplateMVUDispatched, params)
}

// queueNotification inserts one QUEUED outbox document, resolving phone and
// preferred language from the party record when available. Failures are
// logged, never propagated — a lost SMS must not fail the publishing flow.
func (s *service) queueNotification(ctx context.Context, partyID, phone, templateKey string, params map[string]string) {
	language := "hi" // vernacular default (blueprint §13)
	if partyID != "" {
		if party, err := s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, partyID); err == nil {
			if phone == "" {
				phone = party.Phone
			}
			if party.PreferredLanguage != "" {
				language = party.PreferredLanguage
			}
		}
	}
	if phone == "" {
		s.deps.Log.Error("platformops: dropping notification with no phone",
			slog.String("template_key", templateKey), slog.String("party_id", partyID))
		return
	}

	notification := &StoredNotification{Notification: domain.Notification{
		ID:          uuid.NewString(),
		PartyID:     partyID,
		Phone:       phone,
		Channel:     domain.ChannelSMS,
		TemplateKey: templateKey,
		Language:    language,
		Params:      params,
		Status:      domain.NotificationQueued,
		QueuedAt:    time.Now().UTC(),
	}}
	if err := s.repo.insertNotification(ctx, notification); err != nil {
		s.deps.Log.Error("platformops: queue notification failed",
			slog.String("template_key", templateKey), slog.Any("err", err))
	}
}

// unionAncestor returns the MILK_UNION org unit at or above orgUnitID, walking
// the denormalised ancestor Path nearest-first via d.Orgs.Get. Returns nil
// when no union sits on the chain (e.g. a plant directly under the federation).
func (s *service) unionAncestor(ctx context.Context, orgUnitID string) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
	org, err := s.deps.Orgs.Get(ctx, orgUnitID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if org.Type == domain.OrgTypeMilkUnion {
		return org, nil
	}
	// Path holds ancestors root→down; walk nearest ancestor first.
	for i := len(org.Path) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
		ancestor, err := s.deps.Orgs.Get(ctx, org.Path[i])
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if ancestor.Type == domain.OrgTypeMilkUnion {
			return ancestor, nil
		}
	}
	return nil, nil
}

17	// repository is all MongoDB access for the quality module. It owns qc_results
18	// and — as the safety-gate verdict writer (blueprint §8.3) — performs the
19	// documented cross-collection status write onto bmc_lots and
20	// processing_batches. No other module may flip those gate statuses.
21	type repository struct {

28	// newRepository binds the repository to its collections.
29	func newRepository(db *mongo.Database) *repository {

31			results:  db.Collection(mongodb.CollQCResults),
32			bmcLots:  db.Collection(mongodb.CollBMCLots),

40		if _, err := r.results.InsertOne(ctx, res); err != nil {
41			return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("insert qc result: %w", err))
42		}

44	}

47	func (r *repository) setResultProvenanceSeq(ctx context.Context, resultID string, seq int64) error {
48		_, err := r.results.UpdateOne(ctx,
49			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: resultID}},
50			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "provenance_seq", Value: seq}}}},
51		)
52		if err != nil {
53			return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("set qc result provenance seq: %w", err))
54		}
55		return nil
56	}

59	func (r *repository) findResultByID(ctx context.Context, resultID string) (*domain.QCResult, error) {
60		var res domain.QCResult
61		err := r.results.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: resultID}}).Decode(&res)
62		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
63			return nil, httpx.NotFound("qc result")
64		}
65		if err != nil {
66			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("find qc result: %w", err))
67		}
68		return &res, nil

73	func (r *repository) listResults(ctx context.Context, subjectType, subjectID string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.QCResult, int64, error) {

82		total, err := r.results.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
83		if err != nil {
84			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("count qc results: %w", err))
85		}
86	
87		cur, err := r.results.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
88			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "recorded_at", Value: -1}}).
89			SetSkip(page.Offset).
90			SetLimit(page.Limit),
91		)
92		if err != nil {
93			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("list qc results: %w", err))
94		}

96		if err := cur.All(ctx, &results); err != nil {

98		}

117		var batch domain.ProcessingBatch
118		err := r.batches.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: batchID}}).Decode(&batch)
119		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
120			return nil, httpx.NotFound("processing batch")

128	// gateBMCLot applies the gate verdict to a BMC lot still in QC_PENDING.
129	// Returns false when the lot was already gated by a concurrent writer.
130	func (r *repository) gateBMCLot(ctx context.Context, lotID, resultID, newStatus, blockReason string) (bool, error) {
131		return gateSubjectDoc(ctx, r.bmcLots, lotID, domain.BMCLotStatusQCPending, resultID, newStatus, blockReason)
132	}
133	
134	// gateBatch applies the gate verdict to a processing batch still in QC_PENDING.
135	// Returns false when the batch was already gated by a concurrent writer.
136	func (r *repository) gateBatch(ctx context.Context, batchID, resultID, newStatus, blockReason string) (bool, error) {
137		return gateSubjectDoc(ctx, r.batches, batchID, domain.BatchStatusQCPending, resultID, newStatus, blockReason)
138	}
139	
140	// gateSubjectDoc is the shared conditional gate write: the filter pins the
141	// subject to QC_PENDING so a lost race cannot double-apply a verdict — the
142	// optimistic pattern that replaces transactions on a standalone server.
143	func gateSubjectDoc(ctx context.Context, coll *mongo.Collection, subjectID, pendingStatus, resultID, newStatus, blockReason string) (bool, error) {
144		set := bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: newStatus}}
145		if blockReason != "" {
146			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "block_reason", Value: blockReason})
147		}
148		res, err := coll.UpdateOne(ctx,
149			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: subjectID}, {Key: "status", Value: pendingStatus}},
150			bson.D{
151				{Key: "$set", Value: set},
152				{Key: "$push", Value: bson.D{{Key: "qc_result_ids", Value: resultID}}},
153			},
154		)
155		if err != nil {
156			return false, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("gate %s subject %s: %w", coll.Name(), subjectID, err))
157		}
158		return res.MatchedCount == 1, nil
159	}
160	
161	// nextCertificateSeq atomically increments and returns the per-stage QC
162	// certificate counter (counters collection, upsert-on-first-use).
163	func (r *repository) nextCertificateSeq(ctx context.Context, stage string) (int64, error) {
164		var doc struct {
165			Seq int64 `bson:"seq"`
166		}
167		err := r.counters.FindOneAndUpdate(ctx,
168			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: "qc_certificate:" + stage}},
169			bson.D{{Key: "$inc", Value: bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: int64(1)}}}},
170			options.FindOneAndUpdate().SetUpsert(true).SetReturnDocument(options.After),
171		).Decode(&doc)
172		if err != nil {
173			return 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("next qc certificate seq: %w", err))
174		}
175		return doc.Seq, nil
176	}

141	func (r *repository) partiesByIDs(ctx context.Context, ids []string) (map[string]domain.Party, error) {

28		// beneficiary-name match score from the bank; the mock always verifies
29		// with this fixed score.
30		mockPennyDropNameMatch = 0.92
31	)
32	
33	// grantableRoles caps what each NON-admin granter role may hand out
34	// (blueprint §5.2). SUPER_ADMIN and PCDF_ADMIN are unrestricted admin
35	// granters and are handled in granterMayGrant.
36	var grantableRoles = map[string]map[string]bool{
37		// A union president manages the village, logistics and union tiers.
38		domain.RoleUnionPresident: {
39			domain.RoleFarmer:               true,
40			domain.RoleSamitiSacheev:        true,
41			domain.RoleSamitiAdhyaksh:       true,
42			domain.RoleMilkTester:           true,
43			domain.RoleLRP:                  true,
44			domain.RoleAITech:               true,
45			domain.RoleVanRider:             true,
46			domain.RoleDeliveryRider:        true,
47			domain.RoleBMCOperator:          true,
48			domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor: true,
49			domain.RoleUnionPresident:       true,
50		},
51		// A samiti adhyaksh onboards only village workers inside their own DCS.
52		domain.RoleSamitiAdhyaksh: {
53			domain.RoleFarmer:     true,
54			domain.RoleMilkTester: true,
55			domain.RoleLRP:        true,
56		},
57	}
58	
59	// granterMayGrant reports whether granterRole may grant (or revoke)
60	// roleCode. Admin granters pass unconditionally.
61	func granterMayGrant(granterRole, roleCode string) bool {
62		if granterRole == domain.RoleSuperAdmin || granterRole == domain.RolePCDFAdmin {
63			return true
64		}
65		allowed, ok := grantableRoles[granterRole]
66		return ok && allowed[roleCode]
67	}
68	
69	// upgradedKYCTier returns the tier a party should hold after a successful
70	// verification at requestedTier — upgrades only, never a downgrade
71	// (KYCTierSatisfies treats parallel tier-1 proofs as equivalent).
72	func upgradedKYCTier(currentTier, requestedTier string) string {
73		if domain.KYCTierSatisfies(currentTier, requestedTier) {
74			return currentTier
75		}
76		return requestedTier
77	}
78	
79	// maskAccount reduces a bank account number to its ****-prefixed last 4
80	// digits — the only form ever persisted.
81	func maskAccount(accountNumber string) string {
82		if len(accountNumber) < 4 {
83			return "****"
84		}
85		return "****" + accountNumber[len(accountNumber)-4:]
86	}
87	
88	// isNotFound reports whether err is an httpx 404 (used to translate repo
89	// lookups into auth-appropriate 401s on the login path).
90	func isNotFound(err error) bool {
91		var ae *httpx.AppError
92		return errors.As(err, &ae) && ae.Status == http.StatusNotFound
93	}

95	// service holds every business rule of the identity module.
96	type service struct {
97		deps *deps.Deps
98		repo *repository
99	}
100	
101	// newService wires the service.
102	func newService(d *deps.Deps, repo *repository) *service {
103		return &service{deps: d, repo: repo}
104	}
105	
106	// --- Auth: OTP login ---
107	
108	// requestOTP creates a hashed OTP challenge and queues the SMS through the
109	// notification outbox (the platformops worker delivers it).
110	func (s *service) requestOTP(ctx context.Context, phone string) (*otpRequestResponse, error) {
111		now := time.Now().UTC()
112		code, err := auth.GenerateNumericOTP(otpLength)
113		if err != nil {
114			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
115		}
116	
117		challenge := otpChallenge{
118			ID:        uuid.NewString(),
119			Phone:     phone,
120			CodeHash:  auth.HMACHash(s.deps.Cfg.OTPHashSecret, phone, code),
121			ExpiresAt: now.Add(s.deps.Cfg.OTPTTL),
122			Attempts:  0,
123		}
124		if err := s.repo.insertOTPChallenge(ctx, challenge); err != nil {
125			return nil, err
126		}
127	
128		// Outbox SMS: the plaintext code travels only inside the notification
129		// params so the sender can deliver it; the challenge stores the hash.
130		notification := domain.Notification{
131			ID:          uuid.NewString(),
132			Phone:       phone,
133			Channel:     domain.ChannelSMS,
134			TemplateKey: domain.TemplateOTP,
135			Language:    defaultLanguage,
136			Params:      map[string]string{"otp": code},
137			Status:      domain.NotificationQueued,
138			QueuedAt:    now,
139		}
140		if party, err := s.repo.findPartyByPhone(ctx, phone); err == nil {
141			notification.PartyID = party.ID
142			if party.PreferredLanguage != "" {
143				notification.Language = party.PreferredLanguage
144			}
145		}
146		if err := s.repo.insertNotification(ctx, notification); err != nil {
147			return nil, err
148		}
149	
150		resp := &otpRequestResponse{Phone: phone, ExpiresAt: challenge.ExpiresAt}
151		if s.deps.Cfg.OTPDevMode {
152			resp.DevOTP = code // dev only — config refuses OTP_DEV_MODE in prod
153		}
154		return resp, nil
155	}
156	
157	// verifyOTP checks the challenge and logs the phone in, creating the Party
158	// on first login (find-or-create, §4.1).
159	func (s *service) verifyOTP(ctx context.Context, phone, otp string) (*authTokensResponse, error) {
160		now := time.Now().UTC()
161	
162		challenge, err := s.repo.latestOTPChallenge(ctx, phone, now)
163		if err != nil {
164			if isNotFound(err) {
165				return nil, httpx.Unauthorized("no active OTP for this phone — request a new code")
166			}
167			return nil, err
168		}
169		if challenge.Attempts >= maxOTPAttempts {
170			return nil, httpx.TooManyRequests("too many incorrect OTP attempts — request a new code")
171		}
172		expected := auth.HMACHash(s.deps.Cfg.OTPHashSecret, phone, otp)
173		if !auth.ConstantTimeEqual(challenge.CodeHash, expected) {
174			if err := s.repo.incrementOTPAttempts(ctx, challenge.ID); err != nil {
175				return nil, err
176			}
177			return nil, httpx.Unauthorized("incorrect OTP")
178		}
179	
180		// Burn every outstanding challenge for this phone.
181		if err := s.repo.deleteOTPChallenges(ctx, phone); err != nil {
182			return nil, err
183		}
184	
185		party, err := s.repo.upsertPartyByPhone(ctx, phone, now)
186		if err != nil {
187			return nil, err
188		}
189		if party.Status != domain.PartyStatusActive {
190			return nil, httpx.Forbidden("party is suspended")
191		}
192		return s.issueLoginTokens(ctx, party, now)
193	}
194	
195	// issueLoginTokens mints a SESSION access token plus a fresh rotating
196	// refresh token (stored only as an HMAC digest).
197	func (s *service) issueLoginTokens(ctx context.Context, party *domain.Party, now time.Time) (*authTokensResponse, error) {
198		refreshToken, err := auth.RandomToken(32)
199		if err != nil {
200			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
201		}
202		doc := refreshTokenDoc{
203			ID:        uuid.NewString(),
204			TokenHash: auth.HMACHash(s.deps.Cfg.OTPHashSecret, refreshHashLabel, refreshToken),
205			PartyID:   party.ID,
206			ExpiresAt: now.Add(s.deps.Cfg.RefreshTokenTTL),
207			CreatedAt: now,
208		}
209		if err := s.repo.insertRefreshToken(ctx, doc); err != nil {
210			return nil, err
211		}
212		accessToken, err := s.deps.JWT.IssueSessionToken(*party)
213		if err != nil {
214			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
215		}
216		return &authTokensResponse{
217			AccessToken:  accessToken,
218			RefreshToken: refreshToken,
219			Party:        party,
220		}, nil
221	}
222	
223	// refresh rotates a refresh token: the old token is consumed atomically and
224	// a new pair is issued — a replayed token always fails.
225	func (s *service) refresh(ctx context.Context, refreshToken string) (*authTokensResponse, error) {
226		now := time.Now().UTC()
227		tokenHash := auth.HMACHash(s.deps.Cfg.OTPHashSecret, refreshHashLabel, refreshToken)
228	
229		doc, err := s.repo.findRefreshToken(ctx, tokenHash)
230		if err != nil {
231			if isNotFound(err) {
232				return nil, httpx.Unauthorized("invalid refresh token")
233			}
234			return nil, err
235		}
236		if !now.Before(doc.ExpiresAt) {
237			_, _ = s.repo.deleteRefreshToken(ctx, tokenHash)
238			return nil, httpx.Unauthorized("refresh token expired — log in again")
239		}
240	
241		// ROTATE: consume the old token first; DeletedCount==0 means a parallel
242		// request won the race, so this presentation is treated as a replay.
243		deleted, err := s.repo.deleteRefreshToken(ctx, tokenHash)
244		if err != nil {
245			return nil, err
246		}
247		if deleted == 0 {
248			return nil, httpx.Unauthorized("refresh token already used")
249		}
250	
251		party, err := s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, doc.PartyID)
252		if err != nil {
253			if isNotFound(err) {
254				return nil, httpx.Unauthorized("party no longer exists")
255			}
256			return nil, err
257		}
258		if party.Status != domain.PartyStatusActive {
259			return nil, httpx.Forbidden("party is suspended")
260		}
261		return s.issueLoginTokens(ctx, party, now)
262	}
263	
264	// logout revokes one refresh token belonging to the caller. Idempotent.
265	func (s *service) logout(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, refreshToken string) error {
266		tokenHash := auth.HMACHash(s.deps.Cfg.OTPHashSecret, refreshHashLabel, refreshToken)
267		return s.repo.deleteRefreshTokenForParty(ctx, tokenHash, actor.PartyID)
268	}

270	// --- Auth: roles ---
271	
272	// listMyRoles returns the actor's currently usable assignments, enriched
273	// with org-unit display fields for the role-switcher UI.
274	func (s *service) listMyRoles(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor) ([]assignmentWithOrg, error) {
275		assignments, err := s.repo.listActiveAssignments(ctx, actor.PartyID)
276		if err != nil {
277			return nil, err
278		}
279		now := time.Now().UTC()
280		out := make([]assignmentWithOrg, 0, len(assignments))
281		for _, ra := range assignments {
282			if !ra.UsableAt(now) {
283				continue
284			}
285			out = append(out, s.withOrg(ctx, ra))
286		}
287		return out, nil
288	}
289	
290	// withOrg copies org display fields onto an assignment; enrichment is
291	// best-effort (a missing org unit never breaks the listing).
292	func (s *service) withOrg(ctx context.Context, ra domain.RoleAssignment) assignmentWithOrg {
293		enriched := assignmentWithOrg{RoleAssignment: ra}
294		if org, err := s.deps.Orgs.Get(ctx, ra.OrgUnitID); err == nil {
295			enriched.OrgName = org.Name
296			enriched.OrgType = org.Type
297			enriched.OrgCode = org.Code
298		}
299		return enriched
300	}
301	
302	// selectRole exchanges the session for a ROLE-kind token pinned to one
303	// usable assignment, gated on the role's minimum KYC tier (§5.2).
304	func (s *service) selectRole(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, assignmentID string) (*roleSelectResponse, error) {
305		assignment, err := s.repo.findAssignmentByID(ctx, assignmentID)
306		if err != nil {
307			return nil, err
308		}
309		if assignment.PartyID != actor.PartyID {
310			// Same shape as an unknown ID — never confirm other parties' grants.
311			return nil, httpx.NotFound("role assignment")
312		}
313		now := time.Now().UTC()
314		if !assignment.UsableAt(now) {
315			return nil, httpx.Forbidden("role assignment is revoked or outside its validity window")
316		}
317	
318		// Re-read the party: the KYC tier may have upgraded since the session
319		// token was minted.
320		party, err := s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, actor.PartyID)
321		if err != nil {
322			return nil, err
323		}
324		if party.Status != domain.PartyStatusActive {
325			return nil, httpx.Forbidden("party is suspended")
326		}
327		requiredTier := domain.RequiredKYCTier[assignment.RoleCode]
328		if !domain.KYCTierSatisfies(party.KYCTier, requiredTier) {
329			appErr := httpx.Forbidden("your KYC tier does not permit this role — complete verification first").
330				WithDetails(map[string]string{
331					"current_tier":  party.KYCTier,
332					"required_tier": requiredTier,
333				})
334			appErr.Code = "KYC_TIER_INSUFFICIENT"
335			return nil, appErr
336		}
337	
338		org, err := s.deps.Orgs.Get(ctx, assignment.OrgUnitID)
339		if err != nil {
340			return nil, err
341		}
342		accessToken, err := s.deps.JWT.IssueRoleToken(*party, *assignment, org.Type)
343		if err != nil {
344			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
345		}
346		return &roleSelectResponse{
347			AccessToken: accessToken,
348			RoleCode:    assignment.RoleCode,
349			OrgUnitID:   assignment.OrgUnitID,
350			OrgType:     org.Type,
351		}, nil
352	}

356	// getMe aggregates the caller's party, usable assignments and latest KYC
357	// summary in one call.

372				AadhaarLast4:      latest.AadhaarLast4,

374				BankIFSC:          latest.BankIFSC,
375				BankVerified:      latest.BankVerified,
376				VerifiedAt:        latest.VerifiedAt,
377			}
378		} else if !isNotFound(err) {
379			return nil, err
380		}

384	// patchMe updates the caller's own profile fields.
385	func (s *service) patchMe(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req patchMeRequest) (*domain.Party, error) {
386		return s.repo.updatePartyProfile(ctx, actor.PartyID, req.FullName, req.PreferredLanguage, time.Now().UTC())

389	// --- KYC (mock DPI adapters — real UIDAI / penny-drop integration later) ---
390	
391	// verifyAadhaar runs the MOCK Aadhaar eKYC flow (§18-A). The full Aadhaar
392	// number exists only in this request's memory: what is persisted is the
393	// last 4 digits plus an opaque reference from the (mock) Aadhaar Data Vault.
394	func (s *service) verifyAadhaar(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req aadhaarKYCRequest) (*aadhaarKYCResponse, error) {
395		now := time.Now().UTC()
396		party, err := s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, actor.PartyID)
397		if err != nil {
398			return nil, err
399		}
400	
401		language := party.PreferredLanguage
402		if language == "" {
403			language = defaultLanguage
404		}
405		consent := domain.Consent{
406			ID:          uuid.NewString(),
407			PartyID:     party.ID,
408			Purpose:     consentPurposeAadhaarEKYC,
409			TextVersion: consentTextVersion,
410			Language:    language,
411			GrantedAt:   now,
412		}
413		if err := s.repo.insertConsent(ctx, consent); err != nil {
414			return nil, err
415		}
416	
417		// MOCK Aadhaar Data Vault (§18-A): a real deployment sends the number to
418		// the vault service and receives an opaque token. The mock mints a UUID.
419		vaultRef := uuid.NewString()
420		last4 := req.AadhaarNumber[len(req.AadhaarNumber)-4:]
421	
422		// MOCK UIDAI eKYC: always succeeds. The real adapter drives the OTP-based
423		// eKYC exchange and may return PENDING/REJECTED.
424		record := domain.KYCRecord{
425			ID:              uuid.NewString(),
426			PartyID:         party.ID,
427			Tier:            req.RequestedTier,
428			AadhaarLast4:    last4,
429			AadhaarVaultRef: vaultRef,
430			ConsentID:       consent.ID,
431			Status:          domain.KYCStatusVerified,
432			VerifiedAt:      &now,
433			CreatedAt:       now,
434			UpdatedAt:       now,
435		}
436		if err := s.repo.insertKYCRecord(ctx, record); err != nil {
437			return nil, err
438		}
439	
440		newTier := upgradedKYCTier(party.KYCTier, req.RequestedTier)
441		if newTier != party.KYCTier {
442			if err := s.repo.updatePartyKYCTier(ctx, party.ID, newTier, now); err != nil {
443				return nil, err
444			}
445		}
446		return &aadhaarKYCResponse{Record: &record, KYCTier: newTier}, nil
447	}
448	
449	// verifyBank runs the MOCK penny-drop verification and stores ONLY the
450	// masked account tail and IFSC on the caller's latest KYC record (creating
451	// one when none exists yet).
452	func (s *service) verifyBank(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req bankKYCRequest) (*domain.KYCRecord, error) {
453		now := time.Now().UTC()
454		party, err := s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, actor.PartyID)
455		if err != nil {
456			return nil, err
457		}
458		masked := maskAccount(req.AccountNumber)
459	
460		latest, err := s.repo.latestKYCRecord(ctx, actor.PartyID)
461		switch {
462		case err == nil:
463			// MOCK penny-drop: always verified with a fixed name-match score.
464			return s.repo.updateKYCRecordBank(ctx, latest.ID, masked, req.IFSC, mockPennyDropNameMatch, now)
465		case isNotFound(err):
466			record := domain.KYCRecord{
467				ID:                uuid.NewString(),
468				PartyID:           party.ID,
469				Tier:              party.KYCTier,
470				BankAccountMasked: masked,
471				BankIFSC:          req.IFSC,
472				BankVerified:      true, // MOCK penny-drop: always succeeds
473				BankNameMatch:     mockPennyDropNameMatch,
474				Status:            domain.KYCStatusVerified,
475				VerifiedAt:        &now,
476				CreatedAt:         now,
477				UpdatedAt:         now,
478			}
479			if err := s.repo.insertKYCRecord(ctx, record); err != nil {
480				return nil, err
481			}
482			return &record, nil
483		default:
484			return nil, err
485		}
486	}

488	// listMyKYC pages the caller's KYC records (masked fields only — full
489	// numbers are never persisted anywhere).
490	func (s *service) listMyKYC(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.KYCRecord, int64, error) {
491		return s.repo.listKYCRecords(ctx, actor.PartyID, page)
492	}

494	// --- Role administration ---
495	
496	// requireGrantAuthority enforces the non-admin granter matrix (§5.2):
497	// UNION_PRESIDENT manages village/logistics/union-tier roles anywhere in
498	// scope; SAMITI_ADHYAKSH manages only FARMER/MILK_TESTER/LRP inside their
499	// own DCS. Admin granters pass.
500	func (s *service) requireGrantAuthority(actor auth.Actor, roleCode, orgUnitID string) error {
501		if !granterMayGrant(actor.RoleCode, roleCode) {
502			return httpx.Forbidden("role " + actor.RoleCode + " may not grant or revoke " + roleCode)
503		}
504		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSamitiAdhyaksh && orgUnitID != actor.OrgUnitID {
505			return httpx.Forbidden("SAMITI_ADHYAKSH may manage roles only within their own DCS")
506		}
507		return nil
508	}
509	
510	// createAssignment grants a role to a party inside an org unit.
511	func (s *service) createAssignment(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req createAssignmentRequest) (*domain.RoleAssignment, error) {
512		// Resolve the target party (party_id wins over phone).
513		var party *domain.Party
514		var err error
515		if req.PartyID != "" {
516			party, err = s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, req.PartyID)
517		} else {
518			party, err = s.repo.findPartyByPhone(ctx, req.Phone)
519		}
520		if err != nil {
521			return nil, err
522		}
523	
524		if err := s.deps.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.OrgUnitID); err != nil {
525			return nil, err
526		}
527		if err := s.requireGrantAuthority(actor, req.RoleCode, req.OrgUnitID); err != nil {
528			return nil, err
529		}
530	
531		exists, err := s.repo.activeAssignmentExists(ctx, party.ID, req.RoleCode, req.OrgUnitID)
532		if err != nil {
533			return nil, err
534		}
535		if exists {
536			return nil, httpx.Conflict("ASSIGNMENT_EXISTS", "party already holds an active "+req.RoleCode+" assignment in this org unit")
537		}
538	
539		now := time.Now().UTC()
540		validFrom := now
541		if req.ValidFrom != nil {
542			validFrom = req.ValidFrom.UTC()
543		}
544		var validTo *time.Time
545		if req.ValidTo != nil {
546			t := req.ValidTo.UTC()
547			validTo = &t
548		}
549		assignment := domain.RoleAssignment{
550			ID:        uuid.NewString(),
551			PartyID:   party.ID,
552			RoleCode:  req.RoleCode,
553			OrgUnitID: req.OrgUnitID,
554			GrantedBy: actor.PartyID,
555			ValidFrom: validFrom,
556			ValidTo:   validTo,
557			Status:    domain.RoleAssignmentActive,
558			CreatedAt: now,
559		}
560		if err := s.repo.insertAssignment(ctx, assignment); err != nil {
561			return nil, err
562		}
563		return &assignment, nil
564	}
565	
566	// revokeAssignment flips an assignment to REVOKED — the record is never
567	// deleted (§4.1). Revocation authority mirrors grant authority.
568	func (s *service) revokeAssignment(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, assignmentID string) (*domain.RoleAssignment, error) {
569		assignment, err := s.repo.findAssignmentByID(ctx, assignmentID)
570		if err != nil {
571			return nil, err
572		}
573		if err := s.deps.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, assignment.OrgUnitID); err != nil {
574			return nil, err
575		}
576		if err := s.requireGrantAuthority(actor, assignment.RoleCode, assignment.OrgUnitID); err != nil {
577			return nil, err
578		}
579		if assignment.Status != domain.RoleAssignmentActive {
580			return nil, httpx.Conflict("ALREADY_REVOKED", "role assignment is already revoked")
581		}
582		return s.repo.revokeAssignment(ctx, assignmentID, actor.PartyID, time.Now().UTC())
583	}

585	// listAssignments pages assignments inside one org unit the actor can see.
586	func (s *service) listAssignments(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, orgUnitID, roleCode string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.RoleAssignment, int64, error) {
587		if err := s.deps.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, orgUnitID); err != nil {
588			return nil, 0, err
589		}
590		return s.repo.listAssignments(ctx, orgUnitID, roleCode, page)
591	}

package platformops

import (
	"time"

	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"

// SetFlagRequest is the PUT /admin/flags/{key} body. Enabled is a pointer so
// an absent field is distinguishable from an explicit false.
type SetFlagRequest struct {
	Enabled *bool `json:"enabled"`
}

// SetFlagResponse echoes the applied flag state back to the admin console.
type SetFlagResponse struct {
	Key     string `json:"key"`
	Enabled bool   `json:"enabled"`
}

// AuditExport is the attachment body of GET /audit/logs/export — the
// GIGW/DPDP "immutable audit export" (blueprint §12). Entries come straight
// from the insert-only audit_logs collection; there is deliberately no write
// or delete API surface over them.
type AuditExport struct {
	ExportedAt time.Time     `json:"exported_at"`
	From       *time.Time    `json:"from,omitempty"`
	To         *time.Time    `json:"to,omitempty"`
	Count      int           `json:"count"`
	Entries    []audit.Entry `json:"entries"`
}

// StoredNotification is a notifications document as this module reads and
// writes it: the shared domain shape plus the worker-written meta block
// (rendered SMS text kept for demo/ops visibility).
type StoredNotification struct {
	domain.Notification `bson:",inline"`

	Meta map[string]any `bson:"meta,omitempty" json:"meta,omitempty"`
}

// WorkerRunResponse reports how many queued notifications the mock SMS
// worker dispatched in this run.
type WorkerRunResponse struct {
	Sent int `json:"sent"`
}

// PartyRoleView is one active role grant in the support lookup view.
type PartyRoleView struct {
	RoleCode  string `json:"role_code"`
	OrgUnitID string `json:"org_unit_id"`
	OrgName   string `json:"org_name,omitempty"`
}

// PartyLookupResponse is the limited-PII support view (§5.2 role 20):
// identity basics and role grants only — never KYC document numbers.
type PartyLookupResponse struct {
	PartyID  string          `json:"party_id"`
	FullName string          `json:"full_name,omitempty"`
	KYCTier  string          `json:"kyc_tier"`
	Status   string          `json:"status"`
	Roles    []PartyRoleView `json:"roles"`
}

// listMeta is the pagination metadata attached to list responses.
type listMeta struct {
	Limit  int64 `json:"limit"`
	Offset int64 `json:"offset"`
	Total  int64 `json:"total"`
}

// auditLogFilter carries the validated GET /audit/logs query filters.
type auditLogFilter struct {
	ActorPartyID string
	TargetType   string
	Action       string
	From         *time.Time
	To           *time.Time
}

package platformops

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"time"

	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo/options"

	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/audit"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/mongodb"
)

// repository is all MongoDB access for the platformops module. It owns the
// notifications outbox, reads audit_logs strictly read-only (writes go
// through deps.Audit only — the collection is insert-only by design, §12),
// and reads parties / role_assignments for the support lookup and for
// addressing safety alerts. bmc_lots / processing_batches are read solely to
// resolve a gate-blocked subject back to its org unit.
type repository struct {
	auditLogs     *mongo.Collection
	notifications *mongo.Collection
	parties       *mongo.Collection
	assignments   *mongo.Collection
	bmcLots       *mongo.Collection
	batches       *mongo.Collection
}

// newRepository binds the repository to its collections.
func newRepository(db *mongo.Database) *repository {
	return &repository{
		auditLogs:     db.Collection(mongodb.CollAuditLogs),
		notifications: db.Collection(mongodb.CollNotifications),
		parties:       db.Collection(mongodb.CollParties),
		assignments:   db.Collection(mongodb.CollRoleAssignments),
		bmcLots:       db.Collection(mongodb.CollBMCLots),
		batches:       db.Collection(mongodb.CollBatches),
	}
}

// auditFilter builds the bson filter shared by the list and export reads.
func auditFilter(f auditLogFilter) bson.D {
	filter := bson.D{}
	if f.ActorPartyID != "" {
		filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "actor_party_id", Value: f.ActorPartyID})
	}
	if f.TargetType != "" {
		filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "target_type", Value: f.TargetType})
	}
	if f.Action != "" {
		filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "action", Value: f.Action})
	}
	if f.From != nil || f.To != nil {
		tsRange := bson.D{}
		if f.From != nil {
			tsRange = append(tsRange, bson.E{Key: "$gte", Value: *f.From})
		}
		if f.To != nil {
			tsRange = append(tsRange, bson.E{Key: "$lte", Value: *f.To})
		}
		filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "ts", Value: tsRange})
	}
	return filter
}

// listAuditLogs returns a page of audit entries, newest first, plus the total
// matching count for pagination meta.
func (r *repository) listAuditLogs(ctx context.Context, f auditLogFilter, page httpx.Page) ([]audit.Entry, int64, error) {
	filter := auditFilter(f)

	total, err := r.auditLogs.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("count audit logs: %w", err))
	}

	cur, err := r.auditLogs.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
		SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "ts", Value: -1}}).
		SetSkip(page.Offset).
		SetLimit(page.Limit),
	)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("list audit logs: %w", err))
	}
	entries := []audit.Entry{}
	if err := cur.All(ctx, &entries); err != nil {
		return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("decode audit logs: %w", err))
	}
	return entries, total, nil
}

// exportAuditLogs returns up to maxRows entries in the window, newest first —
// the bounded read behind the immutable audit export (§12).
func (r *repository) exportAuditLogs(ctx context.Context, f auditLogFilter, maxRows int64) ([]audit.Entry, error) {
	cur, err := r.auditLogs.Find(ctx, auditFilter(f), options.Find().
		SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "ts", Value: -1}}).
		SetLimit(maxRows),
	)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("export audit logs: %w", err))
	}
	entries := []audit.Entry{}
	if err := cur.All(ctx, &entries); err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("decode audit log export: %w", err))
	}
	return entries, nil
}

// insertNotification queues one outbox document.
func (r *repository) insertNotification(ctx context.Context, n *StoredNotification) error {
	if _, err := r.notifications.InsertOne(ctx, n); err != nil {
		return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("insert notification: %w", err))
	}
	return nil
}

// listNotifications returns a page of outbox documents, newest first,
// optionally filtered by phone and status.
func (r *repository) listNotifications(ctx context.Context, phone, status string, page httpx.Page) ([]StoredNotification, int64, error) {
	filter := bson.D{}
	if phone != "" {
		filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "phone", Value: phone})
	}
	if status != "" {
		filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "status", Value: status})
	}

	total, err := r.notifications.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("count notifications: %w", err))
	}

	cur, err := r.notifications.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
		SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "queued_at", Value: -1}}).
		SetSkip(page.Offset).
		SetLimit(page.Limit),
	)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("list notifications: %w", err))
	}
	notifications := []StoredNotification{}
	if err := cur.All(ctx, &notifications); err != nil {
		return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("decode notifications: %w", err))
	}
	return notifications, total, nil
}

// claimQueuedNotification atomically claims the oldest QUEUED document
// (QUEUED→SENT, sent_at, provider_ref) and returns it, or nil when the queue
// is drained. FindOneAndUpdate makes the claim race-safe across concurrent
// worker runs — never find-then-update.
func (r *repository) claimQueuedNotification(ctx context.Context, providerRef string, now time.Time) (*StoredNotification, error) {
	var n StoredNotification
	err := r.notifications.FindOneAndUpdate(ctx,
		bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: domain.NotificationQueued}},
		bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
			{Key: "status", Value: domain.NotificationSent},
			{Key: "sent_at", Value: now},
			{Key: "provider_ref", Value: providerRef},
		}}},
		options.FindOneAndUpdate().
			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "queued_at", Value: 1}}).
			SetReturnDocument(options.After),
	).Decode(&n)
	if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
		return nil, nil
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("claim queued notification: %w", err))
	}
	return &n, nil
}

// setNotificationMeta stamps the rendered-message meta block onto a claimed
// notification (visibility only — the claim has already succeeded).
func (r *repository) setNotificationMeta(ctx context.Context, notificationID string, meta map[string]any) error {
	_, err := r.notifications.UpdateOne(ctx,
		bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: notificationID}},
		bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "meta", Value: meta}}}},
	)
	if err != nil {
		return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("set notification meta: %w", err))
	}
	return nil
}

// findPartyByPhone returns the party owning a phone number, or NotFound.
func (r *repository) findPartyByPhone(ctx context.Context, phone string) (*domain.Party, error) {
	var party domain.Party
	err := r.parties.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "phone", Value: phone}}).Decode(&party)
	if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
		return nil, httpx.NotFound("party")
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("find party by phone: %w", err))
	}
	return &party, nil
}

// findPartyByID returns one party, or NotFound.
func (r *repository) findPartyByID(ctx context.Context, partyID string) (*domain.Party, error) {
	var party domain.Party
	err := r.parties.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: partyID}}).Decode(&party)
	if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
		return nil, httpx.NotFound("party")
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("find party: %w", err))
	}
	return &party, nil
}

// listActiveAssignmentsForParty returns a party's ACTIVE role assignments
// (bounded — a party holds at most a handful of roles).
func (r *repository) listActiveAssignmentsForParty(ctx context.Context, partyID string) ([]domain.RoleAssignment, error) {
	cur, err := r.assignments.Find(ctx,
		bson.D{
			{Key: "party_id", Value: partyID},
			{Key: "status", Value: domain.RoleAssignmentActive},
		},
		options.Find().SetLimit(100),
	)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("list assignments for party: %w", err))
	}
	assignments := []domain.RoleAssignment{}
	if err := cur.All(ctx, &assignments); err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("decode assignments: %w", err))
	}
	return assignments, nil
}

// listActiveRoleHolders returns the ACTIVE assignments of one role inside one
// org unit (bounded — used to address supervisor safety alerts).
func (r *repository) listActiveRoleHolders(ctx context.Context, orgUnitID, roleCode string) ([]domain.RoleAssignment, error) {
	cur, err := r.assignments.Find(ctx,
		bson.D{
			{Key: "org_unit_id", Value: orgUnitID},
			{Key: "role_code", Value: roleCode},
			{Key: "status", Value: domain.RoleAssignmentActive},
		},
		options.Find().SetLimit(50),
	)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("list role holders: %w", err))
	}
	assignments := []domain.RoleAssignment{}
	if err := cur.All(ctx, &assignments); err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("decode role holders: %w", err))
	}
	return assignments, nil
}

// subjectOrgUnit resolves a gate-blocked QC subject to the org unit that
// holds it (BMC lot → bmc_id, processing batch → plant_id).
func (r *repository) subjectOrgUnit(ctx context.Context, subjectType, subjectID string) (string, error) {
	var coll *mongo.Collection
	var field string
	switch subjectType {
	case domain.QCSubjectBMCLot:
		coll, field = r.bmcLots, "bmc_id"
	case domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch:
		coll, field = r.batches, "plant_id"
	default:
		return "", fmt.Errorf("gate-blocked subject type %q has no org resolution", subjectType)
	}

	var doc bson.M
	err := coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: subjectID}},
		options.FindOne().SetProjection(bson.D{{Key: field, Value: 1}}),
	).Decode(&doc)
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve org of %s %s: %w", subjectType, subjectID, err)
	}
	orgUnitID, _ := doc[field].(string)
	if orgUnitID == "" {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("%s %s carries no %s", subjectType, subjectID, field)
	}
	return orgUnitID, nil
}

package domain

import "time"

// Notification channels — SMS/IVR are essential, not optional, for low-literacy
// users (blueprint §13).
const (
	ChannelSMS  = "SMS"
	ChannelIVR  = "IVR"
	ChannelPush = "PUSH"
)

// Notification statuses (outbox pattern: write locally, provider worker sends).
const (
	NotificationQueued = "QUEUED"
	NotificationSent   = "SENT"
	NotificationFailed = "FAILED"
)

// Template keys used across modules.
const (
	TemplatePourReceipt     = "POUR_RECEIPT"      // "10.5L @ ₹42.30 = ₹444.15 credited to today's bill"
	TemplateInvoiceIssued   = "INVOICE_ISSUED"
	TemplatePayoutCredited  = "PAYOUT_CREDITED"   // "₹444.15 credited to a/c ****1234, UTR ..."
	TemplateSafetyBlock     = "SAFETY_BLOCK"      // supervisor alert on gate failure
	TemplateOTP             = "OTP"
	TemplateMVUDispatched   = "MVU_DISPATCHED"
)

// Notification is one queued vernacular message to a party.
type Notification struct {
	ID          string            `bson:"_id"      json:"id"`
	PartyID     string            `bson:"party_id,omitempty" json:"party_id,omitempty"`
	Phone       string            `bson:"phone"    json:"phone"`
	Channel     string            `bson:"channel"  json:"channel"`
	TemplateKey string            `bson:"template_key" json:"template_key"`
	Language    string            `bson:"language" json:"language"`
	Params      map[string]string `bson:"params,omitempty" json:"params,omitempty"`
	Status      string            `bson:"status"   json:"status"`
	ProviderRef string            `bson:"provider_ref,omitempty" json:"provider_ref,omitempty"`
	Error       string            `bson:"error,omitempty"        json:"error,omitempty"`
	QueuedAt    time.Time         `bson:"queued_at" json:"queued_at"`
	SentAt      *time.Time        `bson:"sent_at,omitempty" json:"sent_at,omitempty"`
}

// verifyAadhaar handles POST /kyc/aadhaar.
func (h *handler) verifyAadhaar(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	actor, ok := actorOr401(w, r)
	if !ok {
		return
	}
	var req aadhaarKYCRequest
	if err := httpx.DecodeJSON(r, &req); err != nil {
		httpx.Error(w, r, err)

		httpx.Error(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	resp, err := h.svc.verifyAadhaar(r.Context(), actor, req)
	if err != nil {
		httpx.Error(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusCreated, resp)
}

19	// repo owns every MongoDB access of the collection module. It maps

21	// httpx.Internal, so the service layer only ever sees AppError-compatible

28		roleAssignments *mongo.Collection

34	// newRepo binds the repo to the module's collections.
35	func newRepo(d *deps.Deps) *repo {
36		return &repo{
37			rateCharts:      d.DB.Collection(mongodb.CollRateCharts),
38			readings:        d.DB.Collection(mongodb.CollAnalyzerReadings),
39			pours:           d.DB.Collection(mongodb.CollMilkPours),
40			invoices:        d.DB.Collection(mongodb.CollInvoices),
41			roleAssignments: d.DB.Collection(mongodb.CollRoleAssignments),
42			parties:         d.DB.Collection(mongodb.CollParties),
43			notifications:   d.DB.Collection(mongodb.CollNotifications),
44			counters:        d.DB.Collection(mongodb.CollCounters),
45		}
46	}
47	
48	// --- rate charts ---
49	
50	// deactivateActiveCharts flips every active chart of an org unit to inactive
51	// (a new chart supersedes the old ones).
52	func (r *repo) deactivateActiveCharts(ctx context.Context, orgUnitID string) error {
53		_, err := r.rateCharts.UpdateMany(ctx,
54			bson.D{{Key: "org_unit_id", Value: orgUnitID}, {Key: "active", Value: true}},
55			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "active", Value: false}}}},
56		)
57		if err != nil {
58			return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("deactivate rate charts: %w", err))
59		}
60		return nil
61	}

63	// insertRateChart stores a new chart.

```text
1	// Package httpapi assembles the HTTP surface: global middleware, operational
2	// endpoints (health/readiness/metrics/version), and the /api/v1 tree where
3	// every domain module mounts its routes.
4	package httpapi
5	
6	import (
7		"context"
8		"net/http"
9		"time"
10	
11		"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
12		chimw "github.com/go-chi/chi/v5/middleware"
13		"github.com/prometheus/client_golang/prometheus/promhttp"
14	
15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
16		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
17		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/middleware"
18	)
19	
20	// Version is stamped via -ldflags at release build time.
21	var Version = "0.1.0-dev"
22	
23	// New builds the fully wired HTTP handler.
24	func New(d *deps.Deps) http.Handler {
25		r := chi.NewRouter()
26	
27		// Order matters: recover innermost-last so panics in anything above are caught.
28		r.Use(chimw.RequestID)
29		r.Use(chimw.RealIP)
30		r.Use(middleware.Metrics)
31		r.Use(middleware.PerIPRateLimit(d.Cfg.RateLimitRPS, d.Cfg.RateLimitBurst))
32		r.Use(chimw.Recoverer)
33		r.Use(chimw.Timeout(30 * time.Second))
34	
35		// Operational endpoints — outside /api/v1, never authenticated.
36		r.Get("/healthz", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
37			httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{"status": "ok"})
38		})
39		r.Get("/readyz", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
40			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 2*time.Second)
41			defer cancel()
42			if err := d.DB.Client().Ping(ctx, nil); err != nil {
43				httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Internal(err))
44				return
45			}
46			httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{"status": "ready"})
47		})
48		r.Handle("/metrics", promhttp.Handler())
49		r.Get("/version", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
50			httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{"version": Version, "service": "saathi-backend"})
51		})
52	
53		r.Route("/api/v1", func(api chi.Router) {
54			api.Use(middleware.AuditMutations(d.Audit))
55			RegisterModules(api, d)
56		})
57	
58		return r
59	}
60

 `./internal/platform/orgscope/resolver.go`

```text
1	// Package orgscope answers the RBAC question "is this resource inside the
2	// caller's organisational scope?" in O(1) DB reads. Org units denormalise
3	// their ancestor chain into Path, so scope checking is a set-membership test
4	// — no recursive tree walks on the hot path.
5	package orgscope
6	
7	import (
8		"context"
9		"errors"
10		"sync"
11		"time"
12	
13		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
14		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
15	
16		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
17		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
18		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
19	)
20	
21	const collection = "org_units"
22	
23	type cachedOrg struct {
24		org domain.OrgUnit
25		at  time.Time
26	}
27	
28	// Resolver caches org units briefly (the tree changes rarely, reads are hot).
29	type Resolver struct {
30		coll *mongo.Collection
31		ttl  time.Duration
32	
33		mu    sync.RWMutex
34		cache map[string]cachedOrg
35	}
36	
37	// NewResolver binds the resolver to the database.
38	func NewResolver(db *mongo.Database) *Resolver {
39		return &Resolver{
40			coll:  db.Collection(collection),
41			ttl:   60 * time.Second,
42			cache: make(map[string]cachedOrg),
43		}
44	}
45	
46	// Get returns an org unit by ID (cached).
47	func (r *Resolver) Get(ctx context.Context, id string) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
48		r.mu.RLock()
49		c, ok := r.cache[id]
50		r.mu.RUnlock()
51		if ok && time.Since(c.at) < r.ttl {
52			org := c.org
53			return &org, nil
54		}
55	
56		var org domain.OrgUnit
57		err := r.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&org)
58		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
59			return nil, httpx.NotFound("org unit " + id)
60		}
61		if err != nil {
62			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
63		}
64	
65		r.mu.Lock()
66		r.cache[id] = cachedOrg{org: org, at: time.Now()}
67		r.mu.Unlock()
68		return &org, nil
69	}
70	
71	// Invalidate drops a cached entry (call after updates).
72	func (r *Resolver) Invalidate(id string) {
73		r.mu.Lock()
74		delete(r.cache, id)
75		r.mu.Unlock()
76	}
77	
78	// InScope reports whether target sits at-or-below scope in the hierarchy:
79	// true when scope == target, or scope appears in target's ancestor Path.
80	func (r *Resolver) InScope(ctx context.Context, scopeOrgID, targetOrgID string) (bool, error) {
81		if scopeOrgID == targetOrgID {
82			return true, nil
83		}
84		target, err := r.Get(ctx, targetOrgID)
85		if err != nil {
86			return false, err
87		}
88		for _, ancestor := range target.Path {
89			if ancestor == scopeOrgID {
90				return true, nil
91			}
92		}
93		return false, nil
94	}
95	
96	// RequireInScope enforces the actor's org scope over a target org unit.
97	// SUPER_ADMIN and STATE_AUDITOR (read-wide roles rooted at the federation)
98	// pass automatically; everyone else needs ancestry.
99	func (r *Resolver) RequireInScope(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, targetOrgID string) error {
100		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSuperAdmin || actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleStateAuditor {
101			return nil
102		}
103		if actor.OrgUnitID == "" {
104			return httpx.Forbidden("role token with org scope required")
105		}
106		ok, err := r.InScope(ctx, actor.OrgUnitID, targetOrgID)
107		if err != nil {
108			return err
109		}
110		if !ok {
111			return httpx.Forbidden("resource is outside your organisational scope")
112		}
113		return nil
114	}
115

75	// (plant module signQRToken) mints: "base64url(qr_code|product_lot_id|
76	// issued_unix)" + "." + hex(HMAC-SHA256(secret, decoded payload)). The HMAC
77	// is computed over the DECODED payload bytes — exactly what issuance signed.
78	// The comparison is constant-time so a forger learns nothing from response
79	// timing.
80	func VerifyQRToken(secret, token string) bool {
81		payloadB64, signature, found := strings.Cut(token, ".")
82		if !found || payloadB64 == "" || signature == "" {
83			return false // malformed: no payload/signature split
84		}
85		payload, err := base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString(payloadB64)
86		if err != nil || len(payload) == 0 {
87			return false // malformed: payload is not valid base64url
88		}
89		expected := auth.HMACHash(secret, string(payload))
90		return auth.ConstantTimeEqual(expected, signature)
91	}

// Package cattle owns the livestock side of Saathi: the animal registry keyed
// on the 12-digit Pashu Aadhaar ear-tag ID, the animal health history with its
// mock Bharat Pashudhan sync, the 1962 Mobile Veterinary Unit dispatch flow,
// the vernacular education hub, and the dormant collar-telemetry path that is
// provisioned but capability-gated until a government collar scheme lands
// (blueprint §9, §10).
package cattle

import (
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"

	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/middleware"
)

// Register wires the cattle module under /cattle. The router mounts this
// subtree at /api/v1, so routes land at /api/v1/cattle/...
func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
	repo := newRepository(d.DB)
	svc := newService(d, repo)
	h := newHandler(svc)

	r.Route("/cattle", func(r chi.Router) {
		r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))

		r.Route("/animals", func(r chi.Router) {
			// Registration: farmers self-serve; village-tier staff and the
			// health tier register on a farmer's behalf.
			r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(
				domain.RoleFarmer, domain.RoleSamitiSacheev, domain.RoleLRP,
				domain.RoleAITech, domain.RoleVeterinarian,
			)).Post("/", h.registerAnimal)

			// Any authenticated party may list; the service pins farmers and
			// plain session tokens to their own herd.
			r.With(middleware.RequireSession).Get("/", h.listAnimals)

			// Reads: the owner farmer, or care-circle roles. Consent gating
			// is a v2 TODO — see canViewAnimal in service.go.
			r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
				r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(
					domain.RoleFarmer, domain.RoleVeterinarian,
					domain.RoleAITech, domain.RoleMissionOfficial,
				))
				r.Get("/{animalID}", h.getAnimal)
				r.Get("/{animalID}/health-events", h.listHealthEvents)
			})

			r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleVeterinarian, domain.RoleAITech)).
				Post("/{animalID}/health-events", h.logHealthEvent)

			// Mock Bharat Pashudhan push (§9) — real integration is a swap of
			// the service internals, not an API change.
			r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleVeterinarian, domain.RolePCDFAdmin)).
				Post("/{animalID}/bp-sync", h.syncBharatPashudhan)
		})

		// 1962 Mobile Veterinary Unit dispatch loop (§10).
		r.Route("/mvu-cases", func(r chi.Router) {
			r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleFarmer)).Post("/", h.createMVUCase)
			r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(
				domain.RoleVeterinarian, domain.RoleMVUDriver,
				domain.RoleSamitiSacheev, domain.RoleMissionOfficial,
			)).Get("/", h.listMVUCases)
			r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleVeterinarian, domain.RoleMVUDriver)).
				Post("/{caseID}/dispatch", h.dispatchMVUCase)
			r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleVeterinarian)).
				Post("/{caseID}/close", h.closeMVUCase)
		})

		// Education hub (§10): published content is readable by everyone.
		r.Route("/education", func(r chi.Router) {
			r.With(middleware.RequireSession).Get("/", h.listEducation)
			r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RolePCDFAdmin, domain.RoleMissionOfficial)).
				Post("/", h.createEducation)
		})

		// Dormant collar backdoor (§9): the endpoint ships now but stays
		// behind flags.FlagCollarTelemetry — activation is a flag flip.
		r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleServiceAccount)).
			Post("/telemetry", h.ingestTelemetry)
	})
}
