```text
package plant

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/hmac"
	"crypto/rand"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/hex"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"

	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/orgscope"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/provenance"
)

// codeSafetyGateBlocked is the stable error code every gate refusal carries —
// the frontend switches on it to show the quarantine screen (blueprint §8.3).
const codeSafetyGateBlocked = "SAFETY_GATE_BLOCKED"

// Service holds the plant module's business logic: lot pooling, the safety
// gate, batch numbering, product lot packaging and QR minting.
type Service struct {
	repo     *Repo
	orgs     *orgscope.Resolver
	ledger   *provenance.Ledger
	qrSecret string
}

// NewService wires the service from the shared dependency container.
func NewService(repo *Repo, d *deps.Deps) *Service {
	return &Service{
		repo:     repo,
		orgs:     d.Orgs,
		ledger:   d.Ledger,
		qrSecret: d.Cfg.QRSigningSecret,
	}
}

// --- safety-gate predicates (§8.3) ---
//
// Pure functions so the refusal matrix is unit-testable without a database.
// Every mutation below ALSO re-checks the status inside the MongoDB update
// filter, so a concurrent QC block can never slip a bad lot through.

// canDispatchBMCLot: only a lot with a passing BMC rapid test may leave on a
// tanker. BLOCKED, QC_PENDING and OPEN lots stay put.
func canDispatchBMCLot(status string) bool {
	return status == domain.BMCLotStatusPassed
}

// canPoolBMCLot: only a DISPATCHED lot (which by construction went
// OPEN→QC_PENDING→PASSED→DISPATCHED) may enter a processing batch.
func canPoolBMCLot(status string) bool {
	return status == domain.BMCLotStatusDispatched
}

// canCompleteBatch: only a batch the plant lab has PASSED may complete.
func canCompleteBatch(status string) bool {
	return status == domain.BatchStatusPassed
}

// canYieldProductLot: only a COMPLETED batch may be packaged into SKU lots.
func canYieldProductLot(batchStatus string) bool {
	return batchStatus == domain.BatchStatusCompleted
}

// canIssueQR: a QR may only label an ACTIVE product lot whose batch is
// COMPLETED — re-checked at mint time so a recall immediately stops printing.
func canIssueQR(lotStatus, batchStatus string) bool {
	return lotStatus == domain.ProductLotStatusActive && batchStatus == domain.BatchStatusCompleted
}

// --- BMC lots ---

// CreateBMCLot pools DELIVERED consignments into a new OPEN lot at a BMC.
func (s *Service) CreateBMCLot(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateBMCLotRequest) (*domain.BMCLot, error) {
	if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.BMCID); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	org, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.BMCID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if org.Type != domain.OrgTypeBMC {
		return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_BMC", "org unit "+req.BMCID+" is not a BMC")
	}

	now := time.Now().UTC()
	date := req.Date
	if date == "" {
		date = domain.DateKeyIST(now)
	}

	ids := dedupe(req.ConsignmentIDs)
	consignments, err := s.repo.ConsignmentsByIDs(ctx, ids)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	if len(consignments) != len(ids) {
		return nil, httpx.NotFound("consignment(s) " + strings.Join(missingIDs(ids, consignments), ", "))
	}
	var undelivered []string
	for _, c := range consignments {
		if c.Status != domain.ConsignmentStatusDelivered {
			undelivered = append(undelivered, c.ID)
		}
	}
	if len(undelivered) > 0 {
		return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("CONSIGNMENT_NOT_DELIVERED",
			"only DELIVERED consignments can be pooled into a BMC lot").
			WithDetails(map[string]any{"consignment_ids": undelivered})
	}

	// Optimistic claim: flip DELIVERED→ACCEPTED stamped with the new lot ID.
	// If another lot raced us on any consignment, release our claims and bail.
	lotID := uuid.NewString()
	claimed, err := s.repo.ClaimConsignments(ctx, ids, lotID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	if claimed != int64(len(ids)) {
		if relErr := s.repo.ReleaseConsignments(ctx, lotID); relErr != nil {
			return nil, httpx.Internal(relErr)
		}
		return nil, httpx.Conflict("CONSIGNMENT_CLAIM_CONFLICT",
			"one or more consignments were pooled by another lot — reload and retry")
	}

	var totalLitres float64
	var tripIDs []string
	seenTrip := map[string]bool{}
	for _, c := range consignments {
		totalLitres += c.TotalQuantityLitres
		if c.RouteTripID != "" && !seenTrip[c.RouteTripID] {
			seenTrip[c.RouteTripID] = true
			tripIDs = append(tripIDs, c.RouteTripID)
		}
	}

	lot := &domain.BMCLot{
		ID:                  lotID,
		BMCID:               req.BMCID,
		Date:                date,
		Shift:               req.Shift,
		ConsignmentIDs:      ids,
		RouteTripIDs:        tripIDs,
		TotalQuantityLitres: totalLitres,
		Status:              domain.BMCLotStatusOpen,
		CreatedBy:           actor.PartyID,
		CreatedAt:           now,
	}
	if err := s.repo.InsertBMCLot(ctx, lot); err != nil {
		_ = s.repo.ReleaseConsignments(ctx, lotID)
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}

	refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, len(ids))
	for _, id := range ids {
		refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{
			EntityType: domain.EntityConsignment, EntityID: id, Relation: "pools",
		})
	}
	ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
		Type:       domain.EventBMCLotCreated,
		EntityType: domain.EntityBMCLot,
		EntityID:   lot.ID,
		Refs:       refs,
		Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
		OrgUnitID:  req.BMCID,
		Payload: map[string]any{
			"date": date, "shift": req.Shift, "total_quantity_litres": totalLitres,
		},
	})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	if err := s.repo.SetBMCLotProvenanceSeq(ctx, lot.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	lot.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
	return lot, nil
}

// CloseBMCLot transitions an OPEN lot to QC_PENDING with the chilling
// temperature. The quality module later flips QC_PENDING→PASSED/BLOCKED.
func (s *Service) CloseBMCLot(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id string, chillingTempC float64) (*domain.BMCLot, error) {
	lot, err := s.getBMCLot(ctx, id)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, lot.BMCID); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if lot.Status != domain.BMCLotStatusOpen {
		return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_NOT_OPEN",
			"only an OPEN lot can be closed; lot is "+lot.Status)
	}
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	ok, err := s.repo.CloseBMCLot(ctx, id, chillingTempC, now)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	if !ok {
		return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_NOT_OPEN",
			"lot changed state concurrently — reload and retry")
	}
	ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
		Type:       domain.EventBMCLotClosed,
		EntityType: domain.EntityBMCLot,
		EntityID:   lot.ID,
		Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
		OrgUnitID:  lot.BMCID,
		Payload:    map[string]any{"chilling_temp_c": chillingTempC},
	})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	if err := s.repo.SetBMCLotProvenanceSeq(ctx, lot.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	lot.Status = domain.BMCLotStatusQCPending
	lot.ChillingTempC = chillingTempC
	lot.ClosedAt = &now
	lot.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
	return lot, nil
}

// DispatchBMCLot transitions PASSED→DISPATCHED. THE safety gate (§8.3): a
// BLOCKED or untested lot never leaves the chilling centre.
func (s *Service) DispatchBMCLot(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id string) (*domain.BMCLot, error) {
	lot, err := s.getBMCLot(ctx, id)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, lot.BMCID); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if lot.Status == domain.BMCLotStatusDispatched {
		return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_ALREADY_DISPATCHED", "lot is already dispatched")
	}
	if !canDispatchBMCLot(lot.Status) {
		msg := "lot cannot be dispatched: safety gate not passed (status " + lot.Status + ")"
		if lot.BlockReason != "" {
			msg += " — " + lot.BlockReason
		}
		return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked, msg).
			WithDetails(map[string]any{"status": lot.Status, "block_reason": lot.BlockReason})
	}
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	ok, err := s.repo.DispatchBMCLot(ctx, id, now)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	if !ok {
		return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_STATE_CHANGED",
			"lot changed state concurrently — reload and retry")
	}
	lot.Status = domain.BMCLotStatusDispatched
	lot.DispatchedAt = &now
	return lot, nil
}

// ListBMCLots pages lots by BMC/date/status. A BMC operator may only list
// within their own scope; downstream readers (plant operator, supervisor,
// lab) see across BMCs — the plant receives tankers from sibling BMCs, so an
// ancestry check against the plant org would wrongly refuse them.
func (s *Service) ListBMCLots(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, f BMCLotListFilter, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.BMCLot, int64, error) {
	if f.BMCID != "" && actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleBMCOperator {
		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, f.BMCID); err != nil {
			return nil, 0, err
		}
	}
	lots, total, err := s.repo.ListBMCLots(ctx, f, page)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return lots, total, nil
}

// --- processing batches ---

// CreateBatch pools DISPATCHED (gate-passed) BMC lots into one production
// run. The gate re-checks here belt-and-braces: aflatoxin M1 survives
// pasteurisation, so a blocked lot must never reach a vat (§8.3).
func (s *Service) CreateBatch(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateBatchRequest) (*domain.ProcessingBatch, error) {
	if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.PlantID); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	org, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.PlantID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if org.Type != domain.OrgTypeProcessingPlant {
		return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_PLANT", "org unit "+req.PlantID+" is not a processing plant")
	}

	ids := dedupe(req.BMCLotIDs)
	lots, err := s.repo.BMCLotsByIDs(ctx, ids)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	if len(lots) != len(ids) {
		return nil, httpx.NotFound("BMC lot(s) " + strings.Join(missingLotIDs(ids, lots), ", "))
	}
	var offending []string
	var inputLitres float64
	for _, lot := range lots {
		if !canPoolBMCLot(lot.Status) {
			offending = append(offending, lot.ID)
			continue
		}
		inputLitres += lot.TotalQuantityLitres
	}
	if len(offending) > 0 {
		return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked,
			"one or more BMC lots have not cleared the safety gate (must be PASSED and DISPATCHED)").
			WithDetails(map[string]any{"blocked_lot_ids": offending})
	}

	now := time.Now().UTC()
	dateKey := domain.DateKeyIST(now)
	seq, err := s.repo.NextSequence(ctx, "batch_number:"+req.PlantID+":"+dateKey)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	batchNumber := fmt.Sprintf("BATCH-%s-%s-%04d",
		org.Code, strings.ReplaceAll(dateKey, "-", ""), seq)

	// CREATED is a transient birth state: the plant lab must clear every
	// batch, so it is persisted straight into QC_PENDING.
	batch := &domain.ProcessingBatch{
		ID:          uuid.NewString(),
		PlantID:     req.PlantID,
		BatchNumber: batchNumber,
		BMCLotIDs:   ids,
		ProductType: req.ProductType,
		InputLitres: inputLitres,
		Status:      domain.BatchStatusQCPending,
		StartedAt:   now,
		CreatedBy:   actor.PartyID,
		CreatedAt:   now,
	}
	if err := s.repo.InsertBatch(ctx, batch); err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}

	refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, len(ids))
	for _, id := range ids {
		refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{
			EntityType: domain.EntityBMCLot, EntityID: id, Relation: "pools",
		})
	}
	ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
		Type:       domain.EventBatchCreated,
		EntityType: domain.EntityBatch,
		EntityID:   batch.ID,
		Refs:       refs,
		Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
		OrgUnitID:  req.PlantID,
		Payload: map[string]any{
			"batch_number": batchNumber, "product_type": req.ProductType, "input_litres": inputLitres,
		},
	})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	if err := s.repo.SetBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx, batch.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	batch.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
	return batch, nil
}

// CompleteBatch transitions PASSED→COMPLETED — only a batch the plant lab
// cleared may finish and go on to yield product lots.
func (s *Service) CompleteBatch(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id string) (*domain.ProcessingBatch, error) {
	batch, err := s.getBatch(ctx, id)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, batch.PlantID); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if batch.Status == domain.BatchStatusCompleted {
		return nil, httpx.Conflict("BATCH_ALREADY_COMPLETED", "batch is already completed")
	}
	if !canCompleteBatch(batch.Status) {
		msg := "batch cannot complete: plant-lab QC not passed (status " + batch.Status + ")"
		if batch.BlockReason != "" {
			msg += " — " + batch.BlockReason
		}
		return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked, msg).
			WithDetails(map[string]any{"status": batch.Status, "block_reason": batch.BlockReason})
	}
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	ok, err := s.repo.CompleteBatch(ctx, id, now)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	if !ok {
		return nil, httpx.Conflict("BATCH_STATE_CHANGED",
			"batch changed state concurrently — reload and retry")
	}
	ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
		Type:       domain.EventBatchCompleted,
		EntityType: domain.EntityBatch,
		EntityID:   batch.ID,
		Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
		OrgUnitID:  batch.PlantID,
		Payload:    map[string]any{"batch_number": batch.BatchNumber},
	})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	if err := s.repo.SetBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx, batch.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	batch.Status = domain.BatchStatusCompleted
	batch.CompletedAt = &now
	batch.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
	return batch, nil
}

// GetBatch returns one batch (including its qc_result_ids) within scope.
func (s *Service) GetBatch(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id string) (*domain.ProcessingBatch, error) {
	batch, err := s.getBatch(ctx, id)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, batch.PlantID); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return batch, nil
}

// ListBatches pages batches by plant/status.
func (s *Service) ListBatches(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, f BatchListFilter, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.ProcessingBatch, int64, error) {
	if f.PlantID != "" {
		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, f.PlantID); err != nil {
			return nil, 0, err
		}
	}
	batches, total, err := s.repo.ListBatches(ctx, f, page)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return batches, total, nil
}

// --- product lots ---

// CreateProductLot packages a COMPLETED batch into a SKU lot (gate re-check).
func (s *Service) CreateProductLot(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateProductLotRequest) (*domain.ProductLot, error) {
	batch, err := s.getBatch(ctx, req.BatchID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, batch.PlantID); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if !canYieldProductLot(batch.Status) {
		msg := "batch has not completed the safety gate (status " + batch.Status + ") — no product lots may be made"
		if batch.BlockReason != "" {
			msg += " — " + batch.BlockReason
		}
		return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked, msg).
			WithDetails(map[string]any{"batch_status": batch.Status, "block_reason": batch.BlockReason})
	}

	now := time.Now().UTC()
	mfgDate := req.MfgDate
	if mfgDate == "" {
		mfgDate = domain.DateKeyIST(now)
	}
	if req.ExpiryDate <= mfgDate {
		return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_EXPIRY", "expiry_date must be after mfg_date")
	}

	lot := &domain.ProductLot{
		ID:          uuid.NewString(),
		BatchID:     batch.ID,
		PlantID:     batch.PlantID,
		SKU:         req.SKU,
		ProductName: req.ProductName,
		Units:       req.Units,
		UnitSize:    req.UnitSize,
		MRP:         req.MRP,
		MfgDate:     mfgDate,
		ExpiryDate:  req.ExpiryDate,
		Status:      domain.ProductLotStatusActive,
		CreatedAt:   now,
	}
	if err := s.repo.InsertProductLot(ctx, lot); err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
		Type:       domain.EventProductLotMade,
		EntityType: domain.EntityProductLot,
		EntityID:   lot.ID,
		Refs: []provenance.Ref{
			{EntityType: domain.EntityBatch, EntityID: batch.ID, Relation: "yields"},
		},
		Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
		OrgUnitID: batch.PlantID,
		Payload: map[string]any{
			"sku": req.SKU, "units": req.Units, "unit_size": req.UnitSize,
			"mfg_date": mfgDate, "expiry_date": req.ExpiryDate,
		},
	})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	if err := s.repo.SetProductLotProvenanceSeq(ctx, lot.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	lot.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
	return lot, nil
}

// RecallProductLot pulls a lot from market (FSSAI recall path, §18-C).
func (s *Service) RecallProductLot(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id, reason string) (*domain.ProductLot, error) {
	lot, err := s.getProductLot(ctx, id)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, lot.PlantID); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if lot.Status == domain.ProductLotStatusRecalled {
		return nil, httpx.Conflict("PRODUCT_LOT_ALREADY_RECALLED", "product lot is already recalled")
	}
	ok, err := s.repo.RecallProductLot(ctx, id, reason)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	if !ok {
		return nil, httpx.Conflict("PRODUCT_LOT_ALREADY_RECALLED", "product lot is already recalled")
	}
	ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
		Type:       domain.EventProductRecalled,
		EntityType: domain.EntityProductLot,
		EntityID:   lot.ID,
		Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
		OrgUnitID:  lot.PlantID,
		Payload:    map[string]any{"reason": reason},
	})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	if err := s.repo.SetProductLotProvenanceSeq(ctx, lot.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	lot.Status = domain.ProductLotStatusRecalled
	lot.RecallReason = reason
	lot.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
	return lot, nil
}

// --- QR issuance ---

// qrAlphabet is the 32-character human-safe set for short codes: A–Z and 2–9
// minus the confusables 0/O and 1/I. 32 divides 256, so a byte modulo the
// alphabet length is unbiased.
const qrAlphabet = "ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789"

// qrCodeLength is the number of random characters after the "PRG-" prefix
// (32^8 ≈ 1.1 trillion codes — collisions are retried on the unique index).
const qrCodeLength = 8

// newQRCode mints a short public code like "[REDACTED:generic-api-key]" from crypto/rand.
func newQRCode() (string, error) {
	buf := make([]byte, qrCodeLength)
	if _, err := rand.Read(buf); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	code := make([]byte, qrCodeLength)
	for i, b := range buf {
		code[i] = qrAlphabet[int(b)%len(qrAlphabet)]
	}
	return "PRG-" + string(code), nil
}

// signQRToken builds the forgery-proof token printed inside the QR:
// base64url(qr_code|product_lot_id|issued_unix) + "." + hex(HMAC-SHA256).
// The consumer app resolves the payload; the signature proves it was minted
// by this server, so IDs cannot be guessed onto counterfeit packs.
func signQRToken(secret, qrCode, productLotID string, issuedAt time.Time) string {
	payload := qrCode + "|" + productLotID + "|" + strconv.FormatInt(issuedAt.Unix(), 10)
	mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte(secret))
	mac.Write([]byte(payload))
	return base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(payload)) + "." + hex.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))
}

// parseQRToken verifies and unpacks a signed QR token.
func parseQRToken(secret, token string) (qrCode, productLotID string, issuedAt time.Time, err error) {
	payloadB64, sigHex, found := strings.Cut(token, ".")
	if !found {
		return "", "", time.Time{}, errors.New("qr token: missing signature separator")
	}
	payloadBytes, err := base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString(payloadB64)
	if err != nil {
		return "", "", time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("qr token: bad payload encoding: %w", err)
	}
	sig, err := hex.DecodeString(sigHex)
	if err != nil {
		return "", "", time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("qr token: bad signature encoding: %w", err)
	}
	mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte(secret))
	mac.Write(payloadBytes)
	if !hmac.Equal(sig, mac.Sum(nil)) {
		return "", "", time.Time{}, errors.New("qr token: signature mismatch")
	}
	parts := strings.Split(string(payloadBytes), "|")
	if len(parts) != 3 {
		return "", "", time.Time{}, errors.New("qr token: malformed payload")
	}
	unix, err := strconv.ParseInt(parts[2], 10, 64)
	if err != nil {
		return "", "", time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("qr token: bad timestamp: %w", err)
	}
	return parts[0], parts[1], time.Unix(unix, 0).UTC(), nil
}

// IssueQR mints one signed QR for an ACTIVE product lot whose batch is
// COMPLETED — the gate is re-checked at mint time so recalled or blocked
// product can never be freshly labelled.
func (s *Service) IssueQR(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, productLotID string) (*domain.BatchQR, error) {
	lot, err := s.getProductLot(ctx, productLotID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, lot.PlantID); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	batch, err := s.getBatch(ctx, lot.BatchID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if !canIssueQR(lot.Status, batch.Status) {
		return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked,
			"QR issuance refused: product lot must be ACTIVE and its batch COMPLETED").
			WithDetails(map[string]any{
				"product_lot_status": lot.Status,
				"batch_status":       batch.Status,
				"recall_reason":      lot.RecallReason,
			})
	}

	now := time.Now().UTC()
	var qr *domain.BatchQR
	const maxMintAttempts = 5
	for attempt := 0; attempt < maxMintAttempts; attempt++ {
		code, err := newQRCode()
		if err != nil {
			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
		}
		candidate := &domain.BatchQR{
			ID:           uuid.NewString(),
			QRCode:       code,
			ProductLotID: lot.ID,
			SignedToken:  signQRToken(s.qrSecret, code, lot.ID, now),
			IssuedBy:     actor.PartyID,
			ScanCount:    0,
			IssuedAt:     now,
		}
		insertErr := s.repo.InsertQR(ctx, candidate)
		if insertErr == nil {
			qr = candidate
			break
		}
		if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(insertErr) {
			continue // short-code collision — regenerate
		}
		return nil, httpx.Internal(insertErr)
	}
	if qr == nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("qr mint: %d consecutive short-code collisions", maxMintAttempts))
	}

	ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
		Type:       domain.EventQRIssued,
		EntityType: domain.EntityBatchQR,
		EntityID:   qr.ID,
		Refs: []provenance.Ref{
			{EntityType: domain.EntityProductLot, EntityID: lot.ID, Relation: "labels"},
		},
		Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
		OrgUnitID: lot.PlantID,
		Payload:   map[string]any{"qr_code": qr.QRCode},
	})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	if err := s.repo.SetQRProvenanceSeq(ctx, qr.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	qr.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
	return qr, nil
}

// ListQRs pages QRs, optionally narrowed to one product lot (scope-checked
// through the lot's plant).
func (s *Service) ListQRs(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, f QRListFilter, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.BatchQR, int64, error) {
	if f.ProductLotID != "" {
		lot, err := s.getProductLot(ctx, f.ProductLotID)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, 0, err
		}
		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, lot.PlantID); err != nil {
			return nil, 0, err
		}
	}
	qrs, total, err := s.repo.ListQRs(ctx, f, page)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return qrs, total, nil
}

// --- small lookups + helpers ---

func (s *Service) getBMCLot(ctx context.Context, id string) (*domain.BMCLot, error) {

	if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {

}

func (s *Service) getBatch(ctx context.Context, id string) (*domain.ProcessingBatch, error) {
	batch, err := s.repo.BatchByID(ctx, id)
	if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
		return nil, httpx.NotFound("processing batch")

	return batch, nil
}

func (s *Service) getProductLot(ctx context.Context, id string) (*domain.ProductLot, error) {
	lot, err := s.repo.ProductLotByID(ctx, id)

	}

	}
	return lot, nil
}

// dedupe removes duplicate IDs preserving first-seen order.
func dedupe(ids []string) []string {
	seen := make(map[string]bool, len(ids))
	out := make([]string, 0, len(ids))
	for _, id := range ids {
		if id == "" || seen[id] {
			continue
		}
		seen[id] = true
		out = append(out, id)
	}
	return out
}

// missingIDs lists requested consignment IDs absent from the fetched set.
func missingIDs(wanted []string, got []domain.DCSConsignment) []string {
	have := make(map[string]bool, len(got))
	for _, c := range got {
		have[c.ID] = true
	}
	var missing []string
	for _, id := range wanted {
		if !have[id] {
			missing = append(missing, id)
		}
	}
	return missing
}

// missingLotIDs lists requested BMC lot IDs absent from the fetched set.
func missingLotIDs(wanted []string, got []domain.BMCLot) []string {
	have := make(map[string]bool, len(got))
	for _, l := range got {
		have[l.ID] = true
	}
	var missing []string
	for _, id := range wanted {
		if !have[id] {
			missing = append(missing, id)
		}
	}
	return missing
}

177	// ---- Support: audited limited-PII lookup (§5.2 role 20) ----
178	
179	// lookupParty resolves a phone to the limited support view. EVERY call —
180	// hit or miss — is recorded as "support.pii_lookup": PII access is audited,
181	// full stop.
182	func (s *service) lookupParty(ctx context.Context, phone string) (*PartyLookupResponse, error) {
183		party, findErr := s.repo.findPartyByPhone(ctx, phone)
184	
185		entry := audit.Entry{
186			Action:     "support.pii_lookup",
187			TargetType: "PARTY",
188			Meta:       map[string]any{"phone": phone, "found": findErr == nil},
189		}
190		if findErr == nil {
191			entry.TargetID = party.ID
192		}
193		s.deps.Audit.Record(ctx, entry)
194	
195		if findErr != nil {
196			return nil, findErr
197		}
198	
199		assignments, err := s.repo.listActiveAssignmentsForParty(ctx, party.ID)
200		if err != nil {
201			return nil, err
202		}
203		now := time.Now().UTC()
204		roles := []PartyRoleView{}
205		for _, assignment := range assignments {
206			if !assignment.UsableAt(now) {
207				continue
208			}
209			orgName := ""
210			if org, orgErr := s.deps.Orgs.Get(ctx, assignment.OrgUnitID); orgErr == nil {
211				orgName = org.Name
212			}
213			roles = append(roles, PartyRoleView{
214				RoleCode:  assignment.RoleCode,
215				OrgUnitID: assignment.OrgUnitID,
216				OrgName:   orgName,
217			})
218		}
219	
220		// Limited PII by construction: no KYC document numbers, no bank details.
221		return &PartyLookupResponse{
222			PartyID:  party.ID,
223			FullName: party.FullName,
224			KYCTier:  party.KYCTier,
225			Status:   party.Status,
226			Roles:    roles,
227		}, nil
228	}
229	
230	// ---- Event-bus reactions: cross-module SMS queuing ----
231	
232	// decodeBusPayload structurally re-decodes a bus payload into this module's
233	// mirror struct — modules never import each other's types (module contract).
234	func decodeBusPayload(payload any, dst any) error {
235		raw, err := json.Marshal(payload)
236		if err != nil {
237			return fmt.Errorf("marshal bus payload: %w", err)
238		}
239		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, dst); err != nil {
240			return fmt.Errorf("unmarshal bus payload: %w", err)
241		}
242		return nil
243	}

// Package config loads all runtime configuration from the environment.
// A local `.env` file is read first (dev convenience, never committed);
// real environment variables always win. There are NO in-code connection
// strings: the server refuses to boot without MONGO_URI.
package config

import (
	"bufio"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

// Config is the fully resolved runtime configuration.
type Config struct {
	Env      string // dev | prod
	Port     int
	LogLevel string

	MongoURI string
	MongoDB  string

	JWTSecret       string
	QRSigningSecret string
	OTPHashSecret   string

	AccessTokenTTL  time.Duration
	RefreshTokenTTL time.Duration
	OTPTTL          time.Duration
	OTPDevMode      bool // true → OTP echoed in API response instead of SMS (dev only)

	RateLimitRPS   float64
	RateLimitBurst int

	SeedAdminPhone string
}

// IsProd reports whether the server runs with production hardening.
func (c *Config) IsProd() bool { return c.Env == "prod" }

// Load reads `.env` (if present) then the process environment, validates the
// result, and returns the Config. Missing MONGO_URI is a hard error.
func Load() (*Config, error) {
	loadDotEnv(".env")

	cfg := &Config{
		Env:             envStr("ENV", "dev"),
		Port:            envInt("PORT", 8080),
		LogLevel:        envStr("LOG_LEVEL", "info"),
		MongoURI:        os.Getenv("MONGO_URI"),
		MongoDB:         envStr("MONGO_DB", "saathi"),
		JWTSecret:       envStr("JWT_SECRET", ""),
		QRSigningSecret: envStr("QR_SIGNING_SECRET", ""),
		OTPHashSecret:   envStr("OTP_HASH_SECRET", ""),
		AccessTokenTTL:  time.Duration(envInt("ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES", 15)) * time.Minute,
		RefreshTokenTTL: time.Duration(envInt("REFRESH_TOKEN_TTL_DAYS", 30)) * 24 * time.Hour,
		OTPTTL:          time.Duration(envInt("OTP_TTL_MINUTES", 5)) * time.Minute,
		OTPDevMode:      envBool("OTP_DEV_MODE", false),
		RateLimitRPS:    envFloat("RATE_LIMIT_RPS", 50),
		RateLimitBurst:  envInt("RATE_LIMIT_BURST", 100),
		SeedAdminPhone:  envStr("SEED_ADMIN_PHONE", "9999999999"),
	}

	if cfg.MongoURI == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("MONGO_URI is required and must be set via environment (no in-code default); see .env.example")
	}
	if cfg.JWTSecret == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("JWT_SECRET is required; see .env.example")
	}
	if cfg.QRSigningSecret == "" {
		cfg.QRSigningSecret = cfg.JWTSecret + ":qr" // derived fallback for dev only
	}
	if cfg.OTPHashSecret == "" {
		cfg.OTPHashSecret = cfg.JWTSecret + ":otp"
	}

	if cfg.IsProd() {
		if strings.Contains(cfg.JWTSecret, "dev-only") {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("refusing to start in prod with a dev-only JWT_SECRET")
		}
		if cfg.OTPDevMode {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("refusing to start in prod with OTP_DEV_MODE=true (OTPs would leak in API responses)")
		}
	}
	return cfg, nil
}

// loadDotEnv parses KEY=VALUE lines from path into the process environment,
// without overriding variables that are already set.
func loadDotEnv(path string) {
	f, err := os.Open(path)
	if err != nil {
		return // optional file
	}
	defer f.Close()

	sc := bufio.NewScanner(f)
	for sc.Scan() {
		line := strings.TrimSpace(sc.Text())
		if line == "" || strings.HasPrefix(line, "#") {
			continue
		}
		key, val, ok := strings.Cut(line, "=")
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		key = strings.TrimSpace(key)
		val = strings.TrimSpace(val)
		val = strings.Trim(val, `"'`)
		if key != "" && os.Getenv(key) == "" {
			os.Setenv(key, val)
		}
	}
}

func envStr(key, def string) string {
	if v := os.Getenv(key); v != "" {
		return v
	}
	return def
}

func envInt(key string, def int) int {
	if v := os.Getenv(key); v != "" {
		if n, err := strconv.Atoi(v); err == nil {
			return n
		}
	}
	return def
}

func envFloat(key string, def float64) float64 {
	if v := os.Getenv(key); v != "" {
		if f, err := strconv.ParseFloat(v, 64); err == nil {
			return f
		}
	}
	return def
}

func envBool(key string, def bool) bool {
	if v := os.Getenv(key); v != "" {
		if b, err := strconv.ParseBool(v); err == nil {
			return b
		}
	}
	return def
}

53	// validatePashuAadhaar enforces the national ear-tag format: exactly 12
54	// ASCII digits (§9). Pure function — unit tested.
55	func validatePashuAadhaar(id string) *httpx.AppError {
56		if len(id) != 12 {
57			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_PASHU_AADHAAR", "pashu_aadhaar must be exactly 12 digits")
58		}
59		for i := 0; i < len(id); i++ {
60			if id[i] < '0' || id[i] > '9' {
61				return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_PASHU_AADHAAR", "pashu_aadhaar must contain digits only")
62			}
63		}
64		return nil
65	}

67	// resolveAnimalOwner decides who the registered animal belongs to. A FARMER
68	// may only register their own animals (any explicit owner_party_id must match
69	// the caller); every other registrar role must name the owner explicitly.
70	// Pure function — unit tested.
71	func resolveAnimalOwner(actor auth.Actor, requestedOwner string) (string, *httpx.AppError) {
72		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleFarmer {
73			if requestedOwner != "" && requestedOwner != actor.PartyID {
74				return "", httpx.Forbidden("farmers may only register their own animals")
75			}
76			return actor.PartyID, nil
77		}
78		if requestedOwner == "" {
79			return "", httpx.BadRequest("OWNER_REQUIRED", "owner_party_id is required when registering on a farmer's behalf")
80		}
81		return requestedOwner, nil
82	}

90	// an animal or its health history. v1 deliberately ships the role check only.
91	func canViewAnimal(actor auth.Actor, animal *domain.Animal) *httpx.AppError {

102	func (s *service) appendLedger(ctx context.Context, in provenance.AppendInput) {

209	func (s *service) LogHealthEvent(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, animalID string, req LogHealthEventRequest) (*domain.HealthEvent, error) {
210		if _, ok := validHealthEventTypes[req.Type]; !ok {
211			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_HEALTH_EVENT_TYPE", "type must be one of the catalog health event types")
212		}
213		animal, err := s.repo.FindAnimalByID(ctx, animalID)
214		if err != nil {
215			return nil, err
216		}
217		if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, animal.DCSID); err != nil {
218			return nil, err
219		}
220	
221		now := time.Now().UTC()
222		occurredAt := now
223		if req.OccurredAt != nil {
224			occurredAt = req.OccurredAt.UTC()
225		}
226		event := &domain.HealthEvent{
227			ID:              uuid.NewString(),
228			AnimalID:        animal.ID,
229			PashuAadhaar:    animal.PashuAadhaar,
230			Type:            req.Type,
231			Details:         req.Details,
232			RecordedByParty: actor.PartyID,
233			RecordedByRole:  actor.RoleCode,
234			OccurredAt:      occurredAt,
235			BharatPashudhan: domain.BPSyncPending, // pushed later via /bp-sync
236			CreatedAt:       now,
237		}
238		if err := s.repo.InsertHealthEvent(ctx, event); err != nil {
239			return nil, err
240		}
241	
242		// The ledger event lands on the animal's timeline (there is no dedicated
243		// health-event entity type); the ref pins the animal it was recorded for.
244		s.appendLedger(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
245			Type:       domain.EventHealthEventLogged,
246			EntityType: domain.EntityAnimal,
247			EntityID:   animal.ID,
248			Refs: []provenance.Ref{
249				{EntityType: domain.EntityAnimal, EntityID: animal.ID, Relation: "recorded_for"},
250			},
251			Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
252			OrgUnitID: animal.DCSID,
253			Payload: map[string]any{
254				"health_event_id": event.ID,
255				"type":            event.Type,
256			},
257		})
258		return event, nil
259	}

261	// SyncBharatPashudhan is the MOCK national-DB push (§9): it marks every
262	// PENDING health event of the animal SYNCED under a mock reference. The real
263	// integration replaces this method body — API and data shapes stay put.
264	func (s *service) SyncBharatPashudhan(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, animalID string) (*BPSyncResponse, error) {
265		animal, err := s.repo.FindAnimalByID(ctx, animalID)
266		if err != nil {
267			return nil, err
268		}
269		if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, animal.DCSID); err != nil {
270			return nil, err
271		}
272		ref := "BP-MOCK-" + uuid.NewString()[:8]
273		count, err := s.repo.MarkPendingHealthEventsSynced(ctx, animal.ID, ref)
274		if err != nil {
275			return nil, err
276		}
277		return &BPSyncResponse{SyncedCount: count, BPSyncRef: ref}, nil
278	}

280	// CreateMVUCase opens a 1962 MVU request (§10). The DCS comes from the
281	// farmer's own animal when animal_id is given, else from the actor's org.
282	func (s *service) CreateMVUCase(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateMVUCaseRequest) (*domain.MVUCase, error) {
283		if strings.TrimSpace(req.Symptoms) == "" {
284			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("SYMPTOMS_REQUIRED", "symptoms description is required")
285		}
286	
287		dcsID := actor.OrgUnitID
288		animalID := ""
289		if req.AnimalID != "" {
290			animal, err := s.repo.FindAnimalByID(ctx, req.AnimalID)
291			if err != nil {
292				return nil, err
293			}
294			if animal.OwnerPartyID != actor.PartyID {
295				return nil, httpx.Forbidden("you may only raise an MVU case for your own animal")
296			}
297			animalID = animal.ID
298			dcsID = animal.DCSID
299		}
300		if dcsID == "" {
301			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("DCS_UNRESOLVED", "cannot resolve a DCS for this case — provide animal_id or use a DCS-scoped role token")
302		}
303	
304		mvuCase := &domain.MVUCase{
305			ID:            uuid.NewString(),
306			AnimalID:      animalID,
307			FarmerPartyID: actor.PartyID,
308			DCSID:         dcsID,
309			Symptoms:      strings.TrimSpace(req.Symptoms),
310			Status:        domain.MVUCaseRequested,
311			RequestedAt:   time.Now().UTC(),
312		}
313		if err := s.repo.InsertMVUCase(ctx, mvuCase); err != nil {
314			return nil, err
315		}
316		return mvuCase, nil
317	}
318	
319	// DispatchMVUCase moves a case REQUESTED → DISPATCHED, records the assignee
320	// from the caller's role, and publishes eventbus.TopicMVUDispatched with a
321	// *domain.MVUCase payload (the notifications module reacts, §10).
322	func (s *service) DispatchMVUCase(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, caseID string) (*domain.MVUCase, error) {
323		mvuCase, err := s.repo.FindMVUCaseByID(ctx, caseID)
324		if err != nil {
325			return nil, err
326		}
327		if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, mvuCase.DCSID); err != nil {
328			return nil, err
329		}
330	
331		var vetPartyID, driverPartyID string
332		switch actor.RoleCode {
333		case domain.RoleVeterinarian:
334			vetPartyID = actor.PartyID
335		case domain.RoleMVUDriver:
336			driverPartyID = actor.PartyID
337			// Any other role reaching here is break-glass SUPER_ADMIN: the case
338			// is dispatched without pinning an assignee.
339		}
340	
341		transitioned, err := s.repo.DispatchMVUCase(ctx, mvuCase.ID, vetPartyID, driverPartyID)
342		if err != nil {
343			return nil, err
344		}
345		if !transitioned {
346			return nil, httpx.Conflict("MVU_NOT_REQUESTED", "MVU case is not in REQUESTED state")
347		}
348	
349		updated, err := s.repo.FindMVUCaseByID(ctx, mvuCase.ID)
350		if err != nil {
351			return nil, err
352		}
353		s.d.Bus.Publish(eventbus.TopicMVUDispatched, updated)
354		return updated, nil
355	}
356	
357	// CloseMVUCase moves a DISPATCHED/ARRIVED case to CLOSED with the visit log.

359		if strings.TrimSpace(req.VisitNotes) == "" {
360			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VISIT_NOTES_REQUIRED", "visit_notes is required to close a case")
361		}
362		mvuCase, err := s.repo.FindMVUCaseByID(ctx, caseID)
363		if err != nil {
364			return nil, err
365		}
366		if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, mvuCase.DCSID); err != nil {
367			return nil, err
368		}
369	
370		transitioned, err := s.repo.CloseMVUCase(ctx, mvuCase.ID, strings.TrimSpace(req.VisitNotes), req.HealthEventIDs, time.Now().UTC())
371		if err != nil {
372			return nil, err
373		}
374		if !transitioned {
375			return nil, httpx.Conflict("MVU_NOT_OPEN", "MVU case must be DISPATCHED or ARRIVED to close")
376		}
377		return s.repo.FindMVUCaseByID(ctx, mvuCase.ID)
378	}

401	// CreateEducation adds an item to the education hub. Published defaults to
402	// true: v1 has no separate publish step, so unpublished items would be
403	// unreachable.
404	func (s *service) CreateEducation(ctx context.Context, req CreateEducationRequest) (*domain.EducationContent, error) {
405		if req.Topic == "" || req.Title == "" || req.Language == "" || req.MediaType == "" || req.MediaURL == "" {
406			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("EDUCATION_FIELDS_REQUIRED", "topic, title, language, media_type and media_url are required")
407		}
408		published := true
409		if req.Published != nil {

411		}
412		content := &domain.EducationContent{

418			MediaURL:    req.MediaURL,

429	// IngestTelemetry is the dormant collar path (§9). The capability gate runs
430	// FIRST: while flags.FlagCollarTelemetry is off the endpoint refuses with
431	// FEATURE_DISABLED, proving the backdoor is provisioned but inert. When the
432	// scheme lands and the flag flips, frames are acknowledged with 202 — the
433	// storage pipeline ships with the scheme, not before.
434	func (s *service) IngestTelemetry(ctx context.Context, req TelemetryRequest) (*TelemetryAck, error) {
435		if !s.d.Flags.Enabled(ctx, flags.FlagCollarTelemetry) {
436			aerr := httpx.Forbidden("collar telemetry is provisioned but dormant (§9)")
437			aerr.Code = "FEATURE_DISABLED"
438			return nil, aerr
439		}
440		if err := validatePashuAadhaar(req.PashuAadhaar); err != nil {
441			return nil, err
442		}
443		return &TelemetryAck{
444			Accepted:     true,
445			PashuAadhaar: req.PashuAadhaar,
446			Note:         "telemetry accepted; persistent storage lands with the collar scheme",
447		}, nil

```text
package middleware

import (
	"net/http"

	chimw "github.com/go-chi/chi/v5/middleware"

	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/audit"
)

// AuditMutations records every state-changing request (non-GET/HEAD/OPTIONS)
// into the immutable audit trail: actor, action, status, IP, request ID.
// Runs after the handler so the final status code is captured; the write
// itself is async and adds no request latency.
func AuditMutations(rec *audit.Recorder) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
		return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			if r.Method == http.MethodGet || r.Method == http.MethodHead || r.Method == http.MethodOptions {
				next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
				return
			}
			ww := chimw.NewWrapResponseWriter(w, r.ProtoMajor)
			next.ServeHTTP(ww, r)

			rec.Record(r.Context(), audit.Entry{
				Action:    "http." + r.Method + " " + r.URL.Path,
				Status:    ww.Status(),
				IP:        r.RemoteAddr,
				RequestID: chimw.GetReqID(r.Context()),
			})
		})
	}
}
// Package audit writes the immutable who-did-what trail required for
// government accountability and DPDP breach forensics (blueprint §12, §16).
// Entries are insert-only; the STATE_AUDITOR role reads them via the
// platformops module.
package audit

import (
	"context"
	"log/slog"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"

	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
)

const collection = "audit_logs"

// Entry is one audit record.
type Entry struct {
	ID           string         `bson:"_id"            json:"id"`
	ActorPartyID string         `bson:"actor_party_id" json:"actor_party_id"`
	ActorRole    string         `bson:"actor_role,omitempty" json:"actor_role,omitempty"`
	Action       string         `bson:"action"         json:"action"` // e.g. "http.POST /api/v1/collection/pours" or "support.pii_lookup"
	TargetType   string         `bson:"target_type,omitempty" json:"target_type,omitempty"`
	TargetID     string         `bson:"target_id,omitempty"   json:"target_id,omitempty"`
	Status       int            `bson:"status,omitempty"      json:"status,omitempty"`
	IP           string         `bson:"ip,omitempty"          json:"ip,omitempty"`
	RequestID    string         `bson:"request_id,omitempty"  json:"request_id,omitempty"`
	Meta         map[string]any `bson:"meta,omitempty"        json:"meta,omitempty"`
	TS           time.Time      `bson:"ts"             json:"ts"`
}

// Recorder persists audit entries asynchronously so auditing never adds
// latency to the request path.
type Recorder struct {
	coll *mongo.Collection
	log  *slog.Logger
}

// NewRecorder binds the recorder to the database.
func NewRecorder(db *mongo.Database, log *slog.Logger) *Recorder {
	return &Recorder{coll: db.Collection(collection), log: log}
}

// Record fills identity fields from the request context and persists the
// entry in the background (fire-and-forget with its own timeout).
func (r *Recorder) Record(ctx context.Context, e Entry) {
	if a, ok := auth.ActorFrom(ctx); ok {
		if e.ActorPartyID == "" {
			e.ActorPartyID = a.PartyID
		}
		if e.ActorRole == "" {
			e.ActorRole = a.RoleCode
		}
	}
	e.ID = uuid.NewString()
	e.TS = time.Now().UTC()

	go func() {
		writeCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
		defer cancel()
		if _, err := r.coll.InsertOne(writeCtx, e); err != nil {
			r.log.Error("audit write failed", slog.String("action", e.Action), slog.Any("err", err))
		}
	}()
}

16	// repo owns every MongoDB access for the logistics module. It returns raw
17	// driver errors (including mongo.ErrNoDocuments); the service layer maps
18	// them to httpx errors. No business logic lives here.
19	type repo struct {
20		consignments *mongo.Collection
21		trips        *mongo.Collection
22		pours        *mongo.Collection // read-only view into the collection module's pours (sanctioned by spec)
23	}

25	// newRepo binds the repo to its collections via the shared name constants.
26	func newRepo(db *mongo.Database) *repo {
27		return &repo{
28			consignments: db.Collection(mongodb.CollConsignments),
29			trips:        db.Collection(mongodb.CollRouteTrips),
30			pours:        db.Collection(mongodb.CollMilkPours),
31		}
32	}

34	// pourRow is the projected slice of a milk pour needed for aggregation.
35	type pourRow struct {
36		ID             string  `bson:"_id"`
37		QuantityLitres float64 `bson:"quantity_litres"`
38		FatPct         float64 `bson:"fat_pct"`
39		SNFPct         float64 `bson:"snf_pct"`
40	}

42	// findRecordedPours returns the RECORDED pours of one DCS date+shift,
43	// projected down to the fields the consignment aggregate needs.
44	func (r *repo) findRecordedPours(ctx context.Context, dcsID, date, shift string) ([]pourRow, error) {
45		filter := bson.D{
46			{Key: "dcs_id", Value: dcsID},
47			{Key: "pour_date", Value: date},
48			{Key: "shift", Value: shift},
49			{Key: "status", Value: domain.PourStatusRecorded},
50		}
51		projection := bson.D{
52			{Key: "_id", Value: 1},
53			{Key: "quantity_litres", Value: 1},
54			{Key: "fat_pct", Value: 1},
55			{Key: "snf_pct", Value: 1},
56		}
57		cur, err := r.pours.Find(ctx, filter,
58			options.Find().SetProjection(projection).SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "created_at", Value: 1}}))
59		if err != nil {
60			return nil, err
61		}
62		var rows []pourRow
63		if err := cur.All(ctx, &rows); err != nil {
64			return nil, err
65		}
66		return rows, nil
67	}

72		_, err := r.consignments.InsertOne(ctx, c)
73		return err

78		var c domain.DCSConsignment
79		if err := r.consignments.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&c); err != nil {
80			return nil, err

86	// the status filter makes the guard atomic without transactions.
87	func (r *repo) markConsignmentDispatched(ctx context.Context, id string, at time.Time) (bool, error) {
88		res, err := r.consignments.UpdateOne(ctx,
89			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}, {Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusOpen}},
90			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
91				{Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusDispatch},
92				{Key: "dispatched_at", Value: at},
93			}}})
94		if err != nil {
95			return false, err
96		}
97		return res.MatchedCount > 0, nil
98	}
99	
100	// markConsignmentPickedUp transitions DISPATCHED→PICKED_UP and pins the
101	// carrying trip, guarded atomically by the status filter.
102	func (r *repo) markConsignmentPickedUp(ctx context.Context, id, tripID string) (bool, error) {
103		res, err := r.consignments.UpdateOne(ctx,
104			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}, {Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusDispatch}},
105			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
106				{Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusPickedUp},
107				{Key: "route_trip_id", Value: tripID},
108			}}})
109		if err != nil {
110			return false, err
111		}
112		return res.MatchedCount > 0, nil
113	}
114	
115	// markConsignmentsDelivered transitions every listed PICKED_UP consignment
116	// to DELIVERED (bulk companion of the trip delivery).

118		_, err := r.consignments.UpdateMany(ctx,
119			bson.D{
120				{Key: "_id", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: ids}}},
121				{Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusPickedUp},
122			},
123			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusDelivered}}}})
124		return err
125	}

136		filter := bson.D{}

148			return nil, 0, err
149		}
150		cur, err := r.consignments.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
151			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "created_at", Value: -1}}).
152			SetSkip(page.Offset).SetLimit(page.Limit))
153		if err != nil {
154			return nil, 0, err
155		}
156		items := []domain.DCSConsignment{}
157		if err := cur.All(ctx, &items); err != nil {
158			return nil, 0, err
159		}

// insertOTPChallenge stores a fresh challenge.
func (r *repository) insertOTPChallenge(ctx context.Context, ch otpChallenge) error {
	if _, err := r.challenges.InsertOne(ctx, ch); err != nil {
		return httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return nil
}

// latestOTPChallenge returns the most recent unexpired challenge for phone.
func (r *repository) latestOTPChallenge(ctx context.Context, phone string, now time.Time) (*otpChallenge, error) {
	filter := bson.D{
		{Key: "phone", Value: phone},
		{Key: "expires_at", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$gt", Value: now}}},
	}
	opts := options.FindOne().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "expires_at", Value: -1}})
	var ch otpChallenge
	err := r.challenges.FindOne(ctx, filter, opts).Decode(&ch)
	if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
		return nil, httpx.NotFound("otp challenge")
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return &ch, nil
}

// incrementOTPAttempts counts one failed verification attempt.
func (r *repository) incrementOTPAttempts(ctx context.Context, id string) error {
	_, err := r.challenges.UpdateByID(ctx, id, bson.D{
		{Key: "$inc", Value: bson.D{{Key: "attempts", Value: 1}}},
	})
	if err != nil {
		return httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return nil
}

// deleteOTPChallenges removes every challenge for a phone (post-login burn).
func (r *repository) deleteOTPChallenges(ctx context.Context, phone string) error {
	if _, err := r.challenges.DeleteMany(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "phone", Value: phone}}); err != nil {
		return httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	return nil
}

1	// Package provenance implements the append-only, hash-chained event ledger —
2	// the source of truth for milk traceability (blueprint §7). Every link in the
3	// pour→QR chain is an immutable Event whose SHA-256 hash covers the previous
4	// event's hash, so history cannot be quietly rewritten (tamper-evidence,
5	// FSSAI recall-grade audit).
6	//
7	// Corrections are NEW events referencing the superseded entity — nothing is
8	// ever updated or deleted in this collection.
9	package provenance
10	
11	import (
12		"context"
13		"crypto/sha256"
14		"encoding/hex"
15		"encoding/json"
16		"errors"
17		"fmt"
18		"strconv"
19		"strings"
20		"time"
21	
22		"github.com/google/uuid"
23		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
24		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
25		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo/options"
26	)
27	
28	const collection = "provenance_events"
29	
30	// Ref is a directed edge to another entity in the trace graph
31	// (e.g. a consignment event referencing the pours it aggregates).
32	type Ref struct {
33		EntityType string `bson:"entity_type" json:"entity_type"`
34		EntityID   string `bson:"entity_id"   json:"entity_id"`
35		Relation   string `bson:"relation"    json:"relation"` // aggregates | supersedes | tested | yields | labels ...
36	}
37	
38	// ActorRef records who caused the event.
39	type ActorRef struct {
40		PartyID  string `bson:"party_id"  json:"party_id"`
41		RoleCode string `bson:"role_code" json:"role_code"`
42	}
43	
44	// Event is one immutable link in the ledger.
45	type Event struct {
46		ID         string         `bson:"_id"         json:"id"`
47		Seq        int64          `bson:"seq"         json:"seq"`
48		Type       string         `bson:"type"        json:"type"`
49		EntityType string         `bson:"entity_type" json:"entity_type"`
50		EntityID   string         `bson:"entity_id"   json:"entity_id"`
51		Refs       []Ref          `bson:"refs,omitempty"    json:"refs,omitempty"`
52		Actor      ActorRef       `bson:"actor"       json:"actor"`
53		OrgUnitID  string         `bson:"org_unit_id,omitempty" json:"org_unit_id,omitempty"`
54		Payload    map[string]any `bson:"payload,omitempty"     json:"payload,omitempty"`
55		TS         time.Time      `bson:"ts"          json:"ts"`
56		PrevHash   string         `bson:"prev_hash"   json:"prev_hash"`
57		Hash       string         `bson:"hash"        json:"hash"`
58	}
59	
60	// AppendInput describes a new event to chain.
61	type AppendInput struct {
62		Type       string
63		EntityType string
64		EntityID   string
65		Refs       []Ref
66		Actor      ActorRef
67		OrgUnitID  string
68		Payload    map[string]any
69	}
70	
71	// Ledger appends to and reads the hash chain.
72	type Ledger struct {
73		coll *mongo.Collection
74	}
75	
76	// NewLedger binds the ledger to the database.
77	func NewLedger(db *mongo.Database) *Ledger {
78		return &Ledger{coll: db.Collection(collection)}
79	}
80	
81	// genesisHash anchors the chain before the first event.
82	const genesisHash = "GENESIS"
83	
84	// Append chains a new event. Concurrency-safe without transactions: it reads
85	// the current head, computes seq+hash optimistically, and relies on the
86	// unique index on `seq` — a duplicate-key collision means another writer won
87	// the slot, so we re-read and retry.
88	func (l *Ledger) Append(ctx context.Context, in AppendInput) (*Event, error) {
89		const maxRetries = 12
90		for attempt := 0; attempt < maxRetries; attempt++ {
91			seq, prevHash, err := l.head(ctx)
92			if err != nil {
93				return nil, err
94			}
95			ev := &Event{
96				ID:         uuid.NewString(),
97				Seq:        seq + 1,
98				Type:       in.Type,
99				EntityType: in.EntityType,
100				EntityID:   in.EntityID,
101				Refs:       in.Refs,
102				Actor:      in.Actor,
103				OrgUnitID:  in.OrgUnitID,
104				Payload:    in.Payload,
105				// Millisecond precision: BSON datetimes store ms, so the persisted
106				// TS must equal the hashed TS or re-verification would break.
107				TS:       time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Millisecond),
108				PrevHash: prevHash,
109			}
110			ev.Hash = computeHash(ev)
111	
112			if _, err := l.coll.InsertOne(ctx, ev); err != nil {
113				if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(err) {
114					continue // lost the seq race — retry against the new head
115				}
116				return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance append: %w", err)
117			}
118			return ev, nil
119		}
120		return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance append: gave up after %d seq collisions", 12)
121	}
122	
123	// head returns the latest (seq, hash), or (0, GENESIS) for an empty chain.
124	func (l *Ledger) head(ctx context.Context) (int64, string, error) {
125		var last Event
126		err := l.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{},
127			options.FindOne().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: -1}}),
128		).Decode(&last)
129		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
130			return 0, genesisHash, nil
131		}
132		if err != nil {
133			return 0, "", fmt.Errorf("provenance head: %w", err)
134		}
135		return last.Seq, last.Hash, nil
136	}
137	
138	// computeHash covers everything that matters: position, linkage, content.
139	// Payload is canonicalised via encoding/json (map keys are sorted) and the
140	// timestamp to millisecond precision (BSON datetime resolution), so the
141	// digest is deterministic across a MongoDB round trip.
142	func computeHash(ev *Event) string {
143		payloadJSON, _ := json.Marshal(ev.Payload)
144		refParts := make([]string, 0, len(ev.Refs))
145		for _, r := range ev.Refs {
146			refParts = append(refParts, r.EntityType+":"+r.EntityID+":"+r.Relation)
147		}
148		material := strings.Join([]string{
149			ev.PrevHash,
150			strconv.FormatInt(ev.Seq, 10),
151			ev.Type,
152			ev.EntityType,
153			ev.EntityID,
154			strings.Join(refParts, ","),
155			ev.Actor.PartyID,
156			ev.Actor.RoleCode,
157			ev.OrgUnitID,
158			string(payloadJSON),
159			ev.TS.UTC().Truncate(time.Millisecond).Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
160		}, "|")
161		sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(material))
162		return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
163	}
164	
165	// EventsForEntity returns an entity's own timeline in chain order.
166	func (l *Ledger) EventsForEntity(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string) ([]Event, error) {
167		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
168			bson.D{{Key: "entity_type", Value: entityType}, {Key: "entity_id", Value: entityID}},
169			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}),
170		)
171		if err != nil {
172			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance events for %s/%s: %w", entityType, entityID, err)
173		}
174		var out []Event
175		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
176			return nil, err
177		}
178		return out, nil
179	}
180	
181	// Trace walks the provenance graph UPSTREAM from an entity: its events, plus
182	// (recursively) the events of everything those events reference. This is how
183	// a consumer QR resolves back to the contributing samiti set, and how a failed
184	// aflatoxin test walks back to source DCSes (blueprint §8.3).
185	func (l *Ledger) Trace(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, maxDepth int) ([]Event, error) {
186		if maxDepth <= 0 {
187			maxDepth = 10
188		}
189		const hardEventCap = 2000
190	
191		type node struct{ etype, eid string }
192		visited := map[node]bool{}
193		frontier := []node{{entityType, entityID}}
194		var all []Event
195	
196		for depth := 0; depth < maxDepth && len(frontier) > 0; depth++ {
197			var next []node
198			for _, n := range frontier {
199				if visited[n] {
200					continue
201				}
202				visited[n] = true
203				evs, err := l.EventsForEntity(ctx, n.etype, n.eid)
204				if err != nil {
205					return nil, err
206				}
207				for _, ev := range evs {
208					all = append(all, ev)
209					if len(all) >= hardEventCap {
210						return all, nil
211					}
212					for _, ref := range ev.Refs {
213						nn := node{ref.EntityType, ref.EntityID}
214						if !visited[nn] {
215							next = append(next, nn)
216						}
217					}
218				}
219			}
220			frontier = next
221		}
222		return all, nil
223	}
224	
225	// DownstreamRefs finds events that reference the given entity — used to walk
226	// FORWARD (e.g. "which batches consumed this blocked BMC lot?").
227	func (l *Ledger) DownstreamRefs(ctx context.Context, entityID string) ([]Event, error) {
228		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
229			bson.D{{Key: "refs.entity_id", Value: entityID}},
230			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}),
231		)
232		if err != nil {
233			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance downstream of %s: %w", entityID, err)
234		}
235		var out []Event
236		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
237			return nil, err
238		}
239		return out, nil
240	}
241	
242	// VerifyChain re-derives every hash in [fromSeq, toSeq] and checks linkage.
243	// Returns (true, 0) when intact, or (false, seq) of the first broken link.
244	func (l *Ledger) VerifyChain(ctx context.Context, fromSeq, toSeq int64) (bool, int64, error) {
245		filter := bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$gte", Value: fromSeq}, {Key: "$lte", Value: toSeq}}}}
246		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}))
247		if err != nil {
248			return false, 0, fmt.Errorf("provenance verify: %w", err)
249		}
250		defer cur.Close(ctx)
251	
252		prevHash := ""
253		prevSeq := int64(0)
254		first := true
255		for cur.Next(ctx) {
256			var ev Event
257			if err := cur.Decode(&ev); err != nil {
258				return false, 0, err
259			}
260			if computeHash(&ev) != ev.Hash {
261				return false, ev.Seq, nil // content tampered
262			}
263			if !first {
264				if ev.Seq != prevSeq+1 || ev.PrevHash != prevHash {
265					return false, ev.Seq, nil // linkage broken
266				}
267			}
268			prevHash, prevSeq, first = ev.Hash, ev.Seq, false
269		}
270		return true, 0, cur.Err()
271	}
272	
273	// LatestSeq returns the current chain head sequence (0 = empty).
274	func (l *Ledger) LatestSeq(ctx context.Context) (int64, error) {
275		seq, _, err := l.head(ctx)
276		return seq, err
277	}

52	// Service resolves consumer QR scans and official trace queries. All reads,

63	// NewService wires the service from the shared dependency container.
64	func NewService(d *deps.Deps) *Service {

66			log:      d.Log,

74	// VerifyQRToken checks a stored signed token in the format QR issuance
75	// (plant module signQRToken) mints: "base64url(qr_code|product_lot_id|
76	// issued_unix)" + "." + hex(HMAC-SHA256(secret, decoded payload)). The HMAC
77	// is computed over the DECODED payload bytes — exactly what issuance signed.
78	// The comparison is constant-time so a forger learns nothing from response
79	// timing.
80	func VerifyQRToken(secret, token string) bool {
81		payloadB64, signature, found := strings.Cut(token, ".")
82		if !found || payloadB64 == "" || signature == "" {
83			return false // malformed: no payload/signature split
84		}
85		payload, err := base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString(payloadB64)
86		if err != nil || len(payload) == 0 {
87			return false // malformed: payload is not valid base64url
88		}
89		expected := auth.HMACHash(secret, string(payload))
90		return auth.ConstantTimeEqual(expected, signature)
91	}

93	// ScanQR resolves one consumer QR scan into the honest provenance view
94	// (§7.4): product + plant + lab certificate + the SET of contributing
95	// samitis — never per-farmer data — plus a live tamper-evidence check.
96	func (s *Service) ScanQR(ctx context.Context, qrCode string) (*QRScanResponse, error) {
97		qr, err := s.repo.qrByCode(ctx, qrCode)
98		if err != nil {
99			return nil, err
100		}
101	
102		// Integrity gate: the stored token must carry a valid HMAC. A mismatch
103		// means the QR record was tampered with or forged — surface it loudly.
104		if !VerifyQRToken(s.qrSecret, qr.SignedToken) {
105			s.log.Warn("QR signed-token integrity check failed — possible forgery",
106				slog.String("qr_code", qrCode), slog.String("qr_id", qr.ID))
107			return nil, httpx.Conflict("QR_INTEGRITY_FAILED",
108				"this QR code failed integrity verification and may be counterfeit")
109		}

111		// Count the scan without ever blocking it: fire-and-forget increment.
112		go func(qrID string) {
113			bg, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)

115			if err := s.repo.incrementScanCount(bg, qrID); err != nil {
116				s.log.Warn("scan_count increment failed", slog.String("qr_id", qrID), slog.Any("err", err))
117			}
118		}(qr.ID)

192	// buildSourcing derives the samiti-set view from traced consignment events:
193	// contributing DCS org ids from each event's org_unit_id/payload, collection
194	// dates from payloads, with the consignment documents as fallback when the
195	// events did not carry those fields.
196	func (s *Service) buildSourcing(ctx context.Context, events []provenance.Event) (*SourcingInfo, error) {
197		dcsIDs := map[string]struct{}{}
198		dates := map[string]struct{}{}
199		consignmentIDs := map[string]struct{}{}
200	
201		for _, ev := range events {
202			if ev.EntityType != domain.EntityConsignment {
203				continue
204			}
205			consignmentIDs[ev.EntityID] = struct{}{}
206			if ev.OrgUnitID != "" {
207				dcsIDs[ev.OrgUnitID] = struct{}{}
208			} else if v, ok := ev.Payload["dcs_id"].(string); ok && v != "" {
209				dcsIDs[v] = struct{}{}
210			}
211			if v, ok := ev.Payload["date"].(string); ok && v != "" {
212				dates[v] = struct{}{}
213			}
214		}
215	
216		// Fallback: if the events lacked DCS ids or dates, read the consignment
217		// docs themselves (still samiti-level — pour ids are never surfaced).
218		if len(consignmentIDs) > 0 && (len(dcsIDs) == 0 || len(dates) == 0) {
219			docs, err := s.repo.consignmentsByIDs(ctx, sortedKeys(consignmentIDs))
220			if err != nil {
221				return nil, err
222			}
223			for _, c := range docs {
224				if c.DCSID != "" {
225					dcsIDs[c.DCSID] = struct{}{}
226				}
227				if c.Date != "" {
228					dates[c.Date] = struct{}{}
229				}
230			}
231		}
232	
233		samitis := make([]SamitiInfo, 0, len(dcsIDs))
234		districts := map[string]struct{}{}
235		for _, id := range sortedKeys(dcsIDs) {
236			org, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, id)
237			if err != nil {
238				// A missing org unit must not break a consumer scan — log and skip.
239				s.log.Warn("QR scan: contributing DCS org not resolvable",
240					slog.String("dcs_org_id", id), slog.Any("err", err))
241				continue
242			}
243			samitis = append(samitis, SamitiInfo{Name: org.Name, Code: org.Code, District: org.District})
244			if org.District != "" {
245				districts[org.District] = struct{}{}
246			}
247		}
248		sort.Slice(samitis, func(i, j int) bool { return samitis[i].Name < samitis[j].Name })
249	
250		collectionDates := sortedKeys(dates)
251		return &SourcingInfo{
252			Message:         sourcingMessage(collectionDates, len(samitis), sortedKeys(districts)),
253			Samitis:         samitis,
254			CollectionDates: collectionDates,
255		}, nil
256	}

258	// sourcingMessage renders the consumer-facing pooled-provenance sentence,
259	// e.g. "Made from milk collected on 2026-07-05 from 3 samitis in Lucknow".
260	func sourcingMessage(dates []string, samitiCount int, districts []string) string {
261		var b strings.Builder
262		b.WriteString("Made from milk collected")
263		if len(dates) > 0 {
264			b.WriteString(" on " + strings.Join(dates, ", "))
265		}
266		noun := "samitis"
267		if samitiCount == 1 {
268			noun = "samiti"
269		}
270		fmt.Fprintf(&b, " from %d %s", samitiCount, noun)
271		if len(districts) > 0 {
272			b.WriteString(" in " + strings.Join(districts, ", "))
273		}
274		return b.String()
275	}
276	
277	// verifyTracedRange re-hashes the ledger over the [min,max] seq window of the
278	// traced events (tamper-evidence baked into every scan). Windows wider than
279	// scanVerifySpanCap are verified partially — the most recent tail — and
280	// flagged as such.
281	func (s *Service) verifyTracedRange(ctx context.Context, events []provenance.Event) (*LedgerInfo, error) {
282		if len(events) == 0 {
283			return &LedgerInfo{Events: 0, Intact: true, VerifiedRange: [2]int64{0, 0}}, nil
284		}
285		minSeq, maxSeq := events[0].Seq, events[0].Seq
286		for _, ev := range events[1:] {
287			if ev.Seq < minSeq {
288				minSeq = ev.Seq
289			}
290			if ev.Seq > maxSeq {
291				maxSeq = ev.Seq
292			}
293		}
294		from, partial := minSeq, false
295		if maxSeq-minSeq+1 > scanVerifySpanCap {
296			from, partial = maxSeq-scanVerifySpanCap+1, true
297		}
298		intact, _, err := s.ledger.VerifyChain(ctx, from, maxSeq)
299		if err != nil {
300			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
301		}
302		return &LedgerInfo{
303			Events:        len(events),
304			Intact:        intact,
305			VerifiedRange: [2]int64{from, maxSeq},
306			Partial:       partial,
307		}, nil
308	}
309	
310	// VerifyLedger runs the public tamper-evidence check over [from,to]. Both
311	// bounds are optional: `to` defaults to the chain head, `from` to the start
312	// of the last publicVerifySpanCap events. Spans over the cap are rejected.
313	func (s *Service) VerifyLedger(ctx context.Context, fromRaw, toRaw string) (*LedgerVerifyResponse, error) {
314		latest, err := s.ledger.LatestSeq(ctx)
315		if err != nil {
316			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
317		}
318		if latest == 0 {
319			return &LedgerVerifyResponse{Intact: true, From: 0, To: 0}, nil // empty chain is trivially intact
320		}
321	
322		to := latest
323		if toRaw != "" {
324			n, err := strconv.ParseInt(toRaw, 10, 64)
325			if err != nil || n < 1 {
326				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_RANGE", "'to' must be a positive sequence number")
327			}
328			to = min(n, latest)
329		}
330		from := max(int64(1), to-publicVerifySpanCap+1)
331		if fromRaw != "" {
332			n, err := strconv.ParseInt(fromRaw, 10, 64)
333			if err != nil || n < 1 {
334				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_RANGE", "'from' must be a positive sequence number")
335			}
336			from = n
337		}
338		if from > to {
339			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_RANGE", "'from' must not exceed 'to'")
340		}
341		if to-from+1 > publicVerifySpanCap {
342			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("SPAN_TOO_WIDE",
343				fmt.Sprintf("verification span is capped at %d events per request", publicVerifySpanCap))
344		}
345	
346		intact, brokenAt, err := s.ledger.VerifyChain(ctx, from, to)
347		if err != nil {
348			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
349		}
350		resp := &LedgerVerifyResponse{Intact: intact, From: from, To: to}
351		if !intact {
352			resp.BrokenAtSeq = &brokenAt
353		}
354		return resp, nil
355	}
356	
357	// TraceGraph returns the full event graph around one entity: upstream via
358	// the recursive ref walk, downstream via reverse-ref lookup — the recall /
359	// root-cause tool (§8.3).
360	func (s *Service) TraceGraph(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string) (*TraceGraphResponse, error) {
361		if err := validateEntityType(entityType); err != nil {
362			return nil, err
363		}
364		upstream, err := s.ledger.Trace(ctx, entityType, entityID, traceDepth)
365		if err != nil {
366			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
367		}
368		downstream, err := s.ledger.DownstreamRefs(ctx, entityID)
369		if err != nil {
370			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
371		}
372		if len(downstream) > downstreamEventCap {
373			downstream = downstream[len(downstream)-downstreamEventCap:]
374		}
375		if len(upstream) == 0 && len(downstream) == 0 {
376			return nil, httpx.NotFound("provenance for entity")
377		}
378		if upstream == nil {
379			upstream = []provenance.Event{}
380		}
381		if downstream == nil {
382			downstream = []provenance.Event{}
383		}
384		return &TraceGraphResponse{Upstream: upstream, Downstream: downstream}, nil
385	}
386	
387	// Timeline returns one entity's own events in chain order, paginated.
388	// The second return value is the total event count before paging.
389	func (s *Service) Timeline(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, page httpx.Page) ([]provenance.Event, int, error) {
390		if err := validateEntityType(entityType); err != nil {
391			return nil, 0, err
392		}
393		events, err := s.ledger.EventsForEntity(ctx, entityType, entityID)
394		if err != nil {
395			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
396		}
397		if len(events) == 0 {
398			return nil, 0, httpx.NotFound("provenance for entity")
399		}
400		total := len(events)
401		start := min(page.Offset, int64(total))
402		end := min(start+page.Limit, int64(total))
403		return events[start:end], total, nil
404	}
405	
406	// validateEntityType rejects entity types outside the domain.Entity* catalog.
407	func validateEntityType(entityType string) error {
408		if _, ok := validEntityTypes[entityType]; !ok {
409			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_ENTITY_TYPE",
410				"unknown entity type "+entityType+" — use one of the provenance entity type constants")
411		}
412		return nil
413	}
414	
415	// sortedKeys returns a set's keys in deterministic (lexicographic) order.
416	func sortedKeys(set map[string]struct{}) []string {
417		out := make([]string, 0, len(set))
418		for k := range set {
419			out = append(out, k)
420		}
421		sort.Strings(out)
422		return out
423	}

63	// NewService wires the service from the shared dependency container.
64	func NewService(d *deps.Deps) *Service {

74	// VerifyQRToken checks a stored signed token in the format QR issuance
75	// (plant module signQRToken) mints: "base64url(qr_code|product_lot_id|
76	// issued_unix)" + "." + hex(HMAC-SHA256(secret, decoded payload)). The HMAC
77	// is computed over the DECODED payload bytes — exactly what issuance signed.
78	// The comparison is constant-time so a forger learns nothing from response
79	// timing.
80	func VerifyQRToken(secret, token string) bool {
81		payloadB64, signature, found := strings.Cut(token, ".")
82		if !found || payloadB64 == "" || signature == "" {
83			return false // malformed: no payload/signature split
84		}
85		payload, err := base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString(payloadB64)
86		if err != nil || len(payload) == 0 {
87			return false // malformed: payload is not valid base64url
88		}
89		expected := auth.HMACHash(secret, string(payload))
90		return auth.ConstantTimeEqual(expected, signature)
91	}

93	// ScanQR resolves one consumer QR scan into the honest provenance view
94	// (§7.4): product + plant + lab certificate + the SET of contributing
95	// samitis — never per-farmer data — plus a live tamper-evidence check.
96	func (s *Service) ScanQR(ctx context.Context, qrCode string) (*QRScanResponse, error) {
97		qr, err := s.repo.qrByCode(ctx, qrCode)
98		if err != nil {
99			return nil, err
100		}
101	
102		// Integrity gate: the stored token must carry a valid HMAC. A mismatch
103		// means the QR record was tampered with or forged — surface it loudly.
104		if !VerifyQRToken(s.qrSecret, qr.SignedToken) {
105			s.log.Warn("QR signed-token integrity check failed — possible forgery",
106				slog.String("qr_code", qrCode), slog.String("qr_id", qr.ID))
107			return nil, httpx.Conflict("QR_INTEGRITY_FAILED",
108				"this QR code failed integrity verification and may be counterfeit")
109		}
110	
111		// Count the scan without ever blocking it: fire-and-forget increment.
112		go func(qrID string) {
113			bg, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
114			defer cancel()
115			if err := s.repo.incrementScanCount(bg, qrID); err != nil {
116				s.log.Warn("scan_count increment failed", slog.String("qr_id", qrID), slog.Any("err", err))
117			}
118		}(qr.ID)

120		lot, err := s.repo.productLotByID(ctx, qr.ProductLotID)
121		if err != nil {
122			return nil, err
123		}
124		batch, err := s.repo.batchByID(ctx, lot.BatchID)
125		if err != nil {
126			return nil, err
127		}
128		plant, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, batch.PlantID)
129		if err != nil {
130			return nil, err
131		}
132	
133		// Walk the provenance graph upstream from the product lot to the pooling
134		// boundary: batch → BMC lots → consignments (§7.4).
135		events, err := s.ledger.Trace(ctx, domain.EntityProductLot, lot.ID, traceDepth)
136		if err != nil {
137			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
138		}
139	
140		sourcing, err := s.buildSourcing(ctx, events)
141		if err != nil {
142			return nil, err
143		}
144	
145		ledgerInfo, err := s.verifyTracedRange(ctx, events)
146		if err != nil {
147			return nil, err
148		}
149	
150		resp := &QRScanResponse{
151			Product: ProductInfo{
152				Name:       lot.ProductName,
153				SKU:        lot.SKU,
154				UnitSize:   lot.UnitSize,
155				MfgDate:    lot.MfgDate,
156				ExpiryDate: lot.ExpiryDate,
157			},
158			BatchNumber: batch.BatchNumber,
159			Plant:       PlantInfo{Name: plant.Name, District: plant.District},
160			Sourcing:    *sourcing,
161			Ledger:      *ledgerInfo,
162			ScanCount:   qr.ScanCount + 1, // reflect this scan; the $inc lands async
163		}
164	
165		// PLANT_LAB pass certificate — omitted (not an error) when absent.
166		qc, err := s.repo.latestPlantLabPass(ctx, batch.ID)
167		if err != nil {
168			return nil, err
169		}
170		if qc != nil {
171			resp.Quality = &QualityInfo{
172				CertificateNumber: qc.CertificateNumber,
173				Stage:             qc.Stage,
174				Tests:             qc.Tests,
175				RecordedAt:        qc.RecordedAt,
176			}
177		}
178	
179		// A recalled lot still resolves with 200 — consumers must SEE the recall
180		// notice, not hit a dead link.
181		if lot.Status == domain.ProductLotStatusRecalled {
182			resp.Recalled = true
183			notice := "This product lot has been RECALLED. Do not consume — return it to the point of purchase."
184			if lot.RecallReason != "" {
185				notice += " Reason: " + lot.RecallReason
186			}
187			resp.RecallNotice = notice
188		}
189		return resp, nil
190	}

192	// buildSourcing derives the samiti-set view from traced consignment events:
193	// contributing DCS org ids from each event's org_unit_id/payload, collection
194	// dates from payloads, with the consignment documents as fallback when the
195	// events did not carry those fields.
196	func (s *Service) buildSourcing(ctx context.Context, events []provenance.Event) (*SourcingInfo, error) {
197		dcsIDs := map[string]struct{}{}
198		dates := map[string]struct{}{}
199		consignmentIDs := map[string]struct{}{}
200	
201		for _, ev := range events {
202			if ev.EntityType != domain.EntityConsignment {
203				continue
204			}
205			consignmentIDs[ev.EntityID] = struct{}{}
206			if ev.OrgUnitID != "" {
207				dcsIDs[ev.OrgUnitID] = struct{}{}
208			} else if v, ok := ev.Payload["dcs_id"].(string); ok && v != "" {
209				dcsIDs[v] = struct{}{}
210			}
211			if v, ok := ev.Payload["date"].(string); ok && v != "" {
212				dates[v] = struct{}{}
213			}
214		}
215	
216		// Fallback: if the events lacked DCS ids or dates, read the consignment
217		// docs themselves (still samiti-level — pour ids are never surfaced).
218		if len(consignmentIDs) > 0 && (len(dcsIDs) == 0 || len(dates) == 0) {
219			docs, err := s.repo.consignmentsByIDs(ctx, sortedKeys(consignmentIDs))
220			if err != nil {
221				return nil, err
222			}
223			for _, c := range docs {
224				if c.DCSID != "" {
225					dcsIDs[c.DCSID] = struct{}{}
226				}
227				if c.Date != "" {
228					dates[c.Date] = struct{}{}
229				}
230			}
231		}
232	
233		samitis := make([]SamitiInfo, 0, len(dcsIDs))
234		districts := map[string]struct{}{}
235		for _, id := range sortedKeys(dcsIDs) {
236			org, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, id)
237			if err != nil {
238				// A missing org unit must not break a consumer scan — log and skip.
239				s.log.Warn("QR scan: contributing DCS org not resolvable",
240					slog.String("dcs_org_id", id), slog.Any("err", err))
241				continue
242			}
243			samitis = append(samitis, SamitiInfo{Name: org.Name, Code: org.Code, District: org.District})
244			if org.District != "" {
245				districts[org.District] = struct{}{}
246			}
247		}
248		sort.Slice(samitis, func(i, j int) bool { return samitis[i].Name < samitis[j].Name })
249	
250		collectionDates := sortedKeys(dates)
251		return &SourcingInfo{
252			Message:         sourcingMessage(collectionDates, len(samitis), sortedKeys(districts)),
253			Samitis:         samitis,
254			CollectionDates: collectionDates,
255		}, nil
256	}

258	// sourcingMessage renders the consumer-facing pooled-provenance sentence,
259	// e.g. "Made from milk collected on 2026-07-05 from 3 samitis in Lucknow".
260	func sourcingMessage(dates []string, samitiCount int, districts []string) string {
261		var b strings.Builder
262		b.WriteString("Made from milk collected")
263		if len(dates) > 0 {
264			b.WriteString(" on " + strings.Join(dates, ", "))
265		}
266		noun := "samitis"
267		if samitiCount == 1 {
268			noun = "samiti"
269		}
270		fmt.Fprintf(&b, " from %d %s", samitiCount, noun)
271		if len(districts) > 0 {
272			b.WriteString(" in " + strings.Join(districts, ", "))
273		}
274		return b.String()
275	}
