277	// verifyTracedRange re-hashes the ledger over the [min,max] seq window of the
278	// traced events (tamper-evidence baked into every scan). Windows wider than
279	// scanVerifySpanCap are verified partially — the most recent tail — and
280	// flagged as such.
281	func (s *Service) verifyTracedRange(ctx context.Context, events []provenance.Event) (*LedgerInfo, error) {
282		if len(events) == 0 {
283			return &LedgerInfo{Events: 0, Intact: true, VerifiedRange: [2]int64{0, 0}}, nil
284		}
285		minSeq, maxSeq := events[0].Seq, events[0].Seq
286		for _, ev := range events[1:] {
287			if ev.Seq < minSeq {
288				minSeq = ev.Seq
289			}
290			if ev.Seq > maxSeq {
291				maxSeq = ev.Seq
292			}
293		}
294		from, partial := minSeq, false
295		if maxSeq-minSeq+1 > scanVerifySpanCap {
296			from, partial = maxSeq-scanVerifySpanCap+1, true
297		}
298		intact, _, err := s.ledger.VerifyChain(ctx, from, maxSeq)
299		if err != nil {
300			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
301		}
302		return &LedgerInfo{
303			Events:        len(events),
304			Intact:        intact,
305			VerifiedRange: [2]int64{from, maxSeq},
306			Partial:       partial,
307		}, nil
308	}

310	// VerifyLedger runs the public tamper-evidence check over [from,to]. Both
311	// bounds are optional: `to` defaults to the chain head, `from` to the start
312	// of the last publicVerifySpanCap events. Spans over the cap are rejected.
313	func (s *Service) VerifyLedger(ctx context.Context, fromRaw, toRaw string) (*LedgerVerifyResponse, error) {
314		latest, err := s.ledger.LatestSeq(ctx)
315		if err != nil {
316			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
317		}
318		if latest == 0 {
319			return &LedgerVerifyResponse{Intact: true, From: 0, To: 0}, nil // empty chain is trivially intact
320		}
321	
322		to := latest
323		if toRaw != "" {
324			n, err := strconv.ParseInt(toRaw, 10, 64)
325			if err != nil || n < 1 {
326				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_RANGE", "'to' must be a positive sequence number")
327			}
328			to = min(n, latest)
329		}
330		from := max(int64(1), to-publicVerifySpanCap+1)
331		if fromRaw != "" {
332			n, err := strconv.ParseInt(fromRaw, 10, 64)
333			if err != nil || n < 1 {
334				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_RANGE", "'from' must be a positive sequence number")
335			}
336			from = n
337		}
338		if from > to {
339			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_RANGE", "'from' must not exceed 'to'")
340		}
341		if to-from+1 > publicVerifySpanCap {
342			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("SPAN_TOO_WIDE",
343				fmt.Sprintf("verification span is capped at %d events per request", publicVerifySpanCap))
344		}
345	
346		intact, brokenAt, err := s.ledger.VerifyChain(ctx, from, to)
347		if err != nil {
348			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
349		}
350		resp := &LedgerVerifyResponse{Intact: intact, From: from, To: to}
351		if !intact {
352			resp.BrokenAtSeq = &brokenAt
353		}
354		return resp, nil
355	}

357	// TraceGraph returns the full event graph around one entity: upstream via
358	// the recursive ref walk, downstream via reverse-ref lookup — the recall /
359	// root-cause tool (§8.3).
360	func (s *Service) TraceGraph(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string) (*TraceGraphResponse, error) {
361		if err := validateEntityType(entityType); err != nil {
362			return nil, err

372		if len(downstream) > downstreamEventCap {
373			downstream = downstream[len(downstream)-downstreamEventCap:]

375		if len(upstream) == 0 && len(downstream) == 0 {

378		if upstream == nil {

381		if downstream == nil {
382			downstream = []provenance.Event{}
383		}
384		return &TraceGraphResponse{Upstream: upstream, Downstream: downstream}, nil
385	}

387	// Timeline returns one entity's own events in chain order, paginated.
388	// The second return value is the total event count before paging.
389	func (s *Service) Timeline(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, page httpx.Page) ([]provenance.Event, int, error) {
390		if err := validateEntityType(entityType); err != nil {
391			return nil, 0, err
392		}
393		events, err := s.ledger.EventsForEntity(ctx, entityType, entityID)
394		if err != nil {
395			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
396		}
397		if len(events) == 0 {
398			return nil, 0, httpx.NotFound("provenance for entity")
399		}
400		total := len(events)
401		start := min(page.Offset, int64(total))
402		end := min(start+page.Limit, int64(total))
403		return events[start:end], total, nil
404	}
405	
406	// validateEntityType rejects entity types outside the domain.Entity* catalog.
407	func validateEntityType(entityType string) error {
408		if _, ok := validEntityTypes[entityType]; !ok {
409			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_ENTITY_TYPE",
410				"unknown entity type "+entityType+" — use one of the provenance entity type constants")
411		}
412		return nil
413	}
414	
415	// sortedKeys returns a set's keys in deterministic (lexicographic) order.
416	func sortedKeys(set map[string]struct{}) []string {
417		out := make([]string, 0, len(set))
418		for k := range set {
419			out = append(out, k)
420		}
421		sort.Strings(out)
422		return out
423	}

2	// the source of truth for milk traceability (blueprint §7). Every link in the

49		EntityType string         `bson:"entity_type" json:"entity_type"`
50		EntityID   string         `bson:"entity_id"   json:"entity_id"`
51		Refs       []Ref          `bson:"refs,omitempty"    json:"refs,omitempty"`
52		Actor      ActorRef       `bson:"actor"       json:"actor"`
53		OrgUnitID  string         `bson:"org_unit_id,omitempty" json:"org_unit_id,omitempty"`
54		Payload    map[string]any `bson:"payload,omitempty"     json:"payload,omitempty"`
55		TS         time.Time      `bson:"ts"          json:"ts"`
56		PrevHash   string         `bson:"prev_hash"   json:"prev_hash"`
57		Hash       string         `bson:"hash"        json:"hash"`

60	// AppendInput describes a new event to chain.
61	type AppendInput struct {
62		Type       string
63		EntityType string
64		EntityID   string
65		Refs       []Ref
66		Actor      ActorRef
67		OrgUnitID  string

69	}

71	// Ledger appends to and reads the hash chain.
72	type Ledger struct {
73		coll *mongo.Collection
74	}

76	// NewLedger binds the ledger to the database.
77	func NewLedger(db *mongo.Database) *Ledger {
78		return &Ledger{coll: db.Collection(collection)}
79	}
80	
81	// genesisHash anchors the chain before the first event.
82	const genesisHash = "GENESIS"
83	
84	// Append chains a new event. Concurrency-safe without transactions: it reads
85	// the current head, computes seq+hash optimistically, and relies on the
86	// unique index on `seq` — a duplicate-key collision means another writer won
87	// the slot, so we re-read and retry.
88	func (l *Ledger) Append(ctx context.Context, in AppendInput) (*Event, error) {
89		const maxRetries = 12
90		for attempt := 0; attempt < maxRetries; attempt++ {
91			seq, prevHash, err := l.head(ctx)
92			if err != nil {
93				return nil, err
94			}
95			ev := &Event{
96				ID:         uuid.NewString(),
97				Seq:        seq + 1,
98				Type:       in.Type,
99				EntityType: in.EntityType,
100				EntityID:   in.EntityID,
101				Refs:       in.Refs,
102				Actor:      in.Actor,
103				OrgUnitID:  in.OrgUnitID,
104				Payload:    in.Payload,
105				// Millisecond precision: BSON datetimes store ms, so the persisted
106				// TS must equal the hashed TS or re-verification would break.
107				TS:       time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Millisecond),
108				PrevHash: prevHash,
109			}
110			ev.Hash = computeHash(ev)
111	
112			if _, err := l.coll.InsertOne(ctx, ev); err != nil {
113				if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(err) {
114					continue // lost the seq race — retry against the new head
115				}
116				return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance append: %w", err)
117			}
118			return ev, nil
119		}
120		return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance append: gave up after %d seq collisions", 12)
121	}
122	
123	// head returns the latest (seq, hash), or (0, GENESIS) for an empty chain.
124	func (l *Ledger) head(ctx context.Context) (int64, string, error) {
125		var last Event
126		err := l.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{},
127			options.FindOne().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: -1}}),
128		).Decode(&last)
129		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
130			return 0, genesisHash, nil
131		}
132		if err != nil {
133			return 0, "", fmt.Errorf("provenance head: %w", err)
134		}
135		return last.Seq, last.Hash, nil
136	}
137	
138	// computeHash covers everything that matters: position, linkage, content.
139	// Payload is canonicalised via encoding/json (map keys are sorted) and the
140	// timestamp to millisecond precision (BSON datetime resolution), so the
141	// digest is deterministic across a MongoDB round trip.
142	func computeHash(ev *Event) string {
143		payloadJSON, _ := json.Marshal(ev.Payload)
144		refParts := make([]string, 0, len(ev.Refs))
145		for _, r := range ev.Refs {
146			refParts = append(refParts, r.EntityType+":"+r.EntityID+":"+r.Relation)
147		}
148		material := strings.Join([]string{
149			ev.PrevHash,
150			strconv.FormatInt(ev.Seq, 10),
151			ev.Type,
152			ev.EntityType,
153			ev.EntityID,
154			strings.Join(refParts, ","),
155			ev.Actor.PartyID,
156			ev.Actor.RoleCode,
157			ev.OrgUnitID,
158			string(payloadJSON),
159			ev.TS.UTC().Truncate(time.Millisecond).Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
160		}, "|")
161		sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(material))
162		return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
163	}

165	// EventsForEntity returns an entity's own timeline in chain order.
166	func (l *Ledger) EventsForEntity(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string) ([]Event, error) {
167		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
168			bson.D{{Key: "entity_type", Value: entityType}, {Key: "entity_id", Value: entityID}},
169			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}),
170		)
171		if err != nil {
172			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance events for %s/%s: %w", entityType, entityID, err)
173		}
174		var out []Event
175		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
176			return nil, err
177		}
178		return out, nil
179	}

181	// Trace walks the provenance graph UPSTREAM from an entity: its events, plus
182	// (recursively) the events of everything those events reference. This is how
183	// a consumer QR resolves back to the contributing samiti set, and how a failed
184	// aflatoxin test walks back to source DCSes (blueprint §8.3).
185	func (l *Ledger) Trace(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, maxDepth int) ([]Event, error) {
186		if maxDepth <= 0 {
187			maxDepth = 10
188		}
189		const hardEventCap = 2000
190	
191		type node struct{ etype, eid string }
192		visited := map[node]bool{}
193		frontier := []node{{entityType, entityID}}
194		var all []Event
195	
196		for depth := 0; depth < maxDepth && len(frontier) > 0; depth++ {
197			var next []node
198			for _, n := range frontier {
199				if visited[n] {
200					continue
201				}
202				visited[n] = true
203				evs, err := l.EventsForEntity(ctx, n.etype, n.eid)
204				if err != nil {
205					return nil, err
206				}
207				for _, ev := range evs {
208					all = append(all, ev)
209					if len(all) >= hardEventCap {
210						return all, nil
211					}
212					for _, ref := range ev.Refs {
213						nn := node{ref.EntityType, ref.EntityID}
214						if !visited[nn] {
215							next = append(next, nn)
216						}
217					}
218				}
219			}
220			frontier = next
221		}
222		return all, nil
223	}
224	
225	// DownstreamRefs finds events that reference the given entity — used to walk
226	// FORWARD (e.g. "which batches consumed this blocked BMC lot?").
227	func (l *Ledger) DownstreamRefs(ctx context.Context, entityID string) ([]Event, error) {
228		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
229			bson.D{{Key: "refs.entity_id", Value: entityID}},
230			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}),
231		)
232		if err != nil {
233			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance downstream of %s: %w", entityID, err)
234		}
235		var out []Event
236		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
237			return nil, err
238		}
239		return out, nil
240	}

242	// VerifyChain re-derives every hash in [fromSeq, toSeq] and checks linkage.
243	// Returns (true, 0) when intact, or (false, seq) of the first broken link.
244	func (l *Ledger) VerifyChain(ctx context.Context, fromSeq, toSeq int64) (bool, int64, error) {
245		filter := bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$gte", Value: fromSeq}, {Key: "$lte", Value: toSeq}}}}
246		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}))
247		if err != nil {
248			return false, 0, fmt.Errorf("provenance verify: %w", err)
249		}
250		defer cur.Close(ctx)
251	
252		prevHash := ""
253		prevSeq := int64(0)
254		first := true
255		for cur.Next(ctx) {
256			var ev Event
257			if err := cur.Decode(&ev); err != nil {
258				return false, 0, err
259			}
260			if computeHash(&ev) != ev.Hash {
261				return false, ev.Seq, nil // content tampered
262			}
263			if !first {
264				if ev.Seq != prevSeq+1 || ev.PrevHash != prevHash {
265					return false, ev.Seq, nil // linkage broken
266				}
267			}
268			prevHash, prevSeq, first = ev.Hash, ev.Seq, false
269		}
270		return true, 0, cur.Err()
271	}
272	
273	// LatestSeq returns the current chain head sequence (0 = empty).
274	func (l *Ledger) LatestSeq(ctx context.Context) (int64, error) {
275		seq, _, err := l.head(ctx)
276		return seq, err
277	}

 `./internal/platform/provenance/ledger.go`

```text
1	// Package provenance implements the append-only, hash-chained event ledger —
2	// the source of truth for milk traceability (blueprint §7). Every link in the
3	// pour→QR chain is an immutable Event whose SHA-256 hash covers the previous
4	// event's hash, so history cannot be quietly rewritten (tamper-evidence,
5	// FSSAI recall-grade audit).
6	//
7	// Corrections are NEW events referencing the superseded entity — nothing is
8	// ever updated or deleted in this collection.
9	package provenance
10	
11	import (
12		"context"
13		"crypto/sha256"
14		"encoding/hex"
15		"encoding/json"
16		"errors"
17		"fmt"
18		"strconv"
19		"strings"
20		"time"
21	
22		"github.com/google/uuid"
23		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
24		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
25		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo/options"
26	)
27	
28	const collection = "provenance_events"
29	
30	// Ref is a directed edge to another entity in the trace graph
31	// (e.g. a consignment event referencing the pours it aggregates).
32	type Ref struct {
33		EntityType string `bson:"entity_type" json:"entity_type"`
34		EntityID   string `bson:"entity_id"   json:"entity_id"`
35		Relation   string `bson:"relation"    json:"relation"` // aggregates | supersedes | tested | yields | labels ...
36	}
37	
38	// ActorRef records who caused the event.
39	type ActorRef struct {
40		PartyID  string `bson:"party_id"  json:"party_id"`
41		RoleCode string `bson:"role_code" json:"role_code"`
42	}
43	
44	// Event is one immutable link in the ledger.
45	type Event struct {
46		ID         string         `bson:"_id"         json:"id"`
47		Seq        int64          `bson:"seq"         json:"seq"`
48		Type       string         `bson:"type"        json:"type"`
49		EntityType string         `bson:"entity_type" json:"entity_type"`
50		EntityID   string         `bson:"entity_id"   json:"entity_id"`
51		Refs       []Ref          `bson:"refs,omitempty"    json:"refs,omitempty"`
52		Actor      ActorRef       `bson:"actor"       json:"actor"`
53		OrgUnitID  string         `bson:"org_unit_id,omitempty" json:"org_unit_id,omitempty"`
54		Payload    map[string]any `bson:"payload,omitempty"     json:"payload,omitempty"`
55		TS         time.Time      `bson:"ts"          json:"ts"`
56		PrevHash   string         `bson:"prev_hash"   json:"prev_hash"`
57		Hash       string         `bson:"hash"        json:"hash"`
58	}
59	
60	// AppendInput describes a new event to chain.
61	type AppendInput struct {
62		Type       string
63		EntityType string
64		EntityID   string
65		Refs       []Ref
66		Actor      ActorRef
67		OrgUnitID  string
68		Payload    map[string]any
69	}
70	
71	// Ledger appends to and reads the hash chain.
72	type Ledger struct {
73		coll *mongo.Collection
74	}
75	
76	// NewLedger binds the ledger to the database.
77	func NewLedger(db *mongo.Database) *Ledger {
78		return &Ledger{coll: db.Collection(collection)}
79	}
80	
81	// genesisHash anchors the chain before the first event.
82	const genesisHash = "GENESIS"
83	
84	// Append chains a new event. Concurrency-safe without transactions: it reads
85	// the current head, computes seq+hash optimistically, and relies on the
86	// unique index on `seq` — a duplicate-key collision means another writer won
87	// the slot, so we re-read and retry.
88	func (l *Ledger) Append(ctx context.Context, in AppendInput) (*Event, error) {
89		const maxRetries = 12
90		for attempt := 0; attempt < maxRetries; attempt++ {
91			seq, prevHash, err := l.head(ctx)
92			if err != nil {
93				return nil, err
94			}
95			ev := &Event{
96				ID:         uuid.NewString(),
97				Seq:        seq + 1,
98				Type:       in.Type,
99				EntityType: in.EntityType,
100				EntityID:   in.EntityID,
101				Refs:       in.Refs,
102				Actor:      in.Actor,
103				OrgUnitID:  in.OrgUnitID,
104				Payload:    in.Payload,
105				// Millisecond precision: BSON datetimes store ms, so the persisted
106				// TS must equal the hashed TS or re-verification would break.
107				TS:       time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Millisecond),
108				PrevHash: prevHash,
109			}
110			ev.Hash = computeHash(ev)
111	
112			if _, err := l.coll.InsertOne(ctx, ev); err != nil {
113				if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(err) {
114					continue // lost the seq race — retry against the new head
115				}
116				return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance append: %w", err)
117			}
118			return ev, nil
119		}
120		return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance append: gave up after %d seq collisions", 12)
121	}
122	
123	// head returns the latest (seq, hash), or (0, GENESIS) for an empty chain.
124	func (l *Ledger) head(ctx context.Context) (int64, string, error) {
125		var last Event
126		err := l.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{},
127			options.FindOne().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: -1}}),
128		).Decode(&last)
129		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
130			return 0, genesisHash, nil
131		}
132		if err != nil {
133			return 0, "", fmt.Errorf("provenance head: %w", err)
134		}
135		return last.Seq, last.Hash, nil
136	}
137	
138	// computeHash covers everything that matters: position, linkage, content.
139	// Payload is canonicalised via encoding/json (map keys are sorted) and the
140	// timestamp to millisecond precision (BSON datetime resolution), so the
141	// digest is deterministic across a MongoDB round trip.
142	func computeHash(ev *Event) string {
143		payloadJSON, _ := json.Marshal(ev.Payload)
144		refParts := make([]string, 0, len(ev.Refs))
145		for _, r := range ev.Refs {
146			refParts = append(refParts, r.EntityType+":"+r.EntityID+":"+r.Relation)
147		}
148		material := strings.Join([]string{
149			ev.PrevHash,
150			strconv.FormatInt(ev.Seq, 10),
151			ev.Type,
152			ev.EntityType,
153			ev.EntityID,
154			strings.Join(refParts, ","),
155			ev.Actor.PartyID,
156			ev.Actor.RoleCode,
157			ev.OrgUnitID,
158			string(payloadJSON),
159			ev.TS.UTC().Truncate(time.Millisecond).Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
160		}, "|")
161		sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(material))
162		return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
163	}
164	
165	// EventsForEntity returns an entity's own timeline in chain order.
166	func (l *Ledger) EventsForEntity(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string) ([]Event, error) {
167		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
168			bson.D{{Key: "entity_type", Value: entityType}, {Key: "entity_id", Value: entityID}},
169			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}),
170		)
171		if err != nil {
172			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance events for %s/%s: %w", entityType, entityID, err)
173		}
174		var out []Event
175		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
176			return nil, err
177		}
178		return out, nil
179	}
180	
181	// Trace walks the provenance graph UPSTREAM from an entity: its events, plus
182	// (recursively) the events of everything those events reference. This is how
183	// a consumer QR resolves back to the contributing samiti set, and how a failed
184	// aflatoxin test walks back to source DCSes (blueprint §8.3).
185	func (l *Ledger) Trace(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, maxDepth int) ([]Event, error) {
186		if maxDepth <= 0 {
187			maxDepth = 10
188		}
189		const hardEventCap = 2000
190	
191		type node struct{ etype, eid string }
192		visited := map[node]bool{}
193		frontier := []node{{entityType, entityID}}
194		var all []Event
195	
196		for depth := 0; depth < maxDepth && len(frontier) > 0; depth++ {
197			var next []node
198			for _, n := range frontier {
199				if visited[n] {
200					continue
201				}
202				visited[n] = true
203				evs, err := l.EventsForEntity(ctx, n.etype, n.eid)
204				if err != nil {
205					return nil, err
206				}
207				for _, ev := range evs {
208					all = append(all, ev)
209					if len(all) >= hardEventCap {
210						return all, nil
211					}
212					for _, ref := range ev.Refs {
213						nn := node{ref.EntityType, ref.EntityID}
214						if !visited[nn] {
215							next = append(next, nn)
216						}
217					}
218				}
219			}
220			frontier = next
221		}
222		return all, nil
223	}
224	
225	// DownstreamRefs finds events that reference the given entity — used to walk
226	// FORWARD (e.g. "which batches consumed this blocked BMC lot?").
227	func (l *Ledger) DownstreamRefs(ctx context.Context, entityID string) ([]Event, error) {
228		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
229			bson.D{{Key: "refs.entity_id", Value: entityID}},
230			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}),
231		)
232		if err != nil {
233			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance downstream of %s: %w", entityID, err)
234		}
235		var out []Event
236		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
237			return nil, err
238		}
239		return out, nil
240	}
241	
242	// VerifyChain re-derives every hash in [fromSeq, toSeq] and checks linkage.
243	// Returns (true, 0) when intact, or (false, seq) of the first broken link.
244	func (l *Ledger) VerifyChain(ctx context.Context, fromSeq, toSeq int64) (bool, int64, error) {
245		filter := bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$gte", Value: fromSeq}, {Key: "$lte", Value: toSeq}}}}
246		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}))
247		if err != nil {
248			return false, 0, fmt.Errorf("provenance verify: %w", err)
249		}
250		defer cur.Close(ctx)
251	
252		prevHash := ""
253		prevSeq := int64(0)
254		first := true
255		for cur.Next(ctx) {
256			var ev Event
257			if err := cur.Decode(&ev); err != nil {
258				return false, 0, err
259			}
260			if computeHash(&ev) != ev.Hash {
261				return false, ev.Seq, nil // content tampered
262			}
263			if !first {
264				if ev.Seq != prevSeq+1 || ev.PrevHash != prevHash {
265					return false, ev.Seq, nil // linkage broken
266				}
267			}
268			prevHash, prevSeq, first = ev.Hash, ev.Seq, false
269		}
270		return true, 0, cur.Err()
271	}
272	
273	// LatestSeq returns the current chain head sequence (0 = empty).
274	func (l *Ledger) LatestSeq(ctx context.Context) (int64, error) {
275		seq, _, err := l.head(ctx)
276		return seq, err
277	}

327		matched, err := s.repo.markConsignmentPickedUp(ctx, consignmentID, trip.ID)
328		if err != nil {
329			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
330		}
331		if !matched {
332			consignment, err := s.loadConsignment(ctx, consignmentID)
333			if err != nil {
334				return nil, err
335			}
336			return nil, httpx.Conflict("CONSIGNMENT_NOT_DISPATCHED",
337				"consignment is "+consignment.Status+"; only DISPATCHED consignments can be picked up")
338		}
339	
340		now := time.Now().UTC()
341		if err := s.repo.markStopPickedUp(ctx, trip.ID, consignmentID, now, *req.TempC, req.Notes); err != nil {
342			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
343		}
344	
345		event, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
346			Type:       domain.EventConsignmentPickedUp,
347			EntityType: domain.EntityConsignment,
348			EntityID:   consignmentID,
349			Refs: []provenance.Ref{
350				{EntityType: domain.EntityRouteTrip, EntityID: trip.ID, Relation: "carried_by"},
351			},
352			Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
353			OrgUnitID: trip.UnionID,
354			Payload:   map[string]any{"temp_c": *req.TempC},
355		})
356		if err != nil {
357			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
358		}
359		if err := s.repo.setConsignmentProvenanceSeq(ctx, consignmentID, event.Seq); err != nil {
360			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
361		}
362	
363		trip.Status = domain.TripStatusInProgress
364		if i := findStop(trip, consignmentID); i >= 0 {
365			trip.Stops[i].PickedUpAt = &now
366			trip.Stops[i].TempC = *req.TempC
367			trip.Stops[i].Notes = req.Notes
368		}
369		return trip, nil
370	}

374	func (s *service) logColdChain(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, tripID string, req coldChainRequest) (*domain.RouteTrip, error) {
375		if err := validateTemp(req.TempC); err != nil {

388			GeoLat: req.GeoLat,
389			GeoLng: req.GeoLng,
390		}
391		if err := s.repo.pushColdChain(ctx, trip.ID, entry); err != nil {
392			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
393		}
394		event, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
395			Type:       domain.EventColdChainLogged,
396			EntityType: domain.EntityRouteTrip,
397			EntityID:   trip.ID,
398			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
399			OrgUnitID:  trip.UnionID,
400			Payload:    map[string]any{"temp_c": *req.TempC},
401		})
402		if err != nil {
403			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
404		}
405		if err := s.repo.setTripProvenanceSeq(ctx, trip.ID, event.Seq); err != nil {
406			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
407		}
408		trip.ColdChain = append(trip.ColdChain, entry)
409		trip.ProvenanceSeq = event.Seq
410		return trip, nil
411	}

413	// deliverTrip hands the whole load to a BMC: every stop must be picked up,
414	// the trip moves IN_PROGRESS→DELIVERED and its consignments PICKED_UP→DELIVERED.
415	func (s *service) deliverTrip(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, tripID string, req deliverRequest) (*domain.RouteTrip, error) {
416		if req.BMCID == "" {
417			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_BMC_ID", "bmc_id is required")
418		}
419		trip, err := s.loadTrip(ctx, tripID)
420		if err != nil {
421			return nil, err
422		}
423		if aerr := validateDeliver(trip, actor.PartyID); aerr != nil {
424			return nil, aerr
425		}
426		bmc, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.BMCID)
427		if err != nil {
428			return nil, err
429		}
430		if bmc.Type != domain.OrgTypeBMC {
431			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_BMC", "org unit "+req.BMCID+" is not a BMC")
432		}
433	
434		now := time.Now().UTC()
435		matched, err := s.repo.markTripDelivered(ctx, trip.ID, req.BMCID, now)
436		if err != nil {
437			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
438		}
439		if !matched { // lost a state race since the read above
440			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_TRIP_STATE", "trip was modified concurrently; reload and retry")
441		}
442	
443		consignmentIDs := make([]string, 0, len(trip.Stops))
444		refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, len(trip.Stops))
445		for _, stop := range trip.Stops {
446			consignmentIDs = append(consignmentIDs, stop.ConsignmentID)
447			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{
448				EntityType: domain.EntityConsignment, EntityID: stop.ConsignmentID, Relation: "delivered",
449			})
450		}
451		if err := s.repo.markConsignmentsDelivered(ctx, consignmentIDs); err != nil {
452			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
453		}
454	
455		event, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
456			Type:       domain.EventTripDelivered,
457			EntityType: domain.EntityRouteTrip,
458			EntityID:   trip.ID,
459			Refs:       refs,
460			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
461			OrgUnitID:  trip.UnionID,
462			Payload:    map[string]any{"bmc_id": req.BMCID},
463		})
464		if err != nil {
465			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
466		}
467		if err := s.repo.setTripProvenanceSeq(ctx, trip.ID, event.Seq); err != nil {
468			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
469		}
470	
471		trip.Status = domain.TripStatusDelivered
472		trip.DeliveredToBMCID = req.BMCID
473		trip.DeliveredAt = &now
474		trip.ProvenanceSeq = event.Seq
475		return trip, nil
476	}

1	// Package publictrace serves the two faces of milk traceability
2	// (blueprint §7, §8.4):
3	//
4	//   - /public — the consumer QR scan and public ledger tamper-check. These
5	//     routes are DELIBERATELY unauthenticated: a shopper points a phone at a
6	//     milk pack and must see its provenance with zero friction. This is not a
7	//     consumer-account backend (descoped) — the global per-IP rate limit is
8	//     the only throttle.
9	//   - /trace  — the official recall / root-cause tools: full upstream +
10	//     downstream event-graph walks for auditors, mission officials and lab
11	//     analysts (§8.3: a failed aflatoxin lot walks back to contributing
12	//     samitis and forward to affected batches and QRs).
13	//
14	// The consumer view is the HONEST provenance view (§7.4): pooled milk traces
15	// to the SET of contributing samitis, never to individual farmers.
16	package publictrace
17	
18	import (
19		"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
20	
21		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
22		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
23		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/middleware"
24	)
25	
26	// Register mounts the public QR/ledger routes and the authed trace tools.
27	func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
28		service := NewService(d)
29		handler := &Handler{service: service}
30	
31		// PUBLIC subtree — no Authenticate middleware by design (see package doc).
32		r.Route("/public", func(pub chi.Router) {
33			pub.Get("/qr/{qr_code}", handler.ScanQR)
34			pub.Get("/ledger/verify", handler.VerifyLedger)
35		})
36	
37		// Official trace tools — role-gated, read-only, cross-org by nature
38		// (a recall walk necessarily spans DCS → BMC → plant boundaries, so no
39		// per-resource org-scope check applies here; the role gate is the fence).
40		r.Route("/trace", func(tr chi.Router) {
41			tr.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
42			tr.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(
43				domain.RoleMissionOfficial,
44				domain.RolePCDFAdmin,
45				domain.RoleUnionPresident,
46				domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor,
47				domain.RolePlantLabAnalyst,
48				domain.RoleStateAuditor,
49			))
50			tr.Get("/{entity_type}/{entity_id}", handler.TraceGraph)
51			tr.Get("/{entity_type}/{entity_id}/timeline", handler.Timeline)
52		})
53	}
54

// PayoutHistory pages payout instructions for one farmer, newest first.
// A FARMER token is always forced to its own party — "my payment history".
func (s *service) PayoutHistory(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, farmerPartyID string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.PayoutInstruction, int64, error) {
	if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleFarmer {
		farmerPartyID = actor.PartyID
	}
	if farmerPartyID == "" {
		return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_FIELD", "farmer_party_id is required")
	}
	return s.repo.payoutsByFarmer(ctx, farmerPartyID, page)
}

It is real only if you can name concrete inputs/state that misbehave. Claim: [medium] listPours and listInvoices sort on fields absent from every index — blocking in-memory sort of a DCS's entire history per page @ internal/modules/collection/repo.go:253 — listPours sorts by poured_at (line 253) but milk_pours indexes are (client_event_id), (dcs_id,pour_date,shift), (farmer_party_id,pour_date). GET /collection/pours?dcs_id=X without a date (allowed — the service only requires dcs_id for staff) matches the DCS's full multi-year pour history via the dcs_id prefix, then Mongo must do a blocking SORT on poured_at for every page request (skip/limit apply after the sort). Same defect in listInvoices (line 386): sort issued_at is in no index, so a dcs_id-only or farmer-only listing sorts the full matched history in memory. Beyond latency, a large DCS will eventually hit the 100MB QueryExceededMemoryLimitNoDiskUseAllowed error and the endpoint fails outright. Sort by an indexed key (pour_date/invoice_date) or add poured_at/issued_at to the compound indexes.

It is real only if you can name concrete inputs/state that misbehave. Claim: [medium] DownstreamRefs and Timeline load unbounded result sets before truncating/paginating in memory @ internal/platform/provenance/ledger.go:228 — DownstreamRefs runs Find({refs.entity_id: X}) with no limit and cursor.All decodes everything; the caller TraceGraph (publictrace/service.go:372) only truncates to the last 2000 events after the full set is already in memory. A heavily referenced entity (e.g. a settlement batch referenced by one payout.credited event per invoice, or a route trip referenced by every consignment it ever carried) pulls its entire referencing history into RAM per request. Timeline (publictrace/service.go:393) has the same shape: EventsForEntity fetches ALL events for the entity and paginates by slicing in Go, so the offset/limit pagination gives no protection — every page re-reads the full timeline. Both should push SetLimit/SetSkip (and a $slice or sort+limit) into the Mongo query.

// Trace walks the provenance graph UPSTREAM from an entity: its events, plus
// (recursively) the events of everything those events reference. This is how
// a consumer QR resolves back to the contributing samiti set, and how a failed
// aflatoxin test walks back to source DCSes (blueprint §8.3).
func (l *Ledger) Trace(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, maxDepth int) ([]Event, error) {
	if maxDepth <= 0 {
		maxDepth = 10
	}
	const hardEventCap = 2000

	type node struct{ etype, eid string }
	visited := map[node]bool{}
	frontier := []node{{entityType, entityID}}
	var all []Event

	for depth := 0; depth < maxDepth && len(frontier) > 0; depth++ {
		var next []node
		for _, n := range frontier {
			if visited[n] {
				continue
			}
			visited[n] = true
			evs, err := l.EventsForEntity(ctx, n.etype, n.eid)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			for _, ev := range evs {
				all = append(all, ev)
				if len(all) >= hardEventCap {
					return all, nil
				}
				for _, ref := range ev.Refs {
					nn := node{ref.EntityType, ref.EntityID}
					if !visited[nn] {
						next = append(next, nn)
					}
				}
			}
		}
		frontier = next
	}
	return all, nil
}

// DownstreamRefs finds events that reference the given entity — used to walk
// FORWARD (e.g. "which batches consumed this blocked BMC lot?").
func (l *Ledger) DownstreamRefs(ctx context.Context, entityID string) ([]Event, error) {
	cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
		bson.D{{Key: "refs.entity_id", Value: entityID}},
		options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}),
	)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance downstream of %s: %w", entityID, err)
	}
	var out []Event
	if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return out, nil
}

// VerifyChain re-derives every hash in [fromSeq, toSeq] and checks linkage.
// Returns (true, 0) when intact, or (false, seq) of the first broken link.
func (l *Ledger) VerifyChain(ctx context.Context, fromSeq, toSeq int64) (bool, int64, error) {
	filter := bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$gte", Value: fromSeq}, {Key: "$lte", Value: toSeq}}}}
	cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}))
	if err != nil {
		return false, 0, fmt.Errorf("provenance verify: %w", err)
	}
	defer cur.Close(ctx)

	prevHash := ""
	prevSeq := int64(0)
	first := true
	for cur.Next(ctx) {
		var ev Event
		if err := cur.Decode(&ev); err != nil {
			return false, 0, err
		}
		if computeHash(&ev) != ev.Hash {
			return false, ev.Seq, nil // content tampered
		}
		if !first {
			if ev.Seq != prevSeq+1 || ev.PrevHash != prevHash {
				return false, ev.Seq, nil // linkage broken
			}
		}
		prevHash, prevSeq, first = ev.Hash, ev.Seq, false
	}
	return true, 0, cur.Err()
}

// LatestSeq returns the current chain head sequence (0 = empty).
func (l *Ledger) LatestSeq(ctx context.Context) (int64, error) {
	seq, _, err := l.head(ctx)
	return seq, err
}

1	// Package publictrace serves the two faces of milk traceability
2	// (blueprint §7, §8.4):
3	//
4	//   - /public — the consumer QR scan and public ledger tamper-check. These
5	//     routes are DELIBERATELY unauthenticated: a shopper points a phone at a
6	//     milk pack and must see its provenance with zero friction. This is not a
7	//     consumer-account backend (descoped) — the global per-IP rate limit is
8	//     the only throttle.
9	//   - /trace  — the official recall / root-cause tools: full upstream +
10	//     downstream event-graph walks for auditors, mission officials and lab
11	//     analysts (§8.3: a failed aflatoxin lot walks back to contributing
12	//     samitis and forward to affected batches and QRs).
13	//
14	// The consumer view is the HONEST provenance view (§7.4): pooled milk traces
15	// to the SET of contributing samitis, never to individual farmers.
16	package publictrace
17	
18	import (
19		"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
20	
21		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
22		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
23		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/middleware"
24	)
25	
26	// Register mounts the public QR/ledger routes and the authed trace tools.
27	func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
28		service := NewService(d)
29		handler := &Handler{service: service}
30	
31		// PUBLIC subtree — no Authenticate middleware by design (see package doc).
32		r.Route("/public", func(pub chi.Router) {
33			pub.Get("/qr/{qr_code}", handler.ScanQR)
34			pub.Get("/ledger/verify", handler.VerifyLedger)
35		})
36	
37		// Official trace tools — role-gated, read-only, cross-org by nature
38		// (a recall walk necessarily spans DCS → BMC → plant boundaries, so no
39		// per-resource org-scope check applies here; the role gate is the fence).
40		r.Route("/trace", func(tr chi.Router) {
41			tr.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
42			tr.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(
43				domain.RoleMissionOfficial,
44				domain.RolePCDFAdmin,
45				domain.RoleUnionPresident,
46				domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor,
47				domain.RolePlantLabAnalyst,
48				domain.RoleStateAuditor,
49			))
50			tr.Get("/{entity_type}/{entity_id}", handler.TraceGraph)
51			tr.Get("/{entity_type}/{entity_id}/timeline", handler.Timeline)
52		})
53	}

155		BMCID  string
156		Date   string
157		Status string
158	}

160	// ListBMCLots returns a page of lots plus the total match count.
161	func (r *Repo) ListBMCLots(ctx context.Context, f BMCLotListFilter, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.BMCLot, int64, error) {
162		filter := bson.D{}
163		if f.BMCID != "" {
164			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "bmc_id", Value: f.BMCID})
165		}
166		if f.Date != "" {
167			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "date", Value: f.Date})
168		}
169		if f.Status != "" {
170			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "status", Value: f.Status})
171		}
172		total, err := r.bmcLots.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
173		if err != nil {
174			return nil, 0, err
175		}
176		cur, err := r.bmcLots.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
177			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "date", Value: -1}, {Key: "created_at", Value: -1}}).
178			SetSkip(page.Offset).SetLimit(page.Limit))
179		if err != nil {
180			return nil, 0, err
181		}
182		out := []domain.BMCLot{}
183		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
184			return nil, 0, err
185		}
186		return out, total, nil
187	}

191	// NextSequence atomically increments and returns the named counter — the
192	// transaction-free way to mint gapless human-readable numbers.
193	func (r *Repo) NextSequence(ctx context.Context, key string) (int64, error) {
194		var doc struct {
195			Seq int64 `bson:"seq"`
196		}
197		err := r.counters.FindOneAndUpdate(ctx,
198			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: key}},
199			bson.D{{Key: "$inc", Value: bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: int64(1)}}}},
200			options.FindOneAndUpdate().SetUpsert(true).SetReturnDocument(options.After),
201		).Decode(&doc)
202		if err != nil {
203			return 0, err
204		}
205		return doc.Seq, nil
206	}

225	func (r *Repo) CompleteBatch(ctx context.Context, id string, completedAt time.Time) (bool, error) {
226		res, err := r.batches.UpdateOne(ctx,

228			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{

231			}}},
232		)
233		if err != nil {
234			return false, err
235		}
236		return res.MatchedCount > 0, nil
237	}

71		overallPass = true
72		evaluated = make([]QCTest, 0, len(tests))
73		for _, t := range tests {
74			pass := true
75			switch t.Name {
76			case TestAflatoxinM1:
77				if t.Value > FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg {
78					pass = false
79					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
80						"AFLATOXIN_M1 %.3f µg/kg exceeds FSSAI limit %.1f µg/kg", t.Value, FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg))
81				}
82			case TestColiform:
83				if t.Value > FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl {
84					pass = false
85					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
86						"COLIFORM %.1f CFU/ml exceeds FSSAI limit %.0f CFU/ml", t.Value, FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl))
87				}
88			case TestAntibiotic:
89				if t.Value > FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg {
90					pass = false
91					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
92						"ANTIBIOTIC_TETRACYCLINE %.3f mg/kg exceeds MRL %.1f mg/kg", t.Value, FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg))
93				}
94			case TestPhosphatase:
95				if t.Value != 0 {
96					pass = false
97					failures = append(failures, "PHOSPHATASE positive — pasteurisation check failed (must be negative)")
98				}
99			}
100			t.Pass = pass
101			if !pass {
102				overallPass = false
103			}
104			evaluated = append(evaluated, t)
105		}
106		return overallPass, failures, evaluated
107	}
108

41	// requiredRoleForStage returns the one role allowed to record results at a

44	func requiredRoleForStage(stage string) (string, bool) {
45		switch stage {
46		case domain.QCStageBMCRapid:
47			return domain.RoleBMCOperator, true
48		case domain.QCStagePlantLab:
49			return domain.RolePlantLabAnalyst, true
50		default:
51			return "", false
52		}
53	}

55	// certificateNumber builds the human-readable QC certificate identifier from
56	// the per-stage counter, e.g. "QC-PLANT_LAB-000042".
57	func certificateNumber(stage string, seq int64) string {
58		return fmt.Sprintf("QC-%s-%06d", stage, seq)
59	}
60	
61	// recordQCResult evaluates the submitted tests against the FSSAI gate,
62	// persists the result, applies the PASSED/BLOCKED verdict to the subject and
63	// chains the provenance events. This is the only write path that moves a
64	// subject out of QC_PENDING.
65	func (s *service) recordQCResult(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req RecordQCResultRequest) (*domain.QCResult, error) {
66		// Stage×role pairing — RequireRoles admits both analyst roles, the exact
67		// pairing is enforced here.
68		requiredRole, ok := requiredRoleForStage(req.Stage)
69		if !ok {
70			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_STAGE", "stage must be "+domain.QCStageBMCRapid+" or "+domain.QCStagePlantLab)
71		}
72		if actor.RoleCode != requiredRole {
73			return nil, httpx.Forbidden("STAGE_ROLE_MISMATCH: stage " + req.Stage + " results may only be recorded by " + requiredRole)
74		}
75	
76		subject, err := s.loadGateSubject(ctx, req.SubjectType, req.SubjectID)
77		if err != nil {
78			return nil, err
79		}
80		if err := s.deps.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, subject.orgUnitID); err != nil {
81			return nil, err
82		}
83	
84		// Evaluate against the FSSAI limits (domain owns the rules).
85		overallPass, failures, evaluated := domain.EvaluateQCTests(toDomainTests(req.Tests))
86	
87		resultID := uuid.NewString()
88		now := time.Now().UTC()
89	
90		result := &domain.QCResult{
91			ID:             resultID,
92			SubjectType:    req.SubjectType,
93			SubjectID:      req.SubjectID,
94			Stage:          req.Stage,
95			Tests:          evaluated,
96			OverallPass:    overallPass,
97			AnalystPartyID: actor.PartyID,
98			LabRef:         req.LabRef,
99			RecordedAt:     now,
100		}
101	
102		blockReason := ""
103		if overallPass {
104			seq, err := s.repo.nextCertificateSeq(ctx, req.Stage)
105			if err != nil {
106				return nil, err
107			}
108			result.CertificateNumber = certificateNumber(req.Stage, seq)
109		} else {
110			result.FailureReasons = failures
111			blockReason = strings.Join(failures, "; ")
112		}
113	
114		// Claim the gate first: the conditional QC_PENDING filter makes concurrent
115		// double-records collide here instead of double-applying verdicts.
116		gated, err := s.applyGate(ctx, req.SubjectType, req.SubjectID, resultID, overallPass, blockReason)
117		if err != nil {
118			return nil, err
119		}
120		if !gated {
121			return nil, httpx.Conflict("SUBJECT_ALREADY_GATED", "subject is no longer awaiting QC — a verdict was already recorded")
122		}
123	
124		if err := s.repo.insertResult(ctx, result); err != nil {
125			return nil, err
126		}
127	
128		// Provenance: qc.recorded, then the gate verdict event (blueprint §7).
129		ledgerActor := provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode}
130		recorded, err := s.deps.Ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
131			Type:       domain.EventQCRecorded,
132			EntityType: domain.EntityQCResult,
133			EntityID:   resultID,
134			Refs: []provenance.Ref{
135				{EntityType: subject.entityType, EntityID: req.SubjectID, Relation: "tested"},
136			},
137			Actor:     ledgerActor,
138			OrgUnitID: subject.orgUnitID,
139			Payload: map[string]any{
140				"stage":        req.Stage,
141				"subject_type": req.SubjectType,
142				"overall_pass": overallPass,
143			},
144		})
145		if err != nil {
146			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
147		}
148	
149		gateEvent := provenance.AppendInput{
150			EntityType: domain.EntityQCResult,
151			EntityID:   resultID,
152			Actor:      ledgerActor,
153			OrgUnitID:  subject.orgUnitID,
154		}
155		if overallPass {
156			gateEvent.Type = domain.EventGatePassed
157			gateEvent.Refs = []provenance.Ref{
158				{EntityType: subject.entityType, EntityID: req.SubjectID, Relation: "certifies"},
159			}
160			gateEvent.Payload = map[string]any{"certificate_number": result.CertificateNumber}
161		} else {
162			gateEvent.Type = domain.EventGateBlocked
163			gateEvent.Refs = []provenance.Ref{
164				{EntityType: subject.entityType, EntityID: req.SubjectID, Relation: "blocks"},
165			}
166			gateEvent.Payload = map[string]any{"failure_reasons": failures}
167		}
168		if _, err := s.deps.Ledger.Append(ctx, gateEvent); err != nil {
169			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
170		}
171	
172		if err := s.repo.setResultProvenanceSeq(ctx, resultID, recorded.Seq); err != nil {
173			return nil, err
174		}
175		result.ProvenanceSeq = recorded.Seq
176	
177		// Broadcast the block so the plant module quarantines downstream — a
178		// blocked lot can never advance.
179		if !overallPass {
180			s.deps.Bus.Publish(eventbus.TopicGateBlocked, GateBlockedPayload{
181				SubjectType:    req.SubjectType,
182				SubjectID:      req.SubjectID,
183				QCResultID:     resultID,
184				Stage:          req.Stage,
185				FailureReasons: failures,
186			})
187		}
188		return result, nil
189	}

191	// loadGateSubject fetches a gate-eligible subject and verifies it is awaiting
192	// QC. Only BMC lots and processing batches carry the software safety gate.
193	func (s *service) loadGateSubject(ctx context.Context, subjectType, subjectID string) (gateSubject, error) {
194		switch subjectType {
195		case domain.QCSubjectBMCLot:
196			lot, err := s.repo.findBMCLot(ctx, subjectID)
197			if err != nil {
198				return gateSubject{}, err
199			}
200			if lot.Status != domain.BMCLotStatusQCPending {
201				return gateSubject{}, httpx.Conflict("SUBJECT_NOT_QC_PENDING", "bmc lot is in status "+lot.Status+" — only QC_PENDING subjects can be gated")
202			}
203			return gateSubject{entityType: domain.EntityBMCLot, orgUnitID: lot.BMCID, status: lot.Status}, nil
204	
205		case domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch:
206			batch, err := s.repo.findBatch(ctx, subjectID)
207			if err != nil {
208				return gateSubject{}, err
209			}
210			if batch.Status != domain.BatchStatusQCPending {
211				return gateSubject{}, httpx.Conflict("SUBJECT_NOT_QC_PENDING", "processing batch is in status "+batch.Status+" — only QC_PENDING subjects can be gated")
212			}
213			return gateSubject{entityType: domain.EntityBatch, orgUnitID: batch.PlantID, status: batch.Status}, nil
214	
215		case domain.QCSubjectDCSConsignment:
216			return gateSubject{}, httpx.Unprocessable("SUBJECT_NOT_GATE_ELIGIBLE", "DCS consignments are not gate subjects — gate at the BMC lot or processing batch")
217	
218		default:
219			return gateSubject{}, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_SUBJECT_TYPE", "subject_type must be one of "+domain.QCSubjectBMCLot+", "+domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch)
220		}
221	}
222	
223	// applyGate routes the conditional verdict write to the subject's collection,
224	// mapping the verdict onto that subject kind's status constants.
225	func (s *service) applyGate(ctx context.Context, subjectType, subjectID, resultID string, pass bool, blockReason string) (bool, error) {
226		switch subjectType {
227		case domain.QCSubjectBMCLot:
228			status := domain.BMCLotStatusBlocked
229			if pass {
230				status = domain.BMCLotStatusPassed
231			}
232			return s.repo.gateBMCLot(ctx, subjectID, resultID, status, blockReason)
233		case domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch:
234			status := domain.BatchStatusBlocked
235			if pass {
236				status = domain.BatchStatusPassed
237			}
238			return s.repo.gateBatch(ctx, subjectID, resultID, status, blockReason)
239		default:
240			return false, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_SUBJECT_TYPE", "subject_type is not gate-eligible")
241		}
242	}
243	
244	// listQCResults returns a page of results, newest first. When the filter
245	// identifies an org-owned subject, the caller must be in that org's scope.
246	func (s *service) listQCResults(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, subjectType, subjectID string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.QCResult, int64, error) {
247		if subjectType != "" && !isValidSubjectType(subjectType) {
248			return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_SUBJECT_TYPE", "unknown subject_type "+subjectType)
249		}
250		if subjectID != "" && subjectType == "" {
251			return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_SUBJECT_TYPE", "subject_id requires subject_type")
252		}
253		if subjectID != "" {
254			if err := s.requireSubjectScope(ctx, actor, subjectType, subjectID); err != nil {
255				return nil, 0, err
256			}
257		}
258		return s.repo.listResults(ctx, subjectType, subjectID, page)
259	}
260	
261	// getQCResult returns one result (its tests carry the stored pass verdicts),
262	// enforcing the subject org scope.
263	func (s *service) getQCResult(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, resultID string) (*domain.QCResult, error) {
264		result, err := s.repo.findResultByID(ctx, resultID)
265		if err != nil {
266			return nil, err
267		}
268		if err := s.requireSubjectScope(ctx, actor, result.SubjectType, result.SubjectID); err != nil {
269			return nil, err
270		}
271		return result, nil
272	}
273	
274	// requireSubjectScope enforces the caller's org scope over the org unit that
275	// owns a QC subject. Subjects that no longer resolve (or subject types that
276	// carry no org) skip the check — the role gate still applies.
277	func (s *service) requireSubjectScope(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, subjectType, subjectID string) error {
278		orgID, err := s.subjectOrgUnit(ctx, subjectType, subjectID)
279		if err != nil {
280			return err
281		}
282		if orgID == "" {
283			return nil
284		}
285		return s.deps.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, orgID)
286	}
287	
288	// subjectOrgUnit resolves the owning org unit of a subject, or "" when the
289	// subject is missing or not an org-owned gate subject.
290	func (s *service) subjectOrgUnit(ctx context.Context, subjectType, subjectID string) (string, error) {
291		switch subjectType {
292		case domain.QCSubjectBMCLot:
293			lot, err := s.repo.findBMCLot(ctx, subjectID)
294			if err != nil {
295				return "", ignoreNotFound(err)
296			}
297			return lot.BMCID, nil
298		case domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch:
299			batch, err := s.repo.findBatch(ctx, subjectID)
300			if err != nil {
301				return "", ignoreNotFound(err)
302			}
303			return batch.PlantID, nil
304		default:
305			return "", nil
306		}
307	}
308	
309	// ignoreNotFound swallows 404 AppErrors and passes everything else through.
310	func ignoreNotFound(err error) error {
311		var appErr *httpx.AppError
312		if errors.As(err, &appErr) && appErr.Status == http.StatusNotFound {
313			return nil
314		}
315		return err
316	}
317	
318	// isValidSubjectType reports whether t is a known QC subject type.
319	func isValidSubjectType(t string) bool {
320		switch t {
321		case domain.QCSubjectDCSConsignment, domain.QCSubjectBMCLot, domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch:
322			return true
323		default:
324			return false
325		}
326	}
327	
328	// toDomainTests converts request test inputs to domain tests for evaluation.
329	func toDomainTests(in []QCTestInput) []domain.QCTest {
330		out := make([]domain.QCTest, 0, len(in))
331		for _, t := range in {
332			out = append(out, domain.QCTest{Name: t.Name, Value: t.Value, Unit: t.Unit})
333		}
334		return out
335	}
336	
337	// limits returns the FSSAI gate constants (blueprint §8.3) as reference data.
338	func (s *service) limits() LimitsResponse {
339		return LimitsResponse{
340			Authority: "FSSAI",
341			Limits: []QCLimit{
342				{
343					TestName:    domain.TestAflatoxinM1,

348				},

352					Unit:        "CFU/ml",

355				},

156			gateEvent.Type = domain.EventGatePassed
157			gateEvent.Refs = []provenance.Ref{
158				{EntityType: subject.entityType, EntityID: req.SubjectID, Relation: "certifies"},
159			}
160			gateEvent.Payload = map[string]any{"certificate_number": result.CertificateNumber}
161		} else {
162			gateEvent.Type = domain.EventGateBlocked
163			gateEvent.Refs = []provenance.Ref{
164				{EntityType: subject.entityType, EntityID: req.SubjectID, Relation: "blocks"},
165			}
166			gateEvent.Payload = map[string]any{"failure_reasons": failures}
167		}
168		if _, err := s.deps.Ledger.Append(ctx, gateEvent); err != nil {
169			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
170		}
171	
172		if err := s.repo.setResultProvenanceSeq(ctx, resultID, recorded.Seq); err != nil {
173			return nil, err
174		}
175		result.ProvenanceSeq = recorded.Seq
176	
177		// Broadcast the block so the plant module quarantines downstream — a
178		// blocked lot can never advance.
179		if !overallPass {
180			s.deps.Bus.Publish(eventbus.TopicGateBlocked, GateBlockedPayload{
181				SubjectType:    req.SubjectType,
182				SubjectID:      req.SubjectID,
183				QCResultID:     resultID,
184				Stage:          req.Stage,
185				FailureReasons: failures,
186			})
187		}
188		return result, nil
189	}

191	// loadGateSubject fetches a gate-eligible subject and verifies it is awaiting
192	// QC. Only BMC lots and processing batches carry the software safety gate.
193	func (s *service) loadGateSubject(ctx context.Context, subjectType, subjectID string) (gateSubject, error) {
194		switch subjectType {
195		case domain.QCSubjectBMCLot:
196			lot, err := s.repo.findBMCLot(ctx, subjectID)
197			if err != nil {
198				return gateSubject{}, err
199			}
200			if lot.Status != domain.BMCLotStatusQCPending {
201				return gateSubject{}, httpx.Conflict("SUBJECT_NOT_QC_PENDING", "bmc lot is in status "+lot.Status+" — only QC_PENDING subjects can be gated")
202			}
203			return gateSubject{entityType: domain.EntityBMCLot, orgUnitID: lot.BMCID, status: lot.Status}, nil
204	
205		case domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch:
206			batch, err := s.repo.findBatch(ctx, subjectID)
207			if err != nil {
208				return gateSubject{}, err
209			}
210			if batch.Status != domain.BatchStatusQCPending {
211				return gateSubject{}, httpx.Conflict("SUBJECT_NOT_QC_PENDING", "processing batch is in status "+batch.Status+" — only QC_PENDING subjects can be gated")
212			}
213			return gateSubject{entityType: domain.EntityBatch, orgUnitID: batch.PlantID, status: batch.Status}, nil
214	
215		case domain.QCSubjectDCSConsignment:
216			return gateSubject{}, httpx.Unprocessable("SUBJECT_NOT_GATE_ELIGIBLE", "DCS consignments are not gate subjects — gate at the BMC lot or processing batch")
217	
218		default:
219			return gateSubject{}, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_SUBJECT_TYPE", "subject_type must be one of "+domain.QCSubjectBMCLot+", "+domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch)
220		}
221	}
222	
223	// applyGate routes the conditional verdict write to the subject's collection,
224	// mapping the verdict onto that subject kind's status constants.
225	func (s *service) applyGate(ctx context.Context, subjectType, subjectID, resultID string, pass bool, blockReason string) (bool, error) {
226		switch subjectType {
227		case domain.QCSubjectBMCLot:
228			status := domain.BMCLotStatusBlocked
229			if pass {
230				status = domain.BMCLotStatusPassed
231			}
232			return s.repo.gateBMCLot(ctx, subjectID, resultID, status, blockReason)
233		case domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch:
234			status := domain.BatchStatusBlocked
235			if pass {
236				status = domain.BatchStatusPassed
237			}
238			return s.repo.gateBatch(ctx, subjectID, resultID, status, blockReason)
239		default:
240			return false, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_SUBJECT_TYPE", "subject_type is not gate-eligible")
241		}
242	}

244	// listQCResults returns a page of results, newest first. When the filter
245	// identifies an org-owned subject, the caller must be in that org's scope.
246	func (s *service) listQCResults(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, subjectType, subjectID string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.QCResult, int64, error) {
247		if subjectType != "" && !isValidSubjectType(subjectType) {
248			return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_SUBJECT_TYPE", "unknown subject_type "+subjectType)
249		}
250		if subjectID != "" && subjectType == "" {
251			return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_SUBJECT_TYPE", "subject_id requires subject_type")
252		}
253		if subjectID != "" {
254			if err := s.requireSubjectScope(ctx, actor, subjectType, subjectID); err != nil {
255				return nil, 0, err
256			}
257		}
258		return s.repo.listResults(ctx, subjectType, subjectID, page)
259	}

264		result, err := s.repo.findResultByID(ctx, resultID)

274	// requireSubjectScope enforces the caller's org scope over the org unit that
275	// owns a QC subject. Subjects that no longer resolve (or subject types that

277	func (s *service) requireSubjectScope(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, subjectType, subjectID string) error {
278		orgID, err := s.subjectOrgUnit(ctx, subjectType, subjectID)

281		}

289	// subject is missing or not an org-owned gate subject.
290	func (s *service) subjectOrgUnit(ctx context.Context, subjectType, subjectID string) (string, error) {
291		switch subjectType {
292		case domain.QCSubjectBMCLot:
293			lot, err := s.repo.findBMCLot(ctx, subjectID)
294			if err != nil {
295				return "", ignoreNotFound(err)
296			}
297			return lot.BMCID, nil
298		case domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch:

302			}
303			return batch.PlantID, nil

305			return "", nil
306		}

313			return nil
314		}
315		return err

// codeSafetyGateBlocked is the stable error code every gate refusal carries —
// the frontend switches on it to show the quarantine screen (blueprint §8.3).
const codeSafetyGateBlocked = "SAFETY_GATE_BLOCKED"

// Service holds the plant module's business logic: lot pooling, the safety
// gate, batch numbering, product lot packaging and QR minting.
type Service struct {
	repo     *Repo
	orgs     *orgscope.Resolver
	ledger   *provenance.Ledger
	qrSecret string
}

// NewService wires the service from the shared dependency container.
func NewService(repo *Repo, d *deps.Deps) *Service {
	return &Service{
		repo:     repo,
		orgs:     d.Orgs,
		ledger:   d.Ledger,
		qrSecret: d.Cfg.QRSigningSecret,
	}
}

// --- safety-gate predicates (§8.3) ---
//
// Pure functions so the refusal matrix is unit-testable without a database.
// Every mutation below ALSO re-checks the status inside the MongoDB update
// filter, so a concurrent QC block can never slip a bad lot through.

// canDispatchBMCLot: only a lot with a passing BMC rapid test may leave on a
// tanker. BLOCKED, QC_PENDING and OPEN lots stay put.
func canDispatchBMCLot(status string) bool {
	return status == domain.BMCLotStatusPassed
}

// canPoolBMCLot: only a DISPATCHED lot (which by construction went
// OPEN→QC_PENDING→PASSED→DISPATCHED) may enter a processing batch.
func canPoolBMCLot(status string) bool {
	return status == domain.BMCLotStatusDispatched
}

// canCompleteBatch: only a batch the plant lab has PASSED may complete.
func canCompleteBatch(status string) bool {
	return status == domain.BatchStatusPassed
}

// canYieldProductLot: only a COMPLETED batch may be packaged into SKU lots.
func canYieldProductLot(batchStatus string) bool {
	return batchStatus == domain.BatchStatusCompleted
}

// canIssueQR: a QR may only label an ACTIVE product lot whose batch is
// COMPLETED — re-checked at mint time so a recall immediately stops printing.
func canIssueQR(lotStatus, batchStatus string) bool {
	return lotStatus == domain.ProductLotStatusActive && batchStatus == domain.BatchStatusCompleted
}

Claim: [high] Consumer QR sourcing lists the MILK UNION as a contributing samiti — §7.4 samiti-set view is wrong on essentially every scan @ internal/modules/publictrace/service.go:207 — buildSourcing collects dcsIDs from every traced event with EntityType==DCS_CONSIGNMENT using ev.OrgUnitID. But logistics pickupStop (internal/modules/logistics/service.go:353) appends the consignment.picked_up event with OrgUnitID = trip.UnionID, not the consignment's DCS. In the normal flow every consignment that reaches a product lot has a picked_up event, so dcsIDs always contains the union org id alongside the real DCS ids; orgs.Get(unionID) resolves successfully, so the union is emitted as a SamitiInfo entry (its name/code/district) and inflates the samiti count and district list in the public message ('from N samitis in ...'). The §7.4 consumer trace must show the set of contributing samitis; it currently shows non-samiti org units and a wrong count. // ListBMCLots pages lots by BMC/date/status. A BMC operator may only list
// within their own scope; downstream readers (plant operator, supervisor,
// lab) see across BMCs — the plant receives tankers from sibling BMCs, so an
// ancestry check against the plant org would wrongly refuse them.
func (s *Service) ListBMCLots(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, f BMCLotListFilter, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.BMCLot, int64, error) {
	if f.BMCID != "" && actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleBMCOperator {
		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, f.BMCID); err != nil {
			return nil, 0, err
		}
	}
	lots, total, err := s.repo.ListBMCLots(ctx, f, page)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)

	return lots, total, nil

func (s *Service) CreateBatch(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateBatchRequest) (*domain.ProcessingBatch, error) {
	if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.PlantID); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	org, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.PlantID)
	if err != nil {

	lots, err := s.repo.BMCLotsByIDs(ctx, ids)

		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)

		return nil, httpx.NotFound("BMC lot(s) " + strings.Join(missingLotIDs(ids, lots), ", "))

	var offending []string
	var inputLitres float64
	for _, lot := range lots {

	}
	batchNumber := fmt.Sprintf("BATCH-%s-%s-%04d",
		org.Code, strings.ReplaceAll(dateKey, "-", ""), seq)

	// CREATED is a transient birth state: the plant lab must clear every
	// batch, so it is persisted straight into QC_PENDING.
	batch := &domain.ProcessingBatch{
		ID:          uuid.NewString(),
		PlantID:     req.PlantID,
		BatchNumber: batchNumber,
		BMCLotIDs:   ids,
		ProductType: req.ProductType,
		InputLitres: inputLitres,
		Status:      domain.BatchStatusQCPending,
		StartedAt:   now,
		CreatedBy:   actor.PartyID,
		CreatedAt:   now,
	}
	if err := s.repo.InsertBatch(ctx, batch); err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}

	refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, len(ids))
	for _, id := range ids {
		refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{
			EntityType: domain.EntityBMCLot, EntityID: id, Relation: "pools",
		})
	}
	ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
		Type:       domain.EventBatchCreated,
		EntityType: domain.EntityBatch,
		EntityID:   batch.ID,
		Refs:       refs,
		Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
		OrgUnitID:  req.PlantID,
		Payload: map[string]any{
			"batch_number": batchNumber, "product_type": req.ProductType, "input_litres": inputLitres,
		},
	})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	if err := s.repo.SetBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx, batch.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	batch.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
	return batch, nil
}

// CompleteBatch transitions PASSED→COMPLETED — only a batch the plant lab
// cleared may finish and go on to yield product lots.
func (s *Service) CompleteBatch(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id string) (*domain.ProcessingBatch, error) {
	batch, err := s.getBatch(ctx, id)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, batch.PlantID); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if batch.Status == domain.BatchStatusCompleted {
		return nil, httpx.Conflict("BATCH_ALREADY_COMPLETED", "batch is already completed")
	}
	if !canCompleteBatch(batch.Status) {
		msg := "batch cannot complete: plant-lab QC not passed (status " + batch.Status + ")"
		if batch.BlockReason != "" {
			msg += " — " + batch.BlockReason
		}
		return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked, msg).
			WithDetails(map[string]any{"status": batch.Status, "block_reason": batch.BlockReason})
	}
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	ok, err := s.repo.CompleteBatch(ctx, id, now)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	if !ok {
		return nil, httpx.Conflict("BATCH_STATE_CHANGED",
			"batch changed state concurrently — reload and retry")
	}
	ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
		Type:       domain.EventBatchCompleted,
		EntityType: domain.EntityBatch,
		EntityID:   batch.ID,
		Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
		OrgUnitID:  batch.PlantID,

// TraceGraph returns the full event graph around one entity: upstream via
// the recursive ref walk, downstream via reverse-ref lookup — the recall /
// root-cause tool (§8.3).
func (s *Service) TraceGraph(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string) (*TraceGraphResponse, error) {
	if err := validateEntityType(entityType); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	upstream, err := s.ledger.Trace(ctx, entityType, entityID, traceDepth)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	downstream, err := s.ledger.DownstreamRefs(ctx, entityID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	if len(downstream) > downstreamEventCap {
		downstream = downstream[len(downstream)-downstreamEventCap:]
	}
	if len(upstream) == 0 && len(downstream) == 0 {
		return nil, httpx.NotFound("provenance for entity")
	}
	if upstream == nil {
		upstream = []provenance.Event{}
	}
	if downstream == nil {
		downstream = []provenance.Event{}
	}
	return &TraceGraphResponse{Upstream: upstream, Downstream: downstream}, nil
}

// Timeline returns one entity's own events in chain order, paginated.
// The second return value is the total event count before paging.
func (s *Service) Timeline(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, page httpx.Page) ([]provenance.Event, int, error) {
	if err := validateEntityType(entityType); err != nil {
		return nil, 0, err
	}
	events, err := s.ledger.EventsForEntity(ctx, entityType, entityID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
	}
	if len(events) == 0 {
		return nil, 0, httpx.NotFound("provenance for entity")
	}
	total := len(events)
	start := min(page.Offset, int64(total))
	end := min(start+page.Limit, int64(total))
	return events[start:end], total, nil
}

// validateEntityType rejects entity types outside the domain.Entity* catalog.
func validateEntityType(entityType string) error {
	if _, ok := validEntityTypes[entityType]; !ok {
		return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_ENTITY_TYPE",
			"unknown entity type "+entityType+" — use one of the provenance entity type constants")
	}
	return nil
}

// sortedKeys returns a set's keys in deterministic (lexicographic) order.
func sortedKeys(set map[string]struct{}) []string {
	out := make([]string, 0, len(set))
	for k := range set {
		out = append(out, k)
	}
	sort.Strings(out)
	return out
}

21	const (
22		// traceDepth bounds the upstream graph walk (QR → lot → batch → BMC lots
23		// → consignments comfortably fits; the ledger also hard-caps event count).
24		traceDepth = 10
25		// scanVerifySpanCap bounds how many ledger events one consumer scan
26		// re-hashes; wider traced ranges are verified partially (most recent tail).
27		scanVerifySpanCap = 5000
28		// publicVerifySpanCap bounds the public /ledger/verify endpoint span.
29		publicVerifySpanCap = 10000
30		// downstreamEventCap keeps the official trace response bounded even for
31		// heavily referenced entities.
32		downstreamEventCap = 2000
33	)

35	// validEntityTypes is the closed set of traceable entity types (domain.Entity*).
36	var validEntityTypes = map[string]struct{}{
37		domain.EntityMilkPour:        {},
38		domain.EntityAnalyzerReading: {},

51	
52	// Service resolves consumer QR scans and official trace queries. All reads,
53	// no writes except the fire-and-forget scan counter — nothing here ever
54	// mutates provenance.
55	type Service struct {
56		log      *slog.Logger
57		repo     *repo
58		ledger   *provenance.Ledger
59		orgs     *orgscope.Resolver
60		qrSecret string
61	}
62	
63	// NewService wires the service from the shared dependency container.
64	func NewService(d *deps.Deps) *Service {
65		return &Service{
66			log:      d.Log,
67			repo:     newRepo(d.DB),
68			ledger:   d.Ledger,
69			orgs:     d.Orgs,
70			qrSecret: d.Cfg.QRSigningSecret,
71		}
72	}

74	// VerifyQRToken checks a stored signed token in the format QR issuance
75	// (plant module signQRToken) mints: "base64url(qr_code|product_lot_id|
76	// issued_unix)" + "." + hex(HMAC-SHA256(secret, decoded payload)). The HMAC
77	// is computed over the DECODED payload bytes — exactly what issuance signed.
78	// The comparison is constant-time so a forger learns nothing from response
79	// timing.
80	func VerifyQRToken(secret, token string) bool {
81		payloadB64, signature, found := strings.Cut(token, ".")
82		if !found || payloadB64 == "" || signature == "" {
83			return false // malformed: no payload/signature split
84		}
85		payload, err := base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString(payloadB64)
86		if err != nil || len(payload) == 0 {
87			return false // malformed: payload is not valid base64url
88		}
89		expected := auth.HMACHash(secret, string(payload))
90		return auth.ConstantTimeEqual(expected, signature)
91	}
92	
93	// ScanQR resolves one consumer QR scan into the honest provenance view
94	// (§7.4): product + plant + lab certificate + the SET of contributing
95	// samitis — never per-farmer data — plus a live tamper-evidence check.
96	func (s *Service) ScanQR(ctx context.Context, qrCode string) (*QRScanResponse, error) {
97		qr, err := s.repo.qrByCode(ctx, qrCode)
98		if err != nil {
99			return nil, err
100		}
101	
102		// Integrity gate: the stored token must carry a valid HMAC. A mismatch
103		// means the QR record was tampered with or forged — surface it loudly.
104		if !VerifyQRToken(s.qrSecret, qr.SignedToken) {
105			s.log.Warn("QR signed-token integrity check failed — possible forgery",
106				slog.String("qr_code", qrCode), slog.String("qr_id", qr.ID))
107			return nil, httpx.Conflict("QR_INTEGRITY_FAILED",
108				"this QR code failed integrity verification and may be counterfeit")
109		}
110	
111		// Count the scan without ever blocking it: fire-and-forget increment.
112		go func(qrID string) {
113			bg, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
114			defer cancel()
115			if err := s.repo.incrementScanCount(bg, qrID); err != nil {
116				s.log.Warn("scan_count increment failed", slog.String("qr_id", qrID), slog.Any("err", err))
117			}
118		}(qr.ID)
119	
120		lot, err := s.repo.productLotByID(ctx, qr.ProductLotID)
121		if err != nil {
122			return nil, err
123		}
124		batch, err := s.repo.batchByID(ctx, lot.BatchID)
125		if err != nil {
126			return nil, err
127		}
128		plant, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, batch.PlantID)
129		if err != nil {
130			return nil, err
131		}
132	
133		// Walk the provenance graph upstream from the product lot to the pooling
134		// boundary: batch → BMC lots → consignments (§7.4).
135		events, err := s.ledger.Trace(ctx, domain.EntityProductLot, lot.ID, traceDepth)
136		if err != nil {
137			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
138		}
139	
140		sourcing, err := s.buildSourcing(ctx, events)
141		if err != nil {
142			return nil, err
143		}
144	
145		ledgerInfo, err := s.verifyTracedRange(ctx, events)
146		if err != nil {
147			return nil, err
148		}
149	
150		resp := &QRScanResponse{
151			Product: ProductInfo{
152				Name:       lot.ProductName,
153				SKU:        lot.SKU,
154				UnitSize:   lot.UnitSize,
155				MfgDate:    lot.MfgDate,
156				ExpiryDate: lot.ExpiryDate,
157			},
158			BatchNumber: batch.BatchNumber,
159			Plant:       PlantInfo{Name: plant.Name, District: plant.District},
160			Sourcing:    *sourcing,
161			Ledger:      *ledgerInfo,
162			ScanCount:   qr.ScanCount + 1, // reflect this scan; the $inc lands async
163		}
164	
165		// PLANT_LAB pass certificate — omitted (not an error) when absent.
166		qc, err := s.repo.latestPlantLabPass(ctx, batch.ID)
167		if err != nil {
168			return nil, err
169		}
170		if qc != nil {
171			resp.Quality = &QualityInfo{
172				CertificateNumber: qc.CertificateNumber,
173				Stage:             qc.Stage,
174				Tests:             qc.Tests,
175				RecordedAt:        qc.RecordedAt,
176			}
177		}
178	
179		// A recalled lot still resolves with 200 — consumers must SEE the recall
180		// notice, not hit a dead link.
181		if lot.Status == domain.ProductLotStatusRecalled {
182			resp.Recalled = true
183			notice := "This product lot has been RECALLED. Do not consume — return it to the point of purchase."
184			if lot.RecallReason != "" {
185				notice += " Reason: " + lot.RecallReason
186			}
187			resp.RecallNotice = notice
