67	// resolveAnimalOwner decides who the registered animal belongs to. A FARMER
68	// may only register their own animals (any explicit owner_party_id must match
69	// the caller); every other registrar role must name the owner explicitly.
70	// Pure function — unit tested.
71	func resolveAnimalOwner(actor auth.Actor, requestedOwner string) (string, *httpx.AppError) {
72		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleFarmer {
73			if requestedOwner != "" && requestedOwner != actor.PartyID {
74				return "", httpx.Forbidden("farmers may only register their own animals")
75			}
76			return actor.PartyID, nil
77		}
78		if requestedOwner == "" {
79			return "", httpx.BadRequest("OWNER_REQUIRED", "owner_party_id is required when registering on a farmer's behalf")
80		}
81		return requestedOwner, nil
82	}

136		now := time.Now().UTC()

282	func (s *service) CreateMVUCase(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateMVUCaseRequest) (*domain.MVUCase, error) {
283		if strings.TrimSpace(req.Symptoms) == "" {
284			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("SYMPTOMS_REQUIRED", "symptoms description is required")
285		}
286	
287		dcsID := actor.OrgUnitID

291			if err != nil {
292				return nil, err
293			}
294			if animal.OwnerPartyID != actor.PartyID {
295				return nil, httpx.Forbidden("you may only raise an MVU case for your own animal")
296			}
297			animalID = animal.ID
298			dcsID = animal.DCSID
299		}
300		if dcsID == "" {
301			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("DCS_UNRESOLVED", "cannot resolve a DCS for this case — provide animal_id or use a DCS-scoped role token")
302		}
303	
304		mvuCase := &domain.MVUCase{
305			ID:            uuid.NewString(),
306			AnimalID:      animalID,
307			FarmerPartyID: actor.PartyID,
308			DCSID:         dcsID,
309			Symptoms:      strings.TrimSpace(req.Symptoms),
310			Status:        domain.MVUCaseRequested,
311			RequestedAt:   time.Now().UTC(),
312		}
313		if err := s.repo.InsertMVUCase(ctx, mvuCase); err != nil {
314			return nil, err
315		}
316		return mvuCase, nil

319	// DispatchMVUCase moves a case REQUESTED → DISPATCHED, records the assignee
320	// from the caller's role, and publishes eventbus.TopicMVUDispatched with a
321	// *domain.MVUCase payload (the notifications module reacts, §10).
322	func (s *service) DispatchMVUCase(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, caseID string) (*domain.MVUCase, error) {
323		mvuCase, err := s.repo.FindMVUCaseByID(ctx, caseID)
324		if err != nil {
325			return nil, err
326		}
327		if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, mvuCase.DCSID); err != nil {
328			return nil, err
329		}
330	
331		var vetPartyID, driverPartyID string
332		switch actor.RoleCode {
333		case domain.RoleVeterinarian:
334			vetPartyID = actor.PartyID
335		case domain.RoleMVUDriver:
336			driverPartyID = actor.PartyID
337			// Any other role reaching here is break-glass SUPER_ADMIN: the case
338			// is dispatched without pinning an assignee.
339		}
340	
341		transitioned, err := s.repo.DispatchMVUCase(ctx, mvuCase.ID, vetPartyID, driverPartyID)
342		if err != nil {
343			return nil, err
344		}
345		if !transitioned {
346			return nil, httpx.Conflict("MVU_NOT_REQUESTED", "MVU case is not in REQUESTED state")
347		}
348	
349		updated, err := s.repo.FindMVUCaseByID(ctx, mvuCase.ID)
350		if err != nil {
351			return nil, err
352		}
353		s.d.Bus.Publish(eventbus.TopicMVUDispatched, updated)
354		return updated, nil
355	}

372			return nil, err
373		}

376		}
377		return s.repo.FindMVUCaseByID(ctx, mvuCase.ID)

232	// decodeBusPayload structurally re-decodes a bus payload into this module's

234	func decodeBusPayload(payload any, dst any) error {
235		raw, err := json.Marshal(payload)

238		}
239		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, dst); err != nil {

335	// queueNotification inserts one QUEUED outbox document, resolving phone and
336	// preferred language from the party record when available. Failures are
337	// logged, never propagated — a lost SMS must not fail the publishing flow.
338	func (s *service) queueNotification(ctx context.Context, partyID, phone, templateKey string, params map[string]string) {
339		language := "hi" // vernacular default (blueprint §13)
340		if partyID != "" {
341			if party, err := s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, partyID); err == nil {
342				if phone == "" {
343					phone = party.Phone
344				}
345				if party.PreferredLanguage != "" {
346					language = party.PreferredLanguage
347				}
348			}
349		}
350		if phone == "" {
351			s.deps.Log.Error("platformops: dropping notification with no phone",
352				slog.String("template_key", templateKey), slog.String("party_id", partyID))
353			return
354		}
355	
356		notification := &StoredNotification{Notification: domain.Notification{
357			ID:          uuid.NewString(),
358			PartyID:     partyID,
359			Phone:       phone,
360			Channel:     domain.ChannelSMS,
361			TemplateKey: templateKey,
362			Language:    language,
363			Params:      params,
364			Status:      domain.NotificationQueued,
365			QueuedAt:    time.Now().UTC(),
366		}}
367		if err := s.repo.insertNotification(ctx, notification); err != nil {
368			s.deps.Log.Error("platformops: queue notification failed",
369				slog.String("template_key", templateKey), slog.Any("err", err))
370		}
371	}
372	
373	// unionAncestor returns the MILK_UNION org unit at or above orgUnitID, walking
374	// the denormalised ancestor Path nearest-first via d.Orgs.Get. Returns nil
375	// when no union sits on the chain (e.g. a plant directly under the federation).
376	func (s *service) unionAncestor(ctx context.Context, orgUnitID string) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
377		org, err := s.deps.Orgs.Get(ctx, orgUnitID)
378		if err != nil {
379			return nil, err
380		}
381		if org.Type == domain.OrgTypeMilkUnion {
382			return org, nil
383		}
384		// Path holds ancestors root→down; walk nearest ancestor first.
385		for i := len(org.Path) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
386			ancestor, err := s.deps.Orgs.Get(ctx, org.Path[i])
387			if err != nil {
388				return nil, err
389			}
390			if ancestor.Type == domain.OrgTypeMilkUnion {
391				return ancestor, nil
392			}
393		}
394		return nil, nil
395	}

1	// Package platformops is the platform-operations module (blueprint §12): the
2	// SUPER_ADMIN feature-flag console, the STATE_AUDITOR read-only audit surface
3	// with its GIGW/DPDP immutable export, the notifications outbox with the mock
4	// SMS dispatch worker (real deployment: MSG91 / telecom DLT gateway, §13),
5	// and the SUPPORT_AGENT audited limited-PII lookup (§5.2 role 20).
6	//
7	// It also subscribes to cross-module bus topics — payout credited, safety
8	// gate blocked, MVU dispatched — and turns them into queued vernacular SMS.
9	package platformops
10	
11	import (
12		"context"
13		"log/slog"
14	
15		"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
16	
17		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
18		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
19		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/eventbus"
20		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/middleware"
21	)
22	
23	// Register wires the platformops module and mounts /admin, /audit,
24	// /notifications and /support (the router hands us the /api/v1 subtree).
25	func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
26		repo := newRepository(d.DB)
27		svc := newService(d, repo)
28		h := newHandler(svc)
29	
30		r.Route("/admin", func(r chi.Router) {
31			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
32	
33			// PCDF_ADMIN may LIST flags; flipping one is SUPER_ADMIN only —
34			// capability gating is a deliberate act (blueprint principle #6).
35			r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSuperAdmin, domain.RolePCDFAdmin)).
36				Get("/flags", h.listFlags)
37			r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSuperAdmin)).
38				Put("/flags/{key}", h.setFlag)
39		})
40	
41		r.Route("/audit", func(r chi.Router) {
42			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
43			r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleStateAuditor, domain.RoleSuperAdmin))
44	
45			// Read-only by design: there is deliberately NO write/delete API
46			// surface for audit logs (§12) — entries land via deps.Audit only.
47			r.Get("/logs", h.listAuditLogs)
48			r.Get("/logs/export", h.exportAuditLogs)
49		})
50	
51		r.Route("/notifications", func(r chi.Router) {
52			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
53	
54			r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSuperAdmin, domain.RoleSupportAgent)).
55				Get("/", h.listNotifications)
56			r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSuperAdmin)).
57				Post("/worker/run", h.runWorker)
58		})
59	
60		r.Route("/support", func(r chi.Router) {
61			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
62			r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSupportAgent, domain.RoleSuperAdmin))
63	
64			r.Get("/parties/lookup", h.lookupParty)
65		})
66	
67		// Cross-module reactions arrive over the bus (modules never import each
68		// other). The bus already runs each handler on its own goroutine with a
69		// bounded context and panic recovery; the wrapper below adds an explicit
70		// second belt at this module's boundary.
71		d.Bus.Subscribe(eventbus.TopicPayoutCredited, safeHandler(d, svc.onPayoutCredited))
72		d.Bus.Subscribe(eventbus.TopicGateBlocked, safeHandler(d, svc.onGateBlocked))
73		d.Bus.Subscribe(eventbus.TopicMVUDispatched, safeHandler(d, svc.onMVUDispatched))
74	}
75	
76	// safeHandler wraps a bus reaction so a programming error in notification
77	// fan-out can never disturb the publishing flow.
78	func safeHandler(d *deps.Deps, reaction func(ctx context.Context, payload any)) eventbus.Handler {
79		return func(ctx context.Context, topic string, payload any) {
80			defer func() {
81				if rec := recover(); rec != nil {
82					d.Log.Error("platformops bus handler panic",
83						slog.String("topic", topic), slog.Any("panic", rec))
84				}
85			}()
86			reaction(ctx, payload)
87		}
88	}

80	
81	// genesisHash anchors the chain before the first event.
82	const genesisHash = "GENESIS"
83	
84	// Append chains a new event. Concurrency-safe without transactions: it reads
85	// the current head, computes seq+hash optimistically, and relies on the
86	// unique index on `seq` — a duplicate-key collision means another writer won
87	// the slot, so we re-read and retry.
88	func (l *Ledger) Append(ctx context.Context, in AppendInput) (*Event, error) {
89		const maxRetries = 12
90		for attempt := 0; attempt < maxRetries; attempt++ {
91			seq, prevHash, err := l.head(ctx)
92			if err != nil {
93				return nil, err
94			}
95			ev := &Event{
96				ID:         uuid.NewString(),
97				Seq:        seq + 1,
98				Type:       in.Type,
99				EntityType: in.EntityType,
100				EntityID:   in.EntityID,
101				Refs:       in.Refs,
102				Actor:      in.Actor,
103				OrgUnitID:  in.OrgUnitID,
104				Payload:    in.Payload,
105				// Millisecond precision: BSON datetimes store ms, so the persisted
106				// TS must equal the hashed TS or re-verification would break.
107				TS:       time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Millisecond),
108				PrevHash: prevHash,
109			}
110			ev.Hash = computeHash(ev)
111	
112			if _, err := l.coll.InsertOne(ctx, ev); err != nil {
113				if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(err) {
114					continue // lost the seq race — retry against the new head
115				}
116				return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance append: %w", err)
117			}
118			return ev, nil
119		}
120		return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance append: gave up after %d seq collisions", 12)
121	}
122	
123	// head returns the latest (seq, hash), or (0, GENESIS) for an empty chain.
124	func (l *Ledger) head(ctx context.Context) (int64, string, error) {
125		var last Event
126		err := l.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{},
127			options.FindOne().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: -1}}),
128		).Decode(&last)
129		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
130			return 0, genesisHash, nil
131		}
132		if err != nil {
133			return 0, "", fmt.Errorf("provenance head: %w", err)
134		}
135		return last.Seq, last.Hash, nil
136	}

139		}
140		if party, err := s.repo.findPartyByPhone(ctx, phone); err == nil {
141			notification.PartyID = party.ID
142			if party.PreferredLanguage != "" {
143				notification.Language = party.PreferredLanguage
144			}
145		}
146		if err := s.repo.insertNotification(ctx, notification); err != nil {
147			return nil, err
148		}
149	
150		resp := &otpRequestResponse{Phone: phone, ExpiresAt: challenge.ExpiresAt}

157	// verifyOTP checks the challenge and logs the phone in, creating the Party
158	// on first login (find-or-create, §4.1).
159	func (s *service) verifyOTP(ctx context.Context, phone, otp string) (*authTokensResponse, error) {
160		now := time.Now().UTC()
161	
162		challenge, err := s.repo.latestOTPChallenge(ctx, phone, now)
163		if err != nil {
164			if isNotFound(err) {
165				return nil, httpx.Unauthorized("no active OTP for this phone — request a new code")
166			}
167			return nil, err
168		}
169		if challenge.Attempts >= maxOTPAttempts {
170			return nil, httpx.TooManyRequests("too many incorrect OTP attempts — request a new code")
171		}
172		expected := auth.HMACHash(s.deps.Cfg.OTPHashSecret, phone, otp)
173		if !auth.ConstantTimeEqual(challenge.CodeHash, expected) {
174			if err := s.repo.incrementOTPAttempts(ctx, challenge.ID); err != nil {
175				return nil, err
176			}
177			return nil, httpx.Unauthorized("incorrect OTP")
178		}
179	
180		// Burn every outstanding challenge for this phone.
181		if err := s.repo.deleteOTPChallenges(ctx, phone); err != nil {
182			return nil, err
183		}
184	
185		party, err := s.repo.upsertPartyByPhone(ctx, phone, now)
186		if err != nil {
187			return nil, err
188		}
189		if party.Status != domain.PartyStatusActive {
190			return nil, httpx.Forbidden("party is suspended")
191		}
192		return s.issueLoginTokens(ctx, party, now)
193	}

195	// issueLoginTokens mints a SESSION access token plus a fresh rotating
196	// refresh token (stored only as an HMAC digest).
197	func (s *service) issueLoginTokens(ctx context.Context, party *domain.Party, now time.Time) (*authTokensResponse, error) {
198		refreshToken, err := auth.RandomToken(32)
199		if err != nil {
200			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
201		}
202		doc := refreshTokenDoc{
203			ID:        uuid.NewString(),
204			TokenHash: auth.HMACHash(s.deps.Cfg.OTPHashSecret, refreshHashLabel, refreshToken),
205			PartyID:   party.ID,
206			ExpiresAt: now.Add(s.deps.Cfg.RefreshTokenTTL),
207			CreatedAt: now,
208		}
209		if err := s.repo.insertRefreshToken(ctx, doc); err != nil {
210			return nil, err
211		}
212		accessToken, err := s.deps.JWT.IssueSessionToken(*party)
213		if err != nil {
214			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
215		}
216		return &authTokensResponse{
217			AccessToken:  accessToken,
218			RefreshToken: refreshToken,
219			Party:        party,
220		}, nil
221	}
222	
223	// refresh rotates a refresh token: the old token is consumed atomically and
224	// a new pair is issued — a replayed token always fails.
225	func (s *service) refresh(ctx context.Context, refreshToken string) (*authTokensResponse, error) {
226		now := time.Now().UTC()
227		tokenHash := auth.HMACHash(s.deps.Cfg.OTPHashSecret, refreshHashLabel, refreshToken)
228	
229		doc, err := s.repo.findRefreshToken(ctx, tokenHash)
230		if err != nil {
231			if isNotFound(err) {
232				return nil, httpx.Unauthorized("invalid refresh token")
233			}
234			return nil, err
235		}
236		if !now.Before(doc.ExpiresAt) {
237			_, _ = s.repo.deleteRefreshToken(ctx, tokenHash)
238			return nil, httpx.Unauthorized("refresh token expired — log in again")
239		}
240	
241		// ROTATE: consume the old token first; DeletedCount==0 means a parallel
242		// request won the race, so this presentation is treated as a replay.
243		deleted, err := s.repo.deleteRefreshToken(ctx, tokenHash)
244		if err != nil {
245			return nil, err
246		}
247		if deleted == 0 {
248			return nil, httpx.Unauthorized("refresh token already used")
249		}
250	
251		party, err := s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, doc.PartyID)
252		if err != nil {
253			if isNotFound(err) {
254				return nil, httpx.Unauthorized("party no longer exists")
255			}
256			return nil, err
257		}
258		if party.Status != domain.PartyStatusActive {
259			return nil, httpx.Forbidden("party is suspended")
260		}
261		return s.issueLoginTokens(ctx, party, now)
262	}

268	}

418		// the vault service and receives an opaque token. The mock mints a UUID.

421	
422		// MOCK UIDAI eKYC: always succeeds. The real adapter drives the OTP-based
423		// eKYC exchange and may return PENDING/REJECTED.
424		record := domain.KYCRecord{

426			PartyID:         party.ID,
427			Tier:            req.RequestedTier,
428			AadhaarLast4:    last4,

431			Status:          domain.KYCStatusVerified,
432			VerifiedAt:      &now,
433			CreatedAt:       now,
434			UpdatedAt:       now,
435		}
436		if err := s.repo.insertKYCRecord(ctx, record); err != nil {
437			return nil, err

440		newTier := upgradedKYCTier(party.KYCTier, req.RequestedTier)
441		if newTier != party.KYCTier {
442			if err := s.repo.updatePartyKYCTier(ctx, party.ID, newTier, now); err != nil {
443				return nil, err
444			}
445		}

447	}

462		case err == nil:

464			return s.repo.updateKYCRecordBank(ctx, latest.ID, masked, req.IFSC, mockPennyDropNameMatch, now)
465		case isNotFound(err):

469				Tier:              party.KYCTier,
470				BankAccountMasked: masked,
471				BankIFSC:          req.IFSC,

473				BankNameMatch:     mockPennyDropNameMatch,
474				Status:            domain.KYCStatusVerified,
475				VerifiedAt:        &now,
476				CreatedAt:         now,
477				UpdatedAt:         now,
478			}
479			if err := s.repo.insertKYCRecord(ctx, record); err != nil {
480				return nil, err
481			}
482			return &record, nil
483		default:
484			return nil, err
485		}
486	}
487	
488	// listMyKYC pages the caller's KYC records (masked fields only — full
489	// numbers are never persisted anywhere).
490	func (s *service) listMyKYC(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.KYCRecord, int64, error) {
491		return s.repo.listKYCRecords(ctx, actor.PartyID, page)
492	}
493	
494	// --- Role administration ---
495	
496	// requireGrantAuthority enforces the non-admin granter matrix (§5.2):
497	// UNION_PRESIDENT manages village/logistics/union-tier roles anywhere in
498	// scope; SAMITI_ADHYAKSH manages only FARMER/MILK_TESTER/LRP inside their
499	// own DCS. Admin granters pass.
500	func (s *service) requireGrantAuthority(actor auth.Actor, roleCode, orgUnitID string) error {
501		if !granterMayGrant(actor.RoleCode, roleCode) {
502			return httpx.Forbidden("role " + actor.RoleCode + " may not grant or revoke " + roleCode)
503		}
504		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSamitiAdhyaksh && orgUnitID != actor.OrgUnitID {
505			return httpx.Forbidden("SAMITI_ADHYAKSH may manage roles only within their own DCS")
506		}
507		return nil
508	}
509	
510	// createAssignment grants a role to a party inside an org unit.
511	func (s *service) createAssignment(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req createAssignmentRequest) (*domain.RoleAssignment, error) {
512		// Resolve the target party (party_id wins over phone).
513		var party *domain.Party
514		var err error
515		if req.PartyID != "" {
516			party, err = s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, req.PartyID)
517		} else {
518			party, err = s.repo.findPartyByPhone(ctx, req.Phone)
519		}
520		if err != nil {
521			return nil, err
522		}
523	
524		if err := s.deps.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.OrgUnitID); err != nil {
525			return nil, err
526		}
527		if err := s.requireGrantAuthority(actor, req.RoleCode, req.OrgUnitID); err != nil {
528			return nil, err
529		}
530	
531		exists, err := s.repo.activeAssignmentExists(ctx, party.ID, req.RoleCode, req.OrgUnitID)
532		if err != nil {
533			return nil, err
534		}
535		if exists {
536			return nil, httpx.Conflict("ASSIGNMENT_EXISTS", "party already holds an active "+req.RoleCode+" assignment in this org unit")
537		}
538	
539		now := time.Now().UTC()
540		validFrom := now
541		if req.ValidFrom != nil {
542			validFrom = req.ValidFrom.UTC()
543		}
544		var validTo *time.Time
545		if req.ValidTo != nil {
546			t := req.ValidTo.UTC()
547			validTo = &t
548		}
549		assignment := domain.RoleAssignment{
550			ID:        uuid.NewString(),
551			PartyID:   party.ID,
552			RoleCode:  req.RoleCode,
553			OrgUnitID: req.OrgUnitID,
554			GrantedBy: actor.PartyID,
555			ValidFrom: validFrom,
556			ValidTo:   validTo,
557			Status:    domain.RoleAssignmentActive,
558			CreatedAt: now,
559		}
560		if err := s.repo.insertAssignment(ctx, assignment); err != nil {
561			return nil, err
562		}
563		return &assignment, nil
564	}
565	
566	// revokeAssignment flips an assignment to REVOKED — the record is never
567	// deleted (§4.1). Revocation authority mirrors grant authority.
568	func (s *service) revokeAssignment(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, assignmentID string) (*domain.RoleAssignment, error) {
569		assignment, err := s.repo.findAssignmentByID(ctx, assignmentID)
570		if err != nil {
571			return nil, err
572		}
573		if err := s.deps.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, assignment.OrgUnitID); err != nil {
574			return nil, err
575		}
576		if err := s.requireGrantAuthority(actor, assignment.RoleCode, assignment.OrgUnitID); err != nil {
577			return nil, err
578		}
579		if assignment.Status != domain.RoleAssignmentActive {
580			return nil, httpx.Conflict("ALREADY_REVOKED", "role assignment is already revoked")
581		}
582		return s.repo.revokeAssignment(ctx, assignmentID, actor.PartyID, time.Now().UTC())
583	}
584	
585	// listAssignments pages assignments inside one org unit the actor can see.
586	func (s *service) listAssignments(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, orgUnitID, roleCode string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.RoleAssignment, int64, error) {
587		if err := s.deps.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, orgUnitID); err != nil {
588			return nil, 0, err
589		}
590		return s.repo.listAssignments(ctx, orgUnitID, roleCode, page)
591	}

30		// get the DEVICE_CLOCK_SKEW flag.

50	// --- rate charts ---

52	// CreateRateChart stores a new pricing chart for an org unit and deactivates
53	// the org's previously active charts (the new chart supersedes them).
54	func (s *service) CreateRateChart(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateRateChartRequest) (*domain.RateChart, error) {
55		if req.OrgUnitID == "" || req.Name == "" {
56			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "org_unit_id and name are required")
57		}
58		if req.BaseRatePerLitre < 0 || req.FatRatePerPoint < 0 || req.SNFRatePerPoint < 0 {
59			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "rates must not be negative")
60		}
61		if req.BaseRatePerLitre+req.FatRatePerPoint+req.SNFRatePerPoint == 0 {
62			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "at least one rate component must be positive")
63		}
64		if _, err := s.d.Orgs.Get(ctx, req.OrgUnitID); err != nil {
65			return nil, err
66		}
67		if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.OrgUnitID); err != nil {
68			return nil, err
69		}
70	
71		now := time.Now().UTC()
72		effectiveFrom := now
73		if req.EffectiveFrom != nil {
74			effectiveFrom = req.EffectiveFrom.UTC()
75		}
76		if err := s.repo.deactivateActiveCharts(ctx, req.OrgUnitID); err != nil {
77			return nil, err
78		}
79		chart := &domain.RateChart{
80			ID:               uuid.NewString(),
81			OrgUnitID:        req.OrgUnitID,
82			Name:             req.Name,
83			BaseRatePerLitre: req.BaseRatePerLitre,
84			FatRatePerPoint:  req.FatRatePerPoint,
85			SNFRatePerPoint:  req.SNFRatePerPoint,
86			EffectiveFrom:    effectiveFrom,
87			Active:           true,
88			CreatedBy:        actor.PartyID,
89			CreatedAt:        now,
90		}
91		if err := s.repo.insertRateChart(ctx, chart); err != nil {
92			return nil, err
93		}
94		return chart, nil
95	}
96	
97	// ResolveActiveChart finds the rate chart pricing a DCS's pours: among active
98	// charts already effective on the DCS itself or any of its ancestors, the
99	// nearest org wins; ties break to the latest effective_from. Returns
100	// httpx.NotFound when no chart covers the DCS.
101	func (s *service) ResolveActiveChart(ctx context.Context, dcsID string) (*domain.RateChart, error) {
102		dcs, err := s.d.Orgs.Get(ctx, dcsID)
103		if err != nil {
104			return nil, err
105		}
106		if dcs.Type != domain.OrgTypeDCS {
107			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_DCS", "org unit "+dcsID+" is not a DCS")
108		}
109	
110		// Distance 0 = the DCS itself; Path is root→parent, so walk it backwards.
111		distance := map[string]int{dcs.ID: 0}
112		orgIDs := []string{dcs.ID}
113		for i := len(dcs.Path) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
114			distance[dcs.Path[i]] = len(dcs.Path) - i
115			orgIDs = append(orgIDs, dcs.Path[i])
116		}
117	
118		charts, err := s.repo.activeChartsForOrgs(ctx, orgIDs, time.Now().UTC())
119		if err != nil {
120			return nil, err
121		}
122		var best *domain.RateChart
123		for i := range charts {
124			c := &charts[i]
125			if best == nil {
126				best = c
127				continue
128			}
129			dc, db := distance[c.OrgUnitID], distance[best.OrgUnitID]
130			if dc < db || (dc == db && c.EffectiveFrom.After(best.EffectiveFrom)) {
131				best = c
132			}
133		}
134		if best == nil {
135			return nil, httpx.NotFound("active rate chart for DCS " + dcsID)
136		}
137		return best, nil
138	}

140	// --- analyzer readings ---
141	
142	// deriveIntegrityFlags computes the anti-tamper flags of a reading from its
143	// capture envelope (blueprint §8.2). Plausibility flags are appended
144	// separately by the caller.
145	func deriveIntegrityFlags(mode string, ocrConfidence float64, hasGeotag bool, deviceTimestamp, serverNow time.Time) []string {
146		var out []string
147		if mode == domain.ReadingModeManual {
148			out = append(out, domain.IntegrityFlagManualEntry)
149		}
150		if mode == domain.ReadingModePhotoOCR && ocrConfidence < lowOCRConfidenceThreshold {
151			out = append(out, domain.IntegrityFlagLowOCRConfidence)
152		}
153		if !hasGeotag {
154			out = append(out, domain.IntegrityFlagMissingGeotag)
155		}
156		if !deviceTimestamp.IsZero() {
157			skew := serverNow.Sub(deviceTimestamp)
158			if skew < 0 {
159				skew = -skew
160			}
161			if skew > maxClockSkew {
162				out = append(out, domain.IntegrityFlagClockSkew)
163			}
164		}
165		return out
166	}
167	
168	// CreateReading stores one analyzer measurement. Suspicious readings are
169	// flagged, never rejected — the anomaly trail is the deterrent (§8.2).
170	func (s *service) CreateReading(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateReadingRequest) (*domain.AnalyzerReading, error) {
171		if req.DCSID == "" {
172			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "dcs_id is required")
173		}
174		switch req.Mode {
175		case domain.ReadingModeDirect, domain.ReadingModePhotoOCR, domain.ReadingModeManual:
176		default:
177			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "mode must be ANALYZER_DIRECT, PHOTO_OCR or MANUAL")
178		}
179		if req.FatPct <= 0 || req.SNFPct <= 0 {
180			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "fat_pct and snf_pct are required")
181		}
182		if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.DCSID); err != nil {
183			return nil, err
184		}
185		if req.Mode == domain.ReadingModePhotoOCR {
186			if !s.d.Flags.Enabled(ctx, flags.FlagPhotoOCR) {
187				featureErr := httpx.Forbidden("photo-OCR ingestion is disabled on this deployment")
188				featureErr.Code = "FEATURE_DISABLED"
189				return nil, featureErr
190			}
191			if req.PhotoObjectKey == "" {
192				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "photo_object_key is required for PHOTO_OCR (evidence retention, §8.2)")
193			}
194		}
195	
196		now := time.Now().UTC()
197		var deviceTS time.Time
198		if req.DeviceTimestamp != nil {
199			deviceTS = req.DeviceTimestamp.UTC()
200		}
201		hasGeo := req.GeoLat != nil && req.GeoLng != nil
202		integrityFlags := deriveIntegrityFlags(req.Mode, req.OCRConfidence, hasGeo, deviceTS, now)
203		plausibilityFlags := domain.CheckPlausibility(req.FatPct, req.SNFPct, req.QuantityLitres)
204		integrityFlags = append(integrityFlags, plausibilityFlags...)
205	
206		reading := &domain.AnalyzerReading{
207			ID:               uuid.NewString(),
208			DCSID:            req.DCSID,
209			DeviceID:         req.DeviceID,
210			Mode:             req.Mode,
211			FatPct:           req.FatPct,
212			SNFPct:           req.SNFPct,
213			CLR:              req.CLR,
214			WaterPct:         req.WaterPct,
215			QuantityLitres:   req.QuantityLitres,
216			PhotoObjectKey:   req.PhotoObjectKey,
217			OCRConfidence:    req.OCRConfidence,
218			DeviceTimestamp:  deviceTS,
219			ServerReceivedAt: now,
220			IntegrityFlags:   integrityFlags,
221			PlausibilityOK:   len(plausibilityFlags) == 0,
222			RecordedBy:       actor.PartyID,
223			CreatedAt:        now,
224		}
225		if hasGeo {
226			reading.GeoLat, reading.GeoLng = *req.GeoLat, *req.GeoLng
227		}
228		if err := s.repo.insertReading(ctx, reading); err != nil {
229			return nil, err
230		}
231	
232		if _, err := s.d.Ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
233			Type:       domain.EventReadingRecorded,
234			EntityType: domain.EntityAnalyzerReading,
235			EntityID:   reading.ID,
236			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
237			OrgUnitID:  reading.DCSID,
238			Payload: map[string]any{
239				"mode":            reading.Mode,
240				"integrity_flags": reading.IntegrityFlags,
241			},
242		}); err != nil {
243			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("append reading provenance: %w", err))
244		}
245		return reading, nil
246	}

248	// ListReadings pages a DCS's readings for anomaly review, optionally
249	// restricted to one IST day.
250	func (s *service) ListReadings(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, dcsID, date string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.AnalyzerReading, error) {
251		if dcsID == "" {
252			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "dcs_id is required")

254		if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, dcsID); err != nil {
255			return nil, err
256		}
257		var dayStart, dayEnd *time.Time
258		if date != "" {

260			if err != nil {
261				return nil, err
262			}
263			dayStart, dayEnd = &start, &end

268	// --- pours ---
269	
270	// CreatePour records one farmer's pour with same-day pricing. Replays of the
271	// same client_event_id return the stored pour with idempotentReplay=true —
272	// offline sync retries are harmless (§3.1).
273	func (s *service) CreatePour(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreatePourRequest) (pour *domain.MilkPour, idempotentReplay bool, err error) {
274		if req.ClientEventID == "" || req.FarmerPartyID == "" || req.DCSID == "" {
275			return nil, false, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "client_event_id, farmer_party_id and dcs_id are required")
276		}
277		if req.Shift != domain.ShiftMorning && req.Shift != domain.ShiftEvening {
278			return nil, false, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "shift must be MORNING or EVENING")
279		}
280		if req.QuantityLitres <= 0 {
281			return nil, false, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "quantity_litres must be positive")
282		}
283		switch req.Source {
284		case domain.ReadingModeDirect, domain.ReadingModePhotoOCR, domain.ReadingModeManual:
285		default:
286			return nil, false, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "source must be ANALYZER_DIRECT, PHOTO_OCR or MANUAL")
287		}
288		if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.DCSID); err != nil {
289			return nil, false, err
290		}
291	
292		now := time.Now().UTC()
293		member, err := s.repo.farmerIsActiveMember(ctx, req.FarmerPartyID, req.DCSID, now)
294		if err != nil {
295			return nil, false, err
296		}
297		if !member {
298			return nil, false, httpx.Unprocessable("FARMER_NOT_MEMBER",
299				"farmer does not hold an active FARMER assignment at this DCS")
300		}
301	
302		// HARD plausibility gate: receipts must be trustworthy, so implausible
303		// values are rejected here (unlike readings, which are merely flagged).
304		if violations := domain.CheckPlausibility(req.FatPct, req.SNFPct, req.QuantityLitres); len(violations) > 0 {
305			return nil, false, httpx.Unprocessable("IMPLAUSIBLE_VALUES",
306				"fat/SNF/quantity outside physically plausible bounds")
307		}
308	
309		chart, err := s.resolveChartForPricing(ctx, req.DCSID)
310		if err != nil {
311			return nil, false, err
312		}
313		rate, amount := chart.PricePour(req.FatPct, req.SNFPct, req.QuantityLitres)
314	
315		pouredAt := now
316		if req.PouredAt != nil {
317			pouredAt = req.PouredAt.UTC()
318		}
319		p := &domain.MilkPour{
320			ID:                uuid.NewString(),
321			ClientEventID:     req.ClientEventID,
322			FarmerPartyID:     req.FarmerPartyID,
323			AnimalID:          req.AnimalID,
324			DCSID:             req.DCSID,
325			Shift:             req.Shift,
326			PourDate:          domain.DateKeyIST(pouredAt),
327			QuantityLitres:    req.QuantityLitres,
328			FatPct:            req.FatPct,
329			SNFPct:            req.SNFPct,
330			CLR:               req.CLR,
331			RatePerLitre:      rate,
332			Amount:            amount,
333			RateChartID:       chart.ID,
334			AnalyzerReadingID: req.AnalyzerReadingID,
335			Source:            req.Source,
336			Status:            domain.PourStatusRecorded,
337			PouredAt:          pouredAt,
338			RecordedBy:        actor.PartyID,
339			DeviceID:          req.DeviceID,
340			CreatedAt:         now,
341		}
342		if req.GeoLat != nil && req.GeoLng != nil {
343			p.GeoLat, p.GeoLng = *req.GeoLat, *req.GeoLng
344		}
345	
346		duplicate, err := s.repo.insertPour(ctx, p)
347		if err != nil {
348			return nil, false, err
349		}
350		if duplicate {
351			existing, err := s.repo.pourByClientEventID(ctx, req.ClientEventID)
352			if err != nil {
353				return nil, false, err
354			}
355			return existing, true, nil
356		}
357	
358		if err := s.recordPourProvenance(ctx, actor, p); err != nil {
359			return nil, false, err
360		}
361		s.d.Bus.Publish(eventbus.TopicPourRecorded, *p)
362		s.queueFarmerSMS(ctx, p.FarmerPartyID, domain.TemplatePourReceipt, map[string]string{
363			"qty":    fmt.Sprintf("%.2f", p.QuantityLitres),
364			"rate":   fmt.Sprintf("%.2f", p.RatePerLitre),
365			"amount": fmt.Sprintf("%.2f", p.Amount),
366		})
367		return p, false, nil
368	}
369	
370	// recordPourProvenance appends EventPourRecorded and stamps the ledger seq
371	// onto the pour.
372	func (s *service) recordPourProvenance(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, p *domain.MilkPour) error {
373		refs := []provenance.Ref{
374			{EntityType: domain.EntityParty, EntityID: p.FarmerPartyID, Relation: "produced_by"},
375		}
376		if p.AnimalID != "" {
377			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{EntityType: domain.EntityAnimal, EntityID: p.AnimalID, Relation: "from_animal"})
378		}
379		if p.AnalyzerReadingID != "" {
380			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{EntityType: domain.EntityAnalyzerReading, EntityID: p.AnalyzerReadingID, Relation: "measured_by"})
381		}
382		ev, err := s.d.Ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
383			Type:       domain.EventPourRecorded,
384			EntityType: domain.EntityMilkPour,
385			EntityID:   p.ID,
386			Refs:       refs,
387			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
388			OrgUnitID:  p.DCSID,
389			Payload: map[string]any{
390				"quantity_litres": p.QuantityLitres,
391				"rate_per_litre":  p.RatePerLitre,
392				"amount":          p.Amount,
393			},
394		})
395		if err != nil {
396			return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("append pour provenance: %w", err))
397		}
398		if err := s.repo.setPourProvenanceSeq(ctx, p.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
399			return err
400		}
401		p.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
402		return nil
403	}
404	
405	// resolveChartForPricing wraps ResolveActiveChart, converting "no chart" into
406	// a 422 — the pour payload itself is fine, the DCS just cannot price it yet.
407	func (s *service) resolveChartForPricing(ctx context.Context, dcsID string) (*domain.RateChart, error) {
408		chart, err := s.ResolveActiveChart(ctx, dcsID)
409		if err != nil {
410			var appErr *httpx.AppError
411			if errors.As(err, &appErr) && appErr.Status == http.StatusNotFound {
412				return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("NO_ACTIVE_RATE_CHART",
413					"no active rate chart covers this DCS — pours cannot be priced")
414			}
415			return nil, err
416		}
417		return chart, nil
418	}
419	
420	// BatchSyncPours replays up to 500 offline-captured pours. Items succeed or
421	// fail independently — the batch never aborts (offline reconnect path, §3.1).
422	func (s *service) BatchSyncPours(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req BatchSyncRequest) ([]BatchSyncItemResult, error) {
423		if len(req.Pours) == 0 {
424			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "pours must not be empty")
425		}
426		if len(req.Pours) > maxBatchSyncItems {
427			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION",
428				fmt.Sprintf("pours must not exceed %d items per batch", maxBatchSyncItems))
429		}
430		results := make([]BatchSyncItemResult, 0, len(req.Pours))
431		for _, item := range req.Pours {
432			res := BatchSyncItemResult{ClientEventID: item.ClientEventID}
433			pour, replay, err := s.CreatePour(ctx, actor, item)
434			switch {
435			case err != nil:
436				res.Status = BatchItemError
437				var appErr *httpx.AppError
438				if errors.As(err, &appErr) {
439					res.Error = appErr.Code + ": " + appErr.Message
440				} else {
441					res.Error = "INTERNAL: internal server error"
442				}
443			case replay:
444				res.Status = BatchItemDuplicate
445				res.PourID = pour.ID
446			default:
447				res.Status = BatchItemCreated
448				res.PourID = pour.ID
449			}
450			results = append(results, res)
451		}
452		return results, nil
453	}
454	
455	// SupersedePour applies an append-only correction (§3.4): the old pour is
456	// marked SUPERSEDED (the document stays), and a new repriced pour referencing
457	// it is recorded.
458	func (s *service) SupersedePour(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, pourID string, req SupersedePourRequest) (*domain.MilkPour, error) {
459		if req.Reason == "" {
460			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "reason is required")
461		}
462		old, err := s.repo.pourByID(ctx, pourID)
463		if err != nil {
464			return nil, err
465		}
466		if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, old.DCSID); err != nil {
467			return nil, err
468		}
469		if old.Status != domain.PourStatusRecorded {
470			return nil, httpx.Conflict("POUR_NOT_CORRECTABLE",
471				"pour is already "+old.Status+" and cannot be superseded")
472		}
473		invoiced, err := s.repo.pourIsInvoiced(ctx, pourID)
474		if err != nil {
475			return nil, err
476		}
477		if invoiced {
478			return nil, httpx.Conflict("POUR_INVOICED",
479				"pour is aggregated by an invoice — correct it through settlement instead")
480		}
481	
482		qty, fat, snf := old.QuantityLitres, old.FatPct, old.SNFPct
483		if req.Corrected.QuantityLitres != nil {
484			qty = *req.Corrected.QuantityLitres
485		}
486		if req.Corrected.FatPct != nil {
487			fat = *req.Corrected.FatPct
488		}
489		if req.Corrected.SNFPct != nil {
490			snf = *req.Corrected.SNFPct
491		}
492		if qty <= 0 {
493			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "corrected quantity_litres must be positive")
494		}
495		if violations := domain.CheckPlausibility(fat, snf, qty); len(violations) > 0 {
496			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("IMPLAUSIBLE_VALUES",
497				"corrected fat/SNF/quantity outside physically plausible bounds")
498		}
499	
500		chart, err := s.resolveChartForPricing(ctx, old.DCSID)
501		if err != nil {
502			return nil, err
503		}
504		rate, amount := chart.PricePour(fat, snf, qty)
505	
506		// Optimistic guard: only one correction can win the RECORDED→SUPERSEDED flip.
507		flipped, err := s.repo.markPourSuperseded(ctx, old.ID)
508		if err != nil {
509			return nil, err
510		}
511		if !flipped {
512			return nil, httpx.Conflict("POUR_NOT_CORRECTABLE", "pour was superseded concurrently")
513		}
514	
515		now := time.Now().UTC()
516		corrected := &domain.MilkPour{
517			ID:                uuid.NewString(),
518			FarmerPartyID:     old.FarmerPartyID,
519			AnimalID:          old.AnimalID,
520			DCSID:             old.DCSID,
521			Shift:             old.Shift,
522			PourDate:          old.PourDate, // correction stays on the original settlement day
523			QuantityLitres:    qty,
524			FatPct:            fat,
525			SNFPct:            snf,
526			CLR:               old.CLR,
527			RatePerLitre:      rate,
528			Amount:            amount,
529			RateChartID:       chart.ID,
530			AnalyzerReadingID: old.AnalyzerReadingID,
531			Source:            old.Source,
532			Status:            domain.PourStatusRecorded,
533			SupersedesPourID:  old.ID,
534			PouredAt:          old.PouredAt,
535			RecordedBy:        actor.PartyID,
536			DeviceID:          old.DeviceID,
537			GeoLat:            old.GeoLat,
538			GeoLng:            old.GeoLng,
539			CreatedAt:         now,
540		}
541		corrected.ClientEventID = old.ClientEventID + "::corr::" + corrected.ID[0:8]
542		if duplicate, err := s.repo.insertPour(ctx, corrected); err != nil {
543			return nil, err
544		} else if duplicate {
545			return nil, httpx.Conflict("POUR_NOT_CORRECTABLE", "correction collided with a concurrent one")
546		}
547	
548		ev, err := s.d.Ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
549			Type:       domain.EventPourSuperseded,
550			EntityType: domain.EntityMilkPour,
551			EntityID:   corrected.ID,
552			Refs: []provenance.Ref{
553				{EntityType: domain.EntityMilkPour, EntityID: old.ID, Relation: "supersedes"},
554			},
555			Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
556			OrgUnitID: corrected.DCSID,
557			Payload:   map[string]any{"reason": req.Reason},
558		})
559		if err != nil {
560			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("append supersede provenance: %w", err))
561		}
562		if err := s.repo.setPourProvenanceSeq(ctx, corrected.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
563			return nil, err
564		}
565		corrected.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
566		return corrected, nil
567	}

569	// ListPours pages pours. FARMER callers are always pinned to their own
570	// pours; staff roles must name a DCS inside their scope.
571	func (s *service) ListPours(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, filter pourListFilter, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.MilkPour, error) {
572		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleFarmer {
573			filter.FarmerPartyID = actor.PartyID // farmers only ever see their own pours
574		} else {
575			if filter.DCSID == "" {
576				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "dcs_id is required")
577			}
578			if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, filter.DCSID); err != nil {
579				return nil, err
580			}
581		}
582		if filter.Date != "" {
583			if err := validateDateKey(filter.Date); err != nil {
584				return nil, err
585			}
586		}
587		if filter.Shift != "" && filter.Shift != domain.ShiftMorning && filter.Shift != domain.ShiftEvening {
588			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "shift must be MORNING or EVENING")
589		}
590		return s.repo.listPours(ctx, filter, page)
591	}
592	
593	// --- invoices ---
594	
595	// GenerateInvoices groups the day's un-invoiced RECORDED pours by farmer and
596	// issues one invoice each — the same-day payment artefact (§8.1). The unique
597	// farmer+DCS+day index is the true duplicate guard; racing generators simply
598	// count the loser as "existing".
599	func (s *service) GenerateInvoices(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req GenerateInvoicesRequest) (*GenerateInvoicesResponse, error) {
600		if req.DCSID == "" {
601			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "dcs_id is required")
602		}
603		now := time.Now().UTC()
604		dateKey := req.Date
605		if dateKey == "" {
606			dateKey = domain.DateKeyIST(now)
607		} else if err := validateDateKey(dateKey); err != nil {
608			return nil, err
609		}
610		dcs, err := s.d.Orgs.Get(ctx, req.DCSID)
611		if err != nil {
612			return nil, err
613		}
614		if dcs.Type != domain.OrgTypeDCS {
615			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_DCS", "org unit "+req.DCSID+" is not a DCS")
616		}
617		if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.DCSID); err != nil {
618			return nil, err
619		}
620	
621		pours, err := s.repo.recordedPoursForDay(ctx, req.DCSID, dateKey)
622		if err != nil {
623			return nil, err
624		}
625		alreadyInvoiced, err := s.repo.invoicedPourIDs(ctx, req.DCSID, dateKey)
626		if err != nil {
627			return nil, err
628		}
629	
630		byFarmer := make(map[string][]domain.MilkPour)
631		for _, p := range pours {
632			if alreadyInvoiced[p.ID] {
633				continue
634			}
635			byFarmer[p.FarmerPartyID] = append(byFarmer[p.FarmerPartyID], p)
636		}
637		farmerIDs := make([]string, 0, len(byFarmer))
638		for id := range byFarmer {
639			farmerIDs = append(farmerIDs, id)
640		}
641		sort.Strings(farmerIDs)
642	
643		resp := &GenerateInvoicesResponse{Invoices: []domain.Invoice{}}
644		counterKey := "invoice:" + dcs.Code + ":" + dateKey
645		for _, farmerID := range farmerIDs {
646			group := byFarmer[farmerID]
647			seq, err := s.repo.nextInvoiceSeq(ctx, counterKey)
648			if err != nil {
649				return nil, err
650			}
651			inv := &domain.Invoice{
652				ID:            uuid.NewString(),
653				InvoiceNumber: domain.InvoiceNumberFor(dcs.Code, dateKey, seq),
654				FarmerPartyID: farmerID,
655				DCSID:         req.DCSID,
656				InvoiceDate:   dateKey,
657				Status:        domain.InvoiceStatusIssued,
658				IssuedAt:      now,
659			}
660			for _, p := range group {
661				inv.PourIDs = append(inv.PourIDs, p.ID)
662				inv.TotalQuantityLitres += p.QuantityLitres
663				inv.TotalAmount += p.Amount
664			}
665			inv.TotalQuantityLitres = math.Round(inv.TotalQuantityLitres*100) / 100
666			inv.TotalAmount = math.Round(inv.TotalAmount*100) / 100
667	
668			duplicate, err := s.repo.insertInvoice(ctx, inv)
669			if err != nil {
670				return nil, err
671			}
672			if duplicate {
673				resp.Existing++
674				continue
675			}
676	
677			refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, len(inv.PourIDs))
678			for _, pid := range inv.PourIDs {
679				refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{EntityType: domain.EntityMilkPour, EntityID: pid, Relation: "aggregates"})
680			}
681			ev, err := s.d.Ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
682				Type:       domain.EventInvoiceIssued,
683				EntityType: domain.EntityInvoice,
684				EntityID:   inv.ID,
685				Refs:       refs,
686				Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
687				OrgUnitID:  inv.DCSID,
688				Payload: map[string]any{
689					"invoice_number":        inv.InvoiceNumber,
690					"total_quantity_litres": inv.TotalQuantityLitres,
691					"total_amount":          inv.TotalAmount,
692				},
693			})
694			if err != nil {
695				return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("append invoice provenance: %w", err))
696			}
697			if err := s.repo.setInvoiceProvenanceSeq(ctx, inv.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
698				return nil, err
699			}
700			inv.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
701	
702			s.d.Bus.Publish(eventbus.TopicInvoiceIssued, *inv)
703			s.queueFarmerSMS(ctx, inv.FarmerPartyID, domain.TemplateInvoiceIssued, map[string]string{
704				"invoice_number": inv.InvoiceNumber,
705				"qty":            fmt.Sprintf("%.2f", inv.TotalQuantityLitres),
706				"amount":         fmt.Sprintf("%.2f", inv.TotalAmount),
707				"date":           inv.InvoiceDate,
708			})
709			resp.Created++
710			resp.Invoices = append(resp.Invoices, *inv)
711		}
712		return resp, nil
713	}
714	
715	// ListInvoices pages invoices. FARMER callers are always pinned to their own
716	// invoices; staff roles must name a DCS inside their scope.
717	func (s *service) ListInvoices(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, filter invoiceListFilter, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.Invoice, error) {
718		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleFarmer {
719			filter.FarmerPartyID = actor.PartyID // farmers only ever see their own invoices
720		} else {
721			if filter.DCSID == "" {
722				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "dcs_id is required")
723			}
724			if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, filter.DCSID); err != nil {
725				return nil, err
726			}
727		}
728		if filter.Date != "" {
729			if err := validateDateKey(filter.Date); err != nil {
730				return nil, err
731			}
732		}
733		if filter.Status != "" {
734			switch filter.Status {
735			case domain.InvoiceStatusIssued, domain.InvoiceStatusSettlementPending,
736				domain.InvoiceStatusPaid, domain.InvoiceStatusHold:
737			default:
738				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "unknown invoice status "+filter.Status)
739			}
740		}
741		return s.repo.listInvoices(ctx, filter, page)
742	}
743	
744	// GetInvoice returns one invoice: a farmer may fetch their own, staff roles
745	// need the invoice's DCS inside their scope.
746	func (s *service) GetInvoice(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id string) (*domain.Invoice, error) {
747		inv, err := s.repo.invoiceByID(ctx, id)
748		if err != nil {
749			return nil, err
750		}
751		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleFarmer {
752			if inv.FarmerPartyID != actor.PartyID {
753				return nil, httpx.Forbidden("farmers may only view their own invoices")
754			}
755			return inv, nil
756		}
757		if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, inv.DCSID); err != nil {
758			return nil, err
759		}
760		return inv, nil
761	}
762	
763	// --- helpers ---
764	
765	// queueFarmerSMS writes an outbox notification for the farmer. Failures are
766	// logged, never fatal — the receipt must not block the pour (§8.1).
767	func (s *service) queueFarmerSMS(ctx context.Context, farmerPartyID, templateKey string, params map[string]string) {
768		farmer, err := s.repo.getParty(ctx, farmerPartyID)
769		if err != nil {
770			s.log.Warn("collection: farmer lookup for SMS failed",
771				slog.String("farmer_party_id", farmerPartyID), slog.Any("err", err))
772			return
773		}
774		language := farmer.PreferredLanguage
775		if language == "" {
776			language = defaultLanguage
777		}
778		n := &domain.Notification{
779			ID:          uuid.NewString(),
780			PartyID:     farmer.ID,
781			Phone:       farmer.Phone,
782			Channel:     domain.ChannelSMS,
783			TemplateKey: templateKey,
784			Language:    language,
785			Params:      params,
786			Status:      domain.NotificationQueued,
787			QueuedAt:    time.Now().UTC(),
788		}
789		if err := s.repo.queueNotification(ctx, n); err != nil {
790			s.log.Warn("collection: notification queue failed",
791				slog.String("template", templateKey), slog.Any("err", err))
792		}
793	}
794	
795	// validateDateKey checks a YYYY-MM-DD day key.
796	func validateDateKey(date string) error {
797		if _, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", date); err != nil {
798			return httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "date must be YYYY-MM-DD")
799		}
800		return nil
801	}
802	
803	// istDayRange converts a YYYY-MM-DD key into the [start, end) UTC window of
804	// that IST calendar day.
805	func istDayRange(date string) (start, end time.Time, err error) {
806		ist := time.FixedZone("IST", 5*3600+1800)
807		day, parseErr := time.ParseInLocation("2006-01-02", date, ist)
808		if parseErr != nil {
809			return time.Time{}, time.Time{}, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "date must be YYYY-MM-DD")
810		}
811		return day.UTC(), day.Add(24 * time.Hour).UTC(), nil
812	}

16	// handler is the HTTP layer: decode, validate shape, call service, respond.
17	type handler struct {
18		svc *service
19	}
20	
21	// newHandler wires the handler.
22	func newHandler(svc *service) *handler {
23		return &handler{svc: svc}
24	}
25	
26	// listFlags handles GET /admin/flags.
27	func (h *handler) listFlags(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
28		all, err := h.svc.listFlags(r.Context())
29		if err != nil {
30			httpx.Error(w, r, err)
31			return
32		}
33		httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, all)
34	}

36	// setFlag handles PUT /admin/flags/{key}.
37	func (h *handler) setFlag(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
38		actor, ok := auth.ActorFrom(r.Context())
39		if !ok {
40			httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Unauthorized("authentication required"))
41			return
42		}
43	
44		var req SetFlagRequest
45		if err := httpx.DecodeJSON(r, &req); err != nil {
46			httpx.Error(w, r, err)
47			return
48		}
49		if req.Enabled == nil {
50			httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_ENABLED", "enabled is required"))
51			return
52		}
53	
54		flag, err := h.svc.setFlag(r.Context(), actor, chi.URLParam(r, "key"), *req.Enabled)
55		if err != nil {
56			httpx.Error(w, r, err)
57			return
58		}
59		httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, flag)
60	}

62	// listAuditLogs handles GET /audit/logs?actor_party_id=&target_type=&action=&from=&to=.
63	func (h *handler) listAuditLogs(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
64		query := r.URL.Query()
65		filter := auditLogFilter{
66			ActorPartyID: query.Get("actor_party_id"),
67			TargetType:   query.Get("target_type"),
68			Action:       query.Get("action"),
69		}
70	
71		from, err := parseTimeParam(query.Get("from"), false)
72		if err != nil {
73			httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_FROM", "from must be RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD"))
74			return
75		}
76		to, err := parseTimeParam(query.Get("to"), true)
77		if err != nil {
78			httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_TO", "to must be RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD"))
79			return
80		}
81		filter.From, filter.To = from, to
82

84		entries, total, err := h.svc.listAuditLogs(r.Context(), filter, page)
85		if err != nil {

104			return

113		filename := "audit-export-" + export.ExportedAt.Format("20060102-150405") + ".json"
114		w.Header().Set("Content-Disposition", fmt.Sprintf("attachment; filename=%q", filename))

143		if err != nil {

151	func (h *handler) lookupParty(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
152		phone := strings.TrimSpace(r.URL.Query().Get("phone"))
153		if phone == "" {
154			httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_PHONE", "phone is required"))
155			return
156		}
157	
158		view, err := h.svc.lookupParty(r.Context(), phone)
159		if err != nil {
160			httpx.Error(w, r, err)
161			return
162		}
163		httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, view)
164	}
165	
166	// parseTimeParam accepts RFC3339 or plain YYYY-MM-DD (empty → nil). Date-only
167	// values mean UTC midnight; with endOfDay they cover the whole day, so
168	// ?to=2026-07-06 is inclusive of the 6th.
169	func parseTimeParam(value string, endOfDay bool) (*time.Time, error) {
170		if value == "" {
171			return nil, nil
172		}
173		if t, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, value); err == nil {
174			t = t.UTC()
175			return &t, nil
176		}
177		t, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", value)
178		if err != nil {
179			return nil, err
180		}
181		if endOfDay {
182			t = t.Add(24*time.Hour - time.Nanosecond)
183		}
184		t = t.UTC()
185		return &t, nil
186	}

1	package platformops
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"errors"
6		"fmt"
7		"time"
8	
9		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
10		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
11		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo/options"
12	
13		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
14		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/audit"
15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
16		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/mongodb"
17	)
18	
19	// repository is all MongoDB access for the platformops module. It owns the
20	// notifications outbox, reads audit_logs strictly read-only (writes go
21	// through deps.Audit only — the collection is insert-only by design, §12),
22	// and reads parties / role_assignments for the support lookup and for
23	// addressing safety alerts. bmc_lots / processing_batches are read solely to
24	// resolve a gate-blocked subject back to its org unit.
25	type repository struct {
26		auditLogs     *mongo.Collection
27		notifications *mongo.Collection
28		parties       *mongo.Collection
29		assignments   *mongo.Collection
30		bmcLots       *mongo.Collection
31		batches       *mongo.Collection
32	}
33	
34	// newRepository binds the repository to its collections.
35	func newRepository(db *mongo.Database) *repository {
36		return &repository{
37			auditLogs:     db.Collection(mongodb.CollAuditLogs),
38			notifications: db.Collection(mongodb.CollNotifications),
39			parties:       db.Collection(mongodb.CollParties),
40			assignments:   db.Collection(mongodb.CollRoleAssignments),
41			bmcLots:       db.Collection(mongodb.CollBMCLots),
42			batches:       db.Collection(mongodb.CollBatches),
43		}
44	}
45	
46	// auditFilter builds the bson filter shared by the list and export reads.
47	func auditFilter(f auditLogFilter) bson.D {
48		filter := bson.D{}
49		if f.ActorPartyID != "" {
50			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "actor_party_id", Value: f.ActorPartyID})
51		}
52		if f.TargetType != "" {
53			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "target_type", Value: f.TargetType})
54		}
55		if f.Action != "" {
56			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "action", Value: f.Action})
57		}
58		if f.From != nil || f.To != nil {
59			tsRange := bson.D{}
60			if f.From != nil {

152	// claimQueuedNotification atomically claims the oldest QUEUED document
153	// (QUEUED→SENT, sent_at, provider_ref) and returns it, or nil when the queue
154	// is drained. FindOneAndUpdate makes the claim race-safe across concurrent
155	// worker runs — never find-then-update.
156	func (r *repository) claimQueuedNotification(ctx context.Context, providerRef string, now time.Time) (*StoredNotification, error) {
157		var n StoredNotification
158		err := r.notifications.FindOneAndUpdate(ctx,
159			bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: domain.NotificationQueued}},
160			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
161				{Key: "status", Value: domain.NotificationSent},
162				{Key: "sent_at", Value: now},
163				{Key: "provider_ref", Value: providerRef},
164			}}},
165			options.FindOneAndUpdate().
166				SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "queued_at", Value: 1}}).
167				SetReturnDocument(options.After),
168		).Decode(&n)
169		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
170			return nil, nil
171		}
172		if err != nil {
173			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("claim queued notification: %w", err))
174		}
175		return &n, nil
176	}

1	package middleware

11	// RequireRoles allows only ROLE-kind tokens whose role is in the allow-list.
12	// SUPER_ADMIN passes every gate (break-glass admin — all its calls are
13	// audited by the audit middleware).
14	func RequireRoles(roles ...string) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
15		allowed := make(map[string]struct{}, len(roles))
16		for _, r := range roles {
17			allowed[r] = struct{}{}
18		}
19		return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
20			return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
21				actor, ok := auth.ActorFrom(r.Context())
22				if !ok {
23					httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Unauthorized("authentication required"))
24					return
25				}
26				if actor.Kind != auth.TokenKindRole {
27					httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Forbidden("a role token is required — select a role first (POST /api/v1/auth/role/select)"))
28					return
29				}
30				if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSuperAdmin {
31					next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
32					return
33				}
34				if _, ok := allowed[actor.RoleCode]; !ok {
35					httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Forbidden("role "+actor.RoleCode+" is not permitted for this action"))
36					return
37				}
38				next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
39			})
40		}
41	}
42	
43	// RequireSession allows any authenticated party (session or role token) —
44	// used for identity endpoints like "list my roles".
45	func RequireSession(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
46		return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
47			if _, ok := auth.ActorFrom(r.Context()); !ok {
48				httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Unauthorized("authentication required"))
49				return
50			}
51			next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
52		})
53	}
54

1	// Package orgscope answers the RBAC question "is this resource inside the
2	// caller's organisational scope?" in O(1) DB reads. Org units denormalise
3	// their ancestor chain into Path, so scope checking is a set-membership test
4	// — no recursive tree walks on the hot path.
5	package orgscope
6	
7	import (
8		"context"
9		"errors"
10		"sync"
11		"time"
12	
13		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
14		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
15	
16		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
17		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
18		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
19	)
20	
21	const collection = "org_units"
22	
23	type cachedOrg struct {
24		org domain.OrgUnit
25		at  time.Time
26	}
27	
28	// Resolver caches org units briefly (the tree changes rarely, reads are hot).
29	type Resolver struct {
30		coll *mongo.Collection
31		ttl  time.Duration
32	
33		mu    sync.RWMutex
34		cache map[string]cachedOrg
35	}
36	
37	// NewResolver binds the resolver to the database.
38	func NewResolver(db *mongo.Database) *Resolver {
39		return &Resolver{
40			coll:  db.Collection(collection),
41			ttl:   60 * time.Second,
42			cache: make(map[string]cachedOrg),
43		}
44	}
45	
46	// Get returns an org unit by ID (cached).
47	func (r *Resolver) Get(ctx context.Context, id string) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
48		r.mu.RLock()
49		c, ok := r.cache[id]
50		r.mu.RUnlock()
51		if ok && time.Since(c.at) < r.ttl {
52			org := c.org
53			return &org, nil
54		}
55	
56		var org domain.OrgUnit
57		err := r.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&org)
58		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
59			return nil, httpx.NotFound("org unit " + id)
60		}
61		if err != nil {
62			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
63		}
64	
65		r.mu.Lock()
66		r.cache[id] = cachedOrg{org: org, at: time.Now()}
67		r.mu.Unlock()
68		return &org, nil
69	}
70	
71	// Invalidate drops a cached entry (call after updates).
72	func (r *Resolver) Invalidate(id string) {
73		r.mu.Lock()
74		delete(r.cache, id)
75		r.mu.Unlock()
76	}
77	
78	// InScope reports whether target sits at-or-below scope in the hierarchy:
79	// true when scope == target, or scope appears in target's ancestor Path.
80	func (r *Resolver) InScope(ctx context.Context, scopeOrgID, targetOrgID string) (bool, error) {
81		if scopeOrgID == targetOrgID {
82			return true, nil
83		}
84		target, err := r.Get(ctx, targetOrgID)
85		if err != nil {
86			return false, err
87		}
88		for _, ancestor := range target.Path {
89			if ancestor == scopeOrgID {
90				return true, nil
91			}
92		}
93		return false, nil
94	}
95	
96	// RequireInScope enforces the actor's org scope over a target org unit.
97	// SUPER_ADMIN and STATE_AUDITOR (read-wide roles rooted at the federation)
98	// pass automatically; everyone else needs ancestry.
99	func (r *Resolver) RequireInScope(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, targetOrgID string) error {
100		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSuperAdmin || actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleStateAuditor {
101			return nil
102		}
103		if actor.OrgUnitID == "" {
104			return httpx.Forbidden("role token with org scope required")
105		}
106		ok, err := r.InScope(ctx, actor.OrgUnitID, targetOrgID)
107		if err != nil {
108			return err
109		}
110		if !ok {
111			return httpx.Forbidden("resource is outside your organisational scope")
112		}
113		return nil
114	}

11	// RequireRoles allows only ROLE-kind tokens whose role is in the allow-list.
12	// SUPER_ADMIN passes every gate (break-glass admin — all its calls are
13	// audited by the audit middleware).
14	func RequireRoles(roles ...string) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
15		allowed := make(map[string]struct{}, len(roles))
16		for _, r := range roles {
17			allowed[r] = struct{}{}
18		}
19		return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
20			return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
21				actor, ok := auth.ActorFrom(r.Context())
22				if !ok {
23					httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Unauthorized("authentication required"))
24					return
25				}
26				if actor.Kind != auth.TokenKindRole {
27					httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Forbidden("a role token is required — select a role first (POST /api/v1/auth/role/select)"))
28					return
29				}
30				if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSuperAdmin {
31					next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
32					return
33				}
34				if _, ok := allowed[actor.RoleCode]; !ok {
35					httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Forbidden("role "+actor.RoleCode+" is not permitted for this action"))
36					return
37				}
38				next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
39			})
40		}
41	}
42	
43	// RequireSession allows any authenticated party (session or role token) —
44	// used for identity endpoints like "list my roles".
45	func RequireSession(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
46		return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
47			if _, ok := auth.ActorFrom(r.Context()); !ok {
48				httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Unauthorized("authentication required"))
49				return
50			}
51			next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
52		})

func (rp *repo) payoutsByFarmer(ctx context.Context, farmerPartyID string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.PayoutInstruction, int64, error) {
	filter := bson.D{{Key: "farmer_party_id", Value: farmerPartyID}}

	if err != nil {

	}

339		_, err := r.invoices.UpdateOne(ctx,

341			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "provenance_seq", Value: seq}}}},
342		)
343		if err != nil {
344			return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("set invoice provenance seq: %w", err))
345		}
346		return nil
347	}

```text
func (r *Resolver) RequireInScope(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, targetOrgID string) error {
	if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSuperAdmin || actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleStateAuditor {
		return nil
	}
	if actor.OrgUnitID == "" {
		return httpx.Forbidden("role token with org scope required")
	}
	ok, err := r.InScope(ctx, actor.OrgUnitID, targetOrgID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if !ok {
		return httpx.Forbidden("resource is outside your organisational scope")
	}
	return nil
}
```

24	// service holds all settlement business logic: the §8.1/§18-B payment

27	type service struct {

37	// validateApproval enforces the dual-control guardrail (§8.1/§18-B): the
38	// approving party MUST differ from the initiator — checked FIRST and on the
39	// party identity itself, so not even SUPER_ADMIN's role bypass can approve a
40	// batch it initiated. Then the batch must still be awaiting approval.
41	func validateApproval(b domain.SettlementBatch, approverPartyID string) error {
42		if b.InitiatedBy == approverPartyID {
43			return httpx.Forbidden("dual-control violation: the settlement initiator cannot approve their own batch (§8.1/§18-B)").
44				WithDetails(map[string]string{"reason": "DUAL_CONTROL_VIOLATION"})
45		}
46		if b.Status != domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval {
47			return httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch is "+b.Status+", expected "+domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval)
48		}
49		return nil
50	}
51	
52	// validateExecution allows execution only for an APPROVED batch — executing
53	// before a human approval is a guardrail breach, not a race.
54	func validateExecution(b domain.SettlementBatch) error {
55		if b.Status != domain.SettlementStatusApproved {
56			return httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch is "+b.Status+", must be "+domain.SettlementStatusApproved+" before execution")
57		}
58		return nil
59	}

61	// mockUTR builds a mock bank transaction reference: "UTRMOCK" + 12 hex chars.
62	func mockUTR() string {
63		return "UTRMOCK" + strings.ToUpper(strings.ReplaceAll(uuid.NewString(), "-", "")[:12])
64	}

78	// Initiate collects a DCS day's ISSUED invoices into a new settlement batch
79	// and parks it PENDING_APPROVAL. The INITIATED status is momentary by design
80	// (§8.1): computation and initiation are one Saathi action; nothing proceeds
81	// until a different human approves.
82	func (s *service) Initiate(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, in InitiateSettlementRequest) (*domain.SettlementBatch, error) {
83		if in.DCSID == "" {
84			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_FIELD", "dcs_id is required")
85		}
86		now := time.Now().UTC()
87		date := in.Date
88		if date == "" {
89			date = domain.DateKeyIST(now)
90		} else if _, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", date); err != nil {
91			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_DATE", "date must be YYYY-MM-DD")
92		}
93		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, in.DCSID); err != nil {
94			return nil, err
95		}
96	
97		candidates, err := s.repo.issuedInvoices(ctx, in.DCSID, date)
98		if err != nil {
99			return nil, err
100		}
101		if len(candidates) == 0 {
102			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("NO_INVOICES", "no ISSUED invoices for DCS "+in.DCSID+" on "+date)
103		}
104	
105		// Claim optimistically: the status guard on the update means each invoice
106		// lands in exactly one batch even under concurrent initiations.
107		batchID := uuid.NewString()
108		ids := make([]string, 0, len(candidates))
109		for _, inv := range candidates {
110			ids = append(ids, inv.ID)
111		}
112		if _, err := s.repo.claimInvoices(ctx, ids, batchID); err != nil {
113			return nil, err
114		}
115		claimed, err := s.repo.invoicesByBatch(ctx, batchID)
116		if err != nil {
117			return nil, err
118		}
119		if len(claimed) == 0 {
120			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("NO_INVOICES", "invoices were claimed by a concurrent settlement for DCS "+in.DCSID+" on "+date)
121		}
122	
123		batch := &domain.SettlementBatch{
124			ID:          batchID,
125			DCSID:       in.DCSID,
126			Date:        date,
127			Status:      domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval, // INITIATED → PENDING_APPROVAL immediately
128			InitiatedBy: actor.PartyID,
129			CreatedAt:   now,
130		}
131		for _, inv := range claimed {
132			batch.InvoiceIDs = append(batch.InvoiceIDs, inv.ID)
133			batch.TotalAmount += inv.TotalAmount
134		}
135		if err := s.repo.insertBatch(ctx, batch); err != nil {
136			// Best-effort release so the claimed invoices are not stranded.
137			if relErr := s.repo.releaseInvoices(ctx, batchID); relErr != nil {
138				s.log.Error("settlement: release after failed insert", slog.String("batch_id", batchID), slog.Any("err", relErr))
139			}
140			return nil, err
141		}
142	
143		refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, min(len(claimed), initiateRefsCap))
144		for i, inv := range claimed {
145			if i >= initiateRefsCap {
146				break
147			}
148			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{EntityType: domain.EntityInvoice, EntityID: inv.ID, Relation: "settles"})
149		}
150		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
151			Type:       domain.EventSettlementInitiated,
152			EntityType: domain.EntitySettlement,
153			EntityID:   batch.ID,
154			Refs:       refs,
155			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
156			OrgUnitID:  batch.DCSID,
157			Payload: map[string]any{
158				"dcs_id":        batch.DCSID,
159				"date":          batch.Date,
160				"invoice_count": len(claimed),
161				"total_amount":  batch.TotalAmount,
162			},
163		})
164		if err != nil {
165			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
166		}
167		if err := s.repo.setBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx, batch.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
168			return nil, err
169		}
170		batch.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
171		return batch, nil
172	}
