405	// resolveChartForPricing wraps ResolveActiveChart, converting "no chart" into
406	// a 422 — the pour payload itself is fine, the DCS just cannot price it yet.
407	func (s *service) resolveChartForPricing(ctx context.Context, dcsID string) (*domain.RateChart, error) {
408		chart, err := s.ResolveActiveChart(ctx, dcsID)
409		if err != nil {
410			var appErr *httpx.AppError
411			if errors.As(err, &appErr) && appErr.Status == http.StatusNotFound {
412				return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("NO_ACTIVE_RATE_CHART",
413					"no active rate chart covers this DCS — pours cannot be priced")
414			}
415			return nil, err
416		}
417		return chart, nil
418	}
419	
420	// BatchSyncPours replays up to 500 offline-captured pours. Items succeed or
421	// fail independently — the batch never aborts (offline reconnect path, §3.1).
422	func (s *service) BatchSyncPours(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req BatchSyncRequest) ([]BatchSyncItemResult, error) {
423		if len(req.Pours) == 0 {
424			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "pours must not be empty")
425		}
426		if len(req.Pours) > maxBatchSyncItems {
427			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION",
428				fmt.Sprintf("pours must not exceed %d items per batch", maxBatchSyncItems))
429		}
430		results := make([]BatchSyncItemResult, 0, len(req.Pours))
431		for _, item := range req.Pours {
432			res := BatchSyncItemResult{ClientEventID: item.ClientEventID}
433			pour, replay, err := s.CreatePour(ctx, actor, item)
434			switch {
435			case err != nil:
436				res.Status = BatchItemError
437				var appErr *httpx.AppError
438				if errors.As(err, &appErr) {
439					res.Error = appErr.Code + ": " + appErr.Message
440				} else {
441					res.Error = "INTERNAL: internal server error"
442				}
443			case replay:
444				res.Status = BatchItemDuplicate
445				res.PourID = pour.ID
446			default:
447				res.Status = BatchItemCreated
448				res.PourID = pour.ID
449			}
450			results = append(results, res)
451		}
452		return results, nil
453	}
454	
455	// SupersedePour applies an append-only correction (§3.4): the old pour is
456	// marked SUPERSEDED (the document stays), and a new repriced pour referencing
457	// it is recorded.
458	func (s *service) SupersedePour(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, pourID string, req SupersedePourRequest) (*domain.MilkPour, error) {
459		if req.Reason == "" {
460			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "reason is required")
461		}
462		old, err := s.repo.pourByID(ctx, pourID)
463		if err != nil {
464			return nil, err
465		}
466		if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, old.DCSID); err != nil {
467			return nil, err
468		}
469		if old.Status != domain.PourStatusRecorded {
470			return nil, httpx.Conflict("POUR_NOT_CORRECTABLE",
471				"pour is already "+old.Status+" and cannot be superseded")
472		}
473		invoiced, err := s.repo.pourIsInvoiced(ctx, pourID)
474		if err != nil {
475			return nil, err
476		}
477		if invoiced {
478			return nil, httpx.Conflict("POUR_INVOICED",
479				"pour is aggregated by an invoice — correct it through settlement instead")
480		}
481	
482		qty, fat, snf := old.QuantityLitres, old.FatPct, old.SNFPct
483		if req.Corrected.QuantityLitres != nil {
484			qty = *req.Corrected.QuantityLitres
485		}
486		if req.Corrected.FatPct != nil {
487			fat = *req.Corrected.FatPct
488		}
489		if req.Corrected.SNFPct != nil {
490			snf = *req.Corrected.SNFPct
491		}
492		if qty <= 0 {
493			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "corrected quantity_litres must be positive")
494		}
495		if violations := domain.CheckPlausibility(fat, snf, qty); len(violations) > 0 {
496			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("IMPLAUSIBLE_VALUES",
497				"corrected fat/SNF/quantity outside physically plausible bounds")
498		}
499	
500		chart, err := s.resolveChartForPricing(ctx, old.DCSID)
501		if err != nil {
502			return nil, err
503		}
504		rate, amount := chart.PricePour(fat, snf, qty)
505	
506		// Optimistic guard: only one correction can win the RECORDED→SUPERSEDED flip.
507		flipped, err := s.repo.markPourSuperseded(ctx, old.ID)
508		if err != nil {
509			return nil, err
510		}
511		if !flipped {
512			return nil, httpx.Conflict("POUR_NOT_CORRECTABLE", "pour was superseded concurrently")
513		}
514	
515		now := time.Now().UTC()
516		corrected := &domain.MilkPour{
517			ID:                uuid.NewString(),
518			FarmerPartyID:     old.FarmerPartyID,
519			AnimalID:          old.AnimalID,
520			DCSID:             old.DCSID,
521			Shift:             old.Shift,
522			PourDate:          old.PourDate, // correction stays on the original settlement day
523			QuantityLitres:    qty,
524			FatPct:            fat,
525			SNFPct:            snf,
526			CLR:               old.CLR,
527			RatePerLitre:      rate,
528			Amount:            amount,
529			RateChartID:       chart.ID,
530			AnalyzerReadingID: old.AnalyzerReadingID,
531			Source:            old.Source,
532			Status:            domain.PourStatusRecorded,
533			SupersedesPourID:  old.ID,
534			PouredAt:          old.PouredAt,
535			RecordedBy:        actor.PartyID,
536			DeviceID:          old.DeviceID,
537			GeoLat:            old.GeoLat,
538			GeoLng:            old.GeoLng,
539			CreatedAt:         now,
540		}
541		corrected.ClientEventID = old.ClientEventID + "::corr::" + corrected.ID[0:8]
542		if duplicate, err := s.repo.insertPour(ctx, corrected); err != nil {
543			return nil, err
544		} else if duplicate {
545			return nil, httpx.Conflict("POUR_NOT_CORRECTABLE", "correction collided with a concurrent one")
546		}
547	
548		ev, err := s.d.Ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
549			Type:       domain.EventPourSuperseded,
550			EntityType: domain.EntityMilkPour,
551			EntityID:   corrected.ID,
552			Refs: []provenance.Ref{
553				{EntityType: domain.EntityMilkPour, EntityID: old.ID, Relation: "supersedes"},
554			},
555			Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
556			OrgUnitID: corrected.DCSID,
557			Payload:   map[string]any{"reason": req.Reason},
558		})
559		if err != nil {
560			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("append supersede provenance: %w", err))
561		}
562		if err := s.repo.setPourProvenanceSeq(ctx, corrected.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
563			return nil, err
564		}
565		corrected.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
566		return corrected, nil
567	}

569	// ListPours pages pours. FARMER callers are always pinned to their own
570	// pours; staff roles must name a DCS inside their scope.
571	func (s *service) ListPours(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, filter pourListFilter, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.MilkPour, error) {
572		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleFarmer {
573			filter.FarmerPartyID = actor.PartyID // farmers only ever see their own pours
574		} else {
575			if filter.DCSID == "" {
576				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "dcs_id is required")
577			}
578			if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, filter.DCSID); err != nil {
579				return nil, err
580			}
581		}
582		if filter.Date != "" {
583			if err := validateDateKey(filter.Date); err != nil {
584				return nil, err
585			}
586		}
587		if filter.Shift != "" && filter.Shift != domain.ShiftMorning && filter.Shift != domain.ShiftEvening {
588			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "shift must be MORNING or EVENING")
589		}
590		return s.repo.listPours(ctx, filter, page)
591	}
592	
593	// --- invoices ---
594	
595	// GenerateInvoices groups the day's un-invoiced RECORDED pours by farmer and
596	// issues one invoice each — the same-day payment artefact (§8.1). The unique
597	// farmer+DCS+day index is the true duplicate guard; racing generators simply
598	// count the loser as "existing".
599	func (s *service) GenerateInvoices(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req GenerateInvoicesRequest) (*GenerateInvoicesResponse, error) {
600		if req.DCSID == "" {
601			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "dcs_id is required")
602		}
603		now := time.Now().UTC()
604		dateKey := req.Date
605		if dateKey == "" {
606			dateKey = domain.DateKeyIST(now)
607		} else if err := validateDateKey(dateKey); err != nil {
608			return nil, err
609		}
610		dcs, err := s.d.Orgs.Get(ctx, req.DCSID)
611		if err != nil {
612			return nil, err
613		}
614		if dcs.Type != domain.OrgTypeDCS {
615			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_DCS", "org unit "+req.DCSID+" is not a DCS")
616		}
617		if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.DCSID); err != nil {
618			return nil, err
619		}
620	
621		pours, err := s.repo.recordedPoursForDay(ctx, req.DCSID, dateKey)
622		if err != nil {
623			return nil, err
624		}
625		alreadyInvoiced, err := s.repo.invoicedPourIDs(ctx, req.DCSID, dateKey)
626		if err != nil {
627			return nil, err
628		}
629	
630		byFarmer := make(map[string][]domain.MilkPour)
631		for _, p := range pours {
632			if alreadyInvoiced[p.ID] {
633				continue
634			}
635			byFarmer[p.FarmerPartyID] = append(byFarmer[p.FarmerPartyID], p)
636		}
637		farmerIDs := make([]string, 0, len(byFarmer))
638		for id := range byFarmer {
639			farmerIDs = append(farmerIDs, id)
640		}
641		sort.Strings(farmerIDs)
642	
643		resp := &GenerateInvoicesResponse{Invoices: []domain.Invoice{}}
644		counterKey := "invoice:" + dcs.Code + ":" + dateKey
645		for _, farmerID := range farmerIDs {
646			group := byFarmer[farmerID]
647			seq, err := s.repo.nextInvoiceSeq(ctx, counterKey)
648			if err != nil {
649				return nil, err
650			}
651			inv := &domain.Invoice{
652				ID:            uuid.NewString(),
653				InvoiceNumber: domain.InvoiceNumberFor(dcs.Code, dateKey, seq),
654				FarmerPartyID: farmerID,
655				DCSID:         req.DCSID,
656				InvoiceDate:   dateKey,
657				Status:        domain.InvoiceStatusIssued,
658				IssuedAt:      now,
659			}
660			for _, p := range group {
661				inv.PourIDs = append(inv.PourIDs, p.ID)
662				inv.TotalQuantityLitres += p.QuantityLitres
663				inv.TotalAmount += p.Amount
664			}
665			inv.TotalQuantityLitres = math.Round(inv.TotalQuantityLitres*100) / 100
666			inv.TotalAmount = math.Round(inv.TotalAmount*100) / 100
667	
668			duplicate, err := s.repo.insertInvoice(ctx, inv)
669			if err != nil {
670				return nil, err
671			}
672			if duplicate {
673				resp.Existing++
674				continue
675			}
676	
677			refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, len(inv.PourIDs))
678			for _, pid := range inv.PourIDs {
679				refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{EntityType: domain.EntityMilkPour, EntityID: pid, Relation: "aggregates"})
680			}
681			ev, err := s.d.Ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
682				Type:       domain.EventInvoiceIssued,
683				EntityType: domain.EntityInvoice,
684				EntityID:   inv.ID,
685				Refs:       refs,
686				Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
687				OrgUnitID:  inv.DCSID,
688				Payload: map[string]any{
689					"invoice_number":        inv.InvoiceNumber,
690					"total_quantity_litres": inv.TotalQuantityLitres,
691					"total_amount":          inv.TotalAmount,
692				},
693			})
694			if err != nil {
695				return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("append invoice provenance: %w", err))
696			}
697			if err := s.repo.setInvoiceProvenanceSeq(ctx, inv.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
698				return nil, err
699			}
700			inv.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
701	
702			s.d.Bus.Publish(eventbus.TopicInvoiceIssued, *inv)
703			s.queueFarmerSMS(ctx, inv.FarmerPartyID, domain.TemplateInvoiceIssued, map[string]string{
704				"invoice_number": inv.InvoiceNumber,
705				"qty":            fmt.Sprintf("%.2f", inv.TotalQuantityLitres),
706				"amount":         fmt.Sprintf("%.2f", inv.TotalAmount),
707				"date":           inv.InvoiceDate,
708			})
709			resp.Created++
710			resp.Invoices = append(resp.Invoices, *inv)
711		}
712		return resp, nil
713	}
714	
715	// ListInvoices pages invoices. FARMER callers are always pinned to their own
716	// invoices; staff roles must name a DCS inside their scope.
717	func (s *service) ListInvoices(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, filter invoiceListFilter, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.Invoice, error) {
718		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleFarmer {
719			filter.FarmerPartyID = actor.PartyID // farmers only ever see their own invoices
720		} else {
721			if filter.DCSID == "" {
722				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "dcs_id is required")
723			}
724			if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, filter.DCSID); err != nil {
725				return nil, err
726			}
727		}
728		if filter.Date != "" {
729			if err := validateDateKey(filter.Date); err != nil {
730				return nil, err
731			}
732		}
733		if filter.Status != "" {
734			switch filter.Status {
735			case domain.InvoiceStatusIssued, domain.InvoiceStatusSettlementPending,
736				domain.InvoiceStatusPaid, domain.InvoiceStatusHold:
737			default:
738				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "unknown invoice status "+filter.Status)
739			}
740		}
741		return s.repo.listInvoices(ctx, filter, page)
742	}
743	
744	// GetInvoice returns one invoice: a farmer may fetch their own, staff roles
745	// need the invoice's DCS inside their scope.
746	func (s *service) GetInvoice(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id string) (*domain.Invoice, error) {
747		inv, err := s.repo.invoiceByID(ctx, id)
748		if err != nil {
749			return nil, err
750		}
751		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleFarmer {
752			if inv.FarmerPartyID != actor.PartyID {
753				return nil, httpx.Forbidden("farmers may only view their own invoices")
754			}
755			return inv, nil
756		}
757		if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, inv.DCSID); err != nil {
758			return nil, err
759		}
760		return inv, nil
761	}
762	
763	// --- helpers ---
764	
765	// queueFarmerSMS writes an outbox notification for the farmer. Failures are
766	// logged, never fatal — the receipt must not block the pour (§8.1).
767	func (s *service) queueFarmerSMS(ctx context.Context, farmerPartyID, templateKey string, params map[string]string) {
768		farmer, err := s.repo.getParty(ctx, farmerPartyID)
769		if err != nil {
770			s.log.Warn("collection: farmer lookup for SMS failed",
771				slog.String("farmer_party_id", farmerPartyID), slog.Any("err", err))
772			return
773		}
774		language := farmer.PreferredLanguage
775		if language == "" {
776			language = defaultLanguage
777		}
778		n := &domain.Notification{
779			ID:          uuid.NewString(),
780			PartyID:     farmer.ID,
781			Phone:       farmer.Phone,
782			Channel:     domain.ChannelSMS,
783			TemplateKey: templateKey,
784			Language:    language,
785			Params:      params,
786			Status:      domain.NotificationQueued,
787			QueuedAt:    time.Now().UTC(),
788		}
789		if err := s.repo.queueNotification(ctx, n); err != nil {
790			s.log.Warn("collection: notification queue failed",
791				slog.String("template", templateKey), slog.Any("err", err))
792		}
793	}
794	
795	// validateDateKey checks a YYYY-MM-DD day key.
796	func validateDateKey(date string) error {
797		if _, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", date); err != nil {
798			return httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "date must be YYYY-MM-DD")
799		}
800		return nil
801	}
802	
803	// istDayRange converts a YYYY-MM-DD key into the [start, end) UTC window of
804	// that IST calendar day.
805	func istDayRange(date string) (start, end time.Time, err error) {
806		ist := time.FixedZone("IST", 5*3600+1800)
807		day, parseErr := time.ParseInLocation("2006-01-02", date, ist)
808		if parseErr != nil {
809			return time.Time{}, time.Time{}, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "date must be YYYY-MM-DD")
810		}
811		return day.UTC(), day.Add(24 * time.Hour).UTC(), nil
812	}

86	// CreateBMCLot pools DELIVERED consignments into a new OPEN lot at a BMC.
87	func (s *Service) CreateBMCLot(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateBMCLotRequest) (*domain.BMCLot, error) {
88		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.BMCID); err != nil {
89			return nil, err
90		}
91		org, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.BMCID)
92		if err != nil {
93			return nil, err
94		}
95		if org.Type != domain.OrgTypeBMC {
96			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_BMC", "org unit "+req.BMCID+" is not a BMC")
97		}
98	
99		now := time.Now().UTC()
100		date := req.Date
101		if date == "" {
102			date = domain.DateKeyIST(now)
103		}
104	
105		ids := dedupe(req.ConsignmentIDs)
106		consignments, err := s.repo.ConsignmentsByIDs(ctx, ids)
107		if err != nil {
108			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
109		}
110		if len(consignments) != len(ids) {
111			return nil, httpx.NotFound("consignment(s) " + strings.Join(missingIDs(ids, consignments), ", "))
112		}
113		var undelivered []string
114		for _, c := range consignments {
115			if c.Status != domain.ConsignmentStatusDelivered {
116				undelivered = append(undelivered, c.ID)
117			}
118		}
119		if len(undelivered) > 0 {
120			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("CONSIGNMENT_NOT_DELIVERED",
121				"only DELIVERED consignments can be pooled into a BMC lot").
122				WithDetails(map[string]any{"consignment_ids": undelivered})
123		}
124	
125		// Optimistic claim: flip DELIVERED→ACCEPTED stamped with the new lot ID.
126		// If another lot raced us on any consignment, release our claims and bail.
127		lotID := uuid.NewString()
128		claimed, err := s.repo.ClaimConsignments(ctx, ids, lotID)
129		if err != nil {
130			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
131		}
132		if claimed != int64(len(ids)) {
133			if relErr := s.repo.ReleaseConsignments(ctx, lotID); relErr != nil {
134				return nil, httpx.Internal(relErr)
135			}
136			return nil, httpx.Conflict("CONSIGNMENT_CLAIM_CONFLICT",
137				"one or more consignments were pooled by another lot — reload and retry")
138		}
139	
140		var totalLitres float64
141		var tripIDs []string
142		seenTrip := map[string]bool{}
143		for _, c := range consignments {
144			totalLitres += c.TotalQuantityLitres
145			if c.RouteTripID != "" && !seenTrip[c.RouteTripID] {
146				seenTrip[c.RouteTripID] = true
147				tripIDs = append(tripIDs, c.RouteTripID)
148			}
149		}
150	
151		lot := &domain.BMCLot{
152			ID:                  lotID,
153			BMCID:               req.BMCID,
154			Date:                date,
155			Shift:               req.Shift,
156			ConsignmentIDs:      ids,
157			RouteTripIDs:        tripIDs,
158			TotalQuantityLitres: totalLitres,
159			Status:              domain.BMCLotStatusOpen,
160			CreatedBy:           actor.PartyID,
161			CreatedAt:           now,
162		}
163		if err := s.repo.InsertBMCLot(ctx, lot); err != nil {
164			_ = s.repo.ReleaseConsignments(ctx, lotID)
165			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
166		}
167	
168		refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, len(ids))
169		for _, id := range ids {
170			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{
171				EntityType: domain.EntityConsignment, EntityID: id, Relation: "pools",
172			})
173		}
174		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
175			Type:       domain.EventBMCLotCreated,
176			EntityType: domain.EntityBMCLot,
177			EntityID:   lot.ID,
178			Refs:       refs,
179			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
180			OrgUnitID:  req.BMCID,
181			Payload: map[string]any{
182				"date": date, "shift": req.Shift, "total_quantity_litres": totalLitres,
183			},
184		})
185		if err != nil {
186			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
187		}
188		if err := s.repo.SetBMCLotProvenanceSeq(ctx, lot.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
189			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
190		}
191		lot.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
192		return lot, nil
193	}

239	// DispatchBMCLot transitions PASSED→DISPATCHED. THE safety gate (§8.3): a
240	// BLOCKED or untested lot never leaves the chilling centre.
241	func (s *Service) DispatchBMCLot(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id string) (*domain.BMCLot, error) {
242		lot, err := s.getBMCLot(ctx, id)
243		if err != nil {
244			return nil, err
245		}
246		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, lot.BMCID); err != nil {
247			return nil, err
248		}
249		if lot.Status == domain.BMCLotStatusDispatched {
250			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_ALREADY_DISPATCHED", "lot is already dispatched")
251		}
252		if !canDispatchBMCLot(lot.Status) {
253			msg := "lot cannot be dispatched: safety gate not passed (status " + lot.Status + ")"
254			if lot.BlockReason != "" {
255				msg += " — " + lot.BlockReason
256			}
257			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked, msg).
258				WithDetails(map[string]any{"status": lot.Status, "block_reason": lot.BlockReason})
259		}
260		now := time.Now().UTC()
261		ok, err := s.repo.DispatchBMCLot(ctx, id, now)
262		if err != nil {
263			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
264		}
265		if !ok {
266			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_STATE_CHANGED",
267				"lot changed state concurrently — reload and retry")
268		}
269		lot.Status = domain.BMCLotStatusDispatched
270		lot.DispatchedAt = &now
271		return lot, nil
272	}

293	// CreateBatch pools DISPATCHED (gate-passed) BMC lots into one production

296	func (s *Service) CreateBatch(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateBatchRequest) (*domain.ProcessingBatch, error) {
297		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.PlantID); err != nil {
298			return nil, err

300		org, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.PlantID)

303		}
304		if org.Type != domain.OrgTypeProcessingPlant {
305			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_PLANT", "org unit "+req.PlantID+" is not a processing plant")
306		}

315		}

318		for _, lot := range lots {

337		batchNumber := fmt.Sprintf("BATCH-%s-%s-%04d",
338			org.Code, strings.ReplaceAll(dateKey, "-", ""), seq)
339	
340		// CREATED is a transient birth state: the plant lab must clear every
341		// batch, so it is persisted straight into QC_PENDING.
342		batch := &domain.ProcessingBatch{
343			ID:          uuid.NewString(),
344			PlantID:     req.PlantID,
345			BatchNumber: batchNumber,
346			BMCLotIDs:   ids,
347			ProductType: req.ProductType,
348			InputLitres: inputLitres,
349			Status:      domain.BatchStatusQCPending,

351			CreatedBy:   actor.PartyID,

353		}

356		}

358		refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, len(ids))
359		for _, id := range ids {

361				EntityType: domain.EntityBMCLot, EntityID: id, Relation: "pools",
362			})
363		}
364		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
365			Type:       domain.EventBatchCreated,
366			EntityType: domain.EntityBatch,
367			EntityID:   batch.ID,

537		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, lot.PlantID); err != nil {
538			return nil, err
539		}
540		if lot.Status == domain.ProductLotStatusRecalled {
541			return nil, httpx.Conflict("PRODUCT_LOT_ALREADY_RECALLED", "product lot is already recalled")
542		}
543		ok, err := s.repo.RecallProductLot(ctx, id, reason)
544		if err != nil {
545			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
546		}
547		if !ok {
548			return nil, httpx.Conflict("PRODUCT_LOT_ALREADY_RECALLED", "product lot is already recalled")
549		}
550		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
551			Type:       domain.EventProductRecalled,
552			EntityType: domain.EntityProductLot,
553			EntityID:   lot.ID,
554			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
555			OrgUnitID:  lot.PlantID,
556			Payload:    map[string]any{"reason": reason},
557		})
558		if err != nil {
559			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
560		}
561		if err := s.repo.SetProductLotProvenanceSeq(ctx, lot.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
562			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
563		}
564		lot.Status = domain.ProductLotStatusRecalled
565		lot.RecallReason = reason
566		lot.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
567		return lot, nil
568	}
569	
570	// --- QR issuance ---
571	
572	// qrAlphabet is the 32-character human-safe set for short codes: A–Z and 2–9
573	// minus the confusables 0/O and 1/I. 32 divides 256, so a byte modulo the
574	// alphabet length is unbiased.
575	const qrAlphabet = "ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789"
576	
577	// qrCodeLength is the number of random characters after the "PRG-" prefix
578	// (32^8 ≈ 1.1 trillion codes — collisions are retried on the unique index).
579	const qrCodeLength = 8
580	
581	// newQRCode mints a short public code like "[REDACTED:generic-api-key]" from crypto/rand.
582	func newQRCode() (string, error) {
583		buf := make([]byte, qrCodeLength)
584		if _, err := rand.Read(buf); err != nil {
585			return "", err
586		}
587		code := make([]byte, qrCodeLength)
588		for i, b := range buf {
589			code[i] = qrAlphabet[int(b)%len(qrAlphabet)]
590		}
591		return "PRG-" + string(code), nil
592	}
593	
594	// signQRToken builds the forgery-proof token printed inside the QR:
595	// base64url(qr_code|product_lot_id|issued_unix) + "." + hex(HMAC-SHA256).
596	// The consumer app resolves the payload; the signature proves it was minted
597	// by this server, so IDs cannot be guessed onto counterfeit packs.
598	func signQRToken(secret, qrCode, productLotID string, issuedAt time.Time) string {
599		payload := qrCode + "|" + productLotID + "|" + strconv.FormatInt(issuedAt.Unix(), 10)
600		mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte(secret))
601		mac.Write([]byte(payload))
602		return base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(payload)) + "." + hex.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))
603	}
604	
605	// parseQRToken verifies and unpacks a signed QR token.
606	func parseQRToken(secret, token string) (qrCode, productLotID string, issuedAt time.Time, err error) {
607		payloadB64, sigHex, found := strings.Cut(token, ".")
608		if !found {
609			return "", "", time.Time{}, errors.New("qr token: missing signature separator")
610		}
611		payloadBytes, err := base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString(payloadB64)
612		if err != nil {
613			return "", "", time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("qr token: bad payload encoding: %w", err)
614		}
615		sig, err := hex.DecodeString(sigHex)
616		if err != nil {
617			return "", "", time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("qr token: bad signature encoding: %w", err)
618		}
619		mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte(secret))
620		mac.Write(payloadBytes)
621		if !hmac.Equal(sig, mac.Sum(nil)) {
622			return "", "", time.Time{}, errors.New("qr token: signature mismatch")
623		}
624		parts := strings.Split(string(payloadBytes), "|")
625		if len(parts) != 3 {
626			return "", "", time.Time{}, errors.New("qr token: malformed payload")
627		}
628		unix, err := strconv.ParseInt(parts[2], 10, 64)
629		if err != nil {
630			return "", "", time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("qr token: bad timestamp: %w", err)
631		}
632		return parts[0], parts[1], time.Unix(unix, 0).UTC(), nil
633	}
634	
635	// IssueQR mints one signed QR for an ACTIVE product lot whose batch is
636	// COMPLETED — the gate is re-checked at mint time so recalled or blocked
637	// product can never be freshly labelled.
638	func (s *Service) IssueQR(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, productLotID string) (*domain.BatchQR, error) {
639		lot, err := s.getProductLot(ctx, productLotID)
640		if err != nil {
641			return nil, err
642		}
643		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, lot.PlantID); err != nil {
644			return nil, err
645		}
646		batch, err := s.getBatch(ctx, lot.BatchID)
647		if err != nil {
648			return nil, err
649		}
650		if !canIssueQR(lot.Status, batch.Status) {
651			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked,
652				"QR issuance refused: product lot must be ACTIVE and its batch COMPLETED").
653				WithDetails(map[string]any{
654					"product_lot_status": lot.Status,
655					"batch_status":       batch.Status,
656					"recall_reason":      lot.RecallReason,
657				})
658		}
659	
660		now := time.Now().UTC()
661		var qr *domain.BatchQR
662		const maxMintAttempts = 5
663		for attempt := 0; attempt < maxMintAttempts; attempt++ {
664			code, err := newQRCode()
665			if err != nil {
666				return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
667			}
668			candidate := &domain.BatchQR{
669				ID:           uuid.NewString(),
670				QRCode:       code,
671				ProductLotID: lot.ID,
672				SignedToken:  signQRToken(s.qrSecret, code, lot.ID, now),
673				IssuedBy:     actor.PartyID,
674				ScanCount:    0,
675				IssuedAt:     now,
676			}
677			insertErr := s.repo.InsertQR(ctx, candidate)
678			if insertErr == nil {
679				qr = candidate
680				break
681			}
682			if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(insertErr) {
683				continue // short-code collision — regenerate
684			}
685			return nil, httpx.Internal(insertErr)
686		}
687		if qr == nil {
688			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("qr mint: %d consecutive short-code collisions", maxMintAttempts))
689		}
690	
691		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
692			Type:       domain.EventQRIssued,
693			EntityType: domain.EntityBatchQR,
694			EntityID:   qr.ID,
695			Refs: []provenance.Ref{
696				{EntityType: domain.EntityProductLot, EntityID: lot.ID, Relation: "labels"},
697			},
698			Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
699			OrgUnitID: lot.PlantID,
700			Payload:   map[string]any{"qr_code": qr.QRCode},
701		})
702		if err != nil {
703			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
704		}
705		if err := s.repo.SetQRProvenanceSeq(ctx, qr.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
706			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
707		}
708		qr.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
709		return qr, nil
710	}

766	// dedupe removes duplicate IDs preserving first-seen order.
767	func dedupe(ids []string) []string {
768		seen := make(map[string]bool, len(ids))
769		out := make([]string, 0, len(ids))
770		for _, id := range ids {
771			if id == "" || seen[id] {
772				continue
773			}
774			seen[id] = true
775			out = append(out, id)
776		}
777		return out
778	}
779	
780	// missingIDs lists requested consignment IDs absent from the fetched set.
781	func missingIDs(wanted []string, got []domain.DCSConsignment) []string {
782		have := make(map[string]bool, len(got))
783		for _, c := range got {
784			have[c.ID] = true
785		}
786		var missing []string
787		for _, id := range wanted {
788			if !have[id] {
789				missing = append(missing, id)
790			}
791		}
792		return missing
793	}
794	
795	// missingLotIDs lists requested BMC lot IDs absent from the fetched set.
796	func missingLotIDs(wanted []string, got []domain.BMCLot) []string {
797		have := make(map[string]bool, len(got))
798		for _, l := range got {
799			have[l.ID] = true
800		}
801		var missing []string
802		for _, id := range wanted {
803			if !have[id] {
804				missing = append(missing, id)
805			}
806		}
807		return missing
808	}

16	// Repo is the plant module's MongoDB access layer. All state transitions use
17	// optimistic filters on the expected status — no transactions (standalone
18	// server), so a lost race simply matches zero documents and the service
19	// reports a conflict instead of corrupting state.
20	type Repo struct {
21		consignments *mongo.Collection
22		bmcLots      *mongo.Collection
23		batches      *mongo.Collection
24		productLots  *mongo.Collection
25		qrs          *mongo.Collection
26		counters     *mongo.Collection
27	}

29	// NewRepo binds the repo to the shared database.
30	func NewRepo(db *mongo.Database) *Repo {
31		return &Repo{
32			consignments: db.Collection(mongodb.CollConsignments),
33			bmcLots:      db.Collection(mongodb.CollBMCLots),
34			batches:      db.Collection(mongodb.CollBatches),
35			productLots:  db.Collection(mongodb.CollProductLots),
36			qrs:          db.Collection(mongodb.CollBatchQRs),
37			counters:     db.Collection(mongodb.CollCounters),
38		}
39	}

42	
43	// ConsignmentsByIDs loads the given consignments (missing IDs simply absent).
44	func (r *Repo) ConsignmentsByIDs(ctx context.Context, ids []string) ([]domain.DCSConsignment, error) {
45		cur, err := r.consignments.Find(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: ids}}}})
46		if err != nil {
47			return nil, err
48		}
49		out := []domain.DCSConsignment{}
50		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
51			return nil, err
52		}
53		return out, nil
54	}

56	// ClaimConsignments atomically flips DELIVERED consignments to ACCEPTED and
57	// stamps the pooling lot ID. Returns how many were actually claimed — fewer
58	// than requested means another lot raced us on at least one consignment.
59	func (r *Repo) ClaimConsignments(ctx context.Context, ids []string, bmcLotID string) (int64, error) {
60		res, err := r.consignments.UpdateMany(ctx,
61			bson.D{
62				{Key: "_id", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: ids}}},
63				{Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusDelivered},
64			},
65			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
66				{Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusAccepted},
67				{Key: "bmc_lot_id", Value: bmcLotID},
68			}}},
69		)
70		if err != nil {
71			return 0, err
72		}
73		return res.ModifiedCount, nil
74	}
75	
76	// ReleaseConsignments undoes a partial claim (compensating action for a lost
77	// race): everything stamped with this lot ID goes back to DELIVERED.
78	func (r *Repo) ReleaseConsignments(ctx context.Context, bmcLotID string) error {
79		_, err := r.consignments.UpdateMany(ctx,
80			bson.D{{Key: "bmc_lot_id", Value: bmcLotID}},
81			bson.D{
82				{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusDelivered}}},
83				{Key: "$unset", Value: bson.D{{Key: "bmc_lot_id", Value: ""}}},
84			},
85		)
86		return err
87	}

279	// ProductLotByID loads one product lot (mongo.ErrNoDocuments when absent).
280	func (r *Repo) ProductLotByID(ctx context.Context, id string) (*domain.ProductLot, error) {
281		var p domain.ProductLot
282		if err := r.productLots.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&p); err != nil {
283			return nil, err
284		}
285		return &p, nil
286	}
287	
288	// RecallProductLot flips any not-yet-recalled lot to RECALLED with the reason.
289	// Returns false when the lot was already recalled (idempotency guard).
290	func (r *Repo) RecallProductLot(ctx context.Context, id, reason string) (bool, error) {
291		res, err := r.productLots.UpdateOne(ctx,
292			bson.D{
293				{Key: "_id", Value: id},
294				{Key: "status", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$ne", Value: domain.ProductLotStatusRecalled}}},
295			},
296			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
297				{Key: "status", Value: domain.ProductLotStatusRecalled},
298				{Key: "recall_reason", Value: reason},
299			}}},
300		)
301		if err != nil {
302			return false, err
303		}
304		return res.MatchedCount > 0, nil
305	}
306	
307	// --- batch QRs ---
308	
309	// InsertQR stores a freshly minted QR. A duplicate-key error means the random
310	// short code collided — the service regenerates and retries.
311	func (r *Repo) InsertQR(ctx context.Context, qr *domain.BatchQR) error {
312		_, err := r.qrs.InsertOne(ctx, qr)
313		return err
314	}
315	
316	// QRListFilter narrows the QR listing.
317	type QRListFilter struct {
318		ProductLotID string
319	}
320	
321	// ListQRs returns a page of QRs plus the total match count.
322	func (r *Repo) ListQRs(ctx context.Context, f QRListFilter, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.BatchQR, int64, error) {
323		filter := bson.D{}
324		if f.ProductLotID != "" {
325			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "product_lot_id", Value: f.ProductLotID})
326		}
327		total, err := r.qrs.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
328		if err != nil {
329			return nil, 0, err
330		}
331		cur, err := r.qrs.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
332			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "issued_at", Value: -1}}).
333			SetSkip(page.Offset).SetLimit(page.Limit))
334		if err != nil {
335			return nil, 0, err
336		}
337		out := []domain.BatchQR{}
338		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
339			return nil, 0, err
340		}
341		return out, total, nil
342	}
343	
344	// --- provenance back-references ---
345	
346	// SetBMCLotProvenanceSeq stamps the ledger sequence onto a lot document.
347	func (r *Repo) SetBMCLotProvenanceSeq(ctx context.Context, id string, seq int64) error {
348		return r.setProvenanceSeq(ctx, r.bmcLots, id, seq)
349	}
350	
351	// SetBatchProvenanceSeq stamps the ledger sequence onto a batch document.
352	func (r *Repo) SetBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx context.Context, id string, seq int64) error {
353		return r.setProvenanceSeq(ctx, r.batches, id, seq)
354	}
355	
356	// SetProductLotProvenanceSeq stamps the ledger sequence onto a product lot.
357	func (r *Repo) SetProductLotProvenanceSeq(ctx context.Context, id string, seq int64) error {
358		return r.setProvenanceSeq(ctx, r.productLots, id, seq)
359	}
360	
361	// SetQRProvenanceSeq stamps the ledger sequence onto a QR document.
362	func (r *Repo) SetQRProvenanceSeq(ctx context.Context, id string, seq int64) error {
363		return r.setProvenanceSeq(ctx, r.qrs, id, seq)
364	}
365	
366	func (r *Repo) setProvenanceSeq(ctx context.Context, coll *mongo.Collection, id string, seq int64) error {
367		_, err := coll.UpdateOne(ctx,
368			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}},
369			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "provenance_seq", Value: seq}}}},
370		)
371		return err
372	}
373

20	// initiateRefsCap bounds how many invoice refs the settlement.initiated
21	// ledger event carries (per module spec: cap 300).

23	
24	// service holds all settlement business logic: the §8.1/§18-B payment
25	// guardrail (compute+initiate → dual-control approve → licensed-PA execute)
26	// and the strictly separate DBT subsidy rail (§13).
27	type service struct {
28		repo   *repo
29		ledger *provenance.Ledger
30		orgs   *orgscope.Resolver
31		bus    *eventbus.Bus
32		log    *slog.Logger

35	// ---- pure guardrail checks (unit-tested without a database) ----
36	
37	// validateApproval enforces the dual-control guardrail (§8.1/§18-B): the
38	// approving party MUST differ from the initiator — checked FIRST and on the
39	// party identity itself, so not even SUPER_ADMIN's role bypass can approve a
40	// batch it initiated. Then the batch must still be awaiting approval.
41	func validateApproval(b domain.SettlementBatch, approverPartyID string) error {
42		if b.InitiatedBy == approverPartyID {
43			return httpx.Forbidden("dual-control violation: the settlement initiator cannot approve their own batch (§8.1/§18-B)").
44				WithDetails(map[string]string{"reason": "DUAL_CONTROL_VIOLATION"})
45		}
46		if b.Status != domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval {
47			return httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch is "+b.Status+", expected "+domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval)
48		}
49		return nil
50	}
51	
52	// validateExecution allows execution only for an APPROVED batch — executing
53	// before a human approval is a guardrail breach, not a race.
54	func validateExecution(b domain.SettlementBatch) error {
55		if b.Status != domain.SettlementStatusApproved {
56			return httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch is "+b.Status+", must be "+domain.SettlementStatusApproved+" before execution")
57		}
58		return nil
59	}

61	// mockUTR builds a mock bank transaction reference: "UTRMOCK" + 12 hex chars.
62	func mockUTR() string {
63		return "UTRMOCK" + strings.ToUpper(strings.ReplaceAll(uuid.NewString(), "-", "")[:12])
64	}
65	
66	// mockPARef builds a mock payment-aggregator batch reference.
67	func mockPARef() string {
68		return "PA-MOCK-" + uuid.NewString()[:8]
69	}

71	// mockPFMSRef builds a mock PFMS acknowledgement reference (§13).
72	func mockPFMSRef() string {

76	// ---- settlement lifecycle ----
77	
78	// Initiate collects a DCS day's ISSUED invoices into a new settlement batch
79	// and parks it PENDING_APPROVAL. The INITIATED status is momentary by design
80	// (§8.1): computation and initiation are one Saathi action; nothing proceeds
81	// until a different human approves.
82	func (s *service) Initiate(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, in InitiateSettlementRequest) (*domain.SettlementBatch, error) {
83		if in.DCSID == "" {
84			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_FIELD", "dcs_id is required")
85		}
86		now := time.Now().UTC()
87		date := in.Date
88		if date == "" {
89			date = domain.DateKeyIST(now)
90		} else if _, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", date); err != nil {
91			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_DATE", "date must be YYYY-MM-DD")
92		}
93		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, in.DCSID); err != nil {
94			return nil, err
95		}
96	
97		candidates, err := s.repo.issuedInvoices(ctx, in.DCSID, date)
98		if err != nil {
99			return nil, err
100		}
101		if len(candidates) == 0 {
102			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("NO_INVOICES", "no ISSUED invoices for DCS "+in.DCSID+" on "+date)
103		}
104	
105		// Claim optimistically: the status guard on the update means each invoice
106		// lands in exactly one batch even under concurrent initiations.
107		batchID := uuid.NewString()
108		ids := make([]string, 0, len(candidates))
109		for _, inv := range candidates {
110			ids = append(ids, inv.ID)
111		}
112		if _, err := s.repo.claimInvoices(ctx, ids, batchID); err != nil {
113			return nil, err
114		}
115		claimed, err := s.repo.invoicesByBatch(ctx, batchID)
116		if err != nil {
117			return nil, err
118		}
119		if len(claimed) == 0 {
120			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("NO_INVOICES", "invoices were claimed by a concurrent settlement for DCS "+in.DCSID+" on "+date)
121		}
122	
123		batch := &domain.SettlementBatch{
124			ID:          batchID,
125			DCSID:       in.DCSID,
126			Date:        date,
127			Status:      domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval, // INITIATED → PENDING_APPROVAL immediately
128			InitiatedBy: actor.PartyID,
129			CreatedAt:   now,
130		}
131		for _, inv := range claimed {
132			batch.InvoiceIDs = append(batch.InvoiceIDs, inv.ID)
133			batch.TotalAmount += inv.TotalAmount
134		}
135		if err := s.repo.insertBatch(ctx, batch); err != nil {
136			// Best-effort release so the claimed invoices are not stranded.
137			if relErr := s.repo.releaseInvoices(ctx, batchID); relErr != nil {
138				s.log.Error("settlement: release after failed insert", slog.String("batch_id", batchID), slog.Any("err", relErr))
139			}
140			return nil, err
141		}
142	
143		refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, min(len(claimed), initiateRefsCap))
144		for i, inv := range claimed {
145			if i >= initiateRefsCap {
146				break
147			}
148			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{EntityType: domain.EntityInvoice, EntityID: inv.ID, Relation: "settles"})
149		}
150		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
151			Type:       domain.EventSettlementInitiated,
152			EntityType: domain.EntitySettlement,
153			EntityID:   batch.ID,
154			Refs:       refs,
155			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
156			OrgUnitID:  batch.DCSID,
157			Payload: map[string]any{
158				"dcs_id":        batch.DCSID,
159				"date":          batch.Date,
160				"invoice_count": len(claimed),
161				"total_amount":  batch.TotalAmount,
162			},
163		})
164		if err != nil {
165			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
166		}
167		if err := s.repo.setBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx, batch.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
168			return nil, err
169		}
170		batch.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
171		return batch, nil
172	}

174	// Approve applies the human dual-control sign-off: PENDING_APPROVAL→APPROVED.
175	func (s *service) Approve(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, batchID string) (*domain.SettlementBatch, error) {
176		batch, err := s.repo.batchByID(ctx, batchID)
177		if err != nil {
178			return nil, err
179		}
180		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, batch.DCSID); err != nil {
181			return nil, err
182		}
183		if err := validateApproval(*batch, actor.PartyID); err != nil {
184			return nil, err
185		}
186	
187		now := time.Now().UTC()
188		ok, err := s.repo.transitionBatch(ctx, batch.ID, domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval, bson.D{
189			{Key: "status", Value: domain.SettlementStatusApproved},
190			{Key: "approved_by", Value: actor.PartyID},
191			{Key: "approved_at", Value: now},
192		})
193		if err != nil {
194			return nil, err
195		}
196		if !ok {
197			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch already left "+domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval)
198		}
199		batch.Status = domain.SettlementStatusApproved
200		batch.ApprovedBy = actor.PartyID
201		batch.ApprovedAt = &now
202	
203		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
204			Type:       domain.EventSettlementApproved,
205			EntityType: domain.EntitySettlement,
206			EntityID:   batch.ID,
207			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
208			OrgUnitID:  batch.DCSID,
209			Payload: map[string]any{
210				"approved_by":  actor.PartyID,
211				"total_amount": batch.TotalAmount,
212			},
213		})
214		if err != nil {
215			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
216		}
217		if err := s.repo.setBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx, batch.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
218			return nil, err
219		}
220		batch.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
221		return batch, nil
222	}

224	// Reject declines a pending batch and returns its invoices to ISSUED so they
225	// can be re-settled.
226	func (s *service) Reject(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, batchID, reason string) (*domain.SettlementBatch, error) {
227		if strings.TrimSpace(reason) == "" {
228			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_FIELD", "reason is required")
229		}
230		batch, err := s.repo.batchByID(ctx, batchID)
231		if err != nil {
232			return nil, err
233		}
234		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, batch.DCSID); err != nil {
235			return nil, err
236		}
237		if batch.Status != domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval {
238			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch is "+batch.Status+", expected "+domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval)
239		}
240	
241		ok, err := s.repo.transitionBatch(ctx, batch.ID, domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval, bson.D{
242			{Key: "status", Value: domain.SettlementStatusRejected},
243			{Key: "rejected_by", Value: actor.PartyID},
244			{Key: "reject_reason", Value: reason},
245		})
246		if err != nil {
247			return nil, err
248		}
249		if !ok {
250			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch already left "+domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval)
251		}
252		if err := s.repo.releaseInvoices(ctx, batch.ID); err != nil {
253			return nil, err
254		}
255		batch.Status = domain.SettlementStatusRejected
256		batch.RejectedBy = actor.PartyID
257		batch.RejectReason = reason
258		return batch, nil
259	}
260	
261	// Execute hands the APPROVED batch to the payment-aggregator adapter and
262	// records the resulting payouts.
263	//
264	// MOCK LICENSED-PA ADAPTER — this is a stand-in for the real integration.
265	// In production (§18-B) execution goes through an RBI-licensed Payment
266	// Aggregator operating a nodal/escrow account: Saathi submits the payout
267	// file, the PA moves the money, and UTRs come back asynchronously via
268	// webhook. Saathi itself never touches funds. The mock credits every payout
269	// instantly with a synthetic UTR so the downstream flow (invoice→PAID,
270	// provenance, farmer SMS) is exercised end to end.
271	func (s *service) Execute(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, batchID string) (*SettlementDetail, error) {
272		batch, err := s.repo.batchByID(ctx, batchID)
273		if err != nil {
274			return nil, err
275		}
276		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, batch.DCSID); err != nil {
277			return nil, err
278		}
279		if err := validateExecution(*batch); err != nil {
280			return nil, err
281		}
282	
283		// Guarded APPROVED→EXECUTING claims execution for this caller only.
284		ok, err := s.repo.transitionBatch(ctx, batch.ID, domain.SettlementStatusApproved, bson.D{
285			{Key: "status", Value: domain.SettlementStatusExecuting},
286		})
287		if err != nil {
288			return nil, err
289		}
290		if !ok {
291			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch is already being executed")
292		}
293	
294		invoices, err := s.repo.invoicesByBatch(ctx, batch.ID)
295		if err != nil {
296			return nil, err
297		}
298	
299		now := time.Now().UTC()
300		payouts := make([]domain.PayoutInstruction, 0, len(invoices))
301		for _, inv := range invoices {
302			masked, err := s.repo.latestBankMasked(ctx, inv.FarmerPartyID)
303			if err != nil {
304				return nil, err
305			}
306			creditedAt := now
307			payout := &domain.PayoutInstruction{
308				ID:                uuid.NewString(),
309				SettlementBatchID: batch.ID,
310				InvoiceID:         inv.ID,
311				FarmerPartyID:     inv.FarmerPartyID,
312				Amount:            inv.TotalAmount,
313				BankAccountMasked: masked,
314				UTR:               mockUTR(),
315				Status:            domain.PayoutStatusSuccess,
316				CreditedAt:        &creditedAt,
317				CreatedAt:         now,
318			}
319			exists, err := s.repo.insertPayout(ctx, payout)
320			if err != nil {
321				return nil, err
322			}
323			if exists {
324				// Retry of an interrupted run — reuse the payout already credited.
325				existing, err := s.repo.payoutByInvoice(ctx, inv.ID)
326				if err != nil {
327					return nil, err
328				}
329				payout = existing
330			}
331			payouts = append(payouts, *payout)
332		}
333	
334		if err := s.repo.markInvoicesPaid(ctx, batch.ID); err != nil {
335			return nil, err
336		}
337	
338		paRef := mockPARef()
339		ok, err = s.repo.transitionBatch(ctx, batch.ID, domain.SettlementStatusExecuting, bson.D{
340			{Key: "status", Value: domain.SettlementStatusExecuted},
341			{Key: "pa_ref", Value: paRef},
342			{Key: "executed_at", Value: now},
343		})
344		if err != nil {
345			return nil, err
346		}
347		if !ok {
348			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch left EXECUTING unexpectedly")
349		}
350		batch.Status = domain.SettlementStatusExecuted
351		batch.PARef = paRef
352		batch.ExecutedAt = &now
353	
354		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
355			Type:       domain.EventSettlementExecuted,
356			EntityType: domain.EntitySettlement,
357			EntityID:   batch.ID,
358			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
359			OrgUnitID:  batch.DCSID,
360			Payload: map[string]any{
361				"pa_ref":       paRef,
362				"payout_count": len(payouts),
363				"total_amount": batch.TotalAmount,
364			},
365		})
366		if err != nil {
367			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
368		}
369		if err := s.repo.setBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx, batch.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
370			return nil, err
371		}
372		batch.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
373	
374		// One payout.credited ledger event per invoice, then the SMS fan-out.
375		// Per-payout ledger/lookup failures are logged, not fatal: the money
376		// outcome is already anchored by settlement.executed above.
377		for _, p := range payouts {
378			if _, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
379				Type:       domain.EventPayoutCredited,
380				EntityType: domain.EntityInvoice,
381				EntityID:   p.InvoiceID,
382				Refs: []provenance.Ref{
383					{EntityType: domain.EntitySettlement, EntityID: batch.ID, Relation: "paid_by"},
384				},
385				Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
386				OrgUnitID: batch.DCSID,
387				Payload:   map[string]any{"utr": p.UTR, "amount": p.Amount},
388			}); err != nil {
389				s.log.Error("settlement: payout.credited ledger append", slog.String("invoice_id", p.InvoiceID), slog.Any("err", err))
390			}
391	
392			phone, err := s.repo.partyPhone(ctx, p.FarmerPartyID)
393			if err != nil {
394				s.log.Error("settlement: farmer phone lookup for payout SMS", slog.String("farmer_party_id", p.FarmerPartyID), slog.Any("err", err))
395				continue
396			}
397			s.bus.Publish(eventbus.TopicPayoutCredited, PayoutCreditedEvent{
398				FarmerPartyID: p.FarmerPartyID,
399				Phone:         phone,
400				Amount:        p.Amount,
401				UTR:           p.UTR,
402			})
403		}
404	
405		return &SettlementDetail{Batch: *batch, Payouts: payouts}, nil
406	}

411	func (s *service) List(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, dcsID, date, status string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.SettlementBatch, int64, error) {
412		if dcsID == "" {

417				// federation-wide read roles may list across DCSes

434		}

438	// Detail returns one batch plus its payout instructions.
439	func (s *service) Detail(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, batchID string) (*SettlementDetail, error) {
440		batch, err := s.repo.batchByID(ctx, batchID)
441		if err != nil {

444		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, batch.DCSID); err != nil {
445			return nil, err
446		}
447		payouts, err := s.repo.payoutsByBatch(ctx, batch.ID)
448		if err != nil {
449			return nil, err
450		}
451		return &SettlementDetail{Batch: *batch, Payouts: payouts}, nil
452	}
453	
454	// PayoutHistory pages payout instructions for one farmer, newest first.
455	// A FARMER token is always forced to its own party — "my payment history".
456	func (s *service) PayoutHistory(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, farmerPartyID string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.PayoutInstruction, int64, error) {
457		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleFarmer {
458			farmerPartyID = actor.PartyID
459		}
460		if farmerPartyID == "" {
461			return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_FIELD", "farmer_party_id is required")
462		}
463		return s.repo.payoutsByFarmer(ctx, farmerPartyID, page)
464	}
465	
466	// ---- DBT subsidy rail (§13) — strictly separate from milk payments ----
467	
468	// CreateDBT submits a scheme subsidy request to the (mocked) PFMS rail.
469	// Saathi only tracks the request; the subsidy is disbursed by PFMS/DBT,
470	// never by Saathi and never through the milk-payment rail.
471	func (s *service) CreateDBT(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, in CreateDBTRequestInput) (*domain.DBTRequest, error) {
472		if in.SchemeCode == "" || in.FarmerPartyID == "" {
473			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_FIELD", "scheme_code and farmer_party_id are required")
474		}
475		if in.Amount <= 0 {
476			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_AMOUNT", "amount must be positive")
477		}
478		if _, err := s.repo.partyPhone(ctx, in.FarmerPartyID); err != nil {
479			return nil, err // farmer must exist
480		}
481	
482		// MOCK PFMS — real integration files the beneficiary+amount with PFMS
483		// and receives an acknowledgement reference (§13).
484		req := &domain.DBTRequest{
485			ID:            uuid.NewString(),
486			SchemeCode:    in.SchemeCode,
487			FarmerPartyID: in.FarmerPartyID,
488			Amount:        in.Amount,
489			PFMSRef:       mockPFMSRef(),
490			Status:        domain.DBTStatusSubmitted,
491			SubmittedBy:   actor.PartyID,
492			CreatedAt:     time.Now().UTC(),
493		}
494		if err := s.repo.insertDBT(ctx, req); err != nil {
495			return nil, err
496		}
497		return req, nil
498	}
499	
500	// UpdateDBTStatus records the DBT rail's progress for a request. CREDITED
501	// stamps credited_at; CREDITED/REJECTED are terminal.
502	func (s *service) UpdateDBTStatus(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id, status string) (*domain.DBTRequest, error) {
503		switch status {
504		case domain.DBTStatusAccepted, domain.DBTStatusCredited, domain.DBTStatusRejected:
505		default:
506			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_STATUS", "status must be one of ACCEPTED, CREDITED, REJECTED")
507		}
508		req, err := s.repo.dbtByID(ctx, id)
509		if err != nil {
510			return nil, err
511		}
512		if req.Status == domain.DBTStatusCredited || req.Status == domain.DBTStatusRejected {
513			return nil, httpx.Conflict("TERMINAL_STATUS", "dbt request is already "+req.Status)
514		}
515	
516		var creditedAt *time.Time
517		if status == domain.DBTStatusCredited {
518			now := time.Now().UTC()
519			creditedAt = &now
520		}
521		ok, err := s.repo.transitionDBT(ctx, req.ID, req.Status, status, creditedAt)
522		if err != nil {
523			return nil, err
524		}
525		if !ok {
526			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "dbt request changed concurrently, retry")
527		}
528		req.Status = status
529		req.CreditedAt = creditedAt
530		_ = actor // status updates carry no extra actor fields today
531		return req, nil
532	}
533	
534	// ListDBT pages DBT requests. A FARMER token is always forced to its own
535	// party.
536	func (s *service) ListDBT(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, farmerPartyID, status string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.DBTRequest, int64, error) {
537		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleFarmer {
538			farmerPartyID = actor.PartyID
539		}
540		filter := bson.D{}
541		if farmerPartyID != "" {
542			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "farmer_party_id", Value: farmerPartyID})
543		}
544		if status != "" {
545			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "status", Value: status})
546		}
547		return s.repo.listDBT(ctx, filter, page)
548	}

1	package quality
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"errors"

7		"net/http"
8		"strings"
9		"time"
10	
11		"github.com/google/uuid"
12	
13		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
14		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
16		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/eventbus"
17		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
18		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/provenance"
19	)
20	
21	// service holds the safety-gate business logic (blueprint §8.3): evaluate
22	// tests against FSSAI limits, write the verdict onto the subject, chain the
23	// provenance events, and broadcast blocks to downstream modules.
24	type service struct {
25		deps *deps.Deps
26		repo *repository
27	}
28	
29	// newService wires the service.
30	func newService(d *deps.Deps, repo *repository) *service {
31		return &service{deps: d, repo: repo}
32	}
33	
34	// gateSubject is what the gate needs to know about an eligible subject.
35	type gateSubject struct {
36		entityType string // provenance entity const for the subject
37		orgUnitID  string // owning org unit (BMC or plant) for scope + ledger
38		status     string
39	}
40	
41	// requiredRoleForStage returns the one role allowed to record results at a
42	// stage (BMC_RAPID↔BMC_OPERATOR, PLANT_LAB↔PLANT_LAB_ANALYST), and whether
43	// the stage is known at all.
44	func requiredRoleForStage(stage string) (string, bool) {
45		switch stage {
46		case domain.QCStageBMCRapid:
47			return domain.RoleBMCOperator, true
48		case domain.QCStagePlantLab:
49			return domain.RolePlantLabAnalyst, true
50		default:
51			return "", false
52		}
53	}
54	
55	// certificateNumber builds the human-readable QC certificate identifier from
56	// the per-stage counter, e.g. "QC-PLANT_LAB-000042".
57	func certificateNumber(stage string, seq int64) string {
58		return fmt.Sprintf("QC-%s-%06d", stage, seq)
59	}
60	
61	// recordQCResult evaluates the submitted tests against the FSSAI gate,
62	// persists the result, applies the PASSED/BLOCKED verdict to the subject and
63	// chains the provenance events. This is the only write path that moves a
64	// subject out of QC_PENDING.
65	func (s *service) recordQCResult(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req RecordQCResultRequest) (*domain.QCResult, error) {
66		// Stage×role pairing — RequireRoles admits both analyst roles, the exact
67		// pairing is enforced here.
68		requiredRole, ok := requiredRoleForStage(req.Stage)
69		if !ok {
70			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_STAGE", "stage must be "+domain.QCStageBMCRapid+" or "+domain.QCStagePlantLab)
71		}
72		if actor.RoleCode != requiredRole {
73			return nil, httpx.Forbidden("STAGE_ROLE_MISMATCH: stage " + req.Stage + " results may only be recorded by " + requiredRole)
74		}
75	
76		subject, err := s.loadGateSubject(ctx, req.SubjectType, req.SubjectID)
77		if err != nil {
78			return nil, err
79		}
80		if err := s.deps.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, subject.orgUnitID); err != nil {
81			return nil, err
82		}
83	
84		// Evaluate against the FSSAI limits (domain owns the rules).
85		overallPass, failures, evaluated := domain.EvaluateQCTests(toDomainTests(req.Tests))
86	
87		resultID := uuid.NewString()
88		now := time.Now().UTC()
89	
90		result := &domain.QCResult{
91			ID:             resultID,
92			SubjectType:    req.SubjectType,
93			SubjectID:      req.SubjectID,
94			Stage:          req.Stage,
95			Tests:          evaluated,
96			OverallPass:    overallPass,
97			AnalystPartyID: actor.PartyID,
98			LabRef:         req.LabRef,
99			RecordedAt:     now,
100		}
101	
102		blockReason := ""
103		if overallPass {
104			seq, err := s.repo.nextCertificateSeq(ctx, req.Stage)
105			if err != nil {
106				return nil, err
107			}
108			result.CertificateNumber = certificateNumber(req.Stage, seq)
109		} else {
110			result.FailureReasons = failures
111			blockReason = strings.Join(failures, "; ")
112		}
113	
114		// Claim the gate first: the conditional QC_PENDING filter makes concurrent
115		// double-records collide here instead of double-applying verdicts.
116		gated, err := s.applyGate(ctx, req.SubjectType, req.SubjectID, resultID, overallPass, blockReason)
117		if err != nil {
118			return nil, err
119		}
120		if !gated {
121			return nil, httpx.Conflict("SUBJECT_ALREADY_GATED", "subject is no longer awaiting QC — a verdict was already recorded")
122		}
123	
124		if err := s.repo.insertResult(ctx, result); err != nil {
125			return nil, err
126		}
127	
128		// Provenance: qc.recorded, then the gate verdict event (blueprint §7).
129		ledgerActor := provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode}
130		recorded, err := s.deps.Ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
131			Type:       domain.EventQCRecorded,
132			EntityType: domain.EntityQCResult,
133			EntityID:   resultID,
134			Refs: []provenance.Ref{
135				{EntityType: subject.entityType, EntityID: req.SubjectID, Relation: "tested"},
136			},
137			Actor:     ledgerActor,
138			OrgUnitID: subject.orgUnitID,
139			Payload: map[string]any{
140				"stage":        req.Stage,
141				"subject_type": req.SubjectType,
142				"overall_pass": overallPass,
143			},
144		})
145		if err != nil {
146			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
147		}
148	
149		gateEvent := provenance.AppendInput{
150			EntityType: domain.EntityQCResult,
151			EntityID:   resultID,
152			Actor:      ledgerActor,
153			OrgUnitID:  subject.orgUnitID,
154		}
155		if overallPass {
156			gateEvent.Type = domain.EventGatePassed
157			gateEvent.Refs = []provenance.Ref{
158				{EntityType: subject.entityType, EntityID: req.SubjectID, Relation: "certifies"},
159			}
160			gateEvent.Payload = map[string]any{"certificate_number": result.CertificateNumber}
161		} else {
162			gateEvent.Type = domain.EventGateBlocked
163			gateEvent.Refs = []provenance.Ref{
164				{EntityType: subject.entityType, EntityID: req.SubjectID, Relation: "blocks"},
165			}
166			gateEvent.Payload = map[string]any{"failure_reasons": failures}
167		}
168		if _, err := s.deps.Ledger.Append(ctx, gateEvent); err != nil {
169			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
170		}
171	
172		if err := s.repo.setResultProvenanceSeq(ctx, resultID, recorded.Seq); err != nil {
173			return nil, err
174		}
175		result.ProvenanceSeq = recorded.Seq
176	
177		// Broadcast the block so the plant module quarantines downstream — a
178		// blocked lot can never advance.
179		if !overallPass {
180			s.deps.Bus.Publish(eventbus.TopicGateBlocked, GateBlockedPayload{
181				SubjectType:    req.SubjectType,
182				SubjectID:      req.SubjectID,
183				QCResultID:     resultID,
184				Stage:          req.Stage,
185				FailureReasons: failures,
186			})
187		}
188		return result, nil
189	}
190	
191	// loadGateSubject fetches a gate-eligible subject and verifies it is awaiting
192	// QC. Only BMC lots and processing batches carry the software safety gate.
193	func (s *service) loadGateSubject(ctx context.Context, subjectType, subjectID string) (gateSubject, error) {
194		switch subjectType {
195		case domain.QCSubjectBMCLot:
196			lot, err := s.repo.findBMCLot(ctx, subjectID)
197			if err != nil {
198				return gateSubject{}, err
199			}
200			if lot.Status != domain.BMCLotStatusQCPending {
201				return gateSubject{}, httpx.Conflict("SUBJECT_NOT_QC_PENDING", "bmc lot is in status "+lot.Status+" — only QC_PENDING subjects can be gated")
202			}
203			return gateSubject{entityType: domain.EntityBMCLot, orgUnitID: lot.BMCID, status: lot.Status}, nil
204	
205		case domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch:
206			batch, err := s.repo.findBatch(ctx, subjectID)
207			if err != nil {
208				return gateSubject{}, err
209			}
210			if batch.Status != domain.BatchStatusQCPending {
211				return gateSubject{}, httpx.Conflict("SUBJECT_NOT_QC_PENDING", "processing batch is in status "+batch.Status+" — only QC_PENDING subjects can be gated")
212			}
213			return gateSubject{entityType: domain.EntityBatch, orgUnitID: batch.PlantID, status: batch.Status}, nil
214	
215		case domain.QCSubjectDCSConsignment:
216			return gateSubject{}, httpx.Unprocessable("SUBJECT_NOT_GATE_ELIGIBLE", "DCS consignments are not gate subjects — gate at the BMC lot or processing batch")
217	
218		default:
219			return gateSubject{}, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_SUBJECT_TYPE", "subject_type must be one of "+domain.QCSubjectBMCLot+", "+domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch)
220		}
221	}
222	
223	// applyGate routes the conditional verdict write to the subject's collection,
224	// mapping the verdict onto that subject kind's status constants.
225	func (s *service) applyGate(ctx context.Context, subjectType, subjectID, resultID string, pass bool, blockReason string) (bool, error) {
226		switch subjectType {
227		case domain.QCSubjectBMCLot:
228			status := domain.BMCLotStatusBlocked
229			if pass {
230				status = domain.BMCLotStatusPassed
231			}
232			return s.repo.gateBMCLot(ctx, subjectID, resultID, status, blockReason)
233		case domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch:
234			status := domain.BatchStatusBlocked
235			if pass {
236				status = domain.BatchStatusPassed
237			}
238			return s.repo.gateBatch(ctx, subjectID, resultID, status, blockReason)
239		default:
240			return false, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_SUBJECT_TYPE", "subject_type is not gate-eligible")
241		}
242	}
243	
244	// listQCResults returns a page of results, newest first. When the filter
245	// identifies an org-owned subject, the caller must be in that org's scope.
246	func (s *service) listQCResults(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, subjectType, subjectID string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.QCResult, int64, error) {
247		if subjectType != "" && !isValidSubjectType(subjectType) {
248			return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_SUBJECT_TYPE", "unknown subject_type "+subjectType)
249		}
250		if subjectID != "" && subjectType == "" {
251			return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_SUBJECT_TYPE", "subject_id requires subject_type")
252		}
253		if subjectID != "" {
254			if err := s.requireSubjectScope(ctx, actor, subjectType, subjectID); err != nil {
255				return nil, 0, err
256			}
257		}
258		return s.repo.listResults(ctx, subjectType, subjectID, page)
259	}
260	
261	// getQCResult returns one result (its tests carry the stored pass verdicts),
262	// enforcing the subject org scope.
263	func (s *service) getQCResult(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, resultID string) (*domain.QCResult, error) {
264		result, err := s.repo.findResultByID(ctx, resultID)
265		if err != nil {
266			return nil, err
267		}
268		if err := s.requireSubjectScope(ctx, actor, result.SubjectType, result.SubjectID); err != nil {
269			return nil, err
270		}
271		return result, nil
272	}
273	
274	// requireSubjectScope enforces the caller's org scope over the org unit that
275	// owns a QC subject. Subjects that no longer resolve (or subject types that
276	// carry no org) skip the check — the role gate still applies.
277	func (s *service) requireSubjectScope(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, subjectType, subjectID string) error {
278		orgID, err := s.subjectOrgUnit(ctx, subjectType, subjectID)
279		if err != nil {
280			return err
281		}
282		if orgID == "" {
283			return nil
284		}
285		return s.deps.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, orgID)
286	}
287	
288	// subjectOrgUnit resolves the owning org unit of a subject, or "" when the
289	// subject is missing or not an org-owned gate subject.
290	func (s *service) subjectOrgUnit(ctx context.Context, subjectType, subjectID string) (string, error) {
291		switch subjectType {
292		case domain.QCSubjectBMCLot:
293			lot, err := s.repo.findBMCLot(ctx, subjectID)
294			if err != nil {
295				return "", ignoreNotFound(err)
296			}
297			return lot.BMCID, nil
298		case domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch:
299			batch, err := s.repo.findBatch(ctx, subjectID)
300			if err != nil {
301				return "", ignoreNotFound(err)
302			}
303			return batch.PlantID, nil
304		default:
305			return "", nil
306		}
307	}
308	
309	// ignoreNotFound swallows 404 AppErrors and passes everything else through.
310	func ignoreNotFound(err error) error {
311		var appErr *httpx.AppError
312		if errors.As(err, &appErr) && appErr.Status == http.StatusNotFound {
313			return nil
314		}
315		return err
316	}
317	
318	// isValidSubjectType reports whether t is a known QC subject type.
319	func isValidSubjectType(t string) bool {
320		switch t {
321		case domain.QCSubjectDCSConsignment, domain.QCSubjectBMCLot, domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch:
322			return true
323		default:
324			return false
325		}
326	}
327	
328	// toDomainTests converts request test inputs to domain tests for evaluation.
329	func toDomainTests(in []QCTestInput) []domain.QCTest {
330		out := make([]domain.QCTest, 0, len(in))
331		for _, t := range in {
332			out = append(out, domain.QCTest{Name: t.Name, Value: t.Value, Unit: t.Unit})
333		}
334		return out
335	}
336	
337	// limits returns the FSSAI gate constants (blueprint §8.3) as reference data.
338	func (s *service) limits() LimitsResponse {

1	package domain
2	
3	import (
4		"fmt"
5		"time"
6	)
7	
8	// FSSAI limits for liquid milk (blueprint §8.3). Aflatoxin M1 is heat-stable
9	// and survives pasteurisation, so it MUST be gated upstream (BMC + plant),
10	// never only at the finished product.
11	const (
12		FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg = 0.5  // AFM1 ≤ 0.5 µg/kg
13		FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl          = 10.0 // coliform ≤ 10 CFU/ml
14		FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg       = 0.1  // antibiotic MRL example
15	)
16	
17	// QC test names.
18	const (
19		TestAflatoxinM1  = "AFLATOXIN_M1"           // µg/kg
20		TestColiform     = "COLIFORM"               // CFU/ml
21		TestTPC          = "TPC"                    // CFU/ml, graded — recorded, not hard-gated here
22		TestAntibiotic   = "ANTIBIOTIC_TETRACYCLINE" // mg/kg
23		TestPhosphatase  = "PHOSPHATASE"            // 0 = negative (pass post-pasteurisation), 1 = positive
24		TestFat          = "FAT"                    // %
25		TestSNF          = "SNF"                    // %
26	)
27	
28	// QC stages.
29	const (
30		QCStageBMCRapid = "BMC_RAPID" // strip/rapid tests at the chilling centre
31		QCStagePlantLab = "PLANT_LAB" // full lab: ELISA/HPLC, culture, LC-MS/MS
32	)
33	
34	// QC subject types.
35	const (
36		QCSubjectDCSConsignment  = "DCS_CONSIGNMENT"
37		QCSubjectBMCLot          = "BMC_LOT"
38		QCSubjectProcessingBatch = "PROCESSING_BATCH"
39	)
40	
41	// QCTest is a single measurement inside a QC result.
42	type QCTest struct {
43		Name  string  `bson:"name"  json:"name"`
44		Value float64 `bson:"value" json:"value"`
45		Unit  string  `bson:"unit"  json:"unit"`
46		Pass  bool    `bson:"pass"  json:"pass"`
47	}
48	
49	// QCResult is the recorded outcome of testing one subject at one stage.
50	// OverallPass drives the safety gate; a certificate is attached to provenance
51	// on pass, a block + quarantine on fail.
52	type QCResult struct {
53		ID                string    `bson:"_id"          json:"id"`
54		SubjectType       string    `bson:"subject_type" json:"subject_type"`
55		SubjectID         string    `bson:"subject_id"   json:"subject_id"`
56		Stage             string    `bson:"stage"        json:"stage"`
57		Tests             []QCTest  `bson:"tests"        json:"tests"`
58		OverallPass       bool      `bson:"overall_pass" json:"overall_pass"`
59		FailureReasons    []string  `bson:"failure_reasons,omitempty" json:"failure_reasons,omitempty"`
60		AnalystPartyID    string    `bson:"analyst_party_id" json:"analyst_party_id"`
61		LabRef            string    `bson:"lab_ref,omitempty"            json:"lab_ref,omitempty"`
62		CertificateNumber string    `bson:"certificate_number,omitempty" json:"certificate_number,omitempty"`
63		RecordedAt        time.Time `bson:"recorded_at"  json:"recorded_at"`
64		ProvenanceSeq     int64     `bson:"provenance_seq,omitempty" json:"provenance_seq,omitempty"`
65	}
66	
67	// EvaluateQCTests applies the FSSAI gate to a set of tests: it fills each
68	// test's Pass verdict and returns the overall verdict plus human-readable
69	// failure reasons. Unknown test names are recorded but do not gate.
70	func EvaluateQCTests(tests []QCTest) (overallPass bool, failures []string, evaluated []QCTest) {
71		overallPass = true
72		evaluated = make([]QCTest, 0, len(tests))
73		for _, t := range tests {
74			pass := true
75			switch t.Name {
76			case TestAflatoxinM1:
77				if t.Value > FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg {
78					pass = false
79					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
80						"AFLATOXIN_M1 %.3f µg/kg exceeds FSSAI limit %.1f µg/kg", t.Value, FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg))
81				}
82			case TestColiform:
83				if t.Value > FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl {
84					pass = false
85					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
86						"COLIFORM %.1f CFU/ml exceeds FSSAI limit %.0f CFU/ml", t.Value, FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl))
87				}
88			case TestAntibiotic:
89				if t.Value > FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg {
90					pass = false
91					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
92						"ANTIBIOTIC_TETRACYCLINE %.3f mg/kg exceeds MRL %.1f mg/kg", t.Value, FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg))
93				}
94			case TestPhosphatase:
95				if t.Value != 0 {
96					pass = false
97					failures = append(failures, "PHOSPHATASE positive — pasteurisation check failed (must be negative)")
98				}
99			}
100			t.Pass = pass
101			if !pass {
102				overallPass = false
103			}
104			evaluated = append(evaluated, t)
105		}
106		return overallPass, failures, evaluated
107	}
108
