```text
1	package logistics
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"errors"
6		"fmt"
7		"math"
8		"time"
9	
10		"github.com/google/uuid"
11		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
12	
13		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
14		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
16		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/orgscope"
17		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/provenance"
18	)
19	
20	const (
21		// canCapacityLitres is the standard milk-can volume used to size a
22		// consignment: can_count = ceil(total litres / 40).
23		canCapacityLitres = 40.0
24	
25		// maxPourRefs caps how many pour references a consignment.created
26		// provenance event carries; beyond it the pour count lives in the
27		// payload only, keeping ledger events bounded.
28		maxPourRefs = 300
29	
30		// maxTripStops bounds a planned route so trip documents stay small.
31		maxTripStops = 100
32	
33		// Physical sanity bounds for a hand-held transit thermometer reading.
34		minPlausibleTempC = -30.0
35		maxPlausibleTempC = 70.0
36	)
37	
38	// service holds all logistics business logic: consignment aggregation,
39	// the consignment/trip state machines, and provenance emission.
40	type service struct {
41		repo   *repo
42		orgs   *orgscope.Resolver
43		ledger *provenance.Ledger
44	}
45	
46	// newService wires the service to its collaborators.
47	func newService(repo *repo, orgs *orgscope.Resolver, ledger *provenance.Ledger) *service {
48		return &service{repo: repo, orgs: orgs, ledger: ledger}
49	}
50	
51	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
52	// Consignments
53	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
54	
55	// createConsignment pools one DCS date+shift's RECORDED pours into an OPEN
56	// consignment: pour IDs, total litres, quantity-weighted fat/SNF averages and
57	// the can count. The unique dcs+date+shift index makes creation idempotent-ish
58	// (a replay returns CONSIGNMENT_EXISTS).
59	func (s *service) createConsignment(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req createConsignmentRequest) (*domain.DCSConsignment, error) {
60		if req.DCSID == "" {
61			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_DCS_ID", "dcs_id is required")
62		}
63		if err := validateShift(req.Shift); err != nil {
64			return nil, err
65		}
66		now := time.Now().UTC()
67		date, err := resolveDate(req.Date, now)
68		if err != nil {
69			return nil, err
70		}
71		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.DCSID); err != nil {
72			return nil, err
73		}
74		org, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.DCSID)
75		if err != nil {
76			return nil, err
77		}
78		if org.Type != domain.OrgTypeDCS {
79			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_DCS", "org unit "+req.DCSID+" is not a DCS")
80		}
81	
82		rows, err := s.repo.findRecordedPours(ctx, req.DCSID, date, req.Shift)
83		if err != nil {
84			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
85		}
86		if len(rows) == 0 {
87			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("NO_POURS_TO_CONSIGN",
88				fmt.Sprintf("no RECORDED pours for DCS %s on %s %s", req.DCSID, date, req.Shift))
89		}
90		pourIDs, totalQty, avgFat, avgSNF := aggregatePours(rows)
91	
92		consignment := &domain.DCSConsignment{
93			ID:                  uuid.NewString(),
94			DCSID:               req.DCSID,
95			Date:                date,
96			Shift:               req.Shift,
97			PourIDs:             pourIDs,
98			TotalQuantityLitres: totalQty,
99			CanCount:            int(math.Ceil(totalQty / canCapacityLitres)),
100			AvgFatPct:           avgFat,
101			AvgSNFPct:           avgSNF,
102			Status:              domain.ConsignmentStatusOpen,
103			CreatedBy:           actor.PartyID,
104			CreatedAt:           now,
105		}
106		if err := s.repo.insertConsignment(ctx, consignment); err != nil {
107			if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(err) {
108				return nil, httpx.Conflict("CONSIGNMENT_EXISTS",
109					fmt.Sprintf("a consignment for DCS %s on %s %s already exists", req.DCSID, date, req.Shift))
110			}
111			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
112		}
113	
114		// Provenance: the pooling-boundary event. Pour refs are capped so the
115		// event stays bounded — past the cap the payload's pour_count is the
116		// authoritative tally (the doc's pour_ids keeps the full set).
117		refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, min(len(pourIDs), maxPourRefs))
118		for i, id := range pourIDs {
119			if i >= maxPourRefs {
120				break
121			}
122			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{EntityType: domain.EntityMilkPour, EntityID: id, Relation: "aggregates"})
123		}
124		event, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
125			Type:       domain.EventConsignmentCreated,
126			EntityType: domain.EntityConsignment,
127			EntityID:   consignment.ID,
128			Refs:       refs,
129			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
130			OrgUnitID:  consignment.DCSID,
131			Payload: map[string]any{
132				"pour_count":            len(pourIDs),
133				"total_quantity_litres": totalQty,
134				"can_count":             consignment.CanCount,
135				"date":                  date,
136				"shift":                 req.Shift,
137			},
138		})
139		if err != nil {
140			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
141		}
142		if err := s.repo.setConsignmentProvenanceSeq(ctx, consignment.ID, event.Seq); err != nil {
143			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
144		}
145		consignment.ProvenanceSeq = event.Seq
146		return consignment, nil
147	}
148	
149	// dispatchConsignment seals an OPEN consignment for pickup (OPEN→DISPATCHED).
150	func (s *service) dispatchConsignment(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id string) (*domain.DCSConsignment, error) {
151		consignment, err := s.loadConsignment(ctx, id)
152		if err != nil {
153			return nil, err
154		}
155		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, consignment.DCSID); err != nil {
156			return nil, err
157		}
158		if consignment.Status != domain.ConsignmentStatusOpen {
159			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_CONSIGNMENT_STATE",
160				"consignment is "+consignment.Status+"; only OPEN consignments can be dispatched")
161		}
162		now := time.Now().UTC()
163		matched, err := s.repo.markConsignmentDispatched(ctx, id, now)
164		if err != nil {
165			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
166		}
167		if !matched { // lost a state race since the read above
168			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_CONSIGNMENT_STATE",
169				"consignment was modified concurrently; reload and retry")
170		}
171		event, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
172			Type:       domain.EventConsignmentDispatched,
173			EntityType: domain.EntityConsignment,
174			EntityID:   consignment.ID,
175			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
176			OrgUnitID:  consignment.DCSID,
177		})
178		if err != nil {
179			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
180		}
181		if err := s.repo.setConsignmentProvenanceSeq(ctx, consignment.ID, event.Seq); err != nil {
182			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
183		}
184		consignment.Status = domain.ConsignmentStatusDispatch
185		consignment.DispatchedAt = &now
186		consignment.ProvenanceSeq = event.Seq
187		return consignment, nil
188	}
189	
190	// listConsignments returns a scoped page of consignments. DCS-scoped actors
191	// default to their own society; wide read roles (SUPER_ADMIN, STATE_AUDITOR)
192	// may list unfiltered; everyone else must name a dcs_id inside their scope.
193	func (s *service) listConsignments(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, q consignmentListQuery, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.DCSConsignment, int64, error) {
194		dcsID := q.DCSID
195		if dcsID == "" {
196			switch {
197			case actor.OrgType == domain.OrgTypeDCS && actor.OrgUnitID != "":
198				dcsID = actor.OrgUnitID
199			case actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSuperAdmin || actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleStateAuditor:
200				// federation-wide read roles may scan unfiltered (still paged)
201			default:
202				return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("DCS_ID_REQUIRED", "dcs_id query parameter is required for your role")
203			}
204		}
205		if dcsID != "" {
206			if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, dcsID); err != nil {
207				return nil, 0, err
208			}
209		}
210		if q.Date != "" {
211			if _, err := resolveDate(q.Date, time.Time{}); err != nil {
212				return nil, 0, err
213			}
214		}
215		if q.Status != "" && !isConsignmentStatus(q.Status) {
216			return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_STATUS", "unknown consignment status "+q.Status)
217		}
218		items, total, err := s.repo.listConsignments(ctx, dcsID, q.Date, q.Status, page)
219		if err != nil {
220			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
221		}
222		return items, total, nil
223	}
224	
225	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
226	// Route trips
227	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
228	
229	// createTrip plans a van run: every stop's consignment must already be
230	// DISPATCHED and must belong to that stop's DCS. The rider defaults to the
231	// actor when a VAN_RIDER plans their own route.
232	func (s *service) createTrip(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req createTripRequest) (*domain.RouteTrip, error) {
233		if req.RouteName == "" {
234			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_ROUTE_NAME", "route_name is required")
235		}
236		if req.UnionID == "" {
237			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_UNION_ID", "union_id is required")
238		}
239		if err := validateShift(req.Shift); err != nil {
240			return nil, err
241		}
242		if len(req.Stops) == 0 {
243			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NO_STOPS", "at least one stop is required")
244		}
245		if len(req.Stops) > maxTripStops {
246			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("TOO_MANY_STOPS", fmt.Sprintf("a trip may have at most %d stops", maxTripStops))
247		}
248		now := time.Now().UTC()
249		date, err := resolveDate(req.Date, now)
250		if err != nil {
251			return nil, err
252		}
253		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.UnionID); err != nil {
254			return nil, err
255		}
256		union, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.UnionID)
257		if err != nil {
258			return nil, err
259		}
260		if union.Type != domain.OrgTypeMilkUnion {
261			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_UNION", "org unit "+req.UnionID+" is not a MILK_UNION")
262		}
263	
264		riderPartyID := req.VanRiderPartyID
265		if riderPartyID == "" {
266			if actor.RoleCode != domain.RoleVanRider {
267				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("RIDER_REQUIRED", "van_rider_party_id is required unless a VAN_RIDER plans their own trip")
268			}
269			riderPartyID = actor.PartyID
270		}
271	
272		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(req.Stops))
273		stops := make([]domain.RouteStop, 0, len(req.Stops))
274		for _, stop := range req.Stops {
275			if stop.DCSID == "" || stop.ConsignmentID == "" {
276				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_STOP", "every stop needs dcs_id and consignment_id")
277			}
278			if _, dup := seen[stop.ConsignmentID]; dup {
279				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("DUPLICATE_STOP", "consignment "+stop.ConsignmentID+" appears in more than one stop")
280			}
281			seen[stop.ConsignmentID] = struct{}{}
282	
283			consignment, err := s.loadConsignment(ctx, stop.ConsignmentID)
284			if err != nil {
285				return nil, err
286			}
287			if aerr := validateStopConsignment(consignment, stop.DCSID); aerr != nil {
288				return nil, aerr
289			}
290			stops = append(stops, domain.RouteStop{DCSID: stop.DCSID, ConsignmentID: stop.ConsignmentID})
291		}
292	
293		trip := &domain.RouteTrip{
294			ID:              uuid.NewString(),
295			RouteName:       req.RouteName,
296			UnionID:         req.UnionID,
297			VanRiderPartyID: riderPartyID,
298			Date:            date,
299			Shift:           req.Shift,
300			Stops:           stops,
301			Status:          domain.TripStatusPlanned,
302			CreatedAt:       now,
303		}
304		if err := s.repo.insertTrip(ctx, trip); err != nil {
305			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
306		}
307		return trip, nil
308	}
309	
310	// pickupStop records the trip's rider collecting one consignment: the stop is
311	// stamped with time+temperature, the consignment moves DISPATCHED→PICKED_UP,
312	// and the trip moves to IN_PROGRESS on its first pickup.
313	func (s *service) pickupStop(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, tripID, consignmentID string, req pickupRequest) (*domain.RouteTrip, error) {
314		if err := validateTemp(req.TempC); err != nil {
315			return nil, err
316		}
317		trip, err := s.loadTrip(ctx, tripID)
318		if err != nil {
319			return nil, err
320		}
321		if aerr := validatePickup(trip, actor.PartyID, consignmentID); aerr != nil {
322			return nil, aerr
323		}
324	
325		// Guard the consignment transition atomically; only a DISPATCHED
326		// consignment can board the van.
327		matched, err := s.repo.markConsignmentPickedUp(ctx, consignmentID, trip.ID)
328		if err != nil {
329			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
330		}
331		if !matched {
332			consignment, err := s.loadConsignment(ctx, consignmentID)
333			if err != nil {
334				return nil, err
335			}
336			return nil, httpx.Conflict("CONSIGNMENT_NOT_DISPATCHED",
337				"consignment is "+consignment.Status+"; only DISPATCHED consignments can be picked up")
338		}
339	
340		now := time.Now().UTC()
341		if err := s.repo.markStopPickedUp(ctx, trip.ID, consignmentID, now, *req.TempC, req.Notes); err != nil {
342			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
343		}
344	
345		event, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
346			Type:       domain.EventConsignmentPickedUp,
347			EntityType: domain.EntityConsignment,
348			EntityID:   consignmentID,
349			Refs: []provenance.Ref{
350				{EntityType: domain.EntityRouteTrip, EntityID: trip.ID, Relation: "carried_by"},
351			},
352			Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
353			OrgUnitID: trip.UnionID,
354			Payload:   map[string]any{"temp_c": *req.TempC},
355		})
356		if err != nil {
357			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
358		}
359		if err := s.repo.setConsignmentProvenanceSeq(ctx, consignmentID, event.Seq); err != nil {
360			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
361		}
362	
363		trip.Status = domain.TripStatusInProgress
364		if i := findStop(trip, consignmentID); i >= 0 {
365			trip.Stops[i].PickedUpAt = &now
366			trip.Stops[i].TempC = *req.TempC
367			trip.Stops[i].Notes = req.Notes
368		}
369		return trip, nil
370	}
371	
372	// logColdChain appends one in-transit temperature sample to the trip —
373	// tamper-evidence for the perishable load between village and BMC.
374	func (s *service) logColdChain(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, tripID string, req coldChainRequest) (*domain.RouteTrip, error) {
375		if err := validateTemp(req.TempC); err != nil {
376			return nil, err
377		}
378		trip, err := s.loadTrip(ctx, tripID)
379		if err != nil {
380			return nil, err
381		}
382		if aerr := validateColdChain(trip, actor.PartyID); aerr != nil {
383			return nil, aerr
384		}
385		entry := domain.ColdChainEntry{
386			TS:     time.Now().UTC(),
387			TempC:  *req.TempC,
388			GeoLat: req.GeoLat,
389			GeoLng: req.GeoLng,
390		}
391		if err := s.repo.pushColdChain(ctx, trip.ID, entry); err != nil {
392			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
393		}
394		event, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
395			Type:       domain.EventColdChainLogged,
396			EntityType: domain.EntityRouteTrip,
397			EntityID:   trip.ID,
398			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
399			OrgUnitID:  trip.UnionID,
400			Payload:    map[string]any{"temp_c": *req.TempC},
401		})
402		if err != nil {
403			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
404		}
405		if err := s.repo.setTripProvenanceSeq(ctx, trip.ID, event.Seq); err != nil {
406			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
407		}
408		trip.ColdChain = append(trip.ColdChain, entry)
409		trip.ProvenanceSeq = event.Seq
410		return trip, nil
411	}
412	
413	// deliverTrip hands the whole load to a BMC: every stop must be picked up,
414	// the trip moves IN_PROGRESS→DELIVERED and its consignments PICKED_UP→DELIVERED.
415	func (s *service) deliverTrip(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, tripID string, req deliverRequest) (*domain.RouteTrip, error) {
416		if req.BMCID == "" {
417			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_BMC_ID", "bmc_id is required")
418		}
419		trip, err := s.loadTrip(ctx, tripID)
420		if err != nil {
421			return nil, err
422		}
423		if aerr := validateDeliver(trip, actor.PartyID); aerr != nil {
424			return nil, aerr
425		}
426		bmc, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.BMCID)
427		if err != nil {
428			return nil, err
429		}
430		if bmc.Type != domain.OrgTypeBMC {
431			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_BMC", "org unit "+req.BMCID+" is not a BMC")
432		}
433	
434		now := time.Now().UTC()
435		matched, err := s.repo.markTripDelivered(ctx, trip.ID, req.BMCID, now)
436		if err != nil {
437			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
438		}
439		if !matched { // lost a state race since the read above
440			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_TRIP_STATE", "trip was modified concurrently; reload and retry")
441		}
442	
443		consignmentIDs := make([]string, 0, len(trip.Stops))
444		refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, len(trip.Stops))
445		for _, stop := range trip.Stops {
446			consignmentIDs = append(consignmentIDs, stop.ConsignmentID)
447			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{
448				EntityType: domain.EntityConsignment, EntityID: stop.ConsignmentID, Relation: "delivered",
449			})
450		}
451		if err := s.repo.markConsignmentsDelivered(ctx, consignmentIDs); err != nil {
452			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
453		}
454	
455		event, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
456			Type:       domain.EventTripDelivered,
457			EntityType: domain.EntityRouteTrip,
458			EntityID:   trip.ID,
459			Refs:       refs,
460			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
461			OrgUnitID:  trip.UnionID,
462			Payload:    map[string]any{"bmc_id": req.BMCID},
463		})
464		if err != nil {
465			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
466		}
467		if err := s.repo.setTripProvenanceSeq(ctx, trip.ID, event.Seq); err != nil {
468			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
469		}
470	
471		trip.Status = domain.TripStatusDelivered
472		trip.DeliveredToBMCID = req.BMCID
473		trip.DeliveredAt = &now
474		trip.ProvenanceSeq = event.Seq
475		return trip, nil
476	}
477	
478	// listTrips returns a scoped page of trips: riders are forced onto their own
479	// trips; supervisors/presidents default to (and are checked against) their
480	// union scope.
481	func (s *service) listTrips(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, q tripListQuery, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.RouteTrip, int64, error) {
482		unionID := q.UnionID
483		riderPartyID := q.VanRiderPartyID
484		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleVanRider {
485			riderPartyID = actor.PartyID // riders only ever see their own trips
486		} else {
487			if unionID == "" &&
488				actor.RoleCode != domain.RoleSuperAdmin && actor.RoleCode != domain.RoleStateAuditor {
489				unionID = actor.OrgUnitID // supervisors/presidents default to their union
490			}
491			if unionID != "" {
492				if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, unionID); err != nil {
493					return nil, 0, err
494				}
495			}
496		}
497		if q.Date != "" {
498			if _, err := resolveDate(q.Date, time.Time{}); err != nil {
499				return nil, 0, err
500			}
501		}
502		items, total, err := s.repo.listTrips(ctx, unionID, q.Date, riderPartyID, page)
503		if err != nil {
504			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
505		}
506		return items, total, nil
507	}
508	
509	// getTrip returns one trip: a rider only their own, everyone else within
510	// union scope.
511	func (s *service) getTrip(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, tripID string) (*domain.RouteTrip, error) {
512		trip, err := s.loadTrip(ctx, tripID)
513		if err != nil {
514			return nil, err
515		}
516		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleVanRider {
517			if trip.VanRiderPartyID != actor.PartyID {
518				return nil, httpx.Forbidden("this trip is assigned to another van rider")
519			}
520			return trip, nil
521		}
522		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, trip.UnionID); err != nil {
523			return nil, err
524		}
525		return trip, nil
526	}

529	// Loaders (mongo.ErrNoDocuments → 404)
530	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
531	
532	// loadConsignment fetches a consignment, mapping a miss to 404.
533	func (s *service) loadConsignment(ctx context.Context, id string) (*domain.DCSConsignment, error) {
534		c, err := s.repo.findConsignmentByID(ctx, id)
535		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
536			return nil, httpx.NotFound("consignment " + id)
537		}
538		if err != nil {
539			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
540		}
541		return c, nil
542	}
543	
544	// loadTrip fetches a trip, mapping a miss to 404.
545	func (s *service) loadTrip(ctx context.Context, id string) (*domain.RouteTrip, error) {
546		t, err := s.repo.findTripByID(ctx, id)
547		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
548			return nil, httpx.NotFound("trip " + id)
549		}
550		if err != nil {
551			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
552		}
553		return t, nil
554	}
555	
556	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
557	// Pure guards & helpers (unit-tested in service_test.go)
558	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
559	
560	// aggregatePours reduces pour rows to (ids, total litres, quantity-weighted
561	// average fat %, quantity-weighted average SNF %), rounded to 2 decimals.
562	func aggregatePours(rows []pourRow) (pourIDs []string, totalQty, avgFat, avgSNF float64) {
563		var fatWeighted, snfWeighted float64
564		pourIDs = make([]string, 0, len(rows))
565		for _, row := range rows {
566			pourIDs = append(pourIDs, row.ID)
567			totalQty += row.QuantityLitres
568			fatWeighted += row.FatPct * row.QuantityLitres
569			snfWeighted += row.SNFPct * row.QuantityLitres
570		}
571		if totalQty > 0 {
572			avgFat = round2(fatWeighted / totalQty)
573			avgSNF = round2(snfWeighted / totalQty)
574		}
575		return pourIDs, round2(totalQty), avgFat, avgSNF
576	}
577	
578	// round2 rounds to 2 decimal places (litres / percentage precision).
579	func round2(v float64) float64 { return math.Round(v*100) / 100 }
580	
581	// validateShift accepts only the two collection shifts.
582	func validateShift(shift string) *httpx.AppError {
583		if shift != domain.ShiftMorning && shift != domain.ShiftEvening {
584			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_SHIFT", "shift must be MORNING or EVENING")
585		}
586		return nil
587	}
588	
589	// resolveDate defaults an empty date to the IST day key of now, otherwise
590	// validates the YYYY-MM-DD form.
591	func resolveDate(date string, now time.Time) (string, error) {
592		if date == "" {
593			return domain.DateKeyIST(now), nil
594		}
595		if _, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", date); err != nil {
596			return "", httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_DATE", "date must be YYYY-MM-DD")
597		}
598		return date, nil
599	}
600	
601	// validateTemp requires a temperature and rejects physically implausible ones.
602	func validateTemp(tempC *float64) *httpx.AppError {
603		if tempC == nil {
604			return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_TEMP", "temp_c is required")
605		}
606		if *tempC < minPlausibleTempC || *tempC > maxPlausibleTempC {
607			return httpx.BadRequest("IMPLAUSIBLE_TEMP",
608				fmt.Sprintf("temp_c must be between %.0f and %.0f °C", minPlausibleTempC, maxPlausibleTempC))
609		}
610		return nil
611	}
612	
613	// isConsignmentStatus reports whether s is a known consignment status.
614	func isConsignmentStatus(s string) bool {
615		switch s {
616		case domain.ConsignmentStatusOpen, domain.ConsignmentStatusDispatch,
617			domain.ConsignmentStatusPickedUp, domain.ConsignmentStatusDelivered,
618			domain.ConsignmentStatusAccepted, domain.ConsignmentStatusRejected:
619			return true
620		}
621		return false
622	}
623	
624	// findStop returns the index of the stop carrying consignmentID, or -1.
625	func findStop(trip *domain.RouteTrip, consignmentID string) int {
626		for i := range trip.Stops {
627			if trip.Stops[i].ConsignmentID == consignmentID {
628				return i
629			}
630		}
631		return -1
632	}
633	
634	// requireTripRider enforces that only the trip's assigned van rider acts on it.
635	func requireTripRider(trip *domain.RouteTrip, riderPartyID string) *httpx.AppError {
636		if trip.VanRiderPartyID != riderPartyID {
637			return httpx.Forbidden("this trip is assigned to another van rider")
638		}
639		return nil
640	}
641	
642	// validateStopConsignment guards trip planning: the stop's consignment must
643	// be DISPATCHED (state machine) and must belong to the stop's DCS.
644	func validateStopConsignment(consignment *domain.DCSConsignment, stopDCSID string) *httpx.AppError {
645		if consignment.Status != domain.ConsignmentStatusDispatch {
646			return httpx.Conflict("CONSIGNMENT_NOT_DISPATCHED",
647				"consignment "+consignment.ID+" is "+consignment.Status+"; only DISPATCHED consignments can be planned onto a trip")
648		}
649		if consignment.DCSID != stopDCSID {
650			return httpx.Unprocessable("CONSIGNMENT_DCS_MISMATCH",
651				"consignment "+consignment.ID+" belongs to DCS "+consignment.DCSID+", not the stop's DCS "+stopDCSID)
652		}
653		return nil
654	}
655	
656	// validatePickup guards the pickup transition: right rider, trip not yet
657	// delivered, stop exists, stop not already picked.
658	func validatePickup(trip *domain.RouteTrip, riderPartyID, consignmentID string) *httpx.AppError {
659		if err := requireTripRider(trip, riderPartyID); err != nil {
660			return err
661		}
662		if trip.Status == domain.TripStatusDelivered {
663			return httpx.Conflict("TRIP_ALREADY_DELIVERED", "trip is DELIVERED; no further pickups are possible")
664		}
665		i := findStop(trip, consignmentID)
666		if i < 0 {
667			return httpx.NotFound("stop for consignment " + consignmentID)
668		}
669		if trip.Stops[i].PickedUpAt != nil {
670			return httpx.Conflict("STOP_ALREADY_PICKED", "consignment "+consignmentID+" was already picked up on this trip")
671		}
672		return nil
673	}
674	
675	// validateColdChain guards cold-chain logging: right rider, trip still moving.
676	func validateColdChain(trip *domain.RouteTrip, riderPartyID string) *httpx.AppError {
677		if err := requireTripRider(trip, riderPartyID); err != nil {
678			return err
679		}
680		if trip.Status == domain.TripStatusDelivered {
681			return httpx.Conflict("TRIP_ALREADY_DELIVERED", "trip is DELIVERED; cold-chain logging is closed")
682		}
683		return nil
684	}
685	
686	// validateDeliver guards delivery: right rider, not already delivered, and
687	// every stop picked up (partial loads cannot be handed to a BMC).
688	func validateDeliver(trip *domain.RouteTrip, riderPartyID string) *httpx.AppError {
689		if err := requireTripRider(trip, riderPartyID); err != nil {
690			return err
691		}
692		if trip.Status == domain.TripStatusDelivered {
693			return httpx.Conflict("TRIP_ALREADY_DELIVERED", "trip is already DELIVERED")
694		}
695		var unpicked []string
696		for _, stop := range trip.Stops {
697			if stop.PickedUpAt == nil {
698				unpicked = append(unpicked, stop.ConsignmentID)
699			}
700		}
701		if len(unpicked) > 0 {
702			return httpx.Unprocessable("STOPS_NOT_PICKED", "every stop must be picked up before delivery").
703				WithDetails(map[string]any{"unpicked_consignment_ids": unpicked})
704		}
705		return nil
706	}
707
```

```text
343					phone = party.Phone

347				}
348			}
349		}

363			Params:      params,

365			QueuedAt:    time.Now().UTC(),
366		}}

373	// unionAncestor returns the MILK_UNION org unit at or above orgUnitID, walking
374	// the denormalised ancestor Path nearest-first via d.Orgs.Get. Returns nil
375	// when no union sits on the chain (e.g. a plant directly under the federation).
376	func (s *service) unionAncestor(ctx context.Context, orgUnitID string) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
377		org, err := s.deps.Orgs.Get(ctx, orgUnitID)
378		if err != nil {
379			return nil, err
380		}
381		if org.Type == domain.OrgTypeMilkUnion {
382			return org, nil
383		}
384		// Path holds ancestors root→down; walk nearest ancestor first.
385		for i := len(org.Path) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
386			ancestor, err := s.deps.Orgs.Get(ctx, org.Path[i])
387			if err != nil {
388				return nil, err
389			}
390			if ancestor.Type == domain.OrgTypeMilkUnion {
391				return ancestor, nil
392			}
393		}
394		return nil, nil
395	}
```

```text
24		traceDepth = 10
25		// scanVerifySpanCap bounds how many ledger events one consumer scan
26		// re-hashes; wider traced ranges are verified partially (most recent tail).
27		scanVerifySpanCap = 5000
28		// publicVerifySpanCap bounds the public /ledger/verify endpoint span.
29		publicVerifySpanCap = 10000
30		// downstreamEventCap keeps the official trace response bounded even for
31		// heavily referenced entities.
32		downstreamEventCap = 2000
33	)

35	// validEntityTypes is the closed set of traceable entity types (domain.Entity*).
36	var validEntityTypes = map[string]struct{}{
37		domain.EntityMilkPour:        {},
38		domain.EntityAnalyzerReading: {},
39		domain.EntityInvoice:         {},
40		domain.EntityConsignment:     {},

46		domain.EntityQCResult:        {},
47		domain.EntitySettlement:      {},
48		domain.EntityAnimal:          {},
49		domain.EntityParty:           {},
50	}
51	
52	// Service resolves consumer QR scans and official trace queries. All reads,
53	// no writes except the fire-and-forget scan counter — nothing here ever
54	// mutates provenance.
55	type Service struct {
56		log      *slog.Logger
57		repo     *repo
58		ledger   *provenance.Ledger
59		orgs     *orgscope.Resolver
60		qrSecret string
61	}
62	
63	// NewService wires the service from the shared dependency container.
64	func NewService(d *deps.Deps) *Service {
65		return &Service{
66			log:      d.Log,
67			repo:     newRepo(d.DB),
68			ledger:   d.Ledger,
69			orgs:     d.Orgs,
70			qrSecret: d.Cfg.QRSigningSecret,
71		}

74	// VerifyQRToken checks a stored signed token in the format QR issuance
75	// (plant module signQRToken) mints: "base64url(qr_code|product_lot_id|
76	// issued_unix)" + "." + hex(HMAC-SHA256(secret, decoded payload)). The HMAC
77	// is computed over the DECODED payload bytes — exactly what issuance signed.
78	// The comparison is constant-time so a forger learns nothing from response
79	// timing.
80	func VerifyQRToken(secret, token string) bool {
81		payloadB64, signature, found := strings.Cut(token, ".")
82		if !found || payloadB64 == "" || signature == "" {
83			return false // malformed: no payload/signature split
84		}
85		payload, err := base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString(payloadB64)
86		if err != nil || len(payload) == 0 {
87			return false // malformed: payload is not valid base64url
88		}
89		expected := auth.HMACHash(secret, string(payload))
90		return auth.ConstantTimeEqual(expected, signature)
91	}

93	// ScanQR resolves one consumer QR scan into the honest provenance view
94	// (§7.4): product + plant + lab certificate + the SET of contributing
95	// samitis — never per-farmer data — plus a live tamper-evidence check.
96	func (s *Service) ScanQR(ctx context.Context, qrCode string) (*QRScanResponse, error) {
97		qr, err := s.repo.qrByCode(ctx, qrCode)
98		if err != nil {
99			return nil, err
100		}
101	
102		// Integrity gate: the stored token must carry a valid HMAC. A mismatch
103		// means the QR record was tampered with or forged — surface it loudly.
104		if !VerifyQRToken(s.qrSecret, qr.SignedToken) {
105			s.log.Warn("QR signed-token integrity check failed — possible forgery",
106				slog.String("qr_code", qrCode), slog.String("qr_id", qr.ID))
107			return nil, httpx.Conflict("QR_INTEGRITY_FAILED",
108				"this QR code failed integrity verification and may be counterfeit")
109		}
110	
111		// Count the scan without ever blocking it: fire-and-forget increment.
112		go func(qrID string) {
113			bg, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
114			defer cancel()
115			if err := s.repo.incrementScanCount(bg, qrID); err != nil {
116				s.log.Warn("scan_count increment failed", slog.String("qr_id", qrID), slog.Any("err", err))
117			}
118		}(qr.ID)
119	
120		lot, err := s.repo.productLotByID(ctx, qr.ProductLotID)
121		if err != nil {
122			return nil, err
123		}
124		batch, err := s.repo.batchByID(ctx, lot.BatchID)
125		if err != nil {
126			return nil, err
127		}
128		plant, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, batch.PlantID)
129		if err != nil {
130			return nil, err
131		}
132	
133		// Walk the provenance graph upstream from the product lot to the pooling
134		// boundary: batch → BMC lots → consignments (§7.4).
135		events, err := s.ledger.Trace(ctx, domain.EntityProductLot, lot.ID, traceDepth)
136		if err != nil {
137			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
138		}
139	
140		sourcing, err := s.buildSourcing(ctx, events)
141		if err != nil {
142			return nil, err
143		}
144	
145		ledgerInfo, err := s.verifyTracedRange(ctx, events)
146		if err != nil {
147			return nil, err
148		}
149	
150		resp := &QRScanResponse{
151			Product: ProductInfo{
152				Name:       lot.ProductName,
153				SKU:        lot.SKU,
154				UnitSize:   lot.UnitSize,
155				MfgDate:    lot.MfgDate,
156				ExpiryDate: lot.ExpiryDate,
157			},
158			BatchNumber: batch.BatchNumber,
159			Plant:       PlantInfo{Name: plant.Name, District: plant.District},
160			Sourcing:    *sourcing,
161			Ledger:      *ledgerInfo,
162			ScanCount:   qr.ScanCount + 1, // reflect this scan; the $inc lands async
163		}
164	
165		// PLANT_LAB pass certificate — omitted (not an error) when absent.
166		qc, err := s.repo.latestPlantLabPass(ctx, batch.ID)
167		if err != nil {
168			return nil, err
169		}
170		if qc != nil {
171			resp.Quality = &QualityInfo{
172				CertificateNumber: qc.CertificateNumber,
173				Stage:             qc.Stage,
174				Tests:             qc.Tests,
175				RecordedAt:        qc.RecordedAt,
176			}
177		}
178	
179		// A recalled lot still resolves with 200 — consumers must SEE the recall
180		// notice, not hit a dead link.
181		if lot.Status == domain.ProductLotStatusRecalled {
182			resp.Recalled = true
183			notice := "This product lot has been RECALLED. Do not consume — return it to the point of purchase."
184			if lot.RecallReason != "" {
185				notice += " Reason: " + lot.RecallReason
186			}
187			resp.RecallNotice = notice
188		}
189		return resp, nil
190	}
191	
192	// buildSourcing derives the samiti-set view from traced consignment events:
193	// contributing DCS org ids from each event's org_unit_id/payload, collection
194	// dates from payloads, with the consignment documents as fallback when the
195	// events did not carry those fields.
196	func (s *Service) buildSourcing(ctx context.Context, events []provenance.Event) (*SourcingInfo, error) {
197		dcsIDs := map[string]struct{}{}
198		dates := map[string]struct{}{}
199		consignmentIDs := map[string]struct{}{}
200	
201		for _, ev := range events {
202			if ev.EntityType != domain.EntityConsignment {
203				continue
204			}
205			consignmentIDs[ev.EntityID] = struct{}{}
206			if ev.OrgUnitID != "" {
207				dcsIDs[ev.OrgUnitID] = struct{}{}
208			} else if v, ok := ev.Payload["dcs_id"].(string); ok && v != "" {
209				dcsIDs[v] = struct{}{}
210			}
211			if v, ok := ev.Payload["date"].(string); ok && v != "" {
212				dates[v] = struct{}{}
213			}
214		}
215	
216		// Fallback: if the events lacked DCS ids or dates, read the consignment
217		// docs themselves (still samiti-level — pour ids are never surfaced).
218		if len(consignmentIDs) > 0 && (len(dcsIDs) == 0 || len(dates) == 0) {
219			docs, err := s.repo.consignmentsByIDs(ctx, sortedKeys(consignmentIDs))
220			if err != nil {
221				return nil, err
222			}
223			for _, c := range docs {
224				if c.DCSID != "" {
225					dcsIDs[c.DCSID] = struct{}{}
226				}
227				if c.Date != "" {
228					dates[c.Date] = struct{}{}
229				}
230			}
231		}
232	
233		samitis := make([]SamitiInfo, 0, len(dcsIDs))
234		districts := map[string]struct{}{}
235		for _, id := range sortedKeys(dcsIDs) {
236			org, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, id)
237			if err != nil {
238				// A missing org unit must not break a consumer scan — log and skip.
239				s.log.Warn("QR scan: contributing DCS org not resolvable",
240					slog.String("dcs_org_id", id), slog.Any("err", err))
241				continue
242			}
243			samitis = append(samitis, SamitiInfo{Name: org.Name, Code: org.Code, District: org.District})
244			if org.District != "" {
245				districts[org.District] = struct{}{}
246			}
247		}
248		sort.Slice(samitis, func(i, j int) bool { return samitis[i].Name < samitis[j].Name })
249	
250		collectionDates := sortedKeys(dates)
251		return &SourcingInfo{
252			Message:         sourcingMessage(collectionDates, len(samitis), sortedKeys(districts)),
253			Samitis:         samitis,
254			CollectionDates: collectionDates,
255		}, nil
256	}
257	
258	// sourcingMessage renders the consumer-facing pooled-provenance sentence,
259	// e.g. "Made from milk collected on 2026-07-05 from 3 samitis in Lucknow".
260	func sourcingMessage(dates []string, samitiCount int, districts []string) string {
261		var b strings.Builder
262		b.WriteString("Made from milk collected")
263		if len(dates) > 0 {
264			b.WriteString(" on " + strings.Join(dates, ", "))
265		}
266		noun := "samitis"
267		if samitiCount == 1 {
268			noun = "samiti"
269		}
270		fmt.Fprintf(&b, " from %d %s", samitiCount, noun)
271		if len(districts) > 0 {
272			b.WriteString(" in " + strings.Join(districts, ", "))
273		}
274		return b.String()
275	}
276	
277	// verifyTracedRange re-hashes the ledger over the [min,max] seq window of the
278	// traced events (tamper-evidence baked into every scan). Windows wider than
279	// scanVerifySpanCap are verified partially — the most recent tail — and
280	// flagged as such.
281	func (s *Service) verifyTracedRange(ctx context.Context, events []provenance.Event) (*LedgerInfo, error) {
282		if len(events) == 0 {
283			return &LedgerInfo{Events: 0, Intact: true, VerifiedRange: [2]int64{0, 0}}, nil
284		}
285		minSeq, maxSeq := events[0].Seq, events[0].Seq
286		for _, ev := range events[1:] {
287			if ev.Seq < minSeq {
288				minSeq = ev.Seq
289			}
290			if ev.Seq > maxSeq {
291				maxSeq = ev.Seq
292			}
293		}
294		from, partial := minSeq, false
295		if maxSeq-minSeq+1 > scanVerifySpanCap {
296			from, partial = maxSeq-scanVerifySpanCap+1, true
297		}
298		intact, _, err := s.ledger.VerifyChain(ctx, from, maxSeq)
299		if err != nil {
300			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
301		}
302		return &LedgerInfo{
303			Events:        len(events),
304			Intact:        intact,
305			VerifiedRange: [2]int64{from, maxSeq},
306			Partial:       partial,
307		}, nil
308	}
309	
310	// VerifyLedger runs the public tamper-evidence check over [from,to]. Both
311	// bounds are optional: `to` defaults to the chain head, `from` to the start
312	// of the last publicVerifySpanCap events. Spans over the cap are rejected.
313	func (s *Service) VerifyLedger(ctx context.Context, fromRaw, toRaw string) (*LedgerVerifyResponse, error) {
314		latest, err := s.ledger.LatestSeq(ctx)
315		if err != nil {
316			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
317		}
318		if latest == 0 {
319			return &LedgerVerifyResponse{Intact: true, From: 0, To: 0}, nil // empty chain is trivially intact
320		}
321	
322		to := latest
323		if toRaw != "" {
324			n, err := strconv.ParseInt(toRaw, 10, 64)
325			if err != nil || n < 1 {
326				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_RANGE", "'to' must be a positive sequence number")
327			}
328			to = min(n, latest)
329		}
330		from := max(int64(1), to-publicVerifySpanCap+1)
331		if fromRaw != "" {
332			n, err := strconv.ParseInt(fromRaw, 10, 64)
333			if err != nil || n < 1 {
334				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_RANGE", "'from' must be a positive sequence number")
335			}
336			from = n
337		}
338		if from > to {
339			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_RANGE", "'from' must not exceed 'to'")
340		}
341		if to-from+1 > publicVerifySpanCap {
342			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("SPAN_TOO_WIDE",
343				fmt.Sprintf("verification span is capped at %d events per request", publicVerifySpanCap))
344		}
345	
346		intact, brokenAt, err := s.ledger.VerifyChain(ctx, from, to)
347		if err != nil {
348			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
349		}
350		resp := &LedgerVerifyResponse{Intact: intact, From: from, To: to}
351		if !intact {
352			resp.BrokenAtSeq = &brokenAt
353		}
354		return resp, nil
355	}
356	
357	// TraceGraph returns the full event graph around one entity: upstream via
358	// the recursive ref walk, downstream via reverse-ref lookup — the recall /
359	// root-cause tool (§8.3).
360	func (s *Service) TraceGraph(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string) (*TraceGraphResponse, error) {
361		if err := validateEntityType(entityType); err != nil {
362			return nil, err
363		}
364		upstream, err := s.ledger.Trace(ctx, entityType, entityID, traceDepth)
365		if err != nil {
366			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
367		}
368		downstream, err := s.ledger.DownstreamRefs(ctx, entityID)
369		if err != nil {
370			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
371		}
372		if len(downstream) > downstreamEventCap {
373			downstream = downstream[len(downstream)-downstreamEventCap:]
374		}
375		if len(upstream) == 0 && len(downstream) == 0 {
376			return nil, httpx.NotFound("provenance for entity")
377		}
378		if upstream == nil {
379			upstream = []provenance.Event{}
380		}
381		if downstream == nil {
382			downstream = []provenance.Event{}
383		}
384		return &TraceGraphResponse{Upstream: upstream, Downstream: downstream}, nil
385	}
386	
387	// Timeline returns one entity's own events in chain order, paginated.
388	// The second return value is the total event count before paging.
389	func (s *Service) Timeline(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, page httpx.Page) ([]provenance.Event, int, error) {
390		if err := validateEntityType(entityType); err != nil {
391			return nil, 0, err
392		}
393		events, err := s.ledger.EventsForEntity(ctx, entityType, entityID)
394		if err != nil {
395			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
396		}
397		if len(events) == 0 {
398			return nil, 0, httpx.NotFound("provenance for entity")
399		}
400		total := len(events)
401		start := min(page.Offset, int64(total))
402		end := min(start+page.Limit, int64(total))
403		return events[start:end], total, nil
404	}
405	
406	// validateEntityType rejects entity types outside the domain.Entity* catalog.
407	func validateEntityType(entityType string) error {
408		if _, ok := validEntityTypes[entityType]; !ok {
409			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_ENTITY_TYPE",
410				"unknown entity type "+entityType+" — use one of the provenance entity type constants")
411		}
412		return nil
413	}
414	
415	// sortedKeys returns a set's keys in deterministic (lexicographic) order.
416	func sortedKeys(set map[string]struct{}) []string {
417		out := make([]string, 0, len(set))
418		for k := range set {
419			out = append(out, k)
420		}
421		sort.Strings(out)
422		return out
423	}
```

```text
1	// Package provenance implements the append-only, hash-chained event ledger —
2	// the source of truth for milk traceability (blueprint §7). Every link in the
3	// pour→QR chain is an immutable Event whose SHA-256 hash covers the previous
4	// event's hash, so history cannot be quietly rewritten (tamper-evidence,
5	// FSSAI recall-grade audit).
6	//
7	// Corrections are NEW events referencing the superseded entity — nothing is
8	// ever updated or deleted in this collection.
9	package provenance
10	
11	import (
12		"context"
13		"crypto/sha256"
14		"encoding/hex"
15		"encoding/json"
16		"errors"
17		"fmt"
18		"strconv"
19		"strings"
20		"time"
21	
22		"github.com/google/uuid"
23		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
24		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
25		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo/options"
26	)
27	
28	const collection = "provenance_events"
29	
30	// Ref is a directed edge to another entity in the trace graph
31	// (e.g. a consignment event referencing the pours it aggregates).
32	type Ref struct {
33		EntityType string `bson:"entity_type" json:"entity_type"`
34		EntityID   string `bson:"entity_id"   json:"entity_id"`
35		Relation   string `bson:"relation"    json:"relation"` // aggregates | supersedes | tested | yields | labels ...
36	}
37	
38	// ActorRef records who caused the event.
39	type ActorRef struct {
40		PartyID  string `bson:"party_id"  json:"party_id"`
41		RoleCode string `bson:"role_code" json:"role_code"`
42	}
43	
44	// Event is one immutable link in the ledger.
45	type Event struct {
46		ID         string         `bson:"_id"         json:"id"`
47		Seq        int64          `bson:"seq"         json:"seq"`
48		Type       string         `bson:"type"        json:"type"`
49		EntityType string         `bson:"entity_type" json:"entity_type"`
50		EntityID   string         `bson:"entity_id"   json:"entity_id"`
51		Refs       []Ref          `bson:"refs,omitempty"    json:"refs,omitempty"`
52		Actor      ActorRef       `bson:"actor"       json:"actor"`
53		OrgUnitID  string         `bson:"org_unit_id,omitempty" json:"org_unit_id,omitempty"`
54		Payload    map[string]any `bson:"payload,omitempty"     json:"payload,omitempty"`
55		TS         time.Time      `bson:"ts"          json:"ts"`
56		PrevHash   string         `bson:"prev_hash"   json:"prev_hash"`
57		Hash       string         `bson:"hash"        json:"hash"`
58	}
59	
60	// AppendInput describes a new event to chain.
61	type AppendInput struct {
62		Type       string
63		EntityType string
64		EntityID   string
65		Refs       []Ref
66		Actor      ActorRef
67		OrgUnitID  string
68		Payload    map[string]any
69	}
70	
71	// Ledger appends to and reads the hash chain.
72	type Ledger struct {
73		coll *mongo.Collection
74	}
75	
76	// NewLedger binds the ledger to the database.
77	func NewLedger(db *mongo.Database) *Ledger {
78		return &Ledger{coll: db.Collection(collection)}
79	}
80	
81	// genesisHash anchors the chain before the first event.
82	const genesisHash = "GENESIS"
83	
84	// Append chains a new event. Concurrency-safe without transactions: it reads
85	// the current head, computes seq+hash optimistically, and relies on the
86	// unique index on `seq` — a duplicate-key collision means another writer won
87	// the slot, so we re-read and retry.
88	func (l *Ledger) Append(ctx context.Context, in AppendInput) (*Event, error) {
89		const maxRetries = 12
90		for attempt := 0; attempt < maxRetries; attempt++ {
91			seq, prevHash, err := l.head(ctx)
92			if err != nil {
93				return nil, err
94			}
95			ev := &Event{
96				ID:         uuid.NewString(),
97				Seq:        seq + 1,
98				Type:       in.Type,
99				EntityType: in.EntityType,
100				EntityID:   in.EntityID,
101				Refs:       in.Refs,
102				Actor:      in.Actor,
103				OrgUnitID:  in.OrgUnitID,
104				Payload:    in.Payload,
105				// Millisecond precision: BSON datetimes store ms, so the persisted
106				// TS must equal the hashed TS or re-verification would break.
107				TS:       time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Millisecond),
108				PrevHash: prevHash,
109			}
110			ev.Hash = computeHash(ev)
111	
112			if _, err := l.coll.InsertOne(ctx, ev); err != nil {
113				if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(err) {
114					continue // lost the seq race — retry against the new head
115				}
116				return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance append: %w", err)
117			}
118			return ev, nil
119		}
120		return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance append: gave up after %d seq collisions", 12)
121	}
122	
123	// head returns the latest (seq, hash), or (0, GENESIS) for an empty chain.
124	func (l *Ledger) head(ctx context.Context) (int64, string, error) {
125		var last Event
126		err := l.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{},
127			options.FindOne().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: -1}}),
128		).Decode(&last)
129		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
130			return 0, genesisHash, nil
131		}
132		if err != nil {
133			return 0, "", fmt.Errorf("provenance head: %w", err)
134		}
135		return last.Seq, last.Hash, nil
136	}
137	
138	// computeHash covers everything that matters: position, linkage, content.
139	// Payload is canonicalised via encoding/json (map keys are sorted) and the
140	// timestamp to millisecond precision (BSON datetime resolution), so the
141	// digest is deterministic across a MongoDB round trip.
142	func computeHash(ev *Event) string {
143		payloadJSON, _ := json.Marshal(ev.Payload)
144		refParts := make([]string, 0, len(ev.Refs))
145		for _, r := range ev.Refs {
146			refParts = append(refParts, r.EntityType+":"+r.EntityID+":"+r.Relation)
147		}
148		material := strings.Join([]string{
149			ev.PrevHash,
150			strconv.FormatInt(ev.Seq, 10),
151			ev.Type,
152			ev.EntityType,
153			ev.EntityID,
154			strings.Join(refParts, ","),
155			ev.Actor.PartyID,
156			ev.Actor.RoleCode,
157			ev.OrgUnitID,
158			string(payloadJSON),
159			ev.TS.UTC().Truncate(time.Millisecond).Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
160		}, "|")
161		sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(material))
162		return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
163	}
164	
165	// EventsForEntity returns an entity's own timeline in chain order.
166	func (l *Ledger) EventsForEntity(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string) ([]Event, error) {
167		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
168			bson.D{{Key: "entity_type", Value: entityType}, {Key: "entity_id", Value: entityID}},
169			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}),
170		)
171		if err != nil {
172			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance events for %s/%s: %w", entityType, entityID, err)
173		}
174		var out []Event
175		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
176			return nil, err
177		}
178		return out, nil
179	}
180	
181	// Trace walks the provenance graph UPSTREAM from an entity: its events, plus
182	// (recursively) the events of everything those events reference. This is how
183	// a consumer QR resolves back to the contributing samiti set, and how a failed
184	// aflatoxin test walks back to source DCSes (blueprint §8.3).
185	func (l *Ledger) Trace(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, maxDepth int) ([]Event, error) {
186		if maxDepth <= 0 {
187			maxDepth = 10
188		}
189		const hardEventCap = 2000
190	
191		type node struct{ etype, eid string }
192		visited := map[node]bool{}
193		frontier := []node{{entityType, entityID}}
194		var all []Event
195	
196		for depth := 0; depth < maxDepth && len(frontier) > 0; depth++ {
197			var next []node
198			for _, n := range frontier {
199				if visited[n] {
200					continue
201				}
202				visited[n] = true
203				evs, err := l.EventsForEntity(ctx, n.etype, n.eid)
204				if err != nil {
205					return nil, err
206				}
207				for _, ev := range evs {
208					all = append(all, ev)
209					if len(all) >= hardEventCap {
210						return all, nil
211					}
212					for _, ref := range ev.Refs {
213						nn := node{ref.EntityType, ref.EntityID}
214						if !visited[nn] {
215							next = append(next, nn)
216						}
217					}
218				}
219			}
220			frontier = next
221		}
222		return all, nil
223	}
224	
225	// DownstreamRefs finds events that reference the given entity — used to walk
226	// FORWARD (e.g. "which batches consumed this blocked BMC lot?").
227	func (l *Ledger) DownstreamRefs(ctx context.Context, entityID string) ([]Event, error) {
228		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
229			bson.D{{Key: "refs.entity_id", Value: entityID}},
230			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}),
231		)
232		if err != nil {
233			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance downstream of %s: %w", entityID, err)
234		}
235		var out []Event
236		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
237			return nil, err
238		}
239		return out, nil
240	}
241	
242	// VerifyChain re-derives every hash in [fromSeq, toSeq] and checks linkage.
243	// Returns (true, 0) when intact, or (false, seq) of the first broken link.
244	func (l *Ledger) VerifyChain(ctx context.Context, fromSeq, toSeq int64) (bool, int64, error) {
245		filter := bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$gte", Value: fromSeq}, {Key: "$lte", Value: toSeq}}}}
246		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}))
247		if err != nil {
248			return false, 0, fmt.Errorf("provenance verify: %w", err)
249		}
250		defer cur.Close(ctx)
251	
252		prevHash := ""
253		prevSeq := int64(0)
254		first := true
255		for cur.Next(ctx) {
256			var ev Event
257			if err := cur.Decode(&ev); err != nil {
258				return false, 0, err
259			}
260			if computeHash(&ev) != ev.Hash {
261				return false, ev.Seq, nil // content tampered
262			}
263			if !first {
264				if ev.Seq != prevSeq+1 || ev.PrevHash != prevHash {
265					return false, ev.Seq, nil // linkage broken
266				}
267			}
268			prevHash, prevSeq, first = ev.Hash, ev.Seq, false
269		}
270		return true, 0, cur.Err()
271	}
272	
273	// LatestSeq returns the current chain head sequence (0 = empty).
274	func (l *Ledger) LatestSeq(ctx context.Context) (int64, error) {
275		seq, _, err := l.head(ctx)
276		return seq, err
277	}
278
```

```text
321	// *domain.MVUCase payload (the notifications module reacts, §10).
322	func (s *service) DispatchMVUCase(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, caseID string) (*domain.MVUCase, error) {
323		mvuCase, err := s.repo.FindMVUCaseByID(ctx, caseID)
324		if err != nil {

328			return nil, err

331		var vetPartyID, driverPartyID string
332		switch actor.RoleCode {
333		case domain.RoleVeterinarian:
334			vetPartyID = actor.PartyID
335		case domain.RoleMVUDriver:
336			driverPartyID = actor.PartyID
337			// Any other role reaching here is break-glass SUPER_ADMIN: the case
338			// is dispatched without pinning an assignee.
339		}
340	
341		transitioned, err := s.repo.DispatchMVUCase(ctx, mvuCase.ID, vetPartyID, driverPartyID)
342		if err != nil {
343			return nil, err
344		}
345		if !transitioned {
346			return nil, httpx.Conflict("MVU_NOT_REQUESTED", "MVU case is not in REQUESTED state")
347		}
348	
349		updated, err := s.repo.FindMVUCaseByID(ctx, mvuCase.ID)
350		if err != nil {
351			return nil, err
352		}
353		s.d.Bus.Publish(eventbus.TopicMVUDispatched, updated)
354		return updated, nil
355	}

429	// IngestTelemetry is the dormant collar path (§9). The capability gate runs
430	// FIRST: while flags.FlagCollarTelemetry is off the endpoint refuses with
431	// FEATURE_DISABLED, proving the backdoor is provisioned but inert. When the
432	// scheme lands and the flag flips, frames are acknowledged with 202 — the
433	// storage pipeline ships with the scheme, not before.
434	func (s *service) IngestTelemetry(ctx context.Context, req TelemetryRequest) (*TelemetryAck, error) {
435		if !s.d.Flags.Enabled(ctx, flags.FlagCollarTelemetry) {
436			aerr := httpx.Forbidden("collar telemetry is provisioned but dormant (§9)")
437			aerr.Code = "FEATURE_DISABLED"

441			return nil, err
442		}
443		return &TelemetryAck{
444			Accepted:     true,
```

```text
1	// Package httpapi assembles the HTTP surface: global middleware, operational
2	// endpoints (health/readiness/metrics/version), and the /api/v1 tree where
3	// every domain module mounts its routes.
4	package httpapi
5	
6	import (
7		"context"
8		"net/http"
9		"time"
10	
11		"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
12		chimw "github.com/go-chi/chi/v5/middleware"
13		"github.com/prometheus/client_golang/prometheus/promhttp"
14	
15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
16		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
17		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/middleware"
18	)
19	
20	// Version is stamped via -ldflags at release build time.
21	var Version = "0.1.0-dev"
22	
23	// New builds the fully wired HTTP handler.
24	func New(d *deps.Deps) http.Handler {
25		r := chi.NewRouter()
26	
27		// Order matters: recover innermost-last so panics in anything above are caught.
28		r.Use(chimw.RequestID)
29		r.Use(chimw.RealIP)
30		r.Use(middleware.Metrics)
31		r.Use(middleware.PerIPRateLimit(d.Cfg.RateLimitRPS, d.Cfg.RateLimitBurst))
32		r.Use(chimw.Recoverer)
33		r.Use(chimw.Timeout(30 * time.Second))
34	
35		// Operational endpoints — outside /api/v1, never authenticated.
36		r.Get("/healthz", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
37			httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{"status": "ok"})
38		})
39		r.Get("/readyz", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
40			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 2*time.Second)
41			defer cancel()
42			if err := d.DB.Client().Ping(ctx, nil); err != nil {
43				httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Internal(err))
44				return
45			}
46			httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{"status": "ready"})
47		})
48		r.Handle("/metrics", promhttp.Handler())
49		r.Get("/version", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
50			httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{"version": Version, "service": "saathi-backend"})
51		})
52	
53		r.Route("/api/v1", func(api chi.Router) {
54			api.Use(middleware.AuditMutations(d.Audit))
55			RegisterModules(api, d)
56		})
57	
58		return r
59	}
60
```

```text
1	package middleware
2	
3	import (
4		"net/http"
5	
6		chimw "github.com/go-chi/chi/v5/middleware"
7	
8		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/audit"
9	)
10	
11	// AuditMutations records every state-changing request (non-GET/HEAD/OPTIONS)
12	// into the immutable audit trail: actor, action, status, IP, request ID.
13	// Runs after the handler so the final status code is captured; the write
14	// itself is async and adds no request latency.
15	func AuditMutations(rec *audit.Recorder) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
16		return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
17			return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
18				if r.Method == http.MethodGet || r.Method == http.MethodHead || r.Method == http.MethodOptions {
19					next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
20					return
21				}
22				ww := chimw.NewWrapResponseWriter(w, r.ProtoMajor)
23				next.ServeHTTP(ww, r)
24	
25				rec.Record(r.Context(), audit.Entry{
26					Action:    "http." + r.Method + " " + r.URL.Path,
27					Status:    ww.Status(),
28					IP:        r.RemoteAddr,
29					RequestID: chimw.GetReqID(r.Context()),
30				})
31			})
32		}
33	}
34
```

```text
1	// Package httpx is the HTTP toolkit shared by every module: typed errors,
2	// uniform JSON envelopes, strict request decoding, pagination.
3	package httpx
4	
5	import (
6		"fmt"
7		"net/http"
8	)
9	
10	// AppError is the single error type handlers return. It carries the HTTP
11	// status plus a stable machine-readable code the frontend can switch on.
12	type AppError struct {
13		Status  int    `json:"-"`
14		Code    string `json:"code"`
15		Message string `json:"message"`
16		Details any    `json:"details,omitempty"`
17	
18		cause error // wrapped internal error — logged server-side, never serialised
19	}
20	
21	func (e *AppError) Error() string {
22		return fmt.Sprintf("%d %s: %s", e.Status, e.Code, e.Message)
23	}
24	
25	// WithDetails returns a copy carrying extra structured context.
26	func (e *AppError) WithDetails(d any) *AppError {
27		cp := *e
28		cp.Details = d
29		return &cp
30	}
31	
32	func newErr(status int, code, msg string) *AppError {
33		return &AppError{Status: status, Code: code, Message: msg}
34	}
35	
36	// Constructors — use these instead of raw errors in handlers/services.
37	
38	func BadRequest(code, msg string) *AppError { return newErr(http.StatusBadRequest, code, msg) }
39	
40	func Unauthorized(msg string) *AppError { return newErr(http.StatusUnauthorized, "UNAUTHORIZED", msg) }
41	
42	func Forbidden(msg string) *AppError { return newErr(http.StatusForbidden, "FORBIDDEN", msg) }
43	
44	func NotFound(resource string) *AppError {
45		return newErr(http.StatusNotFound, "NOT_FOUND", resource+" not found")
46	}
47	
48	func Conflict(code, msg string) *AppError { return newErr(http.StatusConflict, code, msg) }
49	
50	func Unprocessable(code, msg string) *AppError {
51		return newErr(http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, code, msg)
52	}
53	
54	func TooManyRequests(msg string) *AppError {
55		return newErr(http.StatusTooManyRequests, "RATE_LIMITED", msg)
56	}
57	
58	// Internal wraps an unexpected error. The cause is logged server-side but
59	// never leaked to the client.
60	func Internal(err error) *AppError {
61		e := newErr(http.StatusInternalServerError, "INTERNAL", "internal server error")
62		e.cause = err
63		return e
64	}
65	
66	func (e *AppError) Unwrap() error { return e.cause }
67
```

```text
12	// handler is the HTTP edge of the collection module: decode, call service,
13	// respond. No business logic, no MongoDB.
14	type handler struct {
15		svc *service
16	}
17	
18	// requestActor returns the authenticated actor (guaranteed present by the
19	// Authenticate middleware on every route of this module).
20	func requestActor(r *http.Request) auth.Actor {
21		actor, _ := auth.ActorFrom(r.Context())
22		return actor
23	}
24	
25	// createRateChart handles POST /collection/rate-charts.
26	func (h *handler) createRateChart(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
27		var req CreateRateChartRequest
28		if err := httpx.DecodeJSON(r, &req); err != nil {
29			httpx.Error(w, r, err)
30			return
31		}
32		chart, err := h.svc.CreateRateChart(r.Context(), requestActor(r), req)
33		if err != nil {
34			httpx.Error(w, r, err)
35			return
36		}
37		httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusCreated, chart)
38	}
39	
40	// getActiveRateChart handles GET /collection/rate-charts/active?dcs_id=.
41	func (h *handler) getActiveRateChart(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
42		dcsID := r.URL.Query().Get("dcs_id")
43		if dcsID == "" {
44			httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "dcs_id query parameter is required"))
45			return
46		}
47		chart, err := h.svc.ResolveActiveChart(r.Context(), dcsID)
48		if err != nil {
49			httpx.Error(w, r, err)
50			return
51		}
52		httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, chart)
53	}
54	
55	// createReading handles POST /collection/readings.
56	func (h *handler) createReading(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
57		var req CreateReadingRequest
58		if err := httpx.DecodeJSON(r, &req); err != nil {
59			httpx.Error(w, r, err)
60			return
61		}
62		reading, err := h.svc.CreateReading(r.Context(), requestActor(r), req)
63		if err != nil {

73		readings, err := h.svc.ListReadings(r.Context(), requestActor(r),

75		if err != nil {
```

```text
1	// Package collection implements the core procurement loop of Saathi
2	// (blueprint §8.1, §8.2): org-scoped rate charts, anti-tamper analyzer
3	// readings, offline-first idempotent milk pours with same-day pricing, and
4	// per-farmer daily invoices behind the same-day payment promise.
5	//
6	// Bus topics published by this module:
7	//   - eventbus.TopicPourRecorded  — payload domain.MilkPour (the newly recorded pour)
8	//   - eventbus.TopicInvoiceIssued — payload domain.Invoice (the newly issued invoice)
9	package collection
10	
11	import (
12		"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
13	
14		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
16		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/middleware"
17	)
18	
19	// Register mounts the collection module under /collection and wires the
20	// handler → service → repo stack onto the shared platform dependencies.
21	func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
22		repo := newRepo(d)
23		svc := newService(d, repo)
24		h := &handler{svc: svc}
25	
26		r.Route("/collection", func(r chi.Router) {
27			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
28	
29			// Rate charts: pricing policy is set at union/federation level and
30			// resolved downward to each DCS (nearest ancestor wins).
31			r.Route("/rate-charts", func(r chi.Router) {
32				r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RolePCDFAdmin, domain.RoleUnionPresident)).
33					Post("/", h.createRateChart)
34				r.With(middleware.RequireSession).Get("/active", h.getActiveRateChart)
35			})
36	
37			// Analyzer readings: flagged, never rejected (anti-tamper envelope §8.2).
38			r.Route("/readings", func(r chi.Router) {
39				r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSamitiSacheev, domain.RoleMilkTester)).
40					Post("/", h.createReading)
41				r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(
42					domain.RoleSamitiSacheev, domain.RoleMilkTester, domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor,
43				)).Get("/", h.listReadings)
44			})
45	
46			// Pours: THE core loop — offline-first idempotent, hard plausibility gate.
47			r.Route("/pours", func(r chi.Router) {
48				r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
49					r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSamitiSacheev, domain.RoleMilkTester))
50					r.Post("/", h.createPour)
51					r.Post("/batch-sync", h.batchSyncPours)
52					r.Post("/{id}/supersede", h.supersedePour)
53				})
54				r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(
55					domain.RoleSamitiSacheev, domain.RoleMilkTester,
56					domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor, domain.RoleFarmer,
57				)).Get("/", h.listPours)
58			})
59	
60			// Invoices: the same-day settlement artefact (§8.1).
61			r.Route("/invoices", func(r chi.Router) {
62				r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSamitiSacheev)).
63					Post("/generate", h.generateInvoices)
64				r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
65					r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(
66						domain.RoleFarmer, domain.RoleSamitiSacheev, domain.RoleSamitiAdhyaksh,
67						domain.RoleMilkTester, domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor,
68						domain.RoleUnionPresident, domain.RolePCDFAdmin,
69					))
70					r.Get("/", h.listInvoices)
71					r.Get("/{id}", h.getInvoice)
72				})
73			})
74		})
75	}
```

```text
1	package orgs
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"strings"
6		"time"
7	
8		"github.com/google/uuid"
9		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
10		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
11	
12		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
13		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
14		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/orgscope"
16	)
17	
18	// maxTreeNodes caps a subtree response (root included) so a federation-level
19	// tree read can never return an unbounded list.
20	const maxTreeNodes = 500
21	
22	// service holds all business logic of the orgs module.
23	type service struct {
24		repo  *repository
25		scope *orgscope.Resolver
26	}
27	
28	func newService(repo *repository, scope *orgscope.Resolver) *service {
29		return &service{repo: repo, scope: scope}
30	}
31	
32	// validateHierarchy checks whether an org unit of childType may be created
33	// under a parent of parentType ("" = no parent), per domain.ValidOrgParent.
34	// Pure function — unit-tested against the full type matrix.
35	func validateHierarchy(childType, parentType string) *httpx.AppError {
36		if !domain.IsValidOrgType(childType) {
37			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_ORG_TYPE", "unknown org type "+childType)
38		}
39		allowed := domain.ValidOrgParent[childType]
40		if len(allowed) == 0 { // hierarchy root
41			if parentType != "" {
42				return httpx.Unprocessable("ORG_PARENT_TYPE_INVALID",
43					childType+" is the hierarchy root and cannot have a parent")
44			}
45			return nil
46		}
47		if parentType == "" {
48			return httpx.BadRequest("ORG_PARENT_REQUIRED", childType+" requires a parent_id")
49		}
50		for _, t := range allowed {
51			if t == parentType {
52				return nil
53			}
54		}
55		return httpx.Unprocessable("ORG_PARENT_TYPE_INVALID",
56			childType+" cannot be created under a "+parentType)
57	}
58	
59	// Create validates the hierarchy edge and inserts a new org unit
60	// (POST /orgs, blueprint §5.1).
61	func (s *service) Create(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateOrgRequest) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
62		name := strings.TrimSpace(req.Name)
63		if name == "" {
64			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_NAME", "name is required")
65		}
66		code := strings.TrimSpace(req.Code)
67		if code == "" {
68			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_CODE", "code is required")
69		}
70	
71		// Resolve the parent (if any) and validate the hierarchy edge.
72		var parent *domain.OrgUnit
73		if req.ParentID != "" {
74			var err error
75			parent, err = s.repo.getOrg(ctx, req.ParentID)
76			if err != nil {
77				return nil, err
78			}
79		}
80		parentType := ""
81		if parent != nil {
82			parentType = parent.Type
83		}
84		if aerr := validateHierarchy(req.Type, parentType); aerr != nil {
85			return nil, aerr
86		}
87	
88		// The federation is the unique root: reject a second one.
89		if req.Type == domain.OrgTypeFederation {
90			n, err := s.repo.countByType(ctx, domain.OrgTypeFederation)
91			if err != nil {
92				return nil, err
93			}
94			if n > 0 {
95				return nil, httpx.Conflict("FEDERATION_EXISTS", "a federation root org unit already exists")
96			}
97		}
98	
99		// The new unit must be created inside the caller's scope.
100		if parent != nil {
101			if err := s.scope.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, parent.ID); err != nil {
102				return nil, err
103			}
104		}
105	
106		now := time.Now().UTC()
107		org := &domain.OrgUnit{
108			ID:        uuid.NewString(),
109			Type:      req.Type,
110			Name:      name,
111			Code:      code,
112			District:  strings.TrimSpace(req.District),
113			State:     strings.TrimSpace(req.State),
114			Path:      []string{},
115			Active:    true,
116			CreatedAt: now,
117			UpdatedAt: now,
118		}
119		if parent != nil {
120			org.ParentID = parent.ID
121			org.Path = append(append([]string{}, parent.Path...), parent.ID)
122		}
123		if req.GeoLat != nil {
124			org.GeoLat = *req.GeoLat
125		}
126		if req.GeoLng != nil {
127			org.GeoLng = *req.GeoLng
128		}
129	
130		if err := s.repo.insertOrg(ctx, org); err != nil {
131			if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(err) {
132				return nil, httpx.Conflict("ORG_CODE_EXISTS", "an org unit with code "+code+" already exists")
133			}
134			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
135		}
136		s.scope.Invalidate(org.ID)
137		return org, nil
138	}
139	
140	// Update patches name/district/active/geo on an org unit (PATCH /orgs/{id}).
141	// Type or parent moves are rejected — restructuring the tree is out of scope
142	// for v1 because Path denormalisation across a subtree is not transactional.
143	func (s *service) Update(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id string, req UpdateOrgRequest) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
144		if req.Type != nil || req.ParentID != nil {
145			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("ORG_MOVE_UNSUPPORTED",
146				"changing an org unit's type or parent is not supported in v1")
147		}
148		if err := s.scope.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, id); err != nil {
149			return nil, err
150		}
151	
152		set := bson.D{{Key: "updated_at", Value: time.Now().UTC()}}
153		if req.Name != nil {
154			name := strings.TrimSpace(*req.Name)
155			if name == "" {
156				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_NAME", "name cannot be empty")
157			}
158			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "name", Value: name})
159		}
160		if req.District != nil {
161			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "district", Value: strings.TrimSpace(*req.District)})
162		}
163		if req.Active != nil {
164			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "active", Value: *req.Active})
165		}
166		if req.GeoLat != nil {
167			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "geo_lat", Value: *req.GeoLat})
168		}
169		if req.GeoLng != nil {
170			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "geo_lng", Value: *req.GeoLng})
171		}
172		if len(set) == 1 { // only updated_at
173			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("EMPTY_UPDATE", "no updatable fields provided")
174		}
175	
176		org, err := s.repo.updateOrg(ctx, id, set)
177		if err != nil {
178			return nil, err
179		}
180		s.scope.Invalidate(id)
181		return org, nil
182	}
183	
184	// Get returns one org unit (GET /orgs/{id}).
185	func (s *service) Get(ctx context.Context, id string) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
186		return s.repo.getOrg(ctx, id)
187	}
188	
189	// Children pages the direct children of an org unit (GET /orgs/{id}/children).
190	func (s *service) Children(ctx context.Context, id string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.OrgUnit, error) {
191		if _, err := s.repo.getOrg(ctx, id); err != nil {
192			return nil, err
193		}
194		return s.repo.listChildren(ctx, id, page)
195	}
196	
197	// Tree returns the root plus its whole subtree as a flat list (each node
198	// carries parent_id; the client assembles), capped at maxTreeNodes.
199	func (s *service) Tree(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id string) ([]domain.OrgUnit, bool, error) {
200		root, err := s.repo.getOrg(ctx, id)
201		if err != nil {
202			return nil, false, err
203		}
204		if err := s.scope.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, id); err != nil {
205			return nil, false, err
206		}
207		descendants, err := s.repo.listDescendants(ctx, id, maxTreeNodes-1)
208		if err != nil {
209			return nil, false, err
210		}
211		nodes := append([]domain.OrgUnit{*root}, descendants...)
212		truncated := len(descendants) == maxTreeNodes-1
213		return nodes, truncated, nil
214	}
215	
216	// List pages org units filtered by type and/or district (GET /orgs).
217	func (s *service) List(ctx context.Context, orgType, district string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.OrgUnit, error) {
218		filter := bson.D{}
219		if orgType != "" {
220			if !domain.IsValidOrgType(orgType) {
221				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_ORG_TYPE", "unknown org type "+orgType)
222			}
223			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "type", Value: orgType})
224		}
225		if district != "" {
226			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "district", Value: district})
227		}
228		return s.repo.listOrgs(ctx, filter, page)
229	}
230	
231	// Members pages the ACTIVE role assignments at an org unit joined in memory
232	// with party identity fields (GET /orgs/{id}/members) — two indexed queries,
233	// no $lookup.
234	func (s *service) Members(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id string, page httpx.Page) ([]Member, error) {
235		if _, err := s.repo.getOrg(ctx, id); err != nil {
236			return nil, err
237		}
238		if err := s.scope.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, id); err != nil {
239			return nil, err
240		}
241	
242		assignments, err := s.repo.listActiveAssignments(ctx, id, page)
243		if err != nil {
244			return nil, err
245		}
246		partyIDs := make([]string, 0, len(assignments))
247		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(assignments))
248		for _, a := range assignments {
249			if _, dup := seen[a.PartyID]; !dup {
250				seen[a.PartyID] = struct{}{}
251				partyIDs = append(partyIDs, a.PartyID)
252			}
253		}
254		parties, err := s.repo.partiesByIDs(ctx, partyIDs)
255		if err != nil {
256			return nil, err
257		}
258	
259		members := make([]Member, 0, len(assignments))
260		for _, a := range assignments {
261			m := Member{
262				PartyID:          a.PartyID,
263				RoleCode:         a.RoleCode,
264				RoleAssignmentID: a.ID,
265				ValidFrom:        a.ValidFrom,
266				ValidTo:          a.ValidTo,
267			}
268			if p, ok := parties[a.PartyID]; ok {
269				m.Phone = p.Phone
270				m.FullName = p.FullName
271				m.KYCTier = p.KYCTier
272			}
273			members = append(members, m)
274		}
275		return members, nil
276	}
277
```

```text
1	package orgs
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"errors"
6	
7		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
```
