```text
11		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
12		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
13		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/mongodb"
14	)
15	
16	// repository is the module's only MongoDB access point. It reads the
17	// role_assignments and parties collections (allowed by spec for the members
18	// roster) but writes only org_units.
19	type repository struct {
20		orgs        *mongo.Collection
21		assignments *mongo.Collection
22		parties     *mongo.Collection
23	}
24	
25	func newRepository(db *mongo.Database) *repository {
26		return &repository{
27			orgs:        db.Collection(mongodb.CollOrgUnits),
28			assignments: db.Collection(mongodb.CollRoleAssignments),
29			parties:     db.Collection(mongodb.CollParties),
30		}
31	}
32	
33	// insertOrg inserts a new org unit. The raw driver error is returned so the
34	// service can map a duplicate-key violation on code to a Conflict.
35	func (r *repository) insertOrg(ctx context.Context, org *domain.OrgUnit) error {
36		_, err := r.orgs.InsertOne(ctx, org)
37		return err
38	}
39	
40	// getOrg fetches one org unit by ID.
41	func (r *repository) getOrg(ctx context.Context, id string) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
42		var org domain.OrgUnit
43		err := r.orgs.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&org)
44		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
45			return nil, httpx.NotFound("org unit " + id)
46		}
47		if err != nil {
48			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
49		}
50		return &org, nil
51	}
52	
53	// countByType counts org units of the given type (federation-uniqueness check).
54	func (r *repository) countByType(ctx context.Context, orgType string) (int64, error) {
55		n, err := r.orgs.CountDocuments(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "type", Value: orgType}})
56		if err != nil {
57			return 0, httpx.Internal(err)
58		}
59		return n, nil
60	}
61	
62	// updateOrg applies a $set patch and returns the updated document.
63	func (r *repository) updateOrg(ctx context.Context, id string, set bson.D) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
64		var org domain.OrgUnit
65		err := r.orgs.FindOneAndUpdate(ctx,
66			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}},
67			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: set}},
68			options.FindOneAndUpdate().SetReturnDocument(options.After),
69		).Decode(&org)
70		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
71			return nil, httpx.NotFound("org unit " + id)
72		}
73		if err != nil {
74			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
75		}
76		return &org, nil
77	}
78	
79	// listChildren pages the direct children of an org unit (parent_id index).
80	func (r *repository) listChildren(ctx context.Context, parentID string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.OrgUnit, error) {
81		return r.findOrgs(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "parent_id", Value: parentID}},
82			options.Find().
83				SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "code", Value: 1}}).
84				SetSkip(page.Offset).
85				SetLimit(page.Limit))
86	}
87	
88	// listOrgs pages org units matching an arbitrary filter (type/district).
89	func (r *repository) listOrgs(ctx context.Context, filter bson.D, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.OrgUnit, error) {
90		return r.findOrgs(ctx, filter,
91			options.Find().
92				SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "code", Value: 1}}).
93				SetSkip(page.Offset).
94				SetLimit(page.Limit))
95	}
96	
97	// listDescendants returns every org unit whose ancestor Path contains rootID
98	// (path index, array containment), capped at limit nodes.
99	func (r *repository) listDescendants(ctx context.Context, rootID string, limit int64) ([]domain.OrgUnit, error) {
100		return r.findOrgs(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "path", Value: rootID}},
101			options.Find().
102				SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "code", Value: 1}}).
103				SetLimit(limit))
104	}
105	
106	func (r *repository) findOrgs(ctx context.Context, filter bson.D, opts *options.FindOptions) ([]domain.OrgUnit, error) {
107		cur, err := r.orgs.Find(ctx, filter, opts)
108		if err != nil {
109			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
110		}
111		units := []domain.OrgUnit{}
112		if err := cur.All(ctx, &units); err != nil {
113			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
114		}
115		return units, nil
116	}
117	
118	// listActiveAssignments pages the ACTIVE role assignments at one org unit
119	// (org_unit_id + role_code + status index).
120	func (r *repository) listActiveAssignments(ctx context.Context, orgID string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.RoleAssignment, error) {
121		cur, err := r.assignments.Find(ctx,
122			bson.D{
123				{Key: "org_unit_id", Value: orgID},
124				{Key: "status", Value: domain.RoleAssignmentActive},
125			},
126			options.Find().
127				SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "role_code", Value: 1}, {Key: "created_at", Value: 1}}).
128				SetSkip(page.Offset).
129				SetLimit(page.Limit))
130		if err != nil {
131			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
132		}
133		assignments := []domain.RoleAssignment{}
134		if err := cur.All(ctx, &assignments); err != nil {
135			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
136		}
137		return assignments, nil
138	}
139	
140	// partiesByIDs fetches the given parties keyed by ID for the in-memory join.
141	func (r *repository) partiesByIDs(ctx context.Context, ids []string) (map[string]domain.Party, error) {
142		byID := make(map[string]domain.Party, len(ids))
143		if len(ids) == 0 {
144			return byID, nil
145		}
146		cur, err := r.parties.Find(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: ids}}}})
147		if err != nil {
148			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
149		}
150		var parties []domain.Party
151		if err := cur.All(ctx, &parties); err != nil {
152			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
153		}
154		for _, p := range parties {
155			byID[p.ID] = p
156		}
157		return byID, nil
158	}
```

```text
19	// repository is all MongoDB access for the platformops module. It owns the
20	// notifications outbox, reads audit_logs strictly read-only (writes go
21	// through deps.Audit only — the collection is insert-only by design, §12),
22	// and reads parties / role_assignments for the support lookup and for
23	// addressing safety alerts. bmc_lots / processing_batches are read solely to
24	// resolve a gate-blocked subject back to its org unit.
25	type repository struct {
26		auditLogs     *mongo.Collection
27		notifications *mongo.Collection
28		parties       *mongo.Collection
29		assignments   *mongo.Collection
30		bmcLots       *mongo.Collection
31		batches       *mongo.Collection
32	}
33	
34	// newRepository binds the repository to its collections.
35	func newRepository(db *mongo.Database) *repository {
36		return &repository{
37			auditLogs:     db.Collection(mongodb.CollAuditLogs),
38			notifications: db.Collection(mongodb.CollNotifications),
39			parties:       db.Collection(mongodb.CollParties),
40			assignments:   db.Collection(mongodb.CollRoleAssignments),
41			bmcLots:       db.Collection(mongodb.CollBMCLots),
42			batches:       db.Collection(mongodb.CollBatches),
43		}
44	}
45	
46	// auditFilter builds the bson filter shared by the list and export reads.
47	func auditFilter(f auditLogFilter) bson.D {
48		filter := bson.D{}
49		if f.ActorPartyID != "" {
50			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "actor_party_id", Value: f.ActorPartyID})
51		}
52		if f.TargetType != "" {
53			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "target_type", Value: f.TargetType})
54		}
55		if f.Action != "" {
56			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "action", Value: f.Action})
57		}
58		if f.From != nil || f.To != nil {
59			tsRange := bson.D{}
60			if f.From != nil {
61				tsRange = append(tsRange, bson.E{Key: "$gte", Value: *f.From})
62			}
63			if f.To != nil {
64				tsRange = append(tsRange, bson.E{Key: "$lte", Value: *f.To})
65			}
66			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "ts", Value: tsRange})
67		}
68		return filter
69	}
70	
71	// listAuditLogs returns a page of audit entries, newest first, plus the total
72	// matching count for pagination meta.
73	func (r *repository) listAuditLogs(ctx context.Context, f auditLogFilter, page httpx.Page) ([]audit.Entry, int64, error) {
74		filter := auditFilter(f)
75	
76		total, err := r.auditLogs.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
77		if err != nil {
78			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("count audit logs: %w", err))
79		}
80	
81		cur, err := r.auditLogs.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
82			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "ts", Value: -1}}).
83			SetSkip(page.Offset).
84			SetLimit(page.Limit),
85		)
86		if err != nil {
87			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("list audit logs: %w", err))
88		}
89		entries := []audit.Entry{}
90		if err := cur.All(ctx, &entries); err != nil {
91			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("decode audit logs: %w", err))
92		}
93		return entries, total, nil
94	}

96	// exportAuditLogs returns up to maxRows entries in the window, newest first —
97	// the bounded read behind the immutable audit export (§12).
98	func (r *repository) exportAuditLogs(ctx context.Context, f auditLogFilter, maxRows int64) ([]audit.Entry, error) {
99		cur, err := r.auditLogs.Find(ctx, auditFilter(f), options.Find().
100			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "ts", Value: -1}}).
101			SetLimit(maxRows),
102		)
103		if err != nil {
104			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("export audit logs: %w", err))
105		}

113	// insertNotification queues one outbox document.
114	func (r *repository) insertNotification(ctx context.Context, n *StoredNotification) error {
115		if _, err := r.notifications.InsertOne(ctx, n); err != nil {
116			return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("insert notification: %w", err))
117		}

121	// listNotifications returns a page of outbox documents, newest first,
122	// optionally filtered by phone and status.
123	func (r *repository) listNotifications(ctx context.Context, phone, status string, page httpx.Page) ([]StoredNotification, int64, error) {
124		filter := bson.D{}
125		if phone != "" {
126			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "phone", Value: phone})
127		}
128		if status != "" {
129			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "status", Value: status})
130		}
131	
132		total, err := r.notifications.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
133		if err != nil {
134			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("count notifications: %w", err))
135		}
136	
137		cur, err := r.notifications.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
138			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "queued_at", Value: -1}}).
139			SetSkip(page.Offset).
140			SetLimit(page.Limit),
141		)
142		if err != nil {
143			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("list notifications: %w", err))
144		}
145		notifications := []StoredNotification{}
146		if err := cur.All(ctx, &notifications); err != nil {
147			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("decode notifications: %w", err))
148		}
149		return notifications, total, nil
150	}

152	// claimQueuedNotification atomically claims the oldest QUEUED document
153	// (QUEUED→SENT, sent_at, provider_ref) and returns it, or nil when the queue
154	// is drained. FindOneAndUpdate makes the claim race-safe across concurrent
155	// worker runs — never find-then-update.
156	func (r *repository) claimQueuedNotification(ctx context.Context, providerRef string, now time.Time) (*StoredNotification, error) {
157		var n StoredNotification
158		err := r.notifications.FindOneAndUpdate(ctx,
159			bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: domain.NotificationQueued}},
160			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
161				{Key: "status", Value: domain.NotificationSent},
162				{Key: "sent_at", Value: now},
163				{Key: "provider_ref", Value: providerRef},
164			}}},
165			options.FindOneAndUpdate().
166				SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "queued_at", Value: 1}}).
167				SetReturnDocument(options.After),
168		).Decode(&n)
169		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
170			return nil, nil
171		}
172		if err != nil {
173			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("claim queued notification: %w", err))
174		}
175		return &n, nil
176	}

258	// subjectOrgUnit resolves a gate-blocked QC subject to the org unit that
259	// holds it (BMC lot → bmc_id, processing batch → plant_id).
260	func (r *repository) subjectOrgUnit(ctx context.Context, subjectType, subjectID string) (string, error) {
261		var coll *mongo.Collection
262		var field string
263		switch subjectType {
264		case domain.QCSubjectBMCLot:
265			coll, field = r.bmcLots, "bmc_id"
266		case domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch:
267			coll, field = r.batches, "plant_id"
268		default:
269			return "", fmt.Errorf("gate-blocked subject type %q has no org resolution", subjectType)
270		}
271	
272		var doc bson.M
273		err := coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: subjectID}},
274			options.FindOne().SetProjection(bson.D{{Key: field, Value: 1}}),
275		).Decode(&doc)
276		if err != nil {
277			return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve org of %s %s: %w", subjectType, subjectID, err)
278		}
279		orgUnitID, _ := doc[field].(string)
280		if orgUnitID == "" {
281			return "", fmt.Errorf("%s %s carries no %s", subjectType, subjectID, field)
282		}
283		return orgUnitID, nil
284	}
```

```text
1	// Package platformops is the platform-operations module (blueprint §12): the
2	// SUPER_ADMIN feature-flag console, the STATE_AUDITOR read-only audit surface
3	// with its GIGW/DPDP immutable export, the notifications outbox with the mock
4	// SMS dispatch worker (real deployment: MSG91 / telecom DLT gateway, §13),
5	// and the SUPPORT_AGENT audited limited-PII lookup (§5.2 role 20).
6	//
7	// It also subscribes to cross-module bus topics — payout credited, safety
8	// gate blocked, MVU dispatched — and turns them into queued vernacular SMS.
9	package platformops
10	
11	import (
12		"context"
13		"log/slog"
14	
15		"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
16	
17		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
18		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
19		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/eventbus"
20		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/middleware"
21	)
22	
23	// Register wires the platformops module and mounts /admin, /audit,
24	// /notifications and /support (the router hands us the /api/v1 subtree).
25	func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
26		repo := newRepository(d.DB)
27		svc := newService(d, repo)
28		h := newHandler(svc)
29	
30		r.Route("/admin", func(r chi.Router) {
31			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
32	
33			// PCDF_ADMIN may LIST flags; flipping one is SUPER_ADMIN only —
34			// capability gating is a deliberate act (blueprint principle #6).
35			r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSuperAdmin, domain.RolePCDFAdmin)).
36				Get("/flags", h.listFlags)
37			r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSuperAdmin)).
38				Put("/flags/{key}", h.setFlag)
39		})
40	
41		r.Route("/audit", func(r chi.Router) {
42			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
43			r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleStateAuditor, domain.RoleSuperAdmin))
44	
45			// Read-only by design: there is deliberately NO write/delete API
46			// surface for audit logs (§12) — entries land via deps.Audit only.
47			r.Get("/logs", h.listAuditLogs)
48			r.Get("/logs/export", h.exportAuditLogs)
49		})
50	
51		r.Route("/notifications", func(r chi.Router) {
52			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
53	
54			r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSuperAdmin, domain.RoleSupportAgent)).
55				Get("/", h.listNotifications)
56			r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSuperAdmin)).
57				Post("/worker/run", h.runWorker)
58		})
59	
60		r.Route("/support", func(r chi.Router) {
61			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
62			r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSupportAgent, domain.RoleSuperAdmin))
63	
64			r.Get("/parties/lookup", h.lookupParty)
65		})
66	
67		// Cross-module reactions arrive over the bus (modules never import each
68		// other). The bus already runs each handler on its own goroutine with a
69		// bounded context and panic recovery; the wrapper below adds an explicit
70		// second belt at this module's boundary.
71		d.Bus.Subscribe(eventbus.TopicPayoutCredited, safeHandler(d, svc.onPayoutCredited))
72		d.Bus.Subscribe(eventbus.TopicGateBlocked, safeHandler(d, svc.onGateBlocked))
73		d.Bus.Subscribe(eventbus.TopicMVUDispatched, safeHandler(d, svc.onMVUDispatched))
74	}
75	
76	// safeHandler wraps a bus reaction so a programming error in notification
77	// fan-out can never disturb the publishing flow.
78	func safeHandler(d *deps.Deps, reaction func(ctx context.Context, payload any)) eventbus.Handler {
79		return func(ctx context.Context, topic string, payload any) {
80			defer func() {
81				if rec := recover(); rec != nil {
82					d.Log.Error("platformops bus handler panic",
83						slog.String("topic", topic), slog.Any("panic", rec))
84				}
85			}()
86			reaction(ctx, payload)
87		}
88	}
89
```

```text
5	// Actor is the authenticated caller extracted from a verified token and

8		PartyID          string
9		Phone            string

11		Kind             string // session | role

13		RoleCode         string
14		OrgUnitID        string

18	// HasRole reports whether the actor operates under one of the given roles.
19	func (a Actor) HasRole(roles ...string) bool {
20		for _, r := range roles {
21			if a.RoleCode == r {
22				return true
23			}
24		}
25		return false
26	}
27	
28	type actorCtxKey struct{}
29	
30	// WithActor stores the actor on the context.
31	func WithActor(ctx context.Context, a Actor) context.Context {
32		return context.WithValue(ctx, actorCtxKey{}, a)
33	}
34	
35	// ActorFrom retrieves the actor, if any.
36	func ActorFrom(ctx context.Context) (Actor, bool) {
37		a, ok := ctx.Value(actorCtxKey{}).(Actor)
38		return a, ok
39	}
```

```text
1	// Package middleware carries the cross-cutting HTTP concerns: token
2	// authentication, role enforcement, audit capture, per-IP rate limiting,
3	// Prometheus metrics.
4	package middleware
5	
6	import (
7		"net/http"
8		"strings"
9	
10		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
11		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
12	)
13	
14	// Authenticate verifies the Bearer token and installs the Actor on the
15	// request context. Requests without a valid token are rejected — public
16	// routes simply don't mount this middleware.
17	func Authenticate(jwtm *auth.JWTManager) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
18		return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
19			return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
20				header := r.Header.Get("Authorization")
21				token, ok := strings.CutPrefix(header, "Bearer ")
22				if !ok || token == "" {
23					httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Unauthorized("missing bearer token"))
24					return
25				}
26				claims, err := jwtm.Parse(token)
27				if err != nil {
28					httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Unauthorized("invalid or expired token"))
29					return
30				}
31				actor := auth.Actor{
32					PartyID:          claims.PartyID,
33					Phone:            claims.Phone,
34					KYCTier:          claims.KYCTier,
35					Kind:             claims.Kind,
36					RoleAssignmentID: claims.RoleAssignmentID,
37					RoleCode:         claims.RoleCode,
38					OrgUnitID:        claims.OrgUnitID,
39					OrgType:          claims.OrgType,
40				}
41				next.ServeHTTP(w, r.WithContext(auth.WithActor(r.Context(), actor)))
42			})
43		}
44	}
45
```

```text
1	// Package audit writes the immutable who-did-what trail required for
2	// government accountability and DPDP breach forensics (blueprint §12, §16).
3	// Entries are insert-only; the STATE_AUDITOR role reads them via the
4	// platformops module.
5	package audit
6	
7	import (
8		"context"
9		"log/slog"
10		"time"
11	
12		"github.com/google/uuid"
13		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
14	
15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
16	)
17	
18	const collection = "audit_logs"
19	
20	// Entry is one audit record.
21	type Entry struct {
22		ID           string         `bson:"_id"            json:"id"`
23		ActorPartyID string         `bson:"actor_party_id" json:"actor_party_id"`
24		ActorRole    string         `bson:"actor_role,omitempty" json:"actor_role,omitempty"`
25		Action       string         `bson:"action"         json:"action"` // e.g. "http.POST /api/v1/collection/pours" or "support.pii_lookup"
26		TargetType   string         `bson:"target_type,omitempty" json:"target_type,omitempty"`
27		TargetID     string         `bson:"target_id,omitempty"   json:"target_id,omitempty"`
28		Status       int            `bson:"status,omitempty"      json:"status,omitempty"`
29		IP           string         `bson:"ip,omitempty"          json:"ip,omitempty"`
30		RequestID    string         `bson:"request_id,omitempty"  json:"request_id,omitempty"`
31		Meta         map[string]any `bson:"meta,omitempty"        json:"meta,omitempty"`
32		TS           time.Time      `bson:"ts"             json:"ts"`
33	}
34	
35	// Recorder persists audit entries asynchronously so auditing never adds
36	// latency to the request path.
37	type Recorder struct {
38		coll *mongo.Collection
39		log  *slog.Logger
40	}
41	
42	// NewRecorder binds the recorder to the database.
43	func NewRecorder(db *mongo.Database, log *slog.Logger) *Recorder {
44		return &Recorder{coll: db.Collection(collection), log: log}
45	}
46	
47	// Record fills identity fields from the request context and persists the
48	// entry in the background (fire-and-forget with its own timeout).
49	func (r *Recorder) Record(ctx context.Context, e Entry) {
50		if a, ok := auth.ActorFrom(ctx); ok {
51			if e.ActorPartyID == "" {
52				e.ActorPartyID = a.PartyID
53			}
54			if e.ActorRole == "" {
55				e.ActorRole = a.RoleCode
56			}
57		}
58		e.ID = uuid.NewString()
59		e.TS = time.Now().UTC()
60	
61		go func() {
62			writeCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
63			defer cancel()
64			if _, err := r.coll.InsertOne(writeCtx, e); err != nil {
65				r.log.Error("audit write failed", slog.String("action", e.Action), slog.Any("err", err))
66			}
67		}()
68	}
69
```

```text
43	// projected down to the fields the consignment aggregate needs.

45		filter := bson.D{
46			{Key: "dcs_id", Value: dcsID},

48			{Key: "shift", Value: shift},

55			{Key: "snf_pct", Value: 1},
56		}

58			options.Find().SetProjection(projection).SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "created_at", Value: 1}}))
59		if err != nil {
60			return nil, err
61		}
62		var rows []pourRow
63		if err := cur.All(ctx, &rows); err != nil {
64			return nil, err
65		}

67	}

136		filter := bson.D{}

142		}

154			return nil, 0, err
155		}
```

```text
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# scripts/smoke.sh — end-to-end test of the ENTIRE Saathi loop over real HTTP.
#
# Self-contained: drops the scratch DB, builds + starts its own server on :8091
# against MONGO_DB=saathi_smoke, seeds, drives the full pour→QR→settlement loop
# plus the negative gates, and always kills the server on exit.
#
# Requires: bash, curl, python3, mongosh, go. No jq.
set -euo pipefail

export PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH"

REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
cd "$REPO_ROOT"

PORT=8091
HOST="http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}"
BASE="${HOST}/api/v1"
SMOKE_DB="saathi_smoke"
SERVER_PID=""
SERVER_LOG="$(mktemp -t saathi-smoke-server.XXXXXX.log)"

STATUS=""
BODY=""
CURRENT_STEP="setup"

# ── plumbing ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

log()  { echo "$*" >&2; }
pass() { log "PASS  step $CURRENT_STEP — $*"; }

fail() {
  log "FAIL  step $CURRENT_STEP — $*"
  log "----- offending response (HTTP ${STATUS:-n/a}) -----"
  log "${BODY:-<empty body>}"
  log "---------------------------------------------------"
  exit 1
}

cleanup() {
  local code=$?
  if [[ -n "$SERVER_PID" ]] && kill -0 "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null; then
    kill "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
    wait "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
  if [[ $code -ne 0 ]]; then
    log ""
    log "===== last 40 lines of server log ($SERVER_LOG) ====="
    tail -n 40 "$SERVER_LOG" >&2 || true
  fi
  exit $code
}
trap cleanup EXIT

step() { CURRENT_STEP="$1"; shift; log ""; log "── step $CURRENT_STEP: $* ──"; }

# req METHOD PATH TOKEN [JSON_BODY] → sets STATUS + BODY
req() {
  local method="$1" path="$2" token="${3:-}" data="${4:-}"
  local args=(-sS -X "$method" "${BASE}${path}" -H 'Content-Type: application/json')
  [[ -n "$token" ]] && args+=(-H "Authorization: Bearer $token")
  [[ -n "$data" ]] && args+=(--data "$data")
  local out
  out="$(curl "${args[@]}" -w $'\n%{http_code}')" || fail "curl error on $method $path"
  STATUS="${out##*$'\n'}"
  BODY="${out%$'\n'*}"
}

# raw_req METHOD URL → operational endpoints outside /api/v1
raw_req() {
  local method="$1" url="$2"
  local out
  out="$(curl -sS -X "$method" "$url" -w $'\n%{http_code}')" || fail "curl error on $url"
  STATUS="${out##*$'\n'}"
  BODY="${out%$'\n'*}"
}

expect_status() {
  local want="$1" what="$2"
  [[ "$STATUS" == "$want" ]] || fail "$what: expected HTTP $want, got HTTP $STATUS"
}

# jval 'PYTHON_EXPR' — evaluate over parsed BODY (as d); prints result
jval() {
  printf '%s' "$BODY" | python3 -c "
import json, sys
d = json.load(sys.stdin)
print($1)
" 2>/dev/null || fail "could not extract: $1"
}

# jassert 'PYTHON_BOOL_EXPR' 'description'
jassert() {
  local expr="$1" what="$2"
  local res
  res="$(printf '%s' "$BODY" | python3 -c "
import json, sys
d = json.load(sys.stdin)
print('OK' if ($expr) else 'NO')
" 2>/dev/null)" || fail "$what (assertion crashed: $expr)"
  [[ "$res" == "OK" ]] || fail "$what (assertion false: $expr)"
}

py_uuid() { python3 -c 'import uuid; print(uuid.uuid4())'; }

err_code() { jval "d['error']['code']"; }

# ── auth helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# login PHONE → prints session token
login() {
  local phone="$1"
  req POST /auth/otp/request "" "{\"phone\":\"$phone\"}"
  expect_status 200 "otp request for $phone"
  local otp
  otp="$(jval "d['data']['dev_otp']")"
  [[ -n "$otp" ]] || fail "no dev_otp in response for $phone (OTP_DEV_MODE off?)"
  req POST /auth/otp/verify "" "{\"phone\":\"$phone\",\"otp\":\"$otp\"}"
  expect_status 200 "otp verify for $phone"
  jval "d['data']['access_token']"
}

# role_token SESSION_TOKEN ROLE_CODE → prints role token
role_token() {
  local session="$1" role="$2"
  req GET /auth/roles "$session"
  expect_status 200 "list roles"
  local raid
  raid="$(jval "[a['id'] for a in d['data'] if a['role_code']=='$role'][0]")"
  [[ -n "$raid" ]] || fail "no $role assignment found"
  req POST /auth/role/select "$session" "{\"role_assignment_id\":\"$raid\"}"
  expect_status 200 "role select $role"
  jval "d['data']['access_token']"
}

# ── fixture constants (cmd/seed) ────────────────────────────────────────────

DCS="org-dcs-kasmandi-kalan"
BMC="org-bmc-malihabad"
PLANT="org-plant-lucknow-01"
UNION="org-union-lucknow"
FARMER_MAHESH="party-farmer-mahesh"
FARMER_GEETA="party-farmer-geeta"
ANIMAL="animal-gomti"
TODAY="$(TZ=Asia/Kolkata date +%F)"
EXPIRY="$(TZ=Asia/Kolkata date -v+3d +%F 2>/dev/null || TZ=Asia/Kolkata date -d '+3 days' +%F)"

# ── environment bring-up ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

log "smoke: repo=$REPO_ROOT  port=$PORT  db=$SMOKE_DB  today(IST)=$TODAY"

log "smoke: dropping $SMOKE_DB"
mongosh --quiet --eval "db.getSiblingDB(\"$SMOKE_DB\").dropDatabase()" >/dev/null

log "smoke: building server binary"
go build -o bin/saathi-server ./cmd/server

log "smoke: starting server (log: $SERVER_LOG)"
MONGO_DB="$SMOKE_DB" OTP_DEV_MODE=true PORT="$PORT" ./bin/saathi-server >"$SERVER_LOG" 2>&1 &
SERVER_PID=$!

log "smoke: waiting for /readyz"
ready=""
for _ in $(seq 1 60); do
  if curl -sf "${HOST}/readyz" >/dev/null 2>&1; then ready=1; break; fi
  kill -0 "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null || { BODY="$(tail -n 20 "$SERVER_LOG")"; fail "server process died during startup"; }
  sleep 0.5
done
[[ -n "$ready" ]] || { BODY="$(tail -n 20 "$SERVER_LOG")"; fail "server did not become ready in 30s"; }

log "smoke: seeding $SMOKE_DB"
MONGO_DB="$SMOKE_DB" go run ./cmd/seed >/dev/null

# ═══ 1. operational endpoints ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
step 1 "healthz / readyz / version"
raw_req GET "$HOST/healthz";  expect_status 200 "healthz";  jassert "d['data']['status']=='ok'" "healthz status ok"
raw_req GET "$HOST/readyz";   expect_status 200 "readyz";   jassert "d['data']['status']=='ready'" "readyz status ready"
raw_req GET "$HOST/version";  expect_status 200 "version";  jassert "d['data']['service']=='saathi-backend' and len(d['data']['version'])>0" "version body"
pass "healthz/readyz/version all OK"

# ═══ 2. sacheev login + role select ═════════════════════════════════════════
step 2 "sacheev login + role select"
SACHEEV_SESSION="$(login 9000000001)"
SACHEEV="$(role_token "$SACHEEV_SESSION" SAMITI_SACHEEV)"
[[ -n "$SACHEEV" ]] || fail "empty sacheev role token"
pass "sacheev holds a SAMITI_SACHEEV role token"

# ═══ 3. analyzer reading ════════════════════════════════════════════════════
step 3 "analyzer reading (ANALYZER_DIRECT, fat 6.5 / snf 9.0 / qty 10.5)"
NOW_UTC="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
req POST /collection/readings "$SACHEEV" "{
  \"dcs_id\": \"$DCS\",
  \"mode\": \"ANALYZER_DIRECT\",
  \"fat_pct\": 6.5, \"snf_pct\": 9.0, \"quantity_litres\": 10.5,
  \"device_id\": \"smoke-analyzer-01\",
  \"geo_lat\": 26.9124, \"geo_lng\": 80.9430,
  \"device_timestamp\": \"$NOW_UTC\"
}"
expect_status 201 "create reading"
READING_ID="$(jval "d['data']['id']")"
jassert "d['data']['plausibility_ok'] is True" "reading is plausible"
pass "reading $READING_ID recorded"

# ═══ 4. pour for Mahesh with exact pricing ══════════════════════════════════
step 4 "pour for farmer Mahesh (rate 52.75, amount 553.88)"
CEID_MAHESH="$(py_uuid)"
POUR_MAHESH_JSON="{
  \"client_event_id\": \"$CEID_MAHESH\",
  \"farmer_party_id\": \"$FARMER_MAHESH\",
  \"dcs_id\": \"$DCS\", \"shift\": \"MORNING\",
  \"quantity_litres\": 10.5, \"fat_pct\": 6.5, \"snf_pct\": 9.0,
  \"animal_id\": \"$ANIMAL\",
  \"analyzer_reading_id\": \"$READING_ID\",
  \"source\": \"ANALYZER_DIRECT\"
}"
req POST /collection/pours "$SACHEEV" "$POUR_MAHESH_JSON"
expect_status 201 "create pour"
POUR_MAHESH_ID="$(jval "d['data']['pour']['id']")"
jassert "abs(d['data']['pour']['rate_per_litre'] - 52.75) < 0.005" "rate == 52.75 (8.0 + 5.5*6.5 + 1.0*9.0)"
jassert "abs(d['data']['pour']['amount'] - 553.88) < 0.005" "amount == 553.88 (52.75 * 10.5)"
jassert "not d['data'].get('idempotent_replay', False)" "fresh insert, not replay"
pass "pour $POUR_MAHESH_ID priced rate=52.75 amount=553.88"

# ═══ 5. same pour replay → idempotent ═══════════════════════════════════════
step 5 "SAME pour replay → idempotent (offline-first)"
req POST /collection/pours "$SACHEEV" "$POUR_MAHESH_JSON"
expect_status 200 "replayed pour"
jassert "d['data']['idempotent_replay'] is True" "idempotent_replay true"
jassert "d['data']['pour']['id'] == '$POUR_MAHESH_ID'" "same pour returned"
pass "replay returned 200 + idempotent_replay=true, same pour id"

# ═══ 6. batch-sync: Geeta new + Mahesh duplicate ════════════════════════════
step 6 "batch-sync (created / created / duplicate)"
CEID_GEETA1="$(py_uuid)"
CEID_GEETA2="$(py_uuid)"
req POST /collection/pours/batch-sync "$SACHEEV" "{
  \"pours\": [
    {\"client_event_id\": \"$CEID_GEETA1\", \"farmer_party_id\": \"$FARMER_GEETA\", \"dcs_id\": \"$DCS\",
     \"shift\": \"MORNING\", \"quantity_litres\": 8.0, \"fat_pct\": 7.0, \"snf_pct\": 9.1, \"source\": \"ANALYZER_DIRECT\"},
    {\"client_event_id\": \"$CEID_GEETA2\", \"farmer_party_id\": \"$FARMER_GEETA\", \"dcs_id\": \"$DCS\",
     \"shift\": \"MORNING\", \"quantity_litres\": 4.5, \"fat_pct\": 6.8, \"snf_pct\": 8.9, \"source\": \"ANALYZER_DIRECT\"},
    $POUR_MAHESH_JSON
  ]
}"
expect_status 200 "batch sync"
jassert "[r['status'] for r in d['data']] == ['created','created','duplicate']" "statuses created/created/duplicate"
pass "batch-sync outcomes: created, created, duplicate"

# ═══ 7. negative: farmer cannot record pours ════════════════════════════════
step 7 "negative: FARMER role token POST pour → 403"
FARMER_SESSION="$(login 9000000011)"
FARMER="$(role_token "$FARMER_SESSION" FARMER)"
req POST /collection/pours "$FARMER" "{
  \"client_event_id\": \"$(py_uuid)\", \"farmer_party_id\": \"$FARMER_MAHESH\",
  \"dcs_id\": \"$DCS\", \"shift\": \"MORNING\",
  \"quantity_litres\": 5, \"fat_pct\": 6.0, \"snf_pct\": 8.8, \"source\": \"MANUAL\"
}"
expect_status 403 "farmer pour attempt"
pass "farmer POST /collection/pours refused with 403"

# ═══ 8. negative: implausible pour ══════════════════════════════════════════
step 8 "negative: implausible pour (fat 25.0) → 422"
req POST /collection/pours "$SACHEEV" "{
  \"client_event_id\": \"$(py_uuid)\", \"farmer_party_id\": \"$FARMER_MAHESH\",
  \"dcs_id\": \"$DCS\", \"shift\": \"MORNING\",
  \"quantity_litres\": 5, \"fat_pct\": 25.0, \"snf_pct\": 9.0, \"source\": \"ANALYZER_DIRECT\"
}"
expect_status 422 "implausible pour"
[[ "$(err_code)" == "IMPLAUSIBLE_VALUES" ]] || fail "expected IMPLAUSIBLE_VALUES, got $(err_code)"
pass "implausible pour rejected 422 IMPLAUSIBLE_VALUES"

# ═══ 9. invoices ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
step 9 "invoice generate (created>=2) + farmer sees own invoice"
req POST /collection/invoices/generate "$SACHEEV" "{\"dcs_id\": \"$DCS\", \"date\": \"$TODAY\"}"
expect_status 200 "generate invoices"
jassert "d['data']['created'] >= 2" "created >= 2 invoices"
MAHESH_INVOICE_ID="$(jval "[i['id'] for i in d['data']['invoices'] if i['farmer_party_id']=='$FARMER_MAHESH'][0]")"
req GET "/collection/invoices?date=$TODAY" "$FARMER"
expect_status 200 "farmer lists invoices"
jassert "any(i['id']=='$MAHESH_INVOICE_ID' for i in d['data'])" "farmer sees own invoice"
jassert "all(i['farmer_party_id']=='$FARMER_MAHESH' for i in d['data'])" "farmer sees ONLY own invoices"
pass "invoices generated ($MAHESH_INVOICE_ID visible to Mahesh)"

# ═══ 10. consignment create + dispatch ══════════════════════════════════════
step 10 "consignment create + dispatch (sacheev)"
req POST /logistics/consignments "$SACHEEV" "{\"dcs_id\": \"$DCS\", \"date\": \"$TODAY\", \"shift\": \"MORNING\"}"
expect_status 201 "create consignment"
CONSIGNMENT_ID="$(jval "d['data']['id']")"
jassert "d['data']['status']=='OPEN' and len(d['data']['pour_ids'])>=3" "OPEN consignment pooling >=3 pours"
req POST "/logistics/consignments/$CONSIGNMENT_ID/dispatch" "$SACHEEV"
expect_status 200 "dispatch consignment"
jassert "d['data']['status']=='DISPATCHED'" "consignment DISPATCHED"
pass "consignment $CONSIGNMENT_ID OPEN→DISPATCHED"

# ═══ 11. rider trip: pickup → cold chain → deliver ══════════════════════════
step 11 "rider trip: create → pickup 4.2°C → cold-chain → deliver to BMC"
RIDER_SESSION="$(login 9000000021)"
RIDER="$(role_token "$RIDER_SESSION" VAN_RIDER)"
req POST /logistics/trips "$RIDER" "{
  \"route_name\": \"Smoke Route A\", \"union_id\": \"$UNION\",
  \"date\": \"$TODAY\", \"shift\": \"MORNING\",
  \"stops\": [{\"dcs_id\": \"$DCS\", \"consignment_id\": \"$CONSIGNMENT_ID\"}]
}"
expect_status 201 "create trip"
TRIP_ID="$(jval "d['data']['id']")"
jassert "d['data']['status']=='PLANNED'" "trip PLANNED"
req POST "/logistics/trips/$TRIP_ID/stops/$CONSIGNMENT_ID/pickup" "$RIDER" '{"temp_c": 4.2}'
expect_status 200 "pickup"
jassert "d['data']['status']=='IN_PROGRESS'" "trip IN_PROGRESS after pickup"
jassert "abs(d['data']['stops'][0]['temp_c'] - 4.2) < 0.001" "pickup temp recorded"
req POST "/logistics/trips/$TRIP_ID/cold-chain" "$RIDER" '{"temp_c": 4.4, "geo_lat": 26.93, "geo_lng": 80.95}'
expect_status 200 "cold-chain log"
jassert "len(d['data']['cold_chain'])>=1" "cold-chain entry stored"
req POST "/logistics/trips/$TRIP_ID/deliver" "$RIDER" "{\"bmc_id\": \"$BMC\"}"
expect_status 200 "deliver"
jassert "d['data']['status']=='DELIVERED' and d['data']['delivered_to_bmc_id']=='$BMC'" "trip DELIVERED to BMC"
pass "trip $TRIP_ID PLANNED→IN_PROGRESS→DELIVERED"

# ═══ 12. BMC lot create + close ═════════════════════════════════════════════
step 12 "bmc-op: lot create from delivered consignment + close at 3.8°C"
BMCOP_SESSION="$(login 9000000031)"
BMCOP="$(role_token "$BMCOP_SESSION" BMC_OPERATOR)"
req POST /plant/bmc-lots "$BMCOP" "{
  \"bmc_id\": \"$BMC\", \"date\": \"$TODAY\", \"shift\": \"MORNING\",
  \"consignment_ids\": [\"$CONSIGNMENT_ID\"]
}"
expect_status 201 "create bmc lot"
LOT_ID="$(jval "d['data']['id']")"
jassert "d['data']['status']=='OPEN'" "lot OPEN"

expect_status 200 "close lot"
jassert "d['data']['status']=='QC_PENDING' and abs(d['data']['chilling_temp_c']-3.8)<0.001" "lot QC_PENDING at 3.8°C"
pass "bmc lot $LOT_ID OPEN→QC_PENDING"

# ═══ 13. QC pass + dispatch lot ═════════════════════════════════════════════
step 13 "bmc-op QC BMC_RAPID PASS (AFM1 0.3, coliform 5) → PASSED → dispatch"
req POST /quality/qc-results "$BMCOP" "{
  \"subject_type\": \"BMC_LOT\", \"subject_id\": \"$LOT_ID\", \"stage\": \"BMC_RAPID\",
  \"tests\": [
    {\"name\": \"AFLATOXIN_M1\", \"value\": 0.3, \"unit\": \"µg/kg\"},
    {\"name\": \"COLIFORM\", \"value\": 5, \"unit\": \"CFU/ml\"}
  ]
}"
expect_status 201 "record BMC_RAPID QC"
jassert "d['data']['overall_pass'] is True and len(d['data']['certificate_number'])>0" "QC passed with certificate"
req GET "/plant/bmc-lots?bmc_id=$BMC&date=$TODAY" "$BMCOP"
expect_status 200 "list lots"
jassert "[l['status'] for l in d['data'] if l['id']=='$LOT_ID'] == ['PASSED']" "lot status PASSED"
req POST "/plant/bmc-lots/$LOT_ID/dispatch" "$BMCOP"
expect_status 200 "dispatch lot"
jassert "d['data']['status']=='DISPATCHED'" "lot DISPATCHED"
pass "lot $LOT_ID QC PASSED → DISPATCHED"

# ═══ 14. negative gate: full second path → BLOCKED lot ══════════════════════
step 14 "negative gate: 2nd path (evening) → QC fail AFM1 0.9 → BLOCKED → dispatch 422 → batch 422"
# second pour (evening shift keeps the consignment unique-index happy)
CEID_EVE="$(py_uuid)"
req POST /collection/pours "$SACHEEV" "{
  \"client_event_id\": \"$CEID_EVE\", \"farmer_party_id\": \"$FARMER_MAHESH\",
  \"dcs_id\": \"$DCS\", \"shift\": \"EVENING\",
  \"quantity_litres\": 9.0, \"fat_pct\": 6.2, \"snf_pct\": 8.9, \"source\": \"ANALYZER_DIRECT\"
}"
expect_status 201 "evening pour"
req POST /logistics/consignments "$SACHEEV" "{\"dcs_id\": \"$DCS\", \"date\": \"$TODAY\", \"shift\": \"EVENING\"}"
expect_status 201 "evening consignment"
CONSIGNMENT2_ID="$(jval "d['data']['id']")"
req POST "/logistics/consignments/$CONSIGNMENT2_ID/dispatch" "$SACHEEV"
expect_status 200 "dispatch evening consignment"
req POST /logistics/trips "$RIDER" "{
  \"route_name\": \"Smoke Route B\", \"union_id\": \"$UNION\",
  \"date\": \"$TODAY\", \"shift\": \"EVENING\",
  \"stops\": [{\"dcs_id\": \"$DCS\", \"consignment_id\": \"$CONSIGNMENT2_ID\"}]
}"
expect_status 201 "evening trip"
TRIP2_ID="$(jval "d['data']['id']")"
req POST "/logistics/trips/$TRIP2_ID/stops/$CONSIGNMENT2_ID/pickup" "$RIDER" '{"temp_c": 4.0}'
expect_status 200 "evening pickup"
req POST "/logistics/trips/$TRIP2_ID/deliver" "$RIDER" "{\"bmc_id\": \"$BMC\"}"
expect_status 200 "evening deliver"
req POST /plant/bmc-lots "$BMCOP" "{
  \"bmc_id\": \"$BMC\", \"date\": \"$TODAY\", \"shift\": \"EVENING\",
  \"consignment_ids\": [\"$CONSIGNMENT2_ID\"]
}"
expect_status 201 "evening bmc lot"
LOT2_ID="$(jval "d['data']['id']")"
req POST "/plant/bmc-lots/$LOT2_ID/close" "$BMCOP" '{"chilling_temp_c": 3.9}'
expect_status 200 "close evening lot"
req POST /quality/qc-results "$BMCOP" "{
  \"subject_type\": \"BMC_LOT\", \"subject_id\": \"$LOT2_ID\", \"stage\": \"BMC_RAPID\",
  \"tests\": [{\"name\": \"AFLATOXIN_M1\", \"value\": 0.9, \"unit\": \"µg/kg\"}]
}"
expect_status 201 "record failing QC"
jassert "d['data']['overall_pass'] is False and len(d['data']['failure_reasons'])>=1" "QC failed with reasons"
req GET "/plant/bmc-lots?bmc_id=$BMC&date=$TODAY" "$BMCOP"
expect_status 200 "list lots after block"
jassert "[l['status'] for l in d['data'] if l['id']=='$LOT2_ID'] == ['BLOCKED']" "lot2 BLOCKED"
# dispatch of blocked lot must refuse
req POST "/plant/bmc-lots/$LOT2_ID/dispatch" "$BMCOP"
expect_status 422 "dispatch of BLOCKED lot"
[[ "$(err_code)" == "SAFETY_GATE_BLOCKED" ]] || fail "expected SAFETY_GATE_BLOCKED on dispatch, got $(err_code)"
# batching the blocked lot must refuse too
PLANTOP_SESSION="$(login 9000000041)"
PLANTOP="$(role_token "$PLANTOP_SESSION" PLANT_OPERATOR)"
req POST /plant/batches "$PLANTOP" "{

}"
expect_status 422 "batch with BLOCKED lot"
[[ "$(err_code)" == "SAFETY_GATE_BLOCKED" ]] || fail "expected SAFETY_GATE_BLOCKED on batch, got $(err_code)"
pass "blocked lot $LOT2_ID can neither dispatch nor enter a batch (both 422 SAFETY_GATE_BLOCKED)"

# ═══ 15. plant batch: create → lab QC pass → complete ═══════════════════════
step 15 "plant batch from PASSED+DISPATCHED lot → PLANT_LAB pass → COMPLETED"
req POST /plant/batches "$PLANTOP" "{
  \"plant_id\": \"$PLANT\", \"bmc_lot_ids\": [\"$LOT_ID\"], \"product_type\": \"TONED_MILK\"
}"
expect_status 201 "create batch"

BATCH_NUMBER="$(jval "d['data']['batch_number']")"

LAB_SESSION="$(login 9000000042)"
LAB="$(role_token "$LAB_SESSION" PLANT_LAB_ANALYST)"
req POST /quality/qc-results "$LAB" "{
  \"subject_type\": \"PROCESSING_BATCH\", \"subject_id\": \"$BATCH_ID\", \"stage\": \"PLANT_LAB\",
  \"tests\": [
    {\"name\": \"AFLATOXIN_M1\", \"value\": 0.2, \"unit\": \"µg/kg\"},

  ]
}"
expect_status 201 "record PLANT_LAB QC"
jassert "d['data']['overall_pass'] is True" "plant lab QC passed"
req GET "/plant/batches/$BATCH_ID" "$PLANTOP"
expect_status 200 "get batch"
jassert "d['data']['status']=='PASSED'" "batch PASSED"
req POST "/plant/batches/$BATCH_ID/complete" "$PLANTOP"
expect_status 200 "complete batch"
jassert "d['data']['status']=='COMPLETED'" "batch COMPLETED"
pass "batch $BATCH_NUMBER QC_PENDING→PASSED→COMPLETED"

# ═══ 16. product lot + QR ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
step 16 "product lot (PARAG-TM-500, expiry +3d) → QR issue"
req POST /plant/product-lots "$PLANTOP" "{
  \"batch_id\": \"$BATCH_ID\", \"sku\": \"PARAG-TM-500\",
  \"product_name\": \"Parag Toned Milk\", \"units\": 2000, \"unit_size\": \"500ml\",

expect_status 201 "create product lot"

[[ -n "$QR_CODE" ]] || fail "no qr_code in issue response"
pass "product lot $PRODUCT_LOT_ID labelled with QR $QR_CODE"

# ═══ 17. PUBLIC scan without any token ══════════════════════════════════════
step 17 "public QR scan (no token): samiti set + certificate + intact ledger"
STATUS=""; BODY=""
out="$(curl -sS "${BASE}/public/qr/${QR_CODE}" -w $'\n%{http_code}')" || fail "curl error on public scan"
STATUS="${out##*$'\n'}"; BODY="${out%$'\n'*}"
expect_status 200 "public scan"
jassert "'DCS-01842' in [s['code'] for s in d['data']['sourcing']['samitis']]" "sourcing.samitis contains DCS-01842"
jassert "len(d['data']['quality']['certificate_number'])>0" "quality.certificate_number present"
jassert "d['data']['ledger']['intact'] is True" "ledger.intact true"
jassert "d['data']['product']['sku']=='PARAG-TM-500'" "product SKU on scan"
pass "public scan shows honest provenance + intact chain"

# ═══ 18. public ledger verify ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
step 18 "public ledger verify from=1 → intact"
req GET "/public/ledger/verify?from=1&to=100000" ""
expect_status 200 "ledger verify"
jassert "d['data']['intact'] is True and d['data']['from']==1 and d['data']['to']>=10" "full chain intact"
pass "hash chain verified intact from=1 to=$(jval "d['data']['to']")"

# ═══ 19. settlement: initiate → dual control → execute ══════════════════════
step 19 "settlement: initiate → (self-approve 403) → adhyaksh approve → execute → farmer paid"
req POST /settlements "$SACHEEV" "{\"dcs_id\": \"$DCS\", \"date\": \"$TODAY\"}"
expect_status 201 "initiate settlement"
SETTLEMENT_ID="$(jval "d['data']['id']")"
jassert "d['data']['status']=='PENDING_APPROVAL' and len(d['data']['invoice_ids'])>=2" "batch PENDING_APPROVAL with >=2 invoices"
# dual control: initiator (sacheev) must NOT be able to approve own batch
req POST "/settlements/$SETTLEMENT_ID/approve" "$SACHEEV"
expect_status 403 "sacheev approving own batch"
ADHYAKSH_SESSION="$(login 9000000002)"
ADHYAKSH="$(role_token "$ADHYAKSH_SESSION" SAMITI_ADHYAKSH)"
req POST "/settlements/$SETTLEMENT_ID/approve" "$ADHYAKSH"
expect_status 200 "adhyaksh approve"
jassert "d['data']['status']=='APPROVED'" "batch APPROVED"
req POST "/settlements/$SETTLEMENT_ID/execute" "$ADHYAKSH"
expect_status 200 "execute settlement"
jassert "d['data']['batch']['status']=='EXECUTED' and len(d['data']['payout_instructions'])>=2" "EXECUTED with payouts"
jassert "all(p['status']=='SUCCESS' and p['utr'] for p in d['data']['payout_instructions'])" "all payouts SUCCESS with UTR"
# farmer sees the payout + PAID invoice
req GET /settlements/payouts "$FARMER"
expect_status 200 "farmer payout history"
jassert "any(p['farmer_party_id']=='$FARMER_MAHESH' and p['status']=='SUCCESS' for p in d['data'])" "farmer payout visible"
req GET "/collection/invoices/$MAHESH_INVOICE_ID" "$FARMER"
expect_status 200 "farmer fetches invoice"
jassert "d['data']['status']=='PAID'" "invoice PAID"
pass "settlement $SETTLEMENT_ID dual-controlled and executed; Mahesh paid, invoice PAID"

# ═══ 20. platformops: worker, audit, flags, dormant telemetry ═══════════════
step 20 "platformops: SMS worker, audit logs, flags, dormant collar telemetry"
ADMIN_SESSION="$(login 9999999999)"
ADMIN="$(role_token "$ADMIN_SESSION" SUPER_ADMIN)"
req POST /notifications/worker/run "$ADMIN"
expect_status 200 "run notifications worker"
jassert "d['data']['sent'] > 0" "worker sent > 0 SMS"
WORKER_SENT="$(jval "d['data']['sent']")"
req GET "/audit/logs?limit=5" "$ADMIN"
expect_status 200 "list audit logs"
jassert "d['meta']['total'] > 0 and len(d['data']) > 0" "audit entries exist"
req GET /admin/flags "$ADMIN"
expect_status 200 "list flags"
jassert "[f['enabled'] for f in d['data'] if f['key']=='collar_telemetry_enabled'] == [False]" "collar_telemetry_enabled is false"
req POST /cattle/telemetry "$ADMIN" '{"pashu_aadhaar": "356729481027", "metrics": {"temp_c": 38.6, "steps": 4211}}'
expect_status 403 "telemetry while flag off"
[[ "$(err_code)" == "FEATURE_DISABLED" ]] || fail "expected FEATURE_DISABLED, got $(err_code)"
pass "worker sent=$WORKER_SENT; audit trail live; collar flag off; telemetry 403 FEATURE_DISABLED"

log ""
log "SMOKE PASSED — all 20 steps green (db=$SMOKE_DB, port=$PORT)"
```

```text
1	package quality
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"errors"
6		"fmt"
7	
8		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
9		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
10		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo/options"
11	
12		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
13		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
14		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/mongodb"
15	)
16	
17	// repository is all MongoDB access for the quality module. It owns qc_results
18	// and — as the safety-gate verdict writer (blueprint §8.3) — performs the
19	// documented cross-collection status write onto bmc_lots and
20	// processing_batches. No other module may flip those gate statuses.
21	type repository struct {
22		results  *mongo.Collection
23		bmcLots  *mongo.Collection
24		batches  *mongo.Collection
25		counters *mongo.Collection
26	}
27	
28	// newRepository binds the repository to its collections.
29	func newRepository(db *mongo.Database) *repository {
30		return &repository{
31			results:  db.Collection(mongodb.CollQCResults),
32			bmcLots:  db.Collection(mongodb.CollBMCLots),
33			batches:  db.Collection(mongodb.CollBatches),
34			counters: db.Collection(mongodb.CollCounters),
35		}
36	}
37	
38	// insertResult stores a new QC result document.
39	func (r *repository) insertResult(ctx context.Context, res *domain.QCResult) error {
40		if _, err := r.results.InsertOne(ctx, res); err != nil {
41			return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("insert qc result: %w", err))
42		}
43		return nil
44	}
45	
46	// setResultProvenanceSeq stamps the ledger sequence onto a stored result.
47	func (r *repository) setResultProvenanceSeq(ctx context.Context, resultID string, seq int64) error {
48		_, err := r.results.UpdateOne(ctx,
49			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: resultID}},
50			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "provenance_seq", Value: seq}}}},
51		)
52		if err != nil {
53			return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("set qc result provenance seq: %w", err))
54		}
55		return nil
56	}
57	
58	// findResultByID returns one QC result or NotFound.
59	func (r *repository) findResultByID(ctx context.Context, resultID string) (*domain.QCResult, error) {
60		var res domain.QCResult
61		err := r.results.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: resultID}}).Decode(&res)
62		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
63			return nil, httpx.NotFound("qc result")
64		}
65		if err != nil {
66			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("find qc result: %w", err))
67		}
68		return &res, nil
69	}
70	
71	// listResults returns a page of QC results, newest first, optionally filtered
72	// by subject. It also returns the total matching count for pagination meta.
73	func (r *repository) listResults(ctx context.Context, subjectType, subjectID string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.QCResult, int64, error) {
74		filter := bson.D{}
75		if subjectType != "" {
76			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "subject_type", Value: subjectType})
77		}
78		if subjectID != "" {
79			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "subject_id", Value: subjectID})
80		}
81	
82		total, err := r.results.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
83		if err != nil {
84			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("count qc results: %w", err))
85		}
86	
87		cur, err := r.results.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
88			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "recorded_at", Value: -1}}).
89			SetSkip(page.Offset).
90			SetLimit(page.Limit),
91		)
92		if err != nil {
93			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("list qc results: %w", err))
94		}
95		results := []domain.QCResult{}
96		if err := cur.All(ctx, &results); err != nil {
97			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("decode qc results: %w", err))
98		}
99		return results, total, nil
100	}
101	
102	// findBMCLot returns a BMC lot or NotFound.
103	func (r *repository) findBMCLot(ctx context.Context, lotID string) (*domain.BMCLot, error) {
104		var lot domain.BMCLot
105		err := r.bmcLots.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: lotID}}).Decode(&lot)
106		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
107			return nil, httpx.NotFound("bmc lot")
108		}
109		if err != nil {
110			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("find bmc lot: %w", err))
111		}
112		return &lot, nil
113	}
114	
115	// findBatch returns a processing batch or NotFound.
116	func (r *repository) findBatch(ctx context.Context, batchID string) (*domain.ProcessingBatch, error) {
117		var batch domain.ProcessingBatch
118		err := r.batches.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: batchID}}).Decode(&batch)
119		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
120			return nil, httpx.NotFound("processing batch")
121		}
122		if err != nil {
123			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("find processing batch: %w", err))
124		}
125		return &batch, nil
126	}
127	
128	// gateBMCLot applies the gate verdict to a BMC lot still in QC_PENDING.
129	// Returns false when the lot was already gated by a concurrent writer.
130	func (r *repository) gateBMCLot(ctx context.Context, lotID, resultID, newStatus, blockReason string) (bool, error) {
131		return gateSubjectDoc(ctx, r.bmcLots, lotID, domain.BMCLotStatusQCPending, resultID, newStatus, blockReason)
132	}
133	
134	// gateBatch applies the gate verdict to a processing batch still in QC_PENDING.
135	// Returns false when the batch was already gated by a concurrent writer.
136	func (r *repository) gateBatch(ctx context.Context, batchID, resultID, newStatus, blockReason string) (bool, error) {
137		return gateSubjectDoc(ctx, r.batches, batchID, domain.BatchStatusQCPending, resultID, newStatus, blockReason)
138	}
139	
140	// gateSubjectDoc is the shared conditional gate write: the filter pins the
141	// subject to QC_PENDING so a lost race cannot double-apply a verdict — the
142	// optimistic pattern that replaces transactions on a standalone server.
143	func gateSubjectDoc(ctx context.Context, coll *mongo.Collection, subjectID, pendingStatus, resultID, newStatus, blockReason string) (bool, error) {
144		set := bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: newStatus}}
145		if blockReason != "" {
146			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "block_reason", Value: blockReason})
147		}
148		res, err := coll.UpdateOne(ctx,
149			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: subjectID}, {Key: "status", Value: pendingStatus}},
150			bson.D{
151				{Key: "$set", Value: set},
152				{Key: "$push", Value: bson.D{{Key: "qc_result_ids", Value: resultID}}},
153			},
154		)
155		if err != nil {
156			return false, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("gate %s subject %s: %w", coll.Name(), subjectID, err))
157		}
158		return res.MatchedCount == 1, nil
159	}
160	
161	// nextCertificateSeq atomically increments and returns the per-stage QC
162	// certificate counter (counters collection, upsert-on-first-use).
163	func (r *repository) nextCertificateSeq(ctx context.Context, stage string) (int64, error) {
164		var doc struct {
165			Seq int64 `bson:"seq"`
166		}
167		err := r.counters.FindOneAndUpdate(ctx,
168			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: "qc_certificate:" + stage}},
169			bson.D{{Key: "$inc", Value: bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: int64(1)}}}},
170			options.FindOneAndUpdate().SetUpsert(true).SetReturnDocument(options.After),
171		).Decode(&doc)
172		if err != nil {
173			return 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("next qc certificate seq: %w", err))
174		}
175		return doc.Seq, nil
176	}
```

```text
108	// requestOTP creates a hashed OTP challenge and queues the SMS through the
109	// notification outbox (the platformops worker delivers it).
110	func (s *service) requestOTP(ctx context.Context, phone string) (*otpRequestResponse, error) {
111		now := time.Now().UTC()
112		code, err := auth.GenerateNumericOTP(otpLength)
113		if err != nil {
114			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
115		}
116	
117		challenge := otpChallenge{
118			ID:        uuid.NewString(),
119			Phone:     phone,
120			CodeHash:  auth.HMACHash(s.deps.Cfg.OTPHashSecret, phone, code),
121			ExpiresAt: now.Add(s.deps.Cfg.OTPTTL),
122			Attempts:  0,
123		}
124		if err := s.repo.insertOTPChallenge(ctx, challenge); err != nil {
125			return nil, err
126		}
127	
128		// Outbox SMS: the plaintext code travels only inside the notification
129		// params so the sender can deliver it; the challenge stores the hash.
130		notification := domain.Notification{
131			ID:          uuid.NewString(),
132			Phone:       phone,
133			Channel:     domain.ChannelSMS,
134			TemplateKey: domain.TemplateOTP,
135			Language:    defaultLanguage,
136			Params:      map[string]string{"otp": code},
137			Status:      domain.NotificationQueued,
138			QueuedAt:    now,
139		}
140		if party, err := s.repo.findPartyByPhone(ctx, phone); err == nil {
141			notification.PartyID = party.ID
142			if party.PreferredLanguage != "" {
143				notification.Language = party.PreferredLanguage
144			}
145		}
146		if err := s.repo.insertNotification(ctx, notification); err != nil {
147			return nil, err
148		}
149	
150		resp := &otpRequestResponse{Phone: phone, ExpiresAt: challenge.ExpiresAt}
151		if s.deps.Cfg.OTPDevMode {
152			resp.DevOTP = code // dev only — config refuses OTP_DEV_MODE in prod
153		}
154		return resp, nil
155	}
```

```text
52		if strings.TrimSpace(req.SubjectType) == "" {
53			return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_SUBJECT_TYPE", "subject_type is required")
54		}
55		if strings.TrimSpace(req.SubjectID) == "" {
56			return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_SUBJECT_ID", "subject_id is required")
57		}
58		if strings.TrimSpace(req.Stage) == "" {
59			return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_STAGE", "stage is required")
60		}
61		if len(req.Tests) == 0 {
62			return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_TESTS", "at least one test is required")
63		}
64		for i, t := range req.Tests {
65			if strings.TrimSpace(t.Name) == "" {

67			}
68			if t.Value < 0 {
69				return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_TEST_VALUE", "tests["+strconv.Itoa(i)+"].value must not be negative")
70			}
71		}
72		return nil
73	}
```

 `./internal/platform/orgscope/resolver.go`

```text
1	// Package orgscope answers the RBAC question "is this resource inside the
2	// caller's organisational scope?" in O(1) DB reads. Org units denormalise
3	// their ancestor chain into Path, so scope checking is a set-membership test
4	// — no recursive tree walks on the hot path.
5	package orgscope
6	
7	import (
8		"context"
9		"errors"
10		"sync"
11		"time"
12	
13		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
14		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
15	
16		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
17		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
18		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
19	)
20	
21	const collection = "org_units"
22	
23	type cachedOrg struct {
24		org domain.OrgUnit
25		at  time.Time
26	}
27	
28	// Resolver caches org units briefly (the tree changes rarely, reads are hot).
29	type Resolver struct {
30		coll *mongo.Collection
31		ttl  time.Duration
32	
33		mu    sync.RWMutex
34		cache map[string]cachedOrg
35	}
36	
37	// NewResolver binds the resolver to the database.
38	func NewResolver(db *mongo.Database) *Resolver {
39		return &Resolver{
40			coll:  db.Collection(collection),
41			ttl:   60 * time.Second,
42			cache: make(map[string]cachedOrg),
43		}
44	}
45	
46	// Get returns an org unit by ID (cached).
47	func (r *Resolver) Get(ctx context.Context, id string) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
48		r.mu.RLock()
49		c, ok := r.cache[id]
50		r.mu.RUnlock()
51		if ok && time.Since(c.at) < r.ttl {
52			org := c.org
53			return &org, nil
54		}
55	
56		var org domain.OrgUnit
57		err := r.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&org)
58		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
59			return nil, httpx.NotFound("org unit " + id)
60		}
61		if err != nil {
62			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
63		}
64	
65		r.mu.Lock()
66		r.cache[id] = cachedOrg{org: org, at: time.Now()}
67		r.mu.Unlock()
68		return &org, nil
69	}
70	
71	// Invalidate drops a cached entry (call after updates).
72	func (r *Resolver) Invalidate(id string) {
73		r.mu.Lock()
74		delete(r.cache, id)
75		r.mu.Unlock()
76	}
77	
78	// InScope reports whether target sits at-or-below scope in the hierarchy:
79	// true when scope == target, or scope appears in target's ancestor Path.
80	func (r *Resolver) InScope(ctx context.Context, scopeOrgID, targetOrgID string) (bool, error) {
81		if scopeOrgID == targetOrgID {
82			return true, nil
83		}
84		target, err := r.Get(ctx, targetOrgID)
85		if err != nil {
86			return false, err
87		}
88		for _, ancestor := range target.Path {
89			if ancestor == scopeOrgID {
90				return true, nil
91			}
92		}
93		return false, nil
94	}
95	
96	// RequireInScope enforces the actor's org scope over a target org unit.
97	// SUPER_ADMIN and STATE_AUDITOR (read-wide roles rooted at the federation)
98	// pass automatically; everyone else needs ancestry.
99	func (r *Resolver) RequireInScope(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, targetOrgID string) error {
100		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSuperAdmin || actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleStateAuditor {
101			return nil
102		}
103		if actor.OrgUnitID == "" {
104			return httpx.Forbidden("role token with org scope required")
105		}
106		ok, err := r.InScope(ctx, actor.OrgUnitID, targetOrgID)
107		if err != nil {
108			return err
109		}
110		if !ok {
111			return httpx.Forbidden("resource is outside your organisational scope")
112		}
113		return nil
114	}
115
```

```text
3	// mock Bharat Pashudhan sync, the 1962 Mobile Veterinary Unit dispatch flow,

17	// Register wires the cattle module under /cattle. The router mounts this
18	// subtree at /api/v1, so routes land at /api/v1/cattle/...
19	func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
20		repo := newRepository(d.DB)
21		svc := newService(d, repo)
22		h := newHandler(svc)
23	
24		r.Route("/cattle", func(r chi.Router) {
25			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
26	
27			r.Route("/animals", func(r chi.Router) {
28				// Registration: farmers self-serve; village-tier staff and the
29				// health tier register on a farmer's behalf.
30				r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(
31					domain.RoleFarmer, domain.RoleSamitiSacheev, domain.RoleLRP,
32					domain.RoleAITech, domain.RoleVeterinarian,
33				)).Post("/", h.registerAnimal)
34	
35				// Any authenticated party may list; the service pins farmers and
36				// plain session tokens to their own herd.
37				r.With(middleware.RequireSession).Get("/", h.listAnimals)
38	
39				// Reads: the owner farmer, or care-circle roles. Consent gating
40				// is a v2 TODO — see canViewAnimal in service.go.
41				r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
42					r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(
43						domain.RoleFarmer, domain.RoleVeterinarian,
44						domain.RoleAITech, domain.RoleMissionOfficial,
45					))
46					r.Get("/{animalID}", h.getAnimal)
47					r.Get("/{animalID}/health-events", h.listHealthEvents)
48				})
49	
50				r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleVeterinarian, domain.RoleAITech)).
51					Post("/{animalID}/health-events", h.logHealthEvent)
52	
53				// Mock Bharat Pashudhan push (§9) — real integration is a swap of

56					Post("/{animalID}/bp-sync", h.syncBharatPashudhan)

62				r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(

64					domain.RoleSamitiSacheev, domain.RoleMissionOfficial,
```

```text
27	// RateChart prices milk from fat/SNF, scoped to an org unit (union or
28	// federation). rate/L = BaseRatePerLitre + Fat%*FatRatePerPoint + SNF%*SNFRatePerPoint.
29	type RateChart struct {
30		ID               string    `bson:"_id"         json:"id"`
31		OrgUnitID        string    `bson:"org_unit_id" json:"org_unit_id"`
32		Name             string    `bson:"name"        json:"name"`

34		FatRatePerPoint  float64   `bson:"fat_rate_per_point"  json:"fat_rate_per_point"`
35		SNFRatePerPoint  float64   `bson:"snf_rate_per_point"  json:"snf_rate_per_point"`
36		EffectiveFrom    time.Time `bson:"effective_from"      json:"effective_from"`
37		Active           bool      `bson:"active"      json:"active"`

42	// PricePour computes (ratePerLitre, amount) for a pour, rounded to paise.
43	func (rc RateChart) PricePour(fatPct, snfPct, qtyLitres float64) (rate, amount float64) {
44		rate = rc.BaseRatePerLitre + fatPct*rc.FatRatePerPoint + snfPct*rc.SNFRatePerPoint
45		rate = math.Round(rate*100) / 100
46		amount = math.Round(rate*qtyLitres*100) / 100
47		return rate, amount
48	}

92	// CheckPlausibility validates fat/SNF/qty against physical bounds and returns
93	// the violated flags (empty slice = plausible).
94	func CheckPlausibility(fatPct, snfPct, qtyLitres float64) []string {
95		var flags []string
96		if fatPct < PlausibleFatMin || fatPct > PlausibleFatMax ||
97			snfPct < PlausibleSNFMin || snfPct > PlausibleSNFMax {
98			flags = append(flags, IntegrityFlagImplausibleValue)
99		}
100		if qtyLitres != 0 && (qtyLitres < PlausibleQtyMin || qtyLitres > PlausibleQtyMax) {
101			flags = append(flags, IntegrityFlagImplausibleValue)
102		}
103		return flags
104	}
105	
106	// Milk pour statuses. Corrections never edit in place: a correcting pour
107	// references the superseded one (append-only provenance, blueprint §3.4).
108	const (
109		PourStatusRecorded   = "RECORDED"
110		PourStatusSuperseded = "SUPERSEDED"
111		PourStatusCancelled  = "CANCELLED"
112	)
113	
114	// MilkPour is the atomic unit of procurement: one farmer, one can, one shift.
115	// ClientEventID is the offline-first idempotency key — devices generate it
116	// locally and sync later; a unique index makes replays harmless.
117	type MilkPour struct {
118		ID                string    `bson:"_id"       json:"id"`
119		ClientEventID     string    `bson:"client_event_id"  json:"client_event_id"`
120		FarmerPartyID     string    `bson:"farmer_party_id"  json:"farmer_party_id"`

122		DCSID             string    `bson:"dcs_id"    json:"dcs_id"`

125		QuantityLitres    float64   `bson:"quantity_litres" json:"quantity_litres"`
126		FatPct            float64   `bson:"fat_pct"   json:"fat_pct"`
127		SNFPct            float64   `bson:"snf_pct"   json:"snf_pct"`
128		CLR               float64   `bson:"clr,omitempty" json:"clr,omitempty"`
129		RatePerLitre      float64   `bson:"rate_per_litre" json:"rate_per_litre"`
130		Amount            float64   `bson:"amount"    json:"amount"`
131		RateChartID       string    `bson:"rate_chart_id"  json:"rate_chart_id"`
132		AnalyzerReadingID string    `bson:"analyzer_reading_id,omitempty" json:"analyzer_reading_id,omitempty"`
133		Source            string    `bson:"source"    json:"source"` // reading mode that produced the values
134		Status            string    `bson:"status"    json:"status"`
135		SupersedesPourID  string    `bson:"supersedes_pour_id,omitempty" json:"supersedes_pour_id,omitempty"`

142		CreatedAt         time.Time `bson:"created_at"  json:"created_at"`

145	// Invoice statuses through the same-day payment loop (blueprint §8.1).

148		InvoiceStatusSettlementPending = "SETTLEMENT_PENDING"
149		InvoiceStatusPaid              = "PAID"

153	// Invoice aggregates one farmer's pours at one DCS for one day — the artefact
154	// behind "same-day farmer payment".

156		ID                  string    `bson:"_id"     json:"id"`
157		InvoiceNumber       string    `bson:"invoice_number" json:"invoice_number"` // human-readable, e.g. INV-DCS01842-20260706-0001
158		FarmerPartyID       string    `bson:"farmer_party_id" json:"farmer_party_id"`

162		TotalQuantityLitres float64   `bson:"total_quantity_litres" json:"total_quantity_litres"`
163		TotalAmount         float64   `bson:"total_amount" json:"total_amount"`
164		Status              string    `bson:"status"       json:"status"`
165		SettlementBatchID   string    `bson:"settlement_batch_id,omitempty" json:"settlement_batch_id,omitempty"`
166		IssuedAt            time.Time `bson:"issued_at"    json:"issued_at"`

170	// DateKeyIST formats t as the YYYY-MM-DD settlement-day key in IST.
171	func DateKeyIST(t time.Time) string {
172		ist := time.FixedZone("IST", 5*3600+1800)
173		return t.In(ist).Format("2006-01-02")
174	}
175	
176	// InvoiceNumberFor builds the human-readable invoice number.
177	func InvoiceNumberFor(dcsCode, dateKey string, seq int) string {
178		return fmt.Sprintf("INV-%s-%s-%04d", dcsCode, dateKey, seq)
179	}
```

```text
24:
25:// JSONMeta writes a success response with list metadata (pagination etc.).
26:func JSONMeta(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, data, meta any) {
27:	writeJSON(w, status, envelope{Data: data, Meta: meta})
28:}
29:
30:// Error writes the standard error envelope. Unexpected (non-AppError) errors
31:// become an opaque 500 and the cause is logged with the request context.
32:func Error(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, err error) {
33:	var ae *AppError
34:	if !errors.As(err, &ae) {
35:		ae = Internal(err)
36:	}
37:	if ae.Status >= 500 {
38:		slog.ErrorContext(r.Context(), "request failed",
39:			slog.String("method", r.Method),
40:			slog.String("path", r.URL.Path),
41:			slog.String("code", ae.Code),
42:			slog.Any("cause", ae.CauseOrSelf()),
43:		)
44:	}
45:	writeJSON(w, ae.Status, errEnvelope{Error: ae})
46:}
47:
48:// CauseOrSelf returns the wrapped cause if present, else the error itself.
49:func (e *AppError) CauseOrSelf() error {
50:	if e.cause != nil {
51:		return e.cause
52:	}
53:	return e
54:}

57:	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
58:	w.WriteHeader(status)
59:	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(v)
```

```text
package publictrace

import (
	"net/http"

	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"

	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
)

// Handler is the thin HTTP layer: extract params, call the service, respond.
type Handler struct {
	service *Service
}

// ScanQR handles GET /public/qr/{qr_code} — the consumer scan.
func (h *Handler) ScanQR(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	qrCode := chi.URLParam(r, "qr_code")
	if qrCode == "" {
		httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_QR_CODE", "qr_code path parameter is required"))
		return
	}
	resp, err := h.service.ScanQR(r.Context(), qrCode)
	if err != nil {
		httpx.Error(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, resp)
}

// VerifyLedger handles GET /public/ledger/verify?from=&to= — the public
// tamper-evidence check.
func (h *Handler) VerifyLedger(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	resp, err := h.service.VerifyLedger(r.Context(), r.URL.Query().Get("from"), r.URL.Query().Get("to"))
	if err != nil {
		httpx.Error(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, resp)
}

// TraceGraph handles GET /trace/{entity_type}/{entity_id} — the official
// upstream+downstream event-graph walk.
func (h *Handler) TraceGraph(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	resp, err := h.service.TraceGraph(r.Context(),
		chi.URLParam(r, "entity_type"), chi.URLParam(r, "entity_id"))
	if err != nil {
		httpx.Error(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, resp)
}

// Timeline handles GET /trace/{entity_type}/{entity_id}/timeline — one
// entity's own events in chain order.
func (h *Handler) Timeline(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	page := httpx.ParsePage(r)
	events, total, err := h.service.Timeline(r.Context(),
		chi.URLParam(r, "entity_type"), chi.URLParam(r, "entity_id"), page)
	if err != nil {
		httpx.Error(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	httpx.JSONMeta(w, http.StatusOK, events, map[string]any{
		"limit":  page.Limit,
		"offset": page.Offset,
		"total":  total,
	})
}
// Package publictrace serves the two faces of milk traceability
// (blueprint §7, §8.4):
//
//   - /public — the consumer QR scan and public ledger tamper-check. These
//     routes are DELIBERATELY unauthenticated: a shopper points a phone at a
//     milk pack and must see its provenance with zero friction. This is not a
//     consumer-account backend (descoped) — the global per-IP rate limit is
//     the only throttle.
//   - /trace  — the official recall / root-cause tools: full upstream +
//     downstream event-graph walks for auditors, mission officials and lab
//     analysts (§8.3: a failed aflatoxin lot walks back to contributing
//     samitis and forward to affected batches and QRs).
//
// The consumer view is the HONEST provenance view (§7.4): pooled milk traces
// to the SET of contributing samitis, never to individual farmers.
package publictrace

import (
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"

	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/middleware"
)

// Register mounts the public QR/ledger routes and the authed trace tools.
func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
	service := NewService(d)
	handler := &Handler{service: service}

	// PUBLIC subtree — no Authenticate middleware by design (see package doc).
	r.Route("/public", func(pub chi.Router) {
		pub.Get("/qr/{qr_code}", handler.ScanQR)
		pub.Get("/ledger/verify", handler.VerifyLedger)
	})

	// Official trace tools — role-gated, read-only, cross-org by nature
	// (a recall walk necessarily spans DCS → BMC → plant boundaries, so no
	// per-resource org-scope check applies here; the role gate is the fence).
	r.Route("/trace", func(tr chi.Router) {
		tr.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
		tr.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(
			domain.RoleMissionOfficial,
			domain.RolePCDFAdmin,
			domain.RoleUnionPresident,
			domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor,
			domain.RolePlantLabAnalyst,
			domain.RoleStateAuditor,
		))
		tr.Get("/{entity_type}/{entity_id}", handler.TraceGraph)
		tr.Get("/{entity_type}/{entity_id}/timeline", handler.Timeline)
	})
}
package publictrace

import (
	"time"

	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/provenance"
)

// ProductInfo is the pack-label subset of a product lot shown to consumers.
type ProductInfo struct {
	Name       string `json:"name"`
	SKU        string `json:"sku"`
	UnitSize   string `json:"unit_size"`
	MfgDate    string `json:"mfg_date"`
	ExpiryDate string `json:"expiry_date"`
}

// PlantInfo identifies the processing plant that produced the batch.
type PlantInfo struct {
	Name     string `json:"name"`
	District string `json:"district,omitempty"`
}

// QualityInfo is the PLANT_LAB pass certificate attached to the batch.
type QualityInfo struct {
	CertificateNumber string          `json:"certificate_number"`
	Stage             string          `json:"stage"`
	Tests             []domain.QCTest `json:"tests"`
	RecordedAt        time.Time       `json:"recorded_at"`
}

// SamitiInfo is one contributing village society (DCS) — the honest pooled
// provenance grain (§7.4): the set of samitis, never individual farmers.
type SamitiInfo struct {
	Name     string `json:"name"`
	Code     string `json:"code"`
	District string `json:"district,omitempty"`
}

// SourcingInfo summarises where and when the milk was collected.
type SourcingInfo struct {
	Message         string       `json:"message"`
	Samitis         []SamitiInfo `json:"samitis"`
	CollectionDates []string     `json:"collection_dates"`
}

// LedgerInfo reports the tamper-evidence check over the traced events.
type LedgerInfo struct {
	Events        int      `json:"events"`
	Intact        bool     `json:"intact"`
	VerifiedRange [2]int64 `json:"verified_range"`
	// Partial is true when the traced span exceeded the per-scan verification
	// cap and only the most recent portion of the range was re-hashed.
	Partial bool `json:"partial,omitempty"`
}

// QRScanResponse is the consumer-facing provenance view for one QR scan.
type QRScanResponse struct {
	Product      ProductInfo  `json:"product"`
	BatchNumber  string       `json:"batch_number"`
	Plant        PlantInfo    `json:"plant"`
	Quality      *QualityInfo `json:"quality,omitempty"`
	Sourcing     SourcingInfo `json:"sourcing"`
	Ledger       LedgerInfo   `json:"ledger"`
	ScanCount    int64        `json:"scan_count"`
	Recalled     bool         `json:"recalled,omitempty"`
	RecallNotice string       `json:"recall_notice,omitempty"`
}

// LedgerVerifyResponse is the public tamper-evidence check result.
type LedgerVerifyResponse struct {
	Intact      bool   `json:"intact"`
	BrokenAtSeq *int64 `json:"broken_at_seq,omitempty"`
	From        int64  `json:"from"`
	To          int64  `json:"to"`
}

// TraceGraphResponse is the full event graph around one entity: upstream
// (what it was made from) and downstream (what it went into).
type TraceGraphResponse struct {
	Upstream   []provenance.Event `json:"upstream"`
	Downstream []provenance.Event `json:"downstream"`
}
```

```go
package middleware

import (
	"net/http"

	chimw "github.com/go-chi/chi/v5/middleware"

	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/audit"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
)

// AuditMutations records every state-changing request (non-GET/HEAD/OPTIONS)
// into the immutable audit trail: actor, action, status, IP, request ID.
// Runs after the handler so the final status code is captured; the write
// itself is async and adds no request latency.
//
// This middleware mounts OUTSIDE the per-module Authenticate middleware, so
// the actor installed on the inner request context never propagates back to
// this frame. An actor holder is installed on the context before the chain
// runs; auth.WithActor fills it, and the identity is read back here so the
// who-did-what contract holds for every HTTP mutation.
func AuditMutations(rec *audit.Recorder) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
		return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			if r.Method == http.MethodGet || r.Method == http.MethodHead || r.Method == http.MethodOptions {
				next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
				return
			}
			r = r.WithContext(auth.WithActorHolder(r.Context()))
			ww := chimw.NewWrapResponseWriter(w, r.ProtoMajor)
			next.ServeHTTP(ww, r)

			entry := audit.Entry{
				Action:    "http." + r.Method + " " + r.URL.Path,
				Status:    ww.Status(),
				IP:        r.RemoteAddr,
				RequestID: chimw.GetReqID(r.Context()),
			}
			if actor, ok := auth.HeldActor(r.Context()); ok {
				entry.ActorPartyID = actor.PartyID
				entry.ActorRole = actor.RoleCode
			}
			rec.Record(r.Context(), entry)
		})
	}
}
```

```go
package platformops

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
)

// TestRenderSMSPourReceiptIncludesQuantity locks the producer↔renderer param
// contract: the collection module queues the pour receipt with the key
// "quantity", and the renderer must surface the litres — the one number a
// low-literacy farmer needs to verify against the analyzer display.
func TestRenderSMSPourReceiptIncludesQuantity(t *testing.T) {
	// Exactly the param keys collection.announcePour produces.
	params := map[string]string{
		"quantity": "10.50",
		"rate":     "52.75",
		"amount":   "553.88",
	}
	english, hindi := renderSMS(domain.TemplatePourReceipt, params)
	if !strings.Contains(english, "10.50") {
		t.Fatalf("english pour receipt %q missing litres 10.50", english)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(hindi, "10.50") {
		t.Fatalf("hindi pour receipt %q missing litres 10.50", hindi)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(english, "52.75") || !strings.Contains(english, "553.88") {
		t.Fatalf("english pour receipt %q missing rate/amount", english)
	}
}

// TestMVUDispatchedPayloadContract round-trips the exact payload cattle
// publishes on eventbus.TopicMVUDispatched through the structural decode and
// asserts the case ID lands — the farmer SMS must never render "(case )".
func TestMVUDispatchedPayloadContract(t *testing.T) {
	published := map[string]any{
		"case_id":         "case-123",
		"farmer_party_id": "party-farmer-mahesh",
		"animal_id":       "animal-gomti",
		"dcs_id":          "org-dcs-1",
	}
	var event mvuDispatchedEvent
	if err := decodeBusPayload(published, &event); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("decodeBusPayload: %v", err)
	}
	caseID := event.CaseID
	if caseID == "" {
		caseID = event.MVUCaseID
	}
	if caseID == "" {
		caseID = event.ID
	}
	if caseID != "case-123" {
		t.Fatalf("case id = %q, want case-123", caseID)
	}
	if event.FarmerPartyID != "party-farmer-mahesh" {
		t.Fatalf("farmer_party_id = %q", event.FarmerPartyID)
	}

	// Tolerance fallback: a raw domain document (ID under "id") still yields
	// a non-empty case reference.
	var fromRaw mvuDispatchedEvent
	if err := decodeBusPayload(map[string]any{"id": "case-raw"}, &fromRaw); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("decodeBusPayload raw: %v", err)
	}
	got := fromRaw.CaseID
	if got == "" {
		got = fromRaw.MVUCaseID
	}
	if got == "" {
		got = fromRaw.ID
	}
	if got != "case-raw" {
		t.Fatalf("raw-document fallback case id = %q, want case-raw", got)
	}
}

// TestRedactNotificationSecrets ensures the login OTP can never be read back
// through the notifications surface — neither via params nor rendered meta.
func TestRedactNotificationSecrets(t *testing.T) {
	n := StoredNotification{
		Notification: domain.Notification{
			TemplateKey: domain.TemplateOTP,
			Params:      map[string]string{"otp": "123456"},
		},
		Meta: map[string]any{
			"provider":    "SMS-MOCK",
			"rendered_en": "Your Saathi OTP is 123456. Do not share it with anyone.",
			"rendered_hi": "आपका साथी OTP 123456 है।",
		},
	}
	redactNotificationSecrets(&n)
	if n.Params["otp"] != redactedValue {
		t.Fatalf("params.otp = %q, want redacted", n.Params["otp"])
	}
	if n.Meta["rendered_en"] != redactedValue || n.Meta["rendered_hi"] != redactedValue {
		t.Fatalf("rendered meta not redacted: %#v", n.Meta)
	}
	if n.Meta["provider"] != "SMS-MOCK" {
		t.Fatalf("non-secret meta must survive redaction, got %#v", n.Meta)
	}

	// Non-OTP templates pass through untouched.
	receipt := StoredNotification{
		Notification: domain.Notification{
			TemplateKey: domain.TemplatePourReceipt,
			Params:      map[string]string{"quantity": "10.50"},
		},
	}
	redactNotificationSecrets(&receipt)
	if receipt.Params["quantity"] != "10.50" {
		t.Fatalf("pour receipt params must not be redacted, got %#v", receipt.Params)
	}
}
```
