```text
29	const collection = "provenance_events"
30	
31	// Ref is a directed edge to another entity in the trace graph
32	// (e.g. a consignment event referencing the pours it aggregates).
33	type Ref struct {
34		EntityType string `bson:"entity_type" json:"entity_type"`
35		EntityID   string `bson:"entity_id"   json:"entity_id"`
36		Relation   string `bson:"relation"    json:"relation"` // aggregates | supersedes | tested | yields | labels ...
37	}
38	
39	// ActorRef records who caused the event.
40	type ActorRef struct {
41		PartyID  string `bson:"party_id"  json:"party_id"`
42		RoleCode string `bson:"role_code" json:"role_code"`
43	}
44	
45	// Event is one immutable link in the ledger.
46	type Event struct {
47		ID         string         `bson:"_id"         json:"id"`
48		Seq        int64          `bson:"seq"         json:"seq"`
49		Type       string         `bson:"type"        json:"type"`
50		EntityType string         `bson:"entity_type" json:"entity_type"`
51		EntityID   string         `bson:"entity_id"   json:"entity_id"`
52		Refs       []Ref          `bson:"refs,omitempty"    json:"refs,omitempty"`
53		Actor      ActorRef       `bson:"actor"       json:"actor"`
54		OrgUnitID  string         `bson:"org_unit_id,omitempty" json:"org_unit_id,omitempty"`
55		Payload    map[string]any `bson:"payload,omitempty"     json:"payload,omitempty"`
56		TS         time.Time      `bson:"ts"          json:"ts"`
57		PrevHash   string         `bson:"prev_hash"   json:"prev_hash"`
58		Hash       string         `bson:"hash"        json:"hash"`
59	}
60	
61	// AppendInput describes a new event to chain.
62	type AppendInput struct {
63		Type       string
64		EntityType string
65		EntityID   string
66		Refs       []Ref
67		Actor      ActorRef
68		OrgUnitID  string
69		Payload    map[string]any
70	}
71	
72	// Ledger appends to and reads the hash chain.
73	type Ledger struct {
74		coll *mongo.Collection
75	
76		// appendMu serialises the head-read+insert of Append within this process:
77		// every ledger write system-wide shares one global seq, so without local
78		// serialisation concurrent handlers (e.g. a morning pour rush plus a
79		// GenerateInvoices loop) burn duplicate-key retries against each other.
80		// The unique seq index remains the atomic backstop across processes.
81		appendMu sync.Mutex
82	}
83	
84	// NewLedger binds the ledger to the database.
85	func NewLedger(db *mongo.Database) *Ledger {
86		return &Ledger{coll: db.Collection(collection)}
87	}
88	
89	// genesisHash anchors the chain before the first event.
90	const genesisHash = "GENESIS"
91	
92	// Append chains a new event. Concurrency-safe without transactions: it reads
93	// the current head, computes seq+hash optimistically, and relies on the
94	// unique index on `seq` — a duplicate-key collision means another writer won
95	// the slot, so we re-read and retry.
96	func (l *Ledger) Append(ctx context.Context, in AppendInput) (*Event, error) {
97		// Serialise appends within this process (see appendMu): local writers no
98		// longer race each other for the seq slot, so under single-instance
99		// deployment the retry loop only ever fires against external writers.
100		l.appendMu.Lock()
101		defer l.appendMu.Unlock()
102	
103		const maxRetries = 12
104		for attempt := 0; attempt < maxRetries; attempt++ {
105			seq, prevHash, err := l.head(ctx)
106			if err != nil {
107				return nil, err
108			}
109			ev := &Event{
110				ID:         uuid.NewString(),
111				Seq:        seq + 1,
112				Type:       in.Type,
113				EntityType: in.EntityType,
114				EntityID:   in.EntityID,
115				Refs:       in.Refs,
116				Actor:      in.Actor,
117				OrgUnitID:  in.OrgUnitID,
118				Payload:    in.Payload,
119				// Millisecond precision: BSON datetimes store ms, so the persisted
120				// TS must equal the hashed TS or re-verification would break.
121				TS:       time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Millisecond),
122				PrevHash: prevHash,
123			}
124			ev.Hash = computeHash(ev)
125	
126			if _, err := l.coll.InsertOne(ctx, ev); err != nil {
127				if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(err) {
128					continue // lost the seq race — retry against the new head
129				}
130				return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance append: %w", err)
131			}
132			return ev, nil
133		}
134		return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance append: gave up after %d seq collisions", 12)
135	}
136	
137	// head returns the latest (seq, hash), or (0, GENESIS) for an empty chain.
138	func (l *Ledger) head(ctx context.Context) (int64, string, error) {
139		var last Event
140		err := l.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{},
141			options.FindOne().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: -1}}),
142		).Decode(&last)
143		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
144			return 0, genesisHash, nil
145		}
146		if err != nil {
147			return 0, "", fmt.Errorf("provenance head: %w", err)
148		}
149		return last.Seq, last.Hash, nil
150	}
151	
152	// computeHash covers everything that matters: position, linkage, content.
153	// Payload is canonicalised via encoding/json (map keys are sorted) and the
154	// timestamp to millisecond precision (BSON datetime resolution), so the
155	// digest is deterministic across a MongoDB round trip.
156	func computeHash(ev *Event) string {
157		payloadJSON, _ := json.Marshal(ev.Payload)
158		refParts := make([]string, 0, len(ev.Refs))
159		for _, r := range ev.Refs {
160			refParts = append(refParts, r.EntityType+":"+r.EntityID+":"+r.Relation)
161		}
162		material := strings.Join([]string{
163			ev.PrevHash,
164			strconv.FormatInt(ev.Seq, 10),
165			ev.Type,
166			ev.EntityType,
167			ev.EntityID,
168			strings.Join(refParts, ","),
169			ev.Actor.PartyID,
170			ev.Actor.RoleCode,
171			ev.OrgUnitID,
172			string(payloadJSON),
173			ev.TS.UTC().Truncate(time.Millisecond).Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
174		}, "|")
175		sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(material))
176		return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
177	}
178	
179	// EventsForEntity returns an entity's own timeline in chain order.
180	func (l *Ledger) EventsForEntity(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string) ([]Event, error) {
181		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
182			bson.D{{Key: "entity_type", Value: entityType}, {Key: "entity_id", Value: entityID}},
183			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}),
184		)
185		if err != nil {
186			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance events for %s/%s: %w", entityType, entityID, err)
187		}
188		var out []Event
189		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
190			return nil, err
191		}
192		return out, nil
193	}
194	
195	// Trace walks the provenance graph UPSTREAM from an entity: its events, plus
196	// (recursively) the events of everything those events reference. This is how
197	// a consumer QR resolves back to the contributing samiti set, and how a failed
198	// aflatoxin test walks back to source DCSes (blueprint §8.3).
199	func (l *Ledger) Trace(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, maxDepth int) ([]Event, error) {
200		return l.TraceStopAt(ctx, entityType, entityID, maxDepth, nil)
201	}
202	
203	// TraceStopAt is Trace with a stop set: entity types in stopExpand are still
204	// fetched (their events appear in the result) but their refs are never
205	// followed. The consumer QR scan stops at the consignment/pooling boundary so
206	// hundreds of per-pour nodes (and cross-route trip fan-out) are never walked.
207	//
208	// Each BFS level is batched into a bounded number of $or queries instead of
209	// one Find per node, so a walk costs O(depth) round trips, not O(nodes).
210	func (l *Ledger) TraceStopAt(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, maxDepth int, stopExpand map[string]bool) ([]Event, error) {
211		if maxDepth <= 0 {
212			maxDepth = 10
213		}
214		const hardEventCap = 2000
215	
216		type node struct{ etype, eid string }
217		visited := map[node]bool{}
218		frontier := []node{{entityType, entityID}}
219		var all []Event
220	
221		for depth := 0; depth < maxDepth && len(frontier) > 0; depth++ {
222			// Deduplicate this level against everything already visited.
223			level := make([]node, 0, len(frontier))
224			for _, n := range frontier {
225				if visited[n] {
226					continue
227				}
228				visited[n] = true
229				level = append(level, n)
230			}
231			if len(level) == 0 {
232				break
233			}
234	
235			var next []node
236			// One indexed query per chunk of the level (not per node).
237			const orChunk = 200
238			for start := 0; start < len(level); start += orChunk {
239				end := min(start+orChunk, len(level))
240				clauses := make(bson.A, 0, end-start)
241				for _, n := range level[start:end] {
242					clauses = append(clauses, bson.D{
243						{Key: "entity_type", Value: n.etype},
244						{Key: "entity_id", Value: n.eid},
245					})
246				}
247				cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
248					bson.D{{Key: "$or", Value: clauses}},
249					options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}).SetLimit(hardEventCap),
250				)
251				if err != nil {
252					return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance trace level: %w", err)
253				}
254				var evs []Event
255				if err := cur.All(ctx, &evs); err != nil {
256					return nil, err
257				}
258				for _, ev := range evs {
259					all = append(all, ev)
260					if len(all) >= hardEventCap {
261						return all, nil
262					}
263					if stopExpand != nil && stopExpand[ev.EntityType] {
264						continue // include the node's events, never follow its refs
265					}
266					for _, ref := range ev.Refs {
267						nn := node{ref.EntityType, ref.EntityID}
268						if !visited[nn] {
269							next = append(next, nn)
270						}
271					}
272				}
273			}
274			frontier = next
275		}
276		return all, nil
277	}
278	
279	// DownstreamRefs finds events that reference the given entity — used to walk
280	// FORWARD (e.g. "which batches consumed this blocked BMC lot?"). The limit is
281	// pushed into the query: only the LAST limit referencing events are fetched
282	// (ascending chain order preserved). limit <= 0 falls back to 2000.
283	func (l *Ledger) DownstreamRefs(ctx context.Context, entityID string, limit int64) ([]Event, error) {
284		if limit <= 0 {
285			limit = 2000
286		}
287		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
288			bson.D{{Key: "refs.entity_id", Value: entityID}},
289			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: -1}}).SetLimit(limit),
290		)
291		if err != nil {
292			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance downstream of %s: %w", entityID, err)
293		}
294		var out []Event
295		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
296			return nil, err
297		}
298		// Restore ascending chain order.
299		for i, j := 0, len(out)-1; i < j; i, j = i+1, j-1 {
300			out[i], out[j] = out[j], out[i]
301		}
302		return out, nil
303	}
304	
305	// EventsForEntityPage returns one page of an entity's own timeline in chain
306	// order, with skip/limit pushed into the query.
307	func (l *Ledger) EventsForEntityPage(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, offset, limit int64) ([]Event, error) {
308		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
309			bson.D{{Key: "entity_type", Value: entityType}, {Key: "entity_id", Value: entityID}},
310			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}).SetSkip(offset).SetLimit(limit),
311		)
312		if err != nil {
313			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance events page for %s/%s: %w", entityType, entityID, err)
314		}
315		var out []Event
316		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
317			return nil, err
318		}
319		return out, nil
320	}
321	
322	// CountEventsForEntity returns the total number of events on an entity's
323	// timeline (pagination meta companion of EventsForEntityPage).
324	func (l *Ledger) CountEventsForEntity(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string) (int64, error) {
325		n, err := l.coll.CountDocuments(ctx,
326			bson.D{{Key: "entity_type", Value: entityType}, {Key: "entity_id", Value: entityID}})
327		if err != nil {
328			return 0, fmt.Errorf("provenance count for %s/%s: %w", entityType, entityID, err)
329		}
330		return n, nil
331	}
332	
333	// VerifyChain re-derives every hash in [fromSeq, toSeq] and checks linkage.
334	// Returns (true, 0) when intact, or (false, seq) of the first broken link.
335	func (l *Ledger) VerifyChain(ctx context.Context, fromSeq, toSeq int64) (bool, int64, error) {
336		filter := bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$gte", Value: fromSeq}, {Key: "$lte", Value: toSeq}}}}
337		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}))
338		if err != nil {
339			return false, 0, fmt.Errorf("provenance verify: %w", err)
340		}
341		defer cur.Close(ctx)
342	
343		prevHash := ""
344		prevSeq := int64(0)
345		first := true
346		for cur.Next(ctx) {
347			var ev Event
348			if err := cur.Decode(&ev); err != nil {
349				return false, 0, err
350			}
351			if computeHash(&ev) != ev.Hash {
352				return false, ev.Seq, nil // content tampered
353			}
354			if !first {
355				if ev.Seq != prevSeq+1 || ev.PrevHash != prevHash {
356					return false, ev.Seq, nil // linkage broken
357				}
358			}
359			prevHash, prevSeq, first = ev.Hash, ev.Seq, false
360		}
361		return true, 0, cur.Err()
362	}
363	
364	// LatestSeq returns the current chain head sequence (0 = empty).
365	func (l *Ledger) LatestSeq(ctx context.Context) (int64, error) {
366		seq, _, err := l.head(ctx)
367		return seq, err
368	}
```

```go
package middleware

import (
	"log/slog"
	"net/http"
	"time"

	chimw "github.com/go-chi/chi/v5/middleware"

	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
)

// RequestLogger emits one structured log line per request — method, path,
// status, duration, request ID, client IP, and the acting party/role when
// authenticated. This is the debugging backbone: every request is traceable
// end-to-end by request_id across handler/service/repo logs.
func RequestLogger(log *slog.Logger) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
		return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			start := time.Now()
			ww := chimw.NewWrapResponseWriter(w, r.ProtoMajor)
			next.ServeHTTP(ww, r)

			attrs := []slog.Attr{
				slog.String("method", r.Method),
				slog.String("path", r.URL.Path),
				slog.Int("status", ww.Status()),
				slog.Int64("duration_ms", time.Since(start).Milliseconds()),
				slog.String("request_id", chimw.GetReqID(r.Context())),
				slog.String("ip", r.RemoteAddr),
			}
			if a, ok := auth.ActorFrom(r.Context()); ok {
				attrs = append(attrs,
					slog.String("actor_party_id", a.PartyID),
					slog.String("actor_role", a.RoleCode),
				)
			}

			level := slog.LevelInfo
			switch {
			case ww.Status() >= 500:
				level = slog.LevelError
			case ww.Status() >= 400:
				level = slog.LevelWarn
			}
			log.LogAttrs(r.Context(), level, "http request", attrs...)
		})
	}
}
```

```text
1	// Package httpapi assembles the HTTP surface: global middleware, operational
2	// endpoints (health/readiness/metrics/version), and the /api/v1 tree where
3	// every domain module mounts its routes.
4	package httpapi
5	
6	import (
7		"context"
8		"net/http"
9		"time"
10	
11		"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
12		chimw "github.com/go-chi/chi/v5/middleware"
13		"github.com/prometheus/client_golang/prometheus/promhttp"
14	
15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
16		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
17		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/middleware"
18	)
19	
20	// Version is stamped via -ldflags at release build time.
21	var Version = "0.1.0-dev"
22	
23	// New builds the fully wired HTTP handler.
24	func New(d *deps.Deps) http.Handler {
25		r := chi.NewRouter()
26	
27		// Order matters: recover innermost-last so panics in anything above are caught.
28		r.Use(chimw.RequestID)
29		r.Use(chimw.RealIP)
30		r.Use(middleware.Metrics)
31		r.Use(middleware.PerIPRateLimit(d.Cfg.RateLimitRPS, d.Cfg.RateLimitBurst))
32		r.Use(chimw.Recoverer)
33		r.Use(chimw.Timeout(30 * time.Second))
34	
35		// Unmatched routes and wrong methods must carry the same JSON error
36		// envelope every other response uses — never chi's plain-text defaults.
37		// (chimw.Timeout's bare 504 on handler deadline is a known, accepted gap.)
38		r.NotFound(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
39			httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.RouteNotFound())
40		})
41		r.MethodNotAllowed(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
42			httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.MethodNotAllowed())
43		})
44	
45		// Operational endpoints — outside /api/v1, never authenticated.
46		r.Get("/healthz", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
47			httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{"status": "ok"})
48		})
49		r.Get("/readyz", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
50			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 2*time.Second)
51			defer cancel()
52			if err := d.DB.Client().Ping(ctx, nil); err != nil {
53				httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Internal(err))
54				return
55			}
56			httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{"status": "ready"})
57		})
58		r.Handle("/metrics", promhttp.Handler())
59		r.Get("/version", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
60			httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{"version": Version, "service": "saathi-backend"})
61		})
62	
63		r.Route("/api/v1", func(api chi.Router) {
64			// Inner Route() calls create fresh chi Muxes — re-register the JSON
65			// 404/405 handlers so the envelope also covers /api/v1 subtrees.
66			api.NotFound(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
67				httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.RouteNotFound())
68			})
69			api.MethodNotAllowed(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
70				httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.MethodNotAllowed())
71			})
72			api.Use(middleware.AuditMutations(d.Audit))
73			RegisterModules(api, d)
74		})
75	
76		return r
77	}
```

```go
// Command seed loads idempotent baseline data for development and demos:
// the cooperative org tree (PCDF → union → plant/BMC/DCS per the PCDF
// constitution), one party per MVP role, an active rate chart, and sample
// animals.
//
// ID scheme: `_id` is always a Mongo-generated ObjectID. Seeding is
// idempotent via NATURAL business keys (org `code`, party `phone`, animal
// `pashu_aadhaar`) — find-or-insert on the key, then wire relations with the
// returned ObjectIDs. Re-running never duplicates and never rewrites.
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"time"

	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo/options"

	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/config"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/mongodb"
)

func main() {
	if err := run(); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "seed failed:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

func run() error {
	cfg, err := config.Load()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 60*time.Second)
	defer cancel()

	client, db, err := mongodb.Connect(ctx, cfg.MongoURI, cfg.MongoDB)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer client.Disconnect(context.Background())

	if err := mongodb.EnsureIndexes(ctx, db); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	now := time.Now().UTC()

	// ── Org tree (find-or-insert by unique `code`) ──────────────────────────
	federation, err := upsertOrg(ctx, db, domain.OrgUnit{
		Type: domain.OrgTypeFederation, Name: "PCDF / Parag (Uttar Pradesh)", Code: "PCDF",
		Path: []primitive.ObjectID{}, State: "Uttar Pradesh", Active: true, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	union, err := upsertOrg(ctx, db, domain.OrgUnit{
		Type: domain.OrgTypeMilkUnion, Name: "Lucknow Dugdh Utpadak Sahkari Sangh", Code: "UNION-LKO",
		ParentID: &federation.ID, Path: []primitive.ObjectID{federation.ID},
		District: "Lucknow", State: "Uttar Pradesh", Active: true, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	plant, err := upsertOrg(ctx, db, domain.OrgUnit{
		Type: domain.OrgTypeProcessingPlant, Name: "Parag Dairy Plant, Lucknow", Code: "PLANT-LKO-01",
		ParentID: &union.ID, Path: []primitive.ObjectID{federation.ID, union.ID},
		District: "Lucknow", State: "Uttar Pradesh", Active: true, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	bmc, err := upsertOrg(ctx, db, domain.OrgUnit{
		Type: domain.OrgTypeBMC, Name: "BMC Malihabad", Code: "BMC-LKO-007",
		ParentID: &union.ID, Path: []primitive.ObjectID{federation.ID, union.ID},
		District: "Lucknow", State: "Uttar Pradesh", Active: true, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	dcs1, err := upsertOrg(ctx, db, domain.OrgUnit{
		Type: domain.OrgTypeDCS, Name: "DCS Kasmandi Kalan", Code: "DCS-01842",
		ParentID: &bmc.ID, Path: []primitive.ObjectID{federation.ID, union.ID, bmc.ID},
		District: "Lucknow", State: "Uttar Pradesh", Active: true, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	dcs2, err := upsertOrg(ctx, db, domain.OrgUnit{
		Type: domain.OrgTypeDCS, Name: "DCS Rahimabad", Code: "DCS-01907",
		ParentID: &bmc.ID, Path: []primitive.ObjectID{federation.ID, union.ID, bmc.ID},
		District: "Lucknow", State: "Uttar Pradesh", Active: true, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	orgs := []*domain.OrgUnit{federation, union, plant, bmc, dcs1, dcs2}

	// ── Parties (find-or-insert by unique `phone`) + role assignments ───────
	type seedParty struct {
		phone, name, lang, tier, role string
		org                           primitive.ObjectID
	}
	seeds := []seedParty{
		{cfg.SeedAdminPhone, "Platform Admin", "en", domain.KYCTierHighest, domain.RoleSuperAdmin, federation.ID},
		{"9000000001", "Ramesh Kumar", "hi", domain.KYCTierHigh, domain.RoleSamitiSacheev, dcs1.ID},
		{"9000000002", "Sunita Devi", "hi", domain.KYCTierHigh, domain.RoleSamitiAdhyaksh, dcs1.ID},
		{"9000000003", "Anil Verma", "hi", domain.KYCTierStandard, domain.RoleMilkTester, dcs1.ID},
		{"9000000011", "Mahesh Yadav", "hi", domain.KYCTierFarmer, domain.RoleFarmer, dcs1.ID},
		{"9000000012", "Geeta Devi", "hi", domain.KYCTierFarmer, domain.RoleFarmer, dcs1.ID},
		{"9000000021", "Salim Khan", "hi", domain.KYCTierRider, domain.RoleVanRider, union.ID},
		{"9000000031", "Vikas Singh", "hi", domain.KYCTierStandard, domain.RoleBMCOperator, bmc.ID},
		{"9000000041", "Rajeev Ranjan", "hi", domain.KYCTierHigh, domain.RolePlantOperator, plant.ID},
		{"9000000042", "Priya Sharma", "en", domain.KYCTierHigh, domain.RolePlantLabAnalyst, plant.ID},
		{"9000000061", "Dr. A. K. Verma", "hi", domain.KYCTierHigh, domain.RoleVeterinarian, union.ID},
		// Organising Manager — the ground-level field worker who captures and
		// first-level-approves KYC (Dairy Development Department pattern).
		{"9000000071", "Kavita Nishad", "hi", domain.KYCTierHigh, domain.RoleOrganisingManager, union.ID},
		{"9000000051", "Arjun Mehta", "en", domain.KYCTierMinimal, domain.RoleConsumer, federation.ID},
	}

	var mahesh, geeta primitive.ObjectID
	for _, sp := range seeds {
		party, err := upsertParty(ctx, db, domain.Party{
			Phone: sp.phone, FullName: sp.name, PreferredLanguage: sp.lang,
			KYCTier: sp.tier, Status: domain.PartyStatusActive, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now,
		})
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("party %s: %w", sp.name, err)
		}
		if err := upsertRoleAssignment(ctx, db, domain.RoleAssignment{
			PartyID: party.ID, RoleCode: sp.role, OrgUnitID: sp.org,
			ValidFrom: now.Add(-24 * time.Hour), Status: domain.RoleAssignmentActive, CreatedAt: now,
		}); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("role %s→%s: %w", sp.name, sp.role, err)
		}
		switch sp.phone {
		case "9000000011":
			mahesh = party.ID
		case "9000000012":
			geeta = party.ID
		}
		fmt.Printf("  party %-16s %-22s %s\n", sp.phone, sp.role, party.ID.Hex())
	}

	// ── Rate chart (find-or-insert by org+name) ─────────────────────────────
	admin, err := upsertParty(ctx, db, domain.Party{Phone: cfg.SeedAdminPhone, Status: domain.PartyStatusActive, KYCTier: domain.KYCTierHighest, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := upsertByFilter(ctx, db.Collection(mongodb.CollRateCharts),
		bson.D{{Key: "org_unit_id", Value: union.ID}, {Key: "name", Value: "Union LKO standard 2026"}},
		domain.RateChart{
			OrgUnitID: union.ID, Name: "Union LKO standard 2026",
			BaseRatePerLitre: 8.0, FatRatePerPoint: 5.5, SNFRatePerPoint: 1.0,
			EffectiveFrom: now.Add(-30 * 24 * time.Hour), Active: true,
			CreatedBy: admin.ID, CreatedAt: now,
		}); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("rate chart: %w", err)
	}

	// ── Sample animals (find-or-insert by unique pashu_aadhaar) ─────────────
	animals := []domain.Animal{
		{PashuAadhaar: "356729481027", OwnerPartyID: mahesh, DCSID: dcs1.ID, Species: "COW", Breed: "Sahiwal", Sex: "F", LactationStatus: "LACTATING", Status: domain.AnimalStatusActive, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now},
		{PashuAadhaar: "356729481034", OwnerPartyID: geeta, DCSID: dcs1.ID, Species: "BUFFALO", Breed: "Murrah", Sex: "F", LactationStatus: "LACTATING", Status: domain.AnimalStatusActive, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now},
	}
	for _, a := range animals {
		if err := upsertByFilter(ctx, db.Collection(mongodb.CollAnimals),
			bson.D{{Key: "pashu_aadhaar", Value: a.PashuAadhaar}}, a); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("animal %s: %w", a.PashuAadhaar, err)
		}
	}

	fmt.Println("✔ seed complete:")
	for _, o := range orgs {
		fmt.Printf("  org %-14s %-28s %s\n", o.Code, o.Name, o.ID.Hex())
	}
	fmt.Printf("  super admin phone: %s (OTP_DEV_MODE returns the OTP in the login response)\n", cfg.SeedAdminPhone)
	fmt.Println("  demo phones: sacheev 9000000001 · adhyaksh 9000000002 · farmer 9000000011 · rider 9000000021")
	fmt.Println("               bmc-op 9000000031 · plant-op 9000000041 · lab 9000000042 · org-manager 9000000071")
	return nil
}

// upsertOrg finds-or-inserts an org unit by its unique code and returns the
// stored document (with its generated ObjectID).
func upsertOrg(ctx context.Context, db *mongo.Database, o domain.OrgUnit) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
	var out domain.OrgUnit
	err := db.Collection(mongodb.CollOrgUnits).FindOneAndUpdate(ctx,
		bson.D{{Key: "code", Value: o.Code}},
		bson.D{{Key: "$setOnInsert", Value: o}},
		options.FindOneAndUpdate().SetUpsert(true).SetReturnDocument(options.After),
	).Decode(&out)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("org %s: %w", o.Code, err)
	}
	return &out, nil
}

// upsertParty finds-or-inserts a party by its unique phone.
func upsertParty(ctx context.Context, db *mongo.Database, p domain.Party) (*domain.Party, error) {
	var out domain.Party
	err := db.Collection(mongodb.CollParties).FindOneAndUpdate(ctx,
		bson.D{{Key: "phone", Value: p.Phone}},
		bson.D{{Key: "$setOnInsert", Value: p}},
		options.FindOneAndUpdate().SetUpsert(true).SetReturnDocument(options.After),
	).Decode(&out)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &out, nil
}

// upsertRoleAssignment finds-or-inserts by the (party, role, org) natural key.
func upsertRoleAssignment(ctx context.Context, db *mongo.Database, ra domain.RoleAssignment) error {
	_, err := db.Collection(mongodb.CollRoleAssignments).UpdateOne(ctx,
		bson.D{
			{Key: "party_id", Value: ra.PartyID},
			{Key: "role_code", Value: ra.RoleCode},
			{Key: "org_unit_id", Value: ra.OrgUnitID},
		},
		bson.D{{Key: "$setOnInsert", Value: ra}},
		options.Update().SetUpsert(true),
	)
	return err
}

// upsertByFilter inserts doc if nothing matches filter (generic natural-key upsert).
func upsertByFilter(ctx context.Context, coll *mongo.Collection, filter bson.D, doc any) error {
	_, err := coll.UpdateOne(ctx, filter,
		bson.D{{Key: "$setOnInsert", Value: doc}},
		options.Update().SetUpsert(true),
	)
	return err
}
```

You are migrating one module of the Saathi backend (Go + MongoDB) at /Users/divyanshmangla/parag-saathi-be to a NEW foundation contract. Go: export PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH".

MANDATORY FIRST STEP — re-read the changed contract (it was rewritten; your module no longer compiles):
- /Users/divyanshmangla/parag-saathi-be/internal/domain/ (ALL files) — every entity now uses primitive.ObjectID for _id (bson "_id,omitempty") and for ALL cross-collection references; OPTIONAL references are *primitive.ObjectID. Human-readable strings (org code, phone, invoice_number, batch_number, qr_code, pashu_aadhaar, client_event_id) are separate unique business keys — NEVER used for joins.
- /Users/divyanshmangla/parag-saathi-be/internal/platform/httpx/ids.go — httpx.ParseID(hex, field) and httpx.PathID(r, "id") for parsing.
- /Users/divyanshmangla/parag-saathi-be/internal/platform/orgscope/resolver.go — Get(ctx, primitive.ObjectID), GetByCode(ctx, code), InScope/RequireInScope now take ObjectIDs (actor org parsed internally).
- /Users/divyanshmangla/parag-saathi-be/internal/platform/auth/ — JWT claims + Actor still carry ObjectIDs as HEX STRINGS (JWTs are JSON). Parse with httpx.ParseID when querying.
- /Users/divyanshmangla/parag-saathi-be/internal/platform/provenance/ledger.go — Event._id is ObjectID; EntityID/Refs/Actor fields REMAIN hex strings: pass yourID.Hex().
- /Users/divyanshmangla/parag-saathi-be/internal/platform/flags/service.go — Flag now has ObjectID _id + unique Key; the Service API (Enabled/Set/All by key) is UNCHANGED.
- /Users/divyanshmangla/parag-saathi-be/internal/platform/middleware/requestlog.go — request logging exists globally; do not duplicate it.

MIGRATION RULES for your module (internal/modules/<name>/ ONLY — never touch other dirs, no new deps):
1. Repos: filters/updates use primitive.ObjectID values for _id and reference fields. Insert with the domain struct (omitempty _id) and read back InsertedID, OR pre-generate primitive.NewObjectID() and set it before insert when you need the ID for provenance refs in the same flow (prefer pre-generation — it keeps insert+ledger consistent).
2. Handlers: path params via httpx.PathID(r, "id"). Request DTOs: primitive.ObjectID fields unmarshal from plain hex JSON strings natively — use them; for optional ones use *primitive.ObjectID. Query params: httpx.ParseID.
3. Actor identity: actorID, err := httpx.ParseID(actor.PartyID, "actor") — helper it once per service.
4. Ledger calls: EntityID: id.Hex(); refs likewise; OrgUnitID: orgID.Hex().
5. ObjectID equality is == (comparable). Empty check: id.IsZero().
6. STRUCTURED LOGGING (new hard requirement — debugging must be easy):
   - In Register/wiring, derive a module logger: log := d.Log.With(slog.String("module", "<name>")) and pass it to the service.
   - INFO on every successful creation/state transition: entity type, id (hex), key business fields, actor party id. Example: log.InfoContext(ctx, "pour recorded", slog.String("pour_id", ...), slog.String("farmer_party_id", ...), slog.Float64("amount", ...)).
   - WARN on every business rejection: gate blocks, dual-control violations, scope denials, idempotent replays, integrity flags, state-machine 409s — with the reason and ids.
   - ERROR on unexpected failures (before returning httpx.Internal) with slog.Any("err", err) and operation context.
   - Repo errors: wrap with operation context (fmt.Errorf("insert pour: %w", err)) so the ERROR log names the failing op. No fmt.Print anywhere.
7. Keep ALL existing behaviour (statuses, gates, provenance events, bus topics, RBAC, pagination totals) — this is a migration plus logging, not a redesign, except where your module-specific spec below says otherwise.
8. Update your module's _test.go files to the new types; keep them passing.
VERIFY before finishing: cd /Users/divyanshmangla/parag-saathi-be && export PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH" && go build ./internal/modules/<name>/... && go vet ./internal/modules/<name>/... && go test ./internal/modules/<name>/... (NEVER ./... — other agents are writing in parallel).
Return the structured output only.

=== YOUR MODULE ===
MODULE identity — migration PLUS the new KYC APPROVAL WORKFLOW (the user's flow: login → submit KYC → admin/ground-staff approval → only then the role login works).
Behaviour changes:
A. POST /kyc/aadhaar {aadhaar_number, consent, requested_tier} — requested_tier ∈ {FARMER, STANDARD, RIDER, HIGH}; creates KYCRecord with RequestedTier + status=PENDING. NO auto-verify, NO tier change (delete the mock auto-approve). Masking rules unchanged (last4 + vault ref only). If the party already has a PENDING record for the same requested_tier, return that one (200) instead of duplicating. Response includes status PENDING and a human message "awaiting verification".
B. POST /kyc/bank — unchanged mock penny-drop, attaches bank fields to the party's latest KYC record (any status) or creates a PENDING one carrying just bank evidence.
C. NEW GET /kyc/pending?limit&offset — RequireRoles(ORGANISING_MANAGER, DISTRICT_VERIFIER, PCDF_ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN); newest-first PENDING records enriched with party {id, phone, full_name, current kyc_tier}; meta carries total. Audit-record the access (action "kyc.pending_list").
D. NEW POST /kyc/{id}/approve — same roles; record must be PENDING (else 409 KYC_NOT_PENDING); service checks domain.CanApproveKYCTier(actor.RoleCode, record.RequestedTier) — even SUPER_ADMIN goes through the map (it allows everything) — else 403 KYC_TIER_NOT_APPROVABLE; set VERIFIED + reviewed_by/reviewed_by_role/reviewed_at/verified_at; upgrade party.kyc_tier ONLY upward (if !domain.KYCTierSatisfies(current, requested) → set requested); insert notifications doc TemplateKYCApproved {tier} to the party's phone; d.Audit.Record "kyc.approve" target the record; INFO log.
E. NEW POST /kyc/{id}/reject {reason} — same roles + same approvable-tier check; PENDING→REJECTED + rejection_reason + reviewed_by; TemplateKYCRejected notification; audit "kyc.reject"; WARN log.
F. Role-grant matrix: additionally allow ORGANISING_MANAGER to grant FARMER and CONSUMER within their org scope (RequireInScope). Role select logic unchanged — with auto-verify gone it now genuinely blocks un-approved users (403 KYC_TIER_INSUFFICIENT).
G. Migration: all party/assignment/kyc/consent/refresh-token lookups by ObjectID; refresh_tokens.party_id becomes ObjectID; otp_challenges keyed by phone (string, unchanged).
Tests: update existing; ADD table-driven tests for CanApproveKYCTier enforcement and the PENDING→VERIFIED party-tier upgrade (upward only).

```text
1	// Package orgscope answers the RBAC question "is this resource inside the
2	// caller's organisational scope?" in O(1) DB reads. Org units denormalise
3	// their ancestor chain into Path ([]ObjectID), so scope checking is a
4	// set-membership test — no recursive tree walks on the hot path.
5	package orgscope
6	
7	import (
8		"context"
9		"errors"
10		"sync"
11		"time"
12	
13		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
14		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
15		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
16	
17		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
18		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
19		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
20	)
21	
22	const collection = "org_units"
23	
24	type cachedOrg struct {
25		org domain.OrgUnit
26		at  time.Time
27	}
28	
29	// Resolver caches org units briefly (the tree changes rarely, reads are hot).
30	type Resolver struct {
31		coll *mongo.Collection
32		ttl  time.Duration
33	
34		mu    sync.RWMutex
35		cache map[string]cachedOrg // keyed by ObjectID hex
36	}
37	
38	// NewResolver binds the resolver to the database.
39	func NewResolver(db *mongo.Database) *Resolver {
40		return &Resolver{
41			coll:  db.Collection(collection),
42			ttl:   60 * time.Second,
43			cache: make(map[string]cachedOrg),
44		}
45	}
46	
47	// Get returns an org unit by ObjectID (cached).
48	func (r *Resolver) Get(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
49		key := id.Hex()
50		r.mu.RLock()
51		c, ok := r.cache[key]
52		r.mu.RUnlock()
53		if ok && time.Since(c.at) < r.ttl {
54			org := c.org
55			return &org, nil
56		}
57	
58		var org domain.OrgUnit
59		err := r.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&org)
60		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
61			return nil, httpx.NotFound("org unit " + key)
62		}
63		if err != nil {
64			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
65		}
66	
67		r.mu.Lock()
68		r.cache[key] = cachedOrg{org: org, at: time.Now()}
69		r.mu.Unlock()
70		return &org, nil
71	}
72	
73	// GetByCode returns an org unit by its unique human-readable business code
74	// (e.g. "DCS-01842") — display/lookup use only, never for joins.
75	func (r *Resolver) GetByCode(ctx context.Context, code string) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
76		var org domain.OrgUnit
77		err := r.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "code", Value: code}}).Decode(&org)
78		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
79			return nil, httpx.NotFound("org unit with code " + code)
80		}
81		if err != nil {
82			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
83		}
84		return &org, nil
85	}
86	
87	// Invalidate drops a cached entry (call after updates).
88	func (r *Resolver) Invalidate(id primitive.ObjectID) {
89		r.mu.Lock()
90		delete(r.cache, id.Hex())
91		r.mu.Unlock()
92	}
93	
94	// InScope reports whether target sits at-or-below scope in the hierarchy:
95	// true when scope == target, or scope appears in target's ancestor Path.
96	func (r *Resolver) InScope(ctx context.Context, scopeOrgID, targetOrgID primitive.ObjectID) (bool, error) {
97		if scopeOrgID == targetOrgID {
98			return true, nil
99		}
100		target, err := r.Get(ctx, targetOrgID)
101		if err != nil {
102			return false, err
103		}
104		for _, ancestor := range target.Path {
105			if ancestor == scopeOrgID {
106				return true, nil
107			}
108		}
109		return false, nil
110	}
111	
112	// RequireInScope enforces the actor's org scope over a target org unit.
113	// SUPER_ADMIN and STATE_AUDITOR (read-wide roles rooted at the federation)
114	// pass automatically; everyone else needs ancestry. The actor carries its
115	// org unit as an ObjectID hex string (JWT claims are JSON); it is parsed here.
116	func (r *Resolver) RequireInScope(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, targetOrgID primitive.ObjectID) error {
117		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSuperAdmin || actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleStateAuditor {
118			return nil
119		}
120		if actor.OrgUnitID == "" {
121			return httpx.Forbidden("role token with org scope required")
122		}
123		scopeID, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(actor.OrgUnitID)
124		if err != nil {
125			return httpx.Forbidden("role token carries an invalid org scope")
126		}
127		ok, err := r.InScope(ctx, scopeID, targetOrgID)
128		if err != nil {
129			return err
130		}
131		if !ok {
132			return httpx.Forbidden("resource is outside your organisational scope")
133		}
134		return nil
135	}
136
```

```text
1	package domain
2	
3	import (
4		"fmt"

8		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
9	)
10	
11	// Collection shifts.
12	const (
13		ShiftMorning = "MORNING"
14		ShiftEvening = "EVENING"
15	)
16	
17	// Plausibility bounds for analyzer values (blueprint §8.2 integrity checks).
18	// Values outside these bounds are physically implausible for raw milk and are
19	// flagged instead of silently accepted.
20	const (
21		PlausibleFatMin = 2.0
22		PlausibleFatMax = 12.0
23		PlausibleSNFMin = 7.0
24		PlausibleSNFMax = 11.5
25		PlausibleQtyMin = 0.1   // litres per pour
26		PlausibleQtyMax = 200.0 // litres per pour
27	)
28	
29	// RateChart prices milk from fat/SNF, scoped to an org unit (union or
30	// federation). rate/L = BaseRatePerLitre + Fat%*FatRatePerPoint + SNF%*SNFRatePerPoint.
31	type RateChart struct {
32		ID               primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
33		OrgUnitID        primitive.ObjectID `bson:"org_unit_id"   json:"org_unit_id"`
34		Name             string             `bson:"name"          json:"name"`
35		BaseRatePerLitre float64            `bson:"base_rate_per_litre" json:"base_rate_per_litre"`
36		FatRatePerPoint  float64            `bson:"fat_rate_per_point"  json:"fat_rate_per_point"`
37		SNFRatePerPoint  float64            `bson:"snf_rate_per_point"  json:"snf_rate_per_point"`
38		EffectiveFrom    time.Time          `bson:"effective_from"      json:"effective_from"`
39		Active           bool               `bson:"active"        json:"active"`
40		CreatedBy        primitive.ObjectID `bson:"created_by"    json:"created_by"`
41		CreatedAt        time.Time          `bson:"created_at"    json:"created_at"`
42	}
43	
44	// PricePour computes (ratePerLitre, amount) for a pour, rounded to paise.
45	func (rc RateChart) PricePour(fatPct, snfPct, qtyLitres float64) (rate, amount float64) {
46		rate = rc.BaseRatePerLitre + fatPct*rc.FatRatePerPoint + snfPct*rc.SNFRatePerPoint
47		rate = math.Round(rate*100) / 100
48		amount = math.Round(rate*qtyLitres*100) / 100
49		return rate, amount
50	}
51	
52	// Analyzer reading ingestion modes (blueprint §8.2): direct device integration
53	// is the tamper-resistant end-state; photo-OCR is the legacy bridge.
54	const (
55		ReadingModeDirect   = "ANALYZER_DIRECT"
56		ReadingModePhotoOCR = "PHOTO_OCR"
57		ReadingModeManual   = "MANUAL"
58	)
59	
60	// Integrity flags attached to readings by the anti-tamper checks.
61	const (
62		IntegrityFlagLowOCRConfidence = "LOW_OCR_CONFIDENCE"
63		IntegrityFlagImplausibleValue = "IMPLAUSIBLE_VALUE"
64		IntegrityFlagMissingGeotag    = "MISSING_GEOTAG"
65		IntegrityFlagClockSkew        = "DEVICE_CLOCK_SKEW"
66		IntegrityFlagManualEntry      = "MANUAL_ENTRY"

94	// CheckPlausibility validates fat/SNF/qty against physical bounds and returns
95	// the violated flags (empty slice = plausible).
96	func CheckPlausibility(fatPct, snfPct, qtyLitres float64) []string {
97		var flags []string
98		if fatPct < PlausibleFatMin || fatPct > PlausibleFatMax ||
99			snfPct < PlausibleSNFMin || snfPct > PlausibleSNFMax {
100			flags = append(flags, IntegrityFlagImplausibleValue)
101		}
102		if qtyLitres != 0 && (qtyLitres < PlausibleQtyMin || qtyLitres > PlausibleQtyMax) {
103			flags = append(flags, IntegrityFlagImplausibleValue)
104		}
105		return flags
106	}

176	// DateKeyIST formats t as the YYYY-MM-DD settlement-day key in IST.
177	func DateKeyIST(t time.Time) string {
178		ist := time.FixedZone("IST", 5*3600+1800)
179		return t.In(ist).Format("2006-01-02")
```

 `./internal/platform/orgscope/resolver.go`

```text
1	// Package orgscope answers the RBAC question "is this resource inside the
2	// caller's organisational scope?" in O(1) DB reads. Org units denormalise
3	// their ancestor chain into Path ([]ObjectID), so scope checking is a
4	// set-membership test — no recursive tree walks on the hot path.
5	package orgscope
6	
7	import (
8		"context"
9		"errors"
10		"sync"
11		"time"
12	
13		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
14		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
15		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
16	
17		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
18		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
19		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
20	)
21	
22	const collection = "org_units"
23	
24	type cachedOrg struct {
25		org domain.OrgUnit
26		at  time.Time
27	}
28	
29	// Resolver caches org units briefly (the tree changes rarely, reads are hot).
30	type Resolver struct {
31		coll *mongo.Collection
32		ttl  time.Duration
33	
34		mu    sync.RWMutex
35		cache map[string]cachedOrg // keyed by ObjectID hex
36	}
37	
38	// NewResolver binds the resolver to the database.
39	func NewResolver(db *mongo.Database) *Resolver {
40		return &Resolver{
41			coll:  db.Collection(collection),
42			ttl:   60 * time.Second,
43			cache: make(map[string]cachedOrg),
44		}
45	}
46	
47	// Get returns an org unit by ObjectID (cached).
48	func (r *Resolver) Get(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
49		key := id.Hex()
50		r.mu.RLock()
51		c, ok := r.cache[key]
52		r.mu.RUnlock()
53		if ok && time.Since(c.at) < r.ttl {
54			org := c.org
55			return &org, nil
56		}
57	
58		var org domain.OrgUnit
59		err := r.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&org)
60		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
61			return nil, httpx.NotFound("org unit " + key)
62		}
63		if err != nil {
64			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
65		}
66	
67		r.mu.Lock()
68		r.cache[key] = cachedOrg{org: org, at: time.Now()}
69		r.mu.Unlock()
70		return &org, nil
71	}
72	
73	// GetByCode returns an org unit by its unique human-readable business code
74	// (e.g. "DCS-01842") — display/lookup use only, never for joins.
75	func (r *Resolver) GetByCode(ctx context.Context, code string) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
76		var org domain.OrgUnit
77		err := r.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "code", Value: code}}).Decode(&org)
78		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
79			return nil, httpx.NotFound("org unit with code " + code)
80		}
81		if err != nil {
82			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
83		}
84		return &org, nil
85	}
86	
87	// Invalidate drops a cached entry (call after updates).
88	func (r *Resolver) Invalidate(id primitive.ObjectID) {
89		r.mu.Lock()
90		delete(r.cache, id.Hex())
91		r.mu.Unlock()
92	}
93	
94	// InScope reports whether target sits at-or-below scope in the hierarchy:
95	// true when scope == target, or scope appears in target's ancestor Path.
96	func (r *Resolver) InScope(ctx context.Context, scopeOrgID, targetOrgID primitive.ObjectID) (bool, error) {
97		if scopeOrgID == targetOrgID {
98			return true, nil
99		}
100		target, err := r.Get(ctx, targetOrgID)
101		if err != nil {
102			return false, err
103		}
104		for _, ancestor := range target.Path {
105			if ancestor == scopeOrgID {
106				return true, nil
107			}
108		}
109		return false, nil
110	}
111	
112	// RequireInScope enforces the actor's org scope over a target org unit.
113	// SUPER_ADMIN and STATE_AUDITOR (read-wide roles rooted at the federation)
114	// pass automatically; everyone else needs ancestry. The actor carries its
115	// org unit as an ObjectID hex string (JWT claims are JSON); it is parsed here.
116	func (r *Resolver) RequireInScope(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, targetOrgID primitive.ObjectID) error {
117		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSuperAdmin || actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleStateAuditor {
118			return nil
119		}
120		if actor.OrgUnitID == "" {
121			return httpx.Forbidden("role token with org scope required")
122		}
123		scopeID, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(actor.OrgUnitID)
124		if err != nil {
125			return httpx.Forbidden("role token carries an invalid org scope")
126		}
127		ok, err := r.InScope(ctx, scopeID, targetOrgID)
128		if err != nil {
129			return err
130		}
131		if !ok {
132			return httpx.Forbidden("resource is outside your organisational scope")
133		}
134		return nil
135	}
136
```
</details></tool-use>

```text
24		TestAntibiotic  = "ANTIBIOTIC_TETRACYCLINE" // mg/kg

58		Stage             string             `bson:"stage"         json:"stage"`
59		Tests             []QCTest           `bson:"tests"         json:"tests"`
60		OverallPass       bool               `bson:"overall_pass"  json:"overall_pass"`
61		FailureReasons    []string           `bson:"failure_reasons,omitempty" json:"failure_reasons,omitempty"`
62		AnalystPartyID    primitive.ObjectID `bson:"analyst_party_id" json:"analyst_party_id"`
63		LabRef            string             `bson:"lab_ref,omitempty"            json:"lab_ref,omitempty"`
64		CertificateNumber string             `bson:"certificate_number,omitempty" json:"certificate_number,omitempty"`
65		// Superseded marks a result voided after losing the gate race — the
66		// verdict on the subject came from a different, earlier result.
67		Superseded    bool      `bson:"superseded,omitempty" json:"superseded,omitempty"`
68		RecordedAt    time.Time `bson:"recorded_at"   json:"recorded_at"`
69		ProvenanceSeq int64     `bson:"provenance_seq,omitempty" json:"provenance_seq,omitempty"`
70	}
71	
72	// EvaluateQCTests applies the FSSAI gate to a set of tests: it fills each
73	// test's Pass verdict and returns the overall verdict plus human-readable
74	// failure reasons. Unknown test names are recorded but do not gate.
75	func EvaluateQCTests(tests []QCTest) (overallPass bool, failures []string, evaluated []QCTest) {
76		overallPass = true
77		evaluated = make([]QCTest, 0, len(tests))
78		for _, t := range tests {
79			pass := true
80			switch t.Name {
81			case TestAflatoxinM1:
82				if t.Value > FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg {
83					pass = false
84					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
85						"AFLATOXIN_M1 %.3f µg/kg exceeds FSSAI limit %.1f µg/kg", t.Value, FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg))
86				}
87			case TestColiform:
88				if t.Value > FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl {
89					pass = false
90					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
91						"COLIFORM %.1f CFU/ml exceeds FSSAI limit %.0f CFU/ml", t.Value, FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl))
92				}
93			case TestAntibiotic:
94				if t.Value > FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg {
95					pass = false
96					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
97						"ANTIBIOTIC_TETRACYCLINE %.3f mg/kg exceeds MRL %.1f mg/kg", t.Value, FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg))
98				}
99			case TestPhosphatase:
100				if t.Value != 0 {
101					pass = false
102					failures = append(failures, "PHOSPHATASE positive — pasteurisation check failed (must be negative)")
103				}
104			}
105			t.Pass = pass
106			if !pass {
107				overallPass = false
108			}
109			evaluated = append(evaluated, t)
110		}
111		return overallPass, failures, evaluated
112	}
113
```
</details></tool-use>

```text
10	// ParseID converts an ObjectID hex string (from JSON bodies, query params or
11	// JWT claims) into a primitive.ObjectID, or returns a 400 with the offending
12	// field name.
13	func ParseID(hex, field string) (primitive.ObjectID, error) {
14		id, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(hex)
15		if err != nil {
16			return primitive.NilObjectID, BadRequest("INVALID_ID", field+" must be a valid object id")
17		}
18		return id, nil
19	}
20	
21	// PathID extracts a chi URL parameter and parses it as an ObjectID.
22	func PathID(r *http.Request, param string) (primitive.ObjectID, error) {
23		return ParseID(chi.URLParam(r, param), param)
24	}
```

```text
1	// Package orgscope answers the RBAC question "is this resource inside the
2	// caller's organisational scope?" in O(1) DB reads. Org units denormalise
3	// their ancestor chain into Path ([]ObjectID), so scope checking is a
4	// set-membership test — no recursive tree walks on the hot path.
5	package orgscope
6	
7	import (
8		"context"
9		"errors"
10		"sync"
11		"time"
12	
13		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
14		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
15		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
16	
17		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
18		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
19		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
20	)
21	
22	const collection = "org_units"
23	
24	type cachedOrg struct {
25		org domain.OrgUnit
26		at  time.Time
27	}
28	
29	// Resolver caches org units briefly (the tree changes rarely, reads are hot).
30	type Resolver struct {
31		coll *mongo.Collection
32		ttl  time.Duration
33	
34		mu    sync.RWMutex
35		cache map[string]cachedOrg // keyed by ObjectID hex
36	}
37	
38	// NewResolver binds the resolver to the database.
39	func NewResolver(db *mongo.Database) *Resolver {
40		return &Resolver{
41			coll:  db.Collection(collection),
42			ttl:   60 * time.Second,
43			cache: make(map[string]cachedOrg),
44		}
45	}
46	
47	// Get returns an org unit by ObjectID (cached).
48	func (r *Resolver) Get(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
49		key := id.Hex()
50		r.mu.RLock()
51		c, ok := r.cache[key]
52		r.mu.RUnlock()
53		if ok && time.Since(c.at) < r.ttl {
54			org := c.org
55			return &org, nil
56		}
57	
58		var org domain.OrgUnit
59		err := r.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&org)
60		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
61			return nil, httpx.NotFound("org unit " + key)
62		}
63		if err != nil {
64			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
65		}
66	
67		r.mu.Lock()
68		r.cache[key] = cachedOrg{org: org, at: time.Now()}
69		r.mu.Unlock()
70		return &org, nil
71	}
72	
73	// GetByCode returns an org unit by its unique human-readable business code
74	// (e.g. "DCS-01842") — display/lookup use only, never for joins.
75	func (r *Resolver) GetByCode(ctx context.Context, code string) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
76		var org domain.OrgUnit
77		err := r.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "code", Value: code}}).Decode(&org)
78		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
79			return nil, httpx.NotFound("org unit with code " + code)
80		}
81		if err != nil {
82			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
83		}
84		return &org, nil
85	}
86	
87	// Invalidate drops a cached entry (call after updates).
88	func (r *Resolver) Invalidate(id primitive.ObjectID) {
89		r.mu.Lock()
90		delete(r.cache, id.Hex())
91		r.mu.Unlock()
92	}
93	
94	// InScope reports whether target sits at-or-below scope in the hierarchy:
95	// true when scope == target, or scope appears in target's ancestor Path.
96	func (r *Resolver) InScope(ctx context.Context, scopeOrgID, targetOrgID primitive.ObjectID) (bool, error) {
97		if scopeOrgID == targetOrgID {
98			return true, nil
99		}
100		target, err := r.Get(ctx, targetOrgID)
101		if err != nil {
102			return false, err
103		}
104		for _, ancestor := range target.Path {
105			if ancestor == scopeOrgID {
106				return true, nil
107			}
108		}
109		return false, nil
110	}
111	
112	// RequireInScope enforces the actor's org scope over a target org unit.
113	// SUPER_ADMIN and STATE_AUDITOR (read-wide roles rooted at the federation)
114	// pass automatically; everyone else needs ancestry. The actor carries its
115	// org unit as an ObjectID hex string (JWT claims are JSON); it is parsed here.
116	func (r *Resolver) RequireInScope(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, targetOrgID primitive.ObjectID) error {
117		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSuperAdmin || actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleStateAuditor {
118			return nil
119		}
120		if actor.OrgUnitID == "" {
121			return httpx.Forbidden("role token with org scope required")
122		}
123		scopeID, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(actor.OrgUnitID)
124		if err != nil {
125			return httpx.Forbidden("role token carries an invalid org scope")
126		}
127		ok, err := r.InScope(ctx, scopeID, targetOrgID)
128		if err != nil {
129			return err
130		}
131		if !ok {
132			return httpx.Forbidden("resource is outside your organisational scope")
133		}
134		return nil
135	}
136
```
</details></tool-use>

```text
36		FatRatePerPoint  float64            `bson:"fat_rate_per_point"  json:"fat_rate_per_point"`

44	// PricePour computes (ratePerLitre, amount) for a pour, rounded to paise.
45	func (rc RateChart) PricePour(fatPct, snfPct, qtyLitres float64) (rate, amount float64) {
46		rate = rc.BaseRatePerLitre + fatPct*rc.FatRatePerPoint + snfPct*rc.SNFRatePerPoint
47		rate = math.Round(rate*100) / 100
48		amount = math.Round(rate*qtyLitres*100) / 100
49		return rate, amount
50	}

94	// CheckPlausibility validates fat/SNF/qty against physical bounds and returns
95	// the violated flags (empty slice = plausible).
96	func CheckPlausibility(fatPct, snfPct, qtyLitres float64) []string {
97		var flags []string
98		if fatPct < PlausibleFatMin || fatPct > PlausibleFatMax ||
99			snfPct < PlausibleSNFMin || snfPct > PlausibleSNFMax {
100			flags = append(flags, IntegrityFlagImplausibleValue)
101		}
102		if qtyLitres != 0 && (qtyLitres < PlausibleQtyMin || qtyLitres > PlausibleQtyMax) {
103			flags = append(flags, IntegrityFlagImplausibleValue)
104		}
105		return flags
106	}

176	// DateKeyIST formats t as the YYYY-MM-DD settlement-day key in IST.
177	func DateKeyIST(t time.Time) string {
178		ist := time.FixedZone("IST", 5*3600+1800)
179		return t.In(ist).Format("2006-01-02")
180	}
```

```text
53	// UsableAt reports whether the assignment is active and inside its validity
54	// window at instant t.
55	func (ra RoleAssignment) UsableAt(t time.Time) bool {
56		if ra.Status != RoleAssignmentActive {
57			return false
58		}
59		if t.Before(ra.ValidFrom) {
60			return false
61		}
62		if ra.ValidTo != nil && t.After(*ra.ValidTo) {
63			return false
64		}
65		return true
66	}
```

```text
1	package httpx
2	
3	import (
4		"net/http"
5	
6		"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
7		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
8	)
9	
10	// ParseID converts an ObjectID hex string (from JSON bodies, query params or
11	// JWT claims) into a primitive.ObjectID, or returns a 400 with the offending
12	// field name.
13	func ParseID(hex, field string) (primitive.ObjectID, error) {
14		id, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(hex)
15		if err != nil {
16			return primitive.NilObjectID, BadRequest("INVALID_ID", field+" must be a valid object id")
17		}
18		return id, nil
19	}
20	
21	// PathID extracts a chi URL parameter and parses it as an ObjectID.
22	func PathID(r *http.Request, param string) (primitive.ObjectID, error) {
23		return ParseID(chi.URLParam(r, param), param)
24	}
25
```

```text
2	// invariants shared by every module. It has no behaviour beyond validation
3	// and no dependencies outside the standard library and BSON primitives.
4	// This is the contract layer: modules depend on domain, never the other way
5	// around.

7

9	// cooperative constitution (Farmer → Samiti/DCS → Sangh/Union → PCDF).
10	// A Party may hold many time-bounded, org-scoped RoleAssignments.
11	//

13	// new constant + AllRoles entry + RequiredKYCTier entry — nothing else.

134	// kycRank orders tiers so "tier X satisfies requirement Y" is a comparison.
135	var kycRank = map[string]int{
136		KYCTierMinimal:  0,
137		KYCTierFarmer:   1,
138		KYCTierStandard: 1, // Farmer and Standard are parallel tier-1 proofs
139		KYCTierRider:    2,

143	}

145	// KYCTierSatisfies reports whether a party at tier `have` meets `need`.
146	// Parallel tier-1 proofs (FARMER vs STANDARD) satisfy each other.
147	func KYCTierSatisfies(have, need string) bool {
148		h, okH := kycRank[have]
149		n, okN := kycRank[need]
150		if !okH || !okN {
151			return false
152		}
153		return h >= n
154	}
155	
156	// KYCApprovableTiers maps an approver ROLE to the KYC tiers it may approve.
157	// Ground staff clear the field tiers; only federation admins clear HIGH;
158	// only SUPER_ADMIN clears HIGHEST. Extend when new approver roles arrive.
159	var KYCApprovableTiers = map[string][]string{
160		RoleOrganisingManager: {KYCTierMinimal, KYCTierFarmer, KYCTierStandard, KYCTierRider},
161		RoleDistrictVerifier:  {KYCTierMinimal, KYCTierFarmer, KYCTierStandard, KYCTierRider},
162		RolePCDFAdmin:         {KYCTierMinimal, KYCTierFarmer, KYCTierStandard, KYCTierRider, KYCTierHigh},
163		RoleSuperAdmin:        {KYCTierMinimal, KYCTierFarmer, KYCTierStandard, KYCTierRider, KYCTierHigh, KYCTierHighest, KYCTierService},
164	}
165	
166	// CanApproveKYCTier reports whether approverRole may approve a KYC record
167	// requesting the given tier.
168	func CanApproveKYCTier(approverRole, tier string) bool {
169		for _, t := range KYCApprovableTiers[approverRole] {
170			if t == tier {
171				return true
172			}
173		}
174		return false
175	}
```

```text
1	// Package orgscope answers the RBAC question "is this resource inside the
2	// caller's organisational scope?" in O(1) DB reads. Org units denormalise
3	// their ancestor chain into Path ([]ObjectID), so scope checking is a
4	// set-membership test — no recursive tree walks on the hot path.
5	package orgscope
6	
7	import (
8		"context"
9		"errors"
10		"sync"
11		"time"
12	
13		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
14		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
15		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
16	
17		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
18		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
19		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
20	)
21	
22	const collection = "org_units"
23	
24	type cachedOrg struct {
25		org domain.OrgUnit
26		at  time.Time
27	}
28	
29	// Resolver caches org units briefly (the tree changes rarely, reads are hot).
30	type Resolver struct {
31		coll *mongo.Collection
32		ttl  time.Duration
33	
34		mu    sync.RWMutex
35		cache map[string]cachedOrg // keyed by ObjectID hex
36	}
37	
38	// NewResolver binds the resolver to the database.
39	func NewResolver(db *mongo.Database) *Resolver {
40		return &Resolver{
41			coll:  db.Collection(collection),
42			ttl:   60 * time.Second,
43			cache: make(map[string]cachedOrg),
44		}
45	}
46	
47	// Get returns an org unit by ObjectID (cached).
48	func (r *Resolver) Get(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
49		key := id.Hex()
50		r.mu.RLock()
51		c, ok := r.cache[key]
52		r.mu.RUnlock()
53		if ok && time.Since(c.at) < r.ttl {
54			org := c.org
55			return &org, nil
56		}
57	
58		var org domain.OrgUnit
59		err := r.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&org)
60		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
61			return nil, httpx.NotFound("org unit " + key)
62		}
63		if err != nil {
64			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
65		}
66	
67		r.mu.Lock()
68		r.cache[key] = cachedOrg{org: org, at: time.Now()}
69		r.mu.Unlock()
70		return &org, nil
71	}
72	
73	// GetByCode returns an org unit by its unique human-readable business code
74	// (e.g. "DCS-01842") — display/lookup use only, never for joins.
75	func (r *Resolver) GetByCode(ctx context.Context, code string) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
76		var org domain.OrgUnit
77		err := r.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "code", Value: code}}).Decode(&org)
78		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
79			return nil, httpx.NotFound("org unit with code " + code)
80		}
81		if err != nil {
82			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
83		}
84		return &org, nil
85	}
86	
87	// Invalidate drops a cached entry (call after updates).
88	func (r *Resolver) Invalidate(id primitive.ObjectID) {
89		r.mu.Lock()
90		delete(r.cache, id.Hex())
91		r.mu.Unlock()
92	}
93	
94	// InScope reports whether target sits at-or-below scope in the hierarchy:
95	// true when scope == target, or scope appears in target's ancestor Path.
96	func (r *Resolver) InScope(ctx context.Context, scopeOrgID, targetOrgID primitive.ObjectID) (bool, error) {
97		if scopeOrgID == targetOrgID {
98			return true, nil
99		}
100		target, err := r.Get(ctx, targetOrgID)
101		if err != nil {
102			return false, err
103		}
104		for _, ancestor := range target.Path {
105			if ancestor == scopeOrgID {
106				return true, nil
107			}
108		}
109		return false, nil
110	}
111	
112	// RequireInScope enforces the actor's org scope over a target org unit.
113	// SUPER_ADMIN and STATE_AUDITOR (read-wide roles rooted at the federation)
114	// pass automatically; everyone else needs ancestry. The actor carries its
115	// org unit as an ObjectID hex string (JWT claims are JSON); it is parsed here.
116	func (r *Resolver) RequireInScope(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, targetOrgID primitive.ObjectID) error {
117		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSuperAdmin || actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleStateAuditor {
118			return nil
119		}
120		if actor.OrgUnitID == "" {
121			return httpx.Forbidden("role token with org scope required")
122		}
123		scopeID, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(actor.OrgUnitID)
124		if err != nil {
125			return httpx.Forbidden("role token carries an invalid org scope")
126		}
127		ok, err := r.InScope(ctx, scopeID, targetOrgID)
128		if err != nil {
129			return err
130		}
131		if !ok {
132			return httpx.Forbidden("resource is outside your organisational scope")
133		}
134		return nil
135	}
136
```

```text
7		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
8	)
9	
10	// ParseID converts an ObjectID hex string (from JSON bodies, query params or
11	// JWT claims) into a primitive.ObjectID, or returns a 400 with the offending
12	// field name.
13	func ParseID(hex, field string) (primitive.ObjectID, error) {
14		id, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(hex)
15		if err != nil {
16			return primitive.NilObjectID, BadRequest("INVALID_ID", field+" must be a valid object id")
17		}
18		return id, nil
19	}
20	
21	// PathID extracts a chi URL parameter and parses it as an ObjectID.
22	func PathID(r *http.Request, param string) (primitive.ObjectID, error) {
23		return ParseID(chi.URLParam(r, param), param)
24	}
```

```text
28		scanVerifySpanCap = 5000

53	// Service resolves consumer QR scans and official trace queries. All reads,
54	// no writes except the fire-and-forget scan counter — nothing here ever
55	// mutates provenance.
56	type Service struct {
57		log      *slog.Logger
58		repo     *repo
59		ledger   *provenance.Ledger
60		orgs     *orgscope.Resolver
61		qrSecret string
62	
63		// Incremental verification watermark: the chain is verified cumulatively
64		// across scans, so a repeat scan whose traced range is already covered
65		// answers O(1) instead of re-hashing thousands of interleaved events on
66		// the hottest public endpoint. Per-instance; a restart re-verifies.
67		verifyMu     sync.Mutex
68		verifiedUpTo int64
69		chainBroken  bool
70		brokenAtSeq  int64
71	}

73	// NewService wires the service from the shared dependency container.
74	func NewService(d *deps.Deps) *Service {
75		return &Service{
76			log:      d.Log,
77			repo:     newRepo(d.DB),
78			ledger:   d.Ledger,
79			orgs:     d.Orgs,
80			qrSecret: d.Cfg.QRSigningSecret,
```
