```text
84	// VerifyQRToken checks a stored signed token in the format QR issuance
85	// (plant module signQRToken) mints: "base64url(qr_code|product_lot_id|
86	// issued_unix)" + "." + hex(HMAC-SHA256(secret, decoded payload)). The HMAC
87	// is computed over the DECODED payload bytes — exactly what issuance signed.
88	// The comparison is constant-time so a forger learns nothing from response
89	// timing.
90	func VerifyQRToken(secret, token string) bool {
91		payloadB64, signature, found := strings.Cut(token, ".")
92		if !found || payloadB64 == "" || signature == "" {
93			return false // malformed: no payload/signature split
94		}
95		payload, err := base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString(payloadB64)
96		if err != nil || len(payload) == 0 {
97			return false // malformed: payload is not valid base64url
98		}
99		expected := auth.HMACHash(secret, string(payload))
100		return auth.ConstantTimeEqual(expected, signature)
101	}
102	
103	// ScanQR resolves one consumer QR scan into the honest provenance view
104	// (§7.4): product + plant + lab certificate + the SET of contributing
105	// samitis — never per-farmer data — plus a live tamper-evidence check.
106	func (s *Service) ScanQR(ctx context.Context, qrCode string) (*QRScanResponse, error) {
107		qr, err := s.repo.qrByCode(ctx, qrCode)
108		if err != nil {
109			return nil, err
110		}
111	
112		// Integrity gate: the stored token must carry a valid HMAC. A mismatch
113		// means the QR record was tampered with or forged — surface it loudly.
114		if !VerifyQRToken(s.qrSecret, qr.SignedToken) {
115			s.log.Warn("QR signed-token integrity check failed — possible forgery",
116				slog.String("qr_code", qrCode), slog.String("qr_id", qr.ID))
117			return nil, httpx.Conflict("QR_INTEGRITY_FAILED",
118				"this QR code failed integrity verification and may be counterfeit")
119		}
120	
121		// Count the scan without ever blocking it: fire-and-forget increment.
122		go func(qrID string) {
123			bg, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
124			defer cancel()
125			if err := s.repo.incrementScanCount(bg, qrID); err != nil {
126				s.log.Warn("scan_count increment failed", slog.String("qr_id", qrID), slog.Any("err", err))
127			}
128		}(qr.ID)
129	
130		lot, err := s.repo.productLotByID(ctx, qr.ProductLotID)
131		if err != nil {
132			return nil, err
133		}
134		batch, err := s.repo.batchByID(ctx, lot.BatchID)
135		if err != nil {
136			return nil, err
137		}
138		plant, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, batch.PlantID)
139		if err != nil {
140			return nil, err
141		}
142	
143		// Walk the provenance graph upstream from the product lot and STOP at the
144		// pooling boundary: batch → BMC lots → consignments (§7.4). Consignment
145		// refs (hundreds of per-pour nodes, cross-route trip fan-out) are never
146		// expanded — the consumer view only needs the samiti set.
147		events, err := s.ledger.TraceStopAt(ctx, domain.EntityProductLot, lot.ID, traceDepth,
148			map[string]bool{domain.EntityConsignment: true})
149		if err != nil {
150			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
151		}
152	
153		sourcing, err := s.buildSourcing(ctx, events)
154		if err != nil {
155			return nil, err
156		}
157	
158		ledgerInfo, err := s.verifyTracedRange(ctx, events)
159		if err != nil {
160			return nil, err
161		}
162	
163		resp := &QRScanResponse{
164			Product: ProductInfo{
165				Name:       lot.ProductName,
166				SKU:        lot.SKU,
167				UnitSize:   lot.UnitSize,
168				MfgDate:    lot.MfgDate,
169				ExpiryDate: lot.ExpiryDate,
170			},
171			BatchNumber: batch.BatchNumber,
172			Plant:       PlantInfo{Name: plant.Name, District: plant.District},
173			Sourcing:    *sourcing,
174			Ledger:      *ledgerInfo,
175			ScanCount:   qr.ScanCount + 1, // reflect this scan; the $inc lands async
176		}
177	
178		// PLANT_LAB pass certificate — omitted (not an error) when absent.
179		qc, err := s.repo.latestPlantLabPass(ctx, batch.ID)
180		if err != nil {
181			return nil, err
182		}
183		if qc != nil {
184			resp.Quality = &QualityInfo{
185				CertificateNumber: qc.CertificateNumber,
186				Stage:             qc.Stage,
187				Tests:             qc.Tests,
188				RecordedAt:        qc.RecordedAt,
189			}
190		}
191	
192		// A recalled lot still resolves with 200 — consumers must SEE the recall
193		// notice, not hit a dead link.
194		if lot.Status == domain.ProductLotStatusRecalled {
195			resp.Recalled = true
196			notice := "This product lot has been RECALLED. Do not consume — return it to the point of purchase."
197			if lot.RecallReason != "" {
198				notice += " Reason: " + lot.RecallReason
199			}
200			resp.RecallNotice = notice
201		}
202		return resp, nil
203	}
204	
205	// buildSourcing derives the samiti-set view from traced consignment events:
206	// contributing DCS org ids from each event's org_unit_id/payload, collection
207	// dates from payloads, with the consignment documents as fallback when the
208	// events did not carry those fields.
209	func (s *Service) buildSourcing(ctx context.Context, events []provenance.Event) (*SourcingInfo, error) {
210		dcsIDs := map[string]struct{}{}
211		dates := map[string]struct{}{}
212		consignmentIDs := map[string]struct{}{}
213	
214		for _, ev := range events {
215			if ev.EntityType != domain.EntityConsignment {
216				continue
217			}
218			consignmentIDs[ev.EntityID] = struct{}{}
219			// Only created/dispatched events carry the DCS in org_unit_id —
220			// consignment.picked_up is appended by logistics under the UNION's
221			// org id, which must never be counted as a contributing samiti.
222			switch ev.Type {
223			case domain.EventConsignmentCreated, domain.EventConsignmentDispatched:
224				if ev.OrgUnitID != "" {
225					dcsIDs[ev.OrgUnitID] = struct{}{}
226				} else if v, ok := ev.Payload["dcs_id"].(string); ok && v != "" {
227					dcsIDs[v] = struct{}{}
228				}
229			}
230			if v, ok := ev.Payload["date"].(string); ok && v != "" {
231				dates[v] = struct{}{}
232			}
233		}
234	
235		// Fallback: if the events lacked DCS ids or dates, read the consignment
236		// docs themselves (still samiti-level — pour ids are never surfaced).
237		if len(consignmentIDs) > 0 && (len(dcsIDs) == 0 || len(dates) == 0) {
238			docs, err := s.repo.consignmentsByIDs(ctx, sortedKeys(consignmentIDs))
239			if err != nil {
240				return nil, err
241			}
242			for _, c := range docs {
243				if c.DCSID != "" {
244					dcsIDs[c.DCSID] = struct{}{}
245				}
246				if c.Date != "" {
247					dates[c.Date] = struct{}{}
248				}
249			}
250		}
251	
252		samitis := make([]SamitiInfo, 0, len(dcsIDs))
253		districts := map[string]struct{}{}
254		for _, id := range sortedKeys(dcsIDs) {
255			org, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, id)
256			if err != nil {
257				// A missing org unit must not break a consumer scan — log and skip.
258				s.log.Warn("QR scan: contributing DCS org not resolvable",
259					slog.String("dcs_org_id", id), slog.Any("err", err))
260				continue
261			}
262			// Defence in depth: the §7.4 samiti set may only contain DCS units.
263			if org.Type != domain.OrgTypeDCS {
264				s.log.Warn("QR scan: non-DCS org unit skipped from samiti set",
265					slog.String("org_id", id), slog.String("org_type", org.Type))
266				continue
267			}
268			samitis = append(samitis, SamitiInfo{Name: org.Name, Code: org.Code, District: org.District})
269			if org.District != "" {
270				districts[org.District] = struct{}{}
271			}
272		}
273		sort.Slice(samitis, func(i, j int) bool { return samitis[i].Name < samitis[j].Name })
274	
275		collectionDates := sortedKeys(dates)
276		return &SourcingInfo{
277			Message:         sourcingMessage(collectionDates, len(samitis), sortedKeys(districts)),
278			Samitis:         samitis,
279			CollectionDates: collectionDates,
280		}, nil
281	}
282	
283	// sourcingMessage renders the consumer-facing pooled-provenance sentence,
284	// e.g. "Made from milk collected on 2026-07-05 from 3 samitis in Lucknow".
285	func sourcingMessage(dates []string, samitiCount int, districts []string) string {
286		var b strings.Builder
287		b.WriteString("Made from milk collected")
288		if len(dates) > 0 {
289			b.WriteString(" on " + strings.Join(dates, ", "))
290		}
291		noun := "samitis"
292		if samitiCount == 1 {
293			noun = "samiti"
294		}
295		fmt.Fprintf(&b, " from %d %s", samitiCount, noun)
296		if len(districts) > 0 {
297			b.WriteString(" in " + strings.Join(districts, ", "))
298		}
299		return b.String()
300	}
301	
302	// verifyTracedRange answers the per-scan tamper-evidence check from a
303	// cumulative verification watermark: the chain is verified incrementally up
304	// to the traced range's max seq, and once a prefix is verified, later scans
305	// inside it are O(1) — no per-request re-hash of thousands of interleaved
306	// events. Spans over scanVerifySpanCap are verified partially (most recent
307	// tail) and flagged, matching the previous per-scan behaviour.
308	func (s *Service) verifyTracedRange(ctx context.Context, events []provenance.Event) (*LedgerInfo, error) {
309		if len(events) == 0 {
310			return &LedgerInfo{Events: 0, Intact: true, VerifiedRange: [2]int64{0, 0}}, nil
311		}
312		maxSeq := events[0].Seq
313		for _, ev := range events[1:] {
314			if ev.Seq > maxSeq {
315				maxSeq = ev.Seq
316			}
317		}
318	
319		s.verifyMu.Lock()
320		defer s.verifyMu.Unlock()
321	
322		if s.chainBroken {
323			return &LedgerInfo{
324				Events:        len(events),
325				Intact:        false,
326				VerifiedRange: [2]int64{s.brokenAtSeq, s.brokenAtSeq},
327			}, nil
328		}
329		if maxSeq <= s.verifiedUpTo {
330			return &LedgerInfo{
331				Events:        len(events),
332				Intact:        true,
333				VerifiedRange: [2]int64{1, s.verifiedUpTo},
334			}, nil
335		}
336	
337		// Extend the watermark: start at the last verified event (re-hashing it
338		// covers the boundary linkage), capped to the per-request span budget.
339		from, partial := max(int64(1), s.verifiedUpTo), false
340		if maxSeq-from+1 > scanVerifySpanCap {
341			from, partial = maxSeq-scanVerifySpanCap+1, true
342		}
343		intact, brokenAt, err := s.ledger.VerifyChain(ctx, from, maxSeq)
344		if err != nil {
345			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
346		}
347		if intact {
348			s.verifiedUpTo = maxSeq
349		} else {
350			s.chainBroken, s.brokenAtSeq = true, brokenAt
351		}
352		return &LedgerInfo{
353			Events:        len(events),
354			Intact:        intact,
355			VerifiedRange: [2]int64{from, maxSeq},
356			Partial:       partial,
357		}, nil
358	}
359	
360	// VerifyLedger runs the public tamper-evidence check over [from,to]. Both
361	// bounds are optional: `to` defaults to the chain head, `from` to the start
362	// of the last publicVerifySpanCap events. Spans over the cap are rejected.
363	func (s *Service) VerifyLedger(ctx context.Context, fromRaw, toRaw string) (*LedgerVerifyResponse, error) {
364		latest, err := s.ledger.LatestSeq(ctx)
365		if err != nil {
366			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
367		}
368		if latest == 0 {
369			return &LedgerVerifyResponse{Intact: true, From: 0, To: 0}, nil // empty chain is trivially intact
370		}
371	
372		to := latest
373		if toRaw != "" {
374			n, err := strconv.ParseInt(toRaw, 10, 64)
375			if err != nil || n < 1 {
376				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_RANGE", "'to' must be a positive sequence number")
377			}
378			to = min(n, latest)
379		}
380		from := max(int64(1), to-publicVerifySpanCap+1)
381		if fromRaw != "" {
382			n, err := strconv.ParseInt(fromRaw, 10, 64)
383			if err != nil || n < 1 {
384				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_RANGE", "'from' must be a positive sequence number")
385			}
386			from = n
387		}
388		if from > to {
389			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_RANGE", "'from' must not exceed 'to'")
390		}
391		if to-from+1 > publicVerifySpanCap {
392			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("SPAN_TOO_WIDE",
393				fmt.Sprintf("verification span is capped at %d events per request", publicVerifySpanCap))
394		}
395	
396		intact, brokenAt, err := s.ledger.VerifyChain(ctx, from, to)
397		if err != nil {
398			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
399		}
400		resp := &LedgerVerifyResponse{Intact: intact, From: from, To: to}
401		if !intact {
402			resp.BrokenAtSeq = &brokenAt
403		}
404		return resp, nil
405	}
406	
407	// TraceGraph returns the full event graph around one entity: upstream via
408	// the recursive ref walk, downstream via reverse-ref lookup — the recall /
409	// root-cause tool (§8.3).
410	func (s *Service) TraceGraph(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string) (*TraceGraphResponse, error) {
411		if err := validateEntityType(entityType); err != nil {
412			return nil, err
413		}
414		upstream, err := s.ledger.Trace(ctx, entityType, entityID, traceDepth)
415		if err != nil {
416			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
417		}
418		// The cap is pushed into the query: only the LAST downstreamEventCap
419		// referencing events are fetched, instead of decoding an unbounded set
420		// into memory and truncating afterwards.
421		downstream, err := s.ledger.DownstreamRefs(ctx, entityID, downstreamEventCap)
422		if err != nil {
423			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
424		}
425		if len(upstream) == 0 && len(downstream) == 0 {
426			return nil, httpx.NotFound("provenance for entity")
427		}
428		if upstream == nil {
429			upstream = []provenance.Event{}
430		}
431		if downstream == nil {
432			downstream = []provenance.Event{}
433		}
434		return &TraceGraphResponse{Upstream: upstream, Downstream: downstream}, nil
435	}
436	
437	// Timeline returns one entity's own events in chain order, paginated. The
438	// skip/limit is pushed into the Mongo query so a page read never loads the
439	// entity's full history. The second return value is the total event count.
440	func (s *Service) Timeline(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, page httpx.Page) ([]provenance.Event, int, error) {
441		if err := validateEntityType(entityType); err != nil {
442			return nil, 0, err
443		}
444		total, err := s.ledger.CountEventsForEntity(ctx, entityType, entityID)
445		if err != nil {
446			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
447		}
448		if total == 0 {
449			return nil, 0, httpx.NotFound("provenance for entity")
450		}
451		events, err := s.ledger.EventsForEntityPage(ctx, entityType, entityID, page.Offset, page.Limit)
452		if err != nil {
453			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
454		}
455		return events, int(total), nil
456	}
457	
458	// validateEntityType rejects entity types outside the domain.Entity* catalog.
459	func validateEntityType(entityType string) error {
460		if _, ok := validEntityTypes[entityType]; !ok {
461			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_ENTITY_TYPE",
462				"unknown entity type "+entityType+" — use one of the provenance entity type constants")
463		}
464		return nil
465	}
466	
467	// sortedKeys returns a set's keys in deterministic (lexicographic) order.
468	func sortedKeys(set map[string]struct{}) []string {
469		out := make([]string, 0, len(set))
470		for k := range set {
471			out = append(out, k)
472		}
473		sort.Strings(out)
474		return out
475	}
```

```text
1	// Package logistics moves sealed milk from village societies to chilling
2	// centres (blueprint §7.1): a Samiti Sacheev pools a shift's RECORDED pours
3	// into a DCS consignment and dispatches it; a van rider runs a route trip
4	// that picks consignments up stop by stop, logs cold-chain temperatures in
5	// transit, and hands the load to a BMC. Every hop is chained into the
6	// provenance ledger so the pour→QR trace survives the pooling boundary.
7	package logistics
8	
9	import (
10		"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
11	
12		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"

17	// Register mounts the logistics routes under /logistics (the router hands us
18	// the /api/v1 subtree) and wires handler → service → repo.
19	func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
20		svc := newService(newRepo(d.DB), d.Orgs, d.Ledger)
21		h := &handler{svc: svc}
22	
23		r.Route("/logistics", func(r chi.Router) {
24			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
25	
26			r.Route("/consignments", func(r chi.Router) {
27				sacheevOnly := middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSamitiSacheev)
28				r.With(sacheevOnly).Post("/", h.createConsignment)
29				r.With(sacheevOnly).Post("/{consignmentID}/dispatch", h.dispatchConsignment)
30				r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(
31					domain.RoleSamitiSacheev, domain.RoleSamitiAdhyaksh, domain.RoleVanRider,
32					domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor, domain.RoleBMCOperator,
33				)).Get("/", h.listConsignments)
34			})
35	
36			r.Route("/trips", func(r chi.Router) {
37				riderOnly := middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleVanRider)
38				tripReaders := middleware.RequireRoles(
39					domain.RoleVanRider, domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor, domain.RoleUnionPresident,
40				)
41				r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor, domain.RoleVanRider)).
42					Post("/", h.createTrip)
43				r.With(riderOnly).Post("/{tripID}/stops/{consignmentID}/pickup", h.pickupStop)
44				r.With(riderOnly).Post("/{tripID}/cold-chain", h.logColdChain)
45				r.With(riderOnly).Post("/{tripID}/deliver", h.deliverTrip)
46				r.With(tripReaders).Get("/", h.listTrips)
47				r.With(tripReaders).Get("/{tripID}", h.getTrip)
48			})
```

```text
1	// Package orgscope answers the RBAC question "is this resource inside the
2	// caller's organisational scope?" in O(1) DB reads. Org units denormalise
3	// their ancestor chain into Path ([]ObjectID), so scope checking is a
4	// set-membership test — no recursive tree walks on the hot path.
5	package orgscope
6	
7	import (
8		"context"
9		"errors"
10		"sync"
11		"time"
12	
13		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
14		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
15		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
16	
17		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
18		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
19		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
20	)
21	
22	const collection = "org_units"
23	
24	type cachedOrg struct {
25		org domain.OrgUnit
26		at  time.Time
27	}
28	
29	// Resolver caches org units briefly (the tree changes rarely, reads are hot).
30	type Resolver struct {
31		coll *mongo.Collection
32		ttl  time.Duration
33	
34		mu    sync.RWMutex
35		cache map[string]cachedOrg // keyed by ObjectID hex
36	}
37	
38	// NewResolver binds the resolver to the database.
39	func NewResolver(db *mongo.Database) *Resolver {
40		return &Resolver{
41			coll:  db.Collection(collection),
42			ttl:   60 * time.Second,
43			cache: make(map[string]cachedOrg),
44		}
45	}
46	
47	// Get returns an org unit by ObjectID (cached).
48	func (r *Resolver) Get(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
49		key := id.Hex()
50		r.mu.RLock()
51		c, ok := r.cache[key]
52		r.mu.RUnlock()
53		if ok && time.Since(c.at) < r.ttl {
54			org := c.org
55			return &org, nil
56		}
57	
58		var org domain.OrgUnit
59		err := r.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&org)
60		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
61			return nil, httpx.NotFound("org unit " + key)
62		}
63		if err != nil {
64			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
65		}
66	
67		r.mu.Lock()
68		r.cache[key] = cachedOrg{org: org, at: time.Now()}
69		r.mu.Unlock()
70		return &org, nil
71	}
72	
73	// GetByCode returns an org unit by its unique human-readable business code
74	// (e.g. "DCS-01842") — display/lookup use only, never for joins.
75	func (r *Resolver) GetByCode(ctx context.Context, code string) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
76		var org domain.OrgUnit
77		err := r.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "code", Value: code}}).Decode(&org)
78		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
79			return nil, httpx.NotFound("org unit with code " + code)
80		}
81		if err != nil {
82			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
83		}
84		return &org, nil
85	}
86	
87	// Invalidate drops a cached entry (call after updates).
88	func (r *Resolver) Invalidate(id primitive.ObjectID) {
89		r.mu.Lock()
90		delete(r.cache, id.Hex())
91		r.mu.Unlock()
92	}
93	
94	// InScope reports whether target sits at-or-below scope in the hierarchy:
95	// true when scope == target, or scope appears in target's ancestor Path.
96	func (r *Resolver) InScope(ctx context.Context, scopeOrgID, targetOrgID primitive.ObjectID) (bool, error) {
97		if scopeOrgID == targetOrgID {
98			return true, nil
99		}
100		target, err := r.Get(ctx, targetOrgID)
101		if err != nil {
102			return false, err
103		}
104		for _, ancestor := range target.Path {
105			if ancestor == scopeOrgID {
106				return true, nil
107			}
108		}
109		return false, nil
110	}
111	
112	// RequireInScope enforces the actor's org scope over a target org unit.
113	// SUPER_ADMIN and STATE_AUDITOR (read-wide roles rooted at the federation)
114	// pass automatically; everyone else needs ancestry. The actor carries its
115	// org unit as an ObjectID hex string (JWT claims are JSON); it is parsed here.
116	func (r *Resolver) RequireInScope(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, targetOrgID primitive.ObjectID) error {
117		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSuperAdmin || actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleStateAuditor {
118			return nil
119		}
120		if actor.OrgUnitID == "" {
121			return httpx.Forbidden("role token with org scope required")
122		}
123		scopeID, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(actor.OrgUnitID)
124		if err != nil {
125			return httpx.Forbidden("role token carries an invalid org scope")
126		}
127		ok, err := r.InScope(ctx, scopeID, targetOrgID)
128		if err != nil {
129			return err
130		}
131		if !ok {
132			return httpx.Forbidden("resource is outside your organisational scope")
133		}
134		return nil
135	}
136
```

```text
50	// --- rate charts ---
51	
52	// CreateRateChart stores a new pricing chart for an org unit and deactivates
53	// the org's previously active charts (the new chart supersedes them).
54	func (s *service) CreateRateChart(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateRateChartRequest) (*domain.RateChart, error) {
55		if req.OrgUnitID == "" || req.Name == "" {
56			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "org_unit_id and name are required")
57		}
58		if req.BaseRatePerLitre < 0 || req.FatRatePerPoint < 0 || req.SNFRatePerPoint < 0 {
59			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "rates must not be negative")
60		}
61		if req.BaseRatePerLitre+req.FatRatePerPoint+req.SNFRatePerPoint == 0 {
62			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "at least one rate component must be positive")
63		}
64		if _, err := s.d.Orgs.Get(ctx, req.OrgUnitID); err != nil {
65			return nil, err
66		}
67		if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.OrgUnitID); err != nil {
68			return nil, err
69		}
70	
71		now := time.Now().UTC()
72		effectiveFrom := now
73		if req.EffectiveFrom != nil {
74			effectiveFrom = req.EffectiveFrom.UTC()
75		}
76		if err := s.repo.deactivateActiveCharts(ctx, req.OrgUnitID); err != nil {
77			return nil, err
78		}
79		chart := &domain.RateChart{
80			ID:               uuid.NewString(),
81			OrgUnitID:        req.OrgUnitID,
82			Name:             req.Name,
83			BaseRatePerLitre: req.BaseRatePerLitre,
84			FatRatePerPoint:  req.FatRatePerPoint,
85			SNFRatePerPoint:  req.SNFRatePerPoint,
86			EffectiveFrom:    effectiveFrom,
87			Active:           true,
88			CreatedBy:        actor.PartyID,
89			CreatedAt:        now,
90		}
91		if err := s.repo.insertRateChart(ctx, chart); err != nil {
92			return nil, err
93		}
94		return chart, nil
95	}
96	
97	// ResolveActiveChart is the HTTP-facing chart resolution: it enforces the
98	// caller's org scope over the DCS (pricing policy is confidential — any
99	// authenticated user must not be able to enumerate other unions' rates) and
100	// then delegates to the unchecked resolver.
101	func (s *service) ResolveActiveChart(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, dcsID string) (*domain.RateChart, error) {
102		dcs, err := s.d.Orgs.Get(ctx, dcsID)
103		if err != nil {
104			return nil, err
105		}
106		if dcs.Type != domain.OrgTypeDCS {
107			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_DCS", "org unit "+dcsID+" is not a DCS")
108		}
109		if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, dcsID); err != nil {
110			return nil, err
111		}
112		return s.resolveActiveChartForDCS(ctx, dcsID)
113	}
114	
115	// resolveActiveChartForDCS finds the rate chart pricing a DCS's pours: among
116	// active charts already effective on the DCS itself or any of its ancestors,
117	// the nearest org wins; ties break to the latest effective_from. Returns
118	// httpx.NotFound when no chart covers the DCS. Scope enforcement is the
119	// caller's job — the pour pricing path has already checked the actor's scope.
120	func (s *service) resolveActiveChartForDCS(ctx context.Context, dcsID string) (*domain.RateChart, error) {
121		dcs, err := s.d.Orgs.Get(ctx, dcsID)
122		if err != nil {
123			return nil, err
124		}
125		if dcs.Type != domain.OrgTypeDCS {
126			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_DCS", "org unit "+dcsID+" is not a DCS")
127		}
128	
129		// Distance 0 = the DCS itself; Path is root→parent, so walk it backwards.
130		distance := map[string]int{dcs.ID: 0}
131		orgIDs := []string{dcs.ID}
132		for i := len(dcs.Path) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
133			distance[dcs.Path[i]] = len(dcs.Path) - i
134			orgIDs = append(orgIDs, dcs.Path[i])
135		}
136	
137		charts, err := s.repo.activeChartsForOrgs(ctx, orgIDs, time.Now().UTC())
138		if err != nil {
139			return nil, err
140		}
141		var best *domain.RateChart
142		for i := range charts {
143			c := &charts[i]
144			if best == nil {
145				best = c
146				continue
147			}
148			dc, db := distance[c.OrgUnitID], distance[best.OrgUnitID]
149			if dc < db || (dc == db && c.EffectiveFrom.After(best.EffectiveFrom)) {
150				best = c
151			}
152		}
153		if best == nil {
154			return nil, httpx.NotFound("active rate chart for DCS " + dcsID)
155		}
156		return best, nil
157	}

159	// --- analyzer readings ---
160	
161	// deriveIntegrityFlags computes the anti-tamper flags of a reading from its
162	// capture envelope (blueprint §8.2). Plausibility flags are appended
163	// separately by the caller.
164	func deriveIntegrityFlags(mode string, ocrConfidence float64, hasGeotag bool, deviceTimestamp, serverNow time.Time) []string {
165		var out []string
166		if mode == domain.ReadingModeManual {
167			out = append(out, domain.IntegrityFlagManualEntry)
168		}
169		if mode == domain.ReadingModePhotoOCR && ocrConfidence < lowOCRConfidenceThreshold {
170			out = append(out, domain.IntegrityFlagLowOCRConfidence)
171		}
172		if !hasGeotag {
173			out = append(out, domain.IntegrityFlagMissingGeotag)
174		}
175		if !deviceTimestamp.IsZero() {
176			skew := serverNow.Sub(deviceTimestamp)
177			if skew < 0 {
178				skew = -skew
179			}
180			if skew > maxClockSkew {
181				out = append(out, domain.IntegrityFlagClockSkew)
182			}
183		}
184		return out
185	}
186	
187	// CreateReading stores one analyzer measurement. Suspicious readings are
188	// flagged, never rejected — the anomaly trail is the deterrent (§8.2).
189	func (s *service) CreateReading(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateReadingRequest) (*domain.AnalyzerReading, error) {
190		if req.DCSID == "" {
191			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "dcs_id is required")
192		}
193		switch req.Mode {
194		case domain.ReadingModeDirect, domain.ReadingModePhotoOCR, domain.ReadingModeManual:
195		default:
196			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "mode must be ANALYZER_DIRECT, PHOTO_OCR or MANUAL")
197		}
198		if req.FatPct <= 0 || req.SNFPct <= 0 {
199			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "fat_pct and snf_pct are required")
200		}
201		if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.DCSID); err != nil {
202			return nil, err
203		}
204		if req.Mode == domain.ReadingModePhotoOCR {
205			if !s.d.Flags.Enabled(ctx, flags.FlagPhotoOCR) {
206				featureErr := httpx.Forbidden("photo-OCR ingestion is disabled on this deployment")
207				featureErr.Code = "FEATURE_DISABLED"
208				return nil, featureErr
209			}
210			if req.PhotoObjectKey == "" {
211				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "photo_object_key is required for PHOTO_OCR (evidence retention, §8.2)")
212			}
213		}
214	
215		now := time.Now().UTC()
216		var deviceTS time.Time
217		if req.DeviceTimestamp != nil {
218			deviceTS = req.DeviceTimestamp.UTC()
219		}
220		hasGeo := req.GeoLat != nil && req.GeoLng != nil
221		integrityFlags := deriveIntegrityFlags(req.Mode, req.OCRConfidence, hasGeo, deviceTS, now)
222		plausibilityFlags := domain.CheckPlausibility(req.FatPct, req.SNFPct, req.QuantityLitres)
223		integrityFlags = append(integrityFlags, plausibilityFlags...)
224	
225		reading := &domain.AnalyzerReading{
226			ID:               uuid.NewString(),
227			DCSID:            req.DCSID,
228			DeviceID:         req.DeviceID,
229			Mode:             req.Mode,
230			FatPct:           req.FatPct,
231			SNFPct:           req.SNFPct,
232			CLR:              req.CLR,
233			WaterPct:         req.WaterPct,
234			QuantityLitres:   req.QuantityLitres,
235			PhotoObjectKey:   req.PhotoObjectKey,
236			OCRConfidence:    req.OCRConfidence,
237			DeviceTimestamp:  deviceTS,
238			ServerReceivedAt: now,
239			IntegrityFlags:   integrityFlags,
240			PlausibilityOK:   len(plausibilityFlags) == 0,
241			RecordedBy:       actor.PartyID,
242			CreatedAt:        now,
243		}
244		if hasGeo {
245			reading.GeoLat, reading.GeoLng = *req.GeoLat, *req.GeoLng
246		}
247		if err := s.repo.insertReading(ctx, reading); err != nil {
248			return nil, err
249		}
250	
251		if _, err := s.d.Ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
252			Type:       domain.EventReadingRecorded,
253			EntityType: domain.EntityAnalyzerReading,
254			EntityID:   reading.ID,
255			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
256			OrgUnitID:  reading.DCSID,
257			Payload: map[string]any{
258				"mode":            reading.Mode,
259				"integrity_flags": reading.IntegrityFlags,
260			},
261		}); err != nil {
262			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("append reading provenance: %w", err))
263		}
264		return reading, nil
265	}
266	
267	// ListReadings pages a DCS's readings for anomaly review, optionally
268	// restricted to one IST day.
269	func (s *service) ListReadings(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, dcsID, date string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.AnalyzerReading, int64, error) {
270		if dcsID == "" {
271			return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "dcs_id is required")
272		}
273		if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, dcsID); err != nil {
274			return nil, 0, err
275		}
276		var dayStart, dayEnd *time.Time
277		if date != "" {
278			start, end, err := istDayRange(date)
279			if err != nil {
280				return nil, 0, err
281			}
282			dayStart, dayEnd = &start, &end
283		}
284		return s.repo.listReadings(ctx, dcsID, dayStart, dayEnd, page)
285	}
286	
287	// --- pours ---
288	
289	// CreatePour records one farmer's pour with same-day pricing. Replays of the
290	// same client_event_id return the stored pour with idempotentReplay=true —
291	// offline sync retries are harmless (§3.1).
292	func (s *service) CreatePour(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreatePourRequest) (pour *domain.MilkPour, idempotentReplay bool, err error) {
293		if req.ClientEventID == "" || req.FarmerPartyID == "" || req.DCSID == "" {
294			return nil, false, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "client_event_id, farmer_party_id and dcs_id are required")
295		}
296		if req.Shift != domain.ShiftMorning && req.Shift != domain.ShiftEvening {
297			return nil, false, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "shift must be MORNING or EVENING")
298		}
299		if req.QuantityLitres <= 0 {
300			return nil, false, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "quantity_litres must be positive")
301		}
302		switch req.Source {
303		case domain.ReadingModeDirect, domain.ReadingModePhotoOCR, domain.ReadingModeManual:
304		default:
305			return nil, false, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "source must be ANALYZER_DIRECT, PHOTO_OCR or MANUAL")
306		}
307		if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.DCSID); err != nil {
308			return nil, false, err
309		}
310	
311		// Idempotency short-circuit BEFORE any state-dependent business check:
312		// a replay of an already-stored pour must return the stored pour even if
313		// membership lapsed or the rate chart changed since first sync — otherwise
314		// offline devices keep the record dirty and retry forever.
315		if existing, err := s.repo.pourByClientEventID(ctx, req.ClientEventID); err == nil {
316			return s.replayStoredPour(ctx, actor, existing)
317		} else if !isNotFoundErr(err) {
318			return nil, false, err
319		}
320	
321		now := time.Now().UTC()
322		member, err := s.repo.farmerIsActiveMember(ctx, req.FarmerPartyID, req.DCSID, now)
323		if err != nil {
324			return nil, false, err
325		}
326		if !member {
327			return nil, false, httpx.Unprocessable("FARMER_NOT_MEMBER",
328				"farmer does not hold an active FARMER assignment at this DCS")
329		}
330	
331		// HARD plausibility gate: receipts must be trustworthy, so implausible
332		// values are rejected here (unlike readings, which are merely flagged).
333		if violations := domain.CheckPlausibility(req.FatPct, req.SNFPct, req.QuantityLitres); len(violations) > 0 {
334			return nil, false, httpx.Unprocessable("IMPLAUSIBLE_VALUES",
335				"fat/SNF/quantity outside physically plausible bounds")
336		}
337	
338		chart, err := s.resolveChartForPricing(ctx, req.DCSID)
339		if err != nil {
340			return nil, false, err
341		}
342		rate, amount := chart.PricePour(req.FatPct, req.SNFPct, req.QuantityLitres)
343	
344		pouredAt := now
345		if req.PouredAt != nil {
346			pouredAt = req.PouredAt.UTC()
347		}
348	
349		// A shift whose consignment already exists is sealed: milk recorded now
350		// would be invoiced but never board the van — quantity provenance and the
351		// consignment's totals would silently diverge (§7 pooling boundary).
352		pourDate := domain.DateKeyIST(pouredAt)
353		consigned, err := s.repo.shiftConsigned(ctx, req.DCSID, pourDate, req.Shift)
354		if err != nil {
355			return nil, false, err
356		}
357		if consigned {
358			return nil, false, httpx.Conflict("SHIFT_CONSIGNED",
359				"a consignment already pools this DCS shift — the pour set is sealed for "+pourDate+" "+req.Shift)
360		}
361		p := &domain.MilkPour{
362			ID:                uuid.NewString(),
363			ClientEventID:     req.ClientEventID,
364			FarmerPartyID:     req.FarmerPartyID,
365			AnimalID:          req.AnimalID,
366			DCSID:             req.DCSID,
367			Shift:             req.Shift,
368			PourDate:          pourDate,
369			QuantityLitres:    req.QuantityLitres,
370			FatPct:            req.FatPct,
371			SNFPct:            req.SNFPct,
372			CLR:               req.CLR,
373			RatePerLitre:      rate,
374			Amount:            amount,
375			RateChartID:       chart.ID,
376			AnalyzerReadingID: req.AnalyzerReadingID,
377			Source:            req.Source,
378			Status:            domain.PourStatusRecorded,
379			PouredAt:          pouredAt,
380			RecordedBy:        actor.PartyID,
381			DeviceID:          req.DeviceID,
382			CreatedAt:         now,
383		}
384		if req.GeoLat != nil && req.GeoLng != nil {
385			p.GeoLat, p.GeoLng = *req.GeoLat, *req.GeoLng
386		}
387	
388		duplicate, err := s.repo.insertPour(ctx, p)
389		if err != nil {
390			return nil, false, err
391		}
392		if duplicate {
393			// Race backstop: two concurrent requests both missed the lookup —
394			// the unique client_event_id index caught it at insert time.
395			existing, err := s.repo.pourByClientEventID(ctx, req.ClientEventID)
396			if err != nil {
397				return nil, false, err
398			}
399			return s.replayStoredPour(ctx, actor, existing)
400		}
401	
402		if err := s.recordPourProvenance(ctx, actor, p); err != nil {
403			return nil, false, err
404		}
405		s.announcePour(ctx, p)
406		return p, false, nil
407	}
408	
409	// replayStoredPour returns an already-persisted pour as an idempotent replay.
410	// If a previous attempt persisted the pour but died before the ledger append
411	// (provenance_seq still 0), the missing pour.recorded event, bus publish and
412	// receipt SMS are healed first — a failed heal keeps returning the error so
413	// the client retries until the saga completes, instead of blessing an orphan
414	// with no origin link on the hash chain.
415	func (s *service) replayStoredPour(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, existing *domain.MilkPour) (*domain.MilkPour, bool, error) {
416		if existing.Status == domain.PourStatusRecorded && existing.ProvenanceSeq == 0 {
417			// The append itself must stay idempotent: a pour.recorded event may
418			// already be chained if only the seq back-stamp failed last time.
419			evs, err := s.d.Ledger.EventsForEntity(ctx, domain.EntityMilkPour, existing.ID)
420			if err != nil {
421				return nil, false, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("check pour provenance: %w", err))
422			}
423			var chained *provenance.Event
424			for i := range evs {
425				if evs[i].Type == domain.EventPourRecorded {
426					chained = &evs[i]
427					break
428				}
429			}
430			if chained != nil {
431				if err := s.repo.setPourProvenanceSeq(ctx, existing.ID, chained.Seq); err != nil {
432					return nil, false, err
433				}
434				existing.ProvenanceSeq = chained.Seq
435			} else {
436				if err := s.recordPourProvenance(ctx, actor, existing); err != nil {
437					return nil, false, err
438				}
439				s.announcePour(ctx, existing)
440			}
441		}
442		return existing, true, nil
443	}
444	
445	// announcePour publishes the pour on the bus and queues the farmer's receipt
446	// SMS — the anti-cheating receipt (§8.1).
447	func (s *service) announcePour(ctx context.Context, p *domain.MilkPour) {
448		s.d.Bus.Publish(eventbus.TopicPourRecorded, *p)
449		s.queueFarmerSMS(ctx, p.FarmerPartyID, domain.TemplatePourReceipt, map[string]string{
450			"quantity": fmt.Sprintf("%.2f", p.QuantityLitres), // key must match renderSMS's p("quantity")
451			"rate":     fmt.Sprintf("%.2f", p.RatePerLitre),
452			"amount":   fmt.Sprintf("%.2f", p.Amount),
453		})
454	}
455	
456	// isNotFoundErr reports whether err is a 404 AppError.
457	func isNotFoundErr(err error) bool {
458		var appErr *httpx.AppError
459		return errors.As(err, &appErr) && appErr.Status == http.StatusNotFound
460	}
461	
462	// recordPourProvenance appends EventPourRecorded and stamps the ledger seq
463	// onto the pour.
464	func (s *service) recordPourProvenance(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, p *domain.MilkPour) error {
465		refs := []provenance.Ref{
466			{EntityType: domain.EntityParty, EntityID: p.FarmerPartyID, Relation: "produced_by"},
467		}
468		if p.AnimalID != "" {
469			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{EntityType: domain.EntityAnimal, EntityID: p.AnimalID, Relation: "from_animal"})
470		}
471		if p.AnalyzerReadingID != "" {
472			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{EntityType: domain.EntityAnalyzerReading, EntityID: p.AnalyzerReadingID, Relation: "measured_by"})
473		}
474		ev, err := s.d.Ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
475			Type:       domain.EventPourRecorded,
476			EntityType: domain.EntityMilkPour,
477			EntityID:   p.ID,
478			Refs:       refs,
479			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
480			OrgUnitID:  p.DCSID,
481			Payload: map[string]any{
482				"quantity_litres": p.QuantityLitres,
483				"rate_per_litre":  p.RatePerLitre,
484				"amount":          p.Amount,
485			},
486		})
487		if err != nil {
488			return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("append pour provenance: %w", err))
489		}
490		if err := s.repo.setPourProvenanceSeq(ctx, p.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
491			return err
492		}
493		p.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
494		return nil
495	}
496	
497	// resolveChartForPricing wraps resolveActiveChartForDCS, converting "no
498	// chart" into a 422 — the pour payload itself is fine, the DCS just cannot
499	// price it yet.
500	func (s *service) resolveChartForPricing(ctx context.Context, dcsID string) (*domain.RateChart, error) {
501		chart, err := s.resolveActiveChartForDCS(ctx, dcsID)
502		if err != nil {
503			var appErr *httpx.AppError
504			if errors.As(err, &appErr) && appErr.Status == http.StatusNotFound {
505				return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("NO_ACTIVE_RATE_CHART",
506					"no active rate chart covers this DCS — pours cannot be priced")
507			}
508			return nil, err
509		}
510		return chart, nil
511	}
512	
513	// BatchSyncPours replays up to 500 offline-captured pours. Items succeed or
514	// fail independently — the batch never aborts (offline reconnect path, §3.1).
515	func (s *service) BatchSyncPours(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req BatchSyncRequest) ([]BatchSyncItemResult, error) {
516		if len(req.Pours) == 0 {
517			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "pours must not be empty")
518		}
519		if len(req.Pours) > maxBatchSyncItems {
520			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION",
521				fmt.Sprintf("pours must not exceed %d items per batch", maxBatchSyncItems))
522		}
523		results := make([]BatchSyncItemResult, 0, len(req.Pours))
524		for _, item := range req.Pours {
525			res := BatchSyncItemResult{ClientEventID: item.ClientEventID}
526			pour, replay, err := s.CreatePour(ctx, actor, item)
527			switch {
528			case err != nil:
529				res.Status = BatchItemError
530				var appErr *httpx.AppError
531				if errors.As(err, &appErr) {
532					res.Error = appErr.Code + ": " + appErr.Message
533				} else {
534					res.Error = "INTERNAL: internal server error"
535				}
536			case replay:
537				res.Status = BatchItemDuplicate
538				res.PourID = pour.ID
539			default:
540				res.Status = BatchItemCreated
541				res.PourID = pour.ID
542			}
543			results = append(results, res)
544		}
545		return results, nil
546	}
547	
548	// SupersedePour applies an append-only correction (§3.4): the old pour is
549	// marked SUPERSEDED (the document stays), and a new repriced pour referencing
550	// it is recorded.
551	func (s *service) SupersedePour(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, pourID string, req SupersedePourRequest) (*domain.MilkPour, error) {
552		if req.Reason == "" {
553			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "reason is required")
554		}
555		old, err := s.repo.pourByID(ctx, pourID)
556		if err != nil {
557			return nil, err
558		}
559		if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, old.DCSID); err != nil {
560			return nil, err
561		}
562		if old.Status != domain.PourStatusRecorded {
563			return nil, httpx.Conflict("POUR_NOT_CORRECTABLE",
564				"pour is already "+old.Status+" and cannot be superseded")
565		}
566		invoiced, err := s.repo.pourIsInvoiced(ctx, pourID)
567		if err != nil {
568			return nil, err
569		}
570		if invoiced {
571			return nil, httpx.Conflict("POUR_INVOICED",
572				"pour is aggregated by an invoice — correct it through settlement instead")
573		}
574		// The consigned state freezes the pour exactly like the invoiced state:
575		// a consignment's pour set, litres and weighted fat/SNF are snapshotted,
576		// so correcting after pooling would silently desync payment from the
577		// shipped-quantity provenance.
578		consigned, err := s.repo.shiftConsigned(ctx, old.DCSID, old.PourDate, old.Shift)
579		if err != nil {
580			return nil, err
581		}
582		if consigned {
583			return nil, httpx.Conflict("POUR_CONSIGNED",
584				"pour is aggregated by a consignment — correct it through logistics/settlement instead")
585		}
586	
587		qty, fat, snf := old.QuantityLitres, old.FatPct, old.SNFPct
588		if req.Corrected.QuantityLitres != nil {
589			qty = *req.Corrected.QuantityLitres
590		}
591		if req.Corrected.FatPct != nil {
592			fat = *req.Corrected.FatPct
593		}
594		if req.Corrected.SNFPct != nil {
595			snf = *req.Corrected.SNFPct
596		}
597		if qty <= 0 {
598			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "corrected quantity_litres must be positive")
599		}
600		if violations := domain.CheckPlausibility(fat, snf, qty); len(violations) > 0 {
601			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("IMPLAUSIBLE_VALUES",
602				"corrected fat/SNF/quantity outside physically plausible bounds")
603		}
604	
605		chart, err := s.resolveChartForPricing(ctx, old.DCSID)
606		if err != nil {
607			return nil, err
608		}
609		rate, amount := chart.PricePour(fat, snf, qty)
610	
611		// Optimistic guard: only one correction can win the RECORDED→SUPERSEDED flip.
612		flipped, err := s.repo.markPourSuperseded(ctx, old.ID)
613		if err != nil {
614			return nil, err
615		}
616		if !flipped {
617			return nil, httpx.Conflict("POUR_NOT_CORRECTABLE", "pour was superseded concurrently")
618		}
619	
620		now := time.Now().UTC()
621		corrected := &domain.MilkPour{
622			ID:                uuid.NewString(),
623			FarmerPartyID:     old.FarmerPartyID,
624			AnimalID:          old.AnimalID,
625			DCSID:             old.DCSID,
626			Shift:             old.Shift,
627			PourDate:          old.PourDate, // correction stays on the original settlement day
628			QuantityLitres:    qty,
629			FatPct:            fat,
630			SNFPct:            snf,
631			CLR:               old.CLR,
632			RatePerLitre:      rate,
633			Amount:            amount,
634			RateChartID:       chart.ID,
635			AnalyzerReadingID: old.AnalyzerReadingID,
636			Source:            old.Source,
637			Status:            domain.PourStatusRecorded,
638			SupersedesPourID:  old.ID,
639			PouredAt:          old.PouredAt,
640			RecordedBy:        actor.PartyID,
641			DeviceID:          old.DeviceID,
642			GeoLat:            old.GeoLat,
643			GeoLng:            old.GeoLng,
644			CreatedAt:         now,
645		}
646		corrected.ClientEventID = old.ClientEventID + "::corr::" + corrected.ID[0:8]
647		if duplicate, err := s.repo.insertPour(ctx, corrected); err != nil {
648			return nil, err
649		} else if duplicate {
650			return nil, httpx.Conflict("POUR_NOT_CORRECTABLE", "correction collided with a concurrent one")
651		}
652	
653		ev, err := s.d.Ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
654			Type:       domain.EventPourSuperseded,
655			EntityType: domain.EntityMilkPour,
656			EntityID:   corrected.ID,
657			Refs: []provenance.Ref{
658				{EntityType: domain.EntityMilkPour, EntityID: old.ID, Relation: "supersedes"},
659			},
660			Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
661			OrgUnitID: corrected.DCSID,
662			Payload:   map[string]any{"reason": req.Reason},
663		})
664		if err != nil {
665			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("append supersede provenance: %w", err))
666		}
667		if err := s.repo.setPourProvenanceSeq(ctx, corrected.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
668			return nil, err
669		}
670		corrected.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
671		return corrected, nil
672	}

674	// ListPours pages pours. FARMER callers are always pinned to their own
675	// pours; staff roles must name a DCS inside their scope.
676	func (s *service) ListPours(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, filter pourListFilter, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.MilkPour, int64, error) {
677		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleFarmer {
678			filter.FarmerPartyID = actor.PartyID // farmers only ever see their own pours
679		} else {
680			if filter.DCSID == "" {
681				return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "dcs_id is required")
682			}
683			if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, filter.DCSID); err != nil {
684				return nil, 0, err
685			}
686		}
687		if filter.Date != "" {
688			if err := validateDateKey(filter.Date); err != nil {
689				return nil, 0, err
690			}
691		}
692		if filter.Shift != "" && filter.Shift != domain.ShiftMorning && filter.Shift != domain.ShiftEvening {
693			return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "shift must be MORNING or EVENING")
694		}
695		return s.repo.listPours(ctx, filter, page)
696	}

698	// --- invoices ---
699	
700	// GenerateInvoices groups the day's un-invoiced RECORDED pours by farmer and
701	// issues one invoice each — the same-day payment artefact (§8.1). The unique
702	// farmer+DCS+day index is the true duplicate guard; racing generators simply
703	// count the loser as "existing".
704	func (s *service) GenerateInvoices(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req GenerateInvoicesRequest) (*GenerateInvoicesResponse, error) {
705		if req.DCSID == "" {
706			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "dcs_id is required")
707		}
708		now := time.Now().UTC()
709		dateKey := req.Date
710		if dateKey == "" {
711			dateKey = domain.DateKeyIST(now)
712		} else if err := validateDateKey(dateKey); err != nil {
713			return nil, err
714		}
715		dcs, err := s.d.Orgs.Get(ctx, req.DCSID)
716		if err != nil {
717			return nil, err
718		}
719		if dcs.Type != domain.OrgTypeDCS {
720			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_DCS", "org unit "+req.DCSID+" is not a DCS")
721		}
722		if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.DCSID); err != nil {
723			return nil, err
724		}
725	
726		pours, err := s.repo.recordedPoursForDay(ctx, req.DCSID, dateKey)
727		if err != nil {
728			return nil, err
729		}
730		alreadyInvoiced, err := s.repo.invoicedPourIDs(ctx, req.DCSID, dateKey)
731		if err != nil {
732			return nil, err
733		}
734	
735		byFarmer := make(map[string][]domain.MilkPour)
736		for _, p := range pours {
737			if alreadyInvoiced[p.ID] {
738				continue
739			}
740			byFarmer[p.FarmerPartyID] = append(byFarmer[p.FarmerPartyID], p)
741		}
742		farmerIDs := make([]string, 0, len(byFarmer))
743		for id := range byFarmer {
744			farmerIDs = append(farmerIDs, id)
745		}
746		sort.Strings(farmerIDs)
747	
748		resp := &GenerateInvoicesResponse{Invoices: []domain.Invoice{}}
749		counterKey := "invoice:" + dcs.Code + ":" + dateKey
750		for _, farmerID := range farmerIDs {
751			group := byFarmer[farmerID]
752			seq, err := s.repo.nextInvoiceSeq(ctx, counterKey)
753			if err != nil {
754				return nil, err
755			}
756			inv := &domain.Invoice{
757				ID:            uuid.NewString(),
758				InvoiceNumber: domain.InvoiceNumberFor(dcs.Code, dateKey, seq),
759				FarmerPartyID: farmerID,
760				DCSID:         req.DCSID,
761				InvoiceDate:   dateKey,
762				Status:        domain.InvoiceStatusIssued,
763				IssuedAt:      now,
764			}
765			for _, p := range group {
766				inv.PourIDs = append(inv.PourIDs, p.ID)
767				inv.TotalQuantityLitres += p.QuantityLitres
768				inv.TotalAmount += p.Amount
769			}
770			inv.TotalQuantityLitres = math.Round(inv.TotalQuantityLitres*100) / 100
771			inv.TotalAmount = math.Round(inv.TotalAmount*100) / 100
772	
773			duplicate, err := s.repo.insertInvoice(ctx, inv)
774			if err != nil {
775				return nil, err
776			}
777			if duplicate {
778				// The farmer already has today's invoice (e.g. the MORNING run) —
779				// merge the not-yet-invoiced pours into it instead of silently
780				// dropping them, or surface them when the invoice is frozen.
781				if err := s.mergeIntoExistingInvoice(ctx, actor, req.DCSID, dateKey, farmerID, group, resp); err != nil {
782					return nil, err
783				}
784				continue
785			}
786	
787			refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, len(inv.PourIDs))
788			for _, pid := range inv.PourIDs {
789				refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{EntityType: domain.EntityMilkPour, EntityID: pid, Relation: "aggregates"})
790			}
791			ev, err := s.d.Ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
792				Type:       domain.EventInvoiceIssued,
793				EntityType: domain.EntityInvoice,
794				EntityID:   inv.ID,
795				Refs:       refs,
796				Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
797				OrgUnitID:  inv.DCSID,
798				Payload: map[string]any{
799					"invoice_number":        inv.InvoiceNumber,
800					"total_quantity_litres": inv.TotalQuantityLitres,
801					"total_amount":          inv.TotalAmount,
802				},
803			})
804			if err != nil {
805				return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("append invoice provenance: %w", err))
806			}
807			if err := s.repo.setInvoiceProvenanceSeq(ctx, inv.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
808				return nil, err
809			}
810			inv.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
811	
812			s.d.Bus.Publish(eventbus.TopicInvoiceIssued, *inv)
813			s.queueInvoiceSMS(ctx, inv)
814			resp.Created++
815			resp.Invoices = append(resp.Invoices, *inv)
816		}
817		return resp, nil
818	}
819	
820	// mergeIntoExistingInvoice folds a farmer's not-yet-invoiced pours into their
821	// already-issued invoice for the day. Only a still-ISSUED invoice may be
822	// amended (the status guard on the update is atomic against a concurrent
823	// settlement claim); a PAID/settlement-claimed invoice is never mutated —
824	// its pours are surfaced in the response so staff can act, never dropped.
825	func (s *service) mergeIntoExistingInvoice(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, dcsID, dateKey, farmerID string, group []domain.MilkPour, resp *GenerateInvoicesResponse) error {
826		existing, err := s.repo.invoiceByFarmerDay(ctx, farmerID, dcsID, dateKey)
827		if err != nil {
828			return err
829		}
830		// Only pours genuinely missing from the invoice are merged — a racing
831		// generator that lost the insert must not double-add the winner's pours.
832		already := make(map[string]bool, len(existing.PourIDs))
833		for _, id := range existing.PourIDs {
834			already[id] = true
835		}
836		var newPours []domain.MilkPour
837		for _, p := range group {
838			if !already[p.ID] {
839				newPours = append(newPours, p)
840			}
841		}
842		if len(newPours) == 0 {
843			resp.Existing++
844			return nil
845		}
846	
847		skip := func() {
848			resp.Existing++
849			for _, p := range newPours {
850				resp.SkippedPourIDs = append(resp.SkippedPourIDs, p.ID)
851			}
852		}
853		if existing.Status != domain.InvoiceStatusIssued {
854			skip() // frozen by settlement — un-invoiceable today, surface loudly
855			return nil
856		}
857		ids := make([]string, 0, len(newPours))
858		var addQty, addAmount float64
859		for _, p := range newPours {
860			ids = append(ids, p.ID)
861			addQty += p.QuantityLitres
862			addAmount += p.Amount
863		}
864		merged, err := s.repo.appendPoursToInvoice(ctx, existing.ID, ids, addQty, addAmount)
865		if err != nil {
866			return err
867		}
868		if !merged {
869			skip() // invoice left ISSUED between the read and the guarded update
870			return nil
871		}
872		updated, err := s.repo.invoiceByID(ctx, existing.ID)
873		if err != nil {
874			return err
875		}
876		updated.TotalQuantityLitres = math.Round(updated.TotalQuantityLitres*100) / 100
877		updated.TotalAmount = math.Round(updated.TotalAmount*100) / 100
878		if err := s.repo.setInvoiceTotals(ctx, updated.ID, updated.TotalQuantityLitres, updated.TotalAmount); err != nil {
879			return err
880		}
881	
882		refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, len(ids))
883		for _, pid := range ids {
884			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{EntityType: domain.EntityMilkPour, EntityID: pid, Relation: "aggregates"})
885		}
886		ev, err := s.d.Ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
887			Type:       domain.EventInvoiceAmended,
888			EntityType: domain.EntityInvoice,
889			EntityID:   updated.ID,
890			Refs:       refs,
891			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
892			OrgUnitID:  updated.DCSID,
893			Payload: map[string]any{
894				"invoice_number":        updated.InvoiceNumber,
895				"added_pour_count":      len(ids),
896				"total_quantity_litres": updated.TotalQuantityLitres,
897				"total_amount":          updated.TotalAmount,
898			},
899		})
900		if err != nil {
901			return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("append invoice amendment provenance: %w", err))
902		}
903		if err := s.repo.setInvoiceProvenanceSeq(ctx, updated.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
904			return err
905		}
906		updated.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
907	
908		s.d.Bus.Publish(eventbus.TopicInvoiceIssued, *updated)
909		s.queueInvoiceSMS(ctx, updated)
910		resp.Updated++
911		resp.Invoices = append(resp.Invoices, *updated)
912		return nil
913	}

915	// queueInvoiceSMS notifies the farmer of an issued or amended invoice.
916	func (s *service) queueInvoiceSMS(ctx context.Context, inv *domain.Invoice) {

918			"invoice_number": inv.InvoiceNumber,
919			"amount":         fmt.Sprintf("%.2f", inv.TotalAmount),
920			"date":           inv.InvoiceDate,
921		})
922	}

927		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleFarmer {

953	// GetInvoice returns one invoice: a farmer may fetch their own, staff roles
954	// need the invoice's DCS inside their scope.
955	func (s *service) GetInvoice(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id string) (*domain.Invoice, error) {
956		inv, err := s.repo.invoiceByID(ctx, id)

974	// queueFarmerSMS writes an outbox notification for the farmer. Failures are
975	// logged, never fatal — the receipt must not block the pour (§8.1).
976	func (s *service) queueFarmerSMS(ctx context.Context, farmerPartyID, templateKey string, params map[string]string) {
977		farmer, err := s.repo.getParty(ctx, farmerPartyID)
978		if err != nil {
979			s.log.Warn("collection: farmer lookup for SMS failed",
980				slog.String("farmer_party_id", farmerPartyID), slog.Any("err", err))
981			return
982		}
983		language := farmer.PreferredLanguage
984		if language == "" {
985			language = defaultLanguage
986		}
987		n := &domain.Notification{
988			ID:          uuid.NewString(),
989			PartyID:     farmer.ID,
990			Phone:       farmer.Phone,
991			Channel:     domain.ChannelSMS,
992			TemplateKey: templateKey,
993			Language:    language,
994			Params:      params,
995			Status:      domain.NotificationQueued,
996			QueuedAt:    time.Now().UTC(),
997		}
998		if err := s.repo.queueNotification(ctx, n); err != nil {
999			s.log.Warn("collection: notification queue failed",
1000				slog.String("template", templateKey), slog.Any("err", err))
1001		}
1002	}

1004	// validateDateKey checks a YYYY-MM-DD day key.
1005	func validateDateKey(date string) error {
1006		if _, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", date); err != nil {
1007			return httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "date must be YYYY-MM-DD")
1008		}
1009		return nil
1010	}
1011	
1012	// istDayRange converts a YYYY-MM-DD key into the [start, end) UTC window of
1013	// that IST calendar day.
1014	func istDayRange(date string) (start, end time.Time, err error) {
1015		ist := time.FixedZone("IST", 5*3600+1800)
1016		day, parseErr := time.ParseInLocation("2006-01-02", date, ist)
1017		if parseErr != nil {
1018			return time.Time{}, time.Time{}, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "date must be YYYY-MM-DD")
1019		}
1020		return day.UTC(), day.Add(24 * time.Hour).UTC(), nil
1021	}
```

```text
1	// Package provenance implements the append-only, hash-chained event ledger —
2	// the source of truth for milk traceability (blueprint §7). Every link in the
3	// pour→QR chain is an immutable Event whose SHA-256 hash covers the previous
4	// event's hash, so history cannot be quietly rewritten (tamper-evidence,
5	// FSSAI recall-grade audit).
6	//
7	// Corrections are NEW events referencing the superseded entity — nothing is
8	// ever updated or deleted in this collection.
9	package provenance
10	
11	import (
12		"context"
13		"crypto/sha256"
14		"encoding/hex"
15		"encoding/json"
16		"errors"
17		"fmt"
18		"strconv"
19		"strings"
20		"sync"
21		"time"
22	
23		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
24		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
25		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
26		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo/options"
27	)
28	
29	const collection = "provenance_events"
30	
31	// Ref is a directed edge to another entity in the trace graph
32	// (e.g. a consignment event referencing the pours it aggregates).
33	type Ref struct {
34		EntityType string `bson:"entity_type" json:"entity_type"`
35		EntityID   string `bson:"entity_id"   json:"entity_id"`
36		Relation   string `bson:"relation"    json:"relation"` // aggregates | supersedes | tested | yields | labels ...
37	}
38	
39	// ActorRef records who caused the event.
40	type ActorRef struct {
41		PartyID  string `bson:"party_id"  json:"party_id"`
42		RoleCode string `bson:"role_code" json:"role_code"`
43	}
44	
45	// Event is one immutable link in the ledger. `_id` is a generated ObjectID;
46	// EntityID and Refs carry the referenced documents' ObjectIDs as hex strings
47	// (the ledger is a generic event log spanning every entity type, and hex
48	// strings keep the hash material canonical and human-inspectable).
49	type Event struct {
50		ID         primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
51		Seq        int64          `bson:"seq"         json:"seq"`
52		Type       string         `bson:"type"        json:"type"`
53		EntityType string         `bson:"entity_type" json:"entity_type"`
54		EntityID   string         `bson:"entity_id"   json:"entity_id"`
55		Refs       []Ref          `bson:"refs,omitempty"    json:"refs,omitempty"`
56		Actor      ActorRef       `bson:"actor"       json:"actor"`
57		OrgUnitID  string         `bson:"org_unit_id,omitempty" json:"org_unit_id,omitempty"`
58		Payload    map[string]any `bson:"payload,omitempty"     json:"payload,omitempty"`
59		TS         time.Time      `bson:"ts"          json:"ts"`
60		PrevHash   string         `bson:"prev_hash"   json:"prev_hash"`
61		Hash       string         `bson:"hash"        json:"hash"`
62	}
63	
64	// AppendInput describes a new event to chain.
65	type AppendInput struct {
66		Type       string
67		EntityType string
68		EntityID   string
69		Refs       []Ref
70		Actor      ActorRef
71		OrgUnitID  string
72		Payload    map[string]any
73	}
74	
75	// Ledger appends to and reads the hash chain.
76	type Ledger struct {
77		coll *mongo.Collection
78	
79		// appendMu serialises the head-read+insert of Append within this process:
80		// every ledger write system-wide shares one global seq, so without local
81		// serialisation concurrent handlers (e.g. a morning pour rush plus a
82		// GenerateInvoices loop) burn duplicate-key retries against each other.
83		// The unique seq index remains the atomic backstop across processes.
84		appendMu sync.Mutex
85	}
86	
87	// NewLedger binds the ledger to the database.
88	func NewLedger(db *mongo.Database) *Ledger {
89		return &Ledger{coll: db.Collection(collection)}
90	}
91	
92	// genesisHash anchors the chain before the first event.
93	const genesisHash = "GENESIS"
94	
95	// Append chains a new event. Concurrency-safe without transactions: it reads
96	// the current head, computes seq+hash optimistically, and relies on the
97	// unique index on `seq` — a duplicate-key collision means another writer won
98	// the slot, so we re-read and retry.
99	func (l *Ledger) Append(ctx context.Context, in AppendInput) (*Event, error) {
100		// Serialise appends within this process (see appendMu): local writers no
101		// longer race each other for the seq slot, so under single-instance
102		// deployment the retry loop only ever fires against external writers.
103		l.appendMu.Lock()
104		defer l.appendMu.Unlock()
105	
106		const maxRetries = 12
107		for attempt := 0; attempt < maxRetries; attempt++ {
108			seq, prevHash, err := l.head(ctx)
109			if err != nil {
110				return nil, err
111			}
112			ev := &Event{
113				ID:         primitive.NewObjectID(),
114				Seq:        seq + 1,
115				Type:       in.Type,
116				EntityType: in.EntityType,
117				EntityID:   in.EntityID,
118				Refs:       in.Refs,
119				Actor:      in.Actor,
120				OrgUnitID:  in.OrgUnitID,
121				Payload:    in.Payload,
122				// Millisecond precision: BSON datetimes store ms, so the persisted
123				// TS must equal the hashed TS or re-verification would break.
124				TS:       time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Millisecond),
125				PrevHash: prevHash,
126			}
127			ev.Hash = computeHash(ev)
128	
129			if _, err := l.coll.InsertOne(ctx, ev); err != nil {
130				if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(err) {
131					continue // lost the seq race — retry against the new head
132				}
133				return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance append: %w", err)
134			}
135			return ev, nil
136		}
137		return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance append: gave up after %d seq collisions", 12)
138	}
139	
140	// head returns the latest (seq, hash), or (0, GENESIS) for an empty chain.
141	func (l *Ledger) head(ctx context.Context) (int64, string, error) {
142		var last Event
143		err := l.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{},
144			options.FindOne().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: -1}}),
145		).Decode(&last)
146		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
147			return 0, genesisHash, nil
148		}
149		if err != nil {
150			return 0, "", fmt.Errorf("provenance head: %w", err)
151		}
152		return last.Seq, last.Hash, nil
153	}
154	
155	// computeHash covers everything that matters: position, linkage, content.
156	// Payload is canonicalised via encoding/json (map keys are sorted) and the
157	// timestamp to millisecond precision (BSON datetime resolution), so the
158	// digest is deterministic across a MongoDB round trip.
159	func computeHash(ev *Event) string {
160		payloadJSON, _ := json.Marshal(ev.Payload)
161		refParts := make([]string, 0, len(ev.Refs))
162		for _, r := range ev.Refs {
163			refParts = append(refParts, r.EntityType+":"+r.EntityID+":"+r.Relation)
164		}
165		material := strings.Join([]string{
166			ev.PrevHash,
167			strconv.FormatInt(ev.Seq, 10),
168			ev.Type,
169			ev.EntityType,
170			ev.EntityID,
171			strings.Join(refParts, ","),
172			ev.Actor.PartyID,
173			ev.Actor.RoleCode,
174			ev.OrgUnitID,
175			string(payloadJSON),
176			ev.TS.UTC().Truncate(time.Millisecond).Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
177		}, "|")
178		sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(material))
179		return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
180	}
181	
182	// EventsForEntity returns an entity's own timeline in chain order.
183	func (l *Ledger) EventsForEntity(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string) ([]Event, error) {
184		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
185			bson.D{{Key: "entity_type", Value: entityType}, {Key: "entity_id", Value: entityID}},
186			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}),
187		)
188		if err != nil {
189			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance events for %s/%s: %w", entityType, entityID, err)
190		}
191		var out []Event
192		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
193			return nil, err
194		}
195		return out, nil
196	}
197	
198	// Trace walks the provenance graph UPSTREAM from an entity: its events, plus
199	// (recursively) the events of everything those events reference. This is how
200	// a consumer QR resolves back to the contributing samiti set, and how a failed
201	// aflatoxin test walks back to source DCSes (blueprint §8.3).
202	func (l *Ledger) Trace(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, maxDepth int) ([]Event, error) {
203		return l.TraceStopAt(ctx, entityType, entityID, maxDepth, nil)
204	}
205	
206	// TraceStopAt is Trace with a stop set: entity types in stopExpand are still
207	// fetched (their events appear in the result) but their refs are never
208	// followed. The consumer QR scan stops at the consignment/pooling boundary so
209	// hundreds of per-pour nodes (and cross-route trip fan-out) are never walked.
210	//
211	// Each BFS level is batched into a bounded number of $or queries instead of
212	// one Find per node, so a walk costs O(depth) round trips, not O(nodes).
213	func (l *Ledger) TraceStopAt(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, maxDepth int, stopExpand map[string]bool) ([]Event, error) {
214		if maxDepth <= 0 {
215			maxDepth = 10
216		}
217		const hardEventCap = 2000
218	
219		type node struct{ etype, eid string }
220		visited := map[node]bool{}
221		frontier := []node{{entityType, entityID}}
222		var all []Event
223	
224		for depth := 0; depth < maxDepth && len(frontier) > 0; depth++ {
225			// Deduplicate this level against everything already visited.
226			level := make([]node, 0, len(frontier))
227			for _, n := range frontier {
228				if visited[n] {
229					continue
230				}
231				visited[n] = true
232				level = append(level, n)
233			}
234			if len(level) == 0 {
235				break
236			}
237	
238			var next []node
239			// One indexed query per chunk of the level (not per node).
240			const orChunk = 200
241			for start := 0; start < len(level); start += orChunk {
242				end := min(start+orChunk, len(level))
243				clauses := make(bson.A, 0, end-start)
244				for _, n := range level[start:end] {
245					clauses = append(clauses, bson.D{
246						{Key: "entity_type", Value: n.etype},
247						{Key: "entity_id", Value: n.eid},
248					})
249				}
250				cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
251					bson.D{{Key: "$or", Value: clauses}},
252					options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}).SetLimit(hardEventCap),
253				)
254				if err != nil {
255					return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance trace level: %w", err)
256				}
257				var evs []Event
258				if err := cur.All(ctx, &evs); err != nil {
259					return nil, err
260				}
261				for _, ev := range evs {
262					all = append(all, ev)
263					if len(all) >= hardEventCap {
264						return all, nil
265					}
266					if stopExpand != nil && stopExpand[ev.EntityType] {
267						continue // include the node's events, never follow its refs
268					}
269					for _, ref := range ev.Refs {
270						nn := node{ref.EntityType, ref.EntityID}
271						if !visited[nn] {
272							next = append(next, nn)
273						}
274					}
275				}
276			}
277			frontier = next
278		}
279		return all, nil
280	}
281	
282	// DownstreamRefs finds events that reference the given entity — used to walk
283	// FORWARD (e.g. "which batches consumed this blocked BMC lot?"). The limit is
284	// pushed into the query: only the LAST limit referencing events are fetched
285	// (ascending chain order preserved). limit <= 0 falls back to 2000.
286	func (l *Ledger) DownstreamRefs(ctx context.Context, entityID string, limit int64) ([]Event, error) {
287		if limit <= 0 {
288			limit = 2000
289		}
290		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
291			bson.D{{Key: "refs.entity_id", Value: entityID}},
292			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: -1}}).SetLimit(limit),
293		)
294		if err != nil {
295			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance downstream of %s: %w", entityID, err)
296		}
297		var out []Event
298		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
299			return nil, err
300		}
301		// Restore ascending chain order.
302		for i, j := 0, len(out)-1; i < j; i, j = i+1, j-1 {
303			out[i], out[j] = out[j], out[i]
304		}
305		return out, nil
306	}
307	
308	// EventsForEntityPage returns one page of an entity's own timeline in chain
309	// order, with skip/limit pushed into the query.
310	func (l *Ledger) EventsForEntityPage(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, offset, limit int64) ([]Event, error) {
311		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
312			bson.D{{Key: "entity_type", Value: entityType}, {Key: "entity_id", Value: entityID}},
313			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}).SetSkip(offset).SetLimit(limit),
314		)
315		if err != nil {
316			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance events page for %s/%s: %w", entityType, entityID, err)
317		}
318		var out []Event
319		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
320			return nil, err
321		}
322		return out, nil
323	}
324	
325	// CountEventsForEntity returns the total number of events on an entity's
326	// timeline (pagination meta companion of EventsForEntityPage).
327	func (l *Ledger) CountEventsForEntity(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string) (int64, error) {
328		n, err := l.coll.CountDocuments(ctx,
329			bson.D{{Key: "entity_type", Value: entityType}, {Key: "entity_id", Value: entityID}})
330		if err != nil {
331			return 0, fmt.Errorf("provenance count for %s/%s: %w", entityType, entityID, err)
332		}
333		return n, nil
334	}
335	
336	// VerifyChain re-derives every hash in [fromSeq, toSeq] and checks linkage.
337	// Returns (true, 0) when intact, or (false, seq) of the first broken link.
338	func (l *Ledger) VerifyChain(ctx context.Context, fromSeq, toSeq int64) (bool, int64, error) {
339		filter := bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$gte", Value: fromSeq}, {Key: "$lte", Value: toSeq}}}}
340		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}))
341		if err != nil {
342			return false, 0, fmt.Errorf("provenance verify: %w", err)
343		}
344		defer cur.Close(ctx)
345	
346		prevHash := ""
347		prevSeq := int64(0)
348		first := true
349		for cur.Next(ctx) {
350			var ev Event
351			if err := cur.Decode(&ev); err != nil {
352				return false, 0, err
353			}
354			if computeHash(&ev) != ev.Hash {
355				return false, ev.Seq, nil // content tampered
356			}
357			if !first {
358				if ev.Seq != prevSeq+1 || ev.PrevHash != prevHash {
359					return false, ev.Seq, nil // linkage broken
360				}
361			}
362			prevHash, prevSeq, first = ev.Hash, ev.Seq, false
363		}
364		return true, 0, cur.Err()
365	}
366	
367	// LatestSeq returns the current chain head sequence (0 = empty).
368	func (l *Ledger) LatestSeq(ctx context.Context) (int64, error) {
369		seq, _, err := l.head(ctx)
370		return seq, err
371	}
```

```text
220		return res.MatchedCount == 1, nil
221	}
222	
223	// setPourProvenanceSeq stamps the ledger sequence onto the pour document.
224	func (r *repo) setPourProvenanceSeq(ctx context.Context, id string, seq int64) error {
225		_, err := r.pours.UpdateOne(ctx,
226			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}},
227			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "provenance_seq", Value: seq}}}},
228		)
229		if err != nil {
230			return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("set pour provenance seq: %w", err))
231		}
232		return nil
233	}

235	// pourListFilter narrows a pour listing.
236	type pourListFilter struct {
237		DCSID         string
238		Date          string
239		Shift         string
240		FarmerPartyID string
241	}
242	
243	// listPours pages pours matching the filter, newest first, plus the total
244	// matching count for pagination meta.
245	func (r *repo) listPours(ctx context.Context, f pourListFilter, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.MilkPour, int64, error) {
246		filter := bson.D{}
247		if f.DCSID != "" {
248			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "dcs_id", Value: f.DCSID})
249		}
250		if f.Date != "" {
251			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "pour_date", Value: f.Date})
252		}
253		if f.Shift != "" {
254			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "shift", Value: f.Shift})
255		}
256		if f.FarmerPartyID != "" {
257			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "farmer_party_id", Value: f.FarmerPartyID})
258		}
259		total, err := r.pours.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
260		if err != nil {
261			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("count pours: %w", err))
262		}
263		cur, err := r.pours.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
264			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "poured_at", Value: -1}}).
265			SetSkip(page.Offset).
266			SetLimit(page.Limit),
267		)
268		if err != nil {
269			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("list pours: %w", err))
270		}
271		out := []domain.MilkPour{}
272		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
273			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("decode pours: %w", err))
274		}
275		return out, total, nil
276	}
277	
278	// recordedPoursForDay returns a DCS's RECORDED pours for one settlement day
279	// (internal aggregation input for invoice generation).
280	func (r *repo) recordedPoursForDay(ctx context.Context, dcsID, dateKey string) ([]domain.MilkPour, error) {
281		cur, err := r.pours.Find(ctx, bson.D{
282			{Key: "dcs_id", Value: dcsID},
283			{Key: "pour_date", Value: dateKey},
284			{Key: "status", Value: domain.PourStatusRecorded},
285		}, options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "poured_at", Value: 1}}))
286		if err != nil {
287			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("find recorded pours: %w", err))
288		}
289		var out []domain.MilkPour
290		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
291			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("decode recorded pours: %w", err))
292		}
293		return out, nil
294	}

296	// --- invoices ---
297	
298	// pourIsInvoiced reports whether a non-HOLD invoice already aggregates the
299	// pour (such pours are frozen — corrections must go through settlement).
300	func (r *repo) pourIsInvoiced(ctx context.Context, pourID string) (bool, error) {
301		n, err := r.invoices.CountDocuments(ctx, bson.D{
302			{Key: "pour_ids", Value: pourID},
303			{Key: "status", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$ne", Value: domain.InvoiceStatusHold}}},
304		})
305		if err != nil {
306			return false, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("count invoices for pour: %w", err))
307		}
308		return n > 0, nil
309	}

311	// invoicedPourIDs returns the set of pour IDs already aggregated by any
312	// invoice of the DCS on the given day.
313	func (r *repo) invoicedPourIDs(ctx context.Context, dcsID, dateKey string) (map[string]bool, error) {
314		cur, err := r.invoices.Find(ctx, bson.D{
315			{Key: "dcs_id", Value: dcsID},
316			{Key: "invoice_date", Value: dateKey},
317		}, options.Find().SetProjection(bson.D{{Key: "pour_ids", Value: 1}}))
318		if err != nil {
319			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("find day invoices: %w", err))
320		}
321		var docs []struct {
322			PourIDs []string `bson:"pour_ids"`
323		}
324		if err := cur.All(ctx, &docs); err != nil {
325			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("decode day invoices: %w", err))
326		}
327		set := make(map[string]bool)
328		for _, d := range docs {
329			for _, id := range d.PourIDs {
330				set[id] = true
331			}
332		}
333		return set, nil
334	}

336	// insertInvoice inserts an invoice; duplicate=true means the farmer already
337	// has an invoice for that DCS+day (the unique index is the true guard).
338	func (r *repo) insertInvoice(ctx context.Context, inv *domain.Invoice) (duplicate bool, err error) {
339		if _, err := r.invoices.InsertOne(ctx, inv); err != nil {

342			}
343			return false, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("insert invoice: %w", err))
344		}
345		return false, nil
346	}

384		filter := bson.D{}

408		}
```
