```text
173	// claimExecution atomically claims a batch for execution. Three legal claims:
174	//   - APPROVED  → EXECUTING (first run)
175	//   - FAILED    → EXECUTING (re-execution after a recorded failure)
176	//   - EXECUTING → EXECUTING with a STALE lease (resume of a run whose process
177	//     died before it could mark FAILED; staleBefore guards against stealing a
178	//     live executor's batch)
179	//
180	// Every claim stamps executing_at as the new lease. Returns false when no
181	// claim matched — someone else holds a fresh lease or the batch is terminal.
182	func (rp *repo) claimExecution(ctx context.Context, id string, now, staleBefore time.Time) (bool, error) {
183		for _, from := range []string{domain.SettlementStatusApproved, domain.SettlementStatusFailed} {
184			ok, err := rp.transitionBatch(ctx, id, from, bson.D{
185				{Key: "status", Value: domain.SettlementStatusExecuting},
186				{Key: "executing_at", Value: now},
187			})
188			if err != nil || ok {
189				return ok, err
190			}
191		}
192		res, err := rp.batches.UpdateOne(ctx,
193			bson.D{
194				{Key: "_id", Value: id},
195				{Key: "status", Value: domain.SettlementStatusExecuting},
196				{Key: "executing_at", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$lt", Value: staleBefore}}},
197			},
198			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "executing_at", Value: now}}}},
199		)
200		if err != nil {
201			return false, httpx.Internal(err)
202		}
203		return res.MatchedCount > 0, nil
204	}
205	
206	// markExecutionFailed best-effort flips EXECUTING→FAILED with the reason so a
207	// mid-execution error leaves a re-executable batch, never a stuck one.
208	func (rp *repo) markExecutionFailed(ctx context.Context, id, reason string) error {
209		_, err := rp.batches.UpdateOne(ctx,
210			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}, {Key: "status", Value: domain.SettlementStatusExecuting}},
211			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
212				{Key: "status", Value: domain.SettlementStatusFailed},
213				{Key: "fail_reason", Value: reason},
214			}}},
215		)
216		if err != nil {
217			return httpx.Internal(err)
218		}
219		return nil
220	}
221	
222	// setBatchProvenanceSeq stamps the batch with its latest ledger sequence.
223	func (rp *repo) setBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx context.Context, id string, seq int64) error {
224		_, err := rp.batches.UpdateOne(ctx,
225			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}},
226			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "provenance_seq", Value: seq}}}},
227		)
228		if err != nil {
229			return httpx.Internal(err)
230		}
231		return nil
232	}
233	
234	// listBatches pages settlement batches, newest day first.
235	func (rp *repo) listBatches(ctx context.Context, filter bson.D, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.SettlementBatch, int64, error) {
236		total, err := rp.batches.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
237		if err != nil {
238			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
239		}
240		cur, err := rp.batches.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
241			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "date", Value: -1}, {Key: "created_at", Value: -1}}).
242			SetSkip(page.Offset).SetLimit(page.Limit),
243		)
244		if err != nil {
245			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
246		}
247		var out []domain.SettlementBatch
248		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
249			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
250		}
251		return out, total, nil
252	}
253	
254	// ---- payout instructions ----
255	
256	// insertPayout persists one payout. The unique index on invoice_id makes an
257	// execution retry harmless: alreadyExists=true means this invoice was paid
258	// in a previous (possibly interrupted) run.
259	func (rp *repo) insertPayout(ctx context.Context, p *domain.PayoutInstruction) (alreadyExists bool, err error) {
260		if _, err := rp.payouts.InsertOne(ctx, p); err != nil {
261			if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(err) {
262				return true, nil
263			}
264			return false, httpx.Internal(err)
265		}
266		return false, nil
267	}
268	
269	// payoutByInvoice fetches the payout already recorded for an invoice.
270	func (rp *repo) payoutByInvoice(ctx context.Context, invoiceID string) (*domain.PayoutInstruction, error) {
271		var p domain.PayoutInstruction
272		err := rp.payouts.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "invoice_id", Value: invoiceID}}).Decode(&p)
273		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
274			return nil, httpx.NotFound("payout for invoice " + invoiceID)
275		}
276		if err != nil {
277			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
278		}
279		return &p, nil
280	}

282	// payoutsByBatch returns a batch's payout instructions.

285			bson.D{{Key: "settlement_batch_id", Value: batchID}},
286			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "created_at", Value: 1}}).SetLimit(internalFetchCap),
287		)
288		if err != nil {

290		}
291		var out []domain.PayoutInstruction
292		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {

294		}
295		return out, nil
296	}

298	// payoutsByFarmer pages one farmer's payment history, newest first.

300		filter := bson.D{{Key: "farmer_party_id", Value: farmerPartyID}}

308		)

311		}

313		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
314			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
315		}
316		return out, total, nil
317	}

319	// ---- lookups in adjacent collections (read-only, per module spec) ----
320	
321	// latestBankMasked returns the masked bank account from the farmer's most
322	// recent KYC record carrying one, or "" when none exists.
323	func (rp *repo) latestBankMasked(ctx context.Context, partyID string) (string, error) {
324		var rec domain.KYCRecord
325		err := rp.kyc.FindOne(ctx,
326			bson.D{
327				{Key: "party_id", Value: partyID},
328				{Key: "bank_account_masked", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$exists", Value: true}, {Key: "$ne", Value: ""}}},
329			},

331		).Decode(&rec)

333			return "", nil
334		}
335		if err != nil {
336			return "", httpx.Internal(err)

338		return rec.BankAccountMasked, nil
339	}

341	// farmerDCSIDs returns the org units where the party holds an ACTIVE FARMER
342	// assignment — the scope anchors for staff reads of the farmer's financials.
343	func (rp *repo) farmerDCSIDs(ctx context.Context, farmerPartyID string) ([]string, error) {
344		cur, err := rp.assignments.Find(ctx,
345			bson.D{

349			},

351		)

354		}
355		var docs []struct {

357		}
358		if err := cur.All(ctx, &docs); err != nil {
359			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
360		}
361		ids := make([]string, 0, len(docs))
362		for _, d := range docs {
363			if d.OrgUnitID != "" {
364				ids = append(ids, d.OrgUnitID)
365			}
366		}

394	func (rp *repo) dbtByID(ctx context.Context, id string) (*domain.DBTRequest, error) {
395		var d domain.DBTRequest
396		err := rp.dbt.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&d)
397		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
398			return nil, httpx.NotFound("dbt request " + id)

406	// transitionDBT performs a status-guarded DBT update; false = lost the race
407	// or the request already left fromStatus.
408	func (rp *repo) transitionDBT(ctx context.Context, id, fromStatus, toStatus string, creditedAt *time.Time) (bool, error) {
409		set := bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: toStatus}}
410		if creditedAt != nil {
411			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "credited_at", Value: creditedAt})
412		}
413		res, err := rp.dbt.UpdateOne(ctx,
414			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}, {Key: "status", Value: fromStatus}},
415			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: set}},
416		)
417		if err != nil {
418			return false, httpx.Internal(err)
419		}
420		return res.MatchedCount > 0, nil
421	}
422

425		total, err := rp.dbt.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
426		if err != nil {
427			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
428		}
429		cur, err := rp.dbt.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
430			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "created_at", Value: -1}}).
431			SetSkip(page.Offset).SetLimit(page.Limit),
432		)
433		if err != nil {
434			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
435		}
436		var out []domain.DBTRequest
437		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
438			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
439		}
440		return out, total, nil
441	}
```

```text
1	package domain
2	
3	import (
4		"time"
5	
6		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
7	)
8	
9	// Org-unit types — the cooperative backbone RBAC is scoped to (blueprint §5.1,
10	// PCDF constitution: Samiti/DCS → Sangh/Union → PCDF apex).
11	const (
12		OrgTypeFederation      = "FEDERATION"       // PCDF / Parag (state apex)
13		OrgTypeMilkUnion       = "MILK_UNION"       // district Sangh
14		OrgTypeProcessingPlant = "PROCESSING_PLANT" // PCDF plant
15		OrgTypeBMC             = "BMC"              // bulk milk cooler / chilling centre
16		OrgTypeDCS             = "DCS"              // village samiti
17	)
18	
19	// AllOrgTypes is the closed set of org-unit types.
20	var AllOrgTypes = []string{
21		OrgTypeFederation, OrgTypeMilkUnion, OrgTypeProcessingPlant, OrgTypeBMC, OrgTypeDCS,
22	}
23	
24	// ValidOrgParent encodes the allowed hierarchy edges.
25	var ValidOrgParent = map[string][]string{
26		OrgTypeFederation:      {}, // root
27		OrgTypeMilkUnion:       {OrgTypeFederation},
28		OrgTypeProcessingPlant: {OrgTypeMilkUnion, OrgTypeFederation},
29		OrgTypeBMC:             {OrgTypeMilkUnion},
30		OrgTypeDCS:             {OrgTypeMilkUnion, OrgTypeBMC},
31	}
32	
33	// OrgUnit is a node in the cooperative hierarchy.
34	//
35	// ID scheme: `_id` is a generated ObjectID (relations always reference it);
36	// Code is the human-readable unique business key (e.g. "DCS-01842") used for
37	// display, lookups and seed idempotency — never for joins.
38	//
39	// Path holds the ObjectIDs of all ancestors from the root down to (and
40	// excluding) this node — denormalised so "is X inside Y's scope" is a single
41	// indexed array-containment check with no recursive queries on the hot path.
42	type OrgUnit struct {
43		ID        primitive.ObjectID   `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
44		Type      string               `bson:"type"          json:"type"`
45		Name      string               `bson:"name"          json:"name"`
46		Code      string               `bson:"code"          json:"code"` // unique business key, e.g. "DCS-01842"
47		ParentID  *primitive.ObjectID  `bson:"parent_id,omitempty" json:"parent_id,omitempty"`
48		Path      []primitive.ObjectID `bson:"path"          json:"path"`
49		District  string               `bson:"district,omitempty" json:"district,omitempty"`
50		State     string               `bson:"state,omitempty"    json:"state,omitempty"`
51		GeoLat    float64              `bson:"geo_lat,omitempty"  json:"geo_lat,omitempty"`
52		GeoLng    float64              `bson:"geo_lng,omitempty"  json:"geo_lng,omitempty"`
53		Active    bool                 `bson:"active"        json:"active"`
54		CreatedAt time.Time            `bson:"created_at"    json:"created_at"`
55		UpdatedAt time.Time            `bson:"updated_at"    json:"updated_at"`
56	}
57	
58	// IsValidOrgType reports whether t is a known org-unit type.
59	func IsValidOrgType(t string) bool {
60		for _, v := range AllOrgTypes {
61			if v == t {
62				return true
63			}
64		}
65		return false
66	}
67
```

```text
53	// validatePashuAadhaar enforces the national ear-tag format: exactly 12
54	// ASCII digits (§9). Pure function — unit tested.
55	func validatePashuAadhaar(id string) *httpx.AppError {
56		if len(id) != 12 {
57			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_PASHU_AADHAAR", "pashu_aadhaar must be exactly 12 digits")
58		}
59		for i := 0; i < len(id); i++ {
60			if id[i] < '0' || id[i] > '9' {
61				return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_PASHU_AADHAAR", "pashu_aadhaar must contain digits only")
62			}
63		}
64		return nil
65	}

67	// resolveAnimalOwner decides who the registered animal belongs to. A FARMER
68	// may only register their own animals (any explicit owner_party_id must match
69	// the caller); every other registrar role must name the owner explicitly.
70	// Pure function — unit tested.
71	func resolveAnimalOwner(actor auth.Actor, requestedOwner string) (string, *httpx.AppError) {
72		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleFarmer {
73			if requestedOwner != "" && requestedOwner != actor.PartyID {
74				return "", httpx.Forbidden("farmers may only register their own animals")
75			}
76			return actor.PartyID, nil
77		}
78		if requestedOwner == "" {
79			return "", httpx.BadRequest("OWNER_REQUIRED", "owner_party_id is required when registering on a farmer's behalf")
80		}
81		return requestedOwner, nil
82	}
83	
84	// canViewAnimal enforces v1 read access: the owner FARMER, or one of the
85	// care-circle roles already gated at the route (VETERINARIAN, AI_TECH,
86	// MISSION_OFFICIAL).
87	//
88	// TODO(consent): v2 must additionally verify a DPDP consent artefact from the
89	// owner (consents collection, blueprint §18-A) before a non-owner role reads
90	// an animal or its health history. v1 deliberately ships the role check only.
91	func canViewAnimal(actor auth.Actor, animal *domain.Animal) *httpx.AppError {
92		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleFarmer && animal.OwnerPartyID != actor.PartyID {
93			return httpx.Forbidden("farmers may only view their own animals")
94		}
95		return nil
96	}
97	
98	// appendLedger records a provenance event best-effort. The primary document
99	// is already committed when this runs, so a ledger hiccup is logged for
100	// reconciliation rather than turned into a request failure the client would
101	// retry into a duplicate.
102	func (s *service) appendLedger(ctx context.Context, in provenance.AppendInput) {
103		if _, err := s.d.Ledger.Append(ctx, in); err != nil {
104			s.d.Log.Error("cattle: provenance append failed",
105				slog.String("type", in.Type),
106				slog.String("entity_id", in.EntityID),
107				slog.Any("err", err),
108			)
109		}
110	}

112	// RegisterAnimal creates an animal record keyed on Pashu Aadhaar (§9) and
113	// appends the animal.registered provenance event.
114	func (s *service) RegisterAnimal(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req RegisterAnimalRequest) (*domain.Animal, error) {
115		if err := validatePashuAadhaar(req.PashuAadhaar); err != nil {
116			return nil, err
117		}
118		if req.DCSID == "" {
119			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("DCS_REQUIRED", "dcs_id is required")
120		}
121		if req.Species == "" {
122			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("SPECIES_REQUIRED", "species is required")
123		}
124		owner, aerr := resolveAnimalOwner(actor, req.OwnerPartyID)
125		if aerr != nil {
126			return nil, aerr
127		}
128		// Farmers register into their own village context; every other registrar
129		// must hold scope over the target DCS.
130		if actor.RoleCode != domain.RoleFarmer {
131			if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.DCSID); err != nil {
132				return nil, err
133			}
134		}
135	
136		now := time.Now().UTC()
137		animal := &domain.Animal{
138			ID:              uuid.NewString(),
139			PashuAadhaar:    req.PashuAadhaar,
140			OwnerPartyID:    owner,
141			DCSID:           req.DCSID,
142			Species:         req.Species,
143			Breed:           req.Breed,
144			Sex:             req.Sex,
145			LactationStatus: req.LactationStatus,
146			CollarEnabled:   false, // dormant until a collar scheme flips flags.FlagCollarTelemetry (§9)
147			Status:          domain.AnimalStatusActive,
148			CreatedAt:       now,
149			UpdatedAt:       now,
150		}
151		if err := s.repo.InsertAnimal(ctx, animal); err != nil {
152			return nil, err
153		}
154	
155		s.appendLedger(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
156			Type:       domain.EventAnimalRegistered,
157			EntityType: domain.EntityAnimal,
158			EntityID:   animal.ID,
159			Refs: []provenance.Ref{
160				{EntityType: domain.EntityParty, EntityID: owner, Relation: "owned_by"},
161			},
162			Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
163			OrgUnitID: animal.DCSID,
164			Payload: map[string]any{
165				"pashu_aadhaar": animal.PashuAadhaar,
166				"species":       animal.Species,
167			},
168		})
169		return animal, nil
170	}

172	// ListAnimals returns a page of animals. Farmers — and plain session tokens,
173	// which carry no role scope at all — are pinned to their own herd. Every
174	// other role (except the federation-wide read roles) must name a DCS inside
175	// its organisational scope, so a narrowly-scoped or consumer role can never
176	// enumerate the national animal registry.
177	func (s *service) ListAnimals(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, ownerPartyID, dcsID string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.Animal, int64, error) {
178		switch {
179		case actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleFarmer || actor.Kind == auth.TokenKindSession:
180			ownerPartyID = actor.PartyID
181		case actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSuperAdmin || actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleStateAuditor:
182			// federation-wide read roles may filter freely
183		default:
184			if dcsID == "" {
185				return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("DCS_REQUIRED", "dcs_id is required for your role")
186			}
187			if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, dcsID); err != nil {
188				return nil, 0, err
189			}
190		}
191		return s.repo.ListAnimals(ctx, ownerPartyID, dcsID, page)
192	}

194	// requireAnimalReadAccess applies the animal read rule: the owner FARMER, or
195	// a care-circle role whose org scope covers the animal's DCS — a vet from one
196	// union must not read animal health PII across the federation.
197	func (s *service) requireAnimalReadAccess(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, animal *domain.Animal) error {
198		if aerr := canViewAnimal(actor, animal); aerr != nil {
199			return aerr
200		}
201		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleFarmer {
202			return nil // owner (canViewAnimal already pinned ownership)
203		}
204		return s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, animal.DCSID)
205	}

233	// LogHealthEvent records one health-history entry with bp_sync_status PENDING
234	// and appends the health.event_logged provenance event.
235	func (s *service) LogHealthEvent(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, animalID string, req LogHealthEventRequest) (*domain.HealthEvent, error) {
236		if _, ok := validHealthEventTypes[req.Type]; !ok {
237			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_HEALTH_EVENT_TYPE", "type must be one of the catalog health event types")
238		}
239		animal, err := s.repo.FindAnimalByID(ctx, animalID)
240		if err != nil {
241			return nil, err
242		}
243		if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, animal.DCSID); err != nil {
244			return nil, err
245		}
246	
247		now := time.Now().UTC()
248		occurredAt := now
249		if req.OccurredAt != nil {
250			occurredAt = req.OccurredAt.UTC()
251		}
252		event := &domain.HealthEvent{
253			ID:              uuid.NewString(),
254			AnimalID:        animal.ID,
255			PashuAadhaar:    animal.PashuAadhaar,
256			Type:            req.Type,
257			Details:         req.Details,
258			RecordedByParty: actor.PartyID,
259			RecordedByRole:  actor.RoleCode,
260			OccurredAt:      occurredAt,
261			BharatPashudhan: domain.BPSyncPending, // pushed later via /bp-sync
262			CreatedAt:       now,
263		}
264		if err := s.repo.InsertHealthEvent(ctx, event); err != nil {
265			return nil, err
266		}
267	
268		// The ledger event lands on the animal's timeline (there is no dedicated
269		// health-event entity type); the ref pins the animal it was recorded for.
270		s.appendLedger(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
271			Type:       domain.EventHealthEventLogged,
272			EntityType: domain.EntityAnimal,
273			EntityID:   animal.ID,
274			Refs: []provenance.Ref{
275				{EntityType: domain.EntityAnimal, EntityID: animal.ID, Relation: "recorded_for"},
276			},
277			Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
278			OrgUnitID: animal.DCSID,
279			Payload: map[string]any{
280				"health_event_id": event.ID,
281				"type":            event.Type,
282			},
283		})
284		return event, nil
285	}

287	// SyncBharatPashudhan is the MOCK national-DB push (§9): it marks every
288	// PENDING health event of the animal SYNCED under a mock reference. The real

290	func (s *service) SyncBharatPashudhan(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, animalID string) (*BPSyncResponse, error) {

306	// CreateMVUCase opens a 1962 MVU request (§10). The DCS comes from the
307	// farmer's own animal when animal_id is given, else from the actor's org.
308	func (s *service) CreateMVUCase(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateMVUCaseRequest) (*domain.MVUCase, error) {
309		if strings.TrimSpace(req.Symptoms) == "" {
310			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("SYMPTOMS_REQUIRED", "symptoms description is required")
311		}
312	
313		dcsID := actor.OrgUnitID
314		animalID := ""
315		if req.AnimalID != "" {
316			animal, err := s.repo.FindAnimalByID(ctx, req.AnimalID)
317			if err != nil {
318				return nil, err
319			}
320			if animal.OwnerPartyID != actor.PartyID {
321				return nil, httpx.Forbidden("you may only raise an MVU case for your own animal")
322			}
323			animalID = animal.ID
324			dcsID = animal.DCSID
325		}
326		if dcsID == "" {
327			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("DCS_UNRESOLVED", "cannot resolve a DCS for this case — provide animal_id or use a DCS-scoped role token")
328		}
329	
330		mvuCase := &domain.MVUCase{
331			ID:            uuid.NewString(),
332			AnimalID:      animalID,
333			FarmerPartyID: actor.PartyID,
334			DCSID:         dcsID,
335			Symptoms:      strings.TrimSpace(req.Symptoms),
336			Status:        domain.MVUCaseRequested,
337			RequestedAt:   time.Now().UTC(),
338		}
339		if err := s.repo.InsertMVUCase(ctx, mvuCase); err != nil {
340			return nil, err
341		}
342		return mvuCase, nil
343	}
344	
345	// DispatchMVUCase moves a case REQUESTED → DISPATCHED, records the assignee
346	// from the caller's role, and publishes eventbus.TopicMVUDispatched with an
347	// explicit payload contract — keys: case_id, farmer_party_id, animal_id,
348	// dcs_id (the notifications module reacts, §10).
349	func (s *service) DispatchMVUCase(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, caseID string) (*domain.MVUCase, error) {
350		mvuCase, err := s.repo.FindMVUCaseByID(ctx, caseID)
351		if err != nil {
352			return nil, err
353		}
354		if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, mvuCase.DCSID); err != nil {
355			return nil, err
356		}
357	
358		var vetPartyID, driverPartyID string
359		switch actor.RoleCode {
360		case domain.RoleVeterinarian:
361			vetPartyID = actor.PartyID
362		case domain.RoleMVUDriver:
363			driverPartyID = actor.PartyID
364			// Any other role reaching here is break-glass SUPER_ADMIN: the case
365			// is dispatched without pinning an assignee.
366		}
367	
368		transitioned, err := s.repo.DispatchMVUCase(ctx, mvuCase.ID, vetPartyID, driverPartyID)
369		if err != nil {
370			return nil, err
371		}
372		if !transitioned {
373			return nil, httpx.Conflict("MVU_NOT_REQUESTED", "MVU case is not in REQUESTED state")
374		}
375	
376		updated, err := s.repo.FindMVUCaseByID(ctx, mvuCase.ID)
377		if err != nil {
378			return nil, err
379		}
380		// Explicit event shape: the subscriber decodes structurally by JSON key,
381		// so the case ID must travel under "case_id" — publishing the raw domain
382		// document (whose ID marshals as "id") left the farmer SMS caseless.
383		s.d.Bus.Publish(eventbus.TopicMVUDispatched, map[string]any{
384			"case_id":         updated.ID,
385			"farmer_party_id": updated.FarmerPartyID,
386			"animal_id":       updated.AnimalID,
387			"dcs_id":          updated.DCSID,
388		})
389		return updated, nil
390	}
391	
392	// CloseMVUCase moves a DISPATCHED/ARRIVED case to CLOSED with the visit log.
393	func (s *service) CloseMVUCase(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, caseID string, req CloseMVUCaseRequest) (*domain.MVUCase, error) {
394		if strings.TrimSpace(req.VisitNotes) == "" {
395			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VISIT_NOTES_REQUIRED", "visit_notes is required to close a case")
396		}
397		mvuCase, err := s.repo.FindMVUCaseByID(ctx, caseID)
398		if err != nil {
399			return nil, err
400		}
401		if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, mvuCase.DCSID); err != nil {
402			return nil, err
403		}
404	
405		transitioned, err := s.repo.CloseMVUCase(ctx, mvuCase.ID, strings.TrimSpace(req.VisitNotes), req.HealthEventIDs, time.Now().UTC())
406		if err != nil {
407			return nil, err
408		}
409		if !transitioned {
410			return nil, httpx.Conflict("MVU_NOT_OPEN", "MVU case must be DISPATCHED or ARRIVED to close")
411		}
412		return s.repo.FindMVUCaseByID(ctx, mvuCase.ID)
413	}

415	// ListMVUCases returns a page of cases for the field roles. A dcs_id filter
416	// is scope-checked against the caller's org.

418		if status != "" {
419			if _, ok := validMVUStatuses[status]; !ok {
420				return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_MVU_STATUS", "status must be one of REQUESTED, DISPATCHED, ARRIVED, CLOSED, CANCELLED")
421			}
422		}
423		if dcsID != "" {
424			if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, dcsID); err != nil {
425				return nil, 0, err
426			}
427		}
428		return s.repo.ListMVUCases(ctx, dcsID, status, page)

436	// CreateEducation adds an item to the education hub. Published defaults to
437	// true: v1 has no separate publish step, so unpublished items would be
438	// unreachable.
439	func (s *service) CreateEducation(ctx context.Context, req CreateEducationRequest) (*domain.EducationContent, error) {
440		if req.Topic == "" || req.Title == "" || req.Language == "" || req.MediaType == "" || req.MediaURL == "" {
441			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("EDUCATION_FIELDS_REQUIRED", "topic, title, language, media_type and media_url are required")
442		}
443		published := true
444		if req.Published != nil {
445			published = *req.Published
446		}
447		content := &domain.EducationContent{
448			ID:          uuid.NewString(),
449			Topic:       req.Topic,
450			Title:       req.Title,
451			Language:    req.Language,
452			MediaType:   req.MediaType,
453			MediaURL:    req.MediaURL,
454			DurationSec: req.DurationSec,
455			Published:   published,
456			CreatedAt:   time.Now().UTC(),
457		}
458		if err := s.repo.InsertEducation(ctx, content); err != nil {
459			return nil, err
460		}
461		return content, nil
462	}
463	
464	// IngestTelemetry is the dormant collar path (§9). The capability gate runs
465	// FIRST: while flags.FlagCollarTelemetry is off the endpoint refuses with
466	// FEATURE_DISABLED, proving the backdoor is provisioned but inert. When the
467	// scheme lands and the flag flips, frames are acknowledged with 202 — the
468	// storage pipeline ships with the scheme, not before.
469	func (s *service) IngestTelemetry(ctx context.Context, req TelemetryRequest) (*TelemetryAck, error) {
470		if !s.d.Flags.Enabled(ctx, flags.FlagCollarTelemetry) {
471			aerr := httpx.Forbidden("collar telemetry is provisioned but dormant (§9)")
472			aerr.Code = "FEATURE_DISABLED"
473			return nil, aerr
474		}
475		if err := validatePashuAadhaar(req.PashuAadhaar); err != nil {
476			return nil, err
477		}
478		return &TelemetryAck{
479			Accepted:     true,
480			PashuAadhaar: req.PashuAadhaar,
481			Note:         "telemetry accepted; persistent storage lands with the collar scheme",
482		}, nil
483	}
```

```text
24	// recordQCResult handles POST /quality/qc-results.
25	func (h *handler) recordQCResult(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
26		actor, ok := auth.ActorFrom(r.Context())
27		if !ok {
28			httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Unauthorized("authentication required"))
29			return
30		}
31	
32		var req RecordQCResultRequest
33		if err := httpx.DecodeJSON(r, &req); err != nil {
34			httpx.Error(w, r, err)
35			return
36		}
37		if err := validateRecordRequest(req); err != nil {
38			httpx.Error(w, r, err)
39			return
40		}
41	
42		result, err := h.svc.recordQCResult(r.Context(), actor, req)
43		if err != nil {
44			httpx.Error(w, r, err)
45			return
46		}
47		httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusCreated, result)
48	}

50	// validateRecordRequest checks required fields and test shape.
51	func validateRecordRequest(req RecordQCResultRequest) error {
52		if strings.TrimSpace(req.SubjectType) == "" {
53			return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_SUBJECT_TYPE", "subject_type is required")
54		}
55		if strings.TrimSpace(req.SubjectID) == "" {
56			return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_SUBJECT_ID", "subject_id is required")
57		}
58		if strings.TrimSpace(req.Stage) == "" {
59			return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_STAGE", "stage is required")
60		}
61		if len(req.Tests) == 0 {
62			return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_TESTS", "at least one test is required")
63		}
64		for i, t := range req.Tests {
65			if strings.TrimSpace(t.Name) == "" {
66				return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_TEST_NAME", "tests["+strconv.Itoa(i)+"].name is required")
67			}
68			if t.Value < 0 {
69				return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_TEST_VALUE", "tests["+strconv.Itoa(i)+"].value must not be negative")
70			}
71		}
72		return nil
73	}
```

```text
108	// requestOTP creates a hashed OTP challenge and queues the SMS through the
109	// notification outbox (the platformops worker delivers it).
110	func (s *service) requestOTP(ctx context.Context, phone string) (*otpRequestResponse, error) {
111		now := time.Now().UTC()
112		code, err := auth.GenerateNumericOTP(otpLength)
113		if err != nil {
114			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
115		}
116	
117		challenge := otpChallenge{
118			ID:        uuid.NewString(),
119			Phone:     phone,
120			CodeHash:  auth.HMACHash(s.deps.Cfg.OTPHashSecret, phone, code),
121			ExpiresAt: now.Add(s.deps.Cfg.OTPTTL),
122			Attempts:  0,
123		}
124		if err := s.repo.insertOTPChallenge(ctx, challenge); err != nil {
125			return nil, err
126		}
127	
128		// Outbox SMS: the plaintext code travels only inside the notification
129		// params so the sender can deliver it; the challenge stores the hash.
130		notification := domain.Notification{
131			ID:          uuid.NewString(),
132			Phone:       phone,
133			Channel:     domain.ChannelSMS,
134			TemplateKey: domain.TemplateOTP,
135			Language:    defaultLanguage,
136			Params:      map[string]string{"otp": code},
137			Status:      domain.NotificationQueued,
138			QueuedAt:    now,
139		}
140		if party, err := s.repo.findPartyByPhone(ctx, phone); err == nil {
141			notification.PartyID = party.ID
142			if party.PreferredLanguage != "" {
143				notification.Language = party.PreferredLanguage
144			}
145		}
146		if err := s.repo.insertNotification(ctx, notification); err != nil {
147			return nil, err
148		}
149	
150		resp := &otpRequestResponse{Phone: phone, ExpiresAt: challenge.ExpiresAt}
151		if s.deps.Cfg.OTPDevMode {
152			resp.DevOTP = code // dev only — config refuses OTP_DEV_MODE in prod
153		}
154		return resp, nil
155	}
156	
157	// verifyOTP checks the challenge and logs the phone in, creating the Party
158	// on first login (find-or-create, §4.1).
159	func (s *service) verifyOTP(ctx context.Context, phone, otp string) (*authTokensResponse, error) {
160		now := time.Now().UTC()
161	
162		challenge, err := s.repo.latestOTPChallenge(ctx, phone, now)
163		if err != nil {
164			if isNotFound(err) {
165				return nil, httpx.Unauthorized("no active OTP for this phone — request a new code")
166			}
167			return nil, err
168		}
169		if challenge.Attempts >= maxOTPAttempts {
170			return nil, httpx.TooManyRequests("too many incorrect OTP attempts — request a new code")
171		}
172		expected := auth.HMACHash(s.deps.Cfg.OTPHashSecret, phone, otp)
173		if !auth.ConstantTimeEqual(challenge.CodeHash, expected) {
174			if err := s.repo.incrementOTPAttempts(ctx, challenge.ID); err != nil {
175				return nil, err
176			}
177			return nil, httpx.Unauthorized("incorrect OTP")
178		}
179	
180		// Burn every outstanding challenge for this phone.
181		if err := s.repo.deleteOTPChallenges(ctx, phone); err != nil {
182			return nil, err
183		}
184	
185		party, err := s.repo.upsertPartyByPhone(ctx, phone, now)
186		if err != nil {
187			return nil, err
188		}
189		if party.Status != domain.PartyStatusActive {
190			return nil, httpx.Forbidden("party is suspended")
191		}
192		return s.issueLoginTokens(ctx, party, now)
193	}
194	
195	// issueLoginTokens mints a SESSION access token plus a fresh rotating
196	// refresh token (stored only as an HMAC digest).
197	func (s *service) issueLoginTokens(ctx context.Context, party *domain.Party, now time.Time) (*authTokensResponse, error) {
198		refreshToken, err := auth.RandomToken(32)
199		if err != nil {
200			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
201		}
202		doc := refreshTokenDoc{
203			ID:        uuid.NewString(),
204			TokenHash: auth.HMACHash(s.deps.Cfg.OTPHashSecret, refreshHashLabel, refreshToken),
205			PartyID:   party.ID,
206			ExpiresAt: now.Add(s.deps.Cfg.RefreshTokenTTL),
207			CreatedAt: now,
208		}
209		if err := s.repo.insertRefreshToken(ctx, doc); err != nil {
210			return nil, err
211		}
212		accessToken, err := s.deps.JWT.IssueSessionToken(*party)
213		if err != nil {
214			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
215		}
216		return &authTokensResponse{
217			AccessToken:  accessToken,
218			RefreshToken: refreshToken,
219			Party:        party,
220		}, nil
221	}
222	
223	// refresh rotates a refresh token: the old token is consumed atomically and
224	// a new pair is issued — a replayed token always fails.
225	func (s *service) refresh(ctx context.Context, refreshToken string) (*authTokensResponse, error) {
226		now := time.Now().UTC()
227		tokenHash := auth.HMACHash(s.deps.Cfg.OTPHashSecret, refreshHashLabel, refreshToken)
228	
229		doc, err := s.repo.findRefreshToken(ctx, tokenHash)
230		if err != nil {
231			if isNotFound(err) {
232				return nil, httpx.Unauthorized("invalid refresh token")
233			}
234			return nil, err
235		}
236		if !now.Before(doc.ExpiresAt) {
237			_, _ = s.repo.deleteRefreshToken(ctx, tokenHash)
238			return nil, httpx.Unauthorized("refresh token expired — log in again")
239		}
240	
241		// ROTATE: consume the old token first; DeletedCount==0 means a parallel
242		// request won the race, so this presentation is treated as a replay.
243		deleted, err := s.repo.deleteRefreshToken(ctx, tokenHash)
244		if err != nil {
245			return nil, err
246		}
247		if deleted == 0 {
248			return nil, httpx.Unauthorized("refresh token already used")
249		}
250	
251		party, err := s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, doc.PartyID)
252		if err != nil {
253			if isNotFound(err) {
254				return nil, httpx.Unauthorized("party no longer exists")
255			}
256			return nil, err
257		}
258		if party.Status != domain.PartyStatusActive {
259			return nil, httpx.Forbidden("party is suspended")
260		}
261		return s.issueLoginTokens(ctx, party, now)
262	}
263	
264	// logout revokes one refresh token belonging to the caller. Idempotent.
265	func (s *service) logout(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, refreshToken string) error {
266		tokenHash := auth.HMACHash(s.deps.Cfg.OTPHashSecret, refreshHashLabel, refreshToken)
267		return s.repo.deleteRefreshTokenForParty(ctx, tokenHash, actor.PartyID)
268	}

330				WithDetails(map[string]string{

391	// verifyAadhaar runs the MOCK Aadhaar eKYC flow (§18-A). The full Aadhaar
392	// number exists only in this request's memory: what is persisted is the
393	// last 4 digits plus an opaque reference from the (mock) Aadhaar Data Vault.
394	func (s *service) verifyAadhaar(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req aadhaarKYCRequest) (*aadhaarKYCResponse, error) {
395		now := time.Now().UTC()
396		party, err := s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, actor.PartyID)
397		if err != nil {
398			return nil, err
399		}
400	
401		language := party.PreferredLanguage
402		if language == "" {
403			language = defaultLanguage
404		}
405		consent := domain.Consent{
406			ID:          uuid.NewString(),
407			PartyID:     party.ID,
408			Purpose:     consentPurposeAadhaarEKYC,
409			TextVersion: consentTextVersion,
410			Language:    language,
411			GrantedAt:   now,
412		}
413		if err := s.repo.insertConsent(ctx, consent); err != nil {
414			return nil, err
415		}
416	
417		// MOCK Aadhaar Data Vault (§18-A): a real deployment sends the number to
418		// the vault service and receives an opaque token. The mock mints a UUID.
419		vaultRef := uuid.NewString()
420		last4 := req.AadhaarNumber[len(req.AadhaarNumber)-4:]
421	
422		// MOCK UIDAI eKYC: always succeeds. The real adapter drives the OTP-based
423		// eKYC exchange and may return PENDING/REJECTED.
424		record := domain.KYCRecord{
425			ID:              uuid.NewString(),
426			PartyID:         party.ID,
427			Tier:            req.RequestedTier,
428			AadhaarLast4:    last4,
429			AadhaarVaultRef: vaultRef,
430			ConsentID:       consent.ID,
431			Status:          domain.KYCStatusVerified,
432			VerifiedAt:      &now,
433			CreatedAt:       now,
434			UpdatedAt:       now,
435		}
436		if err := s.repo.insertKYCRecord(ctx, record); err != nil {
437			return nil, err
438		}
439	
440		newTier := upgradedKYCTier(party.KYCTier, req.RequestedTier)
441		if newTier != party.KYCTier {
442			if err := s.repo.updatePartyKYCTier(ctx, party.ID, newTier, now); err != nil {
443				return nil, err
444			}
445		}
446		return &aadhaarKYCResponse{Record: &record, KYCTier: newTier}, nil
447	}

450	// masked account tail and IFSC on the caller's latest KYC record (creating
451	// one when none exists yet).
452	func (s *service) verifyBank(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req bankKYCRequest) (*domain.KYCRecord, error) {
453		now := time.Now().UTC()

457		}
458		masked := maskAccount(req.AccountNumber)
459	
460		latest, err := s.repo.latestKYCRecord(ctx, actor.PartyID)
461		switch {
462		case err == nil:
463			// MOCK penny-drop: always verified with a fixed name-match score.
464			return s.repo.updateKYCRecordBank(ctx, latest.ID, masked, req.IFSC, mockPennyDropNameMatch, now)
465		case isNotFound(err):
466			record := domain.KYCRecord{
467				ID:                uuid.NewString(),
468				PartyID:           party.ID,
469				Tier:              party.KYCTier,
470				BankAccountMasked: masked,
471				BankIFSC:          req.IFSC,
472				BankVerified:      true, // MOCK penny-drop: always succeeds
473				BankNameMatch:     mockPennyDropNameMatch,
474				Status:            domain.KYCStatusVerified,
475				VerifiedAt:        &now,
476				CreatedAt:         now,
477				UpdatedAt:         now,
478			}
479			if err := s.repo.insertKYCRecord(ctx, record); err != nil {
480				return nil, err
481			}
482			return &record, nil
483		default:
484			return nil, err
485		}
486	}

496	// requireGrantAuthority enforces the non-admin granter matrix (§5.2):
497	// UNION_PRESIDENT manages village/logistics/union-tier roles anywhere in
498	// scope; SAMITI_ADHYAKSH manages only FARMER/MILK_TESTER/LRP inside their
499	// own DCS. Admin granters pass.
500	func (s *service) requireGrantAuthority(actor auth.Actor, roleCode, orgUnitID string) error {
501		if !granterMayGrant(actor.RoleCode, roleCode) {
502			return httpx.Forbidden("role " + actor.RoleCode + " may not grant or revoke " + roleCode)
503		}
504		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSamitiAdhyaksh && orgUnitID != actor.OrgUnitID {
505			return httpx.Forbidden("SAMITI_ADHYAKSH may manage roles only within their own DCS")
506		}

508	}

510	// createAssignment grants a role to a party inside an org unit.
511	func (s *service) createAssignment(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req createAssignmentRequest) (*domain.RoleAssignment, error) {
512		// Resolve the target party (party_id wins over phone).
513		var party *domain.Party
514		var err error
515		if req.PartyID != "" {
516			party, err = s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, req.PartyID)
517		} else {
518			party, err = s.repo.findPartyByPhone(ctx, req.Phone)
519		}
520		if err != nil {
521			return nil, err
522		}
523	
524		if err := s.deps.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.OrgUnitID); err != nil {
525			return nil, err
526		}
527		if err := s.requireGrantAuthority(actor, req.RoleCode, req.OrgUnitID); err != nil {
528			return nil, err
529		}
530	
531		exists, err := s.repo.activeAssignmentExists(ctx, party.ID, req.RoleCode, req.OrgUnitID)
532		if err != nil {
533			return nil, err
534		}
535		if exists {
536			return nil, httpx.Conflict("ASSIGNMENT_EXISTS", "party already holds an active "+req.RoleCode+" assignment in this org unit")
537		}
538	
539		now := time.Now().UTC()
540		validFrom := now
541		if req.ValidFrom != nil {
542			validFrom = req.ValidFrom.UTC()
543		}
544		var validTo *time.Time
545		if req.ValidTo != nil {
546			t := req.ValidTo.UTC()
547			validTo = &t
548		}
549		assignment := domain.RoleAssignment{
550			ID:        uuid.NewString(),
551			PartyID:   party.ID,
552			RoleCode:  req.RoleCode,
553			OrgUnitID: req.OrgUnitID,
554			GrantedBy: actor.PartyID,
555			ValidFrom: validFrom,
556			ValidTo:   validTo,
557			Status:    domain.RoleAssignmentActive,
558			CreatedAt: now,
559		}
560		if err := s.repo.insertAssignment(ctx, assignment); err != nil {
561			return nil, err
562		}
563		return &assignment, nil
564	}

566	// revokeAssignment flips an assignment to REVOKED — the record is never
567	// deleted (§4.1). Revocation authority mirrors grant authority.
568	func (s *service) revokeAssignment(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, assignmentID string) (*domain.RoleAssignment, error) {
569		assignment, err := s.repo.findAssignmentByID(ctx, assignmentID)
570		if err != nil {
571			return nil, err
572		}
573		if err := s.deps.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, assignment.OrgUnitID); err != nil {
574			return nil, err
575		}
576		if err := s.requireGrantAuthority(actor, assignment.RoleCode, assignment.OrgUnitID); err != nil {
577			return nil, err
578		}
579		if assignment.Status != domain.RoleAssignmentActive {
580			return nil, httpx.Conflict("ALREADY_REVOKED", "role assignment is already revoked")
581		}
582		return s.repo.revokeAssignment(ctx, assignmentID, actor.PartyID, time.Now().UTC())
583	}
584	
585	// listAssignments pages assignments inside one org unit the actor can see.
586	func (s *service) listAssignments(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, orgUnitID, roleCode string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.RoleAssignment, int64, error) {
587		if err := s.deps.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, orgUnitID); err != nil {
588			return nil, 0, err
589		}
590		return s.repo.listAssignments(ctx, orgUnitID, roleCode, page)
591	}
592
```

```text
157	// DispatchMVUCase moves a case REQUESTED → DISPATCHED, recording the vet
158	// and/or driver. The status guard in the filter is the optimistic lock (no
159	// transactions on a standalone server): a false return means the case was
160	// not in REQUESTED state — e.g. a concurrent dispatch won the race.
161	func (r *repository) DispatchMVUCase(ctx context.Context, id, vetPartyID, driverPartyID string) (bool, error) {
162		set := bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: domain.MVUCaseDispatched}}
163		if vetPartyID != "" {
164			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "vet_party_id", Value: vetPartyID})
165		}
166		if driverPartyID != "" {
167			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "driver_party_id", Value: driverPartyID})
168		}
169		res, err := r.mvuCases.UpdateOne(ctx,
170			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}, {Key: "status", Value: domain.MVUCaseRequested}},
171			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: set}})
172		if err != nil {
173			return false, httpx.Internal(err)
174		}
175		return res.MatchedCount == 1, nil
176	}
177	
178	// CloseMVUCase moves a DISPATCHED (or ARRIVED) case to CLOSED with the visit
179	// log. Same optimistic status-guard pattern as DispatchMVUCase.
180	func (r *repository) CloseMVUCase(ctx context.Context, id, visitNotes string, healthEventIDs []string, closedAt time.Time) (bool, error) {
181		set := bson.D{
182			{Key: "status", Value: domain.MVUCaseClosed},
183			{Key: "visit_notes", Value: visitNotes},
184			{Key: "closed_at", Value: closedAt},
185		}
186		if len(healthEventIDs) > 0 {
187			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "health_event_ids", Value: healthEventIDs})
188		}
189		res, err := r.mvuCases.UpdateOne(ctx,
190			bson.D{
191				{Key: "_id", Value: id},
192				{Key: "status", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: []string{
193					domain.MVUCaseDispatched, domain.MVUCaseArrived,
194				}}}},
195			},
196			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: set}})
197		if err != nil {
198			return false, httpx.Internal(err)
199		}
200		return res.MatchedCount == 1, nil
201	}
```

```text
1	// Package orgs implements the cooperative-hierarchy module (blueprint §5.1):
2	// the FEDERATION → MILK_UNION → {PROCESSING_PLANT, BMC, DCS} org-unit tree.
3	// It owns org-unit creation and edits (PCDF/state admins), directory reads
4	// for any authenticated party, subtree reads for oversight roles, and the
5	// membership roster (active role assignments joined with parties).
6	package orgs
7	
8	import (
9		"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
10	
11		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
12		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
13		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/middleware"
14	)

16	// Register mounts the orgs module under /orgs on the /api/v1 subtree.
17	func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
18		repo := newRepository(d.DB)
19		svc := newService(repo, d.Orgs)
20		h := newHandler(svc)
21	
22		r.Route("/orgs", func(r chi.Router) {
23			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
24	
25			// Hierarchy writes — state-apex administrators only.
26			r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
27				r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSuperAdmin, domain.RolePCDFAdmin))
28				r.Post("/", h.create)
29				r.Patch("/{id}", h.update)
30			})
31	
32			// Directory reads — any authenticated party (session or role token).
33			r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
34				r.Use(middleware.RequireSession)
35				r.Get("/", h.list)
36				r.Get("/{id}", h.get)
37				r.Get("/{id}/children", h.children)
38			})
39	
40			// Subtree read — oversight roles, scope-checked in the service.
41			r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
42				r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(
43					domain.RoleSuperAdmin,
44					domain.RolePCDFAdmin,
45					domain.RoleMissionOfficial,
46					domain.RoleUnionPresident,
47					domain.RoleStateAuditor,
48				))
49				r.Get("/{id}/tree", h.tree)
50			})
51	
52			// Membership roster — org staff roles, scope-checked in the service.
53			r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
54				r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(
55					domain.RoleSamitiSacheev,
56					domain.RoleSamitiAdhyaksh,
57					domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor,
58					domain.RoleUnionPresident,
59					domain.RolePCDFAdmin,
60					domain.RoleSuperAdmin,
61				))
62				r.Get("/{id}/members", h.members)
63			})
64		})
65	}
```

```text
1	// Package quality implements QC recording and THE safety-gate verdict writer
2	// (blueprint §8.3). It is the only module permitted to move a BMC lot or a
3	// processing batch out of QC_PENDING: a passing result certifies the subject
4	// (PASSED + certificate), a failing result quarantines it (BLOCKED + reasons).
5	// Aflatoxin M1 is heat-stable and survives pasteurisation, so this gate runs
6	// upstream at the BMC and the plant lab — never only at the finished product.
7	//
8	// A blocked subject can never advance; the plant module enforces that by
9	// refusing blocked inputs and by reacting to eventbus.TopicGateBlocked.
10	package quality
11	
12	import (
13		"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
14	
15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
16		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
17		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/middleware"
18	)
19	
20	// Register wires the quality module and mounts its routes under /quality
21	// (the router hands us the /api/v1 subtree).
22	func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
23		repo := newRepository(d.DB)
24		svc := newService(d, repo)
25		h := newHandler(svc)
26	
27		r.Route("/quality", func(r chi.Router) {
28			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
29	
30			// FSSAI limit constants — reference data for any signed-in client.
31			r.With(middleware.RequireSession).Get("/limits", h.getLimits)
32	
33			// Verdict writing: analyst roles only. Both roles share the endpoint;
34			// the stage×role pairing (BMC_RAPID↔BMC_OPERATOR, PLANT_LAB↔
35			// PLANT_LAB_ANALYST) is enforced in the service.
36			r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleBMCOperator, domain.RolePlantLabAnalyst)).
37				Post("/qc-results", h.recordQCResult)
38	
39			// Reads for supply-chain staff and oversight roles.
40			readRoles := middleware.RequireRoles(
41				domain.RoleBMCOperator,
42				domain.RolePlantLabAnalyst,
43				domain.RolePlantOperator,
44				domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor,
45				domain.RoleMissionOfficial,
46				domain.RoleStateAuditor,
47			)
48			r.With(readRoles).Get("/qc-results", h.listQCResults)
49			r.With(readRoles).Get("/qc-results/{id}", h.getQCResult)
50		})
51	}
52
```

```text
1	// Package plant implements the processing tier of the pour→QR chain:
2	// BMC lots (pooled consignments at the chilling centre), processing batches,
3	// product lots and QR issuance. It is the ENFORCEMENT layer of the safety
4	// gate (blueprint §8.3): a lot or batch that has not PASSED quality control
5	// can never advance — not into a tanker, not into a batch, not onto a shelf.
6	// Aflatoxin M1 survives pasteurisation, so the gate is checked at every hop,
7	// belt-and-braces.
8	package plant
9	
10	import (
11		"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
12	
13		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
14		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/middleware"
16	)
17	
18	// Register wires the plant module under /api/v1/plant.
19	func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
20		repo := NewRepo(d.DB)
21		svc := NewService(repo, d)
22		h := NewHandler(svc)
23	
24		r.Route("/plant", func(pr chi.Router) {
25			pr.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
26	
27			// BMC lots — created/closed/dispatched by the chilling-centre operator;
28			// readable by everyone downstream who receives or supervises the milk.
29			pr.Route("/bmc-lots", func(lr chi.Router) {
30				lr.With(middleware.RequireRoles(
31					domain.RoleBMCOperator, domain.RolePlantOperator,
32					domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor, domain.RolePlantLabAnalyst,
33				)).Get("/", h.ListBMCLots)
34	
35				lr.Group(func(wr chi.Router) {
36					wr.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleBMCOperator))
37					wr.Post("/", h.CreateBMCLot)
38					wr.Post("/{id}/close", h.CloseBMCLot)
39					wr.Post("/{id}/dispatch", h.DispatchBMCLot)
40				})
41			})
42	
43			// Processing batches — plant operator pools dispatched (gate-passed)
44			// BMC lots into a production run; plant lab + supervisor read along.
45			pr.Route("/batches", func(br chi.Router) {
46				read := middleware.RequireRoles(
47					domain.RolePlantOperator, domain.RolePlantLabAnalyst,
48					domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor,
49				)
50				br.With(read).Get("/", h.ListBatches)
51				br.With(read).Get("/{id}", h.GetBatch)
52	
53				br.Group(func(wr chi.Router) {
54					wr.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RolePlantOperator))
55					wr.Post("/", h.CreateBatch)
56					wr.Post("/{id}/complete", h.CompleteBatch)
57				})
58			})
59	
60			// Product lots — packaged SKUs out of a COMPLETED batch. Recall is the
61			// FSSAI path (§18-C): admin or plant lab pulls the lot from market.
62			pr.Route("/product-lots", func(plr chi.Router) {
63				plr.With(middleware.RequireRoles(
64					domain.RolePlantOperator, domain.RolePlantLabAnalyst,
65				)).Post("/", h.CreateProductLot)
66				plr.With(middleware.RequireRoles(
67					domain.RolePCDFAdmin, domain.RolePlantLabAnalyst,
68				)).Post("/{id}/recall", h.RecallProductLot)
69			})
70	
71			// QR issuance — the consumer-facing end of the trace chain (§7).
72			pr.Route("/qrs", func(qr chi.Router) {
73				qr.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(
74					domain.RolePlantOperator, domain.RolePlantLabAnalyst,
75				))
76				qr.Post("/", h.IssueQR)
77				qr.Get("/", h.ListQRs)
78			})
79		})
80	
81		// No bus subscriptions: the quality module flips lot/batch statuses in
82		// their own collections, and every gate here re-reads status at use time.
83	}
84
```

```text
1	// Package collection implements the core procurement loop of Saathi
2	// (blueprint §8.1, §8.2): org-scoped rate charts, anti-tamper analyzer
3	// readings, offline-first idempotent milk pours with same-day pricing, and
4	// per-farmer daily invoices behind the same-day payment promise.
5	//
6	// Bus topics published by this module:
7	//   - eventbus.TopicPourRecorded  — payload domain.MilkPour (the newly recorded pour)
8	//   - eventbus.TopicInvoiceIssued — payload domain.Invoice (the newly issued invoice)
9	package collection
10	
11	import (
12		"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
13	
14		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
16		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/middleware"
17	)
18	
19	// Register mounts the collection module under /collection and wires the
20	// handler → service → repo stack onto the shared platform dependencies.
21	func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
22		repo := newRepo(d)
23		svc := newService(d, repo)
24		h := &handler{svc: svc}
25	
26		r.Route("/collection", func(r chi.Router) {
27			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
28	
29			// Rate charts: pricing policy is set at union/federation level and
30			// resolved downward to each DCS (nearest ancestor wins).
31			r.Route("/rate-charts", func(r chi.Router) {
32				r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RolePCDFAdmin, domain.RoleUnionPresident)).
33					Post("/", h.createRateChart)
34				r.With(middleware.RequireSession).Get("/active", h.getActiveRateChart)
35			})
36	
37			// Analyzer readings: flagged, never rejected (anti-tamper envelope §8.2).
38			r.Route("/readings", func(r chi.Router) {
39				r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSamitiSacheev, domain.RoleMilkTester)).
40					Post("/", h.createReading)
41				r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(
42					domain.RoleSamitiSacheev, domain.RoleMilkTester, domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor,
43				)).Get("/", h.listReadings)
44			})
45	
46			// Pours: THE core loop — offline-first idempotent, hard plausibility gate.
47			r.Route("/pours", func(r chi.Router) {
48				r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
49					r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSamitiSacheev, domain.RoleMilkTester))
50					r.Post("/", h.createPour)
51					r.Post("/batch-sync", h.batchSyncPours)
52					r.Post("/{id}/supersede", h.supersedePour)
53				})
54				r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(
55					domain.RoleSamitiSacheev, domain.RoleMilkTester,
56					domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor, domain.RoleFarmer,
57				)).Get("/", h.listPours)
58			})
59	
60			// Invoices: the same-day settlement artefact (§8.1).
61			r.Route("/invoices", func(r chi.Router) {
62				r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSamitiSacheev)).
63					Post("/generate", h.generateInvoices)
64				r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
65					r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(
66						domain.RoleFarmer, domain.RoleSamitiSacheev, domain.RoleSamitiAdhyaksh,
67						domain.RoleMilkTester, domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor,
68						domain.RoleUnionPresident, domain.RolePCDFAdmin,
69					))
70					r.Get("/", h.listInvoices)
71					r.Get("/{id}", h.getInvoice)
72				})
73			})
74		})
75	}
```

```text
1	// Package settlement implements the same-day payment rail under the
2	// blueprint §8.1/§18-B guardrail: Saathi computes and initiates a batch,
3	// a DIFFERENT authorised human approves it (dual control), and a licensed
4	// Payment Aggregator (mocked here) executes the payouts. Scheme subsidies
5	// ride the strictly separate PFMS/DBT rail (§13) — never the milk-payment
6	// rail, and never the reverse.
7	package settlement
8	
9	import (
10		"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
11	
12		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
13		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
14		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/middleware"
15	)
16	
17	// Register wires the settlement module and mounts /settlements and /dbt
18	// under the /api/v1 subtree it receives.
19	func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
20		svc := &service{
21			repo:   newRepo(d.DB),
22			ledger: d.Ledger,
23			orgs:   d.Orgs,
24			bus:    d.Bus,
25			log:    d.Log,
26		}
27		h := &handler{svc: svc}
28	
29		// Read access to batches: village signatories plus union/state oversight.
30		readRoles := middleware.RequireRoles(
31			domain.RoleSamitiSacheev,
32			domain.RoleSamitiAdhyaksh,
33			domain.RoleUnionPresident,
34			domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor,
35			domain.RoleStateAuditor,
36		)
37	
38		r.Route("/settlements", func(sr chi.Router) {
39			sr.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
40	
41			// Initiate: the Sacheev runs the collection console (§8.1 step 1).
42			sr.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSamitiSacheev)).
43				Post("/", h.initiate)
44	
45			// Approve / reject: a different authorised signatory (dual control is
46			// additionally enforced on party identity inside the service).
47			sr.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSamitiAdhyaksh, domain.RoleUnionPresident)).
48				Post("/{id}/approve", h.approve)
49			sr.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSamitiAdhyaksh, domain.RoleUnionPresident)).
50				Post("/{id}/reject", h.reject)
51	
52			// Execute: hand the approved batch to the (mock) licensed PA.
53			sr.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSamitiSacheev, domain.RoleSamitiAdhyaksh)).
54				Post("/{id}/execute", h.execute)
55	
56			sr.With(readRoles).Get("/", h.list)
57	
58			// Farmer payment history — FARMER tokens are forced to their own party.
59			sr.With(middleware.RequireRoles(
60				domain.RoleFarmer,
61				domain.RoleSamitiSacheev,
62				domain.RoleSamitiAdhyaksh,
63				domain.RoleUnionPresident,
64				domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor,
65				domain.RoleStateAuditor,
66			)).Get("/payouts", h.payouts)
67	
68			sr.With(readRoles).Get("/{id}", h.detail)
69		})
70	
71		r.Route("/dbt", func(dr chi.Router) {
72			dr.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))

74			dr.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleMissionOfficial, domain.RolePCDFAdmin)).

82				domain.RoleStateAuditor,
```

```text
1	package logistics
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"errors"
6		"fmt"
7		"math"
8		"time"
9	
10		"github.com/google/uuid"
11		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
12		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
13	
14		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
16		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
17		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/orgscope"
18		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/provenance"
19	)
20	
21	const (
22		// canCapacityLitres is the standard milk-can volume used to size a
23		// consignment: can_count = ceil(total litres / 40).
24		canCapacityLitres = 40.0
25	
26		// maxPourRefs caps how many pour references a consignment.created
27		// provenance event carries; beyond it the pour count lives in the
28		// payload only, keeping ledger events bounded.
29		maxPourRefs = 300
30	
31		// maxTripStops bounds a planned route so trip documents stay small.
32		maxTripStops = 100
33	
34		// Physical sanity bounds for a hand-held transit thermometer reading.
35		minPlausibleTempC = -30.0
36		maxPlausibleTempC = 70.0
37	)
38	
39	// service holds all logistics business logic: consignment aggregation,
40	// the consignment/trip state machines, and provenance emission.
41	type service struct {
42		repo   *repo
43		orgs   *orgscope.Resolver
44		ledger *provenance.Ledger
45	}
46	
47	// newService wires the service to its collaborators.
48	func newService(repo *repo, orgs *orgscope.Resolver, ledger *provenance.Ledger) *service {
49		return &service{repo: repo, orgs: orgs, ledger: ledger}
50	}
51	
52	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
53	// Consignments
54	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
55	
56	// createConsignment pools one DCS date+shift's RECORDED pours into an OPEN
57	// consignment: pour IDs, total litres, quantity-weighted fat/SNF averages and
58	// the can count. The unique dcs+date+shift index makes creation idempotent-ish
59	// (a replay returns CONSIGNMENT_EXISTS).
60	func (s *service) createConsignment(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req createConsignmentRequest) (*domain.DCSConsignment, error) {
61		if req.DCSID == "" {
62			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_DCS_ID", "dcs_id is required")
63		}
64		if err := validateShift(req.Shift); err != nil {
65			return nil, err
66		}
67		now := time.Now().UTC()
68		date, err := resolveDate(req.Date, now)
69		if err != nil {
70			return nil, err
71		}
72		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.DCSID); err != nil {
73			return nil, err
74		}
75		org, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.DCSID)
76		if err != nil {
77			return nil, err
78		}
79		if org.Type != domain.OrgTypeDCS {
80			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_DCS", "org unit "+req.DCSID+" is not a DCS")
81		}
82	
83		rows, err := s.repo.findRecordedPours(ctx, req.DCSID, date, req.Shift)
84		if err != nil {
85			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
86		}
87		if len(rows) == 0 {
88			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("NO_POURS_TO_CONSIGN",
89				fmt.Sprintf("no RECORDED pours for DCS %s on %s %s", req.DCSID, date, req.Shift))
90		}
91		pourIDs, totalQty, avgFat, avgSNF := aggregatePours(rows)
92	
93		consignment := &domain.DCSConsignment{
94			ID:                  uuid.NewString(),
95			DCSID:               req.DCSID,
96			Date:                date,
97			Shift:               req.Shift,
98			PourIDs:             pourIDs,
99			TotalQuantityLitres: totalQty,
100			CanCount:            int(math.Ceil(totalQty / canCapacityLitres)),
101			AvgFatPct:           avgFat,
102			AvgSNFPct:           avgSNF,
103			Status:              domain.ConsignmentStatusOpen,
104			CreatedBy:           actor.PartyID,
105			CreatedAt:           now,
106		}
107		if err := s.repo.insertConsignment(ctx, consignment); err != nil {
108			if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(err) {
109				return nil, httpx.Conflict("CONSIGNMENT_EXISTS",
110					fmt.Sprintf("a consignment for DCS %s on %s %s already exists", req.DCSID, date, req.Shift))
111			}
112			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
113		}
114	
115		// Provenance: the pooling-boundary event. Pour refs are capped so the
116		// event stays bounded — past the cap the payload's pour_count is the
117		// authoritative tally (the doc's pour_ids keeps the full set).
118		refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, min(len(pourIDs), maxPourRefs))
119		for i, id := range pourIDs {
120			if i >= maxPourRefs {
121				break
122			}
123			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{EntityType: domain.EntityMilkPour, EntityID: id, Relation: "aggregates"})
124		}
125		event, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
126			Type:       domain.EventConsignmentCreated,
127			EntityType: domain.EntityConsignment,
128			EntityID:   consignment.ID,
129			Refs:       refs,
130			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
131			OrgUnitID:  consignment.DCSID,
132			Payload: map[string]any{
133				"pour_count":            len(pourIDs),
134				"total_quantity_litres": totalQty,
135				"can_count":             consignment.CanCount,
136				"date":                  date,
137				"shift":                 req.Shift,
138			},
139		})
140		if err != nil {
141			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
142		}
143		if err := s.repo.setConsignmentProvenanceSeq(ctx, consignment.ID, event.Seq); err != nil {
144			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
145		}
146		consignment.ProvenanceSeq = event.Seq
147		return consignment, nil
148	}
149	
150	// dispatchConsignment seals an OPEN consignment for pickup (OPEN→DISPATCHED).
151	// The creation-time pour snapshot is provisional: the seal re-aggregates the
152	// shift's RECORDED pours so milk recorded between creation and dispatch (the
153	// collection module also rejects such pours, belt-and-braces) is reflected in
154	// pour_ids, litres, can count and weighted fat/SNF before the load leaves.
155	func (s *service) dispatchConsignment(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id string) (*domain.DCSConsignment, error) {
156		consignment, err := s.loadConsignment(ctx, id)
157		if err != nil {
158			return nil, err
159		}
160		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, consignment.DCSID); err != nil {
161			return nil, err
162		}
163		if consignment.Status != domain.ConsignmentStatusOpen {
164			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_CONSIGNMENT_STATE",
165				"consignment is "+consignment.Status+"; only OPEN consignments can be dispatched")
166		}
167	
168		// Re-aggregate at the seal boundary.
169		rows, err := s.repo.findRecordedPours(ctx, consignment.DCSID, consignment.Date, consignment.Shift)
170		if err != nil {
171			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
172		}
173		extraSet := bson.D{}
174		if len(rows) > 0 {
175			pourIDs, totalQty, avgFat, avgSNF := aggregatePours(rows)
176			consignment.PourIDs = pourIDs
177			consignment.TotalQuantityLitres = totalQty
178			consignment.CanCount = int(math.Ceil(totalQty / canCapacityLitres))
179			consignment.AvgFatPct = avgFat
180			consignment.AvgSNFPct = avgSNF
181			extraSet = bson.D{
182				{Key: "pour_ids", Value: pourIDs},
183				{Key: "total_quantity_litres", Value: totalQty},
184				{Key: "can_count", Value: consignment.CanCount},
185				{Key: "avg_fat_pct", Value: avgFat},
186				{Key: "avg_snf_pct", Value: avgSNF},
187			}
188		}
189	
190		now := time.Now().UTC()
191		matched, err := s.repo.markConsignmentDispatched(ctx, id, now, extraSet)
192		if err != nil {
193			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
194		}
195		if !matched { // lost a state race since the read above
196			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_CONSIGNMENT_STATE",
197				"consignment was modified concurrently; reload and retry")
198		}
199		event, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
200			Type:       domain.EventConsignmentDispatched,
201			EntityType: domain.EntityConsignment,
202			EntityID:   consignment.ID,
203			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
204			OrgUnitID:  consignment.DCSID,
205			Payload: map[string]any{
206				"pour_count":            len(consignment.PourIDs),
207				"total_quantity_litres": consignment.TotalQuantityLitres,
208				"can_count":             consignment.CanCount,
209				"date":                  consignment.Date,
210				"shift":                 consignment.Shift,
211			},
212		})
213		if err != nil {
214			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
215		}
216		if err := s.repo.setConsignmentProvenanceSeq(ctx, consignment.ID, event.Seq); err != nil {
217			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
218		}
219		consignment.Status = domain.ConsignmentStatusDispatch
220		consignment.DispatchedAt = &now
221		consignment.ProvenanceSeq = event.Seq
222		return consignment, nil
223	}

225	// listConsignments returns a scoped page of consignments. DCS-scoped actors
226	// default to their own society; wide read roles (SUPER_ADMIN, STATE_AUDITOR)
227	// may list unfiltered; everyone else must name a dcs_id inside their scope.
228	func (s *service) listConsignments(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, q consignmentListQuery, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.DCSConsignment, int64, error) {
229		dcsID := q.DCSID
230		if dcsID == "" {
231			switch {
232			case actor.OrgType == domain.OrgTypeDCS && actor.OrgUnitID != "":
233				dcsID = actor.OrgUnitID
234			case actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSuperAdmin || actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleStateAuditor:
235				// federation-wide read roles may scan unfiltered (still paged)
236			default:
237				return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("DCS_ID_REQUIRED", "dcs_id query parameter is required for your role")
238			}
239		}
240		if dcsID != "" {
241			if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, dcsID); err != nil {
242				return nil, 0, err
243			}
244		}
245		if q.Date != "" {
246			if _, err := resolveDate(q.Date, time.Time{}); err != nil {
247				return nil, 0, err
248			}
249		}
250		if q.Status != "" && !isConsignmentStatus(q.Status) {
251			return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_STATUS", "unknown consignment status "+q.Status)
252		}
253		items, total, err := s.repo.listConsignments(ctx, dcsID, q.Date, q.Status, page)
254		if err != nil {
255			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
256		}
257		return items, total, nil
258	}

260	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
261	// Route trips
262	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
263	
264	// createTrip plans a van run: every stop's consignment must already be
265	// DISPATCHED and must belong to that stop's DCS. The rider defaults to the
266	// actor when a VAN_RIDER plans their own route.
267	func (s *service) createTrip(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req createTripRequest) (*domain.RouteTrip, error) {
268		if req.RouteName == "" {
269			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_ROUTE_NAME", "route_name is required")
270		}
271		if req.UnionID == "" {
272			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_UNION_ID", "union_id is required")
273		}
274		if err := validateShift(req.Shift); err != nil {
275			return nil, err
276		}
277		if len(req.Stops) == 0 {
278			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NO_STOPS", "at least one stop is required")
279		}
280		if len(req.Stops) > maxTripStops {
281			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("TOO_MANY_STOPS", fmt.Sprintf("a trip may have at most %d stops", maxTripStops))
282		}
283		now := time.Now().UTC()
284		date, err := resolveDate(req.Date, now)
285		if err != nil {
286			return nil, err
287		}
288		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.UnionID); err != nil {
289			return nil, err
290		}
291		union, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.UnionID)
292		if err != nil {
293			return nil, err
294		}
295		if union.Type != domain.OrgTypeMilkUnion {
296			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_UNION", "org unit "+req.UnionID+" is not a MILK_UNION")
297		}
298	
299		riderPartyID := req.VanRiderPartyID
300		if riderPartyID == "" {
301			if actor.RoleCode != domain.RoleVanRider {
302				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("RIDER_REQUIRED", "van_rider_party_id is required unless a VAN_RIDER plans their own trip")
303			}
304			riderPartyID = actor.PartyID
305		}
306	
307		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(req.Stops))
308		stops := make([]domain.RouteStop, 0, len(req.Stops))
309		for _, stop := range req.Stops {
310			if stop.DCSID == "" || stop.ConsignmentID == "" {
311				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_STOP", "every stop needs dcs_id and consignment_id")
312			}
313			if _, dup := seen[stop.ConsignmentID]; dup {
314				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("DUPLICATE_STOP", "consignment "+stop.ConsignmentID+" appears in more than one stop")
315			}
316			seen[stop.ConsignmentID] = struct{}{}
317	
318			consignment, err := s.loadConsignment(ctx, stop.ConsignmentID)
319			if err != nil {
320				return nil, err
321			}
322			if aerr := validateStopConsignment(consignment, stop.DCSID); aerr != nil {
323				return nil, aerr
324			}
325			stops = append(stops, domain.RouteStop{DCSID: stop.DCSID, ConsignmentID: stop.ConsignmentID})
326		}
327	
328		trip := &domain.RouteTrip{
329			ID:              uuid.NewString(),
330			RouteName:       req.RouteName,
331			UnionID:         req.UnionID,
332			VanRiderPartyID: riderPartyID,
333			Date:            date,
334			Shift:           req.Shift,
335			Stops:           stops,
336			Status:          domain.TripStatusPlanned,
337			CreatedAt:       now,
338		}
339		if err := s.repo.insertTrip(ctx, trip); err != nil {
340			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
341		}
342		return trip, nil
343	}
344	
345	// pickupStop records the trip's rider collecting one consignment: the stop is
346	// stamped with time+temperature, the consignment moves DISPATCHED→PICKED_UP,
347	// and the trip moves to IN_PROGRESS on its first pickup.
348	func (s *service) pickupStop(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, tripID, consignmentID string, req pickupRequest) (*domain.RouteTrip, error) {
349		if err := validateTemp(req.TempC); err != nil {
350			return nil, err
351		}
352		trip, err := s.loadTrip(ctx, tripID)
353		if err != nil {
354			return nil, err
355		}
356		if aerr := validatePickup(trip, actor.PartyID, consignmentID); aerr != nil {
357			return nil, aerr
358		}
359	
360		// Guard the consignment transition atomically; only a DISPATCHED
361		// consignment can board the van.
362		matched, err := s.repo.markConsignmentPickedUp(ctx, consignmentID, trip.ID)
363		if err != nil {
364			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
365		}
366		if !matched {
367			consignment, err := s.loadConsignment(ctx, consignmentID)
368			if err != nil {
369				return nil, err
370			}
371			return nil, httpx.Conflict("CONSIGNMENT_NOT_DISPATCHED",
372				"consignment is "+consignment.Status+"; only DISPATCHED consignments can be picked up")
373		}
374	
375		now := time.Now().UTC()
376		if err := s.repo.markStopPickedUp(ctx, trip.ID, consignmentID, now, *req.TempC, req.Notes); err != nil {
377			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
378		}
379	
380		event, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
381			Type:       domain.EventConsignmentPickedUp,
382			EntityType: domain.EntityConsignment,
383			EntityID:   consignmentID,
384			Refs: []provenance.Ref{
385				{EntityType: domain.EntityRouteTrip, EntityID: trip.ID, Relation: "carried_by"},
386			},
387			Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
388			OrgUnitID: trip.UnionID,
389			Payload:   map[string]any{"temp_c": *req.TempC},
390		})
391		if err != nil {
392			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
393		}
394		if err := s.repo.setConsignmentProvenanceSeq(ctx, consignmentID, event.Seq); err != nil {
395			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
396		}
397	
398		trip.Status = domain.TripStatusInProgress
399		if i := findStop(trip, consignmentID); i >= 0 {
400			trip.Stops[i].PickedUpAt = &now
401			trip.Stops[i].TempC = *req.TempC
402			trip.Stops[i].Notes = req.Notes
403		}
404		return trip, nil
405	}
406	
407	// logColdChain appends one in-transit temperature sample to the trip —
408	// tamper-evidence for the perishable load between village and BMC.
409	func (s *service) logColdChain(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, tripID string, req coldChainRequest) (*domain.RouteTrip, error) {
410		if err := validateTemp(req.TempC); err != nil {
411			return nil, err
412		}
413		trip, err := s.loadTrip(ctx, tripID)
414		if err != nil {
415			return nil, err
416		}
417		if aerr := validateColdChain(trip, actor.PartyID); aerr != nil {
418			return nil, aerr
419		}
420		entry := domain.ColdChainEntry{
421			TS:     time.Now().UTC(),
422			TempC:  *req.TempC,
423			GeoLat: req.GeoLat,
424			GeoLng: req.GeoLng,
425		}
426		if err := s.repo.pushColdChain(ctx, trip.ID, entry); err != nil {
427			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
428		}
429		event, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
430			Type:       domain.EventColdChainLogged,
431			EntityType: domain.EntityRouteTrip,
432			EntityID:   trip.ID,
433			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
434			OrgUnitID:  trip.UnionID,
435			Payload:    map[string]any{"temp_c": *req.TempC},
436		})
437		if err != nil {
438			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
439		}
440		if err := s.repo.setTripProvenanceSeq(ctx, trip.ID, event.Seq); err != nil {
441			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
442		}
443		trip.ColdChain = append(trip.ColdChain, entry)
444		trip.ProvenanceSeq = event.Seq
445		return trip, nil
446	}
447	
448	// deliverTrip hands the whole load to a BMC: every stop must be picked up,
449	// the trip moves IN_PROGRESS→DELIVERED and its consignments PICKED_UP→DELIVERED.
450	func (s *service) deliverTrip(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, tripID string, req deliverRequest) (*domain.RouteTrip, error) {
451		if req.BMCID == "" {
452			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_BMC_ID", "bmc_id is required")
453		}
454		trip, err := s.loadTrip(ctx, tripID)
455		if err != nil {
456			return nil, err
457		}
458		if aerr := validateDeliver(trip, actor.PartyID); aerr != nil {
459			return nil, aerr
460		}
461		bmc, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.BMCID)
462		if err != nil {
463			return nil, err
464		}
465		if bmc.Type != domain.OrgTypeBMC {
466			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_BMC", "org unit "+req.BMCID+" is not a BMC")
467		}
468	
469		now := time.Now().UTC()
470		matched, err := s.repo.markTripDelivered(ctx, trip.ID, req.BMCID, now)
471		if err != nil {
472			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
473		}
474		if !matched { // lost a state race since the read above
475			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_TRIP_STATE", "trip was modified concurrently; reload and retry")
476		}
477	
478		consignmentIDs := make([]string, 0, len(trip.Stops))
479		refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, len(trip.Stops))
480		for _, stop := range trip.Stops {
481			consignmentIDs = append(consignmentIDs, stop.ConsignmentID)
482			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{
483				EntityType: domain.EntityConsignment, EntityID: stop.ConsignmentID, Relation: "delivered",
484			})
485		}
486		if err := s.repo.markConsignmentsDelivered(ctx, consignmentIDs); err != nil {
487			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
488		}
489	
490		event, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
491			Type:       domain.EventTripDelivered,
492			EntityType: domain.EntityRouteTrip,
493			EntityID:   trip.ID,
494			Refs:       refs,
495			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
496			OrgUnitID:  trip.UnionID,
497			Payload:    map[string]any{"bmc_id": req.BMCID},
498		})
499		if err != nil {
500			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
501		}
502		if err := s.repo.setTripProvenanceSeq(ctx, trip.ID, event.Seq); err != nil {
503			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
504		}
505	
506		trip.Status = domain.TripStatusDelivered
507		trip.DeliveredToBMCID = req.BMCID
508		trip.DeliveredAt = &now
509		trip.ProvenanceSeq = event.Seq
510		return trip, nil
511	}

541		return items, total, nil
```
