```text
591	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
592	// Pure guards & helpers (unit-tested in service_test.go)
593	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
594	
595	// aggregatePours reduces pour rows to (ids, total litres, quantity-weighted
596	// average fat %, quantity-weighted average SNF %), rounded to 2 decimals.
597	func aggregatePours(rows []pourRow) (pourIDs []string, totalQty, avgFat, avgSNF float64) {
598		var fatWeighted, snfWeighted float64
599		pourIDs = make([]string, 0, len(rows))
600		for _, row := range rows {
601			pourIDs = append(pourIDs, row.ID)
602			totalQty += row.QuantityLitres
603			fatWeighted += row.FatPct * row.QuantityLitres
604			snfWeighted += row.SNFPct * row.QuantityLitres
605		}
606		if totalQty > 0 {
607			avgFat = round2(fatWeighted / totalQty)
608			avgSNF = round2(snfWeighted / totalQty)
609		}
610		return pourIDs, round2(totalQty), avgFat, avgSNF
611	}
612	
613	// round2 rounds to 2 decimal places (litres / percentage precision).
614	func round2(v float64) float64 { return math.Round(v*100) / 100 }
615	
616	// validateShift accepts only the two collection shifts.
617	func validateShift(shift string) *httpx.AppError {
618		if shift != domain.ShiftMorning && shift != domain.ShiftEvening {
619			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_SHIFT", "shift must be MORNING or EVENING")
620		}
621		return nil
622	}
623	
624	// resolveDate defaults an empty date to the IST day key of now, otherwise
625	// validates the YYYY-MM-DD form.
626	func resolveDate(date string, now time.Time) (string, error) {
627		if date == "" {
628			return domain.DateKeyIST(now), nil
629		}
630		if _, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", date); err != nil {
631			return "", httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_DATE", "date must be YYYY-MM-DD")
632		}
633		return date, nil
634	}
635	
636	// validateTemp requires a temperature and rejects physically implausible ones.
637	func validateTemp(tempC *float64) *httpx.AppError {
638		if tempC == nil {
639			return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_TEMP", "temp_c is required")
640		}
641		if *tempC < minPlausibleTempC || *tempC > maxPlausibleTempC {
642			return httpx.BadRequest("IMPLAUSIBLE_TEMP",
643				fmt.Sprintf("temp_c must be between %.0f and %.0f °C", minPlausibleTempC, maxPlausibleTempC))
644		}
645		return nil
646	}
647	
648	// isConsignmentStatus reports whether s is a known consignment status.
649	func isConsignmentStatus(s string) bool {
650		switch s {
651		case domain.ConsignmentStatusOpen, domain.ConsignmentStatusDispatch,
652			domain.ConsignmentStatusPickedUp, domain.ConsignmentStatusDelivered,
653			domain.ConsignmentStatusAccepted, domain.ConsignmentStatusRejected:
654			return true
655		}
656		return false
657	}
658	
659	// findStop returns the index of the stop carrying consignmentID, or -1.
660	func findStop(trip *domain.RouteTrip, consignmentID string) int {
661		for i := range trip.Stops {
662			if trip.Stops[i].ConsignmentID == consignmentID {
663				return i
664			}
665		}
666		return -1
667	}
668	
669	// requireTripRider enforces that only the trip's assigned van rider acts on it.
670	func requireTripRider(trip *domain.RouteTrip, riderPartyID string) *httpx.AppError {
671		if trip.VanRiderPartyID != riderPartyID {
672			return httpx.Forbidden("this trip is assigned to another van rider")
673		}
674		return nil
675	}
676	
677	// validateStopConsignment guards trip planning: the stop's consignment must
678	// be DISPATCHED (state machine) and must belong to the stop's DCS.
679	func validateStopConsignment(consignment *domain.DCSConsignment, stopDCSID string) *httpx.AppError {
680		if consignment.Status != domain.ConsignmentStatusDispatch {
681			return httpx.Conflict("CONSIGNMENT_NOT_DISPATCHED",
682				"consignment "+consignment.ID+" is "+consignment.Status+"; only DISPATCHED consignments can be planned onto a trip")
683		}
684		if consignment.DCSID != stopDCSID {
685			return httpx.Unprocessable("CONSIGNMENT_DCS_MISMATCH",
686				"consignment "+consignment.ID+" belongs to DCS "+consignment.DCSID+", not the stop's DCS "+stopDCSID)
687		}
688		return nil
689	}
690	
691	// validatePickup guards the pickup transition: right rider, trip not yet
692	// delivered, stop exists, stop not already picked.
693	func validatePickup(trip *domain.RouteTrip, riderPartyID, consignmentID string) *httpx.AppError {
694		if err := requireTripRider(trip, riderPartyID); err != nil {
695			return err
696		}
697		if trip.Status == domain.TripStatusDelivered {
698			return httpx.Conflict("TRIP_ALREADY_DELIVERED", "trip is DELIVERED; no further pickups are possible")
699		}
700		i := findStop(trip, consignmentID)
701		if i < 0 {
702			return httpx.NotFound("stop for consignment " + consignmentID)
703		}
704		if trip.Stops[i].PickedUpAt != nil {
705			return httpx.Conflict("STOP_ALREADY_PICKED", "consignment "+consignmentID+" was already picked up on this trip")
706		}
707		return nil
708	}
709	
710	// validateColdChain guards cold-chain logging: right rider, trip still moving.
711	func validateColdChain(trip *domain.RouteTrip, riderPartyID string) *httpx.AppError {
712		if err := requireTripRider(trip, riderPartyID); err != nil {
713			return err
714		}
715		if trip.Status == domain.TripStatusDelivered {
716			return httpx.Conflict("TRIP_ALREADY_DELIVERED", "trip is DELIVERED; cold-chain logging is closed")
717		}
718		return nil
719	}
720	
721	// validateDeliver guards delivery: right rider, not already delivered, and
722	// every stop picked up (partial loads cannot be handed to a BMC).
723	func validateDeliver(trip *domain.RouteTrip, riderPartyID string) *httpx.AppError {
724		if err := requireTripRider(trip, riderPartyID); err != nil {
725			return err
726		}
727		if trip.Status == domain.TripStatusDelivered {
728			return httpx.Conflict("TRIP_ALREADY_DELIVERED", "trip is already DELIVERED")
729		}
730		var unpicked []string
731		for _, stop := range trip.Stops {
732			if stop.PickedUpAt == nil {
733				unpicked = append(unpicked, stop.ConsignmentID)
734			}
735		}
736		if len(unpicked) > 0 {
737			return httpx.Unprocessable("STOPS_NOT_PICKED", "every stop must be picked up before delivery").
738				WithDetails(map[string]any{"unpicked_consignment_ids": unpicked})
739		}
740		return nil
741	}
```

| **Anand 3-tier**: Farmer → Samiti/DCS → Sangh/Union → PCDF | Exact org-tree: `FEDERATION → MILK_UNION → {PLANT, BMC, DCS}`, with parent-type validation so an illegal edge (e.g. DCS under Federation) is rejected |
| "Sangh and Milk Union are the same body" | One org type `MILK_UNION`; naming stays Hindi-friendly via `name`/`code` |
| Farmer = member of samiti, supplies milk | `FARMER` role assignment **at a DCS**; pours rejected unless the farmer holds an active membership at that DCS (`FARMER_NOT_MEMBER`) |
| Twice-daily collection, weighing + fat/SNF testing in front of member | `MORNING`/`EVENING` shifts, analyzer readings with anti-tamper envelope, pour receipt SMS on the spot |
| Payment on **quality-cum-quantity** basis, daily | Fat/SNF rate chart → per-pour pricing → same-day invoice → settlement |
| Samiti staff: **paid Secretary (§31)** runs operations, **honorary elected Chairman (§30)** supervises | `SAMITI_SACHEEV` operates (pours/invoices/consignments/initiates settlement); `SAMITI_ADHYAKSH` governs (approvals, dual-control sign-off, member role grants) — the initiate/approve split mirrors the Act's executive/oversight split |
| DCS dispatches milk to Union via routes/BMCs | Consignment → route trip → BMC lot chain |
| Union procures from all DCS, processes, markets | BMC pooling → plant batches → product lots under the union subtree |
| PCDF markets under **Parag** brand, policy, QA labs | `PCDF_ADMIN` (rate policy, product/org masters), `PLANT_LAB_ANALYST` QC, QR carries the Parag product identity |
| Input services routed through samiti: AI, vet first-aid | `AI_TECH`, `VETERINARIAN`, 1962 MVU cases, health events on Pashu Aadhaar |
| Union trains samiti staff / extension | Education hub content (`PCDF_ADMIN`/`MISSION_OFFICIAL` publish) |
| Audit obligation ("continuous and concurrent audit") | Immutable audit trail + `STATE_AUDITOR` read/export |

## 📋 Deliberately not modeled yet (governance/financial artifacts — flagged as future work)

These are constitutional records, not daily operations, and none block the milk/money loop: **share capital & entrance fees** (member share ledger), **year-end dividend/bonus on milk poured**, **election records / Managing Committee registers** (≤13/15/17 seats, 5-year terms, reservations), **Registrar registration workflow** (min-10-member rule), **cattle feed/insurance input services**. I'm adding this exact list to the docs as the "cooperative governance (P2)" roadmap so it's never forgotten.

**Verdict: the operational constitution is fully followed; the governance ledger items are honestly parked, documented, and the org/role model already has the right slots for them** (e.g., election record reference is already part of the Sacheev/Adhyaksh KYC tier definition).

Also confirmed in-flight: **logging is now a hard requirement** — I've already added a global request logger (one structured line per request: method, path, status, duration, request-id, actor, with 4xx→WARN / 5xx→ERROR), and every module agent is under orders to log INFO on state transitions, WARN on business rejections, ERROR with wrapped causes on failures, all tagged `module=<name>` and traceable by `request_id`.

I'll report when the fleet lands — then verify myself, then write `strict_brief.md`.

```text
31	type RateChart struct {

44	// PricePour computes (ratePerLitre, amount) for a pour, rounded to paise.
45	func (rc RateChart) PricePour(fatPct, snfPct, qtyLitres float64) (rate, amount float64) {
46		rate = rc.BaseRatePerLitre + fatPct*rc.FatRatePerPoint + snfPct*rc.SNFRatePerPoint
47		rate = math.Round(rate*100) / 100
48		amount = math.Round(rate*qtyLitres*100) / 100
49		return rate, amount
50	}

94	// CheckPlausibility validates fat/SNF/qty against physical bounds and returns
95	// the violated flags (empty slice = plausible).
96	func CheckPlausibility(fatPct, snfPct, qtyLitres float64) []string {
97		var flags []string
98		if fatPct < PlausibleFatMin || fatPct > PlausibleFatMax ||
99			snfPct < PlausibleSNFMin || snfPct > PlausibleSNFMax {
100			flags = append(flags, IntegrityFlagImplausibleValue)
101		}
102		if qtyLitres != 0 && (qtyLitres < PlausibleQtyMin || qtyLitres > PlausibleQtyMax) {
103			flags = append(flags, IntegrityFlagImplausibleValue)
104		}
105		return flags
106	}

176	// DateKeyIST formats t as the YYYY-MM-DD settlement-day key in IST.
```

```text
1	package domain
2	
3	import (
4		"fmt"
5		"time"
6	
7		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
8	)
9	
10	// FSSAI limits for liquid milk (blueprint §8.3). Aflatoxin M1 is heat-stable
11	// and survives pasteurisation, so it MUST be gated upstream (BMC + plant),
12	// never only at the finished product.
13	const (
14		FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg = 0.5  // AFM1 ≤ 0.5 µg/kg
15		FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl          = 10.0 // coliform ≤ 10 CFU/ml
16		FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg       = 0.1  // antibiotic MRL example
17	)
18	
19	// QC test names.
20	const (
21		TestAflatoxinM1 = "AFLATOXIN_M1"            // µg/kg
22		TestColiform    = "COLIFORM"                // CFU/ml
23		TestTPC         = "TPC"                     // CFU/ml, graded — recorded, not hard-gated here
24		TestAntibiotic  = "ANTIBIOTIC_TETRACYCLINE" // mg/kg
25		TestPhosphatase = "PHOSPHATASE"             // 0 = negative (pass post-pasteurisation), 1 = positive
26		TestFat         = "FAT"                     // %
27		TestSNF         = "SNF"                     // %
28	)
29	
30	// QC stages.
31	const (
32		QCStageBMCRapid = "BMC_RAPID" // strip/rapid tests at the chilling centre
33		QCStagePlantLab = "PLANT_LAB" // full lab: ELISA/HPLC, culture, LC-MS/MS
34	)
35	
36	// QC subject types.
37	const (
38		QCSubjectDCSConsignment  = "DCS_CONSIGNMENT"
39		QCSubjectBMCLot          = "BMC_LOT"
40		QCSubjectProcessingBatch = "PROCESSING_BATCH"
41	)
42	
43	// QCTest is a single measurement inside a QC result.
44	type QCTest struct {
45		Name  string  `bson:"name"  json:"name"`
46		Value float64 `bson:"value" json:"value"`
47		Unit  string  `bson:"unit"  json:"unit"`
48		Pass  bool    `bson:"pass"  json:"pass"`
49	}
50	
51	// QCResult is the recorded outcome of testing one subject at one stage.
52	// OverallPass drives the safety gate; a certificate is attached to provenance
53	// on pass, a block + quarantine on fail.
54	type QCResult struct {
55		ID                primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
56		SubjectType       string             `bson:"subject_type"  json:"subject_type"`
57		SubjectID         primitive.ObjectID `bson:"subject_id"    json:"subject_id"`
58		Stage             string             `bson:"stage"         json:"stage"`
59		Tests             []QCTest           `bson:"tests"         json:"tests"`
60		OverallPass       bool               `bson:"overall_pass"  json:"overall_pass"`
61		FailureReasons    []string           `bson:"failure_reasons,omitempty" json:"failure_reasons,omitempty"`
62		AnalystPartyID    primitive.ObjectID `bson:"analyst_party_id" json:"analyst_party_id"`
63		LabRef            string             `bson:"lab_ref,omitempty"            json:"lab_ref,omitempty"`
64		CertificateNumber string             `bson:"certificate_number,omitempty" json:"certificate_number,omitempty"`
65		// Superseded marks a result voided after losing the gate race — the
66		// verdict on the subject came from a different, earlier result.
67		Superseded    bool      `bson:"superseded,omitempty" json:"superseded,omitempty"`
68		RecordedAt    time.Time `bson:"recorded_at"   json:"recorded_at"`
69		ProvenanceSeq int64     `bson:"provenance_seq,omitempty" json:"provenance_seq,omitempty"`
70	}
71	
72	// EvaluateQCTests applies the FSSAI gate to a set of tests: it fills each
73	// test's Pass verdict and returns the overall verdict plus human-readable
74	// failure reasons. Unknown test names are recorded but do not gate.
75	func EvaluateQCTests(tests []QCTest) (overallPass bool, failures []string, evaluated []QCTest) {
76		overallPass = true
77		evaluated = make([]QCTest, 0, len(tests))
78		for _, t := range tests {
79			pass := true
80			switch t.Name {
81			case TestAflatoxinM1:
82				if t.Value > FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg {
83					pass = false
84					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
85						"AFLATOXIN_M1 %.3f µg/kg exceeds FSSAI limit %.1f µg/kg", t.Value, FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg))
86				}
87			case TestColiform:
88				if t.Value > FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl {
89					pass = false
90					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
91						"COLIFORM %.1f CFU/ml exceeds FSSAI limit %.0f CFU/ml", t.Value, FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl))
92				}
93			case TestAntibiotic:
94				if t.Value > FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg {
95					pass = false
96					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
97						"ANTIBIOTIC_TETRACYCLINE %.3f mg/kg exceeds MRL %.1f mg/kg", t.Value, FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg))
98				}
99			case TestPhosphatase:
100				if t.Value != 0 {
101					pass = false
102					failures = append(failures, "PHOSPHATASE positive — pasteurisation check failed (must be negative)")
103				}
104			}
105			t.Pass = pass
106			if !pass {
107				overallPass = false
108			}
109			evaluated = append(evaluated, t)
110		}
111		return overallPass, failures, evaluated
112	}
```

```text
1	package domain
2	
3	import (
4		"time"
5	
6		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
7	)
8	
9	// Org-unit types — the cooperative backbone RBAC is scoped to (blueprint §5.1,
10	// PCDF constitution: Samiti/DCS → Sangh/Union → PCDF apex).
11	const (
12		OrgTypeFederation      = "FEDERATION"       // PCDF / Parag (state apex)
13		OrgTypeMilkUnion       = "MILK_UNION"       // district Sangh
14		OrgTypeProcessingPlant = "PROCESSING_PLANT" // PCDF plant
15		OrgTypeBMC             = "BMC"              // bulk milk cooler / chilling centre
16		OrgTypeDCS             = "DCS"              // village samiti
17	)
18	
19	// AllOrgTypes is the closed set of org-unit types.
20	var AllOrgTypes = []string{
21		OrgTypeFederation, OrgTypeMilkUnion, OrgTypeProcessingPlant, OrgTypeBMC, OrgTypeDCS,
22	}
23	
24	// ValidOrgParent encodes the allowed hierarchy edges.
25	var ValidOrgParent = map[string][]string{
26		OrgTypeFederation:      {}, // root
27		OrgTypeMilkUnion:       {OrgTypeFederation},
28		OrgTypeProcessingPlant: {OrgTypeMilkUnion, OrgTypeFederation},
29		OrgTypeBMC:             {OrgTypeMilkUnion},
30		OrgTypeDCS:             {OrgTypeMilkUnion, OrgTypeBMC},
31	}
32	
33	// OrgUnit is a node in the cooperative hierarchy.
34	//
35	// ID scheme: `_id` is a generated ObjectID (relations always reference it);
36	// Code is the human-readable unique business key (e.g. "DCS-01842") used for
37	// display, lookups and seed idempotency — never for joins.
38	//
39	// Path holds the ObjectIDs of all ancestors from the root down to (and
40	// excluding) this node — denormalised so "is X inside Y's scope" is a single
41	// indexed array-containment check with no recursive queries on the hot path.
42	type OrgUnit struct {
43		ID        primitive.ObjectID   `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
44		Type      string               `bson:"type"          json:"type"`
45		Name      string               `bson:"name"          json:"name"`
46		Code      string               `bson:"code"          json:"code"` // unique business key, e.g. "DCS-01842"
47		ParentID  *primitive.ObjectID  `bson:"parent_id,omitempty" json:"parent_id,omitempty"`
48		Path      []primitive.ObjectID `bson:"path"          json:"path"`
49		District  string               `bson:"district,omitempty" json:"district,omitempty"`
50		State     string               `bson:"state,omitempty"    json:"state,omitempty"`
51		GeoLat    float64              `bson:"geo_lat,omitempty"  json:"geo_lat,omitempty"`
52		GeoLng    float64              `bson:"geo_lng,omitempty"  json:"geo_lng,omitempty"`
53		Active    bool                 `bson:"active"        json:"active"`
54		CreatedAt time.Time            `bson:"created_at"    json:"created_at"`
55		UpdatedAt time.Time            `bson:"updated_at"    json:"updated_at"`
56	}
57	
58	// IsValidOrgType reports whether t is a known org-unit type.
59	func IsValidOrgType(t string) bool {
60		for _, v := range AllOrgTypes {
61			if v == t {
62				return true
63			}
64		}
65		return false
66	}
```

```text
16	// repository is the module's only MongoDB access point. It reads the
17	// role_assignments and parties collections (allowed by spec for the members
18	// roster) but writes only org_units.
19	type repository struct {
20		orgs        *mongo.Collection
21		assignments *mongo.Collection
22		parties     *mongo.Collection
23	}
24	
25	func newRepository(db *mongo.Database) *repository {
26		return &repository{
27			orgs:        db.Collection(mongodb.CollOrgUnits),
28			assignments: db.Collection(mongodb.CollRoleAssignments),
29			parties:     db.Collection(mongodb.CollParties),
30		}
31	}
32	
33	// insertOrg inserts a new org unit. The raw driver error is returned so the
34	// service can map a duplicate-key violation on code to a Conflict.
35	func (r *repository) insertOrg(ctx context.Context, org *domain.OrgUnit) error {
36		_, err := r.orgs.InsertOne(ctx, org)
37		return err
38	}
39	
40	// getOrg fetches one org unit by ID.
41	func (r *repository) getOrg(ctx context.Context, id string) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
42		var org domain.OrgUnit
43		err := r.orgs.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&org)
44		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
45			return nil, httpx.NotFound("org unit " + id)
46		}
47		if err != nil {
48			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
49		}
50		return &org, nil
51	}
52	
53	// countByType counts org units of the given type (federation-uniqueness check).
54	func (r *repository) countByType(ctx context.Context, orgType string) (int64, error) {
55		n, err := r.orgs.CountDocuments(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "type", Value: orgType}})
56		if err != nil {
57			return 0, httpx.Internal(err)
58		}
59		return n, nil
60	}
61	
62	// updateOrg applies a $set patch and returns the updated document.
63	func (r *repository) updateOrg(ctx context.Context, id string, set bson.D) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
64		var org domain.OrgUnit
65		err := r.orgs.FindOneAndUpdate(ctx,
66			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}},
67			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: set}},
68			options.FindOneAndUpdate().SetReturnDocument(options.After),
69		).Decode(&org)
70		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
71			return nil, httpx.NotFound("org unit " + id)
72		}
73		if err != nil {
74			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
75		}
76		return &org, nil
77	}

79	// listChildren pages the direct children of an org unit (parent_id index)
80	// and returns the total child count for pagination meta.
81	func (r *repository) listChildren(ctx context.Context, parentID string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.OrgUnit, int64, error) {
82		filter := bson.D{{Key: "parent_id", Value: parentID}}
83		total, err := r.orgs.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
84		if err != nil {
85			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
86		}
87		units, err := r.findOrgs(ctx, filter,
88			options.Find().
89				SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "code", Value: 1}}).
90				SetSkip(page.Offset).
91				SetLimit(page.Limit))
92		if err != nil {
93			return nil, 0, err
94		}
95		return units, total, nil
96	}

99	// returns the total matching count for pagination meta.
100	func (r *repository) listOrgs(ctx context.Context, filter bson.D, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.OrgUnit, int64, error) {
101		total, err := r.orgs.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
102		if err != nil {
103			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
104		}
105		units, err := r.findOrgs(ctx, filter,
106			options.Find().
107				SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "code", Value: 1}}).
108				SetSkip(page.Offset).
109				SetLimit(page.Limit))
110		if err != nil {
111			return nil, 0, err
112		}
113		return units, total, nil
114	}
115	
116	// listDescendants returns every org unit whose ancestor Path contains rootID
117	// (path index, array containment), capped at limit nodes.
118	func (r *repository) listDescendants(ctx context.Context, rootID string, limit int64) ([]domain.OrgUnit, error) {
119		return r.findOrgs(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "path", Value: rootID}},
120			options.Find().
121				SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "code", Value: 1}}).
122				SetLimit(limit))
123	}
124	
125	func (r *repository) findOrgs(ctx context.Context, filter bson.D, opts *options.FindOptions) ([]domain.OrgUnit, error) {
126		cur, err := r.orgs.Find(ctx, filter, opts)
127		if err != nil {
128			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
129		}
130		units := []domain.OrgUnit{}
131		if err := cur.All(ctx, &units); err != nil {
132			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
133		}
134		return units, nil
135	}
136	
137	// countActiveAssignments counts the ACTIVE role assignments at one org unit —
138	// the members-listing total.
139	func (r *repository) countActiveAssignments(ctx context.Context, orgID string) (int64, error) {
140		n, err := r.assignments.CountDocuments(ctx, bson.D{
141			{Key: "org_unit_id", Value: orgID},
142			{Key: "status", Value: domain.RoleAssignmentActive},
143		})
144		if err != nil {
145			return 0, httpx.Internal(err)
146		}
147		return n, nil
148	}
149	
150	// listActiveAssignments pages the ACTIVE role assignments at one org unit
151	// (org_unit_id + role_code + status index).
152	func (r *repository) listActiveAssignments(ctx context.Context, orgID string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.RoleAssignment, error) {
153		cur, err := r.assignments.Find(ctx,
154			bson.D{
155				{Key: "org_unit_id", Value: orgID},
156				{Key: "status", Value: domain.RoleAssignmentActive},
157			},
158			options.Find().
159				SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "role_code", Value: 1}, {Key: "created_at", Value: 1}}).
160				SetSkip(page.Offset).
161				SetLimit(page.Limit))
162		if err != nil {
163			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
164		}
165		assignments := []domain.RoleAssignment{}
166		if err := cur.All(ctx, &assignments); err != nil {
167			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
168		}
169		return assignments, nil
170	}
171	
172	// partiesByIDs fetches the given parties keyed by ID for the in-memory join.
173	func (r *repository) partiesByIDs(ctx context.Context, ids []string) (map[string]domain.Party, error) {
174		byID := make(map[string]domain.Party, len(ids))
175		if len(ids) == 0 {
176			return byID, nil
177		}
178		cur, err := r.parties.Find(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: ids}}}})
179		if err != nil {
180			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
181		}
182		var parties []domain.Party
183		if err := cur.All(ctx, &parties); err != nil {
184			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
185		}
186		for _, p := range parties {
187			byID[p.ID] = p
188		}
189		return byID, nil
190	}
```

```text
123		for _, tc := range cases {

127				if pass != tc.wantPass {

129				}
130				if len(failures) != tc.wantFailures {
131					t.Fatalf("got %d failure reasons %v, want %d", len(failures), failures, tc.wantFailures)
132				}
133				if len(evaluated) != len(tc.tests) {
134					t.Fatalf("evaluated %d tests, want %d", len(evaluated), len(tc.tests))
135				}
136				for i, want := range tc.wantTestPass {

141				joined := strings.Join(failures, "; ")
142				for _, sub := range tc.wantReasonSub {
143					if !strings.Contains(joined, sub) {
144						t.Errorf("failure reasons %q missing substring %q", joined, sub)
145					}
146				}
147			})
148		}
149	}
```

```text
1	package plant
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"time"
6	
7		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
8		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
9		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo/options"
10	
11		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
12		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
13		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/mongodb"
14	)
15	
16	// Repo is the plant module's MongoDB access layer. All state transitions use
17	// optimistic filters on the expected status — no transactions (standalone
18	// server), so a lost race simply matches zero documents and the service
19	// reports a conflict instead of corrupting state.
20	type Repo struct {
21		consignments *mongo.Collection
22		bmcLots      *mongo.Collection
23		batches      *mongo.Collection
24		productLots  *mongo.Collection
25		qrs          *mongo.Collection
26		counters     *mongo.Collection
27	}
28	
29	// NewRepo binds the repo to the shared database.
30	func NewRepo(db *mongo.Database) *Repo {
31		return &Repo{
32			consignments: db.Collection(mongodb.CollConsignments),
33			bmcLots:      db.Collection(mongodb.CollBMCLots),
34			batches:      db.Collection(mongodb.CollBatches),
35			productLots:  db.Collection(mongodb.CollProductLots),
36			qrs:          db.Collection(mongodb.CollBatchQRs),
37			counters:     db.Collection(mongodb.CollCounters),
38		}
39	}
40	
41	// --- consignments (read + claim; owned by the logistics module otherwise) ---
42	
43	// ConsignmentsByIDs loads the given consignments (missing IDs simply absent).
44	func (r *Repo) ConsignmentsByIDs(ctx context.Context, ids []string) ([]domain.DCSConsignment, error) {
45		cur, err := r.consignments.Find(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: ids}}}})
46		if err != nil {
47			return nil, err
48		}
49		out := []domain.DCSConsignment{}
50		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
51			return nil, err
52		}
53		return out, nil
54	}
55	
56	// ClaimConsignments atomically flips DELIVERED consignments to ACCEPTED and
57	// stamps the pooling lot ID. Returns how many were actually claimed — fewer
58	// than requested means another lot raced us on at least one consignment.
59	func (r *Repo) ClaimConsignments(ctx context.Context, ids []string, bmcLotID string) (int64, error) {
60		res, err := r.consignments.UpdateMany(ctx,
61			bson.D{
62				{Key: "_id", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: ids}}},
63				{Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusDelivered},
64			},
65			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
66				{Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusAccepted},
67				{Key: "bmc_lot_id", Value: bmcLotID},
68			}}},
69		)
70		if err != nil {
71			return 0, err
72		}
73		return res.ModifiedCount, nil
74	}
75	
76	// ReleaseConsignments undoes a partial claim (compensating action for a lost
77	// race): everything stamped with this lot ID goes back to DELIVERED.
78	func (r *Repo) ReleaseConsignments(ctx context.Context, bmcLotID string) error {
79		_, err := r.consignments.UpdateMany(ctx,
80			bson.D{{Key: "bmc_lot_id", Value: bmcLotID}},
81			bson.D{
82				{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusDelivered}}},
83				{Key: "$unset", Value: bson.D{{Key: "bmc_lot_id", Value: ""}}},
84			},
85		)
86		return err
87	}

91	// InsertBMCLot stores a new lot.

93		_, err := r.bmcLots.InsertOne(ctx, lot)

99		var lot domain.BMCLot

109		if err != nil {

119	// CloseBMCLot transitions OPEN→QC_PENDING with the chilling temperature.
120	// Returns false when the lot was not OPEN (already closed, or raced).
121	func (r *Repo) CloseBMCLot(ctx context.Context, id string, tempC float64, closedAt time.Time) (bool, error) {
122		res, err := r.bmcLots.UpdateOne(ctx,
123			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}, {Key: "status", Value: domain.BMCLotStatusOpen}},
124			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
125				{Key: "status", Value: domain.BMCLotStatusQCPending},
126				{Key: "chilling_temp_c", Value: tempC},
127				{Key: "closed_at", Value: closedAt},
128			}}},
129		)
130		if err != nil {
131			return false, err
132		}
133		return res.MatchedCount > 0, nil
134	}
135	
136	// DispatchBMCLot transitions PASSED→DISPATCHED. The status filter IS the
137	// safety gate at the datastore level: a BLOCKED or QC_PENDING lot can never
138	// match this update.
139	func (r *Repo) DispatchBMCLot(ctx context.Context, id string, dispatchedAt time.Time) (bool, error) {
140		res, err := r.bmcLots.UpdateOne(ctx,
141			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}, {Key: "status", Value: domain.BMCLotStatusPassed}},
142			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
143				{Key: "status", Value: domain.BMCLotStatusDispatched},
144				{Key: "dispatched_at", Value: dispatchedAt},
145			}}},
146		)
147		if err != nil {
148			return false, err
149		}
150		return res.MatchedCount > 0, nil
151	}
152	
153	// ClaimBMCLots atomically claims DISPATCHED lots for a processing batch:
154	// DISPATCHED→POOLED stamped with the batch ID. Returns how many were actually
155	// claimed — fewer than requested means another batch raced us on at least one
156	// lot (or a lot was not DISPATCHED), and the caller must roll back.
157	func (r *Repo) ClaimBMCLots(ctx context.Context, ids []string, batchID string) (int64, error) {
158		res, err := r.bmcLots.UpdateMany(ctx,
159			bson.D{
160				{Key: "_id", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: ids}}},
161				{Key: "status", Value: domain.BMCLotStatusDispatched},
162			},
163			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
164				{Key: "status", Value: domain.BMCLotStatusPooled},
165				{Key: "batch_id", Value: batchID},
166			}}},
167		)
168		if err != nil {
169			return 0, err
170		}
171		return res.ModifiedCount, nil
172	}
173	
174	// ReleaseBMCLots undoes a partial claim (compensating action for a lost
175	// race): every lot stamped with this batch ID goes back to DISPATCHED.
176	func (r *Repo) ReleaseBMCLots(ctx context.Context, batchID string) error {
177		_, err := r.bmcLots.UpdateMany(ctx,
178			bson.D{
179				{Key: "batch_id", Value: batchID},
180				{Key: "status", Value: domain.BMCLotStatusPooled},
181			},
182			bson.D{
183				{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: domain.BMCLotStatusDispatched}}},
184				{Key: "$unset", Value: bson.D{{Key: "batch_id", Value: ""}}},
185			},
186		)
187		return err
188	}

193		Date   string
194		Status string

197	// ListBMCLots returns a page of lots plus the total match count.
198	func (r *Repo) ListBMCLots(ctx context.Context, f BMCLotListFilter, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.BMCLot, int64, error) {
199		filter := bson.D{}
200		if f.BMCID != "" {
201			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "bmc_id", Value: f.BMCID})
202		}
203		if f.Date != "" {
204			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "date", Value: f.Date})
205		}
206		if f.Status != "" {
207			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "status", Value: f.Status})
208		}
209		total, err := r.bmcLots.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
210		if err != nil {
211			return nil, 0, err
212		}
213		cur, err := r.bmcLots.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
214			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "date", Value: -1}, {Key: "created_at", Value: -1}}).
215			SetSkip(page.Offset).SetLimit(page.Limit))
216		if err != nil {
217			return nil, 0, err
218		}
219		out := []domain.BMCLot{}
220		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
221			return nil, 0, err
222		}
223		return out, total, nil
224	}

228	// NextSequence atomically increments and returns the named counter — the
229	// transaction-free way to mint gapless human-readable numbers.
230	func (r *Repo) NextSequence(ctx context.Context, key string) (int64, error) {
231		var doc struct {
232			Seq int64 `bson:"seq"`
233		}
234		err := r.counters.FindOneAndUpdate(ctx,
235			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: key}},
236			bson.D{{Key: "$inc", Value: bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: int64(1)}}}},
237			options.FindOneAndUpdate().SetUpsert(true).SetReturnDocument(options.After),
238		).Decode(&doc)
239		if err != nil {
240			return 0, err
241		}
242		return doc.Seq, nil
243	}

346	// InsertQR stores a freshly minted QR. A duplicate-key error means the random

353	// DeleteQR removes a just-minted QR whose lot turned out to be no longer
354	// ACTIVE at write time (compensating action — the QR was never returned to
355	// the caller, so nothing references it).

357		_, err := r.qrs.DeleteOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}})

361	// TouchActiveLot performs a no-op conditional write on an ACTIVE product lot
362	// ($inc of a stamp counter). MatchedCount == 0 proves the lot is no longer
363	// ACTIVE (e.g. recalled mid-request) at datastore level.
364	func (r *Repo) TouchActiveLot(ctx context.Context, lotID string) (bool, error) {
365		res, err := r.productLots.UpdateOne(ctx,
366			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: lotID}, {Key: "status", Value: domain.ProductLotStatusActive}},
367			bson.D{{Key: "$inc", Value: bson.D{{Key: "qr_issue_stamp", Value: int64(1)}}}},
368		)
369		if err != nil {
370			return false, err
371		}
372		return res.MatchedCount > 0, nil
373	}
```

```text
18	// maxTreeNodes caps a subtree response (root included) so a federation-level
19	// tree read can never return an unbounded list.
20	const maxTreeNodes = 500
21	
22	// service holds all business logic of the orgs module.
23	type service struct {
24		repo  *repository
25		scope *orgscope.Resolver
26	}
27	
28	func newService(repo *repository, scope *orgscope.Resolver) *service {
29		return &service{repo: repo, scope: scope}
30	}

32	// validateHierarchy checks whether an org unit of childType may be created
33	// under a parent of parentType ("" = no parent), per domain.ValidOrgParent.
34	// Pure function — unit-tested against the full type matrix.
35	func validateHierarchy(childType, parentType string) *httpx.AppError {
36		if !domain.IsValidOrgType(childType) {
37			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_ORG_TYPE", "unknown org type "+childType)
38		}
39		allowed := domain.ValidOrgParent[childType]
40		if len(allowed) == 0 { // hierarchy root
41			if parentType != "" {
42				return httpx.Unprocessable("ORG_PARENT_TYPE_INVALID",
43					childType+" is the hierarchy root and cannot have a parent")
44			}
45			return nil
46		}
47		if parentType == "" {
48			return httpx.BadRequest("ORG_PARENT_REQUIRED", childType+" requires a parent_id")
49		}
50		for _, t := range allowed {
51			if t == parentType {
52				return nil
53			}
54		}
55		return httpx.Unprocessable("ORG_PARENT_TYPE_INVALID",
56			childType+" cannot be created under a "+parentType)
57	}
58	
59	// Create validates the hierarchy edge and inserts a new org unit
60	// (POST /orgs, blueprint §5.1).
61	func (s *service) Create(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateOrgRequest) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
62		name := strings.TrimSpace(req.Name)
63		if name == "" {
64			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_NAME", "name is required")
65		}
66		code := strings.TrimSpace(req.Code)
67		if code == "" {
68			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_CODE", "code is required")
69		}
70	
71		// Resolve the parent (if any) and validate the hierarchy edge.
72		var parent *domain.OrgUnit
73		if req.ParentID != "" {
74			var err error
75			parent, err = s.repo.getOrg(ctx, req.ParentID)
76			if err != nil {
77				return nil, err
78			}
79		}
80		parentType := ""
81		if parent != nil {
82			parentType = parent.Type
83		}
84		if aerr := validateHierarchy(req.Type, parentType); aerr != nil {
85			return nil, aerr
86		}
87	
88		// The federation is the unique root: reject a second one.
89		if req.Type == domain.OrgTypeFederation {
90			n, err := s.repo.countByType(ctx, domain.OrgTypeFederation)
91			if err != nil {
92				return nil, err
93			}
94			if n > 0 {
95				return nil, httpx.Conflict("FEDERATION_EXISTS", "a federation root org unit already exists")
96			}
97		}
98	
99		// The new unit must be created inside the caller's scope.
100		if parent != nil {
101			if err := s.scope.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, parent.ID); err != nil {
102				return nil, err
103			}
104		}
105	
106		now := time.Now().UTC()
107		org := &domain.OrgUnit{
108			ID:        uuid.NewString(),
109			Type:      req.Type,
110			Name:      name,
111			Code:      code,
112			District:  strings.TrimSpace(req.District),
113			State:     strings.TrimSpace(req.State),
114			Path:      []string{},
115			Active:    true,
116			CreatedAt: now,
117			UpdatedAt: now,
118		}
119		if parent != nil {
120			org.ParentID = parent.ID
121			org.Path = append(append([]string{}, parent.Path...), parent.ID)
122		}
123		if req.GeoLat != nil {
124			org.GeoLat = *req.GeoLat
125		}
126		if req.GeoLng != nil {
127			org.GeoLng = *req.GeoLng
128		}
129	
130		if err := s.repo.insertOrg(ctx, org); err != nil {
131			if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(err) {
132				return nil, httpx.Conflict("ORG_CODE_EXISTS", "an org unit with code "+code+" already exists")
133			}
134			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
135		}
136		s.scope.Invalidate(org.ID)
137		return org, nil
138	}
139	
140	// Update patches name/district/active/geo on an org unit (PATCH /orgs/{id}).
141	// Type or parent moves are rejected — restructuring the tree is out of scope
142	// for v1 because Path denormalisation across a subtree is not transactional.
143	func (s *service) Update(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id string, req UpdateOrgRequest) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
144		if req.Type != nil || req.ParentID != nil {
145			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("ORG_MOVE_UNSUPPORTED",
146				"changing an org unit's type or parent is not supported in v1")
147		}
148		if err := s.scope.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, id); err != nil {
149			return nil, err
150		}
151	
152		set := bson.D{{Key: "updated_at", Value: time.Now().UTC()}}
153		if req.Name != nil {
154			name := strings.TrimSpace(*req.Name)
155			if name == "" {
156				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_NAME", "name cannot be empty")
157			}
158			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "name", Value: name})
159		}
160		if req.District != nil {
161			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "district", Value: strings.TrimSpace(*req.District)})
162		}
163		if req.Active != nil {
164			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "active", Value: *req.Active})
165		}
166		if req.GeoLat != nil {
167			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "geo_lat", Value: *req.GeoLat})
168		}
169		if req.GeoLng != nil {
170			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "geo_lng", Value: *req.GeoLng})
171		}
172		if len(set) == 1 { // only updated_at
173			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("EMPTY_UPDATE", "no updatable fields provided")
174		}
175	
176		org, err := s.repo.updateOrg(ctx, id, set)
177		if err != nil {
178			return nil, err
179		}
180		s.scope.Invalidate(id)
181		return org, nil
182	}

198	// Tree returns the root plus its whole subtree as a flat list (each node
199	// carries parent_id; the client assembles), capped at maxTreeNodes.
200	func (s *service) Tree(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id string) ([]domain.OrgUnit, bool, error) {
201		root, err := s.repo.getOrg(ctx, id)
202		if err != nil {
203			return nil, false, err
204		}
205		if err := s.scope.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, id); err != nil {
206			return nil, false, err
207		}
208		descendants, err := s.repo.listDescendants(ctx, id, maxTreeNodes-1)
209		if err != nil {
210			return nil, false, err
211		}
212		nodes := append([]domain.OrgUnit{*root}, descendants...)
213		truncated := len(descendants) == maxTreeNodes-1
214		return nodes, truncated, nil
215	}
216	
217	// List pages org units filtered by type and/or district (GET /orgs),
218	// returning the total matching count alongside the page.
219	func (s *service) List(ctx context.Context, orgType, district string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.OrgUnit, int64, error) {
220		filter := bson.D{}
221		if orgType != "" {
222			if !domain.IsValidOrgType(orgType) {
223				return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_ORG_TYPE", "unknown org type "+orgType)
224			}
225			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "type", Value: orgType})
226		}
227		if district != "" {
228			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "district", Value: district})
229		}
230		return s.repo.listOrgs(ctx, filter, page)
231	}
232	
233	// Members pages the ACTIVE role assignments at an org unit joined in memory
234	// with party identity fields (GET /orgs/{id}/members) — two indexed queries,
235	// no $lookup.
236	func (s *service) Members(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id string, page httpx.Page) ([]Member, int64, error) {
237		if _, err := s.repo.getOrg(ctx, id); err != nil {
238			return nil, 0, err
239		}
240		if err := s.scope.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, id); err != nil {
241			return nil, 0, err
242		}
243	
244		total, err := s.repo.countActiveAssignments(ctx, id)
245		if err != nil {
246			return nil, 0, err
247		}
248		assignments, err := s.repo.listActiveAssignments(ctx, id, page)
249		if err != nil {
250			return nil, 0, err
251		}
252		partyIDs := make([]string, 0, len(assignments))
253		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(assignments))
254		for _, a := range assignments {
255			if _, dup := seen[a.PartyID]; !dup {
256				seen[a.PartyID] = struct{}{}
257				partyIDs = append(partyIDs, a.PartyID)
258			}
259		}
260		parties, err := s.repo.partiesByIDs(ctx, partyIDs)
261		if err != nil {
262			return nil, 0, err
263		}
264	
265		members := make([]Member, 0, len(assignments))
266		for _, a := range assignments {
267			m := Member{
268				PartyID:          a.PartyID,
269				RoleCode:         a.RoleCode,
270				RoleAssignmentID: a.ID,
271				ValidFrom:        a.ValidFrom,
272				ValidTo:          a.ValidTo,
273			}
274			if p, ok := parties[a.PartyID]; ok {
275				m.Phone = p.Phone
276				m.FullName = p.FullName
277				m.KYCTier = p.KYCTier
278			}
279			members = append(members, m)
280		}
281		return members, total, nil
282	}
283
```

```text
1	// Package provenance implements the append-only, hash-chained event ledger —
2	// the source of truth for milk traceability (blueprint §7). Every link in the
3	// pour→QR chain is an immutable Event whose SHA-256 hash covers the previous
4	// event's hash, so history cannot be quietly rewritten (tamper-evidence,
5	// FSSAI recall-grade audit).
6	//
7	// Corrections are NEW events referencing the superseded entity — nothing is
8	// ever updated or deleted in this collection.
9	package provenance
10	
11	import (
12		"context"
13		"crypto/sha256"
14		"encoding/hex"
15		"encoding/json"
16		"errors"
17		"fmt"
18		"strconv"
19		"strings"
20		"sync"
21		"time"
22	
23		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
24		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
25		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
26		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo/options"
27	)
28	
29	const collection = "provenance_events"
30	
31	// Ref is a directed edge to another entity in the trace graph
32	// (e.g. a consignment event referencing the pours it aggregates).
33	type Ref struct {
34		EntityType string `bson:"entity_type" json:"entity_type"`
35		EntityID   string `bson:"entity_id"   json:"entity_id"`
36		Relation   string `bson:"relation"    json:"relation"` // aggregates | supersedes | tested | yields | labels ...
37	}
38	
39	// ActorRef records who caused the event.
40	type ActorRef struct {
41		PartyID  string `bson:"party_id"  json:"party_id"`
42		RoleCode string `bson:"role_code" json:"role_code"`
43	}
44	
45	// Event is one immutable link in the ledger. `_id` is a generated ObjectID;
46	// EntityID and Refs carry the referenced documents' ObjectIDs as hex strings
47	// (the ledger is a generic event log spanning every entity type, and hex
48	// strings keep the hash material canonical and human-inspectable).
49	type Event struct {
50		ID         primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
51		Seq        int64          `bson:"seq"         json:"seq"`
52		Type       string         `bson:"type"        json:"type"`
53		EntityType string         `bson:"entity_type" json:"entity_type"`
54		EntityID   string         `bson:"entity_id"   json:"entity_id"`
55		Refs       []Ref          `bson:"refs,omitempty"    json:"refs,omitempty"`
56		Actor      ActorRef       `bson:"actor"       json:"actor"`
57		OrgUnitID  string         `bson:"org_unit_id,omitempty" json:"org_unit_id,omitempty"`
58		Payload    map[string]any `bson:"payload,omitempty"     json:"payload,omitempty"`
59		TS         time.Time      `bson:"ts"          json:"ts"`
60		PrevHash   string         `bson:"prev_hash"   json:"prev_hash"`
61		Hash       string         `bson:"hash"        json:"hash"`
62	}
63	
64	// AppendInput describes a new event to chain.
65	type AppendInput struct {
66		Type       string
67		EntityType string
68		EntityID   string
69		Refs       []Ref
70		Actor      ActorRef
71		OrgUnitID  string
72		Payload    map[string]any
73	}
74	
75	// Ledger appends to and reads the hash chain.
76	type Ledger struct {
77		coll *mongo.Collection
78	
79		// appendMu serialises the head-read+insert of Append within this process:
80		// every ledger write system-wide shares one global seq, so without local
81		// serialisation concurrent handlers (e.g. a morning pour rush plus a
82		// GenerateInvoices loop) burn duplicate-key retries against each other.
83		// The unique seq index remains the atomic backstop across processes.
84		appendMu sync.Mutex
85	}
86	
87	// NewLedger binds the ledger to the database.
88	func NewLedger(db *mongo.Database) *Ledger {
89		return &Ledger{coll: db.Collection(collection)}
90	}
91	
92	// genesisHash anchors the chain before the first event.
93	const genesisHash = "GENESIS"
94	
95	// Append chains a new event. Concurrency-safe without transactions: it reads
96	// the current head, computes seq+hash optimistically, and relies on the
97	// unique index on `seq` — a duplicate-key collision means another writer won
98	// the slot, so we re-read and retry.
99	func (l *Ledger) Append(ctx context.Context, in AppendInput) (*Event, error) {
100		// Serialise appends within this process (see appendMu): local writers no
101		// longer race each other for the seq slot, so under single-instance
102		// deployment the retry loop only ever fires against external writers.
103		l.appendMu.Lock()
104		defer l.appendMu.Unlock()
105	
106		const maxRetries = 12
107		for attempt := 0; attempt < maxRetries; attempt++ {
108			seq, prevHash, err := l.head(ctx)
109			if err != nil {
110				return nil, err
111			}
112			ev := &Event{
113				ID:         primitive.NewObjectID(),
114				Seq:        seq + 1,
115				Type:       in.Type,
116				EntityType: in.EntityType,
117				EntityID:   in.EntityID,
118				Refs:       in.Refs,
119				Actor:      in.Actor,
120				OrgUnitID:  in.OrgUnitID,
121				Payload:    in.Payload,
122				// Millisecond precision: BSON datetimes store ms, so the persisted
123				// TS must equal the hashed TS or re-verification would break.
124				TS:       time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Millisecond),
125				PrevHash: prevHash,
126			}
127			ev.Hash = computeHash(ev)
128	
129			if _, err := l.coll.InsertOne(ctx, ev); err != nil {
130				if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(err) {
131					continue // lost the seq race — retry against the new head
132				}
133				return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance append: %w", err)
134			}
135			return ev, nil
136		}
137		return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance append: gave up after %d seq collisions", 12)
138	}
139	
140	// head returns the latest (seq, hash), or (0, GENESIS) for an empty chain.
141	func (l *Ledger) head(ctx context.Context) (int64, string, error) {
142		var last Event
143		err := l.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{},
144			options.FindOne().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: -1}}),
145		).Decode(&last)
146		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
147			return 0, genesisHash, nil
148		}
149		if err != nil {
150			return 0, "", fmt.Errorf("provenance head: %w", err)
151		}
152		return last.Seq, last.Hash, nil
153	}
154	
155	// computeHash covers everything that matters: position, linkage, content.
156	// Payload is canonicalised via encoding/json (map keys are sorted) and the
157	// timestamp to millisecond precision (BSON datetime resolution), so the
158	// digest is deterministic across a MongoDB round trip.
159	func computeHash(ev *Event) string {
160		payloadJSON, _ := json.Marshal(ev.Payload)
161		refParts := make([]string, 0, len(ev.Refs))
162		for _, r := range ev.Refs {
163			refParts = append(refParts, r.EntityType+":"+r.EntityID+":"+r.Relation)
164		}
165		material := strings.Join([]string{
166			ev.PrevHash,
167			strconv.FormatInt(ev.Seq, 10),
168			ev.Type,
169			ev.EntityType,
170			ev.EntityID,
171			strings.Join(refParts, ","),
172			ev.Actor.PartyID,
173			ev.Actor.RoleCode,
174			ev.OrgUnitID,
175			string(payloadJSON),
176			ev.TS.UTC().Truncate(time.Millisecond).Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
177		}, "|")
178		sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(material))
179		return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
180	}
181	
182	// EventsForEntity returns an entity's own timeline in chain order.
183	func (l *Ledger) EventsForEntity(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string) ([]Event, error) {
184		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
185			bson.D{{Key: "entity_type", Value: entityType}, {Key: "entity_id", Value: entityID}},
186			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}),
187		)
188		if err != nil {
189			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance events for %s/%s: %w", entityType, entityID, err)
190		}
191		var out []Event
192		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
193			return nil, err
194		}
195		return out, nil
196	}
197	
198	// Trace walks the provenance graph UPSTREAM from an entity: its events, plus
199	// (recursively) the events of everything those events reference. This is how
200	// a consumer QR resolves back to the contributing samiti set, and how a failed
201	// aflatoxin test walks back to source DCSes (blueprint §8.3).
202	func (l *Ledger) Trace(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, maxDepth int) ([]Event, error) {
203		return l.TraceStopAt(ctx, entityType, entityID, maxDepth, nil)
204	}
205	
206	// TraceStopAt is Trace with a stop set: entity types in stopExpand are still
207	// fetched (their events appear in the result) but their refs are never
208	// followed. The consumer QR scan stops at the consignment/pooling boundary so
209	// hundreds of per-pour nodes (and cross-route trip fan-out) are never walked.
210	//
211	// Each BFS level is batched into a bounded number of $or queries instead of
212	// one Find per node, so a walk costs O(depth) round trips, not O(nodes).
213	func (l *Ledger) TraceStopAt(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, maxDepth int, stopExpand map[string]bool) ([]Event, error) {
214		if maxDepth <= 0 {
215			maxDepth = 10
216		}
217		const hardEventCap = 2000
218	
219		type node struct{ etype, eid string }
220		visited := map[node]bool{}
221		frontier := []node{{entityType, entityID}}
222		var all []Event
223	
224		for depth := 0; depth < maxDepth && len(frontier) > 0; depth++ {
225			// Deduplicate this level against everything already visited.
226			level := make([]node, 0, len(frontier))
227			for _, n := range frontier {
228				if visited[n] {
229					continue
230				}
231				visited[n] = true
232				level = append(level, n)
233			}
234			if len(level) == 0 {
235				break
236			}
237	
238			var next []node
239			// One indexed query per chunk of the level (not per node).
240			const orChunk = 200
241			for start := 0; start < len(level); start += orChunk {
242				end := min(start+orChunk, len(level))
243				clauses := make(bson.A, 0, end-start)
244				for _, n := range level[start:end] {
245					clauses = append(clauses, bson.D{
246						{Key: "entity_type", Value: n.etype},
247						{Key: "entity_id", Value: n.eid},
248					})
249				}
250				cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
251					bson.D{{Key: "$or", Value: clauses}},
252					options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}).SetLimit(hardEventCap),
253				)
254				if err != nil {
255					return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance trace level: %w", err)
256				}
257				var evs []Event
258				if err := cur.All(ctx, &evs); err != nil {
259					return nil, err
260				}
261				for _, ev := range evs {
262					all = append(all, ev)
263					if len(all) >= hardEventCap {
264						return all, nil
265					}
266					if stopExpand != nil && stopExpand[ev.EntityType] {
267						continue // include the node's events, never follow its refs
268					}
269					for _, ref := range ev.Refs {
270						nn := node{ref.EntityType, ref.EntityID}
271						if !visited[nn] {
272							next = append(next, nn)
273						}
274					}
275				}
276			}
277			frontier = next
278		}
279		return all, nil
280	}
281	
282	// DownstreamRefs finds events that reference the given entity — used to walk
283	// FORWARD (e.g. "which batches consumed this blocked BMC lot?"). The limit is
284	// pushed into the query: only the LAST limit referencing events are fetched
285	// (ascending chain order preserved). limit <= 0 falls back to 2000.
286	func (l *Ledger) DownstreamRefs(ctx context.Context, entityID string, limit int64) ([]Event, error) {
287		if limit <= 0 {
288			limit = 2000
289		}
290		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
291			bson.D{{Key: "refs.entity_id", Value: entityID}},
292			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: -1}}).SetLimit(limit),
293		)
294		if err != nil {
295			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance downstream of %s: %w", entityID, err)
296		}
297		var out []Event
298		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
299			return nil, err
300		}
301		// Restore ascending chain order.
302		for i, j := 0, len(out)-1; i < j; i, j = i+1, j-1 {
303			out[i], out[j] = out[j], out[i]
304		}
305		return out, nil
306	}
307	
308	// EventsForEntityPage returns one page of an entity's own timeline in chain
309	// order, with skip/limit pushed into the query.
310	func (l *Ledger) EventsForEntityPage(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, offset, limit int64) ([]Event, error) {
311		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
312			bson.D{{Key: "entity_type", Value: entityType}, {Key: "entity_id", Value: entityID}},
313			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}).SetSkip(offset).SetLimit(limit),
314		)
315		if err != nil {
316			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance events page for %s/%s: %w", entityType, entityID, err)
317		}
318		var out []Event
319		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
320			return nil, err
321		}
322		return out, nil
323	}
324	
325	// CountEventsForEntity returns the total number of events on an entity's
326	// timeline (pagination meta companion of EventsForEntityPage).
327	func (l *Ledger) CountEventsForEntity(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string) (int64, error) {
328		n, err := l.coll.CountDocuments(ctx,
329			bson.D{{Key: "entity_type", Value: entityType}, {Key: "entity_id", Value: entityID}})
330		if err != nil {
331			return 0, fmt.Errorf("provenance count for %s/%s: %w", entityType, entityID, err)
332		}
333		return n, nil
334	}
335	
336	// VerifyChain re-derives every hash in [fromSeq, toSeq] and checks linkage.
337	// Returns (true, 0) when intact, or (false, seq) of the first broken link.
338	func (l *Ledger) VerifyChain(ctx context.Context, fromSeq, toSeq int64) (bool, int64, error) {
339		filter := bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$gte", Value: fromSeq}, {Key: "$lte", Value: toSeq}}}}
340		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}))
341		if err != nil {
342			return false, 0, fmt.Errorf("provenance verify: %w", err)
343		}
344		defer cur.Close(ctx)
345	
346		prevHash := ""
347		prevSeq := int64(0)
348		first := true
349		for cur.Next(ctx) {
350			var ev Event
351			if err := cur.Decode(&ev); err != nil {
352				return false, 0, err
353			}
354			if computeHash(&ev) != ev.Hash {
355				return false, ev.Seq, nil // content tampered
356			}
357			if !first {
358				if ev.Seq != prevSeq+1 || ev.PrevHash != prevHash {
359					return false, ev.Seq, nil // linkage broken
360				}
361			}
362			prevHash, prevSeq, first = ev.Hash, ev.Seq, false
363		}
364		return true, 0, cur.Err()
365	}
366	
367	// LatestSeq returns the current chain head sequence (0 = empty).
368	func (l *Ledger) LatestSeq(ctx context.Context) (int64, error) {
369		seq, _, err := l.head(ctx)
370		return seq, err
371	}
372
```

```text
16	// repo owns every MongoDB access for the logistics module. It returns raw
17	// driver errors (including mongo.ErrNoDocuments); the service layer maps
18	// them to httpx errors. No business logic lives here.
19	type repo struct {
20		consignments *mongo.Collection
21		trips        *mongo.Collection
22		pours        *mongo.Collection // read-only view into the collection module's pours (sanctioned by spec)
23	}
24	
25	// newRepo binds the repo to its collections via the shared name constants.
26	func newRepo(db *mongo.Database) *repo {
27		return &repo{
28			consignments: db.Collection(mongodb.CollConsignments),
29			trips:        db.Collection(mongodb.CollRouteTrips),
30			pours:        db.Collection(mongodb.CollMilkPours),
31		}
32	}
33	
34	// pourRow is the projected slice of a milk pour needed for aggregation.
35	type pourRow struct {
36		ID             string  `bson:"_id"`
37		QuantityLitres float64 `bson:"quantity_litres"`
38		FatPct         float64 `bson:"fat_pct"`
39		SNFPct         float64 `bson:"snf_pct"`
40	}
41	
42	// findRecordedPours returns the RECORDED pours of one DCS date+shift,
43	// projected down to the fields the consignment aggregate needs.
44	func (r *repo) findRecordedPours(ctx context.Context, dcsID, date, shift string) ([]pourRow, error) {
45		filter := bson.D{
46			{Key: "dcs_id", Value: dcsID},
47			{Key: "pour_date", Value: date},
48			{Key: "shift", Value: shift},
49			{Key: "status", Value: domain.PourStatusRecorded},
50		}
51		projection := bson.D{
52			{Key: "_id", Value: 1},
53			{Key: "quantity_litres", Value: 1},
54			{Key: "fat_pct", Value: 1},
55			{Key: "snf_pct", Value: 1},
56		}
57		cur, err := r.pours.Find(ctx, filter,
58			options.Find().SetProjection(projection).SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "created_at", Value: 1}}))
59		if err != nil {
60			return nil, err
61		}
62		var rows []pourRow
63		if err := cur.All(ctx, &rows); err != nil {
64			return nil, err
65		}
66		return rows, nil
67	}
68	
69	// insertConsignment stores a new consignment. The unique index on
70	// dcs_id+date+shift turns duplicates into a duplicate-key error.
71	func (r *repo) insertConsignment(ctx context.Context, c *domain.DCSConsignment) error {
72		_, err := r.consignments.InsertOne(ctx, c)
73		return err
74	}
75	
76	// findConsignmentByID loads one consignment.
77	func (r *repo) findConsignmentByID(ctx context.Context, id string) (*domain.DCSConsignment, error) {
78		var c domain.DCSConsignment
79		if err := r.consignments.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&c); err != nil {
80			return nil, err
81		}
82		return &c, nil
83	}
84	
85	// markConsignmentDispatched transitions OPEN→DISPATCHED optimistically:
86	// the status filter makes the guard atomic without transactions. The seal
87	// also re-stamps the pour aggregates (extraSet) so pours recorded between
88	// creation and dispatch are never lost from the consignment's totals.
89	func (r *repo) markConsignmentDispatched(ctx context.Context, id string, at time.Time, extraSet bson.D) (bool, error) {
90		set := bson.D{
91			{Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusDispatch},
92			{Key: "dispatched_at", Value: at},
93		}
94		set = append(set, extraSet...)
95		res, err := r.consignments.UpdateOne(ctx,
96			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}, {Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusOpen}},
97			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: set}})
98		if err != nil {
99			return false, err
100		}
101		return res.MatchedCount > 0, nil
102	}
103	
104	// markConsignmentPickedUp transitions DISPATCHED→PICKED_UP and pins the
105	// carrying trip, guarded atomically by the status filter.
106	func (r *repo) markConsignmentPickedUp(ctx context.Context, id, tripID string) (bool, error) {
107		res, err := r.consignments.UpdateOne(ctx,
108			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}, {Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusDispatch}},
109			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
110				{Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusPickedUp},
111				{Key: "route_trip_id", Value: tripID},
112			}}})
113		if err != nil {
114			return false, err
115		}
116		return res.MatchedCount > 0, nil
117	}
118	
119	// markConsignmentsDelivered transitions every listed PICKED_UP consignment
120	// to DELIVERED (bulk companion of the trip delivery).
121	func (r *repo) markConsignmentsDelivered(ctx context.Context, ids []string) error {
122		_, err := r.consignments.UpdateMany(ctx,
123			bson.D{
124				{Key: "_id", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: ids}}},
125				{Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusPickedUp},
126			},
127			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusDelivered}}}})
128		return err
129	}
130	
131	// setConsignmentProvenanceSeq pins the latest ledger sequence on the doc.
132	func (r *repo) setConsignmentProvenanceSeq(ctx context.Context, id string, seq int64) error {
133		_, err := r.consignments.UpdateByID(ctx, id,
134			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "provenance_seq", Value: seq}}}})
135		return err
136	}

139	func (r *repo) listConsignments(ctx context.Context, dcsID, date, status string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.DCSConsignment, int64, error) {
140		filter := bson.D{}
141		if dcsID != "" {
142			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "dcs_id", Value: dcsID})
143		}
144		if date != "" {
145			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "date", Value: date})
146		}
147		if status != "" {
148			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "status", Value: status})
149		}
150		total, err := r.consignments.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
151		if err != nil {
152			return nil, 0, err
153		}
154		cur, err := r.consignments.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
155			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "created_at", Value: -1}}).
156			SetSkip(page.Offset).SetLimit(page.Limit))
157		if err != nil {
158			return nil, 0, err
159		}
160		items := []domain.DCSConsignment{}
161		if err := cur.All(ctx, &items); err != nil {
162			return nil, 0, err
163		}
164		return items, total, nil
165	}

169		_, err := r.trips.InsertOne(ctx, t)
170		return err
171	}
172	
173	// findTripByID loads one trip.

175		var t domain.RouteTrip

177			return nil, err
178		}
179		return &t, nil
180	}
181	
182	// markStopPickedUp stamps the matched stop with pickup time/temperature and
183	// moves the trip to IN_PROGRESS (idempotent once it is already there).
184	func (r *repo) markStopPickedUp(ctx context.Context, tripID, consignmentID string, at time.Time, tempC float64, notes string) error {
185		_, err := r.trips.UpdateOne(ctx,
186			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: tripID}, {Key: "stops.consignment_id", Value: consignmentID}},
187			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
188				{Key: "stops.$.picked_up_at", Value: at},
189				{Key: "stops.$.temp_c", Value: tempC},
190				{Key: "stops.$.notes", Value: notes},
191				{Key: "status", Value: domain.TripStatusInProgress},
192			}}})

196	// pushColdChain appends one temperature sample to the trip's cold-chain log.
197	func (r *repo) pushColdChain(ctx context.Context, tripID string, entry domain.ColdChainEntry) error {
198		_, err := r.trips.UpdateByID(ctx, tripID,
199			bson.D{{Key: "$push", Value: bson.D{{Key: "cold_chain", Value: entry}}}})
200		return err
```

```text
1	package cattle

11	
12	// handler adapts HTTP to the service: decode, call, respond — no business
13	// logic and no MongoDB in this file.
14	type handler struct {
15		svc *service
16	}
17	
18	// newHandler binds the handler to the service.
19	func newHandler(svc *service) *handler {
20		return &handler{svc: svc}
21	}
22	
23	// registerAnimal handles POST /cattle/animals.
24	func (h *handler) registerAnimal(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
25		actor, _ := auth.ActorFrom(r.Context())
26		var req RegisterAnimalRequest
27		if err := httpx.DecodeJSON(r, &req); err != nil {
28			httpx.Error(w, r, err)
29			return
30		}
31		animal, err := h.svc.RegisterAnimal(r.Context(), actor, req)
32		if err != nil {
33			httpx.Error(w, r, err)
34			return
35		}
36		httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusCreated, animal)
37	}
38
```
