```text
27	// codeSafetyGateBlocked is the stable error code every gate refusal carries —
28	// the frontend switches on it to show the quarantine screen (blueprint §8.3).
29	const codeSafetyGateBlocked = "SAFETY_GATE_BLOCKED"
30	
31	// Service holds the plant module's business logic: lot pooling, the safety
32	// gate, batch numbering, product lot packaging and QR minting.
33	type Service struct {
34		repo     *Repo
35		orgs     *orgscope.Resolver
36		ledger   *provenance.Ledger
37		qrSecret string
38	}
39	
40	// NewService wires the service from the shared dependency container.
41	func NewService(repo *Repo, d *deps.Deps) *Service {
42		return &Service{
43			repo:     repo,
44			orgs:     d.Orgs,
45			ledger:   d.Ledger,
46			qrSecret: d.Cfg.QRSigningSecret,
47		}
48	}
49	
50	// --- safety-gate predicates (§8.3) ---
51	//
52	// Pure functions so the refusal matrix is unit-testable without a database.
53	// Every mutation below ALSO re-checks the status inside the MongoDB update
54	// filter, so a concurrent QC block can never slip a bad lot through.
55	
56	// canDispatchBMCLot: only a lot with a passing BMC rapid test may leave on a
57	// tanker. BLOCKED, QC_PENDING and OPEN lots stay put.
58	func canDispatchBMCLot(status string) bool {
59		return status == domain.BMCLotStatusPassed
60	}
61	
62	// canPoolBMCLot: only a DISPATCHED lot (which by construction went
63	// OPEN→QC_PENDING→PASSED→DISPATCHED) may enter a processing batch.
64	func canPoolBMCLot(status string) bool {
65		return status == domain.BMCLotStatusDispatched
66	}
67	
68	// canCompleteBatch: only a batch the plant lab has PASSED may complete.
69	func canCompleteBatch(status string) bool {
70		return status == domain.BatchStatusPassed
71	}
72	
73	// canYieldProductLot: only a COMPLETED batch may be packaged into SKU lots.
74	func canYieldProductLot(batchStatus string) bool {
75		return batchStatus == domain.BatchStatusCompleted
76	}
77	
78	// canIssueQR: a QR may only label an ACTIVE product lot whose batch is
79	// COMPLETED. This read-time check is advisory; IssueQR additionally confirms
80	// the lot is still ACTIVE with a conditional write after the QR insert, so a
81	// recall landing mid-request still stops the mint.
82	func canIssueQR(lotStatus, batchStatus string) bool {
83		return lotStatus == domain.ProductLotStatusActive && batchStatus == domain.BatchStatusCompleted
84	}
85	
86	// --- BMC lots ---
87	
88	// CreateBMCLot pools DELIVERED consignments into a new OPEN lot at a BMC.
89	func (s *Service) CreateBMCLot(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateBMCLotRequest) (*domain.BMCLot, error) {
90		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.BMCID); err != nil {
91			return nil, err
92		}
93		org, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.BMCID)
94		if err != nil {
95			return nil, err
96		}
97		if org.Type != domain.OrgTypeBMC {
98			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_BMC", "org unit "+req.BMCID+" is not a BMC")
99		}
100	
101		now := time.Now().UTC()
102		date := req.Date
103		if date == "" {
104			date = domain.DateKeyIST(now)
105		}
106	
107		ids := dedupe(req.ConsignmentIDs)
108		consignments, err := s.repo.ConsignmentsByIDs(ctx, ids)
109		if err != nil {
110			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
111		}
112		if len(consignments) != len(ids) {
113			return nil, httpx.NotFound("consignment(s) " + strings.Join(missingIDs(ids, consignments), ", "))
114		}
115		var undelivered []string
116		for _, c := range consignments {
117			if c.Status != domain.ConsignmentStatusDelivered {
118				undelivered = append(undelivered, c.ID)
119			}
120		}
121		if len(undelivered) > 0 {
122			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("CONSIGNMENT_NOT_DELIVERED",
123				"only DELIVERED consignments can be pooled into a BMC lot").
124				WithDetails(map[string]any{"consignment_ids": undelivered})
125		}
126	
127		// Optimistic claim: flip DELIVERED→ACCEPTED stamped with the new lot ID.
128		// If another lot raced us on any consignment, release our claims and bail.
129		lotID := uuid.NewString()
130		claimed, err := s.repo.ClaimConsignments(ctx, ids, lotID)
131		if err != nil {
132			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
133		}
134		if claimed != int64(len(ids)) {
135			if relErr := s.repo.ReleaseConsignments(ctx, lotID); relErr != nil {
136				return nil, httpx.Internal(relErr)
137			}
138			return nil, httpx.Conflict("CONSIGNMENT_CLAIM_CONFLICT",
139				"one or more consignments were pooled by another lot — reload and retry")
140		}
141	
142		var totalLitres float64
143		var tripIDs []string
144		seenTrip := map[string]bool{}
145		for _, c := range consignments {
146			totalLitres += c.TotalQuantityLitres
147			if c.RouteTripID != "" && !seenTrip[c.RouteTripID] {
148				seenTrip[c.RouteTripID] = true
149				tripIDs = append(tripIDs, c.RouteTripID)
150			}
151		}
152	
153		lot := &domain.BMCLot{
154			ID:                  lotID,
155			BMCID:               req.BMCID,
156			Date:                date,
157			Shift:               req.Shift,
158			ConsignmentIDs:      ids,
159			RouteTripIDs:        tripIDs,
160			TotalQuantityLitres: totalLitres,
161			Status:              domain.BMCLotStatusOpen,
162			CreatedBy:           actor.PartyID,
163			CreatedAt:           now,
164		}
165		if err := s.repo.InsertBMCLot(ctx, lot); err != nil {
166			_ = s.repo.ReleaseConsignments(ctx, lotID)
167			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
168		}
169	
170		refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, len(ids))
171		for _, id := range ids {
172			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{
173				EntityType: domain.EntityConsignment, EntityID: id, Relation: "pools",
174			})
175		}
176		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
177			Type:       domain.EventBMCLotCreated,
178			EntityType: domain.EntityBMCLot,
179			EntityID:   lot.ID,
180			Refs:       refs,
181			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
182			OrgUnitID:  req.BMCID,
183			Payload: map[string]any{
184				"date": date, "shift": req.Shift, "total_quantity_litres": totalLitres,
185			},
186		})
187		if err != nil {
188			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
189		}
190		if err := s.repo.SetBMCLotProvenanceSeq(ctx, lot.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
191			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
192		}
193		lot.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
194		return lot, nil
195	}
196	
197	// CloseBMCLot transitions an OPEN lot to QC_PENDING with the chilling
198	// temperature. The quality module later flips QC_PENDING→PASSED/BLOCKED.
199	func (s *Service) CloseBMCLot(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id string, chillingTempC float64) (*domain.BMCLot, error) {
200		lot, err := s.getBMCLot(ctx, id)
201		if err != nil {
202			return nil, err
203		}
204		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, lot.BMCID); err != nil {
205			return nil, err
206		}
207		if lot.Status != domain.BMCLotStatusOpen {
208			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_NOT_OPEN",
209				"only an OPEN lot can be closed; lot is "+lot.Status)
210		}
211		now := time.Now().UTC()
212		ok, err := s.repo.CloseBMCLot(ctx, id, chillingTempC, now)
213		if err != nil {
214			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
215		}
216		if !ok {
217			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_NOT_OPEN",
218				"lot changed state concurrently — reload and retry")
219		}
220		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
221			Type:       domain.EventBMCLotClosed,
222			EntityType: domain.EntityBMCLot,
223			EntityID:   lot.ID,
224			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
225			OrgUnitID:  lot.BMCID,
226			Payload:    map[string]any{"chilling_temp_c": chillingTempC},
227		})
228		if err != nil {
229			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
230		}
231		if err := s.repo.SetBMCLotProvenanceSeq(ctx, lot.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
232			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
233		}
234		lot.Status = domain.BMCLotStatusQCPending
235		lot.ChillingTempC = chillingTempC
236		lot.ClosedAt = &now
237		lot.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
238		return lot, nil
239	}
240	
241	// DispatchBMCLot transitions PASSED→DISPATCHED. THE safety gate (§8.3): a
242	// BLOCKED or untested lot never leaves the chilling centre.
243	func (s *Service) DispatchBMCLot(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id string) (*domain.BMCLot, error) {
244		lot, err := s.getBMCLot(ctx, id)
245		if err != nil {
246			return nil, err
247		}
248		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, lot.BMCID); err != nil {
249			return nil, err
250		}
251		if lot.Status == domain.BMCLotStatusDispatched {
252			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_ALREADY_DISPATCHED", "lot is already dispatched")
253		}
254		if !canDispatchBMCLot(lot.Status) {
255			msg := "lot cannot be dispatched: safety gate not passed (status " + lot.Status + ")"
256			if lot.BlockReason != "" {
257				msg += " — " + lot.BlockReason
258			}
259			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked, msg).
260				WithDetails(map[string]any{"status": lot.Status, "block_reason": lot.BlockReason})
261		}
262		now := time.Now().UTC()
263		ok, err := s.repo.DispatchBMCLot(ctx, id, now)
264		if err != nil {
265			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
266		}
267		if !ok {
268			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_STATE_CHANGED",
269				"lot changed state concurrently — reload and retry")
270		}
271		// The custody transition — gate-passed milk physically leaving the
272		// chilling centre — must live on the tamper-evident chain like every
273		// other hop of the pour→QR path, not only in a mutable document field.
274		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
275			Type:       domain.EventBMCLotDispatched,
276			EntityType: domain.EntityBMCLot,
277			EntityID:   lot.ID,
278			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
279			OrgUnitID:  lot.BMCID,
280			Payload: map[string]any{
281				// String, not time.Time: payloads must round-trip BSON⇄JSON
282				// byte-identically or chain re-verification would break.
283				"dispatched_at":         now.Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
284				"total_quantity_litres": lot.TotalQuantityLitres,
285			},
286		})
287		if err != nil {
288			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
289		}
290		if err := s.repo.SetBMCLotProvenanceSeq(ctx, lot.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
291			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
292		}
293		lot.Status = domain.BMCLotStatusDispatched
294		lot.DispatchedAt = &now
295		lot.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
296		return lot, nil
297	}
298	
299	// ListBMCLots pages lots by BMC/date/status. A BMC operator may only list
300	// within their own scope; downstream readers (plant operator, supervisor,
301	// lab) see across BMCs — the plant receives tankers from sibling BMCs, so an
302	// ancestry check against the plant org would wrongly refuse them.
303	func (s *Service) ListBMCLots(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, f BMCLotListFilter, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.BMCLot, int64, error) {
304		if f.BMCID != "" && actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleBMCOperator {
305			if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, f.BMCID); err != nil {
306				return nil, 0, err
307			}
308		}
309		lots, total, err := s.repo.ListBMCLots(ctx, f, page)
310		if err != nil {
311			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(err)
312		}
313		return lots, total, nil
314	}
315	
316	// --- processing batches ---
317	
318	// CreateBatch pools DISPATCHED (gate-passed) BMC lots into one production
319	// run. The gate re-checks here belt-and-braces: aflatoxin M1 survives
320	// pasteurisation, so a blocked lot must never reach a vat (§8.3).
321	func (s *Service) CreateBatch(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateBatchRequest) (*domain.ProcessingBatch, error) {
322		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.PlantID); err != nil {
323			return nil, err
324		}
325		org, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.PlantID)
326		if err != nil {
327			return nil, err
328		}
329		if org.Type != domain.OrgTypeProcessingPlant {
330			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_PLANT", "org unit "+req.PlantID+" is not a processing plant")
331		}
332	
333		ids := dedupe(req.BMCLotIDs)
334		lots, err := s.repo.BMCLotsByIDs(ctx, ids)
335		if err != nil {
336			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
337		}
338		if len(lots) != len(ids) {
339			return nil, httpx.NotFound("BMC lot(s) " + strings.Join(missingLotIDs(ids, lots), ", "))
340		}
341		var offending []string
342		var inputLitres float64
343		for _, lot := range lots {
344			if !canPoolBMCLot(lot.Status) {
345				offending = append(offending, lot.ID)
346				continue
347			}
348			inputLitres += lot.TotalQuantityLitres
349		}
350		if len(offending) > 0 {
351			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked,
352				"one or more BMC lots have not cleared the safety gate (must be PASSED and DISPATCHED)").
353				WithDetails(map[string]any{"blocked_lot_ids": offending})
354		}
355	
356		now := time.Now().UTC()
357		dateKey := domain.DateKeyIST(now)
358		seq, err := s.repo.NextSequence(ctx, "batch_number:"+req.PlantID+":"+dateKey)
359		if err != nil {
360			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
361		}
362		batchNumber := fmt.Sprintf("BATCH-%s-%s-%04d",
363			org.Code, strings.ReplaceAll(dateKey, "-", ""), seq)
364	
365		// Optimistic claim (mirrors ClaimConsignments): flip DISPATCHED→POOLED
366		// stamped with the new batch ID BEFORE inserting the batch. One physical
367		// lot of milk can therefore never be pooled into two batches — neither by
368		// a double-submit nor by two concurrent CreateBatch calls.
369		batchID := uuid.NewString()
370		claimed, err := s.repo.ClaimBMCLots(ctx, ids, batchID)
371		if err != nil {
372			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
373		}
374		if claimed != int64(len(ids)) {
375			if relErr := s.repo.ReleaseBMCLots(ctx, batchID); relErr != nil {
376				return nil, httpx.Internal(relErr)
377			}
378			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_CLAIM_CONFLICT",
379				"one or more BMC lots were pooled by another batch — reload and retry")
380		}
381	
382		// CREATED is a transient birth state: the plant lab must clear every
383		// batch, so it is persisted straight into QC_PENDING.
384		batch := &domain.ProcessingBatch{
385			ID:          batchID,
386			PlantID:     req.PlantID,
387			BatchNumber: batchNumber,
388			BMCLotIDs:   ids,
389			ProductType: req.ProductType,
390			InputLitres: inputLitres,
391			Status:      domain.BatchStatusQCPending,
392			StartedAt:   now,
393			CreatedBy:   actor.PartyID,
394			CreatedAt:   now,
395		}
396		if err := s.repo.InsertBatch(ctx, batch); err != nil {
397			_ = s.repo.ReleaseBMCLots(ctx, batchID)
398			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
399		}
400	
401		refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, len(ids))
402		for _, id := range ids {
403			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{
404				EntityType: domain.EntityBMCLot, EntityID: id, Relation: "pools",
405			})
406		}
407		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
408			Type:       domain.EventBatchCreated,
409			EntityType: domain.EntityBatch,
410			EntityID:   batch.ID,
411			Refs:       refs,
412			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
413			OrgUnitID:  req.PlantID,
414			Payload: map[string]any{
415				"batch_number": batchNumber, "product_type": req.ProductType, "input_litres": inputLitres,
416			},
417		})
418		if err != nil {
419			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
420		}
421		if err := s.repo.SetBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx, batch.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
422			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
423		}
424		batch.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
425		return batch, nil
426	}
427	
428	// CompleteBatch transitions PASSED→COMPLETED — only a batch the plant lab
429	// cleared may finish and go on to yield product lots.
430	func (s *Service) CompleteBatch(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id string) (*domain.ProcessingBatch, error) {
431		batch, err := s.getBatch(ctx, id)
432		if err != nil {
433			return nil, err
434		}
435		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, batch.PlantID); err != nil {
436			return nil, err
437		}
438		if batch.Status == domain.BatchStatusCompleted {
439			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BATCH_ALREADY_COMPLETED", "batch is already completed")
440		}
441		if !canCompleteBatch(batch.Status) {
442			msg := "batch cannot complete: plant-lab QC not passed (status " + batch.Status + ")"
443			if batch.BlockReason != "" {
444				msg += " — " + batch.BlockReason
445			}
446			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked, msg).
447				WithDetails(map[string]any{"status": batch.Status, "block_reason": batch.BlockReason})
448		}
449		now := time.Now().UTC()
450		ok, err := s.repo.CompleteBatch(ctx, id, now)
451		if err != nil {
452			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
453		}
454		if !ok {
455			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BATCH_STATE_CHANGED",
456				"batch changed state concurrently — reload and retry")
457		}
458		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
459			Type:       domain.EventBatchCompleted,
460			EntityType: domain.EntityBatch,
461			EntityID:   batch.ID,
462			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
463			OrgUnitID:  batch.PlantID,
464			Payload:    map[string]any{"batch_number": batch.BatchNumber},
465		})
466		if err != nil {
467			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
468		}
469		if err := s.repo.SetBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx, batch.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
470			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
471		}
472		batch.Status = domain.BatchStatusCompleted
473		batch.CompletedAt = &now
474		batch.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
475		return batch, nil
476	}

506	// CreateProductLot packages a COMPLETED batch into a SKU lot (gate re-check).
507	func (s *Service) CreateProductLot(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateProductLotRequest) (*domain.ProductLot, error) {
508		batch, err := s.getBatch(ctx, req.BatchID)
509		if err != nil {
510			return nil, err
511		}
512		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, batch.PlantID); err != nil {
513			return nil, err
514		}
515		if !canYieldProductLot(batch.Status) {
516			msg := "batch has not completed the safety gate (status " + batch.Status + ") — no product lots may be made"
517			if batch.BlockReason != "" {
518				msg += " — " + batch.BlockReason
519			}
520			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked, msg).
521				WithDetails(map[string]any{"batch_status": batch.Status, "block_reason": batch.BlockReason})
522		}
523	
524		now := time.Now().UTC()
525		mfgDate := req.MfgDate
526		if mfgDate == "" {
527			mfgDate = domain.DateKeyIST(now)
528		}
529		if req.ExpiryDate <= mfgDate {
530			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_EXPIRY", "expiry_date must be after mfg_date")
531		}
532	
533		lot := &domain.ProductLot{
534			ID:          uuid.NewString(),
535			BatchID:     batch.ID,
536			PlantID:     batch.PlantID,
537			SKU:         req.SKU,
538			ProductName: req.ProductName,
539			Units:       req.Units,
540			UnitSize:    req.UnitSize,
541			MRP:         req.MRP,
542			MfgDate:     mfgDate,
543			ExpiryDate:  req.ExpiryDate,
544			Status:      domain.ProductLotStatusActive,
545			CreatedAt:   now,
546		}
547		if err := s.repo.InsertProductLot(ctx, lot); err != nil {
548			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
549		}
550		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
551			Type:       domain.EventProductLotMade,
552			EntityType: domain.EntityProductLot,
553			EntityID:   lot.ID,
554			Refs: []provenance.Ref{
555				{EntityType: domain.EntityBatch, EntityID: batch.ID, Relation: "yields"},
556			},
557			Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
558			OrgUnitID: batch.PlantID,
559			Payload: map[string]any{
560				"sku": req.SKU, "units": req.Units, "unit_size": req.UnitSize,
561				"mfg_date": mfgDate, "expiry_date": req.ExpiryDate,
562			},
563		})
564		if err != nil {
565			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
566		}
567		if err := s.repo.SetProductLotProvenanceSeq(ctx, lot.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
568			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
569		}
570		lot.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
571		return lot, nil
572	}

574	// RecallProductLot pulls a lot from market (FSSAI recall path, §18-C).
575	func (s *Service) RecallProductLot(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id, reason string) (*domain.ProductLot, error) {
576		lot, err := s.getProductLot(ctx, id)
577		if err != nil {
578			return nil, err
579		}
580		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, lot.PlantID); err != nil {
581			return nil, err
582		}
583		if lot.Status == domain.ProductLotStatusRecalled {
584			return nil, httpx.Conflict("PRODUCT_LOT_ALREADY_RECALLED", "product lot is already recalled")
585		}
586		ok, err := s.repo.RecallProductLot(ctx, id, reason)
587		if err != nil {
588			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
589		}
590		if !ok {
591			return nil, httpx.Conflict("PRODUCT_LOT_ALREADY_RECALLED", "product lot is already recalled")
592		}
593		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
594			Type:       domain.EventProductRecalled,
595			EntityType: domain.EntityProductLot,
596			EntityID:   lot.ID,
597			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
598			OrgUnitID:  lot.PlantID,
599			Payload:    map[string]any{"reason": reason},
600		})
601		if err != nil {
602			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
603		}
604		if err := s.repo.SetProductLotProvenanceSeq(ctx, lot.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
605			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
606		}
607		lot.Status = domain.ProductLotStatusRecalled
608		lot.RecallReason = reason
609		lot.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
610		return lot, nil
611	}
612	
613	// --- QR issuance ---
614	
615	// qrAlphabet is the 32-character human-safe set for short codes: A–Z and 2–9
616	// minus the confusables 0/O and 1/I. 32 divides 256, so a byte modulo the
617	// alphabet length is unbiased.
618	const qrAlphabet = "ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789"
619	
620	// qrCodeLength is the number of random characters after the "PRG-" prefix
621	// (32^8 ≈ 1.1 trillion codes — collisions are retried on the unique index).
622	const qrCodeLength = 8
623	
624	// newQRCode mints a short public code like "[REDACTED:generic-api-key]" from crypto/rand.
625	func newQRCode() (string, error) {
626		buf := make([]byte, qrCodeLength)
627		if _, err := rand.Read(buf); err != nil {
628			return "", err
629		}
630		code := make([]byte, qrCodeLength)
631		for i, b := range buf {
632			code[i] = qrAlphabet[int(b)%len(qrAlphabet)]
633		}
634		return "PRG-" + string(code), nil
635	}
636	
637	// signQRToken builds the forgery-proof token printed inside the QR:
638	// base64url(qr_code|product_lot_id|issued_unix) + "." + hex(HMAC-SHA256).
639	// The consumer app resolves the payload; the signature proves it was minted
640	// by this server, so IDs cannot be guessed onto counterfeit packs.
641	func signQRToken(secret, qrCode, productLotID string, issuedAt time.Time) string {
642		payload := qrCode + "|" + productLotID + "|" + strconv.FormatInt(issuedAt.Unix(), 10)
643		mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte(secret))
644		mac.Write([]byte(payload))
645		return base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(payload)) + "." + hex.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))
646	}
647	
648	// parseQRToken verifies and unpacks a signed QR token.
649	func parseQRToken(secret, token string) (qrCode, productLotID string, issuedAt time.Time, err error) {
650		payloadB64, sigHex, found := strings.Cut(token, ".")
651		if !found {
652			return "", "", time.Time{}, errors.New("qr token: missing signature separator")
653		}
654		payloadBytes, err := base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString(payloadB64)
655		if err != nil {
656			return "", "", time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("qr token: bad payload encoding: %w", err)
657		}
658		sig, err := hex.DecodeString(sigHex)
659		if err != nil {
660			return "", "", time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("qr token: bad signature encoding: %w", err)
661		}
662		mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte(secret))
663		mac.Write(payloadBytes)
664		if !hmac.Equal(sig, mac.Sum(nil)) {
665			return "", "", time.Time{}, errors.New("qr token: signature mismatch")
666		}
667		parts := strings.Split(string(payloadBytes), "|")
668		if len(parts) != 3 {
669			return "", "", time.Time{}, errors.New("qr token: malformed payload")
670		}
671		unix, err := strconv.ParseInt(parts[2], 10, 64)
672		if err != nil {
673			return "", "", time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("qr token: bad timestamp: %w", err)
674		}
675		return parts[0], parts[1], time.Unix(unix, 0).UTC(), nil
676	}
677	
678	// IssueQR mints one signed QR for an ACTIVE product lot whose batch is
679	// COMPLETED. The gate is checked on read AND re-confirmed with a conditional
680	// write on the lot after the QR insert, so recalled or blocked product can
681	// never be freshly labelled even when the recall races this request.
682	func (s *Service) IssueQR(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, productLotID string) (*domain.BatchQR, error) {
683		lot, err := s.getProductLot(ctx, productLotID)
684		if err != nil {
685			return nil, err
686		}
687		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, lot.PlantID); err != nil {
688			return nil, err
689		}
690		batch, err := s.getBatch(ctx, lot.BatchID)
691		if err != nil {
692			return nil, err
693		}
694		if !canIssueQR(lot.Status, batch.Status) {
695			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked,
696				"QR issuance refused: product lot must be ACTIVE and its batch COMPLETED").
697				WithDetails(map[string]any{
698					"product_lot_status": lot.Status,
699					"batch_status":       batch.Status,
700					"recall_reason":      lot.RecallReason,
701				})
702		}
703	
704		now := time.Now().UTC()
705		var qr *domain.BatchQR
706		const maxMintAttempts = 5
707		for attempt := 0; attempt < maxMintAttempts; attempt++ {
708			code, err := newQRCode()
709			if err != nil {
710				return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
711			}
712			candidate := &domain.BatchQR{
713				ID:           uuid.NewString(),
714				QRCode:       code,
715				ProductLotID: lot.ID,
716				SignedToken:  signQRToken(s.qrSecret, code, lot.ID, now),
717				IssuedBy:     actor.PartyID,
718				ScanCount:    0,
719				IssuedAt:     now,
720			}
721			insertErr := s.repo.InsertQR(ctx, candidate)
722			if insertErr == nil {
723				qr = candidate
724				break
725			}
726			if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(insertErr) {
727				continue // short-code collision — regenerate
728			}
729			return nil, httpx.Internal(insertErr)
730		}
731		if qr == nil {
732			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("qr mint: %d consecutive short-code collisions", maxMintAttempts))
733		}
734	
735		// Recall re-check at WRITE time: the initial read cannot see a recall that
736		// lands mid-request, so the mint is confirmed with a conditional no-op
737		// write on the lot (filter status=ACTIVE). If the lot left ACTIVE, the
738		// just-inserted QR is deleted and issuance refused — a freshly minted QR
739		// can never label recalled product.
740		active, err := s.repo.TouchActiveLot(ctx, lot.ID)
741		if err != nil {
742			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
743		}
744		if !active {
745			if delErr := s.repo.DeleteQR(ctx, qr.ID); delErr != nil {
746				return nil, httpx.Internal(delErr)
747			}
748			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked,
749				"QR issuance refused: product lot left ACTIVE (e.g. recalled) during issuance")
750		}
751	
752		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
753			Type:       domain.EventQRIssued,
754			EntityType: domain.EntityBatchQR,
755			EntityID:   qr.ID,
756			Refs: []provenance.Ref{
757				{EntityType: domain.EntityProductLot, EntityID: lot.ID, Relation: "labels"},
758			},
759			Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
760			OrgUnitID: lot.PlantID,
761			Payload:   map[string]any{"qr_code": qr.QRCode},
762		})
763		if err != nil {
764			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
765		}
766		if err := s.repo.SetQRProvenanceSeq(ctx, qr.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
767			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
768		}
769		qr.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
770		return qr, nil
771	}

826	
827	// dedupe removes duplicate IDs preserving first-seen order.
828	func dedupe(ids []string) []string {
829		seen := make(map[string]bool, len(ids))
830		out := make([]string, 0, len(ids))
831		for _, id := range ids {
832			if id == "" || seen[id] {
833				continue
834			}
835			seen[id] = true
836			out = append(out, id)
837		}
838		return out
839	}
840	
841	// missingIDs lists requested consignment IDs absent from the fetched set.
842	func missingIDs(wanted []string, got []domain.DCSConsignment) []string {
843		have := make(map[string]bool, len(got))
844		for _, c := range got {
845			have[c.ID] = true
846		}
847		var missing []string
848		for _, id := range wanted {
849			if !have[id] {
850				missing = append(missing, id)
851			}
852		}
853		return missing
854	}
855	
856	// missingLotIDs lists requested BMC lot IDs absent from the fetched set.
857	func missingLotIDs(wanted []string, got []domain.BMCLot) []string {
858		have := make(map[string]bool, len(got))
859		for _, l := range got {
860			have[l.ID] = true
861		}
862		var missing []string
863		for _, id := range wanted {
864			if !have[id] {
865				missing = append(missing, id)
866			}
867		}
868		return missing
869	}
```

```text
1	// Package provenance implements the append-only, hash-chained event ledger —
2	// the source of truth for milk traceability (blueprint §7). Every link in the
3	// pour→QR chain is an immutable Event whose SHA-256 hash covers the previous
4	// event's hash, so history cannot be quietly rewritten (tamper-evidence,
5	// FSSAI recall-grade audit).
6	//
7	// Corrections are NEW events referencing the superseded entity — nothing is
8	// ever updated or deleted in this collection.
9	package provenance
10	
11	import (
12		"context"
13		"crypto/sha256"
14		"encoding/hex"
15		"encoding/json"
16		"errors"
17		"fmt"
18		"strconv"
19		"strings"
20		"sync"
21		"time"
22	
23		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
24		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
25		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
26		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo/options"
27	)
28	
29	const collection = "provenance_events"
30	
31	// Ref is a directed edge to another entity in the trace graph
32	// (e.g. a consignment event referencing the pours it aggregates).
33	type Ref struct {
34		EntityType string `bson:"entity_type" json:"entity_type"`
35		EntityID   string `bson:"entity_id"   json:"entity_id"`
36		Relation   string `bson:"relation"    json:"relation"` // aggregates | supersedes | tested | yields | labels ...
37	}
38	
39	// ActorRef records who caused the event.
40	type ActorRef struct {
41		PartyID  string `bson:"party_id"  json:"party_id"`
42		RoleCode string `bson:"role_code" json:"role_code"`
43	}
44	
45	// Event is one immutable link in the ledger. `_id` is a generated ObjectID;
46	// EntityID and Refs carry the referenced documents' ObjectIDs as hex strings
47	// (the ledger is a generic event log spanning every entity type, and hex
48	// strings keep the hash material canonical and human-inspectable).
49	type Event struct {
50		ID         primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
51		Seq        int64          `bson:"seq"         json:"seq"`
52		Type       string         `bson:"type"        json:"type"`
53		EntityType string         `bson:"entity_type" json:"entity_type"`
54		EntityID   string         `bson:"entity_id"   json:"entity_id"`
55		Refs       []Ref          `bson:"refs,omitempty"    json:"refs,omitempty"`
56		Actor      ActorRef       `bson:"actor"       json:"actor"`
57		OrgUnitID  string         `bson:"org_unit_id,omitempty" json:"org_unit_id,omitempty"`
58		Payload    map[string]any `bson:"payload,omitempty"     json:"payload,omitempty"`
59		TS         time.Time      `bson:"ts"          json:"ts"`
60		PrevHash   string         `bson:"prev_hash"   json:"prev_hash"`
61		Hash       string         `bson:"hash"        json:"hash"`
62	}
63	
64	// AppendInput describes a new event to chain.
65	type AppendInput struct {
66		Type       string
67		EntityType string
68		EntityID   string
69		Refs       []Ref
70		Actor      ActorRef
71		OrgUnitID  string
72		Payload    map[string]any
73	}
74	
75	// Ledger appends to and reads the hash chain.
76	type Ledger struct {
77		coll *mongo.Collection
78	
79		// appendMu serialises the head-read+insert of Append within this process:
80		// every ledger write system-wide shares one global seq, so without local
81		// serialisation concurrent handlers (e.g. a morning pour rush plus a
82		// GenerateInvoices loop) burn duplicate-key retries against each other.
83		// The unique seq index remains the atomic backstop across processes.
84		appendMu sync.Mutex
85	}
86	
87	// NewLedger binds the ledger to the database.
88	func NewLedger(db *mongo.Database) *Ledger {
89		return &Ledger{coll: db.Collection(collection)}
90	}
91	
92	// genesisHash anchors the chain before the first event.
93	const genesisHash = "GENESIS"
94	
95	// Append chains a new event. Concurrency-safe without transactions: it reads
96	// the current head, computes seq+hash optimistically, and relies on the
97	// unique index on `seq` — a duplicate-key collision means another writer won
98	// the slot, so we re-read and retry.
99	func (l *Ledger) Append(ctx context.Context, in AppendInput) (*Event, error) {
100		// Serialise appends within this process (see appendMu): local writers no
101		// longer race each other for the seq slot, so under single-instance
102		// deployment the retry loop only ever fires against external writers.
103		l.appendMu.Lock()
104		defer l.appendMu.Unlock()
105	
106		const maxRetries = 12
107		for attempt := 0; attempt < maxRetries; attempt++ {
108			seq, prevHash, err := l.head(ctx)
109			if err != nil {
110				return nil, err
111			}
112			ev := &Event{
113				ID:         primitive.NewObjectID(),
114				Seq:        seq + 1,
115				Type:       in.Type,
116				EntityType: in.EntityType,
117				EntityID:   in.EntityID,
118				Refs:       in.Refs,
119				Actor:      in.Actor,
120				OrgUnitID:  in.OrgUnitID,
121				Payload:    in.Payload,
122				// Millisecond precision: BSON datetimes store ms, so the persisted
123				// TS must equal the hashed TS or re-verification would break.
124				TS:       time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Millisecond),
125				PrevHash: prevHash,
126			}
127			ev.Hash = computeHash(ev)
128	
129			if _, err := l.coll.InsertOne(ctx, ev); err != nil {
130				if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(err) {
131					continue // lost the seq race — retry against the new head
132				}
133				return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance append: %w", err)
134			}
135			return ev, nil
136		}
137		return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance append: gave up after %d seq collisions", 12)
138	}
139	
140	// head returns the latest (seq, hash), or (0, GENESIS) for an empty chain.
141	func (l *Ledger) head(ctx context.Context) (int64, string, error) {
142		var last Event
143		err := l.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{},
144			options.FindOne().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: -1}}),
145		).Decode(&last)
146		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
147			return 0, genesisHash, nil
148		}
149		if err != nil {
150			return 0, "", fmt.Errorf("provenance head: %w", err)
151		}
152		return last.Seq, last.Hash, nil
153	}
154	
155	// computeHash covers everything that matters: position, linkage, content.
156	// Payload is canonicalised via encoding/json (map keys are sorted) and the
157	// timestamp to millisecond precision (BSON datetime resolution), so the
158	// digest is deterministic across a MongoDB round trip.
159	func computeHash(ev *Event) string {
160		payloadJSON, _ := json.Marshal(ev.Payload)
161		refParts := make([]string, 0, len(ev.Refs))
162		for _, r := range ev.Refs {
163			refParts = append(refParts, r.EntityType+":"+r.EntityID+":"+r.Relation)
164		}
165		material := strings.Join([]string{
166			ev.PrevHash,
167			strconv.FormatInt(ev.Seq, 10),
168			ev.Type,
169			ev.EntityType,
170			ev.EntityID,
171			strings.Join(refParts, ","),
172			ev.Actor.PartyID,
173			ev.Actor.RoleCode,
174			ev.OrgUnitID,
175			string(payloadJSON),
176			ev.TS.UTC().Truncate(time.Millisecond).Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
177		}, "|")
178		sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(material))
179		return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
180	}
181	
182	// EventsForEntity returns an entity's own timeline in chain order.
183	func (l *Ledger) EventsForEntity(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string) ([]Event, error) {
184		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
185			bson.D{{Key: "entity_type", Value: entityType}, {Key: "entity_id", Value: entityID}},
186			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}),
187		)
188		if err != nil {
189			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance events for %s/%s: %w", entityType, entityID, err)
190		}
191		var out []Event
192		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
193			return nil, err
194		}
195		return out, nil
196	}
197	
198	// Trace walks the provenance graph UPSTREAM from an entity: its events, plus
199	// (recursively) the events of everything those events reference. This is how
200	// a consumer QR resolves back to the contributing samiti set, and how a failed
201	// aflatoxin test walks back to source DCSes (blueprint §8.3).
202	func (l *Ledger) Trace(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, maxDepth int) ([]Event, error) {
203		return l.TraceStopAt(ctx, entityType, entityID, maxDepth, nil)
204	}
205	
206	// TraceStopAt is Trace with a stop set: entity types in stopExpand are still
207	// fetched (their events appear in the result) but their refs are never
208	// followed. The consumer QR scan stops at the consignment/pooling boundary so
209	// hundreds of per-pour nodes (and cross-route trip fan-out) are never walked.
210	//
211	// Each BFS level is batched into a bounded number of $or queries instead of
212	// one Find per node, so a walk costs O(depth) round trips, not O(nodes).
213	func (l *Ledger) TraceStopAt(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, maxDepth int, stopExpand map[string]bool) ([]Event, error) {
214		if maxDepth <= 0 {
215			maxDepth = 10
216		}
217		const hardEventCap = 2000
218	
219		type node struct{ etype, eid string }
220		visited := map[node]bool{}
221		frontier := []node{{entityType, entityID}}
222		var all []Event
223	
224		for depth := 0; depth < maxDepth && len(frontier) > 0; depth++ {
225			// Deduplicate this level against everything already visited.
226			level := make([]node, 0, len(frontier))
227			for _, n := range frontier {
228				if visited[n] {
229					continue
230				}
231				visited[n] = true
232				level = append(level, n)
233			}
234			if len(level) == 0 {
235				break
236			}
237	
238			var next []node
239			// One indexed query per chunk of the level (not per node).
240			const orChunk = 200
241			for start := 0; start < len(level); start += orChunk {
242				end := min(start+orChunk, len(level))
243				clauses := make(bson.A, 0, end-start)
244				for _, n := range level[start:end] {
245					clauses = append(clauses, bson.D{
246						{Key: "entity_type", Value: n.etype},
247						{Key: "entity_id", Value: n.eid},
248					})
249				}
250				cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
251					bson.D{{Key: "$or", Value: clauses}},
252					options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}).SetLimit(hardEventCap),
253				)
254				if err != nil {
255					return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance trace level: %w", err)
256				}
257				var evs []Event
258				if err := cur.All(ctx, &evs); err != nil {
259					return nil, err
260				}
261				for _, ev := range evs {
262					all = append(all, ev)
263					if len(all) >= hardEventCap {
264						return all, nil
265					}
266					if stopExpand != nil && stopExpand[ev.EntityType] {
267						continue // include the node's events, never follow its refs
268					}
269					for _, ref := range ev.Refs {
270						nn := node{ref.EntityType, ref.EntityID}
271						if !visited[nn] {
272							next = append(next, nn)
273						}
274					}
275				}
276			}
277			frontier = next
278		}
279		return all, nil
280	}
281	
282	// DownstreamRefs finds events that reference the given entity — used to walk
283	// FORWARD (e.g. "which batches consumed this blocked BMC lot?"). The limit is
284	// pushed into the query: only the LAST limit referencing events are fetched
285	// (ascending chain order preserved). limit <= 0 falls back to 2000.
286	func (l *Ledger) DownstreamRefs(ctx context.Context, entityID string, limit int64) ([]Event, error) {
287		if limit <= 0 {
288			limit = 2000
289		}
290		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
291			bson.D{{Key: "refs.entity_id", Value: entityID}},
292			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: -1}}).SetLimit(limit),
293		)
294		if err != nil {
295			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance downstream of %s: %w", entityID, err)
296		}
297		var out []Event
298		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
299			return nil, err
300		}
301		// Restore ascending chain order.
302		for i, j := 0, len(out)-1; i < j; i, j = i+1, j-1 {
303			out[i], out[j] = out[j], out[i]
304		}
305		return out, nil
306	}
307	
308	// EventsForEntityPage returns one page of an entity's own timeline in chain
309	// order, with skip/limit pushed into the query.
310	func (l *Ledger) EventsForEntityPage(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, offset, limit int64) ([]Event, error) {
311		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
312			bson.D{{Key: "entity_type", Value: entityType}, {Key: "entity_id", Value: entityID}},
313			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}).SetSkip(offset).SetLimit(limit),
314		)
315		if err != nil {
316			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance events page for %s/%s: %w", entityType, entityID, err)
317		}
318		var out []Event
319		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
320			return nil, err
321		}
322		return out, nil
323	}
324	
325	// CountEventsForEntity returns the total number of events on an entity's
326	// timeline (pagination meta companion of EventsForEntityPage).
327	func (l *Ledger) CountEventsForEntity(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string) (int64, error) {
328		n, err := l.coll.CountDocuments(ctx,
329			bson.D{{Key: "entity_type", Value: entityType}, {Key: "entity_id", Value: entityID}})
330		if err != nil {
331			return 0, fmt.Errorf("provenance count for %s/%s: %w", entityType, entityID, err)
332		}
333		return n, nil
334	}
335	
336	// VerifyChain re-derives every hash in [fromSeq, toSeq] and checks linkage.
337	// Returns (true, 0) when intact, or (false, seq) of the first broken link.
338	func (l *Ledger) VerifyChain(ctx context.Context, fromSeq, toSeq int64) (bool, int64, error) {
339		filter := bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$gte", Value: fromSeq}, {Key: "$lte", Value: toSeq}}}}
340		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}))
341		if err != nil {
342			return false, 0, fmt.Errorf("provenance verify: %w", err)
343		}
344		defer cur.Close(ctx)
345	
346		prevHash := ""
347		prevSeq := int64(0)
348		first := true
349		for cur.Next(ctx) {
350			var ev Event
351			if err := cur.Decode(&ev); err != nil {
352				return false, 0, err
353			}
354			if computeHash(&ev) != ev.Hash {
355				return false, ev.Seq, nil // content tampered
356			}
357			if !first {
358				if ev.Seq != prevSeq+1 || ev.PrevHash != prevHash {
359					return false, ev.Seq, nil // linkage broken
360				}
361			}
362			prevHash, prevSeq, first = ev.Hash, ev.Seq, false
363		}
364		return true, 0, cur.Err()
365	}
366	
367	// LatestSeq returns the current chain head sequence (0 = empty).
368	func (l *Ledger) LatestSeq(ctx context.Context) (int64, error) {
369		seq, _, err := l.head(ctx)
370		return seq, err
371	}
372
```

```text
1	// Package cattle owns the livestock side of Saathi: the animal registry keyed
2	// on the 12-digit Pashu Aadhaar ear-tag ID, the animal health history with its
3	// mock Bharat Pashudhan sync, the 1962 Mobile Veterinary Unit dispatch flow,
4	// the vernacular education hub, and the dormant collar-telemetry path that is
5	// provisioned but capability-gated until a government collar scheme lands
6	// (blueprint §9, §10).
7	package cattle
8	
9	import (
10		"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
11	
12		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
13		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
14		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/middleware"
15	)
16	
17	// Register wires the cattle module under /cattle. The router mounts this
18	// subtree at /api/v1, so routes land at /api/v1/cattle/...
19	func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
20		repo := newRepository(d.DB)
21		svc := newService(d, repo)
22		h := newHandler(svc)
23	
24		r.Route("/cattle", func(r chi.Router) {
25			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
26	
27			r.Route("/animals", func(r chi.Router) {
28				// Registration: farmers self-serve; village-tier staff and the
29				// health tier register on a farmer's behalf.
30				r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(
31					domain.RoleFarmer, domain.RoleSamitiSacheev, domain.RoleLRP,
32					domain.RoleAITech, domain.RoleVeterinarian,
33				)).Post("/", h.registerAnimal)
34	
35				// Any authenticated party may list; the service pins farmers and
36				// plain session tokens to their own herd.
37				r.With(middleware.RequireSession).Get("/", h.listAnimals)
38	
39				// Reads: the owner farmer, or care-circle roles. Consent gating
40				// is a v2 TODO — see canViewAnimal in service.go.
41				r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
42					r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(
43						domain.RoleFarmer, domain.RoleVeterinarian,
44						domain.RoleAITech, domain.RoleMissionOfficial,
45					))
46					r.Get("/{animalID}", h.getAnimal)
47					r.Get("/{animalID}/health-events", h.listHealthEvents)
48				})
49	
50				r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleVeterinarian, domain.RoleAITech)).
51					Post("/{animalID}/health-events", h.logHealthEvent)
52	
53				// Mock Bharat Pashudhan push (§9) — real integration is a swap of
54				// the service internals, not an API change.
55				r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleVeterinarian, domain.RolePCDFAdmin)).
56					Post("/{animalID}/bp-sync", h.syncBharatPashudhan)
57			})
58	
59			// 1962 Mobile Veterinary Unit dispatch loop (§10).
60			r.Route("/mvu-cases", func(r chi.Router) {
61				r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleFarmer)).Post("/", h.createMVUCase)
62				r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(
63					domain.RoleVeterinarian, domain.RoleMVUDriver,
64					domain.RoleSamitiSacheev, domain.RoleMissionOfficial,
65				)).Get("/", h.listMVUCases)
66				r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleVeterinarian, domain.RoleMVUDriver)).
67					Post("/{caseID}/dispatch", h.dispatchMVUCase)
68				r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleVeterinarian)).
69					Post("/{caseID}/close", h.closeMVUCase)
70			})
71	
72			// Education hub (§10): published content is readable by everyone.
73			r.Route("/education", func(r chi.Router) {
74				r.With(middleware.RequireSession).Get("/", h.listEducation)
75				r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RolePCDFAdmin, domain.RoleMissionOfficial)).
76					Post("/", h.createEducation)
77			})
78	
79			// Dormant collar backdoor (§9): the endpoint ships now but stays
80			// behind flags.FlagCollarTelemetry — activation is a flag flip.
81			r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleServiceAccount)).
82				Post("/telemetry", h.ingestTelemetry)
83		})
84	}
```

```text
17	// tripFixture builds a two-stop trip; picked marks which consignment IDs are
18	// already picked up.
19	func tripFixture(status string, picked ...string) *domain.RouteTrip {
20		pickedSet := map[string]bool{}
21		for _, id := range picked {
22			pickedSet[id] = true
23		}
24		now := time.Now().UTC()
25		stops := []domain.RouteStop{
26			{DCSID: "dcs-1", ConsignmentID: "con-1"},
27			{DCSID: "dcs-2", ConsignmentID: "con-2"},
28		}
29		for i := range stops {
30			if pickedSet[stops[i].ConsignmentID] {
31				stops[i].PickedUpAt = &now
32			}
33		}
34		return &domain.RouteTrip{
35			ID:              "trip-1",
36			UnionID:         "union-1",
37			VanRiderPartyID: testRider,
38			Status:          status,
39			Stops:           stops,
40		}
41	}
42	
43	func assertAppError(t *testing.T, err *httpx.AppError, wantStatus int, wantCode string) {
44		t.Helper()
45		if wantStatus == 0 {
46			if err != nil {
47				t.Fatalf("expected no error, got %v", err)
48			}
49			return
50		}
51		if err == nil {
52			t.Fatalf("expected %d %s, got nil", wantStatus, wantCode)
53		}
54		if err.Status != wantStatus {
55			t.Fatalf("status = %d, want %d (err: %v)", err.Status, wantStatus, err)
56		}
57		if wantCode != "" && err.Code != wantCode {
58			t.Fatalf("code = %q, want %q (err: %v)", err.Code, wantCode, err)
59		}
60	}

74				wantStatus: http.StatusForbidden, wantCode: "FORBIDDEN",
```

```text
1	// Package provenance implements the append-only, hash-chained event ledger —
2	// the source of truth for milk traceability (blueprint §7). Every link in the
3	// pour→QR chain is an immutable Event whose SHA-256 hash covers the previous
4	// event's hash, so history cannot be quietly rewritten (tamper-evidence,
5	// FSSAI recall-grade audit).
6	//
7	// Corrections are NEW events referencing the superseded entity — nothing is
8	// ever updated or deleted in this collection.
9	package provenance
10	
11	import (
12		"context"
13		"crypto/sha256"
14		"encoding/hex"
15		"encoding/json"
16		"errors"
17		"fmt"
18		"strconv"
19		"strings"
20		"sync"
21		"time"
22	
23		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
24		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
25		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
26		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo/options"
27	)
28	
29	const collection = "provenance_events"
30	
31	// Ref is a directed edge to another entity in the trace graph
32	// (e.g. a consignment event referencing the pours it aggregates).
33	type Ref struct {
34		EntityType string `bson:"entity_type" json:"entity_type"`
35		EntityID   string `bson:"entity_id"   json:"entity_id"`
36		Relation   string `bson:"relation"    json:"relation"` // aggregates | supersedes | tested | yields | labels ...
37	}
38	
39	// ActorRef records who caused the event.
40	type ActorRef struct {
41		PartyID  string `bson:"party_id"  json:"party_id"`
42		RoleCode string `bson:"role_code" json:"role_code"`
43	}
44	
45	// Event is one immutable link in the ledger. `_id` is a generated ObjectID;
46	// EntityID and Refs carry the referenced documents' ObjectIDs as hex strings
47	// (the ledger is a generic event log spanning every entity type, and hex
48	// strings keep the hash material canonical and human-inspectable).
49	type Event struct {
50		ID         primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
51		Seq        int64          `bson:"seq"         json:"seq"`
52		Type       string         `bson:"type"        json:"type"`
53		EntityType string         `bson:"entity_type" json:"entity_type"`
54		EntityID   string         `bson:"entity_id"   json:"entity_id"`
55		Refs       []Ref          `bson:"refs,omitempty"    json:"refs,omitempty"`
56		Actor      ActorRef       `bson:"actor"       json:"actor"`
57		OrgUnitID  string         `bson:"org_unit_id,omitempty" json:"org_unit_id,omitempty"`
58		Payload    map[string]any `bson:"payload,omitempty"     json:"payload,omitempty"`
59		TS         time.Time      `bson:"ts"          json:"ts"`
60		PrevHash   string         `bson:"prev_hash"   json:"prev_hash"`
61		Hash       string         `bson:"hash"        json:"hash"`
62	}
63	
64	// AppendInput describes a new event to chain.
65	type AppendInput struct {
66		Type       string
67		EntityType string
68		EntityID   string
69		Refs       []Ref
70		Actor      ActorRef
71		OrgUnitID  string
72		Payload    map[string]any
73	}
74	
75	// Ledger appends to and reads the hash chain.
76	type Ledger struct {
77		coll *mongo.Collection
78	
79		// appendMu serialises the head-read+insert of Append within this process:
80		// every ledger write system-wide shares one global seq, so without local
81		// serialisation concurrent handlers (e.g. a morning pour rush plus a
82		// GenerateInvoices loop) burn duplicate-key retries against each other.
83		// The unique seq index remains the atomic backstop across processes.
84		appendMu sync.Mutex
85	}
86	
87	// NewLedger binds the ledger to the database.
88	func NewLedger(db *mongo.Database) *Ledger {
89		return &Ledger{coll: db.Collection(collection)}
90	}
91	
92	// genesisHash anchors the chain before the first event.
93	const genesisHash = "GENESIS"
94	
95	// Append chains a new event. Concurrency-safe without transactions: it reads
96	// the current head, computes seq+hash optimistically, and relies on the
97	// unique index on `seq` — a duplicate-key collision means another writer won
98	// the slot, so we re-read and retry.
99	func (l *Ledger) Append(ctx context.Context, in AppendInput) (*Event, error) {
100		// Serialise appends within this process (see appendMu): local writers no
101		// longer race each other for the seq slot, so under single-instance
102		// deployment the retry loop only ever fires against external writers.
103		l.appendMu.Lock()
104		defer l.appendMu.Unlock()
105	
106		const maxRetries = 12
107		for attempt := 0; attempt < maxRetries; attempt++ {
108			seq, prevHash, err := l.head(ctx)
109			if err != nil {
110				return nil, err
111			}
112			ev := &Event{
113				ID:         primitive.NewObjectID(),
114				Seq:        seq + 1,
115				Type:       in.Type,
116				EntityType: in.EntityType,
117				EntityID:   in.EntityID,
118				Refs:       in.Refs,
119				Actor:      in.Actor,
120				OrgUnitID:  in.OrgUnitID,
121				Payload:    in.Payload,
122				// Millisecond precision: BSON datetimes store ms, so the persisted
123				// TS must equal the hashed TS or re-verification would break.
124				TS:       time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Millisecond),
125				PrevHash: prevHash,
126			}
127			ev.Hash = computeHash(ev)
128	
129			if _, err := l.coll.InsertOne(ctx, ev); err != nil {
130				if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(err) {
131					continue // lost the seq race — retry against the new head
132				}
133				return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance append: %w", err)
134			}
135			return ev, nil
136		}
137		return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance append: gave up after %d seq collisions", 12)
138	}
139	
140	// head returns the latest (seq, hash), or (0, GENESIS) for an empty chain.
141	func (l *Ledger) head(ctx context.Context) (int64, string, error) {
142		var last Event
143		err := l.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{},
144			options.FindOne().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: -1}}),
145		).Decode(&last)
146		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
147			return 0, genesisHash, nil
148		}
149		if err != nil {
150			return 0, "", fmt.Errorf("provenance head: %w", err)
151		}
152		return last.Seq, last.Hash, nil
153	}
154	
155	// computeHash covers everything that matters: position, linkage, content.
156	// Payload is canonicalised via encoding/json (map keys are sorted) and the
157	// timestamp to millisecond precision (BSON datetime resolution), so the
158	// digest is deterministic across a MongoDB round trip.
159	func computeHash(ev *Event) string {
160		payloadJSON, _ := json.Marshal(ev.Payload)
161		refParts := make([]string, 0, len(ev.Refs))
162		for _, r := range ev.Refs {
163			refParts = append(refParts, r.EntityType+":"+r.EntityID+":"+r.Relation)
164		}
165		material := strings.Join([]string{
166			ev.PrevHash,
167			strconv.FormatInt(ev.Seq, 10),
168			ev.Type,
169			ev.EntityType,
170			ev.EntityID,
171			strings.Join(refParts, ","),
172			ev.Actor.PartyID,
173			ev.Actor.RoleCode,
174			ev.OrgUnitID,
175			string(payloadJSON),
176			ev.TS.UTC().Truncate(time.Millisecond).Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
177		}, "|")
178		sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(material))
179		return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
180	}
181	
182	// EventsForEntity returns an entity's own timeline in chain order.
183	func (l *Ledger) EventsForEntity(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string) ([]Event, error) {
184		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
185			bson.D{{Key: "entity_type", Value: entityType}, {Key: "entity_id", Value: entityID}},
186			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}),
187		)
188		if err != nil {
189			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance events for %s/%s: %w", entityType, entityID, err)
190		}
191		var out []Event
192		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
193			return nil, err
194		}
195		return out, nil
196	}
197	
198	// Trace walks the provenance graph UPSTREAM from an entity: its events, plus
199	// (recursively) the events of everything those events reference. This is how
200	// a consumer QR resolves back to the contributing samiti set, and how a failed
201	// aflatoxin test walks back to source DCSes (blueprint §8.3).
202	func (l *Ledger) Trace(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, maxDepth int) ([]Event, error) {
203		return l.TraceStopAt(ctx, entityType, entityID, maxDepth, nil)
204	}
205	
206	// TraceStopAt is Trace with a stop set: entity types in stopExpand are still
207	// fetched (their events appear in the result) but their refs are never
208	// followed. The consumer QR scan stops at the consignment/pooling boundary so
209	// hundreds of per-pour nodes (and cross-route trip fan-out) are never walked.
210	//
211	// Each BFS level is batched into a bounded number of $or queries instead of
212	// one Find per node, so a walk costs O(depth) round trips, not O(nodes).
213	func (l *Ledger) TraceStopAt(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, maxDepth int, stopExpand map[string]bool) ([]Event, error) {
214		if maxDepth <= 0 {
215			maxDepth = 10
216		}
217		const hardEventCap = 2000
218	
219		type node struct{ etype, eid string }
220		visited := map[node]bool{}
221		frontier := []node{{entityType, entityID}}
222		var all []Event
223	
224		for depth := 0; depth < maxDepth && len(frontier) > 0; depth++ {
225			// Deduplicate this level against everything already visited.
226			level := make([]node, 0, len(frontier))
227			for _, n := range frontier {
228				if visited[n] {
229					continue
230				}
231				visited[n] = true
232				level = append(level, n)
233			}
234			if len(level) == 0 {
235				break
236			}
237	
238			var next []node
239			// One indexed query per chunk of the level (not per node).
240			const orChunk = 200
241			for start := 0; start < len(level); start += orChunk {
242				end := min(start+orChunk, len(level))
243				clauses := make(bson.A, 0, end-start)
244				for _, n := range level[start:end] {
245					clauses = append(clauses, bson.D{
246						{Key: "entity_type", Value: n.etype},
247						{Key: "entity_id", Value: n.eid},
248					})
249				}
250				cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
251					bson.D{{Key: "$or", Value: clauses}},
252					options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}).SetLimit(hardEventCap),
253				)
254				if err != nil {
255					return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance trace level: %w", err)
256				}
257				var evs []Event
258				if err := cur.All(ctx, &evs); err != nil {
259					return nil, err
260				}
261				for _, ev := range evs {
262					all = append(all, ev)
263					if len(all) >= hardEventCap {
264						return all, nil
265					}
266					if stopExpand != nil && stopExpand[ev.EntityType] {
267						continue // include the node's events, never follow its refs
268					}
269					for _, ref := range ev.Refs {
270						nn := node{ref.EntityType, ref.EntityID}
271						if !visited[nn] {
272							next = append(next, nn)
273						}
274					}
275				}
276			}
277			frontier = next
278		}
279		return all, nil
280	}
281	
282	// DownstreamRefs finds events that reference the given entity — used to walk
283	// FORWARD (e.g. "which batches consumed this blocked BMC lot?"). The limit is
284	// pushed into the query: only the LAST limit referencing events are fetched
285	// (ascending chain order preserved). limit <= 0 falls back to 2000.
286	func (l *Ledger) DownstreamRefs(ctx context.Context, entityID string, limit int64) ([]Event, error) {
287		if limit <= 0 {
288			limit = 2000
289		}
290		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
291			bson.D{{Key: "refs.entity_id", Value: entityID}},
292			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: -1}}).SetLimit(limit),
293		)
294		if err != nil {
295			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance downstream of %s: %w", entityID, err)
296		}
297		var out []Event
298		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
299			return nil, err
300		}
301		// Restore ascending chain order.
302		for i, j := 0, len(out)-1; i < j; i, j = i+1, j-1 {
303			out[i], out[j] = out[j], out[i]
304		}
305		return out, nil
306	}
307	
308	// EventsForEntityPage returns one page of an entity's own timeline in chain
309	// order, with skip/limit pushed into the query.
310	func (l *Ledger) EventsForEntityPage(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, offset, limit int64) ([]Event, error) {
311		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
312			bson.D{{Key: "entity_type", Value: entityType}, {Key: "entity_id", Value: entityID}},
313			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}).SetSkip(offset).SetLimit(limit),
314		)
315		if err != nil {
316			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance events page for %s/%s: %w", entityType, entityID, err)
317		}
318		var out []Event
319		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
320			return nil, err
321		}
322		return out, nil
323	}

325	// CountEventsForEntity returns the total number of events on an entity's
326	// timeline (pagination meta companion of EventsForEntityPage).
327	func (l *Ledger) CountEventsForEntity(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string) (int64, error) {
328		n, err := l.coll.CountDocuments(ctx,
329			bson.D{{Key: "entity_type", Value: entityType}, {Key: "entity_id", Value: entityID}})
330		if err != nil {
331			return 0, fmt.Errorf("provenance count for %s/%s: %w", entityType, entityID, err)
332		}
333		return n, nil
334	}
335	
336	// VerifyChain re-derives every hash in [fromSeq, toSeq] and checks linkage.
337	// Returns (true, 0) when intact, or (false, seq) of the first broken link.
338	func (l *Ledger) VerifyChain(ctx context.Context, fromSeq, toSeq int64) (bool, int64, error) {
339		filter := bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$gte", Value: fromSeq}, {Key: "$lte", Value: toSeq}}}}
340		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}))
341		if err != nil {
342			return false, 0, fmt.Errorf("provenance verify: %w", err)
343		}
344		defer cur.Close(ctx)
345	
346		prevHash := ""
347		prevSeq := int64(0)
348		first := true
349		for cur.Next(ctx) {
350			var ev Event
351			if err := cur.Decode(&ev); err != nil {
352				return false, 0, err
353			}
354			if computeHash(&ev) != ev.Hash {
355				return false, ev.Seq, nil // content tampered
356			}
357			if !first {
358				if ev.Seq != prevSeq+1 || ev.PrevHash != prevHash {
359					return false, ev.Seq, nil // linkage broken
360				}
361			}
362			prevHash, prevSeq, first = ev.Hash, ev.Seq, false
363		}
364		return true, 0, cur.Err()
365	}
366	
367	// LatestSeq returns the current chain head sequence (0 = empty).
368	func (l *Ledger) LatestSeq(ctx context.Context) (int64, error) {
369		seq, _, err := l.head(ctx)
370		return seq, err
371	}
```

```text
1	// Package provenance implements the append-only, hash-chained event ledger —
2	// the source of truth for milk traceability (blueprint §7). Every link in the
3	// pour→QR chain is an immutable Event whose SHA-256 hash covers the previous
4	// event's hash, so history cannot be quietly rewritten (tamper-evidence,
5	// FSSAI recall-grade audit).
6	//
7	// Corrections are NEW events referencing the superseded entity — nothing is
8	// ever updated or deleted in this collection.
9	package provenance
10	
11	import (
12		"context"
13		"crypto/sha256"
14		"encoding/hex"
15		"encoding/json"
16		"errors"
17		"fmt"
18		"strconv"
19		"strings"
20		"sync"
21		"time"
22	
23		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
24		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
25		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
26		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo/options"
27	)
28	
29	const collection = "provenance_events"
30	
31	// Ref is a directed edge to another entity in the trace graph
32	// (e.g. a consignment event referencing the pours it aggregates).
33	type Ref struct {
34		EntityType string `bson:"entity_type" json:"entity_type"`
35		EntityID   string `bson:"entity_id"   json:"entity_id"`
36		Relation   string `bson:"relation"    json:"relation"` // aggregates | supersedes | tested | yields | labels ...
37	}
38	
39	// ActorRef records who caused the event.
40	type ActorRef struct {
41		PartyID  string `bson:"party_id"  json:"party_id"`
42		RoleCode string `bson:"role_code" json:"role_code"`
43	}
44	
45	// Event is one immutable link in the ledger. `_id` is a generated ObjectID;
46	// EntityID and Refs carry the referenced documents' ObjectIDs as hex strings
47	// (the ledger is a generic event log spanning every entity type, and hex
48	// strings keep the hash material canonical and human-inspectable).
49	type Event struct {
50		ID         primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
51		Seq        int64          `bson:"seq"         json:"seq"`
52		Type       string         `bson:"type"        json:"type"`
53		EntityType string         `bson:"entity_type" json:"entity_type"`
54		EntityID   string         `bson:"entity_id"   json:"entity_id"`
55		Refs       []Ref          `bson:"refs,omitempty"    json:"refs,omitempty"`
56		Actor      ActorRef       `bson:"actor"       json:"actor"`
57		OrgUnitID  string         `bson:"org_unit_id,omitempty" json:"org_unit_id,omitempty"`
58		Payload    map[string]any `bson:"payload,omitempty"     json:"payload,omitempty"`
59		TS         time.Time      `bson:"ts"          json:"ts"`
60		PrevHash   string         `bson:"prev_hash"   json:"prev_hash"`
61		Hash       string         `bson:"hash"        json:"hash"`
62	}
63	
64	// AppendInput describes a new event to chain.
65	type AppendInput struct {
66		Type       string
67		EntityType string
68		EntityID   string
69		Refs       []Ref
70		Actor      ActorRef
71		OrgUnitID  string
72		Payload    map[string]any
73	}
74	
75	// Ledger appends to and reads the hash chain.
76	type Ledger struct {
77		coll *mongo.Collection
78	
79		// appendMu serialises the head-read+insert of Append within this process:
80		// every ledger write system-wide shares one global seq, so without local
81		// serialisation concurrent handlers (e.g. a morning pour rush plus a
82		// GenerateInvoices loop) burn duplicate-key retries against each other.
83		// The unique seq index remains the atomic backstop across processes.
84		appendMu sync.Mutex
85	}
86	
87	// NewLedger binds the ledger to the database.
88	func NewLedger(db *mongo.Database) *Ledger {
89		return &Ledger{coll: db.Collection(collection)}
90	}
91	
92	// genesisHash anchors the chain before the first event.
93	const genesisHash = "GENESIS"
94	
95	// Append chains a new event. Concurrency-safe without transactions: it reads
96	// the current head, computes seq+hash optimistically, and relies on the
97	// unique index on `seq` — a duplicate-key collision means another writer won
98	// the slot, so we re-read and retry.
99	func (l *Ledger) Append(ctx context.Context, in AppendInput) (*Event, error) {
100		// Serialise appends within this process (see appendMu): local writers no
101		// longer race each other for the seq slot, so under single-instance
102		// deployment the retry loop only ever fires against external writers.
103		l.appendMu.Lock()
104		defer l.appendMu.Unlock()
105	
106		const maxRetries = 12
107		for attempt := 0; attempt < maxRetries; attempt++ {
108			seq, prevHash, err := l.head(ctx)
109			if err != nil {
110				return nil, err
111			}
112			ev := &Event{
113				ID:         primitive.NewObjectID(),
114				Seq:        seq + 1,
115				Type:       in.Type,
116				EntityType: in.EntityType,
117				EntityID:   in.EntityID,
118				Refs:       in.Refs,
119				Actor:      in.Actor,
120				OrgUnitID:  in.OrgUnitID,
121				Payload:    in.Payload,
122				// Millisecond precision: BSON datetimes store ms, so the persisted
123				// TS must equal the hashed TS or re-verification would break.
124				TS:       time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Millisecond),
125				PrevHash: prevHash,
126			}
127			ev.Hash = computeHash(ev)
128	
129			if _, err := l.coll.InsertOne(ctx, ev); err != nil {
130				if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(err) {
131					continue // lost the seq race — retry against the new head
132				}
133				return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance append: %w", err)
134			}
135			return ev, nil
136		}
137		return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance append: gave up after %d seq collisions", 12)
138	}
139	
140	// head returns the latest (seq, hash), or (0, GENESIS) for an empty chain.
141	func (l *Ledger) head(ctx context.Context) (int64, string, error) {
142		var last Event
143		err := l.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{},
144			options.FindOne().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: -1}}),
145		).Decode(&last)
146		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
147			return 0, genesisHash, nil
148		}
149		if err != nil {
150			return 0, "", fmt.Errorf("provenance head: %w", err)
151		}
152		return last.Seq, last.Hash, nil
153	}
154	
155	// computeHash covers everything that matters: position, linkage, content.
156	// Payload is canonicalised via encoding/json (map keys are sorted) and the
157	// timestamp to millisecond precision (BSON datetime resolution), so the
158	// digest is deterministic across a MongoDB round trip.
159	func computeHash(ev *Event) string {
160		payloadJSON, _ := json.Marshal(ev.Payload)
161		refParts := make([]string, 0, len(ev.Refs))
162		for _, r := range ev.Refs {
163			refParts = append(refParts, r.EntityType+":"+r.EntityID+":"+r.Relation)
164		}
165		material := strings.Join([]string{
166			ev.PrevHash,
167			strconv.FormatInt(ev.Seq, 10),
168			ev.Type,
169			ev.EntityType,
170			ev.EntityID,
171			strings.Join(refParts, ","),
172			ev.Actor.PartyID,
173			ev.Actor.RoleCode,
174			ev.OrgUnitID,
175			string(payloadJSON),
176			ev.TS.UTC().Truncate(time.Millisecond).Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
177		}, "|")
178		sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(material))
179		return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
180	}
181	
182	// EventsForEntity returns an entity's own timeline in chain order.
183	func (l *Ledger) EventsForEntity(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string) ([]Event, error) {
184		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
185			bson.D{{Key: "entity_type", Value: entityType}, {Key: "entity_id", Value: entityID}},
186			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}),
187		)
188		if err != nil {
189			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance events for %s/%s: %w", entityType, entityID, err)
190		}
191		var out []Event
192		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
193			return nil, err
194		}
195		return out, nil
196	}
197	
198	// Trace walks the provenance graph UPSTREAM from an entity: its events, plus
199	// (recursively) the events of everything those events reference. This is how
200	// a consumer QR resolves back to the contributing samiti set, and how a failed
201	// aflatoxin test walks back to source DCSes (blueprint §8.3).
202	func (l *Ledger) Trace(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, maxDepth int) ([]Event, error) {
203		return l.TraceStopAt(ctx, entityType, entityID, maxDepth, nil)
204	}
205	
206	// TraceStopAt is Trace with a stop set: entity types in stopExpand are still
207	// fetched (their events appear in the result) but their refs are never
208	// followed. The consumer QR scan stops at the consignment/pooling boundary so
209	// hundreds of per-pour nodes (and cross-route trip fan-out) are never walked.
210	//
211	// Each BFS level is batched into a bounded number of $or queries instead of
212	// one Find per node, so a walk costs O(depth) round trips, not O(nodes).
213	func (l *Ledger) TraceStopAt(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, maxDepth int, stopExpand map[string]bool) ([]Event, error) {
214		if maxDepth <= 0 {
215			maxDepth = 10
216		}
217		const hardEventCap = 2000
218	
219		type node struct{ etype, eid string }
220		visited := map[node]bool{}
221		frontier := []node{{entityType, entityID}}
222		var all []Event
223	
224		for depth := 0; depth < maxDepth && len(frontier) > 0; depth++ {
225			// Deduplicate this level against everything already visited.
226			level := make([]node, 0, len(frontier))
227			for _, n := range frontier {
228				if visited[n] {
229					continue
230				}
231				visited[n] = true
232				level = append(level, n)
233			}
234			if len(level) == 0 {
235				break
236			}
237	
238			var next []node
239			// One indexed query per chunk of the level (not per node).
240			const orChunk = 200
241			for start := 0; start < len(level); start += orChunk {
242				end := min(start+orChunk, len(level))
243				clauses := make(bson.A, 0, end-start)
244				for _, n := range level[start:end] {
245					clauses = append(clauses, bson.D{
246						{Key: "entity_type", Value: n.etype},
247						{Key: "entity_id", Value: n.eid},
248					})
249				}
250				cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
251					bson.D{{Key: "$or", Value: clauses}},
252					options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}).SetLimit(hardEventCap),
253				)
254				if err != nil {
255					return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance trace level: %w", err)
256				}
257				var evs []Event
258				if err := cur.All(ctx, &evs); err != nil {
259					return nil, err
260				}
261				for _, ev := range evs {
262					all = append(all, ev)
263					if len(all) >= hardEventCap {
264						return all, nil
265					}
266					if stopExpand != nil && stopExpand[ev.EntityType] {
267						continue // include the node's events, never follow its refs
268					}
269					for _, ref := range ev.Refs {
270						nn := node{ref.EntityType, ref.EntityID}
271						if !visited[nn] {
272							next = append(next, nn)
273						}
274					}
275				}
276			}
277			frontier = next
278		}
279		return all, nil
280	}
281	
282	// DownstreamRefs finds events that reference the given entity — used to walk
283	// FORWARD (e.g. "which batches consumed this blocked BMC lot?"). The limit is
284	// pushed into the query: only the LAST limit referencing events are fetched
285	// (ascending chain order preserved). limit <= 0 falls back to 2000.
286	func (l *Ledger) DownstreamRefs(ctx context.Context, entityID string, limit int64) ([]Event, error) {
287		if limit <= 0 {
288			limit = 2000
289		}
290		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
291			bson.D{{Key: "refs.entity_id", Value: entityID}},
292			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: -1}}).SetLimit(limit),
293		)
294		if err != nil {
295			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance downstream of %s: %w", entityID, err)
296		}
297		var out []Event
298		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
299			return nil, err
300		}
301		// Restore ascending chain order.
302		for i, j := 0, len(out)-1; i < j; i, j = i+1, j-1 {
303			out[i], out[j] = out[j], out[i]
304		}
305		return out, nil
306	}
307	
308	// EventsForEntityPage returns one page of an entity's own timeline in chain
309	// order, with skip/limit pushed into the query.
310	func (l *Ledger) EventsForEntityPage(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, offset, limit int64) ([]Event, error) {
311		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
312			bson.D{{Key: "entity_type", Value: entityType}, {Key: "entity_id", Value: entityID}},
313			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}).SetSkip(offset).SetLimit(limit),
314		)
315		if err != nil {
316			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance events page for %s/%s: %w", entityType, entityID, err)
317		}
318		var out []Event
319		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
320			return nil, err
321		}
322		return out, nil
323	}
324	
325	// CountEventsForEntity returns the total number of events on an entity's
326	// timeline (pagination meta companion of EventsForEntityPage).
327	func (l *Ledger) CountEventsForEntity(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string) (int64, error) {
328		n, err := l.coll.CountDocuments(ctx,
329			bson.D{{Key: "entity_type", Value: entityType}, {Key: "entity_id", Value: entityID}})
330		if err != nil {
331			return 0, fmt.Errorf("provenance count for %s/%s: %w", entityType, entityID, err)
332		}
333		return n, nil
334	}
335	
336	// VerifyChain re-derives every hash in [fromSeq, toSeq] and checks linkage.
337	// Returns (true, 0) when intact, or (false, seq) of the first broken link.
338	func (l *Ledger) VerifyChain(ctx context.Context, fromSeq, toSeq int64) (bool, int64, error) {
339		filter := bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$gte", Value: fromSeq}, {Key: "$lte", Value: toSeq}}}}
340		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}))
341		if err != nil {
342			return false, 0, fmt.Errorf("provenance verify: %w", err)
343		}
344		defer cur.Close(ctx)
345	
346		prevHash := ""
347		prevSeq := int64(0)
348		first := true
349		for cur.Next(ctx) {
350			var ev Event
351			if err := cur.Decode(&ev); err != nil {
352				return false, 0, err
353			}
354			if computeHash(&ev) != ev.Hash {
355				return false, ev.Seq, nil // content tampered
356			}
357			if !first {
358				if ev.Seq != prevSeq+1 || ev.PrevHash != prevHash {
359					return false, ev.Seq, nil // linkage broken
360				}
361			}
362			prevHash, prevSeq, first = ev.Hash, ev.Seq, false
363		}
364		return true, 0, cur.Err()
365	}
366	
367	// LatestSeq returns the current chain head sequence (0 = empty).
368	func (l *Ledger) LatestSeq(ctx context.Context) (int64, error) {
369		seq, _, err := l.head(ctx)
370		return seq, err
371	}
```

```text
1	package auth

3	import (
4		"context"

7	
8	// Actor is the authenticated caller extracted from a verified token and
9	// stored on the request context by the auth middleware.
10	type Actor struct {
11		PartyID          string
12		Phone            string
13		KYCTier          string
14		Kind             string // session | role
15		RoleAssignmentID string
16		RoleCode         string
17		OrgUnitID        string
18		OrgType          string
19	}
20	
21	// HasRole reports whether the actor operates under one of the given roles.
22	func (a Actor) HasRole(roles ...string) bool {
23		for _, r := range roles {
24			if a.RoleCode == r {
25				return true
26			}
27		}
28		return false
29	}
30	
31	type actorCtxKey struct{}
32	
33	// actorHolder is a mutable cell installed by OUTER middleware (audit) so
34	// identity established by INNER middleware (Authenticate) can flow back out.
35	// Context values only propagate inward; the shared pointer bridges the gap.
36	type actorHolder struct {
37		mu sync.Mutex
38		a  *Actor
39	}
40	
41	type actorHolderCtxKey struct{}
42	
43	// WithActorHolder installs an empty actor holder on the context. Middleware
44	// mounted before authentication uses it to observe the actor after the
45	// handler chain ran.
46	func WithActorHolder(ctx context.Context) context.Context {
47		return context.WithValue(ctx, actorHolderCtxKey{}, &actorHolder{})
48	}
49	
50	// HeldActor returns the actor captured by an inner WithActor call, if a
51	// holder was installed and authentication happened.
52	func HeldActor(ctx context.Context) (Actor, bool) {
53		h, ok := ctx.Value(actorHolderCtxKey{}).(*actorHolder)
54		if !ok {
55			return Actor{}, false
56		}
57		h.mu.Lock()
58		defer h.mu.Unlock()
59		if h.a == nil {
60			return Actor{}, false
61		}
62		return *h.a, true
63	}
64	
65	// WithActor stores the actor on the context, and also fills the outward
66	// actor holder when one was installed upstream (see WithActorHolder).
67	func WithActor(ctx context.Context, a Actor) context.Context {
68		if h, ok := ctx.Value(actorHolderCtxKey{}).(*actorHolder); ok {
69			h.mu.Lock()
70			cp := a
71			h.a = &cp
72			h.mu.Unlock()
73		}
74		return context.WithValue(ctx, actorCtxKey{}, a)
75	}
76	
77	// ActorFrom retrieves the actor, if any.
78	func ActorFrom(ctx context.Context) (Actor, bool) {
79		a, ok := ctx.Value(actorCtxKey{}).(Actor)
80		return a, ok
81	}
```
