```go
package cattle

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"time"

	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo/options"

	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/mongodb"
)

// repository is the module's only MongoDB touchpoint. It maps driver errors
// to httpx errors (mongo.ErrNoDocuments → NotFound, duplicate key → Conflict)
// so the service layer stays driver-free. Unexpected driver errors are wrapped
// with the failing operation so ERROR logs upstream name the op.
type repository struct {
	animals   *mongo.Collection
	health    *mongo.Collection
	mvuCases  *mongo.Collection
	education *mongo.Collection
}

// newRepository binds the repository to the module's collections.
func newRepository(db *mongo.Database) *repository {
	return &repository{
		animals:   db.Collection(mongodb.CollAnimals),
		health:    db.Collection(mongodb.CollHealthEvents),
		mvuCases:  db.Collection(mongodb.CollMVUCases),
		education: db.Collection(mongodb.CollEducation),
	}
}

// InsertAnimal persists a new animal. The unique index on pashu_aadhaar
// (mongodb.EnsureIndexes) turns a duplicate registration into ANIMAL_EXISTS.
func (r *repository) InsertAnimal(ctx context.Context, a *domain.Animal) error {
	if _, err := r.animals.InsertOne(ctx, a); err != nil {
		if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(err) {
			return httpx.Conflict("ANIMAL_EXISTS", "an animal with this pashu_aadhaar is already registered")
		}
		return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("insert animal: %w", err))
	}
	return nil
}

// FindAnimalByID loads one animal or returns NotFound.
func (r *repository) FindAnimalByID(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.Animal, error) {
	var a domain.Animal
	err := r.animals.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&a)
	if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
		return nil, httpx.NotFound("animal")
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("find animal %s: %w", id.Hex(), err))
	}
	return &a, nil
}

// ListAnimals returns a page of animals filtered by owner and/or DCS (zero
// ObjectID = no filter), newest first, plus the total match count.
func (r *repository) ListAnimals(ctx context.Context, ownerPartyID, dcsID primitive.ObjectID, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.Animal, int64, error) {
	filter := bson.D{}
	if !ownerPartyID.IsZero() {
		filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "owner_party_id", Value: ownerPartyID})
	}
	if !dcsID.IsZero() {
		filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "dcs_id", Value: dcsID})
	}
	total, err := r.animals.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("count animals: %w", err))
	}
	cur, err := r.animals.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
		SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "created_at", Value: -1}}).
		SetSkip(page.Offset).SetLimit(page.Limit))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("list animals: %w", err))
	}
	out := []domain.Animal{}
	if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
		return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("decode animals: %w", err))
	}
	return out, total, nil
}

// InsertHealthEvent appends one entry to an animal's health history.
func (r *repository) InsertHealthEvent(ctx context.Context, e *domain.HealthEvent) error {
	if _, err := r.health.InsertOne(ctx, e); err != nil {
		return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("insert health event: %w", err))
	}
	return nil
}

// ListHealthEventsByAnimal returns a page of an animal's health history,
// most recent occurrence first, plus the total count.
func (r *repository) ListHealthEventsByAnimal(ctx context.Context, animalID primitive.ObjectID, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.HealthEvent, int64, error) {
	filter := bson.D{{Key: "animal_id", Value: animalID}}
	total, err := r.health.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("count health events: %w", err))
	}
	cur, err := r.health.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
		SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "occurred_at", Value: -1}}).
		SetSkip(page.Offset).SetLimit(page.Limit))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("list health events: %w", err))
	}
	out := []domain.HealthEvent{}
	if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
		return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("decode health events: %w", err))
	}
	return out, total, nil
}

// MarkPendingHealthEventsSynced flips every PENDING event of one animal to
// SYNCED with the given Bharat Pashudhan reference, returning how many synced.
func (r *repository) MarkPendingHealthEventsSynced(ctx context.Context, animalID primitive.ObjectID, bpSyncRef string) (int64, error) {
	res, err := r.health.UpdateMany(ctx,
		bson.D{
			{Key: "animal_id", Value: animalID},
			{Key: "bp_sync_status", Value: domain.BPSyncPending},
		},
		bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
			{Key: "bp_sync_status", Value: domain.BPSyncSynced},
			{Key: "bp_sync_ref", Value: bpSyncRef},
		}}})
	if err != nil {
		return 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("mark health events synced: %w", err))
	}
	return res.ModifiedCount, nil
}

// InsertMVUCase persists a new MVU case.
func (r *repository) InsertMVUCase(ctx context.Context, c *domain.MVUCase) error {
	if _, err := r.mvuCases.InsertOne(ctx, c); err != nil {
		return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("insert mvu case: %w", err))
	}
	return nil
}

// FindMVUCaseByID loads one MVU case or returns NotFound.
func (r *repository) FindMVUCaseByID(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.MVUCase, error) {
	var c domain.MVUCase
	err := r.mvuCases.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&c)
	if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
		return nil, httpx.NotFound("MVU case")
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("find mvu case %s: %w", id.Hex(), err))
	}
	return &c, nil
}

// DispatchMVUCase moves a case REQUESTED → DISPATCHED, recording the vet
// and/or driver. The status guard in the filter is the optimistic lock (no
// transactions on a standalone server): a false return means the case was
// not in REQUESTED state — e.g. a concurrent dispatch won the race.
func (r *repository) DispatchMVUCase(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID, vetPartyID, driverPartyID *primitive.ObjectID) (bool, error) {
	set := bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: domain.MVUCaseDispatched}}
	if vetPartyID != nil {
		set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "vet_party_id", Value: *vetPartyID})
	}
	if driverPartyID != nil {
		set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "driver_party_id", Value: *driverPartyID})
	}
	res, err := r.mvuCases.UpdateOne(ctx,
		bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}, {Key: "status", Value: domain.MVUCaseRequested}},
		bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: set}})
	if err != nil {
		return false, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("dispatch mvu case %s: %w", id.Hex(), err))
	}
	return res.MatchedCount == 1, nil
}

// CloseMVUCase moves a DISPATCHED (or ARRIVED) case to CLOSED with the visit
// log. Same optimistic status-guard pattern as DispatchMVUCase.
func (r *repository) CloseMVUCase(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID, visitNotes string, healthEventIDs []primitive.ObjectID, closedAt time.Time) (bool, error) {
	set := bson.D{
		{Key: "status", Value: domain.MVUCaseClosed},
		{Key: "visit_notes", Value: visitNotes},
		{Key: "closed_at", Value: closedAt},
	}
	if len(healthEventIDs) > 0 {
		set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "health_event_ids", Value: healthEventIDs})
	}
	res, err := r.mvuCases.UpdateOne(ctx,
		bson.D{
			{Key: "_id", Value: id},
			{Key: "status", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: []string{
				domain.MVUCaseDispatched, domain.MVUCaseArrived,
			}}}},
		},
		bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: set}})
	if err != nil {
		return false, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("close mvu case %s: %w", id.Hex(), err))
	}
	return res.MatchedCount == 1, nil
}

// ListMVUCases returns a page of cases filtered by DCS (zero ObjectID = no
// filter) and/or status, most recently requested first, plus the total count.
func (r *repository) ListMVUCases(ctx context.Context, dcsID primitive.ObjectID, status string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.MVUCase, int64, error) {
	filter := bson.D{}
	if !dcsID.IsZero() {
		filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "dcs_id", Value: dcsID})
	}
	if status != "" {
		filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "status", Value: status})
	}
	total, err := r.mvuCases.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("count mvu cases: %w", err))
	}
	cur, err := r.mvuCases.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
		SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "requested_at", Value: -1}}).
		SetSkip(page.Offset).SetLimit(page.Limit))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("list mvu cases: %w", err))
	}
	out := []domain.MVUCase{}
	if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
		return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("decode mvu cases: %w", err))
	}
	return out, total, nil
}

// InsertEducation persists a new education-hub item.
func (r *repository) InsertEducation(ctx context.Context, e *domain.EducationContent) error {
	if _, err := r.education.InsertOne(ctx, e); err != nil {
		return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("insert education content: %w", err))
	}
	return nil
}

// ListPublishedEducation returns a page of published content filtered by
// topic and/or language, newest first, plus the total match count.
func (r *repository) ListPublishedEducation(ctx context.Context, topic, language string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.EducationContent, int64, error) {
	filter := bson.D{{Key: "published", Value: true}}
	if topic != "" {
		filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "topic", Value: topic})
	}
	if language != "" {
		filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "language", Value: language})
	}
	total, err := r.education.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("count education content: %w", err))
	}
	cur, err := r.education.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
		SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "created_at", Value: -1}}).
		SetSkip(page.Offset).SetLimit(page.Limit))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("list education content: %w", err))
	}
	out := []domain.EducationContent{}
	if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
		return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("decode education content: %w", err))
	}
	return out, total, nil
}
```

```go
package orgs

import (
	"net/http"

	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
)

// handler is the HTTP edge of the orgs module: decode, validate shape,
// delegate to the service, respond. No business logic, no Mongo.
type handler struct {
	svc *service
}

func newHandler(svc *service) *handler {
	return &handler{svc: svc}
}

// create handles POST /orgs.
func (h *handler) create(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	actor, ok := auth.ActorFrom(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Unauthorized("authentication required"))
		return
	}
	var req CreateOrgRequest
	if err := httpx.DecodeJSON(r, &req); err != nil {
		httpx.Error(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	org, err := h.svc.Create(r.Context(), actor, req)
	if err != nil {
		httpx.Error(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusCreated, org)
}

// update handles PATCH /orgs/{id}.
func (h *handler) update(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	actor, ok := auth.ActorFrom(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Unauthorized("authentication required"))
		return
	}
	id, err := httpx.PathID(r, "id")
	if err != nil {
		httpx.Error(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	var req UpdateOrgRequest
	if err := httpx.DecodeJSON(r, &req); err != nil {
		httpx.Error(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	org, err := h.svc.Update(r.Context(), actor, id, req)
	if err != nil {
		httpx.Error(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, org)
}

// get handles GET /orgs/{id}.
func (h *handler) get(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	id, err := httpx.PathID(r, "id")
	if err != nil {
		httpx.Error(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	org, err := h.svc.Get(r.Context(), id)
	if err != nil {
		httpx.Error(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, org)
}

// children handles GET /orgs/{id}/children.
func (h *handler) children(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	id, err := httpx.PathID(r, "id")
	if err != nil {
		httpx.Error(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	page := httpx.ParsePage(r)
	units, total, err := h.svc.Children(r.Context(), id, page)
	if err != nil {
		httpx.Error(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	httpx.JSONMeta(w, http.StatusOK, units, ListMeta{Limit: page.Limit, Offset: page.Offset, Total: total, Count: len(units)})
}

// tree handles GET /orgs/{id}/tree.
func (h *handler) tree(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	actor, ok := auth.ActorFrom(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Unauthorized("authentication required"))
		return
	}
	id, err := httpx.PathID(r, "id")
	if err != nil {
		httpx.Error(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	nodes, truncated, err := h.svc.Tree(r.Context(), actor, id)
	if err != nil {
		httpx.Error(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	httpx.JSONMeta(w, http.StatusOK, nodes, TreeMeta{Count: len(nodes), Truncated: truncated})
}

// list handles GET /orgs?type=&district=&code= (code is the unique business
// key, exact match — e.g. ?code=DCS-01842 resolves a seeded org's ObjectID).
func (h *handler) list(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	page := httpx.ParsePage(r)
	q := r.URL.Query()
	units, total, err := h.svc.List(r.Context(), q.Get("type"), q.Get("district"), q.Get("code"), page)
	if err != nil {
		httpx.Error(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	httpx.JSONMeta(w, http.StatusOK, units, ListMeta{Limit: page.Limit, Offset: page.Offset, Total: total, Count: len(units)})
}

// members handles GET /orgs/{id}/members.
func (h *handler) members(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	actor, ok := auth.ActorFrom(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Unauthorized("authentication required"))
		return
	}
	id, err := httpx.PathID(r, "id")
	if err != nil {
		httpx.Error(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	page := httpx.ParsePage(r)
	members, total, err := h.svc.Members(r.Context(), actor, id, page)
	if err != nil {
		httpx.Error(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	httpx.JSONMeta(w, http.StatusOK, members, ListMeta{Limit: page.Limit, Offset: page.Offset, Total: total, Count: len(members)})
}
```

```go
package identity

import (
	"regexp"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"

	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
)

// Request-shape validation patterns. Formats only — business rules live in
// the service layer.
var (
	phoneRegexp       = regexp.MustCompile(`^[6-9][0-9]{9}$`)      // 10-digit Indian mobile
	otpRegexp         = regexp.MustCompile(`^[0-9]{6}$`)           // 6-digit numeric OTP
	aadhaarRegexp     = regexp.MustCompile(`^[0-9]{12}$`)          // 12-digit Aadhaar number
	bankAccountRegexp = regexp.MustCompile(`^[0-9]{9,18}$`)        // NPCI-range account number
	ifscRegexp        = regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Z]{4}0[A-Z0-9]{6}$`) // RBI IFSC format
)

// requestableTiers are the KYC tiers a party may ask to be verified at via
// POST /kyc/aadhaar. HIGHEST/SERVICE are never self-requested.
var requestableTiers = map[string]bool{
	domain.KYCTierFarmer:   true,
	domain.KYCTierStandard: true,
	domain.KYCTierRider:    true,
	domain.KYCTierHigh:     true,
}

// otpRequestRequest asks for a login OTP on a phone number.
type otpRequestRequest struct {
	Phone string `json:"phone"`
}

func (r otpRequestRequest) validate() error {
	if !phoneRegexp.MatchString(r.Phone) {
		return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_PHONE", "phone must be a 10-digit Indian mobile number")
	}
	return nil
}

// otpRequestResponse acknowledges the queued OTP. DevOTP is populated ONLY
// when cfg.OTPDevMode is on (never in prod — config refuses to boot).
type otpRequestResponse struct {
	Phone     string    `json:"phone"`
	ExpiresAt time.Time `json:"expires_at"`
	DevOTP    string    `json:"dev_otp,omitempty"`
}

// otpVerifyRequest exchanges phone+OTP for tokens.
type otpVerifyRequest struct {
	Phone string `json:"phone"`
	OTP   string `json:"otp"`
}

func (r otpVerifyRequest) validate() error {
	if !phoneRegexp.MatchString(r.Phone) {
		return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_PHONE", "phone must be a 10-digit Indian mobile number")
	}
	if !otpRegexp.MatchString(r.OTP) {
		return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_OTP", "otp must be a 6-digit numeric code")
	}
	return nil
}

// authTokensResponse is returned by login and refresh: a SESSION-kind access
// token, an opaque rotating refresh token, and the party record.
type authTokensResponse struct {
	AccessToken  string        `json:"access_token"`
	RefreshToken string        `json:"refresh_token"`
	Party        *domain.Party `json:"party"`
}

// refreshRequest rotates a refresh token.
type refreshRequest struct {
	RefreshToken string `json:"refresh_token"`
}

func (r refreshRequest) validate() error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(r.RefreshToken) == "" {
		return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_REFRESH_TOKEN", "refresh_token is required")
	}
	return nil
}

// logoutRequest revokes a refresh token.
type logoutRequest struct {
	RefreshToken string `json:"refresh_token"`
}

func (r logoutRequest) validate() error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(r.RefreshToken) == "" {
		return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_REFRESH_TOKEN", "refresh_token is required")
	}
	return nil
}

// assignmentWithOrg is a role assignment enriched with the org unit's
// display fields so the role-switcher UI needs no second call.
type assignmentWithOrg struct {
	domain.RoleAssignment
	OrgName string `json:"org_name,omitempty"`
	OrgType string `json:"org_type,omitempty"`
	OrgCode string `json:"org_code,omitempty"`
}

// roleSelectRequest picks one active assignment to operate under. The ID
// arrives as an ObjectID hex string and unmarshals natively.
type roleSelectRequest struct {
	RoleAssignmentID primitive.ObjectID `json:"role_assignment_id"`
}

func (r roleSelectRequest) validate() error {
	if r.RoleAssignmentID.IsZero() {
		return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_ROLE_ASSIGNMENT_ID", "role_assignment_id is required")
	}
	return nil
}

// roleSelectResponse carries the fresh ROLE-kind access token.
type roleSelectResponse struct {
	AccessToken string             `json:"access_token"`
	RoleCode    string             `json:"role_code"`
	OrgUnitID   primitive.ObjectID `json:"org_unit_id"`
	OrgType     string             `json:"org_type"`
}

// kycSummary is the masked, client-safe digest of the latest KYC record.
type kycSummary struct {
	RequestedTier     string     `json:"requested_tier"`
	Status            string     `json:"status"`
	AadhaarLast4      string     `json:"aadhaar_last4,omitempty"`
	BankAccountMasked string     `json:"bank_account_masked,omitempty"`
	BankIFSC          string     `json:"bank_ifsc,omitempty"`
	BankVerified      bool       `json:"bank_verified"`
	VerifiedAt        *time.Time `json:"verified_at,omitempty"`
}

// meResponse is the "who am I" aggregate: party, usable assignments, latest
// KYC summary.
type meResponse struct {
	Party       *domain.Party       `json:"party"`
	Assignments []assignmentWithOrg `json:"assignments"`
	KYC         *kycSummary         `json:"kyc,omitempty"`
}

// patchMeRequest updates the caller's own profile fields.
type patchMeRequest struct {
	FullName          *string `json:"full_name,omitempty"`
	PreferredLanguage *string `json:"preferred_language,omitempty"`
}

func (r patchMeRequest) validate() error {
	if r.FullName == nil && r.PreferredLanguage == nil {
		return httpx.BadRequest("EMPTY_PATCH", "provide at least one of full_name, preferred_language")
	}
	if r.FullName != nil {
		name := strings.TrimSpace(*r.FullName)
		if name == "" || len(name) > 120 {
			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_FULL_NAME", "full_name must be 1-120 characters")
		}
	}
	if r.PreferredLanguage != nil {
		lang := strings.TrimSpace(*r.PreferredLanguage)
		if lang == "" || len(lang) > 16 {
			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_LANGUAGE", "preferred_language must be 1-16 characters (e.g. \"hi\", \"en\")")
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// aadhaarKYCRequest submits an Aadhaar KYC request at a requested tier. The
// full number is used transiently and NEVER stored (blueprint §18-A). The
// record enters the approval workflow as PENDING — there is no auto-verify.
type aadhaarKYCRequest struct {
	AadhaarNumber string `json:"aadhaar_number"`
	Consent       bool   `json:"consent"`
	RequestedTier string `json:"requested_tier"` // FARMER | STANDARD | RIDER | HIGH
}

func (r aadhaarKYCRequest) validate() error {
	if !aadhaarRegexp.MatchString(r.AadhaarNumber) {
		return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_AADHAAR", "aadhaar_number must be 12 digits")
	}
	if !r.Consent {
		return httpx.BadRequest("CONSENT_REQUIRED", "explicit consent is required for Aadhaar eKYC (DPDP)")
	}
	if !requestableTiers[r.RequestedTier] {
		return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_TIER", "requested_tier must be one of FARMER, STANDARD, RIDER, HIGH")
	}
	return nil
}

// aadhaarKYCResponse returns the (PENDING) record and a human-readable
// status message for the approval workflow.
type aadhaarKYCResponse struct {
	Record  *domain.KYCRecord `json:"record"`
	Status  string            `json:"status"`
	Message string            `json:"message"`
}

// bankKYCRequest runs the (mock) penny-drop bank verification. Only the
// masked account tail and IFSC are ever persisted.
type bankKYCRequest struct {
	AccountNumber string `json:"account_number"`
	IFSC          string `json:"ifsc"`
}

func (r bankKYCRequest) validate() error {
	if !bankAccountRegexp.MatchString(r.AccountNumber) {
		return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_ACCOUNT", "account_number must be 9-18 digits")
	}
	if !ifscRegexp.MatchString(r.IFSC) {
		return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_IFSC", "ifsc must match the RBI IFSC format (e.g. SBIN0001234)")
	}
	return nil
}

// kycRejectRequest carries the mandatory human-readable rejection reason.
type kycRejectRequest struct {
	Reason string `json:"reason"`
}

func (r kycRejectRequest) validate() error {
	reason := strings.TrimSpace(r.Reason)
	if reason == "" || len(reason) > 500 {
		return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_REASON", "reason must be 1-500 characters")
	}
	return nil
}

// pendingPartySummary is the reviewer-facing digest of the requesting party.
type pendingPartySummary struct {
	ID       primitive.ObjectID `json:"id"`
	Phone    string             `json:"phone"`
	FullName string             `json:"full_name,omitempty"`
	KYCTier  string             `json:"kyc_tier"`
}

// pendingKYCItem is one PENDING KYC record enriched with its party so the
// review console needs no second call.
type pendingKYCItem struct {
	domain.KYCRecord
	Party *pendingPartySummary `json:"party,omitempty"`
}

// kycReviewResponse returns the reviewed record plus the party's KYC tier
// after the review (upgraded on approval when the requested tier is higher).
type kycReviewResponse struct {
	Record  *domain.KYCRecord `json:"record"`
	KYCTier string            `json:"kyc_tier"`
}

// createAssignmentRequest grants a role to a party inside an org unit. The
// target party is addressed by party_id or phone (party_id wins when both
// are present).
type createAssignmentRequest struct {
	PartyID   *primitive.ObjectID `json:"party_id,omitempty"`
	Phone     string              `json:"phone,omitempty"`
	RoleCode  string              `json:"role_code"`
	OrgUnitID primitive.ObjectID  `json:"org_unit_id"`
	ValidFrom *time.Time          `json:"valid_from,omitempty"`
	ValidTo   *time.Time          `json:"valid_to,omitempty"`
}

func (r createAssignmentRequest) validate() error {
	if r.PartyID == nil && r.Phone == "" {
		return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_PARTY", "one of party_id or phone is required")
	}
	if r.PartyID == nil && !phoneRegexp.MatchString(r.Phone) {
		return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_PHONE", "phone must be a 10-digit Indian mobile number")
	}
	if !domain.IsValidRole(r.RoleCode) {
		return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_ROLE", "role_code is not in the role catalog")
	}
	if r.OrgUnitID.IsZero() {
		return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_ORG_UNIT", "org_unit_id is required")
	}
	if r.ValidFrom != nil && r.ValidTo != nil && !r.ValidTo.After(*r.ValidFrom) {
		return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_VALIDITY_WINDOW", "valid_to must be after valid_from")
	}
	return nil
}

// listMeta is the pagination meta block for list endpoints.
type listMeta struct {
	Limit  int64 `json:"limit"`
	Offset int64 `json:"offset"`
	Total  int64 `json:"total"`
}
```

```text
8	)

10	// ParseID converts an ObjectID hex string (from JSON bodies, query params or
11	// JWT claims) into a primitive.ObjectID, or returns a 400 with the offending
12	// field name.
13	func ParseID(hex, field string) (primitive.ObjectID, error) {
14		id, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(hex)
15		if err != nil {
16			return primitive.NilObjectID, BadRequest("INVALID_ID", field+" must be a valid object id")
17		}
18		return id, nil
19	}
20	
21	// PathID extracts a chi URL parameter and parses it as an ObjectID.
22	func PathID(r *http.Request, param string) (primitive.ObjectID, error) {
23		return ParseID(chi.URLParam(r, param), param)
24	}
```

```text
53	// UsableAt reports whether the assignment is active and inside its validity
```

```text
1	// Package flags implements capability gating (blueprint principle #6):
2	// future-scheme features ship dormant behind flags — e.g. collar telemetry —
3	// so a new government scheme is a flag flip, not a schema migration.
4	package flags
5	
6	import (
7		"context"
8		"sync"
9		"time"
10	
11		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
12		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
13		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
14		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo/options"
15	)
16	
17	const collection = "feature_flags"
18	
19	// Well-known flag keys.
20	const (
21		FlagCollarTelemetry  = "collar_telemetry_enabled" // dormant until a collar scheme lands (§9)
22		FlagPhotoOCR         = "photo_ocr_enabled"        // legacy-analyzer bridge (§8.2)
23		FlagONDC             = "ondc_enabled"             // optional commerce network (§11)
24		FlagConsumerCommerce = "consumer_commerce_enabled"
25	)
26	
27	// Flag is the stored document. `_id` is a generated ObjectID; Key is the
28	// unique business identifier all lookups use.
29	type Flag struct {
30		ID          primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
31		Key         string             `bson:"key"           json:"key"`
32		Enabled     bool               `bson:"enabled"       json:"enabled"`
33		Description string             `bson:"description,omitempty" json:"description,omitempty"`
34		UpdatedBy   string             `bson:"updated_by,omitempty"  json:"updated_by,omitempty"` // approver party ObjectID hex
35		UpdatedAt   time.Time          `bson:"updated_at"    json:"updated_at"`
36	}
37	
38	type cached struct {
39		enabled bool
40		at      time.Time
41	}
42	
43	// Service reads flags with a short in-memory cache (hot path: every gated
44	// request) and writes through on change.
45	type Service struct {
46		coll *mongo.Collection
47		ttl  time.Duration
48	
49		mu    sync.RWMutex
50		cache map[string]cached
51	}
52	
53	// NewService binds the flag service to the database.
54	func NewService(db *mongo.Database) *Service {
55		return &Service{
56			coll:  db.Collection(collection),
57			ttl:   30 * time.Second,
58			cache: make(map[string]cached),
59		}
60	}
61	
62	// Enabled returns the flag value (missing flag = false, fail-closed).
63	func (s *Service) Enabled(ctx context.Context, key string) bool {
64		s.mu.RLock()
65		c, ok := s.cache[key]
66		s.mu.RUnlock()
67		if ok && time.Since(c.at) < s.ttl {
68			return c.enabled
69		}
70	
71		var f Flag
72		err := s.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "key", Value: key}}).Decode(&f)
73		enabled := err == nil && f.Enabled
74	
75		s.mu.Lock()
76		s.cache[key] = cached{enabled: enabled, at: time.Now()}
77		s.mu.Unlock()
78		return enabled
79	}
80	
81	// Set upserts a flag by key and invalidates the cache entry immediately.
82	func (s *Service) Set(ctx context.Context, key string, enabled bool, updatedBy string) error {
83		_, err := s.coll.UpdateOne(ctx,
84			bson.D{{Key: "key", Value: key}},
85			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
86				{Key: "enabled", Value: enabled},
87				{Key: "updated_by", Value: updatedBy},
88				{Key: "updated_at", Value: time.Now().UTC()},
89			}}},
90			options.Update().SetUpsert(true),
91		)
92		if err != nil {
93			return err
94		}
95		s.mu.Lock()
96		s.cache[key] = cached{enabled: enabled, at: time.Now()}
97		s.mu.Unlock()
98		return nil
99	}
100	
101	// All lists every flag (admin console).
102	func (s *Service) All(ctx context.Context) ([]Flag, error) {
103		cur, err := s.coll.Find(ctx, bson.D{})
104		if err != nil {
105			return nil, err
106		}
107		var out []Flag
108		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
109			return nil, err
110		}
111		return out, nil
112	}
113	
114	// EnsureDefaults inserts missing flags without touching existing values.
115	func (s *Service) EnsureDefaults(ctx context.Context, defaults map[string]Flag) error {
116		for key, f := range defaults {
117			f.Key = key
118			if f.UpdatedAt.IsZero() {
119				f.UpdatedAt = time.Now().UTC()
120			}
121			_, err := s.coll.UpdateOne(ctx,
122				bson.D{{Key: "key", Value: key}},
123				bson.D{{Key: "$setOnInsert", Value: f}},
124				options.Update().SetUpsert(true),
125			)
126			if err != nil {
127				return err
128			}
129		}
130		return nil
131	}
```

```text
1	// Package platformops is the platform-operations module (blueprint §12): the
2	// SUPER_ADMIN feature-flag console, the STATE_AUDITOR read-only audit surface
3	// with its GIGW/DPDP immutable export, the notifications outbox with the mock
4	// SMS dispatch worker (real deployment: MSG91 / telecom DLT gateway, §13),
5	// and the SUPPORT_AGENT audited limited-PII lookup (§5.2 role 20).
6	//
7	// It also subscribes to cross-module bus topics — payout credited, safety
8	// gate blocked, MVU dispatched — and turns them into queued vernacular SMS.
9	package platformops
10	
11	import (
12		"context"
13		"log/slog"
14	
15		"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
16	
17		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
18		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
19		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/eventbus"
20		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/middleware"
21	)
22	
23	// Register wires the platformops module and mounts /admin, /audit,
24	// /notifications and /support (the router hands us the /api/v1 subtree).
25	func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
26		repo := newRepository(d.DB)
27		svc := newService(d, repo)
28		h := newHandler(svc)
29	
30		r.Route("/admin", func(r chi.Router) {
31			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
32	
33			// PCDF_ADMIN may LIST flags; flipping one is SUPER_ADMIN only —
34			// capability gating is a deliberate act (blueprint principle #6).
35			r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSuperAdmin, domain.RolePCDFAdmin)).
36				Get("/flags", h.listFlags)
37			r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSuperAdmin)).
38				Put("/flags/{key}", h.setFlag)
39		})
40	
41		r.Route("/audit", func(r chi.Router) {
42			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
43			r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleStateAuditor, domain.RoleSuperAdmin))
44	
45			// Read-only by design: there is deliberately NO write/delete API
46			// surface for audit logs (§12) — entries land via deps.Audit only.
47			r.Get("/logs", h.listAuditLogs)
48			r.Get("/logs/export", h.exportAuditLogs)
49		})
50	
51		r.Route("/notifications", func(r chi.Router) {
52			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
53	
54			// SUPER_ADMIN only: a help-desk role has no need to read outbox
55			// message bodies, and the outbox carries credential-adjacent traffic
56			// (OTP notifications — additionally redacted in the service).
57			r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSuperAdmin)).
58				Get("/", h.listNotifications)
59			r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSuperAdmin)).
60				Post("/worker/run", h.runWorker)
61		})
62	
63		r.Route("/support", func(r chi.Router) {
64			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
65			r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSupportAgent, domain.RoleSuperAdmin))
66	
67			r.Get("/parties/lookup", h.lookupParty)
68		})
69	
70		// Cross-module reactions arrive over the bus (modules never import each
71		// other). The bus already runs each handler on its own goroutine with a
72		// bounded context and panic recovery; the wrapper below adds an explicit
73		// second belt at this module's boundary.
74		d.Bus.Subscribe(eventbus.TopicPayoutCredited, safeHandler(d, svc.onPayoutCredited))
75		d.Bus.Subscribe(eventbus.TopicGateBlocked, safeHandler(d, svc.onGateBlocked))
76		d.Bus.Subscribe(eventbus.TopicMVUDispatched, safeHandler(d, svc.onMVUDispatched))
77	}
78	
79	// safeHandler wraps a bus reaction so a programming error in notification
80	// fan-out can never disturb the publishing flow.
81	func safeHandler(d *deps.Deps, reaction func(ctx context.Context, payload any)) eventbus.Handler {
82		return func(ctx context.Context, topic string, payload any) {
83			defer func() {
84				if rec := recover(); rec != nil {
85					d.Log.Error("platformops bus handler panic",
86						slog.String("topic", topic), slog.Any("panic", rec))
87				}
88			}()
89			reaction(ctx, payload)
90		}
91	}
92
```

```text
1	package platformops
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"errors"
6		"fmt"
7		"time"
8	
9		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
10		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
11		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo/options"
12	
13		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
14		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/audit"
15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
16		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/mongodb"
17	)
18	
19	// repository is all MongoDB access for the platformops module. It owns the
20	// notifications outbox, reads audit_logs strictly read-only (writes go
21	// through deps.Audit only — the collection is insert-only by design, §12),
22	// and reads parties / role_assignments for the support lookup and for
23	// addressing safety alerts. bmc_lots / processing_batches are read solely to
24	// resolve a gate-blocked subject back to its org unit.
25	type repository struct {
26		auditLogs     *mongo.Collection
27		notifications *mongo.Collection
28		parties       *mongo.Collection
29		assignments   *mongo.Collection
30		bmcLots       *mongo.Collection
31		batches       *mongo.Collection
32	}
33	
34	// newRepository binds the repository to its collections.
35	func newRepository(db *mongo.Database) *repository {
36		return &repository{
37			auditLogs:     db.Collection(mongodb.CollAuditLogs),
38			notifications: db.Collection(mongodb.CollNotifications),
39			parties:       db.Collection(mongodb.CollParties),
40			assignments:   db.Collection(mongodb.CollRoleAssignments),
41			bmcLots:       db.Collection(mongodb.CollBMCLots),
42			batches:       db.Collection(mongodb.CollBatches),
43		}
44	}
45	
46	// auditFilter builds the bson filter shared by the list and export reads.
47	func auditFilter(f auditLogFilter) bson.D {
48		filter := bson.D{}
49		if f.ActorPartyID != "" {
50			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "actor_party_id", Value: f.ActorPartyID})
51		}
52		if f.TargetType != "" {
53			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "target_type", Value: f.TargetType})
54		}
55		if f.Action != "" {
56			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "action", Value: f.Action})
57		}
58		if f.From != nil || f.To != nil {
59			tsRange := bson.D{}
60			if f.From != nil {
61				tsRange = append(tsRange, bson.E{Key: "$gte", Value: *f.From})
62			}
63			if f.To != nil {
64				tsRange = append(tsRange, bson.E{Key: "$lte", Value: *f.To})
65			}
66			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "ts", Value: tsRange})
67		}
68		return filter
69	}
70	
71	// listAuditLogs returns a page of audit entries, newest first, plus the total
72	// matching count for pagination meta.
73	func (r *repository) listAuditLogs(ctx context.Context, f auditLogFilter, page httpx.Page) ([]audit.Entry, int64, error) {
74		filter := auditFilter(f)
75	
76		total, err := r.auditLogs.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
77		if err != nil {
78			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("count audit logs: %w", err))
79		}
80	
81		cur, err := r.auditLogs.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
82			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "ts", Value: -1}}).
83			SetSkip(page.Offset).
84			SetLimit(page.Limit),
85		)
86		if err != nil {
87			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("list audit logs: %w", err))
88		}
89		entries := []audit.Entry{}
90		if err := cur.All(ctx, &entries); err != nil {
91			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("decode audit logs: %w", err))
92		}
93		return entries, total, nil
94	}
95	
96	// exportAuditLogs returns up to maxRows entries in the window, newest first —
97	// the bounded read behind the immutable audit export (§12).
98	func (r *repository) exportAuditLogs(ctx context.Context, f auditLogFilter, maxRows int64) ([]audit.Entry, error) {
99		cur, err := r.auditLogs.Find(ctx, auditFilter(f), options.Find().
100			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "ts", Value: -1}}).
101			SetLimit(maxRows),
102		)
103		if err != nil {
104			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("export audit logs: %w", err))
105		}
106		entries := []audit.Entry{}
107		if err := cur.All(ctx, &entries); err != nil {
108			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("decode audit log export: %w", err))
109		}
110		return entries, nil
111	}
112	
113	// insertNotification queues one outbox document.
114	func (r *repository) insertNotification(ctx context.Context, n *StoredNotification) error {
115		if _, err := r.notifications.InsertOne(ctx, n); err != nil {
116			return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("insert notification: %w", err))
117		}
118		return nil
119	}
120	
121	// listNotifications returns a page of outbox documents, newest first,
122	// optionally filtered by phone and status.
123	func (r *repository) listNotifications(ctx context.Context, phone, status string, page httpx.Page) ([]StoredNotification, int64, error) {
124		filter := bson.D{}
125		if phone != "" {
126			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "phone", Value: phone})
127		}
128		if status != "" {
129			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "status", Value: status})
130		}
131	
132		total, err := r.notifications.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
133		if err != nil {
134			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("count notifications: %w", err))
135		}
136	
137		cur, err := r.notifications.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
138			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "queued_at", Value: -1}}).
139			SetSkip(page.Offset).
140			SetLimit(page.Limit),
141		)
142		if err != nil {
143			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("list notifications: %w", err))
144		}
145		notifications := []StoredNotification{}
146		if err := cur.All(ctx, &notifications); err != nil {
147			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("decode notifications: %w", err))
148		}
149		return notifications, total, nil
150	}
151	
152	// claimQueuedNotification atomically claims the oldest QUEUED document
153	// (QUEUED→SENT, sent_at, provider_ref) and returns it, or nil when the queue
154	// is drained. FindOneAndUpdate makes the claim race-safe across concurrent
155	// worker runs — never find-then-update.
156	func (r *repository) claimQueuedNotification(ctx context.Context, providerRef string, now time.Time) (*StoredNotification, error) {
157		var n StoredNotification
158		err := r.notifications.FindOneAndUpdate(ctx,
159			bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: domain.NotificationQueued}},
160			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
161				{Key: "status", Value: domain.NotificationSent},
162				{Key: "sent_at", Value: now},
163				{Key: "provider_ref", Value: providerRef},
164			}}},
165			options.FindOneAndUpdate().
166				SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "queued_at", Value: 1}}).
167				SetReturnDocument(options.After),
168		).Decode(&n)
169		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
170			return nil, nil
171		}
172		if err != nil {
173			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("claim queued notification: %w", err))
174		}
175		return &n, nil
176	}
177	
178	// setNotificationMeta stamps the rendered-message meta block onto a claimed
179	// notification (visibility only — the claim has already succeeded).
180	func (r *repository) setNotificationMeta(ctx context.Context, notificationID string, meta map[string]any) error {
181		_, err := r.notifications.UpdateOne(ctx,
182			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: notificationID}},
183			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "meta", Value: meta}}}},
184		)
185		if err != nil {
186			return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("set notification meta: %w", err))
187		}
188		return nil
189	}
190	
191	// findPartyByPhone returns the party owning a phone number, or NotFound.
192	func (r *repository) findPartyByPhone(ctx context.Context, phone string) (*domain.Party, error) {
193		var party domain.Party
194		err := r.parties.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "phone", Value: phone}}).Decode(&party)
195		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
196			return nil, httpx.NotFound("party")
197		}
198		if err != nil {
199			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("find party by phone: %w", err))
200		}
201		return &party, nil
202	}
203	
204	// findPartyByID returns one party, or NotFound.
205	func (r *repository) findPartyByID(ctx context.Context, partyID string) (*domain.Party, error) {
206		var party domain.Party
207		err := r.parties.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: partyID}}).Decode(&party)
208		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
209			return nil, httpx.NotFound("party")
210		}
211		if err != nil {
212			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("find party: %w", err))
213		}
214		return &party, nil
215	}
216	
217	// listActiveAssignmentsForParty returns a party's ACTIVE role assignments
218	// (bounded — a party holds at most a handful of roles).
219	func (r *repository) listActiveAssignmentsForParty(ctx context.Context, partyID string) ([]domain.RoleAssignment, error) {
220		cur, err := r.assignments.Find(ctx,
221			bson.D{
222				{Key: "party_id", Value: partyID},
223				{Key: "status", Value: domain.RoleAssignmentActive},
224			},
225			options.Find().SetLimit(100),
226		)
227		if err != nil {
228			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("list assignments for party: %w", err))
229		}
230		assignments := []domain.RoleAssignment{}
231		if err := cur.All(ctx, &assignments); err != nil {
232			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("decode assignments: %w", err))
233		}
234		return assignments, nil
235	}
236	
237	// listActiveRoleHolders returns the ACTIVE assignments of one role inside one
238	// org unit (bounded — used to address supervisor safety alerts).
239	func (r *repository) listActiveRoleHolders(ctx context.Context, orgUnitID, roleCode string) ([]domain.RoleAssignment, error) {
240		cur, err := r.assignments.Find(ctx,
241			bson.D{
242				{Key: "org_unit_id", Value: orgUnitID},
243				{Key: "role_code", Value: roleCode},
244				{Key: "status", Value: domain.RoleAssignmentActive},
245			},
246			options.Find().SetLimit(50),
247		)
248		if err != nil {
249			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("list role holders: %w", err))
250		}
251		assignments := []domain.RoleAssignment{}
252		if err := cur.All(ctx, &assignments); err != nil {
253			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("decode role holders: %w", err))
254		}
255		return assignments, nil
256	}
257	
258	// subjectOrgUnit resolves a gate-blocked QC subject to the org unit that
259	// holds it (BMC lot → bmc_id, processing batch → plant_id).
260	func (r *repository) subjectOrgUnit(ctx context.Context, subjectType, subjectID string) (string, error) {
261		var coll *mongo.Collection
262		var field string
263		switch subjectType {
264		case domain.QCSubjectBMCLot:
265			coll, field = r.bmcLots, "bmc_id"
266		case domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch:
267			coll, field = r.batches, "plant_id"
268		default:
269			return "", fmt.Errorf("gate-blocked subject type %q has no org resolution", subjectType)
270		}
271	
272		var doc bson.M
273		err := coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: subjectID}},
274			options.FindOne().SetProjection(bson.D{{Key: field, Value: 1}}),
275		).Decode(&doc)
276		if err != nil {
277			return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve org of %s %s: %w", subjectType, subjectID, err)
278		}
279		orgUnitID, _ := doc[field].(string)
280		if orgUnitID == "" {
281			return "", fmt.Errorf("%s %s carries no %s", subjectType, subjectID, field)
282		}
283		return orgUnitID, nil
284	}
```

```text
384	// queueNotification inserts one QUEUED outbox document, resolving phone and
385	// preferred language from the party record when available. Failures are
386	// logged, never propagated — a lost SMS must not fail the publishing flow.
387	func (s *service) queueNotification(ctx context.Context, partyID, phone, templateKey string, params map[string]string) {
388		language := "hi" // vernacular default (blueprint §13)
389		if partyID != "" {
390			if party, err := s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, partyID); err == nil {
391				if phone == "" {
392					phone = party.Phone
393				}
394				if party.PreferredLanguage != "" {
395					language = party.PreferredLanguage
396				}
397			}
398		}
399		if phone == "" {
400			s.deps.Log.Error("platformops: dropping notification with no phone",
401				slog.String("template_key", templateKey), slog.String("party_id", partyID))
402			return
403		}
404	
405		notification := &StoredNotification{Notification: domain.Notification{
406			ID:          uuid.NewString(),
407			PartyID:     partyID,
408			Phone:       phone,
409			Channel:     domain.ChannelSMS,
410			TemplateKey: templateKey,
411			Language:    language,
412			Params:      params,
413			Status:      domain.NotificationQueued,
414			QueuedAt:    time.Now().UTC(),
415		}}
416		if err := s.repo.insertNotification(ctx, notification); err != nil {
417			s.deps.Log.Error("platformops: queue notification failed",
418				slog.String("template_key", templateKey), slog.Any("err", err))
419		}
420	}
421	
422	// unionAncestor returns the MILK_UNION org unit at or above orgUnitID, walking
423	// the denormalised ancestor Path nearest-first via d.Orgs.Get. Returns nil
424	// when no union sits on the chain (e.g. a plant directly under the federation).
425	func (s *service) unionAncestor(ctx context.Context, orgUnitID string) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
426		org, err := s.deps.Orgs.Get(ctx, orgUnitID)
427		if err != nil {
428			return nil, err
429		}
430		if org.Type == domain.OrgTypeMilkUnion {
431			return org, nil
432		}
433		// Path holds ancestors root→down; walk nearest ancestor first.
434		for i := len(org.Path) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
435			ancestor, err := s.deps.Orgs.Get(ctx, org.Path[i])
436			if err != nil {
437				return nil, err
438			}
439			if ancestor.Type == domain.OrgTypeMilkUnion {
440				return ancestor, nil
441			}
442		}
443		return nil, nil
444	}
```

```text
18		svc *service
19	}
20	
21	// newHandler wires the handler.
22	func newHandler(svc *service) *handler {

24	}

26	// listFlags handles GET /admin/flags.
27	func (h *handler) listFlags(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
28		all, err := h.svc.listFlags(r.Context())
29		if err != nil {
30			httpx.Error(w, r, err)
31			return
32		}
33		httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, all)
34	}

36	// setFlag handles PUT /admin/flags/{key}.
37	func (h *handler) setFlag(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
38		actor, ok := auth.ActorFrom(r.Context())
39		if !ok {
40			httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Unauthorized("authentication required"))
41			return
42		}
43	
44		var req SetFlagRequest
45		if err := httpx.DecodeJSON(r, &req); err != nil {
46			httpx.Error(w, r, err)
47			return
48		}
49		if req.Enabled == nil {
50			httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_ENABLED", "enabled is required"))
51			return
52		}
53	
54		flag, err := h.svc.setFlag(r.Context(), actor, chi.URLParam(r, "key"), *req.Enabled)
55		if err != nil {
56			httpx.Error(w, r, err)
57			return
58		}
59		httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, flag)
60	}

62	// listAuditLogs handles GET /audit/logs?actor_party_id=&target_type=&action=&from=&to=.
63	func (h *handler) listAuditLogs(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {

67			TargetType:   query.Get("target_type"),
68			Action:       query.Get("action"),
69		}
70	
71		from, err := parseTimeParam(query.Get("from"), false)
72		if err != nil {

74			return
75		}
76		to, err := parseTimeParam(query.Get("to"), true)
77		if err != nil {
78			httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_TO", "to must be RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD"))
79			return
80		}
81		filter.From, filter.To = from, to
82	
83		page := httpx.ParsePage(r)
84		entries, total, err := h.svc.listAuditLogs(r.Context(), filter, page)
85		if err != nil {
86			httpx.Error(w, r, err)
87			return
88		}
89		httpx.JSONMeta(w, http.StatusOK, entries, listMeta{Limit: page.Limit, Offset: page.Offset, Total: total})

104			return

108		if err != nil {

110			return
111		}
112	
113		filename := "audit-export-" + export.ExportedAt.Format("20060102-150405") + ".json"
114		w.Header().Set("Content-Disposition", fmt.Sprintf("attachment; filename=%q", filename))

116	}

119	func (h *handler) listNotifications(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
120		query := r.URL.Query()
121		phone := strings.TrimSpace(query.Get("phone"))
122		status := query.Get("status")
123		switch status {
124		case "", domain.NotificationQueued, domain.NotificationSent, domain.NotificationFailed:
125		default:
126			httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_STATUS", "status must be QUEUED, SENT or FAILED"))
127			return
128		}
129	
130		page := httpx.ParsePage(r)
131		notifications, total, err := h.svc.listNotifications(r.Context(), phone, status, page)
132		if err != nil {
133			httpx.Error(w, r, err)
134			return

136		httpx.JSONMeta(w, http.StatusOK, notifications, listMeta{Limit: page.Limit, Offset: page.Offset, Total: total})
137	}

140	// dispatch trigger (deterministic demo; production = cron/queue consumer).

142		result, err := h.svc.runWorker(r.Context())
143		if err != nil {

150	// lookupParty handles GET /support/parties/lookup?phone=.
151	func (h *handler) lookupParty(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
152		phone := strings.TrimSpace(r.URL.Query().Get("phone"))
153		if phone == "" {
154			httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_PHONE", "phone is required"))
155			return
156		}
157	
158		view, err := h.svc.lookupParty(r.Context(), phone)
159		if err != nil {
160			httpx.Error(w, r, err)
161			return
162		}
163		httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, view)
164	}
165	
166	// parseTimeParam accepts RFC3339 or plain YYYY-MM-DD (empty → nil). Date-only
167	// values mean UTC midnight; with endOfDay they cover the whole day, so
168	// ?to=2026-07-06 is inclusive of the 6th.
169	func parseTimeParam(value string, endOfDay bool) (*time.Time, error) {
170		if value == "" {
171			return nil, nil
172		}
173		if t, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, value); err == nil {
174			t = t.UTC()
175			return &t, nil
176		}
177		t, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", value)
178		if err != nil {
179			return nil, err
180		}
181		if endOfDay {
182			t = t.Add(24*time.Hour - time.Nanosecond)
183		}
184		t = t.UTC()
185		return &t, nil
186	}
```

```text
1	// Package orgscope answers the RBAC question "is this resource inside the
2	// caller's organisational scope?" in O(1) DB reads. Org units denormalise
3	// their ancestor chain into Path ([]ObjectID), so scope checking is a
4	// set-membership test — no recursive tree walks on the hot path.
5	package orgscope
6	
7	import (
8		"context"
9		"errors"
10		"sync"
11		"time"
12	
13		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
14		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
15		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
16	
17		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
18		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
19		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
20	)
21	
22	const collection = "org_units"
23	
24	type cachedOrg struct {
25		org domain.OrgUnit
26		at  time.Time
27	}
28	
29	// Resolver caches org units briefly (the tree changes rarely, reads are hot).
30	type Resolver struct {
31		coll *mongo.Collection
32		ttl  time.Duration
33	
34		mu    sync.RWMutex
35		cache map[string]cachedOrg // keyed by ObjectID hex
36	}
37	
38	// NewResolver binds the resolver to the database.
39	func NewResolver(db *mongo.Database) *Resolver {
40		return &Resolver{
41			coll:  db.Collection(collection),
42			ttl:   60 * time.Second,
43			cache: make(map[string]cachedOrg),
44		}
45	}
46	
47	// Get returns an org unit by ObjectID (cached).
48	func (r *Resolver) Get(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
49		key := id.Hex()
50		r.mu.RLock()
51		c, ok := r.cache[key]
52		r.mu.RUnlock()
53		if ok && time.Since(c.at) < r.ttl {
54			org := c.org
55			return &org, nil
56		}
57	
58		var org domain.OrgUnit
59		err := r.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&org)
60		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
61			return nil, httpx.NotFound("org unit " + key)
62		}
63		if err != nil {
64			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
65		}
66	
67		r.mu.Lock()
68		r.cache[key] = cachedOrg{org: org, at: time.Now()}
69		r.mu.Unlock()
70		return &org, nil
71	}
72	
73	// GetByCode returns an org unit by its unique human-readable business code
74	// (e.g. "DCS-01842") — display/lookup use only, never for joins.
75	func (r *Resolver) GetByCode(ctx context.Context, code string) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
76		var org domain.OrgUnit
77		err := r.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "code", Value: code}}).Decode(&org)
78		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
79			return nil, httpx.NotFound("org unit with code " + code)
80		}
81		if err != nil {
82			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
83		}
84		return &org, nil
85	}
86	
87	// Invalidate drops a cached entry (call after updates).
88	func (r *Resolver) Invalidate(id primitive.ObjectID) {
89		r.mu.Lock()
90		delete(r.cache, id.Hex())
91		r.mu.Unlock()
92	}
93	
94	// InScope reports whether target sits at-or-below scope in the hierarchy:
95	// true when scope == target, or scope appears in target's ancestor Path.
96	func (r *Resolver) InScope(ctx context.Context, scopeOrgID, targetOrgID primitive.ObjectID) (bool, error) {
97		if scopeOrgID == targetOrgID {
98			return true, nil
99		}
100		target, err := r.Get(ctx, targetOrgID)
101		if err != nil {
102			return false, err
103		}
104		for _, ancestor := range target.Path {
105			if ancestor == scopeOrgID {
106				return true, nil
107			}
108		}
109		return false, nil
110	}
111	
112	// RequireInScope enforces the actor's org scope over a target org unit.
113	// SUPER_ADMIN and STATE_AUDITOR (read-wide roles rooted at the federation)
114	// pass automatically; everyone else needs ancestry. The actor carries its
115	// org unit as an ObjectID hex string (JWT claims are JSON); it is parsed here.
116	func (r *Resolver) RequireInScope(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, targetOrgID primitive.ObjectID) error {
117		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSuperAdmin || actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleStateAuditor {
118			return nil
119		}
120		if actor.OrgUnitID == "" {
121			return httpx.Forbidden("role token with org scope required")
122		}
123		scopeID, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(actor.OrgUnitID)
124		if err != nil {
125			return httpx.Forbidden("role token carries an invalid org scope")
126		}
127		ok, err := r.InScope(ctx, scopeID, targetOrgID)
128		if err != nil {
129			return err
130		}
131		if !ok {
132			return httpx.Forbidden("resource is outside your organisational scope")
133		}
134		return nil
135	}
136
```

```text
1	package domain
2	
3	import (
4		"time"
5	
6		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
7	)
8	
9	// Org-unit types — the cooperative backbone RBAC is scoped to (blueprint §5.1,
10	// PCDF constitution: Samiti/DCS → Sangh/Union → PCDF apex).
11	const (
12		OrgTypeFederation      = "FEDERATION"       // PCDF / Parag (state apex)
13		OrgTypeMilkUnion       = "MILK_UNION"       // district Sangh
14		OrgTypeProcessingPlant = "PROCESSING_PLANT" // PCDF plant
15		OrgTypeBMC             = "BMC"              // bulk milk cooler / chilling centre
16		OrgTypeDCS             = "DCS"              // village samiti
17	)
18	
19	// AllOrgTypes is the closed set of org-unit types.
20	var AllOrgTypes = []string{
21		OrgTypeFederation, OrgTypeMilkUnion, OrgTypeProcessingPlant, OrgTypeBMC, OrgTypeDCS,
22	}
23	
24	// ValidOrgParent encodes the allowed hierarchy edges.
25	var ValidOrgParent = map[string][]string{
26		OrgTypeFederation:      {}, // root
27		OrgTypeMilkUnion:       {OrgTypeFederation},
28		OrgTypeProcessingPlant: {OrgTypeMilkUnion, OrgTypeFederation},
29		OrgTypeBMC:             {OrgTypeMilkUnion},
30		OrgTypeDCS:             {OrgTypeMilkUnion, OrgTypeBMC},
31	}
32	
33	// OrgUnit is a node in the cooperative hierarchy.
34	//
35	// ID scheme: `_id` is a generated ObjectID (relations always reference it);
36	// Code is the human-readable unique business key (e.g. "DCS-01842") used for
37	// display, lookups and seed idempotency — never for joins.
38	//
39	// Path holds the ObjectIDs of all ancestors from the root down to (and
40	// excluding) this node — denormalised so "is X inside Y's scope" is a single
41	// indexed array-containment check with no recursive queries on the hot path.
42	type OrgUnit struct {
43		ID        primitive.ObjectID   `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
44		Type      string               `bson:"type"          json:"type"`
45		Name      string               `bson:"name"          json:"name"`
46		Code      string               `bson:"code"          json:"code"` // unique business key, e.g. "DCS-01842"
47		ParentID  *primitive.ObjectID  `bson:"parent_id,omitempty" json:"parent_id,omitempty"`
48		Path      []primitive.ObjectID `bson:"path"          json:"path"`
49		District  string               `bson:"district,omitempty" json:"district,omitempty"`
50		State     string               `bson:"state,omitempty"    json:"state,omitempty"`
51		GeoLat    float64              `bson:"geo_lat,omitempty"  json:"geo_lat,omitempty"`
52		GeoLng    float64              `bson:"geo_lng,omitempty"  json:"geo_lng,omitempty"`
53		Active    bool                 `bson:"active"        json:"active"`
54		CreatedAt time.Time            `bson:"created_at"    json:"created_at"`
55		UpdatedAt time.Time            `bson:"updated_at"    json:"updated_at"`
56	}
57	
58	// IsValidOrgType reports whether t is a known org-unit type.
59	func IsValidOrgType(t string) bool {
60		for _, v := range AllOrgTypes {
61			if v == t {
62				return true
63			}
64		}
65		return false
66	}
```

```text
1	// Package audit writes the immutable who-did-what trail required for
2	// government accountability and DPDP breach forensics (blueprint §12, §16).
3	// Entries are insert-only; the STATE_AUDITOR role reads them via the
4	// platformops module.
5	package audit
6	
7	import (
8		"context"
9		"log/slog"
10		"time"
11	
12		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
13		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
14	
15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
16	)
17	
18	const collection = "audit_logs"
19	
20	// Entry is one audit record. `_id` is a generated ObjectID; actor identifiers
21	// arrive from JWT claims as ObjectID hex strings.
22	type Entry struct {
23		ID           primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
24		ActorPartyID string         `bson:"actor_party_id" json:"actor_party_id"`
25		ActorRole    string         `bson:"actor_role,omitempty" json:"actor_role,omitempty"`
26		Action       string         `bson:"action"         json:"action"` // e.g. "http.POST /api/v1/collection/pours" or "support.pii_lookup"
27		TargetType   string         `bson:"target_type,omitempty" json:"target_type,omitempty"`
28		TargetID     string         `bson:"target_id,omitempty"   json:"target_id,omitempty"`
29		Status       int            `bson:"status,omitempty"      json:"status,omitempty"`
30		IP           string         `bson:"ip,omitempty"          json:"ip,omitempty"`
31		RequestID    string         `bson:"request_id,omitempty"  json:"request_id,omitempty"`
32		Meta         map[string]any `bson:"meta,omitempty"        json:"meta,omitempty"`
33		TS           time.Time      `bson:"ts"             json:"ts"`
34	}
35	
36	// Recorder persists audit entries asynchronously so auditing never adds
37	// latency to the request path.
38	type Recorder struct {
39		coll *mongo.Collection
40		log  *slog.Logger
41	}
42	
43	// NewRecorder binds the recorder to the database.
44	func NewRecorder(db *mongo.Database, log *slog.Logger) *Recorder {
45		return &Recorder{coll: db.Collection(collection), log: log}
46	}
47	
48	// Record fills identity fields from the request context and persists the
49	// entry in the background (fire-and-forget with its own timeout).
50	func (r *Recorder) Record(ctx context.Context, e Entry) {
51		if a, ok := auth.ActorFrom(ctx); ok {
52			if e.ActorPartyID == "" {
53				e.ActorPartyID = a.PartyID
54			}
55			if e.ActorRole == "" {
56				e.ActorRole = a.RoleCode
57			}
58		}
59		e.ID = primitive.NewObjectID()
60		e.TS = time.Now().UTC()
61	
62		go func() {
63			writeCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
64			defer cancel()
65			if _, err := r.coll.InsertOne(writeCtx, e); err != nil {
66				r.log.Error("audit write failed", slog.String("action", e.Action), slog.Any("err", err))
67			}
68		}()
69	}
```
