```text
1	// Package orgscope answers the RBAC question "is this resource inside the
2	// caller's organisational scope?" in O(1) DB reads. Org units denormalise
3	// their ancestor chain into Path ([]ObjectID), so scope checking is a
4	// set-membership test — no recursive tree walks on the hot path.
5	package orgscope
6	
7	import (
8		"context"
9		"errors"
10		"sync"
11		"time"
12	
13		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
14		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
15		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
16	
17		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
18		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
19		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
20	)
21	
22	const collection = "org_units"
23	
24	type cachedOrg struct {
25		org domain.OrgUnit
26		at  time.Time
27	}
28	
29	// Resolver caches org units briefly (the tree changes rarely, reads are hot).
30	type Resolver struct {
31		coll *mongo.Collection
32		ttl  time.Duration
33	
34		mu    sync.RWMutex
35		cache map[string]cachedOrg // keyed by ObjectID hex
36	}
37	
38	// NewResolver binds the resolver to the database.
39	func NewResolver(db *mongo.Database) *Resolver {
40		return &Resolver{
41			coll:  db.Collection(collection),
42			ttl:   60 * time.Second,
43			cache: make(map[string]cachedOrg),
44		}
45	}
46	
47	// Get returns an org unit by ObjectID (cached).
48	func (r *Resolver) Get(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
49		key := id.Hex()
50		r.mu.RLock()
51		c, ok := r.cache[key]
52		r.mu.RUnlock()
53		if ok && time.Since(c.at) < r.ttl {
54			org := c.org
55			return &org, nil
56		}
57	
58		var org domain.OrgUnit
59		err := r.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&org)
60		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
61			return nil, httpx.NotFound("org unit " + key)
62		}
63		if err != nil {
64			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
65		}
66	
67		r.mu.Lock()
68		r.cache[key] = cachedOrg{org: org, at: time.Now()}
69		r.mu.Unlock()
70		return &org, nil
71	}
72	
73	// GetByCode returns an org unit by its unique human-readable business code
74	// (e.g. "DCS-01842") — display/lookup use only, never for joins.
75	func (r *Resolver) GetByCode(ctx context.Context, code string) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
76		var org domain.OrgUnit
77		err := r.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "code", Value: code}}).Decode(&org)
78		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
79			return nil, httpx.NotFound("org unit with code " + code)
80		}
81		if err != nil {
82			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
83		}
84		return &org, nil
85	}
86	
87	// Invalidate drops a cached entry (call after updates).
88	func (r *Resolver) Invalidate(id primitive.ObjectID) {
89		r.mu.Lock()
90		delete(r.cache, id.Hex())
91		r.mu.Unlock()
92	}
93	
94	// InScope reports whether target sits at-or-below scope in the hierarchy:
95	// true when scope == target, or scope appears in target's ancestor Path.
96	func (r *Resolver) InScope(ctx context.Context, scopeOrgID, targetOrgID primitive.ObjectID) (bool, error) {
97		if scopeOrgID == targetOrgID {
98			return true, nil
99		}
100		target, err := r.Get(ctx, targetOrgID)
101		if err != nil {
102			return false, err
103		}
104		for _, ancestor := range target.Path {
105			if ancestor == scopeOrgID {
106				return true, nil
107			}
108		}
109		return false, nil
110	}
111	
112	// RequireInScope enforces the actor's org scope over a target org unit.
113	// SUPER_ADMIN and STATE_AUDITOR (read-wide roles rooted at the federation)
114	// pass automatically; everyone else needs ancestry. The actor carries its
115	// org unit as an ObjectID hex string (JWT claims are JSON); it is parsed here.
116	func (r *Resolver) RequireInScope(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, targetOrgID primitive.ObjectID) error {
117		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSuperAdmin || actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleStateAuditor {
118			return nil
119		}
120		if actor.OrgUnitID == "" {
121			return httpx.Forbidden("role token with org scope required")
122		}
123		scopeID, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(actor.OrgUnitID)
124		if err != nil {
125			return httpx.Forbidden("role token carries an invalid org scope")
126		}
127		ok, err := r.InScope(ctx, scopeID, targetOrgID)
128		if err != nil {
129			return err
130		}
131		if !ok {
132			return httpx.Forbidden("resource is outside your organisational scope")
133		}
134		return nil
135	}
136
```

1	// Package provenance implements the append-only, hash-chained event ledger —
2	// the source of truth for milk traceability (blueprint §7). Every link in the
3	// pour→QR chain is an immutable Event whose SHA-256 hash covers the previous
4	// event's hash, so history cannot be quietly rewritten (tamper-evidence,
5	// FSSAI recall-grade audit).
6	//
7	// Corrections are NEW events referencing the superseded entity — nothing is
8	// ever updated or deleted in this collection.
9	package provenance
10	
11	import (
12		"context"
13		"crypto/sha256"
14		"encoding/hex"
15		"encoding/json"
16		"errors"
17		"fmt"
18		"strconv"
19		"strings"
20		"sync"
21		"time"
22	
23		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
24		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
25		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
26		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo/options"
27	)
28	
29	const collection = "provenance_events"
30	
31	// Ref is a directed edge to another entity in the trace graph
32	// (e.g. a consignment event referencing the pours it aggregates).
33	type Ref struct {
34		EntityType string `bson:"entity_type" json:"entity_type"`
35		EntityID   string `bson:"entity_id"   json:"entity_id"`
36		Relation   string `bson:"relation"    json:"relation"` // aggregates | supersedes | tested | yields | labels ...
37	}
38	
39	// ActorRef records who caused the event.
40	type ActorRef struct {
41		PartyID  string `bson:"party_id"  json:"party_id"`
42		RoleCode string `bson:"role_code" json:"role_code"`
43	}
44	
45	// Event is one immutable link in the ledger. `_id` is a generated ObjectID;
46	// EntityID and Refs carry the referenced documents' ObjectIDs as hex strings
47	// (the ledger is a generic event log spanning every entity type, and hex
48	// strings keep the hash material canonical and human-inspectable).
49	type Event struct {
50		ID         primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
51		Seq        int64          `bson:"seq"         json:"seq"`
52		Type       string         `bson:"type"        json:"type"`
53		EntityType string         `bson:"entity_type" json:"entity_type"`
54		EntityID   string         `bson:"entity_id"   json:"entity_id"`
55		Refs       []Ref          `bson:"refs,omitempty"    json:"refs,omitempty"`
56		Actor      ActorRef       `bson:"actor"       json:"actor"`
57		OrgUnitID  string         `bson:"org_unit_id,omitempty" json:"org_unit_id,omitempty"`
58		Payload    map[string]any `bson:"payload,omitempty"     json:"payload,omitempty"`
59		TS         time.Time      `bson:"ts"          json:"ts"`
60		PrevHash   string         `bson:"prev_hash"   json:"prev_hash"`
61		Hash       string         `bson:"hash"        json:"hash"`
62	}
63	
64	// AppendInput describes a new event to chain.
65	type AppendInput struct {
66		Type       string
67		EntityType string
68		EntityID   string
69		Refs       []Ref
70		Actor      ActorRef
71		OrgUnitID  string
72		Payload    map[string]any
73	}
74	
75	// Ledger appends to and reads the hash chain.
76	type Ledger struct {
77		coll *mongo.Collection
78	
79		// appendMu serialises the head-read+insert of Append within this process:
80		// every ledger write system-wide shares one global seq, so without local
81		// serialisation concurrent handlers (e.g. a morning pour rush plus a
82		// GenerateInvoices loop) burn duplicate-key retries against each other.
83		// The unique seq index remains the atomic backstop across processes.
84		appendMu sync.Mutex
85	}
86	
87	// NewLedger binds the ledger to the database.
88	func NewLedger(db *mongo.Database) *Ledger {
89		return &Ledger{coll: db.Collection(collection)}
90	}
91	
92	// genesisHash anchors the chain before the first event.
93	const genesisHash = "GENESIS"
94	
95	// Append chains a new event. Concurrency-safe without transactions: it reads
96	// the current head, computes seq+hash optimistically, and relies on the
97	// unique index on `seq` — a duplicate-key collision means another writer won
98	// the slot, so we re-read and retry.
99	func (l *Ledger) Append(ctx context.Context, in AppendInput) (*Event, error) {
100		// Serialise appends within this process (see appendMu): local writers no
101		// longer race each other for the seq slot, so under single-instance
102		// deployment the retry loop only ever fires against external writers.
103		l.appendMu.Lock()
104		defer l.appendMu.Unlock()
105	
106		const maxRetries = 12
107		for attempt := 0; attempt < maxRetries; attempt++ {
108			seq, prevHash, err := l.head(ctx)
109			if err != nil {
110				return nil, err
111			}
112			ev := &Event{
113				ID:         primitive.NewObjectID(),
114				Seq:        seq + 1,
115				Type:       in.Type,
116				EntityType: in.EntityType,
117				EntityID:   in.EntityID,
118				Refs:       in.Refs,
119				Actor:      in.Actor,
120				OrgUnitID:  in.OrgUnitID,
121				Payload:    in.Payload,
122				// Millisecond precision: BSON datetimes store ms, so the persisted
123				// TS must equal the hashed TS or re-verification would break.
124				TS:       time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Millisecond),
125				PrevHash: prevHash,
126			}
127			ev.Hash = computeHash(ev)
128	
129			if _, err := l.coll.InsertOne(ctx, ev); err != nil {
130				if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(err) {
131					continue // lost the seq race — retry against the new head
132				}
133				return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance append: %w", err)
134			}
135			return ev, nil
136		}
137		return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance append: gave up after %d seq collisions", 12)
138	}
139	
140	// head returns the latest (seq, hash), or (0, GENESIS) for an empty chain.
141	func (l *Ledger) head(ctx context.Context) (int64, string, error) {
142		var last Event
143		err := l.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{},
144			options.FindOne().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: -1}}),
145		).Decode(&last)
146		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
147			return 0, genesisHash, nil
148		}
149		if err != nil {
150			return 0, "", fmt.Errorf("provenance head: %w", err)
151		}
152		return last.Seq, last.Hash, nil
153	}
154	
155	// computeHash covers everything that matters: position, linkage, content.
156	// Payload is canonicalised via encoding/json (map keys are sorted) and the
157	// timestamp to millisecond precision (BSON datetime resolution), so the
158	// digest is deterministic across a MongoDB round trip.
159	func computeHash(ev *Event) string {
160		payloadJSON, _ := json.Marshal(ev.Payload)
161		refParts := make([]string, 0, len(ev.Refs))
162		for _, r := range ev.Refs {
163			refParts = append(refParts, r.EntityType+":"+r.EntityID+":"+r.Relation)
164		}
165		material := strings.Join([]string{
166			ev.PrevHash,
167			strconv.FormatInt(ev.Seq, 10),
168			ev.Type,
169			ev.EntityType,
170			ev.EntityID,
171			strings.Join(refParts, ","),
172			ev.Actor.PartyID,
173			ev.Actor.RoleCode,
174			ev.OrgUnitID,
175			string(payloadJSON),
176			ev.TS.UTC().Truncate(time.Millisecond).Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
177		}, "|")
178		sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(material))
179		return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
180	}
181	
182	// EventsForEntity returns an entity's own timeline in chain order.
183	func (l *Ledger) EventsForEntity(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string) ([]Event, error) {
184		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
185			bson.D{{Key: "entity_type", Value: entityType}, {Key: "entity_id", Value: entityID}},
186			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}),
187		)
188		if err != nil {
189			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance events for %s/%s: %w", entityType, entityID, err)
190		}
191		var out []Event
192		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
193			return nil, err
194		}
195		return out, nil
196	}
197	
198	// Trace walks the provenance graph UPSTREAM from an entity: its events, plus
199	// (recursively) the events of everything those events reference. This is how
200	// a consumer QR resolves back to the contributing samiti set, and how a failed
201	// aflatoxin test walks back to source DCSes (blueprint §8.3).
202	func (l *Ledger) Trace(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, maxDepth int) ([]Event, error) {
203		return l.TraceStopAt(ctx, entityType, entityID, maxDepth, nil)
204	}
205	
206	// TraceStopAt is Trace with a stop set: entity types in stopExpand are still
207	// fetched (their events appear in the result) but their refs are never
208	// followed. The consumer QR scan stops at the consignment/pooling boundary so
209	// hundreds of per-pour nodes (and cross-route trip fan-out) are never walked.
210	//
211	// Each BFS level is batched into a bounded number of $or queries instead of
212	// one Find per node, so a walk costs O(depth) round trips, not O(nodes).
213	func (l *Ledger) TraceStopAt(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, maxDepth int, stopExpand map[string]bool) ([]Event, error) {
214		if maxDepth <= 0 {
215			maxDepth = 10
216		}
217		const hardEventCap = 2000
218	
219		type node struct{ etype, eid string }
220		visited := map[node]bool{}
221		frontier := []node{{entityType, entityID}}
222		var all []Event
223	
224		for depth := 0; depth < maxDepth && len(frontier) > 0; depth++ {
225			// Deduplicate this level against everything already visited.
226			level := make([]node, 0, len(frontier))
227			for _, n := range frontier {
228				if visited[n] {
229					continue
230				}
231				visited[n] = true
232				level = append(level, n)
233			}
234			if len(level) == 0 {
235				break
236			}
237	
238			var next []node
239			// One indexed query per chunk of the level (not per node).
240			const orChunk = 200
241			for start := 0; start < len(level); start += orChunk {
242				end := min(start+orChunk, len(level))
243				clauses := make(bson.A, 0, end-start)
244				for _, n := range level[start:end] {
245					clauses = append(clauses, bson.D{
246						{Key: "entity_type", Value: n.etype},
247						{Key: "entity_id", Value: n.eid},
248					})
249				}
250				cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
251					bson.D{{Key: "$or", Value: clauses}},
252					options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}).SetLimit(hardEventCap),
253				)
254				if err != nil {
255					return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance trace level: %w", err)
256				}
257				var evs []Event
258				if err := cur.All(ctx, &evs); err != nil {
259					return nil, err
260				}
261				for _, ev := range evs {
262					all = append(all, ev)
263					if len(all) >= hardEventCap {
264						return all, nil
265					}
266					if stopExpand != nil && stopExpand[ev.EntityType] {
267						continue // include the node's events, never follow its refs
268					}
269					for _, ref := range ev.Refs {
270						nn := node{ref.EntityType, ref.EntityID}
271						if !visited[nn] {
272							next = append(next, nn)
273						}
274					}
275				}
276			}
277			frontier = next
278		}
279		return all, nil
280	}
281	
282	// DownstreamRefs finds events that reference the given entity — used to walk
283	// FORWARD (e.g. "which batches consumed this blocked BMC lot?"). The limit is
284	// pushed into the query: only the LAST limit referencing events are fetched
285	// (ascending chain order preserved). limit <= 0 falls back to 2000.
286	func (l *Ledger) DownstreamRefs(ctx context.Context, entityID string, limit int64) ([]Event, error) {
287		if limit <= 0 {
288			limit = 2000
289		}
290		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
291			bson.D{{Key: "refs.entity_id", Value: entityID}},
292			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: -1}}).SetLimit(limit),
293		)
294		if err != nil {
295			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance downstream of %s: %w", entityID, err)
296		}
297		var out []Event
298		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
299			return nil, err
300		}
301		// Restore ascending chain order.
302		for i, j := 0, len(out)-1; i < j; i, j = i+1, j-1 {
303			out[i], out[j] = out[j], out[i]
304		}
305		return out, nil
306	}
307	
308	// EventsForEntityPage returns one page of an entity's own timeline in chain
309	// order, with skip/limit pushed into the query.
310	func (l *Ledger) EventsForEntityPage(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, offset, limit int64) ([]Event, error) {
311		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
312			bson.D{{Key: "entity_type", Value: entityType}, {Key: "entity_id", Value: entityID}},
313			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}).SetSkip(offset).SetLimit(limit),
314		)
315		if err != nil {
316			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance events page for %s/%s: %w", entityType, entityID, err)
317		}
318		var out []Event
319		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
320			return nil, err
321		}
322		return out, nil
323	}
324	
325	// CountEventsForEntity returns the total number of events on an entity's
326	// timeline (pagination meta companion of EventsForEntityPage).
327	func (l *Ledger) CountEventsForEntity(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string) (int64, error) {
328		n, err := l.coll.CountDocuments(ctx,
329			bson.D{{Key: "entity_type", Value: entityType}, {Key: "entity_id", Value: entityID}})
330		if err != nil {
331			return 0, fmt.Errorf("provenance count for %s/%s: %w", entityType, entityID, err)
332		}
333		return n, nil
334	}
335	
336	// VerifyChain re-derives every hash in [fromSeq, toSeq] and checks linkage.
337	// Returns (true, 0) when intact, or (false, seq) of the first broken link.
338	func (l *Ledger) VerifyChain(ctx context.Context, fromSeq, toSeq int64) (bool, int64, error) {
339		filter := bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$gte", Value: fromSeq}, {Key: "$lte", Value: toSeq}}}}
340		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}))
341		if err != nil {
342			return false, 0, fmt.Errorf("provenance verify: %w", err)
343		}
344		defer cur.Close(ctx)
345	
346		prevHash := ""
347		prevSeq := int64(0)
348		first := true
349		for cur.Next(ctx) {
350			var ev Event
351			if err := cur.Decode(&ev); err != nil {
352				return false, 0, err
353			}
354			if computeHash(&ev) != ev.Hash {
355				return false, ev.Seq, nil // content tampered
356			}
357			if !first {
358				if ev.Seq != prevSeq+1 || ev.PrevHash != prevHash {
359					return false, ev.Seq, nil // linkage broken
360				}
361			}
362			prevHash, prevSeq, first = ev.Hash, ev.Seq, false
363		}
364		return true, 0, cur.Err()
365	}
366	
367	// LatestSeq returns the current chain head sequence (0 = empty).
368	func (l *Ledger) LatestSeq(ctx context.Context) (int64, error) {
369		seq, _, err := l.head(ctx)
370		return seq, err
371	}
372

10	// ParseID converts an ObjectID hex string (from JSON bodies, query params or
11	// JWT claims) into a primitive.ObjectID, or returns a 400 with the offending
12	// field name.

```text
1	// Package provenance implements the append-only, hash-chained event ledger —
2	// the source of truth for milk traceability (blueprint §7). Every link in the
3	// pour→QR chain is an immutable Event whose SHA-256 hash covers the previous
4	// event's hash, so history cannot be quietly rewritten (tamper-evidence,
5	// FSSAI recall-grade audit).
6	//
7	// Corrections are NEW events referencing the superseded entity — nothing is
8	// ever updated or deleted in this collection.
9	package provenance
10	
11	import (
12		"context"
13		"crypto/sha256"
14		"encoding/hex"
15		"encoding/json"
16		"errors"
17		"fmt"
18		"strconv"
19		"strings"
20		"sync"
21		"time"
22	
23		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
24		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
25		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
26		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo/options"
27	)
28	
29	const collection = "provenance_events"
30	
31	// Ref is a directed edge to another entity in the trace graph
32	// (e.g. a consignment event referencing the pours it aggregates).
33	type Ref struct {
34		EntityType string `bson:"entity_type" json:"entity_type"`
35		EntityID   string `bson:"entity_id"   json:"entity_id"`
36		Relation   string `bson:"relation"    json:"relation"` // aggregates | supersedes | tested | yields | labels ...
37	}
38	
39	// ActorRef records who caused the event.
40	type ActorRef struct {
41		PartyID  string `bson:"party_id"  json:"party_id"`
42		RoleCode string `bson:"role_code" json:"role_code"`
43	}
44	
45	// Event is one immutable link in the ledger. `_id` is a generated ObjectID;
46	// EntityID and Refs carry the referenced documents' ObjectIDs as hex strings
47	// (the ledger is a generic event log spanning every entity type, and hex
48	// strings keep the hash material canonical and human-inspectable).
49	type Event struct {
50		ID         primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
51		Seq        int64          `bson:"seq"         json:"seq"`
52		Type       string         `bson:"type"        json:"type"`
53		EntityType string         `bson:"entity_type" json:"entity_type"`
54		EntityID   string         `bson:"entity_id"   json:"entity_id"`
55		Refs       []Ref          `bson:"refs,omitempty"    json:"refs,omitempty"`
56		Actor      ActorRef       `bson:"actor"       json:"actor"`
57		OrgUnitID  string         `bson:"org_unit_id,omitempty" json:"org_unit_id,omitempty"`
58		Payload    map[string]any `bson:"payload,omitempty"     json:"payload,omitempty"`
59		TS         time.Time      `bson:"ts"          json:"ts"`
60		PrevHash   string         `bson:"prev_hash"   json:"prev_hash"`
61		Hash       string         `bson:"hash"        json:"hash"`
62	}
63	
64	// AppendInput describes a new event to chain.
65	type AppendInput struct {
66		Type       string
67		EntityType string
68		EntityID   string
69		Refs       []Ref
70		Actor      ActorRef
71		OrgUnitID  string
72		Payload    map[string]any
73	}
74	
75	// Ledger appends to and reads the hash chain.
76	type Ledger struct {
77		coll *mongo.Collection
78	
79		// appendMu serialises the head-read+insert of Append within this process:
80		// every ledger write system-wide shares one global seq, so without local
81		// serialisation concurrent handlers (e.g. a morning pour rush plus a
82		// GenerateInvoices loop) burn duplicate-key retries against each other.
83		// The unique seq index remains the atomic backstop across processes.
84		appendMu sync.Mutex
85	}
86	
87	// NewLedger binds the ledger to the database.
88	func NewLedger(db *mongo.Database) *Ledger {
89		return &Ledger{coll: db.Collection(collection)}
90	}
91	
92	// genesisHash anchors the chain before the first event.
93	const genesisHash = "GENESIS"
94	
95	// Append chains a new event. Concurrency-safe without transactions: it reads
96	// the current head, computes seq+hash optimistically, and relies on the
97	// unique index on `seq` — a duplicate-key collision means another writer won
98	// the slot, so we re-read and retry.
99	func (l *Ledger) Append(ctx context.Context, in AppendInput) (*Event, error) {
100		// Serialise appends within this process (see appendMu): local writers no
101		// longer race each other for the seq slot, so under single-instance
102		// deployment the retry loop only ever fires against external writers.
103		l.appendMu.Lock()
104		defer l.appendMu.Unlock()
105	
106		const maxRetries = 12
107		for attempt := 0; attempt < maxRetries; attempt++ {
108			seq, prevHash, err := l.head(ctx)
109			if err != nil {
110				return nil, err
111			}
112			ev := &Event{
113				ID:         primitive.NewObjectID(),
114				Seq:        seq + 1,
115				Type:       in.Type,
116				EntityType: in.EntityType,
117				EntityID:   in.EntityID,
118				Refs:       in.Refs,
119				Actor:      in.Actor,
120				OrgUnitID:  in.OrgUnitID,
121				Payload:    in.Payload,
122				// Millisecond precision: BSON datetimes store ms, so the persisted
123				// TS must equal the hashed TS or re-verification would break.
124				TS:       time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Millisecond),
125				PrevHash: prevHash,
126			}
127			ev.Hash = computeHash(ev)
128	
129			if _, err := l.coll.InsertOne(ctx, ev); err != nil {
130				if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(err) {
131					continue // lost the seq race — retry against the new head
132				}
133				return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance append: %w", err)
134			}
135			return ev, nil
136		}
137		return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance append: gave up after %d seq collisions", 12)
138	}
139	
140	// head returns the latest (seq, hash), or (0, GENESIS) for an empty chain.
141	func (l *Ledger) head(ctx context.Context) (int64, string, error) {
142		var last Event
143		err := l.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{},
144			options.FindOne().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: -1}}),
145		).Decode(&last)
146		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
147			return 0, genesisHash, nil
148		}
149		if err != nil {
150			return 0, "", fmt.Errorf("provenance head: %w", err)
151		}
152		return last.Seq, last.Hash, nil
153	}
154	
155	// computeHash covers everything that matters: position, linkage, content.
156	// Payload is canonicalised via encoding/json (map keys are sorted) and the
157	// timestamp to millisecond precision (BSON datetime resolution), so the
158	// digest is deterministic across a MongoDB round trip.
159	func computeHash(ev *Event) string {
160		payloadJSON, _ := json.Marshal(ev.Payload)
161		refParts := make([]string, 0, len(ev.Refs))
162		for _, r := range ev.Refs {
163			refParts = append(refParts, r.EntityType+":"+r.EntityID+":"+r.Relation)
164		}
165		material := strings.Join([]string{
166			ev.PrevHash,
167			strconv.FormatInt(ev.Seq, 10),
168			ev.Type,
169			ev.EntityType,
170			ev.EntityID,
171			strings.Join(refParts, ","),
172			ev.Actor.PartyID,
173			ev.Actor.RoleCode,
174			ev.OrgUnitID,
175			string(payloadJSON),
176			ev.TS.UTC().Truncate(time.Millisecond).Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
177		}, "|")
178		sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(material))
179		return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
180	}
181	
182	// EventsForEntity returns an entity's own timeline in chain order.
183	func (l *Ledger) EventsForEntity(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string) ([]Event, error) {
184		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
185			bson.D{{Key: "entity_type", Value: entityType}, {Key: "entity_id", Value: entityID}},
186			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}),
187		)
188		if err != nil {
189			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance events for %s/%s: %w", entityType, entityID, err)
190		}
191		var out []Event
192		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
193			return nil, err
194		}
195		return out, nil
196	}
197	
198	// Trace walks the provenance graph UPSTREAM from an entity: its events, plus
199	// (recursively) the events of everything those events reference. This is how
200	// a consumer QR resolves back to the contributing samiti set, and how a failed
201	// aflatoxin test walks back to source DCSes (blueprint §8.3).
202	func (l *Ledger) Trace(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, maxDepth int) ([]Event, error) {
203		return l.TraceStopAt(ctx, entityType, entityID, maxDepth, nil)
204	}
205	
206	// TraceStopAt is Trace with a stop set: entity types in stopExpand are still
207	// fetched (their events appear in the result) but their refs are never
208	// followed. The consumer QR scan stops at the consignment/pooling boundary so
209	// hundreds of per-pour nodes (and cross-route trip fan-out) are never walked.
210	//
211	// Each BFS level is batched into a bounded number of $or queries instead of
212	// one Find per node, so a walk costs O(depth) round trips, not O(nodes).
213	func (l *Ledger) TraceStopAt(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, maxDepth int, stopExpand map[string]bool) ([]Event, error) {
214		if maxDepth <= 0 {
215			maxDepth = 10
216		}
217		const hardEventCap = 2000
218	
219		type node struct{ etype, eid string }
220		visited := map[node]bool{}
221		frontier := []node{{entityType, entityID}}
222		var all []Event
223	
224		for depth := 0; depth < maxDepth && len(frontier) > 0; depth++ {
225			// Deduplicate this level against everything already visited.
226			level := make([]node, 0, len(frontier))
227			for _, n := range frontier {
228				if visited[n] {
229					continue
230				}
231				visited[n] = true
232				level = append(level, n)
233			}
234			if len(level) == 0 {
235				break
236			}
237	
238			var next []node
239			// One indexed query per chunk of the level (not per node).
240			const orChunk = 200
241			for start := 0; start < len(level); start += orChunk {
242				end := min(start+orChunk, len(level))
243				clauses := make(bson.A, 0, end-start)
244				for _, n := range level[start:end] {
245					clauses = append(clauses, bson.D{
246						{Key: "entity_type", Value: n.etype},
247						{Key: "entity_id", Value: n.eid},
248					})
249				}
250				cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
251					bson.D{{Key: "$or", Value: clauses}},
252					options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}).SetLimit(hardEventCap),
253				)
254				if err != nil {
255					return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance trace level: %w", err)
256				}
257				var evs []Event
258				if err := cur.All(ctx, &evs); err != nil {
259					return nil, err
260				}
261				for _, ev := range evs {
262					all = append(all, ev)
263					if len(all) >= hardEventCap {
264						return all, nil
265					}
266					if stopExpand != nil && stopExpand[ev.EntityType] {
267						continue // include the node's events, never follow its refs
268					}
269					for _, ref := range ev.Refs {
270						nn := node{ref.EntityType, ref.EntityID}
271						if !visited[nn] {
272							next = append(next, nn)
273						}
274					}
275				}
276			}
277			frontier = next
278		}
279		return all, nil
280	}
281	
282	// DownstreamRefs finds events that reference the given entity — used to walk
283	// FORWARD (e.g. "which batches consumed this blocked BMC lot?"). The limit is
284	// pushed into the query: only the LAST limit referencing events are fetched
285	// (ascending chain order preserved). limit <= 0 falls back to 2000.
286	func (l *Ledger) DownstreamRefs(ctx context.Context, entityID string, limit int64) ([]Event, error) {
287		if limit <= 0 {
288			limit = 2000
289		}
290		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
291			bson.D{{Key: "refs.entity_id", Value: entityID}},
292			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: -1}}).SetLimit(limit),
293		)
294		if err != nil {
295			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance downstream of %s: %w", entityID, err)
296		}
297		var out []Event
298		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
299			return nil, err
300		}
301		// Restore ascending chain order.
302		for i, j := 0, len(out)-1; i < j; i, j = i+1, j-1 {
303			out[i], out[j] = out[j], out[i]
304		}
305		return out, nil
306	}
307	
308	// EventsForEntityPage returns one page of an entity's own timeline in chain
309	// order, with skip/limit pushed into the query.
310	func (l *Ledger) EventsForEntityPage(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, offset, limit int64) ([]Event, error) {
311		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
312			bson.D{{Key: "entity_type", Value: entityType}, {Key: "entity_id", Value: entityID}},
313			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}).SetSkip(offset).SetLimit(limit),
314		)
315		if err != nil {
316			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance events page for %s/%s: %w", entityType, entityID, err)
317		}
318		var out []Event
319		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
320			return nil, err
321		}
322		return out, nil
323	}
324	
325	// CountEventsForEntity returns the total number of events on an entity's
326	// timeline (pagination meta companion of EventsForEntityPage).
327	func (l *Ledger) CountEventsForEntity(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string) (int64, error) {
328		n, err := l.coll.CountDocuments(ctx,
329			bson.D{{Key: "entity_type", Value: entityType}, {Key: "entity_id", Value: entityID}})
330		if err != nil {
331			return 0, fmt.Errorf("provenance count for %s/%s: %w", entityType, entityID, err)
332		}
333		return n, nil
334	}
335	
336	// VerifyChain re-derives every hash in [fromSeq, toSeq] and checks linkage.
337	// Returns (true, 0) when intact, or (false, seq) of the first broken link.
338	func (l *Ledger) VerifyChain(ctx context.Context, fromSeq, toSeq int64) (bool, int64, error) {
339		filter := bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$gte", Value: fromSeq}, {Key: "$lte", Value: toSeq}}}}
340		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}))
341		if err != nil {
342			return false, 0, fmt.Errorf("provenance verify: %w", err)
343		}
344		defer cur.Close(ctx)
345	
346		prevHash := ""
347		prevSeq := int64(0)
348		first := true
349		for cur.Next(ctx) {
350			var ev Event
351			if err := cur.Decode(&ev); err != nil {
352				return false, 0, err
353			}
354			if computeHash(&ev) != ev.Hash {
355				return false, ev.Seq, nil // content tampered
356			}
357			if !first {
358				if ev.Seq != prevSeq+1 || ev.PrevHash != prevHash {
359					return false, ev.Seq, nil // linkage broken
360				}
361			}
362			prevHash, prevSeq, first = ev.Hash, ev.Seq, false
363		}
364		return true, 0, cur.Err()
365	}
366	
367	// LatestSeq returns the current chain head sequence (0 = empty).
368	func (l *Ledger) LatestSeq(ctx context.Context) (int64, error) {
369		seq, _, err := l.head(ctx)
370		return seq, err
371	}

package httpx

import (
	"net/http"

	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
)

// ParseID converts an ObjectID hex string (from JSON bodies, query params or
// JWT claims) into a primitive.ObjectID, or returns a 400 with the offending
// field name.
func ParseID(hex, field string) (primitive.ObjectID, error) {
	id, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(hex)
	if err != nil {
		return primitive.NilObjectID, BadRequest("INVALID_ID", field+" must be a valid object id")
	}
	return id, nil
}

// PathID extracts a chi URL parameter and parses it as an ObjectID.
func PathID(r *http.Request, param string) (primitive.ObjectID, error) {
	return ParseID(chi.URLParam(r, param), param)
}

19	// repository is the module's only MongoDB touchpoint. It maps driver errors
20	// to httpx errors (mongo.ErrNoDocuments → NotFound, duplicate key → Conflict)
21	// so the service layer stays driver-free. Unexpected driver errors are wrapped
22	// with the failing operation so ERROR logs upstream name the op.
23	type repository struct {
24		animals   *mongo.Collection
25		health    *mongo.Collection
26		mvuCases  *mongo.Collection
27		education *mongo.Collection
28	}

30	// newRepository binds the repository to the module's collections.
31	func newRepository(db *mongo.Database) *repository {
32		return &repository{
33			animals:   db.Collection(mongodb.CollAnimals),
34			health:    db.Collection(mongodb.CollHealthEvents),
35			mvuCases:  db.Collection(mongodb.CollMVUCases),
36			education: db.Collection(mongodb.CollEducation),
37		}
38	}

40	// InsertAnimal persists a new animal. The unique index on pashu_aadhaar
41	// (mongodb.EnsureIndexes) turns a duplicate registration into ANIMAL_EXISTS.
42	func (r *repository) InsertAnimal(ctx context.Context, a *domain.Animal) error {
43		if _, err := r.animals.InsertOne(ctx, a); err != nil {
44			if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(err) {
45				return httpx.Conflict("ANIMAL_EXISTS", "an animal with this pashu_aadhaar is already registered")
46			}
47			return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("insert animal: %w", err))
48		}
49		return nil
50	}

52	// FindAnimalByID loads one animal or returns NotFound.
53	func (r *repository) FindAnimalByID(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.Animal, error) {
54		var a domain.Animal
55		err := r.animals.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&a)
56		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
57			return nil, httpx.NotFound("animal")
58		}
59		if err != nil {
60			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("find animal %s: %w", id.Hex(), err))
61		}

66	// ObjectID = no filter), newest first, plus the total match count.

140	func (r *repository) InsertMVUCase(ctx context.Context, c *domain.MVUCase) error {
141		if _, err := r.mvuCases.InsertOne(ctx, c); err != nil {
142			return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("insert mvu case: %w", err))
143		}
144		return nil
145	}
146	
147	// FindMVUCaseByID loads one MVU case or returns NotFound.
148	func (r *repository) FindMVUCaseByID(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.MVUCase, error) {
149		var c domain.MVUCase
150		err := r.mvuCases.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&c)
151		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
152			return nil, httpx.NotFound("MVU case")
153		}
154		if err != nil {
155			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("find mvu case %s: %w", id.Hex(), err))
156		}
157		return &c, nil
158	}
159	
160	// DispatchMVUCase moves a case REQUESTED → DISPATCHED, recording the vet
161	// and/or driver. The status guard in the filter is the optimistic lock (no
162	// transactions on a standalone server): a false return means the case was
163	// not in REQUESTED state — e.g. a concurrent dispatch won the race.
164	func (r *repository) DispatchMVUCase(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID, vetPartyID, driverPartyID *primitive.ObjectID) (bool, error) {
165		set := bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: domain.MVUCaseDispatched}}
166		if vetPartyID != nil {
167			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "vet_party_id", Value: *vetPartyID})
168		}
169		if driverPartyID != nil {
170			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "driver_party_id", Value: *driverPartyID})
171		}
172		res, err := r.mvuCases.UpdateOne(ctx,
173			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}, {Key: "status", Value: domain.MVUCaseRequested}},
174			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: set}})
175		if err != nil {
176			return false, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("dispatch mvu case %s: %w", id.Hex(), err))
177		}
178		return res.MatchedCount == 1, nil
179	}
180	
181	// CloseMVUCase moves a DISPATCHED (or ARRIVED) case to CLOSED with the visit
182	// log. Same optimistic status-guard pattern as DispatchMVUCase.
183	func (r *repository) CloseMVUCase(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID, visitNotes string, healthEventIDs []primitive.ObjectID, closedAt time.Time) (bool, error) {
184		set := bson.D{
185			{Key: "status", Value: domain.MVUCaseClosed},
186			{Key: "visit_notes", Value: visitNotes},
187			{Key: "closed_at", Value: closedAt},
188		}
189		if len(healthEventIDs) > 0 {
190			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "health_event_ids", Value: healthEventIDs})
191		}
192		res, err := r.mvuCases.UpdateOne(ctx,
193			bson.D{
194				{Key: "_id", Value: id},
195				{Key: "status", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: []string{
196					domain.MVUCaseDispatched, domain.MVUCaseArrived,
197				}}}},
198			},
199			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: set}})
200		if err != nil {
201			return false, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("close mvu case %s: %w", id.Hex(), err))
202		}
203		return res.MatchedCount == 1, nil
204	}
205	
206	// ListMVUCases returns a page of cases filtered by DCS (zero ObjectID = no
207	// filter) and/or status, most recently requested first, plus the total count.
208	func (r *repository) ListMVUCases(ctx context.Context, dcsID primitive.ObjectID, status string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.MVUCase, int64, error) {
209		filter := bson.D{}
210		if !dcsID.IsZero() {
211			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "dcs_id", Value: dcsID})
212		}
213		if status != "" {
214			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "status", Value: status})
215		}
216		total, err := r.mvuCases.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
217		if err != nil {
218			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("count mvu cases: %w", err))
219		}
220		cur, err := r.mvuCases.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
221			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "requested_at", Value: -1}}).
222			SetSkip(page.Offset).SetLimit(page.Limit))
223		if err != nil {
224			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("list mvu cases: %w", err))
225		}
226		out := []domain.MVUCase{}
227		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
228			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("decode mvu cases: %w", err))
229		}
230		return out, total, nil
231	}
232	
233	// InsertEducation persists a new education-hub item.
234	func (r *repository) InsertEducation(ctx context.Context, e *domain.EducationContent) error {
235		if _, err := r.education.InsertOne(ctx, e); err != nil {
236			return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("insert education content: %w", err))
237		}
238		return nil
239	}
240	
241	// ListPublishedEducation returns a page of published content filtered by
242	// topic and/or language, newest first, plus the total match count.
243	func (r *repository) ListPublishedEducation(ctx context.Context, topic, language string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.EducationContent, int64, error) {
244		filter := bson.D{{Key: "published", Value: true}}
245		if topic != "" {
246			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "topic", Value: topic})
247		}
248		if language != "" {
249			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "language", Value: language})
250		}
251		total, err := r.education.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
252		if err != nil {
253			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("count education content: %w", err))
254		}
255		cur, err := r.education.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
256			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "created_at", Value: -1}}).
257			SetSkip(page.Offset).SetLimit(page.Limit))
258		if err != nil {
259			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("list education content: %w", err))
260		}
261		out := []domain.EducationContent{}
262		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
263			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("decode education content: %w", err))
264		}
265		return out, total, nil
266	}

```text
1	// Package orgscope answers the RBAC question "is this resource inside the
2	// caller's organisational scope?" in O(1) DB reads. Org units denormalise
3	// their ancestor chain into Path ([]ObjectID), so scope checking is a
4	// set-membership test — no recursive tree walks on the hot path.
5	package orgscope
6	
7	import (
8		"context"
9		"errors"
10		"sync"
11		"time"
12	
13		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
14		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
15		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
16	
17		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
18		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
19		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
20	)
21	
22	const collection = "org_units"
23	
24	type cachedOrg struct {
25		org domain.OrgUnit
26		at  time.Time
27	}
28	
29	// Resolver caches org units briefly (the tree changes rarely, reads are hot).
30	type Resolver struct {
31		coll *mongo.Collection
32		ttl  time.Duration
33	
34		mu    sync.RWMutex
35		cache map[string]cachedOrg // keyed by ObjectID hex
36	}
37	
38	// NewResolver binds the resolver to the database.
39	func NewResolver(db *mongo.Database) *Resolver {
40		return &Resolver{
41			coll:  db.Collection(collection),
42			ttl:   60 * time.Second,
43			cache: make(map[string]cachedOrg),
44		}
45	}
46	
47	// Get returns an org unit by ObjectID (cached).
48	func (r *Resolver) Get(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
49		key := id.Hex()
50		r.mu.RLock()
51		c, ok := r.cache[key]
52		r.mu.RUnlock()
53		if ok && time.Since(c.at) < r.ttl {
54			org := c.org
55			return &org, nil
56		}
57	
58		var org domain.OrgUnit
59		err := r.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&org)
60		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
61			return nil, httpx.NotFound("org unit " + key)
62		}
63		if err != nil {
64			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
65		}
66	
67		r.mu.Lock()
68		r.cache[key] = cachedOrg{org: org, at: time.Now()}
69		r.mu.Unlock()
70		return &org, nil
71	}
72	
73	// GetByCode returns an org unit by its unique human-readable business code
74	// (e.g. "DCS-01842") — display/lookup use only, never for joins.
75	func (r *Resolver) GetByCode(ctx context.Context, code string) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
76		var org domain.OrgUnit
77		err := r.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "code", Value: code}}).Decode(&org)
78		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
79			return nil, httpx.NotFound("org unit with code " + code)
80		}
81		if err != nil {
82			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
83		}
84		return &org, nil
85	}
86	
87	// Invalidate drops a cached entry (call after updates).
88	func (r *Resolver) Invalidate(id primitive.ObjectID) {
89		r.mu.Lock()
90		delete(r.cache, id.Hex())
91		r.mu.Unlock()
92	}
93	
94	// InScope reports whether target sits at-or-below scope in the hierarchy:
95	// true when scope == target, or scope appears in target's ancestor Path.
96	func (r *Resolver) InScope(ctx context.Context, scopeOrgID, targetOrgID primitive.ObjectID) (bool, error) {
97		if scopeOrgID == targetOrgID {
98			return true, nil
99		}
100		target, err := r.Get(ctx, targetOrgID)
101		if err != nil {
102			return false, err
103		}
104		for _, ancestor := range target.Path {
105			if ancestor == scopeOrgID {
106				return true, nil
107			}
108		}
109		return false, nil
110	}
111	
112	// RequireInScope enforces the actor's org scope over a target org unit.
113	// SUPER_ADMIN and STATE_AUDITOR (read-wide roles rooted at the federation)
114	// pass automatically; everyone else needs ancestry. The actor carries its
115	// org unit as an ObjectID hex string (JWT claims are JSON); it is parsed here.
116	func (r *Resolver) RequireInScope(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, targetOrgID primitive.ObjectID) error {
117		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSuperAdmin || actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleStateAuditor {
118			return nil
119		}
120		if actor.OrgUnitID == "" {
121			return httpx.Forbidden("role token with org scope required")
122		}
123		scopeID, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(actor.OrgUnitID)
124		if err != nil {
125			return httpx.Forbidden("role token carries an invalid org scope")
126		}
127		ok, err := r.InScope(ctx, scopeID, targetOrgID)
128		if err != nil {
129			return err
130		}
131		if !ok {
132			return httpx.Forbidden("resource is outside your organisational scope")
133		}
134		return nil
135	}
136

```text
1	// Package flags implements capability gating (blueprint principle #6):
2	// future-scheme features ship dormant behind flags — e.g. collar telemetry —
3	// so a new government scheme is a flag flip, not a schema migration.
4	package flags
5	
6	import (
7		"context"
8		"sync"
9		"time"
10	
11		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
12		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
13		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
14		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo/options"
15	)
16	
17	const collection = "feature_flags"
18	
19	// Well-known flag keys.
20	const (
21		FlagCollarTelemetry  = "collar_telemetry_enabled" // dormant until a collar scheme lands (§9)
22		FlagPhotoOCR         = "photo_ocr_enabled"        // legacy-analyzer bridge (§8.2)
23		FlagONDC             = "ondc_enabled"             // optional commerce network (§11)
24		FlagConsumerCommerce = "consumer_commerce_enabled"
25	)
26	
27	// Flag is the stored document. `_id` is a generated ObjectID; Key is the
28	// unique business identifier all lookups use.
29	type Flag struct {
30		ID          primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
31		Key         string             `bson:"key"           json:"key"`
32		Enabled     bool               `bson:"enabled"       json:"enabled"`
33		Description string             `bson:"description,omitempty" json:"description,omitempty"`
34		UpdatedBy   string             `bson:"updated_by,omitempty"  json:"updated_by,omitempty"` // approver party ObjectID hex
35		UpdatedAt   time.Time          `bson:"updated_at"    json:"updated_at"`
36	}
37	
38	type cached struct {
39		enabled bool
40		at      time.Time
41	}
42	
43	// Service reads flags with a short in-memory cache (hot path: every gated
44	// request) and writes through on change.
45	type Service struct {
46		coll *mongo.Collection
47		ttl  time.Duration
48	
49		mu    sync.RWMutex
50		cache map[string]cached
51	}
52	
53	// NewService binds the flag service to the database.
54	func NewService(db *mongo.Database) *Service {
55		return &Service{
56			coll:  db.Collection(collection),
57			ttl:   30 * time.Second,
58			cache: make(map[string]cached),
59		}
60	}
61	
62	// Enabled returns the flag value (missing flag = false, fail-closed).
63	func (s *Service) Enabled(ctx context.Context, key string) bool {
64		s.mu.RLock()
65		c, ok := s.cache[key]
66		s.mu.RUnlock()
67		if ok && time.Since(c.at) < s.ttl {
68			return c.enabled
69		}
70	
71		var f Flag
72		err := s.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "key", Value: key}}).Decode(&f)
73		enabled := err == nil && f.Enabled
74	
75		s.mu.Lock()
76		s.cache[key] = cached{enabled: enabled, at: time.Now()}
77		s.mu.Unlock()
78		return enabled
79	}
80	
81	// Set upserts a flag by key and invalidates the cache entry immediately.
82	func (s *Service) Set(ctx context.Context, key string, enabled bool, updatedBy string) error {
83		_, err := s.coll.UpdateOne(ctx,
84			bson.D{{Key: "key", Value: key}},
85			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
86				{Key: "enabled", Value: enabled},
87				{Key: "updated_by", Value: updatedBy},
88				{Key: "updated_at", Value: time.Now().UTC()},
89			}}},
90			options.Update().SetUpsert(true),
91		)
92		if err != nil {
93			return err
94		}
95		s.mu.Lock()
96		s.cache[key] = cached{enabled: enabled, at: time.Now()}
97		s.mu.Unlock()
98		return nil
99	}
100	
101	// All lists every flag (admin console).
102	func (s *Service) All(ctx context.Context) ([]Flag, error) {
103		cur, err := s.coll.Find(ctx, bson.D{})
104		if err != nil {
105			return nil, err
106		}
107		var out []Flag
108		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
109			return nil, err
110		}
111		return out, nil
112	}
113	
114	// EnsureDefaults inserts missing flags without touching existing values.
115	func (s *Service) EnsureDefaults(ctx context.Context, defaults map[string]Flag) error {
116		for key, f := range defaults {
117			f.Key = key
118			if f.UpdatedAt.IsZero() {
119				f.UpdatedAt = time.Now().UTC()
120			}
121			_, err := s.coll.UpdateOne(ctx,
122				bson.D{{Key: "key", Value: key}},
123				bson.D{{Key: "$setOnInsert", Value: f}},
124				options.Update().SetUpsert(true),
125			)
126			if err != nil {
127				return err
128			}
129		}
130		return nil
131	}
132

26		d    *deps.Deps
27		repo *repository
28		log  *slog.Logger
29	}
30	
31	// newService wires the service to the platform container, the repository and
32	// the module-scoped logger.
33	func newService(d *deps.Deps, repo *repository, log *slog.Logger) *service {
34		return &service{d: d, repo: repo, log: log}
35	}
36	
37	// actorID parses the actor's party identity once per service call — JWT
38	// claims carry ObjectIDs as hex strings (JWTs are JSON).
39	func actorID(actor auth.Actor) (primitive.ObjectID, error) {

43	// logFailure routes a failed operation to the right log level — WARN for
44	// business rejections (4xx AppErrors: scope denials, conflicts, gate blocks),
45	// ERROR for unexpected failures — and returns err unchanged.
46	func (s *service) logFailure(ctx context.Context, op string, err error, attrs ...any) error {
47		args := append(attrs, slog.Any("err", err))
48		var appErr *httpx.AppError
49		if errors.As(err, &appErr) && appErr.Status < http.StatusInternalServerError {
50			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, op+" rejected", args...)
51		} else {
52			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, op+" failed", args...)
53		}

55	}

78	// validatePashuAadhaar enforces the national ear-tag format: exactly 12
79	// ASCII digits (§9). Pure function — unit tested.
80	func validatePashuAadhaar(id string) *httpx.AppError {
81		if len(id) != 12 {
82			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_PASHU_AADHAAR", "pashu_aadhaar must be exactly 12 digits")
83		}
84		for i := 0; i < len(id); i++ {
85			if id[i] < '0' || id[i] > '9' {
86				return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_PASHU_AADHAAR", "pashu_aadhaar must contain digits only")
87			}
88		}
89		return nil
90	}
91	
92	// resolveAnimalOwner decides who the registered animal belongs to. A FARMER
93	// may only register their own animals (any explicit owner_party_id must match
94	// the caller); every other registrar role must name the owner explicitly.
95	// actorID is the caller's parsed party ObjectID. Pure function — unit tested.
96	func resolveAnimalOwner(actor auth.Actor, actorID primitive.ObjectID, requestedOwner *primitive.ObjectID) (primitive.ObjectID, *httpx.AppError) {
97		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleFarmer {
98			if requestedOwner != nil && !requestedOwner.IsZero() && *requestedOwner != actorID {
99				return primitive.NilObjectID, httpx.Forbidden("farmers may only register their own animals")
100			}
101			return actorID, nil
102		}
103		if requestedOwner == nil || requestedOwner.IsZero() {
104			return primitive.NilObjectID, httpx.BadRequest("OWNER_REQUIRED", "owner_party_id is required when registering on a farmer's behalf")
105		}
106		return *requestedOwner, nil
107	}
108	
109	// canViewAnimal enforces v1 read access: the owner FARMER, or one of the
110	// care-circle roles already gated at the route (VETERINARIAN, AI_TECH,
111	// MISSION_OFFICIAL). actorID is the caller's parsed party ObjectID.
112	//
113	// TODO(consent): v2 must additionally verify a DPDP consent artefact from the
114	// owner (consents collection, blueprint §18-A) before a non-owner role reads
115	// an animal or its health history. v1 deliberately ships the role check only.
116	func canViewAnimal(actor auth.Actor, actorID primitive.ObjectID, animal *domain.Animal) *httpx.AppError {
117		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleFarmer && animal.OwnerPartyID != actorID {
118			return httpx.Forbidden("farmers may only view their own animals")
119		}
120		return nil
121	}
122	
123	// appendLedger records a provenance event best-effort. The primary document
124	// is already committed when this runs, so a ledger hiccup is logged for
125	// reconciliation rather than turned into a request failure the client would
126	// retry into a duplicate.
127	func (s *service) appendLedger(ctx context.Context, in provenance.AppendInput) {
128		if _, err := s.d.Ledger.Append(ctx, in); err != nil {
129			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "provenance append failed",
130				slog.String("type", in.Type),
131				slog.String("entity_id", in.EntityID),
132				slog.Any("err", err),
133			)
134		}
135	}

137	// RegisterAnimal creates an animal record keyed on Pashu Aadhaar (§9) and
138	// appends the animal.registered provenance event.
139	func (s *service) RegisterAnimal(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req RegisterAnimalRequest) (*domain.Animal, error) {
140		callerID, err := actorID(actor)
141		if err != nil {
142			return nil, err
143		}
144		if aerr := validatePashuAadhaar(req.PashuAadhaar); aerr != nil {
145			return nil, aerr
146		}
147		if req.DCSID.IsZero() {
148			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("DCS_REQUIRED", "dcs_id is required")
149		}
150		if req.Species == "" {
151			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("SPECIES_REQUIRED", "species is required")
152		}
153		owner, aerr := resolveAnimalOwner(actor, callerID, req.OwnerPartyID)
154		if aerr != nil {
155			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "animal registration rejected",
156				slog.String("reason", aerr.Code),
157				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
158				slog.String("actor_role", actor.RoleCode))
159			return nil, aerr
160		}
161		// Farmers register into their own village context; every other registrar
162		// must hold scope over the target DCS.
163		if actor.RoleCode != domain.RoleFarmer {
164			if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.DCSID); err != nil {
165				return nil, s.logFailure(ctx, "register animal scope check", err,
166					slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
167					slog.String("dcs_id", req.DCSID.Hex()))
168			}
169		}
170	
171		now := time.Now().UTC()
172		animal := &domain.Animal{
173			// Pre-generated so the insert and the ledger ref share one ID.
174			ID:              primitive.NewObjectID(),
175			PashuAadhaar:    req.PashuAadhaar,
176			OwnerPartyID:    owner,
177			DCSID:           req.DCSID,
178			Species:         req.Species,
179			Breed:           req.Breed,
180			Sex:             req.Sex,
181			LactationStatus: req.LactationStatus,
182			CollarEnabled:   false, // dormant until a collar scheme flips flags.FlagCollarTelemetry (§9)
183			Status:          domain.AnimalStatusActive,
184			CreatedAt:       now,
185			UpdatedAt:       now,
186		}
187		if err := s.repo.InsertAnimal(ctx, animal); err != nil {
188			return nil, s.logFailure(ctx, "insert animal", err,
189				slog.String("pashu_aadhaar", req.PashuAadhaar),
190				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
191		}
192	
193		s.appendLedger(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
194			Type:       domain.EventAnimalRegistered,
195			EntityType: domain.EntityAnimal,
196			EntityID:   animal.ID.Hex(),
197			Refs: []provenance.Ref{
198				{EntityType: domain.EntityParty, EntityID: owner.Hex(), Relation: "owned_by"},
199			},
200			Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
201			OrgUnitID: animal.DCSID.Hex(),
202			Payload: map[string]any{
203				"pashu_aadhaar": animal.PashuAadhaar,
204				"species":       animal.Species,
205			},
206		})
207		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "animal registered",
208			slog.String("animal_id", animal.ID.Hex()),
209			slog.String("pashu_aadhaar", animal.PashuAadhaar),
210			slog.String("owner_party_id", owner.Hex()),
211			slog.String("dcs_id", animal.DCSID.Hex()),
212			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
213		return animal, nil
214	}

216	// ListAnimals returns a page of animals. Farmers — and plain session tokens,
217	// which carry no role scope at all — are pinned to their own herd. Every
218	// other role (except the federation-wide read roles) must name a DCS inside
219	// its organisational scope, so a narrowly-scoped or consumer role can never
220	// enumerate the national animal registry.
221	func (s *service) ListAnimals(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, ownerPartyID, dcsID primitive.ObjectID, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.Animal, int64, error) {
222		switch {
223		case actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleFarmer || actor.Kind == auth.TokenKindSession:
224			callerID, err := actorID(actor)
225			if err != nil {
226				return nil, 0, err
227			}
228			ownerPartyID = callerID
229		case actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSuperAdmin || actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleStateAuditor:
230			// federation-wide read roles may filter freely
231		default:
232			if dcsID.IsZero() {
233				return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("DCS_REQUIRED", "dcs_id is required for your role")
234			}
235			if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, dcsID); err != nil {
236				return nil, 0, s.logFailure(ctx, "list animals scope check", err,
237					slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
238					slog.String("dcs_id", dcsID.Hex()))
239			}
240		}
241		animals, total, err := s.repo.ListAnimals(ctx, ownerPartyID, dcsID, page)
242		if err != nil {
243			return nil, 0, s.logFailure(ctx, "list animals", err)
244		}
245		return animals, total, nil
246	}

248	// requireAnimalReadAccess applies the animal read rule: the owner FARMER, or
249	// a care-circle role whose org scope covers the animal's DCS — a vet from one
250	// union must not read animal health PII across the federation.
251	func (s *service) requireAnimalReadAccess(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, animal *domain.Animal) error {
252		callerID, err := actorID(actor)
253		if err != nil {
254			return err
255		}
256		if aerr := canViewAnimal(actor, callerID, animal); aerr != nil {
257			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "animal read denied",
258				slog.String("animal_id", animal.ID.Hex()),
259				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
260			return aerr
261		}
262		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleFarmer {
263			return nil // owner (canViewAnimal already pinned ownership)
264		}
265		if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, animal.DCSID); err != nil {
266			return s.logFailure(ctx, "animal read scope check", err,
267				slog.String("animal_id", animal.ID.Hex()),
268				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
269		}
270		return nil
271	}

273	// GetAnimal returns one animal after the v1 access check (owner farmer, or a
274	// care-circle role within org scope; DPDP consent gating remains a v2 TODO).
275	func (s *service) GetAnimal(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, animalID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.Animal, error) {
276		animal, err := s.repo.FindAnimalByID(ctx, animalID)
277		if err != nil {
278			return nil, err
279		}
280		if err := s.requireAnimalReadAccess(ctx, actor, animal); err != nil {
281			return nil, err
282		}
283		return animal, nil
284	}

287	// same access rule as GetAnimal.
288	func (s *service) ListHealthEvents(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, animalID primitive.ObjectID, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.HealthEvent, int64, error) {

295		}

299				slog.String("animal_id", animal.ID.Hex()))
300		}
301		return events, total, nil

304	// LogHealthEvent records one health-history entry with bp_sync_status PENDING
305	// and appends the health.event_logged provenance event.
306	func (s *service) LogHealthEvent(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, animalID primitive.ObjectID, req LogHealthEventRequest) (*domain.HealthEvent, error) {
307		callerID, err := actorID(actor)
308		if err != nil {
309			return nil, err
310		}
311		if _, ok := validHealthEventTypes[req.Type]; !ok {
312			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_HEALTH_EVENT_TYPE", "type must be one of the catalog health event types")
313		}
314		animal, err := s.repo.FindAnimalByID(ctx, animalID)
315		if err != nil {
316			return nil, err
317		}
318		if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, animal.DCSID); err != nil {
319			return nil, s.logFailure(ctx, "log health event scope check", err,
320				slog.String("animal_id", animal.ID.Hex()),
321				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
322		}
323	
324		now := time.Now().UTC()
325		occurredAt := now
326		if req.OccurredAt != nil {
327			occurredAt = req.OccurredAt.UTC()
328		}
329		event := &domain.HealthEvent{
330			// Pre-generated so the insert and the ledger payload share one ID.
331			ID:              primitive.NewObjectID(),
332			AnimalID:        animal.ID,
333			PashuAadhaar:    animal.PashuAadhaar,
334			Type:            req.Type,
335			Details:         req.Details,
336			RecordedByParty: callerID,
337			RecordedByRole:  actor.RoleCode,
338			OccurredAt:      occurredAt,
339			BharatPashudhan: domain.BPSyncPending, // pushed later via /bp-sync
340			CreatedAt:       now,
341		}
342		if err := s.repo.InsertHealthEvent(ctx, event); err != nil {
343			return nil, s.logFailure(ctx, "insert health event", err,
344				slog.String("animal_id", animal.ID.Hex()))
345		}
346	
347		// The ledger event lands on the animal's timeline (there is no dedicated
348		// health-event entity type); the ref pins the animal it was recorded for.
349		s.appendLedger(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
350			Type:       domain.EventHealthEventLogged,
351			EntityType: domain.EntityAnimal,
352			EntityID:   animal.ID.Hex(),
353			Refs: []provenance.Ref{
354				{EntityType: domain.EntityAnimal, EntityID: animal.ID.Hex(), Relation: "recorded_for"},
355			},
356			Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
357			OrgUnitID: animal.DCSID.Hex(),
358			Payload: map[string]any{
359				"health_event_id": event.ID.Hex(),
360				"type":            event.Type,
361			},
362		})
363		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "health event logged",
364			slog.String("health_event_id", event.ID.Hex()),
365			slog.String("animal_id", animal.ID.Hex()),
366			slog.String("type", event.Type),
367			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
368		return event, nil
369	}

371	// SyncBharatPashudhan is the MOCK national-DB push (§9): it marks every
372	// PENDING health event of the animal SYNCED under a mock reference. The real
373	// integration replaces this method body — API and data shapes stay put.
374	func (s *service) SyncBharatPashudhan(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, animalID primitive.ObjectID) (*BPSyncResponse, error) {
375		animal, err := s.repo.FindAnimalByID(ctx, animalID)
376		if err != nil {
377			return nil, err
378		}
379		if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, animal.DCSID); err != nil {
380			return nil, s.logFailure(ctx, "bp sync scope check", err,
381				slog.String("animal_id", animal.ID.Hex()),
382				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
383		}
384		ref := "BP-MOCK-" + uuid.NewString()[:8]
385		count, err := s.repo.MarkPendingHealthEventsSynced(ctx, animal.ID, ref)
386		if err != nil {
387			return nil, s.logFailure(ctx, "mark health events synced", err,
388				slog.String("animal_id", animal.ID.Hex()))
389		}
390		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "bharat pashudhan sync completed",
391			slog.String("animal_id", animal.ID.Hex()),
392			slog.Int64("synced_count", count),
393			slog.String("bp_sync_ref", ref),
394			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
395		return &BPSyncResponse{SyncedCount: count, BPSyncRef: ref}, nil
396	}

398	// CreateMVUCase opens a 1962 MVU request (§10). The DCS comes from the
399	// farmer's own animal when animal_id is given, else from the actor's org.
400	func (s *service) CreateMVUCase(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateMVUCaseRequest) (*domain.MVUCase, error) {
401		farmerID, err := actorID(actor)
402		if err != nil {
403			return nil, err
404		}
405		if strings.TrimSpace(req.Symptoms) == "" {
406			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("SYMPTOMS_REQUIRED", "symptoms description is required")
407		}
408	
409		var dcsID primitive.ObjectID
410		if actor.OrgUnitID != "" {
411			dcsID, err = httpx.ParseID(actor.OrgUnitID, "org_unit")
412			if err != nil {
413				return nil, err
414			}
415		}
416		var caseAnimalID *primitive.ObjectID
417		if req.AnimalID != nil && !req.AnimalID.IsZero() {
418			animal, err := s.repo.FindAnimalByID(ctx, *req.AnimalID)
419			if err != nil {
420				return nil, err
421			}
422			if animal.OwnerPartyID != farmerID {
423				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "mvu case rejected: animal not owned by caller",
424					slog.String("animal_id", animal.ID.Hex()),
425					slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
426				return nil, httpx.Forbidden("you may only raise an MVU case for your own animal")
427			}
428			id := animal.ID
429			caseAnimalID = &id
430			dcsID = animal.DCSID
431		}
432		if dcsID.IsZero() {
433			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("DCS_UNRESOLVED", "cannot resolve a DCS for this case — provide animal_id or use a DCS-scoped role token")
434		}
435	
436		mvuCase := &domain.MVUCase{
437			// Pre-generated so downstream logging/refs share one ID.
438			ID:            primitive.NewObjectID(),
439			AnimalID:      caseAnimalID,
440			FarmerPartyID: farmerID,
441			DCSID:         dcsID,
442			Symptoms:      strings.TrimSpace(req.Symptoms),
443			Status:        domain.MVUCaseRequested,
444			RequestedAt:   time.Now().UTC(),
445		}
446		if err := s.repo.InsertMVUCase(ctx, mvuCase); err != nil {
447			return nil, s.logFailure(ctx, "insert mvu case", err,
448				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
449		}
450		animalHex := ""
451		if mvuCase.AnimalID != nil {
452			animalHex = mvuCase.AnimalID.Hex()
453		}
454		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "mvu case created",
455			slog.String("case_id", mvuCase.ID.Hex()),
456			slog.String("farmer_party_id", mvuCase.FarmerPartyID.Hex()),
457			slog.String("dcs_id", mvuCase.DCSID.Hex()),
458			slog.String("animal_id", animalHex),
459			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
460		return mvuCase, nil
461	}
462	
463	// DispatchMVUCase moves a case REQUESTED → DISPATCHED, records the assignee
464	// from the caller's role, and publishes eventbus.TopicMVUDispatched with an
465	// explicit payload contract — keys: case_id, farmer_party_id, animal_id,
466	// dcs_id, values ObjectID hex strings (the notifications module reacts, §10).
467	func (s *service) DispatchMVUCase(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, caseID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.MVUCase, error) {
468		callerID, err := actorID(actor)
469		if err != nil {
470			return nil, err
471		}
472		mvuCase, err := s.repo.FindMVUCaseByID(ctx, caseID)
473		if err != nil {
474			return nil, err
475		}
476		if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, mvuCase.DCSID); err != nil {
477			return nil, s.logFailure(ctx, "dispatch mvu case scope check", err,
478				slog.String("case_id", mvuCase.ID.Hex()),
479				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
480		}
481	
482		var vetPartyID, driverPartyID *primitive.ObjectID
483		switch actor.RoleCode {
484		case domain.RoleVeterinarian:
485			vetPartyID = &callerID
486		case domain.RoleMVUDriver:
487			driverPartyID = &callerID
488			// Any other role reaching here is break-glass SUPER_ADMIN: the case
489			// is dispatched without pinning an assignee.
490		}
491	
492		transitioned, err := s.repo.DispatchMVUCase(ctx, mvuCase.ID, vetPartyID, driverPartyID)
493		if err != nil {
494			return nil, s.logFailure(ctx, "dispatch mvu case", err,
495				slog.String("case_id", mvuCase.ID.Hex()))
496		}
497		if !transitioned {
498			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "mvu dispatch rejected: case not in REQUESTED state",
499				slog.String("case_id", mvuCase.ID.Hex()),
500				slog.String("status", mvuCase.Status),
501				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
502			return nil, httpx.Conflict("MVU_NOT_REQUESTED", "MVU case is not in REQUESTED state")
503		}
504	
505		updated, err := s.repo.FindMVUCaseByID(ctx, mvuCase.ID)
506		if err != nil {
507			return nil, s.logFailure(ctx, "reload mvu case", err,
508				slog.String("case_id", mvuCase.ID.Hex()))
509		}
510		// Explicit event shape: the subscriber decodes structurally by JSON key,
511		// so the case ID must travel under "case_id" — publishing the raw domain
512		// document (whose ID marshals as "id") left the farmer SMS caseless.
513		// Values are ObjectID hex strings; a caseless animal travels as "".
514		animalHex := ""
515		if updated.AnimalID != nil {
516			animalHex = updated.AnimalID.Hex()
517		}
518		s.d.Bus.Publish(eventbus.TopicMVUDispatched, map[string]any{
519			"case_id":         updated.ID.Hex(),
520			"farmer_party_id": updated.FarmerPartyID.Hex(),
521			"animal_id":       animalHex,
522			"dcs_id":          updated.DCSID.Hex(),
523		})
524		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "mvu case dispatched",
525			slog.String("case_id", updated.ID.Hex()),
526			slog.String("farmer_party_id", updated.FarmerPartyID.Hex()),
527			slog.String("dcs_id", updated.DCSID.Hex()),
528			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
529			slog.String("actor_role", actor.RoleCode))
530		return updated, nil
531	}
532	
533	// CloseMVUCase moves a DISPATCHED/ARRIVED case to CLOSED with the visit log.
534	func (s *service) CloseMVUCase(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, caseID primitive.ObjectID, req CloseMVUCaseRequest) (*domain.MVUCase, error) {
535		if strings.TrimSpace(req.VisitNotes) == "" {
536			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VISIT_NOTES_REQUIRED", "visit_notes is required to close a case")
537		}
538		mvuCase, err := s.repo.FindMVUCaseByID(ctx, caseID)
539		if err != nil {
540			return nil, err
541		}
542		if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, mvuCase.DCSID); err != nil {
543			return nil, s.logFailure(ctx, "close mvu case scope check", err,
544				slog.String("case_id", mvuCase.ID.Hex()),
545				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
546		}
547	
548		transitioned, err := s.repo.CloseMVUCase(ctx, mvuCase.ID, strings.TrimSpace(req.VisitNotes), req.HealthEventIDs, time.Now().UTC())
549		if err != nil {
550			return nil, s.logFailure(ctx, "close mvu case", err,
551				slog.String("case_id", mvuCase.ID.Hex()))
552		}
553		if !transitioned {
554			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "mvu close rejected: case not DISPATCHED or ARRIVED",
555				slog.String("case_id", mvuCase.ID.Hex()),
556				slog.String("status", mvuCase.Status),
557				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
558			return nil, httpx.Conflict("MVU_NOT_OPEN", "MVU case must be DISPATCHED or ARRIVED to close")
559		}
560		closed, err := s.repo.FindMVUCaseByID(ctx, mvuCase.ID)
561		if err != nil {
562			return nil, s.logFailure(ctx, "reload mvu case", err,
563				slog.String("case_id", mvuCase.ID.Hex()))
564		}
565		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "mvu case closed",
566			slog.String("case_id", closed.ID.Hex()),

627			return nil, s.logFailure(ctx, "insert education content", err,
628				slog.String("topic", req.Topic))
629		}
630		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "education content created",
631			slog.String("content_id", content.ID.Hex()),
632			slog.String("topic", content.Topic),
633			slog.String("language", content.Language),
634			slog.Bool("published", content.Published))

638	// IngestTelemetry is the dormant collar path (§9). The capability gate runs
639	// FIRST: while flags.FlagCollarTelemetry is off the endpoint refuses with
640	// FEATURE_DISABLED, proving the backdoor is provisioned but inert. When the
641	// scheme lands and the flag flips, frames are acknowledged with 202 — the
642	// storage pipeline ships with the scheme, not before.
643	func (s *service) IngestTelemetry(ctx context.Context, req TelemetryRequest) (*TelemetryAck, error) {
644		if !s.d.Flags.Enabled(ctx, flags.FlagCollarTelemetry) {
645			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "collar telemetry rejected: feature gate disabled",
646				slog.String("flag", flags.FlagCollarTelemetry),
647				slog.String("pashu_aadhaar", req.PashuAadhaar))
648			aerr := httpx.Forbidden("collar telemetry is provisioned but dormant (§9)")
649			aerr.Code = "FEATURE_DISABLED"
650			return nil, aerr
651		}
652		if err := validatePashuAadhaar(req.PashuAadhaar); err != nil {
653			return nil, err
654		}
655		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "telemetry frame accepted",
656			slog.String("pashu_aadhaar", req.PashuAadhaar))
657		return &TelemetryAck{
658			Accepted:     true,
659			PashuAadhaar: req.PashuAadhaar,
660			Note:         "telemetry accepted; persistent storage lands with the collar scheme",
661		}, nil
662	}

10	// ParseID converts an ObjectID hex string (from JSON bodies, query params or
11	// JWT claims) into a primitive.ObjectID, or returns a 400 with the offending
12	// field name.
13	func ParseID(hex, field string) (primitive.ObjectID, error) {
14		id, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(hex)
15		if err != nil {
16			return primitive.NilObjectID, BadRequest("INVALID_ID", field+" must be a valid object id")
17		}
18		return id, nil
19	}
20	
21	// PathID extracts a chi URL parameter and parses it as an ObjectID.
22	func PathID(r *http.Request, param string) (primitive.ObjectID, error) {
23		return ParseID(chi.URLParam(r, param), param)
24	}

 `./internal/platform/orgscope/resolver.go`

```text
1	// Package orgscope answers the RBAC question "is this resource inside the
2	// caller's organisational scope?" in O(1) DB reads. Org units denormalise
3	// their ancestor chain into Path ([]ObjectID), so scope checking is a
4	// set-membership test — no recursive tree walks on the hot path.
5	package orgscope
6	
7	import (
8		"context"
9		"errors"
10		"sync"
11		"time"
12	
13		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
14		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
15		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
16	
17		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
18		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
19		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
20	)
21	
22	const collection = "org_units"
23	
24	type cachedOrg struct {
25		org domain.OrgUnit
26		at  time.Time
27	}
28	
29	// Resolver caches org units briefly (the tree changes rarely, reads are hot).
30	type Resolver struct {
31		coll *mongo.Collection
32		ttl  time.Duration
33	
34		mu    sync.RWMutex
35		cache map[string]cachedOrg // keyed by ObjectID hex
36	}
37	
38	// NewResolver binds the resolver to the database.
39	func NewResolver(db *mongo.Database) *Resolver {
40		return &Resolver{
41			coll:  db.Collection(collection),
42			ttl:   60 * time.Second,
43			cache: make(map[string]cachedOrg),
44		}
45	}
46	
47	// Get returns an org unit by ObjectID (cached).
48	func (r *Resolver) Get(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
49		key := id.Hex()
50		r.mu.RLock()
51		c, ok := r.cache[key]
52		r.mu.RUnlock()
53		if ok && time.Since(c.at) < r.ttl {
54			org := c.org
55			return &org, nil
56		}
57	
58		var org domain.OrgUnit
59		err := r.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&org)
60		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
61			return nil, httpx.NotFound("org unit " + key)
62		}
63		if err != nil {
64			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
65		}
66	
67		r.mu.Lock()
68		r.cache[key] = cachedOrg{org: org, at: time.Now()}
69		r.mu.Unlock()
70		return &org, nil
71	}
72	
73	// GetByCode returns an org unit by its unique human-readable business code
74	// (e.g. "DCS-01842") — display/lookup use only, never for joins.
75	func (r *Resolver) GetByCode(ctx context.Context, code string) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
76		var org domain.OrgUnit
77		err := r.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "code", Value: code}}).Decode(&org)
78		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
79			return nil, httpx.NotFound("org unit with code " + code)
80		}
81		if err != nil {
82			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
83		}
84		return &org, nil
85	}
86	
87	// Invalidate drops a cached entry (call after updates).
88	func (r *Resolver) Invalidate(id primitive.ObjectID) {
89		r.mu.Lock()
90		delete(r.cache, id.Hex())
91		r.mu.Unlock()
92	}
93	
94	// InScope reports whether target sits at-or-below scope in the hierarchy:
95	// true when scope == target, or scope appears in target's ancestor Path.
96	func (r *Resolver) InScope(ctx context.Context, scopeOrgID, targetOrgID primitive.ObjectID) (bool, error) {
97		if scopeOrgID == targetOrgID {
98			return true, nil
99		}
100		target, err := r.Get(ctx, targetOrgID)
101		if err != nil {
102			return false, err
103		}
104		for _, ancestor := range target.Path {
105			if ancestor == scopeOrgID {
106				return true, nil
107			}
108		}
109		return false, nil
110	}
111	
112	// RequireInScope enforces the actor's org scope over a target org unit.
113	// SUPER_ADMIN and STATE_AUDITOR (read-wide roles rooted at the federation)
114	// pass automatically; everyone else needs ancestry. The actor carries its
115	// org unit as an ObjectID hex string (JWT claims are JSON); it is parsed here.
116	func (r *Resolver) RequireInScope(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, targetOrgID primitive.ObjectID) error {
117		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSuperAdmin || actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleStateAuditor {
118			return nil
119		}
120		if actor.OrgUnitID == "" {
121			return httpx.Forbidden("role token with org scope required")
122		}
123		scopeID, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(actor.OrgUnitID)
124		if err != nil {
125			return httpx.Forbidden("role token carries an invalid org scope")
126		}
127		ok, err := r.InScope(ctx, scopeID, targetOrgID)
128		if err != nil {
129			return err
130		}
131		if !ok {
132			return httpx.Forbidden("resource is outside your organisational scope")
133		}
134		return nil
135	}
136
```
