1	// Package provenance implements the append-only, hash-chained event ledger —
2	// the source of truth for milk traceability (blueprint §7). Every link in the
3	// pour→QR chain is an immutable Event whose SHA-256 hash covers the previous
4	// event's hash, so history cannot be quietly rewritten (tamper-evidence,
5	// FSSAI recall-grade audit).
6	//
7	// Corrections are NEW events referencing the superseded entity — nothing is
8	// ever updated or deleted in this collection.
9	package provenance
10	
11	import (
12		"context"
13		"crypto/sha256"
14		"encoding/hex"
15		"encoding/json"
16		"errors"
17		"fmt"
18		"strconv"
19		"strings"
20		"sync"
21		"time"
22	
23		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
24		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
25		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
26		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo/options"
27	)
28	
29	const collection = "provenance_events"
30	
31	// Ref is a directed edge to another entity in the trace graph
32	// (e.g. a consignment event referencing the pours it aggregates).
33	type Ref struct {
34		EntityType string `bson:"entity_type" json:"entity_type"`
35		EntityID   string `bson:"entity_id"   json:"entity_id"`
36		Relation   string `bson:"relation"    json:"relation"` // aggregates | supersedes | tested | yields | labels ...
37	}
38	
39	// ActorRef records who caused the event.
40	type ActorRef struct {
41		PartyID  string `bson:"party_id"  json:"party_id"`
42		RoleCode string `bson:"role_code" json:"role_code"`
43	}
44	
45	// Event is one immutable link in the ledger. `_id` is a generated ObjectID;
46	// EntityID and Refs carry the referenced documents' ObjectIDs as hex strings
47	// (the ledger is a generic event log spanning every entity type, and hex
48	// strings keep the hash material canonical and human-inspectable).
49	type Event struct {
50		ID         primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
51		Seq        int64          `bson:"seq"         json:"seq"`
52		Type       string         `bson:"type"        json:"type"`
53		EntityType string         `bson:"entity_type" json:"entity_type"`
54		EntityID   string         `bson:"entity_id"   json:"entity_id"`
55		Refs       []Ref          `bson:"refs,omitempty"    json:"refs,omitempty"`
56		Actor      ActorRef       `bson:"actor"       json:"actor"`
57		OrgUnitID  string         `bson:"org_unit_id,omitempty" json:"org_unit_id,omitempty"`
58		Payload    map[string]any `bson:"payload,omitempty"     json:"payload,omitempty"`
59		TS         time.Time      `bson:"ts"          json:"ts"`
60		PrevHash   string         `bson:"prev_hash"   json:"prev_hash"`
61		Hash       string         `bson:"hash"        json:"hash"`
62	}
63	
64	// AppendInput describes a new event to chain.
65	type AppendInput struct {
66		Type       string
67		EntityType string
68		EntityID   string
69		Refs       []Ref
70		Actor      ActorRef
71		OrgUnitID  string
72		Payload    map[string]any
73	}
74	
75	// Ledger appends to and reads the hash chain.
76	type Ledger struct {
77		coll *mongo.Collection
78	
79		// appendMu serialises the head-read+insert of Append within this process:
80		// every ledger write system-wide shares one global seq, so without local
81		// serialisation concurrent handlers (e.g. a morning pour rush plus a
82		// GenerateInvoices loop) burn duplicate-key retries against each other.
83		// The unique seq index remains the atomic backstop across processes.
84		appendMu sync.Mutex
85	}
86	
87	// NewLedger binds the ledger to the database.
88	func NewLedger(db *mongo.Database) *Ledger {
89		return &Ledger{coll: db.Collection(collection)}
90	}
91	
92	// genesisHash anchors the chain before the first event.
93	const genesisHash = "GENESIS"
94	
95	// Append chains a new event. Concurrency-safe without transactions: it reads
96	// the current head, computes seq+hash optimistically, and relies on the
97	// unique index on `seq` — a duplicate-key collision means another writer won
98	// the slot, so we re-read and retry.
99	func (l *Ledger) Append(ctx context.Context, in AppendInput) (*Event, error) {
100		// Serialise appends within this process (see appendMu): local writers no
101		// longer race each other for the seq slot, so under single-instance
102		// deployment the retry loop only ever fires against external writers.
103		l.appendMu.Lock()
104		defer l.appendMu.Unlock()
105	
106		const maxRetries = 12
107		for attempt := 0; attempt < maxRetries; attempt++ {
108			seq, prevHash, err := l.head(ctx)
109			if err != nil {
110				return nil, err
111			}
112			ev := &Event{
113				ID:         primitive.NewObjectID(),
114				Seq:        seq + 1,
115				Type:       in.Type,
116				EntityType: in.EntityType,
117				EntityID:   in.EntityID,
118				Refs:       in.Refs,
119				Actor:      in.Actor,
120				OrgUnitID:  in.OrgUnitID,
121				Payload:    in.Payload,
122				// Millisecond precision: BSON datetimes store ms, so the persisted
123				// TS must equal the hashed TS or re-verification would break.
124				TS:       time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Millisecond),
125				PrevHash: prevHash,
126			}
127			ev.Hash = computeHash(ev)
128	
129			if _, err := l.coll.InsertOne(ctx, ev); err != nil {
130				if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(err) {
131					continue // lost the seq race — retry against the new head
132				}
133				return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance append: %w", err)
134			}
135			return ev, nil
136		}
137		return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance append: gave up after %d seq collisions", 12)
138	}
139	
140	// head returns the latest (seq, hash), or (0, GENESIS) for an empty chain.
141	func (l *Ledger) head(ctx context.Context) (int64, string, error) {
142		var last Event
143		err := l.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{},
144			options.FindOne().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: -1}}),
145		).Decode(&last)
146		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
147			return 0, genesisHash, nil
148		}
149		if err != nil {
150			return 0, "", fmt.Errorf("provenance head: %w", err)
151		}
152		return last.Seq, last.Hash, nil
153	}
154	
155	// computeHash covers everything that matters: position, linkage, content.
156	// Payload is canonicalised via encoding/json (map keys are sorted) and the
157	// timestamp to millisecond precision (BSON datetime resolution), so the
158	// digest is deterministic across a MongoDB round trip.
159	func computeHash(ev *Event) string {
160		payloadJSON, _ := json.Marshal(ev.Payload)
161		refParts := make([]string, 0, len(ev.Refs))
162		for _, r := range ev.Refs {
163			refParts = append(refParts, r.EntityType+":"+r.EntityID+":"+r.Relation)
164		}
165		material := strings.Join([]string{
166			ev.PrevHash,
167			strconv.FormatInt(ev.Seq, 10),
168			ev.Type,
169			ev.EntityType,
170			ev.EntityID,
171			strings.Join(refParts, ","),
172			ev.Actor.PartyID,
173			ev.Actor.RoleCode,
174			ev.OrgUnitID,
175			string(payloadJSON),
176			ev.TS.UTC().Truncate(time.Millisecond).Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
177		}, "|")
178		sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(material))
179		return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
180	}
181	
182	// EventsForEntity returns an entity's own timeline in chain order.
183	func (l *Ledger) EventsForEntity(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string) ([]Event, error) {
184		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
185			bson.D{{Key: "entity_type", Value: entityType}, {Key: "entity_id", Value: entityID}},
186			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}),
187		)
188		if err != nil {
189			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance events for %s/%s: %w", entityType, entityID, err)
190		}
191		var out []Event
192		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
193			return nil, err
194		}
195		return out, nil
196	}
197	
198	// Trace walks the provenance graph UPSTREAM from an entity: its events, plus
199	// (recursively) the events of everything those events reference. This is how
200	// a consumer QR resolves back to the contributing samiti set, and how a failed
201	// aflatoxin test walks back to source DCSes (blueprint §8.3).
202	func (l *Ledger) Trace(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, maxDepth int) ([]Event, error) {
203		return l.TraceStopAt(ctx, entityType, entityID, maxDepth, nil)
204	}
205	
206	// TraceStopAt is Trace with a stop set: entity types in stopExpand are still
207	// fetched (their events appear in the result) but their refs are never
208	// followed. The consumer QR scan stops at the consignment/pooling boundary so
209	// hundreds of per-pour nodes (and cross-route trip fan-out) are never walked.
210	//
211	// Each BFS level is batched into a bounded number of $or queries instead of
212	// one Find per node, so a walk costs O(depth) round trips, not O(nodes).
213	func (l *Ledger) TraceStopAt(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, maxDepth int, stopExpand map[string]bool) ([]Event, error) {
214		if maxDepth <= 0 {
215			maxDepth = 10
216		}
217		const hardEventCap = 2000
218	
219		type node struct{ etype, eid string }
220		visited := map[node]bool{}
221		frontier := []node{{entityType, entityID}}
222		var all []Event
223	
224		for depth := 0; depth < maxDepth && len(frontier) > 0; depth++ {
225			// Deduplicate this level against everything already visited.
226			level := make([]node, 0, len(frontier))
227			for _, n := range frontier {
228				if visited[n] {
229					continue
230				}
231				visited[n] = true
232				level = append(level, n)
233			}
234			if len(level) == 0 {
235				break
236			}
237	
238			var next []node
239			// One indexed query per chunk of the level (not per node).
240			const orChunk = 200
241			for start := 0; start < len(level); start += orChunk {
242				end := min(start+orChunk, len(level))
243				clauses := make(bson.A, 0, end-start)
244				for _, n := range level[start:end] {
245					clauses = append(clauses, bson.D{
246						{Key: "entity_type", Value: n.etype},
247						{Key: "entity_id", Value: n.eid},
248					})
249				}
250				cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
251					bson.D{{Key: "$or", Value: clauses}},
252					options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}).SetLimit(hardEventCap),
253				)
254				if err != nil {
255					return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance trace level: %w", err)
256				}
257				var evs []Event
258				if err := cur.All(ctx, &evs); err != nil {
259					return nil, err
260				}
261				for _, ev := range evs {
262					all = append(all, ev)
263					if len(all) >= hardEventCap {
264						return all, nil
265					}
266					if stopExpand != nil && stopExpand[ev.EntityType] {
267						continue // include the node's events, never follow its refs
268					}
269					for _, ref := range ev.Refs {
270						nn := node{ref.EntityType, ref.EntityID}
271						if !visited[nn] {
272							next = append(next, nn)
273						}
274					}
275				}
276			}
277			frontier = next
278		}
279		return all, nil
280	}
281	
282	// DownstreamRefs finds events that reference the given entity — used to walk
283	// FORWARD (e.g. "which batches consumed this blocked BMC lot?"). The limit is
284	// pushed into the query: only the LAST limit referencing events are fetched
285	// (ascending chain order preserved). limit <= 0 falls back to 2000.
286	func (l *Ledger) DownstreamRefs(ctx context.Context, entityID string, limit int64) ([]Event, error) {
287		if limit <= 0 {
288			limit = 2000
289		}
290		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
291			bson.D{{Key: "refs.entity_id", Value: entityID}},
292			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: -1}}).SetLimit(limit),
293		)
294		if err != nil {
295			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance downstream of %s: %w", entityID, err)
296		}
297		var out []Event
298		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
299			return nil, err
300		}
301		// Restore ascending chain order.
302		for i, j := 0, len(out)-1; i < j; i, j = i+1, j-1 {
303			out[i], out[j] = out[j], out[i]
304		}
305		return out, nil
306	}
307	
308	// EventsForEntityPage returns one page of an entity's own timeline in chain
309	// order, with skip/limit pushed into the query.
310	func (l *Ledger) EventsForEntityPage(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, offset, limit int64) ([]Event, error) {
311		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
312			bson.D{{Key: "entity_type", Value: entityType}, {Key: "entity_id", Value: entityID}},
313			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}).SetSkip(offset).SetLimit(limit),
314		)
315		if err != nil {
316			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance events page for %s/%s: %w", entityType, entityID, err)
317		}
318		var out []Event
319		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
320			return nil, err
321		}
322		return out, nil
323	}
324	
325	// CountEventsForEntity returns the total number of events on an entity's
326	// timeline (pagination meta companion of EventsForEntityPage).
327	func (l *Ledger) CountEventsForEntity(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string) (int64, error) {
328		n, err := l.coll.CountDocuments(ctx,
329			bson.D{{Key: "entity_type", Value: entityType}, {Key: "entity_id", Value: entityID}})
330		if err != nil {
331			return 0, fmt.Errorf("provenance count for %s/%s: %w", entityType, entityID, err)
332		}
333		return n, nil
334	}
335	
336	// VerifyChain re-derives every hash in [fromSeq, toSeq] and checks linkage.
337	// Returns (true, 0) when intact, or (false, seq) of the first broken link.
338	func (l *Ledger) VerifyChain(ctx context.Context, fromSeq, toSeq int64) (bool, int64, error) {
339		filter := bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$gte", Value: fromSeq}, {Key: "$lte", Value: toSeq}}}}
340		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}))
341		if err != nil {
342			return false, 0, fmt.Errorf("provenance verify: %w", err)
343		}
344		defer cur.Close(ctx)
345	
346		prevHash := ""
347		prevSeq := int64(0)
348		first := true
349		for cur.Next(ctx) {
350			var ev Event
351			if err := cur.Decode(&ev); err != nil {
352				return false, 0, err
353			}
354			if computeHash(&ev) != ev.Hash {
355				return false, ev.Seq, nil // content tampered
356			}
357			if !first {
358				if ev.Seq != prevSeq+1 || ev.PrevHash != prevHash {
359					return false, ev.Seq, nil // linkage broken
360				}
361			}
362			prevHash, prevSeq, first = ev.Hash, ev.Seq, false
363		}
364		return true, 0, cur.Err()
365	}
366	
367	// LatestSeq returns the current chain head sequence (0 = empty).
368	func (l *Ledger) LatestSeq(ctx context.Context) (int64, error) {
369		seq, _, err := l.head(ctx)
370		return seq, err
371	}

1	package domain

3	import (
4		"time"
5	
6		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
7	)
8	
9	// Org-unit types — the cooperative backbone RBAC is scoped to (blueprint §5.1,
10	// PCDF constitution: Samiti/DCS → Sangh/Union → PCDF apex).
11	const (
12		OrgTypeFederation      = "FEDERATION"       // PCDF / Parag (state apex)
13		OrgTypeMilkUnion       = "MILK_UNION"       // district Sangh
14		OrgTypeProcessingPlant = "PROCESSING_PLANT" // PCDF plant
15		OrgTypeBMC             = "BMC"              // bulk milk cooler / chilling centre
16		OrgTypeDCS             = "DCS"              // village samiti
17	)
18	
19	// AllOrgTypes is the closed set of org-unit types.
20	var AllOrgTypes = []string{
21		OrgTypeFederation, OrgTypeMilkUnion, OrgTypeProcessingPlant, OrgTypeBMC, OrgTypeDCS,
22	}
23	
24	// ValidOrgParent encodes the allowed hierarchy edges.
25	var ValidOrgParent = map[string][]string{
26		OrgTypeFederation:      {}, // root
27		OrgTypeMilkUnion:       {OrgTypeFederation},
28		OrgTypeProcessingPlant: {OrgTypeMilkUnion, OrgTypeFederation},
29		OrgTypeBMC:             {OrgTypeMilkUnion},
30		OrgTypeDCS:             {OrgTypeMilkUnion, OrgTypeBMC},
31	}
32	
33	// OrgUnit is a node in the cooperative hierarchy.
34	//
35	// ID scheme: `_id` is a generated ObjectID (relations always reference it);
36	// Code is the human-readable unique business key (e.g. "DCS-01842") used for
37	// display, lookups and seed idempotency — never for joins.
38	//
39	// Path holds the ObjectIDs of all ancestors from the root down to (and
40	// excluding) this node — denormalised so "is X inside Y's scope" is a single
41	// indexed array-containment check with no recursive queries on the hot path.
42	type OrgUnit struct {
43		ID        primitive.ObjectID   `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
44		Type      string               `bson:"type"          json:"type"`
45		Name      string               `bson:"name"          json:"name"`
46		Code      string               `bson:"code"          json:"code"` // unique business key, e.g. "DCS-01842"
47		ParentID  *primitive.ObjectID  `bson:"parent_id,omitempty" json:"parent_id,omitempty"`
48		Path      []primitive.ObjectID `bson:"path"          json:"path"`
49		District  string               `bson:"district,omitempty" json:"district,omitempty"`
50		State     string               `bson:"state,omitempty"    json:"state,omitempty"`
51		GeoLat    float64              `bson:"geo_lat,omitempty"  json:"geo_lat,omitempty"`
52		GeoLng    float64              `bson:"geo_lng,omitempty"  json:"geo_lng,omitempty"`
53		Active    bool                 `bson:"active"        json:"active"`
54		CreatedAt time.Time            `bson:"created_at"    json:"created_at"`
55		UpdatedAt time.Time            `bson:"updated_at"    json:"updated_at"`
56	}
57	
58	// IsValidOrgType reports whether t is a known org-unit type.
59	func IsValidOrgType(t string) bool {
60		for _, v := range AllOrgTypes {
61			if v == t {
62				return true
63			}
64		}
65		return false
66	}

8	)

10	// FSSAI limits for liquid milk (blueprint §8.3). Aflatoxin M1 is heat-stable
11	// and survives pasteurisation, so it MUST be gated upstream (BMC + plant),
12	// never only at the finished product.
13	const (
14		FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg = 0.5  // AFM1 ≤ 0.5 µg/kg
15		FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl          = 10.0 // coliform ≤ 10 CFU/ml
16		FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg       = 0.1  // antibiotic MRL example
17	)
18	
19	// QC test names.
20	const (
21		TestAflatoxinM1 = "AFLATOXIN_M1"            // µg/kg
22		TestColiform    = "COLIFORM"                // CFU/ml
23		TestTPC         = "TPC"                     // CFU/ml, graded — recorded, not hard-gated here
24		TestAntibiotic  = "ANTIBIOTIC_TETRACYCLINE" // mg/kg
25		TestPhosphatase = "PHOSPHATASE"             // 0 = negative (pass post-pasteurisation), 1 = positive
26		TestFat         = "FAT"                     // %
27		TestSNF         = "SNF"                     // %
28	)
29	
30	// QC stages.
31	const (
32		QCStageBMCRapid = "BMC_RAPID" // strip/rapid tests at the chilling centre
33		QCStagePlantLab = "PLANT_LAB" // full lab: ELISA/HPLC, culture, LC-MS/MS
34	)
35	
36	// QC subject types.
37	const (
38		QCSubjectDCSConsignment  = "DCS_CONSIGNMENT"
39		QCSubjectBMCLot          = "BMC_LOT"
40		QCSubjectProcessingBatch = "PROCESSING_BATCH"
41	)
42	
43	// QCTest is a single measurement inside a QC result.
44	type QCTest struct {
45		Name  string  `bson:"name"  json:"name"`
46		Value float64 `bson:"value" json:"value"`
47		Unit  string  `bson:"unit"  json:"unit"`
48		Pass  bool    `bson:"pass"  json:"pass"`
49	}
50	
51	// QCResult is the recorded outcome of testing one subject at one stage.
52	// OverallPass drives the safety gate; a certificate is attached to provenance
53	// on pass, a block + quarantine on fail.
54	type QCResult struct {
55		ID                primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
56		SubjectType       string             `bson:"subject_type"  json:"subject_type"`
57		SubjectID         primitive.ObjectID `bson:"subject_id"    json:"subject_id"`
58		Stage             string             `bson:"stage"         json:"stage"`
59		Tests             []QCTest           `bson:"tests"         json:"tests"`
60		OverallPass       bool               `bson:"overall_pass"  json:"overall_pass"`
61		FailureReasons    []string           `bson:"failure_reasons,omitempty" json:"failure_reasons,omitempty"`
62		AnalystPartyID    primitive.ObjectID `bson:"analyst_party_id" json:"analyst_party_id"`
63		LabRef            string             `bson:"lab_ref,omitempty"            json:"lab_ref,omitempty"`
64		CertificateNumber string             `bson:"certificate_number,omitempty" json:"certificate_number,omitempty"`
65		// Superseded marks a result voided after losing the gate race — the
66		// verdict on the subject came from a different, earlier result.
67		Superseded    bool      `bson:"superseded,omitempty" json:"superseded,omitempty"`
68		RecordedAt    time.Time `bson:"recorded_at"   json:"recorded_at"`
69		ProvenanceSeq int64     `bson:"provenance_seq,omitempty" json:"provenance_seq,omitempty"`
70	}
71	
72	// EvaluateQCTests applies the FSSAI gate to a set of tests: it fills each
73	// test's Pass verdict and returns the overall verdict plus human-readable
74	// failure reasons. Unknown test names are recorded but do not gate.
75	func EvaluateQCTests(tests []QCTest) (overallPass bool, failures []string, evaluated []QCTest) {
76		overallPass = true
77		evaluated = make([]QCTest, 0, len(tests))
78		for _, t := range tests {
79			pass := true
80			switch t.Name {
81			case TestAflatoxinM1:
82				if t.Value > FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg {
83					pass = false
84					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
85						"AFLATOXIN_M1 %.3f µg/kg exceeds FSSAI limit %.1f µg/kg", t.Value, FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg))
86				}
87			case TestColiform:
88				if t.Value > FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl {
89					pass = false
90					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
91						"COLIFORM %.1f CFU/ml exceeds FSSAI limit %.0f CFU/ml", t.Value, FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl))
92				}
93			case TestAntibiotic:
94				if t.Value > FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg {
95					pass = false
96					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
97						"ANTIBIOTIC_TETRACYCLINE %.3f mg/kg exceeds MRL %.1f mg/kg", t.Value, FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg))
98				}
99			case TestPhosphatase:
100				if t.Value != 0 {
101					pass = false
102					failures = append(failures, "PHOSPHATASE positive — pasteurisation check failed (must be negative)")
103				}
104			}
105			t.Pass = pass
106			if !pass {
107				overallPass = false
108			}
109			evaluated = append(evaluated, t)
110		}
111		return overallPass, failures, evaluated
112	}

2	// the FEDERATION → MILK_UNION → {PROCESSING_PLANT, BMC, DCS} org-unit tree.
3	// It owns org-unit creation and edits (PCDF/state admins), directory reads
4	// for any authenticated party, subtree reads for oversight roles, and the
5	// membership roster (active role assignments joined with parties).

9		"log/slog"

11		"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"

13		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"

15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/middleware"
16	)

18	// Register mounts the orgs module under /orgs on the /api/v1 subtree.
19	func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
20		log := d.Log.With(slog.String("module", "orgs"))
21		repo := newRepository(d.DB)
22		svc := newService(repo, d.Orgs, log)
23		h := newHandler(svc)
24	
25		r.Route("/orgs", func(r chi.Router) {
26			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
27	
28			// Hierarchy writes — state-apex administrators only.
29			r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
30				r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSuperAdmin, domain.RolePCDFAdmin))
31				r.Post("/", h.create)
32				r.Patch("/{id}", h.update)
33			})
34	
35			// Directory reads — any authenticated party (session or role token).
36			r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
37				r.Use(middleware.RequireSession)
38				r.Get("/", h.list)
39				r.Get("/{id}", h.get)
40				r.Get("/{id}/children", h.children)
41			})
42	
43			// Subtree read — oversight roles, scope-checked in the service.
44			r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
45				r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(
46					domain.RoleSuperAdmin,
47					domain.RolePCDFAdmin,
48					domain.RoleMissionOfficial,
49					domain.RoleUnionPresident,
50					domain.RoleStateAuditor,
51				))

1	// Package quality implements QC recording and THE safety-gate verdict writer
2	// (blueprint §8.3). It is the only module permitted to move a BMC lot or a
3	// processing batch out of QC_PENDING: a passing result certifies the subject
4	// (PASSED + certificate), a failing result quarantines it (BLOCKED + reasons).
5	// Aflatoxin M1 is heat-stable and survives pasteurisation, so this gate runs
6	// upstream at the BMC and the plant lab — never only at the finished product.
7	//
8	// A blocked subject can never advance; the plant module enforces that by
9	// refusing blocked inputs and by reacting to eventbus.TopicGateBlocked.
10	package quality
11	
12	import (
13		"log/slog"
14	
15		"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
16	
17		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
18		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
19		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/middleware"
20	)
21	
22	// Register wires the quality module and mounts its routes under /quality
23	// (the router hands us the /api/v1 subtree).
24	func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
25		log := d.Log.With(slog.String("module", "quality"))
26		repo := newRepository(d.DB)
27		svc := newService(d, repo, log)
28		h := newHandler(svc)
29	
30		r.Route("/quality", func(r chi.Router) {
31			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
32	
33			// FSSAI limit constants — reference data for any signed-in client.
34			r.With(middleware.RequireSession).Get("/limits", h.getLimits)
35	
36			// Verdict writing: analyst roles only. Both roles share the endpoint;
37			// the stage×role pairing (BMC_RAPID↔BMC_OPERATOR, PLANT_LAB↔
38			// PLANT_LAB_ANALYST) is enforced in the service.
39			r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleBMCOperator, domain.RolePlantLabAnalyst)).
40				Post("/qc-results", h.recordQCResult)
41	
42			// Reads for supply-chain staff and oversight roles.
43			readRoles := middleware.RequireRoles(
44				domain.RoleBMCOperator,
45				domain.RolePlantLabAnalyst,
46				domain.RolePlantOperator,
47				domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor,
48				domain.RoleMissionOfficial,
49				domain.RoleStateAuditor,
50			)
51			r.With(readRoles).Get("/qc-results", h.listQCResults)
52			r.With(readRoles).Get("/qc-results/{id}", h.getQCResult)
53		})
54	}

1	package orgs
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"errors"
6		"fmt"
7	
8		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
9		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
10		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
11		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo/options"
12	
13		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
14		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/mongodb"
16	)
17	
18	// repository is the module's only MongoDB access point. It reads the
19	// role_assignments and parties collections (allowed by spec for the members
20	// roster) but writes only org_units.
21	//
22	// Error contract: missing documents surface as httpx.NotFound (a business
23	// outcome); every other failure is returned as a raw error wrapped with the
24	// failing operation so the service can log it before mapping to a 500.
25	type repository struct {
26		orgs        *mongo.Collection
27		assignments *mongo.Collection
28		parties     *mongo.Collection
29	}
30	
31	func newRepository(db *mongo.Database) *repository {
32		return &repository{
33			orgs:        db.Collection(mongodb.CollOrgUnits),
34			assignments: db.Collection(mongodb.CollRoleAssignments),
35			parties:     db.Collection(mongodb.CollParties),
36		}
37	}
38	
39	// insertOrg inserts a new org unit (its _id is pre-generated by the service).
40	// The driver error stays inspectable (%w) so the service can map a
41	// duplicate-key violation on code to a Conflict.
42	func (r *repository) insertOrg(ctx context.Context, org *domain.OrgUnit) error {
43		if _, err := r.orgs.InsertOne(ctx, org); err != nil {
44			return fmt.Errorf("insert org unit: %w", err)
45		}
46		return nil
47	}
48	
49	// getOrg fetches one org unit by ObjectID.
50	func (r *repository) getOrg(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
51		var org domain.OrgUnit
52		err := r.orgs.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&org)
53		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
54			return nil, httpx.NotFound("org unit " + id.Hex())
55		}
56		if err != nil {
57			return nil, fmt.Errorf("get org unit %s: %w", id.Hex(), err)
58		}
59		return &org, nil
60	}
61	
62	// countByType counts org units of the given type (federation-uniqueness check).
63	func (r *repository) countByType(ctx context.Context, orgType string) (int64, error) {
64		n, err := r.orgs.CountDocuments(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "type", Value: orgType}})
65		if err != nil {
66			return 0, fmt.Errorf("count org units by type %s: %w", orgType, err)
67		}
68		return n, nil
69	}
70	
71	// updateOrg applies a $set patch and returns the updated document.
72	func (r *repository) updateOrg(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID, set bson.D) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
73		var org domain.OrgUnit
74		err := r.orgs.FindOneAndUpdate(ctx,
75			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}},
76			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: set}},
77			options.FindOneAndUpdate().SetReturnDocument(options.After),
78		).Decode(&org)
79		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
80			return nil, httpx.NotFound("org unit " + id.Hex())
81		}
82		if err != nil {
83			return nil, fmt.Errorf("update org unit %s: %w", id.Hex(), err)
84		}
85		return &org, nil
86	}
87	
88	// listChildren pages the direct children of an org unit (parent_id index)
89	// and returns the total child count for pagination meta.
90	func (r *repository) listChildren(ctx context.Context, parentID primitive.ObjectID, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.OrgUnit, int64, error) {
91		filter := bson.D{{Key: "parent_id", Value: parentID}}
92		total, err := r.orgs.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
93		if err != nil {
94			return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("count org children: %w", err)
95		}
96		units, err := r.findOrgs(ctx, filter,
97			options.Find().
98				SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "code", Value: 1}}).
99				SetSkip(page.Offset).
100				SetLimit(page.Limit))
101		if err != nil {
102			return nil, 0, err
103		}
104		return units, total, nil
105	}
106	
107	// listOrgs pages org units matching an arbitrary filter (type/district/code)
108	// and returns the total matching count for pagination meta.
109	func (r *repository) listOrgs(ctx context.Context, filter bson.D, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.OrgUnit, int64, error) {
110		total, err := r.orgs.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
111		if err != nil {
112			return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("count org units: %w", err)
113		}
114		units, err := r.findOrgs(ctx, filter,
115			options.Find().
116				SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "code", Value: 1}}).
117				SetSkip(page.Offset).
118				SetLimit(page.Limit))
119		if err != nil {
120			return nil, 0, err
121		}
122		return units, total, nil
123	}
124	
125	// listDescendants returns every org unit whose ancestor Path contains rootID
126	// (path index, ObjectID array containment), capped at limit nodes.
127	func (r *repository) listDescendants(ctx context.Context, rootID primitive.ObjectID, limit int64) ([]domain.OrgUnit, error) {
128		return r.findOrgs(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "path", Value: rootID}},
129			options.Find().
130				SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "code", Value: 1}}).
131				SetLimit(limit))
132	}
133	
134	func (r *repository) findOrgs(ctx context.Context, filter bson.D, opts *options.FindOptions) ([]domain.OrgUnit, error) {
135		cur, err := r.orgs.Find(ctx, filter, opts)
136		if err != nil {
137			return nil, fmt.Errorf("find org units: %w", err)
138		}
139		units := []domain.OrgUnit{}
140		if err := cur.All(ctx, &units); err != nil {
141			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode org units: %w", err)
142		}
143		return units, nil
144	}
145	
146	// countActiveAssignments counts the ACTIVE role assignments at one org unit —
147	// the members-listing total.
148	func (r *repository) countActiveAssignments(ctx context.Context, orgID primitive.ObjectID) (int64, error) {
149		n, err := r.assignments.CountDocuments(ctx, bson.D{
150			{Key: "org_unit_id", Value: orgID},
151			{Key: "status", Value: domain.RoleAssignmentActive},
152		})
153		if err != nil {
154			return 0, fmt.Errorf("count active role assignments: %w", err)
155		}
156		return n, nil
157	}
158	
159	// listActiveAssignments pages the ACTIVE role assignments at one org unit
160	// (org_unit_id + role_code + status index).
161	func (r *repository) listActiveAssignments(ctx context.Context, orgID primitive.ObjectID, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.RoleAssignment, error) {
162		cur, err := r.assignments.Find(ctx,
163			bson.D{
164				{Key: "org_unit_id", Value: orgID},
165				{Key: "status", Value: domain.RoleAssignmentActive},
166			},
167			options.Find().
168				SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "role_code", Value: 1}, {Key: "created_at", Value: 1}}).
169				SetSkip(page.Offset).
170				SetLimit(page.Limit))
171		if err != nil {
172			return nil, fmt.Errorf("find active role assignments: %w", err)
173		}
174		assignments := []domain.RoleAssignment{}
175		if err := cur.All(ctx, &assignments); err != nil {
176			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode role assignments: %w", err)
177		}
178		return assignments, nil
179	}
180	
181	// partiesByIDs fetches the given parties keyed by ObjectID for the in-memory join.
182	func (r *repository) partiesByIDs(ctx context.Context, ids []primitive.ObjectID) (map[primitive.ObjectID]domain.Party, error) {
183		byID := make(map[primitive.ObjectID]domain.Party, len(ids))
184		if len(ids) == 0 {
185			return byID, nil
186		}
187		cur, err := r.parties.Find(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: ids}}}})
188		if err != nil {
189			return nil, fmt.Errorf("find parties: %w", err)
190		}
191		var parties []domain.Party
192		if err := cur.All(ctx, &parties); err != nil {
193			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode parties: %w", err)
194		}
195		for _, p := range parties {
196			byID[p.ID] = p
197		}
198		return byID, nil
199	}

1	package quality
2	
3	import (
4		"net/http"
5		"strconv"
6		"strings"
7	
8		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
9	
10		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
11		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
12	)
13	
14	// handler is the HTTP layer: decode, validate shape, call service, respond.
15	type handler struct {
16		svc *service
17	}
18	
19	// newHandler wires the handler.
20	func newHandler(svc *service) *handler {
21		return &handler{svc: svc}
22	}
23	
24	// recordQCResult handles POST /quality/qc-results.
25	func (h *handler) recordQCResult(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
26		actor, ok := auth.ActorFrom(r.Context())
27		if !ok {
28			httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Unauthorized("authentication required"))
29			return
30		}
31	
32		var req RecordQCResultRequest
33		if err := httpx.DecodeJSON(r, &req); err != nil {
34			httpx.Error(w, r, err)
35			return
36		}
37		if err := validateRecordRequest(req); err != nil {
38			httpx.Error(w, r, err)
39			return
40		}
41	
42		result, err := h.svc.recordQCResult(r.Context(), actor, req)
43		if err != nil {
44			httpx.Error(w, r, err)
45			return
46		}
47		httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusCreated, result)
48	}
49	
50	// validateRecordRequest checks required fields and test shape.
51	func validateRecordRequest(req RecordQCResultRequest) error {
52		if strings.TrimSpace(req.SubjectType) == "" {
53			return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_SUBJECT_TYPE", "subject_type is required")
54		}
55		if req.SubjectID.IsZero() {
56			return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_SUBJECT_ID", "subject_id is required")
57		}
58		if strings.TrimSpace(req.Stage) == "" {
59			return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_STAGE", "stage is required")
60		}
61		if len(req.Tests) == 0 {
62			return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_TESTS", "at least one test is required")
63		}
64		for i, t := range req.Tests {
65			if strings.TrimSpace(t.Name) == "" {
66				return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_TEST_NAME", "tests["+strconv.Itoa(i)+"].name is required")
67			}
68			if t.Value < 0 {
69				return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_TEST_VALUE", "tests["+strconv.Itoa(i)+"].value must not be negative")
70			}
71		}
72		return nil
73	}
74	
75	// listQCResults handles GET /quality/qc-results?subject_type=&subject_id=.
76	func (h *handler) listQCResults(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
77		actor, ok := auth.ActorFrom(r.Context())
78		if !ok {
79			httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Unauthorized("authentication required"))
80			return
81		}
82	
83		subjectType := r.URL.Query().Get("subject_type")
84		subjectID := primitive.NilObjectID
85		if raw := r.URL.Query().Get("subject_id"); raw != "" {
86			id, err := httpx.ParseID(raw, "subject_id")
87			if err != nil {
88				httpx.Error(w, r, err)
89				return
90			}
91			subjectID = id
92		}
93		page := httpx.ParsePage(r)
94	
95		results, total, err := h.svc.listQCResults(r.Context(), actor, subjectType, subjectID, page)
96		if err != nil {
97			httpx.Error(w, r, err)
98			return
99		}
100		httpx.JSONMeta(w, http.StatusOK, results, listMeta{Limit: page.Limit, Offset: page.Offset, Total: total})
101	}
102	
103	// getQCResult handles GET /quality/qc-results/{id}.
104	func (h *handler) getQCResult(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
105		actor, ok := auth.ActorFrom(r.Context())
106		if !ok {
107			httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Unauthorized("authentication required"))
108			return
109		}
110	
111		id, err := httpx.PathID(r, "id")
112		if err != nil {
113			httpx.Error(w, r, err)
114			return
115		}
116	
117		result, err := h.svc.getQCResult(r.Context(), actor, id)
118		if err != nil {
119			httpx.Error(w, r, err)
120			return
121		}
122		httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, result)
123	}

1	// Package provenance implements the append-only, hash-chained event ledger —
2	// the source of truth for milk traceability (blueprint §7). Every link in the
3	// pour→QR chain is an immutable Event whose SHA-256 hash covers the previous
4	// event's hash, so history cannot be quietly rewritten (tamper-evidence,
5	// FSSAI recall-grade audit).
6	//
7	// Corrections are NEW events referencing the superseded entity — nothing is
8	// ever updated or deleted in this collection.
9	package provenance
10	
11	import (
12		"context"
13		"crypto/sha256"
14		"encoding/hex"
15		"encoding/json"
16		"errors"
17		"fmt"
18		"strconv"
19		"strings"
20		"sync"
21		"time"
22	
23		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
24		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
25		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
26		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo/options"
27	)
28	
29	const collection = "provenance_events"
30	
31	// Ref is a directed edge to another entity in the trace graph
32	// (e.g. a consignment event referencing the pours it aggregates).
33	type Ref struct {
34		EntityType string `bson:"entity_type" json:"entity_type"`
35		EntityID   string `bson:"entity_id"   json:"entity_id"`
36		Relation   string `bson:"relation"    json:"relation"` // aggregates | supersedes | tested | yields | labels ...
37	}
38	
39	// ActorRef records who caused the event.
40	type ActorRef struct {
41		PartyID  string `bson:"party_id"  json:"party_id"`
42		RoleCode string `bson:"role_code" json:"role_code"`
43	}
44	
45	// Event is one immutable link in the ledger. `_id` is a generated ObjectID;
46	// EntityID and Refs carry the referenced documents' ObjectIDs as hex strings
47	// (the ledger is a generic event log spanning every entity type, and hex
48	// strings keep the hash material canonical and human-inspectable).
49	type Event struct {
50		ID         primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
51		Seq        int64          `bson:"seq"         json:"seq"`
52		Type       string         `bson:"type"        json:"type"`
53		EntityType string         `bson:"entity_type" json:"entity_type"`
54		EntityID   string         `bson:"entity_id"   json:"entity_id"`
55		Refs       []Ref          `bson:"refs,omitempty"    json:"refs,omitempty"`
56		Actor      ActorRef       `bson:"actor"       json:"actor"`
57		OrgUnitID  string         `bson:"org_unit_id,omitempty" json:"org_unit_id,omitempty"`
58		Payload    map[string]any `bson:"payload,omitempty"     json:"payload,omitempty"`
59		TS         time.Time      `bson:"ts"          json:"ts"`
60		PrevHash   string         `bson:"prev_hash"   json:"prev_hash"`
61		Hash       string         `bson:"hash"        json:"hash"`
62	}
63	
64	// AppendInput describes a new event to chain.
65	type AppendInput struct {
66		Type       string
67		EntityType string
68		EntityID   string
69		Refs       []Ref
70		Actor      ActorRef
71		OrgUnitID  string
72		Payload    map[string]any
73	}
74	
75	// Ledger appends to and reads the hash chain.
76	type Ledger struct {
77		coll *mongo.Collection
78	
79		// appendMu serialises the head-read+insert of Append within this process:
80		// every ledger write system-wide shares one global seq, so without local
81		// serialisation concurrent handlers (e.g. a morning pour rush plus a
82		// GenerateInvoices loop) burn duplicate-key retries against each other.
83		// The unique seq index remains the atomic backstop across processes.
84		appendMu sync.Mutex
85	}
86	
87	// NewLedger binds the ledger to the database.
88	func NewLedger(db *mongo.Database) *Ledger {
89		return &Ledger{coll: db.Collection(collection)}
90	}
91	
92	// genesisHash anchors the chain before the first event.
93	const genesisHash = "GENESIS"
94	
95	// Append chains a new event. Concurrency-safe without transactions: it reads
96	// the current head, computes seq+hash optimistically, and relies on the
97	// unique index on `seq` — a duplicate-key collision means another writer won
98	// the slot, so we re-read and retry.
99	func (l *Ledger) Append(ctx context.Context, in AppendInput) (*Event, error) {
100		// Serialise appends within this process (see appendMu): local writers no
101		// longer race each other for the seq slot, so under single-instance
102		// deployment the retry loop only ever fires against external writers.
103		l.appendMu.Lock()
104		defer l.appendMu.Unlock()
105	
106		const maxRetries = 12
107		for attempt := 0; attempt < maxRetries; attempt++ {
108			seq, prevHash, err := l.head(ctx)
109			if err != nil {
110				return nil, err
111			}
112			ev := &Event{
113				ID:         primitive.NewObjectID(),
114				Seq:        seq + 1,
115				Type:       in.Type,
116				EntityType: in.EntityType,
117				EntityID:   in.EntityID,
118				Refs:       in.Refs,
119				Actor:      in.Actor,
120				OrgUnitID:  in.OrgUnitID,
121				Payload:    in.Payload,
122				// Millisecond precision: BSON datetimes store ms, so the persisted
123				// TS must equal the hashed TS or re-verification would break.
124				TS:       time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Millisecond),
125				PrevHash: prevHash,
126			}
127			ev.Hash = computeHash(ev)
128	
129			if _, err := l.coll.InsertOne(ctx, ev); err != nil {
130				if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(err) {
131					continue // lost the seq race — retry against the new head
132				}
133				return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance append: %w", err)
134			}
135			return ev, nil
136		}
137		return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance append: gave up after %d seq collisions", 12)
138	}
139	
140	// head returns the latest (seq, hash), or (0, GENESIS) for an empty chain.
141	func (l *Ledger) head(ctx context.Context) (int64, string, error) {
142		var last Event
143		err := l.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{},
144			options.FindOne().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: -1}}),
145		).Decode(&last)
146		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
147			return 0, genesisHash, nil
148		}
149		if err != nil {
150			return 0, "", fmt.Errorf("provenance head: %w", err)
151		}
152		return last.Seq, last.Hash, nil
153	}
154	
155	// computeHash covers everything that matters: position, linkage, content.
156	// Payload is canonicalised via encoding/json (map keys are sorted) and the
157	// timestamp to millisecond precision (BSON datetime resolution), so the
158	// digest is deterministic across a MongoDB round trip.
159	func computeHash(ev *Event) string {
160		payloadJSON, _ := json.Marshal(ev.Payload)
161		refParts := make([]string, 0, len(ev.Refs))
162		for _, r := range ev.Refs {
163			refParts = append(refParts, r.EntityType+":"+r.EntityID+":"+r.Relation)
164		}
165		material := strings.Join([]string{
166			ev.PrevHash,
167			strconv.FormatInt(ev.Seq, 10),
168			ev.Type,
169			ev.EntityType,
170			ev.EntityID,
171			strings.Join(refParts, ","),
172			ev.Actor.PartyID,
173			ev.Actor.RoleCode,
174			ev.OrgUnitID,
175			string(payloadJSON),
176			ev.TS.UTC().Truncate(time.Millisecond).Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
177		}, "|")
178		sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(material))
179		return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
180	}
181	
182	// EventsForEntity returns an entity's own timeline in chain order.
183	func (l *Ledger) EventsForEntity(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string) ([]Event, error) {
184		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
185			bson.D{{Key: "entity_type", Value: entityType}, {Key: "entity_id", Value: entityID}},
186			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}),
187		)
188		if err != nil {
189			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance events for %s/%s: %w", entityType, entityID, err)
190		}
191		var out []Event
192		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
193			return nil, err
194		}
195		return out, nil
196	}
197	
198	// Trace walks the provenance graph UPSTREAM from an entity: its events, plus
199	// (recursively) the events of everything those events reference. This is how
200	// a consumer QR resolves back to the contributing samiti set, and how a failed
201	// aflatoxin test walks back to source DCSes (blueprint §8.3).
202	func (l *Ledger) Trace(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, maxDepth int) ([]Event, error) {
203		return l.TraceStopAt(ctx, entityType, entityID, maxDepth, nil)
204	}
205	
206	// TraceStopAt is Trace with a stop set: entity types in stopExpand are still
207	// fetched (their events appear in the result) but their refs are never
208	// followed. The consumer QR scan stops at the consignment/pooling boundary so
209	// hundreds of per-pour nodes (and cross-route trip fan-out) are never walked.
210	//
211	// Each BFS level is batched into a bounded number of $or queries instead of
212	// one Find per node, so a walk costs O(depth) round trips, not O(nodes).
213	func (l *Ledger) TraceStopAt(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, maxDepth int, stopExpand map[string]bool) ([]Event, error) {
214		if maxDepth <= 0 {
215			maxDepth = 10
216		}
217		const hardEventCap = 2000
218	
219		type node struct{ etype, eid string }
220		visited := map[node]bool{}
221		frontier := []node{{entityType, entityID}}
222		var all []Event
223	
224		for depth := 0; depth < maxDepth && len(frontier) > 0; depth++ {
225			// Deduplicate this level against everything already visited.
226			level := make([]node, 0, len(frontier))
227			for _, n := range frontier {
228				if visited[n] {
229					continue
230				}
231				visited[n] = true
232				level = append(level, n)
233			}
234			if len(level) == 0 {
235				break
236			}
237	
238			var next []node
239			// One indexed query per chunk of the level (not per node).
240			const orChunk = 200
241			for start := 0; start < len(level); start += orChunk {
242				end := min(start+orChunk, len(level))
243				clauses := make(bson.A, 0, end-start)
244				for _, n := range level[start:end] {
245					clauses = append(clauses, bson.D{
246						{Key: "entity_type", Value: n.etype},
247						{Key: "entity_id", Value: n.eid},
248					})
249				}
250				cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
251					bson.D{{Key: "$or", Value: clauses}},
252					options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}).SetLimit(hardEventCap),
253				)
254				if err != nil {
255					return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance trace level: %w", err)
256				}
257				var evs []Event
258				if err := cur.All(ctx, &evs); err != nil {
259					return nil, err
260				}
261				for _, ev := range evs {
262					all = append(all, ev)
263					if len(all) >= hardEventCap {
264						return all, nil
265					}
266					if stopExpand != nil && stopExpand[ev.EntityType] {
267						continue // include the node's events, never follow its refs
268					}
269					for _, ref := range ev.Refs {
270						nn := node{ref.EntityType, ref.EntityID}
271						if !visited[nn] {
272							next = append(next, nn)
273						}
274					}
275				}
276			}
277			frontier = next
278		}
279		return all, nil
280	}
281	
282	// DownstreamRefs finds events that reference the given entity — used to walk
283	// FORWARD (e.g. "which batches consumed this blocked BMC lot?"). The limit is
284	// pushed into the query: only the LAST limit referencing events are fetched
285	// (ascending chain order preserved). limit <= 0 falls back to 2000.
286	func (l *Ledger) DownstreamRefs(ctx context.Context, entityID string, limit int64) ([]Event, error) {
287		if limit <= 0 {
288			limit = 2000
289		}
290		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
291			bson.D{{Key: "refs.entity_id", Value: entityID}},
292			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: -1}}).SetLimit(limit),
293		)
294		if err != nil {
295			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance downstream of %s: %w", entityID, err)
296		}
297		var out []Event
298		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
299			return nil, err
300		}
301		// Restore ascending chain order.
302		for i, j := 0, len(out)-1; i < j; i, j = i+1, j-1 {
303			out[i], out[j] = out[j], out[i]
304		}
305		return out, nil
306	}
307	
308	// EventsForEntityPage returns one page of an entity's own timeline in chain
309	// order, with skip/limit pushed into the query.
310	func (l *Ledger) EventsForEntityPage(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, offset, limit int64) ([]Event, error) {
311		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
312			bson.D{{Key: "entity_type", Value: entityType}, {Key: "entity_id", Value: entityID}},
313			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}).SetSkip(offset).SetLimit(limit),
314		)
315		if err != nil {
316			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance events page for %s/%s: %w", entityType, entityID, err)
317		}
318		var out []Event
319		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
320			return nil, err
321		}
322		return out, nil
323	}
324	
325	// CountEventsForEntity returns the total number of events on an entity's
326	// timeline (pagination meta companion of EventsForEntityPage).
327	func (l *Ledger) CountEventsForEntity(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string) (int64, error) {
328		n, err := l.coll.CountDocuments(ctx,
329			bson.D{{Key: "entity_type", Value: entityType}, {Key: "entity_id", Value: entityID}})
330		if err != nil {
331			return 0, fmt.Errorf("provenance count for %s/%s: %w", entityType, entityID, err)
332		}
333		return n, nil
334	}
335	
336	// VerifyChain re-derives every hash in [fromSeq, toSeq] and checks linkage.
337	// Returns (true, 0) when intact, or (false, seq) of the first broken link.
338	func (l *Ledger) VerifyChain(ctx context.Context, fromSeq, toSeq int64) (bool, int64, error) {
339		filter := bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$gte", Value: fromSeq}, {Key: "$lte", Value: toSeq}}}}
340		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}))
341		if err != nil {
342			return false, 0, fmt.Errorf("provenance verify: %w", err)
343		}
344		defer cur.Close(ctx)
345	
346		prevHash := ""
347		prevSeq := int64(0)
348		first := true
349		for cur.Next(ctx) {
350			var ev Event
351			if err := cur.Decode(&ev); err != nil {
352				return false, 0, err
353			}
354			if computeHash(&ev) != ev.Hash {
355				return false, ev.Seq, nil // content tampered
356			}
357			if !first {
358				if ev.Seq != prevSeq+1 || ev.PrevHash != prevHash {
359					return false, ev.Seq, nil // linkage broken
360				}
361			}
362			prevHash, prevSeq, first = ev.Hash, ev.Seq, false
363		}
364		return true, 0, cur.Err()
365	}
366	
367	// LatestSeq returns the current chain head sequence (0 = empty).
368	func (l *Ledger) LatestSeq(ctx context.Context) (int64, error) {
369		seq, _, err := l.head(ctx)
370		return seq, err
371	}

1	// Package collection implements the core procurement loop of Saathi
2	// (blueprint §8.1, §8.2): org-scoped rate charts, anti-tamper analyzer
3	// readings, offline-first idempotent milk pours with same-day pricing, and
4	// per-farmer daily invoices behind the same-day payment promise.
5	//
6	// Bus topics published by this module:
7	//   - eventbus.TopicPourRecorded  — payload domain.MilkPour (the newly recorded pour)
8	//   - eventbus.TopicInvoiceIssued — payload domain.Invoice (the newly issued invoice)
9	package collection
10	
11	import (
12		"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
13	
14		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
16		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/middleware"
17	)
18	
19	// Register mounts the collection module under /collection and wires the
20	// handler → service → repo stack onto the shared platform dependencies.
21	func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
22		repo := newRepo(d)
23		svc := newService(d, repo)
24		h := &handler{svc: svc}
25	
26		r.Route("/collection", func(r chi.Router) {
27			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
28	
29			// Rate charts: pricing policy is set at union/federation level and
30			// resolved downward to each DCS (nearest ancestor wins).
31			r.Route("/rate-charts", func(r chi.Router) {
32				r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RolePCDFAdmin, domain.RoleUnionPresident)).
33					Post("/", h.createRateChart)
34				r.With(middleware.RequireSession).Get("/active", h.getActiveRateChart)
35			})
36	
37			// Analyzer readings: flagged, never rejected (anti-tamper envelope §8.2).
38			r.Route("/readings", func(r chi.Router) {
39				r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSamitiSacheev, domain.RoleMilkTester)).
40					Post("/", h.createReading)
41				r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(
42					domain.RoleSamitiSacheev, domain.RoleMilkTester, domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor,
43				)).Get("/", h.listReadings)
44			})
45	
46			// Pours: THE core loop — offline-first idempotent, hard plausibility gate.
47			r.Route("/pours", func(r chi.Router) {
48				r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
49					r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSamitiSacheev, domain.RoleMilkTester))
50					r.Post("/", h.createPour)
51					r.Post("/batch-sync", h.batchSyncPours)
52					r.Post("/{id}/supersede", h.supersedePour)
53				})
54				r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(
55					domain.RoleSamitiSacheev, domain.RoleMilkTester,
56					domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor, domain.RoleFarmer,
57				)).Get("/", h.listPours)
58			})
59	
60			// Invoices: the same-day settlement artefact (§8.1).
61			r.Route("/invoices", func(r chi.Router) {
62				r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSamitiSacheev)).
63					Post("/generate", h.generateInvoices)
64				r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
65					r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(
66						domain.RoleFarmer, domain.RoleSamitiSacheev, domain.RoleSamitiAdhyaksh,

69					))
70					r.Get("/", h.listInvoices)
71					r.Get("/{id}", h.getInvoice)
72				})
73			})
74		})
75	}

1	// Package plant implements the processing tier of the pour→QR chain:
2	// BMC lots (pooled consignments at the chilling centre), processing batches,
3	// product lots and QR issuance. It is the ENFORCEMENT layer of the safety
4	// gate (blueprint §8.3): a lot or batch that has not PASSED quality control
5	// can never advance — not into a tanker, not into a batch, not onto a shelf.
6	// Aflatoxin M1 survives pasteurisation, so the gate is checked at every hop,
7	// belt-and-braces.
8	package plant
9	
10	import (
11		"log/slog"
12	
13		"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
14	
15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
16		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
17		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/middleware"
18	)
19	
20	// Register wires the plant module under /api/v1/plant.
21	func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
22		log := d.Log.With(slog.String("module", "plant"))
23		repo := NewRepo(d.DB)
24		svc := NewService(repo, d, log)
25		h := NewHandler(svc)
26	
27		r.Route("/plant", func(pr chi.Router) {
28			pr.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
29	
30			// BMC lots — created/closed/dispatched by the chilling-centre operator;
31			// readable by everyone downstream who receives or supervises the milk.
32			pr.Route("/bmc-lots", func(lr chi.Router) {
33				lr.With(middleware.RequireRoles(
34					domain.RoleBMCOperator, domain.RolePlantOperator,
35					domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor, domain.RolePlantLabAnalyst,
36				)).Get("/", h.ListBMCLots)
37	
38				lr.Group(func(wr chi.Router) {
39					wr.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleBMCOperator))
40					wr.Post("/", h.CreateBMCLot)
41					wr.Post("/{id}/close", h.CloseBMCLot)
42					wr.Post("/{id}/dispatch", h.DispatchBMCLot)
43				})
44			})
45	
46			// Processing batches — plant operator pools dispatched (gate-passed)
47			// BMC lots into a production run; plant lab + supervisor read along.
48			pr.Route("/batches", func(br chi.Router) {
49				read := middleware.RequireRoles(
50					domain.RolePlantOperator, domain.RolePlantLabAnalyst,
51					domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor,
52				)
53				br.With(read).Get("/", h.ListBatches)
54				br.With(read).Get("/{id}", h.GetBatch)
55	
56				br.Group(func(wr chi.Router) {
57					wr.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RolePlantOperator))
58					wr.Post("/", h.CreateBatch)
59					wr.Post("/{id}/complete", h.CompleteBatch)
60				})
61			})
62	
63			// Product lots — packaged SKUs out of a COMPLETED batch. Recall is the
64			// FSSAI path (§18-C): admin or plant lab pulls the lot from market.
65			pr.Route("/product-lots", func(plr chi.Router) {
66				plr.With(middleware.RequireRoles(
67					domain.RolePlantOperator, domain.RolePlantLabAnalyst,
68				)).Post("/", h.CreateProductLot)
69				plr.With(middleware.RequireRoles(
70					domain.RolePCDFAdmin, domain.RolePlantLabAnalyst,
71				)).Post("/{id}/recall", h.RecallProductLot)
72			})
73	
74			// QR issuance — the consumer-facing end of the trace chain (§7).
75			pr.Route("/qrs", func(qr chi.Router) {
76				qr.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(
77					domain.RolePlantOperator, domain.RolePlantLabAnalyst,
78				))
79				qr.Post("/", h.IssueQR)
80				qr.Get("/", h.ListQRs)
81			})
82		})
83	
84		// No bus subscriptions: the quality module flips lot/batch statuses in
85		// their own collections, and every gate here re-reads status at use time.
86	}

```text
1	// Package logistics moves sealed milk from village societies to chilling
2	// centres (blueprint §7.1): a Samiti Sacheev pools a shift's RECORDED pours
3	// into a DCS consignment and dispatches it; a van rider runs a route trip
4	// that picks consignments up stop by stop, logs cold-chain temperatures in
5	// transit, and hands the load to a BMC. Every hop is chained into the
6	// provenance ledger so the pour→QR trace survives the pooling boundary.
7	package logistics
8	
9	import (
10		"log/slog"
11	
12		"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
13	
14		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
16		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/middleware"
17	)
18	
19	// Register mounts the logistics routes under /logistics (the router hands us
20	// the /api/v1 subtree) and wires handler → service → repo.
21	func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
22		log := d.Log.With(slog.String("module", "logistics"))
23		svc := newService(newRepo(d.DB), d.Orgs, d.Ledger, log)
24		h := &handler{svc: svc}
25	
26		r.Route("/logistics", func(r chi.Router) {
27			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
28	
29			r.Route("/consignments", func(r chi.Router) {
30				sacheevOnly := middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSamitiSacheev)
31				r.With(sacheevOnly).Post("/", h.createConsignment)
32				r.With(sacheevOnly).Post("/{consignmentID}/dispatch", h.dispatchConsignment)
33				r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(
34					domain.RoleSamitiSacheev, domain.RoleSamitiAdhyaksh, domain.RoleVanRider,
35					domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor, domain.RoleBMCOperator,
36				)).Get("/", h.listConsignments)
37			})
38	
39			r.Route("/trips", func(r chi.Router) {
40				riderOnly := middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleVanRider)
41				tripReaders := middleware.RequireRoles(
42					domain.RoleVanRider, domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor, domain.RoleUnionPresident,
43				)
44				r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor, domain.RoleVanRider)).
45					Post("/", h.createTrip)
46				r.With(riderOnly).Post("/{tripID}/stops/{consignmentID}/pickup", h.pickupStop)
47				r.With(riderOnly).Post("/{tripID}/cold-chain", h.logColdChain)
48				r.With(riderOnly).Post("/{tripID}/deliver", h.deliverTrip)
49				r.With(tripReaders).Get("/", h.listTrips)
50				r.With(tripReaders).Get("/{tripID}", h.getTrip)
51			})
52		})
53	}
54
```

17	// Repo is the plant module's MongoDB access layer. All state transitions use
18	// optimistic filters on the expected status — no transactions (standalone
19	// server), so a lost race simply matches zero documents and the service
20	// reports a conflict instead of corrupting state.
21	type Repo struct {
22		consignments *mongo.Collection
23		bmcLots      *mongo.Collection
24		batches      *mongo.Collection
25		productLots  *mongo.Collection
26		qrs          *mongo.Collection
27		counters     *mongo.Collection
28	}

30	// NewRepo binds the repo to the shared database.
31	func NewRepo(db *mongo.Database) *Repo {
32		return &Repo{
33			consignments: db.Collection(mongodb.CollConsignments),
34			bmcLots:      db.Collection(mongodb.CollBMCLots),
35			batches:      db.Collection(mongodb.CollBatches),
36			productLots:  db.Collection(mongodb.CollProductLots),
37			qrs:          db.Collection(mongodb.CollBatchQRs),
38			counters:     db.Collection(mongodb.CollCounters),
39		}
40	}

42	// --- consignments (read + claim; owned by the logistics module otherwise) ---
43	
44	// ConsignmentsByIDs loads the given consignments (missing IDs simply absent).
45	func (r *Repo) ConsignmentsByIDs(ctx context.Context, ids []primitive.ObjectID) ([]domain.DCSConsignment, error) {
46		cur, err := r.consignments.Find(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: ids}}}})
47		if err != nil {
48			return nil, err
49		}
50		out := []domain.DCSConsignment{}
51		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
52			return nil, err
53		}
54		return out, nil
55	}
56	
57	// ClaimConsignments atomically flips DELIVERED consignments to ACCEPTED and
58	// stamps the pooling lot ID. Returns how many were actually claimed — fewer
59	// than requested means another lot raced us on at least one consignment.
60	func (r *Repo) ClaimConsignments(ctx context.Context, ids []primitive.ObjectID, bmcLotID primitive.ObjectID) (int64, error) {
61		res, err := r.consignments.UpdateMany(ctx,
62			bson.D{
63				{Key: "_id", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: ids}}},
64				{Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusDelivered},
65			},
66			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
67				{Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusAccepted},
68				{Key: "bmc_lot_id", Value: bmcLotID},
69			}}},
70		)
71		if err != nil {
72			return 0, err
73		}
74		return res.ModifiedCount, nil
75	}
76	
77	// ReleaseConsignments undoes a partial claim (compensating action for a lost
78	// race): everything stamped with this lot ID goes back to DELIVERED.
79	func (r *Repo) ReleaseConsignments(ctx context.Context, bmcLotID primitive.ObjectID) error {
80		_, err := r.consignments.UpdateMany(ctx,
81			bson.D{{Key: "bmc_lot_id", Value: bmcLotID}},
82			bson.D{
83				{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusDelivered}}},
84				{Key: "$unset", Value: bson.D{{Key: "bmc_lot_id", Value: ""}}},
85			},
86		)
87		return err
88	}

102			return nil, err
103		}
104		return &lot, nil
105	}

108	func (r *Repo) BMCLotsByIDs(ctx context.Context, ids []primitive.ObjectID) ([]domain.BMCLot, error) {
109		cur, err := r.bmcLots.Find(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: ids}}}})
110		if err != nil {
111			return nil, err
112		}
113		out := []domain.BMCLot{}
114		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
115			return nil, err
116		}
117		return out, nil
118	}

120	// CloseBMCLot transitions OPEN→QC_PENDING with the chilling temperature.
121	// Returns false when the lot was not OPEN (already closed, or raced).
122	func (r *Repo) CloseBMCLot(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID, tempC float64, closedAt time.Time) (bool, error) {
123		res, err := r.bmcLots.UpdateOne(ctx,
124			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}, {Key: "status", Value: domain.BMCLotStatusOpen}},
125			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
126				{Key: "status", Value: domain.BMCLotStatusQCPending},
127				{Key: "chilling_temp_c", Value: tempC},
128				{Key: "closed_at", Value: closedAt},
129			}}},
130		)
131		if err != nil {
132			return false, err
133		}
134		return res.MatchedCount > 0, nil
135	}

137	// DispatchBMCLot transitions PASSED→DISPATCHED. The status filter IS the
138	// safety gate at the datastore level: a BLOCKED or QC_PENDING lot can never
139	// match this update.
140	func (r *Repo) DispatchBMCLot(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID, dispatchedAt time.Time) (bool, error) {
141		res, err := r.bmcLots.UpdateOne(ctx,
142			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}, {Key: "status", Value: domain.BMCLotStatusPassed}},
143			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
144				{Key: "status", Value: domain.BMCLotStatusDispatched},
145				{Key: "dispatched_at", Value: dispatchedAt},
146			}}},
147		)
148		if err != nil {
149			return false, err
150		}
151		return res.MatchedCount > 0, nil
152	}

154	// ClaimBMCLots atomically claims DISPATCHED lots for a processing batch:
155	// DISPATCHED→POOLED stamped with the batch ID. Returns how many were actually
156	// claimed — fewer than requested means another batch raced us on at least one
157	// lot (or a lot was not DISPATCHED), and the caller must roll back.
158	func (r *Repo) ClaimBMCLots(ctx context.Context, ids []primitive.ObjectID, batchID primitive.ObjectID) (int64, error) {
159		res, err := r.bmcLots.UpdateMany(ctx,

163			},
164			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
165				{Key: "status", Value: domain.BMCLotStatusPooled},

167			}}},
168		)
169		if err != nil {
170			return 0, err
171		}
172		return res.ModifiedCount, nil

175	// ReleaseBMCLots undoes a partial claim (compensating action for a lost
176	// race): every lot stamped with this batch ID goes back to DISPATCHED.
177	func (r *Repo) ReleaseBMCLots(ctx context.Context, batchID primitive.ObjectID) error {
178		_, err := r.bmcLots.UpdateMany(ctx,
179			bson.D{
180				{Key: "batch_id", Value: batchID},
181				{Key: "status", Value: domain.BMCLotStatusPooled},
182			},
183			bson.D{
184				{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: domain.BMCLotStatusDispatched}}},
185				{Key: "$unset", Value: bson.D{{Key: "batch_id", Value: ""}}},
186			},
187		)
188		return err

191	// BMCLotListFilter narrows the BMC lot listing. Zero-valued fields are
192	// ignored.

195		Date   string
196		Status string
197	}
198	
199	// ListBMCLots returns a page of lots plus the total match count.
200	func (r *Repo) ListBMCLots(ctx context.Context, f BMCLotListFilter, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.BMCLot, int64, error) {
201		filter := bson.D{}
202		if !f.BMCID.IsZero() {
203			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "bmc_id", Value: f.BMCID})
204		}
205		if f.Date != "" {
206			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "date", Value: f.Date})
207		}
208		if f.Status != "" {
209			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "status", Value: f.Status})
210		}
211		total, err := r.bmcLots.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
212		if err != nil {
213			return nil, 0, err
214		}
215		cur, err := r.bmcLots.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
216			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "date", Value: -1}, {Key: "created_at", Value: -1}}).
217			SetSkip(page.Offset).SetLimit(page.Limit))
218		if err != nil {
219			return nil, 0, err
220		}
221		out := []domain.BMCLot{}
222		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
223			return nil, 0, err
224		}
225		return out, total, nil
226	}

230	// NextSequence atomically increments and returns the named counter — the
231	// transaction-free way to mint gapless human-readable numbers.
232	func (r *Repo) NextSequence(ctx context.Context, key string) (int64, error) {

242			return 0, err

89	// --- safety-gate predicates (§8.3) ---
90	//
91	// Pure functions so the refusal matrix is unit-testable without a database.
92	// Every mutation below ALSO re-checks the status inside the MongoDB update
93	// filter, so a concurrent QC block can never slip a bad lot through.
94	
95	// canDispatchBMCLot: only a lot with a passing BMC rapid test may leave on a
96	// tanker. BLOCKED, QC_PENDING and OPEN lots stay put.
97	func canDispatchBMCLot(status string) bool {
98		return status == domain.BMCLotStatusPassed
99	}
100	
101	// canPoolBMCLot: only a DISPATCHED lot (which by construction went
102	// OPEN→QC_PENDING→PASSED→DISPATCHED) may enter a processing batch.
103	func canPoolBMCLot(status string) bool {
104		return status == domain.BMCLotStatusDispatched
105	}
106	
107	// canCompleteBatch: only a batch the plant lab has PASSED may complete.
108	func canCompleteBatch(status string) bool {
109		return status == domain.BatchStatusPassed
110	}
111	
112	// canYieldProductLot: only a COMPLETED batch may be packaged into SKU lots.
113	func canYieldProductLot(batchStatus string) bool {
114		return batchStatus == domain.BatchStatusCompleted
115	}
116	
117	// canIssueQR: a QR may only label an ACTIVE product lot whose batch is
118	// COMPLETED. This read-time check is advisory; IssueQR additionally confirms
119	// the lot is still ACTIVE with a conditional write after the QR insert, so a
120	// recall landing mid-request still stops the mint.
121	func canIssueQR(lotStatus, batchStatus string) bool {
122		return lotStatus == domain.ProductLotStatusActive && batchStatus == domain.BatchStatusCompleted
123	}

127	// CreateBMCLot pools DELIVERED consignments into a new OPEN lot at a BMC.
128	func (s *Service) CreateBMCLot(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateBMCLotRequest) (*domain.BMCLot, error) {
129		actID, err := actorID(actor)
130		if err != nil {
131			return nil, err
132		}
133		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, req.BMCID, "create bmc lot"); err != nil {
134			return nil, err
135		}
136		org, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.BMCID)
137		if err != nil {
138			return nil, err
139		}
140		if org.Type != domain.OrgTypeBMC {
141			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot creation refused: org unit is not a BMC",
142				slog.String("org_unit_id", req.BMCID.Hex()),
143				slog.String("org_type", org.Type),
144				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
145			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_BMC", "org unit "+req.BMCID.Hex()+" is not a BMC")
146		}
147	
148		now := time.Now().UTC()
149		date := req.Date
150		if date == "" {
151			date = domain.DateKeyIST(now)
152		}
153	
154		ids := dedupe(req.ConsignmentIDs)
155		consignments, err := s.repo.ConsignmentsByIDs(ctx, ids)
156		if err != nil {
157			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "load consignments", err)
158		}
159		if len(consignments) != len(ids) {
160			return nil, httpx.NotFound("consignment(s) " + strings.Join(missingIDs(ids, consignments), ", "))
161		}
162		var undelivered []string
163		for _, c := range consignments {
164			if c.Status != domain.ConsignmentStatusDelivered {
165				undelivered = append(undelivered, c.ID.Hex())
166			}
167		}
168		if len(undelivered) > 0 {
169			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot creation refused: consignment(s) not DELIVERED",
170				slog.String("bmc_id", req.BMCID.Hex()),
171				slog.String("consignment_ids", strings.Join(undelivered, ",")),
172				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
173			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("CONSIGNMENT_NOT_DELIVERED",
174				"only DELIVERED consignments can be pooled into a BMC lot").
175				WithDetails(map[string]any{"consignment_ids": undelivered})
176		}
177	
178		// Optimistic claim: flip DELIVERED→ACCEPTED stamped with the new lot ID.
179		// The lot ID is pre-generated so claim, insert and ledger all agree.
180		// If another lot raced us on any consignment, release our claims and bail.
181		lotID := primitive.NewObjectID()
182		claimed, err := s.repo.ClaimConsignments(ctx, ids, lotID)
183		if err != nil {
184			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "claim consignments", err)
185		}
186		if claimed != int64(len(ids)) {
187			if relErr := s.repo.ReleaseConsignments(ctx, lotID); relErr != nil {
188				return nil, s.fail(ctx, "release consignments after lost claim", relErr)
189			}
190			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot creation lost consignment claim race",
191				slog.String("bmc_id", req.BMCID.Hex()),
192				slog.Int64("claimed", claimed), slog.Int("requested", len(ids)),
193				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
194			return nil, httpx.Conflict("CONSIGNMENT_CLAIM_CONFLICT",
195				"one or more consignments were pooled by another lot — reload and retry")
196		}
197	
198		var totalLitres float64
199		var tripIDs []primitive.ObjectID
200		seenTrip := map[primitive.ObjectID]bool{}
201		for _, c := range consignments {
202			totalLitres += c.TotalQuantityLitres
203			if c.RouteTripID != nil && !seenTrip[*c.RouteTripID] {
204				seenTrip[*c.RouteTripID] = true
205				tripIDs = append(tripIDs, *c.RouteTripID)
206			}
207		}
208	
209		lot := &domain.BMCLot{
210			ID:                  lotID,
211			BMCID:               req.BMCID,
212			Date:                date,
213			Shift:               req.Shift,
214			ConsignmentIDs:      ids,
215			RouteTripIDs:        tripIDs,
216			TotalQuantityLitres: totalLitres,
217			Status:              domain.BMCLotStatusOpen,
218			CreatedBy:           actID,
219			CreatedAt:           now,
220		}
221		if err := s.repo.InsertBMCLot(ctx, lot); err != nil {
222			_ = s.repo.ReleaseConsignments(ctx, lotID)
223			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "insert bmc lot", err)
224		}
225	
226		refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, len(ids))
227		for _, id := range ids {
228			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{
229				EntityType: domain.EntityConsignment, EntityID: id.Hex(), Relation: "pools",
230			})
231		}
232		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
233			Type:       domain.EventBMCLotCreated,
234			EntityType: domain.EntityBMCLot,
235			EntityID:   lot.ID.Hex(),
236			Refs:       refs,
237			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
238			OrgUnitID:  req.BMCID.Hex(),
239			Payload: map[string]any{
240				"date": date, "shift": req.Shift, "total_quantity_litres": totalLitres,
241			},
242		})
243		if err != nil {
244			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append bmc_lot.created event", err)
245		}
246		if err := s.repo.SetBMCLotProvenanceSeq(ctx, lot.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
247			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp bmc lot provenance seq", err)
248		}
249		lot.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
250		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "bmc lot created",
251			slog.String("bmc_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()),
252			slog.String("bmc_id", req.BMCID.Hex()),
253			slog.String("date", date), slog.String("shift", req.Shift),
254			slog.Int("consignments", len(ids)),
255			slog.Float64("total_quantity_litres", totalLitres),
256			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
257		return lot, nil
258	}

260	// CloseBMCLot transitions an OPEN lot to QC_PENDING with the chilling
261	// temperature. The quality module later flips QC_PENDING→PASSED/BLOCKED.
262	func (s *Service) CloseBMCLot(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID, chillingTempC float64) (*domain.BMCLot, error) {

268			return nil, err
269		}
270		if lot.Status != domain.BMCLotStatusOpen {
271			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot close refused: not OPEN",
272				slog.String("bmc_lot_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("status", lot.Status),
273				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
274			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_NOT_OPEN",
275				"only an OPEN lot can be closed; lot is "+lot.Status)
276		}
277		now := time.Now().UTC()
278		ok, err := s.repo.CloseBMCLot(ctx, id, chillingTempC, now)
279		if err != nil {
280			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "close bmc lot", err)
281		}
282		if !ok {
283			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot close lost state race",
284				slog.String("bmc_lot_id", id.Hex()),
285				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
286			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_NOT_OPEN",
287				"lot changed state concurrently — reload and retry")
288		}
289		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
290			Type:       domain.EventBMCLotClosed,
291			EntityType: domain.EntityBMCLot,
292			EntityID:   lot.ID.Hex(),
293			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
294			OrgUnitID:  lot.BMCID.Hex(),

296		})
297		if err != nil {
298			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append bmc_lot.closed event", err)
299		}
300		if err := s.repo.SetBMCLotProvenanceSeq(ctx, lot.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
301			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp bmc lot provenance seq", err)
302		}
303		lot.Status = domain.BMCLotStatusQCPending
304		lot.ChillingTempC = chillingTempC
305		lot.ClosedAt = &now
306		lot.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq

308			slog.String("bmc_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()),
