310			slog.Float64("chilling_temp_c", chillingTempC),
311			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
312		return lot, nil
313	}
314	
315	// DispatchBMCLot transitions PASSED→DISPATCHED. THE safety gate (§8.3): a
316	// BLOCKED or untested lot never leaves the chilling centre.
317	func (s *Service) DispatchBMCLot(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.BMCLot, error) {
318		lot, err := s.getBMCLot(ctx, id)
319		if err != nil {
320			return nil, err
321		}
322		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, lot.BMCID, "dispatch bmc lot"); err != nil {
323			return nil, err
324		}
325		if lot.Status == domain.BMCLotStatusDispatched {
326			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot dispatch refused: already dispatched",
327				slog.String("bmc_lot_id", id.Hex()),
328				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
329			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_ALREADY_DISPATCHED", "lot is already dispatched")
330		}
331		if !canDispatchBMCLot(lot.Status) {
332			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot dispatch refused: safety gate not passed",
333				slog.String("bmc_lot_id", id.Hex()),
334				slog.String("status", lot.Status),
335				slog.String("block_reason", lot.BlockReason),
336				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
337			msg := "lot cannot be dispatched: safety gate not passed (status " + lot.Status + ")"
338			if lot.BlockReason != "" {
339				msg += " — " + lot.BlockReason
340			}
341			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked, msg).
342				WithDetails(map[string]any{"status": lot.Status, "block_reason": lot.BlockReason})
343		}
344		now := time.Now().UTC()
345		ok, err := s.repo.DispatchBMCLot(ctx, id, now)
346		if err != nil {
347			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "dispatch bmc lot", err)
348		}
349		if !ok {
350			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot dispatch lost state race",
351				slog.String("bmc_lot_id", id.Hex()),
352				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
353			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_STATE_CHANGED",
354				"lot changed state concurrently — reload and retry")
355		}
356		// The custody transition — gate-passed milk physically leaving the
357		// chilling centre — must live on the tamper-evident chain like every
358		// other hop of the pour→QR path, not only in a mutable document field.
359		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
360			Type:       domain.EventBMCLotDispatched,
361			EntityType: domain.EntityBMCLot,
362			EntityID:   lot.ID.Hex(),
363			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
364			OrgUnitID:  lot.BMCID.Hex(),
365			Payload: map[string]any{
366				// String, not time.Time: payloads must round-trip BSON⇄JSON
367				// byte-identically or chain re-verification would break.
368				"dispatched_at":         now.Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
369				"total_quantity_litres": lot.TotalQuantityLitres,
370			},
371		})
372		if err != nil {
373			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append bmc_lot.dispatched event", err)
374		}
375		if err := s.repo.SetBMCLotProvenanceSeq(ctx, lot.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
376			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp bmc lot provenance seq", err)
377		}
378		lot.Status = domain.BMCLotStatusDispatched
379		lot.DispatchedAt = &now
380		lot.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
381		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "bmc lot dispatched",
382			slog.String("bmc_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()),
383			slog.String("bmc_id", lot.BMCID.Hex()),
384			slog.Float64("total_quantity_litres", lot.TotalQuantityLitres),
385			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
386		return lot, nil
387	}

389	// ListBMCLots pages lots by BMC/date/status. A BMC operator may only list
390	// within their own scope; downstream readers (plant operator, supervisor,
391	// lab) see across BMCs — the plant receives tankers from sibling BMCs, so an
392	// ancestry check against the plant org would wrongly refuse them.
393	func (s *Service) ListBMCLots(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, f BMCLotListFilter, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.BMCLot, int64, error) {
394		if !f.BMCID.IsZero() && actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleBMCOperator {
395			if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, f.BMCID, "list bmc lots"); err != nil {
396				return nil, 0, err
397			}
398		}
399		lots, total, err := s.repo.ListBMCLots(ctx, f, page)
400		if err != nil {
401			return nil, 0, s.fail(ctx, "list bmc lots", err)
402		}
403		return lots, total, nil
404	}

406	// --- processing batches ---
407	
408	// CreateBatch pools DISPATCHED (gate-passed) BMC lots into one production
409	// run. The gate re-checks here belt-and-braces: aflatoxin M1 survives
410	// pasteurisation, so a blocked lot must never reach a vat (§8.3).
411	func (s *Service) CreateBatch(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateBatchRequest) (*domain.ProcessingBatch, error) {
412		actID, err := actorID(actor)
413		if err != nil {
414			return nil, err
415		}
416		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, req.PlantID, "create batch"); err != nil {
417			return nil, err
418		}
419		org, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.PlantID)
420		if err != nil {
421			return nil, err
422		}
423		if org.Type != domain.OrgTypeProcessingPlant {
424			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch creation refused: org unit is not a plant",
425				slog.String("org_unit_id", req.PlantID.Hex()),
426				slog.String("org_type", org.Type),
427				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
428			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_PLANT", "org unit "+req.PlantID.Hex()+" is not a processing plant")
429		}
430	
431		ids := dedupe(req.BMCLotIDs)
432		lots, err := s.repo.BMCLotsByIDs(ctx, ids)
433		if err != nil {
434			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "load bmc lots", err)
435		}
436		if len(lots) != len(ids) {
437			return nil, httpx.NotFound("BMC lot(s) " + strings.Join(missingLotIDs(ids, lots), ", "))
438		}
439		var offending []string
440		var inputLitres float64
441		for _, lot := range lots {
442			if !canPoolBMCLot(lot.Status) {
443				offending = append(offending, lot.ID.Hex())
444				continue
445			}
446			inputLitres += lot.TotalQuantityLitres
447		}
448		if len(offending) > 0 {
449			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch creation refused: bmc lot(s) have not cleared the safety gate",
450				slog.String("plant_id", req.PlantID.Hex()),
451				slog.String("blocked_lot_ids", strings.Join(offending, ",")),
452				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
453			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked,
454				"one or more BMC lots have not cleared the safety gate (must be PASSED and DISPATCHED)").
455				WithDetails(map[string]any{"blocked_lot_ids": offending})
456		}
457	
458		now := time.Now().UTC()
459		dateKey := domain.DateKeyIST(now)
460		seq, err := s.repo.NextSequence(ctx, "batch_number:"+req.PlantID.Hex()+":"+dateKey)
461		if err != nil {
462			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "next batch number sequence", err)
463		}
464		batchNumber := fmt.Sprintf("BATCH-%s-%s-%04d",
465			org.Code, strings.ReplaceAll(dateKey, "-", ""), seq)
466	
467		// Optimistic claim (mirrors ClaimConsignments): flip DISPATCHED→POOLED
468		// stamped with the pre-generated batch ID BEFORE inserting the batch. One
469		// physical lot of milk can therefore never be pooled into two batches —
470		// neither by a double-submit nor by two concurrent CreateBatch calls.
471		batchID := primitive.NewObjectID()
472		claimed, err := s.repo.ClaimBMCLots(ctx, ids, batchID)
473		if err != nil {
474			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "claim bmc lots", err)
475		}
476		if claimed != int64(len(ids)) {
477			if relErr := s.repo.ReleaseBMCLots(ctx, batchID); relErr != nil {
478				return nil, s.fail(ctx, "release bmc lots after lost claim", relErr)
479			}
480			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch creation lost bmc lot claim race",
481				slog.String("plant_id", req.PlantID.Hex()),
482				slog.Int64("claimed", claimed), slog.Int("requested", len(ids)),
483				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
484			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_CLAIM_CONFLICT",
485				"one or more BMC lots were pooled by another batch — reload and retry")
486		}
487	
488		// CREATED is a transient birth state: the plant lab must clear every
489		// batch, so it is persisted straight into QC_PENDING.
490		batch := &domain.ProcessingBatch{
491			ID:          batchID,
492			PlantID:     req.PlantID,
493			BatchNumber: batchNumber,
494			BMCLotIDs:   ids,
495			ProductType: req.ProductType,
496			InputLitres: inputLitres,
497			Status:      domain.BatchStatusQCPending,
498			StartedAt:   now,
499			CreatedBy:   actID,
500			CreatedAt:   now,
501		}
502		if err := s.repo.InsertBatch(ctx, batch); err != nil {
503			_ = s.repo.ReleaseBMCLots(ctx, batchID)
504			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "insert batch", err)
505		}
506	
507		refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, len(ids))
508		for _, id := range ids {
509			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{
510				EntityType: domain.EntityBMCLot, EntityID: id.Hex(), Relation: "pools",
511			})
512		}
513		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
514			Type:       domain.EventBatchCreated,
515			EntityType: domain.EntityBatch,
516			EntityID:   batch.ID.Hex(),
517			Refs:       refs,
518			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
519			OrgUnitID:  req.PlantID.Hex(),
520			Payload: map[string]any{
521				"batch_number": batchNumber, "product_type": req.ProductType, "input_litres": inputLitres,
522			},
523		})
524		if err != nil {
525			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append batch.created event", err)
526		}
527		if err := s.repo.SetBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx, batch.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
528			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp batch provenance seq", err)
529		}
530		batch.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
531		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "processing batch created",
532			slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
533			slog.String("batch_number", batchNumber),
534			slog.String("plant_id", req.PlantID.Hex()),
535			slog.String("product_type", req.ProductType),
536			slog.Int("bmc_lots", len(ids)),
537			slog.Float64("input_litres", inputLitres),
538			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
539		return batch, nil
540	}
541	
542	// CompleteBatch transitions PASSED→COMPLETED — only a batch the plant lab
543	// cleared may finish and go on to yield product lots.
544	func (s *Service) CompleteBatch(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.ProcessingBatch, error) {
545		batch, err := s.getBatch(ctx, id)
546		if err != nil {
547			return nil, err
548		}
549		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, batch.PlantID, "complete batch"); err != nil {
550			return nil, err
551		}
552		if batch.Status == domain.BatchStatusCompleted {
553			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch completion refused: already completed",
554				slog.String("batch_id", id.Hex()),
555				slog.String("batch_number", batch.BatchNumber),
556				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
557			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BATCH_ALREADY_COMPLETED", "batch is already completed")
558		}
559		if !canCompleteBatch(batch.Status) {
560			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch completion refused: plant-lab QC not passed",
561				slog.String("batch_id", id.Hex()),
562				slog.String("batch_number", batch.BatchNumber),
563				slog.String("status", batch.Status),
564				slog.String("block_reason", batch.BlockReason),
565				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
566			msg := "batch cannot complete: plant-lab QC not passed (status " + batch.Status + ")"
567			if batch.BlockReason != "" {
568				msg += " — " + batch.BlockReason
569			}
570			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked, msg).
571				WithDetails(map[string]any{"status": batch.Status, "block_reason": batch.BlockReason})
572		}
573		now := time.Now().UTC()
574		ok, err := s.repo.CompleteBatch(ctx, id, now)
575		if err != nil {
576			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "complete batch", err)
577		}
578		if !ok {
579			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch completion lost state race",
580				slog.String("batch_id", id.Hex()),
581				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
582			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BATCH_STATE_CHANGED",
583				"batch changed state concurrently — reload and retry")
584		}
585		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
586			Type:       domain.EventBatchCompleted,
587			EntityType: domain.EntityBatch,
588			EntityID:   batch.ID.Hex(),
589			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
590			OrgUnitID:  batch.PlantID.Hex(),
591			Payload:    map[string]any{"batch_number": batch.BatchNumber},
592		})
593		if err != nil {
594			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append batch.completed event", err)
595		}
596		if err := s.repo.SetBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx, batch.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
597			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp batch provenance seq", err)
598		}
599		batch.Status = domain.BatchStatusCompleted
600		batch.CompletedAt = &now
601		batch.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
602		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "processing batch completed",
603			slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
604			slog.String("batch_number", batch.BatchNumber),
605			slog.String("plant_id", batch.PlantID.Hex()),
606			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
607		return batch, nil
608	}

638	// CreateProductLot packages a COMPLETED batch into a SKU lot (gate re-check).
639	func (s *Service) CreateProductLot(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateProductLotRequest) (*domain.ProductLot, error) {
640		batch, err := s.getBatch(ctx, req.BatchID)
641		if err != nil {
642			return nil, err
643		}
644		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, batch.PlantID, "create product lot"); err != nil {
645			return nil, err
646		}
647		if !canYieldProductLot(batch.Status) {
648			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "product lot creation refused: batch has not completed the safety gate",
649				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
650				slog.String("batch_number", batch.BatchNumber),
651				slog.String("batch_status", batch.Status),
652				slog.String("block_reason", batch.BlockReason),
653				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
654			msg := "batch has not completed the safety gate (status " + batch.Status + ") — no product lots may be made"
655			if batch.BlockReason != "" {
656				msg += " — " + batch.BlockReason
657			}
658			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked, msg).
659				WithDetails(map[string]any{"batch_status": batch.Status, "block_reason": batch.BlockReason})
660		}
661	
662		now := time.Now().UTC()
663		mfgDate := req.MfgDate
664		if mfgDate == "" {
665			mfgDate = domain.DateKeyIST(now)
666		}
667		if req.ExpiryDate <= mfgDate {
668			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_EXPIRY", "expiry_date must be after mfg_date")
669		}
670	
671		lot := &domain.ProductLot{
672			ID:          primitive.NewObjectID(),
673			BatchID:     batch.ID,
674			PlantID:     batch.PlantID,
675			SKU:         req.SKU,
676			ProductName: req.ProductName,
677			Units:       req.Units,
678			UnitSize:    req.UnitSize,
679			MRP:         req.MRP,
680			MfgDate:     mfgDate,
681			ExpiryDate:  req.ExpiryDate,
682			Status:      domain.ProductLotStatusActive,
683			CreatedAt:   now,
684		}
685		if err := s.repo.InsertProductLot(ctx, lot); err != nil {
686			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "insert product lot", err)
687		}
688		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
689			Type:       domain.EventProductLotMade,
690			EntityType: domain.EntityProductLot,
691			EntityID:   lot.ID.Hex(),
692			Refs: []provenance.Ref{
693				{EntityType: domain.EntityBatch, EntityID: batch.ID.Hex(), Relation: "yields"},
694			},
695			Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
696			OrgUnitID: batch.PlantID.Hex(),
697			Payload: map[string]any{
698				"sku": req.SKU, "units": req.Units, "unit_size": req.UnitSize,
699				"mfg_date": mfgDate, "expiry_date": req.ExpiryDate,
700			},
701		})
702		if err != nil {
703			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append product_lot.created event", err)
704		}
705		if err := s.repo.SetProductLotProvenanceSeq(ctx, lot.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
706			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp product lot provenance seq", err)
707		}
708		lot.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
709		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "product lot created",
710			slog.String("product_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()),
711			slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
712			slog.String("batch_number", batch.BatchNumber),
713			slog.String("sku", req.SKU),
714			slog.Int("units", req.Units),
715			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
716		return lot, nil
717	}

719	// RecallProductLot pulls a lot from market (FSSAI recall path, §18-C).
720	func (s *Service) RecallProductLot(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID, reason string) (*domain.ProductLot, error) {
721		lot, err := s.getProductLot(ctx, id)
722		if err != nil {
723			return nil, err
724		}
725		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, lot.PlantID, "recall product lot"); err != nil {
726			return nil, err
727		}
728		if lot.Status == domain.ProductLotStatusRecalled {
729			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "product lot recall refused: already recalled",
730				slog.String("product_lot_id", id.Hex()),
731				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
732			return nil, httpx.Conflict("PRODUCT_LOT_ALREADY_RECALLED", "product lot is already recalled")
733		}
734		ok, err := s.repo.RecallProductLot(ctx, id, reason)
735		if err != nil {
736			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "recall product lot", err)
737		}
738		if !ok {
739			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "product lot recall lost state race: already recalled",
740				slog.String("product_lot_id", id.Hex()),
741				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
742			return nil, httpx.Conflict("PRODUCT_LOT_ALREADY_RECALLED", "product lot is already recalled")
743		}
744		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
745			Type:       domain.EventProductRecalled,
746			EntityType: domain.EntityProductLot,
747			EntityID:   lot.ID.Hex(),
748			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
749			OrgUnitID:  lot.PlantID.Hex(),
750			Payload:    map[string]any{"reason": reason},
751		})
752		if err != nil {
753			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append product_lot.recalled event", err)
754		}
755		if err := s.repo.SetProductLotProvenanceSeq(ctx, lot.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
756			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp product lot provenance seq", err)
757		}
758		lot.Status = domain.ProductLotStatusRecalled
759		lot.RecallReason = reason
760		lot.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
761		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "product lot recalled",
762			slog.String("product_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()),
763			slog.String("plant_id", lot.PlantID.Hex()),
764			slog.String("sku", lot.SKU),
765			slog.String("reason", reason),
766			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
767		return lot, nil
768	}
769	
770	// --- QR issuance ---
771	
772	// qrAlphabet is the 32-character human-safe set for short codes: A–Z and 2–9
773	// minus the confusables 0/O and 1/I. 32 divides 256, so a byte modulo the
774	// alphabet length is unbiased.
775	const qrAlphabet = "ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789"
776	
777	// qrCodeLength is the number of random characters after the "PRG-" prefix
778	// (32^8 ≈ 1.1 trillion codes — collisions are retried on the unique index).
779	const qrCodeLength = 8
780	
781	// newQRCode mints a short public code like "[REDACTED:generic-api-key]" from crypto/rand.
782	func newQRCode() (string, error) {
783		buf := make([]byte, qrCodeLength)
784		if _, err := rand.Read(buf); err != nil {
785			return "", err
786		}
787		code := make([]byte, qrCodeLength)
788		for i, b := range buf {
789			code[i] = qrAlphabet[int(b)%len(qrAlphabet)]
790		}
791		return "PRG-" + string(code), nil
792	}
793	
794	// signQRToken builds the forgery-proof token printed inside the QR:
795	// base64url(qr_code|product_lot_hex|issued_unix) + "." + hex(HMAC-SHA256).
796	// productLotHex is the product lot ObjectID's hex form — the HMAC material is
797	// "qr_code|lot hex|unix", and the publictrace module verifies the exact same
798	// shape. The consumer app resolves the payload; the signature proves it was
799	// minted by this server, so IDs cannot be guessed onto counterfeit packs.
800	func signQRToken(secret, qrCode, productLotHex string, issuedAt time.Time) string {
801		payload := qrCode + "|" + productLotHex + "|" + strconv.FormatInt(issuedAt.Unix(), 10)
802		mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte(secret))
803		mac.Write([]byte(payload))
804		return base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(payload)) + "." + hex.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))
805	}
806	
807	// parseQRToken verifies and unpacks a signed QR token, returning the product
808	// lot ObjectID as its hex string.
809	func parseQRToken(secret, token string) (qrCode, productLotHex string, issuedAt time.Time, err error) {
810		payloadB64, sigHex, found := strings.Cut(token, ".")
811		if !found {
812			return "", "", time.Time{}, errors.New("qr token: missing signature separator")
813		}
814		payloadBytes, err := base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString(payloadB64)
815		if err != nil {
816			return "", "", time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("qr token: bad payload encoding: %w", err)
817		}
818		sig, err := hex.DecodeString(sigHex)
819		if err != nil {
820			return "", "", time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("qr token: bad signature encoding: %w", err)
821		}
822		mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte(secret))
823		mac.Write(payloadBytes)
824		if !hmac.Equal(sig, mac.Sum(nil)) {
825			return "", "", time.Time{}, errors.New("qr token: signature mismatch")
826		}
827		parts := strings.Split(string(payloadBytes), "|")
828		if len(parts) != 3 {
829			return "", "", time.Time{}, errors.New("qr token: malformed payload")
830		}
831		unix, err := strconv.ParseInt(parts[2], 10, 64)
832		if err != nil {
833			return "", "", time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("qr token: bad timestamp: %w", err)
834		}
835		return parts[0], parts[1], time.Unix(unix, 0).UTC(), nil
836	}
837	
838	// IssueQR mints one signed QR for an ACTIVE product lot whose batch is
839	// COMPLETED. The gate is checked on read AND re-confirmed with a conditional
840	// write on the lot after the QR insert, so recalled or blocked product can
841	// never be freshly labelled even when the recall races this request.
842	func (s *Service) IssueQR(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, productLotID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.BatchQR, error) {
843		actID, err := actorID(actor)
844		if err != nil {
845			return nil, err
846		}
847		lot, err := s.getProductLot(ctx, productLotID)
848		if err != nil {
849			return nil, err
850		}
851		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, lot.PlantID, "issue qr"); err != nil {
852			return nil, err
853		}
854		batch, err := s.getBatch(ctx, lot.BatchID)
855		if err != nil {
856			return nil, err
857		}
858		if !canIssueQR(lot.Status, batch.Status) {
859			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qr issuance refused: safety gate",
860				slog.String("product_lot_id", productLotID.Hex()),
861				slog.String("product_lot_status", lot.Status),
862				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
863				slog.String("batch_status", batch.Status),
864				slog.String("recall_reason", lot.RecallReason),
865				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
866			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked,
867				"QR issuance refused: product lot must be ACTIVE and its batch COMPLETED").
868				WithDetails(map[string]any{
869					"product_lot_status": lot.Status,
870					"batch_status":       batch.Status,
871					"recall_reason":      lot.RecallReason,
872				})
873		}
874	
875		now := time.Now().UTC()
876		var qr *domain.BatchQR
877		const maxMintAttempts = 5
878		for attempt := 0; attempt < maxMintAttempts; attempt++ {
879			code, err := newQRCode()
880			if err != nil {
881				return nil, s.fail(ctx, "generate qr code", err)
882			}
883			candidate := &domain.BatchQR{
884				ID:           primitive.NewObjectID(),
885				QRCode:       code,
886				ProductLotID: lot.ID,
887				SignedToken:  signQRToken(s.qrSecret, code, lot.ID.Hex(), now),
888				IssuedBy:     actID,
889				ScanCount:    0,
890				IssuedAt:     now,
891			}
892			insertErr := s.repo.InsertQR(ctx, candidate)
893			if insertErr == nil {
894				qr = candidate
895				break
896			}
897			if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(insertErr) {
898				continue // short-code collision — regenerate
899			}
900			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "insert qr", insertErr)
901		}
902		if qr == nil {
903			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "mint qr code",
904				fmt.Errorf("%d consecutive short-code collisions", maxMintAttempts))
905		}
906	
907		// Recall re-check at WRITE time: the initial read cannot see a recall that
908		// lands mid-request, so the mint is confirmed with a conditional no-op
909		// write on the lot (filter status=ACTIVE). If the lot left ACTIVE, the
910		// just-inserted QR is deleted and issuance refused — a freshly minted QR
911		// can never label recalled product.
912		active, err := s.repo.TouchActiveLot(ctx, lot.ID)
913		if err != nil {
914			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "confirm product lot active", err)
915		}
916		if !active {
917			if delErr := s.repo.DeleteQR(ctx, qr.ID); delErr != nil {
918				return nil, s.fail(ctx, "delete qr after lot left ACTIVE", delErr)
919			}
920			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qr issuance refused: product lot left ACTIVE during issuance",
921				slog.String("product_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()),
922				slog.String("qr_id", qr.ID.Hex()),
923				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
924			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked,
925				"QR issuance refused: product lot left ACTIVE (e.g. recalled) during issuance")
926		}
927	
928		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
929			Type:       domain.EventQRIssued,
930			EntityType: domain.EntityBatchQR,
931			EntityID:   qr.ID.Hex(),
932			Refs: []provenance.Ref{
933				{EntityType: domain.EntityProductLot, EntityID: lot.ID.Hex(), Relation: "labels"},
934			},
935			Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
936			OrgUnitID: lot.PlantID.Hex(),
937			Payload:   map[string]any{"qr_code": qr.QRCode},
938		})
939		if err != nil {
940			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append qr.issued event", err)
941		}
942		if err := s.repo.SetQRProvenanceSeq(ctx, qr.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
943			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp qr provenance seq", err)
944		}
945		qr.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
946		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "qr issued",
947			slog.String("qr_id", qr.ID.Hex()),
948			slog.String("qr_code", qr.QRCode),
949			slog.String("product_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()),
950			slog.String("plant_id", lot.PlantID.Hex()),
951			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
952		return qr, nil
953	}

987	func (s *Service) getBatch(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.ProcessingBatch, error) {
988		batch, err := s.repo.BatchByID(ctx, id)
989		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
990			return nil, httpx.NotFound("processing batch")
991		}
992		if err != nil {
993			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "load batch", err)
994		}
995		return batch, nil
996	}

998	func (s *Service) getProductLot(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.ProductLot, error) {
999		lot, err := s.repo.ProductLotByID(ctx, id)
1000		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
1001			return nil, httpx.NotFound("product lot")
1002		}
1003		if err != nil {
1004			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "load product lot", err)
1005		}
1006		return lot, nil
1007	}

1009	// dedupe removes zero and duplicate IDs preserving first-seen order.
1010	func dedupe(ids []primitive.ObjectID) []primitive.ObjectID {
1011		seen := make(map[primitive.ObjectID]bool, len(ids))
1012		out := make([]primitive.ObjectID, 0, len(ids))
1013		for _, id := range ids {
1014			if id.IsZero() || seen[id] {
1015				continue
1016			}
1017			seen[id] = true
1018			out = append(out, id)
1019		}
1020		return out
1021	}
1022	
1023	// missingIDs lists requested consignment IDs (as hex) absent from the fetched
1024	// set.
1025	func missingIDs(wanted []primitive.ObjectID, got []domain.DCSConsignment) []string {
1026		have := make(map[primitive.ObjectID]bool, len(got))
1027		for _, c := range got {
1028			have[c.ID] = true
1029		}
1030		var missing []string
1031		for _, id := range wanted {
1032			if !have[id] {
1033				missing = append(missing, id.Hex())
1034			}
1035		}
1036		return missing
1037	}
1038

1040	// set.

1042		have := make(map[primitive.ObjectID]bool, len(got))
1043		for _, l := range got {
1044			have[l.ID] = true
1045		}
1046		var missing []string

13	func TestQRTokenRoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
14		const secret = "test-qr-secret"
15		issuedAt := time.Date(2026, 7, 6, 9, 30, 0, 0, time.UTC)
16		// The HMAC material carries the product lot ObjectID's hex form:
17		// "qr_code|lot hex|unix" — the exact shape publictrace verifies.
18		lotHex := primitive.NewObjectID().Hex()
19	
20		token := signQRToken(secret, "[REDACTED:generic-api-key]", lotHex, issuedAt)
21	
22		code, lotID, ts, err := parseQRToken(secret, token)
23		if err != nil {
24			t.Fatalf("parseQRToken: unexpected error: %v", err)
25		}
26		if code != "[REDACTED:generic-api-key]" {
27			t.Errorf("qr code: got %q, want %q", code, "[REDACTED:generic-api-key]")
28		}
29		if lotID != lotHex {
30			t.Errorf("product lot id: got %q, want %q", lotID, lotHex)
31		}
32		if !ts.Equal(issuedAt) {
33			t.Errorf("issued at: got %v, want %v", ts, issuedAt)
34		}
35	}
36	
37	func TestQRTokenRejectsForgery(t *testing.T) {
38		const secret = "test-qr-secret"
39		issuedAt := time.Now().UTC()
40		token := signQRToken(secret, "PRG-AAAA2222", primitive.NewObjectID().Hex(), issuedAt)
41	
42		cases := []struct {
43			name   string
44			secret string
45			token  string
46		}{
47			{"wrong secret", "attacker-secret", token},
48			{"tampered payload", secret, "X" + token[1:]},
49			{"tampered signature", secret, token[:len(token)-1] + flipHexChar(token[len(token)-1])},
50			{"missing separator", secret, strings.ReplaceAll(token, ".", "")},
51			{"garbage", secret, "not-a-token"},
52			{"empty", secret, ""},
53		}
54		for _, tc := range cases {
55			t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
56				if _, _, _, err := parseQRToken(tc.secret, tc.token); err == nil {
57					t.Errorf("parseQRToken accepted a forged/malformed token")
58				}
59			})
60		}
61	}
62	
63	// flipHexChar returns a different valid hex digit so signature length stays
64	// intact while its value changes.
65	func flipHexChar(c byte) string {
66		if c == '0' {
67			return "1"
68		}
69		return "0"
70	}
71	
72	func TestNewQRCodeShape(t *testing.T) {
73		for i := 0; i < 100; i++ {
74			code, err := newQRCode()
75			if err != nil {
76				t.Fatalf("newQRCode: %v", err)
77			}
78			if !strings.HasPrefix(code, "PRG-") {
79				t.Fatalf("code %q missing PRG- prefix", code)
80			}
81			body := strings.TrimPrefix(code, "PRG-")
82			if len(body) != qrCodeLength {
83				t.Fatalf("code %q body length %d, want %d", code, len(body), qrCodeLength)
84			}
85			for _, ch := range body {
86				if !strings.ContainsRune(qrAlphabet, ch) {
87					t.Fatalf("code %q contains %q outside the safe alphabet", code, ch)
88				}
89				if strings.ContainsRune("0O1I", ch) {
90					t.Fatalf("code %q contains confusable character %q", code, ch)
91				}
92			}
93		}
94	}
95	
96	// TestGateRefusalMatrix pins the §8.3 safety-gate invariants: a lot or batch
97	// that has not passed QC can NEVER advance, at any hop.
98	func TestGateRefusalMatrix(t *testing.T) {
99		t.Run("dispatch: only PASSED lots leave the BMC", func(t *testing.T) {
100			want := map[string]bool{
101				domain.BMCLotStatusOpen:       false,
102				domain.BMCLotStatusQCPending:  false,
103				domain.BMCLotStatusPassed:     true,
104				domain.BMCLotStatusBlocked:    false,
105				domain.BMCLotStatusDispatched: false, // already gone — re-dispatch refused
106			}
107			for status, allowed := range want {
108				if got := canDispatchBMCLot(status); got != allowed {
109					t.Errorf("canDispatchBMCLot(%s) = %v, want %v", status, got, allowed)
110				}
111			}
112		})
113	
114		t.Run("batch pooling: blocked or unpassed lot cannot enter a batch", func(t *testing.T) {
115			want := map[string]bool{
116				domain.BMCLotStatusOpen:       false,
117				domain.BMCLotStatusQCPending:  false,
118				domain.BMCLotStatusPassed:     false, // passed but not yet arrived at the plant
119				domain.BMCLotStatusBlocked:    false, // AFM1 survives pasteurisation — hard refusal
120				domain.BMCLotStatusDispatched: true,
121			}
122			for status, allowed := range want {
123				if got := canPoolBMCLot(status); got != allowed {
124					t.Errorf("canPoolBMCLot(%s) = %v, want %v", status, got, allowed)
125				}
126			}
127		})
128	
129		t.Run("batch completion: only plant-lab PASSED batches complete", func(t *testing.T) {
130			want := map[string]bool{
131				domain.BatchStatusCreated:   false,
132				domain.BatchStatusQCPending: false,
133				domain.BatchStatusPassed:    true,
134				domain.BatchStatusBlocked:   false,
135				domain.BatchStatusCompleted: false,
136			}
137			for status, allowed := range want {
138				if got := canCompleteBatch(status); got != allowed {
139					t.Errorf("canCompleteBatch(%s) = %v, want %v", status, got, allowed)
140				}
141			}
142		})
143

145			want := map[string]bool{
146				domain.BatchStatusCreated:   false,
147				domain.BatchStatusQCPending: false,

36	// RoleAssignment grants one role to one party inside one org unit for a
37	// validity window. Revoking a Sacheev after an election is a single record
38	// update — never an account deletion (blueprint §4.1).
39	type RoleAssignment struct {
40		ID        primitive.ObjectID  `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
41		PartyID   primitive.ObjectID  `bson:"party_id"      json:"party_id"`
42		RoleCode  string              `bson:"role_code"     json:"role_code"`
43		OrgUnitID primitive.ObjectID  `bson:"org_unit_id"   json:"org_unit_id"`
44		GrantedBy *primitive.ObjectID `bson:"granted_by,omitempty" json:"granted_by,omitempty"`
45		ValidFrom time.Time           `bson:"valid_from"    json:"valid_from"`
46		ValidTo   *time.Time          `bson:"valid_to,omitempty"   json:"valid_to,omitempty"` // nil = open-ended
47		Status    string              `bson:"status"        json:"status"`
48		RevokedAt *time.Time          `bson:"revoked_at,omitempty" json:"revoked_at,omitempty"`
49		RevokedBy *primitive.ObjectID `bson:"revoked_by,omitempty" json:"revoked_by,omitempty"`
50		CreatedAt time.Time           `bson:"created_at"    json:"created_at"`
51	}
52	
53	// UsableAt reports whether the assignment is active and inside its validity
54	// window at instant t.
55	func (ra RoleAssignment) UsableAt(t time.Time) bool {
56		if ra.Status != RoleAssignmentActive {
57			return false
58		}
59		if t.Before(ra.ValidFrom) {
60			return false
61		}
62		if ra.ValidTo != nil && t.After(*ra.ValidTo) {
63			return false
64		}
65		return true
66	}

1	// Package publictrace serves the two faces of milk traceability
2	// (blueprint §7, §8.4):
3	//
4	//   - /public — the consumer QR scan and public ledger tamper-check. These
5	//     routes are DELIBERATELY unauthenticated: a shopper points a phone at a
6	//     milk pack and must see its provenance with zero friction. This is not a
7	//     consumer-account backend (descoped) — the global per-IP rate limit is
8	//     the only throttle.
9	//   - /trace  — the official recall / root-cause tools: full upstream +
10	//     downstream event-graph walks for auditors, mission officials and lab
11	//     analysts (§8.3: a failed aflatoxin lot walks back to contributing
12	//     samitis and forward to affected batches and QRs).
13	//
14	// The consumer view is the HONEST provenance view (§7.4): pooled milk traces
15	// to the SET of contributing samitis, never to individual farmers.
16	package publictrace
17	
18	import (
19		"log/slog"
20	
21		"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
22	
23		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
24		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
25		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/middleware"
26	)
27	
28	// Register mounts the public QR/ledger routes and the authed trace tools.
29	func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
30		log := d.Log.With(slog.String("module", "publictrace"))
31		service := NewService(d, log)
32		handler := &Handler{service: service}
33	
34		// PUBLIC subtree — no Authenticate middleware by design (see package doc).
35		r.Route("/public", func(pub chi.Router) {
36			pub.Get("/qr/{qr_code}", handler.ScanQR)
37			pub.Get("/ledger/verify", handler.VerifyLedger)
38		})
39	
40		// Official trace tools — role-gated, read-only, cross-org by nature
41		// (a recall walk necessarily spans DCS → BMC → plant boundaries, so no
42		// per-resource org-scope check applies here; the role gate is the fence).
43		r.Route("/trace", func(tr chi.Router) {
44			tr.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
45			tr.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(
46				domain.RoleMissionOfficial,
47				domain.RolePCDFAdmin,
48				domain.RoleUnionPresident,
49				domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor,
50				domain.RolePlantLabAnalyst,
51				domain.RoleStateAuditor,
52			))
53			tr.Get("/{entity_type}/{entity_id}", handler.TraceGraph)
54			tr.Get("/{entity_type}/{entity_id}/timeline", handler.Timeline)
55		})
56	}
57

1	// Package domain holds the pure entity model of Saathi — structs, enums and
2	// invariants shared by every module. It has no behaviour beyond validation
3	// and no dependencies outside the standard library and BSON primitives.
4	// This is the contract layer: modules depend on domain, never the other way
5	// around.
6	package domain
7	
8	// Role codes — the role catalog from blueprint §5.2, grounded in the PCDF
9	// cooperative constitution (Farmer → Samiti/DCS → Sangh/Union → PCDF).
10	// A Party may hold many time-bounded, org-scoped RoleAssignments.
11	//
12	// The catalog is deliberately open for extension: adding a future role is a
13	// new constant + AllRoles entry + RequiredKYCTier entry — nothing else.
14	const (
15		// Village tier
16		RoleFarmer         = "FARMER"
17		RoleSamitiSacheev  = "SAMITI_SACHEEV"  // DCS paid Secretary (UPCS Act §31) — runs the collection console
18		RoleSamitiAdhyaksh = "SAMITI_ADHYAKSH" // DCS Chairman/Sabhapati (elected, honorary, §30)
19		RoleMilkTester     = "MILK_TESTER"
20		RoleLRP            = "LRP" // Local Resource Person (NDDB village extension)
21		RoleAITech         = "AI_TECH"
22	
23		// Field / organisation tier
24		// ORGANISING_MANAGER is the ground-level field worker (Dairy Development
25		// Department pattern: "promotes and organises new samitis") who performs
26		// doorstep KYC capture and first-level verification.
27		RoleOrganisingManager = "ORGANISING_MANAGER"
28	
29		// Logistics tier
30		RoleVanRider      = "VAN_RIDER"
31		RoleDeliveryRider = "DELIVERY_RIDER"
32	
33		// Union tier
34		RoleBMCOperator          = "BMC_OPERATOR"
35		RoleUnionFieldSupervisor = "UNION_FIELD_SUPERVISOR"
36		RoleUnionPresident       = "UNION_PRESIDENT"
37	
38		// Plant tier
39		RolePlantOperator   = "PLANT_OPERATOR"
40		RolePlantLabAnalyst = "PLANT_LAB_ANALYST"
41	
42		// State / district tier
43		RolePCDFAdmin        = "PCDF_ADMIN"
44		RoleMissionOfficial  = "MISSION_OFFICIAL"
45		RoleDistrictVerifier = "DISTRICT_VERIFIER"
46	
47		// Health tier
48		RoleVeterinarian = "VETERINARIAN"
49		RoleMVUDriver    = "MVU_DRIVER"
50	
51		// Consumer tier
52		RoleConsumer = "CONSUMER"
53	
54		// Platform tier
55		RoleSupportAgent = "SUPPORT_AGENT"
56		RoleStateAuditor = "STATE_AUDITOR"
57		RoleSuperAdmin   = "SUPER_ADMIN"
58	
59		// System tier
60		RoleServiceAccount = "SERVICE_ACCOUNT"
61	)

63	// AllRoles is the closed set of grantable role codes (extend here).
64	var AllRoles = []string{
65		RoleFarmer, RoleSamitiSacheev, RoleSamitiAdhyaksh, RoleMilkTester, RoleLRP, RoleAITech,
66		RoleOrganisingManager,
67		RoleVanRider, RoleDeliveryRider,
68		RoleBMCOperator, RoleUnionFieldSupervisor, RoleUnionPresident,
69		RolePlantOperator, RolePlantLabAnalyst,
70		RolePCDFAdmin, RoleMissionOfficial, RoleDistrictVerifier,
71		RoleVeterinarian, RoleMVUDriver,
72		RoleConsumer,
73		RoleSupportAgent, RoleStateAuditor, RoleSuperAdmin,
74		RoleServiceAccount,
75	}
76	
77	var roleSet = func() map[string]struct{} {
78		s := make(map[string]struct{}, len(AllRoles))
79		for _, r := range AllRoles {
80			s[r] = struct{}{}
81		}
82		return s
83	}()
84	
85	// IsValidRole reports whether code is one of the catalog roles.
86	func IsValidRole(code string) bool {
87		_, ok := roleSet[code]
88		return ok
89	}

91	// KYC assurance tiers (blueprint §4.2). Higher tiers unlock higher-trust roles.
92	const (
93		KYCTierMinimal  = "MINIMAL"  // mobile OTP only (consumer)
94		KYCTierFarmer   = "FARMER"   // Aadhaar OTP eKYC or offline XML + penny-drop
95		KYCTierStandard = "STANDARD" // Aadhaar eKYC

98		KYCTierHighest  = "HIGHEST"  // platform admin: MFA + dual-control
99		KYCTierService  = "SERVICE"  // machine accounts: mTLS / scoped keys

104	// Tier upgrades happen ONLY through the KYC approval workflow: submit →

106	// self-service tier upgrade.

121		RolePlantLabAnalyst:      KYCTierHigh,
122		RolePCDFAdmin:            KYCTierHigh,
123		RoleMissionOfficial:      KYCTierHigh,
124		RoleDistrictVerifier:     KYCTierHigh,
125		RoleVeterinarian:         KYCTierHigh,
126		RoleMVUDriver:            KYCTierStandard,
127		RoleConsumer:             KYCTierMinimal,
128		RoleSupportAgent:         KYCTierHigh,
129		RoleStateAuditor:         KYCTierHigh,
130		RoleSuperAdmin:           KYCTierHighest,
131		RoleServiceAccount:       KYCTierService,
132	}
133	
134	// kycRank orders tiers so "tier X satisfies requirement Y" is a comparison.
135	var kycRank = map[string]int{
136		KYCTierMinimal:  0,
137		KYCTierFarmer:   1,
138		KYCTierStandard: 1, // Farmer and Standard are parallel tier-1 proofs
139		KYCTierRider:    2,
140		KYCTierHigh:     3,
141		KYCTierHighest:  4,
142		KYCTierService:  4,
143	}
144	
145	// KYCTierSatisfies reports whether a party at tier `have` meets `need`.
146	// Parallel tier-1 proofs (FARMER vs STANDARD) satisfy each other.
147	func KYCTierSatisfies(have, need string) bool {
148		h, okH := kycRank[have]
149		n, okN := kycRank[need]
150		if !okH || !okN {
151			return false
152		}
153		return h >= n
154	}
155	
156	// KYCApprovableTiers maps an approver ROLE to the KYC tiers it may approve.
157	// Ground staff clear the field tiers; only federation admins clear HIGH;
158	// only SUPER_ADMIN clears HIGHEST. Extend when new approver roles arrive.
159	var KYCApprovableTiers = map[string][]string{
160		RoleOrganisingManager: {KYCTierMinimal, KYCTierFarmer, KYCTierStandard, KYCTierRider},
161		RoleDistrictVerifier:  {KYCTierMinimal, KYCTierFarmer, KYCTierStandard, KYCTierRider},
162		RolePCDFAdmin:         {KYCTierMinimal, KYCTierFarmer, KYCTierStandard, KYCTierRider, KYCTierHigh},
163		RoleSuperAdmin:        {KYCTierMinimal, KYCTierFarmer, KYCTierStandard, KYCTierRider, KYCTierHigh, KYCTierHighest, KYCTierService},
164	}
165	
166	// CanApproveKYCTier reports whether approverRole may approve a KYC record
167	// requesting the given tier.
168	func CanApproveKYCTier(approverRole, tier string) bool {
169		for _, t := range KYCApprovableTiers[approverRole] {
170			if t == tier {
171				return true
172			}
173		}
174		return false
175	}
176

105				{Key: "subject_id", Value: batchID},

107				{Key: "overall_pass", Value: true},
108				// A result voided after losing the gate race carries no verdict.
109				{Key: "superseded", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$ne", Value: true}}},
110			},
111			options.FindOne().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "recorded_at", Value: -1}}),
112		).Decode(&qc)

123	// source of contributing-DCS ids and collection dates when the ledger events

125	// event cap.

127		if len(ids) == 0 {

129		}

131			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: ids}}}},

135		}
136		var out []domain.DCSConsignment
137		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
138			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode consignments by ids: %w", err)
139		}

19	// Register wires the cattle module under /cattle. The router mounts this
20	// subtree at /api/v1, so routes land at /api/v1/cattle/...
21	func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
22		log := d.Log.With(slog.String("module", "cattle"))
23		repo := newRepository(d.DB)
24		svc := newService(d, repo, log)
25		h := newHandler(svc)

28			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
29	
30			r.Route("/animals", func(r chi.Router) {
31				// Registration: farmers self-serve; village-tier staff and the
32				// health tier register on a farmer's behalf.
33				r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(
34					domain.RoleFarmer, domain.RoleSamitiSacheev, domain.RoleLRP,
35					domain.RoleAITech, domain.RoleVeterinarian,
36				)).Post("/", h.registerAnimal)
37	
38				// Any authenticated party may list; the service pins farmers and
39				// plain session tokens to their own herd.
40				r.With(middleware.RequireSession).Get("/", h.listAnimals)
41	
42				// Reads: the owner farmer, or care-circle roles. Consent gating

44				r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
45					r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(
46						domain.RoleFarmer, domain.RoleVeterinarian,
47						domain.RoleAITech, domain.RoleMissionOfficial,
48					))
49					r.Get("/{animalID}", h.getAnimal)
50					r.Get("/{animalID}/health-events", h.listHealthEvents)
51				})
52	
53				r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleVeterinarian, domain.RoleAITech)).
54					Post("/{animalID}/health-events", h.logHealthEvent)
55	
56				// Mock Bharat Pashudhan push (§9) — real integration is a swap of
57				// the service internals, not an API change.
58				r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleVeterinarian, domain.RolePCDFAdmin)).
59					Post("/{animalID}/bp-sync", h.syncBharatPashudhan)

18	// repository is all MongoDB access for the quality module. It owns qc_results
19	// and — as the safety-gate verdict writer (blueprint §8.3) — performs the
20	// documented cross-collection status write onto bmc_lots and
21	// processing_batches. No other module may flip those gate statuses.
22	type repository struct {
23		results  *mongo.Collection
24		bmcLots  *mongo.Collection
25		batches  *mongo.Collection
26		counters *mongo.Collection
27	}
28	
29	// newRepository binds the repository to its collections.
30	func newRepository(db *mongo.Database) *repository {
31		return &repository{
32			results:  db.Collection(mongodb.CollQCResults),
33			bmcLots:  db.Collection(mongodb.CollBMCLots),
34			batches:  db.Collection(mongodb.CollBatches),
35			counters: db.Collection(mongodb.CollCounters),
36		}
37	}
38	
39	// insertResult stores a new QC result document (its _id is pre-generated by
40	// the service so provenance refs and the gate write share one ID).
41	func (r *repository) insertResult(ctx context.Context, res *domain.QCResult) error {
42		if _, err := r.results.InsertOne(ctx, res); err != nil {
43			return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("insert qc result: %w", err))
44		}
45		return nil
46	}
47	
48	// setResultProvenanceSeq stamps the ledger sequence onto a stored result.
49	func (r *repository) setResultProvenanceSeq(ctx context.Context, resultID primitive.ObjectID, seq int64) error {
50		_, err := r.results.UpdateOne(ctx,
51			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: resultID}},
52			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "provenance_seq", Value: seq}}}},
53		)
54		if err != nil {
55			return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("set qc result provenance seq: %w", err))
56		}
57		return nil
58	}
59	
60	// markResultSuperseded voids a result that lost the gate race — the subject's
61	// verdict came from a different, earlier result.
62	func (r *repository) markResultSuperseded(ctx context.Context, resultID primitive.ObjectID) error {
63		_, err := r.results.UpdateOne(ctx,
64			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: resultID}},
65			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "superseded", Value: true}}}},
66		)
67		if err != nil {
68			return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("mark qc result superseded: %w", err))
69		}
70		return nil
71	}
72	
73	// findResultByID returns one QC result or NotFound.
74	func (r *repository) findResultByID(ctx context.Context, resultID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.QCResult, error) {
75		var res domain.QCResult
76		err := r.results.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: resultID}}).Decode(&res)
77		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
78			return nil, httpx.NotFound("qc result")
79		}
80		if err != nil {
81			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("find qc result: %w", err))
82		}
83		return &res, nil
84	}
85	
86	// listResults returns a page of QC results, newest first, optionally filtered
87	// by subject (a zero subjectID means "no subject filter"). It also returns
88	// the total matching count for pagination meta.
89	func (r *repository) listResults(ctx context.Context, subjectType string, subjectID primitive.ObjectID, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.QCResult, int64, error) {
90		filter := bson.D{}
91		if subjectType != "" {
92			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "subject_type", Value: subjectType})
93		}
94		if !subjectID.IsZero() {
95			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "subject_id", Value: subjectID})
96		}
97	
98		total, err := r.results.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
99		if err != nil {
100			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("count qc results: %w", err))
101		}
102	
103		cur, err := r.results.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
104			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "recorded_at", Value: -1}}).
105			SetSkip(page.Offset).
106			SetLimit(page.Limit),
107		)
108		if err != nil {
109			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("list qc results: %w", err))
110		}
111		results := []domain.QCResult{}
112		if err := cur.All(ctx, &results); err != nil {
113			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("decode qc results: %w", err))
114		}
115		return results, total, nil
116	}
117	
118	// findBMCLot returns a BMC lot or NotFound.
119	func (r *repository) findBMCLot(ctx context.Context, lotID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.BMCLot, error) {
120		var lot domain.BMCLot
121		err := r.bmcLots.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: lotID}}).Decode(&lot)
122		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
123			return nil, httpx.NotFound("bmc lot")
124		}
125		if err != nil {
126			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("find bmc lot: %w", err))
127		}
128		return &lot, nil
129	}
130	
131	// findBatch returns a processing batch or NotFound.
132	func (r *repository) findBatch(ctx context.Context, batchID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.ProcessingBatch, error) {
133		var batch domain.ProcessingBatch
134		err := r.batches.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: batchID}}).Decode(&batch)
135		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
136			return nil, httpx.NotFound("processing batch")
137		}
138		if err != nil {
139			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("find processing batch: %w", err))
140		}
141		return &batch, nil
142	}
143	
144	// gateBMCLot applies the gate verdict to a BMC lot still in QC_PENDING.
145	// Returns false when the lot was already gated by a concurrent writer.
146	func (r *repository) gateBMCLot(ctx context.Context, lotID, resultID primitive.ObjectID, newStatus, blockReason string) (bool, error) {
147		return gateSubjectDoc(ctx, r.bmcLots, lotID, domain.BMCLotStatusQCPending, resultID, newStatus, blockReason)
148	}
149	
150	// gateBatch applies the gate verdict to a processing batch still in QC_PENDING.
151	// Returns false when the batch was already gated by a concurrent writer.
152	func (r *repository) gateBatch(ctx context.Context, batchID, resultID primitive.ObjectID, newStatus, blockReason string) (bool, error) {
153		return gateSubjectDoc(ctx, r.batches, batchID, domain.BatchStatusQCPending, resultID, newStatus, blockReason)
154	}
155	
156	// gateSubjectDoc is the shared conditional gate write: the filter pins the
157	// subject to QC_PENDING so a lost race cannot double-apply a verdict — the
158	// optimistic pattern that replaces transactions on a standalone server.
159	func gateSubjectDoc(ctx context.Context, coll *mongo.Collection, subjectID primitive.ObjectID, pendingStatus string, resultID primitive.ObjectID, newStatus, blockReason string) (bool, error) {
160		set := bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: newStatus}}
161		if blockReason != "" {
162			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "block_reason", Value: blockReason})
163		}
164		res, err := coll.UpdateOne(ctx,
165			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: subjectID}, {Key: "status", Value: pendingStatus}},
166			bson.D{
167				{Key: "$set", Value: set},
168				{Key: "$push", Value: bson.D{{Key: "qc_result_ids", Value: resultID}}},
169			},
170		)
171		if err != nil {
172			return false, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("gate %s subject %s: %w", coll.Name(), subjectID.Hex(), err))
173		}
174		return res.MatchedCount == 1, nil
175	}
176	
177	// nextCertificateSeq atomically increments and returns the per-stage QC
178	// certificate counter (counters collection, upsert-on-first-use). Counter
179	// keys are human-readable strings by design — they are not entity references.
180	func (r *repository) nextCertificateSeq(ctx context.Context, stage string) (int64, error) {
181		var doc struct {
182			Seq int64 `bson:"seq"`
183		}
184		err := r.counters.FindOneAndUpdate(ctx,
185			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: "qc_certificate:" + stage}},
186			bson.D{{Key: "$inc", Value: bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: int64(1)}}}},
187			options.FindOneAndUpdate().SetUpsert(true).SetReturnDocument(options.After),
188		).Decode(&doc)
189		if err != nil {
190			return 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("next qc certificate seq: %w", err))
191		}
192		return doc.Seq, nil
193	}

25	const (
26		// traceDepth bounds the upstream graph walk (QR → lot → batch → BMC lots
27		// → consignments comfortably fits; the ledger also hard-caps event count).
28		traceDepth = 10
29		// scanVerifySpanCap bounds how many ledger events one consumer scan
30		// re-hashes; wider traced ranges are verified partially (most recent tail).
31		scanVerifySpanCap = 5000
32		// publicVerifySpanCap bounds the public /ledger/verify endpoint span.
33		publicVerifySpanCap = 10000
34		// downstreamEventCap keeps the official trace response bounded even for
35		// heavily referenced entities.
36		downstreamEventCap = 2000
37	)
38	
39	// validEntityTypes is the closed set of traceable entity types (domain.Entity*).
40	var validEntityTypes = map[string]struct{}{
41		domain.EntityMilkPour:        {},
42		domain.EntityAnalyzerReading: {},
43		domain.EntityInvoice:         {},
44		domain.EntityConsignment:     {},
45		domain.EntityRouteTrip:       {},
46		domain.EntityBMCLot:          {},
47		domain.EntityBatch:           {},
48		domain.EntityProductLot:      {},
49		domain.EntityBatchQR:         {},
50		domain.EntityQCResult:        {},
51		domain.EntitySettlement:      {},
52		domain.EntityAnimal:          {},
53		domain.EntityParty:           {},
54	}

56	// Service resolves consumer QR scans and official trace queries. All reads,
57	// no writes except the fire-and-forget scan counter — nothing here ever
58	// mutates provenance.
59	type Service struct {
60		log      *slog.Logger
61		repo     *repo
62		ledger   *provenance.Ledger
63		orgs     *orgscope.Resolver
64		qrSecret string
65	
66		// Incremental verification watermark: the chain is verified cumulatively
67		// across scans, so a repeat scan whose traced range is already covered
68		// answers O(1) instead of re-hashing thousands of interleaved events on
69		// the hottest public endpoint. Per-instance; a restart re-verifies.
70		verifyMu     sync.Mutex
71		verifiedUpTo int64
72		chainBroken  bool
73		brokenAtSeq  int64
74	}
75	
76	// NewService wires the service from the shared dependency container. The
77	// logger is the module-scoped logger derived in Register.
78	func NewService(d *deps.Deps, log *slog.Logger) *Service {
79		return &Service{
80			log:      log,
81			repo:     newRepo(d.DB),
82			ledger:   d.Ledger,
83			orgs:     d.Orgs,
84			qrSecret: d.Cfg.QRSigningSecret,
85		}
86	}
87	
88	// internalErr converts an unexpected failure into the opaque 500, logging it
89	// at ERROR with operation context first. Typed AppErrors (404s, 400s, org
90	// resolver errors) pass through untouched so client-facing semantics never
91	// change.
92	func (s *Service) internalErr(ctx context.Context, op string, err error, attrs ...any) error {
93		var appErr *httpx.AppError
94		if errors.As(err, &appErr) {
95			return appErr
96		}
97		args := append([]any{slog.Any("err", err)}, attrs...)
98		s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, op, args...)
99		return httpx.Internal(err)
100	}
101	
102	// VerifyQRToken checks a stored signed token in the format QR issuance
103	// (plant module signQRToken) mints: "base64url(qr_code|product_lot_id_hex|
104	// issued_unix)" + "." + hex(HMAC-SHA256(secret, decoded payload)), where
105	// product_lot_id_hex is productLotID.Hex(). The HMAC is computed over the
106	// DECODED payload bytes — exactly what issuance signed. The comparison is
107	// constant-time so a forger learns nothing from response timing.
108	func VerifyQRToken(secret, token string) bool {
109		payloadB64, signature, found := strings.Cut(token, ".")
110		if !found || payloadB64 == "" || signature == "" {
111			return false // malformed: no payload/signature split
112		}
113		payload, err := base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString(payloadB64)
114		if err != nil || len(payload) == 0 {
115			return false // malformed: payload is not valid base64url
116		}
117		expected := auth.HMACHash(secret, string(payload))
118		return auth.ConstantTimeEqual(expected, signature)
119	}
120	
121	// ScanQR resolves one consumer QR scan into the honest provenance view
122	// (§7.4): product + plant + lab certificate + the SET of contributing
123	// samitis — never per-farmer data — plus a live tamper-evidence check.
124	func (s *Service) ScanQR(ctx context.Context, qrCode string) (*QRScanResponse, error) {
125		qr, err := s.repo.qrByCode(ctx, qrCode)
126		if err != nil {
127			return nil, s.internalErr(ctx, "qr scan: load qr", err, slog.String("qr_code", qrCode))
128		}
129	
130		// Integrity gate: the stored token must carry a valid HMAC. A mismatch
131		// means the QR record was tampered with or forged — surface it loudly.
132		if !VerifyQRToken(s.qrSecret, qr.SignedToken) {
133			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "QR signed-token integrity check failed — possible forgery",
134				slog.String("qr_code", qrCode), slog.String("qr_id", qr.ID.Hex()))
135			return nil, httpx.Conflict("QR_INTEGRITY_FAILED",
136				"this QR code failed integrity verification and may be counterfeit")
137		}
138	
139		// Count the scan without ever blocking it: fire-and-forget increment.
140		go func(qrID primitive.ObjectID) {
141			bg, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
142			defer cancel()
143			if err := s.repo.incrementScanCount(bg, qrID); err != nil {
144				s.log.WarnContext(bg, "scan_count increment failed",
145					slog.String("qr_id", qrID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
146			}
147		}(qr.ID)
148	
149		lot, err := s.repo.productLotByID(ctx, qr.ProductLotID)
150		if err != nil {
151			return nil, s.internalErr(ctx, "qr scan: load product lot", err,
152				slog.String("qr_id", qr.ID.Hex()), slog.String("product_lot_id", qr.ProductLotID.Hex()))
153		}
154		batch, err := s.repo.batchByID(ctx, lot.BatchID)
155		if err != nil {
156			return nil, s.internalErr(ctx, "qr scan: load processing batch", err,
157				slog.String("product_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()), slog.String("batch_id", lot.BatchID.Hex()))
158		}
159		plant, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, batch.PlantID)
160		if err != nil {
161			return nil, s.internalErr(ctx, "qr scan: resolve plant org", err,
162				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()), slog.String("plant_id", batch.PlantID.Hex()))
163		}
164	
165		// Walk the provenance graph upstream from the product lot and STOP at the
166		// pooling boundary: batch → BMC lots → consignments (§7.4). Consignment
167		// refs (hundreds of per-pour nodes, cross-route trip fan-out) are never
168		// expanded — the consumer view only needs the samiti set.
169		events, err := s.ledger.TraceStopAt(ctx, domain.EntityProductLot, lot.ID.Hex(), traceDepth,
170			map[string]bool{domain.EntityConsignment: true})
171		if err != nil {
172			return nil, s.internalErr(ctx, "qr scan: trace product lot", err,
173				slog.String("product_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()))
174		}
175	
176		sourcing, err := s.buildSourcing(ctx, events)
177		if err != nil {
178			return nil, err
179		}
180	
181		ledgerInfo, err := s.verifyTracedRange(ctx, events)
182		if err != nil {
183			return nil, err
184		}
185	
186		resp := &QRScanResponse{
187			Product: ProductInfo{
188				Name:       lot.ProductName,
189				SKU:        lot.SKU,
190				UnitSize:   lot.UnitSize,
191				MfgDate:    lot.MfgDate,
192				ExpiryDate: lot.ExpiryDate,
193			},
194			BatchNumber: batch.BatchNumber,
195			Plant:       PlantInfo{Name: plant.Name, District: plant.District},
196			Sourcing:    *sourcing,
197			Ledger:      *ledgerInfo,
198			ScanCount:   qr.ScanCount + 1, // reflect this scan; the $inc lands async
199		}
200	
201		// PLANT_LAB pass certificate — omitted (not an error) when absent.
202		qc, err := s.repo.latestPlantLabPass(ctx, batch.ID)
203		if err != nil {
204			return nil, s.internalErr(ctx, "qr scan: load plant lab certificate", err,
205				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()))
206		}
207		if qc != nil {
208			resp.Quality = &QualityInfo{
209				CertificateNumber: qc.CertificateNumber,
210				Stage:             qc.Stage,
211				Tests:             qc.Tests,
212				RecordedAt:        qc.RecordedAt,
213			}
214		}
215	
216		// A recalled lot still resolves with 200 — consumers must SEE the recall
217		// notice, not hit a dead link.
218		if lot.Status == domain.ProductLotStatusRecalled {
219			resp.Recalled = true
220			notice := "This product lot has been RECALLED. Do not consume — return it to the point of purchase."
221			if lot.RecallReason != "" {
222				notice += " Reason: " + lot.RecallReason
223			}
224			resp.RecallNotice = notice
225		}
226	
227		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "qr scan resolved",
228			slog.String("qr_code", qrCode),
229			slog.String("qr_id", qr.ID.Hex()),
230			slog.String("product_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()),
231			slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
232			slog.String("batch_number", batch.BatchNumber),
233			slog.Int("samitis", len(sourcing.Samitis)),
234			slog.Bool("ledger_intact", ledgerInfo.Intact),
235			slog.Bool("recalled", resp.Recalled))
236		return resp, nil
237	}
238	
239	// buildSourcing derives the samiti-set view from traced consignment events:
240	// contributing DCS org ids from each event's org_unit_id/payload, collection
241	// dates from payloads, with the consignment documents as fallback when the
242	// events did not carry those fields. Ledger events carry ObjectIDs as hex
243	// strings, so the sets are hex-keyed and parsed at the DB/orgscope boundary.
244	func (s *Service) buildSourcing(ctx context.Context, events []provenance.Event) (*SourcingInfo, error) {
245		dcsIDs := map[string]struct{}{}
246		dates := map[string]struct{}{}
247		consignmentIDs := map[string]struct{}{}
248	
249		for _, ev := range events {
250			if ev.EntityType != domain.EntityConsignment {
251				continue
252			}
253			consignmentIDs[ev.EntityID] = struct{}{}
254			// Only created/dispatched events carry the DCS in org_unit_id —
255			// consignment.picked_up is appended by logistics under the UNION's
256			// org id, which must never be counted as a contributing samiti.
257			switch ev.Type {
258			case domain.EventConsignmentCreated, domain.EventConsignmentDispatched:
259				if ev.OrgUnitID != "" {
260					dcsIDs[ev.OrgUnitID] = struct{}{}
261				} else if v, ok := ev.Payload["dcs_id"].(string); ok && v != "" {
262					dcsIDs[v] = struct{}{}
263				}
264			}
265			if v, ok := ev.Payload["date"].(string); ok && v != "" {
266				dates[v] = struct{}{}
267			}
268		}
269	
270		// Fallback: if the events lacked DCS ids or dates, read the consignment
271		// docs themselves (still samiti-level — pour ids are never surfaced).
272		if len(consignmentIDs) > 0 && (len(dcsIDs) == 0 || len(dates) == 0) {
273			ids := make([]primitive.ObjectID, 0, len(consignmentIDs))
274			for _, hexID := range sortedKeys(consignmentIDs) {
275				cid, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(hexID)
276				if err != nil {
277					// Ledger event ids should always be ObjectID hex — flag and skip.
278					s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "QR scan: traced consignment id is not a valid object id",
279						slog.String("consignment_id", hexID))
280					continue
281				}
282				ids = append(ids, cid)
283			}
284			docs, err := s.repo.consignmentsByIDs(ctx, ids)
285			if err != nil {
286				return nil, s.internalErr(ctx, "qr scan: load consignments for sourcing", err)
287			}
288			for _, c := range docs {
289				if !c.DCSID.IsZero() {
290					dcsIDs[c.DCSID.Hex()] = struct{}{}
291				}
292				if c.Date != "" {
293					dates[c.Date] = struct{}{}
294				}
295			}
296		}
297	
298		samitis := make([]SamitiInfo, 0, len(dcsIDs))
299		districts := map[string]struct{}{}
300		for _, hexID := range sortedKeys(dcsIDs) {
301			orgID, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(hexID)
302			if err != nil {
303				// A malformed id must not break a consumer scan — log and skip.
304				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "QR scan: contributing DCS id is not a valid object id",
305					slog.String("dcs_org_id", hexID))
306				continue
307			}
308			org, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, orgID)
309			if err != nil {
310				// A missing org unit must not break a consumer scan — log and skip.
311				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "QR scan: contributing DCS org not resolvable",
312					slog.String("dcs_org_id", hexID), slog.Any("err", err))
313				continue
314			}
315			// Defence in depth: the §7.4 samiti set may only contain DCS units.
316			if org.Type != domain.OrgTypeDCS {
317				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "QR scan: non-DCS org unit skipped from samiti set",
318					slog.String("org_id", hexID), slog.String("org_type", org.Type))
319				continue
320			}
321			samitis = append(samitis, SamitiInfo{Name: org.Name, Code: org.Code, District: org.District})
322			if org.District != "" {
323				districts[org.District] = struct{}{}
324			}
325		}
326		sort.Slice(samitis, func(i, j int) bool { return samitis[i].Name < samitis[j].Name })
327	
328		collectionDates := sortedKeys(dates)
329		return &SourcingInfo{
330			Message:         sourcingMessage(collectionDates, len(samitis), sortedKeys(districts)),
331			Samitis:         samitis,
332			CollectionDates: collectionDates,
333		}, nil
334	}
335	
336	// sourcingMessage renders the consumer-facing pooled-provenance sentence,
337	// e.g. "Made from milk collected on 2026-07-05 from 3 samitis in Lucknow".
338	func sourcingMessage(dates []string, samitiCount int, districts []string) string {
339		var b strings.Builder
340		b.WriteString("Made from milk collected")
341		if len(dates) > 0 {
342			b.WriteString(" on " + strings.Join(dates, ", "))
343		}
344		noun := "samitis"
345		if samitiCount == 1 {
346			noun = "samiti"
347		}
348		fmt.Fprintf(&b, " from %d %s", samitiCount, noun)
349		if len(districts) > 0 {
350			b.WriteString(" in " + strings.Join(districts, ", "))
351		}
352		return b.String()
353	}
354	
355	// verifyTracedRange answers the per-scan tamper-evidence check from a
356	// cumulative verification watermark: the chain is verified incrementally up
357	// to the traced range's max seq, and once a prefix is verified, later scans
358	// inside it are O(1) — no per-request re-hash of thousands of interleaved
359	// events. Spans over scanVerifySpanCap are verified partially (most recent
360	// tail) and flagged, matching the previous per-scan behaviour.
361	func (s *Service) verifyTracedRange(ctx context.Context, events []provenance.Event) (*LedgerInfo, error) {
362		if len(events) == 0 {
363			return &LedgerInfo{Events: 0, Intact: true, VerifiedRange: [2]int64{0, 0}}, nil
364		}
365		maxSeq := events[0].Seq
366		for _, ev := range events[1:] {
367			if ev.Seq > maxSeq {
368				maxSeq = ev.Seq
369			}
370		}
371	
372		s.verifyMu.Lock()
373		defer s.verifyMu.Unlock()
374	
375		if s.chainBroken {
376			return &LedgerInfo{
377				Events:        len(events),
378				Intact:        false,
379				VerifiedRange: [2]int64{s.brokenAtSeq, s.brokenAtSeq},
380			}, nil
381		}
382		if maxSeq <= s.verifiedUpTo {
383			return &LedgerInfo{
384				Events:        len(events),
385				Intact:        true,
386				VerifiedRange: [2]int64{1, s.verifiedUpTo},
387			}, nil
388		}
389	
390		// Extend the watermark: start at the last verified event (re-hashing it
391		// covers the boundary linkage), capped to the per-request span budget.
392		from, partial := max(int64(1), s.verifiedUpTo), false
393		if maxSeq-from+1 > scanVerifySpanCap {
394			from, partial = maxSeq-scanVerifySpanCap+1, true
395		}
396		intact, brokenAt, err := s.ledger.VerifyChain(ctx, from, maxSeq)
397		if err != nil {
398			return nil, s.internalErr(ctx, "qr scan: verify ledger chain", err,
399				slog.Int64("from", from), slog.Int64("to", maxSeq))
400		}
401		if intact {
402			s.verifiedUpTo = maxSeq
403		} else {
404			s.chainBroken, s.brokenAtSeq = true, brokenAt
405			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "provenance chain break detected during scan verification",
406				slog.Int64("broken_at_seq", brokenAt),
407				slog.Int64("from", from), slog.Int64("to", maxSeq))
408		}
409		return &LedgerInfo{
410			Events:        len(events),
411			Intact:        intact,
412			VerifiedRange: [2]int64{from, maxSeq},
413			Partial:       partial,
414		}, nil
415	}
416	
417	// VerifyLedger runs the public tamper-evidence check over [from,to]. Both
418	// bounds are optional: `to` defaults to the chain head, `from` to the start
419	// of the last publicVerifySpanCap events. Spans over the cap are rejected.
420	func (s *Service) VerifyLedger(ctx context.Context, fromRaw, toRaw string) (*LedgerVerifyResponse, error) {
421		latest, err := s.ledger.LatestSeq(ctx)
422		if err != nil {
423			return nil, s.internalErr(ctx, "ledger verify: read chain head", err)
424		}
425		if latest == 0 {
426			return &LedgerVerifyResponse{Intact: true, From: 0, To: 0}, nil // empty chain is trivially intact
427		}
428	
429		to := latest
430		if toRaw != "" {
431			n, err := strconv.ParseInt(toRaw, 10, 64)
432			if err != nil || n < 1 {
433				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_RANGE", "'to' must be a positive sequence number")
434			}
435			to = min(n, latest)
436		}
437		from := max(int64(1), to-publicVerifySpanCap+1)
438		if fromRaw != "" {
439			n, err := strconv.ParseInt(fromRaw, 10, 64)
440			if err != nil || n < 1 {
441				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_RANGE", "'from' must be a positive sequence number")
442			}
443			from = n
444		}
445		if from > to {
446			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_RANGE", "'from' must not exceed 'to'")
447		}
448		if to-from+1 > publicVerifySpanCap {
449			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("SPAN_TOO_WIDE",
450				fmt.Sprintf("verification span is capped at %d events per request", publicVerifySpanCap))
451		}
452	
453		intact, brokenAt, err := s.ledger.VerifyChain(ctx, from, to)
454		if err != nil {
455			return nil, s.internalErr(ctx, "ledger verify: verify chain", err,
456				slog.Int64("from", from), slog.Int64("to", to))
457		}
458		resp := &LedgerVerifyResponse{Intact: intact, From: from, To: to}
459		if !intact {
460			resp.BrokenAtSeq = &brokenAt
461			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "public ledger verification found a broken chain",
462				slog.Int64("broken_at_seq", brokenAt),
463				slog.Int64("from", from), slog.Int64("to", to))
464		}
465		return resp, nil
466	}
467	
468	// TraceGraph returns the full event graph around one entity: upstream via
469	// the recursive ref walk, downstream via reverse-ref lookup — the recall /
470	// root-cause tool (§8.3). entityID is the entity's ObjectID as a hex string
471	// (already validated by the handler; the ledger stores ids as hex).
472	func (s *Service) TraceGraph(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string) (*TraceGraphResponse, error) {
473		if err := validateEntityType(entityType); err != nil {
474			return nil, err
475		}
476		upstream, err := s.ledger.Trace(ctx, entityType, entityID, traceDepth)
477		if err != nil {
478			return nil, s.internalErr(ctx, "trace graph: upstream walk", err,
479				slog.String("entity_type", entityType), slog.String("entity_id", entityID))
480		}
481		// The cap is pushed into the query: only the LAST downstreamEventCap
482		// referencing events are fetched, instead of decoding an unbounded set
483		// into memory and truncating afterwards.
484		downstream, err := s.ledger.DownstreamRefs(ctx, entityID, downstreamEventCap)
485		if err != nil {
486			return nil, s.internalErr(ctx, "trace graph: downstream refs", err,
487				slog.String("entity_type", entityType), slog.String("entity_id", entityID))
488		}
489		if len(upstream) == 0 && len(downstream) == 0 {
490			return nil, httpx.NotFound("provenance for entity")
491		}
492		if upstream == nil {
493			upstream = []provenance.Event{}
494		}
495		if downstream == nil {
496			downstream = []provenance.Event{}
497		}
498		return &TraceGraphResponse{Upstream: upstream, Downstream: downstream}, nil
499	}
500	
501	// Timeline returns one entity's own events in chain order, paginated. The
502	// skip/limit is pushed into the Mongo query so a page read never loads the
503	// entity's full history. The second return value is the total event count.
504	// entityID is the entity's ObjectID as a hex string (handler-validated).
505	func (s *Service) Timeline(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, page httpx.Page) ([]provenance.Event, int, error) {
506		if err := validateEntityType(entityType); err != nil {
507			return nil, 0, err
508		}
509		total, err := s.ledger.CountEventsForEntity(ctx, entityType, entityID)
510		if err != nil {
511			return nil, 0, s.internalErr(ctx, "timeline: count entity events", err,
512				slog.String("entity_type", entityType), slog.String("entity_id", entityID))
513		}
514		if total == 0 {
515			return nil, 0, httpx.NotFound("provenance for entity")
516		}
517		events, err := s.ledger.EventsForEntityPage(ctx, entityType, entityID, page.Offset, page.Limit)
518		if err != nil {
519			return nil, 0, s.internalErr(ctx, "timeline: load entity events page", err,
520				slog.String("entity_type", entityType), slog.String("entity_id", entityID))
521		}
522		return events, int(total), nil
523	}
524	
525	// validateEntityType rejects entity types outside the domain.Entity* catalog.
526	func validateEntityType(entityType string) error {
527		if _, ok := validEntityTypes[entityType]; !ok {
528			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_ENTITY_TYPE",
529				"unknown entity type "+entityType+" — use one of the provenance entity type constants")
530		}
531		return nil
532	}
533	
534	// sortedKeys returns a set's keys in deterministic (lexicographic) order.
535	func sortedKeys(set map[string]struct{}) []string {
536		out := make([]string, 0, len(set))
537		for k := range set {
538			out = append(out, k)
539		}
540		sort.Strings(out)
541		return out

9	// InitiateSettlementRequest asks Saathi to bundle a DCS day's ISSUED invoices
10	// into one settlement batch (blueprint §8.1 step 1: Saathi computes and
11	// *initiates* — it never moves money). DCSID arrives as a plain hex string in
12	// JSON and unmarshals natively into an ObjectID.
13	type InitiateSettlementRequest struct {
14		DCSID primitive.ObjectID `json:"dcs_id"`
15		Date  string             `json:"date,omitempty"` // YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to today (IST)
16	}

21	}

26		Payouts []domain.PayoutInstruction `json:"payout_instructions"`
27	}
28	
29	// CreateDBTRequestInput submits a scheme subsidy for PFMS/DBT routing
30	// (blueprint §13). Subsidy money is strictly separate from milk payments.
31	type CreateDBTRequestInput struct {
32		SchemeCode    string             `json:"scheme_code"`
33		FarmerPartyID primitive.ObjectID `json:"farmer_party_id"`
34		Amount        float64            `json:"amount"`
35	}

38	type UpdateDBTStatusInput struct {
39		Status string `json:"status"` // ACCEPTED | CREDITED | REJECTED
40	}

44	// module consumes it to queue the TemplatePayoutCredited SMS
45	// ("₹ credited, UTR …" — blueprint §8.1 last step). FarmerPartyID crosses the
46	// bus seam as an ObjectID hex string (bus payloads are a JSON-shape contract).
47	type PayoutCreditedEvent struct {
