```text
1	package quality
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"errors"
6		"fmt"
7		"log/slog"
8		"net/http"
9		"strings"
10		"time"
11	
12		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
13	
14		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
16		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
17		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/eventbus"
18		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
19		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/provenance"
20	)
21	
22	// service holds the safety-gate business logic (blueprint §8.3): evaluate
23	// tests against FSSAI limits, write the verdict onto the subject, chain the
24	// provenance events, and broadcast blocks to downstream modules.
25	type service struct {
26		deps *deps.Deps
27		repo *repository
28		log  *slog.Logger
29	}
30	
31	// newService wires the service with its module-scoped logger.
32	func newService(d *deps.Deps, repo *repository, log *slog.Logger) *service {
33		return &service{deps: d, repo: repo, log: log}
34	}
35	
36	// actorID parses the actor's party ObjectID out of its JWT hex string.
37	func actorID(actor auth.Actor) (primitive.ObjectID, error) {
38		return httpx.ParseID(actor.PartyID, "actor")
39	}
40	
41	// gateSubject is what the gate needs to know about an eligible subject.
42	type gateSubject struct {
43		entityType string             // provenance entity const for the subject
44		orgUnitID  primitive.ObjectID // owning org unit (BMC or plant) for scope + ledger
45		status     string
46	}
47	
48	// requiredRoleForStage returns the one role allowed to record results at a
49	// stage (BMC_RAPID↔BMC_OPERATOR, PLANT_LAB↔PLANT_LAB_ANALYST), and whether
50	// the stage is known at all.
51	func requiredRoleForStage(stage string) (string, bool) {
52		switch stage {
53		case domain.QCStageBMCRapid:
54			return domain.RoleBMCOperator, true
55		case domain.QCStagePlantLab:
56			return domain.RolePlantLabAnalyst, true
57		default:
58			return "", false
59		}
60	}
61	
62	// certificateNumber builds the human-readable QC certificate identifier from
63	// the per-stage counter, e.g. "QC-PLANT_LAB-000042".
64	func certificateNumber(stage string, seq int64) string {
65		return fmt.Sprintf("QC-%s-%06d", stage, seq)
66	}
67	
68	// knownQCTests is the closed vocabulary of recordable test names: the four
69	// gated FSSAI tests plus the explicitly whitelisted grading tests. Anything
70	// else (including a typo like "AFLATOXIN_M") is rejected instead of being
71	// silently recorded as a non-gating pass.
72	var knownQCTests = map[string]struct{}{
73		domain.TestAflatoxinM1: {},
74		domain.TestColiform:    {},
75		domain.TestAntibiotic:  {},
76		domain.TestPhosphatase: {},
77		domain.TestTPC:         {},
78		domain.TestFat:         {},
79		domain.TestSNF:         {},
80	}
81	
82	// mandatoryTestsForStage returns the tests a stage MUST measure before a PASS
83	// verdict may be issued (blueprint §8.3: heat-stable aflatoxin M1 is gated at
84	// BMC and plant; phosphatase proves pasteurisation at the plant lab).
85	func mandatoryTestsForStage(stage string) []string {
86		switch stage {
87		case domain.QCStageBMCRapid:
88			return []string{domain.TestAflatoxinM1, domain.TestColiform}
89		case domain.QCStagePlantLab:
90			return []string{domain.TestAflatoxinM1, domain.TestColiform, domain.TestPhosphatase}
91		default:
92			return nil
93		}
94	}
95	
96	// validateTestNames rejects any test outside the known vocabulary.
97	func validateTestNames(tests []QCTestInput) *httpx.AppError {
98		for _, t := range tests {
99			if _, ok := knownQCTests[t.Name]; !ok {
100				return httpx.BadRequest("UNKNOWN_TEST",
101					"unknown test name "+t.Name+" — gated tests: "+domain.TestAflatoxinM1+", "+
102						domain.TestColiform+", "+domain.TestAntibiotic+", "+domain.TestPhosphatase)
103			}
104		}
105		return nil
106	}
107	
108	// missingMandatoryTests lists the stage's mandatory tests absent from the
109	// submission.
110	func missingMandatoryTests(stage string, tests []QCTestInput) []string {
111		present := make(map[string]bool, len(tests))
112		for _, t := range tests {
113			present[t.Name] = true
114		}
115		var missing []string
116		for _, name := range mandatoryTestsForStage(stage) {
117			if !present[name] {
118				missing = append(missing, name)
119			}
120		}
121		return missing
122	}
123	
124	// recordQCResult evaluates the submitted tests against the FSSAI gate,
125	// persists the result, applies the PASSED/BLOCKED verdict to the subject and
126	// chains the provenance events. This is the only write path that moves a
127	// subject out of QC_PENDING.
128	func (s *service) recordQCResult(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req RecordQCResultRequest) (*domain.QCResult, error) {
129		// Stage×role pairing — RequireRoles admits both analyst roles, the exact
130		// pairing is enforced here.
131		requiredRole, ok := requiredRoleForStage(req.Stage)
132		if !ok {
133			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_STAGE", "stage must be "+domain.QCStageBMCRapid+" or "+domain.QCStagePlantLab)
134		}
135		if actor.RoleCode != requiredRole {
136			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qc stage-role mismatch rejected",
137				slog.String("stage", req.Stage),
138				slog.String("required_role", requiredRole),
139				slog.String("actor_role", actor.RoleCode),
140				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
141				slog.String("subject_type", req.SubjectType),
142				slog.String("subject_id", req.SubjectID.Hex()))
143			return nil, httpx.Forbidden("STAGE_ROLE_MISMATCH: stage " + req.Stage + " results may only be recorded by " + requiredRole)
144		}
145	
146		analystID, err := actorID(actor)
147		if err != nil {
148			return nil, err
149		}
150	
151		subject, err := s.loadGateSubject(ctx, req.SubjectType, req.SubjectID)
152		if err != nil {
153			var appErr *httpx.AppError
154			if errors.As(err, &appErr) && appErr.Status == http.StatusConflict {
155				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qc subject not awaiting verdict",
156					slog.String("subject_type", req.SubjectType),
157					slog.String("subject_id", req.SubjectID.Hex()),
158					slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
159					slog.String("reason", appErr.Error()))
160			}
161			return nil, err
162		}
163		if err := s.deps.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, subject.orgUnitID); err != nil {
164			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qc scope denied",
165				slog.String("subject_type", req.SubjectType),
166				slog.String("subject_id", req.SubjectID.Hex()),
167				slog.String("subject_org_unit_id", subject.orgUnitID.Hex()),
168				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
169				slog.Any("err", err))
170			return nil, err
171		}
172	
173		// Closed test vocabulary: a typo'd or irrelevant test name must never be
174		// able to satisfy the safety gate.
175		if aerr := validateTestNames(req.Tests); aerr != nil {
176			return nil, aerr
177		}
178	
179		// Evaluate against the FSSAI limits (domain owns the rules).
180		overallPass, failures, evaluated := domain.EvaluateQCTests(toDomainTests(req.Tests))
181	
182		// A PASS verdict requires every mandatory test of the stage to be present
183		// AND within limits — the gate cannot be satisfied by a contentless
184		// submission (blueprint §8.3). A failing partial submission still records
185		// its BLOCK: quarantining on partial evidence is safety-conservative.
186		if missing := missingMandatoryTests(req.Stage, req.Tests); len(missing) > 0 && overallPass {
187			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qc pass rejected: mandatory tests missing",
188				slog.String("stage", req.Stage),
189				slog.String("subject_type", req.SubjectType),
190				slog.String("subject_id", req.SubjectID.Hex()),
191				slog.Any("missing_tests", missing),
192				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
193			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("MISSING_MANDATORY_TESTS",
194				"stage "+req.Stage+" cannot PASS without its mandatory tests").
195				WithDetails(map[string]any{"missing_tests": missing})
196		}
197	
198		// Pre-generate the result ID so the insert, the provenance refs and the
199		// gate write all share one consistent identifier.
200		resultID := primitive.NewObjectID()
201		now := time.Now().UTC()
202	
203		result := &domain.QCResult{
204			ID:             resultID,
205			SubjectType:    req.SubjectType,
206			SubjectID:      req.SubjectID,
207			Stage:          req.Stage,
208			Tests:          evaluated,
209			OverallPass:    overallPass,
210			AnalystPartyID: analystID,
211			LabRef:         req.LabRef,
212			RecordedAt:     now,
213		}
214	
215		// The write sequence below must not be aborted midway by a client
216		// disconnect: detach from the request context, keep a server-side bound.
217		wctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.WithoutCancel(ctx), 15*time.Second)
218		defer cancel()
219	
220		blockReason := ""
221		if overallPass {
222			seq, err := s.repo.nextCertificateSeq(wctx, req.Stage)
223			if err != nil {
224				s.logInternal(ctx, "issue qc certificate seq", req, err)
225				return nil, err
226			}
227			result.CertificateNumber = certificateNumber(req.Stage, seq)
228		} else {
229			result.FailureReasons = failures
230			blockReason = strings.Join(failures, "; ")
231		}
232	
233		// Ordering is safety-critical: evidence (qc_results doc) and provenance
234		// (hash-chained events) are persisted FIRST; the irreversible status flip
235		// on the subject happens LAST. A crash mid-sequence can leave an extra
236		// auditable result document, never a PASSED lot without evidence.
237		if err := s.repo.insertResult(wctx, result); err != nil {
238			s.logInternal(ctx, "insert qc result", req, err)
239			return nil, err
240		}
241	
242		// Provenance: qc.recorded, then the gate verdict event (blueprint §7).
243		ledgerActor := provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode}
244		recorded, err := s.deps.Ledger.Append(wctx, provenance.AppendInput{
245			Type:       domain.EventQCRecorded,
246			EntityType: domain.EntityQCResult,
247			EntityID:   resultID.Hex(),
248			Refs: []provenance.Ref{
249				{EntityType: subject.entityType, EntityID: req.SubjectID.Hex(), Relation: "tested"},
250			},
251			Actor:     ledgerActor,
252			OrgUnitID: subject.orgUnitID.Hex(),
253			Payload: map[string]any{
254				"stage":        req.Stage,
255				"subject_type": req.SubjectType,
256				"overall_pass": overallPass,
257			},
258		})
259		if err != nil {
260			s.logInternal(ctx, "append qc.recorded provenance event", req, err)
261			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
262		}
263	
264		gateEvent := provenance.AppendInput{
265			EntityType: domain.EntityQCResult,
266			EntityID:   resultID.Hex(),
267			Actor:      ledgerActor,
268			OrgUnitID:  subject.orgUnitID.Hex(),
269		}
270		if overallPass {
271			gateEvent.Type = domain.EventGatePassed
272			gateEvent.Refs = []provenance.Ref{
273				{EntityType: subject.entityType, EntityID: req.SubjectID.Hex(), Relation: "certifies"},
274			}
275			gateEvent.Payload = map[string]any{"certificate_number": result.CertificateNumber}
276		} else {
277			gateEvent.Type = domain.EventGateBlocked
278			gateEvent.Refs = []provenance.Ref{
279				{EntityType: subject.entityType, EntityID: req.SubjectID.Hex(), Relation: "blocks"},
280			}
281			gateEvent.Payload = map[string]any{"failure_reasons": failures}
282		}
283		if _, err := s.deps.Ledger.Append(wctx, gateEvent); err != nil {
284			s.logInternal(ctx, "append gate verdict provenance event", req, err)
285			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
286		}
287	
288		if err := s.repo.setResultProvenanceSeq(wctx, resultID, recorded.Seq); err != nil {
289			s.logInternal(ctx, "stamp qc result provenance seq", req, err)
290			return nil, err
291		}
292		result.ProvenanceSeq = recorded.Seq
293	
294		// LAST: apply the verdict. The conditional QC_PENDING filter remains the
295		// concurrency guard — a lost race voids OUR result (dangling evidence is
296		// auditable and harmless, unlike a dangling status flip).
297		gated, err := s.applyGate(wctx, req.SubjectType, req.SubjectID, resultID, overallPass, blockReason)
298		if err != nil {
299			s.logInternal(ctx, "apply gate verdict", req, err)
300			return nil, err
301		}
302		if !gated {
303			if err := s.repo.markResultSuperseded(wctx, resultID); err != nil {
304				s.logInternal(ctx, "mark qc result superseded", req, err)
305				return nil, err
306			}
307			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qc gate race lost: result superseded",
308				slog.String("qc_result_id", resultID.Hex()),
309				slog.String("subject_type", req.SubjectType),
310				slog.String("subject_id", req.SubjectID.Hex()),
311				slog.String("stage", req.Stage),
312				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
313			return nil, httpx.Conflict("SUBJECT_ALREADY_GATED", "subject is no longer awaiting QC — a verdict was already recorded")
314		}
315	
316		if overallPass {
317			s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "qc gate passed",
318				slog.String("qc_result_id", resultID.Hex()),
319				slog.String("subject_type", req.SubjectType),
320				slog.String("subject_id", req.SubjectID.Hex()),
321				slog.String("stage", req.Stage),
322				slog.String("certificate_number", result.CertificateNumber),
323				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
324		} else {
325			// Gate block is a WARN: the subject is quarantined and can never advance.
326			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qc gate blocked: subject quarantined",
327				slog.String("qc_result_id", resultID.Hex()),
328				slog.String("subject_type", req.SubjectType),
329				slog.String("subject_id", req.SubjectID.Hex()),
330				slog.String("stage", req.Stage),
331				slog.Any("failure_reasons", failures),
332				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
333			// Broadcast the block so the plant module quarantines downstream — a
334			// blocked lot can never advance.
335			s.deps.Bus.Publish(eventbus.TopicGateBlocked, GateBlockedPayload{
336				SubjectType:    req.SubjectType,
337				SubjectID:      req.SubjectID,
338				QCResultID:     resultID,
339				Stage:          req.Stage,
340				FailureReasons: failures,
341			})
342		}
343		return result, nil
344	}
345	
346	// logInternal records an unexpected failure with the operation and subject
347	// context before the error surfaces as a 500.
348	func (s *service) logInternal(ctx context.Context, op string, req RecordQCResultRequest, err error) {
349		s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "qc record failed: "+op,
350			slog.String("subject_type", req.SubjectType),
351			slog.String("subject_id", req.SubjectID.Hex()),
352			slog.String("stage", req.Stage),
353			slog.Any("err", err))
354	}
355	
356	// loadGateSubject fetches a gate-eligible subject and verifies it is awaiting
357	// QC. Only BMC lots and processing batches carry the software safety gate.
358	func (s *service) loadGateSubject(ctx context.Context, subjectType string, subjectID primitive.ObjectID) (gateSubject, error) {
359		switch subjectType {
360		case domain.QCSubjectBMCLot:
361			lot, err := s.repo.findBMCLot(ctx, subjectID)
362			if err != nil {
363				return gateSubject{}, err
364			}
365			if lot.Status != domain.BMCLotStatusQCPending {
366				return gateSubject{}, httpx.Conflict("SUBJECT_NOT_QC_PENDING", "bmc lot is in status "+lot.Status+" — only QC_PENDING subjects can be gated")
367			}
368			return gateSubject{entityType: domain.EntityBMCLot, orgUnitID: lot.BMCID, status: lot.Status}, nil
369	
370		case domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch:
371			batch, err := s.repo.findBatch(ctx, subjectID)
372			if err != nil {
373				return gateSubject{}, err
374			}
375			if batch.Status != domain.BatchStatusQCPending {
376				return gateSubject{}, httpx.Conflict("SUBJECT_NOT_QC_PENDING", "processing batch is in status "+batch.Status+" — only QC_PENDING subjects can be gated")
377			}
378			return gateSubject{entityType: domain.EntityBatch, orgUnitID: batch.PlantID, status: batch.Status}, nil
379	
380		case domain.QCSubjectDCSConsignment:
381			return gateSubject{}, httpx.Unprocessable("SUBJECT_NOT_GATE_ELIGIBLE", "DCS consignments are not gate subjects — gate at the BMC lot or processing batch")
382	
383		default:
384			return gateSubject{}, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_SUBJECT_TYPE", "subject_type must be one of "+domain.QCSubjectBMCLot+", "+domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch)
385		}
386	}
387	
388	// applyGate routes the conditional verdict write to the subject's collection,
389	// mapping the verdict onto that subject kind's status constants.
390	func (s *service) applyGate(ctx context.Context, subjectType string, subjectID, resultID primitive.ObjectID, pass bool, blockReason string) (bool, error) {
391		switch subjectType {
392		case domain.QCSubjectBMCLot:
393			status := domain.BMCLotStatusBlocked
394			if pass {
395				status = domain.BMCLotStatusPassed
396			}
397			return s.repo.gateBMCLot(ctx, subjectID, resultID, status, blockReason)
398		case domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch:
399			status := domain.BatchStatusBlocked
400			if pass {
401				status = domain.BatchStatusPassed
402			}
403			return s.repo.gateBatch(ctx, subjectID, resultID, status, blockReason)
404		default:
405			return false, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_SUBJECT_TYPE", "subject_type is not gate-eligible")
406		}
407	}
408	
409	// listQCResults returns a page of results, newest first. When the filter
410	// identifies an org-owned subject, the caller must be in that org's scope.
411	// A zero subjectID means "no subject filter".
412	func (s *service) listQCResults(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, subjectType string, subjectID primitive.ObjectID, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.QCResult, int64, error) {
413		if subjectType != "" && !isValidSubjectType(subjectType) {
414			return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_SUBJECT_TYPE", "unknown subject_type "+subjectType)
415		}
416		if !subjectID.IsZero() && subjectType == "" {
417			return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_SUBJECT_TYPE", "subject_id requires subject_type")
418		}
419		if !subjectID.IsZero() {
420			if err := s.requireSubjectScope(ctx, actor, subjectType, subjectID); err != nil {
421				return nil, 0, err
422			}
423		}
424		return s.repo.listResults(ctx, subjectType, subjectID, page)
425	}
426	
427	// getQCResult returns one result (its tests carry the stored pass verdicts),
428	// enforcing the subject org scope.
429	func (s *service) getQCResult(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, resultID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.QCResult, error) {
430		result, err := s.repo.findResultByID(ctx, resultID)
431		if err != nil {
432			return nil, err
433		}
434		if err := s.requireSubjectScope(ctx, actor, result.SubjectType, result.SubjectID); err != nil {
435			return nil, err
436		}
437		return result, nil
438	}
439	
440	// requireSubjectScope enforces the caller's org scope over the org unit that
441	// owns a QC subject. Subjects that no longer resolve (or subject types that
442	// carry no org) skip the check — the role gate still applies.
443	func (s *service) requireSubjectScope(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, subjectType string, subjectID primitive.ObjectID) error {
444		orgID, err := s.subjectOrgUnit(ctx, subjectType, subjectID)
445		if err != nil {
446			return err
447		}
448		if orgID.IsZero() {
449			return nil
450		}
451		if err := s.deps.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, orgID); err != nil {
452			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qc read scope denied",
453				slog.String("subject_type", subjectType),
454				slog.String("subject_id", subjectID.Hex()),
455				slog.String("subject_org_unit_id", orgID.Hex()),
456				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
457				slog.Any("err", err))
458			return err
459		}
460		return nil
461	}
462	
463	// subjectOrgUnit resolves the owning org unit of a subject, or the zero
464	// ObjectID when the subject is missing or not an org-owned gate subject.
465	func (s *service) subjectOrgUnit(ctx context.Context, subjectType string, subjectID primitive.ObjectID) (primitive.ObjectID, error) {
466		switch subjectType {
467		case domain.QCSubjectBMCLot:
468			lot, err := s.repo.findBMCLot(ctx, subjectID)
469			if err != nil {
470				return primitive.NilObjectID, ignoreNotFound(err)
471			}
472			return lot.BMCID, nil
473		case domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch:
474			batch, err := s.repo.findBatch(ctx, subjectID)
475			if err != nil {
476				return primitive.NilObjectID, ignoreNotFound(err)
477			}
478			return batch.PlantID, nil
479		default:
480			return primitive.NilObjectID, nil
481		}
482	}
483	
484	// ignoreNotFound swallows 404 AppErrors and passes everything else through.
485	func ignoreNotFound(err error) error {
486		var appErr *httpx.AppError
487		if errors.As(err, &appErr) && appErr.Status == http.StatusNotFound {
488			return nil
489		}
490		return err
491	}
492	
493	// isValidSubjectType reports whether t is a known QC subject type.
494	func isValidSubjectType(t string) bool {
495		switch t {
496		case domain.QCSubjectDCSConsignment, domain.QCSubjectBMCLot, domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch:
497			return true
498		default:
499			return false
500		}
501	}
502	
503	// toDomainTests converts request test inputs to domain tests for evaluation.
504	func toDomainTests(in []QCTestInput) []domain.QCTest {
505		out := make([]domain.QCTest, 0, len(in))
506		for _, t := range in {
507			out = append(out, domain.QCTest{Name: t.Name, Value: t.Value, Unit: t.Unit})
508		}
509		return out
510	}
511	
512	// limits returns the FSSAI gate constants (blueprint §8.3) as reference data.
513	func (s *service) limits() LimitsResponse {
```

```text
1	package publictrace
2	
3	import (
4		"encoding/base64"
5		"testing"
6	
7		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
8	)
9	
10	// TestVerifyQRToken covers the QR integrity gate: a token is
11	// "base64url(payload)" + "." + hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, decoded payload) —
12	// the exact format the plant module's signQRToken mints, where the payload
13	// embeds the product lot's ObjectID as productLotID.Hex() — and any bit flip
14	// in either part must fail verification.
15	func TestVerifyQRToken(t *testing.T) {
16		const secret = "test-qr-signing-secret"
17		// Product lot ObjectIDs rendered as hex, exactly as issuance signs them.
18		const lotHex = "665f1a2b3c4d5e6f70819202"
19		const otherLotHex = "665f1a2b3c4d5e6f70819203"
20		const payload = "[REDACTED:generic-api-key]|" + lotHex + "|1751700000"
21		b64 := func(s string) string { return base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(s)) }
22		validToken := b64(payload) + "." + auth.HMACHash(secret, payload)
23	
24		tests := []struct {
25			name  string
26			token string
27			want  bool
28		}{
29			{
30				name:  "valid token verifies",
31				token: validToken,
32				want:  true,
33			},
34			{
35				name:  "tampered payload fails",
36				token: b64("[REDACTED:generic-api-key]|"+otherLotHex+"|1751700000") + "." + auth.HMACHash(secret, payload),
37				want:  false,
38			},
39			{
40				name:  "tampered signature fails",
41				token: b64(payload) + "." + auth.HMACHash("wrong-secret", payload),
42				want:  false,
43			},
44			{
45				name:  "truncated signature fails",
46				token: validToken[:len(validToken)-2],
47				want:  false,
48			},
49			{
50				name:  "missing separator fails",
51				token: b64(payload) + auth.HMACHash(secret, payload),
52				want:  false,
53			},
54			{
55				name:  "non-base64 payload fails",
56				token: payload + "." + auth.HMACHash(secret, payload),
57				want:  false,
58			},
59			{
60				name:  "empty payload fails",
61				token: "." + auth.HMACHash(secret, ""),
62				want:  false,
63			},
64			{
65				name:  "empty signature fails",
66				token: b64(payload) + ".",
67				want:  false,
68			},
69			{
70				name:  "empty token fails",
71				token: "",
72				want:  false,
73			},
74		}
75		for _, tc := range tests {
76			t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
77				if got := VerifyQRToken(secret, tc.token); got != tc.want {
78					t.Fatalf("VerifyQRToken(%q) = %v, want %v", tc.token, got, tc.want)
79				}
80			})
81		}
82	}
83
```

```text
1	package orgs
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"errors"
6		"log/slog"
7		"net/http"
8		"strings"
9		"time"
10	
11		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
12		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
13		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
14	
15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
16		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
17		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
18		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/orgscope"
19	)
20	
21	// maxTreeNodes caps a subtree response (root included) so a federation-level
22	// tree read can never return an unbounded list.
23	const maxTreeNodes = 500
24	
25	// service holds all business logic of the orgs module.
26	type service struct {
27		repo  *repository
28		scope *orgscope.Resolver
29		log   *slog.Logger
30	}
31	
32	func newService(repo *repository, scope *orgscope.Resolver, log *slog.Logger) *service {
33		return &service{repo: repo, scope: scope, log: log}
34	}
35	
36	// fail routes an error out of the service: expected AppErrors (404s from the
37	// repo, platform errors) pass through untouched; anything unexpected — or an
38	// AppError already carrying a 5xx — is logged at ERROR with the failing
39	// operation before the client sees an opaque 500.
40	func (s *service) fail(ctx context.Context, op string, err error) error {
41		var appErr *httpx.AppError
42		ok := errors.As(err, &appErr)
43		if !ok || appErr.Status >= http.StatusInternalServerError {
44			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "orgs operation failed",
45				slog.String("op", op),
46				slog.Any("err", err))
47		}
48		if ok {
49			return err
50		}
51		return httpx.Internal(err)
52	}
53	
54	// scopeErr handles a RequireInScope failure: scope denials (403) are logged
55	// at WARN with the actor and target; other errors go through fail.
56	func (s *service) scopeErr(ctx context.Context, op string, actor auth.Actor, targetOrgID primitive.ObjectID, err error) error {
57		var appErr *httpx.AppError
58		if errors.As(err, &appErr) && appErr.Status == http.StatusForbidden {
59			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "org scope denial",
60				slog.String("op", op),
61				slog.String("target_org_id", targetOrgID.Hex()),
62				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
63				slog.String("actor_org_id", actor.OrgUnitID),
64				slog.String("reason", appErr.Message))
65			return err
66		}
67		return s.fail(ctx, op, err)
68	}
69	
70	// validateHierarchy checks whether an org unit of childType may be created
71	// under a parent of parentType ("" = no parent), per domain.ValidOrgParent.
72	// Pure function — unit-tested against the full type matrix.
73	func validateHierarchy(childType, parentType string) *httpx.AppError {
74		if !domain.IsValidOrgType(childType) {
75			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_ORG_TYPE", "unknown org type "+childType)
76		}
77		allowed := domain.ValidOrgParent[childType]
78		if len(allowed) == 0 { // hierarchy root
79			if parentType != "" {
80				return httpx.Unprocessable("ORG_PARENT_TYPE_INVALID",
81					childType+" is the hierarchy root and cannot have a parent")
82			}
83			return nil
84		}
85		if parentType == "" {
86			return httpx.BadRequest("ORG_PARENT_REQUIRED", childType+" requires a parent_id")
87		}
88		for _, t := range allowed {
89			if t == parentType {
90				return nil
91			}
92		}
93		return httpx.Unprocessable("ORG_PARENT_TYPE_INVALID",
94			childType+" cannot be created under a "+parentType)
95	}
96	
97	// Create validates the hierarchy edge and inserts a new org unit
98	// (POST /orgs, blueprint §5.1).
99	func (s *service) Create(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateOrgRequest) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
100		name := strings.TrimSpace(req.Name)
101		if name == "" {
102			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_NAME", "name is required")
103		}
104		code := strings.TrimSpace(req.Code)
105		if code == "" {
106			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_CODE", "code is required")
107		}
108	
109		// Resolve the parent (if any) and validate the hierarchy edge.
110		var parent *domain.OrgUnit
111		if req.ParentID != nil && !req.ParentID.IsZero() {
112			var err error
113			parent, err = s.repo.getOrg(ctx, *req.ParentID)
114			if err != nil {
115				return nil, s.fail(ctx, "get parent org unit", err)
116			}
117		}
118		parentType := ""
119		if parent != nil {
120			parentType = parent.Type
121		}
122		if aerr := validateHierarchy(req.Type, parentType); aerr != nil {
123			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "org create rejected: invalid hierarchy edge",
124				slog.String("org_code", code),
125				slog.String("org_type", req.Type),
126				slog.String("parent_type", parentType),
127				slog.String("reason", aerr.Code),
128				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
129			return nil, aerr
130		}
131	
132		// The federation is the unique root: reject a second one.
133		if req.Type == domain.OrgTypeFederation {
134			n, err := s.repo.countByType(ctx, domain.OrgTypeFederation)
135			if err != nil {
136				return nil, s.fail(ctx, "count federation org units", err)
137			}
138			if n > 0 {
139				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "org create rejected: federation root already exists",
140					slog.String("org_code", code),
141					slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
142				return nil, httpx.Conflict("FEDERATION_EXISTS", "a federation root org unit already exists")
143			}
144		}
145	
146		// The new unit must be created inside the caller's scope.
147		if parent != nil {
148			if err := s.scope.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, parent.ID); err != nil {
149				return nil, s.scopeErr(ctx, "create org unit", actor, parent.ID, err)
150			}
151		}
152	
153		now := time.Now().UTC()
154		org := &domain.OrgUnit{
155			// Pre-generate the id so insert + cache invalidation see one value.
156			ID:        primitive.NewObjectID(),
157			Type:      req.Type,
158			Name:      name,
159			Code:      code,
160			District:  strings.TrimSpace(req.District),
161			State:     strings.TrimSpace(req.State),
162			Path:      []primitive.ObjectID{},
163			Active:    true,
164			CreatedAt: now,
165			UpdatedAt: now,
166		}
167		if parent != nil {
168			parentID := parent.ID
169			org.ParentID = &parentID
170			org.Path = append(append([]primitive.ObjectID{}, parent.Path...), parent.ID)
171		}
172		if req.GeoLat != nil {
173			org.GeoLat = *req.GeoLat
174		}
175		if req.GeoLng != nil {
176			org.GeoLng = *req.GeoLng
177		}
178	
179		if err := s.repo.insertOrg(ctx, org); err != nil {
180			if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(err) {
181				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "org create rejected: duplicate code",
182					slog.String("org_code", code),
183					slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
184				return nil, httpx.Conflict("ORG_CODE_EXISTS", "an org unit with code "+code+" already exists")
185			}
186			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "insert org unit", err)
187		}
188		s.scope.Invalidate(org.ID)
189		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "org unit created",
190			slog.String("org_id", org.ID.Hex()),
191			slog.String("org_code", org.Code),
192			slog.String("org_type", org.Type),
193			slog.String("parent_org_id", hexOrEmpty(org.ParentID)),
194			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
195		return org, nil
196	}
197	
198	// hexOrEmpty renders an optional ObjectID reference for logging.
199	func hexOrEmpty(id *primitive.ObjectID) string {
200		if id == nil {
201			return ""
202		}
203		return id.Hex()
204	}
205	
206	// Update patches name/district/active/geo on an org unit (PATCH /orgs/{id}).
207	// Type or parent moves are rejected — restructuring the tree is out of scope
208	// for v1 because Path denormalisation across a subtree is not transactional.
209	func (s *service) Update(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID, req UpdateOrgRequest) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
210		if req.Type != nil || req.ParentID != nil {
211			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "org update rejected: hierarchy move unsupported",
212				slog.String("org_id", id.Hex()),
213				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
214			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("ORG_MOVE_UNSUPPORTED",
215				"changing an org unit's type or parent is not supported in v1")
216		}
217		if err := s.scope.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, id); err != nil {
218			return nil, s.scopeErr(ctx, "update org unit", actor, id, err)
219		}
220	
221		set := bson.D{{Key: "updated_at", Value: time.Now().UTC()}}
222		if req.Name != nil {
223			name := strings.TrimSpace(*req.Name)
224			if name == "" {
225				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_NAME", "name cannot be empty")
226			}
227			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "name", Value: name})
228		}
229		if req.District != nil {
230			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "district", Value: strings.TrimSpace(*req.District)})
231		}
232		if req.Active != nil {
233			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "active", Value: *req.Active})
234		}
235		if req.GeoLat != nil {
236			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "geo_lat", Value: *req.GeoLat})
237		}
238		if req.GeoLng != nil {
239			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "geo_lng", Value: *req.GeoLng})
240		}
241		if len(set) == 1 { // only updated_at
242			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("EMPTY_UPDATE", "no updatable fields provided")
243		}
244	
245		org, err := s.repo.updateOrg(ctx, id, set)
246		if err != nil {
247			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "update org unit", err)
248		}
249		s.scope.Invalidate(id)
250		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "org unit updated",
251			slog.String("org_id", org.ID.Hex()),
252			slog.String("org_code", org.Code),
253			slog.Bool("active", org.Active),
254			slog.Int("fields_patched", len(set)-1),
255			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
256		return org, nil
257	}
258	
259	// Get returns one org unit (GET /orgs/{id}).
260	func (s *service) Get(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
261		org, err := s.repo.getOrg(ctx, id)
262		if err != nil {
263			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "get org unit", err)
264		}
265		return org, nil
266	}
267	
268	// Children pages the direct children of an org unit (GET /orgs/{id}/children),
269	// returning the total child count alongside the page.
270	func (s *service) Children(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.OrgUnit, int64, error) {
271		if _, err := s.repo.getOrg(ctx, id); err != nil {
272			return nil, 0, s.fail(ctx, "get org unit", err)
273		}
274		units, total, err := s.repo.listChildren(ctx, id, page)
275		if err != nil {
276			return nil, 0, s.fail(ctx, "list org children", err)
277		}
278		return units, total, nil
279	}
280	
281	// Tree returns the root plus its whole subtree as a flat list (each node
282	// carries parent_id; the client assembles), capped at maxTreeNodes.
283	func (s *service) Tree(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID) ([]domain.OrgUnit, bool, error) {
284		root, err := s.repo.getOrg(ctx, id)
285		if err != nil {
286			return nil, false, s.fail(ctx, "get org unit", err)
287		}
288		if err := s.scope.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, id); err != nil {
289			return nil, false, s.scopeErr(ctx, "read org subtree", actor, id, err)
290		}
291		descendants, err := s.repo.listDescendants(ctx, id, maxTreeNodes-1)
292		if err != nil {
293			return nil, false, s.fail(ctx, "list org descendants", err)
294		}
295		nodes := append([]domain.OrgUnit{*root}, descendants...)
296		truncated := len(descendants) == maxTreeNodes-1
297		return nodes, truncated, nil
298	}
299	
300	// List pages org units filtered by type, district and/or exact code — the
301	// unique business key, e.g. ?code=DCS-01842, used to discover an org's
302	// ObjectID (GET /orgs) — returning the total matching count alongside the page.
303	func (s *service) List(ctx context.Context, orgType, district, code string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.OrgUnit, int64, error) {
304		filter := bson.D{}
305		if orgType != "" {
306			if !domain.IsValidOrgType(orgType) {
307				return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_ORG_TYPE", "unknown org type "+orgType)
308			}
309			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "type", Value: orgType})
310		}
311		if district != "" {
312			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "district", Value: district})
313		}
314		if code != "" {
315			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "code", Value: code})
316		}
317		units, total, err := s.repo.listOrgs(ctx, filter, page)
318		if err != nil {
319			return nil, 0, s.fail(ctx, "list org units", err)
320		}
321		return units, total, nil
322	}
323	
324	// Members pages the ACTIVE role assignments at an org unit joined in memory
325	// with party identity fields (GET /orgs/{id}/members) — two indexed queries,
326	// no $lookup.
327	func (s *service) Members(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID, page httpx.Page) ([]Member, int64, error) {
328		if _, err := s.repo.getOrg(ctx, id); err != nil {
329			return nil, 0, s.fail(ctx, "get org unit", err)
330		}
331		if err := s.scope.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, id); err != nil {
332			return nil, 0, s.scopeErr(ctx, "read org members", actor, id, err)
333		}
334	
335		total, err := s.repo.countActiveAssignments(ctx, id)
336		if err != nil {
337			return nil, 0, s.fail(ctx, "count active role assignments", err)
338		}
339		assignments, err := s.repo.listActiveAssignments(ctx, id, page)
340		if err != nil {
341			return nil, 0, s.fail(ctx, "list active role assignments", err)
342		}
343		partyIDs := make([]primitive.ObjectID, 0, len(assignments))
344		seen := make(map[primitive.ObjectID]struct{}, len(assignments))
345		for _, a := range assignments {
346			if _, dup := seen[a.PartyID]; !dup {
347				seen[a.PartyID] = struct{}{}
348				partyIDs = append(partyIDs, a.PartyID)
349			}
350		}
351		parties, err := s.repo.partiesByIDs(ctx, partyIDs)
352		if err != nil {
353			return nil, 0, s.fail(ctx, "fetch member parties", err)
354		}
355	
356		members := make([]Member, 0, len(assignments))
357		for _, a := range assignments {
358			m := Member{
359				PartyID:          a.PartyID,
360				RoleCode:         a.RoleCode,
361				RoleAssignmentID: a.ID,
362				ValidFrom:        a.ValidFrom,
363				ValidTo:          a.ValidTo,
364			}
365			if p, ok := parties[a.PartyID]; ok {
366				m.Phone = p.Phone
367				m.FullName = p.FullName
368				m.KYCTier = p.KYCTier
369			}
370			members = append(members, m)
371		}
372		return members, total, nil
373	}
```

```text
1	// Package settlement implements the same-day payment rail under the
2	// blueprint §8.1/§18-B guardrail: Saathi computes and initiates a batch,
3	// a DIFFERENT authorised human approves it (dual control), and a licensed
4	// Payment Aggregator (mocked here) executes the payouts. Scheme subsidies
5	// ride the strictly separate PFMS/DBT rail (§13) — never the milk-payment
6	// rail, and never the reverse.
7	package settlement
8	
9	import (
10		"log/slog"
11	
12		"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
13	
14		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
16		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/middleware"
17	)
18	
19	// Register wires the settlement module and mounts /settlements and /dbt
20	// under the /api/v1 subtree it receives.
21	func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
22		log := d.Log.With(slog.String("module", "settlement"))
23		svc := &service{
24			repo:   newRepo(d.DB),
25			ledger: d.Ledger,
26			orgs:   d.Orgs,
27			bus:    d.Bus,
28			log:    log,
29		}
30		h := &handler{svc: svc}
31	
32		// Read access to batches: village signatories plus union/state oversight.
33		readRoles := middleware.RequireRoles(
34			domain.RoleSamitiSacheev,
35			domain.RoleSamitiAdhyaksh,
36			domain.RoleUnionPresident,
37			domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor,
38			domain.RoleStateAuditor,
39		)
40	
41		r.Route("/settlements", func(sr chi.Router) {
42			sr.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
43	
44			// Initiate: the Sacheev runs the collection console (§8.1 step 1).
45			sr.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSamitiSacheev)).
46				Post("/", h.initiate)
47	
48			// Approve / reject: a different authorised signatory (dual control is
49			// additionally enforced on party identity inside the service).
50			sr.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSamitiAdhyaksh, domain.RoleUnionPresident)).
51				Post("/{id}/approve", h.approve)
52			sr.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSamitiAdhyaksh, domain.RoleUnionPresident)).
53				Post("/{id}/reject", h.reject)
54	
55			// Execute: hand the approved batch to the (mock) licensed PA.
56			sr.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSamitiSacheev, domain.RoleSamitiAdhyaksh)).
57				Post("/{id}/execute", h.execute)
58	
59			sr.With(readRoles).Get("/", h.list)
60	
61			// Farmer payment history — FARMER tokens are forced to their own party.
62			sr.With(middleware.RequireRoles(
63				domain.RoleFarmer,
64				domain.RoleSamitiSacheev,
65				domain.RoleSamitiAdhyaksh,
66				domain.RoleUnionPresident,
67				domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor,
68				domain.RoleStateAuditor,
69			)).Get("/payouts", h.payouts)
70	
71			sr.With(readRoles).Get("/{id}", h.detail)
72		})
73	
74		r.Route("/dbt", func(dr chi.Router) {
75			dr.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
76	
77			dr.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleMissionOfficial, domain.RolePCDFAdmin)).
78				Post("/requests", h.createDBT)
79			dr.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleMissionOfficial, domain.RolePCDFAdmin)).
80				Post("/requests/{id}/status", h.updateDBTStatus)
81	
82			dr.With(middleware.RequireRoles(
83				domain.RoleMissionOfficial,
84				domain.RolePCDFAdmin,
85				domain.RoleStateAuditor,
86				domain.RoleFarmer, // forced to own requests in the service
87			)).Get("/requests", h.listDBT)
88		})
89	}
```

```text
1	package logistics
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"fmt"
6		"time"
7	
8		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
9		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
10		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
11		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo/options"
12	
13		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
14		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/mongodb"
16	)
17	
18	// repo owns every MongoDB access for the logistics module. It returns raw
19	// driver errors wrapped with operation context (mongo.ErrNoDocuments stays
20	// detectable via errors.Is); the service layer maps them to httpx errors.
21	// No business logic lives here.
22	type repo struct {
23		consignments *mongo.Collection
24		trips        *mongo.Collection
25		pours        *mongo.Collection // read-only view into the collection module's pours (sanctioned by spec)
26	}
27	
28	// newRepo binds the repo to its collections via the shared name constants.
29	func newRepo(db *mongo.Database) *repo {
30		return &repo{
31			consignments: db.Collection(mongodb.CollConsignments),
32			trips:        db.Collection(mongodb.CollRouteTrips),
33			pours:        db.Collection(mongodb.CollMilkPours),
34		}
35	}
36	
37	// pourRow is the projected slice of a milk pour needed for aggregation.
38	type pourRow struct {
39		ID             primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id"`
40		QuantityLitres float64            `bson:"quantity_litres"`
41		FatPct         float64            `bson:"fat_pct"`
42		SNFPct         float64            `bson:"snf_pct"`
43	}
44	
45	// findRecordedPours returns the RECORDED pours of one DCS date+shift,
46	// projected down to the fields the consignment aggregate needs.
47	func (r *repo) findRecordedPours(ctx context.Context, dcsID primitive.ObjectID, date, shift string) ([]pourRow, error) {
48		filter := bson.D{
49			{Key: "dcs_id", Value: dcsID},
50			{Key: "pour_date", Value: date},
51			{Key: "shift", Value: shift},
52			{Key: "status", Value: domain.PourStatusRecorded},
53		}
54		projection := bson.D{
55			{Key: "_id", Value: 1},
56			{Key: "quantity_litres", Value: 1},
57			{Key: "fat_pct", Value: 1},
58			{Key: "snf_pct", Value: 1},
59		}
60		cur, err := r.pours.Find(ctx, filter,
61			options.Find().SetProjection(projection).SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "created_at", Value: 1}}))
62		if err != nil {
63			return nil, fmt.Errorf("find recorded pours: %w", err)
64		}
65		var rows []pourRow
66		if err := cur.All(ctx, &rows); err != nil {
67			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode recorded pours: %w", err)
68		}
69		return rows, nil
70	}
71	
72	// insertConsignment stores a new consignment (the service pre-generates its
73	// ObjectID). The unique index on dcs_id+date+shift turns duplicates into a
74	// duplicate-key error — kept unwrapped-detectable via %w.
75	func (r *repo) insertConsignment(ctx context.Context, c *domain.DCSConsignment) error {
76		if _, err := r.consignments.InsertOne(ctx, c); err != nil {
77			return fmt.Errorf("insert consignment: %w", err)
78		}
79		return nil
80	}
81	
82	// findConsignmentByID loads one consignment.
83	func (r *repo) findConsignmentByID(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.DCSConsignment, error) {
84		var c domain.DCSConsignment
85		if err := r.consignments.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&c); err != nil {
86			return nil, fmt.Errorf("find consignment %s: %w", id.Hex(), err)
87		}
88		return &c, nil
89	}
90	
91	// markConsignmentDispatched transitions OPEN→DISPATCHED optimistically:
92	// the status filter makes the guard atomic without transactions. The seal
93	// also re-stamps the pour aggregates (extraSet) so pours recorded between
94	// creation and dispatch are never lost from the consignment's totals.
95	func (r *repo) markConsignmentDispatched(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID, at time.Time, extraSet bson.D) (bool, error) {
96		set := bson.D{
97			{Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusDispatch},
98			{Key: "dispatched_at", Value: at},
99		}
100		set = append(set, extraSet...)
101		res, err := r.consignments.UpdateOne(ctx,
102			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}, {Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusOpen}},
103			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: set}})
104		if err != nil {
105			return false, fmt.Errorf("mark consignment dispatched: %w", err)
106		}
107		return res.MatchedCount > 0, nil
108	}
109	
110	// markConsignmentPickedUp transitions DISPATCHED→PICKED_UP and pins the
111	// carrying trip, guarded atomically by the status filter.
112	func (r *repo) markConsignmentPickedUp(ctx context.Context, id, tripID primitive.ObjectID) (bool, error) {
113		res, err := r.consignments.UpdateOne(ctx,
114			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}, {Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusDispatch}},
115			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
116				{Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusPickedUp},
117				{Key: "route_trip_id", Value: tripID},
118			}}})
119		if err != nil {
120			return false, fmt.Errorf("mark consignment picked up: %w", err)
121		}
122		return res.MatchedCount > 0, nil
123	}
124	
125	// markConsignmentsDelivered transitions every listed PICKED_UP consignment
126	// to DELIVERED (bulk companion of the trip delivery).
127	func (r *repo) markConsignmentsDelivered(ctx context.Context, ids []primitive.ObjectID) error {
128		_, err := r.consignments.UpdateMany(ctx,
129			bson.D{
130				{Key: "_id", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: ids}}},
131				{Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusPickedUp},
132			},
133			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusDelivered}}}})
134		if err != nil {
135			return fmt.Errorf("mark consignments delivered: %w", err)
136		}
137		return nil
138	}
139	
140	// setConsignmentProvenanceSeq pins the latest ledger sequence on the doc.
141	func (r *repo) setConsignmentProvenanceSeq(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID, seq int64) error {
142		_, err := r.consignments.UpdateByID(ctx, id,
143			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "provenance_seq", Value: seq}}}})
144		if err != nil {
145			return fmt.Errorf("set consignment provenance seq: %w", err)
146		}
147		return nil
148	}
149	
150	// listConsignments returns a filtered, newest-first page plus the total count.
151	// A zero dcsID means "no DCS filter".
152	func (r *repo) listConsignments(ctx context.Context, dcsID primitive.ObjectID, date, status string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.DCSConsignment, int64, error) {
153		filter := bson.D{}
154		if !dcsID.IsZero() {
155			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "dcs_id", Value: dcsID})
156		}
157		if date != "" {
158			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "date", Value: date})
159		}
160		if status != "" {
161			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "status", Value: status})
162		}
163		total, err := r.consignments.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
164		if err != nil {
165			return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("count consignments: %w", err)
166		}
167		cur, err := r.consignments.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
168			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "created_at", Value: -1}}).
169			SetSkip(page.Offset).SetLimit(page.Limit))
170		if err != nil {
171			return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("list consignments: %w", err)
172		}
173		items := []domain.DCSConsignment{}
174		if err := cur.All(ctx, &items); err != nil {
175			return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("decode consignments: %w", err)
176		}
177		return items, total, nil
178	}
179	
180	// insertTrip stores a new route trip (the service pre-generates its ObjectID).
181	func (r *repo) insertTrip(ctx context.Context, t *domain.RouteTrip) error {
182		if _, err := r.trips.InsertOne(ctx, t); err != nil {
183			return fmt.Errorf("insert trip: %w", err)
184		}
185		return nil
186	}
187	
188	// findTripByID loads one trip.
189	func (r *repo) findTripByID(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.RouteTrip, error) {
190		var t domain.RouteTrip
191		if err := r.trips.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&t); err != nil {
192			return nil, fmt.Errorf("find trip %s: %w", id.Hex(), err)
193		}
194		return &t, nil
195	}
196	
197	// markStopPickedUp stamps the matched stop with pickup time/temperature and
198	// moves the trip to IN_PROGRESS (idempotent once it is already there).
199	func (r *repo) markStopPickedUp(ctx context.Context, tripID, consignmentID primitive.ObjectID, at time.Time, tempC float64, notes string) error {
200		_, err := r.trips.UpdateOne(ctx,
201			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: tripID}, {Key: "stops.consignment_id", Value: consignmentID}},
202			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
203				{Key: "stops.$.picked_up_at", Value: at},
204				{Key: "stops.$.temp_c", Value: tempC},
205				{Key: "stops.$.notes", Value: notes},
206				{Key: "status", Value: domain.TripStatusInProgress},
207			}}})
208		if err != nil {
209			return fmt.Errorf("mark stop picked up: %w", err)
210		}
211		return nil
212	}
213	
214	// pushColdChain appends one temperature sample to the trip's cold-chain log.
215	func (r *repo) pushColdChain(ctx context.Context, tripID primitive.ObjectID, entry domain.ColdChainEntry) error {
216		_, err := r.trips.UpdateByID(ctx, tripID,
217			bson.D{{Key: "$push", Value: bson.D{{Key: "cold_chain", Value: entry}}}})
218		if err != nil {
219			return fmt.Errorf("push cold chain entry: %w", err)
220		}
221		return nil
222	}
223	
224	// markTripDelivered transitions IN_PROGRESS→DELIVERED optimistically and
225	// records the receiving BMC.
226	func (r *repo) markTripDelivered(ctx context.Context, tripID, bmcID primitive.ObjectID, at time.Time) (bool, error) {
227		res, err := r.trips.UpdateOne(ctx,
228			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: tripID}, {Key: "status", Value: domain.TripStatusInProgress}},
229			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
230				{Key: "status", Value: domain.TripStatusDelivered},
231				{Key: "delivered_to_bmc_id", Value: bmcID},
232				{Key: "delivered_at", Value: at},
233			}}})
234		if err != nil {
235			return false, fmt.Errorf("mark trip delivered: %w", err)
236		}
237		return res.MatchedCount > 0, nil
238	}
239	
240	// setTripProvenanceSeq pins the latest ledger sequence on the trip doc.
241	func (r *repo) setTripProvenanceSeq(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID, seq int64) error {
242		_, err := r.trips.UpdateByID(ctx, id,
243			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "provenance_seq", Value: seq}}}})
244		if err != nil {
245			return fmt.Errorf("set trip provenance seq: %w", err)
246		}
247		return nil
248	}
249	
250	// listTrips returns a filtered, newest-first page plus the total count.
251	// Zero ObjectIDs mean "no filter" on that field.
252	func (r *repo) listTrips(ctx context.Context, unionID primitive.ObjectID, date string, vanRiderPartyID primitive.ObjectID, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.RouteTrip, int64, error) {
253		filter := bson.D{}
254		if !unionID.IsZero() {
255			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "union_id", Value: unionID})
256		}
257		if date != "" {
258			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "date", Value: date})
259		}
260		if !vanRiderPartyID.IsZero() {
261			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "van_rider_party_id", Value: vanRiderPartyID})
262		}
263		total, err := r.trips.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
264		if err != nil {
265			return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("count trips: %w", err)
266		}
267		cur, err := r.trips.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
268			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "created_at", Value: -1}}).
269			SetSkip(page.Offset).SetLimit(page.Limit))
270		if err != nil {
271			return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("list trips: %w", err)
272		}
273		items := []domain.RouteTrip{}
274		if err := cur.All(ctx, &items); err != nil {
275			return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("decode trips: %w", err)
276		}
277		return items, total, nil
278	}
```
