1	package logistics
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"errors"
6		"fmt"
7		"log/slog"
8		"math"
9		"time"
10	
11		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
12		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
13		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
14	
15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
16		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
17		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
18		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/orgscope"
19		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/provenance"
20	)
21	
22	const (
23		// canCapacityLitres is the standard milk-can volume used to size a
24		// consignment: can_count = ceil(total litres / 40).
25		canCapacityLitres = 40.0
26	
27		// maxPourRefs caps how many pour references a consignment.created
28		// provenance event carries; beyond it the pour count lives in the
29		// payload only, keeping ledger events bounded.
30		maxPourRefs = 300
31	
32		// maxTripStops bounds a planned route so trip documents stay small.
33		maxTripStops = 100
34	
35		// Physical sanity bounds for a hand-held transit thermometer reading.
36		minPlausibleTempC = -30.0
37		maxPlausibleTempC = 70.0
38	)
39	
40	// service holds all logistics business logic: consignment aggregation,
41	// the consignment/trip state machines, and provenance emission.
42	type service struct {
43		repo   *repo
44		orgs   *orgscope.Resolver
45		ledger *provenance.Ledger
46		log    *slog.Logger
47	}
48	
49	// newService wires the service to its collaborators.
50	func newService(repo *repo, orgs *orgscope.Resolver, ledger *provenance.Ledger, log *slog.Logger) *service {
51		return &service{repo: repo, orgs: orgs, ledger: ledger, log: log}
52	}
53	
54	// actorID parses the actor's party ObjectID out of its JWT hex string.
55	func (s *service) actorID(actor auth.Actor) (primitive.ObjectID, error) {
56		return httpx.ParseID(actor.PartyID, "actor")
57	}
58	
59	// internal logs an unexpected failure with its operation context and maps it
60	// to a 500.
61	func (s *service) internal(ctx context.Context, op string, err error) *httpx.AppError {
62		s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, op+" failed", slog.Any("err", err))
63		return httpx.Internal(err)
64	}
65	
66	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
67	// Consignments
68	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
69	
70	// createConsignment pools one DCS date+shift's RECORDED pours into an OPEN
71	// consignment: pour IDs, total litres, quantity-weighted fat/SNF averages and
72	// the can count. The unique dcs+date+shift index makes creation idempotent-ish
73	// (a replay returns CONSIGNMENT_EXISTS).
74	func (s *service) createConsignment(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req createConsignmentRequest) (*domain.DCSConsignment, error) {
75		if req.DCSID.IsZero() {
76			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_DCS_ID", "dcs_id is required")
77		}
78		if err := validateShift(req.Shift); err != nil {
79			return nil, err
80		}
81		now := time.Now().UTC()
82		date, err := resolveDate(req.Date, now)
83		if err != nil {
84			return nil, err
85		}
86		actorID, err := s.actorID(actor)
87		if err != nil {
88			return nil, err
89		}
90		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.DCSID); err != nil {
91			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "consignment creation denied: DCS out of scope",
92				slog.String("dcs_id", req.DCSID.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
93			return nil, err
94		}
95		org, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.DCSID)
96		if err != nil {
97			return nil, err
98		}
99		if org.Type != domain.OrgTypeDCS {
100			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_DCS", "org unit "+req.DCSID.Hex()+" is not a DCS")
101		}
102	
103		rows, err := s.repo.findRecordedPours(ctx, req.DCSID, date, req.Shift)
104		if err != nil {
105			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "create consignment: find recorded pours", err)
106		}
107		if len(rows) == 0 {
108			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "consignment creation rejected: no RECORDED pours",
109				slog.String("dcs_id", req.DCSID.Hex()), slog.String("date", date),
110				slog.String("shift", req.Shift), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
111			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("NO_POURS_TO_CONSIGN",
112				fmt.Sprintf("no RECORDED pours for DCS %s on %s %s", req.DCSID.Hex(), date, req.Shift))
113		}
114		pourIDs, totalQty, avgFat, avgSNF := aggregatePours(rows)
115	
116		consignment := &domain.DCSConsignment{
117			ID:                  primitive.NewObjectID(), // pre-generated: insert + ledger refs stay consistent
118			DCSID:               req.DCSID,
119			Date:                date,
120			Shift:               req.Shift,
121			PourIDs:             pourIDs,
122			TotalQuantityLitres: totalQty,
123			CanCount:            int(math.Ceil(totalQty / canCapacityLitres)),
124			AvgFatPct:           avgFat,
125			AvgSNFPct:           avgSNF,
126			Status:              domain.ConsignmentStatusOpen,
127			CreatedBy:           actorID,
128			CreatedAt:           now,
129		}
130		if err := s.repo.insertConsignment(ctx, consignment); err != nil {
131			if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(err) {
132				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "consignment creation rejected: duplicate for dcs+date+shift",
133					slog.String("dcs_id", req.DCSID.Hex()), slog.String("date", date),
134					slog.String("shift", req.Shift), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
135				return nil, httpx.Conflict("CONSIGNMENT_EXISTS",
136					fmt.Sprintf("a consignment for DCS %s on %s %s already exists", req.DCSID.Hex(), date, req.Shift))
137			}
138			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "create consignment: insert", err)
139		}
140	
141		// Provenance: the pooling-boundary event. Pour refs are capped so the
142		// event stays bounded — past the cap the payload's pour_count is the
143		// authoritative tally (the doc's pour_ids keeps the full set).
144		refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, min(len(pourIDs), maxPourRefs))
145		for i, id := range pourIDs {
146			if i >= maxPourRefs {
147				break
148			}
149			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{EntityType: domain.EntityMilkPour, EntityID: id.Hex(), Relation: "aggregates"})
150		}
151		event, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
152			Type:       domain.EventConsignmentCreated,
153			EntityType: domain.EntityConsignment,
154			EntityID:   consignment.ID.Hex(),
155			Refs:       refs,
156			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
157			OrgUnitID:  consignment.DCSID.Hex(),
158			Payload: map[string]any{
159				"pour_count":            len(pourIDs),
160				"total_quantity_litres": totalQty,
161				"can_count":             consignment.CanCount,
162				"date":                  date,
163				"shift":                 req.Shift,
164			},
165		})
166		if err != nil {
167			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "create consignment: append provenance", err)
168		}
169		if err := s.repo.setConsignmentProvenanceSeq(ctx, consignment.ID, event.Seq); err != nil {
170			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "create consignment: set provenance seq", err)
171		}
172		consignment.ProvenanceSeq = event.Seq
173		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "consignment created",
174			slog.String("consignment_id", consignment.ID.Hex()),
175			slog.String("dcs_id", consignment.DCSID.Hex()),
176			slog.String("date", date), slog.String("shift", req.Shift),
177			slog.Int("pour_count", len(pourIDs)),
178			slog.Float64("total_quantity_litres", totalQty),
179			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
180		return consignment, nil
181	}
182	
183	// dispatchConsignment seals an OPEN consignment for pickup (OPEN→DISPATCHED).
184	// The creation-time pour snapshot is provisional: the seal re-aggregates the
185	// shift's RECORDED pours so milk recorded between creation and dispatch (the
186	// collection module also rejects such pours, belt-and-braces) is reflected in
187	// pour_ids, litres, can count and weighted fat/SNF before the load leaves.
188	func (s *service) dispatchConsignment(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.DCSConsignment, error) {
189		consignment, err := s.loadConsignment(ctx, id)
190		if err != nil {
191			return nil, err
192		}
193		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, consignment.DCSID); err != nil {
194			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "consignment dispatch denied: DCS out of scope",
195				slog.String("consignment_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("dcs_id", consignment.DCSID.Hex()),
196				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
197			return nil, err
198		}
199		if consignment.Status != domain.ConsignmentStatusOpen {
200			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "consignment dispatch rejected: not OPEN",
201				slog.String("consignment_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("status", consignment.Status),
202				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
203			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_CONSIGNMENT_STATE",
204				"consignment is "+consignment.Status+"; only OPEN consignments can be dispatched")
205		}
206	
207		// Re-aggregate at the seal boundary.
208		rows, err := s.repo.findRecordedPours(ctx, consignment.DCSID, consignment.Date, consignment.Shift)
209		if err != nil {
210			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "dispatch consignment: find recorded pours", err)
211		}
212		extraSet := bson.D{}
213		if len(rows) > 0 {
214			pourIDs, totalQty, avgFat, avgSNF := aggregatePours(rows)
215			consignment.PourIDs = pourIDs
216			consignment.TotalQuantityLitres = totalQty
217			consignment.CanCount = int(math.Ceil(totalQty / canCapacityLitres))
218			consignment.AvgFatPct = avgFat
219			consignment.AvgSNFPct = avgSNF
220			extraSet = bson.D{
221				{Key: "pour_ids", Value: pourIDs},
222				{Key: "total_quantity_litres", Value: totalQty},
223				{Key: "can_count", Value: consignment.CanCount},
224				{Key: "avg_fat_pct", Value: avgFat},
225				{Key: "avg_snf_pct", Value: avgSNF},
226			}
227		}
228	
229		now := time.Now().UTC()
230		matched, err := s.repo.markConsignmentDispatched(ctx, id, now, extraSet)
231		if err != nil {
232			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "dispatch consignment: mark dispatched", err)
233		}
234		if !matched { // lost a state race since the read above
235			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "consignment dispatch rejected: lost state race",
236				slog.String("consignment_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
237			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_CONSIGNMENT_STATE",
238				"consignment was modified concurrently; reload and retry")
239		}
240		event, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
241			Type:       domain.EventConsignmentDispatched,
242			EntityType: domain.EntityConsignment,
243			EntityID:   consignment.ID.Hex(),
244			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
245			OrgUnitID:  consignment.DCSID.Hex(),
246			Payload: map[string]any{
247				"pour_count":            len(consignment.PourIDs),
248				"total_quantity_litres": consignment.TotalQuantityLitres,
249				"can_count":             consignment.CanCount,
250				"date":                  consignment.Date,
251				"shift":                 consignment.Shift,
252			},
253		})
254		if err != nil {
255			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "dispatch consignment: append provenance", err)
256		}
257		if err := s.repo.setConsignmentProvenanceSeq(ctx, consignment.ID, event.Seq); err != nil {
258			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "dispatch consignment: set provenance seq", err)
259		}
260		consignment.Status = domain.ConsignmentStatusDispatch
261		consignment.DispatchedAt = &now
262		consignment.ProvenanceSeq = event.Seq
263		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "consignment dispatched",
264			slog.String("consignment_id", consignment.ID.Hex()),
265			slog.String("dcs_id", consignment.DCSID.Hex()),
266			slog.Int("pour_count", len(consignment.PourIDs)),
267			slog.Float64("total_quantity_litres", consignment.TotalQuantityLitres),
268			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
269		return consignment, nil
270	}
271	
272	// listConsignments returns a scoped page of consignments. DCS-scoped actors
273	// default to their own society; wide read roles (SUPER_ADMIN, STATE_AUDITOR)
274	// may list unfiltered; everyone else must name a dcs_id inside their scope.
275	func (s *service) listConsignments(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, q consignmentListQuery, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.DCSConsignment, int64, error) {
276		dcsID := q.DCSID
277		if dcsID.IsZero() {
278			switch {
279			case actor.OrgType == domain.OrgTypeDCS && actor.OrgUnitID != "":
280				id, err := httpx.ParseID(actor.OrgUnitID, "actor org unit")
281				if err != nil {
282					return nil, 0, err
283				}
284				dcsID = id
285			case actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSuperAdmin || actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleStateAuditor:
286				// federation-wide read roles may scan unfiltered (still paged)
287			default:
288				return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("DCS_ID_REQUIRED", "dcs_id query parameter is required for your role")
289			}
290		}
291		if !dcsID.IsZero() {
292			if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, dcsID); err != nil {
293				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "consignment list denied: DCS out of scope",
294					slog.String("dcs_id", dcsID.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
295				return nil, 0, err
296			}
297		}
298		if q.Date != "" {
299			if _, err := resolveDate(q.Date, time.Time{}); err != nil {
300				return nil, 0, err
301			}
302		}
303		if q.Status != "" && !isConsignmentStatus(q.Status) {
304			return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_STATUS", "unknown consignment status "+q.Status)
305		}
306		items, total, err := s.repo.listConsignments(ctx, dcsID, q.Date, q.Status, page)
307		if err != nil {
308			return nil, 0, s.internal(ctx, "list consignments", err)
309		}
310		return items, total, nil
311	}
312	
313	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
314	// Route trips
315	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
316	
317	// createTrip plans a van run: every stop's consignment must already be
318	// DISPATCHED and must belong to that stop's DCS. The rider defaults to the
319	// actor when a VAN_RIDER plans their own route.
320	func (s *service) createTrip(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req createTripRequest) (*domain.RouteTrip, error) {
321		if req.RouteName == "" {
322			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_ROUTE_NAME", "route_name is required")
323		}
324		if req.UnionID.IsZero() {
325			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_UNION_ID", "union_id is required")
326		}
327		if err := validateShift(req.Shift); err != nil {
328			return nil, err
329		}
330		if len(req.Stops) == 0 {
331			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NO_STOPS", "at least one stop is required")
332		}
333		if len(req.Stops) > maxTripStops {
334			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("TOO_MANY_STOPS", fmt.Sprintf("a trip may have at most %d stops", maxTripStops))
335		}
336		now := time.Now().UTC()
337		date, err := resolveDate(req.Date, now)
338		if err != nil {
339			return nil, err
340		}
341		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.UnionID); err != nil {
342			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "trip creation denied: union out of scope",
343				slog.String("union_id", req.UnionID.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
344			return nil, err
345		}
346		union, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.UnionID)
347		if err != nil {
348			return nil, err
349		}
350		if union.Type != domain.OrgTypeMilkUnion {
351			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_UNION", "org unit "+req.UnionID.Hex()+" is not a MILK_UNION")
352		}
353	
354		var riderPartyID primitive.ObjectID
355		if req.VanRiderPartyID != nil && !req.VanRiderPartyID.IsZero() {
356			riderPartyID = *req.VanRiderPartyID
357		} else {
358			if actor.RoleCode != domain.RoleVanRider {
359				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("RIDER_REQUIRED", "van_rider_party_id is required unless a VAN_RIDER plans their own trip")
360			}
361			actorID, err := s.actorID(actor)
362			if err != nil {
363				return nil, err
364			}
365			riderPartyID = actorID
366		}
367	
368		seen := make(map[primitive.ObjectID]struct{}, len(req.Stops))
369		stops := make([]domain.RouteStop, 0, len(req.Stops))
370		for _, stop := range req.Stops {
371			if stop.DCSID.IsZero() || stop.ConsignmentID.IsZero() {
372				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_STOP", "every stop needs dcs_id and consignment_id")
373			}
374			if _, dup := seen[stop.ConsignmentID]; dup {
375				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("DUPLICATE_STOP", "consignment "+stop.ConsignmentID.Hex()+" appears in more than one stop")
376			}
377			seen[stop.ConsignmentID] = struct{}{}
378	
379			consignment, err := s.loadConsignment(ctx, stop.ConsignmentID)
380			if err != nil {
381				return nil, err
382			}
383			if aerr := validateStopConsignment(consignment, stop.DCSID); aerr != nil {
384				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "trip creation rejected: invalid stop consignment",
385					slog.String("consignment_id", stop.ConsignmentID.Hex()),
386					slog.String("stop_dcs_id", stop.DCSID.Hex()),
387					slog.String("consignment_status", consignment.Status),
388					slog.String("code", aerr.Code),
389					slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
390				return nil, aerr
391			}
392			stops = append(stops, domain.RouteStop{DCSID: stop.DCSID, ConsignmentID: stop.ConsignmentID})
393		}
394	
395		trip := &domain.RouteTrip{
396			ID:              primitive.NewObjectID(), // pre-generated so provenance can reference it later
397			RouteName:       req.RouteName,
398			UnionID:         req.UnionID,
399			VanRiderPartyID: riderPartyID,
400			Date:            date,
401			Shift:           req.Shift,
402			Stops:           stops,
403			Status:          domain.TripStatusPlanned,
404			CreatedAt:       now,
405		}
406		if err := s.repo.insertTrip(ctx, trip); err != nil {
407			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "create trip: insert", err)
408		}
409		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "trip created",
410			slog.String("trip_id", trip.ID.Hex()),
411			slog.String("union_id", trip.UnionID.Hex()),
412			slog.String("van_rider_party_id", trip.VanRiderPartyID.Hex()),
413			slog.String("route_name", trip.RouteName),
414			slog.String("date", date), slog.String("shift", req.Shift),
415			slog.Int("stop_count", len(stops)),
416			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
417		return trip, nil
418	}
419	
420	// pickupStop records the trip's rider collecting one consignment: the stop is
421	// stamped with time+temperature, the consignment moves DISPATCHED→PICKED_UP,
422	// and the trip moves to IN_PROGRESS on its first pickup.
423	func (s *service) pickupStop(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, tripID, consignmentID primitive.ObjectID, req pickupRequest) (*domain.RouteTrip, error) {
424		if err := validateTemp(req.TempC); err != nil {
425			return nil, err
426		}
427		actorID, err := s.actorID(actor)
428		if err != nil {
429			return nil, err
430		}
431		trip, err := s.loadTrip(ctx, tripID)
432		if err != nil {
433			return nil, err
434		}
435		if aerr := validatePickup(trip, actorID, consignmentID); aerr != nil {
436			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "stop pickup rejected",
437				slog.String("trip_id", tripID.Hex()), slog.String("consignment_id", consignmentID.Hex()),
438				slog.String("code", aerr.Code), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
439			return nil, aerr
440		}
441	
442		// Guard the consignment transition atomically; only a DISPATCHED
443		// consignment can board the van.
444		matched, err := s.repo.markConsignmentPickedUp(ctx, consignmentID, trip.ID)
445		if err != nil {
446			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "pickup stop: mark consignment picked up", err)
447		}
448		if !matched {
449			consignment, err := s.loadConsignment(ctx, consignmentID)
450			if err != nil {
451				return nil, err
452			}
453			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "stop pickup rejected: consignment not DISPATCHED",
454				slog.String("trip_id", tripID.Hex()), slog.String("consignment_id", consignmentID.Hex()),
455				slog.String("consignment_status", consignment.Status),
456				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
457			return nil, httpx.Conflict("CONSIGNMENT_NOT_DISPATCHED",
458				"consignment is "+consignment.Status+"; only DISPATCHED consignments can be picked up")
459		}
460	
461		now := time.Now().UTC()
462		if err := s.repo.markStopPickedUp(ctx, trip.ID, consignmentID, now, *req.TempC, req.Notes); err != nil {
463			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "pickup stop: mark stop picked up", err)
464		}
465	
466		event, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
467			Type:       domain.EventConsignmentPickedUp,
468			EntityType: domain.EntityConsignment,
469			EntityID:   consignmentID.Hex(),
470			Refs: []provenance.Ref{
471				{EntityType: domain.EntityRouteTrip, EntityID: trip.ID.Hex(), Relation: "carried_by"},
472			},
473			Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
474			OrgUnitID: trip.UnionID.Hex(),
475			Payload:   map[string]any{"temp_c": *req.TempC},
476		})
477		if err != nil {
478			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "pickup stop: append provenance", err)
479		}
480		if err := s.repo.setConsignmentProvenanceSeq(ctx, consignmentID, event.Seq); err != nil {
481			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "pickup stop: set provenance seq", err)
482		}
483	
484		trip.Status = domain.TripStatusInProgress
485		if i := findStop(trip, consignmentID); i >= 0 {
486			trip.Stops[i].PickedUpAt = &now
487			trip.Stops[i].TempC = *req.TempC
488			trip.Stops[i].Notes = req.Notes
489		}
490		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "stop picked up",
491			slog.String("trip_id", trip.ID.Hex()),
492			slog.String("consignment_id", consignmentID.Hex()),
493			slog.Float64("temp_c", *req.TempC),
494			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
495		return trip, nil
496	}
497	
498	// logColdChain appends one in-transit temperature sample to the trip —
499	// tamper-evidence for the perishable load between village and BMC.
500	func (s *service) logColdChain(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, tripID primitive.ObjectID, req coldChainRequest) (*domain.RouteTrip, error) {
501		if err := validateTemp(req.TempC); err != nil {
502			return nil, err
503		}
504		actorID, err := s.actorID(actor)
505		if err != nil {
506			return nil, err
507		}
508		trip, err := s.loadTrip(ctx, tripID)
509		if err != nil {
510			return nil, err
511		}
512		if aerr := validateColdChain(trip, actorID); aerr != nil {
513			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "cold-chain log rejected",
514				slog.String("trip_id", tripID.Hex()), slog.String("code", aerr.Code),
515				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
516			return nil, aerr
517		}
518		entry := domain.ColdChainEntry{
519			TS:     time.Now().UTC(),
520			TempC:  *req.TempC,
521			GeoLat: req.GeoLat,
522			GeoLng: req.GeoLng,
523		}
524		if err := s.repo.pushColdChain(ctx, trip.ID, entry); err != nil {
525			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "log cold chain: push entry", err)
526		}
527		event, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
528			Type:       domain.EventColdChainLogged,
529			EntityType: domain.EntityRouteTrip,
530			EntityID:   trip.ID.Hex(),
531			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
532			OrgUnitID:  trip.UnionID.Hex(),
533			Payload:    map[string]any{"temp_c": *req.TempC},
534		})
535		if err != nil {
536			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "log cold chain: append provenance", err)
537		}
538		if err := s.repo.setTripProvenanceSeq(ctx, trip.ID, event.Seq); err != nil {
539			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "log cold chain: set provenance seq", err)
540		}
541		trip.ColdChain = append(trip.ColdChain, entry)
542		trip.ProvenanceSeq = event.Seq
543		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "cold chain logged",
544			slog.String("trip_id", trip.ID.Hex()),
545			slog.Float64("temp_c", *req.TempC),
546			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
547		return trip, nil
548	}
549	
550	// deliverTrip hands the whole load to a BMC: every stop must be picked up,
551	// the trip moves IN_PROGRESS→DELIVERED and its consignments PICKED_UP→DELIVERED.
552	func (s *service) deliverTrip(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, tripID primitive.ObjectID, req deliverRequest) (*domain.RouteTrip, error) {
553		if req.BMCID.IsZero() {
554			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_BMC_ID", "bmc_id is required")
555		}
556		actorID, err := s.actorID(actor)
557		if err != nil {
558			return nil, err
559		}
560		trip, err := s.loadTrip(ctx, tripID)
561		if err != nil {
562			return nil, err
563		}
564		if aerr := validateDeliver(trip, actorID); aerr != nil {
565			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "trip delivery rejected",
566				slog.String("trip_id", tripID.Hex()), slog.String("code", aerr.Code),
567				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
568			return nil, aerr
569		}
570		bmc, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.BMCID)
571		if err != nil {
572			return nil, err
573		}
574		if bmc.Type != domain.OrgTypeBMC {
575			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_BMC", "org unit "+req.BMCID.Hex()+" is not a BMC")
576		}
577	
578		now := time.Now().UTC()
579		matched, err := s.repo.markTripDelivered(ctx, trip.ID, req.BMCID, now)
580		if err != nil {
581			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "deliver trip: mark delivered", err)
582		}
583		if !matched { // lost a state race since the read above
584			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "trip delivery rejected: lost state race",
585				slog.String("trip_id", tripID.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
586			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_TRIP_STATE", "trip was modified concurrently; reload and retry")
587		}
588	
589		consignmentIDs := make([]primitive.ObjectID, 0, len(trip.Stops))
590		refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, len(trip.Stops))
591		for _, stop := range trip.Stops {
592			consignmentIDs = append(consignmentIDs, stop.ConsignmentID)
593			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{
594				EntityType: domain.EntityConsignment, EntityID: stop.ConsignmentID.Hex(), Relation: "delivered",
595			})
596		}
597		if err := s.repo.markConsignmentsDelivered(ctx, consignmentIDs); err != nil {
598			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "deliver trip: mark consignments delivered", err)
599		}
600	
601		event, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
602			Type:       domain.EventTripDelivered,
603			EntityType: domain.EntityRouteTrip,
604			EntityID:   trip.ID.Hex(),
605			Refs:       refs,
606			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
607			OrgUnitID:  trip.UnionID.Hex(),
608			Payload:    map[string]any{"bmc_id": req.BMCID.Hex()},
609		})
610		if err != nil {
611			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "deliver trip: append provenance", err)
612		}
613		if err := s.repo.setTripProvenanceSeq(ctx, trip.ID, event.Seq); err != nil {
614			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "deliver trip: set provenance seq", err)
615		}
616	
617		trip.Status = domain.TripStatusDelivered
618		trip.DeliveredToBMCID = &req.BMCID
619		trip.DeliveredAt = &now
620		trip.ProvenanceSeq = event.Seq
621		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "trip delivered",
622			slog.String("trip_id", trip.ID.Hex()),
623			slog.String("bmc_id", req.BMCID.Hex()),
624			slog.Int("consignment_count", len(consignmentIDs)),
625			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
626		return trip, nil
627	}
628	
629	// listTrips returns a scoped page of trips: riders are forced onto their own
630	// trips; supervisors/presidents default to (and are checked against) their
631	// union scope.
632	func (s *service) listTrips(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, q tripListQuery, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.RouteTrip, int64, error) {
633		unionID := q.UnionID
634		riderPartyID := q.VanRiderPartyID
635		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleVanRider {
636			actorID, err := s.actorID(actor)
637			if err != nil {
638				return nil, 0, err
639			}
640			riderPartyID = actorID // riders only ever see their own trips
641		} else {
642			if unionID.IsZero() &&
643				actor.RoleCode != domain.RoleSuperAdmin && actor.RoleCode != domain.RoleStateAuditor &&
644				actor.OrgUnitID != "" {
645				id, err := httpx.ParseID(actor.OrgUnitID, "actor org unit")
646				if err != nil {
647					return nil, 0, err
648				}
649				unionID = id // supervisors/presidents default to their union
650			}
651			if !unionID.IsZero() {
652				if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, unionID); err != nil {
653					s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "trip list denied: union out of scope",
654						slog.String("union_id", unionID.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
655					return nil, 0, err
656				}
657			}
658		}
659		if q.Date != "" {
660			if _, err := resolveDate(q.Date, time.Time{}); err != nil {
661				return nil, 0, err
662			}
663		}
664		items, total, err := s.repo.listTrips(ctx, unionID, q.Date, riderPartyID, page)
665		if err != nil {
666			return nil, 0, s.internal(ctx, "list trips", err)
667		}
668		return items, total, nil
669	}
670	
671	// getTrip returns one trip: a rider only their own, everyone else within
672	// union scope.
673	func (s *service) getTrip(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, tripID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.RouteTrip, error) {
674		trip, err := s.loadTrip(ctx, tripID)
675		if err != nil {
676			return nil, err
677		}
678		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleVanRider {
679			actorID, err := s.actorID(actor)
680			if err != nil {
681				return nil, err
682			}
683			if trip.VanRiderPartyID != actorID {
684				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "trip read denied: assigned to another rider",
685					slog.String("trip_id", tripID.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
686				return nil, httpx.Forbidden("this trip is assigned to another van rider")
687			}
688			return trip, nil
689		}
690		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, trip.UnionID); err != nil {
691			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "trip read denied: union out of scope",
692				slog.String("trip_id", tripID.Hex()), slog.String("union_id", trip.UnionID.Hex()),
693				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
694			return nil, err
695		}
696		return trip, nil
697	}
698	
699	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
700	// Loaders (mongo.ErrNoDocuments → 404)
701	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
702	
703	// loadConsignment fetches a consignment, mapping a miss to 404.
704	func (s *service) loadConsignment(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.DCSConsignment, error) {
705		c, err := s.repo.findConsignmentByID(ctx, id)
706		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
707			return nil, httpx.NotFound("consignment " + id.Hex())
708		}
709		if err != nil {
710			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "load consignment", err)
711		}
712		return c, nil
713	}

715	// loadTrip fetches a trip, mapping a miss to 404.
716	func (s *service) loadTrip(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.RouteTrip, error) {
717		t, err := s.repo.findTripByID(ctx, id)
718		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
719			return nil, httpx.NotFound("trip " + id.Hex())
720		}
721		if err != nil {
722			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "load trip", err)
723		}
724		return t, nil

727	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
728	// Pure guards & helpers (unit-tested in service_test.go)
729	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
730	
731	// aggregatePours reduces pour rows to (ids, total litres, quantity-weighted
732	// average fat %, quantity-weighted average SNF %), rounded to 2 decimals.
733	func aggregatePours(rows []pourRow) (pourIDs []primitive.ObjectID, totalQty, avgFat, avgSNF float64) {
734		var fatWeighted, snfWeighted float64
735		pourIDs = make([]primitive.ObjectID, 0, len(rows))
736		for _, row := range rows {
737			pourIDs = append(pourIDs, row.ID)
738			totalQty += row.QuantityLitres
739			fatWeighted += row.FatPct * row.QuantityLitres
740			snfWeighted += row.SNFPct * row.QuantityLitres
741		}
742		if totalQty > 0 {
743			avgFat = round2(fatWeighted / totalQty)
744			avgSNF = round2(snfWeighted / totalQty)
745		}
746		return pourIDs, round2(totalQty), avgFat, avgSNF
747	}
748	
749	// round2 rounds to 2 decimal places (litres / percentage precision).
750	func round2(v float64) float64 { return math.Round(v*100) / 100 }
751	
752	// validateShift accepts only the two collection shifts.
753	func validateShift(shift string) *httpx.AppError {
754		if shift != domain.ShiftMorning && shift != domain.ShiftEvening {
755			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_SHIFT", "shift must be MORNING or EVENING")
756		}
757		return nil
758	}
759	
760	// resolveDate defaults an empty date to the IST day key of now, otherwise
761	// validates the YYYY-MM-DD form.
762	func resolveDate(date string, now time.Time) (string, error) {
763		if date == "" {
764			return domain.DateKeyIST(now), nil
765		}
766		if _, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", date); err != nil {
767			return "", httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_DATE", "date must be YYYY-MM-DD")
768		}
769		return date, nil
770	}
771	
772	// validateTemp requires a temperature and rejects physically implausible ones.
773	func validateTemp(tempC *float64) *httpx.AppError {
774		if tempC == nil {
775			return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_TEMP", "temp_c is required")
776		}
777		if *tempC < minPlausibleTempC || *tempC > maxPlausibleTempC {
778			return httpx.BadRequest("IMPLAUSIBLE_TEMP",
779				fmt.Sprintf("temp_c must be between %.0f and %.0f °C", minPlausibleTempC, maxPlausibleTempC))
780		}
781		return nil
782	}
783	
784	// isConsignmentStatus reports whether s is a known consignment status.
785	func isConsignmentStatus(s string) bool {
786		switch s {
787		case domain.ConsignmentStatusOpen, domain.ConsignmentStatusDispatch,
788			domain.ConsignmentStatusPickedUp, domain.ConsignmentStatusDelivered,
789			domain.ConsignmentStatusAccepted, domain.ConsignmentStatusRejected:
790			return true
791		}
792		return false
793	}
794	
795	// findStop returns the index of the stop carrying consignmentID, or -1.
796	func findStop(trip *domain.RouteTrip, consignmentID primitive.ObjectID) int {
797		for i := range trip.Stops {
798			if trip.Stops[i].ConsignmentID == consignmentID {
799				return i
800			}
801		}
802		return -1
803	}
804	
805	// requireTripRider enforces that only the trip's assigned van rider acts on it.
806	func requireTripRider(trip *domain.RouteTrip, riderPartyID primitive.ObjectID) *httpx.AppError {
807		if trip.VanRiderPartyID != riderPartyID {
808			return httpx.Forbidden("this trip is assigned to another van rider")
809		}
810		return nil
811	}
812	
813	// validateStopConsignment guards trip planning: the stop's consignment must
814	// be DISPATCHED (state machine) and must belong to the stop's DCS.
815	func validateStopConsignment(consignment *domain.DCSConsignment, stopDCSID primitive.ObjectID) *httpx.AppError {
816		if consignment.Status != domain.ConsignmentStatusDispatch {
817			return httpx.Conflict("CONSIGNMENT_NOT_DISPATCHED",
818				"consignment "+consignment.ID.Hex()+" is "+consignment.Status+"; only DISPATCHED consignments can be planned onto a trip")
819		}
820		if consignment.DCSID != stopDCSID {
821			return httpx.Unprocessable("CONSIGNMENT_DCS_MISMATCH",
822				"consignment "+consignment.ID.Hex()+" belongs to DCS "+consignment.DCSID.Hex()+", not the stop's DCS "+stopDCSID.Hex())
823		}
824		return nil
825	}
826	
827	// validatePickup guards the pickup transition: right rider, trip not yet
828	// delivered, stop exists, stop not already picked.
829	func validatePickup(trip *domain.RouteTrip, riderPartyID, consignmentID primitive.ObjectID) *httpx.AppError {
830		if err := requireTripRider(trip, riderPartyID); err != nil {
831			return err
832		}
833		if trip.Status == domain.TripStatusDelivered {
834			return httpx.Conflict("TRIP_ALREADY_DELIVERED", "trip is DELIVERED; no further pickups are possible")
835		}
836		i := findStop(trip, consignmentID)
837		if i < 0 {
838			return httpx.NotFound("stop for consignment " + consignmentID.Hex())
839		}
840		if trip.Stops[i].PickedUpAt != nil {
841			return httpx.Conflict("STOP_ALREADY_PICKED", "consignment "+consignmentID.Hex()+" was already picked up on this trip")
842		}
843		return nil
844	}
845	
846	// validateColdChain guards cold-chain logging: right rider, trip still moving.
847	func validateColdChain(trip *domain.RouteTrip, riderPartyID primitive.ObjectID) *httpx.AppError {
848		if err := requireTripRider(trip, riderPartyID); err != nil {
849			return err
850		}
851		if trip.Status == domain.TripStatusDelivered {
852			return httpx.Conflict("TRIP_ALREADY_DELIVERED", "trip is DELIVERED; cold-chain logging is closed")
853		}
854		return nil
855	}
856	
857	// validateDeliver guards delivery: right rider, not already delivered, and
858	// every stop picked up (partial loads cannot be handed to a BMC).
859	func validateDeliver(trip *domain.RouteTrip, riderPartyID primitive.ObjectID) *httpx.AppError {
860		if err := requireTripRider(trip, riderPartyID); err != nil {
861			return err
862		}
863		if trip.Status == domain.TripStatusDelivered {
864			return httpx.Conflict("TRIP_ALREADY_DELIVERED", "trip is already DELIVERED")
865		}
866		var unpicked []string
867		for _, stop := range trip.Stops {
868			if stop.PickedUpAt == nil {
869				unpicked = append(unpicked, stop.ConsignmentID.Hex())
870			}
871		}
872		if len(unpicked) > 0 {
873			return httpx.Unprocessable("STOPS_NOT_PICKED", "every stop must be picked up before delivery").
874				WithDetails(map[string]any{"unpicked_consignment_ids": unpicked})
875		}
876		return nil
877	}

20	// repo owns every MongoDB access of the collection module. It maps
21	// mongo.ErrNoDocuments to httpx.NotFound and wraps everything unexpected in
22	// httpx.Internal, so the service layer only ever sees AppError-compatible
23	// errors. All _id and cross-collection reference filters use
24	// primitive.ObjectID values; client_event_id and counter keys stay strings
25	// (business keys, never joins).
26	type repo struct {
27		rateCharts      *mongo.Collection
28		readings        *mongo.Collection
29		pours           *mongo.Collection
30		invoices        *mongo.Collection
31		roleAssignments *mongo.Collection
32		parties         *mongo.Collection
33		notifications   *mongo.Collection
34		counters        *mongo.Collection
35		consignments    *mongo.Collection // read-only view: freeze checks against the logistics pooling boundary
36	}
37	
38	// newRepo binds the repo to the module's collections.
39	func newRepo(d *deps.Deps) *repo {
40		return &repo{
41			rateCharts:      d.DB.Collection(mongodb.CollRateCharts),
42			readings:        d.DB.Collection(mongodb.CollAnalyzerReadings),
43			pours:           d.DB.Collection(mongodb.CollMilkPours),
44			invoices:        d.DB.Collection(mongodb.CollInvoices),
45			roleAssignments: d.DB.Collection(mongodb.CollRoleAssignments),
46			parties:         d.DB.Collection(mongodb.CollParties),
47			notifications:   d.DB.Collection(mongodb.CollNotifications),
48			counters:        d.DB.Collection(mongodb.CollCounters),
49			consignments:    d.DB.Collection(mongodb.CollConsignments),
50		}
51	}

53	// --- rate charts ---
54	
55	// deactivateActiveCharts flips every active chart of an org unit to inactive
56	// (a new chart supersedes the old ones).
57	func (r *repo) deactivateActiveCharts(ctx context.Context, orgUnitID primitive.ObjectID) error {
58		_, err := r.rateCharts.UpdateMany(ctx,
59			bson.D{{Key: "org_unit_id", Value: orgUnitID}, {Key: "active", Value: true}},
60			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "active", Value: false}}}},
61		)
62		if err != nil {
63			return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("deactivate rate charts: %w", err))
64		}
65		return nil
66	}

71			return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("insert rate chart: %w", err))

76	// activeChartsForOrgs returns active charts already effective at `now` for
77	// any of the given org units (a DCS plus its ancestor chain — a small set).
78	func (r *repo) activeChartsForOrgs(ctx context.Context, orgUnitIDs []primitive.ObjectID, now time.Time) ([]domain.RateChart, error) {
79		cur, err := r.rateCharts.Find(ctx, bson.D{
80			{Key: "org_unit_id", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: orgUnitIDs}}},
81			{Key: "active", Value: true},
82			{Key: "effective_from", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$lte", Value: now}}},
83		})
84		if err != nil {
85			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("find active rate charts: %w", err))
86		}
87		var out []domain.RateChart
88		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
89			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("decode rate charts: %w", err))
90		}
91		return out, nil
92	}

98		if _, err := r.readings.InsertOne(ctx, rd); err != nil {
99			return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("insert reading: %w", err))
100		}

104	// listReadings pages a DCS's readings, optionally restricted to the
105	// [dayStart, dayEnd) window, newest first.
106	func (r *repo) listReadings(ctx context.Context, dcsID primitive.ObjectID, dayStart, dayEnd *time.Time, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.AnalyzerReading, int64, error) {
107		filter := bson.D{{Key: "dcs_id", Value: dcsID}}
108		if dayStart != nil && dayEnd != nil {
109			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "created_at", Value: bson.D{
110				{Key: "$gte", Value: *dayStart},
111				{Key: "$lt", Value: *dayEnd},
112			}})
113		}
114		total, err := r.readings.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
115		if err != nil {
116			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("count readings: %w", err))
117		}
118		cur, err := r.readings.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
119			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "created_at", Value: -1}}).
120			SetSkip(page.Offset).
121			SetLimit(page.Limit),
122		)
123		if err != nil {
124			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("list readings: %w", err))
125		}
126		out := []domain.AnalyzerReading{}
127		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
128			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("decode readings: %w", err))
129		}
130		return out, total, nil
131	}

214	// the filter makes concurrent supersedes lose cleanly (optimistic, no

247	// listPours pages pours matching the filter, newest first, plus the total
248	// matching count for pagination meta.
249	func (r *repo) listPours(ctx context.Context, f pourListFilter, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.MilkPour, int64, error) {
250		filter := bson.D{}
251		if !f.DCSID.IsZero() {
252			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "dcs_id", Value: f.DCSID})
253		}
254		if f.Date != "" {
255			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "pour_date", Value: f.Date})
256		}
257		if f.Shift != "" {
258			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "shift", Value: f.Shift})
259		}

261			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "farmer_party_id", Value: f.FarmerPartyID})
262		}
263		total, err := r.pours.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)

266		}
267		cur, err := r.pours.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
268			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "poured_at", Value: -1}}).
269			SetSkip(page.Offset).
270			SetLimit(page.Limit),
271		)
272		if err != nil {
273			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("list pours: %w", err))
274		}
275		out := []domain.MilkPour{}

278		}

437	// appendPoursToInvoice merges late pours into a still-ISSUED invoice: the
438	// status guard in the filter makes the merge atomic against a concurrent
439	// settlement claim. Returns false when the invoice already left ISSUED.
440	func (r *repo) appendPoursToInvoice(ctx context.Context, invoiceID primitive.ObjectID, pourIDs []primitive.ObjectID, addQty, addAmount float64) (bool, error) {
441		res, err := r.invoices.UpdateOne(ctx,
442			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: invoiceID}, {Key: "status", Value: domain.InvoiceStatusIssued}},
443			bson.D{
444				{Key: "$push", Value: bson.D{{Key: "pour_ids", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$each", Value: pourIDs}}}}},
445				{Key: "$inc", Value: bson.D{
446					{Key: "total_quantity_litres", Value: addQty},
447					{Key: "total_amount", Value: addAmount},
448				}},
449			},
450		)
451		if err != nil {
452			return false, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("append pours to invoice: %w", err))
453		}
454		return res.MatchedCount == 1, nil
455	}

489	// --- counters & notifications ---
490	
491	// nextInvoiceSeq atomically increments and returns the per-DCS-per-day
492	// invoice counter (findOneAndUpdate upsert — safe without transactions).
493	// Counter keys are internal strings ("invoice:"+dcsCode+":"+date).
494	func (r *repo) nextInvoiceSeq(ctx context.Context, key string) (int, error) {
495		var doc struct {
496			Seq int `bson:"seq"`
497		}
498		err := r.counters.FindOneAndUpdate(ctx,
499			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: key}},
500			bson.D{{Key: "$inc", Value: bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}}},
501			options.FindOneAndUpdate().SetUpsert(true).SetReturnDocument(options.After),
502		).Decode(&doc)
503		if err != nil {
504			return 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("next invoice seq: %w", err))
505		}
506		return doc.Seq, nil
507	}

78	// CreateRateChart stores a new pricing chart for an org unit and deactivates
79	// the org's previously active charts (the new chart supersedes them).
80	func (s *service) CreateRateChart(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateRateChartRequest) (*domain.RateChart, error) {
81		if req.OrgUnitID.IsZero() || req.Name == "" {
82			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "org_unit_id and name are required")
83		}
84		if req.BaseRatePerLitre < 0 || req.FatRatePerPoint < 0 || req.SNFRatePerPoint < 0 {
85			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "rates must not be negative")
86		}
87		if req.BaseRatePerLitre+req.FatRatePerPoint+req.SNFRatePerPoint == 0 {
88			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "at least one rate component must be positive")
89		}
90		if _, err := s.d.Orgs.Get(ctx, req.OrgUnitID); err != nil {
91			return nil, err
92		}
93		if err := s.requireInScope(ctx, actor, req.OrgUnitID, "create rate chart"); err != nil {
94			return nil, err
95		}
96		createdBy, err := actorID(actor)
97		if err != nil {
98			return nil, err
99		}
100	
101		now := time.Now().UTC()
102		effectiveFrom := now
103		if req.EffectiveFrom != nil {
104			effectiveFrom = req.EffectiveFrom.UTC()
105		}
106		if err := s.repo.deactivateActiveCharts(ctx, req.OrgUnitID); err != nil {
107			return nil, err
108		}
109		chart := &domain.RateChart{
110			ID:               primitive.NewObjectID(),
111			OrgUnitID:        req.OrgUnitID,
112			Name:             req.Name,
113			BaseRatePerLitre: req.BaseRatePerLitre,
114			FatRatePerPoint:  req.FatRatePerPoint,
115			SNFRatePerPoint:  req.SNFRatePerPoint,
116			EffectiveFrom:    effectiveFrom,
117			Active:           true,
118			CreatedBy:        createdBy,
119			CreatedAt:        now,
120		}
121		if err := s.repo.insertRateChart(ctx, chart); err != nil {
122			return nil, err
123		}
124		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "rate chart created",
125			slog.String("rate_chart_id", chart.ID.Hex()),
126			slog.String("org_unit_id", chart.OrgUnitID.Hex()),
127			slog.String("name", chart.Name),
128			slog.Float64("base_rate_per_litre", chart.BaseRatePerLitre),
129			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))

133	// ResolveActiveChart is the HTTP-facing chart resolution: it enforces the
134	// caller's org scope over the DCS (pricing policy is confidential — any
135	// authenticated user must not be able to enumerate other unions' rates) and
136	// then delegates to the unchecked resolver.
137	func (s *service) ResolveActiveChart(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, dcsID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.RateChart, error) {
138		dcs, err := s.d.Orgs.Get(ctx, dcsID)
139		if err != nil {
140			return nil, err
141		}
142		if dcs.Type != domain.OrgTypeDCS {
143			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_DCS", "org unit "+dcsID.Hex()+" is not a DCS")
144		}
145		if err := s.requireInScope(ctx, actor, dcsID, "resolve rate chart"); err != nil {
146			return nil, err
147		}
148		return s.resolveActiveChartForDCS(ctx, dcsID)
149	}
150	
151	// resolveActiveChartForDCS finds the rate chart pricing a DCS's pours: among
152	// active charts already effective on the DCS itself or any of its ancestors
153	// (org_unit_id ∈ dcs.Path ∪ {dcs.ID}), the nearest org wins; ties break to
154	// the latest effective_from. Returns httpx.NotFound when no chart covers the
155	// DCS. Scope enforcement is the caller's job — the pour pricing path has
156	// already checked the actor's scope.
157	func (s *service) resolveActiveChartForDCS(ctx context.Context, dcsID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.RateChart, error) {
158		dcs, err := s.d.Orgs.Get(ctx, dcsID)
159		if err != nil {
160			return nil, err
161		}
162		if dcs.Type != domain.OrgTypeDCS {
163			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_DCS", "org unit "+dcsID.Hex()+" is not a DCS")
164		}
165	
166		// Distance 0 = the DCS itself; Path is root→parent, so walk it backwards.
167		distance := map[primitive.ObjectID]int{dcs.ID: 0}
168		orgIDs := []primitive.ObjectID{dcs.ID}
169		for i := len(dcs.Path) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
170			distance[dcs.Path[i]] = len(dcs.Path) - i
171			orgIDs = append(orgIDs, dcs.Path[i])
172		}
173	
174		charts, err := s.repo.activeChartsForOrgs(ctx, orgIDs, time.Now().UTC())
175		if err != nil {
176			return nil, err
177		}
178		var best *domain.RateChart
179		for i := range charts {
180			c := &charts[i]
181			if best == nil {
182				best = c
183				continue
184			}
185			dc, db := distance[c.OrgUnitID], distance[best.OrgUnitID]
186			if dc < db || (dc == db && c.EffectiveFrom.After(best.EffectiveFrom)) {
187				best = c
188			}
189		}
190		if best == nil {
191			return nil, httpx.NotFound("active rate chart for DCS " + dcsID.Hex())
192		}
193		return best, nil
194	}

197	
198	// deriveIntegrityFlags computes the anti-tamper flags of a reading from its
199	// capture envelope (blueprint §8.2). Plausibility flags are appended
200	// separately by the caller.
201	func deriveIntegrityFlags(mode string, ocrConfidence float64, hasGeotag bool, deviceTimestamp, serverNow time.Time) []string {
202		var out []string
203		if mode == domain.ReadingModeManual {
204			out = append(out, domain.IntegrityFlagManualEntry)
205		}
206		if mode == domain.ReadingModePhotoOCR && ocrConfidence < lowOCRConfidenceThreshold {
207			out = append(out, domain.IntegrityFlagLowOCRConfidence)
208		}
209		if !hasGeotag {
210			out = append(out, domain.IntegrityFlagMissingGeotag)
211		}
212		if !deviceTimestamp.IsZero() {
213			skew := serverNow.Sub(deviceTimestamp)
214			if skew < 0 {
215				skew = -skew
216			}
217			if skew > maxClockSkew {
218				out = append(out, domain.IntegrityFlagClockSkew)
219			}
220		}
221		return out
222	}

224	// CreateReading stores one analyzer measurement. Suspicious readings are
225	// flagged, never rejected — the anomaly trail is the deterrent (§8.2).
226	func (s *service) CreateReading(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateReadingRequest) (*domain.AnalyzerReading, error) {
227		if req.DCSID.IsZero() {
228			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "dcs_id is required")
229		}
230		switch req.Mode {
231		case domain.ReadingModeDirect, domain.ReadingModePhotoOCR, domain.ReadingModeManual:
232		default:
233			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "mode must be ANALYZER_DIRECT, PHOTO_OCR or MANUAL")
234		}
235		if req.FatPct <= 0 || req.SNFPct <= 0 {
236			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "fat_pct and snf_pct are required")
237		}
238		if err := s.requireInScope(ctx, actor, req.DCSID, "create reading"); err != nil {
239			return nil, err
240		}
241		recordedBy, err := actorID(actor)
242		if err != nil {
243			return nil, err
244		}
245		if req.Mode == domain.ReadingModePhotoOCR {
246			if !s.d.Flags.Enabled(ctx, flags.FlagPhotoOCR) {
247				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "reading rejected: photo-OCR feature disabled",
248					slog.String("dcs_id", req.DCSID.Hex()),
249					slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))

251				featureErr.Code = "FEATURE_DISABLED"

255				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "photo_object_key is required for PHOTO_OCR (evidence retention, §8.2)")
256			}
257		}
258	
259		now := time.Now().UTC()
260		var deviceTS time.Time
261		if req.DeviceTimestamp != nil {
262			deviceTS = req.DeviceTimestamp.UTC()
263		}
264		hasGeo := req.GeoLat != nil && req.GeoLng != nil
265		integrityFlags := deriveIntegrityFlags(req.Mode, req.OCRConfidence, hasGeo, deviceTS, now)
266		plausibilityFlags := domain.CheckPlausibility(req.FatPct, req.SNFPct, req.QuantityLitres)
267		integrityFlags = append(integrityFlags, plausibilityFlags...)
268	
269		reading := &domain.AnalyzerReading{
270			ID:               primitive.NewObjectID(),
271			DCSID:            req.DCSID,
272			DeviceID:         req.DeviceID,
273			Mode:             req.Mode,
274			FatPct:           req.FatPct,
275			SNFPct:           req.SNFPct,
276			CLR:              req.CLR,
277			WaterPct:         req.WaterPct,
278			QuantityLitres:   req.QuantityLitres,
279			PhotoObjectKey:   req.PhotoObjectKey,
280			OCRConfidence:    req.OCRConfidence,
281			DeviceTimestamp:  deviceTS,
282			ServerReceivedAt: now,
283			IntegrityFlags:   integrityFlags,
284			PlausibilityOK:   len(plausibilityFlags) == 0,
285			RecordedBy:       recordedBy,
286			CreatedAt:        now,
287		}
288		if hasGeo {
289			reading.GeoLat, reading.GeoLng = *req.GeoLat, *req.GeoLng
290		}
291		if err := s.repo.insertReading(ctx, reading); err != nil {
292			return nil, err
293		}
294	
295		if _, err := s.d.Ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
296			Type:       domain.EventReadingRecorded,
297			EntityType: domain.EntityAnalyzerReading,
298			EntityID:   reading.ID.Hex(),
299			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
300			OrgUnitID:  reading.DCSID.Hex(),
301			Payload: map[string]any{
302				"mode":            reading.Mode,
303				"integrity_flags": reading.IntegrityFlags,
304			},
305		}); err != nil {
306			err = fmt.Errorf("append reading provenance: %w", err)
307			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "reading provenance append failed",
308				slog.String("reading_id", reading.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
309			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
310		}
311		if len(integrityFlags) > 0 {
312			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "reading recorded with integrity flags",
313				slog.String("reading_id", reading.ID.Hex()),
314				slog.String("dcs_id", reading.DCSID.Hex()),
315				slog.String("mode", reading.Mode),
316				slog.Any("integrity_flags", integrityFlags),
317				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
318		}
319		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "reading recorded",
320			slog.String("reading_id", reading.ID.Hex()),
321			slog.String("dcs_id", reading.DCSID.Hex()),
322			slog.String("mode", reading.Mode),
323			slog.Float64("fat_pct", reading.FatPct),
324			slog.Float64("snf_pct", reading.SNFPct),
325			slog.Bool("plausibility_ok", reading.PlausibilityOK),
326			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
327		return reading, nil
328	}

330	// ListReadings pages a DCS's readings for anomaly review, optionally
331	// restricted to one IST day.
332	func (s *service) ListReadings(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, dcsID primitive.ObjectID, date string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.AnalyzerReading, int64, error) {
333		if dcsID.IsZero() {
334			return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "dcs_id is required")
335		}
336		if err := s.requireInScope(ctx, actor, dcsID, "list readings"); err != nil {
337			return nil, 0, err
338		}
339		var dayStart, dayEnd *time.Time
340		if date != "" {
341			start, end, err := istDayRange(date)
342			if err != nil {
343				return nil, 0, err
344			}
345			dayStart, dayEnd = &start, &end
346		}
347		return s.repo.listReadings(ctx, dcsID, dayStart, dayEnd, page)
348	}

350	// --- pours ---
351	
352	// CreatePour records one farmer's pour with same-day pricing. Replays of the
353	// same client_event_id return the stored pour with idempotentReplay=true —
354	// offline sync retries are harmless (§3.1).
355	func (s *service) CreatePour(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreatePourRequest) (pour *domain.MilkPour, idempotentReplay bool, err error) {
356		if req.ClientEventID == "" || req.FarmerPartyID.IsZero() || req.DCSID.IsZero() {
357			return nil, false, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "client_event_id, farmer_party_id and dcs_id are required")
358		}
359		if req.Shift != domain.ShiftMorning && req.Shift != domain.ShiftEvening {
360			return nil, false, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "shift must be MORNING or EVENING")
361		}
362		if req.QuantityLitres <= 0 {
363			return nil, false, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "quantity_litres must be positive")
364		}
365		switch req.Source {
366		case domain.ReadingModeDirect, domain.ReadingModePhotoOCR, domain.ReadingModeManual:
367		default:
368			return nil, false, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "source must be ANALYZER_DIRECT, PHOTO_OCR or MANUAL")
369		}
370		if err := s.requireInScope(ctx, actor, req.DCSID, "create pour"); err != nil {
371			return nil, false, err
372		}
373		recordedBy, err := actorID(actor)
374		if err != nil {
375			return nil, false, err
376		}
377	
378		// Idempotency short-circuit BEFORE any state-dependent business check:
379		// a replay of an already-stored pour must return the stored pour even if
380		// membership lapsed or the rate chart changed since first sync — otherwise
381		// offline devices keep the record dirty and retry forever.
382		if existing, err := s.repo.pourByClientEventID(ctx, req.ClientEventID); err == nil {
383			return s.replayStoredPour(ctx, actor, existing)
384		} else if !isNotFoundErr(err) {
385			return nil, false, err
386		}
387	
388		now := time.Now().UTC()
389		member, err := s.repo.farmerIsActiveMember(ctx, req.FarmerPartyID, req.DCSID, now)
390		if err != nil {
391			return nil, false, err
392		}
393		if !member {
394			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "pour rejected: farmer not an active member",
395				slog.String("farmer_party_id", req.FarmerPartyID.Hex()),
396				slog.String("dcs_id", req.DCSID.Hex()),
397				slog.String("client_event_id", req.ClientEventID),
398				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
399			return nil, false, httpx.Unprocessable("FARMER_NOT_MEMBER",
400				"farmer does not hold an active FARMER assignment at this DCS")
401		}
402	
403		// HARD plausibility gate: receipts must be trustworthy, so implausible
404		// values are rejected here (unlike readings, which are merely flagged).
405		if violations := domain.CheckPlausibility(req.FatPct, req.SNFPct, req.QuantityLitres); len(violations) > 0 {
406			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "pour rejected: implausible values",
407				slog.String("farmer_party_id", req.FarmerPartyID.Hex()),
408				slog.String("dcs_id", req.DCSID.Hex()),
409				slog.String("client_event_id", req.ClientEventID),
410				slog.Float64("fat_pct", req.FatPct),
411				slog.Float64("snf_pct", req.SNFPct),
412				slog.Float64("quantity_litres", req.QuantityLitres),
413				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
414			return nil, false, httpx.Unprocessable("IMPLAUSIBLE_VALUES",
415				"fat/SNF/quantity outside physically plausible bounds")
416		}
417	
418		chart, err := s.resolveChartForPricing(ctx, req.DCSID)
419		if err != nil {
420			return nil, false, err
421		}
422		rate, amount := chart.PricePour(req.FatPct, req.SNFPct, req.QuantityLitres)
423	
424		pouredAt := now
425		if req.PouredAt != nil {
426			pouredAt = req.PouredAt.UTC()
427		}
428	
429		// A shift whose consignment already exists is sealed: milk recorded now
430		// would be invoiced but never board the van — quantity provenance and the
431		// consignment's totals would silently diverge (§7 pooling boundary).
432		pourDate := domain.DateKeyIST(pouredAt)
433		consigned, err := s.repo.shiftConsigned(ctx, req.DCSID, pourDate, req.Shift)
434		if err != nil {
435			return nil, false, err
436		}
437		if consigned {
438			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "pour rejected: shift already consigned",
439				slog.String("dcs_id", req.DCSID.Hex()),
440				slog.String("pour_date", pourDate),
441				slog.String("shift", req.Shift),
442				slog.String("client_event_id", req.ClientEventID),
443				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
444			return nil, false, httpx.Conflict("SHIFT_CONSIGNED",
445				"a consignment already pools this DCS shift — the pour set is sealed for "+pourDate+" "+req.Shift)
446		}
447		// Pre-generated _id keeps the insert and the ledger refs consistent in
448		// one flow.
449		p := &domain.MilkPour{
450			ID:                primitive.NewObjectID(),
451			ClientEventID:     req.ClientEventID,
452			FarmerPartyID:     req.FarmerPartyID,
453			AnimalID:          req.AnimalID,
454			DCSID:             req.DCSID,
455			Shift:             req.Shift,
456			PourDate:          pourDate,
457			QuantityLitres:    req.QuantityLitres,
458			FatPct:            req.FatPct,
459			SNFPct:            req.SNFPct,
460			CLR:               req.CLR,
461			RatePerLitre:      rate,
462			Amount:            amount,
463			RateChartID:       chart.ID,
464			AnalyzerReadingID: req.AnalyzerReadingID,
465			Source:            req.Source,
466			Status:            domain.PourStatusRecorded,
467			PouredAt:          pouredAt,
468			RecordedBy:        recordedBy,
469			DeviceID:          req.DeviceID,
470			CreatedAt:         now,
471		}
472		if req.GeoLat != nil && req.GeoLng != nil {
473			p.GeoLat, p.GeoLng = *req.GeoLat, *req.GeoLng
474		}
475	
476		duplicate, err := s.repo.insertPour(ctx, p)
477		if err != nil {
478			return nil, false, err
479		}
480		if duplicate {
481			// Race backstop: two concurrent requests both missed the lookup —
482			// the unique client_event_id index caught it at insert time.
483			existing, err := s.repo.pourByClientEventID(ctx, req.ClientEventID)
484			if err != nil {
485				return nil, false, err
486			}
487			return s.replayStoredPour(ctx, actor, existing)
488		}
489	
490		if err := s.recordPourProvenance(ctx, actor, p); err != nil {
491			return nil, false, err
492		}
493		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "pour recorded",
494			slog.String("pour_id", p.ID.Hex()),
495			slog.String("farmer_party_id", p.FarmerPartyID.Hex()),
496			slog.String("dcs_id", p.DCSID.Hex()),
497			slog.String("pour_date", p.PourDate),
498			slog.String("shift", p.Shift),
499			slog.Float64("quantity_litres", p.QuantityLitres),
500			slog.Float64("rate_per_litre", p.RatePerLitre),
501			slog.Float64("amount", p.Amount),
502			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
503		s.announcePour(ctx, p)
504		return p, false, nil
505	}
506	
507	// replayStoredPour returns an already-persisted pour as an idempotent replay.
508	// If a previous attempt persisted the pour but died before the ledger append
509	// (provenance_seq still 0), the missing pour.recorded event, bus publish and
510	// receipt SMS are healed first — a failed heal keeps returning the error so
511	// the client retries until the saga completes, instead of blessing an orphan
512	// with no origin link on the hash chain.
513	func (s *service) replayStoredPour(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, existing *domain.MilkPour) (*domain.MilkPour, bool, error) {
514		if existing.Status == domain.PourStatusRecorded && existing.ProvenanceSeq == 0 {
515			// The append itself must stay idempotent: a pour.recorded event may
516			// already be chained if only the seq back-stamp failed last time.
517			evs, err := s.d.Ledger.EventsForEntity(ctx, domain.EntityMilkPour, existing.ID.Hex())
518			if err != nil {
519				err = fmt.Errorf("check pour provenance: %w", err)
520				s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "pour provenance check failed",
521					slog.String("pour_id", existing.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
522				return nil, false, httpx.Internal(err)
523			}
524			var chained *provenance.Event
525			for i := range evs {
526				if evs[i].Type == domain.EventPourRecorded {
527					chained = &evs[i]
528					break
529				}
530			}
531			if chained != nil {
532				if err := s.repo.setPourProvenanceSeq(ctx, existing.ID, chained.Seq); err != nil {
533					return nil, false, err
534				}
535				existing.ProvenanceSeq = chained.Seq
536			} else {
537				if err := s.recordPourProvenance(ctx, actor, existing); err != nil {
538					return nil, false, err
539				}
540				s.announcePour(ctx, existing)
541			}
542		}
543		s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "pour replayed idempotently",
544			slog.String("pour_id", existing.ID.Hex()),
545			slog.String("client_event_id", existing.ClientEventID),
546			slog.String("farmer_party_id", existing.FarmerPartyID.Hex()),
547			slog.String("dcs_id", existing.DCSID.Hex()),
548			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
549		return existing, true, nil
550	}
551	
552	// announcePour publishes the pour on the bus and queues the farmer's receipt
553	// SMS — the anti-cheating receipt (§8.1).
554	func (s *service) announcePour(ctx context.Context, p *domain.MilkPour) {
555		s.d.Bus.Publish(eventbus.TopicPourRecorded, *p)
556		s.queueFarmerSMS(ctx, p.FarmerPartyID, domain.TemplatePourReceipt, map[string]string{
557			"quantity": fmt.Sprintf("%.2f", p.QuantityLitres), // key must match renderSMS's p("quantity")
558			"rate":     fmt.Sprintf("%.2f", p.RatePerLitre),
559			"amount":   fmt.Sprintf("%.2f", p.Amount),
560		})
561	}
562	
563	// isNotFoundErr reports whether err is a 404 AppError.
564	func isNotFoundErr(err error) bool {
565		var appErr *httpx.AppError
566		return errors.As(err, &appErr) && appErr.Status == http.StatusNotFound
567	}
568	
569	// recordPourProvenance appends EventPourRecorded and stamps the ledger seq
570	// onto the pour.
571	func (s *service) recordPourProvenance(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, p *domain.MilkPour) error {
572		refs := []provenance.Ref{
573			{EntityType: domain.EntityParty, EntityID: p.FarmerPartyID.Hex(), Relation: "produced_by"},
574		}
575		if p.AnimalID != nil {
576			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{EntityType: domain.EntityAnimal, EntityID: p.AnimalID.Hex(), Relation: "from_animal"})
577		}
578		if p.AnalyzerReadingID != nil {
579			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{EntityType: domain.EntityAnalyzerReading, EntityID: p.AnalyzerReadingID.Hex(), Relation: "measured_by"})
580		}
581		ev, err := s.d.Ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
582			Type:       domain.EventPourRecorded,
583			EntityType: domain.EntityMilkPour,
584			EntityID:   p.ID.Hex(),
585			Refs:       refs,
586			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
587			OrgUnitID:  p.DCSID.Hex(),
588			Payload: map[string]any{
589				"quantity_litres": p.QuantityLitres,
590				"rate_per_litre":  p.RatePerLitre,
591				"amount":          p.Amount,
592			},
593		})
594		if err != nil {
595			err = fmt.Errorf("append pour provenance: %w", err)
596			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "pour provenance append failed",
597				slog.String("pour_id", p.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
598			return httpx.Internal(err)
599		}
600		if err := s.repo.setPourProvenanceSeq(ctx, p.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
601			return err
602		}
603		p.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
604		return nil
605	}
606	
607	// resolveChartForPricing wraps resolveActiveChartForDCS, converting "no
608	// chart" into a 422 — the pour payload itself is fine, the DCS just cannot
609	// price it yet.
610	func (s *service) resolveChartForPricing(ctx context.Context, dcsID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.RateChart, error) {
611		chart, err := s.resolveActiveChartForDCS(ctx, dcsID)
612		if err != nil {
613			var appErr *httpx.AppError
614			if errors.As(err, &appErr) && appErr.Status == http.StatusNotFound {
615				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "pour rejected: no active rate chart",
616					slog.String("dcs_id", dcsID.Hex()))
617				return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("NO_ACTIVE_RATE_CHART",
618					"no active rate chart covers this DCS — pours cannot be priced")
619			}
620			return nil, err
621		}
622		return chart, nil
623	}
624	
625	// BatchSyncPours replays up to 500 offline-captured pours. Items succeed or
626	// fail independently — the batch never aborts (offline reconnect path, §3.1).
627	func (s *service) BatchSyncPours(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req BatchSyncRequest) ([]BatchSyncItemResult, error) {
628		if len(req.Pours) == 0 {
629			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "pours must not be empty")
630		}
631		if len(req.Pours) > maxBatchSyncItems {
632			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION",
633				fmt.Sprintf("pours must not exceed %d items per batch", maxBatchSyncItems))
634		}
635		results := make([]BatchSyncItemResult, 0, len(req.Pours))
636		for _, item := range req.Pours {
637			res := BatchSyncItemResult{ClientEventID: item.ClientEventID}
638			pour, replay, err := s.CreatePour(ctx, actor, item)
639			switch {
640			case err != nil:
641				res.Status = BatchItemError
642				var appErr *httpx.AppError
643				if errors.As(err, &appErr) {
644					res.Error = appErr.Code + ": " + appErr.Message
645				} else {
646					res.Error = "INTERNAL: internal server error"
647				}
648			case replay:
649				res.Status = BatchItemDuplicate
650				res.PourID = pour.ID.Hex()
651			default:
652				res.Status = BatchItemCreated
653				res.PourID = pour.ID.Hex()
654			}
655			results = append(results, res)
656		}
657		return results, nil
658	}
659	
660	// SupersedePour applies an append-only correction (§3.4): the old pour is
661	// marked SUPERSEDED (the document stays), and a new repriced pour referencing
662	// it is recorded.
663	func (s *service) SupersedePour(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, pourID primitive.ObjectID, req SupersedePourRequest) (*domain.MilkPour, error) {
664		if req.Reason == "" {
665			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "reason is required")
666		}
667		old, err := s.repo.pourByID(ctx, pourID)
668		if err != nil {
669			return nil, err
670		}
671		if err := s.requireInScope(ctx, actor, old.DCSID, "supersede pour"); err != nil {
672			return nil, err
673		}
674		recordedBy, err := actorID(actor)
675		if err != nil {
676			return nil, err
677		}
678		if old.Status != domain.PourStatusRecorded {
679			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "supersede rejected: pour not correctable",
680				slog.String("pour_id", old.ID.Hex()),
681				slog.String("status", old.Status),
682				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
683			return nil, httpx.Conflict("POUR_NOT_CORRECTABLE",
684				"pour is already "+old.Status+" and cannot be superseded")
685		}
686		invoiced, err := s.repo.pourIsInvoiced(ctx, pourID)
687		if err != nil {
688			return nil, err
689		}
690		if invoiced {
691			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "supersede rejected: pour already invoiced",
692				slog.String("pour_id", old.ID.Hex()),
693				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
694			return nil, httpx.Conflict("POUR_INVOICED",
695				"pour is aggregated by an invoice — correct it through settlement instead")
696		}
697		// The consigned state freezes the pour exactly like the invoiced state:
698		// a consignment's pour set, litres and weighted fat/SNF are snapshotted,
699		// so correcting after pooling would silently desync payment from the
700		// shipped-quantity provenance.
701		consigned, err := s.repo.shiftConsigned(ctx, old.DCSID, old.PourDate, old.Shift)
702		if err != nil {
703			return nil, err
704		}
705		if consigned {
706			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "supersede rejected: shift already consigned",
707				slog.String("pour_id", old.ID.Hex()),
708				slog.String("dcs_id", old.DCSID.Hex()),
709				slog.String("pour_date", old.PourDate),
710				slog.String("shift", old.Shift),
711				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
712			return nil, httpx.Conflict("POUR_CONSIGNED",
713				"pour is aggregated by a consignment — correct it through logistics/settlement instead")
714		}
715	
716		qty, fat, snf := old.QuantityLitres, old.FatPct, old.SNFPct
717		if req.Corrected.QuantityLitres != nil {
718			qty = *req.Corrected.QuantityLitres
719		}
720		if req.Corrected.FatPct != nil {
721			fat = *req.Corrected.FatPct
722		}
723		if req.Corrected.SNFPct != nil {
724			snf = *req.Corrected.SNFPct
725		}
726		if qty <= 0 {
727			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "corrected quantity_litres must be positive")
728		}
729		if violations := domain.CheckPlausibility(fat, snf, qty); len(violations) > 0 {
730			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "supersede rejected: implausible corrected values",
731				slog.String("pour_id", old.ID.Hex()),
732				slog.Float64("fat_pct", fat),
733				slog.Float64("snf_pct", snf),
734				slog.Float64("quantity_litres", qty),
735				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
736			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("IMPLAUSIBLE_VALUES",
737				"corrected fat/SNF/quantity outside physically plausible bounds")
738		}
739	
740		chart, err := s.resolveChartForPricing(ctx, old.DCSID)
741		if err != nil {
742			return nil, err
743		}
744		rate, amount := chart.PricePour(fat, snf, qty)
745	
746		// Optimistic guard: only one correction can win the RECORDED→SUPERSEDED flip.
747		flipped, err := s.repo.markPourSuperseded(ctx, old.ID)
748		if err != nil {
749			return nil, err
750		}
751		if !flipped {
752			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "supersede rejected: pour superseded concurrently",
753				slog.String("pour_id", old.ID.Hex()),
754				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
755			return nil, httpx.Conflict("POUR_NOT_CORRECTABLE", "pour was superseded concurrently")
756		}
757	
758		now := time.Now().UTC()
759		corrected := &domain.MilkPour{
760			ID:                primitive.NewObjectID(),
761			FarmerPartyID:     old.FarmerPartyID,
762			AnimalID:          old.AnimalID,
763			DCSID:             old.DCSID,
764			Shift:             old.Shift,
765			PourDate:          old.PourDate, // correction stays on the original settlement day
766			QuantityLitres:    qty,
767			FatPct:            fat,
768			SNFPct:            snf,
769			CLR:               old.CLR,
770			RatePerLitre:      rate,
771			Amount:            amount,
772			RateChartID:       chart.ID,
773			AnalyzerReadingID: old.AnalyzerReadingID,
774			Source:            old.Source,
775			Status:            domain.PourStatusRecorded,
776			SupersedesPourID:  &old.ID,
777			PouredAt:          old.PouredAt,
778			RecordedBy:        recordedBy,
779			DeviceID:          old.DeviceID,
780			GeoLat:            old.GeoLat,
781			GeoLng:            old.GeoLng,
782			CreatedAt:         now,
783		}
784		corrected.ClientEventID = old.ClientEventID + "::corr::" + corrected.ID.Hex()[0:8]
785		if duplicate, err := s.repo.insertPour(ctx, corrected); err != nil {
786			return nil, err
787		} else if duplicate {
788			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "supersede rejected: correction collided",
789				slog.String("pour_id", old.ID.Hex()),
790				slog.String("client_event_id", corrected.ClientEventID),
791				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
792			return nil, httpx.Conflict("POUR_NOT_CORRECTABLE", "correction collided with a concurrent one")
793		}
794	
795		ev, err := s.d.Ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
796			Type:       domain.EventPourSuperseded,
797			EntityType: domain.EntityMilkPour,
798			EntityID:   corrected.ID.Hex(),
799			Refs: []provenance.Ref{
800				{EntityType: domain.EntityMilkPour, EntityID: old.ID.Hex(), Relation: "supersedes"},
801			},
802			Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
803			OrgUnitID: corrected.DCSID.Hex(),
804			Payload:   map[string]any{"reason": req.Reason},
805		})
806		if err != nil {
807			err = fmt.Errorf("append supersede provenance: %w", err)
808			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "supersede provenance append failed",
809				slog.String("pour_id", corrected.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
810			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
811		}
812		if err := s.repo.setPourProvenanceSeq(ctx, corrected.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
813			return nil, err
814		}
815		corrected.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
816		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "pour superseded",
817			slog.String("pour_id", corrected.ID.Hex()),
818			slog.String("supersedes_pour_id", old.ID.Hex()),
819			slog.String("farmer_party_id", corrected.FarmerPartyID.Hex()),
820			slog.String("dcs_id", corrected.DCSID.Hex()),
821			slog.Float64("quantity_litres", corrected.QuantityLitres),
822			slog.Float64("amount", corrected.Amount),
823			slog.String("reason", req.Reason),
824			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
825		return corrected, nil
826	}
