828	// ListPours pages pours. FARMER callers are always pinned to their own
829	// pours; staff roles must name a DCS inside their scope.
830	func (s *service) ListPours(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, filter pourListFilter, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.MilkPour, int64, error) {
831		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleFarmer {
832			self, err := actorID(actor)
833			if err != nil {
834				return nil, 0, err
835			}
836			filter.FarmerPartyID = self // farmers only ever see their own pours
837		} else {
838			if filter.DCSID.IsZero() {
839				return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "dcs_id is required")
840			}
841			if err := s.requireInScope(ctx, actor, filter.DCSID, "list pours"); err != nil {
842				return nil, 0, err
843			}
844		}
845		if filter.Date != "" {
846			if err := validateDateKey(filter.Date); err != nil {
847				return nil, 0, err
848			}
849		}
850		if filter.Shift != "" && filter.Shift != domain.ShiftMorning && filter.Shift != domain.ShiftEvening {
851			return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "shift must be MORNING or EVENING")
852		}
853		return s.repo.listPours(ctx, filter, page)
854	}
855	
856	// --- invoices ---
857	
858	// GenerateInvoices groups the day's un-invoiced RECORDED pours by farmer and
859	// issues one invoice each — the same-day payment artefact (§8.1). The unique
860	// farmer+DCS+day index (on ObjectIDs) is the true duplicate guard; racing
861	// generators simply count the loser as "existing".
862	func (s *service) GenerateInvoices(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req GenerateInvoicesRequest) (*GenerateInvoicesResponse, error) {
863		if req.DCSID.IsZero() {
864			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "dcs_id is required")
865		}
866		now := time.Now().UTC()
867		dateKey := req.Date
868		if dateKey == "" {
869			dateKey = domain.DateKeyIST(now)
870		} else if err := validateDateKey(dateKey); err != nil {
871			return nil, err
872		}
873		dcs, err := s.d.Orgs.Get(ctx, req.DCSID)
874		if err != nil {
875			return nil, err
876		}
877		if dcs.Type != domain.OrgTypeDCS {
878			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_DCS", "org unit "+req.DCSID.Hex()+" is not a DCS")
879		}
880		if err := s.requireInScope(ctx, actor, req.DCSID, "generate invoices"); err != nil {
881			return nil, err
882		}
883	
884		pours, err := s.repo.recordedPoursForDay(ctx, req.DCSID, dateKey)
885		if err != nil {
886			return nil, err
887		}
888		alreadyInvoiced, err := s.repo.invoicedPourIDs(ctx, req.DCSID, dateKey)
889		if err != nil {
890			return nil, err
891		}
892	
893		byFarmer := make(map[primitive.ObjectID][]domain.MilkPour)
894		for _, p := range pours {
895			if alreadyInvoiced[p.ID] {
896				continue
897			}
898			byFarmer[p.FarmerPartyID] = append(byFarmer[p.FarmerPartyID], p)
899		}
900		farmerIDs := make([]primitive.ObjectID, 0, len(byFarmer))
901		for id := range byFarmer {
902			farmerIDs = append(farmerIDs, id)
903		}
904		sort.Slice(farmerIDs, func(i, j int) bool { return farmerIDs[i].Hex() < farmerIDs[j].Hex() })
905	
906		resp := &GenerateInvoicesResponse{Invoices: []domain.Invoice{}}
907		// Counter keys stay strings and keep using the org CODE — internal only.
908		counterKey := "invoice:" + dcs.Code + ":" + dateKey
909		for _, farmerID := range farmerIDs {
910			group := byFarmer[farmerID]
911			seq, err := s.repo.nextInvoiceSeq(ctx, counterKey)
912			if err != nil {
913				return nil, err
914			}
915			inv := &domain.Invoice{
916				ID:            primitive.NewObjectID(),
917				InvoiceNumber: domain.InvoiceNumberFor(dcs.Code, dateKey, seq),
918				FarmerPartyID: farmerID,
919				DCSID:         req.DCSID,
920				InvoiceDate:   dateKey,
921				Status:        domain.InvoiceStatusIssued,
922				IssuedAt:      now,
923			}
924			for _, p := range group {
925				inv.PourIDs = append(inv.PourIDs, p.ID)
926				inv.TotalQuantityLitres += p.QuantityLitres
927				inv.TotalAmount += p.Amount
928			}
929			inv.TotalQuantityLitres = math.Round(inv.TotalQuantityLitres*100) / 100
930			inv.TotalAmount = math.Round(inv.TotalAmount*100) / 100
931	
932			duplicate, err := s.repo.insertInvoice(ctx, inv)
933			if err != nil {
934				return nil, err
935			}
936			if duplicate {
937				// The farmer already has today's invoice (e.g. the MORNING run) —
938				// merge the not-yet-invoiced pours into it instead of silently
939				// dropping them, or surface them when the invoice is frozen.
940				if err := s.mergeIntoExistingInvoice(ctx, actor, req.DCSID, dateKey, farmerID, group, resp); err != nil {
941					return nil, err
942				}
943				continue
944			}
945	
946			refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, len(inv.PourIDs))
947			for _, pid := range inv.PourIDs {
948				refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{EntityType: domain.EntityMilkPour, EntityID: pid.Hex(), Relation: "aggregates"})
949			}
950			ev, err := s.d.Ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
951				Type:       domain.EventInvoiceIssued,
952				EntityType: domain.EntityInvoice,
953				EntityID:   inv.ID.Hex(),
954				Refs:       refs,
955				Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
956				OrgUnitID:  inv.DCSID.Hex(),
957				Payload: map[string]any{
958					"invoice_number":        inv.InvoiceNumber,
959					"total_quantity_litres": inv.TotalQuantityLitres,
960					"total_amount":          inv.TotalAmount,
961				},
962			})
963			if err != nil {
964				err = fmt.Errorf("append invoice provenance: %w", err)
965				s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "invoice provenance append failed",
966					slog.String("invoice_id", inv.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
967				return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
968			}
969			if err := s.repo.setInvoiceProvenanceSeq(ctx, inv.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
970				return nil, err
971			}
972			inv.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
973	
974			s.d.Bus.Publish(eventbus.TopicInvoiceIssued, *inv)
975			s.queueInvoiceSMS(ctx, inv)
976			s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "invoice issued",
977				slog.String("invoice_id", inv.ID.Hex()),
978				slog.String("invoice_number", inv.InvoiceNumber),
979				slog.String("farmer_party_id", inv.FarmerPartyID.Hex()),
980				slog.String("dcs_id", inv.DCSID.Hex()),
981				slog.String("invoice_date", inv.InvoiceDate),
982				slog.Int("pour_count", len(inv.PourIDs)),
983				slog.Float64("total_amount", inv.TotalAmount),
984				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
985			resp.Created++
986			resp.Invoices = append(resp.Invoices, *inv)
987		}
988		return resp, nil
989	}
990	
991	// mergeIntoExistingInvoice folds a farmer's not-yet-invoiced pours into their
992	// already-issued invoice for the day. Only a still-ISSUED invoice may be
993	// amended (the status guard on the update is atomic against a concurrent
994	// settlement claim); a PAID/settlement-claimed invoice is never mutated —
995	// its pours are surfaced in the response so staff can act, never dropped.
996	func (s *service) mergeIntoExistingInvoice(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, dcsID primitive.ObjectID, dateKey string, farmerID primitive.ObjectID, group []domain.MilkPour, resp *GenerateInvoicesResponse) error {
997		existing, err := s.repo.invoiceByFarmerDay(ctx, farmerID, dcsID, dateKey)
998		if err != nil {
999			return err
1000		}
1001		// Only pours genuinely missing from the invoice are merged — a racing
1002		// generator that lost the insert must not double-add the winner's pours.
1003		already := make(map[primitive.ObjectID]bool, len(existing.PourIDs))
1004		for _, id := range existing.PourIDs {
1005			already[id] = true
1006		}
1007		var newPours []domain.MilkPour
1008		for _, p := range group {
1009			if !already[p.ID] {
1010				newPours = append(newPours, p)
1011			}
1012		}
1013		if len(newPours) == 0 {
1014			resp.Existing++
1015			return nil
1016		}
1017	
1018		skip := func(reason string) {
1019			resp.Existing++
1020			skipped := make([]string, 0, len(newPours))
1021			for _, p := range newPours {
1022				resp.SkippedPourIDs = append(resp.SkippedPourIDs, p.ID)
1023				skipped = append(skipped, p.ID.Hex())
1024			}
1025			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "invoice merge skipped: "+reason,
1026				slog.String("invoice_id", existing.ID.Hex()),
1027				slog.String("invoice_number", existing.InvoiceNumber),
1028				slog.String("farmer_party_id", farmerID.Hex()),
1029				slog.String("dcs_id", dcsID.Hex()),
1030				slog.Any("skipped_pour_ids", skipped),
1031				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
1032		}
1033		if existing.Status != domain.InvoiceStatusIssued {
1034			skip("invoice frozen by settlement") // un-invoiceable today, surface loudly
1035			return nil
1036		}
1037		ids := make([]primitive.ObjectID, 0, len(newPours))
1038		var addQty, addAmount float64
1039		for _, p := range newPours {
1040			ids = append(ids, p.ID)
1041			addQty += p.QuantityLitres
1042			addAmount += p.Amount
1043		}
1044		merged, err := s.repo.appendPoursToInvoice(ctx, existing.ID, ids, addQty, addAmount)
1045		if err != nil {
1046			return err
1047		}
1048		if !merged {
1049			skip("invoice left ISSUED concurrently") // between the read and the guarded update
1050			return nil
1051		}
1052		updated, err := s.repo.invoiceByID(ctx, existing.ID)
1053		if err != nil {
1054			return err
1055		}
1056		updated.TotalQuantityLitres = math.Round(updated.TotalQuantityLitres*100) / 100
1057		updated.TotalAmount = math.Round(updated.TotalAmount*100) / 100
1058		if err := s.repo.setInvoiceTotals(ctx, updated.ID, updated.TotalQuantityLitres, updated.TotalAmount); err != nil {
1059			return err
1060		}
1061	
1062		refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, len(ids))
1063		for _, pid := range ids {
1064			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{EntityType: domain.EntityMilkPour, EntityID: pid.Hex(), Relation: "aggregates"})
1065		}
1066		ev, err := s.d.Ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
1067			Type:       domain.EventInvoiceAmended,
1068			EntityType: domain.EntityInvoice,
1069			EntityID:   updated.ID.Hex(),
1070			Refs:       refs,
1071			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
1072			OrgUnitID:  updated.DCSID.Hex(),
1073			Payload: map[string]any{
1074				"invoice_number":        updated.InvoiceNumber,
1075				"added_pour_count":      len(ids),
1076				"total_quantity_litres": updated.TotalQuantityLitres,
1077				"total_amount":          updated.TotalAmount,
1078			},
1079		})
1080		if err != nil {
1081			err = fmt.Errorf("append invoice amendment provenance: %w", err)
1082			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "invoice amendment provenance append failed",
1083				slog.String("invoice_id", updated.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
1084			return httpx.Internal(err)
1085		}
1086		if err := s.repo.setInvoiceProvenanceSeq(ctx, updated.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
1087			return err
1088		}
1089		updated.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
1090	
1091		s.d.Bus.Publish(eventbus.TopicInvoiceIssued, *updated)
1092		s.queueInvoiceSMS(ctx, updated)
1093		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "invoice amended",
1094			slog.String("invoice_id", updated.ID.Hex()),
1095			slog.String("invoice_number", updated.InvoiceNumber),
1096			slog.String("farmer_party_id", updated.FarmerPartyID.Hex()),
1097			slog.String("dcs_id", updated.DCSID.Hex()),
1098			slog.Int("added_pour_count", len(ids)),
1099			slog.Float64("total_amount", updated.TotalAmount),
1100			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
1101		resp.Updated++
1102		resp.Invoices = append(resp.Invoices, *updated)
1103		return nil
1104	}

1107	func (s *service) queueInvoiceSMS(ctx context.Context, inv *domain.Invoice) {

1109			"invoice_number": inv.InvoiceNumber,

1111			"date":           inv.InvoiceDate,

1129				return nil, 0, err
1130			}

1148	// GetInvoice returns one invoice: a farmer may fetch their own, staff roles
1149	// need the invoice's DCS inside their scope.
1150	func (s *service) GetInvoice(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.Invoice, error) {
1151		inv, err := s.repo.invoiceByID(ctx, id)
1152		if err != nil {
1153			return nil, err
1154		}
1155		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleFarmer {
1156			self, err := actorID(actor)
1157			if err != nil {
1158				return nil, err
1159			}
1160			if inv.FarmerPartyID != self {
1161				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "invoice access denied: not the farmer's own",
1162					slog.String("invoice_id", inv.ID.Hex()),
1163					slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
1164				return nil, httpx.Forbidden("farmers may only view their own invoices")
1165			}
1166			return inv, nil
1167		}
1168		if err := s.requireInScope(ctx, actor, inv.DCSID, "get invoice"); err != nil {
1169			return nil, err
1170		}
1171		return inv, nil
1172	}

1176	// queueFarmerSMS writes an outbox notification for the farmer. Failures are
1177	// logged, never fatal — the receipt must not block the pour (§8.1).
1178	func (s *service) queueFarmerSMS(ctx context.Context, farmerPartyID primitive.ObjectID, templateKey string, params map[string]string) {
1179		farmer, err := s.repo.getParty(ctx, farmerPartyID)
1180		if err != nil {
1181			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "farmer lookup for SMS failed",
1182				slog.String("farmer_party_id", farmerPartyID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
1183			return
1184		}
1185		language := farmer.PreferredLanguage
1186		if language == "" {
1187			language = defaultLanguage
1188		}
1189		n := &domain.Notification{
1190			ID:          primitive.NewObjectID(),
1191			PartyID:     &farmer.ID,
1192			Phone:       farmer.Phone,
1193			Channel:     domain.ChannelSMS,
1194			TemplateKey: templateKey,
1195			Language:    language,
1196			Params:      params,
1197			Status:      domain.NotificationQueued,
1198			QueuedAt:    time.Now().UTC(),
1199		}
1200		if err := s.repo.queueNotification(ctx, n); err != nil {
1201			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "notification queue failed",
1202				slog.String("template", templateKey),
1203				slog.String("farmer_party_id", farmerPartyID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
1204		}
1205	}

1207	// validateDateKey checks a YYYY-MM-DD day key.
1208	func validateDateKey(date string) error {
1209		if _, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", date); err != nil {
1210			return httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "date must be YYYY-MM-DD")
1211		}
1212		return nil
1213	}
1214	
1215	// istDayRange converts a YYYY-MM-DD key into the [start, end) UTC window of
1216	// that IST calendar day.
1217	func istDayRange(date string) (start, end time.Time, err error) {
1218		ist := time.FixedZone("IST", 5*3600+1800)
1219		day, parseErr := time.ParseInLocation("2006-01-02", date, ist)
1220		if parseErr != nil {
1221			return time.Time{}, time.Time{}, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "date must be YYYY-MM-DD")
1222		}
1223		return day.UTC(), day.Add(24*time.Hour).UTC(), nil
1224	}

1	package settlement
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"log/slog"

7		"time"
8	
9		"github.com/google/uuid"
10		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
11		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"

13		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"

15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/eventbus"

18		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/provenance"
19	)
20	
21	// initiateRefsCap bounds how many invoice refs the settlement.initiated
22	// ledger event carries (per module spec: cap 300).
23	const initiateRefsCap = 300
24	
25	// service holds all settlement business logic: the §8.1/§18-B payment
26	// guardrail (compute+initiate → dual-control approve → licensed-PA execute)
27	// and the strictly separate DBT subsidy rail (§13).
28	type service struct {
29		repo   *repo
30		ledger *provenance.Ledger
31		orgs   *orgscope.Resolver
32		bus    *eventbus.Bus
33		log    *slog.Logger
34	}
35	
36	// actorObjectID parses the actor's party identity. JWT claims carry ObjectIDs
37	// as hex strings (tokens are JSON); every service method that compares or
38	// stores the actor's identity goes through this one helper.
39	func actorObjectID(actor auth.Actor) (primitive.ObjectID, error) {
40		return httpx.ParseID(actor.PartyID, "actor")
41	}
42	
43	// ---- pure guardrail checks (unit-tested without a database) ----
44	
45	// validateApproval enforces the dual-control guardrail (§8.1/§18-B): the
46	// approving party MUST differ from the initiator — checked FIRST and on the
47	// party identity itself, so not even SUPER_ADMIN's role bypass can approve a
48	// batch it initiated. Then the batch must still be awaiting approval.
49	func validateApproval(b domain.SettlementBatch, approverPartyID primitive.ObjectID) error {
50		if b.InitiatedBy == approverPartyID {
51			return httpx.Forbidden("dual-control violation: the settlement initiator cannot approve their own batch (§8.1/§18-B)").
52				WithDetails(map[string]string{"reason": "DUAL_CONTROL_VIOLATION"})
53		}
54		if b.Status != domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval {
55			return httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch is "+b.Status+", expected "+domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval)
56		}
57		return nil
58	}
59	
60	// executionLease is how long an APPROVED→EXECUTING claim is considered live.
61	// A batch stuck EXECUTING longer than this (crashed executor) may be resumed —
62	// the per-invoice payout logic is idempotent, so a replay is safe.
63	const executionLease = 2 * time.Minute
64	
65	// validateExecution gates which states may (re-)enter execution:
66	//   - APPROVED:  the normal dual-controlled first run.
67	//   - EXECUTING: resume of an interrupted run (the lease check in
68	//     claimExecution prevents stealing a live executor's batch).
69	//   - FAILED:    re-execution after a recorded mid-run failure.
70	//
71	// Anything pre-approval is a guardrail breach, not a race; EXECUTED/REJECTED
72	// are terminal.
73	func validateExecution(b domain.SettlementBatch) error {
74		switch b.Status {
75		case domain.SettlementStatusApproved, domain.SettlementStatusExecuting, domain.SettlementStatusFailed:
76			return nil
77		default:
78			return httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch is "+b.Status+", must be "+domain.SettlementStatusApproved+" before execution")
79		}
80	}
81	
82	// mockUTR builds a mock bank transaction reference: "UTRMOCK" + 12 hex chars.
83	func mockUTR() string {
84		return "UTRMOCK" + strings.ToUpper(strings.ReplaceAll(uuid.NewString(), "-", "")[:12])
85	}
86	
87	// mockPARef builds a mock payment-aggregator batch reference.
88	func mockPARef() string {
89		return "PA-MOCK-" + uuid.NewString()[:8]
90	}
91	
92	// mockPFMSRef builds a mock PFMS acknowledgement reference (§13).
93	func mockPFMSRef() string {
94		return "PFMS-MOCK-" + uuid.NewString()[:8]
95	}
96	
97	// ---- settlement lifecycle ----
98	
99	// Initiate collects a DCS day's ISSUED invoices into a new settlement batch
100	// and parks it PENDING_APPROVAL. The INITIATED status is momentary by design
101	// (§8.1): computation and initiation are one Saathi action; nothing proceeds
102	// until a different human approves.
103	func (s *service) Initiate(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, in InitiateSettlementRequest) (*domain.SettlementBatch, error) {
104		actorID, err := actorObjectID(actor)
105		if err != nil {
106			return nil, err
107		}
108		if in.DCSID.IsZero() {
109			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_FIELD", "dcs_id is required")
110		}
111		now := time.Now().UTC()
112		date := in.Date
113		if date == "" {
114			date = domain.DateKeyIST(now)
115		} else if _, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", date); err != nil {
116			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_DATE", "date must be YYYY-MM-DD")
117		}
118		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, in.DCSID); err != nil {
119			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "settlement initiation denied: out of scope",
120				slog.String("dcs_id", in.DCSID.Hex()),
121				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
122			return nil, err
123		}
124	
125		candidates, err := s.repo.issuedInvoices(ctx, in.DCSID, date)
126		if err != nil {
127			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement initiation: load issued invoices",
128				slog.String("dcs_id", in.DCSID.Hex()), slog.String("date", date), slog.Any("err", err))
129			return nil, err
130		}
131		if len(candidates) == 0 {
132			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "settlement initiation rejected: no ISSUED invoices",
133				slog.String("dcs_id", in.DCSID.Hex()), slog.String("date", date),
134				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
135			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("NO_INVOICES", "no ISSUED invoices for DCS "+in.DCSID.Hex()+" on "+date)
136		}
137	
138		// Claim optimistically: the status guard on the update means each invoice
139		// lands in exactly one batch even under concurrent initiations. The batch
140		// ID is pre-generated so claim, insert and ledger all share one identity.
141		batchID := primitive.NewObjectID()
142		ids := make([]primitive.ObjectID, 0, len(candidates))
143		for _, inv := range candidates {
144			ids = append(ids, inv.ID)
145		}
146		if _, err := s.repo.claimInvoices(ctx, ids, batchID); err != nil {
147			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement initiation: claim invoices",
148				slog.String("batch_id", batchID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
149			return nil, err
150		}
151		claimed, err := s.repo.invoicesByBatch(ctx, batchID)
152		if err != nil {
153			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement initiation: read claimed invoices",
154				slog.String("batch_id", batchID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
155			return nil, err
156		}
157		if len(claimed) == 0 {
158			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "settlement initiation rejected: invoices claimed by concurrent batch",
159				slog.String("dcs_id", in.DCSID.Hex()), slog.String("date", date),
160				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
161			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("NO_INVOICES", "invoices were claimed by a concurrent settlement for DCS "+in.DCSID.Hex()+" on "+date)
162		}
163	
164		batch := &domain.SettlementBatch{
165			ID:          batchID,
166			DCSID:       in.DCSID,
167			Date:        date,
168			Status:      domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval, // INITIATED → PENDING_APPROVAL immediately
169			InitiatedBy: actorID,
170			CreatedAt:   now,
171		}
172		for _, inv := range claimed {
173			batch.InvoiceIDs = append(batch.InvoiceIDs, inv.ID)
174			batch.TotalAmount += inv.TotalAmount
175		}
176		if err := s.repo.insertBatch(ctx, batch); err != nil {
177			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement initiation: insert batch",
178				slog.String("batch_id", batchID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
179			// Best-effort release so the claimed invoices are not stranded.
180			if relErr := s.repo.releaseInvoices(ctx, batchID); relErr != nil {
181				s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement: release after failed insert",
182					slog.String("batch_id", batchID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", relErr))
183			}
184			return nil, err
185		}
186	
187		refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, min(len(claimed), initiateRefsCap))
188		for i, inv := range claimed {
189			if i >= initiateRefsCap {
190				break
191			}
192			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{EntityType: domain.EntityInvoice, EntityID: inv.ID.Hex(), Relation: "settles"})
193		}
194		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
195			Type:       domain.EventSettlementInitiated,
196			EntityType: domain.EntitySettlement,
197			EntityID:   batch.ID.Hex(),
198			Refs:       refs,
199			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
200			OrgUnitID:  batch.DCSID.Hex(),
201			Payload: map[string]any{
202				"dcs_id":        batch.DCSID.Hex(),
203				"date":          batch.Date,
204				"invoice_count": len(claimed),
205				"total_amount":  batch.TotalAmount,
206			},
207		})
208		if err != nil {
209			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement initiation: ledger append",
210				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
211			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
212		}
213		if err := s.repo.setBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx, batch.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
214			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement initiation: stamp provenance seq",
215				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
216			return nil, err
217		}
218		batch.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
219	
220		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "settlement batch initiated",
221			slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
222			slog.String("dcs_id", batch.DCSID.Hex()),
223			slog.String("date", batch.Date),
224			slog.Int("invoice_count", len(claimed)),
225			slog.Float64("total_amount", batch.TotalAmount),
226			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
227		return batch, nil
228	}
229	
230	// Approve applies the human dual-control sign-off: PENDING_APPROVAL→APPROVED.
231	func (s *service) Approve(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, batchID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.SettlementBatch, error) {
232		actorID, err := actorObjectID(actor)
233		if err != nil {
234			return nil, err
235		}
236		batch, err := s.repo.batchByID(ctx, batchID)
237		if err != nil {
238			return nil, err
239		}
240		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, batch.DCSID); err != nil {
241			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "settlement approval denied: out of scope",
242				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
243				slog.String("dcs_id", batch.DCSID.Hex()),
244				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
245			return nil, err
246		}
247		if err := validateApproval(*batch, actorID); err != nil {
248			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "settlement approval rejected",
249				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
250				slog.String("status", batch.Status),
251				slog.String("initiated_by", batch.InitiatedBy.Hex()),
252				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
253				slog.String("reason", err.Error()))
254			return nil, err
255		}
256	
257		now := time.Now().UTC()
258		ok, err := s.repo.transitionBatch(ctx, batch.ID, domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval, bson.D{
259			{Key: "status", Value: domain.SettlementStatusApproved},
260			{Key: "approved_by", Value: actorID},
261			{Key: "approved_at", Value: now},
262		})
263		if err != nil {
264			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement approval: transition batch",
265				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
266			return nil, err
267		}
268		if !ok {
269			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "settlement approval rejected: batch left PENDING_APPROVAL concurrently",
270				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
271				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
272			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch already left "+domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval)
273		}
274		batch.Status = domain.SettlementStatusApproved
275		batch.ApprovedBy = &actorID
276		batch.ApprovedAt = &now
277	
278		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
279			Type:       domain.EventSettlementApproved,
280			EntityType: domain.EntitySettlement,
281			EntityID:   batch.ID.Hex(),
282			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
283			OrgUnitID:  batch.DCSID.Hex(),
284			Payload: map[string]any{
285				"approved_by":  actor.PartyID,
286				"total_amount": batch.TotalAmount,
287			},
288		})
289		if err != nil {
290			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement approval: ledger append",
291				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
292			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
293		}
294		if err := s.repo.setBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx, batch.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
295			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement approval: stamp provenance seq",
296				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
297			return nil, err
298		}
299		batch.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
300	
301		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "settlement batch approved",
302			slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
303			slog.String("dcs_id", batch.DCSID.Hex()),
304			slog.Float64("total_amount", batch.TotalAmount),
305			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
306		return batch, nil
307	}
308	
309	// Reject declines a pending batch and returns its invoices to ISSUED so they
310	// can be re-settled.
311	func (s *service) Reject(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, batchID primitive.ObjectID, reason string) (*domain.SettlementBatch, error) {
312		actorID, err := actorObjectID(actor)
313		if err != nil {
314			return nil, err
315		}
316		if strings.TrimSpace(reason) == "" {
317			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_FIELD", "reason is required")
318		}
319		batch, err := s.repo.batchByID(ctx, batchID)
320		if err != nil {
321			return nil, err
322		}
323		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, batch.DCSID); err != nil {
324			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "settlement rejection denied: out of scope",
325				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
326				slog.String("dcs_id", batch.DCSID.Hex()),
327				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
328			return nil, err
329		}
330		if batch.Status != domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval {
331			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "settlement rejection refused: invalid status",
332				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
333				slog.String("status", batch.Status),
334				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
335			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch is "+batch.Status+", expected "+domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval)
336		}
337	
338		ok, err := s.repo.transitionBatch(ctx, batch.ID, domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval, bson.D{
339			{Key: "status", Value: domain.SettlementStatusRejected},
340			{Key: "rejected_by", Value: actorID},
341			{Key: "reject_reason", Value: reason},
342		})
343		if err != nil {
344			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement rejection: transition batch",
345				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
346			return nil, err
347		}
348		if !ok {
349			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "settlement rejection refused: batch left PENDING_APPROVAL concurrently",
350				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
351				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
352			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch already left "+domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval)
353		}
354		if err := s.repo.releaseInvoices(ctx, batch.ID); err != nil {
355			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement rejection: release invoices",
356				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
357			return nil, err
358		}
359		batch.Status = domain.SettlementStatusRejected
360		batch.RejectedBy = &actorID
361		batch.RejectReason = reason
362	
363		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "settlement batch rejected",
364			slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
365			slog.String("dcs_id", batch.DCSID.Hex()),
366			slog.String("reason", reason),
367			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
368		return batch, nil
369	}
370	
371	// Execute hands the APPROVED batch to the payment-aggregator adapter and
372	// records the resulting payouts.
373	//
374	// MOCK LICENSED-PA ADAPTER — this is a stand-in for the real integration.
375	// In production (§18-B) execution goes through an RBI-licensed Payment
376	// Aggregator operating a nodal/escrow account: Saathi submits the payout
377	// file, the PA moves the money, and UTRs come back asynchronously via
378	// webhook. Saathi itself never touches funds. The mock credits every payout
379	// instantly with a synthetic UTR so the downstream flow (invoice→PAID,
380	// provenance, farmer SMS) is exercised end to end.
381	func (s *service) Execute(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, batchID primitive.ObjectID) (*SettlementDetail, error) {
382		batch, err := s.repo.batchByID(ctx, batchID)
383		if err != nil {
384			return nil, err
385		}
386		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, batch.DCSID); err != nil {
387			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "settlement execution denied: out of scope",
388				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
389				slog.String("dcs_id", batch.DCSID.Hex()),
390				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
391			return nil, err
392		}
393		if err := validateExecution(*batch); err != nil {
394			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "settlement execution refused: invalid status",
395				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
396				slog.String("status", batch.Status),
397				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
398			return nil, err
399		}
400	
401		// Guarded claim: first run (APPROVED), re-run after FAILED, or resume of
402		// a stale EXECUTING lease. The per-invoice work below is idempotent
403		// (unique payout-per-invoice index + payout reuse), so replays are safe.
404		now := time.Now().UTC()
405		claimed, err := s.repo.claimExecution(ctx, batch.ID, now, now.Add(-executionLease))
406		if err != nil {
407			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement execution: claim",
408				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
409			return nil, err
410		}
411		if !claimed {
412			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "settlement execution refused: live execution lease held elsewhere",
413				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
414				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
415			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch is already being executed")
416		}
417	
418		// From here on, any error must not strand the batch in EXECUTING forever:
419		// flip it to FAILED (best-effort) so a retry can claim FAILED→EXECUTING.
420		failExecution := func(cause error) error {
421			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement execution failed mid-run",
422				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", cause))
423			if ferr := s.repo.markExecutionFailed(ctx, batch.ID, cause.Error()); ferr != nil {
424				s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement: mark execution failed",
425					slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", ferr))
426			}
427			return cause
428		}
429	
430		invoices, err := s.repo.invoicesByBatch(ctx, batch.ID)
431		if err != nil {
432			return nil, failExecution(err)
433		}
434	
435		payouts := make([]domain.PayoutInstruction, 0, len(invoices))
436		for _, inv := range invoices {
437			masked, err := s.repo.latestBankMasked(ctx, inv.FarmerPartyID)
438			if err != nil {
439				return nil, failExecution(err)
440			}
441			creditedAt := now
442			payout := &domain.PayoutInstruction{
443				ID:                primitive.NewObjectID(),
444				SettlementBatchID: batch.ID,
445				InvoiceID:         inv.ID,
446				FarmerPartyID:     inv.FarmerPartyID,
447				Amount:            inv.TotalAmount,
448				BankAccountMasked: masked,
449				UTR:               mockUTR(),
450				Status:            domain.PayoutStatusSuccess,
451				CreditedAt:        &creditedAt,
452				CreatedAt:         now,
453			}
454			exists, err := s.repo.insertPayout(ctx, payout)
455			if err != nil {
456				return nil, failExecution(err)
457			}
458			if exists {
459				// Retry of an interrupted run — reuse the payout already credited.
460				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "settlement execution: payout already credited, reusing (idempotent replay)",
461					slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
462					slog.String("invoice_id", inv.ID.Hex()))
463				existing, err := s.repo.payoutByInvoice(ctx, inv.ID)
464				if err != nil {
465					return nil, failExecution(err)
466				}
467				payout = existing
468			}
469			payouts = append(payouts, *payout)
470		}
471	
472		if err := s.repo.markInvoicesPaid(ctx, batch.ID); err != nil {
473			return nil, failExecution(err)
474		}
475	
476		paRef := mockPARef()
477		ok, err := s.repo.transitionBatch(ctx, batch.ID, domain.SettlementStatusExecuting, bson.D{
478			{Key: "status", Value: domain.SettlementStatusExecuted},
479			{Key: "pa_ref", Value: paRef},
480			{Key: "executed_at", Value: now},
481		})
482		if err != nil {
483			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement execution: transition to EXECUTED",
484				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
485			return nil, err
486		}
487		if !ok {
488			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "settlement execution: batch left EXECUTING unexpectedly",
489				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()))
490			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch left EXECUTING unexpectedly")
491		}
492		batch.Status = domain.SettlementStatusExecuted
493		batch.PARef = paRef
494		batch.ExecutedAt = &now
495	
496		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
497			Type:       domain.EventSettlementExecuted,
498			EntityType: domain.EntitySettlement,
499			EntityID:   batch.ID.Hex(),
500			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
501			OrgUnitID:  batch.DCSID.Hex(),
502			Payload: map[string]any{
503				"pa_ref":       paRef,
504				"payout_count": len(payouts),
505				"total_amount": batch.TotalAmount,
506			},
507		})
508		if err != nil {
509			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement execution: ledger append",
510				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
511			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
512		}
513		if err := s.repo.setBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx, batch.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
514			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement execution: stamp provenance seq",
515				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
516			return nil, err
517		}
518		batch.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
519	
520		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "settlement batch executed",
521			slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
522			slog.String("dcs_id", batch.DCSID.Hex()),
523			slog.String("pa_ref", paRef),
524			slog.Int("payout_count", len(payouts)),
525			slog.Float64("total_amount", batch.TotalAmount),
526			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
527	
528		// One payout.credited ledger event per invoice, then the SMS fan-out.
529		// Per-payout ledger/lookup failures are logged, not fatal: the money
530		// outcome is already anchored by settlement.executed above.
531		for _, p := range payouts {
532			if _, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
533				Type:       domain.EventPayoutCredited,
534				EntityType: domain.EntityInvoice,
535				EntityID:   p.InvoiceID.Hex(),
536				Refs: []provenance.Ref{
537					{EntityType: domain.EntitySettlement, EntityID: batch.ID.Hex(), Relation: "paid_by"},
538				},
539				Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
540				OrgUnitID: batch.DCSID.Hex(),
541				Payload:   map[string]any{"utr": p.UTR, "amount": p.Amount},
542			}); err != nil {
543				s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement: payout.credited ledger append",
544					slog.String("invoice_id", p.InvoiceID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
545			}
546	
547			phone, err := s.repo.partyPhone(ctx, p.FarmerPartyID)
548			if err != nil {
549				s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement: farmer phone lookup for payout SMS",
550					slog.String("farmer_party_id", p.FarmerPartyID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
551				continue
552			}
553			s.bus.Publish(eventbus.TopicPayoutCredited, PayoutCreditedEvent{
554				FarmerPartyID: p.FarmerPartyID.Hex(),
555				Phone:         phone,
556				Amount:        p.Amount,
557				UTR:           p.UTR,
558			})
559		}
560	
561		return &SettlementDetail{Batch: *batch, Payouts: payouts}, nil
562	}
563	
564	// List pages settlement batches. Callers with a DCS-scoped token default to
565	// their own DCS; wider roles must name a dcs_id (SUPER_ADMIN and
566	// STATE_AUDITOR may list unscoped).
567	func (s *service) List(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, dcsID, date, status string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.SettlementBatch, int64, error) {
568		if dcsID == "" {
569			switch {
570			case actor.OrgType == domain.OrgTypeDCS:
571				dcsID = actor.OrgUnitID
572			case actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSuperAdmin || actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleStateAuditor:
573				// federation-wide read roles may list across DCSes
574			default:

576			}
577		}
578		filter := bson.D{}

588				return nil, 0, err
589			}
590			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "dcs_id", Value: dcsOID})

592		if date != "" {

621	// PayoutHistory pages payout instructions for one farmer, newest first.
622	// A FARMER token is always forced to its own party — "my payment history".
623	// Staff roles are bound to their org scope: the target farmer must hold an
624	// ACTIVE FARMER assignment at a DCS inside the caller's scope, so a village
625	// Sacheev cannot enumerate the financials of farmers nationwide.
626	func (s *service) PayoutHistory(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, farmerPartyID string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.PayoutInstruction, int64, error) {
627		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleFarmer {
628			farmerPartyID = actor.PartyID
629		}
630		if farmerPartyID == "" {
631			return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_FIELD", "farmer_party_id is required")
632		}
633		farmerOID, err := httpx.ParseID(farmerPartyID, "farmer_party_id")
634		if err != nil {
635			return nil, 0, err
636		}
637		if actor.RoleCode != domain.RoleFarmer &&
638			actor.RoleCode != domain.RoleSuperAdmin && actor.RoleCode != domain.RoleStateAuditor {
639			dcsIDs, err := s.repo.farmerDCSIDs(ctx, farmerOID)
640			if err != nil {
641				return nil, 0, err
642			}
643			inScope := false
644			for _, dcsID := range dcsIDs {
645				if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, dcsID); err == nil {
646					inScope = true
647					break
648				}
649			}
650			if !inScope {
651				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "payout history denied: farmer out of scope",
652					slog.String("farmer_party_id", farmerOID.Hex()),
653					slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
654				return nil, 0, httpx.Forbidden("farmer is outside your organisational scope")
655			}
656		}
657		return s.repo.payoutsByFarmer(ctx, farmerOID, page)

660	// ---- DBT subsidy rail (§13) — strictly separate from milk payments ----
661	
662	// CreateDBT submits a scheme subsidy request to the (mocked) PFMS rail.
663	// Saathi only tracks the request; the subsidy is disbursed by PFMS/DBT,
664	// never by Saathi and never through the milk-payment rail.
665	func (s *service) CreateDBT(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, in CreateDBTRequestInput) (*domain.DBTRequest, error) {
666		actorID, err := actorObjectID(actor)
667		if err != nil {
668			return nil, err
669		}
670		if in.SchemeCode == "" || in.FarmerPartyID.IsZero() {
671			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_FIELD", "scheme_code and farmer_party_id are required")
672		}
673		if in.Amount <= 0 {
674			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_AMOUNT", "amount must be positive")
675		}
676		if _, err := s.repo.partyPhone(ctx, in.FarmerPartyID); err != nil {
677			return nil, err // farmer must exist
678		}
679	
680		// MOCK PFMS — real integration files the beneficiary+amount with PFMS
681		// and receives an acknowledgement reference (§13).
682		req := &domain.DBTRequest{
683			ID:            primitive.NewObjectID(),
684			SchemeCode:    in.SchemeCode,
685			FarmerPartyID: in.FarmerPartyID,
686			Amount:        in.Amount,
687			PFMSRef:       mockPFMSRef(),
688			Status:        domain.DBTStatusSubmitted,
689			SubmittedBy:   actorID,
690			CreatedAt:     time.Now().UTC(),
691		}
692		if err := s.repo.insertDBT(ctx, req); err != nil {
693			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "dbt request insert",
694				slog.String("farmer_party_id", in.FarmerPartyID.Hex()),
695				slog.String("scheme_code", in.SchemeCode), slog.Any("err", err))
696			return nil, err
697		}
698	
699		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "dbt request submitted",
700			slog.String("dbt_request_id", req.ID.Hex()),
701			slog.String("scheme_code", req.SchemeCode),
702			slog.String("farmer_party_id", req.FarmerPartyID.Hex()),
703			slog.Float64("amount", req.Amount),
704			slog.String("pfms_ref", req.PFMSRef),
705			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
706		return req, nil
707	}
708	
709	// UpdateDBTStatus records the DBT rail's progress for a request. CREDITED
710	// stamps credited_at; CREDITED/REJECTED are terminal.
711	func (s *service) UpdateDBTStatus(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID, status string) (*domain.DBTRequest, error) {
712		switch status {
713		case domain.DBTStatusAccepted, domain.DBTStatusCredited, domain.DBTStatusRejected:
714		default:
715			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_STATUS", "status must be one of ACCEPTED, CREDITED, REJECTED")
716		}
717		req, err := s.repo.dbtByID(ctx, id)
718		if err != nil {
719			return nil, err
720		}
721		if req.Status == domain.DBTStatusCredited || req.Status == domain.DBTStatusRejected {
722			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "dbt status update refused: terminal status",
723				slog.String("dbt_request_id", req.ID.Hex()),
724				slog.String("status", req.Status),
725				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
726			return nil, httpx.Conflict("TERMINAL_STATUS", "dbt request is already "+req.Status)
727		}
728	
729		var creditedAt *time.Time
730		if status == domain.DBTStatusCredited {
731			now := time.Now().UTC()
732			creditedAt = &now
733		}
734		ok, err := s.repo.transitionDBT(ctx, req.ID, req.Status, status, creditedAt)
735		if err != nil {
736			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "dbt status transition",
737				slog.String("dbt_request_id", req.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
738			return nil, err
739		}
740		if !ok {
741			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "dbt status update refused: concurrent change",
742				slog.String("dbt_request_id", req.ID.Hex()),
743				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
744			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "dbt request changed concurrently, retry")
745		}
746		fromStatus := req.Status
747		req.Status = status
748		req.CreditedAt = creditedAt
749	
750		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "dbt request status updated",
751			slog.String("dbt_request_id", req.ID.Hex()),
752			slog.String("from_status", fromStatus),
753			slog.String("to_status", status),
754			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
755		return req, nil
756	}

1	package auth

3	import (
4		"context"

8	// Actor is the authenticated caller extracted from a verified token and
9	// stored on the request context by the auth middleware.
10	type Actor struct {
11		PartyID          string
12		Phone            string
13		KYCTier          string
14		Kind             string // session | role
15		RoleAssignmentID string
16		RoleCode         string
17		OrgUnitID        string
18		OrgType          string
19	}
20	
21	// HasRole reports whether the actor operates under one of the given roles.
22	func (a Actor) HasRole(roles ...string) bool {
23		for _, r := range roles {
24			if a.RoleCode == r {
25				return true
26			}
27		}
28		return false
29	}
30	
31	type actorCtxKey struct{}
32	
33	// actorHolder is a mutable cell installed by OUTER middleware (audit) so
34	// identity established by INNER middleware (Authenticate) can flow back out.
35	// Context values only propagate inward; the shared pointer bridges the gap.
36	type actorHolder struct {
37		mu sync.Mutex
38		a  *Actor
39	}
40	
41	type actorHolderCtxKey struct{}
42	
43	// WithActorHolder installs an empty actor holder on the context. Middleware
44	// mounted before authentication uses it to observe the actor after the
45	// handler chain ran.
46	func WithActorHolder(ctx context.Context) context.Context {
47		return context.WithValue(ctx, actorHolderCtxKey{}, &actorHolder{})
48	}
49	
50	// HeldActor returns the actor captured by an inner WithActor call, if a
51	// holder was installed and authentication happened.
52	func HeldActor(ctx context.Context) (Actor, bool) {
53		h, ok := ctx.Value(actorHolderCtxKey{}).(*actorHolder)
54		if !ok {
55			return Actor{}, false
56		}
57		h.mu.Lock()
58		defer h.mu.Unlock()
59		if h.a == nil {
60			return Actor{}, false
61		}
62		return *h.a, true
63	}
64	
65	// WithActor stores the actor on the context, and also fills the outward
66	// actor holder when one was installed upstream (see WithActorHolder).
67	func WithActor(ctx context.Context, a Actor) context.Context {
68		if h, ok := ctx.Value(actorHolderCtxKey{}).(*actorHolder); ok {
69			h.mu.Lock()
70			cp := a
71			h.a = &cp
72			h.mu.Unlock()
73		}
74		return context.WithValue(ctx, actorCtxKey{}, a)
75	}
76	
77	// ActorFrom retrieves the actor, if any.
78	func ActorFrom(ctx context.Context) (Actor, bool) {
79		a, ok := ctx.Value(actorCtxKey{}).(Actor)

59	// granterMayGrant reports whether granterRole may grant (or revoke)
60	// roleCode. Admin granters pass unconditionally.
61	func granterMayGrant(granterRole, roleCode string) bool {
62		if granterRole == domain.RoleSuperAdmin || granterRole == domain.RolePCDFAdmin {
63			return true
64		}
65		allowed, ok := grantableRoles[granterRole]
66		return ok && allowed[roleCode]
67	}

106	// --- Auth: OTP login ---
107	
108	// requestOTP creates a hashed OTP challenge and queues the SMS through the
109	// notification outbox (the platformops worker delivers it).
110	func (s *service) requestOTP(ctx context.Context, phone string) (*otpRequestResponse, error) {
111		now := time.Now().UTC()
112		code, err := auth.GenerateNumericOTP(otpLength)
113		if err != nil {
114			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
115		}
116	
117		challenge := otpChallenge{
118			ID:        uuid.NewString(),
119			Phone:     phone,
120			CodeHash:  auth.HMACHash(s.deps.Cfg.OTPHashSecret, phone, code),
121			ExpiresAt: now.Add(s.deps.Cfg.OTPTTL),
122			Attempts:  0,
123		}
124		if err := s.repo.insertOTPChallenge(ctx, challenge); err != nil {
125			return nil, err
126		}
127	
128		// Outbox SMS: the plaintext code travels only inside the notification
129		// params so the sender can deliver it; the challenge stores the hash.
130		notification := domain.Notification{
131			ID:          uuid.NewString(),
132			Phone:       phone,
133			Channel:     domain.ChannelSMS,
134			TemplateKey: domain.TemplateOTP,
135			Language:    defaultLanguage,
136			Params:      map[string]string{"otp": code},
137			Status:      domain.NotificationQueued,
138			QueuedAt:    now,
139		}
140		if party, err := s.repo.findPartyByPhone(ctx, phone); err == nil {
141			notification.PartyID = party.ID
142			if party.PreferredLanguage != "" {
143				notification.Language = party.PreferredLanguage
144			}
145		}
146		if err := s.repo.insertNotification(ctx, notification); err != nil {
147			return nil, err
148		}
149	
150		resp := &otpRequestResponse{Phone: phone, ExpiresAt: challenge.ExpiresAt}
151		if s.deps.Cfg.OTPDevMode {
152			resp.DevOTP = code // dev only — config refuses OTP_DEV_MODE in prod
153		}
154		return resp, nil
155	}
156	
157	// verifyOTP checks the challenge and logs the phone in, creating the Party
158	// on first login (find-or-create, §4.1).
159	func (s *service) verifyOTP(ctx context.Context, phone, otp string) (*authTokensResponse, error) {
160		now := time.Now().UTC()
161	
162		challenge, err := s.repo.latestOTPChallenge(ctx, phone, now)
163		if err != nil {
164			if isNotFound(err) {
165				return nil, httpx.Unauthorized("no active OTP for this phone — request a new code")
166			}
167			return nil, err
168		}
169		if challenge.Attempts >= maxOTPAttempts {
170			return nil, httpx.TooManyRequests("too many incorrect OTP attempts — request a new code")
171		}
172		expected := auth.HMACHash(s.deps.Cfg.OTPHashSecret, phone, otp)
173		if !auth.ConstantTimeEqual(challenge.CodeHash, expected) {
174			if err := s.repo.incrementOTPAttempts(ctx, challenge.ID); err != nil {
175				return nil, err
176			}
177			return nil, httpx.Unauthorized("incorrect OTP")
178		}
179	
180		// Burn every outstanding challenge for this phone.
181		if err := s.repo.deleteOTPChallenges(ctx, phone); err != nil {
182			return nil, err
183		}
184	
185		party, err := s.repo.upsertPartyByPhone(ctx, phone, now)
186		if err != nil {
187			return nil, err
188		}
189		if party.Status != domain.PartyStatusActive {
190			return nil, httpx.Forbidden("party is suspended")
191		}
192		return s.issueLoginTokens(ctx, party, now)
193	}
194	
195	// issueLoginTokens mints a SESSION access token plus a fresh rotating
196	// refresh token (stored only as an HMAC digest).
197	func (s *service) issueLoginTokens(ctx context.Context, party *domain.Party, now time.Time) (*authTokensResponse, error) {
198		refreshToken, err := auth.RandomToken(32)
199		if err != nil {
200			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
201		}
202		doc := refreshTokenDoc{
203			ID:        uuid.NewString(),
204			TokenHash: auth.HMACHash(s.deps.Cfg.OTPHashSecret, refreshHashLabel, refreshToken),
205			PartyID:   party.ID,
206			ExpiresAt: now.Add(s.deps.Cfg.RefreshTokenTTL),
207			CreatedAt: now,
208		}
209		if err := s.repo.insertRefreshToken(ctx, doc); err != nil {
210			return nil, err
211		}
212		accessToken, err := s.deps.JWT.IssueSessionToken(*party)
213		if err != nil {
214			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
215		}
216		return &authTokensResponse{
217			AccessToken:  accessToken,
218			RefreshToken: refreshToken,
219			Party:        party,
220		}, nil
221	}
222	
223	// refresh rotates a refresh token: the old token is consumed atomically and
224	// a new pair is issued — a replayed token always fails.
225	func (s *service) refresh(ctx context.Context, refreshToken string) (*authTokensResponse, error) {
226		now := time.Now().UTC()
227		tokenHash := auth.HMACHash(s.deps.Cfg.OTPHashSecret, refreshHashLabel, refreshToken)
228	
229		doc, err := s.repo.findRefreshToken(ctx, tokenHash)
230		if err != nil {
231			if isNotFound(err) {
232				return nil, httpx.Unauthorized("invalid refresh token")
233			}
234			return nil, err
235		}
236		if !now.Before(doc.ExpiresAt) {
237			_, _ = s.repo.deleteRefreshToken(ctx, tokenHash)
238			return nil, httpx.Unauthorized("refresh token expired — log in again")
239		}
240	
241		// ROTATE: consume the old token first; DeletedCount==0 means a parallel
242		// request won the race, so this presentation is treated as a replay.
243		deleted, err := s.repo.deleteRefreshToken(ctx, tokenHash)
244		if err != nil {
245			return nil, err
246		}
247		if deleted == 0 {
248			return nil, httpx.Unauthorized("refresh token already used")
249		}
250	
251		party, err := s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, doc.PartyID)
252		if err != nil {
253			if isNotFound(err) {
254				return nil, httpx.Unauthorized("party no longer exists")
255			}
256			return nil, err
257		}
258		if party.Status != domain.PartyStatusActive {
259			return nil, httpx.Forbidden("party is suspended")
260		}
261		return s.issueLoginTokens(ctx, party, now)
262	}
263	
264	// logout revokes one refresh token belonging to the caller. Idempotent.
265	func (s *service) logout(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, refreshToken string) error {
266		tokenHash := auth.HMACHash(s.deps.Cfg.OTPHashSecret, refreshHashLabel, refreshToken)
267		return s.repo.deleteRefreshTokenForParty(ctx, tokenHash, actor.PartyID)
268	}

302	// selectRole exchanges the session for a ROLE-kind token pinned to one
303	// usable assignment, gated on the role's minimum KYC tier (§5.2).
304	func (s *service) selectRole(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, assignmentID string) (*roleSelectResponse, error) {
305		assignment, err := s.repo.findAssignmentByID(ctx, assignmentID)
306		if err != nil {
307			return nil, err
308		}
309		if assignment.PartyID != actor.PartyID {
310			// Same shape as an unknown ID — never confirm other parties' grants.
311			return nil, httpx.NotFound("role assignment")
312		}
313		now := time.Now().UTC()
314		if !assignment.UsableAt(now) {
315			return nil, httpx.Forbidden("role assignment is revoked or outside its validity window")
316		}
317	
318		// Re-read the party: the KYC tier may have upgraded since the session
319		// token was minted.
320		party, err := s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, actor.PartyID)
321		if err != nil {
322			return nil, err
323		}
324		if party.Status != domain.PartyStatusActive {
325			return nil, httpx.Forbidden("party is suspended")
326		}
327		requiredTier := domain.RequiredKYCTier[assignment.RoleCode]
328		if !domain.KYCTierSatisfies(party.KYCTier, requiredTier) {
329			appErr := httpx.Forbidden("your KYC tier does not permit this role — complete verification first").
330				WithDetails(map[string]string{
331					"current_tier":  party.KYCTier,
332					"required_tier": requiredTier,
333				})
334			appErr.Code = "KYC_TIER_INSUFFICIENT"
335			return nil, appErr
336		}
337	
338		org, err := s.deps.Orgs.Get(ctx, assignment.OrgUnitID)
339		if err != nil {
340			return nil, err
341		}
342		accessToken, err := s.deps.JWT.IssueRoleToken(*party, *assignment, org.Type)
343		if err != nil {
344			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
345		}
346		return &roleSelectResponse{
347			AccessToken: accessToken,
348			RoleCode:    assignment.RoleCode,
349			OrgUnitID:   assignment.OrgUnitID,
350			OrgType:     org.Type,
351		}, nil
352	}

389	// --- KYC (mock DPI adapters — real UIDAI / penny-drop integration later) ---
390	
391	// verifyAadhaar runs the MOCK Aadhaar eKYC flow (§18-A). The full Aadhaar
392	// number exists only in this request's memory: what is persisted is the
393	// last 4 digits plus an opaque reference from the (mock) Aadhaar Data Vault.
394	func (s *service) verifyAadhaar(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req aadhaarKYCRequest) (*aadhaarKYCResponse, error) {
395		now := time.Now().UTC()
396		party, err := s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, actor.PartyID)
397		if err != nil {
398			return nil, err
399		}
400	
401		language := party.PreferredLanguage
402		if language == "" {
403			language = defaultLanguage
404		}
405		consent := domain.Consent{
406			ID:          uuid.NewString(),
407			PartyID:     party.ID,
408			Purpose:     consentPurposeAadhaarEKYC,
409			TextVersion: consentTextVersion,
410			Language:    language,
411			GrantedAt:   now,
412		}
413		if err := s.repo.insertConsent(ctx, consent); err != nil {
414			return nil, err
415		}
416	
417		// MOCK Aadhaar Data Vault (§18-A): a real deployment sends the number to
418		// the vault service and receives an opaque token. The mock mints a UUID.
419		vaultRef := uuid.NewString()
420		last4 := req.AadhaarNumber[len(req.AadhaarNumber)-4:]
421	
422		// MOCK UIDAI eKYC: always succeeds. The real adapter drives the OTP-based
423		// eKYC exchange and may return PENDING/REJECTED.
424		record := domain.KYCRecord{
425			ID:              uuid.NewString(),
426			PartyID:         party.ID,
427			Tier:            req.RequestedTier,
428			AadhaarLast4:    last4,
429			AadhaarVaultRef: vaultRef,
430			ConsentID:       consent.ID,
431			Status:          domain.KYCStatusVerified,
432			VerifiedAt:      &now,
433			CreatedAt:       now,
434			UpdatedAt:       now,
435		}
436		if err := s.repo.insertKYCRecord(ctx, record); err != nil {
437			return nil, err
438		}
439	
440		newTier := upgradedKYCTier(party.KYCTier, req.RequestedTier)
441		if newTier != party.KYCTier {
442			if err := s.repo.updatePartyKYCTier(ctx, party.ID, newTier, now); err != nil {
443				return nil, err
444			}
445		}
446		return &aadhaarKYCResponse{Record: &record, KYCTier: newTier}, nil
447	}

449	// verifyBank runs the MOCK penny-drop verification and stores ONLY the
450	// masked account tail and IFSC on the caller's latest KYC record (creating
451	// one when none exists yet).
452	func (s *service) verifyBank(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req bankKYCRequest) (*domain.KYCRecord, error) {
453		now := time.Now().UTC()
454		party, err := s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, actor.PartyID)
455		if err != nil {
456			return nil, err
457		}
458		masked := maskAccount(req.AccountNumber)
459	
460		latest, err := s.repo.latestKYCRecord(ctx, actor.PartyID)
461		switch {
462		case err == nil:
463			// MOCK penny-drop: always verified with a fixed name-match score.
464			return s.repo.updateKYCRecordBank(ctx, latest.ID, masked, req.IFSC, mockPennyDropNameMatch, now)
465		case isNotFound(err):
466			record := domain.KYCRecord{
467				ID:                uuid.NewString(),
468				PartyID:           party.ID,
469				Tier:              party.KYCTier,
470				BankAccountMasked: masked,
471				BankIFSC:          req.IFSC,
472				BankVerified:      true, // MOCK penny-drop: always succeeds
473				BankNameMatch:     mockPennyDropNameMatch,
474				Status:            domain.KYCStatusVerified,
475				VerifiedAt:        &now,
476				CreatedAt:         now,
477				UpdatedAt:         now,
478			}
479			if err := s.repo.insertKYCRecord(ctx, record); err != nil {
480				return nil, err
481			}
482			return &record, nil
483		default:
484			return nil, err
485		}
486	}

496	// requireGrantAuthority enforces the non-admin granter matrix (§5.2):
497	// UNION_PRESIDENT manages village/logistics/union-tier roles anywhere in
498	// scope; SAMITI_ADHYAKSH manages only FARMER/MILK_TESTER/LRP inside their
499	// own DCS. Admin granters pass.
500	func (s *service) requireGrantAuthority(actor auth.Actor, roleCode, orgUnitID string) error {
501		if !granterMayGrant(actor.RoleCode, roleCode) {
502			return httpx.Forbidden("role " + actor.RoleCode + " may not grant or revoke " + roleCode)
503		}
504		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSamitiAdhyaksh && orgUnitID != actor.OrgUnitID {
505			return httpx.Forbidden("SAMITI_ADHYAKSH may manage roles only within their own DCS")
506		}
507		return nil
508	}

510	// createAssignment grants a role to a party inside an org unit.
511	func (s *service) createAssignment(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req createAssignmentRequest) (*domain.RoleAssignment, error) {
512		// Resolve the target party (party_id wins over phone).
513		var party *domain.Party
514		var err error
515		if req.PartyID != "" {
516			party, err = s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, req.PartyID)
517		} else {
518			party, err = s.repo.findPartyByPhone(ctx, req.Phone)
519		}
520		if err != nil {
521			return nil, err
522		}
523	
524		if err := s.deps.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.OrgUnitID); err != nil {
525			return nil, err
526		}
527		if err := s.requireGrantAuthority(actor, req.RoleCode, req.OrgUnitID); err != nil {
528			return nil, err
529		}
530	
531		exists, err := s.repo.activeAssignmentExists(ctx, party.ID, req.RoleCode, req.OrgUnitID)
532		if err != nil {
533			return nil, err
534		}
535		if exists {
536			return nil, httpx.Conflict("ASSIGNMENT_EXISTS", "party already holds an active "+req.RoleCode+" assignment in this org unit")
537		}
538	
539		now := time.Now().UTC()
540		validFrom := now
541		if req.ValidFrom != nil {
542			validFrom = req.ValidFrom.UTC()
543		}
544		var validTo *time.Time
545		if req.ValidTo != nil {
546			t := req.ValidTo.UTC()
547			validTo = &t
548		}
549		assignment := domain.RoleAssignment{
550			ID:        uuid.NewString(),
551			PartyID:   party.ID,
552			RoleCode:  req.RoleCode,
553			OrgUnitID: req.OrgUnitID,
554			GrantedBy: actor.PartyID,
555			ValidFrom: validFrom,
556			ValidTo:   validTo,
557			Status:    domain.RoleAssignmentActive,
558			CreatedAt: now,
559		}
560		if err := s.repo.insertAssignment(ctx, assignment); err != nil {
561			return nil, err
562		}
563		return &assignment, nil
564	}
565	
566	// revokeAssignment flips an assignment to REVOKED — the record is never
567	// deleted (§4.1). Revocation authority mirrors grant authority.
568	func (s *service) revokeAssignment(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, assignmentID string) (*domain.RoleAssignment, error) {
569		assignment, err := s.repo.findAssignmentByID(ctx, assignmentID)
570		if err != nil {
571			return nil, err
572		}
573		if err := s.deps.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, assignment.OrgUnitID); err != nil {
574			return nil, err
575		}
576		if err := s.requireGrantAuthority(actor, assignment.RoleCode, assignment.OrgUnitID); err != nil {
577			return nil, err
578		}
579		if assignment.Status != domain.RoleAssignmentActive {
580			return nil, httpx.Conflict("ALREADY_REVOKED", "role assignment is already revoked")
581		}
582		return s.repo.revokeAssignment(ctx, assignmentID, actor.PartyID, time.Now().UTC())
583	}
584	
585	// listAssignments pages assignments inside one org unit the actor can see.
586	func (s *service) listAssignments(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, orgUnitID, roleCode string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.RoleAssignment, int64, error) {
587		if err := s.deps.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, orgUnitID); err != nil {
588			return nil, 0, err
589		}
590		return s.repo.listAssignments(ctx, orgUnitID, roleCode, page)
591	}

173	// race-safe under the unique phone index (one phone = one Party, §4.1).

175		update := bson.D{{Key: "$setOnInsert", Value: bson.D{
176			{Key: "_id", Value: primitive.NewObjectID()},
177			{Key: "phone", Value: phone},

180			{Key: "created_at", Value: now},

183		opts := options.FindOneAndUpdate().SetUpsert(true).SetReturnDocument(options.After)
184		var p domain.Party

186			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("upsert party by phone: %w", err))

459	// approveKYCRecord flips a PENDING record to VERIFIED with the reviewer
460	// stamp. Matching on status makes concurrent reviews lose cleanly (the loser
461	// sees NotFound and the service translates it to a 409).
462	func (r *repository) approveKYCRecord(ctx context.Context, id, reviewedBy primitive.ObjectID, reviewerRole string, now time.Time) (*domain.KYCRecord, error) {
463		filter := bson.D{
464			{Key: "_id", Value: id},
465			{Key: "status", Value: domain.KYCStatusPending},
466		}
467		update := bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
468			{Key: "status", Value: domain.KYCStatusVerified},
469			{Key: "reviewed_by", Value: reviewedBy},
470			{Key: "reviewed_by_role", Value: reviewerRole},
471			{Key: "reviewed_at", Value: now},
472			{Key: "verified_at", Value: now},
473			{Key: "updated_at", Value: now},
474		}}}
475		opts := options.FindOneAndUpdate().SetReturnDocument(options.After)
476		var rec domain.KYCRecord
477		err := r.kycRecords.FindOneAndUpdate(ctx, filter, update, opts).Decode(&rec)
478		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
479			return nil, httpx.NotFound("pending kyc record")
480		}
481		if err != nil {
482			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("approve kyc record: %w", err))
483		}
484		return &rec, nil
485	}
486	
487	// rejectKYCRecord flips a PENDING record to REJECTED with the reviewer stamp
488	// and reason. Same concurrency semantics as approveKYCRecord.
489	func (r *repository) rejectKYCRecord(ctx context.Context, id, reviewedBy primitive.ObjectID, reviewerRole, reason string, now time.Time) (*domain.KYCRecord, error) {
490		filter := bson.D{
491			{Key: "_id", Value: id},
492			{Key: "status", Value: domain.KYCStatusPending},
493		}
494		update := bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
495			{Key: "status", Value: domain.KYCStatusRejected},
496			{Key: "rejection_reason", Value: reason},
497			{Key: "reviewed_by", Value: reviewedBy},
498			{Key: "reviewed_by_role", Value: reviewerRole},
499			{Key: "reviewed_at", Value: now},
500			{Key: "updated_at", Value: now},
501		}}}
502		opts := options.FindOneAndUpdate().SetReturnDocument(options.After)
503		var rec domain.KYCRecord
504		err := r.kycRecords.FindOneAndUpdate(ctx, filter, update, opts).Decode(&rec)
505		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
506			return nil, httpx.NotFound("pending kyc record")
507		}
508		if err != nil {
509			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("reject kyc record: %w", err))
510		}
511		return &rec, nil
512	}
513	
514	// updateKYCRecordBank sets the (masked) bank verification fields on an
515	// existing KYC record and returns the updated record.
516	func (r *repository) updateKYCRecordBank(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID, accountMasked, ifsc string, nameMatch float64, now time.Time) (*domain.KYCRecord, error) {
517		update := bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
518			{Key: "bank_account_masked", Value: accountMasked},
519			{Key: "bank_ifsc", Value: ifsc},
520			{Key: "bank_verified", Value: true},
521			{Key: "bank_name_match", Value: nameMatch},
522			{Key: "updated_at", Value: now},
523		}}}
524		opts := options.FindOneAndUpdate().SetReturnDocument(options.After)
525		var rec domain.KYCRecord
526		err := r.kycRecords.FindOneAndUpdate(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}, update, opts).Decode(&rec)
527		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
528			return nil, httpx.NotFound("kyc record")
529		}
530		if err != nil {
531			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("update kyc record bank: %w", err))
532		}
533		return &rec, nil
534	}
535	
536	// listKYCRecords pages the party's KYC records, newest first.
537	func (r *repository) listKYCRecords(ctx context.Context, partyID primitive.ObjectID, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.KYCRecord, int64, error) {
538		filter := bson.D{{Key: "party_id", Value: partyID}}
539		total, err := r.kycRecords.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
540		if err != nil {
541			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("count kyc records: %w", err))
542		}
543		opts := options.Find().
544			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "created_at", Value: -1}}).
545			SetSkip(page.Offset).
546			SetLimit(page.Limit)
547		cur, err := r.kycRecords.Find(ctx, filter, opts)
548		if err != nil {
549			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("list kyc records: %w", err))
550		}
551		out := make([]domain.KYCRecord, 0)
552		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
553			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("decode kyc records: %w", err))
554		}
555		return out, total, nil
556	}
557	
558	// insertConsent stores a DPDP consent artefact.
559	func (r *repository) insertConsent(ctx context.Context, c domain.Consent) error {
560		if _, err := r.consents.InsertOne(ctx, c); err != nil {
561			return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("insert consent: %w", err))
562		}
563		return nil
564	}

29	// RateChart prices milk from fat/SNF, scoped to an org unit (union or
30	// federation). rate/L = BaseRatePerLitre + Fat%*FatRatePerPoint + SNF%*SNFRatePerPoint.
31	type RateChart struct {
32		ID               primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
33		OrgUnitID        primitive.ObjectID `bson:"org_unit_id"   json:"org_unit_id"`

44	// PricePour computes (ratePerLitre, amount) for a pour, rounded to paise.
45	func (rc RateChart) PricePour(fatPct, snfPct, qtyLitres float64) (rate, amount float64) {
46		rate = rc.BaseRatePerLitre + fatPct*rc.FatRatePerPoint + snfPct*rc.SNFRatePerPoint
47		rate = math.Round(rate*100) / 100
48		amount = math.Round(rate*qtyLitres*100) / 100
49		return rate, amount
50	}

94	// CheckPlausibility validates fat/SNF/qty against physical bounds and returns
95	// the violated flags (empty slice = plausible).
96	func CheckPlausibility(fatPct, snfPct, qtyLitres float64) []string {
97		var flags []string
98		if fatPct < PlausibleFatMin || fatPct > PlausibleFatMax ||
99			snfPct < PlausibleSNFMin || snfPct > PlausibleSNFMax {
100			flags = append(flags, IntegrityFlagImplausibleValue)
101		}
102		if qtyLitres != 0 && (qtyLitres < PlausibleQtyMin || qtyLitres > PlausibleQtyMax) {
103			flags = append(flags, IntegrityFlagImplausibleValue)
104		}
105		return flags
106	}

176	// DateKeyIST formats t as the YYYY-MM-DD settlement-day key in IST.

10	// TestPricePourRounding verifies paise rounding of both the per-litre rate
11	// and the pour amount (blueprint §8.1 — receipts must match to the paisa).
12	func TestPricePourRounding(t *testing.T) {

16			fat, snf   float64
17			qty        float64
18			wantRate   float64
19			wantAmount float64

23				chart: domain.RateChart{BaseRatePerLitre: 10, FatRatePerPoint: 1, SNFRatePerPoint: 0},
24				fat:   4.556, snf: 0, qty: 1,
25				wantRate: 14.56, wantAmount: 14.56,
26			},
27			{
28				name:  "rate rounds down to previous paisa",
29				chart: domain.RateChart{BaseRatePerLitre: 10, FatRatePerPoint: 1, SNFRatePerPoint: 0},
30				fat:   4.554, snf: 0, qty: 1,
31				wantRate: 14.55, wantAmount: 14.55,
32			},
33			{
34				name:  "amount rounds after multiplying exact rate by fractional quantity",
35				chart: domain.RateChart{BaseRatePerLitre: 20, FatRatePerPoint: 5, SNFRatePerPoint: 3},
36				fat:   6.5, snf: 8.5, qty: 10.333,
37				wantRate: 78.00, wantAmount: 805.97,
38			},

40				name:  "blueprint receipt example: 10.5L at 42.30 = 444.15",

42				fat:   3.5, snf: 7.3, qty: 10.5,
43				wantRate: 42.30, wantAmount: 444.15,

48				fat:   4.556, snf: 0, qty: 100,

140				wantFlags: []string{domain.IntegrityFlagMissingGeotag},
141			},
142			{
143				name: "device clock behind by more than 10 minutes flagged",
144				mode: domain.ReadingModeDirect, hasGeo: true,
145				deviceTS:  now.Add(-11 * time.Minute),
146				wantFlags: []string{domain.IntegrityFlagClockSkew},
147			},
148			{
149				name: "device clock ahead by more than 10 minutes flagged",
150				mode: domain.ReadingModeDirect, hasGeo: true,
151				deviceTS:  now.Add(11 * time.Minute),
152				wantFlags: []string{domain.IntegrityFlagClockSkew},
153			},
154			{
155				name: "skew of exactly 10 minutes not flagged",
156				mode: domain.ReadingModeDirect, hasGeo: true,
157				deviceTS:  now.Add(-10 * time.Minute),
158				wantFlags: nil,
159			},
160			{
161				name: "absent device timestamp skips the skew check",
162				mode: domain.ReadingModeDirect, hasGeo: true,
163				deviceTS:  time.Time{},
164				wantFlags: nil,
165			},
166			{
167				name: "manual entry without geotag stacks both flags",
168				mode: domain.ReadingModeManual, hasGeo: false,
169				deviceTS:  now,
170				wantFlags: []string{domain.IntegrityFlagManualEntry, domain.IntegrityFlagMissingGeotag},
171			},
172		}
173		for _, tc := range cases {
174			t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
175				got := deriveIntegrityFlags(tc.mode, tc.ocrConf, tc.hasGeo, tc.deviceTS, now)
176				if len(got) != len(tc.wantFlags) {
177					t.Fatalf("flags = %v, want %v", got, tc.wantFlags)
178				}
179				for i := range got {
180					if got[i] != tc.wantFlags[i] {
181						t.Errorf("flags[%d] = %q, want %q", i, got[i], tc.wantFlags[i])
182					}
183				}
184			})
185		}

1	package domain
2	
3	import (
4		"time"

6		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
7	)
8	
9	// BMC lot statuses. A lot cannot advance past QC_PENDING without a passing
10	// QC result — the safety gate is enforced in software (blueprint §8.3).
11	const (
12		BMCLotStatusOpen       = "OPEN"       // accepting deliveries
13		BMCLotStatusQCPending  = "QC_PENDING" // closed, awaiting rapid tests
14		BMCLotStatusPassed     = "PASSED"     // rapid tests within limits
15		BMCLotStatusBlocked    = "BLOCKED"    // failed — quarantined, cannot advance
16		BMCLotStatusDispatched = "DISPATCHED" // tankered to plant
17		BMCLotStatusPooled     = "POOLED"     // terminal: consumed by a processing batch
18	)
19	
20	// BMCLot pools consignments delivered to one bulk-milk-cooler for a date+shift.
21	type BMCLot struct {
22		ID                  primitive.ObjectID   `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
23		BMCID               primitive.ObjectID   `bson:"bmc_id"  json:"bmc_id"`
24		Date                string               `bson:"date"    json:"date"` // YYYY-MM-DD
25		Shift               string               `bson:"shift"   json:"shift"`
26		ConsignmentIDs      []primitive.ObjectID `bson:"consignment_ids" json:"consignment_ids"`
27		RouteTripIDs        []primitive.ObjectID `bson:"route_trip_ids,omitempty" json:"route_trip_ids,omitempty"`
28		TotalQuantityLitres float64              `bson:"total_quantity_litres" json:"total_quantity_litres"`
29		ChillingTempC       float64              `bson:"chilling_temp_c,omitempty" json:"chilling_temp_c,omitempty"`
30		Status              string               `bson:"status"  json:"status"`
31		// BatchID stamps the processing batch that pooled (consumed) this lot —
32		// set atomically by the DISPATCHED→POOLED claim so one lot can never feed
33		// two batches.
34		BatchID       *primitive.ObjectID  `bson:"batch_id,omitempty" json:"batch_id,omitempty"`
35		QCResultIDs   []primitive.ObjectID `bson:"qc_result_ids,omitempty" json:"qc_result_ids,omitempty"`
36		BlockReason   string               `bson:"block_reason,omitempty"  json:"block_reason,omitempty"`
37		CreatedBy     primitive.ObjectID   `bson:"created_by" json:"created_by"`
38		ClosedAt      *time.Time           `bson:"closed_at,omitempty"     json:"closed_at,omitempty"`
39		DispatchedAt  *time.Time           `bson:"dispatched_at,omitempty" json:"dispatched_at,omitempty"`
40		ProvenanceSeq int64                `bson:"provenance_seq,omitempty" json:"provenance_seq,omitempty"`
41		CreatedAt     time.Time            `bson:"created_at" json:"created_at"`
42	}
43	
44	// Processing batch statuses — same gate discipline as BMC lots.
45	const (
46		BatchStatusCreated   = "CREATED"
47		BatchStatusQCPending = "QC_PENDING"
48		BatchStatusPassed    = "PASSED"
49		BatchStatusBlocked   = "BLOCKED"
50		BatchStatusCompleted = "COMPLETED" // product lots issued
51	)
52	
53	// ProcessingBatch pools BMC lots at a plant into one production run.
54	// BatchNumber is the human-readable unique business key printed on packs.
55	type ProcessingBatch struct {
56		ID            primitive.ObjectID   `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
57		PlantID       primitive.ObjectID   `bson:"plant_id"      json:"plant_id"`
58		BatchNumber   string               `bson:"batch_number"  json:"batch_number"` // unique business key
59		BMCLotIDs     []primitive.ObjectID `bson:"bmc_lot_ids"   json:"bmc_lot_ids"`
60		ProductType   string               `bson:"product_type"  json:"product_type"` // TONED_MILK, FULL_CREAM, GHEE...
61		InputLitres   float64              `bson:"input_litres"  json:"input_litres"`
62		Status        string               `bson:"status"        json:"status"`
63		QCResultIDs   []primitive.ObjectID `bson:"qc_result_ids,omitempty" json:"qc_result_ids,omitempty"`
64		BlockReason   string               `bson:"block_reason,omitempty"  json:"block_reason,omitempty"`
65		StartedAt     time.Time            `bson:"started_at"    json:"started_at"`
66		CompletedAt   *time.Time           `bson:"completed_at,omitempty" json:"completed_at,omitempty"`
67		CreatedBy     primitive.ObjectID   `bson:"created_by"    json:"created_by"`
68		ProvenanceSeq int64                `bson:"provenance_seq,omitempty" json:"provenance_seq,omitempty"`
69		CreatedAt     time.Time            `bson:"created_at"    json:"created_at"`
70	}
71	
72	// Product lot statuses.
73	const (
74		ProductLotStatusActive   = "ACTIVE"
75		ProductLotStatusRecalled = "RECALLED" // FSSAI recall path
76		ProductLotStatusExpired  = "EXPIRED"
77	)
78	
79	// ProductLot is a packaged SKU output of a passed batch. QR issuance is only
80	// legal for lots whose batch has completed the safety gate.
81	type ProductLot struct {
82		ID            primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
83		BatchID       primitive.ObjectID `bson:"batch_id"      json:"batch_id"`
84		PlantID       primitive.ObjectID `bson:"plant_id"      json:"plant_id"`
85		SKU           string             `bson:"sku"           json:"sku"`

87		Units         int                `bson:"units"         json:"units"`
88		UnitSize      string             `bson:"unit_size"     json:"unit_size"` // e.g. "500ml" — Legal Metrology net quantity
89		MRP           float64            `bson:"mrp,omitempty" json:"mrp,omitempty"`
90		MfgDate       string             `bson:"mfg_date"      json:"mfg_date"` // YYYY-MM-DD
91		ExpiryDate    string             `bson:"expiry_date"   json:"expiry_date"`
92		Status        string             `bson:"status"        json:"status"`
93		RecallReason  string             `bson:"recall_reason,omitempty" json:"recall_reason,omitempty"`
94		ProvenanceSeq int64              `bson:"provenance_seq,omitempty" json:"provenance_seq,omitempty"`
95		CreatedAt     time.Time          `bson:"created_at"    json:"created_at"`
96	}
97	
98	// BatchQR is the printed/packed QR for a product lot. QRCode is the short
99	// unique public business key; SignedToken is the HMAC-signed payload the
100	// consumer app resolves, so a QR cannot be forged by guessing IDs.
101	type BatchQR struct {
102		ID            primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
103		QRCode        string             `bson:"qr_code"       json:"qr_code"` // unique public code, e.g. "[REDACTED:generic-api-key]"
104		ProductLotID  primitive.ObjectID `bson:"product_lot_id" json:"product_lot_id"`
105		SignedToken   string             `bson:"signed_token"  json:"signed_token"`
106		IssuedBy      primitive.ObjectID `bson:"issued_by"     json:"issued_by"`
107		ScanCount     int64              `bson:"scan_count"    json:"scan_count"`
108		ProvenanceSeq int64              `bson:"provenance_seq,omitempty" json:"provenance_seq,omitempty"`
109		IssuedAt      time.Time          `bson:"issued_at"     json:"issued_at"`
110	}

53	func assertAppError(t *testing.T, err *httpx.AppError, wantStatus int, wantCode string) {

55		if wantStatus == 0 {
