```text
58			}
59			return
60		}

63		}
64		if err.Status != wantStatus {
65			t.Fatalf("status = %d, want %d (err: %v)", err.Status, wantStatus, err)
66		}
67		if wantCode != "" && err.Code != wantCode {
68			t.Fatalf("code = %q, want %q (err: %v)", err.Code, wantCode, err)
69		}
```

```text
// Package deps is the dependency container handed to every module at wiring
// time. One struct, constructed once in cmd/server, threaded everywhere —
// no globals, trivially fakeable in tests.
package deps

import (
	"log/slog"

	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"

	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/config"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/audit"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/eventbus"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/flags"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/orgscope"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/provenance"
)

// Deps carries every shared platform service.
type Deps struct {
	Cfg    *config.Config
	Log    *slog.Logger
	DB     *mongo.Database
	JWT    *auth.JWTManager
	Ledger *provenance.Ledger
	Audit  *audit.Recorder
	Flags  *flags.Service
	Orgs   *orgscope.Resolver
	Bus    *eventbus.Bus
}
```

```text
71	// claimInvoices atomically flips still-ISSUED invoices to SETTLEMENT_PENDING

161	// transitionBatch performs a status-guarded update (optimistic concurrency —
162	// no transactions on a standalone server). Returns false when the batch was
163	// not in fromStatus, i.e. another actor won the transition.
164	func (rp *repo) transitionBatch(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID, fromStatus string, set bson.D) (bool, error) {
165		res, err := rp.batches.UpdateOne(ctx,
166			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}, {Key: "status", Value: fromStatus}},
167			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: set}},
168		)
169		if err != nil {
170			return false, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("transition settlement batch: %w", err))
171		}
172		return res.MatchedCount > 0, nil
173	}
174	
175	// claimExecution atomically claims a batch for execution. Three legal claims:
176	//   - APPROVED  → EXECUTING (first run)
177	//   - FAILED    → EXECUTING (re-execution after a recorded failure)
178	//   - EXECUTING → EXECUTING with a STALE lease (resume of a run whose process
179	//     died before it could mark FAILED; staleBefore guards against stealing a
180	//     live executor's batch)
181	//
182	// Every claim stamps executing_at as the new lease. Returns false when no
183	// claim matched — someone else holds a fresh lease or the batch is terminal.
184	func (rp *repo) claimExecution(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID, now, staleBefore time.Time) (bool, error) {
185		for _, from := range []string{domain.SettlementStatusApproved, domain.SettlementStatusFailed} {
186			ok, err := rp.transitionBatch(ctx, id, from, bson.D{
187				{Key: "status", Value: domain.SettlementStatusExecuting},
188				{Key: "executing_at", Value: now},
189			})
190			if err != nil || ok {
191				return ok, err
192			}
193		}
194		res, err := rp.batches.UpdateOne(ctx,
195			bson.D{
196				{Key: "_id", Value: id},
197				{Key: "status", Value: domain.SettlementStatusExecuting},
198				{Key: "executing_at", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$lt", Value: staleBefore}}},
199			},
200			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "executing_at", Value: now}}}},
201		)
202		if err != nil {
203			return false, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("claim settlement execution: %w", err))
204		}
205		return res.MatchedCount > 0, nil
206	}
207	
208	// markExecutionFailed best-effort flips EXECUTING→FAILED with the reason so a

210	func (rp *repo) markExecutionFailed(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID, reason string) error {
211		_, err := rp.batches.UpdateOne(ctx,
212			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}, {Key: "status", Value: domain.SettlementStatusExecuting}},
213			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
214				{Key: "status", Value: domain.SettlementStatusFailed},
215				{Key: "fail_reason", Value: reason},
216			}}},
217		)
218		if err != nil {
219			return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("mark settlement execution failed: %w", err))
220		}
221		return nil
222	}

408	// transitionDBT performs a status-guarded DBT update; false = lost the race
409	// or the request already left fromStatus.
410	func (rp *repo) transitionDBT(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID, fromStatus, toStatus string, creditedAt *time.Time) (bool, error) {
411		set := bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: toStatus}}
412		if creditedAt != nil {
413			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "credited_at", Value: creditedAt})
414		}
415		res, err := rp.dbt.UpdateOne(ctx,
416			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}, {Key: "status", Value: fromStatus}},
417			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: set}},
418		)
419		if err != nil {
420			return false, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("transition dbt request: %w", err))
421		}
422		return res.MatchedCount > 0, nil
423	}
```

```text
16	func TestValidateApproval(t *testing.T) {

20	
21		tests := []struct {
22			name       string
23			batch      domain.SettlementBatch
24			approver   primitive.ObjectID
25			wantStatus int    // 0 = no error expected
26			wantReason string // expected details.reason, "" = don't check
27		}{

29				name: "different approver on pending batch passes",
30				batch: domain.SettlementBatch{

32					Status:      domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval,
33				},
34				approver: adhyaksh,
35			},
36			{
37				name: "initiator approving own batch is a dual-control violation",
38				batch: domain.SettlementBatch{

40					Status:      domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval,
41				},
42				approver:   sacheev,
43				wantStatus: http.StatusForbidden,
44				wantReason: "DUAL_CONTROL_VIOLATION",
45			},
46			{
47				name: "dual control is checked before status — even a super-admin initiator on an approved batch is refused as a violation",
48				batch: domain.SettlementBatch{
49					InitiatedBy: superAdmin,
50					Status:      domain.SettlementStatusApproved,
51				},
52				approver:   superAdmin,
53				wantStatus: http.StatusForbidden,
54				wantReason: "DUAL_CONTROL_VIOLATION",
55			},
56			{

70				},
71				approver:   adhyaksh,
72				wantStatus: http.StatusConflict,
73			},
74		}

76		for _, tt := range tests {
77			t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
78				err := validateApproval(tt.batch, tt.approver)
79				if tt.wantStatus == 0 {
```

```text
10	// FSSAI limits for liquid milk (blueprint §8.3). Aflatoxin M1 is heat-stable
11	// and survives pasteurisation, so it MUST be gated upstream (BMC + plant),
12	// never only at the finished product.
13	const (
14		FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg = 0.5  // AFM1 ≤ 0.5 µg/kg
15		FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl          = 10.0 // coliform ≤ 10 CFU/ml
16		FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg       = 0.1  // antibiotic MRL example
17	)
18	
19	// QC test names.
20	const (
21		TestAflatoxinM1 = "AFLATOXIN_M1"            // µg/kg
22		TestColiform    = "COLIFORM"                // CFU/ml
23		TestTPC         = "TPC"                     // CFU/ml, graded — recorded, not hard-gated here
24		TestAntibiotic  = "ANTIBIOTIC_TETRACYCLINE" // mg/kg
25		TestPhosphatase = "PHOSPHATASE"             // 0 = negative (pass post-pasteurisation), 1 = positive
26		TestFat         = "FAT"                     // %
27		TestSNF         = "SNF"                     // %
28	)
29	
30	// QC stages.
31	const (
32		QCStageBMCRapid = "BMC_RAPID" // strip/rapid tests at the chilling centre
33		QCStagePlantLab = "PLANT_LAB" // full lab: ELISA/HPLC, culture, LC-MS/MS
34	)
35	
36	// QC subject types.
37	const (
38		QCSubjectDCSConsignment  = "DCS_CONSIGNMENT"
39		QCSubjectBMCLot          = "BMC_LOT"
40		QCSubjectProcessingBatch = "PROCESSING_BATCH"
41	)
42	
43	// QCTest is a single measurement inside a QC result.
44	type QCTest struct {
45		Name  string  `bson:"name"  json:"name"`
46		Value float64 `bson:"value" json:"value"`
47		Unit  string  `bson:"unit"  json:"unit"`
48		Pass  bool    `bson:"pass"  json:"pass"`
49	}
50	
51	// QCResult is the recorded outcome of testing one subject at one stage.
52	// OverallPass drives the safety gate; a certificate is attached to provenance
53	// on pass, a block + quarantine on fail.
54	type QCResult struct {
55		ID                primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
56		SubjectType       string             `bson:"subject_type"  json:"subject_type"`
57		SubjectID         primitive.ObjectID `bson:"subject_id"    json:"subject_id"`
58		Stage             string             `bson:"stage"         json:"stage"`
59		Tests             []QCTest           `bson:"tests"         json:"tests"`
60		OverallPass       bool               `bson:"overall_pass"  json:"overall_pass"`
61		FailureReasons    []string           `bson:"failure_reasons,omitempty" json:"failure_reasons,omitempty"`
62		AnalystPartyID    primitive.ObjectID `bson:"analyst_party_id" json:"analyst_party_id"`
63		LabRef            string             `bson:"lab_ref,omitempty"            json:"lab_ref,omitempty"`
64		CertificateNumber string             `bson:"certificate_number,omitempty" json:"certificate_number,omitempty"`
65		// Superseded marks a result voided after losing the gate race — the
66		// verdict on the subject came from a different, earlier result.
67		Superseded    bool      `bson:"superseded,omitempty" json:"superseded,omitempty"`
68		RecordedAt    time.Time `bson:"recorded_at"   json:"recorded_at"`
69		ProvenanceSeq int64     `bson:"provenance_seq,omitempty" json:"provenance_seq,omitempty"`
70	}
71	
72	// EvaluateQCTests applies the FSSAI gate to a set of tests: it fills each
73	// test's Pass verdict and returns the overall verdict plus human-readable
74	// failure reasons. Unknown test names are recorded but do not gate.
75	func EvaluateQCTests(tests []QCTest) (overallPass bool, failures []string, evaluated []QCTest) {
76		overallPass = true
77		evaluated = make([]QCTest, 0, len(tests))
78		for _, t := range tests {
79			pass := true
80			switch t.Name {
81			case TestAflatoxinM1:
82				if t.Value > FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg {
83					pass = false
84					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
85						"AFLATOXIN_M1 %.3f µg/kg exceeds FSSAI limit %.1f µg/kg", t.Value, FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg))
86				}
87			case TestColiform:
88				if t.Value > FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl {
89					pass = false
90					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
91						"COLIFORM %.1f CFU/ml exceeds FSSAI limit %.0f CFU/ml", t.Value, FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl))
92				}
93			case TestAntibiotic:
94				if t.Value > FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg {
95					pass = false
96					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
97						"ANTIBIOTIC_TETRACYCLINE %.3f mg/kg exceeds MRL %.1f mg/kg", t.Value, FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg))
98				}
99			case TestPhosphatase:
100				if t.Value != 0 {
101					pass = false
102					failures = append(failures, "PHOSPHATASE positive — pasteurisation check failed (must be negative)")
103				}
104			}
105			t.Pass = pass
106			if !pass {
107				overallPass = false
108			}
109			evaluated = append(evaluated, t)
110		}
111		return overallPass, failures, evaluated
112	}
```

```text
27		actor, ok := auth.ActorFrom(r.Context())
28		if !ok {

30		}
```

```text
14	// Request-shape validation patterns. Formats only — business rules live in
15	// the service layer.
16	var (
17		phoneRegexp       = regexp.MustCompile(`^[6-9][0-9]{9}$`)      // 10-digit Indian mobile
18		otpRegexp         = regexp.MustCompile(`^[0-9]{6}$`)           // 6-digit numeric OTP
19		aadhaarRegexp     = regexp.MustCompile(`^[0-9]{12}$`)          // 12-digit Aadhaar number
20		bankAccountRegexp = regexp.MustCompile(`^[0-9]{9,18}$`)        // NPCI-range account number
21		ifscRegexp        = regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Z]{4}0[A-Z0-9]{6}$`) // RBI IFSC format
22	)
23	
24	// requestableTiers are the KYC tiers a party may ask to be verified at via
25	// POST /kyc/aadhaar. HIGHEST/SERVICE are never self-requested.
26	var requestableTiers = map[string]bool{
27		domain.KYCTierFarmer:   true,

29		domain.KYCTierRider:    true,

31	}

36	}
37

40			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_PHONE", "phone must be a 10-digit Indian mobile number")
41		}
42		return nil
43	}

156	func (r patchMeRequest) validate() error {
157		if r.FullName == nil && r.PreferredLanguage == nil {
158			return httpx.BadRequest("EMPTY_PATCH", "provide at least one of full_name, preferred_language")
159		}
160		if r.FullName != nil {
161			name := strings.TrimSpace(*r.FullName)
162			if name == "" || len(name) > 120 {
163				return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_FULL_NAME", "full_name must be 1-120 characters")
164			}
165		}
166		if r.PreferredLanguage != nil {
167			lang := strings.TrimSpace(*r.PreferredLanguage)
168			if lang == "" || len(lang) > 16 {
169				return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_LANGUAGE", "preferred_language must be 1-16 characters (e.g. \"hi\", \"en\")")
170			}
171		}

176	// full number is used transiently and NEVER stored (blueprint §18-A). The
177	// record enters the approval workflow as PENDING — there is no auto-verify.
178	type aadhaarKYCRequest struct {
179		AadhaarNumber string `json:"aadhaar_number"`
180		Consent       bool   `json:"consent"`
181		RequestedTier string `json:"requested_tier"` // FARMER | STANDARD | RIDER | HIGH

184	func (r aadhaarKYCRequest) validate() error {
185		if !aadhaarRegexp.MatchString(r.AadhaarNumber) {
186			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_AADHAAR", "aadhaar_number must be 12 digits")
187		}
188		if !r.Consent {
189			return httpx.BadRequest("CONSENT_REQUIRED", "explicit consent is required for Aadhaar eKYC (DPDP)")
190		}
191		if !requestableTiers[r.RequestedTier] {
192			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_TIER", "requested_tier must be one of FARMER, STANDARD, RIDER, HIGH")
193		}
194		return nil
195	}
196	
197	// aadhaarKYCResponse returns the (PENDING) record and a human-readable
198	// status message for the approval workflow.
199	type aadhaarKYCResponse struct {
200		Record  *domain.KYCRecord `json:"record"`
201		Status  string            `json:"status"`
202		Message string            `json:"message"`
203	}
204	
205	// bankKYCRequest runs the (mock) penny-drop bank verification. Only the
206	// masked account tail and IFSC are ever persisted.
207	type bankKYCRequest struct {
208		AccountNumber string `json:"account_number"`
209		IFSC          string `json:"ifsc"`
210	}
211	
212	func (r bankKYCRequest) validate() error {
213		if !bankAccountRegexp.MatchString(r.AccountNumber) {
214			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_ACCOUNT", "account_number must be 9-18 digits")
215		}
216		if !ifscRegexp.MatchString(r.IFSC) {
217			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_IFSC", "ifsc must match the RBI IFSC format (e.g. SBIN0001234)")
218		}
219		return nil
220	}
221	
222	// kycRejectRequest carries the mandatory human-readable rejection reason.
223	type kycRejectRequest struct {
224		Reason string `json:"reason"`
225	}
226	
227	func (r kycRejectRequest) validate() error {
228		reason := strings.TrimSpace(r.Reason)
229		if reason == "" || len(reason) > 500 {
230			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_REASON", "reason must be 1-500 characters")
231		}
232		return nil
233	}
234	
235	// pendingPartySummary is the reviewer-facing digest of the requesting party.
236	type pendingPartySummary struct {
237		ID       primitive.ObjectID `json:"id"`
238		Phone    string             `json:"phone"`
239		FullName string             `json:"full_name,omitempty"`
240		KYCTier  string             `json:"kyc_tier"`
241	}
242	
243	// pendingKYCItem is one PENDING KYC record enriched with its party so the
244	// review console needs no second call.
245	type pendingKYCItem struct {
246		domain.KYCRecord
247		Party *pendingPartySummary `json:"party,omitempty"`
248	}
249	
250	// kycReviewResponse returns the reviewed record plus the party's KYC tier
251	// after the review (upgraded on approval when the requested tier is higher).
252	type kycReviewResponse struct {
253		Record  *domain.KYCRecord `json:"record"`
254		KYCTier string            `json:"kyc_tier"`
255	}
256	
257	// createAssignmentRequest grants a role to a party inside an org unit. The
258	// target party is addressed by party_id or phone (party_id wins when both
259	// are present).
260	type createAssignmentRequest struct {
261		PartyID   *primitive.ObjectID `json:"party_id,omitempty"`
262		Phone     string              `json:"phone,omitempty"`
263		RoleCode  string              `json:"role_code"`
264		OrgUnitID primitive.ObjectID  `json:"org_unit_id"`
265		ValidFrom *time.Time          `json:"valid_from,omitempty"`
266		ValidTo   *time.Time          `json:"valid_to,omitempty"`
267	}
268	
269	func (r createAssignmentRequest) validate() error {
270		if r.PartyID == nil && r.Phone == "" {
271			return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_PARTY", "one of party_id or phone is required")
272		}
273		if r.PartyID == nil && !phoneRegexp.MatchString(r.Phone) {
274			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_PHONE", "phone must be a 10-digit Indian mobile number")
275		}
276		if !domain.IsValidRole(r.RoleCode) {
277			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_ROLE", "role_code is not in the role catalog")
278		}
279		if r.OrgUnitID.IsZero() {
280			return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_ORG_UNIT", "org_unit_id is required")
281		}
282		if r.ValidFrom != nil && r.ValidTo != nil && !r.ValidTo.After(*r.ValidFrom) {
283			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_VALIDITY_WINDOW", "valid_to must be after valid_from")
284		}
285		return nil
286	}
287	
288	// listMeta is the pagination meta block for list endpoints.
289	type listMeta struct {
290		Limit  int64 `json:"limit"`
291		Offset int64 `json:"offset"`
292		Total  int64 `json:"total"`
293	}
```

```text
1	// Package identity owns authentication (OTP login, refresh-token rotation,
2	// role selection), the Party registry, org-scoped role assignments and KYC
3	// verification — blueprint §4 (identity) and §5 (roles & RBAC).
4	//
5	// Route prefixes (mounted under /api/v1): /auth, /parties, /roles, /kyc.
6	// This module emits no provenance events; identity changes are covered by
7	// the audit middleware.
8	package identity
9	
10	import (
11		"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
12	
13		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
14		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/middleware"
16	)
17	
18	// Register wires repo → service → handler and mounts the identity routes.
19	func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
20		repo := newRepository(d.DB)
21		svc := newService(d, repo)
22		h := newHandler(svc)
23	
24		r.Route("/auth", func(r chi.Router) {
25			// Public login flow — no token yet.
26			r.Post("/otp/request", h.requestOTP)
27			r.Post("/otp/verify", h.verifyOTP)
28			r.Post("/refresh", h.refresh)
29	
30			// Any logged-in party (session or role token).
31			r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
32				r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT), middleware.RequireSession)
33				r.Post("/logout", h.logout)
34				r.Get("/roles", h.listMyRoles)
35				r.Post("/role/select", h.selectRole)
36			})
37		})
38	
39		r.Route("/parties", func(r chi.Router) {
40			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT), middleware.RequireSession)
41			r.Get("/me", h.getMe)
42			r.Patch("/me", h.patchMe)
43		})
44	
45		r.Route("/kyc", func(r chi.Router) {
46			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT), middleware.RequireSession)
47			r.Post("/aadhaar", h.verifyAadhaar)
48			r.Post("/bank", h.verifyBank)
49			r.Get("/me", h.listMyKYC)
50		})
51	
52		r.Route("/roles", func(r chi.Router) {
53			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
54			// SUPER_ADMIN passes RequireRoles automatically; the fine-grained
55			// granter matrix (§5.2) is enforced in the service.
56			r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(
57				domain.RolePCDFAdmin,
58				domain.RoleUnionPresident,
59				domain.RoleSamitiAdhyaksh,
60			))
61			r.Post("/assignments", h.createAssignment)
62			r.Delete("/assignments/{id}", h.revokeAssignment)
63			r.Get("/assignments", h.listAssignments)
64		})
65	}
66
```

```text
15		RoleAssignmentID string
16		RoleCode         string
17		OrgUnitID        string

21	// HasRole reports whether the actor operates under one of the given roles.
22	func (a Actor) HasRole(roles ...string) bool {
23		for _, r := range roles {
24			if a.RoleCode == r {
25				return true
26			}
27		}
28		return false
29	}

31	type actorCtxKey struct{}
32	
33	// actorHolder is a mutable cell installed by OUTER middleware (audit) so
34	// identity established by INNER middleware (Authenticate) can flow back out.
35	// Context values only propagate inward; the shared pointer bridges the gap.
36	type actorHolder struct {
37		mu sync.Mutex
38		a  *Actor
39	}
40	
41	type actorHolderCtxKey struct{}
42	
43	// WithActorHolder installs an empty actor holder on the context. Middleware
44	// mounted before authentication uses it to observe the actor after the
45	// handler chain ran.
46	func WithActorHolder(ctx context.Context) context.Context {
47		return context.WithValue(ctx, actorHolderCtxKey{}, &actorHolder{})
48	}
49	
50	// HeldActor returns the actor captured by an inner WithActor call, if a
51	// holder was installed and authentication happened.
52	func HeldActor(ctx context.Context) (Actor, bool) {
53		h, ok := ctx.Value(actorHolderCtxKey{}).(*actorHolder)
54		if !ok {
55			return Actor{}, false
56		}
57		h.mu.Lock()
58		defer h.mu.Unlock()
59		if h.a == nil {
60			return Actor{}, false
61		}
62		return *h.a, true
63	}
64	
65	// WithActor stores the actor on the context, and also fills the outward
66	// actor holder when one was installed upstream (see WithActorHolder).
67	func WithActor(ctx context.Context, a Actor) context.Context {
68		if h, ok := ctx.Value(actorHolderCtxKey{}).(*actorHolder); ok {
69			h.mu.Lock()
70			cp := a
71			h.a = &cp
72			h.mu.Unlock()
73		}
74		return context.WithValue(ctx, actorCtxKey{}, a)
75	}
76	
77	// ActorFrom retrieves the actor, if any.
78	func ActorFrom(ctx context.Context) (Actor, bool) {
79		a, ok := ctx.Value(actorCtxKey{}).(Actor)
80		return a, ok
```

```text
10	// ParseID converts an ObjectID hex string (from JSON bodies, query params or
11	// JWT claims) into a primitive.ObjectID, or returns a 400 with the offending
12	// field name.
13	func ParseID(hex, field string) (primitive.ObjectID, error) {
14		id, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(hex)
15		if err != nil {
16			return primitive.NilObjectID, BadRequest("INVALID_ID", field+" must be a valid object id")
17		}
18		return id, nil
19	}
20	
21	// PathID extracts a chi URL parameter and parses it as an ObjectID.
22	func PathID(r *http.Request, param string) (primitive.ObjectID, error) {
23		return ParseID(chi.URLParam(r, param), param)
24	}
```

```text
1	// Package orgscope answers the RBAC question "is this resource inside the
2	// caller's organisational scope?" in O(1) DB reads. Org units denormalise
3	// their ancestor chain into Path ([]ObjectID), so scope checking is a
4	// set-membership test — no recursive tree walks on the hot path.
5	package orgscope
6	
7	import (
8		"context"
9		"errors"
10		"sync"
11		"time"
12	
13		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
14		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"

22	const collection = "org_units"
23	
24	type cachedOrg struct {
25		org domain.OrgUnit
26		at  time.Time
27	}
28	
29	// Resolver caches org units briefly (the tree changes rarely, reads are hot).
30	type Resolver struct {
31		coll *mongo.Collection
32		ttl  time.Duration
33	
34		mu    sync.RWMutex
35		cache map[string]cachedOrg // keyed by ObjectID hex
36	}
37	
38	// NewResolver binds the resolver to the database.
39	func NewResolver(db *mongo.Database) *Resolver {
40		return &Resolver{
41			coll:  db.Collection(collection),
42			ttl:   60 * time.Second,
43			cache: make(map[string]cachedOrg),
44		}
45	}
46	
47	// Get returns an org unit by ObjectID (cached).
48	func (r *Resolver) Get(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
49		key := id.Hex()
50		r.mu.RLock()
51		c, ok := r.cache[key]
52		r.mu.RUnlock()
53		if ok && time.Since(c.at) < r.ttl {
54			org := c.org
55			return &org, nil
56		}
57	
58		var org domain.OrgUnit
59		err := r.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&org)
60		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
61			return nil, httpx.NotFound("org unit " + key)
62		}
63		if err != nil {
64			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
65		}
66	
67		r.mu.Lock()
68		r.cache[key] = cachedOrg{org: org, at: time.Now()}
69		r.mu.Unlock()
70		return &org, nil
71	}
72	
73	// GetByCode returns an org unit by its unique human-readable business code
74	// (e.g. "DCS-01842") — display/lookup use only, never for joins.
75	func (r *Resolver) GetByCode(ctx context.Context, code string) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
76		var org domain.OrgUnit
77		err := r.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "code", Value: code}}).Decode(&org)
78		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
79			return nil, httpx.NotFound("org unit with code " + code)
80		}
81		if err != nil {
82			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
83		}
84		return &org, nil
85	}
86	
87	// Invalidate drops a cached entry (call after updates).
88	func (r *Resolver) Invalidate(id primitive.ObjectID) {
89		r.mu.Lock()
90		delete(r.cache, id.Hex())
91		r.mu.Unlock()
92	}

94	// InScope reports whether target sits at-or-below scope in the hierarchy:
95	// true when scope == target, or scope appears in target's ancestor Path.
96	func (r *Resolver) InScope(ctx context.Context, scopeOrgID, targetOrgID primitive.ObjectID) (bool, error) {
97		if scopeOrgID == targetOrgID {
98			return true, nil
99		}
100		target, err := r.Get(ctx, targetOrgID)
101		if err != nil {

103		}
104		for _, ancestor := range target.Path {
105			if ancestor == scopeOrgID {
106				return true, nil
107			}
108		}
109		return false, nil
110	}
111	
112	// RequireInScope enforces the actor's org scope over a target org unit.
113	// SUPER_ADMIN and STATE_AUDITOR (read-wide roles rooted at the federation)
114	// pass automatically; everyone else needs ancestry. The actor carries its
115	// org unit as an ObjectID hex string (JWT claims are JSON); it is parsed here.
116	func (r *Resolver) RequireInScope(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, targetOrgID primitive.ObjectID) error {
117		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSuperAdmin || actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleStateAuditor {
118			return nil
119		}
120		if actor.OrgUnitID == "" {
121			return httpx.Forbidden("role token with org scope required")
122		}
123		scopeID, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(actor.OrgUnitID)
124		if err != nil {
125			return httpx.Forbidden("role token carries an invalid org scope")
126		}
127		ok, err := r.InScope(ctx, scopeID, targetOrgID)
128		if err != nil {
129			return err
130		}
131		if !ok {
132			return httpx.Forbidden("resource is outside your organisational scope")
133		}
134		return nil
135	}
136
```

```text
1	// Package flags implements capability gating (blueprint principle #6):
2	// future-scheme features ship dormant behind flags — e.g. collar telemetry —
3	// so a new government scheme is a flag flip, not a schema migration.
4	package flags
5	
6	import (
7		"context"
8		"sync"
9		"time"
10	
11		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
12		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
13		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
14		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo/options"
15	)
16	
17	const collection = "feature_flags"
18	
19	// Well-known flag keys.
20	const (
21		FlagCollarTelemetry  = "collar_telemetry_enabled" // dormant until a collar scheme lands (§9)
22		FlagPhotoOCR         = "photo_ocr_enabled"        // legacy-analyzer bridge (§8.2)
23		FlagONDC             = "ondc_enabled"             // optional commerce network (§11)
24		FlagConsumerCommerce = "consumer_commerce_enabled"
25	)
26	
27	// Flag is the stored document. `_id` is a generated ObjectID; Key is the
28	// unique business identifier all lookups use.
29	type Flag struct {
30		ID          primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
31		Key         string             `bson:"key"           json:"key"`
32		Enabled     bool               `bson:"enabled"       json:"enabled"`
33		Description string             `bson:"description,omitempty" json:"description,omitempty"`
34		UpdatedBy   string             `bson:"updated_by,omitempty"  json:"updated_by,omitempty"` // approver party ObjectID hex
35		UpdatedAt   time.Time          `bson:"updated_at"    json:"updated_at"`
36	}
37	
38	type cached struct {
39		enabled bool
40		at      time.Time
41	}
42	
43	// Service reads flags with a short in-memory cache (hot path: every gated
44	// request) and writes through on change.
45	type Service struct {
46		coll *mongo.Collection
47		ttl  time.Duration
48	
49		mu    sync.RWMutex
50		cache map[string]cached
51	}
52	
53	// NewService binds the flag service to the database.
54	func NewService(db *mongo.Database) *Service {
55		return &Service{
56			coll:  db.Collection(collection),
57			ttl:   30 * time.Second,
58			cache: make(map[string]cached),
59		}
60	}
61	
62	// Enabled returns the flag value (missing flag = false, fail-closed).
63	func (s *Service) Enabled(ctx context.Context, key string) bool {
64		s.mu.RLock()
65		c, ok := s.cache[key]
66		s.mu.RUnlock()
67		if ok && time.Since(c.at) < s.ttl {
68			return c.enabled
69		}
70	
71		var f Flag
72		err := s.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "key", Value: key}}).Decode(&f)
73		enabled := err == nil && f.Enabled
74	
75		s.mu.Lock()
76		s.cache[key] = cached{enabled: enabled, at: time.Now()}
77		s.mu.Unlock()
78		return enabled
79	}
80	
81	// Set upserts a flag by key and invalidates the cache entry immediately.
82	func (s *Service) Set(ctx context.Context, key string, enabled bool, updatedBy string) error {
83		_, err := s.coll.UpdateOne(ctx,
84			bson.D{{Key: "key", Value: key}},
85			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
86				{Key: "enabled", Value: enabled},
87				{Key: "updated_by", Value: updatedBy},
88				{Key: "updated_at", Value: time.Now().UTC()},
89			}}},
90			options.Update().SetUpsert(true),
91		)
92		if err != nil {
93			return err
94		}
95		s.mu.Lock()
96		s.cache[key] = cached{enabled: enabled, at: time.Now()}
97		s.mu.Unlock()
98		return nil
99	}
100	
101	// All lists every flag (admin console).
102	func (s *Service) All(ctx context.Context) ([]Flag, error) {
103		cur, err := s.coll.Find(ctx, bson.D{})
104		if err != nil {
105			return nil, err
106		}
107		var out []Flag
108		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
109			return nil, err
110		}
111		return out, nil
112	}
113	
114	// EnsureDefaults inserts missing flags without touching existing values.
115	func (s *Service) EnsureDefaults(ctx context.Context, defaults map[string]Flag) error {
116		for key, f := range defaults {
117			f.Key = key
118			if f.UpdatedAt.IsZero() {
119				f.UpdatedAt = time.Now().UTC()
120			}
121			_, err := s.coll.UpdateOne(ctx,
122				bson.D{{Key: "key", Value: key}},
123				bson.D{{Key: "$setOnInsert", Value: f}},
124				options.Update().SetUpsert(true),
125			)
126			if err != nil {
127				return err
128			}
129		}
130		return nil
131	}
132
```

```text
1	// Package platformops is the platform-operations module (blueprint §12): the
2	// SUPER_ADMIN feature-flag console, the STATE_AUDITOR read-only audit surface
3	// with its GIGW/DPDP immutable export, the notifications outbox with the mock
4	// SMS dispatch worker (real deployment: MSG91 / telecom DLT gateway, §13),
5	// and the SUPPORT_AGENT audited limited-PII lookup (§5.2 role 20).
6	//
7	// It also subscribes to cross-module bus topics — payout credited, safety
8	// gate blocked, MVU dispatched — and turns them into queued vernacular SMS.
9	package platformops
10	
11	import (
12		"context"
13		"log/slog"
14	
15		"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
16	
17		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
18		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
19		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/eventbus"
20		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/middleware"
21	)
22	
23	// Register wires the platformops module and mounts /admin, /audit,
24	// /notifications and /support (the router hands us the /api/v1 subtree).
25	func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
26		repo := newRepository(d.DB)
27		svc := newService(d, repo)
28		h := newHandler(svc)
29	
30		r.Route("/admin", func(r chi.Router) {
31			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
32	
33			// PCDF_ADMIN may LIST flags; flipping one is SUPER_ADMIN only —
34			// capability gating is a deliberate act (blueprint principle #6).
35			r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSuperAdmin, domain.RolePCDFAdmin)).
36				Get("/flags", h.listFlags)
37			r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSuperAdmin)).
38				Put("/flags/{key}", h.setFlag)
39		})
40	
41		r.Route("/audit", func(r chi.Router) {
42			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
43			r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleStateAuditor, domain.RoleSuperAdmin))
44	
45			// Read-only by design: there is deliberately NO write/delete API
46			// surface for audit logs (§12) — entries land via deps.Audit only.
47			r.Get("/logs", h.listAuditLogs)
48			r.Get("/logs/export", h.exportAuditLogs)
49		})
50	
51		r.Route("/notifications", func(r chi.Router) {
52			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
53	
54			// SUPER_ADMIN only: a help-desk role has no need to read outbox
55			// message bodies, and the outbox carries credential-adjacent traffic
56			// (OTP notifications — additionally redacted in the service).
57			r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSuperAdmin)).
58				Get("/", h.listNotifications)
59			r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSuperAdmin)).
60				Post("/worker/run", h.runWorker)
61		})
62	
63		r.Route("/support", func(r chi.Router) {
64			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
65			r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSupportAgent, domain.RoleSuperAdmin))
66	
67			r.Get("/parties/lookup", h.lookupParty)
68		})
69	
70		// Cross-module reactions arrive over the bus (modules never import each
71		// other). The bus already runs each handler on its own goroutine with a
72		// bounded context and panic recovery; the wrapper below adds an explicit
73		// second belt at this module's boundary.
74		d.Bus.Subscribe(eventbus.TopicPayoutCredited, safeHandler(d, svc.onPayoutCredited))
75		d.Bus.Subscribe(eventbus.TopicGateBlocked, safeHandler(d, svc.onGateBlocked))
76		d.Bus.Subscribe(eventbus.TopicMVUDispatched, safeHandler(d, svc.onMVUDispatched))
77	}
78	
79	// safeHandler wraps a bus reaction so a programming error in notification
80	// fan-out can never disturb the publishing flow.
81	func safeHandler(d *deps.Deps, reaction func(ctx context.Context, payload any)) eventbus.Handler {
82		return func(ctx context.Context, topic string, payload any) {
83			defer func() {
84				if rec := recover(); rec != nil {
85					d.Log.Error("platformops bus handler panic",
86						slog.String("topic", topic), slog.Any("panic", rec))
87				}
88			}()
89			reaction(ctx, payload)
90		}
91	}
92
```

Verification summary of what I confirmed against the contract and spec:

- `GET /orgs?code=DCS-01842` exact-match filter is present: `handler.list` passes `q.Get("code")` into `service.List`, which appends `{Key: "code", Value: code}` to the repo query (spec allows "a repo query"). List meta totals preserved via `listOrgs` `CountDocuments`.
- Cache invalidation after writes: `s.scope.Invalidate(org.ID)` in `Create` and `s.scope.Invalidate(id)` in `Update` (`d.Orgs` is `*orgscope.Resolver`, `Invalidate` takes `primitive.ObjectID`).

- Structured logging: module logger derived in `Register` (`d.Log.With(slog.String("module", "orgs"))`); INFO on create/update; WARN on every business rejection (invalid hierarchy edge, `FEDERATION_EXISTS`, duplicate code, `ORG_MOVE_UNSUPPORTED`, scope denials); ERROR via `service.fail` before `httpx.Internal`; all repo errors wrapped with `fmt.Errorf("...: %w", err)`; no `fmt.Print*` anywhere.

```text
16	// handler is the HTTP layer: decode, validate shape, call service, respond.
17	type handler struct {
18		svc *service
19	}
20	
21	// newHandler wires the handler.
22	func newHandler(svc *service) *handler {
23		return &handler{svc: svc}
24	}
25	
26	// listFlags handles GET /admin/flags.
27	func (h *handler) listFlags(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
28		all, err := h.svc.listFlags(r.Context())
29		if err != nil {
30			httpx.Error(w, r, err)
31			return
32		}
33		httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, all)
34	}
35	
36	// setFlag handles PUT /admin/flags/{key}.
37	func (h *handler) setFlag(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
38		actor, ok := auth.ActorFrom(r.Context())
39		if !ok {
40			httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Unauthorized("authentication required"))
41			return
42		}
43	
44		var req SetFlagRequest
45		if err := httpx.DecodeJSON(r, &req); err != nil {
46			httpx.Error(w, r, err)
47			return
48		}
49		if req.Enabled == nil {
50			httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_ENABLED", "enabled is required"))
51			return
52		}
53	
54		flag, err := h.svc.setFlag(r.Context(), actor, chi.URLParam(r, "key"), *req.Enabled)
55		if err != nil {
56			httpx.Error(w, r, err)
57			return
58		}
59		httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusOK, flag)
60	}
61	
62	// listAuditLogs handles GET /audit/logs?actor_party_id=&target_type=&action=&from=&to=.
63	func (h *handler) listAuditLogs(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
64		query := r.URL.Query()
65		filter := auditLogFilter{
66			ActorPartyID: query.Get("actor_party_id"),
67			TargetType:   query.Get("target_type"),
68			Action:       query.Get("action"),
69		}
70	
71		from, err := parseTimeParam(query.Get("from"), false)
72		if err != nil {
73			httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_FROM", "from must be RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD"))
74			return
75		}
76		to, err := parseTimeParam(query.Get("to"), true)
77		if err != nil {

104			return

153		if phone == "" {
154			httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_PHONE", "phone is required"))
155			return
156		}

165	
166	// parseTimeParam accepts RFC3339 or plain YYYY-MM-DD (empty → nil). Date-only
167	// values mean UTC midnight; with endOfDay they cover the whole day, so
168	// ?to=2026-07-06 is inclusive of the 6th.
169	func parseTimeParam(value string, endOfDay bool) (*time.Time, error) {
170		if value == "" {
171			return nil, nil
172		}
173		if t, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, value); err == nil {
174			t = t.UTC()
175			return &t, nil
176		}
177		t, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", value)
178		if err != nil {
179			return nil, err
180		}
181		if endOfDay {
182			t = t.Add(24*time.Hour - time.Nanosecond)
183		}
184		t = t.UTC()
185		return &t, nil
186	}
187
```

```text
124	// redactNotificationSecrets strips the plaintext OTP (params + rendered meta)
125	// from an outbox document before it leaves the API.
126	func redactNotificationSecrets(n *StoredNotification) {
127		if n.TemplateKey != domain.TemplateOTP {
128			return
129		}
130		if n.Params != nil {
131			params := make(map[string]string, len(n.Params))
132			for k, v := range n.Params {
133				if k == "otp" {
134					v = redactedValue
135				}
136				params[k] = v
137			}
138			n.Params = params
139		}
140		if n.Meta != nil {
141			meta := make(map[string]any, len(n.Meta))
142			for k, v := range n.Meta {
143				if k == "rendered_en" || k == "rendered_hi" {
144					v = redactedValue
145				}
146				meta[k] = v
147			}

152	// runWorker is the MOCK SMS provider dispatch (real deployment: MSG91 /
153	// telecom DLT gateway, §13). It claims up to workerClaimCap QUEUED documents
154	// via a race-safe FindOneAndUpdate loop, stamps each SENT with a mock
155	// provider reference, and renders the English/Hindi lines into meta for
156	// visibility. The manual trigger keeps the demo deterministic; production
157	// runs this as a cron/queue consumer.
158	func (s *service) runWorker(ctx context.Context) (*WorkerRunResponse, error) {
159		sent := 0
160		for i := 0; i < workerClaimCap; i++ {
161			providerRef := "SMS-MOCK-" + uuid.NewString()[0:8]
162			claimed, err := s.repo.claimQueuedNotification(ctx, providerRef, time.Now().UTC())
163			if err != nil {
164				return nil, err
165			}
166			if claimed == nil {
167				break // queue drained
168			}
169			sent++
170	
171			english, hindi := renderSMS(claimed.TemplateKey, claimed.Params)
172			if claimed.TemplateKey == domain.TemplateOTP {
173				// Never persist the rendered OTP text — the provider gets the
174				// message transiently; the readable outbox keeps no plaintext code.
175				english, hindi = redactedValue, redactedValue
176			}
177			meta := map[string]any{
178				"provider":    "SMS-MOCK",
179				"rendered_en": english,
180				"rendered_hi": hindi,
181			}
182			if err := s.repo.setNotificationMeta(ctx, claimed.ID, meta); err != nil {
183				// The claim already succeeded — meta is cosmetic, log and move on.
184				s.deps.Log.Error("platformops: stamp notification meta failed",
185					slog.String("notification_id", claimed.ID), slog.Any("err", err))
186			}
187		}
188		return &WorkerRunResponse{Sent: sent}, nil
189	}

388		language := "hi" // vernacular default (blueprint §13)

401				slog.String("template_key", templateKey), slog.String("party_id", partyID))
402			return
403		}
404	
405		notification := &StoredNotification{Notification: domain.Notification{
406			ID:          uuid.NewString(),
407			PartyID:     partyID,
408			Phone:       phone,
409			Channel:     domain.ChannelSMS,
410			TemplateKey: templateKey,
411			Language:    language,
412			Params:      params,
413			Status:      domain.NotificationQueued,
414			QueuedAt:    time.Now().UTC(),
415		}}
416		if err := s.repo.insertNotification(ctx, notification); err != nil {
417			s.deps.Log.Error("platformops: queue notification failed",
418				slog.String("template_key", templateKey), slog.Any("err", err))

422	// unionAncestor returns the MILK_UNION org unit at or above orgUnitID, walking
423	// the denormalised ancestor Path nearest-first via d.Orgs.Get. Returns nil
424	// when no union sits on the chain (e.g. a plant directly under the federation).
425	func (s *service) unionAncestor(ctx context.Context, orgUnitID string) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
426		org, err := s.deps.Orgs.Get(ctx, orgUnitID)
427		if err != nil {
428			return nil, err
429		}
430		if org.Type == domain.OrgTypeMilkUnion {
431			return org, nil
432		}
433		// Path holds ancestors root→down; walk nearest ancestor first.
434		for i := len(org.Path) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
435			ancestor, err := s.deps.Orgs.Get(ctx, org.Path[i])
436			if err != nil {
437				return nil, err
438			}
439			if ancestor.Type == domain.OrgTypeMilkUnion {
440				return ancestor, nil
441			}
442		}
443		return nil, nil
444	}
445
```

```text
46	// auditFilter builds the bson filter shared by the list and export reads.
47	func auditFilter(f auditLogFilter) bson.D {
48		filter := bson.D{}
49		if f.ActorPartyID != "" {
50			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "actor_party_id", Value: f.ActorPartyID})
51		}
52		if f.TargetType != "" {
53			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "target_type", Value: f.TargetType})
54		}
55		if f.Action != "" {
56			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "action", Value: f.Action})
57		}
58		if f.From != nil || f.To != nil {
59			tsRange := bson.D{}
60			if f.From != nil {
61				tsRange = append(tsRange, bson.E{Key: "$gte", Value: *f.From})
62			}
63			if f.To != nil {
64				tsRange = append(tsRange, bson.E{Key: "$lte", Value: *f.To})
65			}
66			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "ts", Value: tsRange})
67		}
68		return filter
69	}

152	// claimQueuedNotification atomically claims the oldest QUEUED document
153	// (QUEUED→SENT, sent_at, provider_ref) and returns it, or nil when the queue
154	// is drained. FindOneAndUpdate makes the claim race-safe across concurrent
155	// worker runs — never find-then-update.
156	func (r *repository) claimQueuedNotification(ctx context.Context, providerRef string, now time.Time) (*StoredNotification, error) {
157		var n StoredNotification
158		err := r.notifications.FindOneAndUpdate(ctx,
159			bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: domain.NotificationQueued}},
160			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
161				{Key: "status", Value: domain.NotificationSent},
162				{Key: "sent_at", Value: now},
163				{Key: "provider_ref", Value: providerRef},
164			}}},
165			options.FindOneAndUpdate().
166				SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "queued_at", Value: 1}}).
167				SetReturnDocument(options.After),
168		).Decode(&n)
169		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
170			return nil, nil
171		}
172		if err != nil {
173			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("claim queued notification: %w", err))
174		}
175		return &n, nil
176	}

258	// subjectOrgUnit resolves a gate-blocked QC subject to the org unit that
259	// holds it (BMC lot → bmc_id, processing batch → plant_id).
260	func (r *repository) subjectOrgUnit(ctx context.Context, subjectType, subjectID string) (string, error) {
261		var coll *mongo.Collection
262		var field string
263		switch subjectType {
264		case domain.QCSubjectBMCLot:
265			coll, field = r.bmcLots, "bmc_id"
266		case domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch:
267			coll, field = r.batches, "plant_id"
268		default:
269			return "", fmt.Errorf("gate-blocked subject type %q has no org resolution", subjectType)
270		}
271	
272		var doc bson.M
273		err := coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: subjectID}},
274			options.FindOne().SetProjection(bson.D{{Key: field, Value: 1}}),
275		).Decode(&doc)
276		if err != nil {
277			return "", fmt.Errorf("resolve org of %s %s: %w", subjectType, subjectID, err)
278		}
279		orgUnitID, _ := doc[field].(string)
280		if orgUnitID == "" {
281			return "", fmt.Errorf("%s %s carries no %s", subjectType, subjectID, field)
282		}
283		return orgUnitID, nil
284	}
```

```text
14	func TestRenderSMSPourReceiptIncludesQuantity(t *testing.T) {
15		// Exactly the param keys collection.announcePour produces.

23			t.Fatalf("english pour receipt %q missing litres 10.50", english)
24		}
25		if !strings.Contains(hindi, "10.50") {
26			t.Fatalf("hindi pour receipt %q missing litres 10.50", hindi)
27		}
28		if !strings.Contains(english, "52.75") || !strings.Contains(english, "553.88") {
```

```text
15	// Party is the single identity record per human (blueprint §4.1):
16	// one phone number = one Party = many org-scoped RoleAssignments.

27		UpdatedAt         time.Time          `bson:"updated_at"    json:"updated_at"`
28	}
29	
30	// RoleAssignment statuses.
31	const (
32		RoleAssignmentActive  = "ACTIVE"
33		RoleAssignmentRevoked = "REVOKED"
34	)
35	
36	// RoleAssignment grants one role to one party inside one org unit for a
37	// validity window. Revoking a Sacheev after an election is a single record
38	// update — never an account deletion (blueprint §4.1).
39	type RoleAssignment struct {
40		ID        primitive.ObjectID  `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
41		PartyID   primitive.ObjectID  `bson:"party_id"      json:"party_id"`
42		RoleCode  string              `bson:"role_code"     json:"role_code"`
43		OrgUnitID primitive.ObjectID  `bson:"org_unit_id"   json:"org_unit_id"`
44		GrantedBy *primitive.ObjectID `bson:"granted_by,omitempty" json:"granted_by,omitempty"`
45		ValidFrom time.Time           `bson:"valid_from"    json:"valid_from"`
46		ValidTo   *time.Time          `bson:"valid_to,omitempty"   json:"valid_to,omitempty"` // nil = open-ended
47		Status    string              `bson:"status"        json:"status"`
48		RevokedAt *time.Time          `bson:"revoked_at,omitempty" json:"revoked_at,omitempty"`
49		RevokedBy *primitive.ObjectID `bson:"revoked_by,omitempty" json:"revoked_by,omitempty"`
50		CreatedAt time.Time           `bson:"created_at"    json:"created_at"`
51	}
52	
53	// UsableAt reports whether the assignment is active and inside its validity
54	// window at instant t.
55	func (ra RoleAssignment) UsableAt(t time.Time) bool {
56		if ra.Status != RoleAssignmentActive {
57			return false
58		}
59		if t.Before(ra.ValidFrom) {
60			return false
61		}
62		if ra.ValidTo != nil && t.After(*ra.ValidTo) {
63			return false
64		}
65		return true
66	}

88		BankAccountMasked string               `bson:"bank_account_masked,omitempty" json:"bank_account_masked,omitempty"`

91		BankNameMatch     float64              `bson:"bank_name_match,omitempty"     json:"bank_name_match,omitempty"` // penny-drop name-match score 0..1
92		DigiLockerDocs    []DocRef             `bson:"digilocker_docs,omitempty"     json:"digilocker_docs,omitempty"`
93		VideoKYCRef       string               `bson:"video_kyc_ref,omitempty"       json:"video_kyc_ref,omitempty"`
94		ConsentID         *primitive.ObjectID  `bson:"consent_id,omitempty"          json:"consent_id,omitempty"`
```

```text
1	// Package domain holds the pure entity model of Saathi — structs, enums and
2	// invariants shared by every module. It has no behaviour beyond validation
3	// and no dependencies outside the standard library and BSON primitives.
4	// This is the contract layer: modules depend on domain, never the other way
5	// around.
6	package domain
7	
8	// Role codes — the role catalog from blueprint §5.2, grounded in the PCDF
9	// cooperative constitution (Farmer → Samiti/DCS → Sangh/Union → PCDF).
10	// A Party may hold many time-bounded, org-scoped RoleAssignments.
11	//
12	// The catalog is deliberately open for extension: adding a future role is a
13	// new constant + AllRoles entry + RequiredKYCTier entry — nothing else.
14	const (
15		// Village tier
16		RoleFarmer         = "FARMER"
17		RoleSamitiSacheev  = "SAMITI_SACHEEV"  // DCS paid Secretary (UPCS Act §31) — runs the collection console
18		RoleSamitiAdhyaksh = "SAMITI_ADHYAKSH" // DCS Chairman/Sabhapati (elected, honorary, §30)
19		RoleMilkTester     = "MILK_TESTER"

21		RoleAITech         = "AI_TECH"
22	
23		// Field / organisation tier

25		// Department pattern: "promotes and organises new samitis") who performs
26		// doorstep KYC capture and first-level verification.
27		RoleOrganisingManager = "ORGANISING_MANAGER"
28	
29		// Logistics tier
30		RoleVanRider      = "VAN_RIDER"
31		RoleDeliveryRider = "DELIVERY_RIDER"
32	
33		// Union tier
34		RoleBMCOperator          = "BMC_OPERATOR"
35		RoleUnionFieldSupervisor = "UNION_FIELD_SUPERVISOR"
36		RoleUnionPresident       = "UNION_PRESIDENT"
37	
38		// Plant tier
39		RolePlantOperator   = "PLANT_OPERATOR"
40		RolePlantLabAnalyst = "PLANT_LAB_ANALYST"
41	
42		// State / district tier
43		RolePCDFAdmin        = "PCDF_ADMIN"
44		RoleMissionOfficial  = "MISSION_OFFICIAL"
45		RoleDistrictVerifier = "DISTRICT_VERIFIER"
46	
47		// Health tier
48		RoleVeterinarian = "VETERINARIAN"
49		RoleMVUDriver    = "MVU_DRIVER"
50	
51		// Consumer tier
52		RoleConsumer = "CONSUMER"
53	
54		// Platform tier
55		RoleSupportAgent = "SUPPORT_AGENT"
56		RoleStateAuditor = "STATE_AUDITOR"
57		RoleSuperAdmin   = "SUPER_ADMIN"
58	
59		// System tier
60		RoleServiceAccount = "SERVICE_ACCOUNT"
61	)
62	
63	// AllRoles is the closed set of grantable role codes (extend here).
64	var AllRoles = []string{
65		RoleFarmer, RoleSamitiSacheev, RoleSamitiAdhyaksh, RoleMilkTester, RoleLRP, RoleAITech,
66		RoleOrganisingManager,
67		RoleVanRider, RoleDeliveryRider,
68		RoleBMCOperator, RoleUnionFieldSupervisor, RoleUnionPresident,
69		RolePlantOperator, RolePlantLabAnalyst,
70		RolePCDFAdmin, RoleMissionOfficial, RoleDistrictVerifier,
71		RoleVeterinarian, RoleMVUDriver,
72		RoleConsumer,
73		RoleSupportAgent, RoleStateAuditor, RoleSuperAdmin,
74		RoleServiceAccount,
75	}
76	
77	var roleSet = func() map[string]struct{} {
78		s := make(map[string]struct{}, len(AllRoles))
79		for _, r := range AllRoles {
80			s[r] = struct{}{}
81		}
82		return s
83	}()
84	
85	// IsValidRole reports whether code is one of the catalog roles.
86	func IsValidRole(code string) bool {
87		_, ok := roleSet[code]
88		return ok
89	}
90	
91	// KYC assurance tiers (blueprint §4.2). Higher tiers unlock higher-trust roles.
92	const (
93		KYCTierMinimal  = "MINIMAL"  // mobile OTP only (consumer)
94		KYCTierFarmer   = "FARMER"   // Aadhaar OTP eKYC or offline XML + penny-drop
95		KYCTierStandard = "STANDARD" // Aadhaar eKYC
96		KYCTierRider    = "RIDER"    // Aadhaar eKYC + DL/RC
97		KYCTierHigh     = "HIGH"     // eKYC + org record / V-CIP for officials
98		KYCTierHighest  = "HIGHEST"  // platform admin: MFA + dual-control
99		KYCTierService  = "SERVICE"  // machine accounts: mTLS / scoped keys
100	)
101	
102	// RequiredKYCTier maps each role to the minimum KYC tier a party must hold
103	// before a role token for it can be issued (blueprint §5.2 "KYC tier").
104	// Tier upgrades happen ONLY through the KYC approval workflow: submit →
105	// PENDING → reviewed by an authorised approver → VERIFIED. There is no
106	// self-service tier upgrade.
107	var RequiredKYCTier = map[string]string{
108		RoleFarmer:               KYCTierFarmer,
109		RoleSamitiSacheev:        KYCTierHigh,
110		RoleSamitiAdhyaksh:       KYCTierHigh,
111		RoleMilkTester:           KYCTierStandard,
112		RoleLRP:                  KYCTierStandard,
113		RoleAITech:               KYCTierStandard,
114		RoleOrganisingManager:    KYCTierHigh,
115		RoleVanRider:             KYCTierRider,
116		RoleDeliveryRider:        KYCTierRider,
117		RoleBMCOperator:          KYCTierStandard,
118		RoleUnionFieldSupervisor: KYCTierHigh,
119		RoleUnionPresident:       KYCTierHigh,
120		RolePlantOperator:        KYCTierHigh,
121		RolePlantLabAnalyst:      KYCTierHigh,
122		RolePCDFAdmin:            KYCTierHigh,
123		RoleMissionOfficial:      KYCTierHigh,
124		RoleDistrictVerifier:     KYCTierHigh,
125		RoleVeterinarian:         KYCTierHigh,
126		RoleMVUDriver:            KYCTierStandard,
127		RoleConsumer:             KYCTierMinimal,
128		RoleSupportAgent:         KYCTierHigh,
129		RoleStateAuditor:         KYCTierHigh,
130		RoleSuperAdmin:           KYCTierHighest,
131		RoleServiceAccount:       KYCTierService,
132	}
133	
134	// kycRank orders tiers so "tier X satisfies requirement Y" is a comparison.
135	var kycRank = map[string]int{
136		KYCTierMinimal:  0,
137		KYCTierFarmer:   1,
138		KYCTierStandard: 1, // Farmer and Standard are parallel tier-1 proofs
139		KYCTierRider:    2,
140		KYCTierHigh:     3,
141		KYCTierHighest:  4,
142		KYCTierService:  4,
143	}
144	
145	// KYCTierSatisfies reports whether a party at tier `have` meets `need`.
146	// Parallel tier-1 proofs (FARMER vs STANDARD) satisfy each other.
147	func KYCTierSatisfies(have, need string) bool {
148		h, okH := kycRank[have]
149		n, okN := kycRank[need]
150		if !okH || !okN {
151			return false
152		}
153		return h >= n
154	}
155	
156	// KYCApprovableTiers maps an approver ROLE to the KYC tiers it may approve.
157	// Ground staff clear the field tiers; only federation admins clear HIGH;
158	// only SUPER_ADMIN clears HIGHEST. Extend when new approver roles arrive.
159	var KYCApprovableTiers = map[string][]string{
160		RoleOrganisingManager: {KYCTierMinimal, KYCTierFarmer, KYCTierStandard, KYCTierRider},
161		RoleDistrictVerifier:  {KYCTierMinimal, KYCTierFarmer, KYCTierStandard, KYCTierRider},
162		RolePCDFAdmin:         {KYCTierMinimal, KYCTierFarmer, KYCTierStandard, KYCTierRider, KYCTierHigh},
163		RoleSuperAdmin:        {KYCTierMinimal, KYCTierFarmer, KYCTierStandard, KYCTierRider, KYCTierHigh, KYCTierHighest, KYCTierService},
164	}
165	
166	// CanApproveKYCTier reports whether approverRole may approve a KYC record
167	// requesting the given tier.
168	func CanApproveKYCTier(approverRole, tier string) bool {
169		for _, t := range KYCApprovableTiers[approverRole] {
170			if t == tier {
171				return true
172			}
173		}
174		return false
175	}
176
```

```text
27		OrgTypeMilkUnion:       {OrgTypeFederation},
28		OrgTypeProcessingPlant: {OrgTypeMilkUnion, OrgTypeFederation},
29		OrgTypeBMC:             {OrgTypeMilkUnion},
30		OrgTypeDCS:             {OrgTypeMilkUnion, OrgTypeBMC},
31	}
32	
33	// OrgUnit is a node in the cooperative hierarchy.
34	//
35	// ID scheme: `_id` is a generated ObjectID (relations always reference it);
36	// Code is the human-readable unique business key (e.g. "DCS-01842") used for
37	// display, lookups and seed idempotency — never for joins.
38	//
39	// Path holds the ObjectIDs of all ancestors from the root down to (and
40	// excluding) this node — denormalised so "is X inside Y's scope" is a single
41	// indexed array-containment check with no recursive queries on the hot path.
42	type OrgUnit struct {
43		ID        primitive.ObjectID   `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
44		Type      string               `bson:"type"          json:"type"`
45		Name      string               `bson:"name"          json:"name"`
46		Code      string               `bson:"code"          json:"code"` // unique business key, e.g. "DCS-01842"
47		ParentID  *primitive.ObjectID  `bson:"parent_id,omitempty" json:"parent_id,omitempty"`
48		Path      []primitive.ObjectID `bson:"path"          json:"path"`
```

```text
// setFlag flips one well-known feature flag and writes the explicit

func (s *service) setFlag(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, key string, enabled bool) (*SetFlagResponse, error) {

		Meta:       map[string]any{"key": key, "enabled": enabled},

type Page struct {
	Limit  int64 `json:"limit"`
	Offset int64 `json:"offset"`
}

// ParsePage reads ?limit= and ?offset= with sane bounds (default 50, max 200).
func ParsePage(r *http.Request) Page {
	p := Page{Limit: 50, Offset: 0}
	if v := r.URL.Query().Get("limit"); v != "" {
		if n, err := strconv.ParseInt(v, 10, 64); err == nil && n > 0 {
			p.Limit = min(n, 200)
		}
	}
	if v := r.URL.Query().Get("offset"); v != "" {
		if n, err := strconv.ParseInt(v, 10, 64); err == nil && n >= 0 {
			p.Offset = n
		}
	}
	return p
}
```

```text
// RequireRoles allows only ROLE-kind tokens whose role is in the allow-list.
// SUPER_ADMIN passes every gate (break-glass admin — all its calls are
// audited by the audit middleware).
func RequireRoles(roles ...string) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
	allowed := make(map[string]struct{}, len(roles))
	for _, r := range roles {
		allowed[r] = struct{}{}
	}
	return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
		return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
			actor, ok := auth.ActorFrom(r.Context())
			if !ok {
				httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Unauthorized("authentication required"))
				return
			}
			if actor.Kind != auth.TokenKindRole {
				httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Forbidden("a role token is required — select a role first (POST /api/v1/auth/role/select)"))
				return
			}
			if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSuperAdmin {
				next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
				return
			}
			if _, ok := allowed[actor.RoleCode]; !ok {
				httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Forbidden("role "+actor.RoleCode+" is not permitted for this action"))
				return
			}
			next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
		})
	}
}
```

```text
// Package collection implements the core procurement loop of Saathi
// (blueprint §8.1, §8.2): org-scoped rate charts, anti-tamper analyzer
// readings, offline-first idempotent milk pours with same-day pricing, and
// per-farmer daily invoices behind the same-day payment promise.
//
// Bus topics published by this module:
//   - eventbus.TopicPourRecorded  — payload domain.MilkPour (the newly recorded pour)
//   - eventbus.TopicInvoiceIssued — payload domain.Invoice (the newly issued invoice)
package collection

import (
	"log/slog"

	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"

	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/middleware"
)

// Register mounts the collection module under /collection and wires the
// handler → service → repo stack onto the shared platform dependencies.
func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
	log := d.Log.With(slog.String("module", "collection"))
	repo := newRepo(d)
	svc := newService(d, repo, log)
	h := &handler{svc: svc}

	r.Route("/collection", func(r chi.Router) {
		r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))

		// Rate charts: pricing policy is set at union/federation level and
		// resolved downward to each DCS (nearest ancestor wins).
		r.Route("/rate-charts", func(r chi.Router) {
			r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RolePCDFAdmin, domain.RoleUnionPresident)).
				Post("/", h.createRateChart)
			r.With(middleware.RequireSession).Get("/active", h.getActiveRateChart)
		})

		// Analyzer readings: flagged, never rejected (anti-tamper envelope §8.2).
		r.Route("/readings", func(r chi.Router) {
			r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSamitiSacheev, domain.RoleMilkTester)).
				Post("/", h.createReading)
			r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(
				domain.RoleSamitiSacheev, domain.RoleMilkTester, domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor,
			)).Get("/", h.listReadings)
		})

		// Pours: THE core loop — offline-first idempotent, hard plausibility gate.
		r.Route("/pours", func(r chi.Router) {
			r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
				r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSamitiSacheev, domain.RoleMilkTester))
				r.Post("/", h.createPour)
				r.Post("/batch-sync", h.batchSyncPours)
				r.Post("/{id}/supersede", h.supersedePour)
			})
			r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(
				domain.RoleSamitiSacheev, domain.RoleMilkTester,
				domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor, domain.RoleFarmer,
			)).Get("/", h.listPours)
		})

		// Invoices: the same-day settlement artefact (§8.1).
		r.Route("/invoices", func(r chi.Router) {
			r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSamitiSacheev)).
				Post("/generate", h.generateInvoices)
			r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
				r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(
					domain.RoleFarmer, domain.RoleSamitiSacheev, domain.RoleSamitiAdhyaksh,
					domain.RoleMilkTester, domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor,
					domain.RoleUnionPresident, domain.RolePCDFAdmin,
				))
				r.Get("/", h.listInvoices)
				r.Get("/{id}", h.getInvoice)
			})
		})
	})
}
```

```text
30		IP           string         `bson:"ip,omitempty"          json:"ip,omitempty"`
31		RequestID    string         `bson:"request_id,omitempty"  json:"request_id,omitempty"`
32		Meta         map[string]any `bson:"meta,omitempty"        json:"meta,omitempty"`
33		TS           time.Time      `bson:"ts"             json:"ts"`
34	}
35	
36	// Recorder persists audit entries asynchronously so auditing never adds
37	// latency to the request path.
38	type Recorder struct {
39		coll *mongo.Collection
40		log  *slog.Logger
41	}
42	
43	// NewRecorder binds the recorder to the database.
44	func NewRecorder(db *mongo.Database, log *slog.Logger) *Recorder {
45		return &Recorder{coll: db.Collection(collection), log: log}
46	}
47	
48	// Record fills identity fields from the request context and persists the
49	// entry in the background (fire-and-forget with its own timeout).
50	func (r *Recorder) Record(ctx context.Context, e Entry) {
51		if a, ok := auth.ActorFrom(ctx); ok {
52			if e.ActorPartyID == "" {
53				e.ActorPartyID = a.PartyID
54			}
55			if e.ActorRole == "" {
56				e.ActorRole = a.RoleCode
57			}
58		}
59		e.ID = primitive.NewObjectID()
60		e.TS = time.Now().UTC()
61	
62		go func() {
63			writeCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
64			defer cancel()
65			if _, err := r.coll.InsertOne(writeCtx, e); err != nil {
66				r.log.Error("audit write failed", slog.String("action", e.Action), slog.Any("err", err))
67			}
68		}()
69	}
```

```text
44	// mounted before authentication uses it to observe the actor after the
45	// handler chain ran.
46	func WithActorHolder(ctx context.Context) context.Context {
47		return context.WithValue(ctx, actorHolderCtxKey{}, &actorHolder{})
48	}
49	
50	// HeldActor returns the actor captured by an inner WithActor call, if a
51	// holder was installed and authentication happened.
52	func HeldActor(ctx context.Context) (Actor, bool) {
53		h, ok := ctx.Value(actorHolderCtxKey{}).(*actorHolder)
54		if !ok {
55			return Actor{}, false
56		}
57		h.mu.Lock()
58		defer h.mu.Unlock()
59		if h.a == nil {
60			return Actor{}, false
61		}
62		return *h.a, true
63	}
64	
65	// WithActor stores the actor on the context, and also fills the outward
66	// actor holder when one was installed upstream (see WithActorHolder).
67	func WithActor(ctx context.Context, a Actor) context.Context {
68		if h, ok := ctx.Value(actorHolderCtxKey{}).(*actorHolder); ok {
69			h.mu.Lock()
70			cp := a
71			h.a = &cp
72			h.mu.Unlock()
73		}
74		return context.WithValue(ctx, actorCtxKey{}, a)
75	}
76	
77	// ActorFrom retrieves the actor, if any.
78	func ActorFrom(ctx context.Context) (Actor, bool) {
79		a, ok := ctx.Value(actorCtxKey{}).(Actor)
80		return a, ok
81	}
82
```

```text
// service holds all business logic of the collection module.
type service struct {
	d    *deps.Deps
	repo *repo
	log  *slog.Logger
}

// newService wires the service onto the platform dependencies. log is the
// module-scoped logger derived in Register.
func newService(d *deps.Deps, r *repo, log *slog.Logger) *service {
	return &service{d: d, repo: r, log: log}
}

// actorID parses the actor's party id (carried as an ObjectID hex string in
// the JWT) into a primitive.ObjectID — call once per service method that
// stores or compares the actor's identity.
func actorID(actor auth.Actor) (primitive.ObjectID, error) {
	return httpx.ParseID(actor.PartyID, "actor")
}
```

```text
104		}
105		return flags
106	}
```

```text
40		QCSubjectProcessingBatch = "PROCESSING_BATCH"
41	)
42	
43	// QCTest is a single measurement inside a QC result.
44	type QCTest struct {
45		Name  string  `bson:"name"  json:"name"`
46		Value float64 `bson:"value" json:"value"`
47		Unit  string  `bson:"unit"  json:"unit"`
48		Pass  bool    `bson:"pass"  json:"pass"`
49	}
50	
51	// QCResult is the recorded outcome of testing one subject at one stage.
52	// OverallPass drives the safety gate; a certificate is attached to provenance
53	// on pass, a block + quarantine on fail.
54	type QCResult struct {
55		ID                primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
56		SubjectType       string             `bson:"subject_type"  json:"subject_type"`
57		SubjectID         primitive.ObjectID `bson:"subject_id"    json:"subject_id"`
58		Stage             string             `bson:"stage"         json:"stage"`
59		Tests             []QCTest           `bson:"tests"         json:"tests"`
60		OverallPass       bool               `bson:"overall_pass"  json:"overall_pass"`
61		FailureReasons    []string           `bson:"failure_reasons,omitempty" json:"failure_reasons,omitempty"`
62		AnalystPartyID    primitive.ObjectID `bson:"analyst_party_id" json:"analyst_party_id"`
63		LabRef            string             `bson:"lab_ref,omitempty"            json:"lab_ref,omitempty"`
64		CertificateNumber string             `bson:"certificate_number,omitempty" json:"certificate_number,omitempty"`
65		// Superseded marks a result voided after losing the gate race — the
66		// verdict on the subject came from a different, earlier result.
67		Superseded    bool      `bson:"superseded,omitempty" json:"superseded,omitempty"`
68		RecordedAt    time.Time `bson:"recorded_at"   json:"recorded_at"`
69		ProvenanceSeq int64     `bson:"provenance_seq,omitempty" json:"provenance_seq,omitempty"`
70	}
71	
72	// EvaluateQCTests applies the FSSAI gate to a set of tests: it fills each
73	// test's Pass verdict and returns the overall verdict plus human-readable
74	// failure reasons. Unknown test names are recorded but do not gate.
75	func EvaluateQCTests(tests []QCTest) (overallPass bool, failures []string, evaluated []QCTest) {
76		overallPass = true
77		evaluated = make([]QCTest, 0, len(tests))
78		for _, t := range tests {
79			pass := true
80			switch t.Name {
81			case TestAflatoxinM1:
82				if t.Value > FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg {
83					pass = false
84					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
85						"AFLATOXIN_M1 %.3f µg/kg exceeds FSSAI limit %.1f µg/kg", t.Value, FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg))
86				}
87			case TestColiform:
88				if t.Value > FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl {
89					pass = false
90					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
91						"COLIFORM %.1f CFU/ml exceeds FSSAI limit %.0f CFU/ml", t.Value, FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl))
92				}
93			case TestAntibiotic:
94				if t.Value > FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg {
95					pass = false
96					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
97						"ANTIBIOTIC_TETRACYCLINE %.3f mg/kg exceeds MRL %.1f mg/kg", t.Value, FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg))
98				}
99			case TestPhosphatase:
100				if t.Value != 0 {
101					pass = false
102					failures = append(failures, "PHOSPHATASE positive — pasteurisation check failed (must be negative)")
103				}
104			}
105			t.Pass = pass
106			if !pass {
107				overallPass = false
108			}
109			evaluated = append(evaluated, t)
110		}
111		return overallPass, failures, evaluated
112	}
113
```

```text
13	// RequestLogger emits one structured log line per request — method, path,
14	// status, duration, request ID, client IP, and the acting party/role when
15	// authenticated. This is the debugging backbone: every request is traceable
16	// end-to-end by request_id across handler/service/repo logs.
17	func RequestLogger(log *slog.Logger) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
18		return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
19			return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
20				start := time.Now()
21				ww := chimw.NewWrapResponseWriter(w, r.ProtoMajor)
22				next.ServeHTTP(ww, r)
23	
24				attrs := []slog.Attr{
25					slog.String("method", r.Method),
26					slog.String("path", r.URL.Path),
27					slog.Int("status", ww.Status()),
28					slog.Int64("duration_ms", time.Since(start).Milliseconds()),
29					slog.String("request_id", chimw.GetReqID(r.Context())),
30					slog.String("ip", r.RemoteAddr),
31				}
32				if a, ok := auth.ActorFrom(r.Context()); ok {
33					attrs = append(attrs,
34						slog.String("actor_party_id", a.PartyID),
35						slog.String("actor_role", a.RoleCode),
36					)
37				}
38	
39				level := slog.LevelInfo
40				switch {
41				case ww.Status() >= 500:
42					level = slog.LevelError
43				case ww.Status() >= 400:
44					level = slog.LevelWarn
45				}
46				log.LogAttrs(r.Context(), level, "http request", attrs...)
47			})
48		}
49	}
```

```text
1	// Package httpx is the HTTP toolkit shared by every module: typed errors,
2	// uniform JSON envelopes, strict request decoding, pagination.
3	package httpx
4	
5	import (
6		"fmt"
7		"net/http"
8	)
9	
10	// AppError is the single error type handlers return. It carries the HTTP
11	// status plus a stable machine-readable code the frontend can switch on.
12	type AppError struct {
13		Status  int    `json:"-"`
14		Code    string `json:"code"`
15		Message string `json:"message"`
16		Details any    `json:"details,omitempty"`
17	
18		cause error // wrapped internal error — logged server-side, never serialised
19	}
20	
21	func (e *AppError) Error() string {
22		return fmt.Sprintf("%d %s: %s", e.Status, e.Code, e.Message)
23	}
24	
25	// WithDetails returns a copy carrying extra structured context.
26	func (e *AppError) WithDetails(d any) *AppError {
27		cp := *e
28		cp.Details = d
29		return &cp
30	}
31	
32	func newErr(status int, code, msg string) *AppError {
33		return &AppError{Status: status, Code: code, Message: msg}
34	}
35	
36	// Constructors — use these instead of raw errors in handlers/services.
37	
38	func BadRequest(code, msg string) *AppError { return newErr(http.StatusBadRequest, code, msg) }
39	
40	func Unauthorized(msg string) *AppError { return newErr(http.StatusUnauthorized, "UNAUTHORIZED", msg) }
41	
42	func Forbidden(msg string) *AppError { return newErr(http.StatusForbidden, "FORBIDDEN", msg) }
43	
44	func NotFound(resource string) *AppError {
45		return newErr(http.StatusNotFound, "NOT_FOUND", resource+" not found")
46	}
47	
48	// RouteNotFound is the router-level 404 for unmatched paths, keeping the
49	// uniform JSON error envelope on typo'd routes.
50	func RouteNotFound() *AppError {
51		return newErr(http.StatusNotFound, "NOT_FOUND", "route not found")
52	}
53	
54	// MethodNotAllowed is the router-level 405 for wrong-method requests.
55	func MethodNotAllowed() *AppError {
56		return newErr(http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", "method not allowed for this route")
57	}
58	
59	func Conflict(code, msg string) *AppError { return newErr(http.StatusConflict, code, msg) }
60	
61	func Unprocessable(code, msg string) *AppError {
62		return newErr(http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, code, msg)
63	}
64	
65	func TooManyRequests(msg string) *AppError {
66		return newErr(http.StatusTooManyRequests, "RATE_LIMITED", msg)
67	}
68	
69	// Internal wraps an unexpected error. The cause is logged server-side but
70	// never leaked to the client.
71	func Internal(err error) *AppError {
72		e := newErr(http.StatusInternalServerError, "INTERNAL", "internal server error")
73		e.cause = err
74		return e
75	}
76	
77	func (e *AppError) Unwrap() error { return e.cause }
```

```text
3	import (
4		"encoding/json"
5		"errors"
6		"log/slog"
7		"net/http"
8	)
9	
10	// envelope is the uniform success shape: {"data": ..., "meta": {...}?}.
11	type envelope struct {
12		Data any `json:"data"`
13		Meta any `json:"meta,omitempty"`
14	}
15	
16	type errEnvelope struct {
17		Error *AppError `json:"error"`
18	}
19	
20	// JSON writes a success response wrapped in the standard envelope.
21	func JSON(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, data any) {
22		writeJSON(w, status, envelope{Data: data})
23	}
24	
25	// JSONMeta writes a success response with list metadata (pagination etc.).
26	func JSONMeta(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, data, meta any) {
27		writeJSON(w, status, envelope{Data: data, Meta: meta})
28	}
29	
30	// Error writes the standard error envelope. Unexpected (non-AppError) errors
31	// become an opaque 500 and the cause is logged with the request context.
32	func Error(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, err error) {
33		var ae *AppError
34		if !errors.As(err, &ae) {
35			ae = Internal(err)
36		}
37		if ae.Status >= 500 {
38			slog.ErrorContext(r.Context(), "request failed",
39				slog.String("method", r.Method),
40				slog.String("path", r.URL.Path),
41				slog.String("code", ae.Code),
42				slog.Any("cause", ae.CauseOrSelf()),
43			)
44		}
45		writeJSON(w, ae.Status, errEnvelope{Error: ae})
46	}
47	
48	// CauseOrSelf returns the wrapped cause if present, else the error itself.
49	func (e *AppError) CauseOrSelf() error {
50		if e.cause != nil {
51			return e.cause
52		}
53		return e
54	}
55	
56	func writeJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, v any) {
57		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
58		w.WriteHeader(status)
59		_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(v)
60	}
```
