1	package identity
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"errors"
6		"fmt"
7		"time"
8	
9		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
10		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
11		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
12		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo/options"
13	
14		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
16		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/mongodb"
17	)
18	
19	// otpChallenge is the persisted OTP challenge. Only the HMAC digest of the
20	// code is stored — a DB leak alone reveals no usable credential. Challenges
21	// are keyed by phone (string) — the party may not exist yet at login time.
22	type otpChallenge struct {
23		ID        string    `bson:"_id"`
24		Phone     string    `bson:"phone"`
25		CodeHash  string    `bson:"code_hash"`
26		ExpiresAt time.Time `bson:"expires_at"`
27		Attempts  int       `bson:"attempts"`
28	}
29	
30	// refreshTokenDoc is the persisted refresh-token digest. The opaque token
31	// itself is only ever held by the client. party_id is an ObjectID reference.
32	type refreshTokenDoc struct {
33		ID        primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id,omitempty"`
34		TokenHash string             `bson:"token_hash"`
35		PartyID   primitive.ObjectID `bson:"party_id"`
36		ExpiresAt time.Time          `bson:"expires_at"`
37		CreatedAt time.Time          `bson:"created_at"`
38	}
39	
40	// repository is the MongoDB gateway for the identity module. Pure data
41	// access — no business rules.
42	type repository struct {
43		parties       *mongo.Collection
44		challenges    *mongo.Collection
45		tokens        *mongo.Collection
46		assignments   *mongo.Collection
47		kycRecords    *mongo.Collection
48		consents      *mongo.Collection
49		notifications *mongo.Collection
50	}
51	
52	// newRepository binds the repository to the module's collections.
53	func newRepository(db *mongo.Database) *repository {
54		return &repository{
55			parties:       db.Collection(mongodb.CollParties),
56			challenges:    db.Collection(mongodb.CollOTPChallenges),
57			tokens:        db.Collection(mongodb.CollRefreshTokens),
58			assignments:   db.Collection(mongodb.CollRoleAssignments),
59			kycRecords:    db.Collection(mongodb.CollKYCRecords),
60			consents:      db.Collection(mongodb.CollConsents),
61			notifications: db.Collection(mongodb.CollNotifications),
62		}
63	}
64	
65	// --- OTP challenges ---
66	
67	// insertOTPChallenge stores a fresh challenge.
68	func (r *repository) insertOTPChallenge(ctx context.Context, ch otpChallenge) error {
69		if _, err := r.challenges.InsertOne(ctx, ch); err != nil {
70			return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("insert otp challenge: %w", err))
71		}
72		return nil
73	}
74	
75	// latestOTPChallenge returns the most recent unexpired challenge for phone.
76	func (r *repository) latestOTPChallenge(ctx context.Context, phone string, now time.Time) (*otpChallenge, error) {
77		filter := bson.D{
78			{Key: "phone", Value: phone},
79			{Key: "expires_at", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$gt", Value: now}}},
80		}
81		opts := options.FindOne().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "expires_at", Value: -1}})
82		var ch otpChallenge
83		err := r.challenges.FindOne(ctx, filter, opts).Decode(&ch)
84		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
85			return nil, httpx.NotFound("otp challenge")
86		}
87		if err != nil {
88			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("find otp challenge: %w", err))
89		}
90		return &ch, nil
91	}
92	
93	// incrementOTPAttempts counts one failed verification attempt.
94	func (r *repository) incrementOTPAttempts(ctx context.Context, id string) error {
95		_, err := r.challenges.UpdateByID(ctx, id, bson.D{
96			{Key: "$inc", Value: bson.D{{Key: "attempts", Value: 1}}},
97		})
98		if err != nil {
99			return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("increment otp attempts: %w", err))
100		}
101		return nil
102	}
103	
104	// deleteOTPChallenges removes every challenge for a phone (post-login burn).
105	func (r *repository) deleteOTPChallenges(ctx context.Context, phone string) error {
106		if _, err := r.challenges.DeleteMany(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "phone", Value: phone}}); err != nil {
107			return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("delete otp challenges: %w", err))
108		}
109		return nil
110	}
111	
112	// --- Notifications (outbox) ---
113	
114	// insertNotification queues an outbox message for the platformops sender.
115	func (r *repository) insertNotification(ctx context.Context, n domain.Notification) error {
116		if _, err := r.notifications.InsertOne(ctx, n); err != nil {
117			return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("insert notification: %w", err))
118		}
119		return nil
120	}
121	
122	// --- Parties ---
123	
124	// findPartyByPhone loads a party by its unique phone number (business key —
125	// display/login lookups only, never joins).
126	func (r *repository) findPartyByPhone(ctx context.Context, phone string) (*domain.Party, error) {
127		var p domain.Party
128		err := r.parties.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "phone", Value: phone}}).Decode(&p)
129		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
130			return nil, httpx.NotFound("party")
131		}
132		if err != nil {
133			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("find party by phone: %w", err))
134		}
135		return &p, nil
136	}
137	
138	// findPartyByID loads a party by ObjectID.
139	func (r *repository) findPartyByID(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.Party, error) {
140		var p domain.Party
141		err := r.parties.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&p)
142		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
143			return nil, httpx.NotFound("party")
144		}
145		if err != nil {
146			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("find party by id: %w", err))
147		}
148		return &p, nil
149	}

151	// findPartiesByIDs loads a batch of parties keyed by ObjectID (list
152	// enrichment; missing parties are simply absent from the map).
153	func (r *repository) findPartiesByIDs(ctx context.Context, ids []primitive.ObjectID) (map[primitive.ObjectID]domain.Party, error) {
154		out := make(map[primitive.ObjectID]domain.Party, len(ids))
155		if len(ids) == 0 {
156			return out, nil
157		}
158		cur, err := r.parties.Find(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: ids}}}})
159		if err != nil {
160			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("find parties by ids: %w", err))
161		}
162		var parties []domain.Party
163		if err := cur.All(ctx, &parties); err != nil {
164			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("decode parties by ids: %w", err))
165		}
166		for _, p := range parties {
167			out[p.ID] = p
168		}
169		return out, nil
170	}

172	// upsertPartyByPhone atomically finds or creates the party for a phone —
173	// race-safe under the unique phone index (one phone = one Party, §4.1).
174	func (r *repository) upsertPartyByPhone(ctx context.Context, phone string, now time.Time) (*domain.Party, error) {
175		update := bson.D{{Key: "$setOnInsert", Value: bson.D{
176			{Key: "_id", Value: primitive.NewObjectID()},
177			{Key: "phone", Value: phone},
178			{Key: "kyc_tier", Value: domain.KYCTierMinimal},
179			{Key: "status", Value: domain.PartyStatusActive},
180			{Key: "created_at", Value: now},
181			{Key: "updated_at", Value: now},
182		}}}
183		opts := options.FindOneAndUpdate().SetUpsert(true).SetReturnDocument(options.After)
184		var p domain.Party
185		if err := r.parties.FindOneAndUpdate(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "phone", Value: phone}}, update, opts).Decode(&p); err != nil {
186			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("upsert party by phone: %w", err))
187		}
188		return &p, nil
189	}

205			return nil, httpx.NotFound("party")

472			{Key: "verified_at", Value: now},

1	// Package identity owns authentication (OTP login, refresh-token rotation,
2	// role selection), the Party registry, org-scoped role assignments and the
3	// KYC approval workflow — blueprint §4 (identity) and §5 (roles & RBAC).
4	//
5	// The KYC flow is: login → submit KYC (PENDING) → an authorised reviewer
6	// (Organising Manager / District Verifier / PCDF Admin / Super Admin)
7	// approves or rejects → only a VERIFIED tier unlocks the matching role token.
8	//
9	// Route prefixes (mounted under /api/v1): /auth, /parties, /roles, /kyc.
10	// This module emits no provenance events; identity changes are covered by
11	// the audit middleware and explicit audit records on KYC review.
12	package identity
13	
14	import (
15		"log/slog"
16	
17		"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
18	
19		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
20		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
21		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/middleware"
22	)
23	
24	// Register wires repo → service → handler and mounts the identity routes.
25	func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
26		log := d.Log.With(slog.String("module", "identity"))
27		repo := newRepository(d.DB)
28		svc := newService(d, repo, log)
29		h := newHandler(svc)
30	
31		r.Route("/auth", func(r chi.Router) {
32			// Public login flow — no token yet.
33			r.Post("/otp/request", h.requestOTP)
34			r.Post("/otp/verify", h.verifyOTP)
35			r.Post("/refresh", h.refresh)
36	
37			// Any logged-in party (session or role token).
38			r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
39				r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT), middleware.RequireSession)
40				r.Post("/logout", h.logout)
41				r.Get("/roles", h.listMyRoles)
42				r.Post("/role/select", h.selectRole)
43			})
44		})
45	
46		r.Route("/parties", func(r chi.Router) {
47			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT), middleware.RequireSession)
48			r.Get("/me", h.getMe)
49			r.Patch("/me", h.patchMe)
50		})
51	
52		r.Route("/kyc", func(r chi.Router) {
53			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
54	
55			// Self-service KYC: any logged-in party submits evidence.
56			r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
57				r.Use(middleware.RequireSession)
58				r.Post("/aadhaar", h.verifyAadhaar)
59				r.Post("/bank", h.verifyBank)
60				r.Get("/me", h.listMyKYC)
61			})
62	
63			// Review console: ground staff and admins approve/reject PENDING KYC.
64			r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
65				r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(
66					domain.RoleOrganisingManager,
67					domain.RoleDistrictVerifier,
68					domain.RolePCDFAdmin,
69					domain.RoleSuperAdmin,
70				))
71				r.Get("/pending", h.listPendingKYC)
72				r.Post("/{id}/approve", h.approveKYC)
73				r.Post("/{id}/reject", h.rejectKYC)
74			})
75		})
76	
77		r.Route("/roles", func(r chi.Router) {
78			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
79			// SUPER_ADMIN passes RequireRoles automatically; the fine-grained
80			// granter matrix (§5.2) is enforced in the service.
81			r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(
82				domain.RolePCDFAdmin,
83				domain.RoleUnionPresident,
84				domain.RoleSamitiAdhyaksh,
85				domain.RoleOrganisingManager,
86			))
87			r.Post("/assignments", h.createAssignment)
88			r.Delete("/assignments/{id}", h.revokeAssignment)
89			r.Get("/assignments", h.listAssignments)
90		})
91	}

126		RoleMVUDriver:            KYCTierStandard,

128		RoleSupportAgent:         KYCTierHigh,
129		RoleStateAuditor:         KYCTierHigh,
130		RoleSuperAdmin:           KYCTierHighest,
131		RoleServiceAccount:       KYCTierService,
132	}

134	// kycRank orders tiers so "tier X satisfies requirement Y" is a comparison.
135	var kycRank = map[string]int{
136		KYCTierMinimal:  0,
137		KYCTierFarmer:   1,
138		KYCTierStandard: 1, // Farmer and Standard are parallel tier-1 proofs
139		KYCTierRider:    2,

145	// KYCTierSatisfies reports whether a party at tier `have` meets `need`.
146	// Parallel tier-1 proofs (FARMER vs STANDARD) satisfy each other.
147	func KYCTierSatisfies(have, need string) bool {
148		h, okH := kycRank[have]
149		n, okN := kycRank[need]
150		if !okH || !okN {
151			return false
152		}
153		return h >= n
154	}
155	
156	// KYCApprovableTiers maps an approver ROLE to the KYC tiers it may approve.
157	// Ground staff clear the field tiers; only federation admins clear HIGH;
158	// only SUPER_ADMIN clears HIGHEST. Extend when new approver roles arrive.
159	var KYCApprovableTiers = map[string][]string{
160		RoleOrganisingManager: {KYCTierMinimal, KYCTierFarmer, KYCTierStandard, KYCTierRider},
161		RoleDistrictVerifier:  {KYCTierMinimal, KYCTierFarmer, KYCTierStandard, KYCTierRider},
162		RolePCDFAdmin:         {KYCTierMinimal, KYCTierFarmer, KYCTierStandard, KYCTierRider, KYCTierHigh},
163		RoleSuperAdmin:        {KYCTierMinimal, KYCTierFarmer, KYCTierStandard, KYCTierRider, KYCTierHigh, KYCTierHighest, KYCTierService},
164	}
165	
166	// CanApproveKYCTier reports whether approverRole may approve a KYC record
167	// requesting the given tier.
168	func CanApproveKYCTier(approverRole, tier string) bool {
169		for _, t := range KYCApprovableTiers[approverRole] {
170			if t == tier {
171				return true
172			}
173		}
174		return false
175	}

1	package domain
2	
3	import (
4		"time"
5	
6		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
7	)
8	
9	// Party statuses.
10	const (
11		PartyStatusActive    = "ACTIVE"
12		PartyStatusSuspended = "SUSPENDED"
13	)
14	
15	// Party is the single identity record per human (blueprint §4.1):
16	// one phone number = one Party = many org-scoped RoleAssignments.
17	// `_id` is a generated ObjectID; `phone` is the unique natural key used for
18	// login — relations always reference the ObjectID, never the phone.
19	type Party struct {
20		ID                primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
21		Phone             string             `bson:"phone"         json:"phone"`
22		FullName          string             `bson:"full_name,omitempty"          json:"full_name,omitempty"`
23		PreferredLanguage string             `bson:"preferred_language,omitempty" json:"preferred_language,omitempty"` // "hi", "en", ...
24		KYCTier           string             `bson:"kyc_tier"      json:"kyc_tier"`
25		Status            string             `bson:"status"        json:"status"`
26		CreatedAt         time.Time          `bson:"created_at"    json:"created_at"`
27		UpdatedAt         time.Time          `bson:"updated_at"    json:"updated_at"`
28	}
29	
30	// RoleAssignment statuses.
31	const (
32		RoleAssignmentActive  = "ACTIVE"
33		RoleAssignmentRevoked = "REVOKED"
34	)
35	
36	// RoleAssignment grants one role to one party inside one org unit for a
37	// validity window. Revoking a Sacheev after an election is a single record
38	// update — never an account deletion (blueprint §4.1).
39	type RoleAssignment struct {
40		ID        primitive.ObjectID  `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
41		PartyID   primitive.ObjectID  `bson:"party_id"      json:"party_id"`
42		RoleCode  string              `bson:"role_code"     json:"role_code"`
43		OrgUnitID primitive.ObjectID  `bson:"org_unit_id"   json:"org_unit_id"`
44		GrantedBy *primitive.ObjectID `bson:"granted_by,omitempty" json:"granted_by,omitempty"`
45		ValidFrom time.Time           `bson:"valid_from"    json:"valid_from"`
46		ValidTo   *time.Time          `bson:"valid_to,omitempty"   json:"valid_to,omitempty"` // nil = open-ended
47		Status    string              `bson:"status"        json:"status"`
48		RevokedAt *time.Time          `bson:"revoked_at,omitempty" json:"revoked_at,omitempty"`
49		RevokedBy *primitive.ObjectID `bson:"revoked_by,omitempty" json:"revoked_by,omitempty"`
50		CreatedAt time.Time           `bson:"created_at"    json:"created_at"`
51	}
52	
53	// UsableAt reports whether the assignment is active and inside its validity
54	// window at instant t.
55	func (ra RoleAssignment) UsableAt(t time.Time) bool {
56		if ra.Status != RoleAssignmentActive {
57			return false
58		}
59		if t.Before(ra.ValidFrom) {
60			return false
61		}
62		if ra.ValidTo != nil && t.After(*ra.ValidTo) {
63			return false
64		}
65		return true
66	}
67	
68	// KYC record statuses — the approval workflow:
69	// submit → PENDING → (Organising Manager / District Verifier / PCDF Admin /
70	// Super Admin reviews) → VERIFIED (tier upgraded) or REJECTED (with reason).
71	// A role token is only issuable once the party's tier satisfies the role's
72	// RequiredKYCTier, so "login as rider" is impossible before approval.
73	const (
74		KYCStatusPending  = "PENDING"
75		KYCStatusVerified = "VERIFIED"
76		KYCStatusRejected = "REJECTED"
77	)
78	
79	// KYCRecord stores verification evidence for a party at a requested tier.
80	// Aadhaar compliance (blueprint §18-A): only the LAST 4 digits and an opaque
81	// vault reference are ever stored — never the full number, never biometrics.
82	type KYCRecord struct {
83		ID                primitive.ObjectID   `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`

1	// Package provenance implements the append-only, hash-chained event ledger —
2	// the source of truth for milk traceability (blueprint §7). Every link in the
3	// pour→QR chain is an immutable Event whose SHA-256 hash covers the previous
4	// event's hash, so history cannot be quietly rewritten (tamper-evidence,
5	// FSSAI recall-grade audit).
6	//
7	// Corrections are NEW events referencing the superseded entity — nothing is
8	// ever updated or deleted in this collection.
9	package provenance
10	
11	import (
12		"context"
13		"crypto/sha256"
14		"encoding/hex"
15		"encoding/json"
16		"errors"
17		"fmt"
18		"strconv"
19		"strings"
20		"sync"

31	// Ref is a directed edge to another entity in the trace graph
32	// (e.g. a consignment event referencing the pours it aggregates).
33	type Ref struct {
34		EntityType string `bson:"entity_type" json:"entity_type"`
35		EntityID   string `bson:"entity_id"   json:"entity_id"`
36		Relation   string `bson:"relation"    json:"relation"` // aggregates | supersedes | tested | yields | labels ...
37	}

41		PartyID  string `bson:"party_id"  json:"party_id"`
42		RoleCode string `bson:"role_code" json:"role_code"`
43	}
44	
45	// Event is one immutable link in the ledger. `_id` is a generated ObjectID;
46	// EntityID and Refs carry the referenced documents' ObjectIDs as hex strings
47	// (the ledger is a generic event log spanning every entity type, and hex
48	// strings keep the hash material canonical and human-inspectable).
49	type Event struct {
50		ID         primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
51		Seq        int64          `bson:"seq"         json:"seq"`
52		Type       string         `bson:"type"        json:"type"`
53		EntityType string         `bson:"entity_type" json:"entity_type"`
54		EntityID   string         `bson:"entity_id"   json:"entity_id"`
55		Refs       []Ref          `bson:"refs,omitempty"    json:"refs,omitempty"`
56		Actor      ActorRef       `bson:"actor"       json:"actor"`
57		OrgUnitID  string         `bson:"org_unit_id,omitempty" json:"org_unit_id,omitempty"`
58		Payload    map[string]any `bson:"payload,omitempty"     json:"payload,omitempty"`
59		TS         time.Time      `bson:"ts"          json:"ts"`
60		PrevHash   string         `bson:"prev_hash"   json:"prev_hash"`
61		Hash       string         `bson:"hash"        json:"hash"`
62	}
63	
64	// AppendInput describes a new event to chain.
65	type AppendInput struct {
66		Type       string
67		EntityType string
68		EntityID   string
69		Refs       []Ref
70		Actor      ActorRef
71		OrgUnitID  string
72		Payload    map[string]any
73	}
74	
75	// Ledger appends to and reads the hash chain.
76	type Ledger struct {
77		coll *mongo.Collection
78	
79		// appendMu serialises the head-read+insert of Append within this process:
80		// every ledger write system-wide shares one global seq, so without local
81		// serialisation concurrent handlers (e.g. a morning pour rush plus a
82		// GenerateInvoices loop) burn duplicate-key retries against each other.
83		// The unique seq index remains the atomic backstop across processes.
84		appendMu sync.Mutex
85	}
86	
87	// NewLedger binds the ledger to the database.
88	func NewLedger(db *mongo.Database) *Ledger {
89		return &Ledger{coll: db.Collection(collection)}
90	}
91	
92	// genesisHash anchors the chain before the first event.
93	const genesisHash = "GENESIS"
94	
95	// Append chains a new event. Concurrency-safe without transactions: it reads
96	// the current head, computes seq+hash optimistically, and relies on the
97	// unique index on `seq` — a duplicate-key collision means another writer won
98	// the slot, so we re-read and retry.
99	func (l *Ledger) Append(ctx context.Context, in AppendInput) (*Event, error) {
100		// Serialise appends within this process (see appendMu): local writers no
101		// longer race each other for the seq slot, so under single-instance
102		// deployment the retry loop only ever fires against external writers.
103		l.appendMu.Lock()
104		defer l.appendMu.Unlock()
105	
106		const maxRetries = 12
107		for attempt := 0; attempt < maxRetries; attempt++ {
108			seq, prevHash, err := l.head(ctx)
109			if err != nil {
110				return nil, err
111			}
112			ev := &Event{
113				ID:         primitive.NewObjectID(),
114				Seq:        seq + 1,
115				Type:       in.Type,
116				EntityType: in.EntityType,
117				EntityID:   in.EntityID,
118				Refs:       in.Refs,
119				Actor:      in.Actor,
120				OrgUnitID:  in.OrgUnitID,
121				Payload:    in.Payload,
122				// Millisecond precision: BSON datetimes store ms, so the persisted
123				// TS must equal the hashed TS or re-verification would break.
124				TS:       time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Millisecond),
125				PrevHash: prevHash,
126			}
127			ev.Hash = computeHash(ev)
128	
129			if _, err := l.coll.InsertOne(ctx, ev); err != nil {
130				if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(err) {
131					continue // lost the seq race — retry against the new head
132				}
133				return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance append: %w", err)
134			}
135			return ev, nil
136		}
137		return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance append: gave up after %d seq collisions", 12)
138	}
139	
140	// head returns the latest (seq, hash), or (0, GENESIS) for an empty chain.
141	func (l *Ledger) head(ctx context.Context) (int64, string, error) {
142		var last Event
143		err := l.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{},
144			options.FindOne().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: -1}}),
145		).Decode(&last)
146		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
147			return 0, genesisHash, nil
148		}
149		if err != nil {
150			return 0, "", fmt.Errorf("provenance head: %w", err)
151		}
152		return last.Seq, last.Hash, nil
153	}
154	
155	// computeHash covers everything that matters: position, linkage, content.
156	// Payload is canonicalised via encoding/json (map keys are sorted) and the
157	// timestamp to millisecond precision (BSON datetime resolution), so the
158	// digest is deterministic across a MongoDB round trip.
159	func computeHash(ev *Event) string {
160		payloadJSON, _ := json.Marshal(ev.Payload)
161		refParts := make([]string, 0, len(ev.Refs))
162		for _, r := range ev.Refs {
163			refParts = append(refParts, r.EntityType+":"+r.EntityID+":"+r.Relation)
164		}
165		material := strings.Join([]string{
166			ev.PrevHash,
167			strconv.FormatInt(ev.Seq, 10),
168			ev.Type,
169			ev.EntityType,
170			ev.EntityID,
171			strings.Join(refParts, ","),
172			ev.Actor.PartyID,
173			ev.Actor.RoleCode,
174			ev.OrgUnitID,
175			string(payloadJSON),
176			ev.TS.UTC().Truncate(time.Millisecond).Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
177		}, "|")
178		sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(material))
179		return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
180	}
181	
182	// EventsForEntity returns an entity's own timeline in chain order.
183	func (l *Ledger) EventsForEntity(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string) ([]Event, error) {
184		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
185			bson.D{{Key: "entity_type", Value: entityType}, {Key: "entity_id", Value: entityID}},
186			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}),
187		)
188		if err != nil {
189			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance events for %s/%s: %w", entityType, entityID, err)
190		}
191		var out []Event
192		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
193			return nil, err
194		}
195		return out, nil
196	}
197	
198	// Trace walks the provenance graph UPSTREAM from an entity: its events, plus
199	// (recursively) the events of everything those events reference. This is how
200	// a consumer QR resolves back to the contributing samiti set, and how a failed
201	// aflatoxin test walks back to source DCSes (blueprint §8.3).
202	func (l *Ledger) Trace(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, maxDepth int) ([]Event, error) {
203		return l.TraceStopAt(ctx, entityType, entityID, maxDepth, nil)
204	}
205	
206	// TraceStopAt is Trace with a stop set: entity types in stopExpand are still
207	// fetched (their events appear in the result) but their refs are never
208	// followed. The consumer QR scan stops at the consignment/pooling boundary so
209	// hundreds of per-pour nodes (and cross-route trip fan-out) are never walked.
210	//
211	// Each BFS level is batched into a bounded number of $or queries instead of
212	// one Find per node, so a walk costs O(depth) round trips, not O(nodes).
213	func (l *Ledger) TraceStopAt(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, maxDepth int, stopExpand map[string]bool) ([]Event, error) {
214		if maxDepth <= 0 {
215			maxDepth = 10
216		}
217		const hardEventCap = 2000
218	
219		type node struct{ etype, eid string }
220		visited := map[node]bool{}
221		frontier := []node{{entityType, entityID}}
222		var all []Event
223	
224		for depth := 0; depth < maxDepth && len(frontier) > 0; depth++ {
225			// Deduplicate this level against everything already visited.
226			level := make([]node, 0, len(frontier))
227			for _, n := range frontier {
228				if visited[n] {
229					continue
230				}
231				visited[n] = true
232				level = append(level, n)
233			}
234			if len(level) == 0 {
235				break
236			}
237	
238			var next []node
239			// One indexed query per chunk of the level (not per node).
240			const orChunk = 200
241			for start := 0; start < len(level); start += orChunk {
242				end := min(start+orChunk, len(level))
243				clauses := make(bson.A, 0, end-start)
244				for _, n := range level[start:end] {
245					clauses = append(clauses, bson.D{
246						{Key: "entity_type", Value: n.etype},
247						{Key: "entity_id", Value: n.eid},
248					})
249				}
250				cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
251					bson.D{{Key: "$or", Value: clauses}},
252					options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}).SetLimit(hardEventCap),
253				)
254				if err != nil {
255					return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance trace level: %w", err)
256				}
257				var evs []Event
258				if err := cur.All(ctx, &evs); err != nil {
259					return nil, err
260				}
261				for _, ev := range evs {
262					all = append(all, ev)
263					if len(all) >= hardEventCap {
264						return all, nil
265					}
266					if stopExpand != nil && stopExpand[ev.EntityType] {
267						continue // include the node's events, never follow its refs
268					}
269					for _, ref := range ev.Refs {
270						nn := node{ref.EntityType, ref.EntityID}
271						if !visited[nn] {
272							next = append(next, nn)
273						}
274					}
275				}
276			}
277			frontier = next
278		}
279		return all, nil
280	}
281	
282	// DownstreamRefs finds events that reference the given entity — used to walk
283	// FORWARD (e.g. "which batches consumed this blocked BMC lot?"). The limit is
284	// pushed into the query: only the LAST limit referencing events are fetched
285	// (ascending chain order preserved). limit <= 0 falls back to 2000.
286	func (l *Ledger) DownstreamRefs(ctx context.Context, entityID string, limit int64) ([]Event, error) {
287		if limit <= 0 {
288			limit = 2000
289		}
290		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
291			bson.D{{Key: "refs.entity_id", Value: entityID}},
292			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: -1}}).SetLimit(limit),
293		)
294		if err != nil {
295			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance downstream of %s: %w", entityID, err)
296		}
297		var out []Event
298		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
299			return nil, err
300		}
301		// Restore ascending chain order.
302		for i, j := 0, len(out)-1; i < j; i, j = i+1, j-1 {
303			out[i], out[j] = out[j], out[i]
304		}
305		return out, nil
306	}
307	
308	// EventsForEntityPage returns one page of an entity's own timeline in chain
309	// order, with skip/limit pushed into the query.
310	func (l *Ledger) EventsForEntityPage(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, offset, limit int64) ([]Event, error) {
311		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
312			bson.D{{Key: "entity_type", Value: entityType}, {Key: "entity_id", Value: entityID}},
313			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}).SetSkip(offset).SetLimit(limit),
314		)
315		if err != nil {
316			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance events page for %s/%s: %w", entityType, entityID, err)
317		}
318		var out []Event
319		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
320			return nil, err
321		}
322		return out, nil
323	}
324	
325	// CountEventsForEntity returns the total number of events on an entity's
326	// timeline (pagination meta companion of EventsForEntityPage).
327	func (l *Ledger) CountEventsForEntity(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string) (int64, error) {
328		n, err := l.coll.CountDocuments(ctx,
329			bson.D{{Key: "entity_type", Value: entityType}, {Key: "entity_id", Value: entityID}})
330		if err != nil {
331			return 0, fmt.Errorf("provenance count for %s/%s: %w", entityType, entityID, err)
332		}
333		return n, nil
334	}
335	
336	// VerifyChain re-derives every hash in [fromSeq, toSeq] and checks linkage.
337	// Returns (true, 0) when intact, or (false, seq) of the first broken link.
338	func (l *Ledger) VerifyChain(ctx context.Context, fromSeq, toSeq int64) (bool, int64, error) {
339		filter := bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$gte", Value: fromSeq}, {Key: "$lte", Value: toSeq}}}}
340		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}))
341		if err != nil {
342			return false, 0, fmt.Errorf("provenance verify: %w", err)
343		}
344		defer cur.Close(ctx)
345	
346		prevHash := ""
347		prevSeq := int64(0)
348		first := true
349		for cur.Next(ctx) {
350			var ev Event
351			if err := cur.Decode(&ev); err != nil {
352				return false, 0, err
353			}
354			if computeHash(&ev) != ev.Hash {
355				return false, ev.Seq, nil // content tampered
356			}
357			if !first {
358				if ev.Seq != prevSeq+1 || ev.PrevHash != prevHash {
359					return false, ev.Seq, nil // linkage broken
360				}
361			}
362			prevHash, prevSeq, first = ev.Hash, ev.Seq, false
363		}
364		return true, 0, cur.Err()
365	}
366	
367	// LatestSeq returns the current chain head sequence (0 = empty).
368	func (l *Ledger) LatestSeq(ctx context.Context) (int64, error) {
369		seq, _, err := l.head(ctx)
370		return seq, err
371	}

1	// Package audit writes the immutable who-did-what trail required for
2	// government accountability and DPDP breach forensics (blueprint §12, §16).
3	// Entries are insert-only; the STATE_AUDITOR role reads them via the
4	// platformops module.
5	package audit
6	
7	import (
8		"context"
9		"log/slog"
10		"time"
11	
12		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
13		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
14	
15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
16	)
17	
18	const collection = "audit_logs"
19	
20	// Entry is one audit record. `_id` is a generated ObjectID; actor identifiers
21	// arrive from JWT claims as ObjectID hex strings.
22	type Entry struct {
23		ID           primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
24		ActorPartyID string         `bson:"actor_party_id" json:"actor_party_id"`
25		ActorRole    string         `bson:"actor_role,omitempty" json:"actor_role,omitempty"`
26		Action       string         `bson:"action"         json:"action"` // e.g. "http.POST /api/v1/collection/pours" or "support.pii_lookup"
27		TargetType   string         `bson:"target_type,omitempty" json:"target_type,omitempty"`
28		TargetID     string         `bson:"target_id,omitempty"   json:"target_id,omitempty"`
29		Status       int            `bson:"status,omitempty"      json:"status,omitempty"`
30		IP           string         `bson:"ip,omitempty"          json:"ip,omitempty"`
31		RequestID    string         `bson:"request_id,omitempty"  json:"request_id,omitempty"`
32		Meta         map[string]any `bson:"meta,omitempty"        json:"meta,omitempty"`
33		TS           time.Time      `bson:"ts"             json:"ts"`
34	}
35	
36	// Recorder persists audit entries asynchronously so auditing never adds
37	// latency to the request path.
38	type Recorder struct {
39		coll *mongo.Collection
40		log  *slog.Logger
41	}
42	
43	// NewRecorder binds the recorder to the database.
44	func NewRecorder(db *mongo.Database, log *slog.Logger) *Recorder {
45		return &Recorder{coll: db.Collection(collection), log: log}
46	}
47	
48	// Record fills identity fields from the request context and persists the
49	// entry in the background (fire-and-forget with its own timeout).
50	func (r *Recorder) Record(ctx context.Context, e Entry) {
51		if a, ok := auth.ActorFrom(ctx); ok {
52			if e.ActorPartyID == "" {
53				e.ActorPartyID = a.PartyID
54			}
55			if e.ActorRole == "" {
56				e.ActorRole = a.RoleCode
57			}
58		}
59		e.ID = primitive.NewObjectID()
60		e.TS = time.Now().UTC()
61	
62		go func() {
63			writeCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
64			defer cancel()
65			if _, err := r.coll.InsertOne(writeCtx, e); err != nil {
66				r.log.Error("audit write failed", slog.String("action", e.Action), slog.Any("err", err))
67			}
68		}()
69	}

190	// upsertOrg finds-or-inserts an org unit by its unique code and returns the
191	// stored document (with its generated ObjectID).
192	func upsertOrg(ctx context.Context, db *mongo.Database, o domain.OrgUnit) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
193		var out domain.OrgUnit
194		err := db.Collection(mongodb.CollOrgUnits).FindOneAndUpdate(ctx,
195			bson.D{{Key: "code", Value: o.Code}},
196			bson.D{{Key: "$setOnInsert", Value: o}},
197			options.FindOneAndUpdate().SetUpsert(true).SetReturnDocument(options.After),
198		).Decode(&out)
199		if err != nil {
200			return nil, fmt.Errorf("org %s: %w", o.Code, err)
201		}
202		return &out, nil
203	}
204	
205	// upsertParty finds-or-inserts a party by its unique phone.
206	func upsertParty(ctx context.Context, db *mongo.Database, p domain.Party) (*domain.Party, error) {
207		var out domain.Party
208		err := db.Collection(mongodb.CollParties).FindOneAndUpdate(ctx,
209			bson.D{{Key: "phone", Value: p.Phone}},
210			bson.D{{Key: "$setOnInsert", Value: p}},
211			options.FindOneAndUpdate().SetUpsert(true).SetReturnDocument(options.After),
212		).Decode(&out)
213		if err != nil {
214			return nil, err
215		}
216		return &out, nil
217	}
218	
219	// upsertRoleAssignment finds-or-inserts by the (party, role, org) natural key.
220	func upsertRoleAssignment(ctx context.Context, db *mongo.Database, ra domain.RoleAssignment) error {
221		_, err := db.Collection(mongodb.CollRoleAssignments).UpdateOne(ctx,
222			bson.D{
223				{Key: "party_id", Value: ra.PartyID},
224				{Key: "role_code", Value: ra.RoleCode},
225				{Key: "org_unit_id", Value: ra.OrgUnitID},
226			},
227			bson.D{{Key: "$setOnInsert", Value: ra}},
228			options.Update().SetUpsert(true),
229		)
230		return err
231	}
232	
233	// upsertByFilter inserts doc if nothing matches filter (generic natural-key upsert).
234	func upsertByFilter(ctx context.Context, coll *mongo.Collection, filter bson.D, doc any) error {
235		_, err := coll.UpdateOne(ctx, filter,
236			bson.D{{Key: "$setOnInsert", Value: doc}},
237			options.Update().SetUpsert(true),
238		)
239		return err
240	}

29	// codeSafetyGateBlocked is the stable error code every gate refusal carries —
30	// the frontend switches on it to show the quarantine screen (blueprint §8.3).
31	const codeSafetyGateBlocked = "SAFETY_GATE_BLOCKED"
32	
33	// Service holds the plant module's business logic: lot pooling, the safety
34	// gate, batch numbering, product lot packaging and QR minting.
35	type Service struct {
36		repo     *Repo
37		orgs     *orgscope.Resolver
38		ledger   *provenance.Ledger
39		qrSecret string
40		log      *slog.Logger
41	}
42	
43	// NewService wires the service from the shared dependency container and the
44	// module-scoped logger.
45	func NewService(repo *Repo, d *deps.Deps, log *slog.Logger) *Service {
46		return &Service{
47			repo:     repo,
48			orgs:     d.Orgs,
49			ledger:   d.Ledger,
50			qrSecret: d.Cfg.QRSigningSecret,
51			log:      log,
52		}
53	}
54	
55	// actorID parses the actor's party identity — carried as an ObjectID hex
56	// string in JWT claims — into the ObjectID persisted on created documents.
57	func actorID(actor auth.Actor) (primitive.ObjectID, error) {
58		return httpx.ParseID(actor.PartyID, "actor")
59	}
60	
61	// fail wraps an unexpected error with its failing operation, logs it at ERROR
62	// and returns the opaque 500 — every internal failure must name its op in the
63	// logs.
64	func (s *Service) fail(ctx context.Context, op string, err error) error {
65		err = fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", op, err)
66		s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "plant operation failed",
67			slog.String("op", op), slog.Any("err", err))
68		return httpx.Internal(err)
69	}
70	
71	// requireScope enforces the actor's org scope and logs denials at WARN so
72	// cross-scope probing is visible.
73	func (s *Service) requireScope(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, targetOrgID primitive.ObjectID, op string) error {
74		err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, targetOrgID)
75		if err == nil {
76			return nil
77		}
78		var app *httpx.AppError
79		if errors.As(err, &app) && app.Status == http.StatusForbidden {
80			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "org scope denied",
81				slog.String("op", op),
82				slog.String("target_org_id", targetOrgID.Hex()),
83				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
84				slog.String("actor_role", actor.RoleCode))
85		}
86		return err
87	}
88	
89	// --- safety-gate predicates (§8.3) ---
90	//
91	// Pure functions so the refusal matrix is unit-testable without a database.
92	// Every mutation below ALSO re-checks the status inside the MongoDB update
93	// filter, so a concurrent QC block can never slip a bad lot through.
94	
95	// canDispatchBMCLot: only a lot with a passing BMC rapid test may leave on a
96	// tanker. BLOCKED, QC_PENDING and OPEN lots stay put.
97	func canDispatchBMCLot(status string) bool {
98		return status == domain.BMCLotStatusPassed
99	}
100	
101	// canPoolBMCLot: only a DISPATCHED lot (which by construction went
102	// OPEN→QC_PENDING→PASSED→DISPATCHED) may enter a processing batch.
103	func canPoolBMCLot(status string) bool {
104		return status == domain.BMCLotStatusDispatched
105	}
106	
107	// canCompleteBatch: only a batch the plant lab has PASSED may complete.
108	func canCompleteBatch(status string) bool {
109		return status == domain.BatchStatusPassed
110	}
111	
112	// canYieldProductLot: only a COMPLETED batch may be packaged into SKU lots.
113	func canYieldProductLot(batchStatus string) bool {
114		return batchStatus == domain.BatchStatusCompleted
115	}
116	
117	// canIssueQR: a QR may only label an ACTIVE product lot whose batch is
118	// COMPLETED. This read-time check is advisory; IssueQR additionally confirms
119	// the lot is still ACTIVE with a conditional write after the QR insert, so a
120	// recall landing mid-request still stops the mint.
121	func canIssueQR(lotStatus, batchStatus string) bool {
122		return lotStatus == domain.ProductLotStatusActive && batchStatus == domain.BatchStatusCompleted
123	}
124	
125	// --- BMC lots ---
126	
127	// CreateBMCLot pools DELIVERED consignments into a new OPEN lot at a BMC.
128	func (s *Service) CreateBMCLot(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateBMCLotRequest) (*domain.BMCLot, error) {
129		actID, err := actorID(actor)
130		if err != nil {
131			return nil, err
132		}
133		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, req.BMCID, "create bmc lot"); err != nil {
134			return nil, err
135		}
136		org, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.BMCID)
137		if err != nil {
138			return nil, err
139		}
140		if org.Type != domain.OrgTypeBMC {
141			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot creation refused: org unit is not a BMC",
142				slog.String("org_unit_id", req.BMCID.Hex()),
143				slog.String("org_type", org.Type),
144				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
145			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_BMC", "org unit "+req.BMCID.Hex()+" is not a BMC")
146		}
147	
148		now := time.Now().UTC()
149		date := req.Date
150		if date == "" {
151			date = domain.DateKeyIST(now)
152		}
153	
154		ids := dedupe(req.ConsignmentIDs)
155		consignments, err := s.repo.ConsignmentsByIDs(ctx, ids)
156		if err != nil {
157			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "load consignments", err)
158		}
159		if len(consignments) != len(ids) {
160			return nil, httpx.NotFound("consignment(s) " + strings.Join(missingIDs(ids, consignments), ", "))
161		}
162		var undelivered []string
163		for _, c := range consignments {
164			if c.Status != domain.ConsignmentStatusDelivered {
165				undelivered = append(undelivered, c.ID.Hex())
166			}
167		}
168		if len(undelivered) > 0 {
169			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot creation refused: consignment(s) not DELIVERED",
170				slog.String("bmc_id", req.BMCID.Hex()),
171				slog.String("consignment_ids", strings.Join(undelivered, ",")),
172				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
173			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("CONSIGNMENT_NOT_DELIVERED",
174				"only DELIVERED consignments can be pooled into a BMC lot").
175				WithDetails(map[string]any{"consignment_ids": undelivered})
176		}
177	
178		// Optimistic claim: flip DELIVERED→ACCEPTED stamped with the new lot ID.
179		// The lot ID is pre-generated so claim, insert and ledger all agree.
180		// If another lot raced us on any consignment, release our claims and bail.
181		lotID := primitive.NewObjectID()
182		claimed, err := s.repo.ClaimConsignments(ctx, ids, lotID)
183		if err != nil {
184			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "claim consignments", err)
185		}
186		if claimed != int64(len(ids)) {
187			if relErr := s.repo.ReleaseConsignments(ctx, lotID); relErr != nil {
188				return nil, s.fail(ctx, "release consignments after lost claim", relErr)
189			}
190			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot creation lost consignment claim race",
191				slog.String("bmc_id", req.BMCID.Hex()),
192				slog.Int64("claimed", claimed), slog.Int("requested", len(ids)),
193				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
194			return nil, httpx.Conflict("CONSIGNMENT_CLAIM_CONFLICT",
195				"one or more consignments were pooled by another lot — reload and retry")
196		}
197	
198		var totalLitres float64
199		var tripIDs []primitive.ObjectID
200		seenTrip := map[primitive.ObjectID]bool{}
201		for _, c := range consignments {
202			totalLitres += c.TotalQuantityLitres
203			if c.RouteTripID != nil && !seenTrip[*c.RouteTripID] {
204				seenTrip[*c.RouteTripID] = true
205				tripIDs = append(tripIDs, *c.RouteTripID)
206			}
207		}
208	
209		lot := &domain.BMCLot{
210			ID:                  lotID,
211			BMCID:               req.BMCID,
212			Date:                date,
213			Shift:               req.Shift,
214			ConsignmentIDs:      ids,
215			RouteTripIDs:        tripIDs,
216			TotalQuantityLitres: totalLitres,
217			Status:              domain.BMCLotStatusOpen,
218			CreatedBy:           actID,
219			CreatedAt:           now,
220		}
221		if err := s.repo.InsertBMCLot(ctx, lot); err != nil {
222			_ = s.repo.ReleaseConsignments(ctx, lotID)
223			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "insert bmc lot", err)
224		}
225	
226		refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, len(ids))
227		for _, id := range ids {
228			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{
229				EntityType: domain.EntityConsignment, EntityID: id.Hex(), Relation: "pools",
230			})
231		}
232		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
233			Type:       domain.EventBMCLotCreated,
234			EntityType: domain.EntityBMCLot,
235			EntityID:   lot.ID.Hex(),
236			Refs:       refs,
237			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
238			OrgUnitID:  req.BMCID.Hex(),
239			Payload: map[string]any{
240				"date": date, "shift": req.Shift, "total_quantity_litres": totalLitres,
241			},
242		})
243		if err != nil {
244			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append bmc_lot.created event", err)
245		}
246		if err := s.repo.SetBMCLotProvenanceSeq(ctx, lot.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
247			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp bmc lot provenance seq", err)
248		}
249		lot.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
250		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "bmc lot created",
251			slog.String("bmc_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()),
252			slog.String("bmc_id", req.BMCID.Hex()),
253			slog.String("date", date), slog.String("shift", req.Shift),
254			slog.Int("consignments", len(ids)),
255			slog.Float64("total_quantity_litres", totalLitres),
256			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
257		return lot, nil
258	}
259	
260	// CloseBMCLot transitions an OPEN lot to QC_PENDING with the chilling
261	// temperature. The quality module later flips QC_PENDING→PASSED/BLOCKED.
262	func (s *Service) CloseBMCLot(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID, chillingTempC float64) (*domain.BMCLot, error) {
263		lot, err := s.getBMCLot(ctx, id)
264		if err != nil {
265			return nil, err
266		}
267		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, lot.BMCID, "close bmc lot"); err != nil {
268			return nil, err
269		}
270		if lot.Status != domain.BMCLotStatusOpen {
271			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot close refused: not OPEN",
272				slog.String("bmc_lot_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("status", lot.Status),
273				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
274			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_NOT_OPEN",
275				"only an OPEN lot can be closed; lot is "+lot.Status)
276		}
277		now := time.Now().UTC()
278		ok, err := s.repo.CloseBMCLot(ctx, id, chillingTempC, now)
279		if err != nil {
280			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "close bmc lot", err)
281		}
282		if !ok {
283			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot close lost state race",
284				slog.String("bmc_lot_id", id.Hex()),
285				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
286			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_NOT_OPEN",
287				"lot changed state concurrently — reload and retry")
288		}
289		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
290			Type:       domain.EventBMCLotClosed,
291			EntityType: domain.EntityBMCLot,
292			EntityID:   lot.ID.Hex(),
293			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
294			OrgUnitID:  lot.BMCID.Hex(),
295			Payload:    map[string]any{"chilling_temp_c": chillingTempC},
296		})
297		if err != nil {
298			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append bmc_lot.closed event", err)
299		}
300		if err := s.repo.SetBMCLotProvenanceSeq(ctx, lot.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
301			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp bmc lot provenance seq", err)
302		}
303		lot.Status = domain.BMCLotStatusQCPending
304		lot.ChillingTempC = chillingTempC
305		lot.ClosedAt = &now
306		lot.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
307		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "bmc lot closed for QC",
308			slog.String("bmc_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()),
309			slog.String("bmc_id", lot.BMCID.Hex()),
310			slog.Float64("chilling_temp_c", chillingTempC),
311			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
312		return lot, nil
313	}
314	
315	// DispatchBMCLot transitions PASSED→DISPATCHED. THE safety gate (§8.3): a
316	// BLOCKED or untested lot never leaves the chilling centre.
317	func (s *Service) DispatchBMCLot(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.BMCLot, error) {
318		lot, err := s.getBMCLot(ctx, id)
319		if err != nil {
320			return nil, err
321		}
322		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, lot.BMCID, "dispatch bmc lot"); err != nil {
323			return nil, err
324		}
325		if lot.Status == domain.BMCLotStatusDispatched {
326			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot dispatch refused: already dispatched",
327				slog.String("bmc_lot_id", id.Hex()),
328				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
329			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_ALREADY_DISPATCHED", "lot is already dispatched")
330		}
331		if !canDispatchBMCLot(lot.Status) {
332			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot dispatch refused: safety gate not passed",
333				slog.String("bmc_lot_id", id.Hex()),
334				slog.String("status", lot.Status),
335				slog.String("block_reason", lot.BlockReason),
336				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
337			msg := "lot cannot be dispatched: safety gate not passed (status " + lot.Status + ")"
338			if lot.BlockReason != "" {
339				msg += " — " + lot.BlockReason
340			}
341			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked, msg).
342				WithDetails(map[string]any{"status": lot.Status, "block_reason": lot.BlockReason})
343		}
344		now := time.Now().UTC()
345		ok, err := s.repo.DispatchBMCLot(ctx, id, now)
346		if err != nil {
347			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "dispatch bmc lot", err)
348		}
349		if !ok {
350			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot dispatch lost state race",
351				slog.String("bmc_lot_id", id.Hex()),
352				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
353			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_STATE_CHANGED",
354				"lot changed state concurrently — reload and retry")
355		}
356		// The custody transition — gate-passed milk physically leaving the
357		// chilling centre — must live on the tamper-evident chain like every
358		// other hop of the pour→QR path, not only in a mutable document field.
359		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
360			Type:       domain.EventBMCLotDispatched,
361			EntityType: domain.EntityBMCLot,
362			EntityID:   lot.ID.Hex(),
363			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
364			OrgUnitID:  lot.BMCID.Hex(),
365			Payload: map[string]any{
366				// String, not time.Time: payloads must round-trip BSON⇄JSON
367				// byte-identically or chain re-verification would break.
368				"dispatched_at":         now.Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
369				"total_quantity_litres": lot.TotalQuantityLitres,
370			},
371		})
372		if err != nil {
373			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append bmc_lot.dispatched event", err)
374		}
375		if err := s.repo.SetBMCLotProvenanceSeq(ctx, lot.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
376			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp bmc lot provenance seq", err)
377		}
378		lot.Status = domain.BMCLotStatusDispatched
379		lot.DispatchedAt = &now
380		lot.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
381		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "bmc lot dispatched",
382			slog.String("bmc_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()),
383			slog.String("bmc_id", lot.BMCID.Hex()),
384			slog.Float64("total_quantity_litres", lot.TotalQuantityLitres),
385			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
386		return lot, nil
387	}
388	
389	// ListBMCLots pages lots by BMC/date/status. A BMC operator may only list
390	// within their own scope; downstream readers (plant operator, supervisor,
391	// lab) see across BMCs — the plant receives tankers from sibling BMCs, so an
392	// ancestry check against the plant org would wrongly refuse them.
393	func (s *Service) ListBMCLots(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, f BMCLotListFilter, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.BMCLot, int64, error) {
394		if !f.BMCID.IsZero() && actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleBMCOperator {
395			if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, f.BMCID, "list bmc lots"); err != nil {
396				return nil, 0, err
397			}
398		}
399		lots, total, err := s.repo.ListBMCLots(ctx, f, page)
400		if err != nil {
401			return nil, 0, s.fail(ctx, "list bmc lots", err)
402		}
403		return lots, total, nil
404	}
405	
406	// --- processing batches ---
407	
408	// CreateBatch pools DISPATCHED (gate-passed) BMC lots into one production
409	// run. The gate re-checks here belt-and-braces: aflatoxin M1 survives
410	// pasteurisation, so a blocked lot must never reach a vat (§8.3).
411	func (s *Service) CreateBatch(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateBatchRequest) (*domain.ProcessingBatch, error) {
412		actID, err := actorID(actor)
413		if err != nil {
414			return nil, err
415		}
416		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, req.PlantID, "create batch"); err != nil {
417			return nil, err
418		}
419		org, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.PlantID)
420		if err != nil {
421			return nil, err
422		}
423		if org.Type != domain.OrgTypeProcessingPlant {
424			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch creation refused: org unit is not a plant",
425				slog.String("org_unit_id", req.PlantID.Hex()),
426				slog.String("org_type", org.Type),
427				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
428			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_PLANT", "org unit "+req.PlantID.Hex()+" is not a processing plant")
429		}
430	
431		ids := dedupe(req.BMCLotIDs)
432		lots, err := s.repo.BMCLotsByIDs(ctx, ids)
433		if err != nil {
434			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "load bmc lots", err)
435		}
436		if len(lots) != len(ids) {
437			return nil, httpx.NotFound("BMC lot(s) " + strings.Join(missingLotIDs(ids, lots), ", "))
438		}
439		var offending []string
440		var inputLitres float64
441		for _, lot := range lots {
442			if !canPoolBMCLot(lot.Status) {
443				offending = append(offending, lot.ID.Hex())
444				continue
445			}
446			inputLitres += lot.TotalQuantityLitres
447		}
448		if len(offending) > 0 {
449			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch creation refused: bmc lot(s) have not cleared the safety gate",
450				slog.String("plant_id", req.PlantID.Hex()),
451				slog.String("blocked_lot_ids", strings.Join(offending, ",")),
452				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
453			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked,
454				"one or more BMC lots have not cleared the safety gate (must be PASSED and DISPATCHED)").
455				WithDetails(map[string]any{"blocked_lot_ids": offending})
456		}
457	
458		now := time.Now().UTC()
459		dateKey := domain.DateKeyIST(now)
460		seq, err := s.repo.NextSequence(ctx, "batch_number:"+req.PlantID.Hex()+":"+dateKey)
461		if err != nil {
462			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "next batch number sequence", err)
463		}
464		batchNumber := fmt.Sprintf("BATCH-%s-%s-%04d",
465			org.Code, strings.ReplaceAll(dateKey, "-", ""), seq)
466	
467		// Optimistic claim (mirrors ClaimConsignments): flip DISPATCHED→POOLED
468		// stamped with the pre-generated batch ID BEFORE inserting the batch. One
469		// physical lot of milk can therefore never be pooled into two batches —
470		// neither by a double-submit nor by two concurrent CreateBatch calls.
471		batchID := primitive.NewObjectID()
472		claimed, err := s.repo.ClaimBMCLots(ctx, ids, batchID)
473		if err != nil {
474			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "claim bmc lots", err)
475		}
476		if claimed != int64(len(ids)) {
477			if relErr := s.repo.ReleaseBMCLots(ctx, batchID); relErr != nil {
478				return nil, s.fail(ctx, "release bmc lots after lost claim", relErr)
479			}
480			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch creation lost bmc lot claim race",
481				slog.String("plant_id", req.PlantID.Hex()),
482				slog.Int64("claimed", claimed), slog.Int("requested", len(ids)),
483				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
484			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_CLAIM_CONFLICT",
485				"one or more BMC lots were pooled by another batch — reload and retry")
486		}
487	
488		// CREATED is a transient birth state: the plant lab must clear every
489		// batch, so it is persisted straight into QC_PENDING.
490		batch := &domain.ProcessingBatch{
491			ID:          batchID,
492			PlantID:     req.PlantID,
493			BatchNumber: batchNumber,
494			BMCLotIDs:   ids,
495			ProductType: req.ProductType,
496			InputLitres: inputLitres,
497			Status:      domain.BatchStatusQCPending,
498			StartedAt:   now,
499			CreatedBy:   actID,
500			CreatedAt:   now,
501		}
502		if err := s.repo.InsertBatch(ctx, batch); err != nil {
503			_ = s.repo.ReleaseBMCLots(ctx, batchID)
504			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "insert batch", err)
505		}
506	
507		refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, len(ids))
508		for _, id := range ids {
509			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{
510				EntityType: domain.EntityBMCLot, EntityID: id.Hex(), Relation: "pools",
511			})
512		}
513		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
514			Type:       domain.EventBatchCreated,
515			EntityType: domain.EntityBatch,
516			EntityID:   batch.ID.Hex(),
517			Refs:       refs,
518			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
519			OrgUnitID:  req.PlantID.Hex(),
520			Payload: map[string]any{
521				"batch_number": batchNumber, "product_type": req.ProductType, "input_litres": inputLitres,
522			},
523		})
524		if err != nil {
525			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append batch.created event", err)
526		}
527		if err := s.repo.SetBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx, batch.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
528			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp batch provenance seq", err)
529		}
530		batch.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
531		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "processing batch created",
532			slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
533			slog.String("batch_number", batchNumber),
534			slog.String("plant_id", req.PlantID.Hex()),
535			slog.String("product_type", req.ProductType),
536			slog.Int("bmc_lots", len(ids)),
537			slog.Float64("input_litres", inputLitres),
538			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
539		return batch, nil
540	}
541	
542	// CompleteBatch transitions PASSED→COMPLETED — only a batch the plant lab
543	// cleared may finish and go on to yield product lots.
544	func (s *Service) CompleteBatch(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.ProcessingBatch, error) {
545		batch, err := s.getBatch(ctx, id)
546		if err != nil {
547			return nil, err
548		}
549		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, batch.PlantID, "complete batch"); err != nil {
550			return nil, err
551		}
552		if batch.Status == domain.BatchStatusCompleted {
553			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch completion refused: already completed",
554				slog.String("batch_id", id.Hex()),
555				slog.String("batch_number", batch.BatchNumber),
556				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
557			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BATCH_ALREADY_COMPLETED", "batch is already completed")
558		}
559		if !canCompleteBatch(batch.Status) {
560			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch completion refused: plant-lab QC not passed",
561				slog.String("batch_id", id.Hex()),
562				slog.String("batch_number", batch.BatchNumber),
563				slog.String("status", batch.Status),
564				slog.String("block_reason", batch.BlockReason),
565				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
566			msg := "batch cannot complete: plant-lab QC not passed (status " + batch.Status + ")"
567			if batch.BlockReason != "" {
568				msg += " — " + batch.BlockReason
569			}
570			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked, msg).
571				WithDetails(map[string]any{"status": batch.Status, "block_reason": batch.BlockReason})
572		}
573		now := time.Now().UTC()
574		ok, err := s.repo.CompleteBatch(ctx, id, now)
575		if err != nil {
576			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "complete batch", err)
577		}
578		if !ok {
579			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch completion lost state race",
580				slog.String("batch_id", id.Hex()),
581				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
582			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BATCH_STATE_CHANGED",
583				"batch changed state concurrently — reload and retry")
584		}
585		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
586			Type:       domain.EventBatchCompleted,
587			EntityType: domain.EntityBatch,
588			EntityID:   batch.ID.Hex(),
589			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
590			OrgUnitID:  batch.PlantID.Hex(),
591			Payload:    map[string]any{"batch_number": batch.BatchNumber},
592		})
593		if err != nil {
594			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append batch.completed event", err)
595		}
596		if err := s.repo.SetBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx, batch.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
597			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp batch provenance seq", err)
598		}
599		batch.Status = domain.BatchStatusCompleted
600		batch.CompletedAt = &now
601		batch.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
602		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "processing batch completed",
603			slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
604			slog.String("batch_number", batch.BatchNumber),
605			slog.String("plant_id", batch.PlantID.Hex()),
606			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
607		return batch, nil
608	}
609	
610	// GetBatch returns one batch (including its qc_result_ids) within scope.
611	func (s *Service) GetBatch(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.ProcessingBatch, error) {
612		batch, err := s.getBatch(ctx, id)
613		if err != nil {
614			return nil, err
615		}
616		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, batch.PlantID, "get batch"); err != nil {
617			return nil, err
618		}
619		return batch, nil
620	}

622	// ListBatches pages batches by plant/status.

770	// --- QR issuance ---
771	
772	// qrAlphabet is the 32-character human-safe set for short codes: A–Z and 2–9
773	// minus the confusables 0/O and 1/I. 32 divides 256, so a byte modulo the
774	// alphabet length is unbiased.
775	const qrAlphabet = "ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789"
776	
777	// qrCodeLength is the number of random characters after the "PRG-" prefix
778	// (32^8 ≈ 1.1 trillion codes — collisions are retried on the unique index).
779	const qrCodeLength = 8
780	
781	// newQRCode mints a short public code like "[REDACTED:generic-api-key]" from crypto/rand.
782	func newQRCode() (string, error) {
783		buf := make([]byte, qrCodeLength)
784		if _, err := rand.Read(buf); err != nil {
785			return "", err
786		}
787		code := make([]byte, qrCodeLength)
788		for i, b := range buf {
789			code[i] = qrAlphabet[int(b)%len(qrAlphabet)]
790		}
791		return "PRG-" + string(code), nil
792	}
793	
794	// signQRToken builds the forgery-proof token printed inside the QR:
795	// base64url(qr_code|product_lot_hex|issued_unix) + "." + hex(HMAC-SHA256).
796	// productLotHex is the product lot ObjectID's hex form — the HMAC material is
797	// "qr_code|lot hex|unix", and the publictrace module verifies the exact same
798	// shape. The consumer app resolves the payload; the signature proves it was
799	// minted by this server, so IDs cannot be guessed onto counterfeit packs.
800	func signQRToken(secret, qrCode, productLotHex string, issuedAt time.Time) string {
801		payload := qrCode + "|" + productLotHex + "|" + strconv.FormatInt(issuedAt.Unix(), 10)
802		mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte(secret))
803		mac.Write([]byte(payload))
804		return base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(payload)) + "." + hex.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))
805	}
806	
807	// parseQRToken verifies and unpacks a signed QR token, returning the product
808	// lot ObjectID as its hex string.
809	func parseQRToken(secret, token string) (qrCode, productLotHex string, issuedAt time.Time, err error) {
810		payloadB64, sigHex, found := strings.Cut(token, ".")
811		if !found {
812			return "", "", time.Time{}, errors.New("qr token: missing signature separator")
813		}
814		payloadBytes, err := base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString(payloadB64)
815		if err != nil {
816			return "", "", time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("qr token: bad payload encoding: %w", err)
817		}
818		sig, err := hex.DecodeString(sigHex)
819		if err != nil {
820			return "", "", time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("qr token: bad signature encoding: %w", err)
821		}
822		mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte(secret))
823		mac.Write(payloadBytes)
824		if !hmac.Equal(sig, mac.Sum(nil)) {
825			return "", "", time.Time{}, errors.New("qr token: signature mismatch")
826		}
827		parts := strings.Split(string(payloadBytes), "|")
828		if len(parts) != 3 {
829			return "", "", time.Time{}, errors.New("qr token: malformed payload")
830		}
831		unix, err := strconv.ParseInt(parts[2], 10, 64)
832		if err != nil {
833			return "", "", time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("qr token: bad timestamp: %w", err)
834		}
835		return parts[0], parts[1], time.Unix(unix, 0).UTC(), nil
836	}
837	
838	// IssueQR mints one signed QR for an ACTIVE product lot whose batch is
839	// COMPLETED. The gate is checked on read AND re-confirmed with a conditional
840	// write on the lot after the QR insert, so recalled or blocked product can
841	// never be freshly labelled even when the recall races this request.
842	func (s *Service) IssueQR(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, productLotID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.BatchQR, error) {
843		actID, err := actorID(actor)
844		if err != nil {
845			return nil, err
846		}
847		lot, err := s.getProductLot(ctx, productLotID)
848		if err != nil {
849			return nil, err
850		}
851		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, lot.PlantID, "issue qr"); err != nil {
852			return nil, err
853		}
854		batch, err := s.getBatch(ctx, lot.BatchID)
855		if err != nil {
856			return nil, err
857		}
858		if !canIssueQR(lot.Status, batch.Status) {
859			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qr issuance refused: safety gate",
860				slog.String("product_lot_id", productLotID.Hex()),
861				slog.String("product_lot_status", lot.Status),
862				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
863				slog.String("batch_status", batch.Status),
864				slog.String("recall_reason", lot.RecallReason),
865				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
866			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked,
867				"QR issuance refused: product lot must be ACTIVE and its batch COMPLETED").
868				WithDetails(map[string]any{
869					"product_lot_status": lot.Status,
870					"batch_status":       batch.Status,
871					"recall_reason":      lot.RecallReason,
872				})
873		}
874	
875		now := time.Now().UTC()
876		var qr *domain.BatchQR
877		const maxMintAttempts = 5
878		for attempt := 0; attempt < maxMintAttempts; attempt++ {
879			code, err := newQRCode()
880			if err != nil {
881				return nil, s.fail(ctx, "generate qr code", err)
882			}
883			candidate := &domain.BatchQR{
884				ID:           primitive.NewObjectID(),
885				QRCode:       code,
886				ProductLotID: lot.ID,
887				SignedToken:  signQRToken(s.qrSecret, code, lot.ID.Hex(), now),
888				IssuedBy:     actID,
889				ScanCount:    0,
890				IssuedAt:     now,
891			}
892			insertErr := s.repo.InsertQR(ctx, candidate)
893			if insertErr == nil {
894				qr = candidate
895				break
896			}
897			if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(insertErr) {
898				continue // short-code collision — regenerate
899			}
900			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "insert qr", insertErr)
901		}
902		if qr == nil {
903			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "mint qr code",
904				fmt.Errorf("%d consecutive short-code collisions", maxMintAttempts))
905		}
906	
907		// Recall re-check at WRITE time: the initial read cannot see a recall that
908		// lands mid-request, so the mint is confirmed with a conditional no-op
909		// write on the lot (filter status=ACTIVE). If the lot left ACTIVE, the
910		// just-inserted QR is deleted and issuance refused — a freshly minted QR
911		// can never label recalled product.
912		active, err := s.repo.TouchActiveLot(ctx, lot.ID)
913		if err != nil {
914			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "confirm product lot active", err)
915		}
916		if !active {
917			if delErr := s.repo.DeleteQR(ctx, qr.ID); delErr != nil {
918				return nil, s.fail(ctx, "delete qr after lot left ACTIVE", delErr)
919			}
920			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qr issuance refused: product lot left ACTIVE during issuance",
921				slog.String("product_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()),
922				slog.String("qr_id", qr.ID.Hex()),
923				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
924			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked,
925				"QR issuance refused: product lot left ACTIVE (e.g. recalled) during issuance")
926		}
927	
928		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
929			Type:       domain.EventQRIssued,
930			EntityType: domain.EntityBatchQR,
931			EntityID:   qr.ID.Hex(),
932			Refs: []provenance.Ref{
933				{EntityType: domain.EntityProductLot, EntityID: lot.ID.Hex(), Relation: "labels"},
934			},
935			Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
936			OrgUnitID: lot.PlantID.Hex(),
937			Payload:   map[string]any{"qr_code": qr.QRCode},
938		})
939		if err != nil {
940			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append qr.issued event", err)
941		}
942		if err := s.repo.SetQRProvenanceSeq(ctx, qr.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
943			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp qr provenance seq", err)
944		}
945		qr.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
946		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "qr issued",
947			slog.String("qr_id", qr.ID.Hex()),
948			slog.String("qr_code", qr.QRCode),
949			slog.String("product_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()),
950			slog.String("plant_id", lot.PlantID.Hex()),
951			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
952		return qr, nil
953	}

1009	// dedupe removes zero and duplicate IDs preserving first-seen order.
1010	func dedupe(ids []primitive.ObjectID) []primitive.ObjectID {
1011		seen := make(map[primitive.ObjectID]bool, len(ids))
1012		out := make([]primitive.ObjectID, 0, len(ids))
1013		for _, id := range ids {
1014			if id.IsZero() || seen[id] {
1015				continue
1016			}
1017			seen[id] = true
1018			out = append(out, id)
1019		}
1020		return out
1021	}

1023	// missingIDs lists requested consignment IDs (as hex) absent from the fetched
1024	// set.
1025	func missingIDs(wanted []primitive.ObjectID, got []domain.DCSConsignment) []string {
1026		have := make(map[primitive.ObjectID]bool, len(got))
1027		for _, c := range got {
1028			have[c.ID] = true
1029		}
1030		var missing []string
1031		for _, id := range wanted {
1032			if !have[id] {
1033				missing = append(missing, id.Hex())
1034			}
1035		}
1036		return missing
1037	}
1038
