81			repo:     newRepo(d.DB),
82			ledger:   d.Ledger,
83			orgs:     d.Orgs,
84			qrSecret: d.Cfg.QRSigningSecret,
85		}
86	}
87	
88	// internalErr converts an unexpected failure into the opaque 500, logging it
89	// at ERROR with operation context first. Typed AppErrors (404s, 400s, org
90	// resolver errors) pass through untouched so client-facing semantics never
91	// change.
92	func (s *Service) internalErr(ctx context.Context, op string, err error, attrs ...any) error {
93		var appErr *httpx.AppError
94		if errors.As(err, &appErr) {
95			return appErr
96		}
97		args := append([]any{slog.Any("err", err)}, attrs...)
98		s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, op, args...)
99		return httpx.Internal(err)
100	}
101	
102	// VerifyQRToken checks a stored signed token in the format QR issuance
103	// (plant module signQRToken) mints: "base64url(qr_code|product_lot_id_hex|
104	// issued_unix)" + "." + hex(HMAC-SHA256(secret, decoded payload)), where
105	// product_lot_id_hex is productLotID.Hex(). The HMAC is computed over the
106	// DECODED payload bytes — exactly what issuance signed. The comparison is
107	// constant-time so a forger learns nothing from response timing.
108	func VerifyQRToken(secret, token string) bool {
109		payloadB64, signature, found := strings.Cut(token, ".")
110		if !found || payloadB64 == "" || signature == "" {
111			return false // malformed: no payload/signature split
112		}
113		payload, err := base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString(payloadB64)
114		if err != nil || len(payload) == 0 {
115			return false // malformed: payload is not valid base64url
116		}
117		expected := auth.HMACHash(secret, string(payload))
118		return auth.ConstantTimeEqual(expected, signature)
119	}
120	
121	// ScanQR resolves one consumer QR scan into the honest provenance view
122	// (§7.4): product + plant + lab certificate + the SET of contributing
123	// samitis — never per-farmer data — plus a live tamper-evidence check.
124	func (s *Service) ScanQR(ctx context.Context, qrCode string) (*QRScanResponse, error) {
125		qr, err := s.repo.qrByCode(ctx, qrCode)
126		if err != nil {
127			return nil, s.internalErr(ctx, "qr scan: load qr", err, slog.String("qr_code", qrCode))
128		}
129	
130		// Integrity gate: the stored token must carry a valid HMAC. A mismatch
131		// means the QR record was tampered with or forged — surface it loudly.
132		if !VerifyQRToken(s.qrSecret, qr.SignedToken) {
133			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "QR signed-token integrity check failed — possible forgery",
134				slog.String("qr_code", qrCode), slog.String("qr_id", qr.ID.Hex()))
135			return nil, httpx.Conflict("QR_INTEGRITY_FAILED",
136				"this QR code failed integrity verification and may be counterfeit")
137		}
138	
139		// Count the scan without ever blocking it: fire-and-forget increment.
140		go func(qrID primitive.ObjectID) {
141			bg, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
142			defer cancel()
143			if err := s.repo.incrementScanCount(bg, qrID); err != nil {
144				s.log.WarnContext(bg, "scan_count increment failed",
145					slog.String("qr_id", qrID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
146			}
147		}(qr.ID)
148	
149		lot, err := s.repo.productLotByID(ctx, qr.ProductLotID)
150		if err != nil {
151			return nil, s.internalErr(ctx, "qr scan: load product lot", err,
152				slog.String("qr_id", qr.ID.Hex()), slog.String("product_lot_id", qr.ProductLotID.Hex()))
153		}
154		batch, err := s.repo.batchByID(ctx, lot.BatchID)
155		if err != nil {
156			return nil, s.internalErr(ctx, "qr scan: load processing batch", err,
157				slog.String("product_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()), slog.String("batch_id", lot.BatchID.Hex()))
158		}
159		plant, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, batch.PlantID)
160		if err != nil {
161			return nil, s.internalErr(ctx, "qr scan: resolve plant org", err,
162				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()), slog.String("plant_id", batch.PlantID.Hex()))
163		}
164	
165		// Walk the provenance graph upstream from the product lot and STOP at the
166		// pooling boundary: batch → BMC lots → consignments (§7.4). Consignment
167		// refs (hundreds of per-pour nodes, cross-route trip fan-out) are never
168		// expanded — the consumer view only needs the samiti set.
169		events, err := s.ledger.TraceStopAt(ctx, domain.EntityProductLot, lot.ID.Hex(), traceDepth,
170			map[string]bool{domain.EntityConsignment: true})
171		if err != nil {
172			return nil, s.internalErr(ctx, "qr scan: trace product lot", err,
173				slog.String("product_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()))
174		}
175	
176		sourcing, err := s.buildSourcing(ctx, events)
177		if err != nil {
178			return nil, err
179		}
180	
181		ledgerInfo, err := s.verifyTracedRange(ctx, events)
182		if err != nil {
183			return nil, err
184		}
185	
186		resp := &QRScanResponse{
187			Product: ProductInfo{
188				Name:       lot.ProductName,
189				SKU:        lot.SKU,
190				UnitSize:   lot.UnitSize,
191				MfgDate:    lot.MfgDate,
192				ExpiryDate: lot.ExpiryDate,
193			},
194			BatchNumber: batch.BatchNumber,
195			Plant:       PlantInfo{Name: plant.Name, District: plant.District},
196			Sourcing:    *sourcing,
197			Ledger:      *ledgerInfo,
198			ScanCount:   qr.ScanCount + 1, // reflect this scan; the $inc lands async
199		}
200	
201		// PLANT_LAB pass certificate — omitted (not an error) when absent.
202		qc, err := s.repo.latestPlantLabPass(ctx, batch.ID)
203		if err != nil {
204			return nil, s.internalErr(ctx, "qr scan: load plant lab certificate", err,
205				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()))
206		}
207		if qc != nil {
208			resp.Quality = &QualityInfo{
209				CertificateNumber: qc.CertificateNumber,
210				Stage:             qc.Stage,
211				Tests:             qc.Tests,
212				RecordedAt:        qc.RecordedAt,
213			}
214		}
215	
216		// A recalled lot still resolves with 200 — consumers must SEE the recall
217		// notice, not hit a dead link.
218		if lot.Status == domain.ProductLotStatusRecalled {
219			resp.Recalled = true
220			notice := "This product lot has been RECALLED. Do not consume — return it to the point of purchase."
221			if lot.RecallReason != "" {
222				notice += " Reason: " + lot.RecallReason
223			}
224			resp.RecallNotice = notice
225		}
226	
227		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "qr scan resolved",
228			slog.String("qr_code", qrCode),
229			slog.String("qr_id", qr.ID.Hex()),
230			slog.String("product_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()),
231			slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
232			slog.String("batch_number", batch.BatchNumber),
233			slog.Int("samitis", len(sourcing.Samitis)),
234			slog.Bool("ledger_intact", ledgerInfo.Intact),
235			slog.Bool("recalled", resp.Recalled))
236		return resp, nil
237	}
238	
239	// buildSourcing derives the samiti-set view from traced consignment events:
240	// contributing DCS org ids from each event's org_unit_id/payload, collection
241	// dates from payloads, with the consignment documents as fallback when the
242	// events did not carry those fields. Ledger events carry ObjectIDs as hex
243	// strings, so the sets are hex-keyed and parsed at the DB/orgscope boundary.
244	func (s *Service) buildSourcing(ctx context.Context, events []provenance.Event) (*SourcingInfo, error) {
245		dcsIDs := map[string]struct{}{}
246		dates := map[string]struct{}{}
247		consignmentIDs := map[string]struct{}{}
248	
249		for _, ev := range events {
250			if ev.EntityType != domain.EntityConsignment {
251				continue
252			}
253			consignmentIDs[ev.EntityID] = struct{}{}
254			// Only created/dispatched events carry the DCS in org_unit_id —
255			// consignment.picked_up is appended by logistics under the UNION's
256			// org id, which must never be counted as a contributing samiti.
257			switch ev.Type {
258			case domain.EventConsignmentCreated, domain.EventConsignmentDispatched:
259				if ev.OrgUnitID != "" {
260					dcsIDs[ev.OrgUnitID] = struct{}{}
261				} else if v, ok := ev.Payload["dcs_id"].(string); ok && v != "" {
262					dcsIDs[v] = struct{}{}
263				}
264			}
265			if v, ok := ev.Payload["date"].(string); ok && v != "" {
266				dates[v] = struct{}{}
267			}
268		}
269	
270		// Fallback: if the events lacked DCS ids or dates, read the consignment
271		// docs themselves (still samiti-level — pour ids are never surfaced).
272		if len(consignmentIDs) > 0 && (len(dcsIDs) == 0 || len(dates) == 0) {
273			ids := make([]primitive.ObjectID, 0, len(consignmentIDs))
274			for _, hexID := range sortedKeys(consignmentIDs) {
275				cid, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(hexID)
276				if err != nil {
277					// Ledger event ids should always be ObjectID hex — flag and skip.
278					s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "QR scan: traced consignment id is not a valid object id",
279						slog.String("consignment_id", hexID))
280					continue
281				}
282				ids = append(ids, cid)
283			}
284			docs, err := s.repo.consignmentsByIDs(ctx, ids)
285			if err != nil {
286				return nil, s.internalErr(ctx, "qr scan: load consignments for sourcing", err)
287			}
288			for _, c := range docs {
289				if !c.DCSID.IsZero() {
290					dcsIDs[c.DCSID.Hex()] = struct{}{}
291				}
292				if c.Date != "" {
293					dates[c.Date] = struct{}{}
294				}
295			}
296		}
297	
298		samitis := make([]SamitiInfo, 0, len(dcsIDs))
299		districts := map[string]struct{}{}
300		for _, hexID := range sortedKeys(dcsIDs) {
301			orgID, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(hexID)
302			if err != nil {
303				// A malformed id must not break a consumer scan — log and skip.
304				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "QR scan: contributing DCS id is not a valid object id",
305					slog.String("dcs_org_id", hexID))
306				continue
307			}
308			org, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, orgID)
309			if err != nil {
310				// A missing org unit must not break a consumer scan — log and skip.
311				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "QR scan: contributing DCS org not resolvable",
312					slog.String("dcs_org_id", hexID), slog.Any("err", err))
313				continue
314			}
315			// Defence in depth: the §7.4 samiti set may only contain DCS units.
316			if org.Type != domain.OrgTypeDCS {
317				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "QR scan: non-DCS org unit skipped from samiti set",
318					slog.String("org_id", hexID), slog.String("org_type", org.Type))
319				continue
320			}
321			samitis = append(samitis, SamitiInfo{Name: org.Name, Code: org.Code, District: org.District})
322			if org.District != "" {
323				districts[org.District] = struct{}{}
324			}
325		}
326		sort.Slice(samitis, func(i, j int) bool { return samitis[i].Name < samitis[j].Name })
327	
328		collectionDates := sortedKeys(dates)
329		return &SourcingInfo{
330			Message:         sourcingMessage(collectionDates, len(samitis), sortedKeys(districts)),
331			Samitis:         samitis,
332			CollectionDates: collectionDates,
333		}, nil
334	}
335	
336	// sourcingMessage renders the consumer-facing pooled-provenance sentence,
337	// e.g. "Made from milk collected on 2026-07-05 from 3 samitis in Lucknow".
338	func sourcingMessage(dates []string, samitiCount int, districts []string) string {
339		var b strings.Builder
340		b.WriteString("Made from milk collected")
341		if len(dates) > 0 {
342			b.WriteString(" on " + strings.Join(dates, ", "))
343		}
344		noun := "samitis"
345		if samitiCount == 1 {
346			noun = "samiti"
347		}
348		fmt.Fprintf(&b, " from %d %s", samitiCount, noun)
349		if len(districts) > 0 {
350			b.WriteString(" in " + strings.Join(districts, ", "))
351		}
352		return b.String()
353	}
354	
355	// verifyTracedRange answers the per-scan tamper-evidence check from a
356	// cumulative verification watermark: the chain is verified incrementally up
357	// to the traced range's max seq, and once a prefix is verified, later scans
358	// inside it are O(1) — no per-request re-hash of thousands of interleaved
359	// events. Spans over scanVerifySpanCap are verified partially (most recent
360	// tail) and flagged, matching the previous per-scan behaviour.
361	func (s *Service) verifyTracedRange(ctx context.Context, events []provenance.Event) (*LedgerInfo, error) {
362		if len(events) == 0 {
363			return &LedgerInfo{Events: 0, Intact: true, VerifiedRange: [2]int64{0, 0}}, nil
364		}
365		maxSeq := events[0].Seq
366		for _, ev := range events[1:] {
367			if ev.Seq > maxSeq {
368				maxSeq = ev.Seq
369			}
370		}
371	
372		s.verifyMu.Lock()
373		defer s.verifyMu.Unlock()
374	
375		if s.chainBroken {
376			return &LedgerInfo{
377				Events:        len(events),
378				Intact:        false,
379				VerifiedRange: [2]int64{s.brokenAtSeq, s.brokenAtSeq},
380			}, nil
381		}
382		if maxSeq <= s.verifiedUpTo {
383			return &LedgerInfo{
384				Events:        len(events),
385				Intact:        true,
386				VerifiedRange: [2]int64{1, s.verifiedUpTo},
387			}, nil
388		}
389	
390		// Extend the watermark: start at the last verified event (re-hashing it
391		// covers the boundary linkage), capped to the per-request span budget.
392		from, partial := max(int64(1), s.verifiedUpTo), false
393		if maxSeq-from+1 > scanVerifySpanCap {
394			from, partial = maxSeq-scanVerifySpanCap+1, true
395		}
396		intact, brokenAt, err := s.ledger.VerifyChain(ctx, from, maxSeq)
397		if err != nil {
398			return nil, s.internalErr(ctx, "qr scan: verify ledger chain", err,
399				slog.Int64("from", from), slog.Int64("to", maxSeq))
400		}
401		if intact {
402			s.verifiedUpTo = maxSeq
403		} else {
404			s.chainBroken, s.brokenAtSeq = true, brokenAt
405			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "provenance chain break detected during scan verification",
406				slog.Int64("broken_at_seq", brokenAt),
407				slog.Int64("from", from), slog.Int64("to", maxSeq))
408		}
409		return &LedgerInfo{
410			Events:        len(events),
411			Intact:        intact,
412			VerifiedRange: [2]int64{from, maxSeq},
413			Partial:       partial,
414		}, nil
415	}
416	
417	// VerifyLedger runs the public tamper-evidence check over [from,to]. Both
418	// bounds are optional: `to` defaults to the chain head, `from` to the start
419	// of the last publicVerifySpanCap events. Spans over the cap are rejected.
420	func (s *Service) VerifyLedger(ctx context.Context, fromRaw, toRaw string) (*LedgerVerifyResponse, error) {
421		latest, err := s.ledger.LatestSeq(ctx)
422		if err != nil {
423			return nil, s.internalErr(ctx, "ledger verify: read chain head", err)
424		}
425		if latest == 0 {
426			return &LedgerVerifyResponse{Intact: true, From: 0, To: 0}, nil // empty chain is trivially intact
427		}
428	
429		to := latest
430		if toRaw != "" {
431			n, err := strconv.ParseInt(toRaw, 10, 64)
432			if err != nil || n < 1 {
433				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_RANGE", "'to' must be a positive sequence number")
434			}
435			to = min(n, latest)
436		}
437		from := max(int64(1), to-publicVerifySpanCap+1)
438		if fromRaw != "" {
439			n, err := strconv.ParseInt(fromRaw, 10, 64)
440			if err != nil || n < 1 {
441				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_RANGE", "'from' must be a positive sequence number")
442			}
443			from = n
444		}
445		if from > to {
446			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_RANGE", "'from' must not exceed 'to'")
447		}
448		if to-from+1 > publicVerifySpanCap {
449			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("SPAN_TOO_WIDE",
450				fmt.Sprintf("verification span is capped at %d events per request", publicVerifySpanCap))
451		}
452	
453		intact, brokenAt, err := s.ledger.VerifyChain(ctx, from, to)
454		if err != nil {
455			return nil, s.internalErr(ctx, "ledger verify: verify chain", err,
456				slog.Int64("from", from), slog.Int64("to", to))
457		}
458		resp := &LedgerVerifyResponse{Intact: intact, From: from, To: to}
459		if !intact {
460			resp.BrokenAtSeq = &brokenAt
461			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "public ledger verification found a broken chain",
462				slog.Int64("broken_at_seq", brokenAt),
463				slog.Int64("from", from), slog.Int64("to", to))
464		}
465		return resp, nil
466	}
467	
468	// TraceGraph returns the full event graph around one entity: upstream via
469	// the recursive ref walk, downstream via reverse-ref lookup — the recall /
470	// root-cause tool (§8.3). entityID is the entity's ObjectID as a hex string
471	// (already validated by the handler; the ledger stores ids as hex).
472	func (s *Service) TraceGraph(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string) (*TraceGraphResponse, error) {
473		if err := validateEntityType(entityType); err != nil {
474			return nil, err
475		}
476		upstream, err := s.ledger.Trace(ctx, entityType, entityID, traceDepth)
477		if err != nil {
478			return nil, s.internalErr(ctx, "trace graph: upstream walk", err,
479				slog.String("entity_type", entityType), slog.String("entity_id", entityID))
480		}
481		// The cap is pushed into the query: only the LAST downstreamEventCap
482		// referencing events are fetched, instead of decoding an unbounded set
483		// into memory and truncating afterwards.
484		downstream, err := s.ledger.DownstreamRefs(ctx, entityID, downstreamEventCap)
485		if err != nil {
486			return nil, s.internalErr(ctx, "trace graph: downstream refs", err,
487				slog.String("entity_type", entityType), slog.String("entity_id", entityID))
488		}
489		if len(upstream) == 0 && len(downstream) == 0 {
490			return nil, httpx.NotFound("provenance for entity")
491		}
492		if upstream == nil {
493			upstream = []provenance.Event{}
494		}
495		if downstream == nil {
496			downstream = []provenance.Event{}
497		}
498		return &TraceGraphResponse{Upstream: upstream, Downstream: downstream}, nil
499	}
500	
501	// Timeline returns one entity's own events in chain order, paginated. The
502	// skip/limit is pushed into the Mongo query so a page read never loads the
503	// entity's full history. The second return value is the total event count.
504	// entityID is the entity's ObjectID as a hex string (handler-validated).
505	func (s *Service) Timeline(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, page httpx.Page) ([]provenance.Event, int, error) {
506		if err := validateEntityType(entityType); err != nil {
507			return nil, 0, err
508		}
509		total, err := s.ledger.CountEventsForEntity(ctx, entityType, entityID)
510		if err != nil {
511			return nil, 0, s.internalErr(ctx, "timeline: count entity events", err,
512				slog.String("entity_type", entityType), slog.String("entity_id", entityID))
513		}
514		if total == 0 {
515			return nil, 0, httpx.NotFound("provenance for entity")
516		}
517		events, err := s.ledger.EventsForEntityPage(ctx, entityType, entityID, page.Offset, page.Limit)
518		if err != nil {
519			return nil, 0, s.internalErr(ctx, "timeline: load entity events page", err,
520				slog.String("entity_type", entityType), slog.String("entity_id", entityID))
521		}
522		return events, int(total), nil
523	}
524	
525	// validateEntityType rejects entity types outside the domain.Entity* catalog.
526	func validateEntityType(entityType string) error {
527		if _, ok := validEntityTypes[entityType]; !ok {
528			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_ENTITY_TYPE",
529				"unknown entity type "+entityType+" — use one of the provenance entity type constants")
530		}
531		return nil
532	}
533	
534	// sortedKeys returns a set's keys in deterministic (lexicographic) order.
535	func sortedKeys(set map[string]struct{}) []string {
536		out := make([]string, 0, len(set))
537		for k := range set {
538			out = append(out, k)
539		}
540		sort.Strings(out)
541		return out
542	}

18	// repo is the read-mostly MongoDB access layer for the trace views. It reads
19	// other modules' collections strictly via the mongodb.Coll* consts, exactly
20	// where the spec sanctions it (QR → lot → batch → qc / consignment lookups).
21	//
22	// Not-found is returned as a typed httpx.NotFound; every unexpected DB error
23	// is wrapped with its operation so the service's ERROR log names the failing
24	// op.
25	type repo struct {
26		batchQRs     *mongo.Collection
27		productLots  *mongo.Collection
28		batches      *mongo.Collection
29		qcResults    *mongo.Collection
30		consignments *mongo.Collection
31	}

33	// newRepo binds the repo to the shared database.
34	func newRepo(db *mongo.Database) *repo {
35		return &repo{
36			batchQRs:     db.Collection(mongodb.CollBatchQRs),
37			productLots:  db.Collection(mongodb.CollProductLots),
38			batches:      db.Collection(mongodb.CollBatches),
39			qcResults:    db.Collection(mongodb.CollQCResults),
40			consignments: db.Collection(mongodb.CollConsignments),
41		}
42	}

44	// qrByCode loads a batch QR by its short public code — qr_code is the unique
45	// human-readable business key (never an ObjectID).
46	func (r *repo) qrByCode(ctx context.Context, code string) (*domain.BatchQR, error) {
47		var qr domain.BatchQR
48		err := r.batchQRs.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "qr_code", Value: code}}).Decode(&qr)
49		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
50			return nil, httpx.NotFound("qr code")
51		}
52		if err != nil {
53			return nil, fmt.Errorf("find qr by code: %w", err)
54		}
55		return &qr, nil

1	package auth

3	import (
4		"crypto/hmac"
5		"crypto/rand"
6		"crypto/sha256"

8		"encoding/base64"
9		"encoding/hex"
10		"fmt"
11		"math/big"
12	)
13	
14	// GenerateNumericOTP returns a cryptographically random n-digit code.
15	func GenerateNumericOTP(n int) (string, error) {
16		if n <= 0 || n > 10 {
17			return "", fmt.Errorf("otp length out of range: %d", n)
18		}
19		max := big.NewInt(1)
20		for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
21			max.Mul(max, big.NewInt(10))
22		}
23		v, err := rand.Int(rand.Reader, max)
24		if err != nil {
25			return "", fmt.Errorf("otp entropy: %w", err)
26		}
27		return fmt.Sprintf("%0*d", n, v), nil
28	}
29	
30	// HMACHash returns hex(HMAC-SHA256(secret, parts joined by '|')). Used for
31	// OTP codes (keyed to the phone) and refresh tokens, so a DB leak alone
32	// reveals no usable credentials.
33	func HMACHash(secret string, parts ...string) string {
34		mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte(secret))
35		for i, p := range parts {
36			if i > 0 {
37				mac.Write([]byte{'|'})
38			}
39			mac.Write([]byte(p))
40		}
41		return hex.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))
42	}
43	
44	// ConstantTimeEqual compares two hex digests without timing leaks.
45	func ConstantTimeEqual(a, b string) bool {
46		return subtle.ConstantTimeCompare([]byte(a), []byte(b)) == 1
47	}
48	
49	// RandomToken returns a URL-safe random token with nBytes of entropy —
50	// used for opaque refresh tokens.
51	func RandomToken(nBytes int) (string, error) {
52		buf := make([]byte, nBytes)
53		if _, err := rand.Read(buf); err != nil {
54			return "", fmt.Errorf("token entropy: %w", err)
55		}
56		return base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString(buf), nil
57	}

167	func (s *service) runWorker(ctx context.Context) (*WorkerRunResponse, error) {
168		sent := 0

301	// ---- Event-bus reactions: cross-module SMS queuing ----
302	
303	// decodeBusPayload structurally re-decodes a bus payload into this module's
304	// mirror struct — modules never import each other's types (module contract).
305	func decodeBusPayload(payload any, dst any) error {
306		raw, err := json.Marshal(payload)
307		if err != nil {
308			return fmt.Errorf("marshal bus payload: %w", err)
309		}
310		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, dst); err != nil {
311			return fmt.Errorf("unmarshal bus payload: %w", err)
312		}
313		return nil
314	}
315	
316	// onPayoutCredited queues the "₹ credited, UTR …" SMS to the farmer
317	// (blueprint §8.1 last step).
318	func (s *service) onPayoutCredited(ctx context.Context, payload any) {
319		var event payoutCreditedEvent
320		if err := decodeBusPayload(payload, &event); err != nil {
321			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "bad payout.credited payload", slog.Any("err", err))
322			return
323		}
324		if event.FarmerPartyID == "" && event.Phone == "" {
325			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "payout.credited payload has no addressee")
326			return
327		}
328		partyID := s.parseAddresseeID(ctx, event.FarmerPartyID, "payout.credited")
329		s.queueNotification(ctx, partyID, event.Phone, domain.TemplatePayoutCredited, map[string]string{
330			"amount": strconv.FormatFloat(event.Amount, 'f', 2, 64),
331			"utr":    event.UTR,
332		})
333	}
334	
335	// onGateBlocked alerts the blocked subject's UNION_FIELD_SUPERVISOR(s): the
336	// subject's org unit is resolved from its document, walked up to the union
337	// ancestor, and every usable supervisor assignment there gets the safety SMS.
338	func (s *service) onGateBlocked(ctx context.Context, payload any) {
339		var event gateBlockedEvent
340		if err := decodeBusPayload(payload, &event); err != nil {
341			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "bad qc.gate_blocked payload", slog.Any("err", err))
342			return
343		}
344	
345		subjectID, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(event.SubjectID)
346		if err != nil {
347			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qc.gate_blocked subject id is not an object id",
348				slog.String("subject_type", event.SubjectType), slog.String("subject_id", event.SubjectID))
349			return
350		}
351		orgUnitID, err := s.repo.subjectOrgUnit(ctx, event.SubjectType, subjectID)
352		if err != nil {
353			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "gate_blocked org resolution failed",
354				slog.String("subject_type", event.SubjectType),
355				slog.String("subject_id", subjectID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
356			return
357		}
358		union, err := s.unionAncestor(ctx, orgUnitID)
359		if err != nil {
360			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "gate_blocked union walk failed",
361				slog.String("org_unit_id", orgUnitID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
362			return
363		}
364		if union == nil {
365			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "gate_blocked org has no union ancestor",
366				slog.String("org_unit_id", orgUnitID.Hex()))
367			return
368		}
369	
370		supervisors, err := s.repo.listActiveRoleHolders(ctx, union.ID, domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor)
371		if err != nil {
372			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "gate_blocked supervisor lookup failed",
373				slog.String("union_id", union.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
374			return
375		}
376	
377		params := map[string]string{
378			"subject_type": event.SubjectType,
379			"subject_id":   event.SubjectID,
380			"stage":        event.Stage,
381			"reasons":      strings.Join(event.FailureReasons, ", "),
382		}
383		now := time.Now().UTC()
384		notified := map[primitive.ObjectID]bool{}
385		for _, assignment := range supervisors {
386			if !assignment.UsableAt(now) || notified[assignment.PartyID] {
387				continue
388			}
389			notified[assignment.PartyID] = true
390			partyID := assignment.PartyID
391			s.queueNotification(ctx, &partyID, "", domain.TemplateSafetyBlock, params)
392		}
393	}
394	
395	// onMVUDispatched queues the "MVU van on its way" SMS to the farmer (§10).
396	func (s *service) onMVUDispatched(ctx context.Context, payload any) {
397		var event mvuDispatchedEvent
398		if err := decodeBusPayload(payload, &event); err != nil {
399			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "bad mvu.dispatched payload", slog.Any("err", err))
400			return
401		}
402		if event.FarmerPartyID == "" && event.Phone == "" {
403			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "mvu.dispatched payload has no addressee")
404			return
405		}
406		caseID := event.CaseID
407		if caseID == "" {
408			caseID = event.MVUCaseID
409		}
410		if caseID == "" {
411			caseID = event.ID
412		}
413		params := map[string]string{"case_id": caseID}
414		if event.ETA != "" {
415			params["eta"] = event.ETA
416		}
417		partyID := s.parseAddresseeID(ctx, event.FarmerPartyID, "mvu.dispatched")
418		s.queueNotification(ctx, partyID, event.Phone, domain.TemplateMVUDispatched, params)
419	}
420	
421	// parseAddresseeID turns an optional addressee party ObjectID hex string
422	// (carried as a hex string on bus payloads) into a *primitive.ObjectID.
423	// An empty value is a legitimate phone-only addressing (returns nil); a
424	// non-empty but malformed value is a business/contract violation (WARN + nil).
425	func (s *service) parseAddresseeID(ctx context.Context, hex, event string) *primitive.ObjectID {
426		if hex == "" {
427			return nil
428		}
429		id, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(hex)
430		if err != nil {
431			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bus payload party id is not an object id",
432				slog.String("event", event), slog.String("party_id", hex))
433			return nil
434		}
435		return &id
436	}
437	
438	// hexOrEmpty renders an optional ObjectID for logs.
439	func hexOrEmpty(id *primitive.ObjectID) string {
440		if id == nil {
441			return ""
442		}
443		return id.Hex()
444	}
445	
446	// queueNotification inserts one QUEUED outbox document, resolving phone and
447	// preferred language from the party record when available. The _id is
448	// pre-generated so the queued entry can be named in the structured log.
449	// Failures are logged, never propagated — a lost SMS must not fail the
450	// publishing flow.
451	func (s *service) queueNotification(ctx context.Context, partyID *primitive.ObjectID, phone, templateKey string, params map[string]string) {
452		language := "hi" // vernacular default (blueprint §13)
453		if partyID != nil {
454			if party, err := s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, *partyID); err == nil {
455				if phone == "" {
456					phone = party.Phone
457				}
458				if party.PreferredLanguage != "" {
459					language = party.PreferredLanguage
460				}
461			}
462		}
463		if phone == "" {
464			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "dropping notification with no phone",
465				slog.String("template_key", templateKey), slog.String("party_id", hexOrEmpty(partyID)))
466			return
467		}
468	
469		id := primitive.NewObjectID()
470		notification := &StoredNotification{Notification: domain.Notification{
471			ID:          id,
472			PartyID:     partyID,
473			Phone:       phone,
474			Channel:     domain.ChannelSMS,
475			TemplateKey: templateKey,
476			Language:    language,
477			Params:      params,
478			Status:      domain.NotificationQueued,
479			QueuedAt:    time.Now().UTC(),
480		}}
481		if err := s.repo.insertNotification(ctx, notification); err != nil {
482			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "queue notification failed",
483				slog.String("template_key", templateKey), slog.Any("err", err))
484			return
485		}
486		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "notification queued",
487			slog.String("notification_id", id.Hex()),
488			slog.String("template_key", templateKey),
489			slog.String("party_id", hexOrEmpty(partyID)),
490			slog.String("status", domain.NotificationQueued))
491	}
492	
493	// unionAncestor returns the MILK_UNION org unit at or above orgUnitID, walking
494	// the denormalised ancestor Path nearest-first via d.Orgs.Get. Returns nil
495	// when no union sits on the chain (e.g. a plant directly under the federation).
496	func (s *service) unionAncestor(ctx context.Context, orgUnitID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
497		org, err := s.deps.Orgs.Get(ctx, orgUnitID)
498		if err != nil {
499			return nil, err
500		}
501		if org.Type == domain.OrgTypeMilkUnion {
502			return org, nil
503		}
504		// Path holds ancestors root→down; walk nearest ancestor first.
505		for i := len(org.Path) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
506			ancestor, err := s.deps.Orgs.Get(ctx, org.Path[i])
507			if err != nil {
508				return nil, err
509			}
510			if ancestor.Type == domain.OrgTypeMilkUnion {
511				return ancestor, nil
512			}
513		}
514		return nil, nil
515	}
516

```text
1	// Package audit writes the immutable who-did-what trail required for
2	// government accountability and DPDP breach forensics (blueprint §12, §16).
3	// Entries are insert-only; the STATE_AUDITOR role reads them via the
4	// platformops module.
5	package audit
6	
7	import (
8		"context"
9		"log/slog"
10		"time"
11	
12		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
13		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
14	
15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
16	)
17	
18	const collection = "audit_logs"
19	
20	// Entry is one audit record. `_id` is a generated ObjectID; actor identifiers
21	// arrive from JWT claims as ObjectID hex strings.
22	type Entry struct {
23		ID           primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
24		ActorPartyID string         `bson:"actor_party_id" json:"actor_party_id"`
25		ActorRole    string         `bson:"actor_role,omitempty" json:"actor_role,omitempty"`
26		Action       string         `bson:"action"         json:"action"` // e.g. "http.POST /api/v1/collection/pours" or "support.pii_lookup"
27		TargetType   string         `bson:"target_type,omitempty" json:"target_type,omitempty"`
28		TargetID     string         `bson:"target_id,omitempty"   json:"target_id,omitempty"`
29		Status       int            `bson:"status,omitempty"      json:"status,omitempty"`
30		IP           string         `bson:"ip,omitempty"          json:"ip,omitempty"`
31		RequestID    string         `bson:"request_id,omitempty"  json:"request_id,omitempty"`
32		Meta         map[string]any `bson:"meta,omitempty"        json:"meta,omitempty"`
33		TS           time.Time      `bson:"ts"             json:"ts"`
34	}
35	
36	// Recorder persists audit entries asynchronously so auditing never adds
37	// latency to the request path.
38	type Recorder struct {
39		coll *mongo.Collection
40		log  *slog.Logger
41	}
42	
43	// NewRecorder binds the recorder to the database.
44	func NewRecorder(db *mongo.Database, log *slog.Logger) *Recorder {
45		return &Recorder{coll: db.Collection(collection), log: log}
46	}
47	
48	// Record fills identity fields from the request context and persists the
49	// entry in the background (fire-and-forget with its own timeout).
50	func (r *Recorder) Record(ctx context.Context, e Entry) {
51		if a, ok := auth.ActorFrom(ctx); ok {
52			if e.ActorPartyID == "" {
53				e.ActorPartyID = a.PartyID
54			}
55			if e.ActorRole == "" {
56				e.ActorRole = a.RoleCode
57			}
58		}
59		e.ID = primitive.NewObjectID()
60		e.TS = time.Now().UTC()
61	
62		go func() {
63			writeCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
64			defer cancel()
65			if _, err := r.coll.InsertOne(writeCtx, e); err != nil {
66				r.log.Error("audit write failed", slog.String("action", e.Action), slog.Any("err", err))
67			}
68		}()
69	}
70

<summary>Tool use: **Read**</summary>
 `./internal/platform/orgscope/resolver.go`

```text
1	// Package orgscope answers the RBAC question "is this resource inside the
2	// caller's organisational scope?" in O(1) DB reads. Org units denormalise
3	// their ancestor chain into Path ([]ObjectID), so scope checking is a
4	// set-membership test — no recursive tree walks on the hot path.
5	package orgscope
6	
7	import (
8		"context"
9		"errors"
10		"sync"
11		"time"
12	
13		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
14		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
15		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
16	
17		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
18		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
19		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
20	)
21	
22	const collection = "org_units"
23	
24	type cachedOrg struct {
25		org domain.OrgUnit
26		at  time.Time
27	}
28	
29	// Resolver caches org units briefly (the tree changes rarely, reads are hot).
30	type Resolver struct {
31		coll *mongo.Collection
32		ttl  time.Duration
33	
34		mu    sync.RWMutex
35		cache map[string]cachedOrg // keyed by ObjectID hex
36	}
37	
38	// NewResolver binds the resolver to the database.
39	func NewResolver(db *mongo.Database) *Resolver {
40		return &Resolver{
41			coll:  db.Collection(collection),
42			ttl:   60 * time.Second,
43			cache: make(map[string]cachedOrg),
44		}
45	}
46	
47	// Get returns an org unit by ObjectID (cached).
48	func (r *Resolver) Get(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
49		key := id.Hex()
50		r.mu.RLock()
51		c, ok := r.cache[key]
52		r.mu.RUnlock()
53		if ok && time.Since(c.at) < r.ttl {
54			org := c.org
55			return &org, nil
56		}
57	
58		var org domain.OrgUnit
59		err := r.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&org)
60		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
61			return nil, httpx.NotFound("org unit " + key)
62		}
63		if err != nil {
64			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
65		}
66	
67		r.mu.Lock()
68		r.cache[key] = cachedOrg{org: org, at: time.Now()}
69		r.mu.Unlock()
70		return &org, nil
71	}
72	
73	// GetByCode returns an org unit by its unique human-readable business code
74	// (e.g. "DCS-01842") — display/lookup use only, never for joins.
75	func (r *Resolver) GetByCode(ctx context.Context, code string) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
76		var org domain.OrgUnit
77		err := r.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "code", Value: code}}).Decode(&org)
78		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
79			return nil, httpx.NotFound("org unit with code " + code)
80		}
81		if err != nil {
82			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
83		}
84		return &org, nil
85	}
86	
87	// Invalidate drops a cached entry (call after updates).
88	func (r *Resolver) Invalidate(id primitive.ObjectID) {
89		r.mu.Lock()
90		delete(r.cache, id.Hex())
91		r.mu.Unlock()
92	}
93	
94	// InScope reports whether target sits at-or-below scope in the hierarchy:
95	// true when scope == target, or scope appears in target's ancestor Path.
96	func (r *Resolver) InScope(ctx context.Context, scopeOrgID, targetOrgID primitive.ObjectID) (bool, error) {
97		if scopeOrgID == targetOrgID {
98			return true, nil
99		}
100		target, err := r.Get(ctx, targetOrgID)
101		if err != nil {
102			return false, err
103		}
104		for _, ancestor := range target.Path {
105			if ancestor == scopeOrgID {
106				return true, nil
107			}
108		}
109		return false, nil
110	}
111	
112	// RequireInScope enforces the actor's org scope over a target org unit.
113	// SUPER_ADMIN and STATE_AUDITOR (read-wide roles rooted at the federation)
114	// pass automatically; everyone else needs ancestry. The actor carries its
115	// org unit as an ObjectID hex string (JWT claims are JSON); it is parsed here.
116	func (r *Resolver) RequireInScope(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, targetOrgID primitive.ObjectID) error {
117		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSuperAdmin || actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleStateAuditor {
118			return nil
119		}
120		if actor.OrgUnitID == "" {
121			return httpx.Forbidden("role token with org scope required")
122		}
123		scopeID, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(actor.OrgUnitID)
124		if err != nil {
125			return httpx.Forbidden("role token carries an invalid org scope")
126		}
127		ok, err := r.InScope(ctx, scopeID, targetOrgID)
128		if err != nil {
129			return err
130		}
131		if !ok {
132			return httpx.Forbidden("resource is outside your organisational scope")
133		}
134		return nil
135	}
136

11	// RequireRoles allows only ROLE-kind tokens whose role is in the allow-list.
12	// SUPER_ADMIN passes every gate (break-glass admin — all its calls are
13	// audited by the audit middleware).
14	func RequireRoles(roles ...string) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
15		allowed := make(map[string]struct{}, len(roles))
16		for _, r := range roles {
17			allowed[r] = struct{}{}
18		}
19		return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
20			return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
21				actor, ok := auth.ActorFrom(r.Context())
22				if !ok {
23					httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Unauthorized("authentication required"))
24					return
25				}
26				if actor.Kind != auth.TokenKindRole {
27					httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Forbidden("a role token is required — select a role first (POST /api/v1/auth/role/select)"))
28					return
29				}
30				if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSuperAdmin {
31					next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
32					return
33				}
34				if _, ok := allowed[actor.RoleCode]; !ok {
35					httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Forbidden("role "+actor.RoleCode+" is not permitted for this action"))
36					return
37				}
38				next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
39			})
40		}
41	}
42	
43	// RequireSession allows any authenticated party (session or role token) —
44	// used for identity endpoints like "list my roles".
45	func RequireSession(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
46		return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
47			if _, ok := auth.ActorFrom(r.Context()); !ok {
48				httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Unauthorized("authentication required"))
49				return
50			}
51			next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
52		})
53	}

1	// Package middleware carries the cross-cutting HTTP concerns: token
2	// authentication, role enforcement, audit capture, per-IP rate limiting,
3	// Prometheus metrics.
4	package middleware
5	
6	import (
7		"net/http"
8		"strings"
9	
10		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
11		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
12	)
13	
14	// Authenticate verifies the Bearer token and installs the Actor on the
15	// request context. Requests without a valid token are rejected — public
16	// routes simply don't mount this middleware.
17	func Authenticate(jwtm *auth.JWTManager) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
18		return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
19			return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
20				header := r.Header.Get("Authorization")
21				token, ok := strings.CutPrefix(header, "Bearer ")
22				if !ok || token == "" {
23					httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Unauthorized("missing bearer token"))
24					return
25				}
26				claims, err := jwtm.Parse(token)
27				if err != nil {
28					httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Unauthorized("invalid or expired token"))
29					return
30				}
31				actor := auth.Actor{
32					PartyID:          claims.PartyID,
33					Phone:            claims.Phone,
34					KYCTier:          claims.KYCTier,
35					Kind:             claims.Kind,
36					RoleAssignmentID: claims.RoleAssignmentID,
37					RoleCode:         claims.RoleCode,
38					OrgUnitID:        claims.OrgUnitID,
39					OrgType:          claims.OrgType,
40				}
41				next.ServeHTTP(w, r.WithContext(auth.WithActor(r.Context(), actor)))
42			})
43		}
44	}
45

1	package middleware

3	import (
4		"net/http"
5	
6		chimw "github.com/go-chi/chi/v5/middleware"
7	
8		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/audit"
9		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
10	)
11	
12	// AuditMutations records every state-changing request (non-GET/HEAD/OPTIONS)
13	// into the immutable audit trail: actor, action, status, IP, request ID.
14	// Runs after the handler so the final status code is captured; the write
15	// itself is async and adds no request latency.
16	//
17	// This middleware mounts OUTSIDE the per-module Authenticate middleware, so
18	// the actor installed on the inner request context never propagates back to
19	// this frame. An actor holder is installed on the context before the chain
20	// runs; auth.WithActor fills it, and the identity is read back here so the
21	// who-did-what contract holds for every HTTP mutation.
22	func AuditMutations(rec *audit.Recorder) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
23		return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
24			return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
25				if r.Method == http.MethodGet || r.Method == http.MethodHead || r.Method == http.MethodOptions {
26					next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
27					return
28				}
29				r = r.WithContext(auth.WithActorHolder(r.Context()))
30				ww := chimw.NewWrapResponseWriter(w, r.ProtoMajor)
31				next.ServeHTTP(ww, r)
32	
33				entry := audit.Entry{
34					Action:    "http." + r.Method + " " + r.URL.Path,
35					Status:    ww.Status(),
36					IP:        r.RemoteAddr,
37					RequestID: chimw.GetReqID(r.Context()),
38				}
39				if actor, ok := auth.HeldActor(r.Context()); ok {
40					entry.ActorPartyID = actor.PartyID
41					entry.ActorRole = actor.RoleCode
42				}
43				rec.Record(r.Context(), entry)
44			})
45		}
46	}

88			return nil, err
89		}
90		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.DCSID); err != nil {
91			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "consignment creation denied: DCS out of scope",
92				slog.String("dcs_id", req.DCSID.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
93			return nil, err
94		}
95		org, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.DCSID)
96		if err != nil {
97			return nil, err
98		}
99		if org.Type != domain.OrgTypeDCS {
100			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_DCS", "org unit "+req.DCSID.Hex()+" is not a DCS")
101		}
102	
103		rows, err := s.repo.findRecordedPours(ctx, req.DCSID, date, req.Shift)
104		if err != nil {
105			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "create consignment: find recorded pours", err)
106		}
107		if len(rows) == 0 {
108			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "consignment creation rejected: no RECORDED pours",
109				slog.String("dcs_id", req.DCSID.Hex()), slog.String("date", date),
110				slog.String("shift", req.Shift), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
111			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("NO_POURS_TO_CONSIGN",
112				fmt.Sprintf("no RECORDED pours for DCS %s on %s %s", req.DCSID.Hex(), date, req.Shift))
113		}
114		pourIDs, totalQty, avgFat, avgSNF := aggregatePours(rows)
115	
116		consignment := &domain.DCSConsignment{
117			ID:                  primitive.NewObjectID(), // pre-generated: insert + ledger refs stay consistent
118			DCSID:               req.DCSID,
119			Date:                date,
120			Shift:               req.Shift,
121			PourIDs:             pourIDs,
122			TotalQuantityLitres: totalQty,
123			CanCount:            int(math.Ceil(totalQty / canCapacityLitres)),
124			AvgFatPct:           avgFat,
125			AvgSNFPct:           avgSNF,
126			Status:              domain.ConsignmentStatusOpen,
127			CreatedBy:           actorID,
128			CreatedAt:           now,
129		}
130		if err := s.repo.insertConsignment(ctx, consignment); err != nil {
131			if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(err) {
132				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "consignment creation rejected: duplicate for dcs+date+shift",
133					slog.String("dcs_id", req.DCSID.Hex()), slog.String("date", date),
134					slog.String("shift", req.Shift), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
135				return nil, httpx.Conflict("CONSIGNMENT_EXISTS",
136					fmt.Sprintf("a consignment for DCS %s on %s %s already exists", req.DCSID.Hex(), date, req.Shift))
137			}
138			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "create consignment: insert", err)
139		}
140	
141		// Provenance: the pooling-boundary event. Pour refs are capped so the
142		// event stays bounded — past the cap the payload's pour_count is the
143		// authoritative tally (the doc's pour_ids keeps the full set).
144		refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, min(len(pourIDs), maxPourRefs))
145		for i, id := range pourIDs {
146			if i >= maxPourRefs {
147				break
148			}
149			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{EntityType: domain.EntityMilkPour, EntityID: id.Hex(), Relation: "aggregates"})
150		}
151		event, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
152			Type:       domain.EventConsignmentCreated,
153			EntityType: domain.EntityConsignment,
154			EntityID:   consignment.ID.Hex(),
155			Refs:       refs,
156			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
157			OrgUnitID:  consignment.DCSID.Hex(),
158			Payload: map[string]any{
159				"pour_count":            len(pourIDs),
160				"total_quantity_litres": totalQty,
161				"can_count":             consignment.CanCount,
162				"date":                  date,
163				"shift":                 req.Shift,
164			},
165		})
166		if err != nil {
167			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "create consignment: append provenance", err)
168		}
169		if err := s.repo.setConsignmentProvenanceSeq(ctx, consignment.ID, event.Seq); err != nil {
170			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "create consignment: set provenance seq", err)
171		}
172		consignment.ProvenanceSeq = event.Seq
173		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "consignment created",
174			slog.String("consignment_id", consignment.ID.Hex()),
175			slog.String("dcs_id", consignment.DCSID.Hex()),
176			slog.String("date", date), slog.String("shift", req.Shift),
177			slog.Int("pour_count", len(pourIDs)),
178			slog.Float64("total_quantity_litres", totalQty),
179			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
180		return consignment, nil
181	}
182	
183	// dispatchConsignment seals an OPEN consignment for pickup (OPEN→DISPATCHED).
184	// The creation-time pour snapshot is provisional: the seal re-aggregates the
185	// shift's RECORDED pours so milk recorded between creation and dispatch (the
186	// collection module also rejects such pours, belt-and-braces) is reflected in
187	// pour_ids, litres, can count and weighted fat/SNF before the load leaves.
188	func (s *service) dispatchConsignment(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.DCSConsignment, error) {
189		consignment, err := s.loadConsignment(ctx, id)
190		if err != nil {
191			return nil, err
192		}
193		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, consignment.DCSID); err != nil {
194			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "consignment dispatch denied: DCS out of scope",
195				slog.String("consignment_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("dcs_id", consignment.DCSID.Hex()),
196				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
197			return nil, err
198		}
199		if consignment.Status != domain.ConsignmentStatusOpen {
200			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "consignment dispatch rejected: not OPEN",
201				slog.String("consignment_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("status", consignment.Status),
202				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
203			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_CONSIGNMENT_STATE",
204				"consignment is "+consignment.Status+"; only OPEN consignments can be dispatched")
205		}
206	
207		// Re-aggregate at the seal boundary.
208		rows, err := s.repo.findRecordedPours(ctx, consignment.DCSID, consignment.Date, consignment.Shift)
209		if err != nil {
210			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "dispatch consignment: find recorded pours", err)
211		}
212		extraSet := bson.D{}
213		if len(rows) > 0 {
214			pourIDs, totalQty, avgFat, avgSNF := aggregatePours(rows)
215			consignment.PourIDs = pourIDs
216			consignment.TotalQuantityLitres = totalQty
217			consignment.CanCount = int(math.Ceil(totalQty / canCapacityLitres))
218			consignment.AvgFatPct = avgFat
219			consignment.AvgSNFPct = avgSNF
220			extraSet = bson.D{
221				{Key: "pour_ids", Value: pourIDs},
222				{Key: "total_quantity_litres", Value: totalQty},
223				{Key: "can_count", Value: consignment.CanCount},
224				{Key: "avg_fat_pct", Value: avgFat},
225				{Key: "avg_snf_pct", Value: avgSNF},
226			}
227		}
228	
229		now := time.Now().UTC()
230		matched, err := s.repo.markConsignmentDispatched(ctx, id, now, extraSet)
231		if err != nil {
232			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "dispatch consignment: mark dispatched", err)
233		}
234		if !matched { // lost a state race since the read above
235			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "consignment dispatch rejected: lost state race",
236				slog.String("consignment_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
237			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_CONSIGNMENT_STATE",
238				"consignment was modified concurrently; reload and retry")
239		}
240		event, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
241			Type:       domain.EventConsignmentDispatched,
242			EntityType: domain.EntityConsignment,
243			EntityID:   consignment.ID.Hex(),
244			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
245			OrgUnitID:  consignment.DCSID.Hex(),
246			Payload: map[string]any{
247				"pour_count":            len(consignment.PourIDs),
248				"total_quantity_litres": consignment.TotalQuantityLitres,
249				"can_count":             consignment.CanCount,
250				"date":                  consignment.Date,
251				"shift":                 consignment.Shift,
252			},
253		})
254		if err != nil {
255			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "dispatch consignment: append provenance", err)
256		}
257		if err := s.repo.setConsignmentProvenanceSeq(ctx, consignment.ID, event.Seq); err != nil {
258			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "dispatch consignment: set provenance seq", err)
259		}
260		consignment.Status = domain.ConsignmentStatusDispatch
261		consignment.DispatchedAt = &now
262		consignment.ProvenanceSeq = event.Seq
263		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "consignment dispatched",
264			slog.String("consignment_id", consignment.ID.Hex()),
265			slog.String("dcs_id", consignment.DCSID.Hex()),
266			slog.Int("pour_count", len(consignment.PourIDs)),
267			slog.Float64("total_quantity_litres", consignment.TotalQuantityLitres),
268			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
269		return consignment, nil
270	}
271	
272	// listConsignments returns a scoped page of consignments. DCS-scoped actors
273	// default to their own society; wide read roles (SUPER_ADMIN, STATE_AUDITOR)
274	// may list unfiltered; everyone else must name a dcs_id inside their scope.
275	func (s *service) listConsignments(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, q consignmentListQuery, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.DCSConsignment, int64, error) {
276		dcsID := q.DCSID
277		if dcsID.IsZero() {
278			switch {
279			case actor.OrgType == domain.OrgTypeDCS && actor.OrgUnitID != "":
280				id, err := httpx.ParseID(actor.OrgUnitID, "actor org unit")
281				if err != nil {
282					return nil, 0, err
283				}
284				dcsID = id
285			case actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSuperAdmin || actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleStateAuditor:
286				// federation-wide read roles may scan unfiltered (still paged)
287			default:
288				return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("DCS_ID_REQUIRED", "dcs_id query parameter is required for your role")
289			}
290		}
291		if !dcsID.IsZero() {
292			if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, dcsID); err != nil {
293				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "consignment list denied: DCS out of scope",
294					slog.String("dcs_id", dcsID.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
295				return nil, 0, err
296			}
297		}
298		if q.Date != "" {
299			if _, err := resolveDate(q.Date, time.Time{}); err != nil {
300				return nil, 0, err
301			}
302		}
303		if q.Status != "" && !isConsignmentStatus(q.Status) {
304			return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_STATUS", "unknown consignment status "+q.Status)
305		}
306		items, total, err := s.repo.listConsignments(ctx, dcsID, q.Date, q.Status, page)
307		if err != nil {
308			return nil, 0, s.internal(ctx, "list consignments", err)
309		}
310		return items, total, nil
311	}
312	
313	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
314	// Route trips
315	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
316	
317	// createTrip plans a van run: every stop's consignment must already be
318	// DISPATCHED and must belong to that stop's DCS. The rider defaults to the
319	// actor when a VAN_RIDER plans their own route.
320	func (s *service) createTrip(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req createTripRequest) (*domain.RouteTrip, error) {
321		if req.RouteName == "" {
322			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_ROUTE_NAME", "route_name is required")
323		}
324		if req.UnionID.IsZero() {
325			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_UNION_ID", "union_id is required")
326		}
327		if err := validateShift(req.Shift); err != nil {
328			return nil, err
329		}
330		if len(req.Stops) == 0 {
331			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NO_STOPS", "at least one stop is required")
332		}
333		if len(req.Stops) > maxTripStops {
334			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("TOO_MANY_STOPS", fmt.Sprintf("a trip may have at most %d stops", maxTripStops))
335		}
336		now := time.Now().UTC()
337		date, err := resolveDate(req.Date, now)
338		if err != nil {
339			return nil, err
340		}
341		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.UnionID); err != nil {
342			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "trip creation denied: union out of scope",
343				slog.String("union_id", req.UnionID.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
344			return nil, err
345		}
346		union, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.UnionID)
347		if err != nil {
348			return nil, err
349		}
350		if union.Type != domain.OrgTypeMilkUnion {
351			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_UNION", "org unit "+req.UnionID.Hex()+" is not a MILK_UNION")
352		}
353	
354		var riderPartyID primitive.ObjectID
355		if req.VanRiderPartyID != nil && !req.VanRiderPartyID.IsZero() {
356			riderPartyID = *req.VanRiderPartyID
357		} else {
358			if actor.RoleCode != domain.RoleVanRider {
359				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("RIDER_REQUIRED", "van_rider_party_id is required unless a VAN_RIDER plans their own trip")
360			}
361			actorID, err := s.actorID(actor)
362			if err != nil {
363				return nil, err
364			}
365			riderPartyID = actorID
366		}
367	
368		seen := make(map[primitive.ObjectID]struct{}, len(req.Stops))
369		stops := make([]domain.RouteStop, 0, len(req.Stops))
370		for _, stop := range req.Stops {
371			if stop.DCSID.IsZero() || stop.ConsignmentID.IsZero() {
372				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_STOP", "every stop needs dcs_id and consignment_id")
373			}
374			if _, dup := seen[stop.ConsignmentID]; dup {
375				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("DUPLICATE_STOP", "consignment "+stop.ConsignmentID.Hex()+" appears in more than one stop")
376			}
377			seen[stop.ConsignmentID] = struct{}{}
378	
379			consignment, err := s.loadConsignment(ctx, stop.ConsignmentID)
380			if err != nil {
381				return nil, err
382			}
383			if aerr := validateStopConsignment(consignment, stop.DCSID); aerr != nil {
384				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "trip creation rejected: invalid stop consignment",
385					slog.String("consignment_id", stop.ConsignmentID.Hex()),
386					slog.String("stop_dcs_id", stop.DCSID.Hex()),
387					slog.String("consignment_status", consignment.Status),
388					slog.String("code", aerr.Code),
389					slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
390				return nil, aerr
391			}
392			stops = append(stops, domain.RouteStop{DCSID: stop.DCSID, ConsignmentID: stop.ConsignmentID})
393		}
394	
395		trip := &domain.RouteTrip{
396			ID:              primitive.NewObjectID(), // pre-generated so provenance can reference it later
397			RouteName:       req.RouteName,
398			UnionID:         req.UnionID,
399			VanRiderPartyID: riderPartyID,
400			Date:            date,
401			Shift:           req.Shift,
402			Stops:           stops,
403			Status:          domain.TripStatusPlanned,
404			CreatedAt:       now,
405		}
406		if err := s.repo.insertTrip(ctx, trip); err != nil {
407			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "create trip: insert", err)
408		}
409		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "trip created",
410			slog.String("trip_id", trip.ID.Hex()),
411			slog.String("union_id", trip.UnionID.Hex()),
412			slog.String("van_rider_party_id", trip.VanRiderPartyID.Hex()),
413			slog.String("route_name", trip.RouteName),
414			slog.String("date", date), slog.String("shift", req.Shift),
415			slog.Int("stop_count", len(stops)),
416			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
417		return trip, nil
418	}
419	
420	// pickupStop records the trip's rider collecting one consignment: the stop is
421	// stamped with time+temperature, the consignment moves DISPATCHED→PICKED_UP,
422	// and the trip moves to IN_PROGRESS on its first pickup.
423	func (s *service) pickupStop(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, tripID, consignmentID primitive.ObjectID, req pickupRequest) (*domain.RouteTrip, error) {
424		if err := validateTemp(req.TempC); err != nil {
425			return nil, err
426		}
427		actorID, err := s.actorID(actor)
428		if err != nil {
429			return nil, err
430		}
431		trip, err := s.loadTrip(ctx, tripID)
432		if err != nil {
433			return nil, err
434		}
435		if aerr := validatePickup(trip, actorID, consignmentID); aerr != nil {
436			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "stop pickup rejected",
437				slog.String("trip_id", tripID.Hex()), slog.String("consignment_id", consignmentID.Hex()),
438				slog.String("code", aerr.Code), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
439			return nil, aerr
440		}
441	
442		// Guard the consignment transition atomically; only a DISPATCHED
443		// consignment can board the van.
444		matched, err := s.repo.markConsignmentPickedUp(ctx, consignmentID, trip.ID)
445		if err != nil {
446			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "pickup stop: mark consignment picked up", err)
447		}
448		if !matched {
449			consignment, err := s.loadConsignment(ctx, consignmentID)
450			if err != nil {
451				return nil, err
452			}
453			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "stop pickup rejected: consignment not DISPATCHED",
454				slog.String("trip_id", tripID.Hex()), slog.String("consignment_id", consignmentID.Hex()),
455				slog.String("consignment_status", consignment.Status),
456				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
457			return nil, httpx.Conflict("CONSIGNMENT_NOT_DISPATCHED",
458				"consignment is "+consignment.Status+"; only DISPATCHED consignments can be picked up")
459		}
460	
461		now := time.Now().UTC()
462		if err := s.repo.markStopPickedUp(ctx, trip.ID, consignmentID, now, *req.TempC, req.Notes); err != nil {
463			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "pickup stop: mark stop picked up", err)
464		}
465	
466		event, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
467			Type:       domain.EventConsignmentPickedUp,
468			EntityType: domain.EntityConsignment,
469			EntityID:   consignmentID.Hex(),
470			Refs: []provenance.Ref{
471				{EntityType: domain.EntityRouteTrip, EntityID: trip.ID.Hex(), Relation: "carried_by"},
472			},
473			Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
474			OrgUnitID: trip.UnionID.Hex(),
475			Payload:   map[string]any{"temp_c": *req.TempC},
476		})
477		if err != nil {
478			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "pickup stop: append provenance", err)
479		}
480		if err := s.repo.setConsignmentProvenanceSeq(ctx, consignmentID, event.Seq); err != nil {
481			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "pickup stop: set provenance seq", err)
482		}
483	
484		trip.Status = domain.TripStatusInProgress
485		if i := findStop(trip, consignmentID); i >= 0 {
486			trip.Stops[i].PickedUpAt = &now
487			trip.Stops[i].TempC = *req.TempC
488			trip.Stops[i].Notes = req.Notes
489		}
490		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "stop picked up",
491			slog.String("trip_id", trip.ID.Hex()),
492			slog.String("consignment_id", consignmentID.Hex()),
493			slog.Float64("temp_c", *req.TempC),
494			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
495		return trip, nil
496	}
497	
498	// logColdChain appends one in-transit temperature sample to the trip —
499	// tamper-evidence for the perishable load between village and BMC.
500	func (s *service) logColdChain(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, tripID primitive.ObjectID, req coldChainRequest) (*domain.RouteTrip, error) {
501		if err := validateTemp(req.TempC); err != nil {
502			return nil, err
503		}
504		actorID, err := s.actorID(actor)
505		if err != nil {
506			return nil, err
507		}
508		trip, err := s.loadTrip(ctx, tripID)
509		if err != nil {
510			return nil, err
511		}
512		if aerr := validateColdChain(trip, actorID); aerr != nil {
513			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "cold-chain log rejected",
514				slog.String("trip_id", tripID.Hex()), slog.String("code", aerr.Code),
515				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
516			return nil, aerr
517		}
518		entry := domain.ColdChainEntry{
519			TS:     time.Now().UTC(),
520			TempC:  *req.TempC,
521			GeoLat: req.GeoLat,
522			GeoLng: req.GeoLng,
523		}
524		if err := s.repo.pushColdChain(ctx, trip.ID, entry); err != nil {
525			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "log cold chain: push entry", err)
526		}
527		event, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
528			Type:       domain.EventColdChainLogged,
529			EntityType: domain.EntityRouteTrip,
530			EntityID:   trip.ID.Hex(),
531			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
532			OrgUnitID:  trip.UnionID.Hex(),
533			Payload:    map[string]any{"temp_c": *req.TempC},
534		})
535		if err != nil {
536			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "log cold chain: append provenance", err)
537		}
538		if err := s.repo.setTripProvenanceSeq(ctx, trip.ID, event.Seq); err != nil {
539			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "log cold chain: set provenance seq", err)
540		}
541		trip.ColdChain = append(trip.ColdChain, entry)
542		trip.ProvenanceSeq = event.Seq
543		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "cold chain logged",
544			slog.String("trip_id", trip.ID.Hex()),
545			slog.Float64("temp_c", *req.TempC),
546			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
547		return trip, nil
548	}
549	
550	// deliverTrip hands the whole load to a BMC: every stop must be picked up,
551	// the trip moves IN_PROGRESS→DELIVERED and its consignments PICKED_UP→DELIVERED.
552	func (s *service) deliverTrip(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, tripID primitive.ObjectID, req deliverRequest) (*domain.RouteTrip, error) {
553		if req.BMCID.IsZero() {
554			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_BMC_ID", "bmc_id is required")
555		}
556		actorID, err := s.actorID(actor)
557		if err != nil {
558			return nil, err
559		}
560		trip, err := s.loadTrip(ctx, tripID)
561		if err != nil {
562			return nil, err
563		}
564		if aerr := validateDeliver(trip, actorID); aerr != nil {
565			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "trip delivery rejected",
566				slog.String("trip_id", tripID.Hex()), slog.String("code", aerr.Code),
567				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
568			return nil, aerr
569		}
570		bmc, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.BMCID)
571		if err != nil {
572			return nil, err
573		}
574		if bmc.Type != domain.OrgTypeBMC {
575			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_BMC", "org unit "+req.BMCID.Hex()+" is not a BMC")
576		}
577	
578		now := time.Now().UTC()
579		matched, err := s.repo.markTripDelivered(ctx, trip.ID, req.BMCID, now)
580		if err != nil {
581			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "deliver trip: mark delivered", err)
582		}
583		if !matched { // lost a state race since the read above
584			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "trip delivery rejected: lost state race",
585				slog.String("trip_id", tripID.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
586			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_TRIP_STATE", "trip was modified concurrently; reload and retry")
587		}
588	
589		consignmentIDs := make([]primitive.ObjectID, 0, len(trip.Stops))
590		refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, len(trip.Stops))
591		for _, stop := range trip.Stops {
592			consignmentIDs = append(consignmentIDs, stop.ConsignmentID)
593			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{
594				EntityType: domain.EntityConsignment, EntityID: stop.ConsignmentID.Hex(), Relation: "delivered",
595			})
596		}
597		if err := s.repo.markConsignmentsDelivered(ctx, consignmentIDs); err != nil {
598			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "deliver trip: mark consignments delivered", err)
599		}
600	
601		event, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
602			Type:       domain.EventTripDelivered,
603			EntityType: domain.EntityRouteTrip,
604			EntityID:   trip.ID.Hex(),
605			Refs:       refs,
606			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
607			OrgUnitID:  trip.UnionID.Hex(),
608			Payload:    map[string]any{"bmc_id": req.BMCID.Hex()},
609		})
610		if err != nil {
611			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "deliver trip: append provenance", err)
612		}
613		if err := s.repo.setTripProvenanceSeq(ctx, trip.ID, event.Seq); err != nil {
614			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "deliver trip: set provenance seq", err)
615		}
616	
617		trip.Status = domain.TripStatusDelivered
618		trip.DeliveredToBMCID = &req.BMCID
619		trip.DeliveredAt = &now
620		trip.ProvenanceSeq = event.Seq
621		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "trip delivered",
622			slog.String("trip_id", trip.ID.Hex()),
623			slog.String("bmc_id", req.BMCID.Hex()),
624			slog.Int("consignment_count", len(consignmentIDs)),
625			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
626		return trip, nil
627	}

629	// listTrips returns a scoped page of trips: riders are forced onto their own
630	// trips; supervisors/presidents default to (and are checked against) their
631	// union scope.
632	func (s *service) listTrips(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, q tripListQuery, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.RouteTrip, int64, error) {
633		unionID := q.UnionID
634		riderPartyID := q.VanRiderPartyID
635		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleVanRider {
636			actorID, err := s.actorID(actor)
637			if err != nil {
638				return nil, 0, err
639			}
640			riderPartyID = actorID // riders only ever see their own trips
641		} else {
642			if unionID.IsZero() &&
643				actor.RoleCode != domain.RoleSuperAdmin && actor.RoleCode != domain.RoleStateAuditor &&
644				actor.OrgUnitID != "" {
645				id, err := httpx.ParseID(actor.OrgUnitID, "actor org unit")
646				if err != nil {
647					return nil, 0, err
648				}
649				unionID = id // supervisors/presidents default to their union
650			}
651			if !unionID.IsZero() {
652				if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, unionID); err != nil {
653					s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "trip list denied: union out of scope",
654						slog.String("union_id", unionID.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
655					return nil, 0, err
656				}
657			}
658		}
659		if q.Date != "" {
660			if _, err := resolveDate(q.Date, time.Time{}); err != nil {
661				return nil, 0, err
662			}
663		}
664		items, total, err := s.repo.listTrips(ctx, unionID, q.Date, riderPartyID, page)
665		if err != nil {
666			return nil, 0, s.internal(ctx, "list trips", err)
667		}
668		return items, total, nil
669	}

671	// getTrip returns one trip: a rider only their own, everyone else within
672	// union scope.
673	func (s *service) getTrip(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, tripID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.RouteTrip, error) {
674		trip, err := s.loadTrip(ctx, tripID)
675		if err != nil {
676			return nil, err
677		}
678		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleVanRider {
679			actorID, err := s.actorID(actor)
680			if err != nil {
681				return nil, err
682			}
683			if trip.VanRiderPartyID != actorID {
684				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "trip read denied: assigned to another rider",
685					slog.String("trip_id", tripID.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
686				return nil, httpx.Forbidden("this trip is assigned to another van rider")
687			}
688			return trip, nil
689		}
690		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, trip.UnionID); err != nil {
691			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "trip read denied: union out of scope",
692				slog.String("trip_id", tripID.Hex()), slog.String("union_id", trip.UnionID.Hex()),
693				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
694			return nil, err

727	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
728	// Pure guards & helpers (unit-tested in service_test.go)
729	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
730	
731	// aggregatePours reduces pour rows to (ids, total litres, quantity-weighted
732	// average fat %, quantity-weighted average SNF %), rounded to 2 decimals.
733	func aggregatePours(rows []pourRow) (pourIDs []primitive.ObjectID, totalQty, avgFat, avgSNF float64) {
734		var fatWeighted, snfWeighted float64
735		pourIDs = make([]primitive.ObjectID, 0, len(rows))
736		for _, row := range rows {
737			pourIDs = append(pourIDs, row.ID)
738			totalQty += row.QuantityLitres
739			fatWeighted += row.FatPct * row.QuantityLitres
740			snfWeighted += row.SNFPct * row.QuantityLitres
741		}
742		if totalQty > 0 {
743			avgFat = round2(fatWeighted / totalQty)
744			avgSNF = round2(snfWeighted / totalQty)
745		}
746		return pourIDs, round2(totalQty), avgFat, avgSNF
747	}
748	
749	// round2 rounds to 2 decimal places (litres / percentage precision).
750	func round2(v float64) float64 { return math.Round(v*100) / 100 }
751	
752	// validateShift accepts only the two collection shifts.
753	func validateShift(shift string) *httpx.AppError {
754		if shift != domain.ShiftMorning && shift != domain.ShiftEvening {
755			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_SHIFT", "shift must be MORNING or EVENING")
756		}
757		return nil
758	}
759	
760	// resolveDate defaults an empty date to the IST day key of now, otherwise
761	// validates the YYYY-MM-DD form.
762	func resolveDate(date string, now time.Time) (string, error) {
763		if date == "" {
764			return domain.DateKeyIST(now), nil
765		}
766		if _, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", date); err != nil {
767			return "", httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_DATE", "date must be YYYY-MM-DD")
768		}
769		return date, nil
770	}
771	
772	// validateTemp requires a temperature and rejects physically implausible ones.
773	func validateTemp(tempC *float64) *httpx.AppError {
774		if tempC == nil {
775			return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_TEMP", "temp_c is required")
776		}
777		if *tempC < minPlausibleTempC || *tempC > maxPlausibleTempC {
778			return httpx.BadRequest("IMPLAUSIBLE_TEMP",
779				fmt.Sprintf("temp_c must be between %.0f and %.0f °C", minPlausibleTempC, maxPlausibleTempC))
780		}
781		return nil
782	}
783	
784	// isConsignmentStatus reports whether s is a known consignment status.
785	func isConsignmentStatus(s string) bool {
786		switch s {
787		case domain.ConsignmentStatusOpen, domain.ConsignmentStatusDispatch,
788			domain.ConsignmentStatusPickedUp, domain.ConsignmentStatusDelivered,
789			domain.ConsignmentStatusAccepted, domain.ConsignmentStatusRejected:
790			return true
791		}
792		return false
793	}

795	// findStop returns the index of the stop carrying consignmentID, or -1.
796	func findStop(trip *domain.RouteTrip, consignmentID primitive.ObjectID) int {
797		for i := range trip.Stops {
798			if trip.Stops[i].ConsignmentID == consignmentID {
799				return i
800			}
801		}
802		return -1
803	}
804	
805	// requireTripRider enforces that only the trip's assigned van rider acts on it.
806	func requireTripRider(trip *domain.RouteTrip, riderPartyID primitive.ObjectID) *httpx.AppError {
807		if trip.VanRiderPartyID != riderPartyID {
808			return httpx.Forbidden("this trip is assigned to another van rider")
809		}
810		return nil
811	}
812	
813	// validateStopConsignment guards trip planning: the stop's consignment must
814	// be DISPATCHED (state machine) and must belong to the stop's DCS.
815	func validateStopConsignment(consignment *domain.DCSConsignment, stopDCSID primitive.ObjectID) *httpx.AppError {
816		if consignment.Status != domain.ConsignmentStatusDispatch {
817			return httpx.Conflict("CONSIGNMENT_NOT_DISPATCHED",
818				"consignment "+consignment.ID.Hex()+" is "+consignment.Status+"; only DISPATCHED consignments can be planned onto a trip")
819		}
820		if consignment.DCSID != stopDCSID {
821			return httpx.Unprocessable("CONSIGNMENT_DCS_MISMATCH",
822				"consignment "+consignment.ID.Hex()+" belongs to DCS "+consignment.DCSID.Hex()+", not the stop's DCS "+stopDCSID.Hex())
823		}
824		return nil
825	}
826	
827	// validatePickup guards the pickup transition: right rider, trip not yet
828	// delivered, stop exists, stop not already picked.
829	func validatePickup(trip *domain.RouteTrip, riderPartyID, consignmentID primitive.ObjectID) *httpx.AppError {
830		if err := requireTripRider(trip, riderPartyID); err != nil {
831			return err
832		}
833		if trip.Status == domain.TripStatusDelivered {
834			return httpx.Conflict("TRIP_ALREADY_DELIVERED", "trip is DELIVERED; no further pickups are possible")
835		}
836		i := findStop(trip, consignmentID)
837		if i < 0 {
838			return httpx.NotFound("stop for consignment " + consignmentID.Hex())
839		}
840		if trip.Stops[i].PickedUpAt != nil {
841			return httpx.Conflict("STOP_ALREADY_PICKED", "consignment "+consignmentID.Hex()+" was already picked up on this trip")
842		}
843		return nil
844	}
845	
846	// validateColdChain guards cold-chain logging: right rider, trip still moving.
847	func validateColdChain(trip *domain.RouteTrip, riderPartyID primitive.ObjectID) *httpx.AppError {
848		if err := requireTripRider(trip, riderPartyID); err != nil {
849			return err
850		}
851		if trip.Status == domain.TripStatusDelivered {
852			return httpx.Conflict("TRIP_ALREADY_DELIVERED", "trip is DELIVERED; cold-chain logging is closed")
853		}
854		return nil
855	}
856	
857	// validateDeliver guards delivery: right rider, not already delivered, and
858	// every stop picked up (partial loads cannot be handed to a BMC).
859	func validateDeliver(trip *domain.RouteTrip, riderPartyID primitive.ObjectID) *httpx.AppError {
860		if err := requireTripRider(trip, riderPartyID); err != nil {
861			return err
862		}
863		if trip.Status == domain.TripStatusDelivered {
864			return httpx.Conflict("TRIP_ALREADY_DELIVERED", "trip is already DELIVERED")
865		}
866		var unpicked []string
867		for _, stop := range trip.Stops {
868			if stop.PickedUpAt == nil {
869				unpicked = append(unpicked, stop.ConsignmentID.Hex())
870			}
871		}
872		if len(unpicked) > 0 {
873			return httpx.Unprocessable("STOPS_NOT_PICKED", "every stop must be picked up before delivery").
874				WithDetails(map[string]any{"unpicked_consignment_ids": unpicked})
875		}
876		return nil
877	}

133	// ResolveActiveChart is the HTTP-facing chart resolution: it enforces the
134	// caller's org scope over the DCS (pricing policy is confidential — any
135	// authenticated user must not be able to enumerate other unions' rates) and
136	// then delegates to the unchecked resolver.
137	func (s *service) ResolveActiveChart(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, dcsID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.RateChart, error) {
138		dcs, err := s.d.Orgs.Get(ctx, dcsID)
139		if err != nil {
140			return nil, err
141		}
142		if dcs.Type != domain.OrgTypeDCS {
143			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_DCS", "org unit "+dcsID.Hex()+" is not a DCS")
144		}
145		if err := s.requireInScope(ctx, actor, dcsID, "resolve rate chart"); err != nil {
146			return nil, err
147		}
148		return s.resolveActiveChartForDCS(ctx, dcsID)
149	}

151	// resolveActiveChartForDCS finds the rate chart pricing a DCS's pours: among
152	// active charts already effective on the DCS itself or any of its ancestors
153	// (org_unit_id ∈ dcs.Path ∪ {dcs.ID}), the nearest org wins; ties break to
154	// the latest effective_from. Returns httpx.NotFound when no chart covers the
155	// DCS. Scope enforcement is the caller's job — the pour pricing path has
156	// already checked the actor's scope.
157	func (s *service) resolveActiveChartForDCS(ctx context.Context, dcsID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.RateChart, error) {
158		dcs, err := s.d.Orgs.Get(ctx, dcsID)
159		if err != nil {
160			return nil, err
161		}
162		if dcs.Type != domain.OrgTypeDCS {
163			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_DCS", "org unit "+dcsID.Hex()+" is not a DCS")
164		}
165	
166		// Distance 0 = the DCS itself; Path is root→parent, so walk it backwards.
167		distance := map[primitive.ObjectID]int{dcs.ID: 0}
168		orgIDs := []primitive.ObjectID{dcs.ID}
169		for i := len(dcs.Path) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
170			distance[dcs.Path[i]] = len(dcs.Path) - i
171			orgIDs = append(orgIDs, dcs.Path[i])
172		}
173	
174		charts, err := s.repo.activeChartsForOrgs(ctx, orgIDs, time.Now().UTC())
175		if err != nil {
176			return nil, err
177		}
178		var best *domain.RateChart
179		for i := range charts {
180			c := &charts[i]
181			if best == nil {
182				best = c
183				continue
184			}
185			dc, db := distance[c.OrgUnitID], distance[best.OrgUnitID]
186			if dc < db || (dc == db && c.EffectiveFrom.After(best.EffectiveFrom)) {
187				best = c
188			}
189		}
190		if best == nil {
191			return nil, httpx.NotFound("active rate chart for DCS " + dcsID.Hex())
192		}
193		return best, nil
194	}
