200	// separately by the caller.
201	func deriveIntegrityFlags(mode string, ocrConfidence float64, hasGeotag bool, deviceTimestamp, serverNow time.Time) []string {
202		var out []string
203		if mode == domain.ReadingModeManual {
204			out = append(out, domain.IntegrityFlagManualEntry)
205		}
206		if mode == domain.ReadingModePhotoOCR && ocrConfidence < lowOCRConfidenceThreshold {
207			out = append(out, domain.IntegrityFlagLowOCRConfidence)
208		}
209		if !hasGeotag {
210			out = append(out, domain.IntegrityFlagMissingGeotag)
211		}
212		if !deviceTimestamp.IsZero() {
213			skew := serverNow.Sub(deviceTimestamp)
214			if skew < 0 {
215				skew = -skew
216			}
217			if skew > maxClockSkew {
218				out = append(out, domain.IntegrityFlagClockSkew)
219			}
220		}
221		return out
222	}
223	
224	// CreateReading stores one analyzer measurement. Suspicious readings are
225	// flagged, never rejected — the anomaly trail is the deterrent (§8.2).
226	func (s *service) CreateReading(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateReadingRequest) (*domain.AnalyzerReading, error) {
227		if req.DCSID.IsZero() {
228			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "dcs_id is required")
229		}
230		switch req.Mode {
231		case domain.ReadingModeDirect, domain.ReadingModePhotoOCR, domain.ReadingModeManual:
232		default:
233			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "mode must be ANALYZER_DIRECT, PHOTO_OCR or MANUAL")
234		}
235		if req.FatPct <= 0 || req.SNFPct <= 0 {
236			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "fat_pct and snf_pct are required")
237		}
238		if err := s.requireInScope(ctx, actor, req.DCSID, "create reading"); err != nil {
239			return nil, err
240		}
241		recordedBy, err := actorID(actor)
242		if err != nil {
243			return nil, err
244		}
245		if req.Mode == domain.ReadingModePhotoOCR {
246			if !s.d.Flags.Enabled(ctx, flags.FlagPhotoOCR) {
247				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "reading rejected: photo-OCR feature disabled",
248					slog.String("dcs_id", req.DCSID.Hex()),
249					slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
250				featureErr := httpx.Forbidden("photo-OCR ingestion is disabled on this deployment")
251				featureErr.Code = "FEATURE_DISABLED"
252				return nil, featureErr
253			}
254			if req.PhotoObjectKey == "" {
255				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "photo_object_key is required for PHOTO_OCR (evidence retention, §8.2)")
256			}
257		}
258	
259		now := time.Now().UTC()
260		var deviceTS time.Time
261		if req.DeviceTimestamp != nil {
262			deviceTS = req.DeviceTimestamp.UTC()
263		}
264		hasGeo := req.GeoLat != nil && req.GeoLng != nil
265		integrityFlags := deriveIntegrityFlags(req.Mode, req.OCRConfidence, hasGeo, deviceTS, now)
266		plausibilityFlags := domain.CheckPlausibility(req.FatPct, req.SNFPct, req.QuantityLitres)
267		integrityFlags = append(integrityFlags, plausibilityFlags...)
268	
269		reading := &domain.AnalyzerReading{
270			ID:               primitive.NewObjectID(),
271			DCSID:            req.DCSID,
272			DeviceID:         req.DeviceID,
273			Mode:             req.Mode,
274			FatPct:           req.FatPct,
275			SNFPct:           req.SNFPct,
276			CLR:              req.CLR,
277			WaterPct:         req.WaterPct,
278			QuantityLitres:   req.QuantityLitres,
279			PhotoObjectKey:   req.PhotoObjectKey,
280			OCRConfidence:    req.OCRConfidence,
281			DeviceTimestamp:  deviceTS,
282			ServerReceivedAt: now,
283			IntegrityFlags:   integrityFlags,
284			PlausibilityOK:   len(plausibilityFlags) == 0,
285			RecordedBy:       recordedBy,
286			CreatedAt:        now,
287		}
288		if hasGeo {
289			reading.GeoLat, reading.GeoLng = *req.GeoLat, *req.GeoLng
290		}
291		if err := s.repo.insertReading(ctx, reading); err != nil {
292			return nil, err
293		}
294	
295		if _, err := s.d.Ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
296			Type:       domain.EventReadingRecorded,
297			EntityType: domain.EntityAnalyzerReading,
298			EntityID:   reading.ID.Hex(),
299			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
300			OrgUnitID:  reading.DCSID.Hex(),
301			Payload: map[string]any{
302				"mode":            reading.Mode,
303				"integrity_flags": reading.IntegrityFlags,
304			},
305		}); err != nil {
306			err = fmt.Errorf("append reading provenance: %w", err)
307			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "reading provenance append failed",
308				slog.String("reading_id", reading.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
309			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
310		}
311		if len(integrityFlags) > 0 {
312			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "reading recorded with integrity flags",
313				slog.String("reading_id", reading.ID.Hex()),
314				slog.String("dcs_id", reading.DCSID.Hex()),
315				slog.String("mode", reading.Mode),
316				slog.Any("integrity_flags", integrityFlags),
317				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
318		}
319		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "reading recorded",
320			slog.String("reading_id", reading.ID.Hex()),
321			slog.String("dcs_id", reading.DCSID.Hex()),
322			slog.String("mode", reading.Mode),
323			slog.Float64("fat_pct", reading.FatPct),
324			slog.Float64("snf_pct", reading.SNFPct),
325			slog.Bool("plausibility_ok", reading.PlausibilityOK),
326			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
327		return reading, nil
328	}

330	// ListReadings pages a DCS's readings for anomaly review, optionally
331	// restricted to one IST day.
332	func (s *service) ListReadings(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, dcsID primitive.ObjectID, date string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.AnalyzerReading, int64, error) {
333		if dcsID.IsZero() {
334			return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "dcs_id is required")
335		}
336		if err := s.requireInScope(ctx, actor, dcsID, "list readings"); err != nil {
337			return nil, 0, err
338		}
339		var dayStart, dayEnd *time.Time
340		if date != "" {
341			start, end, err := istDayRange(date)
342			if err != nil {
343				return nil, 0, err
344			}
345			dayStart, dayEnd = &start, &end
346		}
347		return s.repo.listReadings(ctx, dcsID, dayStart, dayEnd, page)
348	}

350	// --- pours ---
351	
352	// CreatePour records one farmer's pour with same-day pricing. Replays of the
353	// same client_event_id return the stored pour with idempotentReplay=true —
354	// offline sync retries are harmless (§3.1).
355	func (s *service) CreatePour(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreatePourRequest) (pour *domain.MilkPour, idempotentReplay bool, err error) {
356		if req.ClientEventID == "" || req.FarmerPartyID.IsZero() || req.DCSID.IsZero() {
357			return nil, false, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "client_event_id, farmer_party_id and dcs_id are required")
358		}
359		if req.Shift != domain.ShiftMorning && req.Shift != domain.ShiftEvening {
360			return nil, false, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "shift must be MORNING or EVENING")
361		}
362		if req.QuantityLitres <= 0 {
363			return nil, false, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "quantity_litres must be positive")
364		}
365		switch req.Source {
366		case domain.ReadingModeDirect, domain.ReadingModePhotoOCR, domain.ReadingModeManual:
367		default:
368			return nil, false, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "source must be ANALYZER_DIRECT, PHOTO_OCR or MANUAL")
369		}
370		if err := s.requireInScope(ctx, actor, req.DCSID, "create pour"); err != nil {
371			return nil, false, err
372		}
373		recordedBy, err := actorID(actor)
374		if err != nil {
375			return nil, false, err
376		}
377	
378		// Idempotency short-circuit BEFORE any state-dependent business check:
379		// a replay of an already-stored pour must return the stored pour even if
380		// membership lapsed or the rate chart changed since first sync — otherwise
381		// offline devices keep the record dirty and retry forever.
382		if existing, err := s.repo.pourByClientEventID(ctx, req.ClientEventID); err == nil {
383			return s.replayStoredPour(ctx, actor, existing)
384		} else if !isNotFoundErr(err) {
385			return nil, false, err
386		}
387	
388		now := time.Now().UTC()
389		member, err := s.repo.farmerIsActiveMember(ctx, req.FarmerPartyID, req.DCSID, now)
390		if err != nil {
391			return nil, false, err
392		}
393		if !member {
394			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "pour rejected: farmer not an active member",
395				slog.String("farmer_party_id", req.FarmerPartyID.Hex()),
396				slog.String("dcs_id", req.DCSID.Hex()),
397				slog.String("client_event_id", req.ClientEventID),
398				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
399			return nil, false, httpx.Unprocessable("FARMER_NOT_MEMBER",
400				"farmer does not hold an active FARMER assignment at this DCS")
401		}
402	
403		// HARD plausibility gate: receipts must be trustworthy, so implausible
404		// values are rejected here (unlike readings, which are merely flagged).
405		if violations := domain.CheckPlausibility(req.FatPct, req.SNFPct, req.QuantityLitres); len(violations) > 0 {
406			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "pour rejected: implausible values",
407				slog.String("farmer_party_id", req.FarmerPartyID.Hex()),
408				slog.String("dcs_id", req.DCSID.Hex()),
409				slog.String("client_event_id", req.ClientEventID),
410				slog.Float64("fat_pct", req.FatPct),
411				slog.Float64("snf_pct", req.SNFPct),
412				slog.Float64("quantity_litres", req.QuantityLitres),
413				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
414			return nil, false, httpx.Unprocessable("IMPLAUSIBLE_VALUES",
415				"fat/SNF/quantity outside physically plausible bounds")
416		}
417	
418		chart, err := s.resolveChartForPricing(ctx, req.DCSID)
419		if err != nil {
420			return nil, false, err
421		}
422		rate, amount := chart.PricePour(req.FatPct, req.SNFPct, req.QuantityLitres)
423	
424		pouredAt := now
425		if req.PouredAt != nil {
426			pouredAt = req.PouredAt.UTC()
427		}
428	
429		// A shift whose consignment already exists is sealed: milk recorded now
430		// would be invoiced but never board the van — quantity provenance and the
431		// consignment's totals would silently diverge (§7 pooling boundary).
432		pourDate := domain.DateKeyIST(pouredAt)
433		consigned, err := s.repo.shiftConsigned(ctx, req.DCSID, pourDate, req.Shift)
434		if err != nil {
435			return nil, false, err
436		}
437		if consigned {
438			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "pour rejected: shift already consigned",
439				slog.String("dcs_id", req.DCSID.Hex()),
440				slog.String("pour_date", pourDate),
441				slog.String("shift", req.Shift),
442				slog.String("client_event_id", req.ClientEventID),
443				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
444			return nil, false, httpx.Conflict("SHIFT_CONSIGNED",
445				"a consignment already pools this DCS shift — the pour set is sealed for "+pourDate+" "+req.Shift)
446		}
447		// Pre-generated _id keeps the insert and the ledger refs consistent in
448		// one flow.
449		p := &domain.MilkPour{
450			ID:                primitive.NewObjectID(),
451			ClientEventID:     req.ClientEventID,
452			FarmerPartyID:     req.FarmerPartyID,
453			AnimalID:          req.AnimalID,
454			DCSID:             req.DCSID,
455			Shift:             req.Shift,
456			PourDate:          pourDate,
457			QuantityLitres:    req.QuantityLitres,
458			FatPct:            req.FatPct,
459			SNFPct:            req.SNFPct,
460			CLR:               req.CLR,
461			RatePerLitre:      rate,
462			Amount:            amount,
463			RateChartID:       chart.ID,
464			AnalyzerReadingID: req.AnalyzerReadingID,
465			Source:            req.Source,
466			Status:            domain.PourStatusRecorded,
467			PouredAt:          pouredAt,
468			RecordedBy:        recordedBy,
469			DeviceID:          req.DeviceID,
470			CreatedAt:         now,
471		}
472		if req.GeoLat != nil && req.GeoLng != nil {
473			p.GeoLat, p.GeoLng = *req.GeoLat, *req.GeoLng
474		}
475	
476		duplicate, err := s.repo.insertPour(ctx, p)
477		if err != nil {
478			return nil, false, err
479		}
480		if duplicate {
481			// Race backstop: two concurrent requests both missed the lookup —
482			// the unique client_event_id index caught it at insert time.
483			existing, err := s.repo.pourByClientEventID(ctx, req.ClientEventID)
484			if err != nil {
485				return nil, false, err
486			}
487			return s.replayStoredPour(ctx, actor, existing)
488		}
489	
490		if err := s.recordPourProvenance(ctx, actor, p); err != nil {
491			return nil, false, err
492		}
493		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "pour recorded",
494			slog.String("pour_id", p.ID.Hex()),
495			slog.String("farmer_party_id", p.FarmerPartyID.Hex()),
496			slog.String("dcs_id", p.DCSID.Hex()),
497			slog.String("pour_date", p.PourDate),
498			slog.String("shift", p.Shift),
499			slog.Float64("quantity_litres", p.QuantityLitres),
500			slog.Float64("rate_per_litre", p.RatePerLitre),
501			slog.Float64("amount", p.Amount),
502			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
503		s.announcePour(ctx, p)
504		return p, false, nil
505	}
506	
507	// replayStoredPour returns an already-persisted pour as an idempotent replay.
508	// If a previous attempt persisted the pour but died before the ledger append
509	// (provenance_seq still 0), the missing pour.recorded event, bus publish and
510	// receipt SMS are healed first — a failed heal keeps returning the error so
511	// the client retries until the saga completes, instead of blessing an orphan
512	// with no origin link on the hash chain.
513	func (s *service) replayStoredPour(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, existing *domain.MilkPour) (*domain.MilkPour, bool, error) {
514		if existing.Status == domain.PourStatusRecorded && existing.ProvenanceSeq == 0 {
515			// The append itself must stay idempotent: a pour.recorded event may
516			// already be chained if only the seq back-stamp failed last time.
517			evs, err := s.d.Ledger.EventsForEntity(ctx, domain.EntityMilkPour, existing.ID.Hex())
518			if err != nil {
519				err = fmt.Errorf("check pour provenance: %w", err)
520				s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "pour provenance check failed",
521					slog.String("pour_id", existing.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
522				return nil, false, httpx.Internal(err)
523			}
524			var chained *provenance.Event
525			for i := range evs {
526				if evs[i].Type == domain.EventPourRecorded {
527					chained = &evs[i]
528					break
529				}
530			}
531			if chained != nil {
532				if err := s.repo.setPourProvenanceSeq(ctx, existing.ID, chained.Seq); err != nil {
533					return nil, false, err
534				}
535				existing.ProvenanceSeq = chained.Seq
536			} else {
537				if err := s.recordPourProvenance(ctx, actor, existing); err != nil {
538					return nil, false, err
539				}
540				s.announcePour(ctx, existing)
541			}
542		}
543		s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "pour replayed idempotently",
544			slog.String("pour_id", existing.ID.Hex()),
545			slog.String("client_event_id", existing.ClientEventID),
546			slog.String("farmer_party_id", existing.FarmerPartyID.Hex()),
547			slog.String("dcs_id", existing.DCSID.Hex()),
548			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
549		return existing, true, nil
550	}
551	
552	// announcePour publishes the pour on the bus and queues the farmer's receipt
553	// SMS — the anti-cheating receipt (§8.1).
554	func (s *service) announcePour(ctx context.Context, p *domain.MilkPour) {
555		s.d.Bus.Publish(eventbus.TopicPourRecorded, *p)
556		s.queueFarmerSMS(ctx, p.FarmerPartyID, domain.TemplatePourReceipt, map[string]string{
557			"quantity": fmt.Sprintf("%.2f", p.QuantityLitres), // key must match renderSMS's p("quantity")
558			"rate":     fmt.Sprintf("%.2f", p.RatePerLitre),
559			"amount":   fmt.Sprintf("%.2f", p.Amount),
560		})
561	}
562	
563	// isNotFoundErr reports whether err is a 404 AppError.
564	func isNotFoundErr(err error) bool {
565		var appErr *httpx.AppError
566		return errors.As(err, &appErr) && appErr.Status == http.StatusNotFound
567	}
568	
569	// recordPourProvenance appends EventPourRecorded and stamps the ledger seq
570	// onto the pour.
571	func (s *service) recordPourProvenance(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, p *domain.MilkPour) error {
572		refs := []provenance.Ref{
573			{EntityType: domain.EntityParty, EntityID: p.FarmerPartyID.Hex(), Relation: "produced_by"},
574		}
575		if p.AnimalID != nil {
576			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{EntityType: domain.EntityAnimal, EntityID: p.AnimalID.Hex(), Relation: "from_animal"})
577		}
578		if p.AnalyzerReadingID != nil {
579			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{EntityType: domain.EntityAnalyzerReading, EntityID: p.AnalyzerReadingID.Hex(), Relation: "measured_by"})
580		}
581		ev, err := s.d.Ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
582			Type:       domain.EventPourRecorded,
583			EntityType: domain.EntityMilkPour,
584			EntityID:   p.ID.Hex(),
585			Refs:       refs,
586			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
587			OrgUnitID:  p.DCSID.Hex(),
588			Payload: map[string]any{
589				"quantity_litres": p.QuantityLitres,
590				"rate_per_litre":  p.RatePerLitre,
591				"amount":          p.Amount,
592			},
593		})
594		if err != nil {
595			err = fmt.Errorf("append pour provenance: %w", err)
596			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "pour provenance append failed",
597				slog.String("pour_id", p.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
598			return httpx.Internal(err)
599		}
600		if err := s.repo.setPourProvenanceSeq(ctx, p.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
601			return err
602		}
603		p.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
604		return nil
605	}
606	
607	// resolveChartForPricing wraps resolveActiveChartForDCS, converting "no
608	// chart" into a 422 — the pour payload itself is fine, the DCS just cannot
609	// price it yet.
610	func (s *service) resolveChartForPricing(ctx context.Context, dcsID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.RateChart, error) {
611		chart, err := s.resolveActiveChartForDCS(ctx, dcsID)
612		if err != nil {
613			var appErr *httpx.AppError
614			if errors.As(err, &appErr) && appErr.Status == http.StatusNotFound {
615				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "pour rejected: no active rate chart",
616					slog.String("dcs_id", dcsID.Hex()))
617				return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("NO_ACTIVE_RATE_CHART",
618					"no active rate chart covers this DCS — pours cannot be priced")
619			}
620			return nil, err
621		}
622		return chart, nil
623	}
624	
625	// BatchSyncPours replays up to 500 offline-captured pours. Items succeed or
626	// fail independently — the batch never aborts (offline reconnect path, §3.1).
627	func (s *service) BatchSyncPours(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req BatchSyncRequest) ([]BatchSyncItemResult, error) {
628		if len(req.Pours) == 0 {
629			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "pours must not be empty")
630		}
631		if len(req.Pours) > maxBatchSyncItems {
632			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION",
633				fmt.Sprintf("pours must not exceed %d items per batch", maxBatchSyncItems))
634		}
635		results := make([]BatchSyncItemResult, 0, len(req.Pours))
636		for _, item := range req.Pours {
637			res := BatchSyncItemResult{ClientEventID: item.ClientEventID}
638			pour, replay, err := s.CreatePour(ctx, actor, item)
639			switch {
640			case err != nil:
641				res.Status = BatchItemError
642				var appErr *httpx.AppError
643				if errors.As(err, &appErr) {
644					res.Error = appErr.Code + ": " + appErr.Message
645				} else {
646					res.Error = "INTERNAL: internal server error"
647				}
648			case replay:
649				res.Status = BatchItemDuplicate
650				res.PourID = pour.ID.Hex()
651			default:
652				res.Status = BatchItemCreated
653				res.PourID = pour.ID.Hex()
654			}
655			results = append(results, res)
656		}
657		return results, nil
658	}
659	
660	// SupersedePour applies an append-only correction (§3.4): the old pour is
661	// marked SUPERSEDED (the document stays), and a new repriced pour referencing
662	// it is recorded.
663	func (s *service) SupersedePour(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, pourID primitive.ObjectID, req SupersedePourRequest) (*domain.MilkPour, error) {
664		if req.Reason == "" {
665			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "reason is required")
666		}
667		old, err := s.repo.pourByID(ctx, pourID)
668		if err != nil {
669			return nil, err
670		}
671		if err := s.requireInScope(ctx, actor, old.DCSID, "supersede pour"); err != nil {
672			return nil, err
673		}
674		recordedBy, err := actorID(actor)
675		if err != nil {
676			return nil, err
677		}
678		if old.Status != domain.PourStatusRecorded {
679			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "supersede rejected: pour not correctable",
680				slog.String("pour_id", old.ID.Hex()),
681				slog.String("status", old.Status),
682				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
683			return nil, httpx.Conflict("POUR_NOT_CORRECTABLE",
684				"pour is already "+old.Status+" and cannot be superseded")
685		}
686		invoiced, err := s.repo.pourIsInvoiced(ctx, pourID)
687		if err != nil {
688			return nil, err
689		}
690		if invoiced {
691			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "supersede rejected: pour already invoiced",
692				slog.String("pour_id", old.ID.Hex()),
693				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
694			return nil, httpx.Conflict("POUR_INVOICED",
695				"pour is aggregated by an invoice — correct it through settlement instead")
696		}
697		// The consigned state freezes the pour exactly like the invoiced state:
698		// a consignment's pour set, litres and weighted fat/SNF are snapshotted,
699		// so correcting after pooling would silently desync payment from the
700		// shipped-quantity provenance.
701		consigned, err := s.repo.shiftConsigned(ctx, old.DCSID, old.PourDate, old.Shift)
702		if err != nil {
703			return nil, err
704		}
705		if consigned {
706			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "supersede rejected: shift already consigned",
707				slog.String("pour_id", old.ID.Hex()),
708				slog.String("dcs_id", old.DCSID.Hex()),
709				slog.String("pour_date", old.PourDate),
710				slog.String("shift", old.Shift),
711				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
712			return nil, httpx.Conflict("POUR_CONSIGNED",
713				"pour is aggregated by a consignment — correct it through logistics/settlement instead")
714		}
715	
716		qty, fat, snf := old.QuantityLitres, old.FatPct, old.SNFPct
717		if req.Corrected.QuantityLitres != nil {
718			qty = *req.Corrected.QuantityLitres
719		}
720		if req.Corrected.FatPct != nil {
721			fat = *req.Corrected.FatPct
722		}
723		if req.Corrected.SNFPct != nil {
724			snf = *req.Corrected.SNFPct
725		}
726		if qty <= 0 {
727			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "corrected quantity_litres must be positive")
728		}
729		if violations := domain.CheckPlausibility(fat, snf, qty); len(violations) > 0 {
730			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "supersede rejected: implausible corrected values",
731				slog.String("pour_id", old.ID.Hex()),
732				slog.Float64("fat_pct", fat),
733				slog.Float64("snf_pct", snf),
734				slog.Float64("quantity_litres", qty),
735				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
736			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("IMPLAUSIBLE_VALUES",
737				"corrected fat/SNF/quantity outside physically plausible bounds")
738		}
739	
740		chart, err := s.resolveChartForPricing(ctx, old.DCSID)
741		if err != nil {
742			return nil, err
743		}
744		rate, amount := chart.PricePour(fat, snf, qty)
745	
746		// Optimistic guard: only one correction can win the RECORDED→SUPERSEDED flip.
747		flipped, err := s.repo.markPourSuperseded(ctx, old.ID)
748		if err != nil {
749			return nil, err
750		}
751		if !flipped {
752			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "supersede rejected: pour superseded concurrently",
753				slog.String("pour_id", old.ID.Hex()),
754				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
755			return nil, httpx.Conflict("POUR_NOT_CORRECTABLE", "pour was superseded concurrently")
756		}
757	
758		now := time.Now().UTC()
759		corrected := &domain.MilkPour{
760			ID:                primitive.NewObjectID(),
761			FarmerPartyID:     old.FarmerPartyID,
762			AnimalID:          old.AnimalID,
763			DCSID:             old.DCSID,
764			Shift:             old.Shift,
765			PourDate:          old.PourDate, // correction stays on the original settlement day
766			QuantityLitres:    qty,
767			FatPct:            fat,
768			SNFPct:            snf,
769			CLR:               old.CLR,
770			RatePerLitre:      rate,
771			Amount:            amount,
772			RateChartID:       chart.ID,
773			AnalyzerReadingID: old.AnalyzerReadingID,
774			Source:            old.Source,
775			Status:            domain.PourStatusRecorded,
776			SupersedesPourID:  &old.ID,
777			PouredAt:          old.PouredAt,
778			RecordedBy:        recordedBy,
779			DeviceID:          old.DeviceID,
780			GeoLat:            old.GeoLat,
781			GeoLng:            old.GeoLng,
782			CreatedAt:         now,
783		}
784		corrected.ClientEventID = old.ClientEventID + "::corr::" + corrected.ID.Hex()[0:8]
785		if duplicate, err := s.repo.insertPour(ctx, corrected); err != nil {
786			return nil, err
787		} else if duplicate {
788			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "supersede rejected: correction collided",
789				slog.String("pour_id", old.ID.Hex()),
790				slog.String("client_event_id", corrected.ClientEventID),
791				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
792			return nil, httpx.Conflict("POUR_NOT_CORRECTABLE", "correction collided with a concurrent one")
793		}
794	
795		ev, err := s.d.Ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
796			Type:       domain.EventPourSuperseded,
797			EntityType: domain.EntityMilkPour,
798			EntityID:   corrected.ID.Hex(),
799			Refs: []provenance.Ref{
800				{EntityType: domain.EntityMilkPour, EntityID: old.ID.Hex(), Relation: "supersedes"},
801			},
802			Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
803			OrgUnitID: corrected.DCSID.Hex(),
804			Payload:   map[string]any{"reason": req.Reason},
805		})
806		if err != nil {
807			err = fmt.Errorf("append supersede provenance: %w", err)
808			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "supersede provenance append failed",
809				slog.String("pour_id", corrected.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
810			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
811		}
812		if err := s.repo.setPourProvenanceSeq(ctx, corrected.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
813			return nil, err
814		}
815		corrected.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
816		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "pour superseded",
817			slog.String("pour_id", corrected.ID.Hex()),
818			slog.String("supersedes_pour_id", old.ID.Hex()),
819			slog.String("farmer_party_id", corrected.FarmerPartyID.Hex()),
820			slog.String("dcs_id", corrected.DCSID.Hex()),
821			slog.Float64("quantity_litres", corrected.QuantityLitres),
822			slog.Float64("amount", corrected.Amount),
823			slog.String("reason", req.Reason),
824			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
825		return corrected, nil
826	}

828	// ListPours pages pours. FARMER callers are always pinned to their own
829	// pours; staff roles must name a DCS inside their scope.
830	func (s *service) ListPours(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, filter pourListFilter, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.MilkPour, int64, error) {
831		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleFarmer {
832			self, err := actorID(actor)
833			if err != nil {
834				return nil, 0, err
835			}
836			filter.FarmerPartyID = self // farmers only ever see their own pours
837		} else {
838			if filter.DCSID.IsZero() {
839				return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "dcs_id is required")
840			}
841			if err := s.requireInScope(ctx, actor, filter.DCSID, "list pours"); err != nil {
842				return nil, 0, err
843			}
844		}
845		if filter.Date != "" {
846			if err := validateDateKey(filter.Date); err != nil {
847				return nil, 0, err
848			}
849		}
850		if filter.Shift != "" && filter.Shift != domain.ShiftMorning && filter.Shift != domain.ShiftEvening {
851			return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "shift must be MORNING or EVENING")
852		}
853		return s.repo.listPours(ctx, filter, page)
854	}
855	
856	// --- invoices ---
857	
858	// GenerateInvoices groups the day's un-invoiced RECORDED pours by farmer and
859	// issues one invoice each — the same-day payment artefact (§8.1). The unique
860	// farmer+DCS+day index (on ObjectIDs) is the true duplicate guard; racing
861	// generators simply count the loser as "existing".
862	func (s *service) GenerateInvoices(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req GenerateInvoicesRequest) (*GenerateInvoicesResponse, error) {
863		if req.DCSID.IsZero() {
864			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "dcs_id is required")
865		}
866		now := time.Now().UTC()
867		dateKey := req.Date
868		if dateKey == "" {
869			dateKey = domain.DateKeyIST(now)
870		} else if err := validateDateKey(dateKey); err != nil {
871			return nil, err
872		}
873		dcs, err := s.d.Orgs.Get(ctx, req.DCSID)
874		if err != nil {
875			return nil, err
876		}
877		if dcs.Type != domain.OrgTypeDCS {
878			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_DCS", "org unit "+req.DCSID.Hex()+" is not a DCS")
879		}
880		if err := s.requireInScope(ctx, actor, req.DCSID, "generate invoices"); err != nil {
881			return nil, err
882		}
883	
884		pours, err := s.repo.recordedPoursForDay(ctx, req.DCSID, dateKey)
885		if err != nil {
886			return nil, err
887		}
888		alreadyInvoiced, err := s.repo.invoicedPourIDs(ctx, req.DCSID, dateKey)
889		if err != nil {
890			return nil, err
891		}
892	
893		byFarmer := make(map[primitive.ObjectID][]domain.MilkPour)
894		for _, p := range pours {
895			if alreadyInvoiced[p.ID] {
896				continue
897			}
898			byFarmer[p.FarmerPartyID] = append(byFarmer[p.FarmerPartyID], p)
899		}
900		farmerIDs := make([]primitive.ObjectID, 0, len(byFarmer))
901		for id := range byFarmer {
902			farmerIDs = append(farmerIDs, id)
903		}
904		sort.Slice(farmerIDs, func(i, j int) bool { return farmerIDs[i].Hex() < farmerIDs[j].Hex() })
905	
906		resp := &GenerateInvoicesResponse{Invoices: []domain.Invoice{}}
907		// Counter keys stay strings and keep using the org CODE — internal only.
908		counterKey := "invoice:" + dcs.Code + ":" + dateKey
909		for _, farmerID := range farmerIDs {
910			group := byFarmer[farmerID]
911			seq, err := s.repo.nextInvoiceSeq(ctx, counterKey)
912			if err != nil {
913				return nil, err
914			}
915			inv := &domain.Invoice{
916				ID:            primitive.NewObjectID(),
917				InvoiceNumber: domain.InvoiceNumberFor(dcs.Code, dateKey, seq),
918				FarmerPartyID: farmerID,
919				DCSID:         req.DCSID,
920				InvoiceDate:   dateKey,
921				Status:        domain.InvoiceStatusIssued,
922				IssuedAt:      now,
923			}
924			for _, p := range group {
925				inv.PourIDs = append(inv.PourIDs, p.ID)
926				inv.TotalQuantityLitres += p.QuantityLitres
927				inv.TotalAmount += p.Amount
928			}
929			inv.TotalQuantityLitres = math.Round(inv.TotalQuantityLitres*100) / 100
930			inv.TotalAmount = math.Round(inv.TotalAmount*100) / 100
931	
932			duplicate, err := s.repo.insertInvoice(ctx, inv)
933			if err != nil {
934				return nil, err
935			}
936			if duplicate {
937				// The farmer already has today's invoice (e.g. the MORNING run) —
938				// merge the not-yet-invoiced pours into it instead of silently
939				// dropping them, or surface them when the invoice is frozen.
940				if err := s.mergeIntoExistingInvoice(ctx, actor, req.DCSID, dateKey, farmerID, group, resp); err != nil {
941					return nil, err
942				}
943				continue
944			}
945	
946			refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, len(inv.PourIDs))
947			for _, pid := range inv.PourIDs {
948				refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{EntityType: domain.EntityMilkPour, EntityID: pid.Hex(), Relation: "aggregates"})
949			}
950			ev, err := s.d.Ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
951				Type:       domain.EventInvoiceIssued,
952				EntityType: domain.EntityInvoice,
953				EntityID:   inv.ID.Hex(),
954				Refs:       refs,
955				Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
956				OrgUnitID:  inv.DCSID.Hex(),
957				Payload: map[string]any{
958					"invoice_number":        inv.InvoiceNumber,
959					"total_quantity_litres": inv.TotalQuantityLitres,
960					"total_amount":          inv.TotalAmount,
961				},
962			})
963			if err != nil {
964				err = fmt.Errorf("append invoice provenance: %w", err)
965				s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "invoice provenance append failed",
966					slog.String("invoice_id", inv.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
967				return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
968			}
969			if err := s.repo.setInvoiceProvenanceSeq(ctx, inv.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
970				return nil, err
971			}
972			inv.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
973	
974			s.d.Bus.Publish(eventbus.TopicInvoiceIssued, *inv)
975			s.queueInvoiceSMS(ctx, inv)
976			s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "invoice issued",
977				slog.String("invoice_id", inv.ID.Hex()),
978				slog.String("invoice_number", inv.InvoiceNumber),
979				slog.String("farmer_party_id", inv.FarmerPartyID.Hex()),
980				slog.String("dcs_id", inv.DCSID.Hex()),
981				slog.String("invoice_date", inv.InvoiceDate),
982				slog.Int("pour_count", len(inv.PourIDs)),
983				slog.Float64("total_amount", inv.TotalAmount),
984				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
985			resp.Created++
986			resp.Invoices = append(resp.Invoices, *inv)
987		}
988		return resp, nil
989	}
990	
991	// mergeIntoExistingInvoice folds a farmer's not-yet-invoiced pours into their
992	// already-issued invoice for the day. Only a still-ISSUED invoice may be
993	// amended (the status guard on the update is atomic against a concurrent
994	// settlement claim); a PAID/settlement-claimed invoice is never mutated —
995	// its pours are surfaced in the response so staff can act, never dropped.
996	func (s *service) mergeIntoExistingInvoice(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, dcsID primitive.ObjectID, dateKey string, farmerID primitive.ObjectID, group []domain.MilkPour, resp *GenerateInvoicesResponse) error {
997		existing, err := s.repo.invoiceByFarmerDay(ctx, farmerID, dcsID, dateKey)
998		if err != nil {
999			return err
1000		}
1001		// Only pours genuinely missing from the invoice are merged — a racing
1002		// generator that lost the insert must not double-add the winner's pours.
1003		already := make(map[primitive.ObjectID]bool, len(existing.PourIDs))
1004		for _, id := range existing.PourIDs {
1005			already[id] = true
1006		}
1007		var newPours []domain.MilkPour
1008		for _, p := range group {
1009			if !already[p.ID] {
1010				newPours = append(newPours, p)
1011			}
1012		}
1013		if len(newPours) == 0 {
1014			resp.Existing++
1015			return nil
1016		}
1017	
1018		skip := func(reason string) {
1019			resp.Existing++
1020			skipped := make([]string, 0, len(newPours))
1021			for _, p := range newPours {
1022				resp.SkippedPourIDs = append(resp.SkippedPourIDs, p.ID)
1023				skipped = append(skipped, p.ID.Hex())
1024			}
1025			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "invoice merge skipped: "+reason,
1026				slog.String("invoice_id", existing.ID.Hex()),
1027				slog.String("invoice_number", existing.InvoiceNumber),
1028				slog.String("farmer_party_id", farmerID.Hex()),
1029				slog.String("dcs_id", dcsID.Hex()),
1030				slog.Any("skipped_pour_ids", skipped),
1031				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
1032		}
1033		if existing.Status != domain.InvoiceStatusIssued {
1034			skip("invoice frozen by settlement") // un-invoiceable today, surface loudly
1035			return nil
1036		}
1037		ids := make([]primitive.ObjectID, 0, len(newPours))
1038		var addQty, addAmount float64
1039		for _, p := range newPours {
1040			ids = append(ids, p.ID)
1041			addQty += p.QuantityLitres
1042			addAmount += p.Amount
1043		}
1044		merged, err := s.repo.appendPoursToInvoice(ctx, existing.ID, ids, addQty, addAmount)
1045		if err != nil {
1046			return err
1047		}
1048		if !merged {
1049			skip("invoice left ISSUED concurrently") // between the read and the guarded update
1050			return nil
1051		}
1052		updated, err := s.repo.invoiceByID(ctx, existing.ID)
1053		if err != nil {
1054			return err
1055		}
1056		updated.TotalQuantityLitres = math.Round(updated.TotalQuantityLitres*100) / 100
1057		updated.TotalAmount = math.Round(updated.TotalAmount*100) / 100
1058		if err := s.repo.setInvoiceTotals(ctx, updated.ID, updated.TotalQuantityLitres, updated.TotalAmount); err != nil {
1059			return err
1060		}
1061	
1062		refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, len(ids))
1063		for _, pid := range ids {
1064			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{EntityType: domain.EntityMilkPour, EntityID: pid.Hex(), Relation: "aggregates"})
1065		}
1066		ev, err := s.d.Ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
1067			Type:       domain.EventInvoiceAmended,
1068			EntityType: domain.EntityInvoice,
1069			EntityID:   updated.ID.Hex(),
1070			Refs:       refs,
1071			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
1072			OrgUnitID:  updated.DCSID.Hex(),
1073			Payload: map[string]any{
1074				"invoice_number":        updated.InvoiceNumber,
1075				"added_pour_count":      len(ids),
1076				"total_quantity_litres": updated.TotalQuantityLitres,
1077				"total_amount":          updated.TotalAmount,
1078			},
1079		})
1080		if err != nil {
1081			err = fmt.Errorf("append invoice amendment provenance: %w", err)
1082			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "invoice amendment provenance append failed",
1083				slog.String("invoice_id", updated.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
1084			return httpx.Internal(err)
1085		}
1086		if err := s.repo.setInvoiceProvenanceSeq(ctx, updated.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
1087			return err
1088		}
1089		updated.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
1090	
1091		s.d.Bus.Publish(eventbus.TopicInvoiceIssued, *updated)
1092		s.queueInvoiceSMS(ctx, updated)
1093		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "invoice amended",
1094			slog.String("invoice_id", updated.ID.Hex()),
1095			slog.String("invoice_number", updated.InvoiceNumber),
1096			slog.String("farmer_party_id", updated.FarmerPartyID.Hex()),
1097			slog.String("dcs_id", updated.DCSID.Hex()),
1098			slog.Int("added_pour_count", len(ids)),
1099			slog.Float64("total_amount", updated.TotalAmount),
1100			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
1101		resp.Updated++
1102		resp.Invoices = append(resp.Invoices, *updated)
1103		return nil
1104	}
1105	
1106	// queueInvoiceSMS notifies the farmer of an issued or amended invoice.
1107	func (s *service) queueInvoiceSMS(ctx context.Context, inv *domain.Invoice) {
1108		s.queueFarmerSMS(ctx, inv.FarmerPartyID, domain.TemplateInvoiceIssued, map[string]string{
1109			"invoice_number": inv.InvoiceNumber,
1110			"amount":         fmt.Sprintf("%.2f", inv.TotalAmount),
1111			"date":           inv.InvoiceDate,
1112		})
1113	}

1115	// ListInvoices pages invoices. FARMER callers are always pinned to their own
1116	// invoices; staff roles must name a DCS inside their scope.
1117	func (s *service) ListInvoices(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, filter invoiceListFilter, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.Invoice, int64, error) {
1118		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleFarmer {
1119			self, err := actorID(actor)
1120			if err != nil {
1121				return nil, 0, err
1122			}
1123			filter.FarmerPartyID = self // farmers only ever see their own invoices
1124		} else {
1125			if filter.DCSID.IsZero() {
1126				return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "dcs_id is required")
1127			}
1128			if err := s.requireInScope(ctx, actor, filter.DCSID, "list invoices"); err != nil {
1129				return nil, 0, err
1130			}
1131		}
1132		if filter.Date != "" {
1133			if err := validateDateKey(filter.Date); err != nil {
1134				return nil, 0, err
1135			}
1136		}
1137		if filter.Status != "" {
1138			switch filter.Status {
1139			case domain.InvoiceStatusIssued, domain.InvoiceStatusSettlementPending,
1140				domain.InvoiceStatusPaid, domain.InvoiceStatusHold:
1141			default:
1142				return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "unknown invoice status "+filter.Status)
1143			}
1144		}
1145		return s.repo.listInvoices(ctx, filter, page)
1146	}

1148	// GetInvoice returns one invoice: a farmer may fetch their own, staff roles
1149	// need the invoice's DCS inside their scope.
1150	func (s *service) GetInvoice(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.Invoice, error) {
1151		inv, err := s.repo.invoiceByID(ctx, id)
1152		if err != nil {
1153			return nil, err
1154		}
1155		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleFarmer {
1156			self, err := actorID(actor)
1157			if err != nil {
1158				return nil, err
1159			}
1160			if inv.FarmerPartyID != self {
1161				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "invoice access denied: not the farmer's own",
1162					slog.String("invoice_id", inv.ID.Hex()),
1163					slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
1164				return nil, httpx.Forbidden("farmers may only view their own invoices")
1165			}
1166			return inv, nil
1167		}
1168		if err := s.requireInScope(ctx, actor, inv.DCSID, "get invoice"); err != nil {
1169			return nil, err
1170		}
1171		return inv, nil
1172	}

1174	// --- helpers ---
1175	
1176	// queueFarmerSMS writes an outbox notification for the farmer. Failures are
1177	// logged, never fatal — the receipt must not block the pour (§8.1).
1178	func (s *service) queueFarmerSMS(ctx context.Context, farmerPartyID primitive.ObjectID, templateKey string, params map[string]string) {
1179		farmer, err := s.repo.getParty(ctx, farmerPartyID)
1180		if err != nil {
1181			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "farmer lookup for SMS failed",
1182				slog.String("farmer_party_id", farmerPartyID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
1183			return
1184		}
1185		language := farmer.PreferredLanguage
1186		if language == "" {
1187			language = defaultLanguage
1188		}
1189		n := &domain.Notification{
1190			ID:          primitive.NewObjectID(),
1191			PartyID:     &farmer.ID,
1192			Phone:       farmer.Phone,
1193			Channel:     domain.ChannelSMS,
1194			TemplateKey: templateKey,
1195			Language:    language,
1196			Params:      params,
1197			Status:      domain.NotificationQueued,
1198			QueuedAt:    time.Now().UTC(),
1199		}
1200		if err := s.repo.queueNotification(ctx, n); err != nil {
1201			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "notification queue failed",
1202				slog.String("template", templateKey),
1203				slog.String("farmer_party_id", farmerPartyID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
1204		}
1205	}

1207	// validateDateKey checks a YYYY-MM-DD day key.
1208	func validateDateKey(date string) error {
1209		if _, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", date); err != nil {
1210			return httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "date must be YYYY-MM-DD")
1211		}
1212		return nil
1213	}
1214	
1215	// istDayRange converts a YYYY-MM-DD key into the [start, end) UTC window of
1216	// that IST calendar day.
1217	func istDayRange(date string) (start, end time.Time, err error) {
1218		ist := time.FixedZone("IST", 5*3600+1800)
1219		day, parseErr := time.ParseInLocation("2006-01-02", date, ist)
1220		if parseErr != nil {
1221			return time.Time{}, time.Time{}, httpx.BadRequest("VALIDATION", "date must be YYYY-MM-DD")
1222		}
1223		return day.UTC(), day.Add(24*time.Hour).UTC(), nil
1224	}

45	// validateApproval enforces the dual-control guardrail (§8.1/§18-B): the
46	// approving party MUST differ from the initiator — checked FIRST and on the
47	// party identity itself, so not even SUPER_ADMIN's role bypass can approve a
48	// batch it initiated. Then the batch must still be awaiting approval.
49	func validateApproval(b domain.SettlementBatch, approverPartyID primitive.ObjectID) error {
50		if b.InitiatedBy == approverPartyID {
51			return httpx.Forbidden("dual-control violation: the settlement initiator cannot approve their own batch (§8.1/§18-B)").
52				WithDetails(map[string]string{"reason": "DUAL_CONTROL_VIOLATION"})
53		}
54		if b.Status != domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval {
55			return httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch is "+b.Status+", expected "+domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval)
56		}
57		return nil

61	// A batch stuck EXECUTING longer than this (crashed executor) may be resumed —
62	// the per-invoice payout logic is idempotent, so a replay is safe.
63	const executionLease = 2 * time.Minute

65	// validateExecution gates which states may (re-)enter execution:
66	//   - APPROVED:  the normal dual-controlled first run.
67	//   - EXECUTING: resume of an interrupted run (the lease check in
68	//     claimExecution prevents stealing a live executor's batch).
69	//   - FAILED:    re-execution after a recorded mid-run failure.
70	//
71	// Anything pre-approval is a guardrail breach, not a race; EXECUTED/REJECTED
72	// are terminal.
73	func validateExecution(b domain.SettlementBatch) error {
74		switch b.Status {
75		case domain.SettlementStatusApproved, domain.SettlementStatusExecuting, domain.SettlementStatusFailed:
76			return nil
77		default:
78			return httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch is "+b.Status+", must be "+domain.SettlementStatusApproved+" before execution")
79		}

101	// (§8.1): computation and initiation are one Saathi action; nothing proceeds

103	func (s *service) Initiate(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, in InitiateSettlementRequest) (*domain.SettlementBatch, error) {
104		actorID, err := actorObjectID(actor)

117		}

120				slog.String("dcs_id", in.DCSID.Hex()),
121				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))

123		}
124	
125		candidates, err := s.repo.issuedInvoices(ctx, in.DCSID, date)
126		if err != nil {

128				slog.String("dcs_id", in.DCSID.Hex()), slog.String("date", date), slog.Any("err", err))
129			return nil, err
130		}
131		if len(candidates) == 0 {
132			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "settlement initiation rejected: no ISSUED invoices",
133				slog.String("dcs_id", in.DCSID.Hex()), slog.String("date", date),
134				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
135			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("NO_INVOICES", "no ISSUED invoices for DCS "+in.DCSID.Hex()+" on "+date)
136		}
137	
138		// Claim optimistically: the status guard on the update means each invoice
139		// lands in exactly one batch even under concurrent initiations. The batch
140		// ID is pre-generated so claim, insert and ledger all share one identity.
141		batchID := primitive.NewObjectID()
142		ids := make([]primitive.ObjectID, 0, len(candidates))
143		for _, inv := range candidates {
144			ids = append(ids, inv.ID)
145		}
146		if _, err := s.repo.claimInvoices(ctx, ids, batchID); err != nil {

148				slog.String("batch_id", batchID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
149			return nil, err

154				slog.String("batch_id", batchID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))

156		}
157		if len(claimed) == 0 {

160				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
161			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("NO_INVOICES", "invoices were claimed by a concurrent settlement for DCS "+in.DCSID.Hex()+" on "+date)
162		}
163	
164		batch := &domain.SettlementBatch{
165			ID:          batchID,
166			DCSID:       in.DCSID,
167			Date:        date,
168			Status:      domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval, // INITIATED → PENDING_APPROVAL immediately
169			InitiatedBy: actorID,
170			CreatedAt:   now,
171		}
172		for _, inv := range claimed {
173			batch.InvoiceIDs = append(batch.InvoiceIDs, inv.ID)
174			batch.TotalAmount += inv.TotalAmount
175		}
176		if err := s.repo.insertBatch(ctx, batch); err != nil {

182					slog.String("batch_id", batchID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", relErr))
183			}
184			return nil, err
185		}
186

188		for i, inv := range claimed {

191			}
192			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{EntityType: domain.EntityInvoice, EntityID: inv.ID.Hex(), Relation: "settles"})

220		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "settlement batch initiated",

223			slog.String("date", batch.Date),
224			slog.Int("invoice_count", len(claimed)),

371	// Execute hands the APPROVED batch to the payment-aggregator adapter and
372	// records the resulting payouts.
373	//
374	// MOCK LICENSED-PA ADAPTER — this is a stand-in for the real integration.
375	// In production (§18-B) execution goes through an RBI-licensed Payment
376	// Aggregator operating a nodal/escrow account: Saathi submits the payout
377	// file, the PA moves the money, and UTRs come back asynchronously via
378	// webhook. Saathi itself never touches funds. The mock credits every payout
379	// instantly with a synthetic UTR so the downstream flow (invoice→PAID,
380	// provenance, farmer SMS) is exercised end to end.
381	func (s *service) Execute(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, batchID primitive.ObjectID) (*SettlementDetail, error) {
382		batch, err := s.repo.batchByID(ctx, batchID)
383		if err != nil {
384			return nil, err
385		}
386		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, batch.DCSID); err != nil {
387			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "settlement execution denied: out of scope",
388				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
389				slog.String("dcs_id", batch.DCSID.Hex()),
390				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
391			return nil, err
392		}
393		if err := validateExecution(*batch); err != nil {
394			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "settlement execution refused: invalid status",
395				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
396				slog.String("status", batch.Status),
397				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
398			return nil, err
399		}
400	
401		// Guarded claim: first run (APPROVED), re-run after FAILED, or resume of
402		// a stale EXECUTING lease. The per-invoice work below is idempotent
403		// (unique payout-per-invoice index + payout reuse), so replays are safe.
404		now := time.Now().UTC()
405		claimed, err := s.repo.claimExecution(ctx, batch.ID, now, now.Add(-executionLease))
406		if err != nil {
407			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement execution: claim",
408				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
409			return nil, err
410		}
411		if !claimed {
412			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "settlement execution refused: live execution lease held elsewhere",
413				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
414				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
415			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch is already being executed")
416		}
417	
418		// From here on, any error must not strand the batch in EXECUTING forever:
419		// flip it to FAILED (best-effort) so a retry can claim FAILED→EXECUTING.
420		failExecution := func(cause error) error {
421			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement execution failed mid-run",
422				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", cause))
423			if ferr := s.repo.markExecutionFailed(ctx, batch.ID, cause.Error()); ferr != nil {
424				s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement: mark execution failed",
425					slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", ferr))
426			}
427			return cause
428		}
429	
430		invoices, err := s.repo.invoicesByBatch(ctx, batch.ID)
431		if err != nil {
432			return nil, failExecution(err)
433		}
434	
435		payouts := make([]domain.PayoutInstruction, 0, len(invoices))
436		for _, inv := range invoices {
437			masked, err := s.repo.latestBankMasked(ctx, inv.FarmerPartyID)
438			if err != nil {
439				return nil, failExecution(err)
440			}
441			creditedAt := now
442			payout := &domain.PayoutInstruction{
443				ID:                primitive.NewObjectID(),
444				SettlementBatchID: batch.ID,
445				InvoiceID:         inv.ID,
446				FarmerPartyID:     inv.FarmerPartyID,
447				Amount:            inv.TotalAmount,
448				BankAccountMasked: masked,
449				UTR:               mockUTR(),
450				Status:            domain.PayoutStatusSuccess,
451				CreditedAt:        &creditedAt,
452				CreatedAt:         now,
453			}
454			exists, err := s.repo.insertPayout(ctx, payout)
455			if err != nil {
456				return nil, failExecution(err)
457			}
458			if exists {
459				// Retry of an interrupted run — reuse the payout already credited.
460				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "settlement execution: payout already credited, reusing (idempotent replay)",

665	func (s *service) CreateDBT(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, in CreateDBTRequestInput) (*domain.DBTRequest, error) {

672		}

675		}
676		if _, err := s.repo.partyPhone(ctx, in.FarmerPartyID); err != nil {
677			return nil, err // farmer must exist
678		}
679	
680		// MOCK PFMS — real integration files the beneficiary+amount with PFMS
681		// and receives an acknowledgement reference (§13).
682		req := &domain.DBTRequest{
683			ID:            primitive.NewObjectID(),

689			SubmittedBy:   actorID,

691		}
692		if err := s.repo.insertDBT(ctx, req); err != nil {
693			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "dbt request insert",
694				slog.String("farmer_party_id", in.FarmerPartyID.Hex()),
695				slog.String("scheme_code", in.SchemeCode), slog.Any("err", err))
696			return nil, err
697		}
698	
699		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "dbt request submitted",
700			slog.String("dbt_request_id", req.ID.Hex()),
701			slog.String("scheme_code", req.SchemeCode),
702			slog.String("farmer_party_id", req.FarmerPartyID.Hex()),
703			slog.Float64("amount", req.Amount),
704			slog.String("pfms_ref", req.PFMSRef),
705			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
706		return req, nil

708	
709	// UpdateDBTStatus records the DBT rail's progress for a request. CREDITED
710	// stamps credited_at; CREDITED/REJECTED are terminal.
711	func (s *service) UpdateDBTStatus(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID, status string) (*domain.DBTRequest, error) {
712		switch status {
713		case domain.DBTStatusAccepted, domain.DBTStatusCredited, domain.DBTStatusRejected:
714		default:
715			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_STATUS", "status must be one of ACCEPTED, CREDITED, REJECTED")
716		}
717		req, err := s.repo.dbtByID(ctx, id)
718		if err != nil {
719			return nil, err
720		}
721		if req.Status == domain.DBTStatusCredited || req.Status == domain.DBTStatusRejected {
722			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "dbt status update refused: terminal status",
723				slog.String("dbt_request_id", req.ID.Hex()),
724				slog.String("status", req.Status),
725				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
726			return nil, httpx.Conflict("TERMINAL_STATUS", "dbt request is already "+req.Status)
727		}
728	
729		var creditedAt *time.Time
730		if status == domain.DBTStatusCredited {
731			now := time.Now().UTC()
732			creditedAt = &now
733		}
734		ok, err := s.repo.transitionDBT(ctx, req.ID, req.Status, status, creditedAt)
735		if err != nil {
736			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "dbt status transition",
737				slog.String("dbt_request_id", req.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
738			return nil, err
739		}
740		if !ok {
741			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "dbt status update refused: concurrent change",
742				slog.String("dbt_request_id", req.ID.Hex()),
743				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
744			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "dbt request changed concurrently, retry")
745		}
746		fromStatus := req.Status
747		req.Status = status
748		req.CreditedAt = creditedAt
749	
750		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "dbt request status updated",
751			slog.String("dbt_request_id", req.ID.Hex()),
752			slog.String("from_status", fromStatus),
753			slog.String("to_status", status),
754			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
755		return req, nil
756	}

22	// service holds the safety-gate business logic (blueprint §8.3): evaluate
23	// tests against FSSAI limits, write the verdict onto the subject, chain the
24	// provenance events, and broadcast blocks to downstream modules.
25	type service struct {
26		deps *deps.Deps
27		repo *repository
28		log  *slog.Logger
29	}
30	
31	// newService wires the service with its module-scoped logger.
32	func newService(d *deps.Deps, repo *repository, log *slog.Logger) *service {
33		return &service{deps: d, repo: repo, log: log}
34	}
35	
36	// actorID parses the actor's party ObjectID out of its JWT hex string.
37	func actorID(actor auth.Actor) (primitive.ObjectID, error) {
38		return httpx.ParseID(actor.PartyID, "actor")
39	}

41	// gateSubject is what the gate needs to know about an eligible subject.
42	type gateSubject struct {

44		orgUnitID  primitive.ObjectID // owning org unit (BMC or plant) for scope + ledger
45		status     string
46	}

48	// requiredRoleForStage returns the one role allowed to record results at a
49	// stage (BMC_RAPID↔BMC_OPERATOR, PLANT_LAB↔PLANT_LAB_ANALYST), and whether
50	// the stage is known at all.
51	func requiredRoleForStage(stage string) (string, bool) {
52		switch stage {
53		case domain.QCStageBMCRapid:
54			return domain.RoleBMCOperator, true
55		case domain.QCStagePlantLab:
56			return domain.RolePlantLabAnalyst, true
57		default:
58			return "", false
59		}

62	// certificateNumber builds the human-readable QC certificate identifier from
63	// the per-stage counter, e.g. "QC-PLANT_LAB-000042".
64	func certificateNumber(stage string, seq int64) string {
65		return fmt.Sprintf("QC-%s-%06d", stage, seq)
66	}

68	// knownQCTests is the closed vocabulary of recordable test names: the four
69	// gated FSSAI tests plus the explicitly whitelisted grading tests. Anything
70	// else (including a typo like "AFLATOXIN_M") is rejected instead of being
71	// silently recorded as a non-gating pass.
72	var knownQCTests = map[string]struct{}{
73		domain.TestAflatoxinM1: {},
74		domain.TestColiform:    {},
75		domain.TestAntibiotic:  {},
76		domain.TestPhosphatase: {},
77		domain.TestTPC:         {},
78		domain.TestFat:         {},
79		domain.TestSNF:         {},
80	}

82	// mandatoryTestsForStage returns the tests a stage MUST measure before a PASS
83	// verdict may be issued (blueprint §8.3: heat-stable aflatoxin M1 is gated at
84	// BMC and plant; phosphatase proves pasteurisation at the plant lab).
85	func mandatoryTestsForStage(stage string) []string {
86		switch stage {
87		case domain.QCStageBMCRapid:
88			return []string{domain.TestAflatoxinM1, domain.TestColiform}
89		case domain.QCStagePlantLab:
90			return []string{domain.TestAflatoxinM1, domain.TestColiform, domain.TestPhosphatase}
91		default:
92			return nil
93		}
94	}

96	// validateTestNames rejects any test outside the known vocabulary.
97	func validateTestNames(tests []QCTestInput) *httpx.AppError {
98		for _, t := range tests {
99			if _, ok := knownQCTests[t.Name]; !ok {
100				return httpx.BadRequest("UNKNOWN_TEST",
101					"unknown test name "+t.Name+" — gated tests: "+domain.TestAflatoxinM1+", "+
102						domain.TestColiform+", "+domain.TestAntibiotic+", "+domain.TestPhosphatase)
103			}
104		}
105		return nil
106	}

108	// missingMandatoryTests lists the stage's mandatory tests absent from the
109	// submission.
110	func missingMandatoryTests(stage string, tests []QCTestInput) []string {
111		present := make(map[string]bool, len(tests))
112		for _, t := range tests {
113			present[t.Name] = true
114		}
115		var missing []string
116		for _, name := range mandatoryTestsForStage(stage) {
117			if !present[name] {
118				missing = append(missing, name)
119			}
120		}
121		return missing
122	}

124	// recordQCResult evaluates the submitted tests against the FSSAI gate,
125	// persists the result, applies the PASSED/BLOCKED verdict to the subject and
126	// chains the provenance events. This is the only write path that moves a
127	// subject out of QC_PENDING.
128	func (s *service) recordQCResult(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req RecordQCResultRequest) (*domain.QCResult, error) {
129		// Stage×role pairing — RequireRoles admits both analyst roles, the exact
130		// pairing is enforced here.
131		requiredRole, ok := requiredRoleForStage(req.Stage)
132		if !ok {
133			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_STAGE", "stage must be "+domain.QCStageBMCRapid+" or "+domain.QCStagePlantLab)
134		}
135		if actor.RoleCode != requiredRole {
136			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qc stage-role mismatch rejected",
137				slog.String("stage", req.Stage),
138				slog.String("required_role", requiredRole),
139				slog.String("actor_role", actor.RoleCode),
140				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
141				slog.String("subject_type", req.SubjectType),
142				slog.String("subject_id", req.SubjectID.Hex()))
143			return nil, httpx.Forbidden("STAGE_ROLE_MISMATCH: stage " + req.Stage + " results may only be recorded by " + requiredRole)
144		}
145	
146		analystID, err := actorID(actor)
147		if err != nil {
148			return nil, err
149		}
150	
151		subject, err := s.loadGateSubject(ctx, req.SubjectType, req.SubjectID)
152		if err != nil {
153			var appErr *httpx.AppError
154			if errors.As(err, &appErr) && appErr.Status == http.StatusConflict {
155				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qc subject not awaiting verdict",
156					slog.String("subject_type", req.SubjectType),
157					slog.String("subject_id", req.SubjectID.Hex()),
158					slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
159					slog.String("reason", appErr.Error()))
160			}
161			return nil, err
162		}
163		if err := s.deps.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, subject.orgUnitID); err != nil {
164			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qc scope denied",
165				slog.String("subject_type", req.SubjectType),
166				slog.String("subject_id", req.SubjectID.Hex()),
167				slog.String("subject_org_unit_id", subject.orgUnitID.Hex()),
168				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
169				slog.Any("err", err))
170			return nil, err
171		}
172	
173		// Closed test vocabulary: a typo'd or irrelevant test name must never be
174		// able to satisfy the safety gate.
175		if aerr := validateTestNames(req.Tests); aerr != nil {
176			return nil, aerr
177		}
178	
179		// Evaluate against the FSSAI limits (domain owns the rules).
180		overallPass, failures, evaluated := domain.EvaluateQCTests(toDomainTests(req.Tests))
181	
182		// A PASS verdict requires every mandatory test of the stage to be present
183		// AND within limits — the gate cannot be satisfied by a contentless
184		// submission (blueprint §8.3). A failing partial submission still records
185		// its BLOCK: quarantining on partial evidence is safety-conservative.
186		if missing := missingMandatoryTests(req.Stage, req.Tests); len(missing) > 0 && overallPass {
187			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qc pass rejected: mandatory tests missing",
188				slog.String("stage", req.Stage),
189				slog.String("subject_type", req.SubjectType),
190				slog.String("subject_id", req.SubjectID.Hex()),
191				slog.Any("missing_tests", missing),
192				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
193			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("MISSING_MANDATORY_TESTS",
194				"stage "+req.Stage+" cannot PASS without its mandatory tests").
195				WithDetails(map[string]any{"missing_tests": missing})
196		}
197	
198		// Pre-generate the result ID so the insert, the provenance refs and the
199		// gate write all share one consistent identifier.
200		resultID := primitive.NewObjectID()
201		now := time.Now().UTC()
202	
203		result := &domain.QCResult{
204			ID:             resultID,
205			SubjectType:    req.SubjectType,
206			SubjectID:      req.SubjectID,
207			Stage:          req.Stage,
208			Tests:          evaluated,
209			OverallPass:    overallPass,
210			AnalystPartyID: analystID,
211			LabRef:         req.LabRef,
212			RecordedAt:     now,
213		}
214	
215		// The write sequence below must not be aborted midway by a client
216		// disconnect: detach from the request context, keep a server-side bound.
217		wctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.WithoutCancel(ctx), 15*time.Second)
218		defer cancel()
219	
220		blockReason := ""
221		if overallPass {
222			seq, err := s.repo.nextCertificateSeq(wctx, req.Stage)
223			if err != nil {
224				s.logInternal(ctx, "issue qc certificate seq", req, err)
225				return nil, err
226			}
227			result.CertificateNumber = certificateNumber(req.Stage, seq)
228		} else {
229			result.FailureReasons = failures
230			blockReason = strings.Join(failures, "; ")
231		}
232	
233		// Ordering is safety-critical: evidence (qc_results doc) and provenance
234		// (hash-chained events) are persisted FIRST; the irreversible status flip
235		// on the subject happens LAST. A crash mid-sequence can leave an extra
236		// auditable result document, never a PASSED lot without evidence.
237		if err := s.repo.insertResult(wctx, result); err != nil {
238			s.logInternal(ctx, "insert qc result", req, err)
239			return nil, err
240		}
241	
242		// Provenance: qc.recorded, then the gate verdict event (blueprint §7).
243		ledgerActor := provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode}
244		recorded, err := s.deps.Ledger.Append(wctx, provenance.AppendInput{
245			Type:       domain.EventQCRecorded,
246			EntityType: domain.EntityQCResult,
247			EntityID:   resultID.Hex(),
248			Refs: []provenance.Ref{
249				{EntityType: subject.entityType, EntityID: req.SubjectID.Hex(), Relation: "tested"},
250			},
251			Actor:     ledgerActor,
252			OrgUnitID: subject.orgUnitID.Hex(),
253			Payload: map[string]any{
254				"stage":        req.Stage,
255				"subject_type": req.SubjectType,
256				"overall_pass": overallPass,
257			},
258		})
259		if err != nil {
260			s.logInternal(ctx, "append qc.recorded provenance event", req, err)
261			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
262		}
263	
264		gateEvent := provenance.AppendInput{
265			EntityType: domain.EntityQCResult,
266			EntityID:   resultID.Hex(),
267			Actor:      ledgerActor,
268			OrgUnitID:  subject.orgUnitID.Hex(),
269		}
270		if overallPass {
271			gateEvent.Type = domain.EventGatePassed
272			gateEvent.Refs = []provenance.Ref{
273				{EntityType: subject.entityType, EntityID: req.SubjectID.Hex(), Relation: "certifies"},
274			}
275			gateEvent.Payload = map[string]any{"certificate_number": result.CertificateNumber}
276		} else {
277			gateEvent.Type = domain.EventGateBlocked
278			gateEvent.Refs = []provenance.Ref{
279				{EntityType: subject.entityType, EntityID: req.SubjectID.Hex(), Relation: "blocks"},
280			}
281			gateEvent.Payload = map[string]any{"failure_reasons": failures}
282		}
283		if _, err := s.deps.Ledger.Append(wctx, gateEvent); err != nil {
284			s.logInternal(ctx, "append gate verdict provenance event", req, err)
285			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
286		}
287	
288		if err := s.repo.setResultProvenanceSeq(wctx, resultID, recorded.Seq); err != nil {
289			s.logInternal(ctx, "stamp qc result provenance seq", req, err)
290			return nil, err
291		}
292		result.ProvenanceSeq = recorded.Seq
293	
294		// LAST: apply the verdict. The conditional QC_PENDING filter remains the
295		// concurrency guard — a lost race voids OUR result (dangling evidence is
296		// auditable and harmless, unlike a dangling status flip).
297		gated, err := s.applyGate(wctx, req.SubjectType, req.SubjectID, resultID, overallPass, blockReason)
298		if err != nil {
299			s.logInternal(ctx, "apply gate verdict", req, err)
300			return nil, err
301		}
302		if !gated {
303			if err := s.repo.markResultSuperseded(wctx, resultID); err != nil {
304				s.logInternal(ctx, "mark qc result superseded", req, err)
305				return nil, err
306			}
307			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qc gate race lost: result superseded",
308				slog.String("qc_result_id", resultID.Hex()),
309				slog.String("subject_type", req.SubjectType),
310				slog.String("subject_id", req.SubjectID.Hex()),
311				slog.String("stage", req.Stage),
312				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
313			return nil, httpx.Conflict("SUBJECT_ALREADY_GATED", "subject is no longer awaiting QC — a verdict was already recorded")
314		}
315	
316		if overallPass {
317			s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "qc gate passed",
318				slog.String("qc_result_id", resultID.Hex()),
319				slog.String("subject_type", req.SubjectType),
320				slog.String("subject_id", req.SubjectID.Hex()),
321				slog.String("stage", req.Stage),
322				slog.String("certificate_number", result.CertificateNumber),
323				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
324		} else {
325			// Gate block is a WARN: the subject is quarantined and can never advance.
326			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qc gate blocked: subject quarantined",
327				slog.String("qc_result_id", resultID.Hex()),
328				slog.String("subject_type", req.SubjectType),
329				slog.String("subject_id", req.SubjectID.Hex()),
330				slog.String("stage", req.Stage),
331				slog.Any("failure_reasons", failures),
332				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
333			// Broadcast the block so the plant module quarantines downstream — a
334			// blocked lot can never advance.
335			s.deps.Bus.Publish(eventbus.TopicGateBlocked, GateBlockedPayload{
336				SubjectType:    req.SubjectType,
337				SubjectID:      req.SubjectID,
338				QCResultID:     resultID,
339				Stage:          req.Stage,
340				FailureReasons: failures,
341			})
342		}
343		return result, nil
344	}

346	// logInternal records an unexpected failure with the operation and subject
347	// context before the error surfaces as a 500.
348	func (s *service) logInternal(ctx context.Context, op string, req RecordQCResultRequest, err error) {
349		s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "qc record failed: "+op,
350			slog.String("subject_type", req.SubjectType),
351			slog.String("subject_id", req.SubjectID.Hex()),
352			slog.String("stage", req.Stage),
353			slog.Any("err", err))
354	}
355	
356	// loadGateSubject fetches a gate-eligible subject and verifies it is awaiting
357	// QC. Only BMC lots and processing batches carry the software safety gate.
358	func (s *service) loadGateSubject(ctx context.Context, subjectType string, subjectID primitive.ObjectID) (gateSubject, error) {
359		switch subjectType {
360		case domain.QCSubjectBMCLot:
361			lot, err := s.repo.findBMCLot(ctx, subjectID)
362			if err != nil {
363				return gateSubject{}, err
364			}
365			if lot.Status != domain.BMCLotStatusQCPending {
366				return gateSubject{}, httpx.Conflict("SUBJECT_NOT_QC_PENDING", "bmc lot is in status "+lot.Status+" — only QC_PENDING subjects can be gated")
367			}
368			return gateSubject{entityType: domain.EntityBMCLot, orgUnitID: lot.BMCID, status: lot.Status}, nil
369	
370		case domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch:
371			batch, err := s.repo.findBatch(ctx, subjectID)
372			if err != nil {
373				return gateSubject{}, err
374			}
375			if batch.Status != domain.BatchStatusQCPending {
376				return gateSubject{}, httpx.Conflict("SUBJECT_NOT_QC_PENDING", "processing batch is in status "+batch.Status+" — only QC_PENDING subjects can be gated")
377			}
378			return gateSubject{entityType: domain.EntityBatch, orgUnitID: batch.PlantID, status: batch.Status}, nil
379	
380		case domain.QCSubjectDCSConsignment:
381			return gateSubject{}, httpx.Unprocessable("SUBJECT_NOT_GATE_ELIGIBLE", "DCS consignments are not gate subjects — gate at the BMC lot or processing batch")
382	
383		default:
384			return gateSubject{}, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_SUBJECT_TYPE", "subject_type must be one of "+domain.QCSubjectBMCLot+", "+domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch)
385		}
386	}
387	
388	// applyGate routes the conditional verdict write to the subject's collection,
389	// mapping the verdict onto that subject kind's status constants.
390	func (s *service) applyGate(ctx context.Context, subjectType string, subjectID, resultID primitive.ObjectID, pass bool, blockReason string) (bool, error) {
391		switch subjectType {
392		case domain.QCSubjectBMCLot:
393			status := domain.BMCLotStatusBlocked
394			if pass {
395				status = domain.BMCLotStatusPassed
396			}
397			return s.repo.gateBMCLot(ctx, subjectID, resultID, status, blockReason)
398		case domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch:
399			status := domain.BatchStatusBlocked
400			if pass {
401				status = domain.BatchStatusPassed
402			}
403			return s.repo.gateBatch(ctx, subjectID, resultID, status, blockReason)
404		default:
405			return false, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_SUBJECT_TYPE", "subject_type is not gate-eligible")
406		}
407	}
408	
409	// listQCResults returns a page of results, newest first. When the filter
410	// identifies an org-owned subject, the caller must be in that org's scope.
411	// A zero subjectID means "no subject filter".
412	func (s *service) listQCResults(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, subjectType string, subjectID primitive.ObjectID, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.QCResult, int64, error) {
413		if subjectType != "" && !isValidSubjectType(subjectType) {
414			return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_SUBJECT_TYPE", "unknown subject_type "+subjectType)
415		}
416		if !subjectID.IsZero() && subjectType == "" {
417			return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_SUBJECT_TYPE", "subject_id requires subject_type")
418		}
419		if !subjectID.IsZero() {
420			if err := s.requireSubjectScope(ctx, actor, subjectType, subjectID); err != nil {
421				return nil, 0, err
422			}
423		}
424		return s.repo.listResults(ctx, subjectType, subjectID, page)
425	}
426	
427	// getQCResult returns one result (its tests carry the stored pass verdicts),
428	// enforcing the subject org scope.
429	func (s *service) getQCResult(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, resultID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.QCResult, error) {
430		result, err := s.repo.findResultByID(ctx, resultID)
431		if err != nil {
432			return nil, err
433		}
434		if err := s.requireSubjectScope(ctx, actor, result.SubjectType, result.SubjectID); err != nil {
435			return nil, err
436		}
437		return result, nil
438	}
439	
440	// requireSubjectScope enforces the caller's org scope over the org unit that
441	// owns a QC subject. Subjects that no longer resolve (or subject types that
442	// carry no org) skip the check — the role gate still applies.
443	func (s *service) requireSubjectScope(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, subjectType string, subjectID primitive.ObjectID) error {
444		orgID, err := s.subjectOrgUnit(ctx, subjectType, subjectID)
445		if err != nil {
446			return err
447		}
448		if orgID.IsZero() {
449			return nil
450		}
451		if err := s.deps.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, orgID); err != nil {
452			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qc read scope denied",
453				slog.String("subject_type", subjectType),
454				slog.String("subject_id", subjectID.Hex()),
455				slog.String("subject_org_unit_id", orgID.Hex()),
456				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
457				slog.Any("err", err))
458			return err
459		}
460		return nil
461	}
462	
463	// subjectOrgUnit resolves the owning org unit of a subject, or the zero
464	// ObjectID when the subject is missing or not an org-owned gate subject.
465	func (s *service) subjectOrgUnit(ctx context.Context, subjectType string, subjectID primitive.ObjectID) (primitive.ObjectID, error) {
466		switch subjectType {
467		case domain.QCSubjectBMCLot:
468			lot, err := s.repo.findBMCLot(ctx, subjectID)
469			if err != nil {
470				return primitive.NilObjectID, ignoreNotFound(err)
471			}
472			return lot.BMCID, nil
473		case domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch:
474			batch, err := s.repo.findBatch(ctx, subjectID)
475			if err != nil {
476				return primitive.NilObjectID, ignoreNotFound(err)
477			}
478			return batch.PlantID, nil
479		default:
480			return primitive.NilObjectID, nil
481		}
482	}
483	
484	// ignoreNotFound swallows 404 AppErrors and passes everything else through.
485	func ignoreNotFound(err error) error {
486		var appErr *httpx.AppError
487		if errors.As(err, &appErr) && appErr.Status == http.StatusNotFound {
488			return nil
489		}
490		return err
491	}
492	
493	// isValidSubjectType reports whether t is a known QC subject type.
494	func isValidSubjectType(t string) bool {
495		switch t {
496		case domain.QCSubjectDCSConsignment, domain.QCSubjectBMCLot, domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch:
497			return true
498		default:
499			return false
500		}
501	}
502	
503	// toDomainTests converts request test inputs to domain tests for evaluation.
504	func toDomainTests(in []QCTestInput) []domain.QCTest {
505		out := make([]domain.QCTest, 0, len(in))
506		for _, t := range in {
507			out = append(out, domain.QCTest{Name: t.Name, Value: t.Value, Unit: t.Unit})
508		}
509		return out
510	}

133	// redactNotificationSecrets strips the plaintext OTP (params + rendered meta)
134	// from an outbox document before it leaves the API.
135	func redactNotificationSecrets(n *StoredNotification) {
136		if n.TemplateKey != domain.TemplateOTP {
137			return
138		}
139		if n.Params != nil {
140			params := make(map[string]string, len(n.Params))
141			for k, v := range n.Params {
142				if k == "otp" {
143					v = redactedValue
144				}
145				params[k] = v
146			}
147			n.Params = params
148		}
149		if n.Meta != nil {
150			meta := make(map[string]any, len(n.Meta))
151			for k, v := range n.Meta {
152				if k == "rendered_en" || k == "rendered_hi" {
153					v = redactedValue
154				}
155				meta[k] = v
156			}
157			n.Meta = meta
158		}
159	}

161	// runWorker is the MOCK SMS provider dispatch (real deployment: MSG91 /
162	// telecom DLT gateway, §13). It claims up to workerClaimCap QUEUED documents
163	// via a race-safe FindOneAndUpdate loop, stamps each SENT with a mock
164	// provider reference, and renders the English/Hindi lines into meta for
165	// visibility. The manual trigger keeps the demo deterministic; production
166	// runs this as a cron/queue consumer.
167	func (s *service) runWorker(ctx context.Context) (*WorkerRunResponse, error) {
168		sent := 0
169		for i := 0; i < workerClaimCap; i++ {
170			providerRef := "SMS-MOCK-" + uuid.NewString()[0:8]
171			claimed, err := s.repo.claimQueuedNotification(ctx, providerRef, time.Now().UTC())
172			if err != nil {
173				s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "claim queued notification failed", slog.Any("err", err))
174				return nil, err
175			}
176			if claimed == nil {
177				break // queue drained
178			}
179			sent++
180	
181			english, hindi := renderSMS(claimed.TemplateKey, claimed.Params)
182			if claimed.TemplateKey == domain.TemplateOTP {
183				// Never persist the rendered OTP text — the provider gets the
184				// message transiently; the readable outbox keeps no plaintext code.
185				english, hindi = redactedValue, redactedValue
186			}
187			meta := map[string]any{
188				"provider":    "SMS-MOCK",
189				"rendered_en": english,
190				"rendered_hi": hindi,
191			}
192			if err := s.repo.setNotificationMeta(ctx, claimed.ID, meta); err != nil {
193				// The claim already succeeded — meta is cosmetic, log and move on.
194				s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "stamp notification meta failed",
195					slog.String("notification_id", claimed.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
196			}
197			s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "notification dispatched",
198				slog.String("notification_id", claimed.ID.Hex()),
199				slog.String("template_key", claimed.TemplateKey),
200				slog.String("provider_ref", providerRef),
201				slog.String("status", domain.NotificationSent))
202		}
203		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "notification worker run complete", slog.Int("sent", sent))
204		return &WorkerRunResponse{Sent: sent}, nil
205	}

303	// decodeBusPayload structurally re-decodes a bus payload into this module's
304	// mirror struct — modules never import each other's types (module contract).
305	func decodeBusPayload(payload any, dst any) error {
306		raw, err := json.Marshal(payload)
307		if err != nil {
308			return fmt.Errorf("marshal bus payload: %w", err)
309		}
310		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, dst); err != nil {
311			return fmt.Errorf("unmarshal bus payload: %w", err)
312		}
313		return nil
314	}

362			return

364		if union == nil {

366				slog.String("org_unit_id", orgUnitID.Hex()))

368		}

371		if err != nil {

382		}
