446	// queueNotification inserts one QUEUED outbox document, resolving phone and
447	// preferred language from the party record when available. The _id is
448	// pre-generated so the queued entry can be named in the structured log.
449	// Failures are logged, never propagated — a lost SMS must not fail the
450	// publishing flow.
451	func (s *service) queueNotification(ctx context.Context, partyID *primitive.ObjectID, phone, templateKey string, params map[string]string) {
452		language := "hi" // vernacular default (blueprint §13)
453		if partyID != nil {
454			if party, err := s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, *partyID); err == nil {
455				if phone == "" {
456					phone = party.Phone
457				}
458				if party.PreferredLanguage != "" {
459					language = party.PreferredLanguage
460				}
461			}
462		}
463		if phone == "" {
464			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "dropping notification with no phone",
465				slog.String("template_key", templateKey), slog.String("party_id", hexOrEmpty(partyID)))
466			return
467		}
468	
469		id := primitive.NewObjectID()
470		notification := &StoredNotification{Notification: domain.Notification{
471			ID:          id,
472			PartyID:     partyID,
473			Phone:       phone,
474			Channel:     domain.ChannelSMS,
475			TemplateKey: templateKey,
476			Language:    language,
477			Params:      params,
478			Status:      domain.NotificationQueued,
479			QueuedAt:    time.Now().UTC(),
480		}}
481		if err := s.repo.insertNotification(ctx, notification); err != nil {
482			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "queue notification failed",
483				slog.String("template_key", templateKey), slog.Any("err", err))
484			return
485		}
486		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "notification queued",
487			slog.String("notification_id", id.Hex()),
488			slog.String("template_key", templateKey),
489			slog.String("party_id", hexOrEmpty(partyID)),
490			slog.String("status", domain.NotificationQueued))
491	}

493	// unionAncestor returns the MILK_UNION org unit at or above orgUnitID, walking
494	// the denormalised ancestor Path nearest-first via d.Orgs.Get. Returns nil
495	// when no union sits on the chain (e.g. a plant directly under the federation).
496	func (s *service) unionAncestor(ctx context.Context, orgUnitID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
497		org, err := s.deps.Orgs.Get(ctx, orgUnitID)
498		if err != nil {
499			return nil, err
500		}
501		if org.Type == domain.OrgTypeMilkUnion {
502			return org, nil
503		}
504		// Path holds ancestors root→down; walk nearest ancestor first.
505		for i := len(org.Path) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
506			ancestor, err := s.deps.Orgs.Get(ctx, org.Path[i])
507			if err != nil {
508				return nil, err
509			}
510			if ancestor.Type == domain.OrgTypeMilkUnion {
511				return ancestor, nil
512			}
513		}
514		return nil, nil
515	}
516

22	// through deps.Audit only — the collection is insert-only by design, §12),
23	// and reads parties / role_assignments for the support lookup and for

47	// auditFilter builds the bson filter shared by the list and export reads.
48	func auditFilter(f auditLogFilter) bson.D {
49		filter := bson.D{}
50		if f.ActorPartyID != "" {
51			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "actor_party_id", Value: f.ActorPartyID})
52		}
53		if f.TargetType != "" {
54			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "target_type", Value: f.TargetType})
55		}
56		if f.Action != "" {
57			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "action", Value: f.Action})
58		}
59		if f.From != nil || f.To != nil {
60			tsRange := bson.D{}
61			if f.From != nil {
62				tsRange = append(tsRange, bson.E{Key: "$gte", Value: *f.From})
63			}
64			if f.To != nil {
65				tsRange = append(tsRange, bson.E{Key: "$lte", Value: *f.To})
66			}
67			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "ts", Value: tsRange})
68		}
69		return filter
70	}

153	// claimQueuedNotification atomically claims the oldest QUEUED document
154	// (QUEUED→SENT, sent_at, provider_ref) and returns it, or nil when the queue
155	// is drained. FindOneAndUpdate makes the claim race-safe across concurrent
156	// worker runs — never find-then-update.
157	func (r *repository) claimQueuedNotification(ctx context.Context, providerRef string, now time.Time) (*StoredNotification, error) {
158		var n StoredNotification
159		err := r.notifications.FindOneAndUpdate(ctx,
160			bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: domain.NotificationQueued}},
161			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
162				{Key: "status", Value: domain.NotificationSent},
163				{Key: "sent_at", Value: now},
164				{Key: "provider_ref", Value: providerRef},
165			}}},
166			options.FindOneAndUpdate().
167				SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "queued_at", Value: 1}}).
168				SetReturnDocument(options.After),
169		).Decode(&n)
170		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
171			return nil, nil
172		}
173		if err != nil {
174			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("claim queued notification: %w", err))
175		}
176		return &n, nil
177	}

259	// subjectOrgUnit resolves a gate-blocked QC subject to the org unit that
260	// holds it (BMC lot → bmc_id, processing batch → plant_id). Both the subject
261	// _id and the reference field are ObjectIDs.
262	func (r *repository) subjectOrgUnit(ctx context.Context, subjectType string, subjectID primitive.ObjectID) (primitive.ObjectID, error) {
263		var coll *mongo.Collection
264		var field string
265		switch subjectType {
266		case domain.QCSubjectBMCLot:
267			coll, field = r.bmcLots, "bmc_id"
268		case domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch:
269			coll, field = r.batches, "plant_id"
270		default:
271			return primitive.NilObjectID, fmt.Errorf("gate-blocked subject type %q has no org resolution", subjectType)
272		}
273	
274		var doc bson.M
275		err := coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: subjectID}},
276			options.FindOne().SetProjection(bson.D{{Key: field, Value: 1}}),
277		).Decode(&doc)
278		if err != nil {
279			return primitive.NilObjectID, fmt.Errorf("resolve org of %s %s: %w", subjectType, subjectID.Hex(), err)
280		}
281		orgUnitID, _ := doc[field].(primitive.ObjectID)
282		if orgUnitID.IsZero() {
283			return primitive.NilObjectID, fmt.Errorf("%s %s carries no %s", subjectType, subjectID.Hex(), field)
284		}
285		return orgUnitID, nil
286	}

128	// --- Auth: OTP login ---

130	// requestOTP creates a hashed OTP challenge and queues the SMS through the
131	// notification outbox (the platformops worker delivers it).
132	func (s *service) requestOTP(ctx context.Context, phone string) (*otpRequestResponse, error) {
133		now := time.Now().UTC()
134		code, err := auth.GenerateNumericOTP(otpLength)
135		if err != nil {
136			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "otp generation failed", slog.Any("err", err))
137			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
138		}
139	
140		challenge := otpChallenge{
141			ID:        uuid.NewString(),
142			Phone:     phone,
143			CodeHash:  auth.HMACHash(s.deps.Cfg.OTPHashSecret, phone, code),
144			ExpiresAt: now.Add(s.deps.Cfg.OTPTTL),
145			Attempts:  0,
146		}
147		if err := s.repo.insertOTPChallenge(ctx, challenge); err != nil {
148			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "otp challenge insert failed", slog.String("phone", phone), slog.Any("err", err))
149			return nil, err
150		}
151	
152		// Outbox SMS: the plaintext code travels only inside the notification
153		// params so the sender can deliver it; the challenge stores the hash.
154		notification := domain.Notification{
155			Phone:       phone,
156			Channel:     domain.ChannelSMS,
157			TemplateKey: domain.TemplateOTP,
158			Language:    defaultLanguage,
159			Params:      map[string]string{"otp": code},
160			Status:      domain.NotificationQueued,
161			QueuedAt:    now,
162		}
163		if party, err := s.repo.findPartyByPhone(ctx, phone); err == nil {
164			pid := party.ID
165			notification.PartyID = &pid
166			if party.PreferredLanguage != "" {
167				notification.Language = party.PreferredLanguage
168			}
169		}
170		if err := s.repo.insertNotification(ctx, notification); err != nil {
171			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "otp notification queue failed", slog.String("phone", phone), slog.Any("err", err))
172			return nil, err
173		}
174	
175		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "otp requested", slog.String("phone", phone))
176		resp := &otpRequestResponse{Phone: phone, ExpiresAt: challenge.ExpiresAt}
177		if s.deps.Cfg.OTPDevMode {
178			resp.DevOTP = code // dev only — config refuses OTP_DEV_MODE in prod
179		}
180		return resp, nil
181	}
182	
183	// verifyOTP checks the challenge and logs the phone in, creating the Party
184	// on first login (find-or-create, §4.1).
185	func (s *service) verifyOTP(ctx context.Context, phone, otp string) (*authTokensResponse, error) {
186		now := time.Now().UTC()
187	
188		challenge, err := s.repo.latestOTPChallenge(ctx, phone, now)
189		if err != nil {
190			if isNotFound(err) {
191				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "otp verify rejected: no active challenge", slog.String("phone", phone))
192				return nil, httpx.Unauthorized("no active OTP for this phone — request a new code")
193			}
194			return nil, err
195		}
196		if challenge.Attempts >= maxOTPAttempts {
197			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "otp verify rejected: too many attempts", slog.String("phone", phone))
198			return nil, httpx.TooManyRequests("too many incorrect OTP attempts — request a new code")
199		}
200		expected := auth.HMACHash(s.deps.Cfg.OTPHashSecret, phone, otp)
201		if !auth.ConstantTimeEqual(challenge.CodeHash, expected) {
202			if err := s.repo.incrementOTPAttempts(ctx, challenge.ID); err != nil {
203				return nil, err
204			}
205			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "otp verify rejected: incorrect code", slog.String("phone", phone))
206			return nil, httpx.Unauthorized("incorrect OTP")
207		}
208	
209		// Burn every outstanding challenge for this phone.
210		if err := s.repo.deleteOTPChallenges(ctx, phone); err != nil {
211			return nil, err
212		}
213	
214		party, err := s.repo.upsertPartyByPhone(ctx, phone, now)
215		if err != nil {
216			return nil, err
217		}
218		if party.Status != domain.PartyStatusActive {
219			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "otp verify rejected: party suspended",
220				slog.String("phone", phone), slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()))
221			return nil, httpx.Forbidden("party is suspended")
222		}
223		tokens, err := s.issueLoginTokens(ctx, party, now)
224		if err != nil {
225			return nil, err
226		}
227		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "party logged in",
228			slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()), slog.String("phone", phone))
229		return tokens, nil
230	}
231	
232	// issueLoginTokens mints a SESSION access token plus a fresh rotating
233	// refresh token (stored only as an HMAC digest).
234	func (s *service) issueLoginTokens(ctx context.Context, party *domain.Party, now time.Time) (*authTokensResponse, error) {
235		refreshToken, err := auth.RandomToken(32)
236		if err != nil {
237			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "refresh token generation failed", slog.Any("err", err))
238			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
239		}
240		doc := refreshTokenDoc{
241			TokenHash: auth.HMACHash(s.deps.Cfg.OTPHashSecret, refreshHashLabel, refreshToken),
242			PartyID:   party.ID,
243			ExpiresAt: now.Add(s.deps.Cfg.RefreshTokenTTL),
244			CreatedAt: now,
245		}
246		if err := s.repo.insertRefreshToken(ctx, doc); err != nil {
247			return nil, err
248		}
249		accessToken, err := s.deps.JWT.IssueSessionToken(*party)
250		if err != nil {
251			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "session token issue failed",
252				slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
253			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
254		}
255		return &authTokensResponse{
256			AccessToken:  accessToken,
257			RefreshToken: refreshToken,
258			Party:        party,
259		}, nil
260	}
261	
262	// refresh rotates a refresh token: the old token is consumed atomically and
263	// a new pair is issued — a replayed token always fails.
264	func (s *service) refresh(ctx context.Context, refreshToken string) (*authTokensResponse, error) {
265		now := time.Now().UTC()
266		tokenHash := auth.HMACHash(s.deps.Cfg.OTPHashSecret, refreshHashLabel, refreshToken)
267	
268		doc, err := s.repo.findRefreshToken(ctx, tokenHash)
269		if err != nil {
270			if isNotFound(err) {
271				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "refresh rejected: unknown token")
272				return nil, httpx.Unauthorized("invalid refresh token")
273			}
274			return nil, err
275		}
276		if !now.Before(doc.ExpiresAt) {
277			_, _ = s.repo.deleteRefreshToken(ctx, tokenHash)
278			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "refresh rejected: token expired", slog.String("party_id", doc.PartyID.Hex()))
279			return nil, httpx.Unauthorized("refresh token expired — log in again")
280		}
281	
282		// ROTATE: consume the old token first; DeletedCount==0 means a parallel
283		// request won the race, so this presentation is treated as a replay.
284		deleted, err := s.repo.deleteRefreshToken(ctx, tokenHash)
285		if err != nil {
286			return nil, err
287		}
288		if deleted == 0 {
289			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "refresh rejected: token already used", slog.String("party_id", doc.PartyID.Hex()))
290			return nil, httpx.Unauthorized("refresh token already used")
291		}
292	
293		party, err := s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, doc.PartyID)
294		if err != nil {
295			if isNotFound(err) {
296				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "refresh rejected: party gone", slog.String("party_id", doc.PartyID.Hex()))
297				return nil, httpx.Unauthorized("party no longer exists")
298			}
299			return nil, err
300		}
301		if party.Status != domain.PartyStatusActive {
302			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "refresh rejected: party suspended", slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()))
303			return nil, httpx.Forbidden("party is suspended")
304		}
305		return s.issueLoginTokens(ctx, party, now)
306	}
307	
308	// logout revokes one refresh token belonging to the caller. Idempotent.
309	func (s *service) logout(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, refreshToken string) error {
310		aid, err := actorID(actor)
311		if err != nil {
312			return err
313		}
314		tokenHash := auth.HMACHash(s.deps.Cfg.OTPHashSecret, refreshHashLabel, refreshToken)
315		return s.repo.deleteRefreshTokenForParty(ctx, tokenHash, aid)
316	}

319	
320	// listMyRoles returns the actor's currently usable assignments, enriched
321	// with org-unit display fields for the role-switcher UI.
322	func (s *service) listMyRoles(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor) ([]assignmentWithOrg, error) {
323		aid, err := actorID(actor)
324		if err != nil {
325			return nil, err
326		}
327		assignments, err := s.repo.listActiveAssignments(ctx, aid)
328		if err != nil {
329			return nil, err
330		}
331		now := time.Now().UTC()
332		out := make([]assignmentWithOrg, 0, len(assignments))
333		for _, ra := range assignments {
334			if !ra.UsableAt(now) {
335				continue
336			}
337			out = append(out, s.withOrg(ctx, ra))
338		}
339		return out, nil
340	}
341	
342	// withOrg copies org display fields onto an assignment; enrichment is
343	// best-effort (a missing org unit never breaks the listing).
344	func (s *service) withOrg(ctx context.Context, ra domain.RoleAssignment) assignmentWithOrg {
345		enriched := assignmentWithOrg{RoleAssignment: ra}
346		if org, err := s.deps.Orgs.Get(ctx, ra.OrgUnitID); err == nil {
347			enriched.OrgName = org.Name
348			enriched.OrgType = org.Type
349			enriched.OrgCode = org.Code
350		}
351		return enriched
352	}
353	
354	// selectRole exchanges the session for a ROLE-kind token pinned to one
355	// usable assignment, gated on the role's minimum KYC tier (§5.2). With
356	// auto-verify gone, this genuinely blocks un-approved parties.
357	func (s *service) selectRole(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, assignmentID primitive.ObjectID) (*roleSelectResponse, error) {
358		aid, err := actorID(actor)
359		if err != nil {
360			return nil, err
361		}
362		assignment, err := s.repo.findAssignmentByID(ctx, assignmentID)
363		if err != nil {
364			return nil, err
365		}
366		if assignment.PartyID != aid {
367			// Same shape as an unknown ID — never confirm other parties' grants.
368			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "role select rejected: not owner",
369				slog.String("assignment_id", assignmentID.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
370			return nil, httpx.NotFound("role assignment")
371		}
372		now := time.Now().UTC()
373		if !assignment.UsableAt(now) {
374			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "role select rejected: assignment not usable",
375				slog.String("assignment_id", assignmentID.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
376			return nil, httpx.Forbidden("role assignment is revoked or outside its validity window")
377		}
378	
379		// Re-read the party: the KYC tier may have upgraded since the session
380		// token was minted.
381		party, err := s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, aid)
382		if err != nil {
383			return nil, err
384		}
385		if party.Status != domain.PartyStatusActive {
386			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "role select rejected: party suspended", slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()))
387			return nil, httpx.Forbidden("party is suspended")
388		}
389		requiredTier := domain.RequiredKYCTier[assignment.RoleCode]
390		if !domain.KYCTierSatisfies(party.KYCTier, requiredTier) {
391			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "role select rejected: kyc tier insufficient",
392				slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()),
393				slog.String("role_code", assignment.RoleCode),
394				slog.String("current_tier", party.KYCTier),
395				slog.String("required_tier", requiredTier))
396			appErr := httpx.Forbidden("your KYC tier does not permit this role — complete verification first").
397				WithDetails(map[string]string{
398					"current_tier":  party.KYCTier,
399					"required_tier": requiredTier,
400				})
401			appErr.Code = "KYC_TIER_INSUFFICIENT"
402			return nil, appErr
403		}
404	
405		org, err := s.deps.Orgs.Get(ctx, assignment.OrgUnitID)
406		if err != nil {
407			return nil, err
408		}
409		accessToken, err := s.deps.JWT.IssueRoleToken(*party, *assignment, org.Type)
410		if err != nil {
411			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "role token issue failed",
412				slog.String("assignment_id", assignmentID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
413			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
414		}
415		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "role selected",
416			slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()),
417			slog.String("assignment_id", assignmentID.Hex()),
418			slog.String("role_code", assignment.RoleCode),
419			slog.String("org_unit_id", assignment.OrgUnitID.Hex()))
420		return &roleSelectResponse{
421			AccessToken: accessToken,
422			RoleCode:    assignment.RoleCode,
423			OrgUnitID:   assignment.OrgUnitID,
424			OrgType:     org.Type,
425		}, nil
426	}

470	
471	// --- KYC (mock DPI adapters — real UIDAI / penny-drop integration later) ---
472	
473	// verifyAadhaar runs the MOCK Aadhaar eKYC capture (§18-A). The full Aadhaar
474	// number exists only in this request's memory: what is persisted is the
475	// last 4 digits plus an opaque reference from the (mock) Aadhaar Data Vault.
476	//
477	// There is NO auto-verify and NO tier change here: the record is created
478	// PENDING and enters the approval workflow. Returns created=false when an
479	// identical PENDING request already exists (idempotent replay → 200).
480	func (s *service) verifyAadhaar(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req aadhaarKYCRequest) (*aadhaarKYCResponse, bool, error) {
481		now := time.Now().UTC()
482		aid, err := actorID(actor)
483		if err != nil {
484			return nil, false, err
485		}
486		party, err := s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, aid)
487		if err != nil {
488			return nil, false, err
489		}
490	
491		// Idempotency: an existing PENDING request for the same tier is returned
492		// as-is rather than duplicated.
493		if existing, err := s.repo.findPendingKYCRecord(ctx, party.ID, req.RequestedTier); err == nil {
494			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "kyc submit replayed idempotently",
495				slog.String("kyc_id", existing.ID.Hex()),
496				slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()),
497				slog.String("requested_tier", req.RequestedTier))
498			return &aadhaarKYCResponse{
499				Record:  existing,
500				Status:  domain.KYCStatusPending,
501				Message: msgAwaitingVerification,
502			}, false, nil
503		} else if !isNotFound(err) {
504			return nil, false, err
505		}
506	
507		language := party.PreferredLanguage
508		if language == "" {
509			language = defaultLanguage
510		}
511		// Pre-generate the consent id so the KYC record can reference it in the
512		// same flow.
513		consentID := primitive.NewObjectID()
514		consent := domain.Consent{
515			ID:          consentID,
516			PartyID:     party.ID,
517			Purpose:     consentPurposeAadhaarEKYC,
518			TextVersion: consentTextVersion,
519			Language:    language,
520			GrantedAt:   now,
521		}
522		if err := s.repo.insertConsent(ctx, consent); err != nil {
523			return nil, false, err
524		}
525	
526		// MOCK Aadhaar Data Vault (§18-A): a real deployment sends the number to
527		// the vault service and receives an opaque token. The mock mints a UUID.
528		vaultRef := uuid.NewString()
529		last4 := req.AadhaarNumber[len(req.AadhaarNumber)-4:]
530	
531		record := domain.KYCRecord{
532			ID:              primitive.NewObjectID(),
533			PartyID:         party.ID,
534			RequestedTier:   req.RequestedTier,
535			AadhaarLast4:    last4,
536			AadhaarVaultRef: vaultRef,
537			ConsentID:       &consentID,
538			Status:          domain.KYCStatusPending,
539			CreatedAt:       now,
540			UpdatedAt:       now,
541		}
542		if err := s.repo.insertKYCRecord(ctx, record); err != nil {
543			return nil, false, err
544		}
545	
546		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "kyc submitted",
547			slog.String("kyc_id", record.ID.Hex()),
548			slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()),
549			slog.String("requested_tier", req.RequestedTier))
550		return &aadhaarKYCResponse{
551			Record:  &record,
552			Status:  domain.KYCStatusPending,
553			Message: msgAwaitingVerification,
554		}, true, nil
555	}
556	
557	// verifyBank runs the MOCK penny-drop verification and stores ONLY the
558	// masked account tail and IFSC on the caller's latest KYC record (creating a
559	// PENDING record carrying just the bank evidence when none exists yet).
560	func (s *service) verifyBank(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req bankKYCRequest) (*domain.KYCRecord, error) {
561		now := time.Now().UTC()
562		aid, err := actorID(actor)
563		if err != nil {
564			return nil, err
565		}
566		party, err := s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, aid)
567		if err != nil {
568			return nil, err
569		}
570		masked := maskAccount(req.AccountNumber)
571	
572		latest, err := s.repo.latestKYCRecord(ctx, aid)
573		switch {
574		case err == nil:
575			// MOCK penny-drop: always verified with a fixed name-match score.
576			rec, err := s.repo.updateKYCRecordBank(ctx, latest.ID, masked, req.IFSC, mockPennyDropNameMatch, now)
577			if err != nil {
578				return nil, err
579			}
580			s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "bank evidence attached",
581				slog.String("kyc_id", rec.ID.Hex()), slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()))
582			return rec, nil
583		case isNotFound(err):
584			record := domain.KYCRecord{
585				ID:                primitive.NewObjectID(),
586				PartyID:           party.ID,
587				RequestedTier:     party.KYCTier,
588				BankAccountMasked: masked,
589				BankIFSC:          req.IFSC,
590				BankVerified:      true, // MOCK penny-drop: always succeeds
591				BankNameMatch:     mockPennyDropNameMatch,
592				Status:            domain.KYCStatusPending,
593				CreatedAt:         now,
594				UpdatedAt:         now,
595			}
596			if err := s.repo.insertKYCRecord(ctx, record); err != nil {
597				return nil, err
598			}
599			s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "bank evidence recorded on new pending kyc",
600				slog.String("kyc_id", record.ID.Hex()), slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()))
601			return &record, nil
602		default:
603			return nil, err
604		}
605	}

610		aid, err := actorID(actor)
611		if err != nil {

617	// --- KYC approval workflow (reviewer console) ---
618	
619	// listPendingKYC pages all PENDING KYC records newest-first, enriched with a
620	// reviewer-facing party summary, and audits the access.
621	func (s *service) listPendingKYC(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, page httpx.Page) ([]pendingKYCItem, int64, error) {
622		records, total, err := s.repo.listPendingKYC(ctx, page)
623		if err != nil {
624			return nil, 0, err
625		}
626		ids := make([]primitive.ObjectID, 0, len(records))
627		for _, rec := range records {
628			ids = append(ids, rec.PartyID)
629		}
630		parties, err := s.repo.findPartiesByIDs(ctx, ids)
631		if err != nil {
632			return nil, 0, err
633		}
634		items := make([]pendingKYCItem, 0, len(records))
635		for _, rec := range records {
636			item := pendingKYCItem{KYCRecord: rec}
637			if p, ok := parties[rec.PartyID]; ok {
638				item.Party = &pendingPartySummary{
639					ID:       p.ID,
640					Phone:    p.Phone,
641					FullName: p.FullName,
642					KYCTier:  p.KYCTier,
643				}
644			}
645			items = append(items, item)
646		}
647	
648		s.deps.Audit.Record(ctx, audit.Entry{
649			Action: "kyc.pending_list",
650			Meta:   map[string]any{"count": len(items), "total": total},
651		})
652		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "kyc pending list accessed",
653			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
654			slog.Int("count", len(items)),
655			slog.Int64("total", total))
656		return items, total, nil
657	}
658	
659	// approveKYC verifies a PENDING record, upgrades the party's KYC tier upward
660	// only, notifies the party and audits the decision. The reviewer's role must
661	// be authorised for the requested tier — even SUPER_ADMIN passes through the
662	// approvable-tier map (which grants it everything).
663	func (s *service) approveKYC(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID) (*kycReviewResponse, error) {
664		now := time.Now().UTC()
665		aid, err := actorID(actor)
666		if err != nil {
667			return nil, err
668		}
669		record, err := s.repo.findKYCRecordByID(ctx, id)
670		if err != nil {
671			return nil, err
672		}
673		if record.Status != domain.KYCStatusPending {
674			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "kyc approve rejected: record not pending",
675				slog.String("kyc_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("status", record.Status),
676				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
677			return nil, httpx.Conflict("KYC_NOT_PENDING", "kyc record is not pending review")
678		}
679		if !domain.CanApproveKYCTier(actor.RoleCode, record.RequestedTier) {
680			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "kyc approve rejected: tier not approvable",
681				slog.String("kyc_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("reviewer_role", actor.RoleCode),
682				slog.String("requested_tier", record.RequestedTier))
683			appErr := httpx.Forbidden("your role may not approve KYC at the " + record.RequestedTier + " tier")
684			appErr.Code = "KYC_TIER_NOT_APPROVABLE"
685			return nil, appErr
686		}
687	
688		updated, err := s.repo.approveKYCRecord(ctx, id, aid, actor.RoleCode, now)
689		if err != nil {
690			if isNotFound(err) {
691				// Lost the race — another reviewer already moved it out of PENDING.
692				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "kyc approve lost race: record no longer pending",
693					slog.String("kyc_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
694				return nil, httpx.Conflict("KYC_NOT_PENDING", "kyc record is not pending review")
695			}
696			return nil, err
697		}
698	
699		party, err := s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, updated.PartyID)
700		if err != nil {
701			return nil, err
702		}
703		newTier := upgradedKYCTier(party.KYCTier, updated.RequestedTier)
704		if newTier != party.KYCTier {
705			if err := s.repo.updatePartyKYCTier(ctx, party.ID, newTier, now); err != nil {
706				return nil, err
707			}
708		}
709	
710		language := party.PreferredLanguage
711		if language == "" {
712			language = defaultLanguage
713		}
714		pid := party.ID
715		if err := s.repo.insertNotification(ctx, domain.Notification{
716			PartyID:     &pid,
717			Phone:       party.Phone,
718			Channel:     domain.ChannelSMS,
719			TemplateKey: domain.TemplateKYCApproved,
720			Language:    language,
721			Params:      map[string]string{"tier": updated.RequestedTier},
722			Status:      domain.NotificationQueued,
723			QueuedAt:    now,
724		}); err != nil {
725			return nil, err
726		}
727	
728		s.deps.Audit.Record(ctx, audit.Entry{
729			Action:     "kyc.approve",
730			TargetType: "kyc_record",
731			TargetID:   id.Hex(),
732			Meta: map[string]any{
733				"party_id":       party.ID.Hex(),
734				"requested_tier": updated.RequestedTier,
735				"new_tier":       newTier,
736			},
737		})
738		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "kyc approved",
739			slog.String("kyc_id", id.Hex()),
740			slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()),
741			slog.String("requested_tier", updated.RequestedTier),
742			slog.String("new_tier", newTier),
743			slog.String("reviewer_role", actor.RoleCode),
744			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
745		return &kycReviewResponse{Record: updated, KYCTier: newTier}, nil
746	}
747	
748	// rejectKYC moves a PENDING record to REJECTED with a mandatory reason,
749	// notifies the party and audits the decision. Same approvable-tier authority
750	// as approveKYC.
751	func (s *service) rejectKYC(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID, reason string) (*kycReviewResponse, error) {
752		now := time.Now().UTC()
753		aid, err := actorID(actor)
754		if err != nil {
755			return nil, err
756		}
757		record, err := s.repo.findKYCRecordByID(ctx, id)
758		if err != nil {
759			return nil, err
760		}
761		if record.Status != domain.KYCStatusPending {
762			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "kyc reject rejected: record not pending",
763				slog.String("kyc_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("status", record.Status),
764				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
765			return nil, httpx.Conflict("KYC_NOT_PENDING", "kyc record is not pending review")
766		}
767		if !domain.CanApproveKYCTier(actor.RoleCode, record.RequestedTier) {
768			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "kyc reject rejected: tier not approvable",

830	// requireGrantAuthority enforces the non-admin granter matrix (§5.2):
831	// UNION_PRESIDENT manages village/logistics/union-tier roles anywhere in
832	// scope; SAMITI_ADHYAKSH manages only FARMER/MILK_TESTER/LRP inside their
833	// own DCS; ORGANISING_MANAGER enrols FARMER/CONSUMER within org scope.
834	// Admin granters pass.
835	func (s *service) requireGrantAuthority(actor auth.Actor, roleCode string, orgUnitID primitive.ObjectID) error {
836		if !granterMayGrant(actor.RoleCode, roleCode) {
837			return httpx.Forbidden("role " + actor.RoleCode + " may not grant or revoke " + roleCode)
838		}
839		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSamitiAdhyaksh && orgUnitID.Hex() != actor.OrgUnitID {
840			return httpx.Forbidden("SAMITI_ADHYAKSH may manage roles only within their own DCS")
841		}
842		return nil
843	}

845	// createAssignment grants a role to a party inside an org unit.
846	func (s *service) createAssignment(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req createAssignmentRequest) (*domain.RoleAssignment, error) {
847		aid, err := actorID(actor)
848		if err != nil {
849			return nil, err
850		}
851	
852		// Resolve the target party (party_id wins over phone).
853		var party *domain.Party
854		if req.PartyID != nil {
855			party, err = s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, *req.PartyID)
856		} else {
857			party, err = s.repo.findPartyByPhone(ctx, req.Phone)
858		}
859		if err != nil {
860			return nil, err
861		}
862	
863		if err := s.deps.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.OrgUnitID); err != nil {
864			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "assignment grant denied: out of scope",
865				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
866				slog.String("org_unit_id", req.OrgUnitID.Hex()),
867				slog.String("role_code", req.RoleCode))
868			return nil, err
869		}
870		if err := s.requireGrantAuthority(actor, req.RoleCode, req.OrgUnitID); err != nil {
871			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "assignment grant denied: granter not authorised",
872				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
873				slog.String("granter_role", actor.RoleCode),
874				slog.String("role_code", req.RoleCode))
875			return nil, err
876		}
877	
878		exists, err := s.repo.activeAssignmentExists(ctx, party.ID, req.RoleCode, req.OrgUnitID)
879		if err != nil {
880			return nil, err
881		}
882		if exists {
883			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "assignment grant rejected: already exists",
884				slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()),
885				slog.String("role_code", req.RoleCode),
886				slog.String("org_unit_id", req.OrgUnitID.Hex()))
887			return nil, httpx.Conflict("ASSIGNMENT_EXISTS", "party already holds an active "+req.RoleCode+" assignment in this org unit")
888		}
889	
890		now := time.Now().UTC()
891		validFrom := now
892		if req.ValidFrom != nil {
893			validFrom = req.ValidFrom.UTC()
894		}
895		var validTo *time.Time
896		if req.ValidTo != nil {
897			t := req.ValidTo.UTC()
898			validTo = &t
899		}
900		assignment := domain.RoleAssignment{
901			ID:        primitive.NewObjectID(),
902			PartyID:   party.ID,
903			RoleCode:  req.RoleCode,
904			OrgUnitID: req.OrgUnitID,
905			GrantedBy: &aid,
906			ValidFrom: validFrom,
907			ValidTo:   validTo,
908			Status:    domain.RoleAssignmentActive,
909			CreatedAt: now,
910		}
911		if err := s.repo.insertAssignment(ctx, assignment); err != nil {
912			return nil, err
913		}
914		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "role assignment created",
915			slog.String("assignment_id", assignment.ID.Hex()),
916			slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()),
917			slog.String("role_code", req.RoleCode),
918			slog.String("org_unit_id", req.OrgUnitID.Hex()),
919			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
920		return &assignment, nil
921	}

924	// deleted (§4.1). Revocation authority mirrors grant authority.
925	func (s *service) revokeAssignment(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, assignmentID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.RoleAssignment, error) {
926		aid, err := actorID(actor)

928			return nil, err
929		}

936				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
937				slog.String("assignment_id", assignmentID.Hex()))
938			return nil, err

942				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
943				slog.String("granter_role", actor.RoleCode),
944				slog.String("role_code", assignment.RoleCode))
945			return nil, err
946		}
947		if assignment.Status != domain.RoleAssignmentActive {
948			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "assignment revoke rejected: already revoked",
949				slog.String("assignment_id", assignmentID.Hex()))
950			return nil, httpx.Conflict("ALREADY_REVOKED", "role assignment is already revoked")
951		}
952		revoked, err := s.repo.revokeAssignment(ctx, assignmentID, aid, time.Now().UTC())
953		if err != nil {
954			return nil, err
955		}
956		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "role assignment revoked",
957			slog.String("assignment_id", assignmentID.Hex()),
958			slog.String("party_id", revoked.PartyID.Hex()),
959			slog.String("role_code", revoked.RoleCode),
960			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))

```text
1	// Package orgscope answers the RBAC question "is this resource inside the
2	// caller's organisational scope?" in O(1) DB reads. Org units denormalise
3	// their ancestor chain into Path ([]ObjectID), so scope checking is a
4	// set-membership test — no recursive tree walks on the hot path.
5	package orgscope
6	
7	import (
8		"context"
9		"errors"
10		"sync"
11		"time"
12	
13		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
14		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
15		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
16	
17		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
18		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
19		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
20	)
21	
22	const collection = "org_units"
23	
24	type cachedOrg struct {
25		org domain.OrgUnit
26		at  time.Time
27	}
28	
29	// Resolver caches org units briefly (the tree changes rarely, reads are hot).
30	type Resolver struct {
31		coll *mongo.Collection
32		ttl  time.Duration
33	
34		mu    sync.RWMutex
35		cache map[string]cachedOrg // keyed by ObjectID hex
36	}
37	
38	// NewResolver binds the resolver to the database.
39	func NewResolver(db *mongo.Database) *Resolver {
40		return &Resolver{
41			coll:  db.Collection(collection),
42			ttl:   60 * time.Second,
43			cache: make(map[string]cachedOrg),
44		}
45	}
46	
47	// Get returns an org unit by ObjectID (cached).
48	func (r *Resolver) Get(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
49		key := id.Hex()
50		r.mu.RLock()
51		c, ok := r.cache[key]
52		r.mu.RUnlock()
53		if ok && time.Since(c.at) < r.ttl {
54			org := c.org
55			return &org, nil
56		}
57	
58		var org domain.OrgUnit
59		err := r.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&org)
60		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
61			return nil, httpx.NotFound("org unit " + key)
62		}
63		if err != nil {
64			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
65		}
66	
67		r.mu.Lock()
68		r.cache[key] = cachedOrg{org: org, at: time.Now()}
69		r.mu.Unlock()
70		return &org, nil
71	}
72	
73	// GetByCode returns an org unit by its unique human-readable business code
74	// (e.g. "DCS-01842") — display/lookup use only, never for joins.
75	func (r *Resolver) GetByCode(ctx context.Context, code string) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
76		var org domain.OrgUnit
77		err := r.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "code", Value: code}}).Decode(&org)
78		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
79			return nil, httpx.NotFound("org unit with code " + code)
80		}
81		if err != nil {
82			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
83		}
84		return &org, nil
85	}
86	
87	// Invalidate drops a cached entry (call after updates).
88	func (r *Resolver) Invalidate(id primitive.ObjectID) {
89		r.mu.Lock()
90		delete(r.cache, id.Hex())
91		r.mu.Unlock()
92	}
93	
94	// InScope reports whether target sits at-or-below scope in the hierarchy:
95	// true when scope == target, or scope appears in target's ancestor Path.
96	func (r *Resolver) InScope(ctx context.Context, scopeOrgID, targetOrgID primitive.ObjectID) (bool, error) {
97		if scopeOrgID == targetOrgID {
98			return true, nil
99		}
100		target, err := r.Get(ctx, targetOrgID)
101		if err != nil {
102			return false, err
103		}
104		for _, ancestor := range target.Path {
105			if ancestor == scopeOrgID {
106				return true, nil
107			}
108		}
109		return false, nil
110	}
111	
112	// RequireInScope enforces the actor's org scope over a target org unit.
113	// SUPER_ADMIN and STATE_AUDITOR (read-wide roles rooted at the federation)
114	// pass automatically; everyone else needs ancestry. The actor carries its
115	// org unit as an ObjectID hex string (JWT claims are JSON); it is parsed here.
116	func (r *Resolver) RequireInScope(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, targetOrgID primitive.ObjectID) error {
117		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSuperAdmin || actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleStateAuditor {
118			return nil
119		}
120		if actor.OrgUnitID == "" {
121			return httpx.Forbidden("role token with org scope required")
122		}
123		scopeID, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(actor.OrgUnitID)
124		if err != nil {
125			return httpx.Forbidden("role token carries an invalid org scope")
126		}
127		ok, err := r.InScope(ctx, scopeID, targetOrgID)
128		if err != nil {
129			return err
130		}
131		if !ok {
132			return httpx.Forbidden("resource is outside your organisational scope")
133		}
134		return nil
135	}
136

1	package httpx

3	import (

5	
6		"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
7		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
8	)

10	// ParseID converts an ObjectID hex string (from JSON bodies, query params or
11	// JWT claims) into a primitive.ObjectID, or returns a 400 with the offending
12	// field name.
13	func ParseID(hex, field string) (primitive.ObjectID, error) {
14		id, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(hex)
15		if err != nil {
16			return primitive.NilObjectID, BadRequest("INVALID_ID", field+" must be a valid object id")
17		}
18		return id, nil
19	}
20	
21	// PathID extracts a chi URL parameter and parses it as an ObjectID.
22	func PathID(r *http.Request, param string) (primitive.ObjectID, error) {
23		return ParseID(chi.URLParam(r, param), param)
24	}

31	// newService wires the service to the platform container, the repository and
32	// the module-scoped logger.
33	func newService(d *deps.Deps, repo *repository, log *slog.Logger) *service {
34		return &service{d: d, repo: repo, log: log}
35	}

37	// actorID parses the actor's party identity once per service call — JWT
38	// claims carry ObjectIDs as hex strings (JWTs are JSON).
39	func actorID(actor auth.Actor) (primitive.ObjectID, error) {
40		return httpx.ParseID(actor.PartyID, "actor")
41	}
42	
43	// logFailure routes a failed operation to the right log level — WARN for
44	// business rejections (4xx AppErrors: scope denials, conflicts, gate blocks),
45	// ERROR for unexpected failures — and returns err unchanged.
46	func (s *service) logFailure(ctx context.Context, op string, err error, attrs ...any) error {
47		args := append(attrs, slog.Any("err", err))
48		var appErr *httpx.AppError
49		if errors.As(err, &appErr) && appErr.Status < http.StatusInternalServerError {
50			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, op+" rejected", args...)
51		} else {
52			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, op+" failed", args...)
53		}
54		return err
55	}

57	// validHealthEventTypes is the closed set of loggable event types — the
58	// domain constants aligned with Bharat Pashudhan transaction types (§9).
59	var validHealthEventTypes = map[string]struct{}{
60		domain.HealthEventVaccination:   {},
61		domain.HealthEventTreatment:     {},
62		domain.HealthEventAI:            {},
63		domain.HealthEventDiseaseReport: {},
64		domain.HealthEventCalving:       {},
65		domain.HealthEventMilkRecording: {},
66		domain.HealthEventEPrescription: {},
67	}
68	
69	// validMVUStatuses is the closed set of MVU case statuses (filter validation).
70	var validMVUStatuses = map[string]struct{}{
71		domain.MVUCaseRequested:  {},
72		domain.MVUCaseDispatched: {},
73		domain.MVUCaseArrived:    {},
74		domain.MVUCaseClosed:     {},
75		domain.MVUCaseCancelled:  {},
76	}

78	// validatePashuAadhaar enforces the national ear-tag format: exactly 12
79	// ASCII digits (§9). Pure function — unit tested.
80	func validatePashuAadhaar(id string) *httpx.AppError {
81		if len(id) != 12 {
82			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_PASHU_AADHAAR", "pashu_aadhaar must be exactly 12 digits")
83		}
84		for i := 0; i < len(id); i++ {
85			if id[i] < '0' || id[i] > '9' {
86				return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_PASHU_AADHAAR", "pashu_aadhaar must contain digits only")
87			}
88		}
89		return nil
90	}
91	
92	// resolveAnimalOwner decides who the registered animal belongs to. A FARMER
93	// may only register their own animals (any explicit owner_party_id must match
94	// the caller); every other registrar role must name the owner explicitly.
95	// actorID is the caller's parsed party ObjectID. Pure function — unit tested.
96	func resolveAnimalOwner(actor auth.Actor, actorID primitive.ObjectID, requestedOwner *primitive.ObjectID) (primitive.ObjectID, *httpx.AppError) {
97		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleFarmer {
98			if requestedOwner != nil && !requestedOwner.IsZero() && *requestedOwner != actorID {
99				return primitive.NilObjectID, httpx.Forbidden("farmers may only register their own animals")
100			}
101			return actorID, nil
102		}
103		if requestedOwner == nil || requestedOwner.IsZero() {
104			return primitive.NilObjectID, httpx.BadRequest("OWNER_REQUIRED", "owner_party_id is required when registering on a farmer's behalf")
105		}
106		return *requestedOwner, nil
107	}
108	
109	// canViewAnimal enforces v1 read access: the owner FARMER, or one of the
110	// care-circle roles already gated at the route (VETERINARIAN, AI_TECH,
111	// MISSION_OFFICIAL). actorID is the caller's parsed party ObjectID.
112	//
113	// TODO(consent): v2 must additionally verify a DPDP consent artefact from the
114	// owner (consents collection, blueprint §18-A) before a non-owner role reads
115	// an animal or its health history. v1 deliberately ships the role check only.
116	func canViewAnimal(actor auth.Actor, actorID primitive.ObjectID, animal *domain.Animal) *httpx.AppError {
117		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleFarmer && animal.OwnerPartyID != actorID {
118			return httpx.Forbidden("farmers may only view their own animals")
119		}
120		return nil
121	}
122	
123	// appendLedger records a provenance event best-effort. The primary document
124	// is already committed when this runs, so a ledger hiccup is logged for
125	// reconciliation rather than turned into a request failure the client would
126	// retry into a duplicate.
127	func (s *service) appendLedger(ctx context.Context, in provenance.AppendInput) {
128		if _, err := s.d.Ledger.Append(ctx, in); err != nil {
129			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "provenance append failed",
130				slog.String("type", in.Type),
131				slog.String("entity_id", in.EntityID),
132				slog.Any("err", err),
133			)
134		}
135	}

137	// RegisterAnimal creates an animal record keyed on Pashu Aadhaar (§9) and
138	// appends the animal.registered provenance event.
139	func (s *service) RegisterAnimal(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req RegisterAnimalRequest) (*domain.Animal, error) {
140		callerID, err := actorID(actor)
141		if err != nil {
142			return nil, err
143		}
144		if aerr := validatePashuAadhaar(req.PashuAadhaar); aerr != nil {
145			return nil, aerr
146		}
147		if req.DCSID.IsZero() {
148			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("DCS_REQUIRED", "dcs_id is required")
149		}
150		if req.Species == "" {
151			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("SPECIES_REQUIRED", "species is required")
152		}
153		owner, aerr := resolveAnimalOwner(actor, callerID, req.OwnerPartyID)
154		if aerr != nil {
155			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "animal registration rejected",
156				slog.String("reason", aerr.Code),
157				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
158				slog.String("actor_role", actor.RoleCode))
159			return nil, aerr
160		}
161		// Farmers register into their own village context; every other registrar
162		// must hold scope over the target DCS.
163		if actor.RoleCode != domain.RoleFarmer {
164			if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.DCSID); err != nil {
165				return nil, s.logFailure(ctx, "register animal scope check", err,
166					slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
167					slog.String("dcs_id", req.DCSID.Hex()))
168			}
169		}
170	
171		now := time.Now().UTC()
172		animal := &domain.Animal{
173			// Pre-generated so the insert and the ledger ref share one ID.
174			ID:              primitive.NewObjectID(),
175			PashuAadhaar:    req.PashuAadhaar,
176			OwnerPartyID:    owner,
177			DCSID:           req.DCSID,
178			Species:         req.Species,
179			Breed:           req.Breed,
180			Sex:             req.Sex,
181			LactationStatus: req.LactationStatus,
182			CollarEnabled:   false, // dormant until a collar scheme flips flags.FlagCollarTelemetry (§9)
183			Status:          domain.AnimalStatusActive,
184			CreatedAt:       now,
185			UpdatedAt:       now,
186		}
187		if err := s.repo.InsertAnimal(ctx, animal); err != nil {
188			return nil, s.logFailure(ctx, "insert animal", err,
189				slog.String("pashu_aadhaar", req.PashuAadhaar),
190				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
191		}
192	
193		s.appendLedger(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
194			Type:       domain.EventAnimalRegistered,
195			EntityType: domain.EntityAnimal,
196			EntityID:   animal.ID.Hex(),
197			Refs: []provenance.Ref{
198				{EntityType: domain.EntityParty, EntityID: owner.Hex(), Relation: "owned_by"},
199			},
200			Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
201			OrgUnitID: animal.DCSID.Hex(),
202			Payload: map[string]any{
203				"pashu_aadhaar": animal.PashuAadhaar,
204				"species":       animal.Species,
205			},
206		})
207		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "animal registered",
208			slog.String("animal_id", animal.ID.Hex()),
209			slog.String("pashu_aadhaar", animal.PashuAadhaar),
210			slog.String("owner_party_id", owner.Hex()),
211			slog.String("dcs_id", animal.DCSID.Hex()),
212			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
213		return animal, nil
214	}
215	
216	// ListAnimals returns a page of animals. Farmers — and plain session tokens,
217	// which carry no role scope at all — are pinned to their own herd. Every
218	// other role (except the federation-wide read roles) must name a DCS inside
219	// its organisational scope, so a narrowly-scoped or consumer role can never
220	// enumerate the national animal registry.
221	func (s *service) ListAnimals(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, ownerPartyID, dcsID primitive.ObjectID, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.Animal, int64, error) {
222		switch {
223		case actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleFarmer || actor.Kind == auth.TokenKindSession:
224			callerID, err := actorID(actor)
225			if err != nil {
226				return nil, 0, err
227			}
228			ownerPartyID = callerID
229		case actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSuperAdmin || actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleStateAuditor:
230			// federation-wide read roles may filter freely
231		default:
232			if dcsID.IsZero() {
233				return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("DCS_REQUIRED", "dcs_id is required for your role")
234			}
235			if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, dcsID); err != nil {
236				return nil, 0, s.logFailure(ctx, "list animals scope check", err,
237					slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
238					slog.String("dcs_id", dcsID.Hex()))
239			}
240		}
241		animals, total, err := s.repo.ListAnimals(ctx, ownerPartyID, dcsID, page)
242		if err != nil {
243			return nil, 0, s.logFailure(ctx, "list animals", err)
244		}
245		return animals, total, nil
246	}
247	
248	// requireAnimalReadAccess applies the animal read rule: the owner FARMER, or
249	// a care-circle role whose org scope covers the animal's DCS — a vet from one
250	// union must not read animal health PII across the federation.
251	func (s *service) requireAnimalReadAccess(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, animal *domain.Animal) error {
252		callerID, err := actorID(actor)
253		if err != nil {
254			return err
255		}
256		if aerr := canViewAnimal(actor, callerID, animal); aerr != nil {
257			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "animal read denied",
258				slog.String("animal_id", animal.ID.Hex()),
259				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
260			return aerr
261		}
262		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleFarmer {
263			return nil // owner (canViewAnimal already pinned ownership)
264		}
265		if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, animal.DCSID); err != nil {
266			return s.logFailure(ctx, "animal read scope check", err,
267				slog.String("animal_id", animal.ID.Hex()),
268				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
269		}
270		return nil
271	}

273	// GetAnimal returns one animal after the v1 access check (owner farmer, or a
274	// care-circle role within org scope; DPDP consent gating remains a v2 TODO).
275	func (s *service) GetAnimal(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, animalID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.Animal, error) {
276		animal, err := s.repo.FindAnimalByID(ctx, animalID)
277		if err != nil {
278			return nil, err
279		}
280		if err := s.requireAnimalReadAccess(ctx, actor, animal); err != nil {
281			return nil, err
282		}
283		return animal, nil
284	}

286	// ListHealthEvents returns a page of an animal's health history under the
287	// same access rule as GetAnimal.
288	func (s *service) ListHealthEvents(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, animalID primitive.ObjectID, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.HealthEvent, int64, error) {
289		animal, err := s.repo.FindAnimalByID(ctx, animalID)
290		if err != nil {
291			return nil, 0, err
292		}
293		if err := s.requireAnimalReadAccess(ctx, actor, animal); err != nil {
294			return nil, 0, err
295		}
296		events, total, err := s.repo.ListHealthEventsByAnimal(ctx, animal.ID, page)
297		if err != nil {
298			return nil, 0, s.logFailure(ctx, "list health events", err,
299				slog.String("animal_id", animal.ID.Hex()))
300		}
301		return events, total, nil
302	}

304	// LogHealthEvent records one health-history entry with bp_sync_status PENDING
305	// and appends the health.event_logged provenance event.
306	func (s *service) LogHealthEvent(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, animalID primitive.ObjectID, req LogHealthEventRequest) (*domain.HealthEvent, error) {
307		callerID, err := actorID(actor)
308		if err != nil {
309			return nil, err
310		}
311		if _, ok := validHealthEventTypes[req.Type]; !ok {
312			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_HEALTH_EVENT_TYPE", "type must be one of the catalog health event types")
313		}
314		animal, err := s.repo.FindAnimalByID(ctx, animalID)
315		if err != nil {
316			return nil, err
317		}
318		if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, animal.DCSID); err != nil {
319			return nil, s.logFailure(ctx, "log health event scope check", err,
320				slog.String("animal_id", animal.ID.Hex()),
321				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
322		}
323	
324		now := time.Now().UTC()
325		occurredAt := now
326		if req.OccurredAt != nil {
327			occurredAt = req.OccurredAt.UTC()
328		}
329		event := &domain.HealthEvent{
330			// Pre-generated so the insert and the ledger payload share one ID.
331			ID:              primitive.NewObjectID(),
332			AnimalID:        animal.ID,
333			PashuAadhaar:    animal.PashuAadhaar,
334			Type:            req.Type,
335			Details:         req.Details,
336			RecordedByParty: callerID,
337			RecordedByRole:  actor.RoleCode,
338			OccurredAt:      occurredAt,
339			BharatPashudhan: domain.BPSyncPending, // pushed later via /bp-sync
340			CreatedAt:       now,
341		}
342		if err := s.repo.InsertHealthEvent(ctx, event); err != nil {
343			return nil, s.logFailure(ctx, "insert health event", err,
344				slog.String("animal_id", animal.ID.Hex()))
345		}
346	
347		// The ledger event lands on the animal's timeline (there is no dedicated
348		// health-event entity type); the ref pins the animal it was recorded for.
349		s.appendLedger(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
350			Type:       domain.EventHealthEventLogged,
351			EntityType: domain.EntityAnimal,
352			EntityID:   animal.ID.Hex(),
353			Refs: []provenance.Ref{
354				{EntityType: domain.EntityAnimal, EntityID: animal.ID.Hex(), Relation: "recorded_for"},
355			},
356			Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
357			OrgUnitID: animal.DCSID.Hex(),
358			Payload: map[string]any{
359				"health_event_id": event.ID.Hex(),
360				"type":            event.Type,
361			},
362		})
363		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "health event logged",
364			slog.String("health_event_id", event.ID.Hex()),
365			slog.String("animal_id", animal.ID.Hex()),
366			slog.String("type", event.Type),
367			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
368		return event, nil
369	}

371	// SyncBharatPashudhan is the MOCK national-DB push (§9): it marks every
372	// PENDING health event of the animal SYNCED under a mock reference. The real
373	// integration replaces this method body — API and data shapes stay put.
374	func (s *service) SyncBharatPashudhan(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, animalID primitive.ObjectID) (*BPSyncResponse, error) {
375		animal, err := s.repo.FindAnimalByID(ctx, animalID)
376		if err != nil {
377			return nil, err
378		}
379		if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, animal.DCSID); err != nil {
380			return nil, s.logFailure(ctx, "bp sync scope check", err,
381				slog.String("animal_id", animal.ID.Hex()),
382				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
383		}
384		ref := "BP-MOCK-" + uuid.NewString()[:8]
385		count, err := s.repo.MarkPendingHealthEventsSynced(ctx, animal.ID, ref)
386		if err != nil {
387			return nil, s.logFailure(ctx, "mark health events synced", err,
388				slog.String("animal_id", animal.ID.Hex()))
389		}
390		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "bharat pashudhan sync completed",
391			slog.String("animal_id", animal.ID.Hex()),
392			slog.Int64("synced_count", count),
393			slog.String("bp_sync_ref", ref),
394			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
395		return &BPSyncResponse{SyncedCount: count, BPSyncRef: ref}, nil
396	}

398	// CreateMVUCase opens a 1962 MVU request (§10). The DCS comes from the
399	// farmer's own animal when animal_id is given, else from the actor's org.
400	func (s *service) CreateMVUCase(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateMVUCaseRequest) (*domain.MVUCase, error) {
401		farmerID, err := actorID(actor)
402		if err != nil {
403			return nil, err
404		}
405		if strings.TrimSpace(req.Symptoms) == "" {
406			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("SYMPTOMS_REQUIRED", "symptoms description is required")
407		}
408	
409		var dcsID primitive.ObjectID
410		if actor.OrgUnitID != "" {
411			dcsID, err = httpx.ParseID(actor.OrgUnitID, "org_unit")
412			if err != nil {
413				return nil, err
414			}
415		}
416		var caseAnimalID *primitive.ObjectID
417		if req.AnimalID != nil && !req.AnimalID.IsZero() {
418			animal, err := s.repo.FindAnimalByID(ctx, *req.AnimalID)
419			if err != nil {
420				return nil, err
421			}
422			if animal.OwnerPartyID != farmerID {
423				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "mvu case rejected: animal not owned by caller",
424					slog.String("animal_id", animal.ID.Hex()),
425					slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
426				return nil, httpx.Forbidden("you may only raise an MVU case for your own animal")
427			}
428			id := animal.ID
429			caseAnimalID = &id
430			dcsID = animal.DCSID
431		}
432		if dcsID.IsZero() {
433			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("DCS_UNRESOLVED", "cannot resolve a DCS for this case — provide animal_id or use a DCS-scoped role token")
434		}
435	
436		mvuCase := &domain.MVUCase{
437			// Pre-generated so downstream logging/refs share one ID.
438			ID:            primitive.NewObjectID(),
439			AnimalID:      caseAnimalID,
440			FarmerPartyID: farmerID,
441			DCSID:         dcsID,
442			Symptoms:      strings.TrimSpace(req.Symptoms),
443			Status:        domain.MVUCaseRequested,
444			RequestedAt:   time.Now().UTC(),
445		}
446		if err := s.repo.InsertMVUCase(ctx, mvuCase); err != nil {
447			return nil, s.logFailure(ctx, "insert mvu case", err,
448				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
449		}
450		animalHex := ""
451		if mvuCase.AnimalID != nil {
452			animalHex = mvuCase.AnimalID.Hex()
453		}
454		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "mvu case created",
455			slog.String("case_id", mvuCase.ID.Hex()),
456			slog.String("farmer_party_id", mvuCase.FarmerPartyID.Hex()),
457			slog.String("dcs_id", mvuCase.DCSID.Hex()),
458			slog.String("animal_id", animalHex),
459			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
460		return mvuCase, nil
461	}
462	
463	// DispatchMVUCase moves a case REQUESTED → DISPATCHED, records the assignee
464	// from the caller's role, and publishes eventbus.TopicMVUDispatched with an
465	// explicit payload contract — keys: case_id, farmer_party_id, animal_id,
466	// dcs_id, values ObjectID hex strings (the notifications module reacts, §10).
467	func (s *service) DispatchMVUCase(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, caseID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.MVUCase, error) {
468		callerID, err := actorID(actor)
469		if err != nil {
470			return nil, err
471		}
472		mvuCase, err := s.repo.FindMVUCaseByID(ctx, caseID)
473		if err != nil {
474			return nil, err
475		}
476		if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, mvuCase.DCSID); err != nil {
477			return nil, s.logFailure(ctx, "dispatch mvu case scope check", err,
478				slog.String("case_id", mvuCase.ID.Hex()),
479				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
480		}
481	
482		var vetPartyID, driverPartyID *primitive.ObjectID
483		switch actor.RoleCode {
484		case domain.RoleVeterinarian:
485			vetPartyID = &callerID
486		case domain.RoleMVUDriver:
487			driverPartyID = &callerID
488			// Any other role reaching here is break-glass SUPER_ADMIN: the case
489			// is dispatched without pinning an assignee.
490		}
491	
492		transitioned, err := s.repo.DispatchMVUCase(ctx, mvuCase.ID, vetPartyID, driverPartyID)
493		if err != nil {
494			return nil, s.logFailure(ctx, "dispatch mvu case", err,
495				slog.String("case_id", mvuCase.ID.Hex()))
496		}
497		if !transitioned {
498			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "mvu dispatch rejected: case not in REQUESTED state",
499				slog.String("case_id", mvuCase.ID.Hex()),
500				slog.String("status", mvuCase.Status),
501				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
502			return nil, httpx.Conflict("MVU_NOT_REQUESTED", "MVU case is not in REQUESTED state")
503		}
504	
505		updated, err := s.repo.FindMVUCaseByID(ctx, mvuCase.ID)
506		if err != nil {
507			return nil, s.logFailure(ctx, "reload mvu case", err,
508				slog.String("case_id", mvuCase.ID.Hex()))
509		}
510		// Explicit event shape: the subscriber decodes structurally by JSON key,
511		// so the case ID must travel under "case_id" — publishing the raw domain
512		// document (whose ID marshals as "id") left the farmer SMS caseless.
513		// Values are ObjectID hex strings; a caseless animal travels as "".
514		animalHex := ""
515		if updated.AnimalID != nil {
516			animalHex = updated.AnimalID.Hex()
517		}
518		s.d.Bus.Publish(eventbus.TopicMVUDispatched, map[string]any{
519			"case_id":         updated.ID.Hex(),
520			"farmer_party_id": updated.FarmerPartyID.Hex(),
521			"animal_id":       animalHex,
522			"dcs_id":          updated.DCSID.Hex(),
523		})
524		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "mvu case dispatched",
525			slog.String("case_id", updated.ID.Hex()),
526			slog.String("farmer_party_id", updated.FarmerPartyID.Hex()),
527			slog.String("dcs_id", updated.DCSID.Hex()),
528			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
529			slog.String("actor_role", actor.RoleCode))
530		return updated, nil
531	}
532	
533	// CloseMVUCase moves a DISPATCHED/ARRIVED case to CLOSED with the visit log.
534	func (s *service) CloseMVUCase(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, caseID primitive.ObjectID, req CloseMVUCaseRequest) (*domain.MVUCase, error) {
535		if strings.TrimSpace(req.VisitNotes) == "" {
536			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VISIT_NOTES_REQUIRED", "visit_notes is required to close a case")
537		}
538		mvuCase, err := s.repo.FindMVUCaseByID(ctx, caseID)
539		if err != nil {
540			return nil, err
541		}
542		if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, mvuCase.DCSID); err != nil {
543			return nil, s.logFailure(ctx, "close mvu case scope check", err,
544				slog.String("case_id", mvuCase.ID.Hex()),
545				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
546		}
547	
548		transitioned, err := s.repo.CloseMVUCase(ctx, mvuCase.ID, strings.TrimSpace(req.VisitNotes), req.HealthEventIDs, time.Now().UTC())
549		if err != nil {
550			return nil, s.logFailure(ctx, "close mvu case", err,
551				slog.String("case_id", mvuCase.ID.Hex()))
552		}
553		if !transitioned {
554			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "mvu close rejected: case not DISPATCHED or ARRIVED",
555				slog.String("case_id", mvuCase.ID.Hex()),
556				slog.String("status", mvuCase.Status),
557				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
558			return nil, httpx.Conflict("MVU_NOT_OPEN", "MVU case must be DISPATCHED or ARRIVED to close")
559		}
560		closed, err := s.repo.FindMVUCaseByID(ctx, mvuCase.ID)
561		if err != nil {
562			return nil, s.logFailure(ctx, "reload mvu case", err,
563				slog.String("case_id", mvuCase.ID.Hex()))
564		}
565		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "mvu case closed",
566			slog.String("case_id", closed.ID.Hex()),
567			slog.String("farmer_party_id", closed.FarmerPartyID.Hex()),
568			slog.Int("health_event_count", len(req.HealthEventIDs)),
569			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
570		return closed, nil
571	}

574	// is scope-checked against the caller's org.
575	func (s *service) ListMVUCases(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, dcsID primitive.ObjectID, status string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.MVUCase, int64, error) {
576		if status != "" {
577			if _, ok := validMVUStatuses[status]; !ok {
578				return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_MVU_STATUS", "status must be one of REQUESTED, DISPATCHED, ARRIVED, CLOSED, CANCELLED")
579			}
580		}
581		if !dcsID.IsZero() {
582			if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, dcsID); err != nil {
583				return nil, 0, s.logFailure(ctx, "list mvu cases scope check", err,
584					slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
585					slog.String("dcs_id", dcsID.Hex()))
586			}
587		}
588		cases, total, err := s.repo.ListMVUCases(ctx, dcsID, status, page)
589		if err != nil {
590			return nil, 0, s.logFailure(ctx, "list mvu cases", err)
591		}
592		return cases, total, nil
593	}

595	// ListEducation returns a page of PUBLISHED education-hub content (§10).
596	func (s *service) ListEducation(ctx context.Context, topic, language string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.EducationContent, int64, error) {
597		items, total, err := s.repo.ListPublishedEducation(ctx, topic, language, page)
598		if err != nil {

600		}

604	// CreateEducation adds an item to the education hub. Published defaults to
605	// true: v1 has no separate publish step, so unpublished items would be
606	// unreachable.
607	func (s *service) CreateEducation(ctx context.Context, req CreateEducationRequest) (*domain.EducationContent, error) {
608		if req.Topic == "" || req.Title == "" || req.Language == "" || req.MediaType == "" || req.MediaURL == "" {
609			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("EDUCATION_FIELDS_REQUIRED", "topic, title, language, media_type and media_url are required")
610		}
611		published := true
612		if req.Published != nil {
613			published = *req.Published
614		}
615		content := &domain.EducationContent{
616			ID:          primitive.NewObjectID(),
617			Topic:       req.Topic,
618			Title:       req.Title,
619			Language:    req.Language,
620			MediaType:   req.MediaType,
621			MediaURL:    req.MediaURL,
622			DurationSec: req.DurationSec,
623			Published:   published,
624			CreatedAt:   time.Now().UTC(),
625		}
626		if err := s.repo.InsertEducation(ctx, content); err != nil {
627			return nil, s.logFailure(ctx, "insert education content", err,
628				slog.String("topic", req.Topic))
629		}
630		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "education content created",
631			slog.String("content_id", content.ID.Hex()),
632			slog.String("topic", content.Topic),
633			slog.String("language", content.Language),
634			slog.Bool("published", content.Published))
635		return content, nil
636	}

638	// IngestTelemetry is the dormant collar path (§9). The capability gate runs
639	// FIRST: while flags.FlagCollarTelemetry is off the endpoint refuses with
640	// FEATURE_DISABLED, proving the backdoor is provisioned but inert. When the
641	// scheme lands and the flag flips, frames are acknowledged with 202 — the
642	// storage pipeline ships with the scheme, not before.
643	func (s *service) IngestTelemetry(ctx context.Context, req TelemetryRequest) (*TelemetryAck, error) {
644		if !s.d.Flags.Enabled(ctx, flags.FlagCollarTelemetry) {
645			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "collar telemetry rejected: feature gate disabled",
646				slog.String("flag", flags.FlagCollarTelemetry),
647				slog.String("pashu_aadhaar", req.PashuAadhaar))
648			aerr := httpx.Forbidden("collar telemetry is provisioned but dormant (§9)")
649			aerr.Code = "FEATURE_DISABLED"
650			return nil, aerr
651		}
652		if err := validatePashuAadhaar(req.PashuAadhaar); err != nil {
653			return nil, err
654		}
655		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "telemetry frame accepted",
656			slog.String("pashu_aadhaar", req.PashuAadhaar))
657		return &TelemetryAck{
658			Accepted:     true,
659			PashuAadhaar: req.PashuAadhaar,
660			Note:         "telemetry accepted; persistent storage lands with the collar scheme",
661		}, nil
662	}

23	// Register wires the platformops module and mounts /admin, /audit,
24	// /notifications and /support (the router hands us the /api/v1 subtree).
25	func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
26		log := d.Log.With(slog.String("module", "platformops"))
27		repo := newRepository(d.DB)
28		svc := newService(d, repo, log)
29		h := newHandler(svc)
30	
31		r.Route("/admin", func(r chi.Router) {
32			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
33	
34			// PCDF_ADMIN may LIST flags; flipping one is SUPER_ADMIN only —
35			// capability gating is a deliberate act (blueprint principle #6).
36			r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSuperAdmin, domain.RolePCDFAdmin)).
37				Get("/flags", h.listFlags)
38			r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSuperAdmin)).
39				Put("/flags/{key}", h.setFlag)
40		})
41	
42		r.Route("/audit", func(r chi.Router) {
43			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
44			r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleStateAuditor, domain.RoleSuperAdmin))
45	
46			// Read-only by design: there is deliberately NO write/delete API
47			// surface for audit logs (§12) — entries land via deps.Audit only.
48			r.Get("/logs", h.listAuditLogs)
49			r.Get("/logs/export", h.exportAuditLogs)
50		})
51	
52		r.Route("/notifications", func(r chi.Router) {
53			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
54	
55			// SUPER_ADMIN only: a help-desk role has no need to read outbox
56			// message bodies, and the outbox carries credential-adjacent traffic
57			// (OTP notifications — additionally redacted in the service).
58			r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSuperAdmin)).
59				Get("/", h.listNotifications)
60			r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSuperAdmin)).
61				Post("/worker/run", h.runWorker)
62		})
63	
64		r.Route("/support", func(r chi.Router) {
65			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
66			r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSupportAgent, domain.RoleSuperAdmin))
67	
68			r.Get("/parties/lookup", h.lookupParty)
69		})
70	
71		// Cross-module reactions arrive over the bus (modules never import each
72		// other). The bus already runs each handler on its own goroutine with a
73		// bounded context and panic recovery; the wrapper below adds an explicit
74		// second belt at this module's boundary.
75		d.Bus.Subscribe(eventbus.TopicPayoutCredited, safeHandler(log, svc.onPayoutCredited))
76		d.Bus.Subscribe(eventbus.TopicGateBlocked, safeHandler(log, svc.onGateBlocked))
77		d.Bus.Subscribe(eventbus.TopicMVUDispatched, safeHandler(log, svc.onMVUDispatched))
78	}
79	
80	// safeHandler wraps a bus reaction so a programming error in notification
81	// fan-out can never disturb the publishing flow.
82	func safeHandler(log *slog.Logger, reaction func(ctx context.Context, payload any)) eventbus.Handler {
83		return func(ctx context.Context, topic string, payload any) {
84			defer func() {
85				if rec := recover(); rec != nil {
86					log.Error("platformops bus handler panic",
87						slog.String("topic", topic), slog.Any("panic", rec))
88				}
89			}()
90			reaction(ctx, payload)
91		}
92	}

166	// parseTimeParam accepts RFC3339 or plain YYYY-MM-DD (empty → nil). Date-only
167	// values mean UTC midnight; with endOfDay they cover the whole day, so
168	// ?to=2026-07-06 is inclusive of the 6th.
169	func parseTimeParam(value string, endOfDay bool) (*time.Time, error) {
170		if value == "" {
171			return nil, nil
172		}
173		if t, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, value); err == nil {
174			t = t.UTC()
175			return &t, nil
176		}
177		t, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", value)
178		if err != nil {
179			return nil, err
180		}
181		if endOfDay {
182			t = t.Add(24*time.Hour - time.Nanosecond)
183		}
184		t = t.UTC()
185		return &t, nil
186	}

437	// appendPoursToInvoice merges late pours into a still-ISSUED invoice: the
438	// status guard in the filter makes the merge atomic against a concurrent
439	// settlement claim. Returns false when the invoice already left ISSUED.
440	func (r *repo) appendPoursToInvoice(ctx context.Context, invoiceID primitive.ObjectID, pourIDs []primitive.ObjectID, addQty, addAmount float64) (bool, error) {
441		res, err := r.invoices.UpdateOne(ctx,
442			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: invoiceID}, {Key: "status", Value: domain.InvoiceStatusIssued}},
443			bson.D{
444				{Key: "$push", Value: bson.D{{Key: "pour_ids", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$each", Value: pourIDs}}}}},
445				{Key: "$inc", Value: bson.D{
446					{Key: "total_quantity_litres", Value: addQty},
447					{Key: "total_amount", Value: addAmount},
448				}},
449			},
450		)
451		if err != nil {
452			return false, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("append pours to invoice: %w", err))
453		}
454		return res.MatchedCount == 1, nil
455	}

492	// invoice counter (findOneAndUpdate upsert — safe without transactions).
493	// Counter keys are internal strings ("invoice:"+dcsCode+":"+date).
494	func (r *repo) nextInvoiceSeq(ctx context.Context, key string) (int, error) {
495		var doc struct {
496			Seq int `bson:"seq"`
497		}
498		err := r.counters.FindOneAndUpdate(ctx,
499			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: key}},
500			bson.D{{Key: "$inc", Value: bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}}},
501			options.FindOneAndUpdate().SetUpsert(true).SetReturnDocument(options.After),
502		).Decode(&doc)
503		if err != nil {
504			return 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("next invoice seq: %w", err))
505		}
506		return doc.Seq, nil

29	func newRepo(db *mongo.Database) *repo {
30		return &repo{
31			consignments: db.Collection(mongodb.CollConsignments),
32			trips:        db.Collection(mongodb.CollRouteTrips),
33			pours:        db.Collection(mongodb.CollMilkPours),
34		}
35	}

37	// pourRow is the projected slice of a milk pour needed for aggregation.
38	type pourRow struct {
39		ID             primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id"`
40		QuantityLitres float64            `bson:"quantity_litres"`
41		FatPct         float64            `bson:"fat_pct"`
42		SNFPct         float64            `bson:"snf_pct"`
43	}
44	
45	// findRecordedPours returns the RECORDED pours of one DCS date+shift,
46	// projected down to the fields the consignment aggregate needs.
47	func (r *repo) findRecordedPours(ctx context.Context, dcsID primitive.ObjectID, date, shift string) ([]pourRow, error) {
48		filter := bson.D{
49			{Key: "dcs_id", Value: dcsID},
50			{Key: "pour_date", Value: date},
51			{Key: "shift", Value: shift},
52			{Key: "status", Value: domain.PourStatusRecorded},
53		}
54		projection := bson.D{
55			{Key: "_id", Value: 1},
56			{Key: "quantity_litres", Value: 1},
57			{Key: "fat_pct", Value: 1},
58			{Key: "snf_pct", Value: 1},
59		}
60		cur, err := r.pours.Find(ctx, filter,
61			options.Find().SetProjection(projection).SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "created_at", Value: 1}}))
62		if err != nil {
63			return nil, fmt.Errorf("find recorded pours: %w", err)
64		}
65		var rows []pourRow
66		if err := cur.All(ctx, &rows); err != nil {
67			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode recorded pours: %w", err)
68		}
69		return rows, nil
70	}
71	
72	// insertConsignment stores a new consignment (the service pre-generates its
73	// ObjectID). The unique index on dcs_id+date+shift turns duplicates into a
74	// duplicate-key error — kept unwrapped-detectable via %w.
75	func (r *repo) insertConsignment(ctx context.Context, c *domain.DCSConsignment) error {
76		if _, err := r.consignments.InsertOne(ctx, c); err != nil {
77			return fmt.Errorf("insert consignment: %w", err)
78		}
79		return nil
80	}
81	
82	// findConsignmentByID loads one consignment.
83	func (r *repo) findConsignmentByID(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.DCSConsignment, error) {
84		var c domain.DCSConsignment
85		if err := r.consignments.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&c); err != nil {
86			return nil, fmt.Errorf("find consignment %s: %w", id.Hex(), err)
87		}
88		return &c, nil
89	}

91	// markConsignmentDispatched transitions OPEN→DISPATCHED optimistically:
92	// the status filter makes the guard atomic without transactions. The seal
93	// also re-stamps the pour aggregates (extraSet) so pours recorded between
94	// creation and dispatch are never lost from the consignment's totals.
95	func (r *repo) markConsignmentDispatched(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID, at time.Time, extraSet bson.D) (bool, error) {
96		set := bson.D{
97			{Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusDispatch},
98			{Key: "dispatched_at", Value: at},
99		}
100		set = append(set, extraSet...)
101		res, err := r.consignments.UpdateOne(ctx,
102			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}, {Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusOpen}},
103			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: set}})
104		if err != nil {
105			return false, fmt.Errorf("mark consignment dispatched: %w", err)
106		}
107		return res.MatchedCount > 0, nil
108	}
109	
110	// markConsignmentPickedUp transitions DISPATCHED→PICKED_UP and pins the
111	// carrying trip, guarded atomically by the status filter.
112	func (r *repo) markConsignmentPickedUp(ctx context.Context, id, tripID primitive.ObjectID) (bool, error) {
113		res, err := r.consignments.UpdateOne(ctx,
114			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}, {Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusDispatch}},
115			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
116				{Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusPickedUp},
117				{Key: "route_trip_id", Value: tripID},
118			}}})
119		if err != nil {
120			return false, fmt.Errorf("mark consignment picked up: %w", err)
121		}
122		return res.MatchedCount > 0, nil
123	}

126	// to DELIVERED (bulk companion of the trip delivery).
127	func (r *repo) markConsignmentsDelivered(ctx context.Context, ids []primitive.ObjectID) error {
128		_, err := r.consignments.UpdateMany(ctx,

131				{Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusPickedUp},
132			},
133			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusDelivered}}}})
134		if err != nil {

152	func (r *repo) listConsignments(ctx context.Context, dcsID primitive.ObjectID, date, status string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.DCSConsignment, int64, error) {
153		filter := bson.D{}

155			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "dcs_id", Value: dcsID})

159		}
160		if status != "" {
161			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "status", Value: status})

164		if err != nil {

168			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "created_at", Value: -1}}).
169			SetSkip(page.Offset).SetLimit(page.Limit))
170		if err != nil {
171			return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("list consignments: %w", err)
172		}
173		items := []domain.DCSConsignment{}
174		if err := cur.All(ctx, &items); err != nil {
175			return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("decode consignments: %w", err)
176		}
177		return items, total, nil

71	// claimInvoices atomically flips still-ISSUED invoices to SETTLEMENT_PENDING
72	// under the given batch. The status guard makes concurrent initiations safe
73	// without transactions: each invoice is claimed by exactly one batch.

161	// transitionBatch performs a status-guarded update (optimistic concurrency —
162	// no transactions on a standalone server). Returns false when the batch was
163	// not in fromStatus, i.e. another actor won the transition.
164	func (rp *repo) transitionBatch(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID, fromStatus string, set bson.D) (bool, error) {
165		res, err := rp.batches.UpdateOne(ctx,
166			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}, {Key: "status", Value: fromStatus}},
167			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: set}},
168		)
169		if err != nil {
170			return false, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("transition settlement batch: %w", err))
171		}
172		return res.MatchedCount > 0, nil
173	}
