```text
634	
635	// --- KYC approval workflow (reviewer console) ---
636	
637	// kycSubjectInScope reports whether the reviewer's org scope covers the KYC
638	// subject: true when the subject holds at least one active role assignment
639	// inside the reviewer's organisational scope (the KYC record itself carries
640	// no org, so the subject's org is resolved via their assignments — mirroring
641	// how createAssignment/revokeAssignment obtain the OrgUnitID). SUPER_ADMIN and
642	// STATE_AUDITOR are platform-wide and always cover; PCDF_ADMIN (rooted at the
643	// federation) covers naturally through RequireInScope's ancestry test.
644	func (s *service) kycSubjectInScope(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, subjectPartyID primitive.ObjectID) (bool, error) {
645		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSuperAdmin || actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleStateAuditor {
646			return true, nil
647		}
648		assignments, err := s.repo.listActiveAssignments(ctx, subjectPartyID)
649		if err != nil {
650			return false, err
651		}
652		for _, ra := range assignments {
653			if s.deps.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, ra.OrgUnitID) == nil {
654				return true, nil
655			}
656		}
657		return false, nil
658	}
659	
660	// requireKYCSubjectInScope denies the reviewer a KYC decision on a subject
661	// outside their organisational scope (a cross-org privilege escalation guard).
662	func (s *service) requireKYCSubjectInScope(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, subjectPartyID primitive.ObjectID) error {
663		inScope, err := s.kycSubjectInScope(ctx, actor, subjectPartyID)
664		if err != nil {
665			return err
666		}
667		if !inScope {
668			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "kyc review denied: subject out of scope",
669				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
670				slog.String("subject_party_id", subjectPartyID.Hex()))
671			appErr := httpx.Forbidden("KYC subject is outside your organisational scope")
672			appErr.Code = "KYC_SUBJECT_OUT_OF_SCOPE"
673			return appErr
674		}
675		return nil
676	}
677	
678	// listPendingKYC pages PENDING KYC records newest-first, constrained to
679	// subjects within the reviewer's org scope, enriched with a reviewer-facing
680	// party summary, and audits the access.
681	func (s *service) listPendingKYC(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, page httpx.Page) ([]pendingKYCItem, int64, error) {
682		records, total, err := s.repo.listPendingKYC(ctx, page)
683		if err != nil {
684			return nil, 0, err
685		}
686		ids := make([]primitive.ObjectID, 0, len(records))
687		for _, rec := range records {
688			ids = append(ids, rec.PartyID)
689		}
690		parties, err := s.repo.findPartiesByIDs(ctx, ids)
691		if err != nil {
692			return nil, 0, err
693		}
694		items := make([]pendingKYCItem, 0, len(records))
695		for _, rec := range records {
696			// Org-scope gate: a scoped reviewer only ever sees (and thus only ever
697			// gets the contact PII of) subjects within their own area.
698			inScope, err := s.kycSubjectInScope(ctx, actor, rec.PartyID)
699			if err != nil {
700				return nil, 0, err
701			}
702			if !inScope {
703				continue
704			}
705			item := pendingKYCItem{KYCRecord: rec}
706			if p, ok := parties[rec.PartyID]; ok {
707				item.Party = &pendingPartySummary{
708					ID:       p.ID,
709					Phone:    p.Phone,
710					FullName: p.FullName,
711					KYCTier:  p.KYCTier,
712				}
713			}
714			items = append(items, item)
715		}
716	
717		s.deps.Audit.Record(ctx, audit.Entry{
718			Action: "kyc.pending_list",
719			Meta:   map[string]any{"count": len(items), "total": total},
720		})
721		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "kyc pending list accessed",
722			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
723			slog.Int("count", len(items)),
724			slog.Int64("total", total))
725		return items, total, nil
726	}
727	
728	// pendingKYCScanCap bounds the scoped-count scan. The pending queue is a
729	// human-drained work-list (realistically dozens, not millions); beyond the cap
730	// the badge shows "cap+" rather than paying for an unbounded scan.
731	const pendingKYCScanCap = 1000
732	
733	// pendingKYCCount returns how many PENDING records fall within the reviewer's
734	// org scope — the live badge value. It reuses the exact scope logic of the
735	// pending list (so badge and list always agree) and dedupes the per-subject
736	// scope lookup. Returns (count, capped).
737	func (s *service) pendingKYCCount(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor) (int64, bool, error) {
738		records, _, err := s.repo.listPendingKYC(ctx, httpx.Page{Limit: pendingKYCScanCap, Offset: 0})
739		if err != nil {
740			return 0, false, err
741		}
742		scopeCache := make(map[primitive.ObjectID]bool)
743		var count int64
744		for _, rec := range records {
745			inScope, seen := scopeCache[rec.PartyID]
746			if !seen {
747				inScope, err = s.kycSubjectInScope(ctx, actor, rec.PartyID)
748				if err != nil {
749					return 0, false, err
750				}
751				scopeCache[rec.PartyID] = inScope
752			}
753			if inScope {
754				count++
755			}
756		}
757		capped := len(records) >= pendingKYCScanCap
758		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "kyc pending count",
759			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID), slog.Int64("count", count), slog.Bool("capped", capped))
760		return count, capped, nil
761	}
762	
763	// approveKYC verifies a PENDING record, upgrades the party's KYC tier upward
764	// only, notifies the party and audits the decision. The reviewer's role must
765	// be authorised for the requested tier — even SUPER_ADMIN passes through the
766	// approvable-tier map (which grants it everything).
767	func (s *service) approveKYC(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID) (*kycReviewResponse, error) {
768		now := time.Now().UTC()
769		aid, err := actorID(actor)
770		if err != nil {
771			return nil, err
772		}
773		record, err := s.repo.findKYCRecordByID(ctx, id)
774		if err != nil {
775			return nil, err
776		}
777		if record.Status != domain.KYCStatusPending {
778			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "kyc approve rejected: record not pending",
779				slog.String("kyc_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("status", record.Status),
780				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
781			return nil, httpx.Conflict("KYC_NOT_PENDING", "kyc record is not pending review")
782		}
783		// Separation of duties: a reviewer may never decide their own KYC record.
784		if record.PartyID == aid {
785			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "kyc approve rejected: self-review",
786				slog.String("kyc_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
787			appErr := httpx.Forbidden("you may not review your own KYC record")
788			appErr.Code = "KYC_SELF_REVIEW"
789			return nil, appErr
790		}
791		// Org scope: a reviewer may only decide KYC for subjects within their area.
792		if err := s.requireKYCSubjectInScope(ctx, actor, record.PartyID); err != nil {
793			return nil, err
794		}
795		if !domain.CanApproveKYCTier(actor.RoleCode, record.RequestedTier) {
796			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "kyc approve rejected: tier not approvable",
797				slog.String("kyc_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("reviewer_role", actor.RoleCode),
798				slog.String("requested_tier", record.RequestedTier))
799			appErr := httpx.Forbidden("your role may not approve KYC at the " + record.RequestedTier + " tier")
800			appErr.Code = "KYC_TIER_NOT_APPROVABLE"
801			return nil, appErr
802		}
803	
804		updated, err := s.repo.approveKYCRecord(ctx, id, aid, actor.RoleCode, now)
805		if err != nil {
806			if isNotFound(err) {
807				// Lost the race — another reviewer already moved it out of PENDING.
808				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "kyc approve lost race: record no longer pending",
809					slog.String("kyc_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
810				return nil, httpx.Conflict("KYC_NOT_PENDING", "kyc record is not pending review")
811			}
812			return nil, err
813		}
814	
815		party, err := s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, updated.PartyID)
816		if err != nil {
817			return nil, err
818		}
819		newTier := upgradedKYCTier(party.KYCTier, updated.RequestedTier)
820		if newTier != party.KYCTier {
821			if err := s.repo.updatePartyKYCTier(ctx, party.ID, newTier, now); err != nil {
822				return nil, err
823			}
824		}
825	
826		language := party.PreferredLanguage
827		if language == "" {
828			language = defaultLanguage
829		}
830		pid := party.ID
831		if err := s.repo.insertNotification(ctx, domain.Notification{
832			PartyID:     &pid,
833			Phone:       party.Phone,
834			Channel:     domain.ChannelSMS,
835			TemplateKey: domain.TemplateKYCApproved,
836			Language:    language,
837			Params:      map[string]string{"tier": updated.RequestedTier},
838			Status:      domain.NotificationQueued,
839			QueuedAt:    now,
840		}); err != nil {
841			return nil, err
842		}
843	
844		s.deps.Audit.Record(ctx, audit.Entry{
845			Action:     "kyc.approve",
846			TargetType: "kyc_record",
847			TargetID:   id.Hex(),
848			Meta: map[string]any{
849				"party_id":       party.ID.Hex(),
850				"requested_tier": updated.RequestedTier,
851				"new_tier":       newTier,
852			},
853		})
854		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "kyc approved",
855			slog.String("kyc_id", id.Hex()),
856			slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()),
857			slog.String("requested_tier", updated.RequestedTier),
858			slog.String("new_tier", newTier),
859			slog.String("reviewer_role", actor.RoleCode),
860			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
861		// Nudge reviewer dashboards: this record left the PENDING queue.
862		s.publishKYCQueueChanged("approved", id, party.ID)
863		return &kycReviewResponse{Record: updated, KYCTier: newTier}, nil
864	}
865	
866	// rejectKYC moves a PENDING record to REJECTED with a mandatory reason,
867	// notifies the party and audits the decision. Same approvable-tier authority
868	// as approveKYC.
869	func (s *service) rejectKYC(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID, reason string) (*kycReviewResponse, error) {
870		now := time.Now().UTC()
871		aid, err := actorID(actor)
872		if err != nil {
873			return nil, err
874		}
875		record, err := s.repo.findKYCRecordByID(ctx, id)
876		if err != nil {
877			return nil, err
878		}
879		if record.Status != domain.KYCStatusPending {
880			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "kyc reject rejected: record not pending",
881				slog.String("kyc_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("status", record.Status),
882				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
883			return nil, httpx.Conflict("KYC_NOT_PENDING", "kyc record is not pending review")
884		}
885		// Separation of duties: a reviewer may never decide their own KYC record.
886		if record.PartyID == aid {
887			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "kyc reject rejected: self-review",
888				slog.String("kyc_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
889			appErr := httpx.Forbidden("you may not review your own KYC record")
890			appErr.Code = "KYC_SELF_REVIEW"
891			return nil, appErr
892		}
893		// Org scope: a reviewer may only decide KYC for subjects within their area.
894		if err := s.requireKYCSubjectInScope(ctx, actor, record.PartyID); err != nil {
895			return nil, err
896		}
897		if !domain.CanApproveKYCTier(actor.RoleCode, record.RequestedTier) {
898			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "kyc reject rejected: tier not approvable",
899				slog.String("kyc_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("reviewer_role", actor.RoleCode),
900				slog.String("requested_tier", record.RequestedTier))
901			appErr := httpx.Forbidden("your role may not review KYC at the " + record.RequestedTier + " tier")
902			appErr.Code = "KYC_TIER_NOT_APPROVABLE"
903			return nil, appErr
904		}
905	
906		updated, err := s.repo.rejectKYCRecord(ctx, id, aid, actor.RoleCode, reason, now)
907		if err != nil {
908			if isNotFound(err) {
909				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "kyc reject lost race: record no longer pending",
910					slog.String("kyc_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
911				return nil, httpx.Conflict("KYC_NOT_PENDING", "kyc record is not pending review")
912			}
913			return nil, err
914		}
915	
916		party, err := s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, updated.PartyID)
917		if err != nil {
918			return nil, err
919		}
920		language := party.PreferredLanguage
921		if language == "" {
922			language = defaultLanguage
923		}
924		pid := party.ID
925		if err := s.repo.insertNotification(ctx, domain.Notification{
926			PartyID:     &pid,
927			Phone:       party.Phone,
928			Channel:     domain.ChannelSMS,
929			TemplateKey: domain.TemplateKYCRejected,
930			Language:    language,
931			Params:      map[string]string{"tier": updated.RequestedTier, "reason": reason},
932			Status:      domain.NotificationQueued,
933			QueuedAt:    now,
934		}); err != nil {
935			return nil, err
936		}
937	
938		s.deps.Audit.Record(ctx, audit.Entry{
939			Action:     "kyc.reject",
940			TargetType: "kyc_record",
941			TargetID:   id.Hex(),
942			Meta: map[string]any{
943				"party_id":       party.ID.Hex(),
944				"requested_tier": updated.RequestedTier,
945				"reason":         reason,
946			},
947		})
948		s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "kyc rejected",
949			slog.String("kyc_id", id.Hex()),
950			slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()),
951			slog.String("requested_tier", updated.RequestedTier),
952			slog.String("reviewer_role", actor.RoleCode),
953			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
954			slog.String("reason", reason))
955		// Nudge reviewer dashboards: this record left the PENDING queue.
956		s.publishKYCQueueChanged("rejected", id, party.ID)
957		return &kycReviewResponse{Record: updated, KYCTier: party.KYCTier}, nil
958	}
959	
960	// --- Role administration ---
961	
962	// requireGrantAuthority enforces the non-admin granter matrix (§5.2):
963	// UNION_PRESIDENT manages village/logistics/union-tier roles anywhere in
964	// scope; SAMITI_ADHYAKSH manages only FARMER/MILK_TESTER/LRP inside their
965	// own DCS; ORGANISING_MANAGER enrols FARMER/CONSUMER within org scope.
966	// Admin granters pass.
967	func (s *service) requireGrantAuthority(actor auth.Actor, roleCode string, orgUnitID primitive.ObjectID) error {
968		if !granterMayGrant(actor.RoleCode, roleCode) {
969			return httpx.Forbidden("role " + actor.RoleCode + " may not grant or revoke " + roleCode)
970		}
971		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSamitiAdhyaksh && orgUnitID.Hex() != actor.OrgUnitID {
972			return httpx.Forbidden("SAMITI_ADHYAKSH may manage roles only within their own DCS")
973		}
974		return nil
975	}
976	
977	// createAssignment grants a role to a party inside an org unit.
978	func (s *service) createAssignment(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req createAssignmentRequest) (*domain.RoleAssignment, error) {
979		aid, err := actorID(actor)
980		if err != nil {
981			return nil, err
982		}
983	
984		// Resolve the target party (party_id wins over phone).
985		var party *domain.Party
986		if req.PartyID != nil {
987			party, err = s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, *req.PartyID)
988		} else {
989			party, err = s.repo.findPartyByPhone(ctx, req.Phone)
990		}
991		if err != nil {
992			return nil, err
993		}
994	
995		if err := s.deps.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.OrgUnitID); err != nil {
996			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "assignment grant denied: out of scope",
997				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
998				slog.String("org_unit_id", req.OrgUnitID.Hex()),
999				slog.String("role_code", req.RoleCode))
1000			return nil, err
1001		}
1002		if err := s.requireGrantAuthority(actor, req.RoleCode, req.OrgUnitID); err != nil {
1003			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "assignment grant denied: granter not authorised",
1004				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
1005				slog.String("granter_role", actor.RoleCode),
1006				slog.String("role_code", req.RoleCode))
1007			return nil, err
1008		}
1009	
1010		exists, err := s.repo.activeAssignmentExists(ctx, party.ID, req.RoleCode, req.OrgUnitID)
1011		if err != nil {
1012			return nil, err
1013		}
1014		if exists {
1015			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "assignment grant rejected: already exists",
1016				slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()),
1017				slog.String("role_code", req.RoleCode),
1018				slog.String("org_unit_id", req.OrgUnitID.Hex()))
1019			return nil, httpx.Conflict("ASSIGNMENT_EXISTS", "party already holds an active "+req.RoleCode+" assignment in this org unit")
1020		}
1021	
1022		now := time.Now().UTC()
1023		validFrom := now
1024		if req.ValidFrom != nil {
1025			validFrom = req.ValidFrom.UTC()
1026		}
1027		var validTo *time.Time
1028		if req.ValidTo != nil {
1029			t := req.ValidTo.UTC()
1030			validTo = &t
1031		}
1032		assignment := domain.RoleAssignment{
1033			ID:        primitive.NewObjectID(),
1034			PartyID:   party.ID,
1035			RoleCode:  req.RoleCode,
1036			OrgUnitID: req.OrgUnitID,
1037			GrantedBy: &aid,
1038			ValidFrom: validFrom,
1039			ValidTo:   validTo,
1040			Status:    domain.RoleAssignmentActive,
1041			CreatedAt: now,
1042		}
1043		if err := s.repo.insertAssignment(ctx, assignment); err != nil {
1044			return nil, err
1045		}
1046		s.deps.Audit.Record(ctx, audit.Entry{
1047			Action:     "role.grant",
1048			TargetType: "role_assignment",
1049			TargetID:   assignment.ID.Hex(),
1050			Meta: map[string]any{
1051				"party_id":    party.ID.Hex(),
1052				"role_code":   req.RoleCode,
1053				"org_unit_id": req.OrgUnitID.Hex(),
1054			},
1055		})
1056		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "role assignment created",
1057			slog.String("assignment_id", assignment.ID.Hex()),
1058			slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()),
1059			slog.String("role_code", req.RoleCode),
1060			slog.String("org_unit_id", req.OrgUnitID.Hex()),
1061			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
1062		return &assignment, nil
1063	}
1064	
1065	// revokeAssignment flips an assignment to REVOKED — the record is never
1066	// deleted (§4.1). Revocation authority mirrors grant authority.
1067	func (s *service) revokeAssignment(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, assignmentID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.RoleAssignment, error) {
1068		aid, err := actorID(actor)
1069		if err != nil {
1070			return nil, err
1071		}
1072		assignment, err := s.repo.findAssignmentByID(ctx, assignmentID)
1073		if err != nil {
1074			return nil, err
1075		}
1076		if err := s.deps.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, assignment.OrgUnitID); err != nil {
1077			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "assignment revoke denied: out of scope",
1078				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
1079				slog.String("assignment_id", assignmentID.Hex()))
1080			return nil, err
1081		}
1082		if err := s.requireGrantAuthority(actor, assignment.RoleCode, assignment.OrgUnitID); err != nil {
1083			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "assignment revoke denied: granter not authorised",
1084				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
1085				slog.String("granter_role", actor.RoleCode),
1086				slog.String("role_code", assignment.RoleCode))
1087			return nil, err
1088		}
1089		if assignment.Status != domain.RoleAssignmentActive {
1090			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "assignment revoke rejected: already revoked",
1091				slog.String("assignment_id", assignmentID.Hex()))
1092			return nil, httpx.Conflict("ALREADY_REVOKED", "role assignment is already revoked")
1093		}
1094		revoked, err := s.repo.revokeAssignment(ctx, assignmentID, aid, time.Now().UTC())
1095		if err != nil {
1096			return nil, err
1097		}
1098		s.deps.Audit.Record(ctx, audit.Entry{
1099			Action:     "role.revoke",
1100			TargetType: "role_assignment",
1101			TargetID:   assignmentID.Hex(),
1102			Meta: map[string]any{
1103				"party_id":    revoked.PartyID.Hex(),
1104				"role_code":   revoked.RoleCode,
1105				"org_unit_id": revoked.OrgUnitID.Hex(),
1106			},
1107		})
1108		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "role assignment revoked",
1109			slog.String("assignment_id", assignmentID.Hex()),
1110			slog.String("party_id", revoked.PartyID.Hex()),
1111			slog.String("role_code", revoked.RoleCode),
1112			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
1113		return revoked, nil
1114	}
1115	
1116	// listAssignments pages assignments inside one org unit the actor can see.
1117	func (s *service) listAssignments(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, orgUnitID primitive.ObjectID, roleCode string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.RoleAssignment, int64, error) {
1118		if err := s.deps.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, orgUnitID); err != nil {
1119			return nil, 0, err
1120		}
1121		return s.repo.listAssignments(ctx, orgUnitID, roleCode, page)
1122	}
```

```text
5	
6		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"

9	// Party statuses.
10	const (
11		PartyStatusActive    = "ACTIVE"
12		PartyStatusSuspended = "SUSPENDED"
13	)
14	
15	// Party is the single identity record per human (blueprint §4.1):
16	// one phone number = one Party = many org-scoped RoleAssignments.
17	// `_id` is a generated ObjectID; `phone` is the unique natural key used for
18	// login — relations always reference the ObjectID, never the phone.
19	type Party struct {
20		ID                primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
21		Phone             string             `bson:"phone"         json:"phone"`
22		FullName          string             `bson:"full_name,omitempty"          json:"full_name,omitempty"`
23		PreferredLanguage string             `bson:"preferred_language,omitempty" json:"preferred_language,omitempty"` // "hi", "en", ...
24		KYCTier           string             `bson:"kyc_tier"      json:"kyc_tier"`
25		Status            string             `bson:"status"        json:"status"`
26		CreatedAt         time.Time          `bson:"created_at"    json:"created_at"`
27		UpdatedAt         time.Time          `bson:"updated_at"    json:"updated_at"`
28	}
29	
30	// RoleAssignment statuses.
31	const (
32		RoleAssignmentActive  = "ACTIVE"
33		RoleAssignmentRevoked = "REVOKED"
34	)
35	
36	// RoleAssignment grants one role to one party inside one org unit for a
37	// validity window. Revoking a Sacheev after an election is a single record
38	// update — never an account deletion (blueprint §4.1).
39	type RoleAssignment struct {
40		ID        primitive.ObjectID  `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
41		PartyID   primitive.ObjectID  `bson:"party_id"      json:"party_id"`
42		RoleCode  string              `bson:"role_code"     json:"role_code"`
43		OrgUnitID primitive.ObjectID  `bson:"org_unit_id"   json:"org_unit_id"`
44		GrantedBy *primitive.ObjectID `bson:"granted_by,omitempty" json:"granted_by,omitempty"`
45		ValidFrom time.Time           `bson:"valid_from"    json:"valid_from"`
46		ValidTo   *time.Time          `bson:"valid_to,omitempty"   json:"valid_to,omitempty"` // nil = open-ended
47		Status    string              `bson:"status"        json:"status"`
48		RevokedAt *time.Time          `bson:"revoked_at,omitempty" json:"revoked_at,omitempty"`
49		RevokedBy *primitive.ObjectID `bson:"revoked_by,omitempty" json:"revoked_by,omitempty"`
50		CreatedAt time.Time           `bson:"created_at"    json:"created_at"`
51	}
52	
53	// UsableAt reports whether the assignment is active and inside its validity
54	// window at instant t.
55	func (ra RoleAssignment) UsableAt(t time.Time) bool {
56		if ra.Status != RoleAssignmentActive {
57			return false
58		}
59		if t.Before(ra.ValidFrom) {
60			return false
61		}
62		if ra.ValidTo != nil && t.After(*ra.ValidTo) {
63			return false
64		}
65		return true
66	}
67	
68	// KYC record statuses — the approval workflow:
69	// submit → PENDING → (Organising Manager / District Verifier / PCDF Admin /
70	// Super Admin reviews) → VERIFIED (tier upgraded) or REJECTED (with reason).
71	// A role token is only issuable once the party's tier satisfies the role's
72	// RequiredKYCTier, so "login as rider" is impossible before approval.
73	const (
74		KYCStatusPending  = "PENDING"
75		KYCStatusVerified = "VERIFIED"
76		KYCStatusRejected = "REJECTED"
77	)
78	
79	// KYCRecord stores verification evidence for a party at a requested tier.
80	// Aadhaar compliance (blueprint §18-A): only the LAST 4 digits and an opaque
81	// vault reference are ever stored — never the full number, never biometrics.
82	type KYCRecord struct {
83		ID                primitive.ObjectID  `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
84		PartyID           primitive.ObjectID  `bson:"party_id"      json:"party_id"`
85		RequestedTier     string              `bson:"requested_tier" json:"requested_tier"`
86		AadhaarLast4      string              `bson:"aadhaar_last4,omitempty"       json:"aadhaar_last4,omitempty"`
87		AadhaarVaultRef   string              `bson:"aadhaar_vault_ref,omitempty"   json:"-"` // opaque Aadhaar Data Vault de-tokenization handle — persisted, NEVER serialized to any client surface
88		BankAccountMasked string              `bson:"bank_account_masked,omitempty" json:"bank_account_masked,omitempty"`
89		BankIFSC          string              `bson:"bank_ifsc,omitempty"           json:"bank_ifsc,omitempty"`
90		BankVerified      bool                `bson:"bank_verified"                 json:"bank_verified"`
91		BankNameMatch     float64             `bson:"bank_name_match,omitempty"     json:"bank_name_match,omitempty"` // penny-drop name-match score 0..1
92		DigiLockerDocs    []DocRef            `bson:"digilocker_docs,omitempty"     json:"digilocker_docs,omitempty"`
93		VideoKYCRef       string              `bson:"video_kyc_ref,omitempty"       json:"video_kyc_ref,omitempty"`
94		ConsentID         *primitive.ObjectID `bson:"consent_id,omitempty"          json:"consent_id,omitempty"`
95		Status            string              `bson:"status"        json:"status"`
96		RejectionReason   string              `bson:"rejection_reason,omitempty" json:"rejection_reason,omitempty"`
97		ReviewedBy        *primitive.ObjectID `bson:"reviewed_by,omitempty"      json:"reviewed_by,omitempty"` // approver party
98		ReviewedByRole    string              `bson:"reviewed_by_role,omitempty" json:"reviewed_by_role,omitempty"`
99		ReviewedAt        *time.Time          `bson:"reviewed_at,omitempty"      json:"reviewed_at,omitempty"`
100		VerifiedAt        *time.Time          `bson:"verified_at,omitempty"      json:"verified_at,omitempty"`
101		CreatedAt         time.Time           `bson:"created_at"    json:"created_at"`
102		UpdatedAt         time.Time           `bson:"updated_at"    json:"updated_at"`
103	}
104	
105	// DocRef points at an externally fetched document (DigiLocker etc.).
106	type DocRef struct {
107		DocType   string    `bson:"doc_type"  json:"doc_type"` // LAND_RECORD, CASTE_CERT, DL, RC ...
108		Issuer    string    `bson:"issuer"    json:"issuer"`
109		RefID     string    `bson:"ref_id"    json:"ref_id"`
110		FetchedAt time.Time `bson:"fetched_at" json:"fetched_at"`
111	}
```

```text
2	// invariants shared by every module. It has no behaviour beyond validation
3	// and no dependencies outside the standard library and BSON primitives.
4	// This is the contract layer: modules depend on domain, never the other way
5	// around.
6	package domain
7	
8	// Role codes — the role catalog from blueprint §5.2, grounded in the PCDF
9	// cooperative constitution (Farmer → Samiti/DCS → Sangh/Union → PCDF).
10	// A Party may hold many time-bounded, org-scoped RoleAssignments.
11	//
12	// The catalog is deliberately open for extension: adding a future role is a
13	// new constant + AllRoles entry + RequiredKYCTier entry — nothing else.

130		RoleSuperAdmin:           KYCTierHighest,
131		RoleServiceAccount:       KYCTierService,
132	}

134	// kycRank orders tiers so "tier X satisfies requirement Y" is a comparison.
135	var kycRank = map[string]int{
136		KYCTierMinimal:  0,
137		KYCTierFarmer:   1,
138		KYCTierStandard: 1, // Farmer and Standard are parallel tier-1 proofs
139		KYCTierRider:    2,

143	}

145	// KYCTierSatisfies reports whether a party at tier `have` meets `need`.
146	// Parallel tier-1 proofs (FARMER vs STANDARD) satisfy each other.
147	func KYCTierSatisfies(have, need string) bool {
148		h, okH := kycRank[have]
149		n, okN := kycRank[need]
150		if !okH || !okN {
151			return false
152		}
153		return h >= n
154	}
155	
156	// KYCApprovableTiers maps an approver ROLE to the KYC tiers it may approve.
157	// Ground staff clear the field tiers; only federation admins clear HIGH;
158	// only SUPER_ADMIN clears HIGHEST. Extend when new approver roles arrive.
159	var KYCApprovableTiers = map[string][]string{
160		RoleOrganisingManager: {KYCTierMinimal, KYCTierFarmer, KYCTierStandard, KYCTierRider},
161		RoleDistrictVerifier:  {KYCTierMinimal, KYCTierFarmer, KYCTierStandard, KYCTierRider},
162		RolePCDFAdmin:         {KYCTierMinimal, KYCTierFarmer, KYCTierStandard, KYCTierRider, KYCTierHigh},
163		RoleSuperAdmin:        {KYCTierMinimal, KYCTierFarmer, KYCTierStandard, KYCTierRider, KYCTierHigh, KYCTierHighest, KYCTierService},
164	}
165	
166	// CanApproveKYCTier reports whether approverRole may approve a KYC record
167	// requesting the given tier.
168	func CanApproveKYCTier(approverRole, tier string) bool {
169		for _, t := range KYCApprovableTiers[approverRole] {
170			if t == tier {
171				return true
172			}
173		}
174		return false
175	}
```

```text
6	/**
7	 * Identity & auth - aligned with the implemented Go backend
8	 * (parag-saathi-be, internal/modules/identity):
9	 *
10	 *   POST /auth/otp/request   → { phone, expires_at, dev_otp? }
11	 *   POST /auth/otp/verify    → { access_token (SESSION), refresh_token, party }
12	 *   GET  /parties/me         → { party, assignments (+org enrichment), kyc? }
13	 *   POST /auth/role/select   → { access_token (ROLE), role_code, org_unit_id }
14	 *   POST /auth/refresh       → rotated token pair (handled inside client.ts)
15	 *   POST /auth/logout        → revokes the refresh token
16	 *   POST /kyc/aadhaar | /kyc/bank | PATCH /parties/me
17	 *
18	 * The backend find-or-creates the Party on first OTP login (§4.1); consumers
19	 * onboard with mobile OTP only (§4.2). Mock mode mirrors those semantics.
20	 * Demo OTP: 123456.
```

```text
1	// Package auth owns tokens and credentials: JWT issue/verify, OTP generation
2	// and HMAC hashing, opaque refresh tokens. Nothing secret is ever stored in
3	// plaintext — OTPs and refresh tokens live in the DB only as HMAC-SHA256
4	// digests.
5	package auth
6	
7	import (
8		"fmt"
9		"time"
10	
11		"github.com/golang-jwt/jwt/v5"
12		"github.com/google/uuid"
13	
14		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
15	)
16	
17	// Token kinds. A SESSION token proves "this phone logged in"; a ROLE token
18	// additionally pins one active role assignment + org scope (the role switcher
19	// simply issues a fresh ROLE token).
20	const (
21		TokenKindSession = "session"
22		TokenKindRole    = "role"
23	)
24	
25	// Claims is the JWT payload.
26	type Claims struct {
27		PartyID          string `json:"pid"`
28		Phone            string `json:"phn"`
29		KYCTier          string `json:"kyc"`
30		Kind             string `json:"knd"`
31		RoleAssignmentID string `json:"rid,omitempty"`
32		RoleCode         string `json:"rol,omitempty"`
33		OrgUnitID        string `json:"org,omitempty"`
34		OrgType          string `json:"ogt,omitempty"`
35		jwt.RegisteredClaims
36	}
37	
38	// JWTManager issues and parses access tokens.
39	type JWTManager struct {
40		secret []byte
41		ttl    time.Duration
42	}
43	
44	// NewJWTManager builds a manager with the shared HS256 secret and access TTL.
45	func NewJWTManager(secret string, ttl time.Duration) *JWTManager {
46		return &JWTManager{secret: []byte(secret), ttl: ttl}
47	}
48	
49	// IssueSessionToken returns a SESSION-kind access token for a logged-in party.
50	// ObjectIDs travel in claims as hex strings (JWTs are JSON).
51	func (m *JWTManager) IssueSessionToken(p domain.Party) (string, error) {
52		return m.sign(Claims{
53			PartyID: p.ID.Hex(),
54			Phone:   p.Phone,
55			KYCTier: p.KYCTier,
56			Kind:    TokenKindSession,
57		})
58	}
59	
60	// IssueRoleToken returns a ROLE-kind access token pinned to one assignment.
61	func (m *JWTManager) IssueRoleToken(p domain.Party, ra domain.RoleAssignment, orgType string) (string, error) {
62		return m.sign(Claims{
63			PartyID:          p.ID.Hex(),
64			Phone:            p.Phone,
65			KYCTier:          p.KYCTier,
66			Kind:             TokenKindRole,
67			RoleAssignmentID: ra.ID.Hex(),
68			RoleCode:         ra.RoleCode,
69			OrgUnitID:        ra.OrgUnitID.Hex(),
70			OrgType:          orgType,
71		})
72	}
73	
74	func (m *JWTManager) sign(c Claims) (string, error) {
75		now := time.Now()
76		c.RegisteredClaims = jwt.RegisteredClaims{
77			Issuer:    "saathi-backend",
78			Subject:   c.PartyID,
79			IssuedAt:  jwt.NewNumericDate(now),
80			ExpiresAt: jwt.NewNumericDate(now.Add(m.ttl)),
81			ID:        uuid.NewString(),
82		}
83		return jwt.NewWithClaims(jwt.SigningMethodHS256, c).SignedString(m.secret)
84	}
85	
86	// Parse validates signature+expiry and returns the claims.
87	func (m *JWTManager) Parse(token string) (*Claims, error) {
88		parsed, err := jwt.ParseWithClaims(token, &Claims{},
89			func(t *jwt.Token) (any, error) { return m.secret, nil },
90			jwt.WithValidMethods([]string{jwt.SigningMethodHS256.Alg()}),
91			jwt.WithIssuer("saathi-backend"),
92		)
93		if err != nil {
94			return nil, fmt.Errorf("parse token: %w", err)
95		}
96		claims, ok := parsed.Claims.(*Claims)
97		if !ok || !parsed.Valid {
98			return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid token claims")
99		}
100		return claims, nil
101	}
102
```

```text
1	package auth
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"sync"
6	)
7	
8	// Actor is the authenticated caller extracted from a verified token and
9	// stored on the request context by the auth middleware.
10	type Actor struct {
11		PartyID          string
12		Phone            string
13		KYCTier          string
14		Kind             string // session | role
15		RoleAssignmentID string
16		RoleCode         string
17		OrgUnitID        string
18		OrgType          string
19	}
20	
21	// HasRole reports whether the actor operates under one of the given roles.
22	func (a Actor) HasRole(roles ...string) bool {
23		for _, r := range roles {
24			if a.RoleCode == r {
25				return true
26			}
27		}
28		return false
29	}
30	
31	type actorCtxKey struct{}
32	
33	// actorHolder is a mutable cell installed by OUTER middleware (audit) so
34	// identity established by INNER middleware (Authenticate) can flow back out.
35	// Context values only propagate inward; the shared pointer bridges the gap.
36	type actorHolder struct {
37		mu sync.Mutex
38		a  *Actor
39	}
40	
41	type actorHolderCtxKey struct{}
42	
43	// WithActorHolder installs an empty actor holder on the context. Middleware
44	// mounted before authentication uses it to observe the actor after the
45	// handler chain ran.
46	func WithActorHolder(ctx context.Context) context.Context {
47		return context.WithValue(ctx, actorHolderCtxKey{}, &actorHolder{})
48	}
49	
50	// HeldActor returns the actor captured by an inner WithActor call, if a
51	// holder was installed and authentication happened.
52	func HeldActor(ctx context.Context) (Actor, bool) {
53		h, ok := ctx.Value(actorHolderCtxKey{}).(*actorHolder)
54		if !ok {
55			return Actor{}, false
56		}
57		h.mu.Lock()
58		defer h.mu.Unlock()
59		if h.a == nil {
60			return Actor{}, false
61		}
62		return *h.a, true
63	}
64	
65	// WithActor stores the actor on the context, and also fills the outward
66	// actor holder when one was installed upstream (see WithActorHolder).
67	func WithActor(ctx context.Context, a Actor) context.Context {
68		if h, ok := ctx.Value(actorHolderCtxKey{}).(*actorHolder); ok {
69			h.mu.Lock()
70			cp := a
71			h.a = &cp
72			h.mu.Unlock()
73		}
74		return context.WithValue(ctx, actorCtxKey{}, a)
75	}
76	
77	// ActorFrom retrieves the actor, if any.
78	func ActorFrom(ctx context.Context) (Actor, bool) {
79		a, ok := ctx.Value(actorCtxKey{}).(Actor)
80		return a, ok
81	}
82
```

```text
5	import { ROLES } from '@/core/types/roles';
6	import { clearTokens, getRefreshToken, setAccessToken } from '@/core/api/client';
7	import * as authApi from '@/core/api/endpoints/auth';
8	
9	/**
10	 * Session + active-role state ("one phone, many roles", §4).
11	 *
12	 * Auth flow (matches the real backend, parag-saathi-be):
13	 *   verify OTP → SESSION access token + refresh token + party
14	 *   GET /parties/me → assignments (+org enrichment) = the Session here
15	 *   activateRole() → POST /auth/role/select → ROLE-kind access token
16	 *
17	 * Persisted to AsyncStorage so the field app opens signed-in
18	 * (offline-first: no network needed to reach your console, §3.1).
19	 */
20	interface AuthState {
21	  session: Session | null;
22	  activeAssignmentId: string | null;
23	  /** true once AsyncStorage rehydration finished (gate initial redirects) */
24	  hydrated: boolean;
25	  login: (session: Session) => void;
26	  /** Refresh the session snapshot (e.g. after /parties/me on app start) */
27	  setSession: (session: Session) => void;
28	  /**
29	   * Select the assignment to operate under. Exchanges the access token for
30	   * a ROLE-scoped one via the backend before flipping the UI (§4/§17).
31	   */
32	  activateRole: (assignmentId: string) => Promise<void>;
33	  logout: () => void;
34	  setHydrated: (v: boolean) => void;
35	}
36	
37	export const useAuthStore = create<AuthState>()(
38	  persist(
39	    (set) => ({
40	      session: null,
41	      activeAssignmentId: null,
42	      hydrated: false,
43	      login: (session) => set({ session, activeAssignmentId: null }),
44	      setSession: (session) => set({ session }),
45	      activateRole: async (assignmentId) => {
46	        const { accessToken } = await authApi.selectRole({ roleAssignmentId: assignmentId });
47	        setAccessToken(accessToken);
48	        set({ activeAssignmentId: assignmentId });
49	      },
50	      logout: () => {
51	        // Revoke the refresh token server-side, then drop local credentials.
52	        const refresh = getRefreshToken();
53	        if (refresh) void authApi.logoutServer({ refreshToken: refresh }).catch(() => undefined);
54	        clearTokens();
55	        set({ session: null, activeAssignmentId: null });
56	      },
57	      setHydrated: (v) => set({ hydrated: v }),
58	    }),
59	    {
60	      name: 'saathi-session',
61	      storage: createJSONStorage(() => AsyncStorage),
62	      partialize: (s) => ({ session: s.session, activeAssignmentId: s.activeAssignmentId }),
63	      onRehydrateStorage: () => () => {
64	        // Always release the hydration gate — even if reading/parsing the
65	        // persisted store failed (corrupt AsyncStorage) — so the app boots to
66	        // /login instead of hanging on a blank screen after the splash.
67	        useAuthStore.setState({ hydrated: true });
68	      },
69	    },
70	  ),
71	);
72	
73	/** The currently active role assignment (null until the user picks one). */
74	export function useActiveRole(): RoleAssignment | null {
75	  const { session, activeAssignmentId } = useAuthStore();
76	  if (!session) return null;
77	  return session.assignments.find((a) => a.id === activeAssignmentId) ?? null;
78	}
79	
80	/** Org unit the active role is scoped to. */
81	export function useActiveOrgUnit(): OrgUnit | null {
82	  const { session } = useAuthStore();
83	  const active = useActiveRole();
84	  if (!session || !active) return null;
85	  return session.orgUnits.find((o) => o.id === active.orgUnitId) ?? null;
86	}
87	
88	/** Home path for an assignment (falls back to /coming-soon for non-MVP or
89	 *  unknown roles — a persisted role missing from ROLES must not crash startup). */
90	export function roleHomePath(assignment: RoleAssignment): string {
91	  return ROLES[assignment.role]?.homePath ?? '/coming-soon';
92	}
```

```text
1	import type { ReactNode } from 'react';
2	import { Redirect } from 'expo-router';
3	import type { RoleCode } from '@/core/types/roles';
4	import { roleHomePath, useActiveRole, useAuthStore } from './store';
5	
6	/**
7	 * Module gate for role-group layouts (§4, §17): wraps a role group's
8	 * <Tabs>/<Stack>. Unauthenticated → /login; no active role picked →
9	 * /select-role; wrong role → that role's own home. Renders nothing until
10	 * the persisted session has rehydrated (avoids redirect flicker).
11	 */
12	export function RoleGate({ allow, children }: { allow: RoleCode[]; children: ReactNode }) {
13	  const { session, hydrated } = useAuthStore();
14	  const active = useActiveRole();
15	  if (!hydrated) return null;
16	  if (!session) return <Redirect href="/login" />;
17	  if (!active) return <Redirect href="/select-role" />;
18	  if (!allow.includes(active.role)) {
19	    return <Redirect href={roleHomePath(active)} />;
20	  }
21	  return <>{children}</>;
22	}
```

```text
434	    }
435	    lot.status = 'DISPATCHED';

437	    // rider verifies this code at pickup so milk cannot be swapped in transit.
438	    lot.sealCode = sealCodeFor(lot.consignmentCode);

445	      detail: `${lot.consignmentCode} sealed ${lot.sealCode}`,
446	    });

448	    const trip = db.trips.find(

450	    );
451	    const stop = trip?.stops.find((s) => s.dcsId === lot.dcsId && !s.lotId);
452	    if (stop) stop.lotId = lot.id;

454	      actorPartyId: dispatchedByPartyId,
455	      actorRole: 'SAMITI_SACHEEV',
456	      action: 'LOT_DISPATCHED',
457	      subject: lot.consignmentCode,
458	      detail: `${lot.totalLitres}L dispatched${trip ? `, attached to route ${trip.code}` : ''}`,
459	    });

462	});

464	/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

466	/* for the Union and a B2B GST invoice is generated (§5.2, §13).       */

468	
469	/** Indian fiscal year label for a date, e.g. 2026-27 (FY starts in April). */
470	function fiscalYear(date: string): string {
471	  const y = Number(date.slice(0, 4));
472	  const m = Number(date.slice(5, 7));
473	  const start = m >= 4 ? y : y - 1;
474	  return `${start}-${String((start + 1) % 100).padStart(2, '0')}`;
475	}
476	
477	/** Derive the DCS to Union B2B invoice from an approved consignment. */
478	function buildConsignmentInvoice(db: MockDb, lot: DcsLot): ConsignmentInvoice {
479	  const dcs = db.orgUnits.find((o) => o.id === lot.dcsId);
480	  const taxable = lot.unionInvoiceAmount ?? 0;
481	  const farmerCount = new Set(
482	    db.pours.filter((p) => lot.pourIds.includes(p.id)).map((p) => p.farmerPartyId),
483	  ).size;
484	  return {
485	    invoiceNo: lot.unionInvoiceNo ?? '',
486	    lotId: lot.id,
487	    consignmentCode: lot.consignmentCode,
488	    fromDcsId: lot.dcsId,
489	    toUnionId: dcs?.parentId ?? '',
490	    date: lot.date,
491	    shift: lot.shift,
492	    hsnCode: '0401',
493	    totalLitres: lot.totalLitres,
494	    avgFatPct: lot.avgFatPct,
495	    avgSnfPct: lot.avgSnfPct,
496	    farmerCount,
497	    taxableAmount: taxable,
498	    taxAmount: 0,
499	    totalAmount: taxable,
500	    gstNote: 'Fresh milk is GST exempt (HSN 0401)',
501	    generatedByPartyId: lot.unionApprovedByPartyId ?? '',
502	    generatedAt: lot.unionApprovedAt ?? '',
503	  };
504	}

506	/**
507	 * The Sachiv approves the consignment's data for the Union. This is the gate:
508	 * the Union only receives data the Sachiv has approved. Approval also generates
509	 * the DCS to Union B2B GST e-invoice (§13) and returns it.
510	 */
511	// TODO(backend): union approval + B2B invoice route not exposed yet, mock only
512	export const approveForUnion = endpoint<

521	    if (lot.unionApproved) {

523	    }
524	    if (lot.status === 'REJECTED') {

527	        'LOT_REJECTED',
528	        'A rejected consignment cannot be approved for the Union',
529	      );
530	    }
531	    const value =
532	      Math.round(
533	        db.pours
534	          .filter((p) => lot.pourIds.includes(p.id))
535	          .reduce((s, p) => s + p.amount, 0) * 100,
536	      ) / 100;
537	    const dcs = db.orgUnits.find((o) => o.id === lot.dcsId);
538	    const seq = db.lots.filter((l) => l.unionApproved).length + 45;
539	    lot.unionApproved = true;
540	    lot.unionApprovedAt = new Date().toISOString();
541	    lot.unionApprovedByPartyId = approvedByPartyId;
542	    lot.unionInvoiceNo = `${dcs?.code ?? 'DCS'}/${fiscalYear(lot.date)}/${String(seq).padStart(6, '0')}`;
543	    lot.unionInvoiceAmount = value;
544	    audit(db, {
545	      actorPartyId: approvedByPartyId,
546	      actorRole: 'SAMITI_SACHEEV',
547	      action: 'UNION_DATA_APPROVED',
548	      subject: lot.consignmentCode,
549	      detail: `Approved ${lot.totalLitres}L for the Union; invoice ${lot.unionInvoiceNo} generated (value Rs. ${value})`,
550	    });
551	    return buildConsignmentInvoice(db, lot);
552	  },
553	});
```

```text
25		actor, ok := auth.ActorFrom(r.Context())
```

```text
41	// grantableRoles caps what each NON-admin granter role may hand out
42	// (blueprint §5.2). SUPER_ADMIN and PCDF_ADMIN are unrestricted admin
43	// granters and are handled in granterMayGrant.
44	var grantableRoles = map[string]map[string]bool{
45		// A union president manages the village, logistics and union tiers.
46		domain.RoleUnionPresident: {
47			domain.RoleFarmer:               true,
48			domain.RoleSamitiSacheev:        true,
49			domain.RoleSamitiAdhyaksh:       true,
50			domain.RoleMilkTester:           true,
51			domain.RoleLRP:                  true,
52			domain.RoleAITech:               true,
53			domain.RoleVanRider:             true,
54			domain.RoleDeliveryRider:        true,
55			domain.RoleBMCOperator:          true,
56			domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor: true,
57			domain.RoleUnionPresident:       true,
58		},
59		// A samiti adhyaksh onboards only village workers inside their own DCS.
60		domain.RoleSamitiAdhyaksh: {
61			domain.RoleFarmer:     true,
62			domain.RoleMilkTester: true,
63			domain.RoleLRP:        true,
64		},
65		// An organising manager (ground-level field worker) enrols farmers and
66		// consumers within their own org scope (enforced via RequireInScope).
67		domain.RoleOrganisingManager: {
68			domain.RoleFarmer:   true,
69			domain.RoleConsumer: true,
70		},

73	// granterMayGrant reports whether granterRole may grant (or revoke)
74	// roleCode. Admin granters pass unconditionally.
75	func granterMayGrant(granterRole, roleCode string) bool {
76		if granterRole == domain.RoleSuperAdmin || granterRole == domain.RolePCDFAdmin {
77			return true
78		}
79		allowed, ok := grantableRoles[granterRole]
80		return ok && allowed[roleCode]
81	}
82	
83	// upgradedKYCTier returns the tier a party should hold after a successful
84	// verification at requestedTier — upgrades only, never a downgrade
85	// (KYCTierSatisfies treats parallel tier-1 proofs as equivalent).
86	func upgradedKYCTier(currentTier, requestedTier string) string {
87		if domain.KYCTierSatisfies(currentTier, requestedTier) {
88			return currentTier
89		}
90		return requestedTier
91	}

93	// maskAccount reduces a bank account number to its ****-prefixed last 4
94	// digits — the only form ever persisted.
95	func maskAccount(accountNumber string) string {
96		if len(accountNumber) < 4 {
97			return "****"
98		}
99		return "****" + accountNumber[len(accountNumber)-4:]
100	}

102	// isNotFound reports whether err is an httpx 404 (used to translate repo
103	// lookups into auth-appropriate 401s on the login path).
104	func isNotFound(err error) bool {
105		var ae *httpx.AppError
106		return errors.As(err, &ae) && ae.Status == http.StatusNotFound
107	}

111	// stores or compares the actor's identity.

114	}
115	
116	// service holds every business rule of the identity module.
117	type service struct {
118		deps *deps.Deps
119		repo *repository
120		log  *slog.Logger
121	}
122	
123	// newService wires the service. log is the module-scoped logger derived in
124	// Register.
125	func newService(d *deps.Deps, repo *repository, log *slog.Logger) *service {
126		return &service{deps: d, repo: repo, log: log}
127	}
128	
129	// --- Auth: OTP login ---
130	
131	// requestOTP creates a hashed OTP challenge and queues the SMS through the
132	// notification outbox (the platformops worker delivers it).
133	func (s *service) requestOTP(ctx context.Context, phone string) (*otpRequestResponse, error) {
134		now := time.Now().UTC()
135		code, err := auth.GenerateNumericOTP(otpLength)
136		if err != nil {
137			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "otp generation failed", slog.Any("err", err))
138			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
139		}
140	
141		challenge := otpChallenge{
142			ID:        uuid.NewString(),
143			Phone:     phone,
144			CodeHash:  auth.HMACHash(s.deps.Cfg.OTPHashSecret, phone, code),
145			ExpiresAt: now.Add(s.deps.Cfg.OTPTTL),
146			Attempts:  0,
147		}
148		if err := s.repo.insertOTPChallenge(ctx, challenge); err != nil {
149			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "otp challenge insert failed", slog.String("phone", phone), slog.Any("err", err))
150			return nil, err
151		}
152	
153		// Outbox SMS: the plaintext code travels only inside the notification
154		// params so the sender can deliver it; the challenge stores the hash.
155		notification := domain.Notification{
156			Phone:       phone,
157			Channel:     domain.ChannelSMS,
158			TemplateKey: domain.TemplateOTP,
159			Language:    defaultLanguage,
160			Params:      map[string]string{"otp": code},
161			Status:      domain.NotificationQueued,
162			QueuedAt:    now,
163		}
164		if party, err := s.repo.findPartyByPhone(ctx, phone); err == nil {
165			pid := party.ID
166			notification.PartyID = &pid
167			if party.PreferredLanguage != "" {
168				notification.Language = party.PreferredLanguage
169			}
170		}
171		if err := s.repo.insertNotification(ctx, notification); err != nil {
172			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "otp notification queue failed", slog.String("phone", phone), slog.Any("err", err))
173			return nil, err
174		}
175	
176		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "otp requested", slog.String("phone", phone))
177		resp := &otpRequestResponse{Phone: phone, ExpiresAt: challenge.ExpiresAt}
178		if s.deps.Cfg.OTPDevMode {
179			resp.DevOTP = code // dev only — config refuses OTP_DEV_MODE in prod
180		}
181		return resp, nil
182	}
183	
184	// verifyOTP checks the challenge and logs the phone in, creating the Party
185	// on first login (find-or-create, §4.1).
186	func (s *service) verifyOTP(ctx context.Context, phone, otp string) (*authTokensResponse, error) {
187		now := time.Now().UTC()
188	
189		challenge, err := s.repo.latestOTPChallenge(ctx, phone, now)
190		if err != nil {
191			if isNotFound(err) {
192				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "otp verify rejected: no active challenge", slog.String("phone", phone))
193				return nil, httpx.Unauthorized("no active OTP for this phone — request a new code")
194			}
195			return nil, err
196		}
197		if challenge.Attempts >= maxOTPAttempts {
198			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "otp verify rejected: too many attempts", slog.String("phone", phone))
199			return nil, httpx.TooManyRequests("too many incorrect OTP attempts — request a new code")
200		}
201		expected := auth.HMACHash(s.deps.Cfg.OTPHashSecret, phone, otp)
202		if !auth.ConstantTimeEqual(challenge.CodeHash, expected) {
203			if err := s.repo.incrementOTPAttempts(ctx, challenge.ID); err != nil {
204				return nil, err
205			}
206			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "otp verify rejected: incorrect code", slog.String("phone", phone))
207			return nil, httpx.Unauthorized("incorrect OTP")
208		}
209	
210		// Burn every outstanding challenge for this phone.
211		if err := s.repo.deleteOTPChallenges(ctx, phone); err != nil {
212			return nil, err
213		}
214	
215		party, err := s.repo.upsertPartyByPhone(ctx, phone, now)
216		if err != nil {
217			return nil, err
218		}
219		if party.Status != domain.PartyStatusActive {
220			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "otp verify rejected: party suspended",
221				slog.String("phone", phone), slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()))
222			return nil, httpx.Forbidden("party is suspended")
223		}
224		tokens, err := s.issueLoginTokens(ctx, party, now)
225		if err != nil {
226			return nil, err
227		}
228		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "party logged in",
229			slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()), slog.String("phone", phone))
230		return tokens, nil
231	}
232	
233	// issueLoginTokens mints a SESSION access token plus a fresh rotating
234	// refresh token (stored only as an HMAC digest).
235	func (s *service) issueLoginTokens(ctx context.Context, party *domain.Party, now time.Time) (*authTokensResponse, error) {
236		refreshToken, err := auth.RandomToken(32)
237		if err != nil {
238			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "refresh token generation failed", slog.Any("err", err))
239			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
240		}
241		doc := refreshTokenDoc{
242			TokenHash: auth.HMACHash(s.deps.Cfg.OTPHashSecret, refreshHashLabel, refreshToken),
243			PartyID:   party.ID,
244			ExpiresAt: now.Add(s.deps.Cfg.RefreshTokenTTL),
245			CreatedAt: now,
246		}
247		if err := s.repo.insertRefreshToken(ctx, doc); err != nil {
248			return nil, err
249		}
250		accessToken, err := s.deps.JWT.IssueSessionToken(*party)
251		if err != nil {
252			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "session token issue failed",
253				slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
254			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
255		}
256		return &authTokensResponse{
257			AccessToken:  accessToken,
258			RefreshToken: refreshToken,
259			Party:        party,
260		}, nil
261	}
262	
263	// refresh rotates a refresh token: the old token is consumed atomically and
264	// a new pair is issued — a replayed token always fails.
265	func (s *service) refresh(ctx context.Context, refreshToken string) (*authTokensResponse, error) {
266		now := time.Now().UTC()
267		tokenHash := auth.HMACHash(s.deps.Cfg.OTPHashSecret, refreshHashLabel, refreshToken)
268	
269		doc, err := s.repo.findRefreshToken(ctx, tokenHash)
270		if err != nil {
271			if isNotFound(err) {
272				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "refresh rejected: unknown token")
273				return nil, httpx.Unauthorized("invalid refresh token")
274			}
275			return nil, err
276		}
277		if !now.Before(doc.ExpiresAt) {
278			_, _ = s.repo.deleteRefreshToken(ctx, tokenHash)
279			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "refresh rejected: token expired", slog.String("party_id", doc.PartyID.Hex()))
280			return nil, httpx.Unauthorized("refresh token expired — log in again")
281		}
282	
283		// ROTATE: consume the old token first; DeletedCount==0 means a parallel
284		// request won the race, so this presentation is treated as a replay.
285		deleted, err := s.repo.deleteRefreshToken(ctx, tokenHash)
286		if err != nil {
287			return nil, err
288		}
289		if deleted == 0 {
290			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "refresh rejected: token already used", slog.String("party_id", doc.PartyID.Hex()))
291			return nil, httpx.Unauthorized("refresh token already used")
292		}
293	
294		party, err := s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, doc.PartyID)
295		if err != nil {
296			if isNotFound(err) {
297				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "refresh rejected: party gone", slog.String("party_id", doc.PartyID.Hex()))
298				return nil, httpx.Unauthorized("party no longer exists")
299			}
300			return nil, err
301		}
302		if party.Status != domain.PartyStatusActive {
303			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "refresh rejected: party suspended", slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()))
304			return nil, httpx.Forbidden("party is suspended")
305		}
306		return s.issueLoginTokens(ctx, party, now)
307	}
308	
309	// logout revokes one refresh token belonging to the caller. Idempotent.
310	func (s *service) logout(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, refreshToken string) error {
311		aid, err := actorID(actor)
312		if err != nil {
313			return err
314		}
315		tokenHash := auth.HMACHash(s.deps.Cfg.OTPHashSecret, refreshHashLabel, refreshToken)
316		return s.repo.deleteRefreshTokenForParty(ctx, tokenHash, aid)
317	}

319	// --- Auth: roles ---
320	
321	// listMyRoles returns the actor's currently usable assignments, enriched
322	// with org-unit display fields for the role-switcher UI.
323	func (s *service) listMyRoles(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor) ([]assignmentWithOrg, error) {
324		aid, err := actorID(actor)
325		if err != nil {
326			return nil, err
327		}
328		assignments, err := s.repo.listActiveAssignments(ctx, aid)
329		if err != nil {
330			return nil, err
331		}
332		now := time.Now().UTC()
333		out := make([]assignmentWithOrg, 0, len(assignments))
334		for _, ra := range assignments {
335			if !ra.UsableAt(now) {
336				continue
337			}
338			out = append(out, s.withOrg(ctx, ra))
339		}
340		return out, nil
341	}
342	
343	// withOrg copies org display fields onto an assignment; enrichment is
344	// best-effort (a missing org unit never breaks the listing).
345	func (s *service) withOrg(ctx context.Context, ra domain.RoleAssignment) assignmentWithOrg {
346		enriched := assignmentWithOrg{RoleAssignment: ra}
347		if org, err := s.deps.Orgs.Get(ctx, ra.OrgUnitID); err == nil {
348			enriched.OrgName = org.Name
349			enriched.OrgType = org.Type
350			enriched.OrgCode = org.Code
351		}
352		return enriched
353	}
354	
355	// selectRole exchanges the session for a ROLE-kind token pinned to one
356	// usable assignment, gated on the role's minimum KYC tier (§5.2). With
357	// auto-verify gone, this genuinely blocks un-approved parties.
358	func (s *service) selectRole(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, assignmentID primitive.ObjectID) (*roleSelectResponse, error) {
359		aid, err := actorID(actor)
360		if err != nil {
361			return nil, err
362		}
363		assignment, err := s.repo.findAssignmentByID(ctx, assignmentID)
364		if err != nil {
365			return nil, err
366		}
367		if assignment.PartyID != aid {
368			// Same shape as an unknown ID — never confirm other parties' grants.
369			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "role select rejected: not owner",
370				slog.String("assignment_id", assignmentID.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
371			return nil, httpx.NotFound("role assignment")
372		}
373		now := time.Now().UTC()
374		if !assignment.UsableAt(now) {
375			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "role select rejected: assignment not usable",
376				slog.String("assignment_id", assignmentID.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
377			return nil, httpx.Forbidden("role assignment is revoked or outside its validity window")
378		}
379	
380		// Re-read the party: the KYC tier may have upgraded since the session
381		// token was minted.
382		party, err := s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, aid)
383		if err != nil {
384			return nil, err
385		}
386		if party.Status != domain.PartyStatusActive {
387			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "role select rejected: party suspended", slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()))
388			return nil, httpx.Forbidden("party is suspended")
389		}
390		requiredTier := domain.RequiredKYCTier[assignment.RoleCode]
391		if !domain.KYCTierSatisfies(party.KYCTier, requiredTier) {
392			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "role select rejected: kyc tier insufficient",
393				slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()),
394				slog.String("role_code", assignment.RoleCode),
395				slog.String("current_tier", party.KYCTier),
396				slog.String("required_tier", requiredTier))
397			appErr := httpx.Forbidden("your KYC tier does not permit this role — complete verification first").
398				WithDetails(map[string]string{
399					"current_tier":  party.KYCTier,
400					"required_tier": requiredTier,
401				})
402			appErr.Code = "KYC_TIER_INSUFFICIENT"
403			return nil, appErr
404		}
405	
406		org, err := s.deps.Orgs.Get(ctx, assignment.OrgUnitID)
407		if err != nil {
408			return nil, err
409		}
410		accessToken, err := s.deps.JWT.IssueRoleToken(*party, *assignment, org.Type)
411		if err != nil {
412			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "role token issue failed",
413				slog.String("assignment_id", assignmentID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
414			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
415		}
416		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "role selected",
417			slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()),
418			slog.String("assignment_id", assignmentID.Hex()),
419			slog.String("role_code", assignment.RoleCode),
420			slog.String("org_unit_id", assignment.OrgUnitID.Hex()))
421		return &roleSelectResponse{
422			AccessToken: accessToken,
423			RoleCode:    assignment.RoleCode,
424			OrgUnitID:   assignment.OrgUnitID,
425			OrgType:     org.Type,
426		}, nil
427	}

430	
431	// getMe aggregates the caller's party, usable assignments and latest KYC
432	// summary in one call.
433	func (s *service) getMe(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor) (*meResponse, error) {
434		aid, err := actorID(actor)
435		if err != nil {
436			return nil, err
437		}
438		party, err := s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, aid)
439		if err != nil {
440			return nil, err
441		}
442		assignments, err := s.listMyRoles(ctx, actor)
443		if err != nil {
444			return nil, err
445		}
446		resp := &meResponse{Party: party, Assignments: assignments}
447		if latest, err := s.repo.latestKYCRecord(ctx, aid); err == nil {
448			resp.KYC = &kycSummary{
449				RequestedTier:     latest.RequestedTier,
450				Status:            latest.Status,
451				AadhaarLast4:      latest.AadhaarLast4,
452				BankAccountMasked: latest.BankAccountMasked,
453				BankIFSC:          latest.BankIFSC,
454				BankVerified:      latest.BankVerified,
455				VerifiedAt:        latest.VerifiedAt,
456			}
457		} else if !isNotFound(err) {
458			return nil, err
459		}
460		return resp, nil
461	}
462	
463	// patchMe updates the caller's own profile fields.
464	func (s *service) patchMe(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req patchMeRequest) (*domain.Party, error) {
465		aid, err := actorID(actor)
466		if err != nil {
467			return nil, err
468		}
469		return s.repo.updatePartyProfile(ctx, aid, req.FullName, req.PreferredLanguage, time.Now().UTC())
470	}
471	
472	// --- KYC (mock DPI adapters — real UIDAI / penny-drop integration later) ---
473	
474	// verifyAadhaar runs the MOCK Aadhaar eKYC capture (§18-A). The full Aadhaar
475	// number exists only in this request's memory: what is persisted is the
476	// last 4 digits plus an opaque reference from the (mock) Aadhaar Data Vault.
477	//
478	// There is NO auto-verify and NO tier change here: the record is created
479	// PENDING and enters the approval workflow. Returns created=false when an
480	// identical PENDING request already exists (idempotent replay → 200).
481	func (s *service) verifyAadhaar(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req aadhaarKYCRequest) (*aadhaarKYCResponse, bool, error) {
482		now := time.Now().UTC()
483		aid, err := actorID(actor)
484		if err != nil {
485			return nil, false, err
486		}
487		party, err := s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, aid)
488		if err != nil {
489			return nil, false, err
490		}
491	
492		// Idempotency: an existing PENDING request for the same tier is returned
493		// as-is rather than duplicated.
494		if existing, err := s.repo.findPendingKYCRecord(ctx, party.ID, req.RequestedTier); err == nil {
495			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "kyc submit replayed idempotently",
496				slog.String("kyc_id", existing.ID.Hex()),
497				slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()),
498				slog.String("requested_tier", req.RequestedTier))
499			return &aadhaarKYCResponse{
500				Record:  existing,
501				Status:  domain.KYCStatusPending,
502				Message: msgAwaitingVerification,
503			}, false, nil
504		} else if !isNotFound(err) {
505			return nil, false, err
506		}
507	
508		language := party.PreferredLanguage
509		if language == "" {
510			language = defaultLanguage
511		}
512		// Pre-generate the consent id so the KYC record can reference it in the
513		// same flow.
514		consentID := primitive.NewObjectID()
515		consent := domain.Consent{
516			ID:          consentID,
517			PartyID:     party.ID,
518			Purpose:     consentPurposeAadhaarEKYC,
519			TextVersion: consentTextVersion,
520			Language:    language,
521			GrantedAt:   now,
522		}
523		if err := s.repo.insertConsent(ctx, consent); err != nil {
524			return nil, false, err
525		}
526	
527		// MOCK Aadhaar Data Vault (§18-A): a real deployment sends the number to
528		// the vault service and receives an opaque token. The mock mints a UUID.
529		vaultRef := uuid.NewString()
530		last4 := req.AadhaarNumber[len(req.AadhaarNumber)-4:]
531	
532		record := domain.KYCRecord{
533			ID:              primitive.NewObjectID(),
534			PartyID:         party.ID,
535			RequestedTier:   req.RequestedTier,
536			AadhaarLast4:    last4,
537			AadhaarVaultRef: vaultRef,
538			ConsentID:       &consentID,
539			Status:          domain.KYCStatusPending,
540			CreatedAt:       now,
541			UpdatedAt:       now,
542		}
543		if err := s.repo.insertKYCRecord(ctx, record); err != nil {
544			return nil, false, err
545		}
546	
547		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "kyc submitted",
548			slog.String("kyc_id", record.ID.Hex()),
549			slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()),
550			slog.String("requested_tier", req.RequestedTier))
551		// Nudge reviewer dashboards: a new record entered the PENDING queue.
552		s.publishKYCQueueChanged("submitted", record.ID, party.ID)
553		return &aadhaarKYCResponse{
554			Record:  &record,
555			Status:  domain.KYCStatusPending,
556			Message: msgAwaitingVerification,
557		}, true, nil
558	}
559	
560	// publishKYCQueueChanged nudges the live "pending KYC" dashboard badge via the
561	// event bus → SSE hub. It is a nudge only; subscribers re-query the scoped
562	// pending count. Never blocks the request path (the bus dispatches async).
563	func (s *service) publishKYCQueueChanged(reason string, kycID, subjectID primitive.ObjectID) {
564		s.deps.Bus.Publish(eventbus.TopicKYCQueueChanged, eventbus.KYCQueueEvent{
565			Reason:    reason,
566			KYCID:     kycID.Hex(),
567			SubjectID: subjectID.Hex(),
568		})
569	}
570	
571	// verifyBank runs the MOCK penny-drop verification and stores ONLY the
572	// masked account tail and IFSC on the caller's latest KYC record (creating a
573	// PENDING record carrying just the bank evidence when none exists yet).
574	func (s *service) verifyBank(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req bankKYCRequest) (*domain.KYCRecord, error) {
575		now := time.Now().UTC()
576		aid, err := actorID(actor)
577		if err != nil {
578			return nil, err
579		}
580		party, err := s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, aid)
581		if err != nil {
582			return nil, err
583		}
584		masked := maskAccount(req.AccountNumber)
585	
586		latest, err := s.repo.latestKYCRecord(ctx, aid)
587		switch {
588		case err == nil && latest.Status == domain.KYCStatusPending:
589			// Only a PENDING record may accrue bank evidence in place — a reviewer
590			// has not yet decided it. MOCK penny-drop: fixed name-match score.
591			rec, err := s.repo.updateKYCRecordBank(ctx, latest.ID, masked, req.IFSC, mockPennyDropNameMatch, now)
592			if err != nil {
593				return nil, err
594			}
595			s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "bank evidence attached",
596				slog.String("kyc_id", rec.ID.Hex()), slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()))
597			return rec, nil
598		case err == nil, isNotFound(err):
599			// The latest record is terminal (VERIFIED/REJECTED) or none exists yet:
600			// a changed bank account must NOT silently overwrite reviewer-approved
601			// evidence, so route it back through review as a fresh PENDING record.
602			record := domain.KYCRecord{
603				ID:                primitive.NewObjectID(),
604				PartyID:           party.ID,
605				RequestedTier:     party.KYCTier,
606				BankAccountMasked: masked,
607				BankIFSC:          req.IFSC,
608				BankVerified:      true, // MOCK penny-drop: always succeeds
609				BankNameMatch:     mockPennyDropNameMatch,
610				Status:            domain.KYCStatusPending,
611				CreatedAt:         now,
612				UpdatedAt:         now,
613			}
614			if err := s.repo.insertKYCRecord(ctx, record); err != nil {
615				return nil, err
616			}
617			s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "bank evidence recorded on new pending kyc",
618				slog.String("kyc_id", record.ID.Hex()), slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()))
619			return &record, nil
620		default:
621			return nil, err
622		}
623	}
624	
625	// listMyKYC pages the caller's KYC records (masked fields only — full
626	// numbers are never persisted anywhere).
627	func (s *service) listMyKYC(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.KYCRecord, int64, error) {
628		aid, err := actorID(actor)
629		if err != nil {
630			return nil, 0, err
631		}
632		return s.repo.listKYCRecords(ctx, aid, page)
633	}
634	
635	// --- KYC approval workflow (reviewer console) ---
636	
637	// kycSubjectInScope reports whether the reviewer's org scope covers the KYC
638	// subject: true when the subject holds at least one active role assignment
639	// inside the reviewer's organisational scope (the KYC record itself carries
640	// no org, so the subject's org is resolved via their assignments — mirroring
641	// how createAssignment/revokeAssignment obtain the OrgUnitID). SUPER_ADMIN and
642	// STATE_AUDITOR are platform-wide and always cover; PCDF_ADMIN (rooted at the
643	// federation) covers naturally through RequireInScope's ancestry test.
644	func (s *service) kycSubjectInScope(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, subjectPartyID primitive.ObjectID) (bool, error) {
645		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSuperAdmin || actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleStateAuditor {
646			return true, nil
647		}
648		assignments, err := s.repo.listActiveAssignments(ctx, subjectPartyID)
649		if err != nil {
650			return false, err
651		}
652		for _, ra := range assignments {
653			if s.deps.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, ra.OrgUnitID) == nil {
654				return true, nil
655			}
656		}
657		return false, nil
658	}

660	// requireKYCSubjectInScope denies the reviewer a KYC decision on a subject
661	// outside their organisational scope (a cross-org privilege escalation guard).
662	func (s *service) requireKYCSubjectInScope(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, subjectPartyID primitive.ObjectID) error {
663		inScope, err := s.kycSubjectInScope(ctx, actor, subjectPartyID)
664		if err != nil {
665			return err
666		}
667		if !inScope {
668			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "kyc review denied: subject out of scope",
669				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
670				slog.String("subject_party_id", subjectPartyID.Hex()))
671			appErr := httpx.Forbidden("KYC subject is outside your organisational scope")
672			appErr.Code = "KYC_SUBJECT_OUT_OF_SCOPE"
673			return appErr
674		}
675		return nil
676	}

678	// listPendingKYC pages PENDING KYC records newest-first, constrained to
679	// subjects within the reviewer's org scope, enriched with a reviewer-facing
680	// party summary, and audits the access.
681	func (s *service) listPendingKYC(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, page httpx.Page) ([]pendingKYCItem, int64, error) {
682		records, total, err := s.repo.listPendingKYC(ctx, page)
683		if err != nil {
684			return nil, 0, err
685		}
686		ids := make([]primitive.ObjectID, 0, len(records))
687		for _, rec := range records {
688			ids = append(ids, rec.PartyID)
689		}
690		parties, err := s.repo.findPartiesByIDs(ctx, ids)
691		if err != nil {
692			return nil, 0, err
693		}
694		items := make([]pendingKYCItem, 0, len(records))
695		for _, rec := range records {
696			// Org-scope gate: a scoped reviewer only ever sees (and thus only ever
697			// gets the contact PII of) subjects within their own area.
698			inScope, err := s.kycSubjectInScope(ctx, actor, rec.PartyID)
699			if err != nil {
700				return nil, 0, err
701			}
702			if !inScope {
703				continue
704			}
705			item := pendingKYCItem{KYCRecord: rec}
706			if p, ok := parties[rec.PartyID]; ok {
707				item.Party = &pendingPartySummary{
708					ID:       p.ID,
709					Phone:    p.Phone,
710					FullName: p.FullName,
711					KYCTier:  p.KYCTier,
712				}
713			}
714			items = append(items, item)
715		}
716	
717		s.deps.Audit.Record(ctx, audit.Entry{
718			Action: "kyc.pending_list",
719			Meta:   map[string]any{"count": len(items), "total": total},
720		})
721		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "kyc pending list accessed",
722			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
723			slog.Int("count", len(items)),
724			slog.Int64("total", total))
725		return items, total, nil
726	}
727	
728	// pendingKYCScanCap bounds the scoped-count scan. The pending queue is a
729	// human-drained work-list (realistically dozens, not millions); beyond the cap
730	// the badge shows "cap+" rather than paying for an unbounded scan.
731	const pendingKYCScanCap = 1000
732	
733	// pendingKYCCount returns how many PENDING records fall within the reviewer's
734	// org scope — the live badge value. It reuses the exact scope logic of the
735	// pending list (so badge and list always agree) and dedupes the per-subject
736	// scope lookup. Returns (count, capped).
737	func (s *service) pendingKYCCount(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor) (int64, bool, error) {
738		records, _, err := s.repo.listPendingKYC(ctx, httpx.Page{Limit: pendingKYCScanCap, Offset: 0})
739		if err != nil {
740			return 0, false, err
741		}
742		scopeCache := make(map[primitive.ObjectID]bool)
743		var count int64
744		for _, rec := range records {
745			inScope, seen := scopeCache[rec.PartyID]
746			if !seen {
747				inScope, err = s.kycSubjectInScope(ctx, actor, rec.PartyID)
748				if err != nil {
749					return 0, false, err
750				}
751				scopeCache[rec.PartyID] = inScope
752			}
753			if inScope {
754				count++
755			}
756		}
757		capped := len(records) >= pendingKYCScanCap
758		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "kyc pending count",
759			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID), slog.Int64("count", count), slog.Bool("capped", capped))
760		return count, capped, nil
761	}
762	
763	// approveKYC verifies a PENDING record, upgrades the party's KYC tier upward
764	// only, notifies the party and audits the decision. The reviewer's role must
765	// be authorised for the requested tier — even SUPER_ADMIN passes through the
766	// approvable-tier map (which grants it everything).
767	func (s *service) approveKYC(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID) (*kycReviewResponse, error) {
768		now := time.Now().UTC()
769		aid, err := actorID(actor)
770		if err != nil {
771			return nil, err
772		}
773		record, err := s.repo.findKYCRecordByID(ctx, id)
774		if err != nil {
775			return nil, err
776		}
777		if record.Status != domain.KYCStatusPending {
778			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "kyc approve rejected: record not pending",
779				slog.String("kyc_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("status", record.Status),
780				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
781			return nil, httpx.Conflict("KYC_NOT_PENDING", "kyc record is not pending review")
782		}
783		// Separation of duties: a reviewer may never decide their own KYC record.
784		if record.PartyID == aid {
785			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "kyc approve rejected: self-review",
786				slog.String("kyc_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
787			appErr := httpx.Forbidden("you may not review your own KYC record")
788			appErr.Code = "KYC_SELF_REVIEW"
789			return nil, appErr
790		}
791		// Org scope: a reviewer may only decide KYC for subjects within their area.
792		if err := s.requireKYCSubjectInScope(ctx, actor, record.PartyID); err != nil {
793			return nil, err
794		}
795		if !domain.CanApproveKYCTier(actor.RoleCode, record.RequestedTier) {
796			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "kyc approve rejected: tier not approvable",
797				slog.String("kyc_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("reviewer_role", actor.RoleCode),
798				slog.String("requested_tier", record.RequestedTier))
799			appErr := httpx.Forbidden("your role may not approve KYC at the " + record.RequestedTier + " tier")
800			appErr.Code = "KYC_TIER_NOT_APPROVABLE"
801			return nil, appErr
802		}
803	
804		updated, err := s.repo.approveKYCRecord(ctx, id, aid, actor.RoleCode, now)
805		if err != nil {
806			if isNotFound(err) {
807				// Lost the race — another reviewer already moved it out of PENDING.
808				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "kyc approve lost race: record no longer pending",
809					slog.String("kyc_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
810				return nil, httpx.Conflict("KYC_NOT_PENDING", "kyc record is not pending review")
811			}
812			return nil, err
813		}
814	
815		party, err := s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, updated.PartyID)
816		if err != nil {
817			return nil, err
818		}
819		newTier := upgradedKYCTier(party.KYCTier, updated.RequestedTier)
820		if newTier != party.KYCTier {
821			if err := s.repo.updatePartyKYCTier(ctx, party.ID, newTier, now); err != nil {
822				return nil, err
823			}
824		}
825	
826		language := party.PreferredLanguage
827		if language == "" {
828			language = defaultLanguage
829		}
830		pid := party.ID
831		if err := s.repo.insertNotification(ctx, domain.Notification{
832			PartyID:     &pid,
833			Phone:       party.Phone,
834			Channel:     domain.ChannelSMS,
835			TemplateKey: domain.TemplateKYCApproved,
836			Language:    language,
837			Params:      map[string]string{"tier": updated.RequestedTier},
838			Status:      domain.NotificationQueued,
839			QueuedAt:    now,
840		}); err != nil {
841			return nil, err
842		}
843	
844		s.deps.Audit.Record(ctx, audit.Entry{
845			Action:     "kyc.approve",
846			TargetType: "kyc_record",
847			TargetID:   id.Hex(),
848			Meta: map[string]any{
849				"party_id":       party.ID.Hex(),
850				"requested_tier": updated.RequestedTier,
851				"new_tier":       newTier,
852			},
853		})
854		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "kyc approved",
855			slog.String("kyc_id", id.Hex()),
856			slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()),
857			slog.String("requested_tier", updated.RequestedTier),
858			slog.String("new_tier", newTier),
859			slog.String("reviewer_role", actor.RoleCode),
860			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
861		// Nudge reviewer dashboards: this record left the PENDING queue.
862		s.publishKYCQueueChanged("approved", id, party.ID)
863		return &kycReviewResponse{Record: updated, KYCTier: newTier}, nil
864	}

867	// notifies the party and audits the decision. Same approvable-tier authority

888				slog.String("kyc_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))

890			appErr.Code = "KYC_SELF_REVIEW"

912			}
913			return nil, err
914		}
915	
916		party, err := s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, updated.PartyID)
917		if err != nil {
918			return nil, err

924		pid := party.ID
925		if err := s.repo.insertNotification(ctx, domain.Notification{

927			Phone:       party.Phone,

929			TemplateKey: domain.TemplateKYCRejected,
930			Language:    language,
931			Params:      map[string]string{"tier": updated.RequestedTier, "reason": reason},
932			Status:      domain.NotificationQueued,
933			QueuedAt:    now,
934		}); err != nil {
935			return nil, err
936		}
937	
938		s.deps.Audit.Record(ctx, audit.Entry{
939			Action:     "kyc.reject",
940			TargetType: "kyc_record",
941			TargetID:   id.Hex(),
942			Meta: map[string]any{
943				"party_id":       party.ID.Hex(),
944				"requested_tier": updated.RequestedTier,
```
