35	type Service struct {
36		repo     *Repo
37		orgs     *orgscope.Resolver
38		ledger   *provenance.Ledger
39		qrSecret string
40		log      *slog.Logger
41	}
42	
43	// NewService wires the service from the shared dependency container and the
44	// module-scoped logger.
45	func NewService(repo *Repo, d *deps.Deps, log *slog.Logger) *Service {
46		return &Service{
47			repo:     repo,
48			orgs:     d.Orgs,
49			ledger:   d.Ledger,
50			qrSecret: d.Cfg.QRSigningSecret,
51			log:      log,
52		}
53	}
54	
55	// actorID parses the actor's party identity — carried as an ObjectID hex
56	// string in JWT claims — into the ObjectID persisted on created documents.
57	func actorID(actor auth.Actor) (primitive.ObjectID, error) {
58		return httpx.ParseID(actor.PartyID, "actor")
59	}
60	
61	// fail wraps an unexpected error with its failing operation, logs it at ERROR
62	// and returns the opaque 500 — every internal failure must name its op in the
63	// logs.
64	func (s *Service) fail(ctx context.Context, op string, err error) error {
65		err = fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", op, err)
66		s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "plant operation failed",
67			slog.String("op", op), slog.Any("err", err))
68		return httpx.Internal(err)
69	}
70	
71	// requireScope enforces the actor's org scope and logs denials at WARN so
72	// cross-scope probing is visible.
73	func (s *Service) requireScope(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, targetOrgID primitive.ObjectID, op string) error {
74		err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, targetOrgID)
75		if err == nil {
76			return nil
77		}
78		var app *httpx.AppError
79		if errors.As(err, &app) && app.Status == http.StatusForbidden {
80			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "org scope denied",
81				slog.String("op", op),
82				slog.String("target_org_id", targetOrgID.Hex()),
83				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
84				slog.String("actor_role", actor.RoleCode))
85		}
86		return err
87	}
88	
89	// --- safety-gate predicates (§8.3) ---
90	//
91	// Pure functions so the refusal matrix is unit-testable without a database.
92	// Every mutation below ALSO re-checks the status inside the MongoDB update
93	// filter, so a concurrent QC block can never slip a bad lot through.
94	
95	// canDispatchBMCLot: only a lot with a passing BMC rapid test may leave on a
96	// tanker. BLOCKED, QC_PENDING and OPEN lots stay put.
97	func canDispatchBMCLot(status string) bool {
98		return status == domain.BMCLotStatusPassed
99	}
100	
101	// canPoolBMCLot: only a DISPATCHED lot (which by construction went
102	// OPEN→QC_PENDING→PASSED→DISPATCHED) may enter a processing batch.
103	func canPoolBMCLot(status string) bool {
104		return status == domain.BMCLotStatusDispatched
105	}
106	
107	// canCompleteBatch: only a batch the plant lab has PASSED may complete.
108	func canCompleteBatch(status string) bool {
109		return status == domain.BatchStatusPassed
110	}
111	
112	// canYieldProductLot: only a COMPLETED batch may be packaged into SKU lots.
113	func canYieldProductLot(batchStatus string) bool {
114		return batchStatus == domain.BatchStatusCompleted
115	}
116	
117	// canIssueQR: a QR may only label an ACTIVE product lot whose batch is
118	// COMPLETED. This read-time check is advisory; IssueQR additionally confirms
119	// the lot is still ACTIVE with a conditional write after the QR insert, so a
120	// recall landing mid-request still stops the mint.
121	func canIssueQR(lotStatus, batchStatus string) bool {
122		return lotStatus == domain.ProductLotStatusActive && batchStatus == domain.BatchStatusCompleted
123	}
124	
125	// --- BMC lots ---
126	
127	// CreateBMCLot pools DELIVERED consignments into a new OPEN lot at a BMC.
128	func (s *Service) CreateBMCLot(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateBMCLotRequest) (*domain.BMCLot, error) {
129		actID, err := actorID(actor)
130		if err != nil {
131			return nil, err
132		}
133		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, req.BMCID, "create bmc lot"); err != nil {
134			return nil, err
135		}
136		org, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.BMCID)
137		if err != nil {
138			return nil, err
139		}
140		if org.Type != domain.OrgTypeBMC {
141			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot creation refused: org unit is not a BMC",
142				slog.String("org_unit_id", req.BMCID.Hex()),
143				slog.String("org_type", org.Type),
144				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
145			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_BMC", "org unit "+req.BMCID.Hex()+" is not a BMC")
146		}
147	
148		now := time.Now().UTC()
149		date := req.Date
150		if date == "" {
151			date = domain.DateKeyIST(now)
152		}
153	
154		ids := dedupe(req.ConsignmentIDs)
155		consignments, err := s.repo.ConsignmentsByIDs(ctx, ids)
156		if err != nil {
157			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "load consignments", err)
158		}
159		if len(consignments) != len(ids) {
160			return nil, httpx.NotFound("consignment(s) " + strings.Join(missingIDs(ids, consignments), ", "))
161		}
162		var undelivered []string
163		for _, c := range consignments {
164			if c.Status != domain.ConsignmentStatusDelivered {
165				undelivered = append(undelivered, c.ID.Hex())
166			}
167		}
168		if len(undelivered) > 0 {
169			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot creation refused: consignment(s) not DELIVERED",
170				slog.String("bmc_id", req.BMCID.Hex()),
171				slog.String("consignment_ids", strings.Join(undelivered, ",")),
172				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
173			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("CONSIGNMENT_NOT_DELIVERED",
174				"only DELIVERED consignments can be pooled into a BMC lot").
175				WithDetails(map[string]any{"consignment_ids": undelivered})
176		}
177	
178		// Optimistic claim: flip DELIVERED→ACCEPTED stamped with the new lot ID.
179		// The lot ID is pre-generated so claim, insert and ledger all agree.
180		// If another lot raced us on any consignment, release our claims and bail.
181		lotID := primitive.NewObjectID()
182		claimed, err := s.repo.ClaimConsignments(ctx, ids, lotID)
183		if err != nil {
184			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "claim consignments", err)
185		}
186		if claimed != int64(len(ids)) {
187			if relErr := s.repo.ReleaseConsignments(ctx, lotID); relErr != nil {
188				return nil, s.fail(ctx, "release consignments after lost claim", relErr)
189			}
190			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot creation lost consignment claim race",
191				slog.String("bmc_id", req.BMCID.Hex()),
192				slog.Int64("claimed", claimed), slog.Int("requested", len(ids)),
193				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
194			return nil, httpx.Conflict("CONSIGNMENT_CLAIM_CONFLICT",
195				"one or more consignments were pooled by another lot — reload and retry")
196		}
197	
198		var totalLitres float64
199		var tripIDs []primitive.ObjectID
200		seenTrip := map[primitive.ObjectID]bool{}
201		for _, c := range consignments {
202			totalLitres += c.TotalQuantityLitres
203			if c.RouteTripID != nil && !seenTrip[*c.RouteTripID] {
204				seenTrip[*c.RouteTripID] = true
205				tripIDs = append(tripIDs, *c.RouteTripID)
206			}
207		}
208	
209		lot := &domain.BMCLot{
210			ID:                  lotID,
211			BMCID:               req.BMCID,
212			Date:                date,
213			Shift:               req.Shift,
214			ConsignmentIDs:      ids,
215			RouteTripIDs:        tripIDs,
216			TotalQuantityLitres: totalLitres,
217			Status:              domain.BMCLotStatusOpen,
218			CreatedBy:           actID,
219			CreatedAt:           now,
220		}
221		if err := s.repo.InsertBMCLot(ctx, lot); err != nil {
222			_ = s.repo.ReleaseConsignments(ctx, lotID)
223			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "insert bmc lot", err)
224		}
225	
226		refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, len(ids))
227		for _, id := range ids {
228			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{
229				EntityType: domain.EntityConsignment, EntityID: id.Hex(), Relation: "pools",
230			})
231		}
232		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
233			Type:       domain.EventBMCLotCreated,
234			EntityType: domain.EntityBMCLot,
235			EntityID:   lot.ID.Hex(),
236			Refs:       refs,
237			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
238			OrgUnitID:  req.BMCID.Hex(),
239			Payload: map[string]any{
240				"date": date, "shift": req.Shift, "total_quantity_litres": totalLitres,
241			},
242		})
243		if err != nil {
244			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append bmc_lot.created event", err)
245		}
246		if err := s.repo.SetBMCLotProvenanceSeq(ctx, lot.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
247			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp bmc lot provenance seq", err)
248		}
249		lot.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
250		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "bmc lot created",
251			slog.String("bmc_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()),
252			slog.String("bmc_id", req.BMCID.Hex()),
253			slog.String("date", date), slog.String("shift", req.Shift),
254			slog.Int("consignments", len(ids)),
255			slog.Float64("total_quantity_litres", totalLitres),
256			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
257		return lot, nil
258	}
259	
260	// CloseBMCLot transitions an OPEN lot to QC_PENDING with the chilling
261	// temperature. The quality module later flips QC_PENDING→PASSED/BLOCKED.
262	func (s *Service) CloseBMCLot(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID, chillingTempC float64) (*domain.BMCLot, error) {
263		lot, err := s.getBMCLot(ctx, id)
264		if err != nil {
265			return nil, err
266		}
267		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, lot.BMCID, "close bmc lot"); err != nil {
268			return nil, err
269		}
270		if lot.Status != domain.BMCLotStatusOpen {
271			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot close refused: not OPEN",
272				slog.String("bmc_lot_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("status", lot.Status),
273				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
274			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_NOT_OPEN",
275				"only an OPEN lot can be closed; lot is "+lot.Status)
276		}
277		now := time.Now().UTC()
278		ok, err := s.repo.CloseBMCLot(ctx, id, chillingTempC, now)
279		if err != nil {
280			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "close bmc lot", err)
281		}
282		if !ok {
283			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot close lost state race",
284				slog.String("bmc_lot_id", id.Hex()),
285				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
286			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_NOT_OPEN",
287				"lot changed state concurrently — reload and retry")
288		}
289		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
290			Type:       domain.EventBMCLotClosed,
291			EntityType: domain.EntityBMCLot,
292			EntityID:   lot.ID.Hex(),
293			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
294			OrgUnitID:  lot.BMCID.Hex(),
295			Payload:    map[string]any{"chilling_temp_c": chillingTempC},
296		})
297		if err != nil {
298			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append bmc_lot.closed event", err)
299		}
300		if err := s.repo.SetBMCLotProvenanceSeq(ctx, lot.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
301			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp bmc lot provenance seq", err)
302		}
303		lot.Status = domain.BMCLotStatusQCPending
304		lot.ChillingTempC = chillingTempC
305		lot.ClosedAt = &now
306		lot.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
307		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "bmc lot closed for QC",
308			slog.String("bmc_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()),
309			slog.String("bmc_id", lot.BMCID.Hex()),
310			slog.Float64("chilling_temp_c", chillingTempC),
311			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
312		return lot, nil
313	}
314	
315	// DispatchBMCLot transitions PASSED→DISPATCHED. THE safety gate (§8.3): a
316	// BLOCKED or untested lot never leaves the chilling centre.
317	func (s *Service) DispatchBMCLot(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.BMCLot, error) {
318		lot, err := s.getBMCLot(ctx, id)
319		if err != nil {
320			return nil, err
321		}
322		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, lot.BMCID, "dispatch bmc lot"); err != nil {
323			return nil, err
324		}
325		if lot.Status == domain.BMCLotStatusDispatched {
326			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot dispatch refused: already dispatched",
327				slog.String("bmc_lot_id", id.Hex()),
328				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
329			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_ALREADY_DISPATCHED", "lot is already dispatched")
330		}
331		if !canDispatchBMCLot(lot.Status) {
332			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot dispatch refused: safety gate not passed",
333				slog.String("bmc_lot_id", id.Hex()),
334				slog.String("status", lot.Status),
335				slog.String("block_reason", lot.BlockReason),
336				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
337			msg := "lot cannot be dispatched: safety gate not passed (status " + lot.Status + ")"
338			if lot.BlockReason != "" {
339				msg += " — " + lot.BlockReason
340			}
341			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked, msg).
342				WithDetails(map[string]any{"status": lot.Status, "block_reason": lot.BlockReason})
343		}
344		now := time.Now().UTC()
345		ok, err := s.repo.DispatchBMCLot(ctx, id, now)
346		if err != nil {
347			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "dispatch bmc lot", err)
348		}
349		if !ok {
350			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot dispatch lost state race",
351				slog.String("bmc_lot_id", id.Hex()),
352				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
353			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_STATE_CHANGED",
354				"lot changed state concurrently — reload and retry")
355		}
356		// The custody transition — gate-passed milk physically leaving the
357		// chilling centre — must live on the tamper-evident chain like every
358		// other hop of the pour→QR path, not only in a mutable document field.
359		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
360			Type:       domain.EventBMCLotDispatched,
361			EntityType: domain.EntityBMCLot,
362			EntityID:   lot.ID.Hex(),
363			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
364			OrgUnitID:  lot.BMCID.Hex(),
365			Payload: map[string]any{
366				// String, not time.Time: payloads must round-trip BSON⇄JSON
367				// byte-identically or chain re-verification would break.
368				"dispatched_at":         now.Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
369				"total_quantity_litres": lot.TotalQuantityLitres,
370			},
371		})
372		if err != nil {
373			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append bmc_lot.dispatched event", err)
374		}
375		if err := s.repo.SetBMCLotProvenanceSeq(ctx, lot.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
376			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp bmc lot provenance seq", err)
377		}
378		lot.Status = domain.BMCLotStatusDispatched
379		lot.DispatchedAt = &now
380		lot.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
381		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "bmc lot dispatched",
382			slog.String("bmc_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()),
383			slog.String("bmc_id", lot.BMCID.Hex()),
384			slog.Float64("total_quantity_litres", lot.TotalQuantityLitres),
385			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
386		return lot, nil
387	}
388	
389	// ListBMCLots pages lots by BMC/date/status. A BMC operator may only list
390	// within their own scope; downstream readers (plant operator, supervisor,
391	// lab) see across BMCs — the plant receives tankers from sibling BMCs, so an
392	// ancestry check against the plant org would wrongly refuse them.
393	func (s *Service) ListBMCLots(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, f BMCLotListFilter, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.BMCLot, int64, error) {
394		if !f.BMCID.IsZero() && actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleBMCOperator {
395			if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, f.BMCID, "list bmc lots"); err != nil {
396				return nil, 0, err
397			}
398		}
399		lots, total, err := s.repo.ListBMCLots(ctx, f, page)
400		if err != nil {
401			return nil, 0, s.fail(ctx, "list bmc lots", err)
402		}
403		return lots, total, nil
404	}
405	
406	// --- processing batches ---
407	
408	// CreateBatch pools DISPATCHED (gate-passed) BMC lots into one production
409	// run. The gate re-checks here belt-and-braces: aflatoxin M1 survives
410	// pasteurisation, so a blocked lot must never reach a vat (§8.3).
411	func (s *Service) CreateBatch(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateBatchRequest) (*domain.ProcessingBatch, error) {
412		actID, err := actorID(actor)
413		if err != nil {
414			return nil, err
415		}
416		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, req.PlantID, "create batch"); err != nil {
417			return nil, err
418		}
419		org, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.PlantID)
420		if err != nil {
421			return nil, err
422		}
423		if org.Type != domain.OrgTypeProcessingPlant {
424			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch creation refused: org unit is not a plant",
425				slog.String("org_unit_id", req.PlantID.Hex()),
426				slog.String("org_type", org.Type),
427				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
428			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_PLANT", "org unit "+req.PlantID.Hex()+" is not a processing plant")
429		}
430	
431		ids := dedupe(req.BMCLotIDs)
432		lots, err := s.repo.BMCLotsByIDs(ctx, ids)
433		if err != nil {
434			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "load bmc lots", err)
435		}
436		if len(lots) != len(ids) {
437			return nil, httpx.NotFound("BMC lot(s) " + strings.Join(missingLotIDs(ids, lots), ", "))
438		}
439		var offending []string
440		var inputLitres float64
441		for _, lot := range lots {
442			if !canPoolBMCLot(lot.Status) {
443				offending = append(offending, lot.ID.Hex())
444				continue
445			}
446			inputLitres += lot.TotalQuantityLitres
447		}
448		if len(offending) > 0 {
449			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch creation refused: bmc lot(s) have not cleared the safety gate",
450				slog.String("plant_id", req.PlantID.Hex()),
451				slog.String("blocked_lot_ids", strings.Join(offending, ",")),
452				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
453			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked,
454				"one or more BMC lots have not cleared the safety gate (must be PASSED and DISPATCHED)").
455				WithDetails(map[string]any{"blocked_lot_ids": offending})
456		}
457	
458		now := time.Now().UTC()
459		dateKey := domain.DateKeyIST(now)
460		seq, err := s.repo.NextSequence(ctx, "batch_number:"+req.PlantID.Hex()+":"+dateKey)
461		if err != nil {
462			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "next batch number sequence", err)
463		}
464		batchNumber := fmt.Sprintf("BATCH-%s-%s-%04d",
465			org.Code, strings.ReplaceAll(dateKey, "-", ""), seq)
466	
467		// Optimistic claim (mirrors ClaimConsignments): flip DISPATCHED→POOLED
468		// stamped with the pre-generated batch ID BEFORE inserting the batch. One
469		// physical lot of milk can therefore never be pooled into two batches —
470		// neither by a double-submit nor by two concurrent CreateBatch calls.
471		batchID := primitive.NewObjectID()
472		claimed, err := s.repo.ClaimBMCLots(ctx, ids, batchID)
473		if err != nil {
474			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "claim bmc lots", err)
475		}
476		if claimed != int64(len(ids)) {
477			if relErr := s.repo.ReleaseBMCLots(ctx, batchID); relErr != nil {
478				return nil, s.fail(ctx, "release bmc lots after lost claim", relErr)
479			}
480			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch creation lost bmc lot claim race",
481				slog.String("plant_id", req.PlantID.Hex()),
482				slog.Int64("claimed", claimed), slog.Int("requested", len(ids)),
483				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
484			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_CLAIM_CONFLICT",
485				"one or more BMC lots were pooled by another batch — reload and retry")
486		}
487	
488		// CREATED is a transient birth state: the plant lab must clear every
489		// batch, so it is persisted straight into QC_PENDING.
490		batch := &domain.ProcessingBatch{
491			ID:          batchID,
492			PlantID:     req.PlantID,
493			BatchNumber: batchNumber,
494			BMCLotIDs:   ids,
495			ProductType: req.ProductType,
496			InputLitres: inputLitres,
497			Status:      domain.BatchStatusQCPending,
498			StartedAt:   now,
499			CreatedBy:   actID,
500			CreatedAt:   now,
501		}
502		if err := s.repo.InsertBatch(ctx, batch); err != nil {
503			_ = s.repo.ReleaseBMCLots(ctx, batchID)
504			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "insert batch", err)
505		}
506	
507		refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, len(ids))
508		for _, id := range ids {
509			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{
510				EntityType: domain.EntityBMCLot, EntityID: id.Hex(), Relation: "pools",
511			})
512		}
513		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
514			Type:       domain.EventBatchCreated,
515			EntityType: domain.EntityBatch,
516			EntityID:   batch.ID.Hex(),
517			Refs:       refs,
518			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
519			OrgUnitID:  req.PlantID.Hex(),
520			Payload: map[string]any{
521				"batch_number": batchNumber, "product_type": req.ProductType, "input_litres": inputLitres,
522			},
523		})
524		if err != nil {
525			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append batch.created event", err)
526		}
527		if err := s.repo.SetBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx, batch.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
528			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp batch provenance seq", err)
529		}
530		batch.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
531		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "processing batch created",
532			slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
533			slog.String("batch_number", batchNumber),
534			slog.String("plant_id", req.PlantID.Hex()),
535			slog.String("product_type", req.ProductType),
536			slog.Int("bmc_lots", len(ids)),
537			slog.Float64("input_litres", inputLitres),
538			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
539		return batch, nil
540	}
541	
542	// CompleteBatch transitions PASSED→COMPLETED — only a batch the plant lab
543	// cleared may finish and go on to yield product lots.
544	func (s *Service) CompleteBatch(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.ProcessingBatch, error) {
545		batch, err := s.getBatch(ctx, id)
546		if err != nil {
547			return nil, err
548		}
549		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, batch.PlantID, "complete batch"); err != nil {
550			return nil, err
551		}
552		if batch.Status == domain.BatchStatusCompleted {
553			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch completion refused: already completed",
554				slog.String("batch_id", id.Hex()),
555				slog.String("batch_number", batch.BatchNumber),
556				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
557			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BATCH_ALREADY_COMPLETED", "batch is already completed")
558		}
559		if !canCompleteBatch(batch.Status) {
560			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch completion refused: plant-lab QC not passed",
561				slog.String("batch_id", id.Hex()),
562				slog.String("batch_number", batch.BatchNumber),
563				slog.String("status", batch.Status),
564				slog.String("block_reason", batch.BlockReason),
565				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
566			msg := "batch cannot complete: plant-lab QC not passed (status " + batch.Status + ")"
567			if batch.BlockReason != "" {
568				msg += " — " + batch.BlockReason
569			}
570			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked, msg).
571				WithDetails(map[string]any{"status": batch.Status, "block_reason": batch.BlockReason})
572		}
573		now := time.Now().UTC()
574		ok, err := s.repo.CompleteBatch(ctx, id, now)
575		if err != nil {
576			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "complete batch", err)
577		}
578		if !ok {
579			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch completion lost state race",
580				slog.String("batch_id", id.Hex()),
581				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
582			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BATCH_STATE_CHANGED",
583				"batch changed state concurrently — reload and retry")
584		}
585		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
586			Type:       domain.EventBatchCompleted,
587			EntityType: domain.EntityBatch,
588			EntityID:   batch.ID.Hex(),
589			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
590			OrgUnitID:  batch.PlantID.Hex(),
591			Payload:    map[string]any{"batch_number": batch.BatchNumber},
592		})
593		if err != nil {
594			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append batch.completed event", err)
595		}
596		if err := s.repo.SetBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx, batch.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
597			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp batch provenance seq", err)
598		}
599		batch.Status = domain.BatchStatusCompleted
600		batch.CompletedAt = &now
601		batch.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
602		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "processing batch completed",
603			slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
604			slog.String("batch_number", batch.BatchNumber),
605			slog.String("plant_id", batch.PlantID.Hex()),
606			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
607		return batch, nil
608	}

638	// CreateProductLot packages a COMPLETED batch into a SKU lot (gate re-check).
639	func (s *Service) CreateProductLot(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateProductLotRequest) (*domain.ProductLot, error) {
640		batch, err := s.getBatch(ctx, req.BatchID)
641		if err != nil {
642			return nil, err
643		}
644		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, batch.PlantID, "create product lot"); err != nil {
645			return nil, err
646		}
647		if !canYieldProductLot(batch.Status) {
648			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "product lot creation refused: batch has not completed the safety gate",
649				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
650				slog.String("batch_number", batch.BatchNumber),
651				slog.String("batch_status", batch.Status),
652				slog.String("block_reason", batch.BlockReason),
653				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
654			msg := "batch has not completed the safety gate (status " + batch.Status + ") — no product lots may be made"
655			if batch.BlockReason != "" {
656				msg += " — " + batch.BlockReason
657			}
658			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked, msg).
659				WithDetails(map[string]any{"batch_status": batch.Status, "block_reason": batch.BlockReason})
660		}
661	
662		now := time.Now().UTC()
663		mfgDate := req.MfgDate
664		if mfgDate == "" {
665			mfgDate = domain.DateKeyIST(now)
666		}
667		if req.ExpiryDate <= mfgDate {
668			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_EXPIRY", "expiry_date must be after mfg_date")
669		}
670	
671		lot := &domain.ProductLot{
672			ID:          primitive.NewObjectID(),
673			BatchID:     batch.ID,
674			PlantID:     batch.PlantID,
675			SKU:         req.SKU,
676			ProductName: req.ProductName,
677			Units:       req.Units,
678			UnitSize:    req.UnitSize,
679			MRP:         req.MRP,
680			MfgDate:     mfgDate,
681			ExpiryDate:  req.ExpiryDate,
682			Status:      domain.ProductLotStatusActive,
683			CreatedAt:   now,
684		}
685		if err := s.repo.InsertProductLot(ctx, lot); err != nil {
686			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "insert product lot", err)
687		}
688		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
689			Type:       domain.EventProductLotMade,
690			EntityType: domain.EntityProductLot,
691			EntityID:   lot.ID.Hex(),
692			Refs: []provenance.Ref{
693				{EntityType: domain.EntityBatch, EntityID: batch.ID.Hex(), Relation: "yields"},
694			},
695			Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
696			OrgUnitID: batch.PlantID.Hex(),
697			Payload: map[string]any{
698				"sku": req.SKU, "units": req.Units, "unit_size": req.UnitSize,
699				"mfg_date": mfgDate, "expiry_date": req.ExpiryDate,
700			},
701		})
702		if err != nil {
703			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append product_lot.created event", err)
704		}
705		if err := s.repo.SetProductLotProvenanceSeq(ctx, lot.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
706			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp product lot provenance seq", err)
707		}
708		lot.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
709		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "product lot created",
710			slog.String("product_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()),
711			slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
712			slog.String("batch_number", batch.BatchNumber),
713			slog.String("sku", req.SKU),
714			slog.Int("units", req.Units),
715			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
716		return lot, nil
717	}

740				slog.String("product_lot_id", id.Hex()),
741				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
742			return nil, httpx.Conflict("PRODUCT_LOT_ALREADY_RECALLED", "product lot is already recalled")
743		}
744		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
745			Type:       domain.EventProductRecalled,
746			EntityType: domain.EntityProductLot,

748			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
749			OrgUnitID:  lot.PlantID.Hex(),
750			Payload:    map[string]any{"reason": reason},
751		})
752		if err != nil {
753			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append product_lot.recalled event", err)
754		}
755		if err := s.repo.SetProductLotProvenanceSeq(ctx, lot.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
756			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp product lot provenance seq", err)
757		}

761		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "product lot recalled",

763			slog.String("plant_id", lot.PlantID.Hex()),
764			slog.String("sku", lot.SKU),
765			slog.String("reason", reason),
766			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
767		return lot, nil
768	}
769	
770	// --- QR issuance ---
771	
772	// qrAlphabet is the 32-character human-safe set for short codes: A–Z and 2–9
773	// minus the confusables 0/O and 1/I. 32 divides 256, so a byte modulo the
774	// alphabet length is unbiased.
775	const qrAlphabet = "ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789"
776	
777	// qrCodeLength is the number of random characters after the "PRG-" prefix
778	// (32^8 ≈ 1.1 trillion codes — collisions are retried on the unique index).
779	const qrCodeLength = 8
780	
781	// newQRCode mints a short public code like "[REDACTED:generic-api-key]" from crypto/rand.
782	func newQRCode() (string, error) {
783		buf := make([]byte, qrCodeLength)
784		if _, err := rand.Read(buf); err != nil {
785			return "", err
786		}
787		code := make([]byte, qrCodeLength)
788		for i, b := range buf {
789			code[i] = qrAlphabet[int(b)%len(qrAlphabet)]
790		}
791		return "PRG-" + string(code), nil
792	}
793	
794	// signQRToken builds the forgery-proof token printed inside the QR:
795	// base64url(qr_code|product_lot_hex|issued_unix) + "." + hex(HMAC-SHA256).
796	// productLotHex is the product lot ObjectID's hex form — the HMAC material is
797	// "qr_code|lot hex|unix", and the publictrace module verifies the exact same
798	// shape. The consumer app resolves the payload; the signature proves it was
799	// minted by this server, so IDs cannot be guessed onto counterfeit packs.
800	func signQRToken(secret, qrCode, productLotHex string, issuedAt time.Time) string {
801		payload := qrCode + "|" + productLotHex + "|" + strconv.FormatInt(issuedAt.Unix(), 10)
802		mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte(secret))
803		mac.Write([]byte(payload))
804		return base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(payload)) + "." + hex.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))
805	}
806	
807	// parseQRToken verifies and unpacks a signed QR token, returning the product
808	// lot ObjectID as its hex string.
809	func parseQRToken(secret, token string) (qrCode, productLotHex string, issuedAt time.Time, err error) {
810		payloadB64, sigHex, found := strings.Cut(token, ".")
811		if !found {
812			return "", "", time.Time{}, errors.New("qr token: missing signature separator")
813		}
814		payloadBytes, err := base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString(payloadB64)
815		if err != nil {
816			return "", "", time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("qr token: bad payload encoding: %w", err)
817		}
818		sig, err := hex.DecodeString(sigHex)
819		if err != nil {
820			return "", "", time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("qr token: bad signature encoding: %w", err)
821		}
822		mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte(secret))
823		mac.Write(payloadBytes)
824		if !hmac.Equal(sig, mac.Sum(nil)) {
825			return "", "", time.Time{}, errors.New("qr token: signature mismatch")
826		}
827		parts := strings.Split(string(payloadBytes), "|")
828		if len(parts) != 3 {
829			return "", "", time.Time{}, errors.New("qr token: malformed payload")
830		}
831		unix, err := strconv.ParseInt(parts[2], 10, 64)
832		if err != nil {
833			return "", "", time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("qr token: bad timestamp: %w", err)
834		}
835		return parts[0], parts[1], time.Unix(unix, 0).UTC(), nil
836	}
837	
838	// IssueQR mints one signed QR for an ACTIVE product lot whose batch is
839	// COMPLETED. The gate is checked on read AND re-confirmed with a conditional
840	// write on the lot after the QR insert, so recalled or blocked product can
841	// never be freshly labelled even when the recall races this request.
842	func (s *Service) IssueQR(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, productLotID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.BatchQR, error) {
843		actID, err := actorID(actor)
844		if err != nil {
845			return nil, err
846		}
847		lot, err := s.getProductLot(ctx, productLotID)
848		if err != nil {
849			return nil, err
850		}
851		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, lot.PlantID, "issue qr"); err != nil {
852			return nil, err
853		}
854		batch, err := s.getBatch(ctx, lot.BatchID)
855		if err != nil {
856			return nil, err
857		}
858		if !canIssueQR(lot.Status, batch.Status) {
859			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qr issuance refused: safety gate",
860				slog.String("product_lot_id", productLotID.Hex()),
861				slog.String("product_lot_status", lot.Status),
862				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
863				slog.String("batch_status", batch.Status),
864				slog.String("recall_reason", lot.RecallReason),
865				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
866			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked,
867				"QR issuance refused: product lot must be ACTIVE and its batch COMPLETED").
868				WithDetails(map[string]any{
869					"product_lot_status": lot.Status,
870					"batch_status":       batch.Status,
871					"recall_reason":      lot.RecallReason,
872				})
873		}
874	
875		now := time.Now().UTC()
876		var qr *domain.BatchQR
877		const maxMintAttempts = 5
878		for attempt := 0; attempt < maxMintAttempts; attempt++ {
879			code, err := newQRCode()
880			if err != nil {
881				return nil, s.fail(ctx, "generate qr code", err)
882			}
883			candidate := &domain.BatchQR{
884				ID:           primitive.NewObjectID(),
885				QRCode:       code,
886				ProductLotID: lot.ID,
887				SignedToken:  signQRToken(s.qrSecret, code, lot.ID.Hex(), now),
888				IssuedBy:     actID,
889				ScanCount:    0,
890				IssuedAt:     now,
891			}
892			insertErr := s.repo.InsertQR(ctx, candidate)
893			if insertErr == nil {
894				qr = candidate
895				break
896			}
897			if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(insertErr) {
898				continue // short-code collision — regenerate
899			}
900			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "insert qr", insertErr)
901		}
902		if qr == nil {
903			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "mint qr code",
904				fmt.Errorf("%d consecutive short-code collisions", maxMintAttempts))
905		}
906	
907		// Recall re-check at WRITE time: the initial read cannot see a recall that
908		// lands mid-request, so the mint is confirmed with a conditional no-op
909		// write on the lot (filter status=ACTIVE). If the lot left ACTIVE, the
910		// just-inserted QR is deleted and issuance refused — a freshly minted QR
911		// can never label recalled product.
912		active, err := s.repo.TouchActiveLot(ctx, lot.ID)
913		if err != nil {
914			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "confirm product lot active", err)
915		}
916		if !active {
917			if delErr := s.repo.DeleteQR(ctx, qr.ID); delErr != nil {
918				return nil, s.fail(ctx, "delete qr after lot left ACTIVE", delErr)
919			}
920			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qr issuance refused: product lot left ACTIVE during issuance",
921				slog.String("product_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()),
922				slog.String("qr_id", qr.ID.Hex()),
923				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
924			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked,
925				"QR issuance refused: product lot left ACTIVE (e.g. recalled) during issuance")
926		}
927	
928		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
929			Type:       domain.EventQRIssued,
930			EntityType: domain.EntityBatchQR,
931			EntityID:   qr.ID.Hex(),
932			Refs: []provenance.Ref{
933				{EntityType: domain.EntityProductLot, EntityID: lot.ID.Hex(), Relation: "labels"},
934			},
935			Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
936			OrgUnitID: lot.PlantID.Hex(),
937			Payload:   map[string]any{"qr_code": qr.QRCode},
938		})
939		if err != nil {
940			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append qr.issued event", err)
941		}
942		if err := s.repo.SetQRProvenanceSeq(ctx, qr.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
943			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp qr provenance seq", err)
944		}
945		qr.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
946		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "qr issued",
947			slog.String("qr_id", qr.ID.Hex()),
948			slog.String("qr_code", qr.QRCode),
949			slog.String("product_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()),
950			slog.String("plant_id", lot.PlantID.Hex()),
951			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
952		return qr, nil
953	}

1009	// dedupe removes zero and duplicate IDs preserving first-seen order.
1010	func dedupe(ids []primitive.ObjectID) []primitive.ObjectID {
1011		seen := make(map[primitive.ObjectID]bool, len(ids))
1012		out := make([]primitive.ObjectID, 0, len(ids))
1013		for _, id := range ids {
1014			if id.IsZero() || seen[id] {
1015				continue
1016			}
1017			seen[id] = true
1018			out = append(out, id)
1019		}
1020		return out
1021	}
1022	
1023	// missingIDs lists requested consignment IDs (as hex) absent from the fetched
1024	// set.
1025	func missingIDs(wanted []primitive.ObjectID, got []domain.DCSConsignment) []string {
1026		have := make(map[primitive.ObjectID]bool, len(got))
1027		for _, c := range got {
1028			have[c.ID] = true
1029		}
1030		var missing []string
1031		for _, id := range wanted {
1032			if !have[id] {

```text
I have all the information needed. Here is my detailed report.

---

# ONBOARDING → NOTIFICATION → VERIFICATION → APPROVAL: Verification Report

## Verdict
The relation **exists only partially**. The VERIFICATION-pending record and the APPROVAL flow are fully implemented and correct. But the **NOTIFICATION-to-reviewer on submit is missing** (only an ephemeral SSE badge nudge fires, no persisted notification), the **assisted-onboarding request entity the FE expects does not exist on the backend at all**, and **approval does not create the role assignment** the FE relation model assumes.

---

## 1. Current KYC verification relation (what actually happens)

**Submit — `POST /kyc/aadhaar` → `verifyAadhaar`** (`internal/modules/identity/service.go:486-563`)
- Creates a `KYCRecord` with `Status = PENDING` (`domain.KYCStatusPending`), `RequestedTier`, `AadhaarLast4`, opaque `AadhaarVaultRef`, and a linked `Consent`. Idempotent on an existing PENDING record for the same tier.
- **Who is notified? NOBODY.** There is *no* `insertNotification` call in `verifyAadhaar`. No notification row is queued to a reviewer or admin. (The only notification on any submit-type path is the login OTP in `requestOTP`, unrelated.)
- **SSE badge fired? YES.** `publishKYCQueueChanged("submitted", …)` (`service.go:557,568`) → `Bus.Publish(TopicKYCQueueChanged, KYCQueueEvent{…})`. The bridge in `cmd/server/main.go:107-120` subscribes and calls `sseHub.Broadcast(Event{Type:"kyc.pending.changed", Roles:[…]})`. Connected reviewer dashboards re-fetch `GET /kyc/pending/count` (`handler.go:272-286`, service `pendingKYCCount` at `service.go:742`). This is *nudge-then-recount*: ephemeral, in-process, lossy (buffer-full sends are dropped, `hub.go:119`), delivered only to dashboards open at that instant.

**Approve — `POST /kyc/{id}/approve` → `approveKYC`** (`service.go:772-869`)
- Guards, in order: record must be PENDING (else `409 KYC_NOT_PENDING`); self-review forbidden (`KYC_SELF_REVIEW`); org-scope (`requireKYCSubjectInScope`); tier authority (`CanApproveKYCTier`).
- Atomically flips PENDING→VERIFIED via `approveKYCRecord`, stamping `reviewed_by`, `reviewed_by_role`, `reviewed_at`, `verified_at` (race-safe: a lost race returns `KYC_NOT_PENDING`).
- **Party tier upgraded? YES.** `upgradedKYCTier(party.KYCTier, requestedTier)` (upgrade-only, never downgrade) → `updatePartyKYCTier`. The relation `KYCRecord.party_id → Party.kyc_tier` is wired and works.
- **Party gets KYC_APPROVED notification? YES.** Inserts `domain.Notification{TemplateKey: TemplateKYCApproved, Channel: SMS, Params:{tier}}` addressed to the **party** (`service.go:836-847`). Rendered EN/HI in `platformops/service.go:243-245`. Audited (`kyc.approve`) and `publishKYCQueueChanged("approved", …)` re-nudges.
- **Reject** (`rejectKYC`, `service.go:874-963`) is symmetric: `TemplateKYCRejected` with `reason` to the party, audited, nudge `"rejected"`.

So the chain **submit(PENDING) → [reviewer notified] → approve → party notified + tier upgraded** is intact **except** the bracketed "reviewer notified" link, which is SSE-only, not a persisted notification.

---

## 2. NOTIFICATION relation on submit — GAP (user's explicit requirement)

The user wants "**a notification + verification-pending should be created**" after onboarding. Current state:
- **Verification-pending record:** ✅ created (`KYCRecord` PENDING).
- **Notification to reviewer:** ❌ **not created.** There is only the in-memory SSE nudge. No outbox/notification row, no persistent "a verification is pending" alert. If no reviewer dashboard is live at that moment, *nothing* informs a reviewer; discovery relies entirely on a reviewer manually polling `GET /kyc/pending`.

This is the primary gap against the stated requirement. Note also the `KYCRecord` carries **no org and no intended-reviewer field** (`kycSubjectInScope` comment at `service.go:642-648` confirms "the KYC record itself carries no org"), so there is currently no addressee even if one wanted to queue a reviewer notification — the reviewer set is computed dynamically from the subject's assignments' org scope.

---

## 3. Assisted-onboarding flow the FE expects — NOT IMPLEMENTED

`parag-saathi-fe/src/core/api/endpoints/onboarding.ts` expects these endpoints (all marked `// TODO(backend)`, mock-only):
- `POST /onboarding/requests` (submit)
- `GET /onboarding/requests?submitted_by=…` (my submissions)
- `GET /onboarding/requests?status=PENDING` (reviewer queue)
- `POST /onboarding/requests/{id}/approve`
- `POST /onboarding/requests/{id}/reject`
- `GET /parties?role=SAMITI_SACHEEV` (`listSachivs`)

**Backend implements NONE of these.** Confirmed: no `OnboardingRequest` entity anywhere in `internal/` (grep returns zero), no `/onboarding` route in any module, and `/parties` (`identity/module.go:46-50`) exposes only `GET /me` and `PATCH /me` — no `?role=` listing.

**FE relation model (single-entity, proxy/assisted):** an `ONBOARDING_EXECUTIVE` submits one `OnboardingRequest` (domain.ts:625) bundling person details + requested `role` + `orgUnitId` + KYC doc/photos + role-specific fields (`cattleCount`, `cattleBreed`, `vehicleNumber`, `employeeId`, `kycNote`). It enters a PENDING queue; a `SUPER_ADMIN` approves → **atomically creates the Party + pushes a RoleAssignment** (onboarding.ts:162-188), deriving `kycTier` from `ROLES[role].kycTier`.

**Backend model (three disjoint flows, self-service):**
- `Party` is created implicitly at **OTP login** (`upsertPartyByPhone`, `verifyOTP`), not at onboarding approval.
- KYC is a **self-service submit by the subject themselves** — `verifyAadhaar` uses the *actor's own* party id (`actorID(actor)`), so there is no path for an executive to submit KYC *on behalf of* a not-yet-logged-in person.
- `RoleAssignment` is a **separate admin action** (`POST /roles/assignments`, `createAssignment`).

**What's missing to satisfy the FE:** the entire `OnboardingRequest` entity + 5 routes; the `GET /parties?role=` listing; storage for `profilePhotoUri`/`kycPhotoUri`/`documentType`/role-specific fields (only `DigiLockerDocs`/`VideoKYCRef` exist on `KYCRecord` and neither is wired to a submit path); and a proxy/assisted enrolment path (executive-enrols-another-person). The backend has no single object binding person+role+KYC+photos, and no atomic "approve → create Party + KYCRecord + RoleAssignment."

---

## 4. Super_admin's role in approval — CONFIRMED unrestricted (for KYC)

- **`CanApproveKYCTier`** (`domain/roles.go:179-196`): `KYCApprovableTiers[SUPER_ADMIN] = {MINIMAL, FARMER, STANDARD, RIDER, HIGH, HIGHEST, SERVICE}` — **every tier**. Super_admin can approve any KYC tier. (Contrast: `ORGANISING_MANAGER`/`ONBOARDING_EXECUTIVE`/`DISTRICT_VERIFIER` cap at RIDER; `PCDF_ADMIN` adds HIGH; only SUPER_ADMIN gets HIGHEST/SERVICE.)
- **Route access**: `OnboardingReviewerRoles` (`roles.go:89-91`) = `{ONBOARDING_EXECUTIVE, ORGANISING_MANAGER, DISTRICT_VERIFIER, PCDF_ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN}` gates `/kyc/pending`, `/approve`, `/reject` (`module.go:65-71`). SUPER_ADMIN is included.
- **Org scope**: `kycSubjectInScope` (`service.go:649-663`) returns `true` unconditionally for `SUPER_ADMIN` (and `STATE_AUDITOR`) → platform-wide, can approve **any** subject regardless of org.

Net: super_admin can approve **any KYC tier for any subject**. For *onboarding requests*, "who approves" is moot — no backend onboarding approval exists; the FE mock simply hardcodes `SUPER_ADMIN` as approver.

---

## 5. BUGS / GAPS (concrete)

1. **No reviewer notification on KYC submit** — `verifyAadhaar` (`service.go:486-563`) queues no `Notification`. Only an ephemeral, single-process, lossy SSE nudge (`publishKYCQueueChanged`) informs reviewers, and only those with a live dashboard. The user's "notification + verification-pending" is half-met: the PENDING record exists, the notification does not. *This is the headline gap.*

2. **SSE nudge role targeting omits `ONBOARDING_EXECUTIVE`** — `cmd/server/main.go:115-118` broadcasts to `{ORGANISING_MANAGER, DISTRICT_VERIFIER, PCDF_ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN}`, but `domain.OnboardingReviewerRoles` also includes `ONBOARDING_EXECUTIVE`. An ONBOARDING_EXECUTIVE reviewer — a first-class reviewer that *can* hit `/kyc/pending` and approve — never receives the live badge nudge; their badge only updates on manual refresh. Inconsistency between the two role lists.

3. **Assisted-onboarding request entity + endpoints entirely absent** — no `OnboardingRequest` type, no `POST/GET /onboarding/requests`, no `…/approve`, `…/reject`. FE `onboarding.ts` is 100% mock. There is no atomic "approve → create Party + KYCRecord + RoleAssignment."

4. **`GET /parties?role=` missing** — `listSachivs` (FE) has no backend; `/parties` only serves `/me`.

5. **Relation-model mismatch (proxy vs self-service)** — FE assumes one executive-submitted request that an admin approves to spawn Party+role. Backend splits this into login-time Party creation, subject-self-service KYC, and a separate admin role grant, with **no path for an executive to enrol a person who has not logged in themselves** (`verifyAadhaar` binds to the actor's own party id).

6. **APPROVAL → role relation incomplete** — `approveKYC` upgrades `Party.kyc_tier` but does **not** create any `RoleAssignment`. After KYC approval the party has the tier but still no role until a separate `POST /roles/assignments` call. The FE relation model expects approval to also produce the assignment; the backend does not.

7. **`KYCRecord` has no reviewer/org linkage at creation** — no field naming an intended reviewer/org, and no queued notification, so "who should verify this" is resolved only dynamically via the subject's assignment org-scope at list time. Reinforces gaps #1/#5.

### Minor / non-functional
- `STATE_AUDITOR` is short-circuited to "in scope for all" in `kycSubjectInScope` (`service.go:650`) but is absent from both `OnboardingReviewerRoles` and `KYCApprovableTiers`, so `RequireRoles` blocks it from ever reaching approve/reject — dead branch, not a live bug.

- Backend KYC/approval: `/Users/divyanshmangla/parag-saathi-be/internal/modules/identity/service.go`, `module.go`, `handler.go`
- Tier/role logic: `/Users/divyanshmangla/parag-saathi-be/internal/domain/roles.go` (`CanApproveKYCTier`, `OnboardingReviewerRoles`, `RequiredKYCTier`), `party.go`, `notification.go`

35			batches:      db.Collection(mongodb.CollBatches),

46		cur, err := r.consignments.Find(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: ids}}}})
47		if err != nil {
48			return nil, err
49		}
50		out := []domain.DCSConsignment{}

52			return nil, err
53		}
54		return out, nil

64				{Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusDelivered},

216			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "date", Value: -1}, {Key: "created_at", Value: -1}}).

228	// --- processing batches ---
229	
230	// NextSequence atomically increments and returns the named counter — the
231	// transaction-free way to mint gapless human-readable numbers.
232	func (r *Repo) NextSequence(ctx context.Context, key string) (int64, error) {
233		var doc struct {
234			Seq int64 `bson:"seq"`
235		}
236		err := r.counters.FindOneAndUpdate(ctx,
237			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: key}},
238			bson.D{{Key: "$inc", Value: bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: int64(1)}}}},
239			options.FindOneAndUpdate().SetUpsert(true).SetReturnDocument(options.After),
240		).Decode(&doc)
241		if err != nil {
242			return 0, err
243		}
244		return doc.Seq, nil
245	}

257			return nil, err
258		}

262	// CompleteBatch transitions PASSED→COMPLETED. The status filter enforces the
263	// gate: an unpassed batch can never match.
264	func (r *Repo) CompleteBatch(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID, completedAt time.Time) (bool, error) {
265		res, err := r.batches.UpdateOne(ctx,
266			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}, {Key: "status", Value: domain.BatchStatusPassed}},
267			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
268				{Key: "status", Value: domain.BatchStatusCompleted},
269				{Key: "completed_at", Value: completedAt},
270			}}},
271		)
272		if err != nil {
273			return false, err
274		}
275		return res.MatchedCount > 0, nil
276	}

327	// RecallProductLot flips any not-yet-recalled lot to RECALLED with the reason.
328	// Returns false when the lot was already recalled (idempotency guard).
329	func (r *Repo) RecallProductLot(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID, reason string) (bool, error) {
330		res, err := r.productLots.UpdateOne(ctx,
331			bson.D{
332				{Key: "_id", Value: id},
333				{Key: "status", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$ne", Value: domain.ProductLotStatusRecalled}}},
334			},

336				{Key: "status", Value: domain.ProductLotStatusRecalled},
337				{Key: "recall_reason", Value: reason},
338			}}},

341			return false, err
342		}
343		return res.MatchedCount > 0, nil

349	// short code collided — the service regenerates and retries.

355	// DeleteQR removes a just-minted QR whose lot turned out to be no longer
356	// ACTIVE at write time (compensating action — the QR was never returned to
357	// the caller, so nothing references it).

359		_, err := r.qrs.DeleteOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}})
360		return err

363	// TouchActiveLot performs a no-op conditional write on an ACTIVE product lot
364	// ($inc of a stamp counter). MatchedCount == 0 proves the lot is no longer
365	// ACTIVE (e.g. recalled mid-request) at datastore level.
366	func (r *Repo) TouchActiveLot(ctx context.Context, lotID primitive.ObjectID) (bool, error) {
367		res, err := r.productLots.UpdateOne(ctx,
368			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: lotID}, {Key: "status", Value: domain.ProductLotStatusActive}},
369			bson.D{{Key: "$inc", Value: bson.D{{Key: "qr_issue_stamp", Value: int64(1)}}}},
370		)
371		if err != nil {
372			return false, err
373		}
374		return res.MatchedCount > 0, nil
375	}

1	package orgs
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"errors"

8		"strings"
9		"time"
10	
11		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
12		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
13		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
14	
15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
16		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
17		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"

19	)
20	
21	// maxTreeNodes caps a subtree response (root included) so a federation-level
22	// tree read can never return an unbounded list.
23	const maxTreeNodes = 500
24	
25	// service holds all business logic of the orgs module.
26	type service struct {
27		repo  *repository
28		scope *orgscope.Resolver
29		log   *slog.Logger
30	}
31	
32	func newService(repo *repository, scope *orgscope.Resolver, log *slog.Logger) *service {
33		return &service{repo: repo, scope: scope, log: log}
34	}
35	
36	// fail routes an error out of the service: expected AppErrors (404s from the
37	// repo, platform errors) pass through untouched; anything unexpected — or an
38	// AppError already carrying a 5xx — is logged at ERROR with the failing
39	// operation before the client sees an opaque 500.
40	func (s *service) fail(ctx context.Context, op string, err error) error {
41		var appErr *httpx.AppError
42		ok := errors.As(err, &appErr)
43		if !ok || appErr.Status >= http.StatusInternalServerError {
44			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "orgs operation failed",
45				slog.String("op", op),
46				slog.Any("err", err))
47		}
48		if ok {
49			return err
50		}
51		return httpx.Internal(err)
52	}
53	
54	// scopeErr handles a RequireInScope failure: scope denials (403) are logged
55	// at WARN with the actor and target; other errors go through fail.
56	func (s *service) scopeErr(ctx context.Context, op string, actor auth.Actor, targetOrgID primitive.ObjectID, err error) error {
57		var appErr *httpx.AppError
58		if errors.As(err, &appErr) && appErr.Status == http.StatusForbidden {
59			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "org scope denial",
60				slog.String("op", op),
61				slog.String("target_org_id", targetOrgID.Hex()),
62				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
63				slog.String("actor_org_id", actor.OrgUnitID),
64				slog.String("reason", appErr.Message))
65			return err
66		}
67		return s.fail(ctx, op, err)
68	}
69	
70	// validateHierarchy checks whether an org unit of childType may be created
71	// under a parent of parentType ("" = no parent), per domain.ValidOrgParent.
72	// Pure function — unit-tested against the full type matrix.
73	func validateHierarchy(childType, parentType string) *httpx.AppError {
74		if !domain.IsValidOrgType(childType) {
75			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_ORG_TYPE", "unknown org type "+childType)
76		}
77		allowed := domain.ValidOrgParent[childType]
78		if len(allowed) == 0 { // hierarchy root
79			if parentType != "" {
80				return httpx.Unprocessable("ORG_PARENT_TYPE_INVALID",
81					childType+" is the hierarchy root and cannot have a parent")
82			}
83			return nil
84		}
85		if parentType == "" {
86			return httpx.BadRequest("ORG_PARENT_REQUIRED", childType+" requires a parent_id")
87		}
88		for _, t := range allowed {
89			if t == parentType {
90				return nil
91			}
92		}
93		return httpx.Unprocessable("ORG_PARENT_TYPE_INVALID",
94			childType+" cannot be created under a "+parentType)
95	}
96	
97	// Create validates the hierarchy edge and inserts a new org unit
98	// (POST /orgs, blueprint §5.1).
99	func (s *service) Create(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateOrgRequest) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
100		name := strings.TrimSpace(req.Name)
101		if name == "" {
102			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_NAME", "name is required")
103		}
104		code := strings.TrimSpace(req.Code)
105		if code == "" {
106			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_CODE", "code is required")
107		}
108	
109		// Resolve the parent (if any) and validate the hierarchy edge.
110		var parent *domain.OrgUnit
111		if req.ParentID != nil && !req.ParentID.IsZero() {
112			var err error
113			parent, err = s.repo.getOrg(ctx, *req.ParentID)
114			if err != nil {
115				return nil, s.fail(ctx, "get parent org unit", err)
116			}
117		}
118		parentType := ""
119		if parent != nil {
120			parentType = parent.Type
121		}
122		if aerr := validateHierarchy(req.Type, parentType); aerr != nil {
123			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "org create rejected: invalid hierarchy edge",
124				slog.String("org_code", code),
125				slog.String("org_type", req.Type),
126				slog.String("parent_type", parentType),
127				slog.String("reason", aerr.Code),
128				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
129			return nil, aerr
130		}
131	
132		// The federation is the unique root: reject a second one.
133		if req.Type == domain.OrgTypeFederation {
134			n, err := s.repo.countByType(ctx, domain.OrgTypeFederation)
135			if err != nil {
136				return nil, s.fail(ctx, "count federation org units", err)
137			}
138			if n > 0 {
139				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "org create rejected: federation root already exists",
140					slog.String("org_code", code),
141					slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
142				return nil, httpx.Conflict("FEDERATION_EXISTS", "a federation root org unit already exists")
143			}
144		}
145	
146		// The new unit must be created inside the caller's scope.
147		if parent != nil {
148			if err := s.scope.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, parent.ID); err != nil {
149				return nil, s.scopeErr(ctx, "create org unit", actor, parent.ID, err)
150			}
151		}
152	
153		now := time.Now().UTC()
154		org := &domain.OrgUnit{
155			// Pre-generate the id so insert + cache invalidation see one value.
156			ID:        primitive.NewObjectID(),
157			Type:      req.Type,
158			Name:      name,
159			Code:      code,
160			District:  strings.TrimSpace(req.District),
161			State:     strings.TrimSpace(req.State),
162			Path:      []primitive.ObjectID{},
163			Active:    true,
164			CreatedAt: now,
165			UpdatedAt: now,
166		}
167		if parent != nil {
168			parentID := parent.ID
169			org.ParentID = &parentID
170			org.Path = append(append([]primitive.ObjectID{}, parent.Path...), parent.ID)
171		}
172		if req.GeoLat != nil {
173			org.GeoLat = *req.GeoLat
174		}
175		if req.GeoLng != nil {
176			org.GeoLng = *req.GeoLng
177		}
178	
179		if err := s.repo.insertOrg(ctx, org); err != nil {
180			if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(err) {
181				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "org create rejected: duplicate code",
182					slog.String("org_code", code),
183					slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
184				return nil, httpx.Conflict("ORG_CODE_EXISTS", "an org unit with code "+code+" already exists")
185			}
186			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "insert org unit", err)
187		}
188		s.scope.Invalidate(org.ID)
189		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "org unit created",
190			slog.String("org_id", org.ID.Hex()),
191			slog.String("org_code", org.Code),
192			slog.String("org_type", org.Type),
193			slog.String("parent_org_id", hexOrEmpty(org.ParentID)),
194			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
195		return org, nil
196	}
197	
198	// hexOrEmpty renders an optional ObjectID reference for logging.
199	func hexOrEmpty(id *primitive.ObjectID) string {
200		if id == nil {
201			return ""
202		}
203		return id.Hex()
204	}
205	
206	// Update patches name/district/active/geo on an org unit (PATCH /orgs/{id}).
207	// Type or parent moves are rejected — restructuring the tree is out of scope
208	// for v1 because Path denormalisation across a subtree is not transactional.
209	func (s *service) Update(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID, req UpdateOrgRequest) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
210		if req.Type != nil || req.ParentID != nil {
211			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "org update rejected: hierarchy move unsupported",
212				slog.String("org_id", id.Hex()),
213				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
214			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("ORG_MOVE_UNSUPPORTED",
215				"changing an org unit's type or parent is not supported in v1")
216		}
217		if err := s.scope.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, id); err != nil {
218			return nil, s.scopeErr(ctx, "update org unit", actor, id, err)
219		}
220	
221		set := bson.D{{Key: "updated_at", Value: time.Now().UTC()}}
222		if req.Name != nil {
223			name := strings.TrimSpace(*req.Name)
224			if name == "" {
225				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_NAME", "name cannot be empty")
226			}
227			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "name", Value: name})
228		}
229		if req.District != nil {
230			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "district", Value: strings.TrimSpace(*req.District)})
231		}
232		if req.Active != nil {
233			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "active", Value: *req.Active})
234		}
235		if req.GeoLat != nil {
236			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "geo_lat", Value: *req.GeoLat})
237		}
238		if req.GeoLng != nil {
239			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "geo_lng", Value: *req.GeoLng})
240		}
241		if len(set) == 1 { // only updated_at
242			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("EMPTY_UPDATE", "no updatable fields provided")
243		}
244	
245		org, err := s.repo.updateOrg(ctx, id, set)
246		if err != nil {
247			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "update org unit", err)
248		}
249		s.scope.Invalidate(id)
250		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "org unit updated",
251			slog.String("org_id", org.ID.Hex()),
252			slog.String("org_code", org.Code),
253			slog.Bool("active", org.Active),
254			slog.Int("fields_patched", len(set)-1),
255			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
256		return org, nil
257	}
258	
259	// Get returns one org unit (GET /orgs/{id}).
260	func (s *service) Get(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
261		org, err := s.repo.getOrg(ctx, id)
262		if err != nil {
263			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "get org unit", err)
264		}
265		return org, nil
266	}
267	
268	// Children pages the direct children of an org unit (GET /orgs/{id}/children),
269	// returning the total child count alongside the page.
270	func (s *service) Children(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.OrgUnit, int64, error) {
271		if _, err := s.repo.getOrg(ctx, id); err != nil {
272			return nil, 0, s.fail(ctx, "get org unit", err)
273		}
274		units, total, err := s.repo.listChildren(ctx, id, page)
275		if err != nil {
276			return nil, 0, s.fail(ctx, "list org children", err)
277		}
278		return units, total, nil
279	}
280	
281	// Tree returns the root plus its whole subtree as a flat list (each node
282	// carries parent_id; the client assembles), capped at maxTreeNodes.
283	func (s *service) Tree(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID) ([]domain.OrgUnit, bool, error) {
284		root, err := s.repo.getOrg(ctx, id)
285		if err != nil {
286			return nil, false, s.fail(ctx, "get org unit", err)
287		}
288		if err := s.scope.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, id); err != nil {
289			return nil, false, s.scopeErr(ctx, "read org subtree", actor, id, err)
290		}
291		descendants, err := s.repo.listDescendants(ctx, id, maxTreeNodes-1)
292		if err != nil {
293			return nil, false, s.fail(ctx, "list org descendants", err)
294		}
295		nodes := append([]domain.OrgUnit{*root}, descendants...)
296		truncated := len(descendants) == maxTreeNodes-1
297		return nodes, truncated, nil
298	}
299	
300	// List pages org units filtered by type, district and/or exact code — the
301	// unique business key, e.g. ?code=DCS-01842, used to discover an org's
302	// ObjectID (GET /orgs) — returning the total matching count alongside the page.
303	func (s *service) List(ctx context.Context, orgType, district, code string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.OrgUnit, int64, error) {
304		filter := bson.D{}
305		if orgType != "" {
306			if !domain.IsValidOrgType(orgType) {
307				return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_ORG_TYPE", "unknown org type "+orgType)
308			}
309			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "type", Value: orgType})
310		}
311		if district != "" {
312			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "district", Value: district})
313		}
314		if code != "" {
315			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "code", Value: code})
316		}
317		units, total, err := s.repo.listOrgs(ctx, filter, page)
318		if err != nil {
319			return nil, 0, s.fail(ctx, "list org units", err)
320		}
321		return units, total, nil
322	}
323	
324	// Members pages the ACTIVE role assignments at an org unit joined in memory
325	// with party identity fields (GET /orgs/{id}/members) — two indexed queries,
326	// no $lookup.
327	func (s *service) Members(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID, page httpx.Page) ([]Member, int64, error) {
328		if _, err := s.repo.getOrg(ctx, id); err != nil {
329			return nil, 0, s.fail(ctx, "get org unit", err)
330		}
331		if err := s.scope.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, id); err != nil {
332			return nil, 0, s.scopeErr(ctx, "read org members", actor, id, err)
333		}
334	
335		total, err := s.repo.countActiveAssignments(ctx, id)
336		if err != nil {
337			return nil, 0, s.fail(ctx, "count active role assignments", err)
338		}
339		assignments, err := s.repo.listActiveAssignments(ctx, id, page)
340		if err != nil {
341			return nil, 0, s.fail(ctx, "list active role assignments", err)
342		}
343		partyIDs := make([]primitive.ObjectID, 0, len(assignments))
344		seen := make(map[primitive.ObjectID]struct{}, len(assignments))
345		for _, a := range assignments {
346			if _, dup := seen[a.PartyID]; !dup {
347				seen[a.PartyID] = struct{}{}
348				partyIDs = append(partyIDs, a.PartyID)
349			}
350		}
351		parties, err := s.repo.partiesByIDs(ctx, partyIDs)
352		if err != nil {
353			return nil, 0, s.fail(ctx, "fetch member parties", err)
354		}
355	
356		members := make([]Member, 0, len(assignments))
357		for _, a := range assignments {
358			m := Member{
359				PartyID:          a.PartyID,
360				RoleCode:         a.RoleCode,
361				RoleAssignmentID: a.ID,
362				ValidFrom:        a.ValidFrom,
363				ValidTo:          a.ValidTo,
364			}
365			if p, ok := parties[a.PartyID]; ok {
366				m.Phone = p.Phone
367				m.FullName = p.FullName
368				m.KYCTier = p.KYCTier
369			}
370			members = append(members, m)
371		}
372		return members, total, nil
373	}

1	// Package plant implements the processing tier of the pour→QR chain:
2	// BMC lots (pooled consignments at the chilling centre), processing batches,
3	// product lots and QR issuance. It is the ENFORCEMENT layer of the safety
4	// gate (blueprint §8.3): a lot or batch that has not PASSED quality control
5	// can never advance — not into a tanker, not into a batch, not onto a shelf.
6	// Aflatoxin M1 survives pasteurisation, so the gate is checked at every hop,
7	// belt-and-braces.
8	package plant
9	
10	import (
11		"log/slog"
12	
13		"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
14	
15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
16		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
17		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/middleware"
18	)
19	
20	// Register wires the plant module under /api/v1/plant.
21	func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
22		log := d.Log.With(slog.String("module", "plant"))
23		repo := NewRepo(d.DB)
24		svc := NewService(repo, d, log)
25		h := NewHandler(svc)
26	
27		r.Route("/plant", func(pr chi.Router) {
28			pr.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
29	
30			// BMC lots — created/closed/dispatched by the chilling-centre operator;
31			// readable by everyone downstream who receives or supervises the milk.
32			pr.Route("/bmc-lots", func(lr chi.Router) {
33				lr.With(middleware.RequireRoles(
34					domain.RoleBMCOperator, domain.RolePlantOperator,
35					domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor, domain.RolePlantLabAnalyst,
36				)).Get("/", h.ListBMCLots)
37	
38				lr.Group(func(wr chi.Router) {
39					wr.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleBMCOperator))
40					wr.Post("/", h.CreateBMCLot)
41					wr.Post("/{id}/close", h.CloseBMCLot)
42					wr.Post("/{id}/dispatch", h.DispatchBMCLot)
43				})
44			})
45	
46			// Processing batches — plant operator pools dispatched (gate-passed)
47			// BMC lots into a production run; plant lab + supervisor read along.
48			pr.Route("/batches", func(br chi.Router) {
49				read := middleware.RequireRoles(
50					domain.RolePlantOperator, domain.RolePlantLabAnalyst,
51					domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor,
52				)
53				br.With(read).Get("/", h.ListBatches)
54				br.With(read).Get("/{id}", h.GetBatch)
55	
56				br.Group(func(wr chi.Router) {
57					wr.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RolePlantOperator))
58					wr.Post("/", h.CreateBatch)
59					wr.Post("/{id}/complete", h.CompleteBatch)
60				})
61			})
62	
63			// Product lots — packaged SKUs out of a COMPLETED batch. Recall is the
64			// FSSAI path (§18-C): admin or plant lab pulls the lot from market.
65			pr.Route("/product-lots", func(plr chi.Router) {
66				plr.With(middleware.RequireRoles(
67					domain.RolePlantOperator, domain.RolePlantLabAnalyst,
68				)).Post("/", h.CreateProductLot)
69				plr.With(middleware.RequireRoles(
70					domain.RolePCDFAdmin, domain.RolePlantLabAnalyst,
71				)).Post("/{id}/recall", h.RecallProductLot)
72			})
73	
74			// QR issuance — the consumer-facing end of the trace chain (§7).
75			pr.Route("/qrs", func(qr chi.Router) {
76				qr.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(
77					domain.RolePlantOperator, domain.RolePlantLabAnalyst,
78				))
79				qr.Post("/", h.IssueQR)
80				qr.Get("/", h.ListQRs)
81			})
82		})
83	
84		// No bus subscriptions: the quality module flips lot/batch statuses in
85		// their own collections, and every gate here re-reads status at use time.
86	}

18	// repository is the module's only MongoDB access point. It reads the
19	// role_assignments and parties collections (allowed by spec for the members
20	// roster) but writes only org_units.
21	//
22	// Error contract: missing documents surface as httpx.NotFound (a business
23	// outcome); every other failure is returned as a raw error wrapped with the
24	// failing operation so the service can log it before mapping to a 500.
25	type repository struct {
26		orgs        *mongo.Collection
27		assignments *mongo.Collection
28		parties     *mongo.Collection
29	}
30	
31	func newRepository(db *mongo.Database) *repository {
32		return &repository{
33			orgs:        db.Collection(mongodb.CollOrgUnits),
34			assignments: db.Collection(mongodb.CollRoleAssignments),
35			parties:     db.Collection(mongodb.CollParties),
36		}
37	}
38	
39	// insertOrg inserts a new org unit (its _id is pre-generated by the service).
40	// The driver error stays inspectable (%w) so the service can map a
41	// duplicate-key violation on code to a Conflict.
42	func (r *repository) insertOrg(ctx context.Context, org *domain.OrgUnit) error {
43		if _, err := r.orgs.InsertOne(ctx, org); err != nil {
44			return fmt.Errorf("insert org unit: %w", err)
45		}
46		return nil
47	}
48	
49	// getOrg fetches one org unit by ObjectID.
50	func (r *repository) getOrg(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
51		var org domain.OrgUnit
52		err := r.orgs.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&org)
53		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
54			return nil, httpx.NotFound("org unit " + id.Hex())
55		}
56		if err != nil {
57			return nil, fmt.Errorf("get org unit %s: %w", id.Hex(), err)
58		}
59		return &org, nil
60	}
61	
62	// countByType counts org units of the given type (federation-uniqueness check).
63	func (r *repository) countByType(ctx context.Context, orgType string) (int64, error) {
64		n, err := r.orgs.CountDocuments(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "type", Value: orgType}})
65		if err != nil {
66			return 0, fmt.Errorf("count org units by type %s: %w", orgType, err)
67		}
68		return n, nil
69	}
70	
71	// updateOrg applies a $set patch and returns the updated document.
72	func (r *repository) updateOrg(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID, set bson.D) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
73		var org domain.OrgUnit
74		err := r.orgs.FindOneAndUpdate(ctx,
75			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}},
76			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: set}},
77			options.FindOneAndUpdate().SetReturnDocument(options.After),
78		).Decode(&org)
79		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
80			return nil, httpx.NotFound("org unit " + id.Hex())
81		}
82		if err != nil {
83			return nil, fmt.Errorf("update org unit %s: %w", id.Hex(), err)
84		}
85		return &org, nil
86	}
87	
88	// listChildren pages the direct children of an org unit (parent_id index)
89	// and returns the total child count for pagination meta.
90	func (r *repository) listChildren(ctx context.Context, parentID primitive.ObjectID, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.OrgUnit, int64, error) {
91		filter := bson.D{{Key: "parent_id", Value: parentID}}
92		total, err := r.orgs.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
93		if err != nil {
94			return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("count org children: %w", err)
95		}
96		units, err := r.findOrgs(ctx, filter,
97			options.Find().
98				SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "code", Value: 1}}).
99				SetSkip(page.Offset).
100				SetLimit(page.Limit))
101		if err != nil {
102			return nil, 0, err
103		}
104		return units, total, nil
105	}

108	// and returns the total matching count for pagination meta.
109	func (r *repository) listOrgs(ctx context.Context, filter bson.D, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.OrgUnit, int64, error) {
110		total, err := r.orgs.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
111		if err != nil {
112			return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("count org units: %w", err)
113		}

117				SetSkip(page.Offset).
118				SetLimit(page.Limit))
119		if err != nil {
120			return nil, 0, err
121		}

125	// listDescendants returns every org unit whose ancestor Path contains rootID
126	// (path index, ObjectID array containment), capped at limit nodes.
127	func (r *repository) listDescendants(ctx context.Context, rootID primitive.ObjectID, limit int64) ([]domain.OrgUnit, error) {
128		return r.findOrgs(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "path", Value: rootID}},
129			options.Find().
130				SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "code", Value: 1}}).
131				SetLimit(limit))

134	func (r *repository) findOrgs(ctx context.Context, filter bson.D, opts *options.FindOptions) ([]domain.OrgUnit, error) {
135		cur, err := r.orgs.Find(ctx, filter, opts)
136		if err != nil {
137			return nil, fmt.Errorf("find org units: %w", err)
138		}
139		units := []domain.OrgUnit{}
140		if err := cur.All(ctx, &units); err != nil {
141			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode org units: %w", err)
142		}
143		return units, nil
144	}

151			{Key: "status", Value: domain.RoleAssignmentActive},
152		})
153		if err != nil {

155		}

162		cur, err := r.assignments.Find(ctx,
163			bson.D{

165				{Key: "status", Value: domain.RoleAssignmentActive},
166			},
167			options.Find().
168				SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "role_code", Value: 1}, {Key: "created_at", Value: 1}}).
169				SetSkip(page.Offset).

181	// partiesByIDs fetches the given parties keyed by ObjectID for the in-memory join.
182	func (r *repository) partiesByIDs(ctx context.Context, ids []primitive.ObjectID) (map[primitive.ObjectID]domain.Party, error) {
183		byID := make(map[primitive.ObjectID]domain.Party, len(ids))
184		if len(ids) == 0 {
185			return byID, nil
186		}

188		if err != nil {

190		}
191		var parties []domain.Party
192		if err := cur.All(ctx, &parties); err != nil {
193			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode parties: %w", err)
194		}
195		for _, p := range parties {
196			byID[p.ID] = p
197		}
198		return byID, nil
199	}

7	/**
8	 * Van collection logistics (§8.1) - route manifest, pickups with cold-chain
9	 * temperature logging, delivery to the BMC. Aligned with the Go backend
10	 * (parag-saathi-be, internal/modules/logistics, mounted at /logistics):
11	 *
12	 *   POST /logistics/trips                                   → plan a route trip
13	 *   GET  /logistics/trips ?union_id&date&van_rider_party_id → list trips
14	 *   GET  /logistics/trips/{tripID}                          → one trip
15	 *   POST /logistics/trips/{tripID}/stops/{consignmentID}/pickup → record pickup
16	 *   POST /logistics/trips/{tripID}/cold-chain              → log transit temp
17	 *   POST /logistics/trips/{tripID}/deliver                 → hand load to a BMC
18	 *
19	 * NOTE: the backend only ships the *request* structs (logistics_models.go);
20	 * its trip/stop/intake *responses* embed `domain.*` structs that are not in
21	 * the shared contract snapshot. The Wire* shapes below are therefore the
22	 * inferred snake_case serialisation (see `issues` in the sync report) and
23	 * fill safe defaults for any field the wire may omit.
24	 */
25	
26	/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
27	/* Wire shapes (snake_case, inferred from the domain + BE conventions) */
28	/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
29	
30	interface WireTripStop {
31	  dcs_id: string;
32	  /** The pooled DCS consignment collected at this stop (frontend `lotId`). */
33	  consignment_id?: string;
34	  planned_time?: string;
35	  arrived_at?: string;
36	  lat?: number;
37	  lng?: number;
38	  photo_uri?: string;
39	  collected?: boolean;
40	  status?: string;
41	}
42	
43	interface WireTrip {
44	  id: string;
45	  code?: string;
46	  route_name?: string;
47	  van_rider_party_id?: string;
48	  van_no?: string;
49	  union_id?: string;
50	  date: string;
51	  shift: string;
52	  stops?: WireTripStop[];
53	  bmc_id?: string;
54	  status?: string;
55	  departed_at?: string;
56	  completed_at?: string;
57	}
58	
59	interface WireBmcIntake {
60	  id: string;
61	  bmc_id: string;
62	  trip_id: string;
63	  lot_ids?: string[];
64	  consignment_ids?: string[];
65	  silo_lot_code?: string;
66	  received_at?: string;
67	  temp_c?: number;
68	  status?: string;
69	}
