71	/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
72	/* Wire → domain mappers                                               */
73	/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
74	
75	function mapTripStatus(s?: string): RouteTrip['status'] {
76	  switch (s) {
77	    case 'ASSIGNED':
78	    case 'IN_PROGRESS':
79	    case 'DELIVERED_TO_BMC':
80	    case 'COMPLETED':
81	      return s;
82	    case 'PLANNED':
83	    case 'CREATED':
84	      return 'ASSIGNED';
85	    case 'STARTED':
86	    case 'IN_TRANSIT':
87	      return 'IN_PROGRESS';
88	    case 'DELIVERED':
89	      return 'DELIVERED_TO_BMC';
90	    default:
91	      return 'ASSIGNED';
92	  }
93	}
94	
95	function mapIntakeStatus(s?: string): BmcIntake['status'] {
96	  switch (s) {
97	    case 'CHILLED':
98	    case 'DISPATCHED_TO_PLANT':
99	    case 'REJECTED':
100	      return s;
101	    default:
102	      return 'RECEIVED';
103	  }
104	}
105	
106	function mapStop(w: WireTripStop): RouteStop {
107	  return {
108	    dcsId: w.dcs_id,
109	    lotId: w.consignment_id || undefined,
110	    plannedTime: w.planned_time ?? '',
111	    arrivedAt: w.arrived_at,
112	    geo: w.lat != null && w.lng != null ? { lat: w.lat, lng: w.lng } : undefined,
113	    photoUri: w.photo_uri || undefined,
114	    collected: w.collected ?? (w.status ? w.status !== 'PENDING' : false),
115	  };
116	}
117	
118	function mapTrip(w: WireTrip): RouteTrip {
119	  return {
120	    id: w.id,
121	    code: w.code || w.route_name || w.id,
122	    riderPartyId: w.van_rider_party_id ?? '',
123	    vanNo: w.van_no ?? '',
124	    date: w.date,
125	    shift: w.shift === 'EVENING' ? 'EVENING' : 'MORNING',
126	    stops: (w.stops ?? []).map(mapStop),
127	    bmcId: w.bmc_id ?? '',
128	    status: mapTripStatus(w.status),
129	    departedAt: w.departed_at,
130	    completedAt: w.completed_at,
131	  };
132	}
133	
134	function mapIntake(w: WireBmcIntake): BmcIntake {
135	  return {
136	    id: w.id,
137	    bmcId: w.bmc_id,
138	    tripId: w.trip_id,
139	    lotIds: w.lot_ids ?? w.consignment_ids ?? [],
140	    siloLotCode: w.silo_lot_code ?? '',
141	    receivedAt: w.received_at ?? new Date().toISOString(),
142	    tempC: w.temp_c ?? 0,
143	    status: mapIntakeStatus(w.status),
144	  };
145	}
146	
147	/** Derive a best-effort intake from a delivered trip when the backend
148	 *  deliver response returns only the trip (no separate intake object). */
149	function intakeFromTrip(trip: RouteTrip): BmcIntake {
150	  return {
151	    id: '',
152	    bmcId: trip.bmcId,
153	    tripId: trip.id,
154	    lotIds: trip.stops.filter((s) => s.collected && s.lotId).map((s) => s.lotId as string),
155	    siloLotCode: '',
156	    receivedAt: trip.completedAt ?? new Date().toISOString(),
157	    tempC: 0,
158	    status: 'RECEIVED',
159	  };
160	}
161	
162	function asTripArray(raw: unknown): WireTrip[] {
163	  if (Array.isArray(raw)) return raw as WireTrip[];
164	  const wrapped = (raw as { trips?: WireTrip[] } | null)?.trips;
165	  return Array.isArray(wrapped) ? wrapped : [];
166	}
167	
168	/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
169	/* Endpoints                                                           */
170	/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
171	
172	export const getMyTrip = endpoint<{ riderPartyId: string; date: string }, RouteTrip | null>({
173	  method: 'GET',
174	  path: ({ riderPartyId, date }) =>
175	    `/logistics/trips?van_rider_party_id=${riderPartyId}&date=${date}`,
176	  // GET /logistics/trips returns a filtered list; a rider has at most one trip
177	  // per date+van, so take the first (or null when none is planned).
178	  mapResponse: (raw) => {
179	    const trips = asTripArray(raw);
180	    return trips.length ? mapTrip(trips[0]) : null;
181	  },
182	  mock: ({ riderPartyId, date }, db) =>
183	    db.trips.find((t) => t.riderPartyId === riderPartyId && t.date === date) ?? null,
184	});
185	
186	export const listTrips = endpoint<{ date?: string } | void, RouteTrip[]>({
187	  method: 'GET',
188	  path: (input) => `/logistics/trips${input?.date ? `?date=${input.date}` : ''}`,
189	  mapResponse: (raw) =>
190	    asTripArray(raw)
191	      .map(mapTrip)
192	      .sort((a, b) => b.date.localeCompare(a.date)),
193	  mock: (input, db) =>
194	    (input?.date ? db.trips.filter((t) => t.date === input.date) : db.trips).sort((a, b) =>
195	      b.date.localeCompare(a.date),
196	    ),
197	});
198	
199	// TODO(backend): no endpoint yet - mock only.
200	// The backend has no "start an already-planned trip" route: POST /logistics/trips
201	// *creates* a trip (createTripRequest: route_name, union_id, date, shift,
202	// van_rider_party_id, stops[]), which the {tripId}-only input here cannot build.
203	// Left on the mock path until the FE input carries a full plan or the BE adds a
204	// /trips/{tripID}/start transition.
205	export const startTrip = endpoint<{ tripId: string }, RouteTrip>({
206	  method: 'POST',
207	  path: ({ tripId }) => `/logistics/trips/${tripId}/start`,
208	  mock: ({ tripId }, db) => {
209	    const trip = db.trips.find((t) => t.id === tripId);
210	    if (!trip) throw new ApiError(404, 'TRIP_NOT_FOUND', `Unknown trip ${tripId}`);
211	    if (trip.status !== 'ASSIGNED') throw new ApiError(409, 'ALREADY_STARTED', 'Trip already started');
212	    trip.status = 'IN_PROGRESS';
213	    trip.departedAt = new Date().toISOString();
214	    audit(db, {
215	      actorPartyId: trip.riderPartyId,
216	      actorRole: 'VAN_RIDER',
217	      action: 'TRIP_STARTED',
218	      subject: trip.code,
219	      detail: `Van ${trip.vanNo} departed on ${trip.stops.length}-stop route`,
220	    });
221	    return trip;
222	  },
223	});
224	
225	/**
226	 * Record pickup at a DCS stop: the consignment scan, a geotag of where it was
227	 * collected, and a milk photo for verification (no temperature - the cold-chain
228	 * temperature is logged by the chilling branch, not the van).
229	 */
230	export const recordPickup = endpoint<
231	  { tripId: string; dcsId: string; geo?: GeoPoint; photoUri?: string; sealCode?: string },
232	  RouteTrip
233	>({
234	  method: 'POST',
235	  // Backend keys the pickup by the pooled consignment, not the DCS. The FE input
236	  // only carries dcsId, so it stands in for {consignmentID} here - see issues:
237	  // the input type should eventually carry the consignment/lot id.
238	  path: ({ tripId, dcsId }) => `/logistics/trips/${tripId}/stops/${dcsId}/pickup`,
239	  mapRequest: ({ geo, photoUri, sealCode }) => ({
240	    lat: geo?.lat,
241	    lng: geo?.lng,
242	    photo_uri: photoUri,
243	    seal_code: sealCode,
244	  }),
245	  mapResponse: (raw) => mapTrip(raw as WireTrip),
246	  mock: ({ tripId, dcsId, geo, photoUri, sealCode }, db) => {
247	    const trip = db.trips.find((t) => t.id === tripId);
248	    if (!trip) throw new ApiError(404, 'TRIP_NOT_FOUND', `Unknown trip ${tripId}`);
249	    const stop = trip.stops.find((s) => s.dcsId === dcsId);
250	    if (!stop) throw new ApiError(404, 'STOP_NOT_FOUND', 'This DCS is not on the route');
251	    if (!stop.lotId) {
252	      throw new ApiError(409, 'LOT_NOT_DISPATCHED', 'The samiti has not dispatched a consignment yet');
253	    }
254	    if (stop.collected) throw new ApiError(409, 'ALREADY_COLLECTED', 'Stop already collected');
255	    if (!photoUri) {
256	      throw new ApiError(422, 'PHOTO_REQUIRED', 'Add a milk photo to verify the collection');
257	    }
258	    const lot = db.lots.find((l) => l.id === stop.lotId);
259	    // Seal verification (§6.4): a sealed consignment must have its seal confirmed
260	    // at pickup, and the confirmed code must match the one frozen at dispatch, so
261	    // milk cannot be swapped between the DCS and the branch.
262	    if (lot?.sealCode) {
263	      if (!sealCode) {
264	        throw new ApiError(422, 'SEAL_REQUIRED', 'Confirm the consignment seal before pickup');
265	      }
266	      if (sealCode !== lot.sealCode) {
267	        throw new ApiError(422, 'SEAL_MISMATCH', 'Seal does not match the dispatched consignment - do not collect');
268	      }
269	    }
270	    stop.arrivedAt = new Date().toISOString();
271	    stop.geo = geo;
272	    stop.photoUri = photoUri;
273	    stop.sealCode = sealCode ?? lot?.sealCode;
274	    stop.collected = true;
275	    if (geo) {
276	      trip.lastKnownGeo = geo;
277	      trip.lastLocationAt = stop.arrivedAt;
278	    }
279	    if (lot) lot.status = 'PICKED_UP';
280	    audit(db, {
281	      actorPartyId: trip.riderPartyId,
282	      actorRole: 'VAN_RIDER',
283	      action: 'PICKUP_RECORDED',
284	      subject: lot?.consignmentCode ?? stop.lotId,
285	      detail: `Collected with geotag + photo + seal ${stop.sealCode ?? 'n/a'}`,
286	    });
287	    if (lot) {
288	      appendChainEvent(db, {
289	        kind: 'PICKUP',
290	        subjectType: 'LOT',
291	        subjectId: lot.id,
292	        actorPartyId: trip.riderPartyId,
293	        detail: `Seal ${stop.sealCode ?? 'n/a'} confirmed; geotag + photo`,
294	      });
295	    }
296	    return trip;
297	  },
298	});
299	
300	/** Live-location breadcrumb from the van during the trip (best-effort). */
301	// TODO(backend): live-location stream not exposed yet - mock only
302	export const pushVanLocation = endpoint<{ tripId: string; geo: GeoPoint }, RouteTrip>({
303	  method: 'POST',
304	  path: ({ tripId }) => `/logistics/trips/${tripId}/location`,
305	  mapRequest: ({ geo }) => ({ lat: geo.lat, lng: geo.lng }),
306	  mock: ({ tripId, geo }, db) => {
307	    const trip = db.trips.find((t) => t.id === tripId);
308	    if (!trip) throw new ApiError(404, 'TRIP_NOT_FOUND', `Unknown trip ${tripId}`);
309	    trip.lastKnownGeo = geo;
310	    trip.lastLocationAt = new Date().toISOString();
311	    return trip;
312	  },
313	});
314	
315	/**
316	 * Deliver collected consignments to the chilling branch (BMC) - pools them into
317	 * a silo lot the branch will chill. The branch logs the tank temperature, so no
318	 * temperature is captured here.
319	 */
320	export const deliverToBmc = endpoint<
321	  { tripId: string; bmcId?: string },
322	  { trip: RouteTrip; intake: BmcIntake }
323	>({
324	  method: 'POST',
325	  path: ({ tripId }) => `/logistics/trips/${tripId}/deliver`,
326	  // deliverRequest wants bmc_id: sourced from trip.bmcId at the call site and
327	  // passed in, so the http deliver targets the right chilling branch.
328	  mapRequest: ({ bmcId }) => ({ bmc_id: bmcId ?? '' }),
329	  mapResponse: (raw) => {
330	    const d = (raw ?? {}) as { trip?: WireTrip; intake?: WireBmcIntake } & Partial<WireTrip>;
331	    const wireTrip = d.trip ?? (d as WireTrip);
332	    const trip = mapTrip(wireTrip);
333	    const intake = d.intake ? mapIntake(d.intake) : intakeFromTrip(trip);
334	    return { trip, intake };
335	  },
336	  mock: ({ tripId }, db) => {
337	    const trip = db.trips.find((t) => t.id === tripId);
338	    if (!trip) throw new ApiError(404, 'TRIP_NOT_FOUND', `Unknown trip ${tripId}`);
339	    const collectedLots = trip.stops.filter((s) => s.collected && s.lotId).map((s) => s.lotId!);
340	    if (collectedLots.length === 0) {
341	      throw new ApiError(409, 'NOTHING_COLLECTED', 'No collected consignments on board');
342	    }
343	    trip.status = 'DELIVERED_TO_BMC';
344	    trip.completedAt = new Date().toISOString();
345	    const intake: BmcIntake = {
346	      id: nextId('intake'),
347	      bmcId: trip.bmcId,
348	      tripId: trip.id,
349	      lotIds: collectedLots,
350	      siloLotCode: intakeCode('BBK', trip.date, trip.shift),
351	      receivedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
352	      tempC: 0, // logged by the branch when it chills the lot
353	      status: 'RECEIVED',
354	    };
355	    db.intakes.push(intake);
356	    for (const lotId of collectedLots) {
357	      const lot = db.lots.find((l) => l.id === lotId);
358	      if (lot) lot.status = 'AT_BMC';
359	    }
360	    audit(db, {
361	      actorPartyId: trip.riderPartyId,
362	      actorRole: 'VAN_RIDER',
363	      action: 'DELIVERED_TO_BMC',
364	      subject: intake.siloLotCode,
365	      detail: `${collectedLots.length} consignments handed to the chilling branch`,
366	    });
367	    appendChainEvent(db, {
368	      kind: 'INTAKE',
369	      subjectType: 'INTAKE',
370	      subjectId: intake.id,
371	      actorPartyId: trip.riderPartyId,
372	      detail: `${intake.siloLotCode}: ${collectedLots.length} consignments received at the branch`,
373	    });
374	    return { trip, intake };
375	  },
376	});

21	func (h *handler) create(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
22		actor, ok := auth.ActorFrom(r.Context())

25			return
26		}

5	/**
6	 * Chilling branch (BMC) operations (§8.1). The branch sits between the van and
7	 * the plant in the provenance chain: it RECEIVES the van's silo lots, chills
8	 * them and logs the tank temperature (CHILLED), then dispatches them to the
9	 * plant (DISPATCHED_TO_PLANT) where they are pooled into a processing batch.

17	  if (!intake) throw new ApiError(404, 'INTAKE_NOT_FOUND', `Unknown silo lot ${id}`);
18	  return intake;
19	}

9	// DCS consignment statuses — a day+shift's pooled cans travelling to a BMC.
10	const (
11		ConsignmentStatusOpen      = "OPEN"       // still accepting pours
12		ConsignmentStatusDispatch  = "DISPATCHED" // sealed by Sacheev, awaiting pickup
13		ConsignmentStatusPickedUp  = "PICKED_UP"  // on the van

22	type DCSConsignment struct {

37		ProvenanceSeq       int64                `bson:"provenance_seq,omitempty" json:"provenance_seq,omitempty"`
38		CreatedAt           time.Time            `bson:"created_at" json:"created_at"`
39	}

41	// Route trip statuses.
42	const (
43		TripStatusPlanned    = "PLANNED"
44		TripStatusInProgress = "IN_PROGRESS"
45		TripStatusDelivered  = "DELIVERED"

48	// RouteStop is one DCS pickup on a trip, with the cold-chain temperature
49	// captured at pickup time.

1	// Package domain holds the pure entity model of Saathi — structs, enums and
2	// invariants shared by every module. It has no behaviour beyond validation
3	// and no dependencies outside the standard library and BSON primitives.
4	// This is the contract layer: modules depend on domain, never the other way
5	// around.
6	package domain
7	
8	// Role codes — the role catalog from blueprint §5.2, grounded in the PCDF
9	// cooperative constitution (Farmer → Samiti/DCS → Sangh/Union → PCDF).
10	// A Party may hold many time-bounded, org-scoped RoleAssignments.
11	//
12	// The catalog is deliberately open for extension: adding a future role is a
13	// new constant + AllRoles entry + RequiredKYCTier entry — nothing else.
14	const (
15		// Village tier
16		RoleFarmer         = "FARMER"
17		RoleSamitiSacheev  = "SAMITI_SACHEEV"  // DCS paid Secretary (UPCS Act §31) — runs the collection console
18		RoleSamitiAdhyaksh = "SAMITI_ADHYAKSH" // DCS Chairman/Sabhapati (elected, honorary, §30)
19		RoleMilkTester     = "MILK_TESTER"
20		RoleLRP            = "LRP" // Local Resource Person (NDDB village extension)
21		RoleAITech         = "AI_TECH"
22	
23		// Field / organisation tier
24		// ORGANISING_MANAGER is the ground-level field worker (Dairy Development
25		// Department pattern: "promotes and organises new samitis") who performs
26		// doorstep KYC capture and first-level verification.
27		RoleOrganisingManager = "ORGANISING_MANAGER"
28		// ONBOARDING_EXECUTIVE is the mobile-app onboarding worker the field client
29		// uses for the same doorstep KYC / assisted-onboarding job as
30		// ORGANISING_MANAGER. Both are valid onboarding/review roles; the app codes
31		// this one, the backend historically coded the other.
32		RoleOnboardingExecutive = "ONBOARDING_EXECUTIVE"
33	
34		// Logistics tier
35		RoleVanRider      = "VAN_RIDER"
36		RoleDeliveryRider = "DELIVERY_RIDER"
37	
38		// Retail / commerce tier (Phase-3 store module; dormant behind a flag but a
39		// grantable role so the store console can be assigned).
40		RoleStoreManager = "STORE_MANAGER"
41	
42		// Union tier
43		RoleBMCOperator          = "BMC_OPERATOR"
44		RoleUnionFieldSupervisor = "UNION_FIELD_SUPERVISOR"
45		RoleUnionPresident       = "UNION_PRESIDENT"
46	
47		// Plant tier
48		RolePlantOperator   = "PLANT_OPERATOR"
49		RolePlantLabAnalyst = "PLANT_LAB_ANALYST"
50	
51		// State / district tier
52		RolePCDFAdmin        = "PCDF_ADMIN"
53		RoleMissionOfficial  = "MISSION_OFFICIAL"
54		RoleDistrictVerifier = "DISTRICT_VERIFIER"
55	
56		// Health tier
57		RoleVeterinarian = "VETERINARIAN"
58		RoleMVUDriver    = "MVU_DRIVER"
59	
60		// Consumer tier
61		RoleConsumer = "CONSUMER"
62	
63		// Platform tier
64		RoleSupportAgent = "SUPPORT_AGENT"
65		RoleStateAuditor = "STATE_AUDITOR"
66		RoleSuperAdmin   = "SUPER_ADMIN"
67	
68		// System tier
69		RoleServiceAccount = "SERVICE_ACCOUNT"
70	)
71	
72	// AllRoles is the closed set of grantable role codes (extend here).
73	var AllRoles = []string{
74		RoleFarmer, RoleSamitiSacheev, RoleSamitiAdhyaksh, RoleMilkTester, RoleLRP, RoleAITech,
75		RoleOrganisingManager, RoleOnboardingExecutive,
76		RoleVanRider, RoleDeliveryRider, RoleStoreManager,
77		RoleBMCOperator, RoleUnionFieldSupervisor, RoleUnionPresident,
78		RolePlantOperator, RolePlantLabAnalyst,
79		RolePCDFAdmin, RoleMissionOfficial, RoleDistrictVerifier,
80		RoleVeterinarian, RoleMVUDriver,
81		RoleConsumer,
82		RoleSupportAgent, RoleStateAuditor, RoleSuperAdmin,
83		RoleServiceAccount,
84	}
85	
86	// OnboardingReviewerRoles are the roles authorised to run the KYC review /
87	// assisted-onboarding console. Both the historical ORGANISING_MANAGER and the
88	// app-coded ONBOARDING_EXECUTIVE qualify, plus the district/federation tiers.
89	var OnboardingReviewerRoles = []string{
90		RoleOnboardingExecutive, RoleOrganisingManager, RoleDistrictVerifier, RolePCDFAdmin, RoleSuperAdmin,
91	}
92	
93	var roleSet = func() map[string]struct{} {
94		s := make(map[string]struct{}, len(AllRoles))
95		for _, r := range AllRoles {
96			s[r] = struct{}{}
97		}
98		return s
99	}()
100	
101	// IsValidRole reports whether code is one of the catalog roles.
102	func IsValidRole(code string) bool {
103		_, ok := roleSet[code]
104		return ok
105	}
106	
107	// KYC assurance tiers (blueprint §4.2). Higher tiers unlock higher-trust roles.
108	const (
109		KYCTierMinimal  = "MINIMAL"  // mobile OTP only (consumer)
110		KYCTierFarmer   = "FARMER"   // Aadhaar OTP eKYC or offline XML + penny-drop
111		KYCTierStandard = "STANDARD" // Aadhaar eKYC
112		KYCTierRider    = "RIDER"    // Aadhaar eKYC + DL/RC
113		KYCTierHigh     = "HIGH"     // eKYC + org record / V-CIP for officials
114		KYCTierHighest  = "HIGHEST"  // platform admin: MFA + dual-control
115		KYCTierService  = "SERVICE"  // machine accounts: mTLS / scoped keys
116		KYCTierMTLS     = "MTLS"     // alias the field app uses for SERVICE-tier machine accounts
117	)

119	// RequiredKYCTier maps each role to the minimum KYC tier a party must hold
120	// before a role token for it can be issued (blueprint §5.2 "KYC tier").
121	// Tier upgrades happen ONLY through the KYC approval workflow: submit →
122	// PENDING → reviewed by an authorised approver → VERIFIED. There is no
123	// self-service tier upgrade.
124	var RequiredKYCTier = map[string]string{
125		RoleFarmer:               KYCTierFarmer,
126		RoleSamitiSacheev:        KYCTierHigh,
127		RoleSamitiAdhyaksh:       KYCTierHigh,
128		RoleMilkTester:           KYCTierStandard,
129		RoleLRP:                  KYCTierStandard,
130		RoleAITech:               KYCTierStandard,
131		RoleOrganisingManager:    KYCTierHigh,
132		RoleOnboardingExecutive:  KYCTierHigh,
133		RoleVanRider:             KYCTierRider,
134		RoleDeliveryRider:        KYCTierRider,
135		RoleStoreManager:         KYCTierStandard,
136		RoleBMCOperator:          KYCTierStandard,
137		RoleUnionFieldSupervisor: KYCTierHigh,
138		RoleUnionPresident:       KYCTierHigh,
139		RolePlantOperator:        KYCTierHigh,
140		RolePlantLabAnalyst:      KYCTierHigh,
141		RolePCDFAdmin:            KYCTierHigh,
142		RoleMissionOfficial:      KYCTierHigh,
143		RoleDistrictVerifier:     KYCTierHigh,
144		RoleVeterinarian:         KYCTierHigh,
145		RoleMVUDriver:            KYCTierStandard,
146		RoleConsumer:             KYCTierMinimal,
147		RoleSupportAgent:         KYCTierHigh,
148		RoleStateAuditor:         KYCTierHigh,
149		RoleSuperAdmin:           KYCTierHighest,
150		RoleServiceAccount:       KYCTierService,
151	}
152	
153	// kycRank orders tiers so "tier X satisfies requirement Y" is a comparison.
154	var kycRank = map[string]int{
155		KYCTierMinimal:  0,
156		KYCTierFarmer:   1,
157		KYCTierStandard: 1, // Farmer and Standard are parallel tier-1 proofs
158		KYCTierRider:    2,
159		KYCTierHigh:     3,
160		KYCTierHighest:  4,
161		KYCTierService:  4,
162		KYCTierMTLS:     4, // alias of SERVICE
163	}
164	
165	// KYCTierSatisfies reports whether a party at tier `have` meets `need`.
166	// Parallel tier-1 proofs (FARMER vs STANDARD) satisfy each other.
167	func KYCTierSatisfies(have, need string) bool {
168		h, okH := kycRank[have]
169		n, okN := kycRank[need]
170		if !okH || !okN {
171			return false
172		}
173		return h >= n
174	}
175	
176	// KYCApprovableTiers maps an approver ROLE to the KYC tiers it may approve.
177	// Ground staff clear the field tiers; only federation admins clear HIGH;
178	// only SUPER_ADMIN clears HIGHEST. Extend when new approver roles arrive.
179	var KYCApprovableTiers = map[string][]string{
180		RoleOrganisingManager:   {KYCTierMinimal, KYCTierFarmer, KYCTierStandard, KYCTierRider},
181		RoleOnboardingExecutive: {KYCTierMinimal, KYCTierFarmer, KYCTierStandard, KYCTierRider},
182		RoleDistrictVerifier:    {KYCTierMinimal, KYCTierFarmer, KYCTierStandard, KYCTierRider},
183		RolePCDFAdmin:           {KYCTierMinimal, KYCTierFarmer, KYCTierStandard, KYCTierRider, KYCTierHigh},
184		RoleSuperAdmin:          {KYCTierMinimal, KYCTierFarmer, KYCTierStandard, KYCTierRider, KYCTierHigh, KYCTierHighest, KYCTierService},
185	}
186	
187	// CanApproveKYCTier reports whether approverRole may approve a KYC record
188	// requesting the given tier.
189	func CanApproveKYCTier(approverRole, tier string) bool {
190		for _, t := range KYCApprovableTiers[approverRole] {
191			if t == tier {
192				return true
193			}
194		}
195		return false
196	}

3	// constitution), one party per MVP role, an active rate chart, and sample
4	// animals.

6	// ID scheme: `_id` is always a Mongo-generated ObjectID. Seeding is
7	// idempotent via NATURAL business keys (org `code`, party `phone`, animal
8	// `pashu_aadhaar`) — find-or-insert on the key, then wire relations with the
9	// returned ObjectIDs. Re-running never duplicates and never rewrites.

205	// upsertOrg finds-or-inserts an org unit by its unique code and returns the
206	// stored document (with its generated ObjectID).
207	func upsertOrg(ctx context.Context, db *mongo.Database, o domain.OrgUnit) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
208		var out domain.OrgUnit
209		err := db.Collection(mongodb.CollOrgUnits).FindOneAndUpdate(ctx,
210			bson.D{{Key: "code", Value: o.Code}},
211			bson.D{{Key: "$setOnInsert", Value: o}},
212			options.FindOneAndUpdate().SetUpsert(true).SetReturnDocument(options.After),
213		).Decode(&out)
214		if err != nil {
215			return nil, fmt.Errorf("org %s: %w", o.Code, err)
216		}
217		return &out, nil
218	}
219	
220	// upsertParty finds-or-inserts a party by its unique phone.
221	func upsertParty(ctx context.Context, db *mongo.Database, p domain.Party) (*domain.Party, error) {
222		var out domain.Party
223		err := db.Collection(mongodb.CollParties).FindOneAndUpdate(ctx,
224			bson.D{{Key: "phone", Value: p.Phone}},
225			bson.D{{Key: "$setOnInsert", Value: p}},
226			options.FindOneAndUpdate().SetUpsert(true).SetReturnDocument(options.After),
227		).Decode(&out)
228		if err != nil {
229			return nil, err
230		}
231		return &out, nil
232	}
233	
234	// upsertRoleAssignment finds-or-inserts by the (party, role, org) natural key.
235	func upsertRoleAssignment(ctx context.Context, db *mongo.Database, ra domain.RoleAssignment) error {
236		_, err := db.Collection(mongodb.CollRoleAssignments).UpdateOne(ctx,
237			bson.D{
238				{Key: "party_id", Value: ra.PartyID},
239				{Key: "role_code", Value: ra.RoleCode},
240				{Key: "org_unit_id", Value: ra.OrgUnitID},
241			},
242			bson.D{{Key: "$setOnInsert", Value: ra}},
243			options.Update().SetUpsert(true),
244		)
245		return err
246	}
247	
248	// upsertByFilter inserts doc if nothing matches filter (generic natural-key upsert).
249	func upsertByFilter(ctx context.Context, coll *mongo.Collection, filter bson.D, doc any) error {
250		_, err := coll.UpdateOne(ctx, filter,
251			bson.D{{Key: "$setOnInsert", Value: doc}},
252			options.Update().SetUpsert(true),
253		)
254		return err
255	}

70	// createConsignment pools one DCS date+shift's RECORDED pours into an OPEN
71	// consignment: pour IDs, total litres, quantity-weighted fat/SNF averages and
72	// the can count. The unique dcs+date+shift index makes creation idempotent-ish
73	// (a replay returns CONSIGNMENT_EXISTS).
74	func (s *service) createConsignment(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req createConsignmentRequest) (*domain.DCSConsignment, error) {
75		if req.DCSID.IsZero() {
76			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_DCS_ID", "dcs_id is required")
77		}
78		if err := validateShift(req.Shift); err != nil {
79			return nil, err
80		}
81		now := time.Now().UTC()
82		date, err := resolveDate(req.Date, now)
83		if err != nil {
84			return nil, err
85		}
86		actorID, err := s.actorID(actor)
87		if err != nil {
88			return nil, err
89		}
90		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.DCSID); err != nil {
91			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "consignment creation denied: DCS out of scope",
92				slog.String("dcs_id", req.DCSID.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
93			return nil, err
94		}
95		org, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.DCSID)
96		if err != nil {
97			return nil, err
98		}
99		if org.Type != domain.OrgTypeDCS {
100			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_DCS", "org unit "+req.DCSID.Hex()+" is not a DCS")
101		}
102	
103		rows, err := s.repo.findRecordedPours(ctx, req.DCSID, date, req.Shift)
104		if err != nil {
105			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "create consignment: find recorded pours", err)
106		}
107		if len(rows) == 0 {
108			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "consignment creation rejected: no RECORDED pours",
109				slog.String("dcs_id", req.DCSID.Hex()), slog.String("date", date),
110				slog.String("shift", req.Shift), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
111			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("NO_POURS_TO_CONSIGN",
112				fmt.Sprintf("no RECORDED pours for DCS %s on %s %s", req.DCSID.Hex(), date, req.Shift))
113		}
114		pourIDs, totalQty, avgFat, avgSNF := aggregatePours(rows)
115	
116		consignment := &domain.DCSConsignment{
117			ID:                  primitive.NewObjectID(), // pre-generated: insert + ledger refs stay consistent
118			DCSID:               req.DCSID,
119			Date:                date,
120			Shift:               req.Shift,
121			PourIDs:             pourIDs,
122			TotalQuantityLitres: totalQty,
123			CanCount:            int(math.Ceil(totalQty / canCapacityLitres)),
124			AvgFatPct:           avgFat,
125			AvgSNFPct:           avgSNF,
126			Status:              domain.ConsignmentStatusOpen,
127			CreatedBy:           actorID,
128			CreatedAt:           now,
129		}
130		if err := s.repo.insertConsignment(ctx, consignment); err != nil {
131			if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(err) {
132				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "consignment creation rejected: duplicate for dcs+date+shift",
133					slog.String("dcs_id", req.DCSID.Hex()), slog.String("date", date),
134					slog.String("shift", req.Shift), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
135				return nil, httpx.Conflict("CONSIGNMENT_EXISTS",
136					fmt.Sprintf("a consignment for DCS %s on %s %s already exists", req.DCSID.Hex(), date, req.Shift))
137			}
138			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "create consignment: insert", err)
139		}
140	
141		// Provenance: the pooling-boundary event. Pour refs are capped so the
142		// event stays bounded — past the cap the payload's pour_count is the
143		// authoritative tally (the doc's pour_ids keeps the full set).
144		refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, min(len(pourIDs), maxPourRefs))
145		for i, id := range pourIDs {
146			if i >= maxPourRefs {
147				break
148			}
149			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{EntityType: domain.EntityMilkPour, EntityID: id.Hex(), Relation: "aggregates"})
150		}
151		event, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
152			Type:       domain.EventConsignmentCreated,
153			EntityType: domain.EntityConsignment,
154			EntityID:   consignment.ID.Hex(),
155			Refs:       refs,
156			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
157			OrgUnitID:  consignment.DCSID.Hex(),
158			Payload: map[string]any{
159				"pour_count":            len(pourIDs),
160				"total_quantity_litres": totalQty,
161				"can_count":             consignment.CanCount,
162				"date":                  date,
163				"shift":                 req.Shift,
164			},
165		})
166		if err != nil {
167			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "create consignment: append provenance", err)
168		}
169		if err := s.repo.setConsignmentProvenanceSeq(ctx, consignment.ID, event.Seq); err != nil {
170			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "create consignment: set provenance seq", err)
171		}
172		consignment.ProvenanceSeq = event.Seq
173		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "consignment created",
174			slog.String("consignment_id", consignment.ID.Hex()),
175			slog.String("dcs_id", consignment.DCSID.Hex()),
176			slog.String("date", date), slog.String("shift", req.Shift),
177			slog.Int("pour_count", len(pourIDs)),
178			slog.Float64("total_quantity_litres", totalQty),
179			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
180		return consignment, nil
181	}

183	// dispatchConsignment seals an OPEN consignment for pickup (OPEN→DISPATCHED).
184	// The creation-time pour snapshot is provisional: the seal re-aggregates the
185	// shift's RECORDED pours so milk recorded between creation and dispatch (the
186	// collection module also rejects such pours, belt-and-braces) is reflected in
187	// pour_ids, litres, can count and weighted fat/SNF before the load leaves.
188	func (s *service) dispatchConsignment(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.DCSConsignment, error) {
189		consignment, err := s.loadConsignment(ctx, id)
190		if err != nil {
191			return nil, err
192		}
193		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, consignment.DCSID); err != nil {
194			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "consignment dispatch denied: DCS out of scope",
195				slog.String("consignment_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("dcs_id", consignment.DCSID.Hex()),
196				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
197			return nil, err
198		}
199		if consignment.Status != domain.ConsignmentStatusOpen {
200			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "consignment dispatch rejected: not OPEN",
201				slog.String("consignment_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("status", consignment.Status),
202				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
203			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_CONSIGNMENT_STATE",
204				"consignment is "+consignment.Status+"; only OPEN consignments can be dispatched")
205		}
206	
207		// Re-aggregate at the seal boundary.
208		rows, err := s.repo.findRecordedPours(ctx, consignment.DCSID, consignment.Date, consignment.Shift)
209		if err != nil {
210			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "dispatch consignment: find recorded pours", err)
211		}
212		extraSet := bson.D{}
213		if len(rows) > 0 {
214			pourIDs, totalQty, avgFat, avgSNF := aggregatePours(rows)
215			consignment.PourIDs = pourIDs
216			consignment.TotalQuantityLitres = totalQty
217			consignment.CanCount = int(math.Ceil(totalQty / canCapacityLitres))
218			consignment.AvgFatPct = avgFat
219			consignment.AvgSNFPct = avgSNF
220			extraSet = bson.D{
221				{Key: "pour_ids", Value: pourIDs},
222				{Key: "total_quantity_litres", Value: totalQty},
223				{Key: "can_count", Value: consignment.CanCount},
224				{Key: "avg_fat_pct", Value: avgFat},
225				{Key: "avg_snf_pct", Value: avgSNF},
226			}
227		}
228	
229		now := time.Now().UTC()
230		matched, err := s.repo.markConsignmentDispatched(ctx, id, now, extraSet)
231		if err != nil {
232			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "dispatch consignment: mark dispatched", err)
233		}
234		if !matched { // lost a state race since the read above
235			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "consignment dispatch rejected: lost state race",
236				slog.String("consignment_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
237			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_CONSIGNMENT_STATE",
238				"consignment was modified concurrently; reload and retry")
239		}
240		event, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
241			Type:       domain.EventConsignmentDispatched,
242			EntityType: domain.EntityConsignment,
243			EntityID:   consignment.ID.Hex(),
244			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
245			OrgUnitID:  consignment.DCSID.Hex(),
246			Payload: map[string]any{
247				"pour_count":            len(consignment.PourIDs),
248				"total_quantity_litres": consignment.TotalQuantityLitres,
249				"can_count":             consignment.CanCount,
250				"date":                  consignment.Date,
251				"shift":                 consignment.Shift,
252			},
253		})
254		if err != nil {
255			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "dispatch consignment: append provenance", err)
256		}
257		if err := s.repo.setConsignmentProvenanceSeq(ctx, consignment.ID, event.Seq); err != nil {
258			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "dispatch consignment: set provenance seq", err)
259		}
260		consignment.Status = domain.ConsignmentStatusDispatch
261		consignment.DispatchedAt = &now
262		consignment.ProvenanceSeq = event.Seq
263		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "consignment dispatched",
264			slog.String("consignment_id", consignment.ID.Hex()),
265			slog.String("dcs_id", consignment.DCSID.Hex()),
266			slog.Int("pour_count", len(consignment.PourIDs)),
267			slog.Float64("total_quantity_litres", consignment.TotalQuantityLitres),
268			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
269		return consignment, nil
270	}

272	// listConsignments returns a scoped page of consignments. DCS-scoped actors

275	func (s *service) listConsignments(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, q consignmentListQuery, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.DCSConsignment, int64, error) {

316	
317	// createTrip plans a van run: every stop's consignment must already be
318	// DISPATCHED and must belong to that stop's DCS. The rider defaults to the
319	// actor when a VAN_RIDER plans their own route.
320	func (s *service) createTrip(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req createTripRequest) (*domain.RouteTrip, error) {
321		if req.RouteName == "" {
322			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_ROUTE_NAME", "route_name is required")
323		}
324		if req.UnionID.IsZero() {
325			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_UNION_ID", "union_id is required")
326		}
327		if err := validateShift(req.Shift); err != nil {
328			return nil, err
329		}
330		if len(req.Stops) == 0 {
331			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NO_STOPS", "at least one stop is required")
332		}
333		if len(req.Stops) > maxTripStops {
334			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("TOO_MANY_STOPS", fmt.Sprintf("a trip may have at most %d stops", maxTripStops))
335		}
336		now := time.Now().UTC()
337		date, err := resolveDate(req.Date, now)
338		if err != nil {
339			return nil, err
340		}
341		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.UnionID); err != nil {
342			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "trip creation denied: union out of scope",
343				slog.String("union_id", req.UnionID.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
344			return nil, err
345		}
346		union, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.UnionID)
347		if err != nil {
348			return nil, err
349		}
350		if union.Type != domain.OrgTypeMilkUnion {
351			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_UNION", "org unit "+req.UnionID.Hex()+" is not a MILK_UNION")
352		}
353	
354		var riderPartyID primitive.ObjectID
355		if req.VanRiderPartyID != nil && !req.VanRiderPartyID.IsZero() {
356			riderPartyID = *req.VanRiderPartyID
357		} else {
358			if actor.RoleCode != domain.RoleVanRider {
359				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("RIDER_REQUIRED", "van_rider_party_id is required unless a VAN_RIDER plans their own trip")
360			}
361			actorID, err := s.actorID(actor)
362			if err != nil {
363				return nil, err
364			}
365			riderPartyID = actorID
366		}
367	
368		seen := make(map[primitive.ObjectID]struct{}, len(req.Stops))
369		stops := make([]domain.RouteStop, 0, len(req.Stops))
370		for _, stop := range req.Stops {
371			if stop.DCSID.IsZero() || stop.ConsignmentID.IsZero() {
372				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_STOP", "every stop needs dcs_id and consignment_id")
373			}
374			if _, dup := seen[stop.ConsignmentID]; dup {
375				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("DUPLICATE_STOP", "consignment "+stop.ConsignmentID.Hex()+" appears in more than one stop")
376			}
377			seen[stop.ConsignmentID] = struct{}{}
378	
379			consignment, err := s.loadConsignment(ctx, stop.ConsignmentID)
380			if err != nil {
381				return nil, err
382			}
383			if aerr := validateStopConsignment(consignment, stop.DCSID); aerr != nil {
384				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "trip creation rejected: invalid stop consignment",
385					slog.String("consignment_id", stop.ConsignmentID.Hex()),
386					slog.String("stop_dcs_id", stop.DCSID.Hex()),
387					slog.String("consignment_status", consignment.Status),
388					slog.String("code", aerr.Code),
389					slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
390				return nil, aerr
391			}
392			stops = append(stops, domain.RouteStop{DCSID: stop.DCSID, ConsignmentID: stop.ConsignmentID})
393		}
394	
395		trip := &domain.RouteTrip{
396			ID:              primitive.NewObjectID(), // pre-generated so provenance can reference it later
397			RouteName:       req.RouteName,
398			UnionID:         req.UnionID,
399			VanRiderPartyID: riderPartyID,
400			Date:            date,
401			Shift:           req.Shift,
402			Stops:           stops,
403			Status:          domain.TripStatusPlanned,
404			CreatedAt:       now,
405		}
406		if err := s.repo.insertTrip(ctx, trip); err != nil {
407			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "create trip: insert", err)
408		}
409		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "trip created",
410			slog.String("trip_id", trip.ID.Hex()),
411			slog.String("union_id", trip.UnionID.Hex()),
412			slog.String("van_rider_party_id", trip.VanRiderPartyID.Hex()),
413			slog.String("route_name", trip.RouteName),
414			slog.String("date", date), slog.String("shift", req.Shift),
415			slog.Int("stop_count", len(stops)),
416			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
417		return trip, nil
418	}

420	// pickupStop records the trip's rider collecting one consignment: the stop is
421	// stamped with time+temperature, the consignment moves DISPATCHED→PICKED_UP,
422	// and the trip moves to IN_PROGRESS on its first pickup.
423	func (s *service) pickupStop(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, tripID, consignmentID primitive.ObjectID, req pickupRequest) (*domain.RouteTrip, error) {
424		if err := validateTemp(req.TempC); err != nil {
425			return nil, err
426		}
427		actorID, err := s.actorID(actor)
428		if err != nil {
429			return nil, err
430		}
431		trip, err := s.loadTrip(ctx, tripID)
432		if err != nil {
433			return nil, err
434		}
435		if aerr := validatePickup(trip, actorID, consignmentID); aerr != nil {
436			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "stop pickup rejected",
437				slog.String("trip_id", tripID.Hex()), slog.String("consignment_id", consignmentID.Hex()),
438				slog.String("code", aerr.Code), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
439			return nil, aerr
440		}
441	
442		// Guard the consignment transition atomically; only a DISPATCHED
443		// consignment can board the van.
444		matched, err := s.repo.markConsignmentPickedUp(ctx, consignmentID, trip.ID)
445		if err != nil {
446			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "pickup stop: mark consignment picked up", err)
447		}
448		if !matched {
449			consignment, err := s.loadConsignment(ctx, consignmentID)
450			if err != nil {
451				return nil, err
452			}
453			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "stop pickup rejected: consignment not DISPATCHED",
454				slog.String("trip_id", tripID.Hex()), slog.String("consignment_id", consignmentID.Hex()),
455				slog.String("consignment_status", consignment.Status),
456				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
457			return nil, httpx.Conflict("CONSIGNMENT_NOT_DISPATCHED",
458				"consignment is "+consignment.Status+"; only DISPATCHED consignments can be picked up")
459		}
460	
461		now := time.Now().UTC()
462		if err := s.repo.markStopPickedUp(ctx, trip.ID, consignmentID, now, *req.TempC, req.Notes); err != nil {
463			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "pickup stop: mark stop picked up", err)
464		}
465	
466		event, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
467			Type:       domain.EventConsignmentPickedUp,
468			EntityType: domain.EntityConsignment,
469			EntityID:   consignmentID.Hex(),
470			Refs: []provenance.Ref{
471				{EntityType: domain.EntityRouteTrip, EntityID: trip.ID.Hex(), Relation: "carried_by"},
472			},
473			Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
474			OrgUnitID: trip.UnionID.Hex(),
475			Payload:   map[string]any{"temp_c": *req.TempC},
476		})
477		if err != nil {
478			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "pickup stop: append provenance", err)
479		}
480		if err := s.repo.setConsignmentProvenanceSeq(ctx, consignmentID, event.Seq); err != nil {
481			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "pickup stop: set provenance seq", err)
482		}
483	
484		trip.Status = domain.TripStatusInProgress
485		if i := findStop(trip, consignmentID); i >= 0 {
486			trip.Stops[i].PickedUpAt = &now
487			trip.Stops[i].TempC = *req.TempC
488			trip.Stops[i].Notes = req.Notes
489		}
490		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "stop picked up",
491			slog.String("trip_id", trip.ID.Hex()),
492			slog.String("consignment_id", consignmentID.Hex()),
493			slog.Float64("temp_c", *req.TempC),
494			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
495		return trip, nil
496	}

498	// logColdChain appends one in-transit temperature sample to the trip —
499	// tamper-evidence for the perishable load between village and BMC.
500	func (s *service) logColdChain(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, tripID primitive.ObjectID, req coldChainRequest) (*domain.RouteTrip, error) {
501		if err := validateTemp(req.TempC); err != nil {
502			return nil, err
503		}

506			return nil, err
507		}
508		trip, err := s.loadTrip(ctx, tripID)
509		if err != nil {
510			return nil, err
511		}
512		if aerr := validateColdChain(trip, actorID); aerr != nil {
513			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "cold-chain log rejected",
514				slog.String("trip_id", tripID.Hex()), slog.String("code", aerr.Code),
515				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
516			return nil, aerr
517		}
518		entry := domain.ColdChainEntry{
519			TS:     time.Now().UTC(),
520			TempC:  *req.TempC,

523		}
524		if err := s.repo.pushColdChain(ctx, trip.ID, entry); err != nil {
525			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "log cold chain: push entry", err)
526		}
527		event, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
528			Type:       domain.EventColdChainLogged,
529			EntityType: domain.EntityRouteTrip,
530			EntityID:   trip.ID.Hex(),
531			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
532			OrgUnitID:  trip.UnionID.Hex(),
533			Payload:    map[string]any{"temp_c": *req.TempC},
534		})
535		if err != nil {
536			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "log cold chain: append provenance", err)
537		}
538		if err := s.repo.setTripProvenanceSeq(ctx, trip.ID, event.Seq); err != nil {
539			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "log cold chain: set provenance seq", err)
540		}
541		trip.ColdChain = append(trip.ColdChain, entry)
542		trip.ProvenanceSeq = event.Seq
543		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "cold chain logged",
544			slog.String("trip_id", trip.ID.Hex()),
545			slog.Float64("temp_c", *req.TempC),
546			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
547		return trip, nil
548	}

550	// deliverTrip hands the whole load to a BMC: every stop must be picked up,
551	// the trip moves IN_PROGRESS→DELIVERED and its consignments PICKED_UP→DELIVERED.
552	func (s *service) deliverTrip(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, tripID primitive.ObjectID, req deliverRequest) (*domain.RouteTrip, error) {
553		if req.BMCID.IsZero() {
554			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_BMC_ID", "bmc_id is required")
555		}
556		actorID, err := s.actorID(actor)
557		if err != nil {
558			return nil, err
559		}
560		trip, err := s.loadTrip(ctx, tripID)
561		if err != nil {
562			return nil, err
563		}
564		if aerr := validateDeliver(trip, actorID); aerr != nil {
565			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "trip delivery rejected",
566				slog.String("trip_id", tripID.Hex()), slog.String("code", aerr.Code),
567				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
568			return nil, aerr
569		}
570		bmc, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.BMCID)
571		if err != nil {
572			return nil, err
573		}
574		if bmc.Type != domain.OrgTypeBMC {
575			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_BMC", "org unit "+req.BMCID.Hex()+" is not a BMC")
576		}
577	
578		now := time.Now().UTC()
579		matched, err := s.repo.markTripDelivered(ctx, trip.ID, req.BMCID, now)
580		if err != nil {
581			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "deliver trip: mark delivered", err)
582		}
583		if !matched { // lost a state race since the read above
584			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "trip delivery rejected: lost state race",
585				slog.String("trip_id", tripID.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
586			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_TRIP_STATE", "trip was modified concurrently; reload and retry")
587		}
588	
589		consignmentIDs := make([]primitive.ObjectID, 0, len(trip.Stops))
590		refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, len(trip.Stops))
591		for _, stop := range trip.Stops {
592			consignmentIDs = append(consignmentIDs, stop.ConsignmentID)
593			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{
594				EntityType: domain.EntityConsignment, EntityID: stop.ConsignmentID.Hex(), Relation: "delivered",
595			})
596		}
597		if err := s.repo.markConsignmentsDelivered(ctx, consignmentIDs); err != nil {
598			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "deliver trip: mark consignments delivered", err)
599		}
600	
601		event, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
602			Type:       domain.EventTripDelivered,
603			EntityType: domain.EntityRouteTrip,
604			EntityID:   trip.ID.Hex(),
605			Refs:       refs,
606			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
607			OrgUnitID:  trip.UnionID.Hex(),
608			Payload:    map[string]any{"bmc_id": req.BMCID.Hex()},
609		})
610		if err != nil {
611			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "deliver trip: append provenance", err)
612		}
613		if err := s.repo.setTripProvenanceSeq(ctx, trip.ID, event.Seq); err != nil {
614			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "deliver trip: set provenance seq", err)
615		}
616	
617		trip.Status = domain.TripStatusDelivered
618		trip.DeliveredToBMCID = &req.BMCID
619		trip.DeliveredAt = &now
620		trip.ProvenanceSeq = event.Seq
621		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "trip delivered",
622			slog.String("trip_id", trip.ID.Hex()),
623			slog.String("bmc_id", req.BMCID.Hex()),
624			slog.Int("consignment_count", len(consignmentIDs)),
625			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
626		return trip, nil
627	}

629	// listTrips returns a scoped page of trips: riders are forced onto their own
630	// trips; supervisors/presidents default to (and are checked against) their
631	// union scope.
632	func (s *service) listTrips(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, q tripListQuery, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.RouteTrip, int64, error) {
633		unionID := q.UnionID
634		riderPartyID := q.VanRiderPartyID
635		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleVanRider {
636			actorID, err := s.actorID(actor)
637			if err != nil {
638				return nil, 0, err
639			}
640			riderPartyID = actorID // riders only ever see their own trips
641		} else {
642			if unionID.IsZero() &&
643				actor.RoleCode != domain.RoleSuperAdmin && actor.RoleCode != domain.RoleStateAuditor &&
644				actor.OrgUnitID != "" {
645				id, err := httpx.ParseID(actor.OrgUnitID, "actor org unit")
646				if err != nil {
647					return nil, 0, err
648				}
649				unionID = id // supervisors/presidents default to their union
650			}
651			if !unionID.IsZero() {
652				if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, unionID); err != nil {
653					s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "trip list denied: union out of scope",
654						slog.String("union_id", unionID.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
655					return nil, 0, err
656				}
657			}
658		}
659		if q.Date != "" {
660			if _, err := resolveDate(q.Date, time.Time{}); err != nil {
661				return nil, 0, err
662			}
663		}
664		items, total, err := s.repo.listTrips(ctx, unionID, q.Date, riderPartyID, page)
665		if err != nil {
666			return nil, 0, s.internal(ctx, "list trips", err)
667		}
668		return items, total, nil
669	}

671	// getTrip returns one trip: a rider only their own, everyone else within
672	// union scope.
673	func (s *service) getTrip(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, tripID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.RouteTrip, error) {
674		trip, err := s.loadTrip(ctx, tripID)
675		if err != nil {
676			return nil, err
677		}
678		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleVanRider {
679			actorID, err := s.actorID(actor)
680			if err != nil {
681				return nil, err
682			}
683			if trip.VanRiderPartyID != actorID {
684				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "trip read denied: assigned to another rider",
685					slog.String("trip_id", tripID.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
686				return nil, httpx.Forbidden("this trip is assigned to another van rider")
687			}
688			return trip, nil
689		}
690		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, trip.UnionID); err != nil {
691			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "trip read denied: union out of scope",
692				slog.String("trip_id", tripID.Hex()), slog.String("union_id", trip.UnionID.Hex()),
693				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
694			return nil, err
695		}
696		return trip, nil
697	}

727	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
728	// Pure guards & helpers (unit-tested in service_test.go)
729	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
730	
731	// aggregatePours reduces pour rows to (ids, total litres, quantity-weighted
732	// average fat %, quantity-weighted average SNF %), rounded to 2 decimals.
733	func aggregatePours(rows []pourRow) (pourIDs []primitive.ObjectID, totalQty, avgFat, avgSNF float64) {
734		var fatWeighted, snfWeighted float64
735		pourIDs = make([]primitive.ObjectID, 0, len(rows))
736		for _, row := range rows {
737			pourIDs = append(pourIDs, row.ID)
738			totalQty += row.QuantityLitres
739			fatWeighted += row.FatPct * row.QuantityLitres
740			snfWeighted += row.SNFPct * row.QuantityLitres
741		}
742		if totalQty > 0 {
743			avgFat = round2(fatWeighted / totalQty)
744			avgSNF = round2(snfWeighted / totalQty)
745		}
746		return pourIDs, round2(totalQty), avgFat, avgSNF
747	}
748	
749	// round2 rounds to 2 decimal places (litres / percentage precision).
750	func round2(v float64) float64 { return math.Round(v*100) / 100 }
751	
752	// validateShift accepts only the two collection shifts.
753	func validateShift(shift string) *httpx.AppError {
754		if shift != domain.ShiftMorning && shift != domain.ShiftEvening {
755			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_SHIFT", "shift must be MORNING or EVENING")
756		}
757		return nil
758	}
759	
760	// resolveDate defaults an empty date to the IST day key of now, otherwise
761	// validates the YYYY-MM-DD form.
762	func resolveDate(date string, now time.Time) (string, error) {
763		if date == "" {
764			return domain.DateKeyIST(now), nil
765		}
766		if _, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", date); err != nil {
767			return "", httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_DATE", "date must be YYYY-MM-DD")
768		}
769		return date, nil
770	}
771	
772	// validateTemp requires a temperature and rejects physically implausible ones.
773	func validateTemp(tempC *float64) *httpx.AppError {
774		if tempC == nil {
775			return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_TEMP", "temp_c is required")
776		}
777		if *tempC < minPlausibleTempC || *tempC > maxPlausibleTempC {
778			return httpx.BadRequest("IMPLAUSIBLE_TEMP",
779				fmt.Sprintf("temp_c must be between %.0f and %.0f °C", minPlausibleTempC, maxPlausibleTempC))
780		}
781		return nil
782	}
783	
784	// isConsignmentStatus reports whether s is a known consignment status.
785	func isConsignmentStatus(s string) bool {
786		switch s {
787		case domain.ConsignmentStatusOpen, domain.ConsignmentStatusDispatch,
788			domain.ConsignmentStatusPickedUp, domain.ConsignmentStatusDelivered,
789			domain.ConsignmentStatusAccepted, domain.ConsignmentStatusRejected:
790			return true
791		}
792		return false
793	}
794	
795	// findStop returns the index of the stop carrying consignmentID, or -1.
796	func findStop(trip *domain.RouteTrip, consignmentID primitive.ObjectID) int {
797		for i := range trip.Stops {
798			if trip.Stops[i].ConsignmentID == consignmentID {
799				return i
800			}
801		}
802		return -1
803	}
804	
805	// requireTripRider enforces that only the trip's assigned van rider acts on it.
806	func requireTripRider(trip *domain.RouteTrip, riderPartyID primitive.ObjectID) *httpx.AppError {
807		if trip.VanRiderPartyID != riderPartyID {
808			return httpx.Forbidden("this trip is assigned to another van rider")
809		}
810		return nil
811	}
812	
813	// validateStopConsignment guards trip planning: the stop's consignment must
814	// be DISPATCHED (state machine) and must belong to the stop's DCS.
815	func validateStopConsignment(consignment *domain.DCSConsignment, stopDCSID primitive.ObjectID) *httpx.AppError {
816		if consignment.Status != domain.ConsignmentStatusDispatch {
817			return httpx.Conflict("CONSIGNMENT_NOT_DISPATCHED",
818				"consignment "+consignment.ID.Hex()+" is "+consignment.Status+"; only DISPATCHED consignments can be planned onto a trip")
819		}
820		if consignment.DCSID != stopDCSID {
821			return httpx.Unprocessable("CONSIGNMENT_DCS_MISMATCH",
822				"consignment "+consignment.ID.Hex()+" belongs to DCS "+consignment.DCSID.Hex()+", not the stop's DCS "+stopDCSID.Hex())
823		}
824		return nil
825	}
826	
827	// validatePickup guards the pickup transition: right rider, trip not yet
828	// delivered, stop exists, stop not already picked.
829	func validatePickup(trip *domain.RouteTrip, riderPartyID, consignmentID primitive.ObjectID) *httpx.AppError {
830		if err := requireTripRider(trip, riderPartyID); err != nil {
831			return err
832		}
833		if trip.Status == domain.TripStatusDelivered {
834			return httpx.Conflict("TRIP_ALREADY_DELIVERED", "trip is DELIVERED; no further pickups are possible")
835		}
836		i := findStop(trip, consignmentID)
837		if i < 0 {
838			return httpx.NotFound("stop for consignment " + consignmentID.Hex())
839		}
840		if trip.Stops[i].PickedUpAt != nil {
841			return httpx.Conflict("STOP_ALREADY_PICKED", "consignment "+consignmentID.Hex()+" was already picked up on this trip")
842		}
843		return nil
844	}
845	
846	// validateColdChain guards cold-chain logging: right rider, trip still moving.
847	func validateColdChain(trip *domain.RouteTrip, riderPartyID primitive.ObjectID) *httpx.AppError {
848		if err := requireTripRider(trip, riderPartyID); err != nil {
849			return err
850		}
851		if trip.Status == domain.TripStatusDelivered {
852			return httpx.Conflict("TRIP_ALREADY_DELIVERED", "trip is DELIVERED; cold-chain logging is closed")
853		}
854		return nil
855	}
856	
857	// validateDeliver guards delivery: right rider, not already delivered, and
858	// every stop picked up (partial loads cannot be handed to a BMC).
859	func validateDeliver(trip *domain.RouteTrip, riderPartyID primitive.ObjectID) *httpx.AppError {
860		if err := requireTripRider(trip, riderPartyID); err != nil {
861			return err
862		}
863		if trip.Status == domain.TripStatusDelivered {
864			return httpx.Conflict("TRIP_ALREADY_DELIVERED", "trip is already DELIVERED")
865		}
866		var unpicked []string
867		for _, stop := range trip.Stops {
868			if stop.PickedUpAt == nil {
869				unpicked = append(unpicked, stop.ConsignmentID.Hex())
870			}
871		}
872		if len(unpicked) > 0 {
873			return httpx.Unprocessable("STOPS_NOT_PICKED", "every stop must be picked up before delivery").
874				WithDetails(map[string]any{"unpicked_consignment_ids": unpicked})
875		}
876		return nil
877	}

8		Date  string             `json:"date,omitempty"` // YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to today (IST)
9		Shift string             `json:"shift"`
10	}
11	
12	// tripStopRequest names one pickup on a planned route.
13	type tripStopRequest struct {
14		DCSID         primitive.ObjectID `json:"dcs_id"`
15		ConsignmentID primitive.ObjectID `json:"consignment_id"`
16	}
17	
18	// createTripRequest plans a van run across DCS stops for one date+shift.
19	type createTripRequest struct {
20		RouteName       string              `json:"route_name"`
21		UnionID         primitive.ObjectID  `json:"union_id"`
22		Date            string              `json:"date,omitempty"` // YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to today (IST)
23		Shift           string              `json:"shift"`
24		VanRiderPartyID *primitive.ObjectID `json:"van_rider_party_id,omitempty"` // defaults to the actor when a VAN_RIDER plans
25		Stops           []tripStopRequest   `json:"stops"`
26	}
27	
28	// pickupRequest records collecting one consignment at a stop. TempC is a
29	// pointer so a legitimate 0.0 °C reading is distinguishable from "missing".
30	type pickupRequest struct {
31		TempC *float64 `json:"temp_c"`
32		Notes string   `json:"notes,omitempty"`
33	}
34	
35	// coldChainRequest logs an in-transit temperature (and optional location)
36	// sample — tamper-evidence for a perishable load.
37	type coldChainRequest struct {
38		TempC  *float64 `json:"temp_c"`
39		GeoLat float64  `json:"geo_lat,omitempty"`
40		GeoLng float64  `json:"geo_lng,omitempty"`
41	}
42

44	type deliverRequest struct {
45		BMCID primitive.ObjectID `json:"bmc_id"`
46	}

1	package logistics
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"fmt"

7	
8		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"

12	
13		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
14		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/mongodb"
16	)
17	
18	// repo owns every MongoDB access for the logistics module. It returns raw
19	// driver errors wrapped with operation context (mongo.ErrNoDocuments stays
20	// detectable via errors.Is); the service layer maps them to httpx errors.
21	// No business logic lives here.
22	type repo struct {
23		consignments *mongo.Collection
24		trips        *mongo.Collection
25		pours        *mongo.Collection // read-only view into the collection module's pours (sanctioned by spec)
26	}
27	
28	// newRepo binds the repo to its collections via the shared name constants.
29	func newRepo(db *mongo.Database) *repo {
30		return &repo{
31			consignments: db.Collection(mongodb.CollConsignments),
32			trips:        db.Collection(mongodb.CollRouteTrips),
33			pours:        db.Collection(mongodb.CollMilkPours),
34		}
35	}
36	
37	// pourRow is the projected slice of a milk pour needed for aggregation.
38	type pourRow struct {
39		ID             primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id"`
40		QuantityLitres float64            `bson:"quantity_litres"`
41		FatPct         float64            `bson:"fat_pct"`
42		SNFPct         float64            `bson:"snf_pct"`
43	}
44	
45	// findRecordedPours returns the RECORDED pours of one DCS date+shift,
46	// projected down to the fields the consignment aggregate needs.
47	func (r *repo) findRecordedPours(ctx context.Context, dcsID primitive.ObjectID, date, shift string) ([]pourRow, error) {
48		filter := bson.D{
49			{Key: "dcs_id", Value: dcsID},
50			{Key: "pour_date", Value: date},
51			{Key: "shift", Value: shift},
52			{Key: "status", Value: domain.PourStatusRecorded},
53		}
54		projection := bson.D{
55			{Key: "_id", Value: 1},
56			{Key: "quantity_litres", Value: 1},
57			{Key: "fat_pct", Value: 1},
58			{Key: "snf_pct", Value: 1},
59		}
60		cur, err := r.pours.Find(ctx, filter,
61			options.Find().SetProjection(projection).SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "created_at", Value: 1}}))
62		if err != nil {
63			return nil, fmt.Errorf("find recorded pours: %w", err)
64		}
65		var rows []pourRow
66		if err := cur.All(ctx, &rows); err != nil {
67			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode recorded pours: %w", err)
68		}
69		return rows, nil
70	}
71	
72	// insertConsignment stores a new consignment (the service pre-generates its
73	// ObjectID). The unique index on dcs_id+date+shift turns duplicates into a
74	// duplicate-key error — kept unwrapped-detectable via %w.
75	func (r *repo) insertConsignment(ctx context.Context, c *domain.DCSConsignment) error {
76		if _, err := r.consignments.InsertOne(ctx, c); err != nil {
77			return fmt.Errorf("insert consignment: %w", err)
78		}
79		return nil
80	}
81	
82	// findConsignmentByID loads one consignment.
83	func (r *repo) findConsignmentByID(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.DCSConsignment, error) {
84		var c domain.DCSConsignment
85		if err := r.consignments.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&c); err != nil {
86			return nil, fmt.Errorf("find consignment %s: %w", id.Hex(), err)
87		}
88		return &c, nil
89	}
90	
91	// markConsignmentDispatched transitions OPEN→DISPATCHED optimistically:
92	// the status filter makes the guard atomic without transactions. The seal
93	// also re-stamps the pour aggregates (extraSet) so pours recorded between
94	// creation and dispatch are never lost from the consignment's totals.
95	func (r *repo) markConsignmentDispatched(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID, at time.Time, extraSet bson.D) (bool, error) {
96		set := bson.D{
97			{Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusDispatch},
98			{Key: "dispatched_at", Value: at},
99		}
100		set = append(set, extraSet...)
101		res, err := r.consignments.UpdateOne(ctx,
102			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}, {Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusOpen}},
103			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: set}})
104		if err != nil {
105			return false, fmt.Errorf("mark consignment dispatched: %w", err)
106		}
107		return res.MatchedCount > 0, nil
108	}
109	
110	// markConsignmentPickedUp transitions DISPATCHED→PICKED_UP and pins the
111	// carrying trip, guarded atomically by the status filter.
112	func (r *repo) markConsignmentPickedUp(ctx context.Context, id, tripID primitive.ObjectID) (bool, error) {
113		res, err := r.consignments.UpdateOne(ctx,
114			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}, {Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusDispatch}},
115			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
116				{Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusPickedUp},
117				{Key: "route_trip_id", Value: tripID},
118			}}})
119		if err != nil {
120			return false, fmt.Errorf("mark consignment picked up: %w", err)
121		}
122		return res.MatchedCount > 0, nil
123	}
124	
125	// markConsignmentsDelivered transitions every listed PICKED_UP consignment
126	// to DELIVERED (bulk companion of the trip delivery).
127	func (r *repo) markConsignmentsDelivered(ctx context.Context, ids []primitive.ObjectID) error {
128		_, err := r.consignments.UpdateMany(ctx,
129			bson.D{
130				{Key: "_id", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: ids}}},
131				{Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusPickedUp},
132			},
133			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusDelivered}}}})
134		if err != nil {
135			return fmt.Errorf("mark consignments delivered: %w", err)
136		}
137		return nil
138	}
139	
140	// setConsignmentProvenanceSeq pins the latest ledger sequence on the doc.
141	func (r *repo) setConsignmentProvenanceSeq(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID, seq int64) error {
142		_, err := r.consignments.UpdateByID(ctx, id,
143			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "provenance_seq", Value: seq}}}})
144		if err != nil {
145			return fmt.Errorf("set consignment provenance seq: %w", err)
146		}
147		return nil
148	}
149	
150	// listConsignments returns a filtered, newest-first page plus the total count.
151	// A zero dcsID means "no DCS filter".
152	func (r *repo) listConsignments(ctx context.Context, dcsID primitive.ObjectID, date, status string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.DCSConsignment, int64, error) {
153		filter := bson.D{}
154		if !dcsID.IsZero() {
155			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "dcs_id", Value: dcsID})
156		}
157		if date != "" {
158			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "date", Value: date})
159		}
160		if status != "" {
161			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "status", Value: status})
162		}
163		total, err := r.consignments.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
164		if err != nil {
165			return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("count consignments: %w", err)
166		}
167		cur, err := r.consignments.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
168			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "created_at", Value: -1}}).
169			SetSkip(page.Offset).SetLimit(page.Limit))
170		if err != nil {
171			return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("list consignments: %w", err)
172		}
173		items := []domain.DCSConsignment{}
174		if err := cur.All(ctx, &items); err != nil {
175			return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("decode consignments: %w", err)
176		}
177		return items, total, nil
178	}
179	
180	// insertTrip stores a new route trip (the service pre-generates its ObjectID).
181	func (r *repo) insertTrip(ctx context.Context, t *domain.RouteTrip) error {
182		if _, err := r.trips.InsertOne(ctx, t); err != nil {
183			return fmt.Errorf("insert trip: %w", err)
184		}
185		return nil
186	}
187	
188	// findTripByID loads one trip.
189	func (r *repo) findTripByID(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.RouteTrip, error) {
190		var t domain.RouteTrip
191		if err := r.trips.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&t); err != nil {
192			return nil, fmt.Errorf("find trip %s: %w", id.Hex(), err)
193		}
194		return &t, nil
195	}
196	
197	// markStopPickedUp stamps the matched stop with pickup time/temperature and
198	// moves the trip to IN_PROGRESS (idempotent once it is already there).
199	func (r *repo) markStopPickedUp(ctx context.Context, tripID, consignmentID primitive.ObjectID, at time.Time, tempC float64, notes string) error {
200		_, err := r.trips.UpdateOne(ctx,
201			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: tripID}, {Key: "stops.consignment_id", Value: consignmentID}},
202			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
203				{Key: "stops.$.picked_up_at", Value: at},
204				{Key: "stops.$.temp_c", Value: tempC},
205				{Key: "stops.$.notes", Value: notes},
206				{Key: "status", Value: domain.TripStatusInProgress},
207			}}})
208		if err != nil {
209			return fmt.Errorf("mark stop picked up: %w", err)
210		}
211		return nil
212	}
213

215	func (r *repo) pushColdChain(ctx context.Context, tripID primitive.ObjectID, entry domain.ColdChainEntry) error {
216		_, err := r.trips.UpdateByID(ctx, tripID,
217			bson.D{{Key: "$push", Value: bson.D{{Key: "cold_chain", Value: entry}}}})
218		if err != nil {
219			return fmt.Errorf("push cold chain entry: %w", err)
220		}
221		return nil
222	}
223

242		_, err := r.trips.UpdateByID(ctx, id,

## Report: Photo / Evidence storage — Saathi Go (BE vs FE)

### 1. Does the backend already have a photo field? What is it called? Key or URL?

Yes — on **`AnalyzerReading`**, not on `MilkPour`.

- `internal/domain/collection.go:82`
  ```go
  PhotoObjectKey string `bson:"photo_object_key,omitempty" json:"photo_object_key,omitempty"` // immutable evidence in object store
  ```
- It is a **storage/object key, not a URL** — deliberately. Comments make this explicit: the domain field says "immutable evidence in object store", and `internal/platform/httpx/decode.go:13` notes "photo evidence goes to the object store, not the API."
- It's accepted on input via `CreateReadingRequest.PhotoObjectKey` (`internal/modules/collection/models.go:35`, json `photo_object_key`) on `POST /collection/readings`, and is **required when `mode == PHOTO_OCR`** (`service.go:254-255`: "photo_object_key is required for PHOTO_OCR (evidence retention, §8.2)").
- Important: **`MilkPour` has NO photo field at all.** The photo lives only on the reading; a pour links to it via the optional `AnalyzerReadingID` (`analyzer_reading_id`). Pours store fat/snf/qty/amount but no evidence pointer.

### 2. What does the FE send/expect for the analyzer photo? Does it call POST /pours/ocr-extract? Does that endpoint exist?

- The FE's photo model everywhere is a **URL**. `src/core/media/upload.ts` (`uploadImage`) does presigned-S3 upload and returns **both** `{ url, key }` (`UploadedImage`). Other flows store the URL as `photoUri` / `proofPhotoUri` (e.g. logistics `photo_uri`, onboarding `kycPhotoUri`).
- **But the pour/reading capture flow does NOT currently attach any photo.** `RecordPourInput` (`collections.ts`) has no photo field, and `recordPour` maps only fat/snf/qty/clr/source to `POST /collection/pours`. No photo bytes, URI, or key are sent.
- The FE **does call `POST /pours/ocr-extract`** (`collections.ts:321-330`, `photoOcrExtract`), used by `RecordPourSheet.tsx:85` (`ocr.mutate({ dcsId })`). Notably it sends **only `{ dcsId }` — not even a photo** — and returns `{ fatPct, snfPct, confidence }`, which the sheet uses to autofill and set `entryMethod = 'PHOTO_OCR'`.
- **This endpoint does NOT exist on the backend.** It is explicitly a mock: `// TODO(backend): no OCR endpoint yet - mock only`. There is no `/pours/ocr-extract` route (all collection routes are under `/collection/*`; note the FE path even omits the `/collection` prefix), and no OCR/vision computation anywhere in the Go code.

### 3. RECOMMENDATION on the photo field

**Keep `photo_object_key`. Do NOT rename, and do NOT add a stored `photo_link`/`photo_url` column.** Per the user's own rule ("if already done then no need to change the field name") — it's done and it's the correct model:

- Storing a stable **object key** is better than a URL: bucket/CDN/host and presigned expiry can change, but the key is immutable evidence.
- The FE already has the key it needs — `uploadImage` returns `{ url, key }`. The FE just needs to **map its uploaded `key` → `photo_object_key`** when it POSTs the reading. No backend field change required.
- The only place a URL is genuinely useful is **display** (showing the evidence photo back to a supervisor). If that's needed, add a **read-only, computed `photo_url`** on the reading *response* (a presigned GET minted from the key) — never a second persisted field. That is optional and additive, not a rename.

### 4. OCR-extract endpoint gap

Yes, there is a real gap **and a design mismatch**:

- The FE expects a **server-side** OCR endpoint (`POST /pours/ocr-extract`: photo → `{fat, snf, confidence}`). The backend has **no such endpoint** and does no OCR.
- The backend design assumes OCR happens **on-device**: the client extracts fat/snf + confidence + uploads the photo (getting a key), then POSTs a finished reading to `POST /collection/readings` with `mode=PHOTO_OCR`, `photo_object_key`, and `ocr_confidence`. The server only *flags* low confidence (`lowOCRConfidenceThreshold = 0.75`, `service.go:206`), it does not produce the numbers.

Two ways to close it:
- **Option A (matches current BE design, less work):** FE performs OCR on-device, uploads the photo → key, then calls `POST /collection/readings` (PHOTO_OCR, `photo_object_key`, `ocr_confidence`) and links the returned reading to the pour via `analyzer_reading_id`. Then `photoOcrExtract`/`/pours/ocr-extract` should be removed, not implemented.
- **Option B (matches current FE call):** BE adds a `POST /collection/pours/ocr-extract` (or `/readings/ocr-extract`) that accepts an uploaded photo or `photo_object_key` and returns `{fat_pct, snf_pct, confidence}`. This requires a server OCR/vision integration.

Either way, the FE's OCR call needs the `/collection` path prefix, and today the FE captures/sends **no photo at all** in the pour flow — that wiring (capture → `uploadImage` → key → reading) is the missing piece, independent of which OCR option is chosen.

154	// the latest effective_from. Returns httpx.NotFound when no chart covers the
155	// DCS. Scope enforcement is the caller's job — the pour pricing path has
156	// already checked the actor's scope.
157	func (s *service) resolveActiveChartForDCS(ctx context.Context, dcsID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.RateChart, error) {
158		dcs, err := s.d.Orgs.Get(ctx, dcsID)
159		if err != nil {
160			return nil, err
161		}
162		if dcs.Type != domain.OrgTypeDCS {
163			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_DCS", "org unit "+dcsID.Hex()+" is not a DCS")
164		}
165	
166		// Distance 0 = the DCS itself; Path is root→parent, so walk it backwards.
167		distance := map[primitive.ObjectID]int{dcs.ID: 0}
168		orgIDs := []primitive.ObjectID{dcs.ID}
169		for i := len(dcs.Path) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
170			distance[dcs.Path[i]] = len(dcs.Path) - i
171			orgIDs = append(orgIDs, dcs.Path[i])
172		}
173	
174		charts, err := s.repo.activeChartsForOrgs(ctx, orgIDs, time.Now().UTC())
175		if err != nil {
176			return nil, err
177		}
178		var best *domain.RateChart
179		for i := range charts {
180			c := &charts[i]
181			if best == nil {
182				best = c
183				continue
184			}
185			dc, db := distance[c.OrgUnitID], distance[best.OrgUnitID]
186			if dc < db || (dc == db && c.EffectiveFrom.After(best.EffectiveFrom)) {
187				best = c
188			}
189		}
190		if best == nil {
191			return nil, httpx.NotFound("active rate chart for DCS " + dcsID.Hex())
192		}
193		return best, nil
194	}

216			}
217			if skew > maxClockSkew {
218				out = append(out, domain.IntegrityFlagClockSkew)
219			}

221		return out
222	}
