```text
1	package auth
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"sync"
6	)
7	
8	// Actor is the authenticated caller extracted from a verified token and
9	// stored on the request context by the auth middleware.
10	type Actor struct {
11		PartyID          string
12		Phone            string
13		KYCTier          string
14		Kind             string // session | role
15		RoleAssignmentID string
16		RoleCode         string
17		OrgUnitID        string
18		OrgType          string
19	}
20	
21	// HasRole reports whether the actor operates under one of the given roles.
22	func (a Actor) HasRole(roles ...string) bool {
23		for _, r := range roles {
24			if a.RoleCode == r {
25				return true
26			}
27		}
28		return false
29	}
30	
31	type actorCtxKey struct{}
32	
33	// actorHolder is a mutable cell installed by OUTER middleware (audit) so
34	// identity established by INNER middleware (Authenticate) can flow back out.
35	// Context values only propagate inward; the shared pointer bridges the gap.
36	type actorHolder struct {
37		mu sync.Mutex
38		a  *Actor
39	}
40	
41	type actorHolderCtxKey struct{}
42	
43	// WithActorHolder installs an empty actor holder on the context. Middleware
44	// mounted before authentication uses it to observe the actor after the
45	// handler chain ran.
46	func WithActorHolder(ctx context.Context) context.Context {
47		return context.WithValue(ctx, actorHolderCtxKey{}, &actorHolder{})
48	}
49	
50	// HeldActor returns the actor captured by an inner WithActor call, if a
51	// holder was installed and authentication happened.
52	func HeldActor(ctx context.Context) (Actor, bool) {
53		h, ok := ctx.Value(actorHolderCtxKey{}).(*actorHolder)
54		if !ok {
55			return Actor{}, false
56		}
57		h.mu.Lock()
58		defer h.mu.Unlock()
59		if h.a == nil {
60			return Actor{}, false
61		}
62		return *h.a, true
63	}
64	
65	// WithActor stores the actor on the context, and also fills the outward
66	// actor holder when one was installed upstream (see WithActorHolder).
67	func WithActor(ctx context.Context, a Actor) context.Context {
68		if h, ok := ctx.Value(actorHolderCtxKey{}).(*actorHolder); ok {
69			h.mu.Lock()
70			cp := a
71			h.a = &cp
72			h.mu.Unlock()
73		}
74		return context.WithValue(ctx, actorCtxKey{}, a)
75	}
76	
77	// ActorFrom retrieves the actor, if any.
78	func ActorFrom(ctx context.Context) (Actor, bool) {
79		a, ok := ctx.Value(actorCtxKey{}).(Actor)
80		return a, ok
81	}
82
```

```text
136	// requestOTP creates a hashed OTP challenge and queues the SMS through the
137	// notification outbox (the platformops worker delivers it).
138	func (s *service) requestOTP(ctx context.Context, phone string) (*otpRequestResponse, error) {
139		now := time.Now().UTC()
140		code, err := auth.GenerateNumericOTP(otpLength)
141		if err != nil {
142			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "otp generation failed", slog.Any("err", err))
143			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
144		}
145	
146		challenge := otpChallenge{
147			ID:        uuid.NewString(),
148			Phone:     phone,
149			CodeHash:  auth.HMACHash(s.deps.Cfg.OTPHashSecret, phone, code),
150			ExpiresAt: now.Add(s.deps.Cfg.OTPTTL),
151			Attempts:  0,
152		}
153		if err := s.repo.insertOTPChallenge(ctx, challenge); err != nil {
154			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "otp challenge insert failed", slog.String("phone", phone), slog.Any("err", err))
155			return nil, err
156		}
157	
158		// Outbox SMS: the plaintext code travels only inside the notification
159		// params so the sender can deliver it; the challenge stores the hash.
160		notification := domain.Notification{
161			Phone:       phone,
162			Channel:     domain.ChannelSMS,
163			TemplateKey: domain.TemplateOTP,
164			Language:    defaultLanguage,
165			Params:      map[string]string{"otp": code},
166			Status:      domain.NotificationQueued,
167			QueuedAt:    now,
168		}
169		if party, err := s.repo.findPartyByPhone(ctx, phone); err == nil {
170			pid := party.ID
171			notification.PartyID = &pid
172			if party.PreferredLanguage != "" {
173				notification.Language = party.PreferredLanguage
174			}
175		}
176		if err := s.repo.insertNotification(ctx, notification); err != nil {
177			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "otp notification queue failed", slog.String("phone", phone), slog.Any("err", err))
178			return nil, err
179		}
180	
181		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "otp requested", slog.String("phone", phone))
182		resp := &otpRequestResponse{Phone: phone, ExpiresAt: challenge.ExpiresAt}
183		if s.deps.Cfg.OTPDevMode {
184			resp.DevOTP = code // dev only — config refuses OTP_DEV_MODE in prod
185		}
186		return resp, nil
187	}
188	
189	// verifyOTP checks the challenge and logs the phone in, creating the Party
190	// on first login (find-or-create, §4.1).
191	func (s *service) verifyOTP(ctx context.Context, phone, otp string) (*authTokensResponse, error) {
192		now := time.Now().UTC()
193	
194		challenge, err := s.repo.latestOTPChallenge(ctx, phone, now)
195		if err != nil {
196			if isNotFound(err) {
197				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "otp verify rejected: no active challenge", slog.String("phone", phone))
198				return nil, httpx.Unauthorized("no active OTP for this phone — request a new code")
199			}
200			return nil, err
201		}
202		if challenge.Attempts >= maxOTPAttempts {
203			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "otp verify rejected: too many attempts", slog.String("phone", phone))
204			return nil, httpx.TooManyRequests("too many incorrect OTP attempts — request a new code")
205		}
206		expected := auth.HMACHash(s.deps.Cfg.OTPHashSecret, phone, otp)
207		if !auth.ConstantTimeEqual(challenge.CodeHash, expected) {
208			if err := s.repo.incrementOTPAttempts(ctx, challenge.ID); err != nil {
209				return nil, err
210			}
211			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "otp verify rejected: incorrect code", slog.String("phone", phone))
212			return nil, httpx.Unauthorized("incorrect OTP")
213		}
214	
215		// Burn every outstanding challenge for this phone.
216		if err := s.repo.deleteOTPChallenges(ctx, phone); err != nil {
217			return nil, err
218		}
219	
220		party, err := s.repo.upsertPartyByPhone(ctx, phone, now)
221		if err != nil {
222			return nil, err
223		}
224		if party.Status != domain.PartyStatusActive {
225			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "otp verify rejected: party suspended",
226				slog.String("phone", phone), slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()))
227			return nil, httpx.Forbidden("party is suspended")
228		}
229		tokens, err := s.issueLoginTokens(ctx, party, now)
230		if err != nil {
231			return nil, err
232		}
233		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "party logged in",
234			slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()), slog.String("phone", phone))
235		return tokens, nil
236	}

238	// issueLoginTokens mints a SESSION access token plus a fresh rotating

240	func (s *service) issueLoginTokens(ctx context.Context, party *domain.Party, now time.Time) (*authTokensResponse, error) {
241		refreshToken, err := auth.RandomToken(32)
242		if err != nil {
243			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "refresh token generation failed", slog.Any("err", err))
244			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
245		}
246		doc := refreshTokenDoc{
247			TokenHash: auth.HMACHash(s.deps.Cfg.OTPHashSecret, refreshHashLabel, refreshToken),
248			PartyID:   party.ID,
249			ExpiresAt: now.Add(s.deps.Cfg.RefreshTokenTTL),
250			CreatedAt: now,
251		}
252		if err := s.repo.insertRefreshToken(ctx, doc); err != nil {
253			return nil, err
254		}
255		accessToken, err := s.deps.JWT.IssueSessionToken(*party)
256		if err != nil {
257			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "session token issue failed",
258				slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
259			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
260		}
261		return &authTokensResponse{
262			AccessToken:  accessToken,
263			RefreshToken: refreshToken,
264			Party:        party,
265		}, nil
266	}
267	
268	// refresh rotates a refresh token: the old token is consumed atomically and
269	// a new pair is issued — a replayed token always fails.
270	func (s *service) refresh(ctx context.Context, refreshToken string) (*authTokensResponse, error) {
271		now := time.Now().UTC()
272		tokenHash := auth.HMACHash(s.deps.Cfg.OTPHashSecret, refreshHashLabel, refreshToken)
273	
274		doc, err := s.repo.findRefreshToken(ctx, tokenHash)
275		if err != nil {
276			if isNotFound(err) {
277				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "refresh rejected: unknown token")
278				return nil, httpx.Unauthorized("invalid refresh token")
279			}
280			return nil, err
281		}
282		if !now.Before(doc.ExpiresAt) {
283			_, _ = s.repo.deleteRefreshToken(ctx, tokenHash)
284			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "refresh rejected: token expired", slog.String("party_id", doc.PartyID.Hex()))
285			return nil, httpx.Unauthorized("refresh token expired — log in again")
286		}
287	
288		// ROTATE: consume the old token first; DeletedCount==0 means a parallel
289		// request won the race, so this presentation is treated as a replay.
290		deleted, err := s.repo.deleteRefreshToken(ctx, tokenHash)
291		if err != nil {
292			return nil, err
293		}
294		if deleted == 0 {
295			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "refresh rejected: token already used", slog.String("party_id", doc.PartyID.Hex()))
296			return nil, httpx.Unauthorized("refresh token already used")
297		}
298	
299		party, err := s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, doc.PartyID)
300		if err != nil {
301			if isNotFound(err) {
302				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "refresh rejected: party gone", slog.String("party_id", doc.PartyID.Hex()))
303				return nil, httpx.Unauthorized("party no longer exists")
304			}
305			return nil, err
306		}
307		if party.Status != domain.PartyStatusActive {
308			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "refresh rejected: party suspended", slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()))
309			return nil, httpx.Forbidden("party is suspended")
310		}
311		return s.issueLoginTokens(ctx, party, now)
312	}

348	// withOrg copies org display fields onto an assignment; enrichment is
349	// best-effort (a missing org unit never breaks the listing).
350	func (s *service) withOrg(ctx context.Context, ra domain.RoleAssignment) assignmentWithOrg {
351		enriched := assignmentWithOrg{RoleAssignment: ra}
352		if org, err := s.deps.Orgs.Get(ctx, ra.OrgUnitID); err == nil {

360	// selectRole exchanges the session for a ROLE-kind token pinned to one
361	// usable assignment, gated on the role's minimum KYC tier (§5.2). With
362	// auto-verify gone, this genuinely blocks un-approved parties.
363	func (s *service) selectRole(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, assignmentID primitive.ObjectID) (*roleSelectResponse, error) {
364		aid, err := actorID(actor)
365		if err != nil {
366			return nil, err
367		}
368		assignment, err := s.repo.findAssignmentByID(ctx, assignmentID)
369		if err != nil {
370			return nil, err
371		}
372		if assignment.PartyID != aid {
373			// Same shape as an unknown ID — never confirm other parties' grants.
374			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "role select rejected: not owner",
375				slog.String("assignment_id", assignmentID.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
376			return nil, httpx.NotFound("role assignment")
377		}
378		now := time.Now().UTC()
379		if !assignment.UsableAt(now) {
380			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "role select rejected: assignment not usable",
381				slog.String("assignment_id", assignmentID.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
382			return nil, httpx.Forbidden("role assignment is revoked or outside its validity window")
383		}
384	
385		// Re-read the party: the KYC tier may have upgraded since the session
386		// token was minted.
387		party, err := s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, aid)
388		if err != nil {
389			return nil, err
390		}
391		if party.Status != domain.PartyStatusActive {
392			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "role select rejected: party suspended", slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()))
393			return nil, httpx.Forbidden("party is suspended")
394		}
395		requiredTier := domain.RequiredKYCTier[assignment.RoleCode]
396		if !domain.KYCTierSatisfies(party.KYCTier, requiredTier) {
397			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "role select rejected: kyc tier insufficient",
398				slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()),
399				slog.String("role_code", assignment.RoleCode),
400				slog.String("current_tier", party.KYCTier),
401				slog.String("required_tier", requiredTier))
402			appErr := httpx.Forbidden("your KYC tier does not permit this role — complete verification first").
403				WithDetails(map[string]string{
404					"current_tier":  party.KYCTier,
405					"required_tier": requiredTier,
406				})
407			appErr.Code = "KYC_TIER_INSUFFICIENT"
408			return nil, appErr
409		}
410	
411		org, err := s.deps.Orgs.Get(ctx, assignment.OrgUnitID)
412		if err != nil {
413			return nil, err
414		}
415		accessToken, err := s.deps.JWT.IssueRoleToken(*party, *assignment, org.Type)
416		if err != nil {
417			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "role token issue failed",
418				slog.String("assignment_id", assignmentID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
419			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
420		}
421		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "role selected",
422			slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()),
423			slog.String("assignment_id", assignmentID.Hex()),
424			slog.String("role_code", assignment.RoleCode),
425			slog.String("org_unit_id", assignment.OrgUnitID.Hex()))
426		return &roleSelectResponse{
427			AccessToken: accessToken,
428			RoleCode:    assignment.RoleCode,
429			OrgUnitID:   assignment.OrgUnitID,
430			OrgType:     org.Type,
431		}, nil
432	}

475	}
476	
477	// --- KYC (mock DPI adapters — real UIDAI / penny-drop integration later) ---
478	
479	// verifyAadhaar runs the MOCK Aadhaar eKYC capture (§18-A). The full Aadhaar
480	// number exists only in this request's memory: what is persisted is the
481	// last 4 digits plus an opaque reference from the (mock) Aadhaar Data Vault.
482	//
483	// There is NO auto-verify and NO tier change here: the record is created
484	// PENDING and enters the approval workflow. Returns created=false when an
485	// identical PENDING request already exists (idempotent replay → 200).
486	func (s *service) verifyAadhaar(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req aadhaarKYCRequest) (*aadhaarKYCResponse, bool, error) {
487		now := time.Now().UTC()
488		aid, err := actorID(actor)
489		if err != nil {
490			return nil, false, err
491		}
492		party, err := s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, aid)
493		if err != nil {
494			return nil, false, err
495		}
496	
497		// Idempotency: an existing PENDING request for the same tier is returned
498		// as-is rather than duplicated.
499		if existing, err := s.repo.findPendingKYCRecord(ctx, party.ID, req.RequestedTier); err == nil {
500			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "kyc submit replayed idempotently",
501				slog.String("kyc_id", existing.ID.Hex()),
502				slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()),
503				slog.String("requested_tier", req.RequestedTier))
504			return &aadhaarKYCResponse{
505				Record:  existing,
506				Status:  domain.KYCStatusPending,
507				Message: msgAwaitingVerification,
508			}, false, nil
509		} else if !isNotFound(err) {
510			return nil, false, err
511		}
512	
513		language := party.PreferredLanguage
514		if language == "" {
515			language = defaultLanguage
516		}
517		// Pre-generate the consent id so the KYC record can reference it in the
518		// same flow.
519		consentID := primitive.NewObjectID()
520		consent := domain.Consent{
521			ID:          consentID,
522			PartyID:     party.ID,
523			Purpose:     consentPurposeAadhaarEKYC,
524			TextVersion: consentTextVersion,
525			Language:    language,
526			GrantedAt:   now,
527		}
528		if err := s.repo.insertConsent(ctx, consent); err != nil {
529			return nil, false, err
530		}
531	
532		// MOCK Aadhaar Data Vault (§18-A): a real deployment sends the number to
533		// the vault service and receives an opaque token. The mock mints a UUID.
534		vaultRef := uuid.NewString()
535		last4 := req.AadhaarNumber[len(req.AadhaarNumber)-4:]
536	
537		record := domain.KYCRecord{
538			ID:              primitive.NewObjectID(),
539			PartyID:         party.ID,
540			RequestedTier:   req.RequestedTier,
541			AadhaarLast4:    last4,
542			AadhaarVaultRef: vaultRef,
543			ConsentID:       &consentID,
544			Status:          domain.KYCStatusPending,
545			CreatedAt:       now,
546			UpdatedAt:       now,
547		}
548		if err := s.repo.insertKYCRecord(ctx, record); err != nil {
549			return nil, false, err
550		}
551	
552		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "kyc submitted",
553			slog.String("kyc_id", record.ID.Hex()),
554			slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()),
555			slog.String("requested_tier", req.RequestedTier))
556		// Nudge reviewer dashboards: a new record entered the PENDING queue.
557		s.publishKYCQueueChanged("submitted", record.ID, party.ID)
558		return &aadhaarKYCResponse{
559			Record:  &record,
560			Status:  domain.KYCStatusPending,
561			Message: msgAwaitingVerification,
562		}, true, nil
563	}
564	
565	// publishKYCQueueChanged nudges the live "pending KYC" dashboard badge via the
566	// event bus → SSE hub. It is a nudge only; subscribers re-query the scoped
567	// pending count. Never blocks the request path (the bus dispatches async).
568	func (s *service) publishKYCQueueChanged(reason string, kycID, subjectID primitive.ObjectID) {
569		s.deps.Bus.Publish(eventbus.TopicKYCQueueChanged, eventbus.KYCQueueEvent{
570			Reason:    reason,
571			KYCID:     kycID.Hex(),
572			SubjectID: subjectID.Hex(),
573		})
574	}
575	
576	// verifyBank runs the MOCK penny-drop verification and stores ONLY the
577	// masked account tail and IFSC on the caller's latest KYC record (creating a
578	// PENDING record carrying just the bank evidence when none exists yet).
579	func (s *service) verifyBank(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req bankKYCRequest) (*domain.KYCRecord, error) {
580		now := time.Now().UTC()
581		aid, err := actorID(actor)
582		if err != nil {
583			return nil, err
584		}
585		party, err := s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, aid)
586		if err != nil {
587			return nil, err
588		}
589		masked := maskAccount(req.AccountNumber)
590	
591		latest, err := s.repo.latestKYCRecord(ctx, aid)
592		switch {
593		case err == nil && latest.Status == domain.KYCStatusPending:
594			// Only a PENDING record may accrue bank evidence in place — a reviewer
595			// has not yet decided it. MOCK penny-drop: fixed name-match score.
596			rec, err := s.repo.updateKYCRecordBank(ctx, latest.ID, masked, req.IFSC, mockPennyDropNameMatch, now)
597			if err != nil {
598				return nil, err
599			}
600			s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "bank evidence attached",
601				slog.String("kyc_id", rec.ID.Hex()), slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()))
602			return rec, nil
603		case err == nil, isNotFound(err):
604			// The latest record is terminal (VERIFIED/REJECTED) or none exists yet:
605			// a changed bank account must NOT silently overwrite reviewer-approved
606			// evidence, so route it back through review as a fresh PENDING record.
607			record := domain.KYCRecord{
608				ID:                primitive.NewObjectID(),
609				PartyID:           party.ID,
610				RequestedTier:     party.KYCTier,
611				BankAccountMasked: masked,
612				BankIFSC:          req.IFSC,
613				BankVerified:      true, // MOCK penny-drop: always succeeds
614				BankNameMatch:     mockPennyDropNameMatch,
615				Status:            domain.KYCStatusPending,
616				CreatedAt:         now,
617				UpdatedAt:         now,
618			}
619			if err := s.repo.insertKYCRecord(ctx, record); err != nil {
620				return nil, err
621			}
622			s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "bank evidence recorded on new pending kyc",
623				slog.String("kyc_id", record.ID.Hex()), slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()))
624			return &record, nil
625		default:
626			return nil, err
627		}
628	}

633		aid, err := actorID(actor)

639	
640	// --- KYC approval workflow (reviewer console) ---
641	
642	// kycSubjectInScope reports whether the reviewer's org scope covers the KYC
643	// subject: true when the subject holds at least one active role assignment
644	// inside the reviewer's organisational scope (the KYC record itself carries
645	// no org, so the subject's org is resolved via their assignments — mirroring
646	// how createAssignment/revokeAssignment obtain the OrgUnitID). SUPER_ADMIN and
647	// STATE_AUDITOR are platform-wide and always cover; PCDF_ADMIN (rooted at the
648	// federation) covers naturally through RequireInScope's ancestry test.
649	func (s *service) kycSubjectInScope(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, subjectPartyID primitive.ObjectID) (bool, error) {
650		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSuperAdmin || actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleStateAuditor {
651			return true, nil
652		}
653		assignments, err := s.repo.listActiveAssignments(ctx, subjectPartyID)
654		if err != nil {
655			return false, err
656		}
657		for _, ra := range assignments {
658			if s.deps.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, ra.OrgUnitID) == nil {
659				return true, nil
660			}
661		}
662		return false, nil
663	}
664	
665	// requireKYCSubjectInScope denies the reviewer a KYC decision on a subject
666	// outside their organisational scope (a cross-org privilege escalation guard).
667	func (s *service) requireKYCSubjectInScope(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, subjectPartyID primitive.ObjectID) error {
668		inScope, err := s.kycSubjectInScope(ctx, actor, subjectPartyID)
669		if err != nil {
670			return err
671		}
672		if !inScope {
673			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "kyc review denied: subject out of scope",
674				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
675				slog.String("subject_party_id", subjectPartyID.Hex()))
676			appErr := httpx.Forbidden("KYC subject is outside your organisational scope")
677			appErr.Code = "KYC_SUBJECT_OUT_OF_SCOPE"
678			return appErr
679		}
680		return nil
681	}
682	
683	// listPendingKYC pages PENDING KYC records newest-first, constrained to
684	// subjects within the reviewer's org scope, enriched with a reviewer-facing
685	// party summary, and audits the access.
686	func (s *service) listPendingKYC(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, page httpx.Page) ([]pendingKYCItem, int64, error) {
687		records, total, err := s.repo.listPendingKYC(ctx, page)
688		if err != nil {
689			return nil, 0, err
690		}
691		ids := make([]primitive.ObjectID, 0, len(records))
692		for _, rec := range records {
693			ids = append(ids, rec.PartyID)
694		}
695		parties, err := s.repo.findPartiesByIDs(ctx, ids)
696		if err != nil {
697			return nil, 0, err
698		}
699		items := make([]pendingKYCItem, 0, len(records))
700		for _, rec := range records {
701			// Org-scope gate: a scoped reviewer only ever sees (and thus only ever
702			// gets the contact PII of) subjects within their own area.
703			inScope, err := s.kycSubjectInScope(ctx, actor, rec.PartyID)
704			if err != nil {
705				return nil, 0, err
706			}
707			if !inScope {
708				continue
709			}
710			item := pendingKYCItem{KYCRecord: rec}
711			if p, ok := parties[rec.PartyID]; ok {
712				item.Party = &pendingPartySummary{
713					ID:       p.ID,
714					Phone:    p.Phone,
715					FullName: p.FullName,
716					KYCTier:  p.KYCTier,
717				}
718			}
719			items = append(items, item)
720		}
721	
722		s.deps.Audit.Record(ctx, audit.Entry{
723			Action: "kyc.pending_list",
724			Meta:   map[string]any{"count": len(items), "total": total},
725		})
726		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "kyc pending list accessed",
727			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
728			slog.Int("count", len(items)),
729			slog.Int64("total", total))
730		return items, total, nil
731	}
732	
733	// pendingKYCScanCap bounds the scoped-count scan. The pending queue is a
734	// human-drained work-list (realistically dozens, not millions); beyond the cap
735	// the badge shows "cap+" rather than paying for an unbounded scan.
736	const pendingKYCScanCap = 1000
737	
738	// pendingKYCCount returns how many PENDING records fall within the reviewer's
739	// org scope — the live badge value. It reuses the exact scope logic of the
740	// pending list (so badge and list always agree) and dedupes the per-subject
741	// scope lookup. Returns (count, capped).
742	func (s *service) pendingKYCCount(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor) (int64, bool, error) {
743		records, _, err := s.repo.listPendingKYC(ctx, httpx.Page{Limit: pendingKYCScanCap, Offset: 0})
744		if err != nil {
745			return 0, false, err
746		}
747		scopeCache := make(map[primitive.ObjectID]bool)
748		var count int64
749		for _, rec := range records {
750			inScope, seen := scopeCache[rec.PartyID]
751			if !seen {
752				inScope, err = s.kycSubjectInScope(ctx, actor, rec.PartyID)
753				if err != nil {
754					return 0, false, err
755				}
756				scopeCache[rec.PartyID] = inScope
757			}
758			if inScope {
759				count++
760			}
761		}
762		capped := len(records) >= pendingKYCScanCap
763		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "kyc pending count",
764			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID), slog.Int64("count", count), slog.Bool("capped", capped))
765		return count, capped, nil
766	}
767	
768	// approveKYC verifies a PENDING record, upgrades the party's KYC tier upward
769	// only, notifies the party and audits the decision. The reviewer's role must
770	// be authorised for the requested tier — even SUPER_ADMIN passes through the
771	// approvable-tier map (which grants it everything).
772	func (s *service) approveKYC(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID) (*kycReviewResponse, error) {
773		now := time.Now().UTC()
774		aid, err := actorID(actor)
775		if err != nil {
776			return nil, err
777		}
778		record, err := s.repo.findKYCRecordByID(ctx, id)
779		if err != nil {
780			return nil, err
781		}
782		if record.Status != domain.KYCStatusPending {
783			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "kyc approve rejected: record not pending",
784				slog.String("kyc_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("status", record.Status),
785				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
786			return nil, httpx.Conflict("KYC_NOT_PENDING", "kyc record is not pending review")
787		}
788		// Separation of duties: a reviewer may never decide their own KYC record.
789		if record.PartyID == aid {
790			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "kyc approve rejected: self-review",
791				slog.String("kyc_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
792			appErr := httpx.Forbidden("you may not review your own KYC record")
793			appErr.Code = "KYC_SELF_REVIEW"
794			return nil, appErr
795		}
796		// Org scope: a reviewer may only decide KYC for subjects within their area.
797		if err := s.requireKYCSubjectInScope(ctx, actor, record.PartyID); err != nil {
798			return nil, err
799		}
800		if !domain.CanApproveKYCTier(actor.RoleCode, record.RequestedTier) {
801			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "kyc approve rejected: tier not approvable",
802				slog.String("kyc_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("reviewer_role", actor.RoleCode),
803				slog.String("requested_tier", record.RequestedTier))
804			appErr := httpx.Forbidden("your role may not approve KYC at the " + record.RequestedTier + " tier")
805			appErr.Code = "KYC_TIER_NOT_APPROVABLE"
806			return nil, appErr
807		}
808	
809		updated, err := s.repo.approveKYCRecord(ctx, id, aid, actor.RoleCode, now)
810		if err != nil {
811			if isNotFound(err) {
812				// Lost the race — another reviewer already moved it out of PENDING.
813				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "kyc approve lost race: record no longer pending",
814					slog.String("kyc_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
815				return nil, httpx.Conflict("KYC_NOT_PENDING", "kyc record is not pending review")
816			}
817			return nil, err
818		}
819	
820		party, err := s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, updated.PartyID)
821		if err != nil {
822			return nil, err
823		}
824		newTier := upgradedKYCTier(party.KYCTier, updated.RequestedTier)
825		if newTier != party.KYCTier {
826			if err := s.repo.updatePartyKYCTier(ctx, party.ID, newTier, now); err != nil {
827				return nil, err
828			}
829		}
830	
831		language := party.PreferredLanguage
832		if language == "" {
833			language = defaultLanguage
834		}
835		pid := party.ID
836		if err := s.repo.insertNotification(ctx, domain.Notification{
837			PartyID:     &pid,
838			Phone:       party.Phone,
839			Channel:     domain.ChannelSMS,
840			TemplateKey: domain.TemplateKYCApproved,
841			Language:    language,
842			Params:      map[string]string{"tier": updated.RequestedTier},
843			Status:      domain.NotificationQueued,
844			QueuedAt:    now,
845		}); err != nil {
846			return nil, err
847		}
848	
849		s.deps.Audit.Record(ctx, audit.Entry{
850			Action:     "kyc.approve",
851			TargetType: "kyc_record",
852			TargetID:   id.Hex(),
853			Meta: map[string]any{
854				"party_id":       party.ID.Hex(),
855				"requested_tier": updated.RequestedTier,
856				"new_tier":       newTier,
857			},
858		})
859		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "kyc approved",
860			slog.String("kyc_id", id.Hex()),
861			slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()),
862			slog.String("requested_tier", updated.RequestedTier),
863			slog.String("new_tier", newTier),
864			slog.String("reviewer_role", actor.RoleCode),
865			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
866		// Nudge reviewer dashboards: this record left the PENDING queue.
867		s.publishKYCQueueChanged("approved", id, party.ID)
868		return &kycReviewResponse{Record: updated, KYCTier: newTier}, nil
869	}
870	
871	// rejectKYC moves a PENDING record to REJECTED with a mandatory reason,
872	// notifies the party and audits the decision. Same approvable-tier authority
873	// as approveKYC.
874	func (s *service) rejectKYC(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID, reason string) (*kycReviewResponse, error) {
875		now := time.Now().UTC()
876		aid, err := actorID(actor)
877		if err != nil {
878			return nil, err
879		}
880		record, err := s.repo.findKYCRecordByID(ctx, id)
881		if err != nil {
882			return nil, err
883		}
884		if record.Status != domain.KYCStatusPending {
885			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "kyc reject rejected: record not pending",
886				slog.String("kyc_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("status", record.Status),
887				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
888			return nil, httpx.Conflict("KYC_NOT_PENDING", "kyc record is not pending review")
889		}
890		// Separation of duties: a reviewer may never decide their own KYC record.
891		if record.PartyID == aid {
892			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "kyc reject rejected: self-review",
893				slog.String("kyc_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
894			appErr := httpx.Forbidden("you may not review your own KYC record")
895			appErr.Code = "KYC_SELF_REVIEW"
896			return nil, appErr
897		}
898		// Org scope: a reviewer may only decide KYC for subjects within their area.
899		if err := s.requireKYCSubjectInScope(ctx, actor, record.PartyID); err != nil {
900			return nil, err
901		}
902		if !domain.CanApproveKYCTier(actor.RoleCode, record.RequestedTier) {
903			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "kyc reject rejected: tier not approvable",
904				slog.String("kyc_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("reviewer_role", actor.RoleCode),
905				slog.String("requested_tier", record.RequestedTier))
```

```text
35			r.Post("/refresh", h.refresh)
36	
37			// Any logged-in party (session or role token).
38			r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
39				r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT), middleware.RequireSession)
40				r.Post("/logout", h.logout)
41				r.Get("/roles", h.listMyRoles)
42				r.Post("/role/select", h.selectRole)
43			})
44		})
45	
46		r.Route("/parties", func(r chi.Router) {
47			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT), middleware.RequireSession)
48			r.Get("/me", h.getMe)
49			r.Patch("/me", h.patchMe)
50		})
51	
52		r.Route("/kyc", func(r chi.Router) {
53			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
54	
55			// Self-service KYC: any logged-in party submits evidence.
56			r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
57				r.Use(middleware.RequireSession)
58				r.Post("/aadhaar", h.verifyAadhaar)
59				r.Post("/bank", h.verifyBank)
60				r.Get("/me", h.listMyKYC)
61			})
62	
63			// Review console: ground staff and admins approve/reject PENDING KYC.
64			// Both ORGANISING_MANAGER and the app-coded ONBOARDING_EXECUTIVE qualify.
65			r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
66				r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.OnboardingReviewerRoles...))
67				r.Get("/pending", h.listPendingKYC)

69				r.Post("/{id}/approve", h.approveKYC)
```

```text
45	func (rc RateChart) PricePour(fatPct, snfPct, qtyLitres float64) (rate, amount float64) {
46		rate = rc.BaseRatePerLitre + fatPct*rc.FatRatePerPoint + snfPct*rc.SNFRatePerPoint
47		rate = math.Round(rate*100) / 100
48		amount = math.Round(rate*qtyLitres*100) / 100
49		return rate, amount

94	// CheckPlausibility validates fat/SNF/qty against physical bounds and returns
95	// the violated flags (empty slice = plausible).
96	func CheckPlausibility(fatPct, snfPct, qtyLitres float64) []string {
97		var flags []string
98		if fatPct < PlausibleFatMin || fatPct > PlausibleFatMax ||
99			snfPct < PlausibleSNFMin || snfPct > PlausibleSNFMax {
100			flags = append(flags, IntegrityFlagImplausibleValue)
101		}
102		if qtyLitres != 0 && (qtyLitres < PlausibleQtyMin || qtyLitres > PlausibleQtyMax) {
103			flags = append(flags, IntegrityFlagImplausibleValue)
104		}
105		return flags
106	}

147		CreatedAt         time.Time           `bson:"created_at"    json:"created_at"`
148	}
149	
150	// Invoice statuses through the same-day payment loop (blueprint §8.1).
151	const (
152		InvoiceStatusIssued            = "ISSUED"
153		InvoiceStatusSettlementPending = "SETTLEMENT_PENDING"
154		InvoiceStatusPaid              = "PAID"
155		InvoiceStatusHold              = "HOLD" // e.g. safety-gate payment hold
156	)
157	
158	// Invoice aggregates one farmer's pours at one DCS for one day — the artefact
159	// behind "same-day farmer payment". InvoiceNumber is the human-readable
160	// unique business key; relations use ObjectIDs.
161	type Invoice struct {
162		ID                  primitive.ObjectID   `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
163		InvoiceNumber       string               `bson:"invoice_number" json:"invoice_number"` // unique, e.g. INV-DCS01842-20260706-0001
164		FarmerPartyID       primitive.ObjectID   `bson:"farmer_party_id" json:"farmer_party_id"`
165		DCSID               primitive.ObjectID   `bson:"dcs_id"        json:"dcs_id"`
166		InvoiceDate         string               `bson:"invoice_date"  json:"invoice_date"` // YYYY-MM-DD
167		PourIDs             []primitive.ObjectID `bson:"pour_ids"      json:"pour_ids"`
168		TotalQuantityLitres float64              `bson:"total_quantity_litres" json:"total_quantity_litres"`
169		TotalAmount         float64              `bson:"total_amount"  json:"total_amount"`
170		Status              string               `bson:"status"        json:"status"`
171		SettlementBatchID   *primitive.ObjectID  `bson:"settlement_batch_id,omitempty" json:"settlement_batch_id,omitempty"`
172		IssuedAt            time.Time            `bson:"issued_at"     json:"issued_at"`
173		ProvenanceSeq       int64                `bson:"provenance_seq,omitempty" json:"provenance_seq,omitempty"`
174	}
175	
176	// DateKeyIST formats t as the YYYY-MM-DD settlement-day key in IST.
177	func DateKeyIST(t time.Time) string {
178		ist := time.FixedZone("IST", 5*3600+1800)
179		return t.In(ist).Format("2006-01-02")
180	}
181	
182	// InvoiceNumberFor builds the human-readable invoice number.
183	func InvoiceNumberFor(dcsCode, dateKey string, seq int) string {
184		return fmt.Sprintf("INV-%s-%s-%04d", dcsCode, dateKey, seq)
185	}
```

```text
40	// RoleAssignment grants one role to one party inside one org unit for a
41	// validity window. Revoking a Sacheev after an election is a single record
42	// update — never an account deletion (blueprint §4.1).
43	type RoleAssignment struct {

45		PartyID   primitive.ObjectID  `bson:"party_id"      json:"party_id"`
46		RoleCode  string              `bson:"role_code"     json:"role_code"`

48		GrantedBy *primitive.ObjectID `bson:"granted_by,omitempty" json:"granted_by,omitempty"`
49		ValidFrom time.Time           `bson:"valid_from"    json:"valid_from"`
50		ValidTo   *time.Time          `bson:"valid_to,omitempty"   json:"valid_to,omitempty"` // nil = open-ended
51		Status    string              `bson:"status"        json:"status"`
52		RevokedAt *time.Time          `bson:"revoked_at,omitempty" json:"revoked_at,omitempty"`
53		RevokedBy *primitive.ObjectID `bson:"revoked_by,omitempty" json:"revoked_by,omitempty"`

55	}

57	// UsableAt reports whether the assignment is active and inside its validity
58	// window at instant t.
59	func (ra RoleAssignment) UsableAt(t time.Time) bool {
60		if ra.Status != RoleAssignmentActive {
61			return false
62		}
63		if t.Before(ra.ValidFrom) {
64			return false
65		}
66		if ra.ValidTo != nil && t.After(*ra.ValidTo) {
67			return false
68		}
69		return true
70	}
```

```text
import { ApiError, endpoint } from '../client';
import type {
  ConsignmentInvoice,
  DcsLot,
  Party,
  Pour,
  PourEntryMethod,
  Shift,
} from '@/core/types/domain';
import type { KycTier } from '@/core/types/roles';
import { appendChainEvent, audit, type MockDb } from '@/core/mocks/db';
import { computePourAmount } from '@/core/utils/rate';
import { isPlausibleReading } from '@/core/utils/rate';
import { assuranceOf, weakestAssurance } from '@/core/utils/assurance';
import { consignmentCode, sealCodeFor } from '@/core/utils/codes';
import { todayISO } from '@/core/utils/format';
import { hashString, mulberry32, nextId } from '@/core/utils/id';

/**
 * Collection console (Sacheev / AMCU) - daily pour → lot → dispatch (§8.1).
 */

export interface DcsMember {
  party: Party;
  animalCount: number;
  pouredToday: boolean;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Wire shapes (snake_case, exactly as the backend serialises)         */
/*   collection: domain.MilkPour, PourResponse                         */
/*   logistics:  DCS consignment (== our "lot")                        */
/*   orgs:       Member roster row                                     */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

interface WirePour {
  id: string;
  farmer_party_id: string;
  dcs_id: string;
  date?: string; // YYYY-MM-DD (IST); else derived from poured_at/created_at
  poured_at?: string;
  shift: string; // MORNING | EVENING
  quantity_litres: number;
  fat_pct: number;
  snf_pct: number;
  rate_applied?: number;
  rate_per_litre?: number;
  rate_chart_version?: string;
  amount?: number;
  source?: string; // reading mode that produced the values
  status: string; // RECORDED | IN_LOT | INVOICED | PAID | ...
  lot_id?: string;
  consignment_id?: string;
  created_at: string;
}

// POST /collection/pours → { pour, idempotent_replay }
interface WirePourResponse {
  pour: WirePour;
  idempotent_replay?: boolean;
}

interface WireConsignment {
  id: string;
  consignment_code?: string;
  code?: string;
  dcs_id: string;
  date: string;
  shift: string;
  pour_ids?: string[];
  total_litres?: number;
  avg_fat_pct?: number;
  avg_snf_pct?: number;
  seal_code?: string;
  sealed_at?: string;
  status: string; // OPEN | DISPATCHED | PICKED_UP | AT_BMC | AT_PLANT | REJECTED
}

// GET /orgs/{id}/members roster row (orgs.Member)
interface WireMember {
  party_id: string;
  phone?: string;
  full_name?: string;
  kyc_tier?: string;
  role_code: string;
  role_assignment_id: string;
  valid_from: string;
  valid_to?: string;
}

/** Backend reading mode (source) → our PourEntryMethod domain union. */
function mapEntryMethod(source?: string): PourEntryMethod {
  switch (source) {
    case 'ANALYZER_AUTO':
    case 'ANALYZER_DIRECT':
      return 'ANALYZER_AUTO';
    case 'PHOTO_OCR':
      return 'PHOTO_OCR';
    default:
      return 'MANUAL';
  }
}

function mapPour(w: WirePour): Pour {
  const stamp = w.date || w.poured_at || w.created_at || '';
  return {
    id: w.id,
    farmerPartyId: w.farmer_party_id,
    dcsId: w.dcs_id,
    date: stamp.slice(0, 10),
    shift: (w.shift as Shift) || 'MORNING',
    quantityLitres: w.quantity_litres ?? 0,
    fatPct: w.fat_pct ?? 0,
    snfPct: w.snf_pct ?? 0,
    rateApplied: w.rate_applied ?? w.rate_per_litre ?? 0,
    amount: w.amount ?? 0,
    entryMethod: mapEntryMethod(w.source),
    assurance: assuranceOf(mapEntryMethod(w.source)),
    rateChartVersion: w.rate_chart_version,
    status: (w.status as Pour['status']) || 'RECORDED',
    lotId: w.lot_id ?? w.consignment_id,
    // Anything the backend has persisted is, by definition, synced.
    synced: true,
    createdAt: w.created_at,
  };
}

function mapConsignment(w: WireConsignment): DcsLot {
  return {
    id: w.id,
    consignmentCode: w.consignment_code ?? w.code ?? '',
    dcsId: w.dcs_id,
    date: w.date,
    shift: (w.shift as Shift) || 'MORNING',
    pourIds: w.pour_ids ?? [],
    totalLitres: w.total_litres ?? 0,
    avgFatPct: w.avg_fat_pct ?? 0,
    avgSnfPct: w.avg_snf_pct ?? 0,
    sealCode: w.seal_code,
    sealedAt: w.sealed_at,
    status: (w.status as DcsLot['status']) || 'OPEN',
  };
}

function mapMemberParty(m: WireMember): Party {
  return {
    id: m.party_id,
    name: m.full_name || (m.phone ? `User ${m.phone.slice(-4)}` : 'Member'),
    phone: m.phone ?? '',
    kycTier: (m.kyc_tier as KycTier) || 'MINIMAL',
    bankVerified: false,
    createdAt: '',
  };
}

export const listDcsMembers = endpoint<{ dcsId: string }, DcsMember[]>({
  method: 'GET',
  path: ({ dcsId }) => `/orgs/${dcsId}/members`,
  // The roster returns every active assignment at the org; the collection
  // console only lists FARMER members. animalCount/pouredToday aren't on the
  // roster row - safe zero defaults (see issues) until dedicated endpoints.
  mapResponse: (raw) =>
    ((raw as WireMember[]) ?? [])
      .filter((m) => m.role_code === 'FARMER')
      .map((m) => ({ party: mapMemberParty(m), animalCount: 0, pouredToday: false })),
  mock: ({ dcsId }, db) => {
    const today = todayISO();
    const memberIds = db.assignments
      .filter((a) => a.orgUnitId === dcsId && a.role === 'FARMER' && a.active)
      .map((a) => a.partyId);
    return memberIds.map((pid) => ({
      party: db.parties.find((p) => p.id === pid)!,
      animalCount: db.animals.filter((an) => an.ownerPartyId === pid && an.status === 'ACTIVE').length,
      pouredToday: db.pours.some((po) => po.farmerPartyId === pid && po.date === today),
    }));
  },
});

export const listPours = endpoint<
  { dcsId?: string; farmerPartyId?: string; date?: string; shift?: Shift },
  Pour[]
>({
  method: 'GET',
  path: (f) => {
    const q = new URLSearchParams();
    if (f.dcsId) q.set('dcs_id', f.dcsId);
    if (f.farmerPartyId) q.set('farmer_party_id', f.farmerPartyId);
    if (f.date) q.set('date', f.date);
    if (f.shift) q.set('shift', f.shift);
    const qs = q.toString();
    return `/collection/pours${qs ? `?${qs}` : ''}`;
  },
  mapResponse: (raw) => ((raw as WirePour[]) ?? []).map(mapPour),
  mock: (f, db) =>
    db.pours
      .filter(
        (po) =>
          (!f.dcsId || po.dcsId === f.dcsId) &&
          (!f.farmerPartyId || po.farmerPartyId === f.farmerPartyId) &&
          (!f.date || po.date === f.date) &&
          (!f.shift || po.shift === f.shift),
      )
      .sort((a, b) => b.createdAt.localeCompare(a.createdAt)),
});

export interface RecordPourInput {
  dcsId: string;
  farmerPartyId: string;
  quantityLitres: number;
  fatPct: number;
  snfPct: number;
  clr?: number;
  temperatureC?: number;
  shift: Shift;
  entryMethod: PourEntryMethod;
  recordedByPartyId: string;
}

export const recordPour = endpoint<RecordPourInput, Pour>({
  method: 'POST',
  path: () => '/collection/pours',
  // client_event_id is the offline-first idempotency key (§3.1); the input has
  // no stable one, so mint a fresh evt id per attempt.
  mapRequest: (input) => ({
    client_event_id: nextId('evt'),
    farmer_party_id: input.farmerPartyId,
    dcs_id: input.dcsId,
    shift: input.shift,
    quantity_litres: input.quantityLitres,
    fat_pct: input.fatPct,
    snf_pct: input.snfPct,
    clr: input.clr,
    temperature_c: input.temperatureC,
    source: input.entryMethod,
  }),
  mapResponse: (raw) => mapPour((raw as WirePourResponse).pour),
  mock: (input, db) => {
    // Anti-tamper plausibility bounds (§8.2) - implausible readings are blocked
    if (!isPlausibleReading(input)) {
      throw new ApiError(
        422,
        'IMPLAUSIBLE_READING',
        'Reading outside plausible bounds (fat 1.5-12%, SNF 6-11%, qty 0.1-60L) - re-test the sample',
      );
    }
    const date = todayISO();
    const { ratePerLitre, amount } = computePourAmount(
      input.quantityLitres,
      input.fatPct,
      input.snfPct,
      db.rateConfig,
    );
    const pour: Pour = {
      id: nextId('pour'),
      farmerPartyId: input.farmerPartyId,
      dcsId: input.dcsId,
      date,
      shift: input.shift,
      quantityLitres: input.quantityLitres,
      fatPct: input.fatPct,
      snfPct: input.snfPct,
      clr: input.clr,
      temperatureC: input.temperatureC,
      rateApplied: ratePerLitre,
      amount,
      entryMethod: input.entryMethod,
      assurance: assuranceOf(input.entryMethod),
      rateChartVersion: db.rateConfig.version,
      status: 'RECORDED',
      synced: true,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    db.pours.push(pour);
    // Provenance leaf: the first link in this milk's hash-chained ledger (§5).
    appendChainEvent(db, {
      kind: 'POUR',
      subjectType: 'POUR',
      subjectId: pour.id,
      actorPartyId: input.recordedByPartyId,
      detail: `${input.quantityLitres}L @ fat ${input.fatPct}% (${pour.assurance})`,
    });

    // Same-day autofilled invoice (§8.1): create/update the farmer's draft bill
    let inv = db.invoices.find(
      (i) => i.farmerPartyId === input.farmerPartyId && i.date === date && i.status === 'DRAFT',
    );
    if (!inv) {
      inv = {
        id: nextId('inv'),
        farmerPartyId: input.farmerPartyId,
        dcsId: input.dcsId,
        date,
        pourIds: [],
        grossAmount: 0,
        deductions: 0,
        netAmount: 0,
        status: 'DRAFT',
      };
      db.invoices.push(inv);
    }
    inv.pourIds.push(pour.id);
    inv.grossAmount = Math.round((inv.grossAmount + amount) * 100) / 100;
    inv.netAmount = inv.grossAmount - inv.deductions;

    audit(db, {
      actorPartyId: input.recordedByPartyId,
      actorRole: 'SAMITI_SACHEEV',
      action: 'POUR_RECORDED',
      subject: `${input.quantityLitres}L @ fat ${input.fatPct}%`,
      detail: `Pour ${pour.id} recorded via ${input.entryMethod}; ₹${amount} added to same-day invoice`,
    });
    return pour;
  },
});

/**
 * Photo-OCR bridge (§8.2): the mock simulates on-device OCR of an analyzer
 * screen photo and returns extracted readings with a confidence score.
 */
// TODO(backend): no OCR endpoint yet - mock only
export const photoOcrExtract = endpoint<
  { dcsId: string },
  { fatPct: number; snfPct: number; confidence: number }
>({
  method: 'POST',
  path: () => '/pours/ocr-extract',
  mock: ({ dcsId }) => {
    const rng = mulberry32(hashString(`${dcsId}|${Date.now() >> 12}`));
    return {
      fatPct: Math.round((3.8 + rng() * 2.8) * 10) / 10,
      snfPct: Math.round((8.2 + rng() * 0.8) * 10) / 10,
      confidence: Math.round((0.87 + rng() * 0.12) * 100) / 100,
    };
  },
});

export const listLots = endpoint<{ dcsId?: string; date?: string; status?: DcsLot['status'] }, DcsLot[]>({
  method: 'GET',
  path: (f) => {
    const q = new URLSearchParams();
    if (f.dcsId) q.set('dcs_id', f.dcsId);
    if (f.date) q.set('date', f.date);
    if (f.status) q.set('status', f.status);
    const qs = q.toString();
    return `/logistics/consignments${qs ? `?${qs}` : ''}`;
  },
  mapResponse: (raw) => ((raw as WireConsignment[]) ?? []).map(mapConsignment),
  mock: (f, db) =>
    db.lots
      .filter(
        (l) =>
          (!f.dcsId || l.dcsId === f.dcsId) &&
          (!f.date || l.date === f.date) &&
          (!f.status || l.status === f.status),
      )
      .sort((a, b) => b.date.localeCompare(a.date)),
});

// TODO(backend): no endpoint yet - mock only
// (logistics exposes GET /consignments list + POST create/dispatch, but no
//  GET /consignments/{id}; fetch a single lot from the list result for now.)
export const getLot = endpoint<{ lotId: string }, DcsLot>({
  method: 'GET',
  path: ({ lotId }) => `/lots/${lotId}`,
  mock: ({ lotId }, db) => {
    const lot = db.lots.find((l) => l.id === lotId);
    if (!lot) throw new ApiError(404, 'LOT_NOT_FOUND', `Unknown lot ${lotId}`);
    return lot;
  },
});

/** Pool the shift's recorded pours into a consignment lot (provenance edge). */
export const createLot = endpoint<
  { dcsId: string; shift: Shift; createdByPartyId: string },
  DcsLot
>({
  method: 'POST',
  path: () => '/logistics/consignments',
  mapRequest: ({ dcsId, shift }) => ({ dcs_id: dcsId, date: todayISO(), shift }),
  mapResponse: (raw) => mapConsignment(raw as WireConsignment),
  mock: ({ dcsId, shift, createdByPartyId }, db) => {
    const date = todayISO();
    const pours = db.pours.filter(
      (po) => po.dcsId === dcsId && po.date === date && po.shift === shift && !po.lotId,
    );
    if (pours.length === 0) {
      throw new ApiError(409, 'NO_POURS', 'No recorded pours in this shift to pool into a lot');
    }
    const org = db.orgUnits.find((o) => o.id === dcsId)!;
    const totalLitres = Math.round(pours.reduce((s, po) => s + po.quantityLitres, 0) * 10) / 10;
    const lot: DcsLot = {
      id: nextId('lot'),
      consignmentCode: consignmentCode(org.code, date, shift),
      dcsId,
      date,
      shift,
      pourIds: pours.map((po) => po.id),
      totalLitres,
      avgFatPct:
        Math.round((pours.reduce((s, po) => s + po.fatPct * po.quantityLitres, 0) / totalLitres) * 10) / 10,
      avgSnfPct:
        Math.round((pours.reduce((s, po) => s + po.snfPct * po.quantityLitres, 0) / totalLitres) * 10) / 10,
      // §6.2: the consignment inherits the weakest capture-assurance of its pours.
      assurance: weakestAssurance(pours.map((po) => po.assurance)),
      status: 'OPEN',
    };
    for (const po of pours) {
      po.status = 'IN_LOT';
      po.lotId = lot.id;
    }
    db.lots.push(lot);
    audit(db, {
      actorPartyId: createdByPartyId,
      actorRole: 'SAMITI_SACHEEV',
      action: 'LOT_CREATED',
      subject: lot.consignmentCode,
      detail: `${pours.length} pours pooled → ${totalLitres}L consignment`,
    });
    return lot;
  },
});

/** Dispatch the lot; it becomes visible to the van rider's route stop. */
export const dispatchLot = endpoint<{ lotId: string; dispatchedByPartyId: string }, DcsLot>({
  method: 'POST',
  path: ({ lotId }) => `/logistics/consignments/${lotId}/dispatch`,
  mapRequest: () => ({}),
  mapResponse: (raw) => mapConsignment(raw as WireConsignment),
  mock: ({ lotId, dispatchedByPartyId }, db) => {
    const lot = db.lots.find((l) => l.id === lotId);
    if (!lot) throw new ApiError(404, 'LOT_NOT_FOUND', `Unknown lot ${lotId}`);
    if (lot.status !== 'OPEN') {
      throw new ApiError(409, 'ALREADY_DISPATCHED', 'This consignment is already dispatched');
    }
    lot.status = 'DISPATCHED';
    // Seal the consignment (§6.4): its pours/readings are now frozen and the van
    // rider verifies this code at pickup so milk cannot be swapped in transit.
    lot.sealCode = sealCodeFor(lot.consignmentCode);
    lot.sealedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    appendChainEvent(db, {
      kind: 'LOT_SEALED',
      subjectType: 'LOT',
      subjectId: lot.id,
      actorPartyId: dispatchedByPartyId,
      detail: `${lot.consignmentCode} sealed ${lot.sealCode}`,
    });
    // Attach to today's route stop awaiting this DCS
    const trip = db.trips.find(
      (t) => t.date === lot.date && t.stops.some((s) => s.dcsId === lot.dcsId && !s.lotId),
    );
    const stop = trip?.stops.find((s) => s.dcsId === lot.dcsId && !s.lotId);
    if (stop) stop.lotId = lot.id;
    audit(db, {
      actorPartyId: dispatchedByPartyId,
      actorRole: 'SAMITI_SACHEEV',
      action: 'LOT_DISPATCHED',
      subject: lot.consignmentCode,
      detail: `${lot.totalLitres}L dispatched${trip ? `, attached to route ${trip.code}` : ''}`,
    });
    return lot;
  },
});

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* DCS to Union submission: the Sachiv approves the consignment data   */
/* for the Union and a B2B GST invoice is generated (§5.2, §13).       */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

/** Indian fiscal year label for a date, e.g. 2026-27 (FY starts in April). */
function fiscalYear(date: string): string {
  const y = Number(date.slice(0, 4));
  const m = Number(date.slice(5, 7));
  const start = m >= 4 ? y : y - 1;
  return `${start}-${String((start + 1) % 100).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

/** Derive the DCS to Union B2B invoice from an approved consignment. */
function buildConsignmentInvoice(db: MockDb, lot: DcsLot): ConsignmentInvoice {
  const dcs = db.orgUnits.find((o) => o.id === lot.dcsId);
  const taxable = lot.unionInvoiceAmount ?? 0;
  const farmerCount = new Set(
    db.pours.filter((p) => lot.pourIds.includes(p.id)).map((p) => p.farmerPartyId),
  ).size;
  return {
    invoiceNo: lot.unionInvoiceNo ?? '',
    lotId: lot.id,
    consignmentCode: lot.consignmentCode,
    fromDcsId: lot.dcsId,
    toUnionId: dcs?.parentId ?? '',
    date: lot.date,
    shift: lot.shift,
    hsnCode: '0401',
    totalLitres: lot.totalLitres,
    avgFatPct: lot.avgFatPct,
    avgSnfPct: lot.avgSnfPct,
    farmerCount,
    taxableAmount: taxable,
    taxAmount: 0,
    totalAmount: taxable,
    gstNote: 'Fresh milk is GST exempt (HSN 0401)',
    generatedByPartyId: lot.unionApprovedByPartyId ?? '',
    generatedAt: lot.unionApprovedAt ?? '',
  };
}

/**
 * The Sachiv approves the consignment's data for the Union. This is the gate:
 * the Union only receives data the Sachiv has approved. Approval also generates
 * the DCS to Union B2B GST e-invoice (§13) and returns it.
 */
// TODO(backend): union approval + B2B invoice route not exposed yet, mock only
export const approveForUnion = endpoint<
  { lotId: string; approvedByPartyId: string },
  ConsignmentInvoice
>({
  method: 'POST',
  path: ({ lotId }) => `/collection/consignments/${lotId}/approve-union`,
  mock: ({ lotId, approvedByPartyId }, db) => {
    const lot = db.lots.find((l) => l.id === lotId);
    if (!lot) throw new ApiError(404, 'LOT_NOT_FOUND', `Unknown consignment ${lotId}`);
    if (lot.unionApproved) {
      throw new ApiError(409, 'ALREADY_APPROVED', 'This consignment is already approved for the Union');
    }
    if (lot.status === 'REJECTED') {
      throw new ApiError(
        409,
        'LOT_REJECTED',
        'A rejected consignment cannot be approved for the Union',
      );
    }
    const value =
      Math.round(
        db.pours
          .filter((p) => lot.pourIds.includes(p.id))
          .reduce((s, p) => s + p.amount, 0) * 100,
      ) / 100;
    const dcs = db.orgUnits.find((o) => o.id === lot.dcsId);
    const seq = db.lots.filter((l) => l.unionApproved).length + 45;
    lot.unionApproved = true;
    lot.unionApprovedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    lot.unionApprovedByPartyId = approvedByPartyId;
    lot.unionInvoiceNo = `${dcs?.code ?? 'DCS'}/${fiscalYear(lot.date)}/${String(seq).padStart(6, '0')}`;
    lot.unionInvoiceAmount = value;
    audit(db, {
      actorPartyId: approvedByPartyId,
      actorRole: 'SAMITI_SACHEEV',
      action: 'UNION_DATA_APPROVED',
      subject: lot.consignmentCode,
      detail: `Approved ${lot.totalLitres}L for the Union; invoice ${lot.unionInvoiceNo} generated (value Rs. ${value})`,
    });
    return buildConsignmentInvoice(db, lot);
  },
});

/** Fetch the generated DCS to Union invoice for an approved consignment. */
// TODO(backend): union approval + B2B invoice route not exposed yet, mock only
export const getConsignmentInvoice = endpoint<{ lotId: string }, ConsignmentInvoice>({
  method: 'GET',
  path: ({ lotId }) => `/collection/consignments/${lotId}/invoice`,
  mock: ({ lotId }, db) => {
    const lot = db.lots.find((l) => l.id === lotId);
    if (!lot || !lot.unionApproved) {
      throw new ApiError(404, 'INVOICE_NOT_FOUND', 'No invoice has been generated for this consignment');
    }
    return buildConsignmentInvoice(db, lot);
  },
});
```

```text
81				slog.String("op", op),
82				slog.String("target_org_id", targetOrgID.Hex()),
83				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
84				slog.String("actor_role", actor.RoleCode))
85		}
86		return err
87	}
88	
89	// --- safety-gate predicates (§8.3) ---
90	//
91	// Pure functions so the refusal matrix is unit-testable without a database.
92	// Every mutation below ALSO re-checks the status inside the MongoDB update
93	// filter, so a concurrent QC block can never slip a bad lot through.
94	
95	// canDispatchBMCLot: only a lot with a passing BMC rapid test may leave on a
96	// tanker. BLOCKED, QC_PENDING and OPEN lots stay put.
97	func canDispatchBMCLot(status string) bool {
98		return status == domain.BMCLotStatusPassed
99	}
100	
101	// canPoolBMCLot: only a DISPATCHED lot (which by construction went
102	// OPEN→QC_PENDING→PASSED→DISPATCHED) may enter a processing batch.
103	func canPoolBMCLot(status string) bool {
104		return status == domain.BMCLotStatusDispatched
105	}
106	
107	// canCompleteBatch: only a batch the plant lab has PASSED may complete.
108	func canCompleteBatch(status string) bool {
109		return status == domain.BatchStatusPassed
110	}
111	
112	// canYieldProductLot: only a COMPLETED batch may be packaged into SKU lots.
113	func canYieldProductLot(batchStatus string) bool {
114		return batchStatus == domain.BatchStatusCompleted
115	}
116	
117	// canIssueQR: a QR may only label an ACTIVE product lot whose batch is
118	// COMPLETED. This read-time check is advisory; IssueQR additionally confirms
119	// the lot is still ACTIVE with a conditional write after the QR insert, so a
120	// recall landing mid-request still stops the mint.
121	func canIssueQR(lotStatus, batchStatus string) bool {
122		return lotStatus == domain.ProductLotStatusActive && batchStatus == domain.BatchStatusCompleted
123	}
124	
125	// --- BMC lots ---
126	
127	// CreateBMCLot pools DELIVERED consignments into a new OPEN lot at a BMC.
128	func (s *Service) CreateBMCLot(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateBMCLotRequest) (*domain.BMCLot, error) {
129		actID, err := actorID(actor)
130		if err != nil {
131			return nil, err
132		}
133		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, req.BMCID, "create bmc lot"); err != nil {
134			return nil, err
135		}
136		org, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.BMCID)
137		if err != nil {
138			return nil, err
139		}
140		if org.Type != domain.OrgTypeBMC {
141			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot creation refused: org unit is not a BMC",
142				slog.String("org_unit_id", req.BMCID.Hex()),
143				slog.String("org_type", org.Type),
144				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
145			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_BMC", "org unit "+req.BMCID.Hex()+" is not a BMC")
146		}
147	
148		now := time.Now().UTC()
149		date := req.Date
150		if date == "" {
151			date = domain.DateKeyIST(now)
152		}
153	
154		ids := dedupe(req.ConsignmentIDs)
155		consignments, err := s.repo.ConsignmentsByIDs(ctx, ids)
156		if err != nil {
157			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "load consignments", err)
158		}
159		if len(consignments) != len(ids) {
160			return nil, httpx.NotFound("consignment(s) " + strings.Join(missingIDs(ids, consignments), ", "))
161		}
162		var undelivered []string
163		for _, c := range consignments {
164			if c.Status != domain.ConsignmentStatusDelivered {
165				undelivered = append(undelivered, c.ID.Hex())
166			}
167		}
168		if len(undelivered) > 0 {
169			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot creation refused: consignment(s) not DELIVERED",
170				slog.String("bmc_id", req.BMCID.Hex()),
171				slog.String("consignment_ids", strings.Join(undelivered, ",")),
172				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
173			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("CONSIGNMENT_NOT_DELIVERED",
174				"only DELIVERED consignments can be pooled into a BMC lot").
175				WithDetails(map[string]any{"consignment_ids": undelivered})
176		}
177	
178		// Optimistic claim: flip DELIVERED→ACCEPTED stamped with the new lot ID.
179		// The lot ID is pre-generated so claim, insert and ledger all agree.
180		// If another lot raced us on any consignment, release our claims and bail.
181		lotID := primitive.NewObjectID()
182		claimed, err := s.repo.ClaimConsignments(ctx, ids, lotID)
183		if err != nil {
184			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "claim consignments", err)
185		}
186		if claimed != int64(len(ids)) {
187			if relErr := s.repo.ReleaseConsignments(ctx, lotID); relErr != nil {
188				return nil, s.fail(ctx, "release consignments after lost claim", relErr)
189			}
190			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot creation lost consignment claim race",
191				slog.String("bmc_id", req.BMCID.Hex()),
192				slog.Int64("claimed", claimed), slog.Int("requested", len(ids)),
193				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
194			return nil, httpx.Conflict("CONSIGNMENT_CLAIM_CONFLICT",
195				"one or more consignments were pooled by another lot — reload and retry")
196		}
197	
198		var totalLitres float64
199		var tripIDs []primitive.ObjectID
200		seenTrip := map[primitive.ObjectID]bool{}
201		for _, c := range consignments {
202			totalLitres += c.TotalQuantityLitres
203			if c.RouteTripID != nil && !seenTrip[*c.RouteTripID] {
204				seenTrip[*c.RouteTripID] = true
205				tripIDs = append(tripIDs, *c.RouteTripID)
206			}
207		}
208	
209		lot := &domain.BMCLot{
210			ID:                  lotID,
211			BMCID:               req.BMCID,
212			Date:                date,
213			Shift:               req.Shift,
214			ConsignmentIDs:      ids,
215			RouteTripIDs:        tripIDs,
216			TotalQuantityLitres: totalLitres,
217			Status:              domain.BMCLotStatusOpen,
218			CreatedBy:           actID,
219			CreatedAt:           now,
220		}
221		if err := s.repo.InsertBMCLot(ctx, lot); err != nil {
222			_ = s.repo.ReleaseConsignments(ctx, lotID)
223			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "insert bmc lot", err)
224		}
225	
226		refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, len(ids))
227		for _, id := range ids {
228			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{
229				EntityType: domain.EntityConsignment, EntityID: id.Hex(), Relation: "pools",
230			})
231		}
232		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
233			Type:       domain.EventBMCLotCreated,
234			EntityType: domain.EntityBMCLot,
235			EntityID:   lot.ID.Hex(),
236			Refs:       refs,
237			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
238			OrgUnitID:  req.BMCID.Hex(),
239			Payload: map[string]any{
240				"date": date, "shift": req.Shift, "total_quantity_litres": totalLitres,
241			},
242		})
243		if err != nil {
244			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append bmc_lot.created event", err)
245		}
246		if err := s.repo.SetBMCLotProvenanceSeq(ctx, lot.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
247			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp bmc lot provenance seq", err)
248		}
249		lot.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
250		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "bmc lot created",
251			slog.String("bmc_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()),
252			slog.String("bmc_id", req.BMCID.Hex()),
253			slog.String("date", date), slog.String("shift", req.Shift),
254			slog.Int("consignments", len(ids)),
255			slog.Float64("total_quantity_litres", totalLitres),
256			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
257		return lot, nil
258	}
259	
260	// CloseBMCLot transitions an OPEN lot to QC_PENDING with the chilling
261	// temperature. The quality module later flips QC_PENDING→PASSED/BLOCKED.
262	func (s *Service) CloseBMCLot(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID, chillingTempC float64) (*domain.BMCLot, error) {
263		lot, err := s.getBMCLot(ctx, id)
264		if err != nil {
265			return nil, err
266		}
267		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, lot.BMCID, "close bmc lot"); err != nil {
268			return nil, err
269		}
270		if lot.Status != domain.BMCLotStatusOpen {
271			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot close refused: not OPEN",
272				slog.String("bmc_lot_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("status", lot.Status),
273				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
274			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_NOT_OPEN",
275				"only an OPEN lot can be closed; lot is "+lot.Status)
276		}
277		now := time.Now().UTC()
278		ok, err := s.repo.CloseBMCLot(ctx, id, chillingTempC, now)
279		if err != nil {
280			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "close bmc lot", err)
281		}
282		if !ok {
283			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot close lost state race",
284				slog.String("bmc_lot_id", id.Hex()),
285				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
286			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_NOT_OPEN",
287				"lot changed state concurrently — reload and retry")
288		}
289		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
290			Type:       domain.EventBMCLotClosed,
291			EntityType: domain.EntityBMCLot,
292			EntityID:   lot.ID.Hex(),
293			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
294			OrgUnitID:  lot.BMCID.Hex(),
295			Payload:    map[string]any{"chilling_temp_c": chillingTempC},
296		})
297		if err != nil {
298			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append bmc_lot.closed event", err)
299		}
300		if err := s.repo.SetBMCLotProvenanceSeq(ctx, lot.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
301			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp bmc lot provenance seq", err)
302		}
303		lot.Status = domain.BMCLotStatusQCPending
304		lot.ChillingTempC = chillingTempC
305		lot.ClosedAt = &now
306		lot.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
307		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "bmc lot closed for QC",
308			slog.String("bmc_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()),
309			slog.String("bmc_id", lot.BMCID.Hex()),
310			slog.Float64("chilling_temp_c", chillingTempC),
311			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
312		return lot, nil
313	}
314	
315	// DispatchBMCLot transitions PASSED→DISPATCHED. THE safety gate (§8.3): a
316	// BLOCKED or untested lot never leaves the chilling centre.
317	func (s *Service) DispatchBMCLot(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.BMCLot, error) {
318		lot, err := s.getBMCLot(ctx, id)
319		if err != nil {
320			return nil, err
321		}
322		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, lot.BMCID, "dispatch bmc lot"); err != nil {
323			return nil, err
324		}
325		if lot.Status == domain.BMCLotStatusDispatched {
326			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot dispatch refused: already dispatched",
327				slog.String("bmc_lot_id", id.Hex()),
328				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
329			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_ALREADY_DISPATCHED", "lot is already dispatched")
330		}
331		if !canDispatchBMCLot(lot.Status) {
332			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot dispatch refused: safety gate not passed",
333				slog.String("bmc_lot_id", id.Hex()),
334				slog.String("status", lot.Status),
335				slog.String("block_reason", lot.BlockReason),
336				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
337			msg := "lot cannot be dispatched: safety gate not passed (status " + lot.Status + ")"
338			if lot.BlockReason != "" {
339				msg += " — " + lot.BlockReason
340			}
341			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked, msg).
342				WithDetails(map[string]any{"status": lot.Status, "block_reason": lot.BlockReason})
343		}
344		now := time.Now().UTC()
345		ok, err := s.repo.DispatchBMCLot(ctx, id, now)
346		if err != nil {
347			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "dispatch bmc lot", err)
348		}
349		if !ok {
350			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot dispatch lost state race",
351				slog.String("bmc_lot_id", id.Hex()),
352				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
353			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_STATE_CHANGED",
354				"lot changed state concurrently — reload and retry")
355		}
356		// The custody transition — gate-passed milk physically leaving the
357		// chilling centre — must live on the tamper-evident chain like every
358		// other hop of the pour→QR path, not only in a mutable document field.
359		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
360			Type:       domain.EventBMCLotDispatched,
361			EntityType: domain.EntityBMCLot,
362			EntityID:   lot.ID.Hex(),
363			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
364			OrgUnitID:  lot.BMCID.Hex(),
365			Payload: map[string]any{
366				// String, not time.Time: payloads must round-trip BSON⇄JSON
367				// byte-identically or chain re-verification would break.
368				"dispatched_at":         now.Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
369				"total_quantity_litres": lot.TotalQuantityLitres,
370			},
371		})
372		if err != nil {
373			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append bmc_lot.dispatched event", err)
374		}
375		if err := s.repo.SetBMCLotProvenanceSeq(ctx, lot.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
376			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp bmc lot provenance seq", err)
377		}
378		lot.Status = domain.BMCLotStatusDispatched
379		lot.DispatchedAt = &now
380		lot.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
381		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "bmc lot dispatched",
382			slog.String("bmc_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()),
383			slog.String("bmc_id", lot.BMCID.Hex()),
384			slog.Float64("total_quantity_litres", lot.TotalQuantityLitres),
385			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
386		return lot, nil
387	}
388	
389	// ListBMCLots pages lots by BMC/date/status. A BMC operator may only list
390	// within their own scope; downstream readers (plant operator, supervisor,
391	// lab) see across BMCs — the plant receives tankers from sibling BMCs, so an
392	// ancestry check against the plant org would wrongly refuse them.
393	func (s *Service) ListBMCLots(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, f BMCLotListFilter, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.BMCLot, int64, error) {
394		if !f.BMCID.IsZero() && actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleBMCOperator {
395			if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, f.BMCID, "list bmc lots"); err != nil {
396				return nil, 0, err
397			}
398		}
399		lots, total, err := s.repo.ListBMCLots(ctx, f, page)
400		if err != nil {
401			return nil, 0, s.fail(ctx, "list bmc lots", err)
402		}
403		return lots, total, nil
404	}
405	
406	// --- processing batches ---
407	
408	// CreateBatch pools DISPATCHED (gate-passed) BMC lots into one production
409	// run. The gate re-checks here belt-and-braces: aflatoxin M1 survives
410	// pasteurisation, so a blocked lot must never reach a vat (§8.3).
411	func (s *Service) CreateBatch(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateBatchRequest) (*domain.ProcessingBatch, error) {
412		actID, err := actorID(actor)
413		if err != nil {
414			return nil, err
415		}
416		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, req.PlantID, "create batch"); err != nil {
417			return nil, err
418		}
419		org, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.PlantID)
420		if err != nil {
421			return nil, err
422		}
423		if org.Type != domain.OrgTypeProcessingPlant {
424			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch creation refused: org unit is not a plant",
425				slog.String("org_unit_id", req.PlantID.Hex()),
426				slog.String("org_type", org.Type),
427				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
428			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_PLANT", "org unit "+req.PlantID.Hex()+" is not a processing plant")
429		}
430	
431		ids := dedupe(req.BMCLotIDs)
432		lots, err := s.repo.BMCLotsByIDs(ctx, ids)
433		if err != nil {
434			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "load bmc lots", err)
435		}
436		if len(lots) != len(ids) {
437			return nil, httpx.NotFound("BMC lot(s) " + strings.Join(missingLotIDs(ids, lots), ", "))
438		}
439		var offending []string
440		var inputLitres float64
441		for _, lot := range lots {
442			if !canPoolBMCLot(lot.Status) {
443				offending = append(offending, lot.ID.Hex())
444				continue
445			}
446			inputLitres += lot.TotalQuantityLitres
447		}
448		if len(offending) > 0 {
449			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch creation refused: bmc lot(s) have not cleared the safety gate",
450				slog.String("plant_id", req.PlantID.Hex()),
451				slog.String("blocked_lot_ids", strings.Join(offending, ",")),
452				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
453			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked,
454				"one or more BMC lots have not cleared the safety gate (must be PASSED and DISPATCHED)").
455				WithDetails(map[string]any{"blocked_lot_ids": offending})
456		}
457	
458		now := time.Now().UTC()
459		dateKey := domain.DateKeyIST(now)
460		seq, err := s.repo.NextSequence(ctx, "batch_number:"+req.PlantID.Hex()+":"+dateKey)
461		if err != nil {
462			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "next batch number sequence", err)
463		}
464		batchNumber := fmt.Sprintf("BATCH-%s-%s-%04d",
465			org.Code, strings.ReplaceAll(dateKey, "-", ""), seq)
466	
467		// Optimistic claim (mirrors ClaimConsignments): flip DISPATCHED→POOLED
468		// stamped with the pre-generated batch ID BEFORE inserting the batch. One
469		// physical lot of milk can therefore never be pooled into two batches —
470		// neither by a double-submit nor by two concurrent CreateBatch calls.
471		batchID := primitive.NewObjectID()
472		claimed, err := s.repo.ClaimBMCLots(ctx, ids, batchID)
473		if err != nil {
474			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "claim bmc lots", err)
475		}
476		if claimed != int64(len(ids)) {
477			if relErr := s.repo.ReleaseBMCLots(ctx, batchID); relErr != nil {
478				return nil, s.fail(ctx, "release bmc lots after lost claim", relErr)
479			}
480			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch creation lost bmc lot claim race",
481				slog.String("plant_id", req.PlantID.Hex()),
482				slog.Int64("claimed", claimed), slog.Int("requested", len(ids)),
483				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
484			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_CLAIM_CONFLICT",
485				"one or more BMC lots were pooled by another batch — reload and retry")
486		}
487	
488		// CREATED is a transient birth state: the plant lab must clear every
489		// batch, so it is persisted straight into QC_PENDING.
490		batch := &domain.ProcessingBatch{
491			ID:          batchID,
492			PlantID:     req.PlantID,
493			BatchNumber: batchNumber,
494			BMCLotIDs:   ids,
495			ProductType: req.ProductType,
496			InputLitres: inputLitres,
497			Status:      domain.BatchStatusQCPending,
498			StartedAt:   now,
499			CreatedBy:   actID,
500			CreatedAt:   now,
501		}
502		if err := s.repo.InsertBatch(ctx, batch); err != nil {
503			_ = s.repo.ReleaseBMCLots(ctx, batchID)
504			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "insert batch", err)
505		}
506	
507		refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, len(ids))
508		for _, id := range ids {
509			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{
510				EntityType: domain.EntityBMCLot, EntityID: id.Hex(), Relation: "pools",
511			})
512		}
513		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
514			Type:       domain.EventBatchCreated,
515			EntityType: domain.EntityBatch,
516			EntityID:   batch.ID.Hex(),
517			Refs:       refs,
518			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
519			OrgUnitID:  req.PlantID.Hex(),
520			Payload: map[string]any{
521				"batch_number": batchNumber, "product_type": req.ProductType, "input_litres": inputLitres,
522			},
523		})
524		if err != nil {
525			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append batch.created event", err)
526		}
527		if err := s.repo.SetBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx, batch.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
528			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp batch provenance seq", err)
529		}
530		batch.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
531		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "processing batch created",
532			slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
533			slog.String("batch_number", batchNumber),
534			slog.String("plant_id", req.PlantID.Hex()),
535			slog.String("product_type", req.ProductType),
536			slog.Int("bmc_lots", len(ids)),
537			slog.Float64("input_litres", inputLitres),
538			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
539		return batch, nil
540	}
541	
542	// CompleteBatch transitions PASSED→COMPLETED — only a batch the plant lab
543	// cleared may finish and go on to yield product lots.
544	func (s *Service) CompleteBatch(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.ProcessingBatch, error) {
545		batch, err := s.getBatch(ctx, id)
546		if err != nil {
547			return nil, err
548		}
549		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, batch.PlantID, "complete batch"); err != nil {
550			return nil, err
551		}
552		if batch.Status == domain.BatchStatusCompleted {
553			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch completion refused: already completed",
554				slog.String("batch_id", id.Hex()),
555				slog.String("batch_number", batch.BatchNumber),
556				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
557			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BATCH_ALREADY_COMPLETED", "batch is already completed")
558		}
559		if !canCompleteBatch(batch.Status) {
560			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch completion refused: plant-lab QC not passed",
561				slog.String("batch_id", id.Hex()),
562				slog.String("batch_number", batch.BatchNumber),
563				slog.String("status", batch.Status),
564				slog.String("block_reason", batch.BlockReason),
565				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
566			msg := "batch cannot complete: plant-lab QC not passed (status " + batch.Status + ")"
567			if batch.BlockReason != "" {
568				msg += " — " + batch.BlockReason
569			}
570			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked, msg).
571				WithDetails(map[string]any{"status": batch.Status, "block_reason": batch.BlockReason})
572		}
573		now := time.Now().UTC()
574		ok, err := s.repo.CompleteBatch(ctx, id, now)
575		if err != nil {
576			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "complete batch", err)
577		}
578		if !ok {
579			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch completion lost state race",
580				slog.String("batch_id", id.Hex()),
581				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
582			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BATCH_STATE_CHANGED",
583				"batch changed state concurrently — reload and retry")
584		}
585		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
586			Type:       domain.EventBatchCompleted,
587			EntityType: domain.EntityBatch,
588			EntityID:   batch.ID.Hex(),
589			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
590			OrgUnitID:  batch.PlantID.Hex(),
591			Payload:    map[string]any{"batch_number": batch.BatchNumber},
592		})
593		if err != nil {
594			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append batch.completed event", err)
595		}
596		if err := s.repo.SetBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx, batch.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
597			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp batch provenance seq", err)
598		}
599		batch.Status = domain.BatchStatusCompleted
600		batch.CompletedAt = &now
601		batch.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
602		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "processing batch completed",
603			slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
604			slog.String("batch_number", batch.BatchNumber),
605			slog.String("plant_id", batch.PlantID.Hex()),
606			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
607		return batch, nil
608	}
```
