```text
770	// --- QR issuance ---
771	
772	// qrAlphabet is the 32-character human-safe set for short codes: A–Z and 2–9
773	// minus the confusables 0/O and 1/I. 32 divides 256, so a byte modulo the
774	// alphabet length is unbiased.
775	const qrAlphabet = "ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789"
776	
777	// qrCodeLength is the number of random characters after the "PRG-" prefix
778	// (32^8 ≈ 1.1 trillion codes — collisions are retried on the unique index).
779	const qrCodeLength = 8
780	
781	// newQRCode mints a short public code like "[REDACTED:generic-api-key]" from crypto/rand.
782	func newQRCode() (string, error) {
783		buf := make([]byte, qrCodeLength)
784		if _, err := rand.Read(buf); err != nil {
785			return "", err
786		}
787		code := make([]byte, qrCodeLength)
788		for i, b := range buf {
789			code[i] = qrAlphabet[int(b)%len(qrAlphabet)]
790		}
791		return "PRG-" + string(code), nil
792	}
793	
794	// signQRToken builds the forgery-proof token printed inside the QR:
795	// base64url(qr_code|product_lot_hex|issued_unix) + "." + hex(HMAC-SHA256).
796	// productLotHex is the product lot ObjectID's hex form — the HMAC material is
797	// "qr_code|lot hex|unix", and the publictrace module verifies the exact same
798	// shape. The consumer app resolves the payload; the signature proves it was
799	// minted by this server, so IDs cannot be guessed onto counterfeit packs.
800	func signQRToken(secret, qrCode, productLotHex string, issuedAt time.Time) string {
801		payload := qrCode + "|" + productLotHex + "|" + strconv.FormatInt(issuedAt.Unix(), 10)
802		mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte(secret))
803		mac.Write([]byte(payload))
804		return base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(payload)) + "." + hex.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))
805	}
806	
807	// parseQRToken verifies and unpacks a signed QR token, returning the product
808	// lot ObjectID as its hex string.
809	func parseQRToken(secret, token string) (qrCode, productLotHex string, issuedAt time.Time, err error) {
810		payloadB64, sigHex, found := strings.Cut(token, ".")
811		if !found {
812			return "", "", time.Time{}, errors.New("qr token: missing signature separator")
813		}
814		payloadBytes, err := base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString(payloadB64)
815		if err != nil {
816			return "", "", time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("qr token: bad payload encoding: %w", err)
817		}
818		sig, err := hex.DecodeString(sigHex)
819		if err != nil {
820			return "", "", time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("qr token: bad signature encoding: %w", err)
821		}
822		mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte(secret))
823		mac.Write(payloadBytes)
824		if !hmac.Equal(sig, mac.Sum(nil)) {
825			return "", "", time.Time{}, errors.New("qr token: signature mismatch")
826		}
827		parts := strings.Split(string(payloadBytes), "|")
828		if len(parts) != 3 {
829			return "", "", time.Time{}, errors.New("qr token: malformed payload")
830		}
831		unix, err := strconv.ParseInt(parts[2], 10, 64)
832		if err != nil {
833			return "", "", time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("qr token: bad timestamp: %w", err)
834		}
835		return parts[0], parts[1], time.Unix(unix, 0).UTC(), nil
836	}
837	
838	// IssueQR mints one signed QR for an ACTIVE product lot whose batch is
839	// COMPLETED. The gate is checked on read AND re-confirmed with a conditional
840	// write on the lot after the QR insert, so recalled or blocked product can
841	// never be freshly labelled even when the recall races this request.
842	func (s *Service) IssueQR(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, productLotID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.BatchQR, error) {
843		actID, err := actorID(actor)
844		if err != nil {
845			return nil, err
846		}
847		lot, err := s.getProductLot(ctx, productLotID)
848		if err != nil {
849			return nil, err
850		}
851		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, lot.PlantID, "issue qr"); err != nil {
852			return nil, err
853		}
854		batch, err := s.getBatch(ctx, lot.BatchID)
855		if err != nil {
856			return nil, err
857		}
858		if !canIssueQR(lot.Status, batch.Status) {
859			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qr issuance refused: safety gate",
860				slog.String("product_lot_id", productLotID.Hex()),
861				slog.String("product_lot_status", lot.Status),
862				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
863				slog.String("batch_status", batch.Status),
864				slog.String("recall_reason", lot.RecallReason),
865				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
866			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked,
867				"QR issuance refused: product lot must be ACTIVE and its batch COMPLETED").
868				WithDetails(map[string]any{
869					"product_lot_status": lot.Status,
870					"batch_status":       batch.Status,
871					"recall_reason":      lot.RecallReason,
872				})
873		}
874	
875		now := time.Now().UTC()
876		var qr *domain.BatchQR
877		const maxMintAttempts = 5
878		for attempt := 0; attempt < maxMintAttempts; attempt++ {
879			code, err := newQRCode()
880			if err != nil {
881				return nil, s.fail(ctx, "generate qr code", err)
882			}
883			candidate := &domain.BatchQR{
884				ID:           primitive.NewObjectID(),
885				QRCode:       code,
886				ProductLotID: lot.ID,
887				SignedToken:  signQRToken(s.qrSecret, code, lot.ID.Hex(), now),
888				IssuedBy:     actID,
889				ScanCount:    0,
890				IssuedAt:     now,
891			}
892			insertErr := s.repo.InsertQR(ctx, candidate)
893			if insertErr == nil {
894				qr = candidate
895				break
896			}
897			if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(insertErr) {
898				continue // short-code collision — regenerate
899			}
900			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "insert qr", insertErr)
901		}
902		if qr == nil {
903			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "mint qr code",
904				fmt.Errorf("%d consecutive short-code collisions", maxMintAttempts))
905		}
906	
907		// Recall re-check at WRITE time: the initial read cannot see a recall that
908		// lands mid-request, so the mint is confirmed with a conditional no-op
909		// write on the lot (filter status=ACTIVE). If the lot left ACTIVE, the
910		// just-inserted QR is deleted and issuance refused — a freshly minted QR
911		// can never label recalled product.
912		active, err := s.repo.TouchActiveLot(ctx, lot.ID)
913		if err != nil {
914			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "confirm product lot active", err)
915		}
916		if !active {
917			if delErr := s.repo.DeleteQR(ctx, qr.ID); delErr != nil {
918				return nil, s.fail(ctx, "delete qr after lot left ACTIVE", delErr)
919			}
920			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qr issuance refused: product lot left ACTIVE during issuance",
921				slog.String("product_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()),
922				slog.String("qr_id", qr.ID.Hex()),
923				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
924			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked,
925				"QR issuance refused: product lot left ACTIVE (e.g. recalled) during issuance")
926		}
927	
928		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
929			Type:       domain.EventQRIssued,
930			EntityType: domain.EntityBatchQR,
931			EntityID:   qr.ID.Hex(),
932			Refs: []provenance.Ref{
933				{EntityType: domain.EntityProductLot, EntityID: lot.ID.Hex(), Relation: "labels"},
934			},
935			Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
936			OrgUnitID: lot.PlantID.Hex(),
937			Payload:   map[string]any{"qr_code": qr.QRCode},
938		})
939		if err != nil {
940			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append qr.issued event", err)
941		}
942		if err := s.repo.SetQRProvenanceSeq(ctx, qr.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
943			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp qr provenance seq", err)
944		}
945		qr.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
946		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "qr issued",
947			slog.String("qr_id", qr.ID.Hex()),
948			slog.String("qr_code", qr.QRCode),
949			slog.String("product_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()),
950			slog.String("plant_id", lot.PlantID.Hex()),
951			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
952		return qr, nil
953	}

1009	// dedupe removes zero and duplicate IDs preserving first-seen order.
1010	func dedupe(ids []primitive.ObjectID) []primitive.ObjectID {
1011		seen := make(map[primitive.ObjectID]bool, len(ids))
1012		out := make([]primitive.ObjectID, 0, len(ids))
1013		for _, id := range ids {
1014			if id.IsZero() || seen[id] {
1015				continue
1016			}
1017			seen[id] = true
1018			out = append(out, id)
1019		}
1020		return out
1021	}

1023	// missingIDs lists requested consignment IDs (as hex) absent from the fetched
1024	// set.
1025	func missingIDs(wanted []primitive.ObjectID, got []domain.DCSConsignment) []string {
1026		have := make(map[primitive.ObjectID]bool, len(got))
1027		for _, c := range got {
1028			have[c.ID] = true
1029		}
1030		var missing []string
1031		for _, id := range wanted {
1032			if !have[id] {
1033				missing = append(missing, id.Hex())
1034			}
1035		}
1036		return missing
1037	}
1038

1041	func missingLotIDs(wanted []primitive.ObjectID, got []domain.BMCLot) []string {

1045		}
```

```text
1	// Package plant implements the processing tier of the pour→QR chain:
2	// BMC lots (pooled consignments at the chilling centre), processing batches,
3	// product lots and QR issuance. It is the ENFORCEMENT layer of the safety
4	// gate (blueprint §8.3): a lot or batch that has not PASSED quality control
5	// can never advance — not into a tanker, not into a batch, not onto a shelf.
6	// Aflatoxin M1 survives pasteurisation, so the gate is checked at every hop,
7	// belt-and-braces.
8	package plant
9	
10	import (
11		"log/slog"
12	
13		"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
14	
15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
16		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
17		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/middleware"
18	)
19	
20	// Register wires the plant module under /api/v1/plant.
21	func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
22		log := d.Log.With(slog.String("module", "plant"))
23		repo := NewRepo(d.DB)
24		svc := NewService(repo, d, log)
25		h := NewHandler(svc)
26	
27		r.Route("/plant", func(pr chi.Router) {
28			pr.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
29	
30			// BMC lots — created/closed/dispatched by the chilling-centre operator;
31			// readable by everyone downstream who receives or supervises the milk.
32			pr.Route("/bmc-lots", func(lr chi.Router) {
33				lr.With(middleware.RequireRoles(
34					domain.RoleBMCOperator, domain.RolePlantOperator,
35					domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor, domain.RolePlantLabAnalyst,
36				)).Get("/", h.ListBMCLots)
37	
38				lr.Group(func(wr chi.Router) {
39					wr.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleBMCOperator))
40					wr.Post("/", h.CreateBMCLot)
41					wr.Post("/{id}/close", h.CloseBMCLot)
42					wr.Post("/{id}/dispatch", h.DispatchBMCLot)
43				})
44			})
45	
46			// Processing batches — plant operator pools dispatched (gate-passed)
47			// BMC lots into a production run; plant lab + supervisor read along.
48			pr.Route("/batches", func(br chi.Router) {
49				read := middleware.RequireRoles(
50					domain.RolePlantOperator, domain.RolePlantLabAnalyst,
51					domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor,
52				)
53				br.With(read).Get("/", h.ListBatches)
54				br.With(read).Get("/{id}", h.GetBatch)
55	
56				br.Group(func(wr chi.Router) {
57					wr.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RolePlantOperator))
58					wr.Post("/", h.CreateBatch)
59					wr.Post("/{id}/complete", h.CompleteBatch)
60				})
61			})
62	
63			// Product lots — packaged SKUs out of a COMPLETED batch. Recall is the
64			// FSSAI path (§18-C): admin or plant lab pulls the lot from market.
65			pr.Route("/product-lots", func(plr chi.Router) {
66				plr.With(middleware.RequireRoles(
67					domain.RolePlantOperator, domain.RolePlantLabAnalyst,
68				)).Post("/", h.CreateProductLot)
69				plr.With(middleware.RequireRoles(
70					domain.RolePCDFAdmin, domain.RolePlantLabAnalyst,
71				)).Post("/{id}/recall", h.RecallProductLot)
72			})
73	
74			// QR issuance — the consumer-facing end of the trace chain (§7).
75			pr.Route("/qrs", func(qr chi.Router) {
76				qr.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(
77					domain.RolePlantOperator, domain.RolePlantLabAnalyst,
78				))
79				qr.Post("/", h.IssueQR)
80				qr.Get("/", h.ListQRs)
81			})
82		})
83	
84		// No bus subscriptions: the quality module flips lot/batch statuses in
85		// their own collections, and every gate here re-reads status at use time.
86	}
```

```text
22	// service holds the safety-gate business logic (blueprint §8.3): evaluate
23	// tests against FSSAI limits, write the verdict onto the subject, chain the
24	// provenance events, and broadcast blocks to downstream modules.
25	type service struct {
26		deps *deps.Deps
27		repo *repository
28		log  *slog.Logger
29	}
30	
31	// newService wires the service with its module-scoped logger.
32	func newService(d *deps.Deps, repo *repository, log *slog.Logger) *service {
33		return &service{deps: d, repo: repo, log: log}
34	}
35	
36	// actorID parses the actor's party ObjectID out of its JWT hex string.
37	func actorID(actor auth.Actor) (primitive.ObjectID, error) {
38		return httpx.ParseID(actor.PartyID, "actor")
39	}
40	
41	// gateSubject is what the gate needs to know about an eligible subject.
42	type gateSubject struct {
43		entityType string             // provenance entity const for the subject
44		orgUnitID  primitive.ObjectID // owning org unit (BMC or plant) for scope + ledger
45		status     string
46	}
47	
48	// requiredRoleForStage returns the one role allowed to record results at a
49	// stage (BMC_RAPID↔BMC_OPERATOR, PLANT_LAB↔PLANT_LAB_ANALYST), and whether
50	// the stage is known at all.
51	func requiredRoleForStage(stage string) (string, bool) {
52		switch stage {
53		case domain.QCStageBMCRapid:
54			return domain.RoleBMCOperator, true
55		case domain.QCStagePlantLab:
56			return domain.RolePlantLabAnalyst, true
57		default:
58			return "", false
59		}
60	}
61	
62	// certificateNumber builds the human-readable QC certificate identifier from
63	// the per-stage counter, e.g. "QC-PLANT_LAB-000042".
64	func certificateNumber(stage string, seq int64) string {
65		return fmt.Sprintf("QC-%s-%06d", stage, seq)
66	}
67	
68	// knownQCTests is the closed vocabulary of recordable test names: the four
69	// gated FSSAI tests plus the explicitly whitelisted grading tests. Anything
70	// else (including a typo like "AFLATOXIN_M") is rejected instead of being
71	// silently recorded as a non-gating pass.
72	var knownQCTests = map[string]struct{}{
73		domain.TestAflatoxinM1: {},
74		domain.TestColiform:    {},
75		domain.TestAntibiotic:  {},
76		domain.TestPhosphatase: {},
77		domain.TestTPC:         {},
78		domain.TestFat:         {},
79		domain.TestSNF:         {},
80	}
81	
82	// mandatoryTestsForStage returns the tests a stage MUST measure before a PASS
83	// verdict may be issued (blueprint §8.3: heat-stable aflatoxin M1 is gated at
84	// BMC and plant; phosphatase proves pasteurisation at the plant lab).
85	func mandatoryTestsForStage(stage string) []string {
86		switch stage {
87		case domain.QCStageBMCRapid:
88			return []string{domain.TestAflatoxinM1, domain.TestColiform}
89		case domain.QCStagePlantLab:
90			return []string{domain.TestAflatoxinM1, domain.TestColiform, domain.TestPhosphatase}
91		default:
92			return nil
93		}
94	}
95	
96	// validateTestNames rejects any test outside the known vocabulary.
97	func validateTestNames(tests []QCTestInput) *httpx.AppError {
98		for _, t := range tests {
99			if _, ok := knownQCTests[t.Name]; !ok {
100				return httpx.BadRequest("UNKNOWN_TEST",
101					"unknown test name "+t.Name+" — gated tests: "+domain.TestAflatoxinM1+", "+
102						domain.TestColiform+", "+domain.TestAntibiotic+", "+domain.TestPhosphatase)
103			}
104		}
105		return nil
106	}
107	
108	// missingMandatoryTests lists the stage's mandatory tests absent from the
109	// submission.
110	func missingMandatoryTests(stage string, tests []QCTestInput) []string {
111		present := make(map[string]bool, len(tests))
112		for _, t := range tests {
113			present[t.Name] = true
114		}
115		var missing []string
116		for _, name := range mandatoryTestsForStage(stage) {
117			if !present[name] {
118				missing = append(missing, name)
119			}
120		}
121		return missing
122	}
123	
124	// recordQCResult evaluates the submitted tests against the FSSAI gate,
125	// persists the result, applies the PASSED/BLOCKED verdict to the subject and
126	// chains the provenance events. This is the only write path that moves a
127	// subject out of QC_PENDING.
128	func (s *service) recordQCResult(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req RecordQCResultRequest) (*domain.QCResult, error) {
129		// Stage×role pairing — RequireRoles admits both analyst roles, the exact
130		// pairing is enforced here.
131		requiredRole, ok := requiredRoleForStage(req.Stage)
132		if !ok {
133			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_STAGE", "stage must be "+domain.QCStageBMCRapid+" or "+domain.QCStagePlantLab)
134		}
135		if actor.RoleCode != requiredRole {
136			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qc stage-role mismatch rejected",
137				slog.String("stage", req.Stage),
138				slog.String("required_role", requiredRole),
139				slog.String("actor_role", actor.RoleCode),
140				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
141				slog.String("subject_type", req.SubjectType),
142				slog.String("subject_id", req.SubjectID.Hex()))
143			return nil, httpx.Forbidden("STAGE_ROLE_MISMATCH: stage " + req.Stage + " results may only be recorded by " + requiredRole)
144		}
145	
146		analystID, err := actorID(actor)
147		if err != nil {
148			return nil, err
149		}
150	
151		subject, err := s.loadGateSubject(ctx, req.SubjectType, req.SubjectID)
152		if err != nil {
153			var appErr *httpx.AppError
154			if errors.As(err, &appErr) && appErr.Status == http.StatusConflict {
155				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qc subject not awaiting verdict",
156					slog.String("subject_type", req.SubjectType),
157					slog.String("subject_id", req.SubjectID.Hex()),
158					slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
159					slog.String("reason", appErr.Error()))
160			}
161			return nil, err
162		}
163		if err := s.deps.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, subject.orgUnitID); err != nil {
164			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qc scope denied",
165				slog.String("subject_type", req.SubjectType),
166				slog.String("subject_id", req.SubjectID.Hex()),
167				slog.String("subject_org_unit_id", subject.orgUnitID.Hex()),
168				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
169				slog.Any("err", err))
170			return nil, err
171		}
172	
173		// Closed test vocabulary: a typo'd or irrelevant test name must never be
174		// able to satisfy the safety gate.
175		if aerr := validateTestNames(req.Tests); aerr != nil {
176			return nil, aerr
177		}
178	
179		// Evaluate against the FSSAI limits (domain owns the rules).
180		overallPass, failures, evaluated := domain.EvaluateQCTests(toDomainTests(req.Tests))
181	
182		// A PASS verdict requires every mandatory test of the stage to be present
183		// AND within limits — the gate cannot be satisfied by a contentless
184		// submission (blueprint §8.3). A failing partial submission still records
185		// its BLOCK: quarantining on partial evidence is safety-conservative.
186		if missing := missingMandatoryTests(req.Stage, req.Tests); len(missing) > 0 && overallPass {
187			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qc pass rejected: mandatory tests missing",
188				slog.String("stage", req.Stage),
189				slog.String("subject_type", req.SubjectType),
190				slog.String("subject_id", req.SubjectID.Hex()),
191				slog.Any("missing_tests", missing),
192				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
193			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("MISSING_MANDATORY_TESTS",
194				"stage "+req.Stage+" cannot PASS without its mandatory tests").
195				WithDetails(map[string]any{"missing_tests": missing})
196		}
197	
198		// Pre-generate the result ID so the insert, the provenance refs and the
199		// gate write all share one consistent identifier.
200		resultID := primitive.NewObjectID()
201		now := time.Now().UTC()
202	
203		result := &domain.QCResult{
204			ID:             resultID,
205			SubjectType:    req.SubjectType,
206			SubjectID:      req.SubjectID,
207			Stage:          req.Stage,
208			Tests:          evaluated,
209			OverallPass:    overallPass,
210			AnalystPartyID: analystID,
211			LabRef:         req.LabRef,
212			RecordedAt:     now,
213		}
214	
215		// The write sequence below must not be aborted midway by a client
216		// disconnect: detach from the request context, keep a server-side bound.
217		wctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.WithoutCancel(ctx), 15*time.Second)
218		defer cancel()
219	
220		blockReason := ""
221		if overallPass {
222			seq, err := s.repo.nextCertificateSeq(wctx, req.Stage)
223			if err != nil {
224				s.logInternal(ctx, "issue qc certificate seq", req, err)
225				return nil, err
226			}
227			result.CertificateNumber = certificateNumber(req.Stage, seq)
228		} else {
229			result.FailureReasons = failures
230			blockReason = strings.Join(failures, "; ")
231		}
232	
233		// Ordering is safety-critical: evidence (qc_results doc) and provenance
234		// (hash-chained events) are persisted FIRST; the irreversible status flip
235		// on the subject happens LAST. A crash mid-sequence can leave an extra
236		// auditable result document, never a PASSED lot without evidence.
237		if err := s.repo.insertResult(wctx, result); err != nil {
238			s.logInternal(ctx, "insert qc result", req, err)
239			return nil, err
240		}
241	
242		// Provenance: qc.recorded, then the gate verdict event (blueprint §7).
243		ledgerActor := provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode}
244		recorded, err := s.deps.Ledger.Append(wctx, provenance.AppendInput{
245			Type:       domain.EventQCRecorded,
246			EntityType: domain.EntityQCResult,
247			EntityID:   resultID.Hex(),
248			Refs: []provenance.Ref{
249				{EntityType: subject.entityType, EntityID: req.SubjectID.Hex(), Relation: "tested"},
250			},
251			Actor:     ledgerActor,
252			OrgUnitID: subject.orgUnitID.Hex(),
253			Payload: map[string]any{
254				"stage":        req.Stage,
255				"subject_type": req.SubjectType,
256				"overall_pass": overallPass,
257			},
258		})
259		if err != nil {
260			s.logInternal(ctx, "append qc.recorded provenance event", req, err)
261			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
262		}
263	
264		gateEvent := provenance.AppendInput{
265			EntityType: domain.EntityQCResult,
266			EntityID:   resultID.Hex(),
267			Actor:      ledgerActor,
268			OrgUnitID:  subject.orgUnitID.Hex(),
269		}
270		if overallPass {
271			gateEvent.Type = domain.EventGatePassed
272			gateEvent.Refs = []provenance.Ref{
273				{EntityType: subject.entityType, EntityID: req.SubjectID.Hex(), Relation: "certifies"},
274			}
275			gateEvent.Payload = map[string]any{"certificate_number": result.CertificateNumber}
276		} else {
277			gateEvent.Type = domain.EventGateBlocked
278			gateEvent.Refs = []provenance.Ref{
279				{EntityType: subject.entityType, EntityID: req.SubjectID.Hex(), Relation: "blocks"},
280			}
281			gateEvent.Payload = map[string]any{"failure_reasons": failures}
282		}
283		if _, err := s.deps.Ledger.Append(wctx, gateEvent); err != nil {
284			s.logInternal(ctx, "append gate verdict provenance event", req, err)
285			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
286		}
287	
288		if err := s.repo.setResultProvenanceSeq(wctx, resultID, recorded.Seq); err != nil {
289			s.logInternal(ctx, "stamp qc result provenance seq", req, err)
290			return nil, err
291		}
292		result.ProvenanceSeq = recorded.Seq
293	
294		// LAST: apply the verdict. The conditional QC_PENDING filter remains the
295		// concurrency guard — a lost race voids OUR result (dangling evidence is
296		// auditable and harmless, unlike a dangling status flip).
297		gated, err := s.applyGate(wctx, req.SubjectType, req.SubjectID, resultID, overallPass, blockReason)
298		if err != nil {
299			s.logInternal(ctx, "apply gate verdict", req, err)
300			return nil, err
301		}
302		if !gated {
303			if err := s.repo.markResultSuperseded(wctx, resultID); err != nil {
304				s.logInternal(ctx, "mark qc result superseded", req, err)
305				return nil, err
306			}
307			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qc gate race lost: result superseded",
308				slog.String("qc_result_id", resultID.Hex()),
309				slog.String("subject_type", req.SubjectType),
310				slog.String("subject_id", req.SubjectID.Hex()),
311				slog.String("stage", req.Stage),
312				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
313			return nil, httpx.Conflict("SUBJECT_ALREADY_GATED", "subject is no longer awaiting QC — a verdict was already recorded")
314		}
315	
316		if overallPass {
317			s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "qc gate passed",
318				slog.String("qc_result_id", resultID.Hex()),
319				slog.String("subject_type", req.SubjectType),
320				slog.String("subject_id", req.SubjectID.Hex()),
321				slog.String("stage", req.Stage),
322				slog.String("certificate_number", result.CertificateNumber),
323				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
324		} else {
325			// Gate block is a WARN: the subject is quarantined and can never advance.
326			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qc gate blocked: subject quarantined",
327				slog.String("qc_result_id", resultID.Hex()),
328				slog.String("subject_type", req.SubjectType),
329				slog.String("subject_id", req.SubjectID.Hex()),
330				slog.String("stage", req.Stage),
331				slog.Any("failure_reasons", failures),
332				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
333			// Broadcast the block so the plant module quarantines downstream — a
334			// blocked lot can never advance.
335			s.deps.Bus.Publish(eventbus.TopicGateBlocked, GateBlockedPayload{
336				SubjectType:    req.SubjectType,
337				SubjectID:      req.SubjectID,
338				QCResultID:     resultID,
339				Stage:          req.Stage,
340				FailureReasons: failures,
341			})
342		}
343		return result, nil
344	}
345	
346	// logInternal records an unexpected failure with the operation and subject
347	// context before the error surfaces as a 500.
348	func (s *service) logInternal(ctx context.Context, op string, req RecordQCResultRequest, err error) {
349		s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "qc record failed: "+op,
350			slog.String("subject_type", req.SubjectType),
351			slog.String("subject_id", req.SubjectID.Hex()),
352			slog.String("stage", req.Stage),
353			slog.Any("err", err))
354	}
355	
356	// loadGateSubject fetches a gate-eligible subject and verifies it is awaiting
357	// QC. Only BMC lots and processing batches carry the software safety gate.
358	func (s *service) loadGateSubject(ctx context.Context, subjectType string, subjectID primitive.ObjectID) (gateSubject, error) {
359		switch subjectType {
360		case domain.QCSubjectBMCLot:
361			lot, err := s.repo.findBMCLot(ctx, subjectID)
362			if err != nil {
363				return gateSubject{}, err
364			}
365			if lot.Status != domain.BMCLotStatusQCPending {
366				return gateSubject{}, httpx.Conflict("SUBJECT_NOT_QC_PENDING", "bmc lot is in status "+lot.Status+" — only QC_PENDING subjects can be gated")
367			}
368			return gateSubject{entityType: domain.EntityBMCLot, orgUnitID: lot.BMCID, status: lot.Status}, nil
369	
370		case domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch:
371			batch, err := s.repo.findBatch(ctx, subjectID)
372			if err != nil {
373				return gateSubject{}, err
374			}
375			if batch.Status != domain.BatchStatusQCPending {
376				return gateSubject{}, httpx.Conflict("SUBJECT_NOT_QC_PENDING", "processing batch is in status "+batch.Status+" — only QC_PENDING subjects can be gated")
377			}
378			return gateSubject{entityType: domain.EntityBatch, orgUnitID: batch.PlantID, status: batch.Status}, nil
379	
380		case domain.QCSubjectDCSConsignment:
381			return gateSubject{}, httpx.Unprocessable("SUBJECT_NOT_GATE_ELIGIBLE", "DCS consignments are not gate subjects — gate at the BMC lot or processing batch")
382	
383		default:
384			return gateSubject{}, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_SUBJECT_TYPE", "subject_type must be one of "+domain.QCSubjectBMCLot+", "+domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch)
385		}
386	}
387	
388	// applyGate routes the conditional verdict write to the subject's collection,
389	// mapping the verdict onto that subject kind's status constants.
390	func (s *service) applyGate(ctx context.Context, subjectType string, subjectID, resultID primitive.ObjectID, pass bool, blockReason string) (bool, error) {
391		switch subjectType {
392		case domain.QCSubjectBMCLot:
393			status := domain.BMCLotStatusBlocked
394			if pass {
395				status = domain.BMCLotStatusPassed
396			}
397			return s.repo.gateBMCLot(ctx, subjectID, resultID, status, blockReason)
398		case domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch:
399			status := domain.BatchStatusBlocked
400			if pass {
401				status = domain.BatchStatusPassed
402			}
403			return s.repo.gateBatch(ctx, subjectID, resultID, status, blockReason)
404		default:
405			return false, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_SUBJECT_TYPE", "subject_type is not gate-eligible")
406		}
407	}
408	
409	// listQCResults returns a page of results, newest first. When the filter
410	// identifies an org-owned subject, the caller must be in that org's scope.
411	// A zero subjectID means "no subject filter".
412	func (s *service) listQCResults(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, subjectType string, subjectID primitive.ObjectID, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.QCResult, int64, error) {
413		if subjectType != "" && !isValidSubjectType(subjectType) {
414			return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_SUBJECT_TYPE", "unknown subject_type "+subjectType)
415		}
416		if !subjectID.IsZero() && subjectType == "" {
417			return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_SUBJECT_TYPE", "subject_id requires subject_type")
418		}
419		if !subjectID.IsZero() {
420			if err := s.requireSubjectScope(ctx, actor, subjectType, subjectID); err != nil {
421				return nil, 0, err
422			}
423		}
424		return s.repo.listResults(ctx, subjectType, subjectID, page)
425	}
426	
427	// getQCResult returns one result (its tests carry the stored pass verdicts),
428	// enforcing the subject org scope.
429	func (s *service) getQCResult(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, resultID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.QCResult, error) {
430		result, err := s.repo.findResultByID(ctx, resultID)
431		if err != nil {
432			return nil, err
433		}
434		if err := s.requireSubjectScope(ctx, actor, result.SubjectType, result.SubjectID); err != nil {
435			return nil, err
436		}
437		return result, nil
438	}
439	
440	// requireSubjectScope enforces the caller's org scope over the org unit that
441	// owns a QC subject. Subjects that no longer resolve (or subject types that
442	// carry no org) skip the check — the role gate still applies.
443	func (s *service) requireSubjectScope(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, subjectType string, subjectID primitive.ObjectID) error {
444		orgID, err := s.subjectOrgUnit(ctx, subjectType, subjectID)
445		if err != nil {
446			return err
447		}
448		if orgID.IsZero() {
449			return nil
450		}
451		if err := s.deps.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, orgID); err != nil {
452			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qc read scope denied",
453				slog.String("subject_type", subjectType),
454				slog.String("subject_id", subjectID.Hex()),
455				slog.String("subject_org_unit_id", orgID.Hex()),
456				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
457				slog.Any("err", err))
458			return err
459		}
460		return nil
461	}
462	
463	// subjectOrgUnit resolves the owning org unit of a subject, or the zero
464	// ObjectID when the subject is missing or not an org-owned gate subject.
465	func (s *service) subjectOrgUnit(ctx context.Context, subjectType string, subjectID primitive.ObjectID) (primitive.ObjectID, error) {
466		switch subjectType {
467		case domain.QCSubjectBMCLot:
468			lot, err := s.repo.findBMCLot(ctx, subjectID)
469			if err != nil {
470				return primitive.NilObjectID, ignoreNotFound(err)
471			}
472			return lot.BMCID, nil
473		case domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch:
474			batch, err := s.repo.findBatch(ctx, subjectID)
475			if err != nil {
476				return primitive.NilObjectID, ignoreNotFound(err)
477			}
478			return batch.PlantID, nil
479		default:
480			return primitive.NilObjectID, nil
481		}
482	}
483	
484	// ignoreNotFound swallows 404 AppErrors and passes everything else through.
485	func ignoreNotFound(err error) error {
486		var appErr *httpx.AppError
487		if errors.As(err, &appErr) && appErr.Status == http.StatusNotFound {
488			return nil
489		}
490		return err
491	}
492	
493	// isValidSubjectType reports whether t is a known QC subject type.
494	func isValidSubjectType(t string) bool {
495		switch t {
496		case domain.QCSubjectDCSConsignment, domain.QCSubjectBMCLot, domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch:
497			return true
498		default:
499			return false
500		}
501	}
502	
503	// toDomainTests converts request test inputs to domain tests for evaluation.
504	func toDomainTests(in []QCTestInput) []domain.QCTest {
505		out := make([]domain.QCTest, 0, len(in))
506		for _, t := range in {
507			out = append(out, domain.QCTest{Name: t.Name, Value: t.Value, Unit: t.Unit})
508		}
509		return out
510	}
511	
512	// limits returns the FSSAI gate constants (blueprint §8.3) as reference data.
513	func (s *service) limits() LimitsResponse {
```

```text
1	// Package quality implements QC recording and THE safety-gate verdict writer
2	// (blueprint §8.3). It is the only module permitted to move a BMC lot or a
3	// processing batch out of QC_PENDING: a passing result certifies the subject
4	// (PASSED + certificate), a failing result quarantines it (BLOCKED + reasons).
5	// Aflatoxin M1 is heat-stable and survives pasteurisation, so this gate runs
6	// upstream at the BMC and the plant lab — never only at the finished product.
7	//
8	// A blocked subject can never advance; the plant module enforces that by
9	// refusing blocked inputs and by reacting to eventbus.TopicGateBlocked.
10	package quality
11	
12	import (
13		"log/slog"
14	
15		"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
16	
17		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
18		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
19		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/middleware"
20	)
21	
22	// Register wires the quality module and mounts its routes under /quality
23	// (the router hands us the /api/v1 subtree).
24	func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
25		log := d.Log.With(slog.String("module", "quality"))
26		repo := newRepository(d.DB)
27		svc := newService(d, repo, log)
28		h := newHandler(svc)
29	
30		r.Route("/quality", func(r chi.Router) {
31			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
32	
33			// FSSAI limit constants — reference data for any signed-in client.
34			r.With(middleware.RequireSession).Get("/limits", h.getLimits)
35	
36			// Verdict writing: analyst roles only. Both roles share the endpoint;
37			// the stage×role pairing (BMC_RAPID↔BMC_OPERATOR, PLANT_LAB↔
38			// PLANT_LAB_ANALYST) is enforced in the service.
39			r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleBMCOperator, domain.RolePlantLabAnalyst)).
40				Post("/qc-results", h.recordQCResult)
41	
42			// Reads for supply-chain staff and oversight roles.
43			readRoles := middleware.RequireRoles(
44				domain.RoleBMCOperator,
45				domain.RolePlantLabAnalyst,
46				domain.RolePlantOperator,
47				domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor,
48				domain.RoleMissionOfficial,
49				domain.RoleStateAuditor,
50			)
51			r.With(readRoles).Get("/qc-results", h.listQCResults)
52			r.With(readRoles).Get("/qc-results/{id}", h.getQCResult)
53		})
54	}
55
```

```text
1	// Package eventbus is the in-process pub/sub seam between modules
2	// (e.g. settlement executed → notifications module queues the SMS).
3	// It deliberately mirrors a message-broker API: when the platform splits
4	// into microservices, this interface is re-implemented over Kafka/NATS
5	// (blueprint §15) without touching module code.
6	package eventbus
7	
8	import (
9		"context"
10		"log/slog"
11		"sync"
12		"time"
13	)
14	
15	// Topics published across module seams.
16	const (
17		TopicPourRecorded       = "pour.recorded"
18		TopicInvoiceIssued      = "invoice.issued"
19		TopicGateBlocked        = "qc.gate_blocked"
20		TopicSettlementExecuted = "settlement.executed"
21		TopicPayoutCredited     = "payout.credited"
22		TopicMVUDispatched      = "mvu.dispatched"
23		// KYC review queue changed — a record entered PENDING (submitted) or left
24		// it (approved/rejected). Drives the live "pending KYC" dashboard badge via
25		// the SSE hub. Payload: KYCQueueEvent.
26		TopicKYCQueueChanged = "kyc.queue_changed"
27	)
28	
29	// KYCQueueEvent is the payload for TopicKYCQueueChanged. It is a nudge, not a
30	// count — subscribers re-query the authoritative, org-scoped pending count.
31	type KYCQueueEvent struct {
32		Reason    string `json:"reason"` // "submitted" | "approved" | "rejected"
33		KYCID     string `json:"kyc_id"`
34		SubjectID string `json:"subject_id"` // party whose KYC it is (hex)
35	}
36	
37	// Handler consumes a published event. Payload types are documented per topic
38	// by the publishing module.
39	type Handler func(ctx context.Context, topic string, payload any)
40	
41	// Bus is a minimal async pub/sub.
42	type Bus struct {
43		log *slog.Logger
44	
45		mu   sync.RWMutex
46		subs map[string][]Handler
47	}
48	
49	// New builds an empty bus.
50	func New(log *slog.Logger) *Bus {
51		return &Bus{log: log, subs: make(map[string][]Handler)}
52	}
53	
54	// Subscribe registers a handler for a topic. Call during module wiring only
55	// (not concurrently with Publish traffic).
56	func (b *Bus) Subscribe(topic string, h Handler) {
57		b.mu.Lock()
58		defer b.mu.Unlock()
59		b.subs[topic] = append(b.subs[topic], h)
60	}
61	
62	// Publish dispatches asynchronously: each handler runs on its own goroutine
63	// with a bounded context and panic isolation, so a slow or broken subscriber
64	// can never stall the request path.
65	func (b *Bus) Publish(topic string, payload any) {
66		b.mu.RLock()
67		handlers := b.subs[topic]
68		b.mu.RUnlock()
69	
70		for _, h := range handlers {
71			h := h
72			go func() {
73				ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 15*time.Second)
74				defer cancel()
75				defer func() {
76					if rec := recover(); rec != nil {
77						b.log.Error("eventbus handler panic",
78							slog.String("topic", topic), slog.Any("panic", rec))
79					}
80				}()
81				h(ctx, topic, payload)
82			}()
83		}
84	}
85
```

```text
1	// Package sse implements a Server-Sent Events hub for pushing live updates to
2	// dashboards that are already open — e.g. an Organising Manager's "pending KYC:
3	// 33" badge ticking up without a refresh.
4	//
5	// Why SSE, not WebSocket: a dashboard badge is a one-way, server→client signal.
6	// SSE runs over plain HTTP (no new dependency), auto-reconnects in the browser,
7	// and is far simpler than a WebSocket. It cannot talk to a browser any more
8	// directly than that — the whole point is the server pushing down an open HTTP
9	// connection.
10	//
11	// Delivery model — "nudge, then re-count": the hub pushes a lightweight event
12	// (e.g. "kyc.pending.changed"), and the client re-fetches the authoritative,
13	// org-scoped count from its normal REST endpoint. The nudge is never trusted as
14	// the number itself, so a slightly-broad nudge is harmless — the scoped count
15	// query is the source of truth and can never drift.
16	//
17	// Single-instance scope: this hub fans out within ONE process. When the API
18	// runs as multiple replicas, an event raised on replica B must reach a client
19	// connected to replica A — at that point WireToBus is re-pointed at a shared
20	// pub/sub (Redis pub/sub or NATS), and nothing else changes. That is the ONLY
21	// place multi-node real-time needs external infrastructure; the atomic
22	// duplicate-prevention guarantees live entirely in MongoDB and are unaffected.
23	package sse
24	
25	import (
26		"log/slog"
27		"sync"
28	
29		"github.com/google/uuid"
30	)
31	
32	// Event is one message pushed to matching clients.
33	type Event struct {
34		Type string `json:"type"` // e.g. "kyc.pending.changed"
35		Data any    `json:"data,omitempty"`
36		// Roles restricts delivery to clients holding one of these role codes.
37		// Empty means "every connected client". Because clients re-fetch a scoped
38		// count on receipt, role-level targeting is sufficient — over-delivery only
39		// costs a harmless re-count, never a wrong number.
40		Roles []string `json:"-"`
41	}
42	
43	// Client is one connected dashboard. send is buffered and lossy by design:
44	// if a slow client's buffer is full we drop the nudge rather than block the
45	// hub — the next nudge (or the client's periodic poll) re-syncs it.
46	type Client struct {
47		ID        string
48		PartyID   string
49		RoleCode  string
50		OrgUnitID string
51		send      chan Event
52	}
53	
54	// Events is the channel the HTTP handler ranges over to write the stream.
55	func (c *Client) Events() <-chan Event { return c.send }
56	
57	const clientBuffer = 16
58	
59	// Hub tracks connected clients and fans events out to them.
60	type Hub struct {
61		log *slog.Logger
62	
63		mu      sync.RWMutex
64		clients map[string]*Client
65	}
66	
67	// NewHub builds an empty hub.
68	func NewHub(log *slog.Logger) *Hub {
69		return &Hub{log: log, clients: make(map[string]*Client)}
70	}
71	
72	// Register adds a client and returns it. The caller (HTTP handler) must call
73	// Unregister when the connection closes.
74	func (h *Hub) Register(partyID, roleCode, orgUnitID string) *Client {
75		c := &Client{
76			ID:        uuid.NewString(),
77			PartyID:   partyID,
78			RoleCode:  roleCode,
79			OrgUnitID: orgUnitID,
80			send:      make(chan Event, clientBuffer),
81		}
82		h.mu.Lock()
83		h.clients[c.ID] = c
84		n := len(h.clients)
85		h.mu.Unlock()
86		h.log.Debug("sse client connected",
87			slog.String("client_id", c.ID), slog.String("role", roleCode), slog.Int("connections", n))
88		return c
89	}
90	
91	// Unregister removes a client and closes its channel. Safe to call once.
92	func (h *Hub) Unregister(id string) {
93		h.mu.Lock()
94		c, ok := h.clients[id]
95		if ok {
96			delete(h.clients, id)
97		}
98		n := len(h.clients)
99		h.mu.Unlock()
100		if ok {
101			close(c.send)
102			h.log.Debug("sse client disconnected",
103				slog.String("client_id", id), slog.Int("connections", n))
104		}
105	}
106	
107	// Broadcast delivers ev to every matching client with a non-blocking send.
108	func (h *Hub) Broadcast(ev Event) {
109		h.mu.RLock()
110		defer h.mu.RUnlock()
111		delivered, dropped := 0, 0
112		for _, c := range h.clients {
113			if !roleMatches(ev.Roles, c.RoleCode) {
114				continue
115			}
116			select {
117			case c.send <- ev:
118				delivered++
119			default:
120				dropped++ // buffer full — client is slow; the next nudge re-syncs it
121			}
122		}
123		if delivered > 0 || dropped > 0 {
124			h.log.Debug("sse broadcast",
125				slog.String("type", ev.Type), slog.Int("delivered", delivered), slog.Int("dropped", dropped))
126		}
127	}
128	
129	// ConnectionCount reports currently-connected clients (metrics/debugging).
130	func (h *Hub) ConnectionCount() int {
131		h.mu.RLock()
132		defer h.mu.RUnlock()
133		return len(h.clients)
134	}
135	
136	func roleMatches(roles []string, role string) bool {
137		if len(roles) == 0 {
138			return true
139		}
140		for _, r := range roles {
141			if r == role {
142				return true
143			}
144		}
145		return false
146	}
147
```

```text
1	package sse
2	
3	import (
4		"encoding/json"
5		"fmt"
6		"net/http"
7		"time"
8	
9		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
10		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
11	)
12	
13	// heartbeatInterval keeps the connection alive through proxies/load balancers
14	// that would otherwise reap an idle stream.
15	const heartbeatInterval = 25 * time.Second
16	
17	// StreamHandler returns the HTTP handler for GET /events/stream. It must be
18	// mounted behind Authenticate (it reads the actor from the request context).
19	// The connection stays open until the client disconnects or the server shuts
20	// down; on either the client is unregistered, so no goroutine or channel leaks.
21	func StreamHandler(hub *Hub) http.HandlerFunc {
22		return func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
23			actor, ok := auth.ActorFrom(r.Context())
24			if !ok {
25				httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Unauthorized("authentication required"))
26				return
27			}
28			flusher, ok := w.(http.Flusher)
29			if !ok {
30				httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("streaming unsupported by this server")))
31				return
32			}
33			// Clear the server's per-request write deadline for this connection —
34			// an SSE stream is long-lived and must outlive the global WriteTimeout.
35			if rc := http.NewResponseController(w); rc != nil {
36				_ = rc.SetWriteDeadline(time.Time{})
37			}
38	
39			w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/event-stream")
40			w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-cache")
41			w.Header().Set("Connection", "keep-alive")
42			w.Header().Set("X-Accel-Buffering", "no") // disable nginx buffering
43			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
44	
45			client := hub.Register(actor.PartyID, actor.RoleCode, actor.OrgUnitID)
46			defer hub.Unregister(client.ID)
47	
48			// Opening frame so the client knows the stream is live and can render
49			// its first badge value from its normal REST count call.
50			writeSSE(w, "ready", map[string]any{"connected": true})
51			flusher.Flush()
52	
53			heartbeat := time.NewTicker(heartbeatInterval)
54			defer heartbeat.Stop()
55	
56			for {
57				select {
58				case <-r.Context().Done():
59					return // client disconnected — defer Unregister cleans up
60				case ev, open := <-client.Events():
61					if !open {
62						return // hub closed this client (server shutdown)
63					}
64					writeSSE(w, ev.Type, ev.Data)
65					flusher.Flush()
66				case <-heartbeat.C:
67					// SSE comment line — ignored by clients, keeps the socket warm.
68					fmt.Fprint(w, ": ping\n\n")
69					flusher.Flush()
70				}
71			}
72		}
73	}
74	
75	// writeSSE encodes one SSE frame: an event name + a JSON data line.
76	func writeSSE(w http.ResponseWriter, event string, data any) {
77		payload, err := json.Marshal(data)
78		if err != nil {
79			payload = []byte("{}")
80		}
81		fmt.Fprintf(w, "event: %s\ndata: %s\n\n", event, payload)
82	}
```

```text
18	// requestActor returns the authenticated actor (guaranteed present by the

20	func requestActor(r *http.Request) auth.Actor {

23	}
24	
25	// optionalQueryID parses an optional ObjectID query parameter: absent means
26	// the zero ObjectID (no filter), present-but-malformed is a 400.
27	func optionalQueryID(r *http.Request, param string) (primitive.ObjectID, error) {
28		raw := r.URL.Query().Get(param)
29		if raw == "" {
30			return primitive.NilObjectID, nil
31		}
32		return httpx.ParseID(raw, param)
33	}

35	// createRateChart handles POST /collection/rate-charts.
```

```text
65	// setFlag flips one well-known feature flag and writes the explicit

67	func (s *service) setFlag(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, key string, enabled bool) (*SetFlagResponse, error) {
68		if _, ok := settableFlagKeys[key]; !ok {
69			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "feature flag set rejected: unknown key",
70				slog.String("key", key), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))

73		if err := s.deps.Flags.Set(ctx, key, enabled, actor.PartyID); err != nil {

83		})

85			slog.String("key", key), slog.Bool("enabled", enabled),

87		return &SetFlagResponse{Key: key, Enabled: enabled}, nil

113	// ---- Notifications outbox + mock SMS worker (§12, §13) ----
114	
115	// listNotifications returns a page of outbox documents with credential
116	// material redacted: the login OTP must never be readable through the
117	// outbox surface, or anyone with this route could mint any user's session
118	// (request OTP for the victim's phone, read it here, verify).
119	func (s *service) listNotifications(ctx context.Context, phone, status string, page httpx.Page) ([]StoredNotification, int64, error) {
120		items, total, err := s.repo.listNotifications(ctx, phone, status, page)
121		if err != nil {
122			return nil, 0, err
123		}
124		for i := range items {
125			redactNotificationSecrets(&items[i])
126		}
127		// Bulk-PII read (every party's phone + template params): audited for DPDP
128		// forensics, mirroring support.pii_lookup and kyc.pending_list.
129		s.deps.Audit.Record(ctx, audit.Entry{
130			Action:     "admin.notifications_read",
131			TargetType: "NOTIFICATION",
132			Meta: map[string]any{
133				"phone_filter":  phone,
134				"status_filter": status,
135				"count":         len(items),
136				"total":         total,
137			},
138		})
139		return items, total, nil
140	}

142	// redactedValue replaces credential material in read surfaces.
143	const redactedValue = "[REDACTED]"
144	
145	// redactNotificationSecrets strips the plaintext OTP (params + rendered meta)
146	// from an outbox document before it leaves the API.
147	func redactNotificationSecrets(n *StoredNotification) {
148		if n.TemplateKey != domain.TemplateOTP {
149			return
150		}
151		if n.Params != nil {
152			params := make(map[string]string, len(n.Params))
153			for k, v := range n.Params {
154				if k == "otp" {
155					v = redactedValue
156				}
157				params[k] = v
158			}
159			n.Params = params
160		}
161		if n.Meta != nil {
162			meta := make(map[string]any, len(n.Meta))
163			for k, v := range n.Meta {
164				if k == "rendered_en" || k == "rendered_hi" {
165					v = redactedValue
166				}
167				meta[k] = v
168			}
169			n.Meta = meta
170		}
171	}
172	
173	// runWorker is the MOCK SMS provider dispatch (real deployment: MSG91 /
174	// telecom DLT gateway, §13). It claims up to workerClaimCap QUEUED documents
175	// via a race-safe FindOneAndUpdate loop, stamps each SENT with a mock
176	// provider reference, and renders the English/Hindi lines into meta for
177	// visibility. The manual trigger keeps the demo deterministic; production
178	// runs this as a cron/queue consumer.
179	func (s *service) runWorker(ctx context.Context) (*WorkerRunResponse, error) {
180		sent := 0
181		for i := 0; i < workerClaimCap; i++ {
182			providerRef := "SMS-MOCK-" + uuid.NewString()[0:8]
183			claimed, err := s.repo.claimQueuedNotification(ctx, providerRef, time.Now().UTC())
184			if err != nil {
185				s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "claim queued notification failed", slog.Any("err", err))
186				return nil, err
187			}
188			if claimed == nil {
189				break // queue drained
190			}
191			sent++
192	
193			english, hindi := renderSMS(claimed.TemplateKey, claimed.Params)
194			if claimed.TemplateKey == domain.TemplateOTP {
195				// Never persist the rendered OTP text — the provider gets the
196				// message transiently; the readable outbox keeps no plaintext code.
197				english, hindi = redactedValue, redactedValue
198			}
199			meta := map[string]any{
200				"provider":    "SMS-MOCK",
201				"rendered_en": english,
202				"rendered_hi": hindi,
203			}
204			if err := s.repo.setNotificationMeta(ctx, claimed.ID, meta); err != nil {
205				// The claim already succeeded — meta is cosmetic, log and move on.
206				s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "stamp notification meta failed",
207					slog.String("notification_id", claimed.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
208			}
209			s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "notification dispatched",
210				slog.String("notification_id", claimed.ID.Hex()),
211				slog.String("template_key", claimed.TemplateKey),
212				slog.String("provider_ref", providerRef),
213				slog.String("status", domain.NotificationSent))
214		}
215		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "notification worker run complete", slog.Int("sent", sent))
216		return &WorkerRunResponse{Sent: sent}, nil
217	}

219	// renderSMS produces one simple English and one Hindi line per template key —
220	// mock rendering for visibility; real templates live with the DLT-registered
221	// provider (§13). Missing params render as empty strings, never a panic.
222	func renderSMS(templateKey string, params map[string]string) (english, hindi string) {
223		p := func(key string) string { return params[key] } // nil-map reads are safe
224	
225		switch templateKey {
226		case domain.TemplatePayoutCredited:
227			return fmt.Sprintf("Rs %s credited to your bank account. UTR %s. - Saathi", p("amount"), p("utr")),
228				fmt.Sprintf("₹%s आपके बैंक खाते में जमा हुए। UTR %s। - साथी", p("amount"), p("utr"))
229		case domain.TemplateSafetyBlock:
230			return fmt.Sprintf("SAFETY ALERT: %s %s blocked at %s. Reasons: %s. Quarantine and inspect immediately. - Saathi",
231					p("subject_type"), p("subject_id"), p("stage"), p("reasons")),
232				fmt.Sprintf("सुरक्षा चेतावनी: %s %s को %s पर रोका गया। कारण: %s। तुरंत जांच करें। - साथी",
233					p("subject_type"), p("subject_id"), p("stage"), p("reasons"))
234		case domain.TemplateMVUDispatched:
235			return fmt.Sprintf("MVU 1962 van dispatched for your animal (case %s). Please stay reachable. - Saathi", p("case_id")),
236				fmt.Sprintf("आपके पशु के लिए 1962 एमवीयू वैन रवाना (केस %s)। कृपया संपर्क में रहें। - साथी", p("case_id"))
237		case domain.TemplatePourReceipt:
238			return fmt.Sprintf("%sL @ Rs %s = Rs %s credited to today's bill. - Saathi", p("quantity"), p("rate"), p("amount")),
239				fmt.Sprintf("%s लीटर @ ₹%s = ₹%s आज के बिल में जुड़े। - साथी", p("quantity"), p("rate"), p("amount"))
240		case domain.TemplateInvoiceIssued:
241			return fmt.Sprintf("Invoice %s for Rs %s issued. - Saathi", p("invoice_number"), p("amount")),
242				fmt.Sprintf("₹%s का बिल %s जारी हुआ। - साथी", p("amount"), p("invoice_number"))
243		case domain.TemplateKYCApproved:
244			return fmt.Sprintf("KYC approved — tier %s unlocked. - Saathi", p("tier")),
245				fmt.Sprintf("KYC स्वीकृत — टियर %s अनलॉक हुआ। - साथी", p("tier"))
246		case domain.TemplateKYCRejected:
247			return fmt.Sprintf("KYC rejected: %s. - Saathi", p("reason")),
248				fmt.Sprintf("KYC अस्वीकृत: %s। - साथी", p("reason"))
249		case domain.TemplateOTP:
250			return fmt.Sprintf("Your Saathi OTP is %s. Do not share it with anyone.", p("otp")),
251				fmt.Sprintf("आपका साथी OTP %s है। इसे किसी से साझा न करें।", p("otp"))
252		default:
253			return "Saathi update: " + templateKey, "साथी सूचना: " + templateKey
254		}
255	}

259	// lookupParty resolves a phone to the limited support view. EVERY call —
260	// hit or miss — is recorded as "support.pii_lookup": PII access is audited,
261	// full stop.
262	func (s *service) lookupParty(ctx context.Context, phone string) (*PartyLookupResponse, error) {
263		party, findErr := s.repo.findPartyByPhone(ctx, phone)
264	
265		entry := audit.Entry{
266			Action:     "support.pii_lookup",
267			TargetType: "PARTY",
268			Meta:       map[string]any{"phone": phone, "found": findErr == nil},
269		}
270		if findErr == nil {
271			entry.TargetID = party.ID.Hex()
272		}
273		s.deps.Audit.Record(ctx, entry)
274	
275		if findErr != nil {
276			return nil, findErr
277		}
278	
279		assignments, err := s.repo.listActiveAssignmentsForParty(ctx, party.ID)
280		if err != nil {
281			return nil, err
282		}
283		now := time.Now().UTC()
284		roles := []PartyRoleView{}
285		for _, assignment := range assignments {
286			if !assignment.UsableAt(now) {
287				continue
288			}
289			orgName := ""
290			if org, orgErr := s.deps.Orgs.Get(ctx, assignment.OrgUnitID); orgErr == nil {
291				orgName = org.Name
292			}
293			roles = append(roles, PartyRoleView{
294				RoleCode:  assignment.RoleCode,
295				OrgUnitID: assignment.OrgUnitID.Hex(),
296				OrgName:   orgName,
297			})
298		}
299	
300		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "support party lookup",
301			slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()), slog.Int("roles", len(roles)))
302	
303		// Limited PII by construction: no KYC document numbers, no bank details.
304		return &PartyLookupResponse{
305			PartyID:  party.ID.Hex(),
306			FullName: party.FullName,
307			KYCTier:  party.KYCTier,
308			Status:   party.Status,
309			Roles:    roles,
310		}, nil
311	}

313	// ---- Event-bus reactions: cross-module SMS queuing ----
314	
315	// decodeBusPayload structurally re-decodes a bus payload into this module's
316	// mirror struct — modules never import each other's types (module contract).
317	func decodeBusPayload(payload any, dst any) error {
318		raw, err := json.Marshal(payload)
319		if err != nil {
320			return fmt.Errorf("marshal bus payload: %w", err)
321		}
322		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, dst); err != nil {
323			return fmt.Errorf("unmarshal bus payload: %w", err)
324		}
325		return nil
326	}
327	
328	// onPayoutCredited queues the "₹ credited, UTR …" SMS to the farmer
329	// (blueprint §8.1 last step).
330	func (s *service) onPayoutCredited(ctx context.Context, payload any) {
331		var event payoutCreditedEvent
332		if err := decodeBusPayload(payload, &event); err != nil {
333			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "bad payout.credited payload", slog.Any("err", err))
334			return
335		}
336		if event.FarmerPartyID == "" && event.Phone == "" {
337			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "payout.credited payload has no addressee")
338			return
339		}
340		partyID := s.parseAddresseeID(ctx, event.FarmerPartyID, "payout.credited")
341		s.queueNotification(ctx, partyID, event.Phone, domain.TemplatePayoutCredited, map[string]string{
342			"amount": strconv.FormatFloat(event.Amount, 'f', 2, 64),
343			"utr":    event.UTR,
344		})
345	}
346	
347	// onGateBlocked alerts the blocked subject's UNION_FIELD_SUPERVISOR(s): the
348	// subject's org unit is resolved from its document, walked up to the union
349	// ancestor, and every usable supervisor assignment there gets the safety SMS.
350	func (s *service) onGateBlocked(ctx context.Context, payload any) {
351		var event gateBlockedEvent
352		if err := decodeBusPayload(payload, &event); err != nil {
353			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "bad qc.gate_blocked payload", slog.Any("err", err))
354			return
355		}
356	
357		subjectID, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(event.SubjectID)
358		if err != nil {
359			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qc.gate_blocked subject id is not an object id",
360				slog.String("subject_type", event.SubjectType), slog.String("subject_id", event.SubjectID))
361			return
362		}
363		orgUnitID, err := s.repo.subjectOrgUnit(ctx, event.SubjectType, subjectID)
364		if err != nil {
365			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "gate_blocked org resolution failed",
366				slog.String("subject_type", event.SubjectType),
367				slog.String("subject_id", subjectID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
368			return
369		}
370		union, err := s.unionAncestor(ctx, orgUnitID)
371		if err != nil {
372			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "gate_blocked union walk failed",
373				slog.String("org_unit_id", orgUnitID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
374			return
375		}
376		if union == nil {
377			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "gate_blocked org has no union ancestor",
378				slog.String("org_unit_id", orgUnitID.Hex()))
379			return
380		}
381	
382		supervisors, err := s.repo.listActiveRoleHolders(ctx, union.ID, domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor)
383		if err != nil {
384			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "gate_blocked supervisor lookup failed",
385				slog.String("union_id", union.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
386			return
387		}
388	
389		params := map[string]string{
390			"subject_type": event.SubjectType,
391			"subject_id":   event.SubjectID,
392			"stage":        event.Stage,
393			"reasons":      strings.Join(event.FailureReasons, ", "),
394		}
395		now := time.Now().UTC()
396		notified := map[primitive.ObjectID]bool{}
397		for _, assignment := range supervisors {
398			if !assignment.UsableAt(now) || notified[assignment.PartyID] {
399				continue
400			}
401			notified[assignment.PartyID] = true
402			partyID := assignment.PartyID
403			s.queueNotification(ctx, &partyID, "", domain.TemplateSafetyBlock, params)
404		}
405	}
406	
407	// onMVUDispatched queues the "MVU van on its way" SMS to the farmer (§10).
408	func (s *service) onMVUDispatched(ctx context.Context, payload any) {
409		var event mvuDispatchedEvent
410		if err := decodeBusPayload(payload, &event); err != nil {
411			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "bad mvu.dispatched payload", slog.Any("err", err))
412			return
413		}
414		if event.FarmerPartyID == "" && event.Phone == "" {
415			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "mvu.dispatched payload has no addressee")
416			return
417		}
418		caseID := event.CaseID
419		if caseID == "" {
420			caseID = event.MVUCaseID
421		}
422		if caseID == "" {
423			caseID = event.ID
424		}
425		params := map[string]string{"case_id": caseID}
426		if event.ETA != "" {
427			params["eta"] = event.ETA
428		}
429		partyID := s.parseAddresseeID(ctx, event.FarmerPartyID, "mvu.dispatched")
430		s.queueNotification(ctx, partyID, event.Phone, domain.TemplateMVUDispatched, params)
431	}
432	
433	// parseAddresseeID turns an optional addressee party ObjectID hex string
434	// (carried as a hex string on bus payloads) into a *primitive.ObjectID.
435	// An empty value is a legitimate phone-only addressing (returns nil); a
436	// non-empty but malformed value is a business/contract violation (WARN + nil).
437	func (s *service) parseAddresseeID(ctx context.Context, hex, event string) *primitive.ObjectID {
438		if hex == "" {
439			return nil
440		}
441		id, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(hex)
442		if err != nil {
443			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bus payload party id is not an object id",
444				slog.String("event", event), slog.String("party_id", hex))
445			return nil
446		}
447		return &id
448	}
449	
450	// hexOrEmpty renders an optional ObjectID for logs.
451	func hexOrEmpty(id *primitive.ObjectID) string {
452		if id == nil {
453			return ""
454		}
455		return id.Hex()
456	}
457	
458	// queueNotification inserts one QUEUED outbox document, resolving phone and
459	// preferred language from the party record when available. The _id is
460	// pre-generated so the queued entry can be named in the structured log.
461	// Failures are logged, never propagated — a lost SMS must not fail the
462	// publishing flow.
463	func (s *service) queueNotification(ctx context.Context, partyID *primitive.ObjectID, phone, templateKey string, params map[string]string) {
464		language := "hi" // vernacular default (blueprint §13)
465		if partyID != nil {
466			if party, err := s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, *partyID); err == nil {
467				if phone == "" {
468					phone = party.Phone
469				}
470				if party.PreferredLanguage != "" {
471					language = party.PreferredLanguage
472				}
473			}
474		}
475		if phone == "" {
476			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "dropping notification with no phone",
477				slog.String("template_key", templateKey), slog.String("party_id", hexOrEmpty(partyID)))
478			return
479		}
480	
481		id := primitive.NewObjectID()
482		notification := &StoredNotification{Notification: domain.Notification{
483			ID:          id,
484			PartyID:     partyID,
485			Phone:       phone,
486			Channel:     domain.ChannelSMS,
487			TemplateKey: templateKey,
488			Language:    language,
489			Params:      params,
490			Status:      domain.NotificationQueued,
491			QueuedAt:    time.Now().UTC(),
492		}}
493		if err := s.repo.insertNotification(ctx, notification); err != nil {
494			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "queue notification failed",
495				slog.String("template_key", templateKey), slog.Any("err", err))
496			return
497		}
498		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "notification queued",
499			slog.String("notification_id", id.Hex()),
500			slog.String("template_key", templateKey),
501			slog.String("party_id", hexOrEmpty(partyID)),
502			slog.String("status", domain.NotificationQueued))
503	}
504	
505	// unionAncestor returns the MILK_UNION org unit at or above orgUnitID, walking
506	// the denormalised ancestor Path nearest-first via d.Orgs.Get. Returns nil
507	// when no union sits on the chain (e.g. a plant directly under the federation).
508	func (s *service) unionAncestor(ctx context.Context, orgUnitID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
509		org, err := s.deps.Orgs.Get(ctx, orgUnitID)
510		if err != nil {
511			return nil, err
512		}
513		if org.Type == domain.OrgTypeMilkUnion {
514			return org, nil
515		}
516		// Path holds ancestors root→down; walk nearest ancestor first.
517		for i := len(org.Path) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
518			ancestor, err := s.deps.Orgs.Get(ctx, org.Path[i])
519			if err != nil {
520				return nil, err
521			}
522			if ancestor.Type == domain.OrgTypeMilkUnion {
523				return ancestor, nil
524			}
525		}
526		return nil, nil
527	}
```

```text
1	// Package collection implements the core procurement loop of Saathi
2	// (blueprint §8.1, §8.2): org-scoped rate charts, anti-tamper analyzer
3	// readings, offline-first idempotent milk pours with same-day pricing, and
4	// per-farmer daily invoices behind the same-day payment promise.
5	//
6	// Bus topics published by this module:
7	//   - eventbus.TopicPourRecorded  — payload domain.MilkPour (the newly recorded pour)
8	//   - eventbus.TopicInvoiceIssued — payload domain.Invoice (the newly issued invoice)
9	package collection
10	
11	import (
12		"log/slog"
13	
14		"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
15	
16		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
17		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
18		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/middleware"
19	)
20	
21	// Register mounts the collection module under /collection and wires the
22	// handler → service → repo stack onto the shared platform dependencies.
23	func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
24		log := d.Log.With(slog.String("module", "collection"))
25		repo := newRepo(d)
26		svc := newService(d, repo, log)
27		h := &handler{svc: svc}
28	
29		r.Route("/collection", func(r chi.Router) {
30			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
31	
32			// Rate charts: pricing policy is set at union/federation level and
33			// resolved downward to each DCS (nearest ancestor wins).
34			r.Route("/rate-charts", func(r chi.Router) {
35				r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RolePCDFAdmin, domain.RoleUnionPresident)).
36					Post("/", h.createRateChart)
37				r.With(middleware.RequireSession).Get("/active", h.getActiveRateChart)
38			})
39	
40			// Analyzer readings: flagged, never rejected (anti-tamper envelope §8.2).
41			r.Route("/readings", func(r chi.Router) {
42				r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSamitiSacheev, domain.RoleMilkTester)).
43					Post("/", h.createReading)
44				r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(
45					domain.RoleSamitiSacheev, domain.RoleMilkTester, domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor,
46				)).Get("/", h.listReadings)
47			})
48	
49			// Pours: THE core loop — offline-first idempotent, hard plausibility gate.
50			r.Route("/pours", func(r chi.Router) {
51				r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
52					r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSamitiSacheev, domain.RoleMilkTester))
53					r.Post("/", h.createPour)
54					r.Post("/batch-sync", h.batchSyncPours)
55					r.Post("/{id}/supersede", h.supersedePour)
56				})
57				r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(
58					domain.RoleSamitiSacheev, domain.RoleMilkTester,
59					domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor, domain.RoleFarmer,
60				)).Get("/", h.listPours)
61			})
62	
63			// Invoices: the same-day settlement artefact (§8.1).
64			r.Route("/invoices", func(r chi.Router) {
65				r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSamitiSacheev)).
66					Post("/generate", h.generateInvoices)
67				r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
68					r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(
69						domain.RoleFarmer, domain.RoleSamitiSacheev, domain.RoleSamitiAdhyaksh,
70						domain.RoleMilkTester, domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor,
71						domain.RoleUnionPresident, domain.RolePCDFAdmin,
72					))
73					r.Get("/", h.listInvoices)
74					r.Get("/{id}", h.getInvoice)
75				})
76			})
77		})
78	}
79
```

```text
19	// RegisterModules mounts every domain module under /api/v1.
20	//
21	// Module contract: each package under internal/modules/<name> exposes
22	//
23	//	func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps)
24	//
25	// and mounts its own subtree with its own auth/RBAC middleware. Modules are
26	// the future microservice seams — they may import domain and platform
27	// packages, but NEVER each other; cross-module reactions go through the
28	// event bus.
29	func RegisterModules(api chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
30		// publictrace first — it mounts /public without auth.
31		publictrace.Register(api, d)
32	
33		identity.Register(api, d)
34		orgs.Register(api, d)
35		cattle.Register(api, d)
36		collection.Register(api, d)
37		logistics.Register(api, d)
38		plant.Register(api, d)
```

```text
240	/**
241	 * One immutable provenance event. `eventHash = H(prevHash | canonical(payload))`
242	 * links it to its predecessor, so any edit to an earlier event breaks every
243	 * downstream hash - the tamper-evidence the consumer trace verifies (§5, §12).
244	 * The real backend signs each event (`deviceSig`) and anchors the chain; on the
245	 * mock these are deterministic stand-ins behind the same shape.
246	 */

251	  subjectId: string;

253	  /** Offline-first idempotency key (§3.1) - a replay resolves to the same event. */
254	  clientEventId: string;
255	  prevHash: string;
256	  eventHash: string;
257	  actorPartyId?: string;
258	  detail?: string;
259	}
```

```text
219	export const recordPour = endpoint<RecordPourInput, Pour>({
220	  method: 'POST',
221	  path: () => '/collection/pours',
222	  // client_event_id is the offline-first idempotency key (§3.1); the input has
223	  // no stable one, so mint a fresh evt id per attempt.
224	  mapRequest: (input) => ({
225	    client_event_id: nextId('evt'),
226	    farmer_party_id: input.farmerPartyId,
227	    dcs_id: input.dcsId,
228	    shift: input.shift,
229	    quantity_litres: input.quantityLitres,
230	    fat_pct: input.fatPct,
231	    snf_pct: input.snfPct,
232	    clr: input.clr,
233	    temperature_c: input.temperatureC,
234	    source: input.entryMethod,
235	  }),
236	  mapResponse: (raw) => mapPour((raw as WirePourResponse).pour),
237	  mock: (input, db) => {
238	    // Anti-tamper plausibility bounds (§8.2) - implausible readings are blocked
239	    if (!isPlausibleReading(input)) {
240	      throw new ApiError(
241	        422,
242	        'IMPLAUSIBLE_READING',
243	        'Reading outside plausible bounds (fat 1.5-12%, SNF 6-11%, qty 0.1-60L) - re-test the sample',
244	      );
245	    }
246	    const date = todayISO();
247	    const { ratePerLitre, amount } = computePourAmount(
248	      input.quantityLitres,
249	      input.fatPct,
250	      input.snfPct,
251	      db.rateConfig,
252	    );
253	    const pour: Pour = {
254	      id: nextId('pour'),
255	      farmerPartyId: input.farmerPartyId,
256	      dcsId: input.dcsId,
257	      date,
258	      shift: input.shift,
259	      quantityLitres: input.quantityLitres,
260	      fatPct: input.fatPct,
261	      snfPct: input.snfPct,
262	      clr: input.clr,
263	      temperatureC: input.temperatureC,
264	      rateApplied: ratePerLitre,
265	      amount,
266	      entryMethod: input.entryMethod,
267	      assurance: assuranceOf(input.entryMethod),
268	      rateChartVersion: db.rateConfig.version,
269	      status: 'RECORDED',
270	      synced: true,
271	      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
272	    };
273	    db.pours.push(pour);
274	    // Provenance leaf: the first link in this milk's hash-chained ledger (§5).
275	    appendChainEvent(db, {
276	      kind: 'POUR',
277	      subjectType: 'POUR',
278	      subjectId: pour.id,
279	      actorPartyId: input.recordedByPartyId,
280	      detail: `${input.quantityLitres}L @ fat ${input.fatPct}% (${pour.assurance})`,
281	    });
282	
283	    // Same-day autofilled invoice (§8.1): create/update the farmer's draft bill
284	    let inv = db.invoices.find(
285	      (i) => i.farmerPartyId === input.farmerPartyId && i.date === date && i.status === 'DRAFT',
286	    );
287	    if (!inv) {
288	      inv = {
289	        id: nextId('inv'),
290	        farmerPartyId: input.farmerPartyId,
291	        dcsId: input.dcsId,
292	        date,
293	        pourIds: [],
294	        grossAmount: 0,
295	        deductions: 0,
296	        netAmount: 0,
297	        status: 'DRAFT',
298	      };
299	      db.invoices.push(inv);
300	    }
301	    inv.pourIds.push(pour.id);
302	    inv.grossAmount = Math.round((inv.grossAmount + amount) * 100) / 100;
303	    inv.netAmount = inv.grossAmount - inv.deductions;
304	
305	    audit(db, {
306	      actorPartyId: input.recordedByPartyId,
307	      actorRole: 'SAMITI_SACHEEV',
308	      action: 'POUR_RECORDED',
309	      subject: `${input.quantityLitres}L @ fat ${input.fatPct}%`,
310	      detail: `Pour ${pour.id} recorded via ${input.entryMethod}; ₹${amount} added to same-day invoice`,
311	    });
312	    return pour;
313	  },
314	});

430	    const lot = db.lots.find((l) => l.id === lotId);
431	    if (!lot) throw new ApiError(404, 'LOT_NOT_FOUND', `Unknown lot ${lotId}`);
432	    if (lot.status !== 'OPEN') {
433	      throw new ApiError(409, 'ALREADY_DISPATCHED', 'This consignment is already dispatched');
434	    }
435	    lot.status = 'DISPATCHED';
436	    // Seal the consignment (§6.4): its pours/readings are now frozen and the van
437	    // rider verifies this code at pickup so milk cannot be swapped in transit.
438	    lot.sealCode = sealCodeFor(lot.consignmentCode);
439	    lot.sealedAt = new Date().toISOString();
440	    appendChainEvent(db, {
441	      kind: 'LOT_SEALED',
442	      subjectType: 'LOT',
443	      subjectId: lot.id,
444	      actorPartyId: dispatchedByPartyId,
445	      detail: `${lot.consignmentCode} sealed ${lot.sealCode}`,
446	    });
447	    // Attach to today's route stop awaiting this DCS
448	    const trip = db.trips.find(
449	      (t) => t.date === lot.date && t.stops.some((s) => s.dcsId === lot.dcsId && !s.lotId),
450	    );
451	    const stop = trip?.stops.find((s) => s.dcsId === lot.dcsId && !s.lotId);
452	    if (stop) stop.lotId = lot.id;
453	    audit(db, {
454	      actorPartyId: dispatchedByPartyId,
455	      actorRole: 'SAMITI_SACHEEV',
456	      action: 'LOT_DISPATCHED',
457	      subject: lot.consignmentCode,
458	      detail: `${lot.totalLitres}L dispatched${trip ? `, attached to route ${trip.code}` : ''}`,
459	    });
460	    return lot;
461	  },
462	});
463	
464	/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
465	/* DCS to Union submission: the Sachiv approves the consignment data   */
466	/* for the Union and a B2B GST invoice is generated (§5.2, §13).       */
467	/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
468	
469	/** Indian fiscal year label for a date, e.g. 2026-27 (FY starts in April). */
470	function fiscalYear(date: string): string {
471	  const y = Number(date.slice(0, 4));
472	  const m = Number(date.slice(5, 7));
473	  const start = m >= 4 ? y : y - 1;
474	  return `${start}-${String((start + 1) % 100).padStart(2, '0')}`;
475	}
476	
477	/** Derive the DCS to Union B2B invoice from an approved consignment. */
478	function buildConsignmentInvoice(db: MockDb, lot: DcsLot): ConsignmentInvoice {
479	  const dcs = db.orgUnits.find((o) => o.id === lot.dcsId);
480	  const taxable = lot.unionInvoiceAmount ?? 0;
481	  const farmerCount = new Set(
482	    db.pours.filter((p) => lot.pourIds.includes(p.id)).map((p) => p.farmerPartyId),
483	  ).size;
484	  return {
485	    invoiceNo: lot.unionInvoiceNo ?? '',
486	    lotId: lot.id,
487	    consignmentCode: lot.consignmentCode,
488	    fromDcsId: lot.dcsId,
489	    toUnionId: dcs?.parentId ?? '',
490	    date: lot.date,
491	    shift: lot.shift,
492	    hsnCode: '0401',
493	    totalLitres: lot.totalLitres,
494	    avgFatPct: lot.avgFatPct,
495	    avgSnfPct: lot.avgSnfPct,
496	    farmerCount,
497	    taxableAmount: taxable,
498	    taxAmount: 0,
499	    totalAmount: taxable,
500	    gstNote: 'Fresh milk is GST exempt (HSN 0401)',
501	    generatedByPartyId: lot.unionApprovedByPartyId ?? '',
502	    generatedAt: lot.unionApprovedAt ?? '',
503	  };
504	}
505	
506	/**
507	 * The Sachiv approves the consignment's data for the Union. This is the gate:
508	 * the Union only receives data the Sachiv has approved. Approval also generates
509	 * the DCS to Union B2B GST e-invoice (§13) and returns it.
510	 */
511	// TODO(backend): union approval + B2B invoice route not exposed yet, mock only
512	export const approveForUnion = endpoint<
513	  { lotId: string; approvedByPartyId: string },
514	  ConsignmentInvoice
515	>({
516	  method: 'POST',
517	  path: ({ lotId }) => `/collection/consignments/${lotId}/approve-union`,
518	  mock: ({ lotId, approvedByPartyId }, db) => {
519	    const lot = db.lots.find((l) => l.id === lotId);
520	    if (!lot) throw new ApiError(404, 'LOT_NOT_FOUND', `Unknown consignment ${lotId}`);
521	    if (lot.unionApproved) {
522	      throw new ApiError(409, 'ALREADY_APPROVED', 'This consignment is already approved for the Union');
523	    }
524	    if (lot.status === 'REJECTED') {
525	      throw new ApiError(
526	        409,
527	        'LOT_REJECTED',
528	        'A rejected consignment cannot be approved for the Union',
529	      );
530	    }
531	    const value =
532	      Math.round(
533	        db.pours
534	          .filter((p) => lot.pourIds.includes(p.id))
535	          .reduce((s, p) => s + p.amount, 0) * 100,
536	      ) / 100;
537	    const dcs = db.orgUnits.find((o) => o.id === lot.dcsId);
538	    const seq = db.lots.filter((l) => l.unionApproved).length + 45;
539	    lot.unionApproved = true;
540	    lot.unionApprovedAt = new Date().toISOString();
541	    lot.unionApprovedByPartyId = approvedByPartyId;
542	    lot.unionInvoiceNo = `${dcs?.code ?? 'DCS'}/${fiscalYear(lot.date)}/${String(seq).padStart(6, '0')}`;
543	    lot.unionInvoiceAmount = value;
544	    audit(db, {
545	      actorPartyId: approvedByPartyId,
546	      actorRole: 'SAMITI_SACHEEV',
547	      action: 'UNION_DATA_APPROVED',
548	      subject: lot.consignmentCode,
549	      detail: `Approved ${lot.totalLitres}L for the Union; invoice ${lot.unionInvoiceNo} generated (value Rs. ${value})`,
550	    });
551	    return buildConsignmentInvoice(db, lot);
552	  },
553	});
554	
555	/** Fetch the generated DCS to Union invoice for an approved consignment. */
556	// TODO(backend): union approval + B2B invoice route not exposed yet, mock only
557	export const getConsignmentInvoice = endpoint<{ lotId: string }, ConsignmentInvoice>({
558	  method: 'GET',
559	  path: ({ lotId }) => `/collection/consignments/${lotId}/invoice`,
560	  mock: ({ lotId }, db) => {
561	    const lot = db.lots.find((l) => l.id === lotId);
562	    if (!lot || !lot.unionApproved) {
563	      throw new ApiError(404, 'INVOICE_NOT_FOUND', 'No invoice has been generated for this consignment');
564	    }
565	    return buildConsignmentInvoice(db, lot);
566	  },
567	});
```

```text
	for coll, models := range specs {
		if _, err := db.Collection(coll).Indexes().CreateMany(ctx, models); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("ensure indexes on %s: %w", coll, err)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func idx(keys bson.D, opts *options.IndexOptions) mongo.IndexModel {
	m := mongo.IndexModel{Keys: keys}
	if opts != nil {
		m.Options = opts
	}
	return m
}
```

```text
  // Fall back to a neutral dash while the org name resolves - never leak the

    o ? (hindi ? o.nameHi ?? o.name : o.name) : '-';
  const fromName = orgName(fromQ.data);

  const onShare = (inv: ConsignmentInvoice) => {

      `${t('invoice.total')}: ${formatINR(inv.totalAmount, true)}`,
      t('invoice.gstExempt'),
    ];
    void Share.share({ message: lines.join('\n') });
  };

  return (
    <Screen header>
      <View style={styles.topbar}>
        <Button
          title={tc('actions.back')}
          variant="ghost"
          size="md"
          icon={ArrowLeft}
          onPress={goBack}
        />
        {invoice ? (
          <Button
            title={t('invoice.share')}
            variant="ghost"
            size="md"
            icon={Share2}
            onPress={() => onShare(invoice)}
```
