682	
683	// --- KYC approval workflow (reviewer console) ---
684	
685	// kycSubjectInScope reports whether the reviewer's org scope covers the KYC
686	// subject: true when the subject holds at least one active role assignment
687	// inside the reviewer's organisational scope (the KYC record itself carries
688	// no org, so the subject's org is resolved via their assignments — mirroring
689	// how createAssignment/revokeAssignment obtain the OrgUnitID). SUPER_ADMIN and
690	// STATE_AUDITOR are platform-wide and always cover; PCDF_ADMIN (rooted at the
691	// federation) covers naturally through RequireInScope's ancestry test.
692	func (s *service) kycSubjectInScope(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, subjectPartyID primitive.ObjectID) (bool, error) {
693		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSuperAdmin || actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleStateAuditor {
694			return true, nil
695		}
696		assignments, err := s.repo.listActiveAssignments(ctx, subjectPartyID)
697		if err != nil {
698			return false, err
699		}
700		for _, ra := range assignments {
701			if s.deps.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, ra.OrgUnitID) == nil {
702				return true, nil
703			}
704		}
705		return false, nil
706	}
707	
708	// requireKYCSubjectInScope denies the reviewer a KYC decision on a subject
709	// outside their organisational scope (a cross-org privilege escalation guard).
710	func (s *service) requireKYCSubjectInScope(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, subjectPartyID primitive.ObjectID) error {
711		inScope, err := s.kycSubjectInScope(ctx, actor, subjectPartyID)
712		if err != nil {
713			return err
714		}
715		if !inScope {
716			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "kyc review denied: subject out of scope",
717				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
718				slog.String("subject_party_id", subjectPartyID.Hex()))
719			appErr := httpx.Forbidden("KYC subject is outside your organisational scope")
720			appErr.Code = "KYC_SUBJECT_OUT_OF_SCOPE"
721			return appErr
722		}
723		return nil
724	}
725	
726	// listPendingKYC pages PENDING KYC records newest-first, constrained to
727	// subjects within the reviewer's org scope, enriched with a reviewer-facing
728	// party summary, and audits the access.
729	func (s *service) listPendingKYC(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, page httpx.Page) ([]pendingKYCItem, int64, error) {
730		records, total, err := s.repo.listPendingKYC(ctx, page)
731		if err != nil {
732			return nil, 0, err
733		}
734		ids := make([]primitive.ObjectID, 0, len(records))
735		for _, rec := range records {
736			ids = append(ids, rec.PartyID)
737		}
738		parties, err := s.repo.findPartiesByIDs(ctx, ids)
739		if err != nil {
740			return nil, 0, err
741		}
742		items := make([]pendingKYCItem, 0, len(records))
743		for _, rec := range records {
744			// Org-scope gate: a scoped reviewer only ever sees (and thus only ever
745			// gets the contact PII of) subjects within their own area.
746			inScope, err := s.kycSubjectInScope(ctx, actor, rec.PartyID)
747			if err != nil {
748				return nil, 0, err
749			}
750			if !inScope {
751				continue
752			}
753			item := pendingKYCItem{KYCRecord: rec}
754			if p, ok := parties[rec.PartyID]; ok {
755				item.Party = &pendingPartySummary{
756					ID:       p.ID,
757					Phone:    p.Phone,
758					FullName: p.FullName,
759					KYCTier:  p.KYCTier,
760				}
761			}
762			items = append(items, item)
763		}
764	
765		s.deps.Audit.Record(ctx, audit.Entry{
766			Action: "kyc.pending_list",
767			Meta:   map[string]any{"count": len(items), "total": total},
768		})
769		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "kyc pending list accessed",
770			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
771			slog.Int("count", len(items)),
772			slog.Int64("total", total))
773		return items, total, nil
774	}
775	
776	// pendingKYCScanCap bounds the scoped-count scan. The pending queue is a
777	// human-drained work-list (realistically dozens, not millions); beyond the cap
778	// the badge shows "cap+" rather than paying for an unbounded scan.
779	const pendingKYCScanCap = 1000
780	
781	// pendingKYCCount returns how many PENDING records fall within the reviewer's
782	// org scope — the live badge value. It reuses the exact scope logic of the
783	// pending list (so badge and list always agree) and dedupes the per-subject
784	// scope lookup. Returns (count, capped).
785	func (s *service) pendingKYCCount(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor) (int64, bool, error) {
786		records, _, err := s.repo.listPendingKYC(ctx, httpx.Page{Limit: pendingKYCScanCap, Offset: 0})
787		if err != nil {
788			return 0, false, err
789		}
790		scopeCache := make(map[primitive.ObjectID]bool)
791		var count int64
792		for _, rec := range records {
793			inScope, seen := scopeCache[rec.PartyID]
794			if !seen {
795				inScope, err = s.kycSubjectInScope(ctx, actor, rec.PartyID)
796				if err != nil {
797					return 0, false, err
798				}
799				scopeCache[rec.PartyID] = inScope
800			}
801			if inScope {
802				count++
803			}
804		}
805		capped := len(records) >= pendingKYCScanCap
806		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "kyc pending count",
807			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID), slog.Int64("count", count), slog.Bool("capped", capped))
808		return count, capped, nil
809	}
810	
811	// approveKYC verifies a PENDING record, upgrades the party's KYC tier upward
812	// only, notifies the party and audits the decision. The reviewer's role must
813	// be authorised for the requested tier — even SUPER_ADMIN passes through the
814	// approvable-tier map (which grants it everything).
815	func (s *service) approveKYC(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID) (*kycReviewResponse, error) {
816		now := time.Now().UTC()
817		aid, err := actorID(actor)
818		if err != nil {
819			return nil, err
820		}
821		record, err := s.repo.findKYCRecordByID(ctx, id)
822		if err != nil {
823			return nil, err
824		}
825		if record.Status != domain.KYCStatusPending {
826			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "kyc approve rejected: record not pending",
827				slog.String("kyc_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("status", record.Status),
828				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
829			return nil, httpx.Conflict("KYC_NOT_PENDING", "kyc record is not pending review")
830		}
831		// Separation of duties: a reviewer may never decide their own KYC record.
832		if record.PartyID == aid {
833			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "kyc approve rejected: self-review",
834				slog.String("kyc_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
835			appErr := httpx.Forbidden("you may not review your own KYC record")
836			appErr.Code = "KYC_SELF_REVIEW"
837			return nil, appErr
838		}
839		// Org scope: a reviewer may only decide KYC for subjects within their area.
840		if err := s.requireKYCSubjectInScope(ctx, actor, record.PartyID); err != nil {
841			return nil, err
842		}
843		if !domain.CanApproveKYCTier(actor.RoleCode, record.RequestedTier) {
844			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "kyc approve rejected: tier not approvable",
845				slog.String("kyc_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("reviewer_role", actor.RoleCode),
846				slog.String("requested_tier", record.RequestedTier))
847			appErr := httpx.Forbidden("your role may not approve KYC at the " + record.RequestedTier + " tier")
848			appErr.Code = "KYC_TIER_NOT_APPROVABLE"
849			return nil, appErr
850		}
851	
852		updated, err := s.repo.approveKYCRecord(ctx, id, aid, actor.RoleCode, now)
853		if err != nil {
854			if isNotFound(err) {
855				// Lost the race — another reviewer already moved it out of PENDING.
856				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "kyc approve lost race: record no longer pending",
857					slog.String("kyc_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
858				return nil, httpx.Conflict("KYC_NOT_PENDING", "kyc record is not pending review")
859			}
860			return nil, err
861		}
862	
863		party, err := s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, updated.PartyID)
864		if err != nil {
865			return nil, err
866		}
867		newTier := upgradedKYCTier(party.KYCTier, updated.RequestedTier)
868		if newTier != party.KYCTier {
869			if err := s.repo.updatePartyKYCTier(ctx, party.ID, newTier, now); err != nil {
870				return nil, err
871			}
872		}
873	
874		language := party.PreferredLanguage
875		if language == "" {
876			language = defaultLanguage
877		}
878		pid := party.ID
879		if err := s.repo.insertNotification(ctx, domain.Notification{
880			PartyID:     &pid,
881			Phone:       party.Phone,
882			Channel:     domain.ChannelSMS,
883			TemplateKey: domain.TemplateKYCApproved,
884			Language:    language,
885			Params:      map[string]string{"tier": updated.RequestedTier},
886			Status:      domain.NotificationQueued,
887			QueuedAt:    now,
888		}); err != nil {
889			return nil, err
890		}
891	
892		s.deps.Audit.Record(ctx, audit.Entry{
893			Action:     "kyc.approve",
894			TargetType: "kyc_record",
895			TargetID:   id.Hex(),
896			Meta: map[string]any{
897				"party_id":       party.ID.Hex(),
898				"requested_tier": updated.RequestedTier,
899				"new_tier":       newTier,
900			},
901		})
902		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "kyc approved",
903			slog.String("kyc_id", id.Hex()),
904			slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()),
905			slog.String("requested_tier", updated.RequestedTier),
906			slog.String("new_tier", newTier),
907			slog.String("reviewer_role", actor.RoleCode),
908			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
909		// Nudge reviewer dashboards: this record left the PENDING queue.
910		s.publishKYCQueueChanged("approved", id, party.ID)
911		return &kycReviewResponse{Record: updated, KYCTier: newTier}, nil
912	}
913	
914	// rejectKYC moves a PENDING record to REJECTED with a mandatory reason,
915	// notifies the party and audits the decision. Same approvable-tier authority
916	// as approveKYC.
917	func (s *service) rejectKYC(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID, reason string) (*kycReviewResponse, error) {
918		now := time.Now().UTC()
919		aid, err := actorID(actor)
920		if err != nil {
921			return nil, err
922		}
923		record, err := s.repo.findKYCRecordByID(ctx, id)
924		if err != nil {
925			return nil, err
926		}
927		if record.Status != domain.KYCStatusPending {
928			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "kyc reject rejected: record not pending",
929				slog.String("kyc_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("status", record.Status),
930				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
931			return nil, httpx.Conflict("KYC_NOT_PENDING", "kyc record is not pending review")
932		}
933		// Separation of duties: a reviewer may never decide their own KYC record.
934		if record.PartyID == aid {
935			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "kyc reject rejected: self-review",
936				slog.String("kyc_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
937			appErr := httpx.Forbidden("you may not review your own KYC record")
938			appErr.Code = "KYC_SELF_REVIEW"
939			return nil, appErr
940		}
941		// Org scope: a reviewer may only decide KYC for subjects within their area.
942		if err := s.requireKYCSubjectInScope(ctx, actor, record.PartyID); err != nil {
943			return nil, err
944		}
945		if !domain.CanApproveKYCTier(actor.RoleCode, record.RequestedTier) {
946			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "kyc reject rejected: tier not approvable",
947				slog.String("kyc_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("reviewer_role", actor.RoleCode),
948				slog.String("requested_tier", record.RequestedTier))
949			appErr := httpx.Forbidden("your role may not review KYC at the " + record.RequestedTier + " tier")
950			appErr.Code = "KYC_TIER_NOT_APPROVABLE"
951			return nil, appErr
952		}
953	
954		updated, err := s.repo.rejectKYCRecord(ctx, id, aid, actor.RoleCode, reason, now)
955		if err != nil {
956			if isNotFound(err) {
957				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "kyc reject lost race: record no longer pending",
958					slog.String("kyc_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
959				return nil, httpx.Conflict("KYC_NOT_PENDING", "kyc record is not pending review")
960			}
961			return nil, err
962		}
963	
964		party, err := s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, updated.PartyID)
965		if err != nil {
966			return nil, err
967		}
968		language := party.PreferredLanguage
969		if language == "" {
970			language = defaultLanguage
971		}
972		pid := party.ID
973		if err := s.repo.insertNotification(ctx, domain.Notification{
974			PartyID:     &pid,
975			Phone:       party.Phone,
976			Channel:     domain.ChannelSMS,
977			TemplateKey: domain.TemplateKYCRejected,
978			Language:    language,
979			Params:      map[string]string{"tier": updated.RequestedTier, "reason": reason},
980			Status:      domain.NotificationQueued,
981			QueuedAt:    now,
982		}); err != nil {
983			return nil, err
984		}
985	
986		s.deps.Audit.Record(ctx, audit.Entry{
987			Action:     "kyc.reject",
988			TargetType: "kyc_record",
989			TargetID:   id.Hex(),
990			Meta: map[string]any{
991				"party_id":       party.ID.Hex(),
992				"requested_tier": updated.RequestedTier,
993				"reason":         reason,
994			},
995		})
996		s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "kyc rejected",
997			slog.String("kyc_id", id.Hex()),
998			slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()),
999			slog.String("requested_tier", updated.RequestedTier),
1000			slog.String("reviewer_role", actor.RoleCode),
1001			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
1002			slog.String("reason", reason))
1003		// Nudge reviewer dashboards: this record left the PENDING queue.
1004		s.publishKYCQueueChanged("rejected", id, party.ID)
1005		return &kycReviewResponse{Record: updated, KYCTier: party.KYCTier}, nil
1006	}
1007	
1008	// --- Role administration ---
1009	
1010	// requireGrantAuthority enforces the non-admin granter matrix (§5.2):
1011	// UNION_PRESIDENT manages village/logistics/union-tier roles anywhere in
1012	// scope; SAMITI_ADHYAKSH manages only FARMER/MILK_TESTER/LRP inside their
1013	// own DCS; ORGANISING_MANAGER enrols FARMER/CONSUMER within org scope.
1014	// Admin granters pass.
1015	func (s *service) requireGrantAuthority(actor auth.Actor, roleCode string, orgUnitID primitive.ObjectID) error {
1016		if !granterMayGrant(actor.RoleCode, roleCode) {
1017			return httpx.Forbidden("role " + actor.RoleCode + " may not grant or revoke " + roleCode)
1018		}
1019		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSamitiAdhyaksh && orgUnitID.Hex() != actor.OrgUnitID {
1020			return httpx.Forbidden("SAMITI_ADHYAKSH may manage roles only within their own DCS")
1021		}
1022		return nil
1023	}
1024	
1025	// createAssignment grants a role to a party inside an org unit.
1026	func (s *service) createAssignment(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req createAssignmentRequest) (*domain.RoleAssignment, error) {
1027		aid, err := actorID(actor)
1028		if err != nil {
1029			return nil, err
1030		}
1031	
1032		// Resolve the target party (party_id wins over phone).
1033		var party *domain.Party
1034		if req.PartyID != nil {
1035			party, err = s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, *req.PartyID)
1036		} else {
1037			party, err = s.repo.findPartyByPhone(ctx, req.Phone)
1038		}
1039		if err != nil {
1040			return nil, err
1041		}
1042	
1043		if err := s.deps.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.OrgUnitID); err != nil {
1044			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "assignment grant denied: out of scope",
1045				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
1046				slog.String("org_unit_id", req.OrgUnitID.Hex()),
1047				slog.String("role_code", req.RoleCode))
1048			return nil, err
1049		}
1050		if err := s.requireGrantAuthority(actor, req.RoleCode, req.OrgUnitID); err != nil {
1051			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "assignment grant denied: granter not authorised",
1052				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
1053				slog.String("granter_role", actor.RoleCode),
1054				slog.String("role_code", req.RoleCode))
1055			return nil, err
1056		}
1057	
1058		exists, err := s.repo.activeAssignmentExists(ctx, party.ID, req.RoleCode, req.OrgUnitID)
1059		if err != nil {
1060			return nil, err
1061		}
1062		if exists {
1063			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "assignment grant rejected: already exists",
1064				slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()),
1065				slog.String("role_code", req.RoleCode),
1066				slog.String("org_unit_id", req.OrgUnitID.Hex()))
1067			return nil, httpx.Conflict("ASSIGNMENT_EXISTS", "party already holds an active "+req.RoleCode+" assignment in this org unit")
1068		}
1069	
1070		now := time.Now().UTC()
1071		validFrom := now
1072		if req.ValidFrom != nil {
1073			validFrom = req.ValidFrom.UTC()
1074		}
1075		var validTo *time.Time
1076		if req.ValidTo != nil {
1077			t := req.ValidTo.UTC()
1078			validTo = &t
1079		}
1080		assignment := domain.RoleAssignment{
1081			ID:        primitive.NewObjectID(),
1082			PartyID:   party.ID,
1083			RoleCode:  req.RoleCode,
1084			OrgUnitID: req.OrgUnitID,
1085			GrantedBy: &aid,
1086			ValidFrom: validFrom,
1087			ValidTo:   validTo,
1088			Status:    domain.RoleAssignmentActive,
1089			CreatedAt: now,
1090		}
1091		if err := s.repo.insertAssignment(ctx, assignment); err != nil {
1092			return nil, err
1093		}
1094		s.deps.Audit.Record(ctx, audit.Entry{
1095			Action:     "role.grant",
1096			TargetType: "role_assignment",
1097			TargetID:   assignment.ID.Hex(),
1098			Meta: map[string]any{
1099				"party_id":    party.ID.Hex(),
1100				"role_code":   req.RoleCode,
1101				"org_unit_id": req.OrgUnitID.Hex(),
1102			},
1103		})
1104		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "role assignment created",
1105			slog.String("assignment_id", assignment.ID.Hex()),
1106			slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()),
1107			slog.String("role_code", req.RoleCode),
1108			slog.String("org_unit_id", req.OrgUnitID.Hex()),
1109			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
1110		return &assignment, nil
1111	}
1112	
1113	// revokeAssignment flips an assignment to REVOKED — the record is never
1114	// deleted (§4.1). Revocation authority mirrors grant authority.
1115	func (s *service) revokeAssignment(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, assignmentID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.RoleAssignment, error) {
1116		aid, err := actorID(actor)
1117		if err != nil {
1118			return nil, err
1119		}
1120		assignment, err := s.repo.findAssignmentByID(ctx, assignmentID)
1121		if err != nil {
1122			return nil, err
1123		}
1124		if err := s.deps.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, assignment.OrgUnitID); err != nil {
1125			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "assignment revoke denied: out of scope",
1126				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
1127				slog.String("assignment_id", assignmentID.Hex()))
1128			return nil, err
1129		}
1130		if err := s.requireGrantAuthority(actor, assignment.RoleCode, assignment.OrgUnitID); err != nil {
1131			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "assignment revoke denied: granter not authorised",
1132				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
1133				slog.String("granter_role", actor.RoleCode),
1134				slog.String("role_code", assignment.RoleCode))
1135			return nil, err
1136		}
1137		if assignment.Status != domain.RoleAssignmentActive {
1138			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "assignment revoke rejected: already revoked",
1139				slog.String("assignment_id", assignmentID.Hex()))
1140			return nil, httpx.Conflict("ALREADY_REVOKED", "role assignment is already revoked")
1141		}
1142		revoked, err := s.repo.revokeAssignment(ctx, assignmentID, aid, time.Now().UTC())
1143		if err != nil {
1144			return nil, err
1145		}
1146		s.deps.Audit.Record(ctx, audit.Entry{
1147			Action:     "role.revoke",
1148			TargetType: "role_assignment",
1149			TargetID:   assignmentID.Hex(),
1150			Meta: map[string]any{
1151				"party_id":    revoked.PartyID.Hex(),
1152				"role_code":   revoked.RoleCode,
1153				"org_unit_id": revoked.OrgUnitID.Hex(),
1154			},
1155		})
1156		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "role assignment revoked",
1157			slog.String("assignment_id", assignmentID.Hex()),
1158			slog.String("party_id", revoked.PartyID.Hex()),
1159			slog.String("role_code", revoked.RoleCode),
1160			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
1161		return revoked, nil
1162	}
1163	
1164	// listAssignments pages assignments inside one org unit the actor can see.
1165	func (s *service) listAssignments(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, orgUnitID primitive.ObjectID, roleCode string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.RoleAssignment, int64, error) {
1166		if err := s.deps.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, orgUnitID); err != nil {
1167			return nil, 0, err
1168		}
1169		return s.repo.listAssignments(ctx, orgUnitID, roleCode, page)
1170	}

25	const (
26		// traceDepth bounds the upstream graph walk (QR → lot → batch → BMC lots
27		// → consignments comfortably fits; the ledger also hard-caps event count).
28		traceDepth = 10
29		// scanVerifySpanCap bounds how many ledger events one consumer scan
30		// re-hashes; wider traced ranges are verified partially (most recent tail).
31		scanVerifySpanCap = 5000
32		// publicVerifySpanCap bounds the public /ledger/verify endpoint span.
33		publicVerifySpanCap = 10000
34		// downstreamEventCap keeps the official trace response bounded even for
35		// heavily referenced entities.
36		downstreamEventCap = 2000
37	)
38	
39	// validEntityTypes is the closed set of traceable entity types (domain.Entity*).
40	var validEntityTypes = map[string]struct{}{
41		domain.EntityMilkPour:        {},
42		domain.EntityAnalyzerReading: {},
43		domain.EntityInvoice:         {},
44		domain.EntityConsignment:     {},
45		domain.EntityRouteTrip:       {},
46		domain.EntityBMCLot:          {},
47		domain.EntityBatch:           {},
48		domain.EntityProductLot:      {},
49		domain.EntityBatchQR:         {},
50		domain.EntityQCResult:        {},
51		domain.EntitySettlement:      {},
52		domain.EntityAnimal:          {},
53		domain.EntityParty:           {},
54	}
55	
56	// Service resolves consumer QR scans and official trace queries. All reads,
57	// no writes except the fire-and-forget scan counter — nothing here ever
58	// mutates provenance.
59	type Service struct {
60		log      *slog.Logger
61		repo     *repo
62		ledger   *provenance.Ledger
63		orgs     *orgscope.Resolver
64		qrSecret string
65	
66		// Incremental verification watermark: the chain is verified cumulatively
67		// across scans, so a repeat scan whose traced range is already covered
68		// answers O(1) instead of re-hashing thousands of interleaved events on
69		// the hottest public endpoint. Per-instance; a restart re-verifies.
70		verifyMu     sync.Mutex
71		verifiedUpTo int64
72		chainBroken  bool
73		brokenAtSeq  int64
74	}
75	
76	// NewService wires the service from the shared dependency container. The
77	// logger is the module-scoped logger derived in Register.
78	func NewService(d *deps.Deps, log *slog.Logger) *Service {
79		return &Service{
80			log:      log,
81			repo:     newRepo(d.DB),
82			ledger:   d.Ledger,
83			orgs:     d.Orgs,
84			qrSecret: d.Cfg.QRSigningSecret,
85		}
86	}
87	
88	// internalErr converts an unexpected failure into the opaque 500, logging it
89	// at ERROR with operation context first. Typed AppErrors (404s, 400s, org
90	// resolver errors) pass through untouched so client-facing semantics never
91	// change.
92	func (s *Service) internalErr(ctx context.Context, op string, err error, attrs ...any) error {
93		var appErr *httpx.AppError
94		if errors.As(err, &appErr) {
95			return appErr
96		}
97		args := append([]any{slog.Any("err", err)}, attrs...)
98		s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, op, args...)
99		return httpx.Internal(err)
100	}
101	
102	// VerifyQRToken checks a stored signed token in the format QR issuance
103	// (plant module signQRToken) mints: "base64url(qr_code|product_lot_id_hex|
104	// issued_unix)" + "." + hex(HMAC-SHA256(secret, decoded payload)), where
105	// product_lot_id_hex is productLotID.Hex(). The HMAC is computed over the
106	// DECODED payload bytes — exactly what issuance signed. The comparison is
107	// constant-time so a forger learns nothing from response timing.
108	func VerifyQRToken(secret, token string) bool {
109		payloadB64, signature, found := strings.Cut(token, ".")
110		if !found || payloadB64 == "" || signature == "" {
111			return false // malformed: no payload/signature split
112		}
113		payload, err := base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString(payloadB64)
114		if err != nil || len(payload) == 0 {
115			return false // malformed: payload is not valid base64url
116		}
117		expected := auth.HMACHash(secret, string(payload))
118		return auth.ConstantTimeEqual(expected, signature)
119	}
120	
121	// ScanQR resolves one consumer QR scan into the honest provenance view
122	// (§7.4): product + plant + lab certificate + the SET of contributing
123	// samitis — never per-farmer data — plus a live tamper-evidence check.
124	func (s *Service) ScanQR(ctx context.Context, qrCode string) (*QRScanResponse, error) {
125		qr, err := s.repo.qrByCode(ctx, qrCode)
126		if err != nil {
127			return nil, s.internalErr(ctx, "qr scan: load qr", err, slog.String("qr_code", qrCode))
128		}
129	
130		// Integrity gate: the stored token must carry a valid HMAC. A mismatch
131		// means the QR record was tampered with or forged — surface it loudly.
132		if !VerifyQRToken(s.qrSecret, qr.SignedToken) {
133			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "QR signed-token integrity check failed — possible forgery",
134				slog.String("qr_code", qrCode), slog.String("qr_id", qr.ID.Hex()))
135			return nil, httpx.Conflict("QR_INTEGRITY_FAILED",
136				"this QR code failed integrity verification and may be counterfeit")
137		}
138	
139		// Count the scan without ever blocking it: fire-and-forget increment.
140		go func(qrID primitive.ObjectID) {
141			bg, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
142			defer cancel()
143			if err := s.repo.incrementScanCount(bg, qrID); err != nil {
144				s.log.WarnContext(bg, "scan_count increment failed",
145					slog.String("qr_id", qrID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
146			}
147		}(qr.ID)
148	
149		lot, err := s.repo.productLotByID(ctx, qr.ProductLotID)
150		if err != nil {
151			return nil, s.internalErr(ctx, "qr scan: load product lot", err,
152				slog.String("qr_id", qr.ID.Hex()), slog.String("product_lot_id", qr.ProductLotID.Hex()))
153		}
154		batch, err := s.repo.batchByID(ctx, lot.BatchID)
155		if err != nil {
156			return nil, s.internalErr(ctx, "qr scan: load processing batch", err,
157				slog.String("product_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()), slog.String("batch_id", lot.BatchID.Hex()))
158		}
159		plant, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, batch.PlantID)
160		if err != nil {
161			return nil, s.internalErr(ctx, "qr scan: resolve plant org", err,
162				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()), slog.String("plant_id", batch.PlantID.Hex()))
163		}
164	
165		// Walk the provenance graph upstream from the product lot and STOP at the
166		// pooling boundary: batch → BMC lots → consignments (§7.4). Consignment
167		// refs (hundreds of per-pour nodes, cross-route trip fan-out) are never
168		// expanded — the consumer view only needs the samiti set.
169		events, err := s.ledger.TraceStopAt(ctx, domain.EntityProductLot, lot.ID.Hex(), traceDepth,
170			map[string]bool{domain.EntityConsignment: true})
171		if err != nil {
172			return nil, s.internalErr(ctx, "qr scan: trace product lot", err,
173				slog.String("product_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()))
174		}
175	
176		sourcing, err := s.buildSourcing(ctx, events)
177		if err != nil {
178			return nil, err
179		}
180	
181		ledgerInfo, err := s.verifyTracedRange(ctx, events)
182		if err != nil {
183			return nil, err
184		}
185	
186		resp := &QRScanResponse{
187			Product: ProductInfo{
188				Name:       lot.ProductName,
189				SKU:        lot.SKU,
190				UnitSize:   lot.UnitSize,
191				MfgDate:    lot.MfgDate,
192				ExpiryDate: lot.ExpiryDate,
193			},
194			BatchNumber: batch.BatchNumber,
195			Plant:       PlantInfo{Name: plant.Name, District: plant.District},
196			Sourcing:    *sourcing,
197			Ledger:      *ledgerInfo,
198			ScanCount:   qr.ScanCount + 1, // reflect this scan; the $inc lands async
199		}
200	
201		// PLANT_LAB pass certificate — omitted (not an error) when absent.
202		qc, err := s.repo.latestPlantLabPass(ctx, batch.ID)
203		if err != nil {
204			return nil, s.internalErr(ctx, "qr scan: load plant lab certificate", err,
205				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()))
206		}
207		if qc != nil {
208			resp.Quality = &QualityInfo{
209				CertificateNumber: qc.CertificateNumber,
210				Stage:             qc.Stage,
211				Tests:             qc.Tests,
212				RecordedAt:        qc.RecordedAt,
213			}
214		}
215	
216		// A recalled lot still resolves with 200 — consumers must SEE the recall
217		// notice, not hit a dead link.
218		if lot.Status == domain.ProductLotStatusRecalled {
219			resp.Recalled = true
220			notice := "This product lot has been RECALLED. Do not consume — return it to the point of purchase."
221			if lot.RecallReason != "" {
222				notice += " Reason: " + lot.RecallReason
223			}
224			resp.RecallNotice = notice
225		}
226	
227		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "qr scan resolved",
228			slog.String("qr_code", qrCode),
229			slog.String("qr_id", qr.ID.Hex()),
230			slog.String("product_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()),
231			slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
232			slog.String("batch_number", batch.BatchNumber),
233			slog.Int("samitis", len(sourcing.Samitis)),
234			slog.Bool("ledger_intact", ledgerInfo.Intact),
235			slog.Bool("recalled", resp.Recalled))
236		return resp, nil
237	}
238	
239	// buildSourcing derives the samiti-set view from traced consignment events:
240	// contributing DCS org ids from each event's org_unit_id/payload, collection
241	// dates from payloads, with the consignment documents as fallback when the
242	// events did not carry those fields. Ledger events carry ObjectIDs as hex
243	// strings, so the sets are hex-keyed and parsed at the DB/orgscope boundary.
244	func (s *Service) buildSourcing(ctx context.Context, events []provenance.Event) (*SourcingInfo, error) {
245		dcsIDs := map[string]struct{}{}
246		dates := map[string]struct{}{}
247		consignmentIDs := map[string]struct{}{}
248	
249		for _, ev := range events {
250			if ev.EntityType != domain.EntityConsignment {
251				continue
252			}
253			consignmentIDs[ev.EntityID] = struct{}{}
254			// Only created/dispatched events carry the DCS in org_unit_id —
255			// consignment.picked_up is appended by logistics under the UNION's
256			// org id, which must never be counted as a contributing samiti.
257			switch ev.Type {
258			case domain.EventConsignmentCreated, domain.EventConsignmentDispatched:
259				if ev.OrgUnitID != "" {
260					dcsIDs[ev.OrgUnitID] = struct{}{}
261				} else if v, ok := ev.Payload["dcs_id"].(string); ok && v != "" {
262					dcsIDs[v] = struct{}{}
263				}
264			}
265			if v, ok := ev.Payload["date"].(string); ok && v != "" {
266				dates[v] = struct{}{}
267			}
268		}
269	
270		// Fallback: if the events lacked DCS ids or dates, read the consignment
271		// docs themselves (still samiti-level — pour ids are never surfaced).
272		if len(consignmentIDs) > 0 && (len(dcsIDs) == 0 || len(dates) == 0) {
273			ids := make([]primitive.ObjectID, 0, len(consignmentIDs))
274			for _, hexID := range sortedKeys(consignmentIDs) {
275				cid, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(hexID)
276				if err != nil {
277					// Ledger event ids should always be ObjectID hex — flag and skip.
278					s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "QR scan: traced consignment id is not a valid object id",
279						slog.String("consignment_id", hexID))
280					continue
281				}
282				ids = append(ids, cid)
283			}
284			docs, err := s.repo.consignmentsByIDs(ctx, ids)
285			if err != nil {
286				return nil, s.internalErr(ctx, "qr scan: load consignments for sourcing", err)
287			}
288			for _, c := range docs {
289				if !c.DCSID.IsZero() {
290					dcsIDs[c.DCSID.Hex()] = struct{}{}
291				}
292				if c.Date != "" {
293					dates[c.Date] = struct{}{}
294				}
295			}
296		}
297	
298		samitis := make([]SamitiInfo, 0, len(dcsIDs))
299		districts := map[string]struct{}{}
300		for _, hexID := range sortedKeys(dcsIDs) {
301			orgID, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(hexID)
302			if err != nil {
303				// A malformed id must not break a consumer scan — log and skip.
304				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "QR scan: contributing DCS id is not a valid object id",
305					slog.String("dcs_org_id", hexID))
306				continue
307			}
308			org, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, orgID)
309			if err != nil {
310				// A missing org unit must not break a consumer scan — log and skip.
311				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "QR scan: contributing DCS org not resolvable",
312					slog.String("dcs_org_id", hexID), slog.Any("err", err))
313				continue
314			}
315			// Defence in depth: the §7.4 samiti set may only contain DCS units.
316			if org.Type != domain.OrgTypeDCS {
317				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "QR scan: non-DCS org unit skipped from samiti set",
318					slog.String("org_id", hexID), slog.String("org_type", org.Type))
319				continue
320			}
321			samitis = append(samitis, SamitiInfo{Name: org.Name, Code: org.Code, District: org.District})
322			if org.District != "" {
323				districts[org.District] = struct{}{}
324			}
325		}
326		sort.Slice(samitis, func(i, j int) bool { return samitis[i].Name < samitis[j].Name })
327	
328		collectionDates := sortedKeys(dates)
329		return &SourcingInfo{
330			Message:         sourcingMessage(collectionDates, len(samitis), sortedKeys(districts)),
331			Samitis:         samitis,
332			CollectionDates: collectionDates,
333		}, nil
334	}
335	
336	// sourcingMessage renders the consumer-facing pooled-provenance sentence,
337	// e.g. "Made from milk collected on 2026-07-05 from 3 samitis in Lucknow".
338	func sourcingMessage(dates []string, samitiCount int, districts []string) string {
339		var b strings.Builder
340		b.WriteString("Made from milk collected")
341		if len(dates) > 0 {
342			b.WriteString(" on " + strings.Join(dates, ", "))
343		}
344		noun := "samitis"
345		if samitiCount == 1 {
346			noun = "samiti"
347		}
348		fmt.Fprintf(&b, " from %d %s", samitiCount, noun)
349		if len(districts) > 0 {
350			b.WriteString(" in " + strings.Join(districts, ", "))
351		}
352		return b.String()
353	}
354	
355	// verifyTracedRange answers the per-scan tamper-evidence check from a
356	// cumulative verification watermark: the chain is verified incrementally up
357	// to the traced range's max seq, and once a prefix is verified, later scans
358	// inside it are O(1) — no per-request re-hash of thousands of interleaved
359	// events. Spans over scanVerifySpanCap are verified partially (most recent
360	// tail) and flagged, matching the previous per-scan behaviour.
361	func (s *Service) verifyTracedRange(ctx context.Context, events []provenance.Event) (*LedgerInfo, error) {
362		if len(events) == 0 {
363			return &LedgerInfo{Events: 0, Intact: true, VerifiedRange: [2]int64{0, 0}}, nil
364		}
365		maxSeq := events[0].Seq
366		for _, ev := range events[1:] {
367			if ev.Seq > maxSeq {
368				maxSeq = ev.Seq
369			}
370		}
371	
372		s.verifyMu.Lock()
373		defer s.verifyMu.Unlock()
374	
375		if s.chainBroken {
376			return &LedgerInfo{
377				Events:        len(events),
378				Intact:        false,
379				VerifiedRange: [2]int64{s.brokenAtSeq, s.brokenAtSeq},
380			}, nil
381		}
382		if maxSeq <= s.verifiedUpTo {
383			return &LedgerInfo{
384				Events:        len(events),
385				Intact:        true,
386				VerifiedRange: [2]int64{1, s.verifiedUpTo},
387			}, nil
388		}
389	
390		// Extend the watermark: start at the last verified event (re-hashing it
391		// covers the boundary linkage), capped to the per-request span budget.
392		from, partial := max(int64(1), s.verifiedUpTo), false
393		if maxSeq-from+1 > scanVerifySpanCap {
394			from, partial = maxSeq-scanVerifySpanCap+1, true
395		}
396		intact, brokenAt, err := s.ledger.VerifyChain(ctx, from, maxSeq)
397		if err != nil {
398			return nil, s.internalErr(ctx, "qr scan: verify ledger chain", err,
399				slog.Int64("from", from), slog.Int64("to", maxSeq))
400		}
401		if intact {
402			s.verifiedUpTo = maxSeq
403		} else {
404			s.chainBroken, s.brokenAtSeq = true, brokenAt
405			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "provenance chain break detected during scan verification",
406				slog.Int64("broken_at_seq", brokenAt),
407				slog.Int64("from", from), slog.Int64("to", maxSeq))
408		}
409		return &LedgerInfo{
410			Events:        len(events),
411			Intact:        intact,
412			VerifiedRange: [2]int64{from, maxSeq},
413			Partial:       partial,
414		}, nil
415	}
416	
417	// VerifyLedger runs the public tamper-evidence check over [from,to]. Both
418	// bounds are optional: `to` defaults to the chain head, `from` to the start
419	// of the last publicVerifySpanCap events. Spans over the cap are rejected.
420	func (s *Service) VerifyLedger(ctx context.Context, fromRaw, toRaw string) (*LedgerVerifyResponse, error) {
421		latest, err := s.ledger.LatestSeq(ctx)
422		if err != nil {
423			return nil, s.internalErr(ctx, "ledger verify: read chain head", err)
424		}
425		if latest == 0 {
426			return &LedgerVerifyResponse{Intact: true, From: 0, To: 0}, nil // empty chain is trivially intact
427		}
428	
429		to := latest
430		if toRaw != "" {
431			n, err := strconv.ParseInt(toRaw, 10, 64)
432			if err != nil || n < 1 {
433				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_RANGE", "'to' must be a positive sequence number")
434			}
435			to = min(n, latest)
436		}
437		from := max(int64(1), to-publicVerifySpanCap+1)
438		if fromRaw != "" {
439			n, err := strconv.ParseInt(fromRaw, 10, 64)
440			if err != nil || n < 1 {
441				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_RANGE", "'from' must be a positive sequence number")
442			}
443			from = n
444		}
445		if from > to {
446			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_RANGE", "'from' must not exceed 'to'")
447		}
448		if to-from+1 > publicVerifySpanCap {
449			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("SPAN_TOO_WIDE",
450				fmt.Sprintf("verification span is capped at %d events per request", publicVerifySpanCap))
451		}
452	
453		intact, brokenAt, err := s.ledger.VerifyChain(ctx, from, to)
454		if err != nil {
455			return nil, s.internalErr(ctx, "ledger verify: verify chain", err,
456				slog.Int64("from", from), slog.Int64("to", to))
457		}
458		resp := &LedgerVerifyResponse{Intact: intact, From: from, To: to}
459		if !intact {
460			resp.BrokenAtSeq = &brokenAt
461			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "public ledger verification found a broken chain",
462				slog.Int64("broken_at_seq", brokenAt),
463				slog.Int64("from", from), slog.Int64("to", to))
464		}
465		return resp, nil
466	}
467	
468	// TraceGraph returns the full event graph around one entity: upstream via
469	// the recursive ref walk, downstream via reverse-ref lookup — the recall /
470	// root-cause tool (§8.3). entityID is the entity's ObjectID as a hex string
471	// (already validated by the handler; the ledger stores ids as hex).
472	func (s *Service) TraceGraph(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string) (*TraceGraphResponse, error) {
473		if err := validateEntityType(entityType); err != nil {
474			return nil, err
475		}
476		upstream, err := s.ledger.Trace(ctx, entityType, entityID, traceDepth)
477		if err != nil {
478			return nil, s.internalErr(ctx, "trace graph: upstream walk", err,
479				slog.String("entity_type", entityType), slog.String("entity_id", entityID))
480		}
481		// The cap is pushed into the query: only the LAST downstreamEventCap
482		// referencing events are fetched, instead of decoding an unbounded set
483		// into memory and truncating afterwards.
484		downstream, err := s.ledger.DownstreamRefs(ctx, entityID, downstreamEventCap)
485		if err != nil {
486			return nil, s.internalErr(ctx, "trace graph: downstream refs", err,
487				slog.String("entity_type", entityType), slog.String("entity_id", entityID))
488		}
489		if len(upstream) == 0 && len(downstream) == 0 {
490			return nil, httpx.NotFound("provenance for entity")
491		}
492		if upstream == nil {
493			upstream = []provenance.Event{}
494		}
495		if downstream == nil {
496			downstream = []provenance.Event{}
497		}
498		return &TraceGraphResponse{Upstream: upstream, Downstream: downstream}, nil
499	}
500	
501	// Timeline returns one entity's own events in chain order, paginated. The
502	// skip/limit is pushed into the Mongo query so a page read never loads the
503	// entity's full history. The second return value is the total event count.
504	// entityID is the entity's ObjectID as a hex string (handler-validated).
505	func (s *Service) Timeline(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, page httpx.Page) ([]provenance.Event, int, error) {
506		if err := validateEntityType(entityType); err != nil {
507			return nil, 0, err
508		}
509		total, err := s.ledger.CountEventsForEntity(ctx, entityType, entityID)
510		if err != nil {
511			return nil, 0, s.internalErr(ctx, "timeline: count entity events", err,
512				slog.String("entity_type", entityType), slog.String("entity_id", entityID))
513		}
514		if total == 0 {
515			return nil, 0, httpx.NotFound("provenance for entity")
516		}
517		events, err := s.ledger.EventsForEntityPage(ctx, entityType, entityID, page.Offset, page.Limit)
518		if err != nil {
519			return nil, 0, s.internalErr(ctx, "timeline: load entity events page", err,
520				slog.String("entity_type", entityType), slog.String("entity_id", entityID))
521		}
522		return events, int(total), nil
523	}
524	
525	// validateEntityType rejects entity types outside the domain.Entity* catalog.
526	func validateEntityType(entityType string) error {
527		if _, ok := validEntityTypes[entityType]; !ok {
528			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_ENTITY_TYPE",
529				"unknown entity type "+entityType+" — use one of the provenance entity type constants")
530		}
531		return nil
532	}
533	
534	// sortedKeys returns a set's keys in deterministic (lexicographic) order.
535	func sortedKeys(set map[string]struct{}) []string {
536		out := make([]string, 0, len(set))
537		for k := range set {
538			out = append(out, k)
539		}
540		sort.Strings(out)
541		return out
542	}

1	// Package plant implements the processing tier of the pour→QR chain:
2	// BMC lots (pooled consignments at the chilling centre), processing batches,
3	// product lots and QR issuance. It is the ENFORCEMENT layer of the safety
4	// gate (blueprint §8.3): a lot or batch that has not PASSED quality control
5	// can never advance — not into a tanker, not into a batch, not onto a shelf.
6	// Aflatoxin M1 survives pasteurisation, so the gate is checked at every hop,
7	// belt-and-braces.

68				)).Post("/", h.CreateProductLot)

70					domain.RolePCDFAdmin, domain.RolePlantLabAnalyst,
71				)).Post("/{id}/recall", h.RecallProductLot)
72			})
73	
74			// QR issuance — the consumer-facing end of the trace chain (§7).
75			pr.Route("/qrs", func(qr chi.Router) {
76				qr.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(
77					domain.RolePlantOperator, domain.RolePlantLabAnalyst,
78				))
79				qr.Post("/", h.IssueQR)
80				qr.Get("/", h.ListQRs)
81			})
82		})
83	
84		// No bus subscriptions: the quality module flips lot/batch statuses in
85		// their own collections, and every gate here re-reads status at use time.
86	}

18	// repo is the read-mostly MongoDB access layer for the trace views. It reads
19	// other modules' collections strictly via the mongodb.Coll* consts, exactly
20	// where the spec sanctions it (QR → lot → batch → qc / consignment lookups).
21	//
22	// Not-found is returned as a typed httpx.NotFound; every unexpected DB error
23	// is wrapped with its operation so the service's ERROR log names the failing
24	// op.
25	type repo struct {
26		batchQRs     *mongo.Collection
27		productLots  *mongo.Collection
28		batches      *mongo.Collection
29		qcResults    *mongo.Collection
30		consignments *mongo.Collection
31	}
32	
33	// newRepo binds the repo to the shared database.
34	func newRepo(db *mongo.Database) *repo {
35		return &repo{
36			batchQRs:     db.Collection(mongodb.CollBatchQRs),
37			productLots:  db.Collection(mongodb.CollProductLots),
38			batches:      db.Collection(mongodb.CollBatches),
39			qcResults:    db.Collection(mongodb.CollQCResults),
40			consignments: db.Collection(mongodb.CollConsignments),
41		}
42	}
43	
44	// qrByCode loads a batch QR by its short public code — qr_code is the unique
45	// human-readable business key (never an ObjectID).
46	func (r *repo) qrByCode(ctx context.Context, code string) (*domain.BatchQR, error) {
47		var qr domain.BatchQR
48		err := r.batchQRs.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "qr_code", Value: code}}).Decode(&qr)
49		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
50			return nil, httpx.NotFound("qr code")
51		}
52		if err != nil {
53			return nil, fmt.Errorf("find qr by code: %w", err)
54		}
55		return &qr, nil
56	}
57	
58	// incrementScanCount bumps the QR's scan counter. Called fire-and-forget by
59	// the service so it never delays a consumer scan.
60	func (r *repo) incrementScanCount(ctx context.Context, qrID primitive.ObjectID) error {
61		_, err := r.batchQRs.UpdateOne(ctx,
62			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: qrID}},
63			bson.D{{Key: "$inc", Value: bson.D{{Key: "scan_count", Value: int64(1)}}}},
64		)
65		if err != nil {
66			return fmt.Errorf("increment qr scan_count: %w", err)
67		}
68		return nil
69	}

72	func (r *repo) productLotByID(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.ProductLot, error) {
73		var lot domain.ProductLot
74		err := r.productLots.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&lot)
75		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
76			return nil, httpx.NotFound("product lot")
77		}
78		if err != nil {
79			return nil, fmt.Errorf("find product lot: %w", err)
80		}
81		return &lot, nil
82	}
83	
84	// batchByID loads a processing batch.
85	func (r *repo) batchByID(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.ProcessingBatch, error) {
86		var batch domain.ProcessingBatch
87		err := r.batches.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&batch)
88		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
89			return nil, httpx.NotFound("processing batch")
90		}
91		if err != nil {
92			return nil, fmt.Errorf("find processing batch: %w", err)
93		}
94		return &batch, nil
95	}

97	// latestPlantLabPass returns the most recent passing PLANT_LAB QC result for
98	// a batch, or nil when none exists yet (absence is not an error — the public
99	// view simply omits the certificate).
100	func (r *repo) latestPlantLabPass(ctx context.Context, batchID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.QCResult, error) {
101		var qc domain.QCResult
102		err := r.qcResults.FindOne(ctx,
103			bson.D{
104				{Key: "subject_type", Value: domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch},
105				{Key: "subject_id", Value: batchID},
106				{Key: "stage", Value: domain.QCStagePlantLab},
107				{Key: "overall_pass", Value: true},
108				// A result voided after losing the gate race carries no verdict.
109				{Key: "superseded", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$ne", Value: true}}},
110			},
111			options.FindOne().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "recorded_at", Value: -1}}),
112		).Decode(&qc)
113		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
114			return nil, nil
115		}
116		if err != nil {
117			return nil, fmt.Errorf("find latest plant lab pass: %w", err)
118		}
119		return &qc, nil
120	}
121	
122	// consignmentsByIDs loads consignment documents by ObjectID — the fallback
123	// source of contributing-DCS ids and collection dates when the ledger events
124	// did not carry them in org_unit_id/payload. Input is bounded by the trace
125	// event cap.
126	func (r *repo) consignmentsByIDs(ctx context.Context, ids []primitive.ObjectID) ([]domain.DCSConsignment, error) {
127		if len(ids) == 0 {
128			return nil, nil
129		}
130		cur, err := r.consignments.Find(ctx,
131			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: ids}}}},
132		)
133		if err != nil {
134			return nil, fmt.Errorf("find consignments by ids: %w", err)
135		}
136		var out []domain.DCSConsignment
137		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
138			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode consignments by ids: %w", err)
139		}
140		return out, nil
141	}

6	// upstream at the BMC and the plant lab — never only at the finished product.

1	// Package platformops is the platform-operations module (blueprint §12): the
2	// SUPER_ADMIN feature-flag console, the STATE_AUDITOR read-only audit surface
3	// with its GIGW/DPDP immutable export, the notifications outbox with the mock

7	// It also subscribes to cross-module bus topics — payout credited, safety

9	package platformops
10	
11	import (
12		"context"
13		"log/slog"
14	
15		"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
16	
17		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"

20		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/middleware"
21	)
22	
23	// Register wires the platformops module and mounts /admin, /audit,
24	// /notifications and /support (the router hands us the /api/v1 subtree).
25	func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
26		log := d.Log.With(slog.String("module", "platformops"))
27		repo := newRepository(d.DB)
28		svc := newService(d, repo, log)
29		h := newHandler(svc)
30	
31		r.Route("/admin", func(r chi.Router) {
32			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
33	
34			// PCDF_ADMIN may LIST flags; flipping one is SUPER_ADMIN only —
35			// capability gating is a deliberate act (blueprint principle #6).
36			r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSuperAdmin, domain.RolePCDFAdmin)).
37				Get("/flags", h.listFlags)
38			r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSuperAdmin)).
39				Put("/flags/{key}", h.setFlag)
40		})
41	
42		r.Route("/audit", func(r chi.Router) {
43			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
44			r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleStateAuditor, domain.RoleSuperAdmin))
45	
46			// Read-only by design: there is deliberately NO write/delete API
47			// surface for audit logs (§12) — entries land via deps.Audit only.
48			r.Get("/logs", h.listAuditLogs)
49			r.Get("/logs/export", h.exportAuditLogs)
50		})
51	
52		r.Route("/notifications", func(r chi.Router) {
53			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
54	
55			// SUPER_ADMIN only: a help-desk role has no need to read outbox
56			// message bodies, and the outbox carries credential-adjacent traffic
57			// (OTP notifications — additionally redacted in the service).
58			r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSuperAdmin)).
59				Get("/", h.listNotifications)
60			r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSuperAdmin)).
61				Post("/worker/run", h.runWorker)
62		})
63	
64		r.Route("/support", func(r chi.Router) {
65			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
66			r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSupportAgent, domain.RoleSuperAdmin))
67	
68			r.Get("/parties/lookup", h.lookupParty)
69		})
70	
71		// Cross-module reactions arrive over the bus (modules never import each
72		// other). The bus already runs each handler on its own goroutine with a
73		// bounded context and panic recovery; the wrapper below adds an explicit
74		// second belt at this module's boundary.
75		d.Bus.Subscribe(eventbus.TopicPayoutCredited, safeHandler(log, svc.onPayoutCredited))
76		d.Bus.Subscribe(eventbus.TopicGateBlocked, safeHandler(log, svc.onGateBlocked))
77		d.Bus.Subscribe(eventbus.TopicMVUDispatched, safeHandler(log, svc.onMVUDispatched))
78	}
79	
80	// safeHandler wraps a bus reaction so a programming error in notification
81	// fan-out can never disturb the publishing flow.
82	func safeHandler(log *slog.Logger, reaction func(ctx context.Context, payload any)) eventbus.Handler {
83		return func(ctx context.Context, topic string, payload any) {
84			defer func() {
85				if rec := recover(); rec != nil {
86					log.Error("platformops bus handler panic",
87						slog.String("topic", topic), slog.Any("panic", rec))
88				}
89			}()
90			reaction(ctx, payload)
91		}
92	}

17	}
18	
19	// newHandler wires the handler.
20	func newHandler(svc *service) *handler {
21		return &handler{svc: svc}
22	}

24	// recordQCResult handles POST /quality/qc-results.
25	func (h *handler) recordQCResult(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
26		actor, ok := auth.ActorFrom(r.Context())
27		if !ok {
28			httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Unauthorized("authentication required"))
29			return
30		}
31	
32		var req RecordQCResultRequest
33		if err := httpx.DecodeJSON(r, &req); err != nil {

50	// validateRecordRequest checks required fields and test shape.
51	func validateRecordRequest(req RecordQCResultRequest) error {
52		if strings.TrimSpace(req.SubjectType) == "" {
53			return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_SUBJECT_TYPE", "subject_type is required")
54		}
55		if req.SubjectID.IsZero() {
56			return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_SUBJECT_ID", "subject_id is required")
57		}
58		if strings.TrimSpace(req.Stage) == "" {
59			return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_STAGE", "stage is required")
60		}
61		if len(req.Tests) == 0 {
62			return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_TESTS", "at least one test is required")
63		}
64		for i, t := range req.Tests {
65			if strings.TrimSpace(t.Name) == "" {
66				return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_TEST_NAME", "tests["+strconv.Itoa(i)+"].name is required")
67			}
68			if t.Value < 0 {
69				return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_TEST_VALUE", "tests["+strconv.Itoa(i)+"].value must not be negative")
70			}
71		}
72		return nil
73	}

166	// parseTimeParam accepts RFC3339 or plain YYYY-MM-DD (empty → nil). Date-only
167	// values mean UTC midnight; with endOfDay they cover the whole day, so
168	// ?to=2026-07-06 is inclusive of the 6th.
169	func parseTimeParam(value string, endOfDay bool) (*time.Time, error) {
170		if value == "" {
171			return nil, nil
172		}
173		if t, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, value); err == nil {
174			t = t.UTC()
175			return &t, nil
176		}
177		t, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", value)
178		if err != nil {
179			return nil, err
180		}
181		if endOfDay {
182			t = t.Add(24*time.Hour - time.Nanosecond)
183		}
184		t = t.UTC()
185		return &t, nil
186	}

22	// service holds the safety-gate business logic (blueprint §8.3): evaluate
23	// tests against FSSAI limits, write the verdict onto the subject, chain the
24	// provenance events, and broadcast blocks to downstream modules.
25	type service struct {
26		deps *deps.Deps
27		repo *repository
28		log  *slog.Logger
29	}
30	
31	// newService wires the service with its module-scoped logger.
32	func newService(d *deps.Deps, repo *repository, log *slog.Logger) *service {
33		return &service{deps: d, repo: repo, log: log}
34	}
35	
36	// actorID parses the actor's party ObjectID out of its JWT hex string.
37	func actorID(actor auth.Actor) (primitive.ObjectID, error) {
38		return httpx.ParseID(actor.PartyID, "actor")
39	}
40	
41	// gateSubject is what the gate needs to know about an eligible subject.
42	type gateSubject struct {
43		entityType string             // provenance entity const for the subject
44		orgUnitID  primitive.ObjectID // owning org unit (BMC or plant) for scope + ledger
45		status     string
46	}
47	
48	// requiredRoleForStage returns the one role allowed to record results at a
49	// stage (BMC_RAPID↔BMC_OPERATOR, PLANT_LAB↔PLANT_LAB_ANALYST), and whether
50	// the stage is known at all.
51	func requiredRoleForStage(stage string) (string, bool) {
52		switch stage {
53		case domain.QCStageBMCRapid:
54			return domain.RoleBMCOperator, true
55		case domain.QCStagePlantLab:
56			return domain.RolePlantLabAnalyst, true
57		default:
58			return "", false
59		}
60	}
61	
62	// certificateNumber builds the human-readable QC certificate identifier from
63	// the per-stage counter, e.g. "QC-PLANT_LAB-000042".
64	func certificateNumber(stage string, seq int64) string {
65		return fmt.Sprintf("QC-%s-%06d", stage, seq)
66	}
67	
68	// knownQCTests is the closed vocabulary of recordable test names: the four
69	// gated FSSAI tests plus the explicitly whitelisted grading tests. Anything
70	// else (including a typo like "AFLATOXIN_M") is rejected instead of being
71	// silently recorded as a non-gating pass.
72	var knownQCTests = map[string]struct{}{
73		domain.TestAflatoxinM1: {},
74		domain.TestColiform:    {},
75		domain.TestAntibiotic:  {},
76		domain.TestPhosphatase: {},
77		domain.TestTPC:         {},
78		domain.TestFat:         {},
79		domain.TestSNF:         {},
80	}
81	
82	// mandatoryTestsForStage returns the tests a stage MUST measure before a PASS
83	// verdict may be issued (blueprint §8.3: heat-stable aflatoxin M1 is gated at
84	// BMC and plant; phosphatase proves pasteurisation at the plant lab).
85	func mandatoryTestsForStage(stage string) []string {
86		switch stage {
87		case domain.QCStageBMCRapid:
88			return []string{domain.TestAflatoxinM1, domain.TestColiform}
89		case domain.QCStagePlantLab:
90			return []string{domain.TestAflatoxinM1, domain.TestColiform, domain.TestPhosphatase}
91		default:
92			return nil
93		}
94	}
95	
96	// validateTestNames rejects any test outside the known vocabulary.
97	func validateTestNames(tests []QCTestInput) *httpx.AppError {
98		for _, t := range tests {
99			if _, ok := knownQCTests[t.Name]; !ok {
100				return httpx.BadRequest("UNKNOWN_TEST",
101					"unknown test name "+t.Name+" — gated tests: "+domain.TestAflatoxinM1+", "+
102						domain.TestColiform+", "+domain.TestAntibiotic+", "+domain.TestPhosphatase)
103			}
104		}
105		return nil
106	}
107	
108	// missingMandatoryTests lists the stage's mandatory tests absent from the
109	// submission.
110	func missingMandatoryTests(stage string, tests []QCTestInput) []string {
111		present := make(map[string]bool, len(tests))
112		for _, t := range tests {
113			present[t.Name] = true
114		}
115		var missing []string
116		for _, name := range mandatoryTestsForStage(stage) {
117			if !present[name] {
118				missing = append(missing, name)
119			}
120		}
121		return missing
122	}
123	
124	// recordQCResult evaluates the submitted tests against the FSSAI gate,
125	// persists the result, applies the PASSED/BLOCKED verdict to the subject and
126	// chains the provenance events. This is the only write path that moves a
127	// subject out of QC_PENDING.
128	func (s *service) recordQCResult(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req RecordQCResultRequest) (*domain.QCResult, error) {
129		// Stage×role pairing — RequireRoles admits both analyst roles, the exact
130		// pairing is enforced here.
131		requiredRole, ok := requiredRoleForStage(req.Stage)
132		if !ok {
133			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_STAGE", "stage must be "+domain.QCStageBMCRapid+" or "+domain.QCStagePlantLab)
134		}
135		if actor.RoleCode != requiredRole {
136			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qc stage-role mismatch rejected",
137				slog.String("stage", req.Stage),
138				slog.String("required_role", requiredRole),
139				slog.String("actor_role", actor.RoleCode),
140				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
141				slog.String("subject_type", req.SubjectType),
142				slog.String("subject_id", req.SubjectID.Hex()))
143			return nil, httpx.Forbidden("STAGE_ROLE_MISMATCH: stage " + req.Stage + " results may only be recorded by " + requiredRole)
144		}
145	
146		analystID, err := actorID(actor)
147		if err != nil {
148			return nil, err
149		}
150	
151		subject, err := s.loadGateSubject(ctx, req.SubjectType, req.SubjectID)
152		if err != nil {
153			var appErr *httpx.AppError
154			if errors.As(err, &appErr) && appErr.Status == http.StatusConflict {
155				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qc subject not awaiting verdict",
156					slog.String("subject_type", req.SubjectType),
157					slog.String("subject_id", req.SubjectID.Hex()),
158					slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
159					slog.String("reason", appErr.Error()))
160			}
161			return nil, err
162		}
163		if err := s.deps.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, subject.orgUnitID); err != nil {
164			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qc scope denied",
165				slog.String("subject_type", req.SubjectType),
166				slog.String("subject_id", req.SubjectID.Hex()),
167				slog.String("subject_org_unit_id", subject.orgUnitID.Hex()),
168				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
169				slog.Any("err", err))
170			return nil, err
171		}
172	
173		// Closed test vocabulary: a typo'd or irrelevant test name must never be
174		// able to satisfy the safety gate.
175		if aerr := validateTestNames(req.Tests); aerr != nil {
176			return nil, aerr
177		}
178	
179		// Evaluate against the FSSAI limits (domain owns the rules).
180		overallPass, failures, evaluated := domain.EvaluateQCTests(toDomainTests(req.Tests))
181	
182		// A PASS verdict requires every mandatory test of the stage to be present
183		// AND within limits — the gate cannot be satisfied by a contentless
184		// submission (blueprint §8.3). A failing partial submission still records
185		// its BLOCK: quarantining on partial evidence is safety-conservative.
186		if missing := missingMandatoryTests(req.Stage, req.Tests); len(missing) > 0 && overallPass {
187			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qc pass rejected: mandatory tests missing",
188				slog.String("stage", req.Stage),
189				slog.String("subject_type", req.SubjectType),
190				slog.String("subject_id", req.SubjectID.Hex()),
191				slog.Any("missing_tests", missing),
192				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
193			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("MISSING_MANDATORY_TESTS",
194				"stage "+req.Stage+" cannot PASS without its mandatory tests").
195				WithDetails(map[string]any{"missing_tests": missing})
196		}
197	
198		// Pre-generate the result ID so the insert, the provenance refs and the
199		// gate write all share one consistent identifier.
200		resultID := primitive.NewObjectID()
201		now := time.Now().UTC()
202	
203		result := &domain.QCResult{
204			ID:             resultID,
205			SubjectType:    req.SubjectType,
206			SubjectID:      req.SubjectID,
207			Stage:          req.Stage,
208			Tests:          evaluated,
209			OverallPass:    overallPass,
210			AnalystPartyID: analystID,
211			LabRef:         req.LabRef,
212			RecordedAt:     now,
213		}
214	
215		// The write sequence below must not be aborted midway by a client
216		// disconnect: detach from the request context, keep a server-side bound.
217		wctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.WithoutCancel(ctx), 15*time.Second)
218		defer cancel()
219	
220		blockReason := ""
221		if overallPass {
222			seq, err := s.repo.nextCertificateSeq(wctx, req.Stage)
223			if err != nil {
224				s.logInternal(ctx, "issue qc certificate seq", req, err)
225				return nil, err
226			}
227			result.CertificateNumber = certificateNumber(req.Stage, seq)
228		} else {
229			result.FailureReasons = failures
230			blockReason = strings.Join(failures, "; ")
231		}
232	
233		// Ordering is safety-critical: evidence (qc_results doc) and provenance
234		// (hash-chained events) are persisted FIRST; the irreversible status flip
235		// on the subject happens LAST. A crash mid-sequence can leave an extra
236		// auditable result document, never a PASSED lot without evidence.
237		if err := s.repo.insertResult(wctx, result); err != nil {
238			s.logInternal(ctx, "insert qc result", req, err)
239			return nil, err
240		}
241	
242		// Provenance: qc.recorded, then the gate verdict event (blueprint §7).
243		ledgerActor := provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode}
244		recorded, err := s.deps.Ledger.Append(wctx, provenance.AppendInput{
245			Type:       domain.EventQCRecorded,
246			EntityType: domain.EntityQCResult,
247			EntityID:   resultID.Hex(),
248			Refs: []provenance.Ref{
249				{EntityType: subject.entityType, EntityID: req.SubjectID.Hex(), Relation: "tested"},
250			},
251			Actor:     ledgerActor,
252			OrgUnitID: subject.orgUnitID.Hex(),
253			Payload: map[string]any{
254				"stage":        req.Stage,
255				"subject_type": req.SubjectType,
256				"overall_pass": overallPass,
257			},
258		})
259		if err != nil {
260			s.logInternal(ctx, "append qc.recorded provenance event", req, err)
261			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
262		}
263	
264		gateEvent := provenance.AppendInput{
265			EntityType: domain.EntityQCResult,
266			EntityID:   resultID.Hex(),
267			Actor:      ledgerActor,
268			OrgUnitID:  subject.orgUnitID.Hex(),
269		}
270		if overallPass {
271			gateEvent.Type = domain.EventGatePassed
272			gateEvent.Refs = []provenance.Ref{
273				{EntityType: subject.entityType, EntityID: req.SubjectID.Hex(), Relation: "certifies"},
274			}
275			gateEvent.Payload = map[string]any{"certificate_number": result.CertificateNumber}
276		} else {
277			gateEvent.Type = domain.EventGateBlocked
278			gateEvent.Refs = []provenance.Ref{
279				{EntityType: subject.entityType, EntityID: req.SubjectID.Hex(), Relation: "blocks"},
280			}
281			gateEvent.Payload = map[string]any{"failure_reasons": failures}
282		}
283		if _, err := s.deps.Ledger.Append(wctx, gateEvent); err != nil {
284			s.logInternal(ctx, "append gate verdict provenance event", req, err)
285			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
286		}
287	
288		if err := s.repo.setResultProvenanceSeq(wctx, resultID, recorded.Seq); err != nil {
289			s.logInternal(ctx, "stamp qc result provenance seq", req, err)
290			return nil, err
291		}
292		result.ProvenanceSeq = recorded.Seq
293	
294		// LAST: apply the verdict. The conditional QC_PENDING filter remains the
295		// concurrency guard — a lost race voids OUR result (dangling evidence is
296		// auditable and harmless, unlike a dangling status flip).
297		gated, err := s.applyGate(wctx, req.SubjectType, req.SubjectID, resultID, overallPass, blockReason)
298		if err != nil {
299			s.logInternal(ctx, "apply gate verdict", req, err)
300			return nil, err
301		}
302		if !gated {
303			if err := s.repo.markResultSuperseded(wctx, resultID); err != nil {
304				s.logInternal(ctx, "mark qc result superseded", req, err)
305				return nil, err
306			}
307			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qc gate race lost: result superseded",
308				slog.String("qc_result_id", resultID.Hex()),
309				slog.String("subject_type", req.SubjectType),
310				slog.String("subject_id", req.SubjectID.Hex()),
311				slog.String("stage", req.Stage),
312				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
313			return nil, httpx.Conflict("SUBJECT_ALREADY_GATED", "subject is no longer awaiting QC — a verdict was already recorded")
314		}
315	
316		if overallPass {
317			s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "qc gate passed",
318				slog.String("qc_result_id", resultID.Hex()),
319				slog.String("subject_type", req.SubjectType),
320				slog.String("subject_id", req.SubjectID.Hex()),
321				slog.String("stage", req.Stage),
322				slog.String("certificate_number", result.CertificateNumber),
323				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
324		} else {
325			// Gate block is a WARN: the subject is quarantined and can never advance.
326			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qc gate blocked: subject quarantined",
327				slog.String("qc_result_id", resultID.Hex()),
328				slog.String("subject_type", req.SubjectType),
329				slog.String("subject_id", req.SubjectID.Hex()),
330				slog.String("stage", req.Stage),
331				slog.Any("failure_reasons", failures),
332				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
333			// Broadcast the block so the plant module quarantines downstream — a
334			// blocked lot can never advance.
335			s.deps.Bus.Publish(eventbus.TopicGateBlocked, GateBlockedPayload{
336				SubjectType:    req.SubjectType,
337				SubjectID:      req.SubjectID,
338				QCResultID:     resultID,
339				Stage:          req.Stage,
340				FailureReasons: failures,
341			})
342		}
343		return result, nil
344	}
345	
346	// logInternal records an unexpected failure with the operation and subject
347	// context before the error surfaces as a 500.
348	func (s *service) logInternal(ctx context.Context, op string, req RecordQCResultRequest, err error) {
349		s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "qc record failed: "+op,
350			slog.String("subject_type", req.SubjectType),
351			slog.String("subject_id", req.SubjectID.Hex()),
352			slog.String("stage", req.Stage),
353			slog.Any("err", err))
354	}
355	
356	// loadGateSubject fetches a gate-eligible subject and verifies it is awaiting
357	// QC. Only BMC lots and processing batches carry the software safety gate.
358	func (s *service) loadGateSubject(ctx context.Context, subjectType string, subjectID primitive.ObjectID) (gateSubject, error) {
359		switch subjectType {
360		case domain.QCSubjectBMCLot:
361			lot, err := s.repo.findBMCLot(ctx, subjectID)
362			if err != nil {
363				return gateSubject{}, err
364			}
365			if lot.Status != domain.BMCLotStatusQCPending {
366				return gateSubject{}, httpx.Conflict("SUBJECT_NOT_QC_PENDING", "bmc lot is in status "+lot.Status+" — only QC_PENDING subjects can be gated")
367			}
368			return gateSubject{entityType: domain.EntityBMCLot, orgUnitID: lot.BMCID, status: lot.Status}, nil
369	
370		case domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch:
371			batch, err := s.repo.findBatch(ctx, subjectID)
372			if err != nil {
373				return gateSubject{}, err
374			}
375			if batch.Status != domain.BatchStatusQCPending {
376				return gateSubject{}, httpx.Conflict("SUBJECT_NOT_QC_PENDING", "processing batch is in status "+batch.Status+" — only QC_PENDING subjects can be gated")
377			}
378			return gateSubject{entityType: domain.EntityBatch, orgUnitID: batch.PlantID, status: batch.Status}, nil
379	
380		case domain.QCSubjectDCSConsignment:
381			return gateSubject{}, httpx.Unprocessable("SUBJECT_NOT_GATE_ELIGIBLE", "DCS consignments are not gate subjects — gate at the BMC lot or processing batch")
382	
383		default:
384			return gateSubject{}, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_SUBJECT_TYPE", "subject_type must be one of "+domain.QCSubjectBMCLot+", "+domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch)
385		}
386	}
387	
388	// applyGate routes the conditional verdict write to the subject's collection,
389	// mapping the verdict onto that subject kind's status constants.
390	func (s *service) applyGate(ctx context.Context, subjectType string, subjectID, resultID primitive.ObjectID, pass bool, blockReason string) (bool, error) {
391		switch subjectType {
392		case domain.QCSubjectBMCLot:
393			status := domain.BMCLotStatusBlocked
394			if pass {
395				status = domain.BMCLotStatusPassed
396			}
397			return s.repo.gateBMCLot(ctx, subjectID, resultID, status, blockReason)
398		case domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch:
399			status := domain.BatchStatusBlocked
400			if pass {
401				status = domain.BatchStatusPassed
402			}
403			return s.repo.gateBatch(ctx, subjectID, resultID, status, blockReason)
404		default:
405			return false, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_SUBJECT_TYPE", "subject_type is not gate-eligible")
406		}
407	}
408	
409	// listQCResults returns a page of results, newest first. When the filter
410	// identifies an org-owned subject, the caller must be in that org's scope.
411	// A zero subjectID means "no subject filter".
412	func (s *service) listQCResults(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, subjectType string, subjectID primitive.ObjectID, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.QCResult, int64, error) {
413		if subjectType != "" && !isValidSubjectType(subjectType) {
414			return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_SUBJECT_TYPE", "unknown subject_type "+subjectType)
415		}
416		if !subjectID.IsZero() && subjectType == "" {
417			return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_SUBJECT_TYPE", "subject_id requires subject_type")
418		}
419		if !subjectID.IsZero() {
420			if err := s.requireSubjectScope(ctx, actor, subjectType, subjectID); err != nil {
421				return nil, 0, err
422			}
423		}
424		return s.repo.listResults(ctx, subjectType, subjectID, page)
425	}
426	
427	// getQCResult returns one result (its tests carry the stored pass verdicts),
428	// enforcing the subject org scope.
429	func (s *service) getQCResult(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, resultID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.QCResult, error) {
430		result, err := s.repo.findResultByID(ctx, resultID)
431		if err != nil {
432			return nil, err
433		}
434		if err := s.requireSubjectScope(ctx, actor, result.SubjectType, result.SubjectID); err != nil {
435			return nil, err
436		}
437		return result, nil
438	}
439	
440	// requireSubjectScope enforces the caller's org scope over the org unit that
441	// owns a QC subject. Subjects that no longer resolve (or subject types that
442	// carry no org) skip the check — the role gate still applies.
443	func (s *service) requireSubjectScope(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, subjectType string, subjectID primitive.ObjectID) error {
444		orgID, err := s.subjectOrgUnit(ctx, subjectType, subjectID)
445		if err != nil {
446			return err
447		}
448		if orgID.IsZero() {
449			return nil
450		}
451		if err := s.deps.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, orgID); err != nil {
452			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qc read scope denied",
453				slog.String("subject_type", subjectType),
454				slog.String("subject_id", subjectID.Hex()),
455				slog.String("subject_org_unit_id", orgID.Hex()),
456				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
457				slog.Any("err", err))
458			return err
459		}
460		return nil
461	}
462	
463	// subjectOrgUnit resolves the owning org unit of a subject, or the zero
464	// ObjectID when the subject is missing or not an org-owned gate subject.
465	func (s *service) subjectOrgUnit(ctx context.Context, subjectType string, subjectID primitive.ObjectID) (primitive.ObjectID, error) {
466		switch subjectType {
467		case domain.QCSubjectBMCLot:
468			lot, err := s.repo.findBMCLot(ctx, subjectID)
469			if err != nil {
470				return primitive.NilObjectID, ignoreNotFound(err)
471			}
472			return lot.BMCID, nil
473		case domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch:
474			batch, err := s.repo.findBatch(ctx, subjectID)
475			if err != nil {
476				return primitive.NilObjectID, ignoreNotFound(err)
477			}
478			return batch.PlantID, nil
479		default:
480			return primitive.NilObjectID, nil
481		}
482	}
483	
484	// ignoreNotFound swallows 404 AppErrors and passes everything else through.
485	func ignoreNotFound(err error) error {
486		var appErr *httpx.AppError
487		if errors.As(err, &appErr) && appErr.Status == http.StatusNotFound {
488			return nil
489		}
490		return err
491	}
492	
493	// isValidSubjectType reports whether t is a known QC subject type.
494	func isValidSubjectType(t string) bool {
495		switch t {
496		case domain.QCSubjectDCSConsignment, domain.QCSubjectBMCLot, domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch:
497			return true
498		default:
499			return false
500		}
501	}
502	
503	// toDomainTests converts request test inputs to domain tests for evaluation.
504	func toDomainTests(in []QCTestInput) []domain.QCTest {
505		out := make([]domain.QCTest, 0, len(in))
506		for _, t := range in {
507			out = append(out, domain.QCTest{Name: t.Name, Value: t.Value, Unit: t.Unit})
508		}
509		return out
510	}
511	
512	// limits returns the FSSAI gate constants (blueprint §8.3) as reference data.

1	package platformops
