20		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
21	)
22	
23	// exportMaxRows caps the immutable audit export (§12) — bounded by contract.
24	const exportMaxRows = 5000
25	
26	// workerClaimCap bounds one mock-SMS worker run to 100 claims.
27	const workerClaimCap = 100
28	
29	// settableFlagKeys is the closed set of PUT-able feature flags. Capability
30	// gating is a deliberate act, not a free-text store (blueprint principle #6):
31	// an unknown key is NotFound, never an implicit insert.
32	var settableFlagKeys = map[string]struct{}{
33		flags.FlagCollarTelemetry:  {},
34		flags.FlagPhotoOCR:         {},
35		flags.FlagONDC:             {},
36		flags.FlagConsumerCommerce: {},
37	}
38	
39	// service holds all platformops business logic.
40	type service struct {
41		deps *deps.Deps
42		repo *repository
43		log  *slog.Logger
44	}
45	
46	// newService wires the service with its module-scoped logger.
47	func newService(d *deps.Deps, repo *repository, log *slog.Logger) *service {
48		return &service{deps: d, repo: repo, log: log}
49	}
50	
51	// ---- Admin: feature flags (§12) ----
52	
53	// listFlags returns every stored feature flag for the admin console.
54	func (s *service) listFlags(ctx context.Context) ([]flags.Flag, error) {
55		all, err := s.deps.Flags.All(ctx)
56		if err != nil {
57			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("list feature flags: %w", err))
58		}
59		if all == nil {
60			all = []flags.Flag{}
61		}
62		return all, nil
63	}
64	
65	// setFlag flips one well-known feature flag and writes the explicit
66	// "admin.flag_set" audit entry.
67	func (s *service) setFlag(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, key string, enabled bool) (*SetFlagResponse, error) {
68		if _, ok := settableFlagKeys[key]; !ok {
69			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "feature flag set rejected: unknown key",
70				slog.String("key", key), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
71			return nil, httpx.NotFound("feature flag " + key)
72		}
73		if err := s.deps.Flags.Set(ctx, key, enabled, actor.PartyID); err != nil {
74			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "set feature flag failed",
75				slog.String("key", key), slog.Any("err", err))
76			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("set feature flag: %w", err))
77		}
78		s.deps.Audit.Record(ctx, audit.Entry{
79			Action:     "admin.flag_set",
80			TargetType: "FEATURE_FLAG",
81			TargetID:   key,
82			Meta:       map[string]any{"key": key, "enabled": enabled},
83		})
84		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "feature flag set",
85			slog.String("key", key), slog.Bool("enabled", enabled),
86			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
87		return &SetFlagResponse{Key: key, Enabled: enabled}, nil
88	}
89	
90	// ---- Auditor: read-only audit-log surface (§12) ----
91	
92	// listAuditLogs returns a page of audit entries, newest first.
93	func (s *service) listAuditLogs(ctx context.Context, f auditLogFilter, page httpx.Page) ([]audit.Entry, int64, error) {
94		return s.repo.listAuditLogs(ctx, f, page)
95	}
96	
97	// exportAuditLogs assembles the capped attachment body for the GIGW/DPDP
98	// immutable audit export.
99	func (s *service) exportAuditLogs(ctx context.Context, from, to *time.Time) (*AuditExport, error) {
100		entries, err := s.repo.exportAuditLogs(ctx, auditLogFilter{From: from, To: to}, exportMaxRows)
101		if err != nil {
102			return nil, err
103		}
104		return &AuditExport{
105			ExportedAt: time.Now().UTC(),
106			From:       from,
107			To:         to,
108			Count:      len(entries),
109			Entries:    entries,
110		}, nil
111	}
112	
113	// ---- Notifications outbox + mock SMS worker (§12, §13) ----
114	
115	// listNotifications returns a page of outbox documents with credential
116	// material redacted: the login OTP must never be readable through the
117	// outbox surface, or anyone with this route could mint any user's session
118	// (request OTP for the victim's phone, read it here, verify).
119	func (s *service) listNotifications(ctx context.Context, phone, status string, page httpx.Page) ([]StoredNotification, int64, error) {
120		items, total, err := s.repo.listNotifications(ctx, phone, status, page)
121		if err != nil {
122			return nil, 0, err
123		}
124		for i := range items {
125			redactNotificationSecrets(&items[i])
126		}
127		// Bulk-PII read (every party's phone + template params): audited for DPDP
128		// forensics, mirroring support.pii_lookup and kyc.pending_list.
129		s.deps.Audit.Record(ctx, audit.Entry{
130			Action:     "admin.notifications_read",
131			TargetType: "NOTIFICATION",
132			Meta: map[string]any{
133				"phone_filter":  phone,
134				"status_filter": status,
135				"count":         len(items),
136				"total":         total,
137			},
138		})
139		return items, total, nil
140	}
141	
142	// redactedValue replaces credential material in read surfaces.
143	const redactedValue = "[REDACTED]"
144	
145	// redactNotificationSecrets strips the plaintext OTP (params + rendered meta)
146	// from an outbox document before it leaves the API.
147	func redactNotificationSecrets(n *StoredNotification) {
148		if n.TemplateKey != domain.TemplateOTP {
149			return
150		}
151		if n.Params != nil {
152			params := make(map[string]string, len(n.Params))
153			for k, v := range n.Params {
154				if k == "otp" {
155					v = redactedValue
156				}
157				params[k] = v
158			}
159			n.Params = params
160		}
161		if n.Meta != nil {
162			meta := make(map[string]any, len(n.Meta))
163			for k, v := range n.Meta {
164				if k == "rendered_en" || k == "rendered_hi" {
165					v = redactedValue
166				}
167				meta[k] = v
168			}
169			n.Meta = meta
170		}
171	}
172	
173	// runWorker is the MOCK SMS provider dispatch (real deployment: MSG91 /
174	// telecom DLT gateway, §13). It claims up to workerClaimCap QUEUED documents
175	// via a race-safe FindOneAndUpdate loop, stamps each SENT with a mock
176	// provider reference, and renders the English/Hindi lines into meta for
177	// visibility. The manual trigger keeps the demo deterministic; production
178	// runs this as a cron/queue consumer.
179	func (s *service) runWorker(ctx context.Context) (*WorkerRunResponse, error) {
180		sent := 0
181		for i := 0; i < workerClaimCap; i++ {
182			providerRef := "SMS-MOCK-" + uuid.NewString()[0:8]
183			claimed, err := s.repo.claimQueuedNotification(ctx, providerRef, time.Now().UTC())
184			if err != nil {
185				s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "claim queued notification failed", slog.Any("err", err))
186				return nil, err
187			}
188			if claimed == nil {
189				break // queue drained
190			}
191			sent++
192	
193			english, hindi := renderSMS(claimed.TemplateKey, claimed.Params)
194			if claimed.TemplateKey == domain.TemplateOTP {
195				// Never persist the rendered OTP text — the provider gets the
196				// message transiently; the readable outbox keeps no plaintext code.
197				english, hindi = redactedValue, redactedValue
198			}
199			meta := map[string]any{
200				"provider":    "SMS-MOCK",
201				"rendered_en": english,
202				"rendered_hi": hindi,
203			}
204			if err := s.repo.setNotificationMeta(ctx, claimed.ID, meta); err != nil {
205				// The claim already succeeded — meta is cosmetic, log and move on.
206				s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "stamp notification meta failed",
207					slog.String("notification_id", claimed.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
208			}
209			s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "notification dispatched",
210				slog.String("notification_id", claimed.ID.Hex()),
211				slog.String("template_key", claimed.TemplateKey),
212				slog.String("provider_ref", providerRef),
213				slog.String("status", domain.NotificationSent))
214		}
215		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "notification worker run complete", slog.Int("sent", sent))
216		return &WorkerRunResponse{Sent: sent}, nil
217	}
218	
219	// renderSMS produces one simple English and one Hindi line per template key —
220	// mock rendering for visibility; real templates live with the DLT-registered
221	// provider (§13). Missing params render as empty strings, never a panic.
222	func renderSMS(templateKey string, params map[string]string) (english, hindi string) {
223		p := func(key string) string { return params[key] } // nil-map reads are safe
224	
225		switch templateKey {
226		case domain.TemplatePayoutCredited:
227			return fmt.Sprintf("Rs %s credited to your bank account. UTR %s. - Saathi", p("amount"), p("utr")),
228				fmt.Sprintf("₹%s आपके बैंक खाते में जमा हुए। UTR %s। - साथी", p("amount"), p("utr"))
229		case domain.TemplateSafetyBlock:
230			return fmt.Sprintf("SAFETY ALERT: %s %s blocked at %s. Reasons: %s. Quarantine and inspect immediately. - Saathi",
231					p("subject_type"), p("subject_id"), p("stage"), p("reasons")),
232				fmt.Sprintf("सुरक्षा चेतावनी: %s %s को %s पर रोका गया। कारण: %s। तुरंत जांच करें। - साथी",
233					p("subject_type"), p("subject_id"), p("stage"), p("reasons"))
234		case domain.TemplateMVUDispatched:
235			return fmt.Sprintf("MVU 1962 van dispatched for your animal (case %s). Please stay reachable. - Saathi", p("case_id")),
236				fmt.Sprintf("आपके पशु के लिए 1962 एमवीयू वैन रवाना (केस %s)। कृपया संपर्क में रहें। - साथी", p("case_id"))
237		case domain.TemplatePourReceipt:
238			return fmt.Sprintf("%sL @ Rs %s = Rs %s credited to today's bill. - Saathi", p("quantity"), p("rate"), p("amount")),
239				fmt.Sprintf("%s लीटर @ ₹%s = ₹%s आज के बिल में जुड़े। - साथी", p("quantity"), p("rate"), p("amount"))
240		case domain.TemplateInvoiceIssued:
241			return fmt.Sprintf("Invoice %s for Rs %s issued. - Saathi", p("invoice_number"), p("amount")),
242				fmt.Sprintf("₹%s का बिल %s जारी हुआ। - साथी", p("amount"), p("invoice_number"))
243		case domain.TemplateKYCApproved:
244			return fmt.Sprintf("KYC approved — tier %s unlocked. - Saathi", p("tier")),

246		case domain.TemplateKYCRejected:

249		case domain.TemplateKYCPending:

251				fmt.Sprintf("%s (टियर %s) का KYC सत्यापन लंबित — साथी में समीक्षा करें।", p("subject"), p("tier"))
252		case domain.TemplateOTP:
253			return fmt.Sprintf("Your Saathi OTP is %s. Do not share it with anyone.", p("otp")),
254				fmt.Sprintf("आपका साथी OTP %s है। इसे किसी से साझा न करें।", p("otp"))
255		default:
256			return "Saathi update: " + templateKey, "साथी सूचना: " + templateKey
257		}
258	}
259	
260	// ---- Support: audited limited-PII lookup (§5.2 role 20) ----
261	
262	// lookupParty resolves a phone to the limited support view. EVERY call —
263	// hit or miss — is recorded as "support.pii_lookup": PII access is audited,
264	// full stop.
265	func (s *service) lookupParty(ctx context.Context, phone string) (*PartyLookupResponse, error) {
266		party, findErr := s.repo.findPartyByPhone(ctx, phone)
267	
268		entry := audit.Entry{
269			Action:     "support.pii_lookup",
270			TargetType: "PARTY",
271			Meta:       map[string]any{"phone": phone, "found": findErr == nil},
272		}
273		if findErr == nil {
274			entry.TargetID = party.ID.Hex()
275		}
276		s.deps.Audit.Record(ctx, entry)
277	
278		if findErr != nil {
279			return nil, findErr
280		}
281	
282		assignments, err := s.repo.listActiveAssignmentsForParty(ctx, party.ID)
283		if err != nil {
284			return nil, err
285		}
286		now := time.Now().UTC()
287		roles := []PartyRoleView{}
288		for _, assignment := range assignments {
289			if !assignment.UsableAt(now) {
290				continue
291			}
292			orgName := ""
293			if org, orgErr := s.deps.Orgs.Get(ctx, assignment.OrgUnitID); orgErr == nil {
294				orgName = org.Name
295			}
296			roles = append(roles, PartyRoleView{
297				RoleCode:  assignment.RoleCode,
298				OrgUnitID: assignment.OrgUnitID.Hex(),
299				OrgName:   orgName,
300			})
301		}
302	
303		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "support party lookup",
304			slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()), slog.Int("roles", len(roles)))
305	
306		// Limited PII by construction: no KYC document numbers, no bank details.
307		return &PartyLookupResponse{
308			PartyID:  party.ID.Hex(),
309			FullName: party.FullName,
310			KYCTier:  party.KYCTier,
311			Status:   party.Status,
312			Roles:    roles,
313		}, nil
314	}
315	
316	// ---- Event-bus reactions: cross-module SMS queuing ----
317	
318	// decodeBusPayload structurally re-decodes a bus payload into this module's
319	// mirror struct — modules never import each other's types (module contract).
320	func decodeBusPayload(payload any, dst any) error {
321		raw, err := json.Marshal(payload)
322		if err != nil {
323			return fmt.Errorf("marshal bus payload: %w", err)
324		}
325		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, dst); err != nil {
326			return fmt.Errorf("unmarshal bus payload: %w", err)
327		}
328		return nil
329	}
330	
331	// onPayoutCredited queues the "₹ credited, UTR …" SMS to the farmer
332	// (blueprint §8.1 last step).
333	func (s *service) onPayoutCredited(ctx context.Context, payload any) {
334		var event payoutCreditedEvent
335		if err := decodeBusPayload(payload, &event); err != nil {
336			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "bad payout.credited payload", slog.Any("err", err))
337			return
338		}
339		if event.FarmerPartyID == "" && event.Phone == "" {
340			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "payout.credited payload has no addressee")
341			return
342		}
343		partyID := s.parseAddresseeID(ctx, event.FarmerPartyID, "payout.credited")
344		s.queueNotification(ctx, partyID, event.Phone, domain.TemplatePayoutCredited, map[string]string{
345			"amount": strconv.FormatFloat(event.Amount, 'f', 2, 64),
346			"utr":    event.UTR,
347		})
348	}
349	
350	// onGateBlocked alerts the blocked subject's UNION_FIELD_SUPERVISOR(s): the
351	// subject's org unit is resolved from its document, walked up to the union
352	// ancestor, and every usable supervisor assignment there gets the safety SMS.
353	func (s *service) onGateBlocked(ctx context.Context, payload any) {
354		var event gateBlockedEvent
355		if err := decodeBusPayload(payload, &event); err != nil {
356			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "bad qc.gate_blocked payload", slog.Any("err", err))
357			return
358		}
359	
360		subjectID, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(event.SubjectID)
361		if err != nil {
362			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qc.gate_blocked subject id is not an object id",
363				slog.String("subject_type", event.SubjectType), slog.String("subject_id", event.SubjectID))
364			return
365		}
366		orgUnitID, err := s.repo.subjectOrgUnit(ctx, event.SubjectType, subjectID)
367		if err != nil {
368			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "gate_blocked org resolution failed",
369				slog.String("subject_type", event.SubjectType),
370				slog.String("subject_id", subjectID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
371			return
372		}
373		union, err := s.unionAncestor(ctx, orgUnitID)
374		if err != nil {
375			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "gate_blocked union walk failed",
376				slog.String("org_unit_id", orgUnitID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
377			return
378		}
379		if union == nil {
380			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "gate_blocked org has no union ancestor",
381				slog.String("org_unit_id", orgUnitID.Hex()))
382			return
383		}
384	
385		supervisors, err := s.repo.listActiveRoleHolders(ctx, union.ID, domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor)
386		if err != nil {
387			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "gate_blocked supervisor lookup failed",
388				slog.String("union_id", union.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
389			return
390		}
391	
392		params := map[string]string{
393			"subject_type": event.SubjectType,
394			"subject_id":   event.SubjectID,
395			"stage":        event.Stage,
396			"reasons":      strings.Join(event.FailureReasons, ", "),
397		}
398		now := time.Now().UTC()
399		notified := map[primitive.ObjectID]bool{}
400		for _, assignment := range supervisors {
401			if !assignment.UsableAt(now) || notified[assignment.PartyID] {
402				continue
403			}
404			notified[assignment.PartyID] = true
405			partyID := assignment.PartyID
406			s.queueNotification(ctx, &partyID, "", domain.TemplateSafetyBlock, params)
407		}
408	}
409	
410	// onMVUDispatched queues the "MVU van on its way" SMS to the farmer (§10).
411	func (s *service) onMVUDispatched(ctx context.Context, payload any) {
412		var event mvuDispatchedEvent
413		if err := decodeBusPayload(payload, &event); err != nil {
414			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "bad mvu.dispatched payload", slog.Any("err", err))
415			return
416		}
417		if event.FarmerPartyID == "" && event.Phone == "" {
418			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "mvu.dispatched payload has no addressee")
419			return
420		}
421		caseID := event.CaseID
422		if caseID == "" {
423			caseID = event.MVUCaseID
424		}
425		if caseID == "" {
426			caseID = event.ID
427		}
428		params := map[string]string{"case_id": caseID}
429		if event.ETA != "" {
430			params["eta"] = event.ETA
431		}
432		partyID := s.parseAddresseeID(ctx, event.FarmerPartyID, "mvu.dispatched")
433		s.queueNotification(ctx, partyID, event.Phone, domain.TemplateMVUDispatched, params)
434	}
435	
436	// parseAddresseeID turns an optional addressee party ObjectID hex string
437	// (carried as a hex string on bus payloads) into a *primitive.ObjectID.
438	// An empty value is a legitimate phone-only addressing (returns nil); a
439	// non-empty but malformed value is a business/contract violation (WARN + nil).
440	func (s *service) parseAddresseeID(ctx context.Context, hex, event string) *primitive.ObjectID {
441		if hex == "" {
442			return nil
443		}
444		id, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(hex)
445		if err != nil {
446			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bus payload party id is not an object id",
447				slog.String("event", event), slog.String("party_id", hex))
448			return nil
449		}
450		return &id
451	}
452	
453	// hexOrEmpty renders an optional ObjectID for logs.
454	func hexOrEmpty(id *primitive.ObjectID) string {
455		if id == nil {
456			return ""
457		}
458		return id.Hex()
459	}
460	
461	// queueNotification inserts one QUEUED outbox document, resolving phone and
462	// preferred language from the party record when available. The _id is
463	// pre-generated so the queued entry can be named in the structured log.
464	// Failures are logged, never propagated — a lost SMS must not fail the
465	// publishing flow.
466	func (s *service) queueNotification(ctx context.Context, partyID *primitive.ObjectID, phone, templateKey string, params map[string]string) {
467		language := "hi" // vernacular default (blueprint §13)
468		if partyID != nil {
469			if party, err := s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, *partyID); err == nil {
470				if phone == "" {
471					phone = party.Phone
472				}
473				if party.PreferredLanguage != "" {
474					language = party.PreferredLanguage
475				}
476			}
477		}
478		if phone == "" {
479			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "dropping notification with no phone",
480				slog.String("template_key", templateKey), slog.String("party_id", hexOrEmpty(partyID)))
481			return
482		}
483	
484		id := primitive.NewObjectID()
485		notification := &StoredNotification{Notification: domain.Notification{
486			ID:          id,
487			PartyID:     partyID,
488			Phone:       phone,
489			Channel:     domain.ChannelSMS,
490			TemplateKey: templateKey,
491			Language:    language,
492			Params:      params,
493			Status:      domain.NotificationQueued,
494			QueuedAt:    time.Now().UTC(),
495		}}
496		if err := s.repo.insertNotification(ctx, notification); err != nil {
497			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "queue notification failed",
498				slog.String("template_key", templateKey), slog.Any("err", err))
499			return
500		}
501		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "notification queued",
502			slog.String("notification_id", id.Hex()),
503			slog.String("template_key", templateKey),
504			slog.String("party_id", hexOrEmpty(partyID)),
505			slog.String("status", domain.NotificationQueued))
506	}
507	
508	// unionAncestor returns the MILK_UNION org unit at or above orgUnitID, walking
509	// the denormalised ancestor Path nearest-first via d.Orgs.Get. Returns nil
510	// when no union sits on the chain (e.g. a plant directly under the federation).
511	func (s *service) unionAncestor(ctx context.Context, orgUnitID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
512		org, err := s.deps.Orgs.Get(ctx, orgUnitID)
513		if err != nil {
514			return nil, err
515		}
516		if org.Type == domain.OrgTypeMilkUnion {
517			return org, nil
518		}
519		// Path holds ancestors root→down; walk nearest ancestor first.
520		for i := len(org.Path) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
521			ancestor, err := s.deps.Orgs.Get(ctx, org.Path[i])
522			if err != nil {
523				return nil, err
524			}
525			if ancestor.Type == domain.OrgTypeMilkUnion {
526				return ancestor, nil
527			}
528		}
529		return nil, nil
530	}

1	package platformops
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"errors"
6		"fmt"
7		"time"
8	
9		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
10		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
11		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
12		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo/options"
13	
14		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/audit"
16		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
17		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/mongodb"
18	)
19	
20	// repository is all MongoDB access for the platformops module. It owns the
21	// notifications outbox, reads audit_logs strictly read-only (writes go
22	// through deps.Audit only — the collection is insert-only by design, §12),
23	// and reads parties / role_assignments for the support lookup and for
24	// addressing safety alerts. bmc_lots / processing_batches are read solely to
25	// resolve a gate-blocked subject back to its org unit.
26	type repository struct {
27		auditLogs     *mongo.Collection
28		notifications *mongo.Collection
29		parties       *mongo.Collection
30		assignments   *mongo.Collection
31		bmcLots       *mongo.Collection
32		batches       *mongo.Collection
33	}
34	
35	// newRepository binds the repository to its collections.
36	func newRepository(db *mongo.Database) *repository {
37		return &repository{
38			auditLogs:     db.Collection(mongodb.CollAuditLogs),
39			notifications: db.Collection(mongodb.CollNotifications),
40			parties:       db.Collection(mongodb.CollParties),
41			assignments:   db.Collection(mongodb.CollRoleAssignments),
42			bmcLots:       db.Collection(mongodb.CollBMCLots),
43			batches:       db.Collection(mongodb.CollBatches),
44		}
45	}
46	
47	// auditFilter builds the bson filter shared by the list and export reads.
48	func auditFilter(f auditLogFilter) bson.D {
49		filter := bson.D{}
50		if f.ActorPartyID != "" {
51			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "actor_party_id", Value: f.ActorPartyID})
52		}
53		if f.TargetType != "" {
54			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "target_type", Value: f.TargetType})
55		}
56		if f.Action != "" {
57			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "action", Value: f.Action})
58		}
59		if f.From != nil || f.To != nil {
60			tsRange := bson.D{}
61			if f.From != nil {
62				tsRange = append(tsRange, bson.E{Key: "$gte", Value: *f.From})
63			}
64			if f.To != nil {
65				tsRange = append(tsRange, bson.E{Key: "$lte", Value: *f.To})
66			}
67			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "ts", Value: tsRange})
68		}
69		return filter
70	}
71	
72	// listAuditLogs returns a page of audit entries, newest first, plus the total
73	// matching count for pagination meta.
74	func (r *repository) listAuditLogs(ctx context.Context, f auditLogFilter, page httpx.Page) ([]audit.Entry, int64, error) {
75		filter := auditFilter(f)
76	
77		total, err := r.auditLogs.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
78		if err != nil {
79			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("count audit logs: %w", err))
80		}
81	
82		cur, err := r.auditLogs.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
83			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "ts", Value: -1}}).
84			SetSkip(page.Offset).
85			SetLimit(page.Limit),
86		)
87		if err != nil {
88			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("list audit logs: %w", err))
89		}
90		entries := []audit.Entry{}
91		if err := cur.All(ctx, &entries); err != nil {
92			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("decode audit logs: %w", err))
93		}
94		return entries, total, nil
95	}
96	
97	// exportAuditLogs returns up to maxRows entries in the window, newest first —
98	// the bounded read behind the immutable audit export (§12).
99	func (r *repository) exportAuditLogs(ctx context.Context, f auditLogFilter, maxRows int64) ([]audit.Entry, error) {
100		cur, err := r.auditLogs.Find(ctx, auditFilter(f), options.Find().
101			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "ts", Value: -1}}).
102			SetLimit(maxRows),
103		)
104		if err != nil {
105			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("export audit logs: %w", err))
106		}
107		entries := []audit.Entry{}
108		if err := cur.All(ctx, &entries); err != nil {
109			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("decode audit log export: %w", err))
110		}
111		return entries, nil
112	}
113	
114	// insertNotification queues one outbox document.
115	func (r *repository) insertNotification(ctx context.Context, n *StoredNotification) error {
116		if _, err := r.notifications.InsertOne(ctx, n); err != nil {
117			return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("insert notification: %w", err))
118		}
119		return nil
120	}
121	
122	// listNotifications returns a page of outbox documents, newest first,
123	// optionally filtered by phone and status.
124	func (r *repository) listNotifications(ctx context.Context, phone, status string, page httpx.Page) ([]StoredNotification, int64, error) {
125		filter := bson.D{}
126		if phone != "" {
127			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "phone", Value: phone})
128		}
129		if status != "" {
130			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "status", Value: status})
131		}
132	
133		total, err := r.notifications.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
134		if err != nil {
135			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("count notifications: %w", err))
136		}
137	
138		cur, err := r.notifications.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
139			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "queued_at", Value: -1}}).
140			SetSkip(page.Offset).
141			SetLimit(page.Limit),
142		)
143		if err != nil {
144			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("list notifications: %w", err))
145		}
146		notifications := []StoredNotification{}
147		if err := cur.All(ctx, &notifications); err != nil {
148			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("decode notifications: %w", err))
149		}
150		return notifications, total, nil
151	}
152	
153	// claimQueuedNotification atomically claims the oldest QUEUED document
154	// (QUEUED→SENT, sent_at, provider_ref) and returns it, or nil when the queue
155	// is drained. FindOneAndUpdate makes the claim race-safe across concurrent
156	// worker runs — never find-then-update.
157	func (r *repository) claimQueuedNotification(ctx context.Context, providerRef string, now time.Time) (*StoredNotification, error) {
158		var n StoredNotification
159		err := r.notifications.FindOneAndUpdate(ctx,
160			bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: domain.NotificationQueued}},
161			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
162				{Key: "status", Value: domain.NotificationSent},
163				{Key: "sent_at", Value: now},
164				{Key: "provider_ref", Value: providerRef},
165			}}},
166			options.FindOneAndUpdate().
167				SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "queued_at", Value: 1}}).
168				SetReturnDocument(options.After),
169		).Decode(&n)
170		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
171			return nil, nil
172		}
173		if err != nil {
174			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("claim queued notification: %w", err))
175		}
176		return &n, nil
177	}
178	
179	// setNotificationMeta stamps the rendered-message meta block onto a claimed
180	// notification (visibility only — the claim has already succeeded).
181	func (r *repository) setNotificationMeta(ctx context.Context, notificationID primitive.ObjectID, meta map[string]any) error {
182		_, err := r.notifications.UpdateOne(ctx,
183			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: notificationID}},
184			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "meta", Value: meta}}}},
185		)
186		if err != nil {
187			return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("set notification meta: %w", err))
188		}
189		return nil
190	}

192	// findPartyByPhone returns the party owning a phone number, or NotFound.
193	func (r *repository) findPartyByPhone(ctx context.Context, phone string) (*domain.Party, error) {
194		var party domain.Party
195		err := r.parties.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "phone", Value: phone}}).Decode(&party)
196		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
197			return nil, httpx.NotFound("party")
198		}
199		if err != nil {
200			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("find party by phone: %w", err))
201		}
202		return &party, nil
203	}
204	
205	// findPartyByID returns one party, or NotFound.
206	func (r *repository) findPartyByID(ctx context.Context, partyID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.Party, error) {
207		var party domain.Party
208		err := r.parties.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: partyID}}).Decode(&party)
209		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
210			return nil, httpx.NotFound("party")
211		}
212		if err != nil {
213			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("find party: %w", err))
214		}
215		return &party, nil
216	}
217	
218	// listActiveAssignmentsForParty returns a party's ACTIVE role assignments
219	// (bounded — a party holds at most a handful of roles).
220	func (r *repository) listActiveAssignmentsForParty(ctx context.Context, partyID primitive.ObjectID) ([]domain.RoleAssignment, error) {
221		cur, err := r.assignments.Find(ctx,
222			bson.D{
223				{Key: "party_id", Value: partyID},
224				{Key: "status", Value: domain.RoleAssignmentActive},
225			},
226			options.Find().SetLimit(100),
227		)
228		if err != nil {
229			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("list assignments for party: %w", err))
230		}
231		assignments := []domain.RoleAssignment{}
232		if err := cur.All(ctx, &assignments); err != nil {
233			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("decode assignments: %w", err))
234		}
235		return assignments, nil
236	}
237	
238	// listActiveRoleHolders returns the ACTIVE assignments of one role inside one
239	// org unit (bounded — used to address supervisor safety alerts).
240	func (r *repository) listActiveRoleHolders(ctx context.Context, orgUnitID primitive.ObjectID, roleCode string) ([]domain.RoleAssignment, error) {
241		cur, err := r.assignments.Find(ctx,
242			bson.D{
243				{Key: "org_unit_id", Value: orgUnitID},
244				{Key: "role_code", Value: roleCode},
245				{Key: "status", Value: domain.RoleAssignmentActive},
246			},
247			options.Find().SetLimit(50),
248		)
249		if err != nil {
250			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("list role holders: %w", err))
251		}
252		assignments := []domain.RoleAssignment{}
253		if err := cur.All(ctx, &assignments); err != nil {
254			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("decode role holders: %w", err))
255		}
256		return assignments, nil
257	}
258	
259	// subjectOrgUnit resolves a gate-blocked QC subject to the org unit that
260	// holds it (BMC lot → bmc_id, processing batch → plant_id). Both the subject
261	// _id and the reference field are ObjectIDs.
262	func (r *repository) subjectOrgUnit(ctx context.Context, subjectType string, subjectID primitive.ObjectID) (primitive.ObjectID, error) {
263		var coll *mongo.Collection
264		var field string
265		switch subjectType {
266		case domain.QCSubjectBMCLot:
267			coll, field = r.bmcLots, "bmc_id"
268		case domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch:
269			coll, field = r.batches, "plant_id"
270		default:
271			return primitive.NilObjectID, fmt.Errorf("gate-blocked subject type %q has no org resolution", subjectType)
272		}
273	
274		var doc bson.M
275		err := coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: subjectID}},
276			options.FindOne().SetProjection(bson.D{{Key: field, Value: 1}}),
277		).Decode(&doc)
278		if err != nil {
279			return primitive.NilObjectID, fmt.Errorf("resolve org of %s %s: %w", subjectType, subjectID.Hex(), err)
280		}
281		orgUnitID, _ := doc[field].(primitive.ObjectID)
282		if orgUnitID.IsZero() {
283			return primitive.NilObjectID, fmt.Errorf("%s %s carries no %s", subjectType, subjectID.Hex(), field)
284		}
285		return orgUnitID, nil
286	}

43	// logFailure routes a failed operation to the right log level — WARN for

47		args := append(attrs, slog.Any("err", err))
48		var appErr *httpx.AppError
49		if errors.As(err, &appErr) && appErr.Status < http.StatusInternalServerError {
50			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, op+" rejected", args...)
51		} else {

78	// validatePashuAadhaar enforces the national ear-tag format: exactly 12
79	// ASCII digits (§9). Pure function — unit tested.
80	func validatePashuAadhaar(id string) *httpx.AppError {
81		if len(id) != 12 {
82			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_PASHU_AADHAAR", "pashu_aadhaar must be exactly 12 digits")
83		}
84		for i := 0; i < len(id); i++ {
85			if id[i] < '0' || id[i] > '9' {
86				return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_PASHU_AADHAAR", "pashu_aadhaar must contain digits only")
87			}
88		}
89		return nil
90	}

96	func resolveAnimalOwner(actor auth.Actor, actorID primitive.ObjectID, requestedOwner *primitive.ObjectID) (primitive.ObjectID, *httpx.AppError) {

398	// CreateMVUCase opens a 1962 MVU request (§10). The DCS comes from the
399	// farmer's own animal when animal_id is given, else from the actor's org.
400	func (s *service) CreateMVUCase(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateMVUCaseRequest) (*domain.MVUCase, error) {
401		farmerID, err := actorID(actor)
402		if err != nil {
403			return nil, err
404		}
405		if strings.TrimSpace(req.Symptoms) == "" {
406			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("SYMPTOMS_REQUIRED", "symptoms description is required")
407		}
408	
409		var dcsID primitive.ObjectID
410		if actor.OrgUnitID != "" {
411			dcsID, err = httpx.ParseID(actor.OrgUnitID, "org_unit")
412			if err != nil {
413				return nil, err
414			}
415		}
416		var caseAnimalID *primitive.ObjectID
417		if req.AnimalID != nil && !req.AnimalID.IsZero() {
418			animal, err := s.repo.FindAnimalByID(ctx, *req.AnimalID)
419			if err != nil {
420				return nil, err
421			}
422			if animal.OwnerPartyID != farmerID {
423				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "mvu case rejected: animal not owned by caller",
424					slog.String("animal_id", animal.ID.Hex()),
425					slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
426				return nil, httpx.Forbidden("you may only raise an MVU case for your own animal")
427			}
428			id := animal.ID
429			caseAnimalID = &id
430			dcsID = animal.DCSID
431		}
432		if dcsID.IsZero() {
433			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("DCS_UNRESOLVED", "cannot resolve a DCS for this case — provide animal_id or use a DCS-scoped role token")
434		}
435	
436		mvuCase := &domain.MVUCase{
437			// Pre-generated so downstream logging/refs share one ID.
438			ID:            primitive.NewObjectID(),
439			AnimalID:      caseAnimalID,
440			FarmerPartyID: farmerID,
441			DCSID:         dcsID,
442			Symptoms:      strings.TrimSpace(req.Symptoms),
443			Status:        domain.MVUCaseRequested,
444			RequestedAt:   time.Now().UTC(),
445		}
446		if err := s.repo.InsertMVUCase(ctx, mvuCase); err != nil {
447			return nil, s.logFailure(ctx, "insert mvu case", err,
448				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
449		}
450		animalHex := ""
451		if mvuCase.AnimalID != nil {
452			animalHex = mvuCase.AnimalID.Hex()
453		}
454		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "mvu case created",
455			slog.String("case_id", mvuCase.ID.Hex()),
456			slog.String("farmer_party_id", mvuCase.FarmerPartyID.Hex()),
457			slog.String("dcs_id", mvuCase.DCSID.Hex()),
458			slog.String("animal_id", animalHex),
459			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
460		return mvuCase, nil
461	}
462	
463	// DispatchMVUCase moves a case REQUESTED → DISPATCHED, records the assignee
464	// from the caller's role, and publishes eventbus.TopicMVUDispatched with an
465	// explicit payload contract — keys: case_id, farmer_party_id, animal_id,
466	// dcs_id, values ObjectID hex strings (the notifications module reacts, §10).
467	func (s *service) DispatchMVUCase(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, caseID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.MVUCase, error) {
468		callerID, err := actorID(actor)
469		if err != nil {
470			return nil, err
471		}
472		mvuCase, err := s.repo.FindMVUCaseByID(ctx, caseID)
473		if err != nil {
474			return nil, err
475		}
476		if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, mvuCase.DCSID); err != nil {
477			return nil, s.logFailure(ctx, "dispatch mvu case scope check", err,
478				slog.String("case_id", mvuCase.ID.Hex()),
479				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
480		}
481	
482		var vetPartyID, driverPartyID *primitive.ObjectID
483		switch actor.RoleCode {
484		case domain.RoleVeterinarian:
485			vetPartyID = &callerID
486		case domain.RoleMVUDriver:
487			driverPartyID = &callerID
488			// Any other role reaching here is break-glass SUPER_ADMIN: the case
489			// is dispatched without pinning an assignee.
490		}
491	
492		transitioned, err := s.repo.DispatchMVUCase(ctx, mvuCase.ID, vetPartyID, driverPartyID)
493		if err != nil {
494			return nil, s.logFailure(ctx, "dispatch mvu case", err,
495				slog.String("case_id", mvuCase.ID.Hex()))
496		}
497		if !transitioned {
498			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "mvu dispatch rejected: case not in REQUESTED state",
499				slog.String("case_id", mvuCase.ID.Hex()),
500				slog.String("status", mvuCase.Status),
501				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
502			return nil, httpx.Conflict("MVU_NOT_REQUESTED", "MVU case is not in REQUESTED state")
503		}
504	
505		updated, err := s.repo.FindMVUCaseByID(ctx, mvuCase.ID)
506		if err != nil {
507			return nil, s.logFailure(ctx, "reload mvu case", err,
508				slog.String("case_id", mvuCase.ID.Hex()))
509		}
510		// Explicit event shape: the subscriber decodes structurally by JSON key,
511		// so the case ID must travel under "case_id" — publishing the raw domain
512		// document (whose ID marshals as "id") left the farmer SMS caseless.
513		// Values are ObjectID hex strings; a caseless animal travels as "".
514		animalHex := ""
515		if updated.AnimalID != nil {
516			animalHex = updated.AnimalID.Hex()
517		}
518		s.d.Bus.Publish(eventbus.TopicMVUDispatched, map[string]any{
519			"case_id":         updated.ID.Hex(),
520			"farmer_party_id": updated.FarmerPartyID.Hex(),
521			"animal_id":       animalHex,
522			"dcs_id":          updated.DCSID.Hex(),
523		})
524		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "mvu case dispatched",
525			slog.String("case_id", updated.ID.Hex()),
526			slog.String("farmer_party_id", updated.FarmerPartyID.Hex()),
527			slog.String("dcs_id", updated.DCSID.Hex()),
528			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
529			slog.String("actor_role", actor.RoleCode))
530		return updated, nil
531	}
532	
533	// CloseMVUCase moves a DISPATCHED/ARRIVED case to CLOSED with the visit log.
534	func (s *service) CloseMVUCase(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, caseID primitive.ObjectID, req CloseMVUCaseRequest) (*domain.MVUCase, error) {
535		if strings.TrimSpace(req.VisitNotes) == "" {
536			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("VISIT_NOTES_REQUIRED", "visit_notes is required to close a case")
537		}
538		mvuCase, err := s.repo.FindMVUCaseByID(ctx, caseID)
539		if err != nil {
540			return nil, err
541		}
542		if err := s.d.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, mvuCase.DCSID); err != nil {
543			return nil, s.logFailure(ctx, "close mvu case scope check", err,
544				slog.String("case_id", mvuCase.ID.Hex()),
545				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
546		}
547	
548		transitioned, err := s.repo.CloseMVUCase(ctx, mvuCase.ID, strings.TrimSpace(req.VisitNotes), req.HealthEventIDs, time.Now().UTC())
549		if err != nil {
550			return nil, s.logFailure(ctx, "close mvu case", err,
551				slog.String("case_id", mvuCase.ID.Hex()))
552		}
553		if !transitioned {
554			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "mvu close rejected: case not DISPATCHED or ARRIVED",
555				slog.String("case_id", mvuCase.ID.Hex()),
556				slog.String("status", mvuCase.Status),
557				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
558			return nil, httpx.Conflict("MVU_NOT_OPEN", "MVU case must be DISPATCHED or ARRIVED to close")
559		}
560		closed, err := s.repo.FindMVUCaseByID(ctx, mvuCase.ID)
561		if err != nil {
562			return nil, s.logFailure(ctx, "reload mvu case", err,
563				slog.String("case_id", mvuCase.ID.Hex()))
564		}
565		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "mvu case closed",
566			slog.String("case_id", closed.ID.Hex()),
567			slog.String("farmer_party_id", closed.FarmerPartyID.Hex()),
568			slog.Int("health_event_count", len(req.HealthEventIDs)),
569			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
570		return closed, nil
571	}
572	
573	// ListMVUCases returns a page of cases for the field roles. A dcs_id filter
574	// is scope-checked against the caller's org.

576		if status != "" {
577			if _, ok := validMVUStatuses[status]; !ok {
578				return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_MVU_STATUS", "status must be one of REQUESTED, DISPATCHED, ARRIVED, CLOSED, CANCELLED")
579			}
580		}
581		if !dcsID.IsZero() {

584					slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),

589		if err != nil {
590			return nil, 0, s.logFailure(ctx, "list mvu cases", err)
591		}
592		return cases, total, nil
593	}

595	// ListEducation returns a page of PUBLISHED education-hub content (§10).
596	func (s *service) ListEducation(ctx context.Context, topic, language string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.EducationContent, int64, error) {
597		items, total, err := s.repo.ListPublishedEducation(ctx, topic, language, page)

604	// CreateEducation adds an item to the education hub. Published defaults to
605	// true: v1 has no separate publish step, so unpublished items would be
606	// unreachable.
607	func (s *service) CreateEducation(ctx context.Context, req CreateEducationRequest) (*domain.EducationContent, error) {
608		if req.Topic == "" || req.Title == "" || req.Language == "" || req.MediaType == "" || req.MediaURL == "" {
609			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("EDUCATION_FIELDS_REQUIRED", "topic, title, language, media_type and media_url are required")
610		}
611		published := true
612		if req.Published != nil {
613			published = *req.Published
614		}
615		content := &domain.EducationContent{
616			ID:          primitive.NewObjectID(),
617			Topic:       req.Topic,
618			Title:       req.Title,
619			Language:    req.Language,
620			MediaType:   req.MediaType,
621			MediaURL:    req.MediaURL,
622			DurationSec: req.DurationSec,
623			Published:   published,
624			CreatedAt:   time.Now().UTC(),
625		}
626		if err := s.repo.InsertEducation(ctx, content); err != nil {
627			return nil, s.logFailure(ctx, "insert education content", err,
628				slog.String("topic", req.Topic))
629		}
630		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "education content created",
631			slog.String("content_id", content.ID.Hex()),
632			slog.String("topic", content.Topic),
633			slog.String("language", content.Language),
634			slog.Bool("published", content.Published))
635		return content, nil
636	}

638	// IngestTelemetry is the dormant collar path (§9). The capability gate runs
639	// FIRST: while flags.FlagCollarTelemetry is off the endpoint refuses with
640	// FEATURE_DISABLED, proving the backdoor is provisioned but inert. When the
641	// scheme lands and the flag flips, frames are acknowledged with 202 — the
642	// storage pipeline ships with the scheme, not before.
643	func (s *service) IngestTelemetry(ctx context.Context, req TelemetryRequest) (*TelemetryAck, error) {
644		if !s.d.Flags.Enabled(ctx, flags.FlagCollarTelemetry) {
645			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "collar telemetry rejected: feature gate disabled",
646				slog.String("flag", flags.FlagCollarTelemetry),
647				slog.String("pashu_aadhaar", req.PashuAadhaar))
648			aerr := httpx.Forbidden("collar telemetry is provisioned but dormant (§9)")
649			aerr.Code = "FEATURE_DISABLED"
650			return nil, aerr
651		}
652		if err := validatePashuAadhaar(req.PashuAadhaar); err != nil {
653			return nil, err
654		}
655		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "telemetry frame accepted",
656			slog.String("pashu_aadhaar", req.PashuAadhaar))
657		return &TelemetryAck{
658			Accepted:     true,
659			PashuAadhaar: req.PashuAadhaar,
660			Note:         "telemetry accepted; persistent storage lands with the collar scheme",
661		}, nil
662	}

18	// repository is all MongoDB access for the quality module. It owns qc_results
19	// and — as the safety-gate verdict writer (blueprint §8.3) — performs the
20	// documented cross-collection status write onto bmc_lots and
21	// processing_batches. No other module may flip those gate statuses.
22	type repository struct {
23		results  *mongo.Collection
24		bmcLots  *mongo.Collection
25		batches  *mongo.Collection
26		counters *mongo.Collection
27	}
28	
29	// newRepository binds the repository to its collections.
30	func newRepository(db *mongo.Database) *repository {
31		return &repository{
32			results:  db.Collection(mongodb.CollQCResults),
33			bmcLots:  db.Collection(mongodb.CollBMCLots),
34			batches:  db.Collection(mongodb.CollBatches),
35			counters: db.Collection(mongodb.CollCounters),
36		}
37	}
38	
39	// insertResult stores a new QC result document (its _id is pre-generated by
40	// the service so provenance refs and the gate write share one ID).
41	func (r *repository) insertResult(ctx context.Context, res *domain.QCResult) error {
42		if _, err := r.results.InsertOne(ctx, res); err != nil {
43			return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("insert qc result: %w", err))
44		}
45		return nil
46	}
47	
48	// setResultProvenanceSeq stamps the ledger sequence onto a stored result.
49	func (r *repository) setResultProvenanceSeq(ctx context.Context, resultID primitive.ObjectID, seq int64) error {
50		_, err := r.results.UpdateOne(ctx,
51			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: resultID}},
52			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "provenance_seq", Value: seq}}}},
53		)
54		if err != nil {
55			return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("set qc result provenance seq: %w", err))
56		}
57		return nil
58	}
59	
60	// markResultSuperseded voids a result that lost the gate race — the subject's
61	// verdict came from a different, earlier result.
62	func (r *repository) markResultSuperseded(ctx context.Context, resultID primitive.ObjectID) error {
63		_, err := r.results.UpdateOne(ctx,
64			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: resultID}},
65			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "superseded", Value: true}}}},
66		)
67		if err != nil {
68			return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("mark qc result superseded: %w", err))
69		}
70		return nil
71	}
72	
73	// findResultByID returns one QC result or NotFound.
74	func (r *repository) findResultByID(ctx context.Context, resultID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.QCResult, error) {
75		var res domain.QCResult
76		err := r.results.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: resultID}}).Decode(&res)
77		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
78			return nil, httpx.NotFound("qc result")
79		}
80		if err != nil {
81			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("find qc result: %w", err))
82		}
83		return &res, nil
84	}
85	
86	// listResults returns a page of QC results, newest first, optionally filtered
87	// by subject (a zero subjectID means "no subject filter"). It also returns
88	// the total matching count for pagination meta.
89	func (r *repository) listResults(ctx context.Context, subjectType string, subjectID primitive.ObjectID, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.QCResult, int64, error) {
90		filter := bson.D{}
91		if subjectType != "" {
92			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "subject_type", Value: subjectType})
93		}
94		if !subjectID.IsZero() {
95			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "subject_id", Value: subjectID})
96		}
97	
98		total, err := r.results.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
99		if err != nil {
100			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("count qc results: %w", err))
101		}
102	
103		cur, err := r.results.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
104			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "recorded_at", Value: -1}}).
105			SetSkip(page.Offset).
106			SetLimit(page.Limit),
107		)
108		if err != nil {
109			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("list qc results: %w", err))
110		}
111		results := []domain.QCResult{}
112		if err := cur.All(ctx, &results); err != nil {
113			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("decode qc results: %w", err))
114		}
115		return results, total, nil
116	}

133		var batch domain.ProcessingBatch
134		err := r.batches.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: batchID}}).Decode(&batch)
135		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {

144	// gateBMCLot applies the gate verdict to a BMC lot still in QC_PENDING.
145	// Returns false when the lot was already gated by a concurrent writer.
146	func (r *repository) gateBMCLot(ctx context.Context, lotID, resultID primitive.ObjectID, newStatus, blockReason string) (bool, error) {
147		return gateSubjectDoc(ctx, r.bmcLots, lotID, domain.BMCLotStatusQCPending, resultID, newStatus, blockReason)
148	}
149	
150	// gateBatch applies the gate verdict to a processing batch still in QC_PENDING.
151	// Returns false when the batch was already gated by a concurrent writer.
152	func (r *repository) gateBatch(ctx context.Context, batchID, resultID primitive.ObjectID, newStatus, blockReason string) (bool, error) {
153		return gateSubjectDoc(ctx, r.batches, batchID, domain.BatchStatusQCPending, resultID, newStatus, blockReason)
154	}
155	
156	// gateSubjectDoc is the shared conditional gate write: the filter pins the
157	// subject to QC_PENDING so a lost race cannot double-apply a verdict — the
158	// optimistic pattern that replaces transactions on a standalone server.
159	func gateSubjectDoc(ctx context.Context, coll *mongo.Collection, subjectID primitive.ObjectID, pendingStatus string, resultID primitive.ObjectID, newStatus, blockReason string) (bool, error) {
160		set := bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: newStatus}}
161		if blockReason != "" {
162			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "block_reason", Value: blockReason})
163		}
164		res, err := coll.UpdateOne(ctx,
165			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: subjectID}, {Key: "status", Value: pendingStatus}},
166			bson.D{
167				{Key: "$set", Value: set},
168				{Key: "$push", Value: bson.D{{Key: "qc_result_ids", Value: resultID}}},
169			},
170		)
171		if err != nil {
172			return false, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("gate %s subject %s: %w", coll.Name(), subjectID.Hex(), err))
173		}
174		return res.MatchedCount == 1, nil
175	}
176	
177	// nextCertificateSeq atomically increments and returns the per-stage QC
178	// certificate counter (counters collection, upsert-on-first-use). Counter
179	// keys are human-readable strings by design — they are not entity references.
180	func (r *repository) nextCertificateSeq(ctx context.Context, stage string) (int64, error) {
181		var doc struct {
182			Seq int64 `bson:"seq"`
183		}
184		err := r.counters.FindOneAndUpdate(ctx,
185			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: "qc_certificate:" + stage}},
186			bson.D{{Key: "$inc", Value: bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: int64(1)}}}},
187			options.FindOneAndUpdate().SetUpsert(true).SetReturnDocument(options.After),
188		).Decode(&doc)
189		if err != nil {
190			return 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("next qc certificate seq: %w", err))
191		}
192		return doc.Seq, nil
193	}

1	// Package settlement implements the same-day payment rail under the
2	// blueprint §8.1/§18-B guardrail: Saathi computes and initiates a batch,
3	// a DIFFERENT authorised human approves it (dual control), and a licensed
4	// Payment Aggregator (mocked here) executes the payouts. Scheme subsidies
5	// ride the strictly separate PFMS/DBT rail (§13) — never the milk-payment
6	// rail, and never the reverse.
7	package settlement
8	
9	import (
10		"log/slog"
11	
12		"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
13	
14		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
16		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/middleware"
17	)
18	
19	// Register wires the settlement module and mounts /settlements and /dbt
20	// under the /api/v1 subtree it receives.
21	func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
22		log := d.Log.With(slog.String("module", "settlement"))
23		svc := &service{
24			repo:   newRepo(d.DB),
25			ledger: d.Ledger,
26			orgs:   d.Orgs,
27			bus:    d.Bus,
28			log:    log,
29		}
30		h := &handler{svc: svc}
31	
32		// Read access to batches: village signatories plus union/state oversight.
33		readRoles := middleware.RequireRoles(
34			domain.RoleSamitiSacheev,
35			domain.RoleSamitiAdhyaksh,
36			domain.RoleUnionPresident,
37			domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor,
38			domain.RoleStateAuditor,
39		)
40	
41		r.Route("/settlements", func(sr chi.Router) {
42			sr.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
43	
44			// Initiate: the Sacheev runs the collection console (§8.1 step 1).
45			sr.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSamitiSacheev)).
46				Post("/", h.initiate)
47	
48			// Approve / reject: a different authorised signatory (dual control is
49			// additionally enforced on party identity inside the service).
50			sr.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSamitiAdhyaksh, domain.RoleUnionPresident)).
51				Post("/{id}/approve", h.approve)
52			sr.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSamitiAdhyaksh, domain.RoleUnionPresident)).
53				Post("/{id}/reject", h.reject)

160	// DispatchMVUCase moves a case REQUESTED → DISPATCHED, recording the vet
161	// and/or driver. The status guard in the filter is the optimistic lock (no
162	// transactions on a standalone server): a false return means the case was
163	// not in REQUESTED state — e.g. a concurrent dispatch won the race.
164	func (r *repository) DispatchMVUCase(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID, vetPartyID, driverPartyID *primitive.ObjectID) (bool, error) {
165		set := bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: domain.MVUCaseDispatched}}
166		if vetPartyID != nil {
167			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "vet_party_id", Value: *vetPartyID})
168		}
169		if driverPartyID != nil {
170			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "driver_party_id", Value: *driverPartyID})
171		}
172		res, err := r.mvuCases.UpdateOne(ctx,
173			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}, {Key: "status", Value: domain.MVUCaseRequested}},
174			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: set}})
175		if err != nil {
176			return false, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("dispatch mvu case %s: %w", id.Hex(), err))
177		}
178		return res.MatchedCount == 1, nil
179	}
180	
181	// CloseMVUCase moves a DISPATCHED (or ARRIVED) case to CLOSED with the visit
182	// log. Same optimistic status-guard pattern as DispatchMVUCase.
183	func (r *repository) CloseMVUCase(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID, visitNotes string, healthEventIDs []primitive.ObjectID, closedAt time.Time) (bool, error) {
184		set := bson.D{
185			{Key: "status", Value: domain.MVUCaseClosed},
186			{Key: "visit_notes", Value: visitNotes},
187			{Key: "closed_at", Value: closedAt},
188		}
189		if len(healthEventIDs) > 0 {
190			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "health_event_ids", Value: healthEventIDs})
191		}
192		res, err := r.mvuCases.UpdateOne(ctx,
193			bson.D{
194				{Key: "_id", Value: id},
195				{Key: "status", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: []string{
196					domain.MVUCaseDispatched, domain.MVUCaseArrived,
197				}}}},
198			},
199			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: set}})
200		if err != nil {
201			return false, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("close mvu case %s: %w", id.Hex(), err))
202		}
203		return res.MatchedCount == 1, nil
204	}

1	import { ApiError, endpoint } from '../client';
2	import type { Invoice, RateConfig, ReleaseStage, ReleaseSummary } from '@/core/types/domain';
3	import { audit } from '@/core/mocks/db';
4	import { todayISO } from '@/core/utils/format';
5	
6	/**
7	 * Same-day payment rail (§8.1) wired to the real Go backend:
8	 *   - collection module (mount /collection): per-farmer invoices + rate charts
9	 *       GET  /collection/invoices            → list (dcs_id/farmer_party_id/status/date)
10	 *       GET  /collection/rate-charts/active  → the active pricing chart
11	 *       POST /collection/rate-charts         → create/replace the active chart
12	 *   - settlement module (mount /settlements): READ-only from the client's view
13	 *       GET  /settlements                    → the day's computed batches
14	 *
15	 * Settlement WRITES (approve invoices / settle / assisted release) are
16	 * computed + event-driven on the backend: the settlement models exist
17	 * (InitiateSettlementRequest / RejectSettlementRequest) but no POST route is
18	 * registered, so those endpoints stay mock-only until the backend exposes them.
19	 * Settlement is always an authorised human action - Saathi computes and
20	 * initiates, it never moves funds autonomously (§18-B guardrail).
21	 */
22	
23	/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
24	/* Wire shapes (snake_case, exactly as the backend serialises)         */
25	/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
26	
27	/** domain.Invoice - the same-day settlement artefact (§8.1). */
28	interface WireInvoice {
29	  id: string;
30	  farmer_party_id: string;
31	  dcs_id: string;
32	  date: string;
33	  pour_ids?: string[];
34	  gross_amount?: number;
35	  deductions?: number;
36	  net_amount?: number;
37	  status?: string;
38	  settled_at?: string;
39	  utr?: string;
40	}
41	
42	/** collection.CreateRateChartRequest-shaped active chart (base + two-axis). */
43	interface WireRateChart {
44	  id?: string;
45	  org_unit_id?: string;
46	  name?: string;
47	  base_rate_per_litre: number;
48	  fat_rate_per_point: number;
49	  snf_rate_per_point: number;
50	  effective_from?: string;
51	  active?: boolean;
52	}
53	
54	/** domain.SettlementBatch (GET /settlements list item) - mapped best-effort. */
55	interface WireSettlementBatch {
56	  id?: string;
57	  dcs_id?: string;
58	  date?: string;
59	  status?: string;
60	  union_ref?: string;
61	  total_amount?: number;
62	  farmer_count?: number;
63	  invoice_ids?: string[];
64	  approved_at?: string;
65	  executed_at?: string;
66	  utr_batch?: string;
67	}
68	
69	/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
70	/* Wire → domain mappers                                               */
71	/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
72	
73	/**
74	 * The backend keeps invoice + settlement state on separate rails; the domain
75	 * Invoice collapses them into three states. SETTLED/PAID → SETTLED, APPROVED →
76	 * APPROVED, everything else (ISSUED/DRAFT/…) → DRAFT. Best-effort - the exact
77	 * backend status vocabulary isn't pinned in the shared models.
78	 */
79	function mapInvoiceStatus(s: string | undefined): Invoice['status'] {
80	  switch (s) {
81	    case 'SETTLED':
82	    case 'PAID':
83	      return 'SETTLED';
84	    case 'APPROVED':
85	      return 'APPROVED';
86	    default:
87	      return 'DRAFT';
88	  }
89	}
90	
91	function mapInvoice(w: WireInvoice): Invoice {
92	  return {
93	    id: w.id,
94	    farmerPartyId: w.farmer_party_id,
95	    dcsId: w.dcs_id,
96	    date: w.date,
97	    pourIds: w.pour_ids ?? [],
98	    grossAmount: w.gross_amount ?? 0,
99	    deductions: w.deductions ?? 0,
100	    netAmount: w.net_amount ?? 0,
101	    status: mapInvoiceStatus(w.status),
102	    settledAt: w.settled_at,
103	    utr: w.utr,
104	  };
105	}
106	
107	/** Fold the CreateRateChart-shaped chart into the two-axis RateConfig. */
108	function mapRateChart(w: WireRateChart): RateConfig {
109	  return {
110	    effectiveFrom: (w.effective_from ?? '').slice(0, 10) || todayISO(),
111	    baselinePricePerLitre: w.base_rate_per_litre,
112	    fatRatePerKg: w.fat_rate_per_point,
113	    snfRatePerKg: w.snf_rate_per_point,
114	    note: w.name || 'Saathi rate chart',
115	  };
116	}
117	
118	/** Map a settlement batch status onto the assisted-release stage machine. */
119	function mapReleaseStage(status: string | undefined): ReleaseStage {
120	  switch (status) {
121	    case 'APPROVED':
122	      return 'UNION_FUNDED';
123	    case 'EXECUTING':
124	    case 'DISTRIBUTING':
125	      return 'DISTRIBUTING';
126	    case 'EXECUTED':
127	    case 'PAID':
128	    case 'SETTLED':
129	    case 'COMPLETED':
130	      return 'FARMERS_PAID';
131	    default: // INITIATED / PENDING / unknown
132	      return 'PENDING_APPROVAL';
133	  }
134	}
135	
136	/** Derive the assisted-release stage for a DCS + date from its invoices. */
137	function computeRelease(
138	  invoices: Invoice[],
139	  dcsId: string,
140	  date: string,
141	): ReleaseSummary {
142	  const day = invoices.filter((i) => i.dcsId === dcsId && i.date === date);
143	  const approved = day.filter((i) => i.status === 'APPROVED');
144	  const settled = day.filter((i) => i.status === 'SETTLED');
145	  const drafts = day.filter((i) => i.status === 'DRAFT');
146	  const releasable = [...approved, ...settled];
147	  const farmerCount = new Set(releasable.map((i) => i.farmerPartyId)).size;
148	  const totalAmount = Math.round(releasable.reduce((s, i) => s + i.netAmount, 0) * 100) / 100;
149	
150	  let stage: ReleaseStage;
151	  if (drafts.length > 0 || releasable.length === 0) stage = 'PENDING_APPROVAL';
152	  else if (approved.length > 0) stage = 'UNION_FUNDED';
153	  else stage = 'FARMERS_PAID';
154	
155	  const firstSettled = settled.find((i) => i.settledAt);
156	  return {
157	    dcsId,
158	    date,
159	    unionRef: `UNION-${dcsId.replace('org_dcs_', '').toUpperCase()}-${date.slice(2).replaceAll('-', '')}`,
160	    farmerCount,
161	    totalAmount,
162	    stage,
163	    approvedInvoiceIds: approved.map((i) => i.id),
164	    sachivApprovedAt: firstSettled?.settledAt,
165	    distributedAt: firstSettled?.settledAt,
166	    utrBatch: firstSettled?.utr ? `BATCH-${firstSettled.utr}` : undefined,
167	  };
168	}
169	
170	/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
171	/* Endpoints                                                           */
172	/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
173	
174	export const listInvoices = endpoint<
175	  { farmerPartyId?: string; dcsId?: string; status?: Invoice['status']; date?: string },
176	  Invoice[]
177	>({
178	  method: 'GET',
179	  path: (f) => {
180	    const q = new URLSearchParams();
181	    if (f.farmerPartyId) q.set('farmer_party_id', f.farmerPartyId);
182	    if (f.dcsId) q.set('dcs_id', f.dcsId);
183	    if (f.status) q.set('status', f.status);
184	    if (f.date) q.set('date', f.date);
185	    const s = q.toString();
186	    return s ? `/collection/invoices?${s}` : '/collection/invoices';
187	  },
188	  mapResponse: (raw) => (raw as WireInvoice[] | null ?? []).map(mapInvoice),
189	  mock: (f, db) =>
190	    db.invoices
191	      .filter(
192	        (i) =>
193	          (!f.farmerPartyId || i.farmerPartyId === f.farmerPartyId) &&
194	          (!f.dcsId || i.dcsId === f.dcsId) &&
195	          (!f.status || i.status === f.status) &&
196	          (!f.date || i.date === f.date),
197	      )
198	      .sort((a, b) => b.date.localeCompare(a.date)),
199	});

201	/** Sacheev approves the day's draft invoices (pre-settlement check). */
202	// TODO(backend): settlement write endpoint not exposed yet - mock only
203	export const approveInvoices = endpoint<
204	  { dcsId: string; date: string; approvedByPartyId: string },
205	  Invoice[]
206	>({
207	  method: 'POST',
208	  path: ({ dcsId }) => `/dcs/${dcsId}/invoices/approve`,
209	  mock: ({ dcsId, date, approvedByPartyId }, db) => {
210	    const drafts = db.invoices.filter(
211	      (i) => i.dcsId === dcsId && i.date === date && i.status === 'DRAFT',
212	    );
213	    if (drafts.length === 0) throw new ApiError(409, 'NOTHING_TO_APPROVE', 'No draft invoices for this date');
214	    for (const inv of drafts) {
215	      inv.status = 'APPROVED';
216	      for (const pid of inv.pourIds) {
217	        const pour = db.pours.find((po) => po.id === pid);
218	        if (pour) pour.status = 'INVOICED';
219	      }
220	    }
221	    audit(db, {
222	      actorPartyId: approvedByPartyId,
223	      actorRole: 'SAMITI_SACHEEV',
224	      action: 'INVOICES_APPROVED',
225	      subject: `${drafts.length} invoices - ${date}`,
226	      detail: `Total ₹${drafts.reduce((s, i) => s + i.netAmount, 0).toFixed(2)} approved for settlement`,
227	    });
228	    return drafts;
229	  },
230	});

232	/** Initiate settlement of approved invoices (authorised human action, §18-B). */

235	  { invoiceIds: string[]; initiatedByPartyId: string },
236	  Invoice[]
237	>({
238	  method: 'POST',
239	  path: () => '/invoices/settle',
240	  mock: ({ invoiceIds, initiatedByPartyId }, db) => {
241	    const settled: Invoice[] = [];
242	    for (const id of invoiceIds) {
243	      const inv = db.invoices.find((i) => i.id === id);
244	      if (!inv || inv.status !== 'APPROVED') continue;
245	      inv.status = 'SETTLED';
246	      inv.settledAt = new Date().toISOString();
247	      inv.utr = `UTR${todayISO().slice(2).replaceAll('-', '')}${inv.id.slice(-4).toUpperCase()}`;
248	      for (const pid of inv.pourIds) {
249	        const pour = db.pours.find((po) => po.id === pid);
250	        if (pour) pour.status = 'PAID';
251	      }
252	      settled.push(inv);
253	    }
254	    if (settled.length === 0) {
255	      throw new ApiError(409, 'NOTHING_TO_SETTLE', 'No approved invoices in the selection');
256	    }
257	    audit(db, {

269	export const getReleaseSummary = endpoint<{ dcsId: string; date: string }, ReleaseSummary>({
270	  method: 'GET',
271	  path: ({ dcsId, date }) => `/settlements?dcs_id=${encodeURIComponent(dcsId)}&date=${encodeURIComponent(date)}`,
272	  mapResponse: (raw) => {

274	    const b = batches[0];
275	    if (!b) {
276	      return {
277	        dcsId: '',
278	        date: '',
279	        unionRef: '',
280	        farmerCount: 0,
281	        totalAmount: 0,
282	        stage: 'PENDING_APPROVAL',
283	        approvedInvoiceIds: [],
284	      };
285	    }
286	    return {
287	      dcsId: b.dcs_id ?? '',
288	      date: b.date ?? '',
289	      unionRef: b.union_ref ?? b.id ?? '',
290	      farmerCount: b.farmer_count ?? b.invoice_ids?.length ?? 0,
291	      totalAmount: b.total_amount ?? 0,
292	      stage: mapReleaseStage(b.status),
293	      approvedInvoiceIds: b.invoice_ids ?? [],
294	      sachivApprovedAt: b.approved_at,

302	/**
303	 * "Mode 2: Assisted" release. The Sachiv approves the day's funded payout; the
304	 * cooperative then distributes to every farmer's account through the settlement
305	 * rail. This is the single human control point - money never reaches farmers
306	 * without it (§18-B). Approve + distribute happen atomically from the client's
307	 * view (distribution is simulated).
308	 */
309	// TODO(backend): settlement write endpoint not exposed yet - mock only
310	export const approveRelease = endpoint<
311	  { dcsId: string; date: string; approvedByPartyId: string },
312	  ReleaseSummary
313	>({
314	  method: 'POST',
315	  path: ({ dcsId }) => `/dcs/${dcsId}/release/approve`,
316	  mock: ({ dcsId, date, approvedByPartyId }, db) => {
317	    const approved = db.invoices.filter(
318	      (i) => i.dcsId === dcsId && i.date === date && i.status === 'APPROVED',
319	    );
320	    if (approved.length === 0) {
321	      throw new ApiError(409, 'NOTHING_TO_RELEASE', 'No union-funded payout awaiting release for this date');
322	    }
323	    const now = new Date().toISOString();
324	    const batchUtr = `UTR${date.slice(2).replaceAll('-', '')}${dcsId.slice(-3).toUpperCase()}`;
325	    for (const inv of approved) {
326	      inv.status = 'SETTLED';
327	      inv.settledAt = now;
328	      inv.utr = batchUtr;
329	      for (const pid of inv.pourIds) {
330	        const pour = db.pours.find((po) => po.id === pid);
331	        if (pour) pour.status = 'PAID';
332	      }
333	    }
334	    const total = Math.round(approved.reduce((s, i) => s + i.netAmount, 0) * 100) / 100;
335	    const farmers = new Set(approved.map((i) => i.farmerPartyId)).size;
336	    audit(db, {
337	      actorPartyId: approvedByPartyId,
338	      actorRole: 'SAMITI_SACHEEV',
339	      action: 'RELEASE_APPROVED',
340	      subject: `Assisted release - ${date}`,
341	      detail: `Sachiv approved the release of ₹${total.toFixed(2)} to ${farmers} farmers; distributing via settlement rail`,
342	    });
343	    audit(db, {
344	      actorPartyId: approvedByPartyId,
345	      actorRole: 'SAMITI_SACHEEV',
346	      action: 'RELEASE_DISTRIBUTED',
347	      subject: `Batch ${batchUtr}`,
348	      detail: `Distributed ₹${total.toFixed(2)} to ${farmers} farmer accounts`,
349	    });
350	    return computeRelease(db.invoices, dcsId, date);
351	  },
352	});

1	package domain
2	
3	import (
4		"fmt"

9	)

11	// FSSAI limits for liquid milk (blueprint §8.3). Aflatoxin M1 is heat-stable
12	// and survives pasteurisation, so it MUST be gated upstream (BMC + plant),
13	// never only at the finished product.
14	const (
15		FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg = 0.5  // AFM1 ≤ 0.5 µg/kg
16		FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl          = 10.0 // coliform ≤ 10 CFU/ml
17		FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg       = 0.1  // antibiotic MRL example
18	)
19	
20	// QC test names.
21	const (
22		TestAflatoxinM1 = "AFLATOXIN_M1"            // µg/kg
23		TestColiform    = "COLIFORM"                // CFU/ml
24		TestTPC         = "TPC"                     // CFU/ml, graded — recorded, not hard-gated here
25		TestAntibiotic  = "ANTIBIOTIC_TETRACYCLINE" // mg/kg
26		TestPhosphatase = "PHOSPHATASE"             // 0 = negative (pass post-pasteurisation), 1 = positive
27		TestFat         = "FAT"                     // %
28		TestSNF         = "SNF"                     // %
29	)
30	
31	// QC stages.
32	const (
33		QCStageBMCRapid = "BMC_RAPID" // strip/rapid tests at the chilling centre
34		QCStagePlantLab = "PLANT_LAB" // full lab: ELISA/HPLC, culture, LC-MS/MS
35	)
36	
37	// QC subject types.
38	const (
39		QCSubjectDCSConsignment  = "DCS_CONSIGNMENT"
40		QCSubjectBMCLot          = "BMC_LOT"
41		QCSubjectProcessingBatch = "PROCESSING_BATCH"
42	)
43	
44	// QCTest is a single measurement inside a QC result.
45	type QCTest struct {
46		Name  string  `bson:"name"  json:"name"`
47		Value float64 `bson:"value" json:"value"`
48		Unit  string  `bson:"unit"  json:"unit"`
49		Pass  bool    `bson:"pass"  json:"pass"`
50	}
51	
52	// QCResult is the recorded outcome of testing one subject at one stage.
53	// OverallPass drives the safety gate; a certificate is attached to provenance
54	// on pass, a block + quarantine on fail.
55	type QCResult struct {
56		ID                primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
57		SubjectType       string             `bson:"subject_type"  json:"subject_type"`
58		SubjectID         primitive.ObjectID `bson:"subject_id"    json:"subject_id"`
59		Stage             string             `bson:"stage"         json:"stage"`
60		Tests             []QCTest           `bson:"tests"         json:"tests"`
61		OverallPass       bool               `bson:"overall_pass"  json:"overall_pass"`
62		FailureReasons    []string           `bson:"failure_reasons,omitempty" json:"failure_reasons,omitempty"`
63		AnalystPartyID    primitive.ObjectID `bson:"analyst_party_id" json:"analyst_party_id"`
64		LabRef            string             `bson:"lab_ref,omitempty"            json:"lab_ref,omitempty"`
65		CertificateNumber string             `bson:"certificate_number,omitempty" json:"certificate_number,omitempty"`
66		// Superseded marks a result voided after losing the gate race — the
67		// verdict on the subject came from a different, earlier result.
68		Superseded    bool      `bson:"superseded,omitempty" json:"superseded,omitempty"`
69		RecordedAt    time.Time `bson:"recorded_at"   json:"recorded_at"`
70		ProvenanceSeq int64     `bson:"provenance_seq,omitempty" json:"provenance_seq,omitempty"`
71	}
72	
73	// NormalizeTestName maps common field aliases to the canonical FSSAI test
74	// name so the safety gate can NEVER be bypassed by a spelling difference
75	// (e.g. the app sends "AFM1"; the gate keys on "AFLATOXIN_M1"). A test whose
76	// name still doesn't resolve to a gated parameter is recorded but not gated.
77	func NormalizeTestName(name string) string {
78		switch strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(name)) {
79		case "AFM1", "AFLATOXIN", "AFLATOXINM1", "AFLATOXIN_M1", "AFLATOXIN-M1":
80			return TestAflatoxinM1
81		case "COLIFORM", "COLIFORMS":
82			return TestColiform
83		case "TPC", "TOTAL_PLATE_COUNT":
84			return TestTPC
85		case "ANTIBIOTIC", "TETRACYCLINE", "ANTIBIOTIC_TETRACYCLINE":
86			return TestAntibiotic
87		case "PHOSPHATASE", "ALP":
88			return TestPhosphatase
89		case "FAT":
90			return TestFat
91		case "SNF":
92			return TestSNF
93		default:
94			return strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(name))
95		}
96	}
97	
98	// EvaluateQCTests applies the FSSAI gate to a set of tests: it normalizes each
99	// test name, fills its Pass verdict, and returns the overall verdict plus
100	// human-readable failure reasons. Unknown test names are recorded but do not
101	// gate. The returned tests carry the CANONICAL name so storage is consistent.
102	func EvaluateQCTests(tests []QCTest) (overallPass bool, failures []string, evaluated []QCTest) {
103		overallPass = true
104		evaluated = make([]QCTest, 0, len(tests))
105		for _, t := range tests {
106			t.Name = NormalizeTestName(t.Name) // canonicalise so the gate cannot be dodged by alias
107			pass := true
108			switch t.Name {
109			case TestAflatoxinM1:
110				if t.Value > FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg {
111					pass = false
112					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
113						"AFLATOXIN_M1 %.3f µg/kg exceeds FSSAI limit %.1f µg/kg", t.Value, FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg))
114				}
115			case TestColiform:
116				if t.Value > FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl {
117					pass = false
118					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
119						"COLIFORM %.1f CFU/ml exceeds FSSAI limit %.0f CFU/ml", t.Value, FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl))
120				}
121			case TestAntibiotic:
122				if t.Value > FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg {
123					pass = false
124					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
125						"ANTIBIOTIC_TETRACYCLINE %.3f mg/kg exceeds MRL %.1f mg/kg", t.Value, FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg))
126				}
127			case TestPhosphatase:
128				if t.Value != 0 {
129					pass = false
130					failures = append(failures, "PHOSPHATASE positive — pasteurisation check failed (must be negative)")
131				}
132			}
133			t.Pass = pass
134			if !pass {
135				overallPass = false
136			}
137			evaluated = append(evaluated, t)
138		}
139		return overallPass, failures, evaluated
140	}
141

1	import { ApiError, endpoint } from '../client';
2	import type { PlantBatch, QcCertificate, QualityTestResult, TraceResult } from '@/core/types/domain';
3	import type { TestParameter, TestStage } from '@/core/types/domain';
4	import { appendChainEvent, audit, buildBatchSources } from '@/core/mocks/db';
5	import { evaluateReading, PLANT_MANDATORY_PARAMETERS, QUALITY_PARAMETERS } from '@/core/utils/quality';
6	import { nextId } from '@/core/utils/id';
7	
8	/**
9	 * QC lab (§8.3): the safety gate. Aflatoxin M1 survives pasteurisation, so
10	 * a FAIL here blocks the batch and triggers trace-back to source samitis.
11	 *
12	 * Backend (parag-saathi-be, internal/modules/quality, mounted at /quality):
13	 *   POST /quality/qc-results        → record a SET of tests → domain.QCResult
14	 *   GET  /quality/qc-results        → list results (?subject_id=…)
15	 *   GET  /quality/qc-results/{id}   → one result
16	 *   GET  /quality/limits            → FSSAI reference limits
17	 * The gate verdict is computed server-side (domain.EvaluateQCTests); clients
18	 * only send {name,value,unit}. The FE domain models ONE parameter per row
19	 * (QualityTestResult), so a wire QCResult with N tests fans out to N rows.
20	 */
21	
22	/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
23	/* Wire shapes (snake_case, exactly as the quality module serialises)  */
24	/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
25	
26	/** One measurement inside a QCResult (domain.QCTest). */
27	interface WireQcTest {
28	  name: string;
29	  value: number;
30	  unit: string;
31	  /** Server-computed per-test verdict, when present. */
32	  passed?: boolean;
33	}
34	
35	/** A recorded gate evaluation (domain.QCResult). */
36	interface WireQcResult {
37	  id: string;
38	  subject_type: string; // domain.QCSubject* (e.g. BMC_LOT | PLANT_BATCH)
39	  subject_id: string;
40	  stage: string; // BMC_RAPID | PLANT_LAB
41	  tests: WireQcTest[];
42	  passed?: boolean;
43	  failure_reasons?: string[];
44	  lab_ref?: string;
45	  recorded_at?: string;
46	  created_at?: string;
47	  recorded_by_party_id?: string;
48	}
49	
50	/* Wire ⇄ domain enum bridges (backend stage/subject vocab ≠ FE vocab). */
51	const WIRE_STAGE_TO_DOMAIN: Record<string, TestStage> = {
52	  BMC_RAPID: 'BMC',
53	  PLANT_LAB: 'PLANT',
54	};
55	// The FE also records a notional 'DCS' stage; the backend gate only runs at
56	// the BMC rapid test and the plant lab, so DCS falls back to the BMC gate.
57	const DOMAIN_STAGE_TO_WIRE: Record<'DCS' | 'BMC' | 'PLANT', string> = {
58	  DCS: 'BMC_RAPID',
59	  BMC: 'BMC_RAPID',
60	  PLANT: 'PLANT_LAB',
61	};
62	const SUBJECT_TYPE_TO_WIRE: Record<'LOT' | 'INTAKE' | 'BATCH', string> = {
63	  LOT: 'BMC_LOT',
64	  INTAKE: 'BMC_INTAKE',
65	  BATCH: 'PLANT_BATCH',
66	};
67	
68	function mapSubjectType(w: string): QualityTestResult['subjectType'] {
69	  const s = (w || '').toUpperCase();
70	  if (s.includes('BATCH')) return 'BATCH';
71	  if (s.includes('INTAKE')) return 'INTAKE';
72	  if (s.includes('LOT')) return 'LOT';
73	  return 'BATCH';
74	}
75	
76	/** Resolve a wire test name to the closed FE parameter union (tolerant). */
77	function mapParameter(name: string): TestParameter | null {
78	  const s = (name || '').toUpperCase().replace(/[\s-]/g, '_');
79	  if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(QUALITY_PARAMETERS, s)) return s as TestParameter;
80	  if (s.includes('AFLATOX') || s.includes('AFM1')) return 'AFM1';
81	  if (s.includes('COLIFORM')) return 'COLIFORM';
82	  if (s.includes('TPC') || s.includes('PLATE')) return 'TPC';
83	  if (s.includes('TETRACYC') || s.includes('ANTIBIOT')) return 'ANTIBIOTIC_TETRACYCLINE';
84	  if (s.includes('PHOSPHAT')) return 'PHOSPHATASE';
85	  return null;
86	}
87	
88	/**
89	 * Map one wire test (within a QCResult) to a FE QualityTestResult row.
90	 * limitLabel/method aren't carried on the wire per-test - they're enriched
91	 * from the FE's own FSSAI spec table; the verdict prefers the server's
92	 * `passed`, falling back to re-evaluating the reading locally.
93	 */
94	function mapQcTest(w: WireQcResult, t: WireQcTest, index: number): QualityTestResult {
95	  const parameter = mapParameter(t.name) ?? 'AFM1';
96	  const spec = QUALITY_PARAMETERS[parameter];
97	  const verdict: 'PASS' | 'FAIL' =
98	    typeof t.passed === 'boolean' ? (t.passed ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL') : evaluateReading(parameter, t.value);
