165	/**
166	 * Record a lab reading. The verdict is computed against FSSAI limits - a
167	 * FAIL immediately fails the batch (gate) and audit-logs the block; when
168	 * every mandatory parameter has passed, the batch flips to QC PASS.
169	 */
170	export const recordTest = endpoint<RecordTestInput, QualityTestResult>({
171	  method: 'POST',
172	  path: () => '/quality/qc-results',
173	  // Backend records a SET of tests at once; the FE records one - send a
174	  // single-element `tests` array (RecordQCResultRequest).
175	  mapRequest: (input) => ({
176	    subject_type: SUBJECT_TYPE_TO_WIRE[input.subjectType],
177	    subject_id: input.subjectId,
178	    stage: DOMAIN_STAGE_TO_WIRE[input.stage],
179	    tests: [{ name: input.parameter, value: input.value, unit: QUALITY_PARAMETERS[input.parameter].unit }],
180	  }),
181	  // The created QCResult echoes back the one test we posted (tests[0]).
182	  mapResponse: (raw) => {
183	    const r = raw as WireQcResult;
184	    const t = r.tests?.[0] ?? { name: '', value: 0, unit: '' };
185	    return mapQcTest(r, t, 0);
186	  },
187	  mock: (input, db) => {
188	    const spec = QUALITY_PARAMETERS[input.parameter];
189	    const existing = db.tests.find(
190	      (t) => t.subjectId === input.subjectId && t.parameter === input.parameter,
191	    );
192	    if (existing) {
193	      throw new ApiError(409, 'ALREADY_TESTED', `${spec.label} already recorded for this subject`);
194	    }
195	    const test: QualityTestResult = {
196	      id: nextId('test'),
197	      subjectType: input.subjectType,
198	      subjectId: input.subjectId,
199	      parameter: input.parameter,
200	      value: input.value,
201	      unit: spec.unit,
202	      limitLabel: spec.limitLabel,
203	      verdict: evaluateReading(input.parameter, input.value),
204	      method: spec.method,
205	      stage: input.stage,
206	      testedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
207	      testedByPartyId: input.testedByPartyId,
208	    };
209	    db.tests.push(test);
210	
211	    if (input.subjectType === 'BATCH') {
212	      const batch = db.batches.find((b) => b.id === input.subjectId);
213	      if (batch) {
214	        if (test.verdict === 'FAIL') {
215	          batch.qcStatus = 'FAIL';
216	          batch.stage = 'REJECTED';
217	          audit(db, {
218	            actorPartyId: input.testedByPartyId,
219	            actorRole: 'PLANT_LAB_ANALYST',
220	            action: 'SAFETY_GATE_FAIL',
221	            subject: batch.code,
222	            detail: `${spec.label} = ${input.value} ${spec.unit} breaches ${spec.limitLabel} - batch blocked; trace-back to contributing samitis available`,
223	          });
224	          appendChainEvent(db, {
225	            kind: 'QC',
226	            subjectType: 'BATCH',
227	            subjectId: batch.id,
228	            actorPartyId: input.testedByPartyId,
229	            detail: `FAIL: ${spec.label} ${input.value} ${spec.unit} breaches ${spec.limitLabel}`,
230	          });
231	        } else {
232	          const done = db.tests.filter((t) => t.subjectId === batch.id && t.verdict === 'PASS');
233	          const allPassed = PLANT_MANDATORY_PARAMETERS.every((p) =>
234	            done.some((t) => t.parameter === p),
235	          );
236	          if (allPassed && batch.qcStatus === 'PENDING') {
237	            batch.qcStatus = 'PASS';
238	            audit(db, {
239	              actorPartyId: input.testedByPartyId,
240	              actorRole: 'PLANT_LAB_ANALYST',
241	              action: 'QC_ALL_PASS',
242	              subject: batch.code,
243	              detail: 'All mandatory FSSAI parameters PASS - batch cleared to pack',
244	            });
245	            appendChainEvent(db, {
246	              kind: 'QC',
247	              subjectType: 'BATCH',
248	              subjectId: batch.id,
249	              actorPartyId: input.testedByPartyId,
250	              detail: `PASS: all mandatory FSSAI parameters cleared for ${batch.code}`,
251	            });
252	          }
253	        }
254	      }
255	    }
256	    return test;
257	  },
258	});

52	function mapEducation(w: WireEducation): EducationContent {
53	  return {
54	    id: w.id,
55	    title: w.title ?? '',
56	    titleHi: w.title_hi ?? w.title ?? '',
57	    kind: (w.media_type ?? '').toUpperCase() === 'AUDIO' ? 'AUDIO' : 'VIDEO',

64	function mapSchemeStatus(s?: string): SchemeApplication['status'] {
65	  switch ((s ?? '').toUpperCase()) {
66	    case 'ACCEPTED':
67	      return 'DBT_INITIATED';
68	    case 'CREDITED':
69	      return 'APPROVED';
70	    case 'REJECTED':
71	      return 'REJECTED';
72	    default:

75	}

81	    schemeNameHi: w.scheme_name_hi ?? w.scheme_name ?? w.scheme_code ?? '',
82	    applicantPartyId: w.farmer_party_id ?? '',
83	    appliedAt: w.created_at ?? '',
84	    status: mapSchemeStatus(w.status),
85	    dbtAmount: w.amount,
86	  };

```text
1	# Profile: Onboarding Executive (`/onboarding`)
2	
3	Role `ONBOARDING_EXECUTIVE`. The **entry point to the chain**: a field executive
4	enrols a new person (farmer, tester, rider, plant/branch staff, ...) with assisted
5	KYC; the request enters a queue and the **super admin verifies** before the role
6	goes live. Nothing is granted without that verification.
7	
8	## Place in the chain
9	
10	```
11	[Executive enrols person + assisted KYC] ─▶ PENDING queue ─▶ [Super admin verifies]
12	                                          ─▶ Party + role assignment created ─▶ that person joins the chain
13	```
14	
15	- **Upstream:** none - this is how people *enter* the system.
16	- **Downstream:** the **super admin** (see `docs/profiles/admin.md`) approves; the
17	  same governance guard runs here as on the admin grant path, so the Sachiv cap
18	  can never be bypassed by approving an onboarding request.
19	
20	## Screens
21	
22	- `index` - role-first chooser ─▶ a form that adapts to the role: profile photo,
23	  identity, a **location-aware centre picker** (nearby ranking) or a **Sachiv
24	  dropdown** for farmers, plus role-specific fields (cattle count + breed, vehicle
25	  number, employee id) and the KYC document (type + number + photo / DigiLocker pull).
26	
27	## Backdoors used (from `@/core/integration`)
28	
29	| Seam | Use |
30	|------|-----|
31	| **backend** | submit onboarding, list Sachivs, verification queue |
32	| **capture** | `capturePhoto('KYC_DOCUMENT' / 'PROFILE')` |
33	| **upload** | `uploadImage()` - photos to S3; only the object URL is stored |
34	| **nearby** | `useNearbyCentres()` - rank the "Assigned to" centres by distance (on-device) |
35	
36	This branch routes the capture + upload seams through the unified
37	`@/core/integration` surface (were direct seam imports).
38	
39	## Consumer-app connection
40	
41	None. Onboarding is internal governance; it feeds people *into* the operations
42	app, not the consumer app.
43	
44	## Fixes in this branch
45	
46	- `listSachivs` now filters to **active** assignments (a revoked Sachiv no longer
47	  appears in the farmer's "assigned under" dropdown) - closes an audit finding.
48	- Re-stripped the em/en dashes reintroduced in the onboarding-module files to the
49	  codebase's ASCII convention.
50	
51	## Backend wiring status
52	
53	The verification queue is `// TODO(backend)` (identity exposes /kyc + /roles but no
54	queue yet), served by the mock. Role↔org scoping + governance-role exclusions +
55	required KYC/photo are enforced client- and mock-side. Feature-complete; this
56	branch routes the device seams via the integration surface + applies the fixes.
57
```

33	// Service holds the plant module's business logic: lot pooling, the safety

35	type Service struct {
36		repo     *Repo

43	// NewService wires the service from the shared dependency container and the

45	func NewService(repo *Repo, d *deps.Deps, log *slog.Logger) *Service {
46		return &Service{
47			repo:     repo,
48			orgs:     d.Orgs,
49			ledger:   d.Ledger,
50			qrSecret: d.Cfg.QRSigningSecret,
51			log:      log,
52		}

55	// actorID parses the actor's party identity — carried as an ObjectID hex
56	// string in JWT claims — into the ObjectID persisted on created documents.
57	func actorID(actor auth.Actor) (primitive.ObjectID, error) {
58		return httpx.ParseID(actor.PartyID, "actor")
59	}
60	
61	// fail wraps an unexpected error with its failing operation, logs it at ERROR
62	// and returns the opaque 500 — every internal failure must name its op in the
63	// logs.
64	func (s *Service) fail(ctx context.Context, op string, err error) error {
65		err = fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", op, err)
66		s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "plant operation failed",
67			slog.String("op", op), slog.Any("err", err))
68		return httpx.Internal(err)
69	}
70	
71	// requireScope enforces the actor's org scope and logs denials at WARN so
72	// cross-scope probing is visible.
73	func (s *Service) requireScope(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, targetOrgID primitive.ObjectID, op string) error {
74		err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, targetOrgID)
75		if err == nil {
76			return nil
77		}
78		var app *httpx.AppError
79		if errors.As(err, &app) && app.Status == http.StatusForbidden {
80			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "org scope denied",
81				slog.String("op", op),
82				slog.String("target_org_id", targetOrgID.Hex()),
83				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
84				slog.String("actor_role", actor.RoleCode))
85		}
86		return err
87	}

89	// --- safety-gate predicates (§8.3) ---
90	//
91	// Pure functions so the refusal matrix is unit-testable without a database.
92	// Every mutation below ALSO re-checks the status inside the MongoDB update
93	// filter, so a concurrent QC block can never slip a bad lot through.
94	
95	// canDispatchBMCLot: only a lot with a passing BMC rapid test may leave on a
96	// tanker. BLOCKED, QC_PENDING and OPEN lots stay put.
97	func canDispatchBMCLot(status string) bool {
98		return status == domain.BMCLotStatusPassed
99	}
100	
101	// canPoolBMCLot: only a DISPATCHED lot (which by construction went
102	// OPEN→QC_PENDING→PASSED→DISPATCHED) may enter a processing batch.
103	func canPoolBMCLot(status string) bool {
104		return status == domain.BMCLotStatusDispatched
105	}

107	// canCompleteBatch: only a batch the plant lab has PASSED may complete.
108	func canCompleteBatch(status string) bool {
109		return status == domain.BatchStatusPassed
110	}
111	
112	// canYieldProductLot: only a COMPLETED batch may be packaged into SKU lots.
113	func canYieldProductLot(batchStatus string) bool {
114		return batchStatus == domain.BatchStatusCompleted
115	}

118	// COMPLETED. This read-time check is advisory; IssueQR additionally confirms
119	// the lot is still ACTIVE with a conditional write after the QR insert, so a
120	// recall landing mid-request still stops the mint.
121	func canIssueQR(lotStatus, batchStatus string) bool {
122		return lotStatus == domain.ProductLotStatusActive && batchStatus == domain.BatchStatusCompleted
123	}

125	// --- BMC lots ---
126	
127	// CreateBMCLot pools DELIVERED consignments into a new OPEN lot at a BMC.
128	func (s *Service) CreateBMCLot(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateBMCLotRequest) (*domain.BMCLot, error) {
129		actID, err := actorID(actor)
130		if err != nil {
131			return nil, err
132		}
133		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, req.BMCID, "create bmc lot"); err != nil {
134			return nil, err
135		}
136		org, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.BMCID)
137		if err != nil {
138			return nil, err
139		}
140		if org.Type != domain.OrgTypeBMC {
141			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot creation refused: org unit is not a BMC",
142				slog.String("org_unit_id", req.BMCID.Hex()),
143				slog.String("org_type", org.Type),
144				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
145			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_BMC", "org unit "+req.BMCID.Hex()+" is not a BMC")
146		}
147	
148		now := time.Now().UTC()
149		date := req.Date
150		if date == "" {
151			date = domain.DateKeyIST(now)
152		}
153	
154		ids := dedupe(req.ConsignmentIDs)
155		consignments, err := s.repo.ConsignmentsByIDs(ctx, ids)
156		if err != nil {
157			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "load consignments", err)
158		}
159		if len(consignments) != len(ids) {
160			return nil, httpx.NotFound("consignment(s) " + strings.Join(missingIDs(ids, consignments), ", "))
161		}
162		var undelivered []string
163		for _, c := range consignments {
164			if c.Status != domain.ConsignmentStatusDelivered {
165				undelivered = append(undelivered, c.ID.Hex())
166			}
167		}
168		if len(undelivered) > 0 {
169			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot creation refused: consignment(s) not DELIVERED",
170				slog.String("bmc_id", req.BMCID.Hex()),
171				slog.String("consignment_ids", strings.Join(undelivered, ",")),
172				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
173			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("CONSIGNMENT_NOT_DELIVERED",
174				"only DELIVERED consignments can be pooled into a BMC lot").
175				WithDetails(map[string]any{"consignment_ids": undelivered})
176		}
177	
178		// Optimistic claim: flip DELIVERED→ACCEPTED stamped with the new lot ID.
179		// The lot ID is pre-generated so claim, insert and ledger all agree.
180		// If another lot raced us on any consignment, release our claims and bail.
181		lotID := primitive.NewObjectID()
182		claimed, err := s.repo.ClaimConsignments(ctx, ids, lotID)
183		if err != nil {
184			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "claim consignments", err)
185		}
186		if claimed != int64(len(ids)) {
187			if relErr := s.repo.ReleaseConsignments(ctx, lotID); relErr != nil {
188				return nil, s.fail(ctx, "release consignments after lost claim", relErr)
189			}
190			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot creation lost consignment claim race",
191				slog.String("bmc_id", req.BMCID.Hex()),
192				slog.Int64("claimed", claimed), slog.Int("requested", len(ids)),
193				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
194			return nil, httpx.Conflict("CONSIGNMENT_CLAIM_CONFLICT",
195				"one or more consignments were pooled by another lot — reload and retry")
196		}
197	
198		var totalLitres float64
199		var tripIDs []primitive.ObjectID
200		seenTrip := map[primitive.ObjectID]bool{}
201		for _, c := range consignments {
202			totalLitres += c.TotalQuantityLitres
203			if c.RouteTripID != nil && !seenTrip[*c.RouteTripID] {
204				seenTrip[*c.RouteTripID] = true
205				tripIDs = append(tripIDs, *c.RouteTripID)
206			}
207		}
208	
209		lot := &domain.BMCLot{
210			ID:                  lotID,
211			BMCID:               req.BMCID,
212			Date:                date,
213			Shift:               req.Shift,
214			ConsignmentIDs:      ids,
215			RouteTripIDs:        tripIDs,
216			TotalQuantityLitres: totalLitres,
217			Status:              domain.BMCLotStatusOpen,
218			CreatedBy:           actID,
219			CreatedAt:           now,
220		}
221		if err := s.repo.InsertBMCLot(ctx, lot); err != nil {
222			_ = s.repo.ReleaseConsignments(ctx, lotID)
223			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "insert bmc lot", err)
224		}
225	
226		refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, len(ids))
227		for _, id := range ids {
228			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{
229				EntityType: domain.EntityConsignment, EntityID: id.Hex(), Relation: "pools",
230			})
231		}
232		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
233			Type:       domain.EventBMCLotCreated,
234			EntityType: domain.EntityBMCLot,
235			EntityID:   lot.ID.Hex(),
236			Refs:       refs,
237			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
238			OrgUnitID:  req.BMCID.Hex(),
239			Payload: map[string]any{
240				"date": date, "shift": req.Shift, "total_quantity_litres": totalLitres,
241			},
242		})
243		if err != nil {
244			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append bmc_lot.created event", err)
245		}
246		if err := s.repo.SetBMCLotProvenanceSeq(ctx, lot.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
247			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp bmc lot provenance seq", err)
248		}
249		lot.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
250		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "bmc lot created",
251			slog.String("bmc_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()),
252			slog.String("bmc_id", req.BMCID.Hex()),
253			slog.String("date", date), slog.String("shift", req.Shift),
254			slog.Int("consignments", len(ids)),
255			slog.Float64("total_quantity_litres", totalLitres),
256			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
257		return lot, nil
258	}
259	
260	// CloseBMCLot transitions an OPEN lot to QC_PENDING with the chilling
261	// temperature. The quality module later flips QC_PENDING→PASSED/BLOCKED.
262	func (s *Service) CloseBMCLot(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID, chillingTempC float64) (*domain.BMCLot, error) {
263		lot, err := s.getBMCLot(ctx, id)
264		if err != nil {
265			return nil, err
266		}
267		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, lot.BMCID, "close bmc lot"); err != nil {
268			return nil, err
269		}
270		if lot.Status != domain.BMCLotStatusOpen {
271			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot close refused: not OPEN",
272				slog.String("bmc_lot_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("status", lot.Status),
273				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
274			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_NOT_OPEN",
275				"only an OPEN lot can be closed; lot is "+lot.Status)
276		}
277		now := time.Now().UTC()
278		ok, err := s.repo.CloseBMCLot(ctx, id, chillingTempC, now)
279		if err != nil {
280			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "close bmc lot", err)
281		}
282		if !ok {
283			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot close lost state race",
284				slog.String("bmc_lot_id", id.Hex()),
285				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
286			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_NOT_OPEN",
287				"lot changed state concurrently — reload and retry")
288		}
289		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
290			Type:       domain.EventBMCLotClosed,
291			EntityType: domain.EntityBMCLot,
292			EntityID:   lot.ID.Hex(),
293			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
294			OrgUnitID:  lot.BMCID.Hex(),
295			Payload:    map[string]any{"chilling_temp_c": chillingTempC},
296		})
297		if err != nil {
298			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append bmc_lot.closed event", err)
299		}
300		if err := s.repo.SetBMCLotProvenanceSeq(ctx, lot.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
301			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp bmc lot provenance seq", err)
302		}
303		lot.Status = domain.BMCLotStatusQCPending
304		lot.ChillingTempC = chillingTempC
305		lot.ClosedAt = &now
306		lot.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
307		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "bmc lot closed for QC",
308			slog.String("bmc_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()),
309			slog.String("bmc_id", lot.BMCID.Hex()),
310			slog.Float64("chilling_temp_c", chillingTempC),
311			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
312		return lot, nil
313	}
314	
315	// DispatchBMCLot transitions PASSED→DISPATCHED. THE safety gate (§8.3): a
316	// BLOCKED or untested lot never leaves the chilling centre.
317	func (s *Service) DispatchBMCLot(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.BMCLot, error) {
318		lot, err := s.getBMCLot(ctx, id)
319		if err != nil {
320			return nil, err
321		}
322		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, lot.BMCID, "dispatch bmc lot"); err != nil {
323			return nil, err
324		}
325		if lot.Status == domain.BMCLotStatusDispatched {
326			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot dispatch refused: already dispatched",
327				slog.String("bmc_lot_id", id.Hex()),
328				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
329			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_ALREADY_DISPATCHED", "lot is already dispatched")
330		}
331		if !canDispatchBMCLot(lot.Status) {
332			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot dispatch refused: safety gate not passed",
333				slog.String("bmc_lot_id", id.Hex()),
334				slog.String("status", lot.Status),
335				slog.String("block_reason", lot.BlockReason),
336				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
337			msg := "lot cannot be dispatched: safety gate not passed (status " + lot.Status + ")"
338			if lot.BlockReason != "" {
339				msg += " — " + lot.BlockReason
340			}
341			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked, msg).
342				WithDetails(map[string]any{"status": lot.Status, "block_reason": lot.BlockReason})
343		}
344		now := time.Now().UTC()
345		ok, err := s.repo.DispatchBMCLot(ctx, id, now)
346		if err != nil {
347			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "dispatch bmc lot", err)
348		}
349		if !ok {
350			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot dispatch lost state race",
351				slog.String("bmc_lot_id", id.Hex()),
352				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
353			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_STATE_CHANGED",
354				"lot changed state concurrently — reload and retry")
355		}
356		// The custody transition — gate-passed milk physically leaving the
357		// chilling centre — must live on the tamper-evident chain like every
358		// other hop of the pour→QR path, not only in a mutable document field.
359		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
360			Type:       domain.EventBMCLotDispatched,
361			EntityType: domain.EntityBMCLot,
362			EntityID:   lot.ID.Hex(),
363			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
364			OrgUnitID:  lot.BMCID.Hex(),
365			Payload: map[string]any{
366				// String, not time.Time: payloads must round-trip BSON⇄JSON
367				// byte-identically or chain re-verification would break.
368				"dispatched_at":         now.Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
369				"total_quantity_litres": lot.TotalQuantityLitres,
370			},
371		})
372		if err != nil {
373			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append bmc_lot.dispatched event", err)
374		}
375		if err := s.repo.SetBMCLotProvenanceSeq(ctx, lot.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
376			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp bmc lot provenance seq", err)
377		}
378		lot.Status = domain.BMCLotStatusDispatched
379		lot.DispatchedAt = &now
380		lot.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
381		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "bmc lot dispatched",
382			slog.String("bmc_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()),
383			slog.String("bmc_id", lot.BMCID.Hex()),
384			slog.Float64("total_quantity_litres", lot.TotalQuantityLitres),
385			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
386		return lot, nil
387	}
388	
389	// ListBMCLots pages lots by BMC/date/status. A BMC operator may only list
390	// within their own scope; downstream readers (plant operator, supervisor,
391	// lab) see across BMCs — the plant receives tankers from sibling BMCs, so an
392	// ancestry check against the plant org would wrongly refuse them.
393	func (s *Service) ListBMCLots(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, f BMCLotListFilter, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.BMCLot, int64, error) {
394		if !f.BMCID.IsZero() && actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleBMCOperator {
395			if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, f.BMCID, "list bmc lots"); err != nil {
396				return nil, 0, err
397			}
398		}
399		lots, total, err := s.repo.ListBMCLots(ctx, f, page)
400		if err != nil {
401			return nil, 0, s.fail(ctx, "list bmc lots", err)
402		}
403		return lots, total, nil
404	}
405	
406	// --- processing batches ---
407	
408	// CreateBatch pools DISPATCHED (gate-passed) BMC lots into one production
409	// run. The gate re-checks here belt-and-braces: aflatoxin M1 survives
410	// pasteurisation, so a blocked lot must never reach a vat (§8.3).
411	func (s *Service) CreateBatch(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateBatchRequest) (*domain.ProcessingBatch, error) {
412		actID, err := actorID(actor)
413		if err != nil {
414			return nil, err
415		}
416		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, req.PlantID, "create batch"); err != nil {
417			return nil, err
418		}
419		org, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.PlantID)
420		if err != nil {
421			return nil, err
422		}
423		if org.Type != domain.OrgTypeProcessingPlant {
424			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch creation refused: org unit is not a plant",
425				slog.String("org_unit_id", req.PlantID.Hex()),
426				slog.String("org_type", org.Type),
427				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
428			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_PLANT", "org unit "+req.PlantID.Hex()+" is not a processing plant")
429		}
430	
431		ids := dedupe(req.BMCLotIDs)
432		lots, err := s.repo.BMCLotsByIDs(ctx, ids)
433		if err != nil {
434			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "load bmc lots", err)
435		}
436		if len(lots) != len(ids) {
437			return nil, httpx.NotFound("BMC lot(s) " + strings.Join(missingLotIDs(ids, lots), ", "))
438		}
439		var offending []string
440		var inputLitres float64
441		for _, lot := range lots {
442			if !canPoolBMCLot(lot.Status) {
443				offending = append(offending, lot.ID.Hex())
444				continue
445			}
446			inputLitres += lot.TotalQuantityLitres
447		}
448		if len(offending) > 0 {
449			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch creation refused: bmc lot(s) have not cleared the safety gate",
450				slog.String("plant_id", req.PlantID.Hex()),
451				slog.String("blocked_lot_ids", strings.Join(offending, ",")),
452				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
453			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked,
454				"one or more BMC lots have not cleared the safety gate (must be PASSED and DISPATCHED)").
455				WithDetails(map[string]any{"blocked_lot_ids": offending})
456		}
457	
458		now := time.Now().UTC()
459		dateKey := domain.DateKeyIST(now)
460		seq, err := s.repo.NextSequence(ctx, "batch_number:"+req.PlantID.Hex()+":"+dateKey)
461		if err != nil {
462			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "next batch number sequence", err)
463		}
464		batchNumber := fmt.Sprintf("BATCH-%s-%s-%04d",
465			org.Code, strings.ReplaceAll(dateKey, "-", ""), seq)
466	
467		// Optimistic claim (mirrors ClaimConsignments): flip DISPATCHED→POOLED
468		// stamped with the pre-generated batch ID BEFORE inserting the batch. One
469		// physical lot of milk can therefore never be pooled into two batches —
470		// neither by a double-submit nor by two concurrent CreateBatch calls.
471		batchID := primitive.NewObjectID()
472		claimed, err := s.repo.ClaimBMCLots(ctx, ids, batchID)
473		if err != nil {
474			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "claim bmc lots", err)
475		}
476		if claimed != int64(len(ids)) {
477			if relErr := s.repo.ReleaseBMCLots(ctx, batchID); relErr != nil {
478				return nil, s.fail(ctx, "release bmc lots after lost claim", relErr)
479			}
480			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch creation lost bmc lot claim race",
481				slog.String("plant_id", req.PlantID.Hex()),
482				slog.Int64("claimed", claimed), slog.Int("requested", len(ids)),
483				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
484			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_CLAIM_CONFLICT",
485				"one or more BMC lots were pooled by another batch — reload and retry")
486		}
487	
488		// CREATED is a transient birth state: the plant lab must clear every
489		// batch, so it is persisted straight into QC_PENDING.
490		batch := &domain.ProcessingBatch{
491			ID:          batchID,
492			PlantID:     req.PlantID,
493			BatchNumber: batchNumber,
494			BMCLotIDs:   ids,
495			ProductType: req.ProductType,
496			InputLitres: inputLitres,
497			Status:      domain.BatchStatusQCPending,
498			StartedAt:   now,
499			CreatedBy:   actID,
500			CreatedAt:   now,
501		}
502		if err := s.repo.InsertBatch(ctx, batch); err != nil {
503			_ = s.repo.ReleaseBMCLots(ctx, batchID)
504			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "insert batch", err)
505		}
506	
507		refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, len(ids))
508		for _, id := range ids {
509			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{
510				EntityType: domain.EntityBMCLot, EntityID: id.Hex(), Relation: "pools",
511			})
512		}
513		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
514			Type:       domain.EventBatchCreated,
515			EntityType: domain.EntityBatch,
516			EntityID:   batch.ID.Hex(),
517			Refs:       refs,
518			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
519			OrgUnitID:  req.PlantID.Hex(),
520			Payload: map[string]any{
521				"batch_number": batchNumber, "product_type": req.ProductType, "input_litres": inputLitres,
522			},
523		})
524		if err != nil {
525			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append batch.created event", err)
526		}
527		if err := s.repo.SetBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx, batch.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
528			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp batch provenance seq", err)
529		}
530		batch.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
531		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "processing batch created",
532			slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
533			slog.String("batch_number", batchNumber),
534			slog.String("plant_id", req.PlantID.Hex()),
535			slog.String("product_type", req.ProductType),
536			slog.Int("bmc_lots", len(ids)),
537			slog.Float64("input_litres", inputLitres),
538			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
539		return batch, nil
540	}
541	
542	// CompleteBatch transitions PASSED→COMPLETED — only a batch the plant lab
543	// cleared may finish and go on to yield product lots.
544	func (s *Service) CompleteBatch(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.ProcessingBatch, error) {
545		batch, err := s.getBatch(ctx, id)
546		if err != nil {
547			return nil, err
548		}
549		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, batch.PlantID, "complete batch"); err != nil {
550			return nil, err
551		}
552		if batch.Status == domain.BatchStatusCompleted {
553			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch completion refused: already completed",
554				slog.String("batch_id", id.Hex()),
555				slog.String("batch_number", batch.BatchNumber),
556				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
557			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BATCH_ALREADY_COMPLETED", "batch is already completed")
558		}
559		if !canCompleteBatch(batch.Status) {
560			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch completion refused: plant-lab QC not passed",
561				slog.String("batch_id", id.Hex()),
562				slog.String("batch_number", batch.BatchNumber),
563				slog.String("status", batch.Status),
564				slog.String("block_reason", batch.BlockReason),
565				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
566			msg := "batch cannot complete: plant-lab QC not passed (status " + batch.Status + ")"
567			if batch.BlockReason != "" {
568				msg += " — " + batch.BlockReason
569			}
570			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked, msg).
571				WithDetails(map[string]any{"status": batch.Status, "block_reason": batch.BlockReason})
572		}
573		now := time.Now().UTC()
574		ok, err := s.repo.CompleteBatch(ctx, id, now)
575		if err != nil {
576			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "complete batch", err)
577		}
578		if !ok {
579			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch completion lost state race",
580				slog.String("batch_id", id.Hex()),
581				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
582			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BATCH_STATE_CHANGED",
583				"batch changed state concurrently — reload and retry")
584		}
585		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
586			Type:       domain.EventBatchCompleted,
587			EntityType: domain.EntityBatch,
588			EntityID:   batch.ID.Hex(),
589			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
590			OrgUnitID:  batch.PlantID.Hex(),
591			Payload:    map[string]any{"batch_number": batch.BatchNumber},
592		})
593		if err != nil {
594			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append batch.completed event", err)
595		}
596		if err := s.repo.SetBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx, batch.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
597			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp batch provenance seq", err)
598		}
599		batch.Status = domain.BatchStatusCompleted
600		batch.CompletedAt = &now
601		batch.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
602		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "processing batch completed",
603			slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
604			slog.String("batch_number", batch.BatchNumber),
605			slog.String("plant_id", batch.PlantID.Hex()),
606			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
607		return batch, nil
608	}

636	// --- product lots ---
637	
638	// CreateProductLot packages a COMPLETED batch into a SKU lot (gate re-check).
639	func (s *Service) CreateProductLot(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateProductLotRequest) (*domain.ProductLot, error) {
640		batch, err := s.getBatch(ctx, req.BatchID)
641		if err != nil {
642			return nil, err
643		}
644		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, batch.PlantID, "create product lot"); err != nil {
645			return nil, err
646		}
647		if !canYieldProductLot(batch.Status) {
648			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "product lot creation refused: batch has not completed the safety gate",
649				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
650				slog.String("batch_number", batch.BatchNumber),
651				slog.String("batch_status", batch.Status),
652				slog.String("block_reason", batch.BlockReason),
653				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
654			msg := "batch has not completed the safety gate (status " + batch.Status + ") — no product lots may be made"
655			if batch.BlockReason != "" {
656				msg += " — " + batch.BlockReason
657			}
658			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked, msg).
659				WithDetails(map[string]any{"batch_status": batch.Status, "block_reason": batch.BlockReason})
660		}
661	
662		now := time.Now().UTC()
663		mfgDate := req.MfgDate
664		if mfgDate == "" {
665			mfgDate = domain.DateKeyIST(now)
666		}
667		if req.ExpiryDate <= mfgDate {
668			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_EXPIRY", "expiry_date must be after mfg_date")
669		}
670	
671		lot := &domain.ProductLot{
672			ID:          primitive.NewObjectID(),
673			BatchID:     batch.ID,
674			PlantID:     batch.PlantID,
675			SKU:         req.SKU,
676			ProductName: req.ProductName,
677			Units:       req.Units,
678			UnitSize:    req.UnitSize,
679			MRP:         req.MRP,
680			MfgDate:     mfgDate,
681			ExpiryDate:  req.ExpiryDate,
682			Status:      domain.ProductLotStatusActive,
683			CreatedAt:   now,
684		}
685		if err := s.repo.InsertProductLot(ctx, lot); err != nil {
686			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "insert product lot", err)
687		}
688		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
689			Type:       domain.EventProductLotMade,
690			EntityType: domain.EntityProductLot,
691			EntityID:   lot.ID.Hex(),
692			Refs: []provenance.Ref{
693				{EntityType: domain.EntityBatch, EntityID: batch.ID.Hex(), Relation: "yields"},
694			},
695			Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
696			OrgUnitID: batch.PlantID.Hex(),
697			Payload: map[string]any{
698				"sku": req.SKU, "units": req.Units, "unit_size": req.UnitSize,
699				"mfg_date": mfgDate, "expiry_date": req.ExpiryDate,
700			},
701		})
702		if err != nil {
703			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append product_lot.created event", err)
704		}
705		if err := s.repo.SetProductLotProvenanceSeq(ctx, lot.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
706			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp product lot provenance seq", err)
707		}
708		lot.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
709		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "product lot created",
710			slog.String("product_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()),
711			slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
712			slog.String("batch_number", batch.BatchNumber),
713			slog.String("sku", req.SKU),
714			slog.Int("units", req.Units),
715			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
716		return lot, nil
717	}
718	
719	// RecallProductLot pulls a lot from market (FSSAI recall path, §18-C).
720	func (s *Service) RecallProductLot(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID, reason string) (*domain.ProductLot, error) {
721		lot, err := s.getProductLot(ctx, id)
722		if err != nil {
723			return nil, err
724		}
725		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, lot.PlantID, "recall product lot"); err != nil {
726			return nil, err
727		}
728		if lot.Status == domain.ProductLotStatusRecalled {
729			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "product lot recall refused: already recalled",
730				slog.String("product_lot_id", id.Hex()),
731				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
732			return nil, httpx.Conflict("PRODUCT_LOT_ALREADY_RECALLED", "product lot is already recalled")
733		}
734		ok, err := s.repo.RecallProductLot(ctx, id, reason)
735		if err != nil {
736			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "recall product lot", err)
737		}
738		if !ok {
739			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "product lot recall lost state race: already recalled",
740				slog.String("product_lot_id", id.Hex()),
741				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
742			return nil, httpx.Conflict("PRODUCT_LOT_ALREADY_RECALLED", "product lot is already recalled")
743		}
744		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
745			Type:       domain.EventProductRecalled,
746			EntityType: domain.EntityProductLot,
747			EntityID:   lot.ID.Hex(),
748			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
749			OrgUnitID:  lot.PlantID.Hex(),
750			Payload:    map[string]any{"reason": reason},
751		})
752		if err != nil {
753			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append product_lot.recalled event", err)
754		}
755		if err := s.repo.SetProductLotProvenanceSeq(ctx, lot.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
756			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp product lot provenance seq", err)
757		}
758		lot.Status = domain.ProductLotStatusRecalled
759		lot.RecallReason = reason
760		lot.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
761		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "product lot recalled",
762			slog.String("product_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()),

770	// --- QR issuance ---
771	
772	// qrAlphabet is the 32-character human-safe set for short codes: A–Z and 2–9
773	// minus the confusables 0/O and 1/I. 32 divides 256, so a byte modulo the
774	// alphabet length is unbiased.
775	const qrAlphabet = "ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789"
776	
777	// qrCodeLength is the number of random characters after the "PRG-" prefix
778	// (32^8 ≈ 1.1 trillion codes — collisions are retried on the unique index).
779	const qrCodeLength = 8
780	
781	// newQRCode mints a short public code like "[REDACTED:generic-api-key]" from crypto/rand.
782	func newQRCode() (string, error) {
783		buf := make([]byte, qrCodeLength)
784		if _, err := rand.Read(buf); err != nil {
785			return "", err
786		}
787		code := make([]byte, qrCodeLength)
788		for i, b := range buf {
789			code[i] = qrAlphabet[int(b)%len(qrAlphabet)]
790		}
791		return "PRG-" + string(code), nil
792	}
793	
794	// signQRToken builds the forgery-proof token printed inside the QR:
795	// base64url(qr_code|product_lot_hex|issued_unix) + "." + hex(HMAC-SHA256).
796	// productLotHex is the product lot ObjectID's hex form — the HMAC material is
797	// "qr_code|lot hex|unix", and the publictrace module verifies the exact same
798	// shape. The consumer app resolves the payload; the signature proves it was
799	// minted by this server, so IDs cannot be guessed onto counterfeit packs.
800	func signQRToken(secret, qrCode, productLotHex string, issuedAt time.Time) string {
801		payload := qrCode + "|" + productLotHex + "|" + strconv.FormatInt(issuedAt.Unix(), 10)
802		mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte(secret))
803		mac.Write([]byte(payload))
804		return base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(payload)) + "." + hex.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))
805	}
806	
807	// parseQRToken verifies and unpacks a signed QR token, returning the product
808	// lot ObjectID as its hex string.
809	func parseQRToken(secret, token string) (qrCode, productLotHex string, issuedAt time.Time, err error) {
810		payloadB64, sigHex, found := strings.Cut(token, ".")
811		if !found {
812			return "", "", time.Time{}, errors.New("qr token: missing signature separator")
813		}
814		payloadBytes, err := base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString(payloadB64)
815		if err != nil {
816			return "", "", time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("qr token: bad payload encoding: %w", err)
817		}
818		sig, err := hex.DecodeString(sigHex)
819		if err != nil {
820			return "", "", time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("qr token: bad signature encoding: %w", err)
821		}
822		mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte(secret))
823		mac.Write(payloadBytes)
824		if !hmac.Equal(sig, mac.Sum(nil)) {
825			return "", "", time.Time{}, errors.New("qr token: signature mismatch")
826		}
827		parts := strings.Split(string(payloadBytes), "|")
828		if len(parts) != 3 {
829			return "", "", time.Time{}, errors.New("qr token: malformed payload")
830		}
831		unix, err := strconv.ParseInt(parts[2], 10, 64)
832		if err != nil {
833			return "", "", time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("qr token: bad timestamp: %w", err)
834		}
835		return parts[0], parts[1], time.Unix(unix, 0).UTC(), nil
836	}
837	
838	// IssueQR mints one signed QR for an ACTIVE product lot whose batch is
839	// COMPLETED. The gate is checked on read AND re-confirmed with a conditional
840	// write on the lot after the QR insert, so recalled or blocked product can
841	// never be freshly labelled even when the recall races this request.
842	func (s *Service) IssueQR(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, productLotID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.BatchQR, error) {
843		actID, err := actorID(actor)
844		if err != nil {
845			return nil, err
846		}
847		lot, err := s.getProductLot(ctx, productLotID)
848		if err != nil {
849			return nil, err
850		}
851		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, lot.PlantID, "issue qr"); err != nil {
852			return nil, err
853		}
854		batch, err := s.getBatch(ctx, lot.BatchID)
855		if err != nil {
856			return nil, err
857		}
858		if !canIssueQR(lot.Status, batch.Status) {
859			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qr issuance refused: safety gate",
860				slog.String("product_lot_id", productLotID.Hex()),
861				slog.String("product_lot_status", lot.Status),
862				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
863				slog.String("batch_status", batch.Status),
864				slog.String("recall_reason", lot.RecallReason),
865				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
866			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked,
867				"QR issuance refused: product lot must be ACTIVE and its batch COMPLETED").
868				WithDetails(map[string]any{
869					"product_lot_status": lot.Status,
870					"batch_status":       batch.Status,
871					"recall_reason":      lot.RecallReason,
872				})
873		}
874	
875		now := time.Now().UTC()
876		var qr *domain.BatchQR
877		const maxMintAttempts = 5
878		for attempt := 0; attempt < maxMintAttempts; attempt++ {
879			code, err := newQRCode()
880			if err != nil {
881				return nil, s.fail(ctx, "generate qr code", err)
882			}
883			candidate := &domain.BatchQR{
884				ID:           primitive.NewObjectID(),
885				QRCode:       code,
886				ProductLotID: lot.ID,
887				SignedToken:  signQRToken(s.qrSecret, code, lot.ID.Hex(), now),
888				IssuedBy:     actID,
889				ScanCount:    0,
890				IssuedAt:     now,
891			}
892			insertErr := s.repo.InsertQR(ctx, candidate)
893			if insertErr == nil {
894				qr = candidate
895				break
896			}
897			if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(insertErr) {
898				continue // short-code collision — regenerate
899			}
900			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "insert qr", insertErr)
901		}
902		if qr == nil {
903			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "mint qr code",
904				fmt.Errorf("%d consecutive short-code collisions", maxMintAttempts))
905		}
906	
907		// Recall re-check at WRITE time: the initial read cannot see a recall that
908		// lands mid-request, so the mint is confirmed with a conditional no-op
909		// write on the lot (filter status=ACTIVE). If the lot left ACTIVE, the
910		// just-inserted QR is deleted and issuance refused — a freshly minted QR
911		// can never label recalled product.
912		active, err := s.repo.TouchActiveLot(ctx, lot.ID)
913		if err != nil {
914			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "confirm product lot active", err)
915		}
916		if !active {
917			if delErr := s.repo.DeleteQR(ctx, qr.ID); delErr != nil {
918				return nil, s.fail(ctx, "delete qr after lot left ACTIVE", delErr)
919			}
920			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qr issuance refused: product lot left ACTIVE during issuance",
921				slog.String("product_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()),
922				slog.String("qr_id", qr.ID.Hex()),
923				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
924			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked,
925				"QR issuance refused: product lot left ACTIVE (e.g. recalled) during issuance")
926		}
927	
928		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
929			Type:       domain.EventQRIssued,
930			EntityType: domain.EntityBatchQR,
931			EntityID:   qr.ID.Hex(),
932			Refs: []provenance.Ref{
933				{EntityType: domain.EntityProductLot, EntityID: lot.ID.Hex(), Relation: "labels"},
934			},
935			Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
936			OrgUnitID: lot.PlantID.Hex(),
937			Payload:   map[string]any{"qr_code": qr.QRCode},
938		})
939		if err != nil {
940			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append qr.issued event", err)
941		}
942		if err := s.repo.SetQRProvenanceSeq(ctx, qr.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
943			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp qr provenance seq", err)
944		}
945		qr.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
946		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "qr issued",
947			slog.String("qr_id", qr.ID.Hex()),
948			slog.String("qr_code", qr.QRCode),
949			slog.String("product_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()),
950			slog.String("plant_id", lot.PlantID.Hex()),
951			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))

953	}

1009	// dedupe removes zero and duplicate IDs preserving first-seen order.
1010	func dedupe(ids []primitive.ObjectID) []primitive.ObjectID {
1011		seen := make(map[primitive.ObjectID]bool, len(ids))
1012		out := make([]primitive.ObjectID, 0, len(ids))
1013		for _, id := range ids {
1014			if id.IsZero() || seen[id] {
1015				continue
1016			}
1017			seen[id] = true
1018			out = append(out, id)
1019		}
1020		return out
1021	}

1	// Package orgscope answers the RBAC question "is this resource inside the
2	// caller's organisational scope?" in O(1) DB reads. Org units denormalise
3	// their ancestor chain into Path ([]ObjectID), so scope checking is a
4	// set-membership test — no recursive tree walks on the hot path.
5	package orgscope
6	
7	import (
8		"context"
9		"errors"
10		"sync"
11		"time"
12	
13		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
14		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
15		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
16	
17		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
18		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
19		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
20	)
21	
22	const collection = "org_units"
23	
24	type cachedOrg struct {
25		org domain.OrgUnit
26		at  time.Time
27	}
28	
29	// Resolver caches org units briefly (the tree changes rarely, reads are hot).
30	type Resolver struct {
31		coll *mongo.Collection
32		ttl  time.Duration
33	
34		mu    sync.RWMutex
35		cache map[string]cachedOrg // keyed by ObjectID hex
36	}
37	
38	// NewResolver binds the resolver to the database.
39	func NewResolver(db *mongo.Database) *Resolver {
40		return &Resolver{
41			coll:  db.Collection(collection),
42			ttl:   60 * time.Second,
43			cache: make(map[string]cachedOrg),
44		}
45	}
46	
47	// Get returns an org unit by ObjectID (cached).
48	func (r *Resolver) Get(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
49		key := id.Hex()
50		r.mu.RLock()
51		c, ok := r.cache[key]
52		r.mu.RUnlock()
53		if ok && time.Since(c.at) < r.ttl {
54			org := c.org
55			return &org, nil
56		}
57	
58		var org domain.OrgUnit
59		err := r.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&org)
60		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
61			return nil, httpx.NotFound("org unit " + key)
62		}
63		if err != nil {
64			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
65		}
66	
67		r.mu.Lock()
68		r.cache[key] = cachedOrg{org: org, at: time.Now()}
69		r.mu.Unlock()
70		return &org, nil
71	}
72	
73	// GetByCode returns an org unit by its unique human-readable business code
74	// (e.g. "DCS-01842") — display/lookup use only, never for joins.
75	func (r *Resolver) GetByCode(ctx context.Context, code string) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
76		var org domain.OrgUnit
77		err := r.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "code", Value: code}}).Decode(&org)
78		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
79			return nil, httpx.NotFound("org unit with code " + code)
80		}
81		if err != nil {
82			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
83		}
84		return &org, nil
85	}
86	
87	// Invalidate drops a cached entry (call after updates).
88	func (r *Resolver) Invalidate(id primitive.ObjectID) {
89		r.mu.Lock()
90		delete(r.cache, id.Hex())
91		r.mu.Unlock()
92	}
93	
94	// InScope reports whether target sits at-or-below scope in the hierarchy:
95	// true when scope == target, or scope appears in target's ancestor Path.
96	func (r *Resolver) InScope(ctx context.Context, scopeOrgID, targetOrgID primitive.ObjectID) (bool, error) {
97		if scopeOrgID == targetOrgID {
98			return true, nil
99		}
100		target, err := r.Get(ctx, targetOrgID)
101		if err != nil {
102			return false, err
103		}
104		for _, ancestor := range target.Path {
105			if ancestor == scopeOrgID {
106				return true, nil
107			}
108		}
109		return false, nil
110	}
111	
112	// RequireInScope enforces the actor's org scope over a target org unit.
113	// SUPER_ADMIN and STATE_AUDITOR (read-wide roles rooted at the federation)
114	// pass automatically; everyone else needs ancestry. The actor carries its
115	// org unit as an ObjectID hex string (JWT claims are JSON); it is parsed here.
116	func (r *Resolver) RequireInScope(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, targetOrgID primitive.ObjectID) error {
117		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSuperAdmin || actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleStateAuditor {
118			return nil
119		}
120		if actor.OrgUnitID == "" {
121			return httpx.Forbidden("role token with org scope required")
122		}
123		scopeID, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(actor.OrgUnitID)
124		if err != nil {
125			return httpx.Forbidden("role token carries an invalid org scope")
126		}
127		ok, err := r.InScope(ctx, scopeID, targetOrgID)
128		if err != nil {
129			return err
130		}
131		if !ok {
132			return httpx.Forbidden("resource is outside your organisational scope")
133		}
134		return nil
135	}

21	// HasRole reports whether the actor operates under one of the given roles.

24			if a.RoleCode == r {
25				return true
26			}
27		}

31	type actorCtxKey struct{}
32	
33	// actorHolder is a mutable cell installed by OUTER middleware (audit) so
34	// identity established by INNER middleware (Authenticate) can flow back out.
35	// Context values only propagate inward; the shared pointer bridges the gap.
36	type actorHolder struct {
37		mu sync.Mutex
38		a  *Actor
39	}
40	
41	type actorHolderCtxKey struct{}
42	
43	// WithActorHolder installs an empty actor holder on the context. Middleware
44	// mounted before authentication uses it to observe the actor after the
45	// handler chain ran.
46	func WithActorHolder(ctx context.Context) context.Context {
47		return context.WithValue(ctx, actorHolderCtxKey{}, &actorHolder{})
48	}
49	
50	// HeldActor returns the actor captured by an inner WithActor call, if a
51	// holder was installed and authentication happened.
52	func HeldActor(ctx context.Context) (Actor, bool) {
53		h, ok := ctx.Value(actorHolderCtxKey{}).(*actorHolder)
54		if !ok {
55			return Actor{}, false
56		}
57		h.mu.Lock()
58		defer h.mu.Unlock()
59		if h.a == nil {
60			return Actor{}, false
61		}
62		return *h.a, true
63	}
64	
65	// WithActor stores the actor on the context, and also fills the outward
66	// actor holder when one was installed upstream (see WithActorHolder).
67	func WithActor(ctx context.Context, a Actor) context.Context {
68		if h, ok := ctx.Value(actorHolderCtxKey{}).(*actorHolder); ok {
69			h.mu.Lock()
70			cp := a
71			h.a = &cp
72			h.mu.Unlock()
73		}
74		return context.WithValue(ctx, actorCtxKey{}, a)
75	}

1	// Package domain holds the pure entity model of Saathi — structs, enums and
2	// invariants shared by every module. It has no behaviour beyond validation
3	// and no dependencies outside the standard library and BSON primitives.
4	// This is the contract layer: modules depend on domain, never the other way
5	// around.
6	package domain
7	
8	// Role codes — the role catalog from blueprint §5.2, grounded in the PCDF
9	// cooperative constitution (Farmer → Samiti/DCS → Sangh/Union → PCDF).
10	// A Party may hold many time-bounded, org-scoped RoleAssignments.
11	//
12	// The catalog is deliberately open for extension: adding a future role is a
13	// new constant + AllRoles entry + RequiredKYCTier entry — nothing else.
14	const (
15		// Village tier
16		RoleFarmer         = "FARMER"
17		RoleSamitiSacheev  = "SAMITI_SACHEEV"  // DCS paid Secretary (UPCS Act §31) — runs the collection console
18		RoleSamitiAdhyaksh = "SAMITI_ADHYAKSH" // DCS Chairman/Sabhapati (elected, honorary, §30)
19		RoleMilkTester     = "MILK_TESTER"
20		RoleLRP            = "LRP" // Local Resource Person (NDDB village extension)
21		RoleAITech         = "AI_TECH"
22	
23		// Field / organisation tier
24		// ORGANISING_MANAGER is the ground-level field worker (Dairy Development
25		// Department pattern: "promotes and organises new samitis") who performs
26		// doorstep KYC capture and first-level verification.
27		RoleOrganisingManager = "ORGANISING_MANAGER"
28		// ONBOARDING_EXECUTIVE is the mobile-app onboarding worker the field client
29		// uses for the same doorstep KYC / assisted-onboarding job as
30		// ORGANISING_MANAGER. Both are valid onboarding/review roles; the app codes
31		// this one, the backend historically coded the other.
32		RoleOnboardingExecutive = "ONBOARDING_EXECUTIVE"
33	
34		// Logistics tier
35		RoleVanRider      = "VAN_RIDER"
36		RoleDeliveryRider = "DELIVERY_RIDER"

39		// grantable role so the store console can be assigned).
40		RoleStoreManager = "STORE_MANAGER"

89	var OnboardingReviewerRoles = []string{

101	// IsValidRole reports whether code is one of the catalog roles.

107	// KYC assurance tiers (blueprint §4.2). Higher tiers unlock higher-trust roles.
108	const (

111		KYCTierStandard = "STANDARD" // Aadhaar eKYC
112		KYCTierRider    = "RIDER"    // Aadhaar eKYC + DL/RC

137		RoleUnionFieldSupervisor: KYCTierHigh,
138		RoleUnionPresident:       KYCTierHigh,
139		RolePlantOperator:        KYCTierHigh,
140		RolePlantLabAnalyst:      KYCTierHigh,
141		RolePCDFAdmin:            KYCTierHigh,
142		RoleMissionOfficial:      KYCTierHigh,
143		RoleDistrictVerifier:     KYCTierHigh,
144		RoleVeterinarian:         KYCTierHigh,
145		RoleMVUDriver:            KYCTierStandard,
146		RoleConsumer:             KYCTierMinimal,
147		RoleSupportAgent:         KYCTierHigh,
148		RoleStateAuditor:         KYCTierHigh,
149		RoleSuperAdmin:           KYCTierHighest,
150		RoleServiceAccount:       KYCTierService,
151	}

153	// kycRank orders tiers so "tier X satisfies requirement Y" is a comparison.
154	var kycRank = map[string]int{
155		KYCTierMinimal:  0,
156		KYCTierFarmer:   1,
157		KYCTierStandard: 1, // Farmer and Standard are parallel tier-1 proofs
158		KYCTierRider:    2,
159		KYCTierHigh:     3,
160		KYCTierHighest:  4,
161		KYCTierService:  4,
162		KYCTierMTLS:     4, // alias of SERVICE
163	}
164	
165	// KYCTierSatisfies reports whether a party at tier `have` meets `need`.
166	// Parallel tier-1 proofs (FARMER vs STANDARD) satisfy each other.
167	func KYCTierSatisfies(have, need string) bool {
168		h, okH := kycRank[have]
169		n, okN := kycRank[need]
170		if !okH || !okN {
171			return false
172		}
173		return h >= n
174	}
175	
176	// KYCApprovableTiers maps an approver ROLE to the KYC tiers it may approve.
177	// Ground staff clear the field tiers; only federation admins clear HIGH;
178	// only SUPER_ADMIN clears HIGHEST. Extend when new approver roles arrive.
179	var KYCApprovableTiers = map[string][]string{
180		RoleOrganisingManager:   {KYCTierMinimal, KYCTierFarmer, KYCTierStandard, KYCTierRider},
181		RoleOnboardingExecutive: {KYCTierMinimal, KYCTierFarmer, KYCTierStandard, KYCTierRider},
182		RoleDistrictVerifier:    {KYCTierMinimal, KYCTierFarmer, KYCTierStandard, KYCTierRider},
183		RolePCDFAdmin:           {KYCTierMinimal, KYCTierFarmer, KYCTierStandard, KYCTierRider, KYCTierHigh},
184		RoleSuperAdmin:          {KYCTierMinimal, KYCTierFarmer, KYCTierStandard, KYCTierRider, KYCTierHigh, KYCTierHighest, KYCTierService},
185	}
186	
187	// CanApproveKYCTier reports whether approverRole may approve a KYC record
188	// requesting the given tier.
189	func CanApproveKYCTier(approverRole, tier string) bool {
190		for _, t := range KYCApprovableTiers[approverRole] {
191			if t == tier {
192				return true
193			}
194		}
195		return false
196	}
197

9	// Org-unit types — the cooperative backbone RBAC is scoped to (blueprint §5.1,
10	// PCDF constitution: Samiti/DCS → Sangh/Union → PCDF apex).
11	const (
12		OrgTypeFederation      = "FEDERATION"       // PCDF / Parag (state apex)
13		OrgTypeMilkUnion       = "MILK_UNION"       // district Sangh
14		OrgTypeProcessingPlant = "PROCESSING_PLANT" // PCDF plant
15		OrgTypeBMC             = "BMC"              // bulk milk cooler / chilling centre
16		OrgTypeDCS             = "DCS"              // village samiti
17	)
18	
19	// AllOrgTypes is the closed set of org-unit types.
20	var AllOrgTypes = []string{
21		OrgTypeFederation, OrgTypeMilkUnion, OrgTypeProcessingPlant, OrgTypeBMC, OrgTypeDCS,
22	}
23	
24	// ValidOrgParent encodes the allowed hierarchy edges.
25	var ValidOrgParent = map[string][]string{
26		OrgTypeFederation:      {}, // root
27		OrgTypeMilkUnion:       {OrgTypeFederation},
28		OrgTypeProcessingPlant: {OrgTypeMilkUnion, OrgTypeFederation},
29		OrgTypeBMC:             {OrgTypeMilkUnion},
30		OrgTypeDCS:             {OrgTypeMilkUnion, OrgTypeBMC},
31	}
32	
33	// OrgUnit is a node in the cooperative hierarchy.
34	//
35	// ID scheme: `_id` is a generated ObjectID (relations always reference it);
36	// Code is the human-readable unique business key (e.g. "DCS-01842") used for
37	// display, lookups and seed idempotency — never for joins.
38	//
39	// Path holds the ObjectIDs of all ancestors from the root down to (and
40	// excluding) this node — denormalised so "is X inside Y's scope" is a single
41	// indexed array-containment check with no recursive queries on the hot path.
42	type OrgUnit struct {
43		ID        primitive.ObjectID   `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
44		Type      string               `bson:"type"          json:"type"`
45		Name      string               `bson:"name"          json:"name"`
46		Code      string               `bson:"code"          json:"code"` // unique business key, e.g. "DCS-01842"
47		ParentID  *primitive.ObjectID  `bson:"parent_id,omitempty" json:"parent_id,omitempty"`
48		Path      []primitive.ObjectID `bson:"path"          json:"path"`
49		District  string               `bson:"district,omitempty" json:"district,omitempty"`
50		State     string               `bson:"state,omitempty"    json:"state,omitempty"`
51		GeoLat    float64              `bson:"geo_lat,omitempty"  json:"geo_lat,omitempty"`
52		GeoLng    float64              `bson:"geo_lng,omitempty"  json:"geo_lng,omitempty"`
53		Active    bool                 `bson:"active"        json:"active"`
54		CreatedAt time.Time            `bson:"created_at"    json:"created_at"`
55		UpdatedAt time.Time            `bson:"updated_at"    json:"updated_at"`
56	}
57	
58	// IsValidOrgType reports whether t is a known org-unit type.
59	func IsValidOrgType(t string) bool {
60		for _, v := range AllOrgTypes {
61			if v == t {
62				return true
63			}
64		}
65		return false
66	}

23	const (
24		// canCapacityLitres is the standard milk-can volume used to size a
25		// consignment: can_count = ceil(total litres / 40).
26		canCapacityLitres = 40.0
27	
28		// maxPourRefs caps how many pour references a consignment.created
29		// provenance event carries; beyond it the pour count lives in the
30		// payload only, keeping ledger events bounded.
31		maxPourRefs = 300
32	
33		// maxTripStops bounds a planned route so trip documents stay small.
34		maxTripStops = 100
35	
36		// Physical sanity bounds for a hand-held transit thermometer reading.
37		minPlausibleTempC = -30.0
38		maxPlausibleTempC = 70.0
39	)
40	
41	// service holds all logistics business logic: consignment aggregation,
42	// the consignment/trip state machines, and provenance emission.
43	type service struct {
44		repo   *repo
45		orgs   *orgscope.Resolver
46		ledger *provenance.Ledger
47		log    *slog.Logger
48	}
49	
50	// newService wires the service to its collaborators.
51	func newService(repo *repo, orgs *orgscope.Resolver, ledger *provenance.Ledger, log *slog.Logger) *service {
52		return &service{repo: repo, orgs: orgs, ledger: ledger, log: log}
53	}
54	
55	// actorID parses the actor's party ObjectID out of its JWT hex string.
56	func (s *service) actorID(actor auth.Actor) (primitive.ObjectID, error) {
57		return httpx.ParseID(actor.PartyID, "actor")
58	}
59	
60	// internal logs an unexpected failure with its operation context and maps it
61	// to a 500.
62	func (s *service) internal(ctx context.Context, op string, err error) *httpx.AppError {
63		s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, op+" failed", slog.Any("err", err))
64		return httpx.Internal(err)
65	}
66	
67	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
68	// Consignments
69	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
70	
71	// createConsignment pools one DCS date+shift's RECORDED pours into an OPEN
72	// consignment: pour IDs, total litres, quantity-weighted fat/SNF averages and
73	// the can count. The unique dcs+date+shift index makes creation idempotent-ish
74	// (a replay returns CONSIGNMENT_EXISTS).
75	func (s *service) createConsignment(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req createConsignmentRequest) (*domain.DCSConsignment, error) {
76		if req.DCSID.IsZero() {
77			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_DCS_ID", "dcs_id is required")
78		}
79		if err := validateShift(req.Shift); err != nil {
80			return nil, err
81		}
82		now := time.Now().UTC()
83		date, err := resolveDate(req.Date, now)
84		if err != nil {
85			return nil, err
86		}
87		actorID, err := s.actorID(actor)
88		if err != nil {
89			return nil, err
90		}
91		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.DCSID); err != nil {
92			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "consignment creation denied: DCS out of scope",
93				slog.String("dcs_id", req.DCSID.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
94			return nil, err
95		}
96		org, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.DCSID)
97		if err != nil {
98			return nil, err
99		}
100		if org.Type != domain.OrgTypeDCS {
101			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_DCS", "org unit "+req.DCSID.Hex()+" is not a DCS")
102		}
103	
104		rows, err := s.repo.findRecordedPours(ctx, req.DCSID, date, req.Shift)
105		if err != nil {
106			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "create consignment: find recorded pours", err)
107		}
108		if len(rows) == 0 {
109			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "consignment creation rejected: no RECORDED pours",
110				slog.String("dcs_id", req.DCSID.Hex()), slog.String("date", date),
111				slog.String("shift", req.Shift), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
112			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("NO_POURS_TO_CONSIGN",
113				fmt.Sprintf("no RECORDED pours for DCS %s on %s %s", req.DCSID.Hex(), date, req.Shift))
114		}
115		pourIDs, totalQty, avgFat, avgSNF, assurance := aggregatePours(rows)
116	
117		consignment := &domain.DCSConsignment{
118			ID:                  primitive.NewObjectID(), // pre-generated: insert + ledger refs stay consistent
119			DCSID:               req.DCSID,
120			Date:                date,
121			Shift:               req.Shift,
122			PourIDs:             pourIDs,
123			TotalQuantityLitres: totalQty,
124			CanCount:            int(math.Ceil(totalQty / canCapacityLitres)),
125			AvgFatPct:           avgFat,
126			AvgSNFPct:           avgSNF,
127			Assurance:           assurance,
128			Status:              domain.ConsignmentStatusOpen,
129			CreatedBy:           actorID,
130			CreatedAt:           now,
131		}
132		if err := s.repo.insertConsignment(ctx, consignment); err != nil {
133			if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(err) {
134				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "consignment creation rejected: duplicate for dcs+date+shift",
135					slog.String("dcs_id", req.DCSID.Hex()), slog.String("date", date),
136					slog.String("shift", req.Shift), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
137				return nil, httpx.Conflict("CONSIGNMENT_EXISTS",
138					fmt.Sprintf("a consignment for DCS %s on %s %s already exists", req.DCSID.Hex(), date, req.Shift))
139			}
140			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "create consignment: insert", err)
141		}
142	
143		// Provenance: the pooling-boundary event. Pour refs are capped so the
144		// event stays bounded — past the cap the payload's pour_count is the
145		// authoritative tally (the doc's pour_ids keeps the full set).
146		refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, min(len(pourIDs), maxPourRefs))
147		for i, id := range pourIDs {
148			if i >= maxPourRefs {
149				break
150			}
151			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{EntityType: domain.EntityMilkPour, EntityID: id.Hex(), Relation: "aggregates"})
152		}
153		event, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
154			Type:       domain.EventConsignmentCreated,
155			EntityType: domain.EntityConsignment,
156			EntityID:   consignment.ID.Hex(),
157			Refs:       refs,
158			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
159			OrgUnitID:  consignment.DCSID.Hex(),
160			Payload: map[string]any{
161				"pour_count":            len(pourIDs),
162				"total_quantity_litres": totalQty,
163				"can_count":             consignment.CanCount,
164				"date":                  date,
165				"shift":                 req.Shift,
166			},
167		})
168		if err != nil {
169			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "create consignment: append provenance", err)
170		}
171		if err := s.repo.setConsignmentProvenanceSeq(ctx, consignment.ID, event.Seq); err != nil {
172			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "create consignment: set provenance seq", err)
173		}
174		consignment.ProvenanceSeq = event.Seq
175		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "consignment created",
176			slog.String("consignment_id", consignment.ID.Hex()),
177			slog.String("dcs_id", consignment.DCSID.Hex()),
178			slog.String("date", date), slog.String("shift", req.Shift),
179			slog.Int("pour_count", len(pourIDs)),
180			slog.Float64("total_quantity_litres", totalQty),
181			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
182		return consignment, nil
183	}
184	
185	// dispatchConsignment seals an OPEN consignment for pickup (OPEN→DISPATCHED).
186	// The creation-time pour snapshot is provisional: the seal re-aggregates the
187	// shift's RECORDED pours so milk recorded between creation and dispatch (the
188	// collection module also rejects such pours, belt-and-braces) is reflected in
189	// pour_ids, litres, can count and weighted fat/SNF before the load leaves.
190	func (s *service) dispatchConsignment(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.DCSConsignment, error) {
191		consignment, err := s.loadConsignment(ctx, id)
192		if err != nil {
193			return nil, err
194		}
195		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, consignment.DCSID); err != nil {
196			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "consignment dispatch denied: DCS out of scope",
197				slog.String("consignment_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("dcs_id", consignment.DCSID.Hex()),
198				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
199			return nil, err
200		}
201		if consignment.Status != domain.ConsignmentStatusOpen {
202			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "consignment dispatch rejected: not OPEN",
203				slog.String("consignment_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("status", consignment.Status),
204				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
205			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_CONSIGNMENT_STATE",
206				"consignment is "+consignment.Status+"; only OPEN consignments can be dispatched")
207		}
208	
209		// Re-aggregate at the seal boundary.
210		rows, err := s.repo.findRecordedPours(ctx, consignment.DCSID, consignment.Date, consignment.Shift)
211		if err != nil {
212			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "dispatch consignment: find recorded pours", err)
213		}
214		extraSet := bson.D{}
215		if len(rows) > 0 {
216			pourIDs, totalQty, avgFat, avgSNF, assurance := aggregatePours(rows)
217			consignment.PourIDs = pourIDs
218			consignment.TotalQuantityLitres = totalQty
219			consignment.CanCount = int(math.Ceil(totalQty / canCapacityLitres))
220			consignment.AvgFatPct = avgFat
221			consignment.AvgSNFPct = avgSNF
222			consignment.Assurance = assurance
223			extraSet = bson.D{
224				{Key: "pour_ids", Value: pourIDs},
225				{Key: "total_quantity_litres", Value: totalQty},
226				{Key: "can_count", Value: consignment.CanCount},
227				{Key: "avg_fat_pct", Value: avgFat},
228				{Key: "avg_snf_pct", Value: avgSNF},
229				{Key: "assurance", Value: assurance},
230			}
231		}
232	
233		now := time.Now().UTC()
234		// §6.4: sealing freezes the pour set to the physical cans. The seal_code is
235		// an operational human-readable tamper marker (SEAL-<consignment>-<checksum>);
236		// the append-only hash chain is the cryptographic integrity anchor.
237		sealCode := mintSealCode(consignment.ID, consignment.PourIDs)
238		consignment.SealCode = sealCode
239		consignment.SealedAt = &now
240		extraSet = append(extraSet,
241			bson.E{Key: "seal_code", Value: sealCode},
242			bson.E{Key: "sealed_at", Value: now},
243		)
244		matched, err := s.repo.markConsignmentDispatched(ctx, id, now, extraSet)
245		if err != nil {
246			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "dispatch consignment: mark dispatched", err)
247		}
248		if !matched { // lost a state race since the read above
249			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "consignment dispatch rejected: lost state race",
250				slog.String("consignment_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
251			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_CONSIGNMENT_STATE",
252				"consignment was modified concurrently; reload and retry")
253		}
254		event, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
255			Type:       domain.EventConsignmentDispatched,
256			EntityType: domain.EntityConsignment,
257			EntityID:   consignment.ID.Hex(),
258			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
259			OrgUnitID:  consignment.DCSID.Hex(),
260			Payload: map[string]any{
261				"pour_count":            len(consignment.PourIDs),
262				"total_quantity_litres": consignment.TotalQuantityLitres,
263				"can_count":             consignment.CanCount,
264				"date":                  consignment.Date,
265				"shift":                 consignment.Shift,
266			},
267		})
268		if err != nil {
269			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "dispatch consignment: append provenance", err)
270		}
271		if err := s.repo.setConsignmentProvenanceSeq(ctx, consignment.ID, event.Seq); err != nil {
272			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "dispatch consignment: set provenance seq", err)
273		}
274		consignment.Status = domain.ConsignmentStatusDispatch
275		consignment.DispatchedAt = &now
276		consignment.ProvenanceSeq = event.Seq
277		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "consignment dispatched",
278			slog.String("consignment_id", consignment.ID.Hex()),
279			slog.String("dcs_id", consignment.DCSID.Hex()),
280			slog.Int("pour_count", len(consignment.PourIDs)),
281			slog.Float64("total_quantity_litres", consignment.TotalQuantityLitres),
282			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
283		return consignment, nil
284	}
285	
286	// listConsignments returns a scoped page of consignments. DCS-scoped actors
287	// default to their own society; wide read roles (SUPER_ADMIN, STATE_AUDITOR)
288	// may list unfiltered; everyone else must name a dcs_id inside their scope.
289	func (s *service) listConsignments(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, q consignmentListQuery, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.DCSConsignment, int64, error) {
290		dcsID := q.DCSID
291		if dcsID.IsZero() {
292			switch {
293			case actor.OrgType == domain.OrgTypeDCS && actor.OrgUnitID != "":
294				id, err := httpx.ParseID(actor.OrgUnitID, "actor org unit")
295				if err != nil {
296					return nil, 0, err
297				}
298				dcsID = id
299			case actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSuperAdmin || actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleStateAuditor:
300				// federation-wide read roles may scan unfiltered (still paged)
301			default:
302				return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("DCS_ID_REQUIRED", "dcs_id query parameter is required for your role")
303			}
304		}
305		if !dcsID.IsZero() {
306			if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, dcsID); err != nil {
307				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "consignment list denied: DCS out of scope",
308					slog.String("dcs_id", dcsID.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
309				return nil, 0, err
310			}
311		}
312		if q.Date != "" {
313			if _, err := resolveDate(q.Date, time.Time{}); err != nil {
314				return nil, 0, err
315			}
316		}
317		if q.Status != "" && !isConsignmentStatus(q.Status) {
318			return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_STATUS", "unknown consignment status "+q.Status)
319		}
320		items, total, err := s.repo.listConsignments(ctx, dcsID, q.Date, q.Status, page)
321		if err != nil {
322			return nil, 0, s.internal(ctx, "list consignments", err)
323		}
324		return items, total, nil
325	}
