327	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
328	// Route trips
329	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
330	
331	// createTrip plans a van run: every stop's consignment must already be
332	// DISPATCHED and must belong to that stop's DCS. The rider defaults to the
333	// actor when a VAN_RIDER plans their own route.
334	func (s *service) createTrip(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req createTripRequest) (*domain.RouteTrip, error) {
335		if req.RouteName == "" {
336			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_ROUTE_NAME", "route_name is required")
337		}
338		if req.UnionID.IsZero() {
339			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_UNION_ID", "union_id is required")
340		}
341		if err := validateShift(req.Shift); err != nil {
342			return nil, err
343		}
344		if len(req.Stops) == 0 {
345			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NO_STOPS", "at least one stop is required")
346		}
347		if len(req.Stops) > maxTripStops {
348			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("TOO_MANY_STOPS", fmt.Sprintf("a trip may have at most %d stops", maxTripStops))
349		}
350		now := time.Now().UTC()
351		date, err := resolveDate(req.Date, now)
352		if err != nil {
353			return nil, err
354		}
355		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.UnionID); err != nil {
356			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "trip creation denied: union out of scope",
357				slog.String("union_id", req.UnionID.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
358			return nil, err
359		}
360		union, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.UnionID)
361		if err != nil {
362			return nil, err
363		}
364		if union.Type != domain.OrgTypeMilkUnion {
365			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_UNION", "org unit "+req.UnionID.Hex()+" is not a MILK_UNION")
366		}
367	
368		var riderPartyID primitive.ObjectID
369		if req.VanRiderPartyID != nil && !req.VanRiderPartyID.IsZero() {
370			riderPartyID = *req.VanRiderPartyID
371		} else {
372			if actor.RoleCode != domain.RoleVanRider {
373				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("RIDER_REQUIRED", "van_rider_party_id is required unless a VAN_RIDER plans their own trip")
374			}
375			actorID, err := s.actorID(actor)
376			if err != nil {
377				return nil, err
378			}
379			riderPartyID = actorID
380		}
381	
382		seen := make(map[primitive.ObjectID]struct{}, len(req.Stops))
383		stops := make([]domain.RouteStop, 0, len(req.Stops))
384		for _, stop := range req.Stops {
385			if stop.DCSID.IsZero() || stop.ConsignmentID.IsZero() {
386				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_STOP", "every stop needs dcs_id and consignment_id")
387			}
388			if _, dup := seen[stop.ConsignmentID]; dup {
389				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("DUPLICATE_STOP", "consignment "+stop.ConsignmentID.Hex()+" appears in more than one stop")
390			}
391			seen[stop.ConsignmentID] = struct{}{}
392	
393			// Scope guard (IDOR): the stop's DCS must be within the actor's org
394			// scope, so one union's rider/supervisor cannot pull another union's
395			// consignment onto their trip (cross-union pooling / foreign mutation).
396			if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, stop.DCSID); err != nil {
397				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "trip creation rejected: stop DCS out of scope",
398					slog.String("stop_dcs_id", stop.DCSID.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
399				return nil, err
400			}
401			consignment, err := s.loadConsignment(ctx, stop.ConsignmentID)
402			if err != nil {
403				return nil, err
404			}
405			if aerr := validateStopConsignment(consignment, stop.DCSID); aerr != nil {
406				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "trip creation rejected: invalid stop consignment",
407					slog.String("consignment_id", stop.ConsignmentID.Hex()),
408					slog.String("stop_dcs_id", stop.DCSID.Hex()),
409					slog.String("consignment_status", consignment.Status),
410					slog.String("code", aerr.Code),
411					slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
412				return nil, aerr
413			}
414			stops = append(stops, domain.RouteStop{DCSID: stop.DCSID, ConsignmentID: stop.ConsignmentID})
415		}
416	
417		trip := &domain.RouteTrip{
418			ID:              primitive.NewObjectID(), // pre-generated so provenance can reference it later
419			RouteName:       req.RouteName,
420			UnionID:         req.UnionID,
421			VanRiderPartyID: riderPartyID,
422			Date:            date,
423			Shift:           req.Shift,
424			Stops:           stops,
425			Status:          domain.TripStatusPlanned,
426			CreatedAt:       now,
427		}
428		if err := s.repo.insertTrip(ctx, trip); err != nil {
429			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "create trip: insert", err)
430		}
431		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "trip created",
432			slog.String("trip_id", trip.ID.Hex()),
433			slog.String("union_id", trip.UnionID.Hex()),
434			slog.String("van_rider_party_id", trip.VanRiderPartyID.Hex()),
435			slog.String("route_name", trip.RouteName),
436			slog.String("date", date), slog.String("shift", req.Shift),
437			slog.Int("stop_count", len(stops)),
438			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
439		return trip, nil
440	}
441	
442	// pickupStop records the trip's rider collecting one consignment: the stop is
443	// stamped with time+temperature, the consignment moves DISPATCHED→PICKED_UP,
444	// and the trip moves to IN_PROGRESS on its first pickup.
445	func (s *service) pickupStop(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, tripID, consignmentID primitive.ObjectID, req pickupRequest) (*domain.RouteTrip, error) {
446		if err := validateTemp(req.TempC); err != nil {
447			return nil, err
448		}
449		actorID, err := s.actorID(actor)
450		if err != nil {
451			return nil, err
452		}
453		trip, err := s.loadTrip(ctx, tripID)
454		if err != nil {
455			return nil, err
456		}
457		if aerr := validatePickup(trip, actorID, consignmentID); aerr != nil {
458			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "stop pickup rejected",
459				slog.String("trip_id", tripID.Hex()), slog.String("consignment_id", consignmentID.Hex()),
460				slog.String("code", aerr.Code), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
461			return nil, aerr
462		}
463	
464		// Guard the consignment transition atomically; only a DISPATCHED
465		// consignment can board the van.
466		matched, err := s.repo.markConsignmentPickedUp(ctx, consignmentID, trip.ID)
467		if err != nil {
468			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "pickup stop: mark consignment picked up", err)
469		}
470		if !matched {
471			consignment, err := s.loadConsignment(ctx, consignmentID)
472			if err != nil {
473				return nil, err
474			}
475			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "stop pickup rejected: consignment not DISPATCHED",
476				slog.String("trip_id", tripID.Hex()), slog.String("consignment_id", consignmentID.Hex()),
477				slog.String("consignment_status", consignment.Status),
478				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
479			return nil, httpx.Conflict("CONSIGNMENT_NOT_DISPATCHED",
480				"consignment is "+consignment.Status+"; only DISPATCHED consignments can be picked up")
481		}
482	
483		now := time.Now().UTC()
484		if err := s.repo.markStopPickedUp(ctx, trip.ID, consignmentID, now, *req.TempC, req.Notes); err != nil {
485			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "pickup stop: mark stop picked up", err)
486		}
487	
488		event, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
489			Type:       domain.EventConsignmentPickedUp,
490			EntityType: domain.EntityConsignment,
491			EntityID:   consignmentID.Hex(),
492			Refs: []provenance.Ref{
493				{EntityType: domain.EntityRouteTrip, EntityID: trip.ID.Hex(), Relation: "carried_by"},
494			},
495			Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
496			OrgUnitID: trip.UnionID.Hex(),
497			Payload:   map[string]any{"temp_c": *req.TempC},
498		})
499		if err != nil {
500			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "pickup stop: append provenance", err)
501		}
502		if err := s.repo.setConsignmentProvenanceSeq(ctx, consignmentID, event.Seq); err != nil {
503			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "pickup stop: set provenance seq", err)
504		}
505	
506		trip.Status = domain.TripStatusInProgress
507		if i := findStop(trip, consignmentID); i >= 0 {
508			trip.Stops[i].PickedUpAt = &now
509			trip.Stops[i].TempC = *req.TempC
510			trip.Stops[i].Notes = req.Notes
511		}
512		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "stop picked up",
513			slog.String("trip_id", trip.ID.Hex()),
514			slog.String("consignment_id", consignmentID.Hex()),
515			slog.Float64("temp_c", *req.TempC),
516			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
517		return trip, nil
518	}
519	
520	// logColdChain appends one in-transit temperature sample to the trip —
521	// tamper-evidence for the perishable load between village and BMC.
522	func (s *service) logColdChain(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, tripID primitive.ObjectID, req coldChainRequest) (*domain.RouteTrip, error) {
523		if err := validateTemp(req.TempC); err != nil {
524			return nil, err
525		}
526		actorID, err := s.actorID(actor)
527		if err != nil {
528			return nil, err
529		}
530		trip, err := s.loadTrip(ctx, tripID)
531		if err != nil {
532			return nil, err
533		}
534		if aerr := validateColdChain(trip, actorID); aerr != nil {
535			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "cold-chain log rejected",
536				slog.String("trip_id", tripID.Hex()), slog.String("code", aerr.Code),
537				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
538			return nil, aerr
539		}
540		entry := domain.ColdChainEntry{
541			TS:     time.Now().UTC(),
542			TempC:  *req.TempC,
543			GeoLat: req.GeoLat,
544			GeoLng: req.GeoLng,
545		}
546		if err := s.repo.pushColdChain(ctx, trip.ID, entry); err != nil {
547			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "log cold chain: push entry", err)
548		}
549		event, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
550			Type:       domain.EventColdChainLogged,
551			EntityType: domain.EntityRouteTrip,
552			EntityID:   trip.ID.Hex(),
553			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
554			OrgUnitID:  trip.UnionID.Hex(),
555			Payload:    map[string]any{"temp_c": *req.TempC},
556		})
557		if err != nil {
558			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "log cold chain: append provenance", err)
559		}
560		if err := s.repo.setTripProvenanceSeq(ctx, trip.ID, event.Seq); err != nil {
561			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "log cold chain: set provenance seq", err)
562		}
563		trip.ColdChain = append(trip.ColdChain, entry)
564		trip.ProvenanceSeq = event.Seq
565		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "cold chain logged",
566			slog.String("trip_id", trip.ID.Hex()),
567			slog.Float64("temp_c", *req.TempC),
568			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
569		return trip, nil
570	}
571	
572	// deliverTrip hands the whole load to a BMC: every stop must be picked up,
573	// the trip moves IN_PROGRESS→DELIVERED and its consignments PICKED_UP→DELIVERED.
574	func (s *service) deliverTrip(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, tripID primitive.ObjectID, req deliverRequest) (*domain.RouteTrip, error) {
575		if req.BMCID.IsZero() {
576			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_BMC_ID", "bmc_id is required")
577		}
578		actorID, err := s.actorID(actor)
579		if err != nil {
580			return nil, err
581		}
582		trip, err := s.loadTrip(ctx, tripID)
583		if err != nil {
584			return nil, err
585		}
586		if aerr := validateDeliver(trip, actorID); aerr != nil {
587			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "trip delivery rejected",
588				slog.String("trip_id", tripID.Hex()), slog.String("code", aerr.Code),
589				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
590			return nil, aerr
591		}
592		bmc, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.BMCID)
593		if err != nil {
594			return nil, err
595		}
596		if bmc.Type != domain.OrgTypeBMC {
597			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_BMC", "org unit "+req.BMCID.Hex()+" is not a BMC")
598		}
599		// Scope guard: the destination BMC must be within the actor's org scope so
600		// a trip cannot be delivered into an unrelated union's chilling centre.
601		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.BMCID); err != nil {
602			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "trip delivery rejected: BMC out of scope",
603				slog.String("bmc_id", req.BMCID.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
604			return nil, err
605		}
606	
607		now := time.Now().UTC()
608		matched, err := s.repo.markTripDelivered(ctx, trip.ID, req.BMCID, now)
609		if err != nil {
610			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "deliver trip: mark delivered", err)
611		}
612		if !matched { // lost a state race since the read above
613			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "trip delivery rejected: lost state race",
614				slog.String("trip_id", tripID.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
615			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_TRIP_STATE", "trip was modified concurrently; reload and retry")
616		}
617	
618		consignmentIDs := make([]primitive.ObjectID, 0, len(trip.Stops))
619		refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, len(trip.Stops))
620		for _, stop := range trip.Stops {
621			consignmentIDs = append(consignmentIDs, stop.ConsignmentID)
622			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{
623				EntityType: domain.EntityConsignment, EntityID: stop.ConsignmentID.Hex(), Relation: "delivered",
624			})
625		}
626		if err := s.repo.markConsignmentsDelivered(ctx, consignmentIDs); err != nil {
627			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "deliver trip: mark consignments delivered", err)
628		}
629	
630		event, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
631			Type:       domain.EventTripDelivered,
632			EntityType: domain.EntityRouteTrip,
633			EntityID:   trip.ID.Hex(),
634			Refs:       refs,
635			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
636			OrgUnitID:  trip.UnionID.Hex(),
637			Payload:    map[string]any{"bmc_id": req.BMCID.Hex()},
638		})
639		if err != nil {
640			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "deliver trip: append provenance", err)
641		}
642		if err := s.repo.setTripProvenanceSeq(ctx, trip.ID, event.Seq); err != nil {
643			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "deliver trip: set provenance seq", err)
644		}
645	
646		trip.Status = domain.TripStatusDelivered
647		trip.DeliveredToBMCID = &req.BMCID
648		trip.DeliveredAt = &now
649		trip.ProvenanceSeq = event.Seq
650		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "trip delivered",
651			slog.String("trip_id", trip.ID.Hex()),
652			slog.String("bmc_id", req.BMCID.Hex()),
653			slog.Int("consignment_count", len(consignmentIDs)),
654			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
655		return trip, nil
656	}
657	
658	// listTrips returns a scoped page of trips: riders are forced onto their own
659	// trips; supervisors/presidents default to (and are checked against) their
660	// union scope.
661	func (s *service) listTrips(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, q tripListQuery, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.RouteTrip, int64, error) {
662		unionID := q.UnionID
663		riderPartyID := q.VanRiderPartyID
664		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleVanRider {
665			actorID, err := s.actorID(actor)
666			if err != nil {
667				return nil, 0, err
668			}
669			riderPartyID = actorID // riders only ever see their own trips
670		} else {
671			if unionID.IsZero() &&
672				actor.RoleCode != domain.RoleSuperAdmin && actor.RoleCode != domain.RoleStateAuditor &&
673				actor.OrgUnitID != "" {
674				id, err := httpx.ParseID(actor.OrgUnitID, "actor org unit")
675				if err != nil {
676					return nil, 0, err
677				}
678				unionID = id // supervisors/presidents default to their union
679			}
680			if !unionID.IsZero() {
681				if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, unionID); err != nil {
682					s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "trip list denied: union out of scope",
683						slog.String("union_id", unionID.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
684					return nil, 0, err
685				}
686			}
687		}
688		if q.Date != "" {
689			if _, err := resolveDate(q.Date, time.Time{}); err != nil {
690				return nil, 0, err
691			}
692		}
693		items, total, err := s.repo.listTrips(ctx, unionID, q.Date, riderPartyID, page)
694		if err != nil {
695			return nil, 0, s.internal(ctx, "list trips", err)
696		}
697		return items, total, nil
698	}
699	
700	// getTrip returns one trip: a rider only their own, everyone else within
701	// union scope.
702	func (s *service) getTrip(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, tripID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.RouteTrip, error) {
703		trip, err := s.loadTrip(ctx, tripID)
704		if err != nil {
705			return nil, err
706		}
707		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleVanRider {
708			actorID, err := s.actorID(actor)
709			if err != nil {
710				return nil, err
711			}
712			if trip.VanRiderPartyID != actorID {
713				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "trip read denied: assigned to another rider",
714					slog.String("trip_id", tripID.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
715				return nil, httpx.Forbidden("this trip is assigned to another van rider")
716			}
717			return trip, nil
718		}
719		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, trip.UnionID); err != nil {
720			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "trip read denied: union out of scope",
721				slog.String("trip_id", tripID.Hex()), slog.String("union_id", trip.UnionID.Hex()),
722				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
723			return nil, err
724		}
725		return trip, nil
726	}

728	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
729	// Loaders (mongo.ErrNoDocuments → 404)
730	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
731	
732	// loadConsignment fetches a consignment, mapping a miss to 404.
733	func (s *service) loadConsignment(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.DCSConsignment, error) {
734		c, err := s.repo.findConsignmentByID(ctx, id)
735		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
736			return nil, httpx.NotFound("consignment " + id.Hex())
737		}
738		if err != nil {
739			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "load consignment", err)
740		}
741		return c, nil
742	}
743	
744	// loadTrip fetches a trip, mapping a miss to 404.
745	func (s *service) loadTrip(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.RouteTrip, error) {
746		t, err := s.repo.findTripByID(ctx, id)
747		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
748			return nil, httpx.NotFound("trip " + id.Hex())
749		}
750		if err != nil {
751			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "load trip", err)
752		}
753		return t, nil
754	}
755	
756	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
757	// Pure guards & helpers (unit-tested in service_test.go)
758	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
759	
760	// aggregatePours reduces pour rows to (ids, total litres, quantity-weighted
761	// average fat %, quantity-weighted average SNF %), rounded to 2 decimals.
762	func aggregatePours(rows []pourRow) (pourIDs []primitive.ObjectID, totalQty, avgFat, avgSNF float64, assurance string) {
763		var fatWeighted, snfWeighted float64
764		levels := make([]string, 0, len(rows))
765		pourIDs = make([]primitive.ObjectID, 0, len(rows))
766		for _, row := range rows {
767			pourIDs = append(pourIDs, row.ID)
768			totalQty += row.QuantityLitres
769			fatWeighted += row.FatPct * row.QuantityLitres
770			snfWeighted += row.SNFPct * row.QuantityLitres
771			levels = append(levels, row.Assurance)
772		}
773		if totalQty > 0 {
774			avgFat = round2(fatWeighted / totalQty)
775			avgSNF = round2(snfWeighted / totalQty)
776		}
777		// §6.2: the consignment inherits the WEAKEST assurance of its pours.
778		return pourIDs, round2(totalQty), avgFat, avgSNF, domain.WeakestAssurance(levels...)
779	}
780	
781	// round2 rounds to 2 decimal places (litres / percentage precision).
782	func round2(v float64) float64 { return math.Round(v*100) / 100 }
783	
784	// mintSealCode builds the §6.4 / Appendix-A seal code SEAL-<consignment>-<checksum>,
785	// where the checksum is a CRC32 over the frozen pour set so a later silent
786	// change to the pour list produces a different code.
787	func mintSealCode(consignmentID primitive.ObjectID, pourIDs []primitive.ObjectID) string {
788		h := crc32.NewIEEE()
789		h.Write(consignmentID[:])
790		for _, id := range pourIDs {
791			h.Write(id[:])
792		}
793		return fmt.Sprintf("SEAL-%s-%04X", consignmentID.Hex()[18:24], h.Sum32()&0xFFFF)
794	}
795	
796	// validateShift accepts only the two collection shifts.
797	func validateShift(shift string) *httpx.AppError {
798		if shift != domain.ShiftMorning && shift != domain.ShiftEvening {
799			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_SHIFT", "shift must be MORNING or EVENING")
800		}
801		return nil
802	}
803	
804	// resolveDate defaults an empty date to the IST day key of now, otherwise
805	// validates the YYYY-MM-DD form.
806	func resolveDate(date string, now time.Time) (string, error) {
807		if date == "" {
808			return domain.DateKeyIST(now), nil
809		}
810		if _, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", date); err != nil {
811			return "", httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_DATE", "date must be YYYY-MM-DD")
812		}
813		return date, nil
814	}
815	
816	// validateTemp requires a temperature and rejects physically implausible ones.
817	func validateTemp(tempC *float64) *httpx.AppError {
818		if tempC == nil {
819			return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_TEMP", "temp_c is required")
820		}
821		if *tempC < minPlausibleTempC || *tempC > maxPlausibleTempC {
822			return httpx.BadRequest("IMPLAUSIBLE_TEMP",
823				fmt.Sprintf("temp_c must be between %.0f and %.0f °C", minPlausibleTempC, maxPlausibleTempC))
824		}
825		return nil
826	}
827	
828	// isConsignmentStatus reports whether s is a known consignment status.
829	func isConsignmentStatus(s string) bool {
830		switch s {
831		case domain.ConsignmentStatusOpen, domain.ConsignmentStatusDispatch,
832			domain.ConsignmentStatusPickedUp, domain.ConsignmentStatusDelivered,
833			domain.ConsignmentStatusAccepted, domain.ConsignmentStatusRejected:
834			return true
835		}
836		return false
837	}
838	
839	// findStop returns the index of the stop carrying consignmentID, or -1.
840	func findStop(trip *domain.RouteTrip, consignmentID primitive.ObjectID) int {
841		for i := range trip.Stops {
842			if trip.Stops[i].ConsignmentID == consignmentID {
843				return i
844			}
845		}
846		return -1
847	}
848	
849	// requireTripRider enforces that only the trip's assigned van rider acts on it.
850	func requireTripRider(trip *domain.RouteTrip, riderPartyID primitive.ObjectID) *httpx.AppError {
851		if trip.VanRiderPartyID != riderPartyID {
852			return httpx.Forbidden("this trip is assigned to another van rider")
853		}
854		return nil
855	}
856	
857	// validateStopConsignment guards trip planning: the stop's consignment must
858	// be DISPATCHED (state machine) and must belong to the stop's DCS.
859	func validateStopConsignment(consignment *domain.DCSConsignment, stopDCSID primitive.ObjectID) *httpx.AppError {
860		if consignment.Status != domain.ConsignmentStatusDispatch {
861			return httpx.Conflict("CONSIGNMENT_NOT_DISPATCHED",
862				"consignment "+consignment.ID.Hex()+" is "+consignment.Status+"; only DISPATCHED consignments can be planned onto a trip")
863		}
864		if consignment.DCSID != stopDCSID {
865			return httpx.Unprocessable("CONSIGNMENT_DCS_MISMATCH",
866				"consignment "+consignment.ID.Hex()+" belongs to DCS "+consignment.DCSID.Hex()+", not the stop's DCS "+stopDCSID.Hex())
867		}
868		return nil
869	}
870	
871	// validatePickup guards the pickup transition: right rider, trip not yet
872	// delivered, stop exists, stop not already picked.
873	func validatePickup(trip *domain.RouteTrip, riderPartyID, consignmentID primitive.ObjectID) *httpx.AppError {
874		if err := requireTripRider(trip, riderPartyID); err != nil {
875			return err
876		}
877		if trip.Status == domain.TripStatusDelivered {
878			return httpx.Conflict("TRIP_ALREADY_DELIVERED", "trip is DELIVERED; no further pickups are possible")
879		}
880		i := findStop(trip, consignmentID)
881		if i < 0 {
882			return httpx.NotFound("stop for consignment " + consignmentID.Hex())
883		}
884		if trip.Stops[i].PickedUpAt != nil {
885			return httpx.Conflict("STOP_ALREADY_PICKED", "consignment "+consignmentID.Hex()+" was already picked up on this trip")
886		}
887		return nil
888	}
889	
890	// validateColdChain guards cold-chain logging: right rider, trip still moving.
891	func validateColdChain(trip *domain.RouteTrip, riderPartyID primitive.ObjectID) *httpx.AppError {
892		if err := requireTripRider(trip, riderPartyID); err != nil {
893			return err
894		}
895		if trip.Status == domain.TripStatusDelivered {
896			return httpx.Conflict("TRIP_ALREADY_DELIVERED", "trip is DELIVERED; cold-chain logging is closed")
897		}
898		return nil
899	}
900	
901	// validateDeliver guards delivery: right rider, not already delivered, and
902	// every stop picked up (partial loads cannot be handed to a BMC).
903	func validateDeliver(trip *domain.RouteTrip, riderPartyID primitive.ObjectID) *httpx.AppError {
904		if err := requireTripRider(trip, riderPartyID); err != nil {
905			return err
906		}
907		if trip.Status == domain.TripStatusDelivered {
908			return httpx.Conflict("TRIP_ALREADY_DELIVERED", "trip is already DELIVERED")
909		}
910		var unpicked []string
911		for _, stop := range trip.Stops {
912			if stop.PickedUpAt == nil {
913				unpicked = append(unpicked, stop.ConsignmentID.Hex())
914			}
915		}
916		if len(unpicked) > 0 {
917			return httpx.Unprocessable("STOPS_NOT_PICKED", "every stop must be picked up before delivery").
918				WithDetails(map[string]any{"unpicked_consignment_ids": unpicked})
919		}
920		return nil
921	}
922

```text
1	# Saathi Backend — Technical Notes & Handoff
2	
3	> **Audience:** the next engineer or LLM working on this repo. Read this file plus
4	> `SAATHI_Architecture_Framework_Parag.pdf` (the blueprint, source of truth) and you have the
5	> complete picture. Blueprint section references look like (§8.3).
6	>
7	> **Status:** P0 + P1 implemented end-to-end (identity → **KYC approval** → pour → invoice →
8	> logistics → safety gate → batch → QR → public trace → settlement), with P2 foundations
9	> (cattle/health, MVU, education, dormant collar path). Consumer commerce is **deliberately
10	> descoped** (dormant flag).
11	>
12	> **For the full API surface + per-endpoint behaviour, see [`strict_brief.md`](strict_brief.md).**
13	> **For role-by-role flows with diagrams, see [`WORKFLOW_GUIDE.md`](WORKFLOW_GUIDE.md).**
14	> **For why the org/role model is shaped this way, see [`PCDF_Cooperative_Constitution.md`](PCDF_Cooperative_Constitution.md)** (the real UP cooperative structure — Farmer → Samiti → Sangh → PCDF — that the org tree and 23-role catalog are grounded in).
15	
16	---
17	
18	## 1. Stack & system design decision
19	
20	| Decision | Choice | Why |
21	|---|---|---|
22	| Language | **Go 1.23+** | memory-safe/typed per §15; single static binary; trivial horizontal scaling for 1cr+ users |
23	| Database | **MongoDB** (env-configured URI only) | team decision; normalized ("scattered") collections with ID references, not embedded blobs |
24	| Architecture | **Modular monolith** with hard module seams | §6 prescribes event-driven microservices as end-state; at greenfield stage one deployable with 10 isolated modules + an in-process event bus gives the same boundaries with none of the ops tax. Each module = one future microservice. |
25	| HTTP | chi router, REST JSON under `/api/v1` | frontend lives in a separate repo; this is a pure API |
26	| Events | in-process pub/sub (`internal/platform/eventbus`) | mirrors a broker API; swap to Kafka/NATS (§15) without touching module code |
27	| Provenance | **hash-chained append-only event ledger in MongoDB** (§7.3 "ledger-style" option) | tamper-evident without running a graph DB; graph traversal implemented over `refs` edges; can be projected to Neo4j later |
28	| IDs | **MongoDB ObjectID `_id`**; every cross-collection reference is an ObjectID (`farmer_party_id`, `dcs_id`, …) so `$lookup`/populate is native. Human-readable strings (`code`, `phone`, `invoice_number`, `qr_code`, `pashu_aadhaar`) are **separate unique business keys**, never used for joins. | ObjectID refs are the natural Mongo mapping/populate primitive. The one string kept for identity is `milk_pours.client_event_id` — an offline device-minted idempotency key (§3.1); the server still assigns a real ObjectID `_id`. |
29	| Onboarding | **KYC approval workflow**: submit → `PENDING` → reviewer (`ORGANISING_MANAGER` / `DISTRICT_VERIFIER` / `PCDF_ADMIN` / `SUPER_ADMIN`) approves → tier upgraded. A role token is only issuable once the party's tier satisfies the role — so "login as rider" is impossible before approval. | Matches the field reality: a ground-level Organising Manager decides a user's position after verifying them; the position itself is a `RoleAssignment` (role_code + org scope), which the frontend reads to pick the dashboard. |
30	| Logging | Structured `slog`: one line per request (id, actor, status, duration) + per-module INFO/WARN/ERROR tagged `module=` and correlatable by `request_id`. | Debugging & CERT-In ≥180-day retention (§17); every rejection and failure is traceable end-to-end. |
31	
32	### Scaling posture (1cr+ users)
33	- Stateless server → run N replicas behind a gateway/LB; per-IP rate limiting is per-replica by
34	  design (global fairness belongs to the WAF/gateway tier, §6).
35	- Every hot query path has a compound index (see `internal/platform/mongodb/indexes.go` — the
36	  single index catalog). No collection scans on request paths.
37	- In-memory caches with short TTLs for org-tree (60s) and feature flags (30s) — the two
38	  read-on-every-request lookups.
39	- Write bursts (twice-daily pour shifts, §16) are absorbed by: connection pool 200, idempotent
40	  ingest (unique `client_event_id`), and batch sync endpoint.
41	- Mongo can be sharded later (shard keys would be `dcs_id`/date for pours); the provenance
42	  ledger's global sequence is the one serialization point — at true national scale, switch
43	  `Append` to per-entity chains or a partitioned ledger (documented trade-off, §20-2).
44	
45	## 2. Repository layout
46	
47	```
48	cmd/server/          boot: config → logger → mongo → indexes → deps → router (graceful shutdown)
49	cmd/seed/            idempotent demo/dev data (org tree, parties per role, rate chart, animals)
50	internal/config/     env-only config (.env supported; MONGO_URI required, no in-code default)
51	internal/domain/     THE CONTRACT: pure entities/enums/invariants; no deps; modules depend on it
52	internal/platform/   shared services: httpx, auth (JWT/OTP/HMAC), middleware (authn/rbac/audit/
53	                     ratelimit/metrics), mongodb (client+index catalog), provenance (hash-chain
54	                     ledger), orgscope (path-based scope checks), flags, audit, eventbus, deps
55	internal/httpapi/    router assembly + module registration
56	internal/modules/    10 domain modules (identity, orgs, cattle, collection, logistics, plant,
57	                     quality, settlement, publictrace, platformops)
58	scripts/smoke.sh     end-to-end test of the entire loop over live HTTP + MongoDB
59	```
60	
61	**Module contract** (enforced): `Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps)`; layering
62	`handler.go` (HTTP only) → `service.go` (business logic) → `repo.go` (Mongo only) + `models.go`
63	(DTOs). Modules never import each other; cross-module reactions go through the event bus;
64	collection names only via `mongodb.Coll*` consts.
65	
66	## 3. Identity model (§4) — how auth works
67	
68	1. `POST /api/v1/auth/otp/request {phone}` → 6-digit OTP (stored **HMAC-hashed**, TTL, max 5
69	   attempts). Dev mode (`OTP_DEV_MODE=true`) returns `dev_otp` in the response.
70	2. `POST /api/v1/auth/otp/verify` → finds-or-creates the **Party** (one phone = one human) →
71	   returns a **session JWT** + rotating **refresh token** (stored hashed).
72	3. `GET /api/v1/auth/roles` → the party's org-scoped **RoleAssignments** (23-role catalog §5.2).
73	4. `POST /api/v1/auth/role/select {role_assignment_id}` → **role JWT** pinned to
74	   role+org (this IS the role switcher; KYC tier gates apply, §4.2).
75	5. Protected routes: `middleware.Authenticate` (JWT) → `middleware.RequireRoles(...)`
76	   (SUPER_ADMIN passes all gates; every mutation is audit-logged) → `orgscope.RequireInScope`
77	   (path-array ancestry check, O(1)).
78	
79	## 4. The core loop (what the smoke test drives)
80	
81	```
82	analyzer reading (anti-tamper: geotag/device-time/OCR-confidence/plausibility §8.2)
83	→ pour (idempotent client_event_id; priced off org-scoped rate chart; SMS receipt) 
84	→ same-day invoice (unique farmer+dcs+date)
85	→ consignment (DCS day+shift aggregate = the pooling boundary §7.4)
86	→ route trip (pickup temp, cold-chain log, deliver to BMC)
87	→ BMC lot (pool consignments, chill temp) → QC BMC_RAPID   ── FSSAI gate §8.3
88	→ processing batch (only PASSED lots can enter)  → QC PLANT_LAB ── gate again
89	→ product lot (only COMPLETED batches) → QR (HMAC-signed, forgery-proof)
90	→ PUBLIC scan /api/v1/public/qr/{code} → honest samiti-SET provenance + QC certificate
91	→ settlement: initiate (Sacheev) → approve (DIFFERENT person — dual control §8.1) 
92	  → execute (mock licensed-PA) → farmer paid, UTR, SMS
93	```
94	
95	Every hop appends a **provenance event** to the hash chain with `refs` edges; the public scan
96	returns `ledger.intact` from re-verifying the chain segment. Corrections (pour supersede) are
97	new events referencing the old — nothing is ever edited in place (§3.4).
98	
99	**FSSAI limits enforced in software** (`internal/domain/quality.go`): AFM1 ≤ 0.5 µg/kg,
100	coliform ≤ 10 CFU/ml, tetracycline MRL 0.1 mg/kg, phosphatase must be negative. A failed subject
101	is BLOCKED and *every* forward path re-checks status (dispatch, batch creation, product lot, QR).
102	
103	## 5. Hashing / crypto inventory
104	
105	| What | Mechanism | Where |
106	|---|---|---|
107	| OTP codes | HMAC-SHA256(secret, phone, code) — DB never sees plaintext | `platform/auth/otp.go` |
108	| Refresh tokens | opaque 32-byte random, stored as HMAC digest, rotated on every refresh | identity module |
109	| Provenance chain | SHA-256 over (prev_hash, seq, type, entity, refs, actor, payload, ts) | `platform/provenance/ledger.go` |
110	| QR tokens | HMAC-SHA256 signature over (qr_code, product_lot_id, issued_at) | plant module + public verify |
111	| JWT | HS256, 15-min access, kind=session/role | `platform/auth/jwt.go` |
112	| Aadhaar | **never stored** — last-4 + mock Data-Vault ref only (§18-A) | identity/KYC |
113	
114	## 6. What is mocked (clearly labelled in code) vs real
115	
116	**Real:** everything in the loop above — auth, RBAC, org scoping, pricing, idempotent ingest,
117	gate logic, hash-chained ledger, trace, settlements state machine, audit trail, flags, metrics.
118	
119	**Mocked (intentional — DPI integrations are Phase-gated, §13):** Aadhaar eKYC (always verifies,
120	stores masked ref), bank penny-drop (0.92 name-match), Bharat Pashudhan sync (marks SYNCED),
121	PFMS/DBT (ref generation only), licensed-PA payout execution (instant SUCCESS + mock UTR),
122	SMS provider (worker marks SENT). Each mock is a single clearly named function — replacing it
123	with the real connector does not touch the surrounding flow.
124	
125	**Dormant (capability-gated, OFF):** collar telemetry (`collar_telemetry_enabled` §9), ONDC,
126	consumer commerce (descoped by product decision — only the public QR scan is consumer-facing).
127	
128	## 7. How to run
129	
130	```bash
131	# prerequisites: Go 1.23+, MongoDB running locally (or any URI)
132	cp .env.example .env             # then set MONGO_URI (env is the ONLY source)
133	make tidy                        # deps
134	make run                         # start API on :8080
135	make seed                        # demo org tree + parties + rate chart (idempotent)
136	make test                        # unit tests
137	make smoke                       # full E2E loop against a scratch DB (starts its own server)

17	// Repo is the plant module's MongoDB access layer. All state transitions use
18	// optimistic filters on the expected status — no transactions (standalone
19	// server), so a lost race simply matches zero documents and the service
20	// reports a conflict instead of corrupting state.
21	type Repo struct {
22		consignments *mongo.Collection

30	// NewRepo binds the repo to the shared database.
31	func NewRepo(db *mongo.Database) *Repo {
32		return &Repo{
33			consignments: db.Collection(mongodb.CollConsignments),
34			bmcLots:      db.Collection(mongodb.CollBMCLots),
35			batches:      db.Collection(mongodb.CollBatches),
36			productLots:  db.Collection(mongodb.CollProductLots),
37			qrs:          db.Collection(mongodb.CollBatchQRs),
38			counters:     db.Collection(mongodb.CollCounters),

45	func (r *Repo) ConsignmentsByIDs(ctx context.Context, ids []primitive.ObjectID) ([]domain.DCSConsignment, error) {
46		cur, err := r.consignments.Find(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: ids}}}})
47		if err != nil {
48			return nil, err
49		}
50		out := []domain.DCSConsignment{}
51		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
52			return nil, err
53		}
54		return out, nil
55	}

58	// stamps the pooling lot ID. Returns how many were actually claimed — fewer
59	// than requested means another lot raced us on at least one consignment.
60	func (r *Repo) ClaimConsignments(ctx context.Context, ids []primitive.ObjectID, bmcLotID primitive.ObjectID) (int64, error) {
61		res, err := r.consignments.UpdateMany(ctx,
62			bson.D{

64				{Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusDelivered},
65			},

68				{Key: "bmc_lot_id", Value: bmcLotID},
69			}}},
70		)
71		if err != nil {
72			return 0, err
73		}
74		return res.ModifiedCount, nil
75	}

78	// race): everything stamped with this lot ID goes back to DELIVERED.

82			bson.D{

84				{Key: "$unset", Value: bson.D{{Key: "bmc_lot_id", Value: ""}}},
85			},

199	// ListBMCLots returns a page of lots plus the total match count.
200	func (r *Repo) ListBMCLots(ctx context.Context, f BMCLotListFilter, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.BMCLot, int64, error) {
201		filter := bson.D{}
202		if !f.BMCID.IsZero() {
203			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "bmc_id", Value: f.BMCID})
204		}
205		if f.Date != "" {
206			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "date", Value: f.Date})
207		}
208		if f.Status != "" {
209			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "status", Value: f.Status})
210		}
211		total, err := r.bmcLots.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
212		if err != nil {
213			return nil, 0, err
214		}
215		cur, err := r.bmcLots.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
216			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "date", Value: -1}, {Key: "created_at", Value: -1}}).
217			SetSkip(page.Offset).SetLimit(page.Limit))
218		if err != nil {
219			return nil, 0, err
220		}
221		out := []domain.BMCLot{}
222		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
223			return nil, 0, err
224		}
225		return out, total, nil
226	}

10	// handler is the HTTP edge of the settlement module: decode, validate shape,
11	// call the service, respond. No business logic, no MongoDB.
12	type handler struct {
13		svc *service
14	}
15	
16	// initiate handles POST /settlements.
17	func (h *handler) initiate(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
18		actor, _ := auth.ActorFrom(r.Context())
19		var in InitiateSettlementRequest
20		if err := httpx.DecodeJSON(r, &in); err != nil {
21			httpx.Error(w, r, err)
22			return
23		}
24		batch, err := h.svc.Initiate(r.Context(), actor, in)
25		if err != nil {
26			httpx.Error(w, r, err)
27			return
28		}
29		httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusCreated, batch)
30	}
31	
32	// approve handles POST /settlements/{id}/approve.
33	func (h *handler) approve(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {

21	// initiateRefsCap bounds how many invoice refs the settlement.initiated
22	// ledger event carries (per module spec: cap 300).
23	const initiateRefsCap = 300
24	
25	// service holds all settlement business logic: the §8.1/§18-B payment
26	// guardrail (compute+initiate → dual-control approve → licensed-PA execute)
27	// and the strictly separate DBT subsidy rail (§13).
28	type service struct {
29		repo   *repo
30		ledger *provenance.Ledger
31		orgs   *orgscope.Resolver
32		bus    *eventbus.Bus
33		log    *slog.Logger
34	}

36	// actorObjectID parses the actor's party identity. JWT claims carry ObjectIDs
37	// as hex strings (tokens are JSON); every service method that compares or
38	// stores the actor's identity goes through this one helper.
39	func actorObjectID(actor auth.Actor) (primitive.ObjectID, error) {
40		return httpx.ParseID(actor.PartyID, "actor")
41	}
42	
43	// ---- pure guardrail checks (unit-tested without a database) ----
44	
45	// validateApproval enforces the dual-control guardrail (§8.1/§18-B): the
46	// approving party MUST differ from the initiator — checked FIRST and on the
47	// party identity itself, so not even SUPER_ADMIN's role bypass can approve a
48	// batch it initiated. Then the batch must still be awaiting approval.
49	func validateApproval(b domain.SettlementBatch, approverPartyID primitive.ObjectID) error {
50		if b.InitiatedBy == approverPartyID {
51			return httpx.Forbidden("dual-control violation: the settlement initiator cannot approve their own batch (§8.1/§18-B)").
52				WithDetails(map[string]string{"reason": "DUAL_CONTROL_VIOLATION"})
53		}
54		if b.Status != domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval {
55			return httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch is "+b.Status+", expected "+domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval)
56		}
57		return nil
58	}
59	
60	// executionLease is how long an APPROVED→EXECUTING claim is considered live.
61	// A batch stuck EXECUTING longer than this (crashed executor) may be resumed —
62	// the per-invoice payout logic is idempotent, so a replay is safe.
63	const executionLease = 2 * time.Minute
64	
65	// validateExecution gates which states may (re-)enter execution:
66	//   - APPROVED:  the normal dual-controlled first run.
67	//   - EXECUTING: resume of an interrupted run (the lease check in
68	//     claimExecution prevents stealing a live executor's batch).
69	//   - FAILED:    re-execution after a recorded mid-run failure.
70	//
71	// Anything pre-approval is a guardrail breach, not a race; EXECUTED/REJECTED
72	// are terminal.
73	func validateExecution(b domain.SettlementBatch) error {
74		switch b.Status {
75		case domain.SettlementStatusApproved, domain.SettlementStatusExecuting, domain.SettlementStatusFailed:
76			return nil
77		default:
78			return httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch is "+b.Status+", must be "+domain.SettlementStatusApproved+" before execution")
79		}
80	}

97	// ---- settlement lifecycle ----

99	// Initiate collects a DCS day's ISSUED invoices into a new settlement batch
100	// and parks it PENDING_APPROVAL. The INITIATED status is momentary by design
101	// (§8.1): computation and initiation are one Saathi action; nothing proceeds
102	// until a different human approves.
103	func (s *service) Initiate(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, in InitiateSettlementRequest) (*domain.SettlementBatch, error) {
104		actorID, err := actorObjectID(actor)
105		if err != nil {
106			return nil, err
107		}
108		if in.DCSID.IsZero() {
109			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_FIELD", "dcs_id is required")
110		}
111		now := time.Now().UTC()
112		date := in.Date
113		if date == "" {
114			date = domain.DateKeyIST(now)
115		} else if _, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", date); err != nil {
116			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_DATE", "date must be YYYY-MM-DD")
117		}
118		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, in.DCSID); err != nil {
119			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "settlement initiation denied: out of scope",
120				slog.String("dcs_id", in.DCSID.Hex()),
121				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
122			return nil, err
123		}
124	
125		candidates, err := s.repo.issuedInvoices(ctx, in.DCSID, date)
126		if err != nil {
127			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement initiation: load issued invoices",
128				slog.String("dcs_id", in.DCSID.Hex()), slog.String("date", date), slog.Any("err", err))
129			return nil, err
130		}
131		if len(candidates) == 0 {
132			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "settlement initiation rejected: no ISSUED invoices",
133				slog.String("dcs_id", in.DCSID.Hex()), slog.String("date", date),
134				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
135			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("NO_INVOICES", "no ISSUED invoices for DCS "+in.DCSID.Hex()+" on "+date)
136		}
137	
138		// Claim optimistically: the status guard on the update means each invoice
139		// lands in exactly one batch even under concurrent initiations. The batch
140		// ID is pre-generated so claim, insert and ledger all share one identity.
141		batchID := primitive.NewObjectID()
142		ids := make([]primitive.ObjectID, 0, len(candidates))
143		for _, inv := range candidates {
144			ids = append(ids, inv.ID)
145		}
146		if _, err := s.repo.claimInvoices(ctx, ids, batchID); err != nil {
147			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement initiation: claim invoices",
148				slog.String("batch_id", batchID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
149			return nil, err
150		}
151		claimed, err := s.repo.invoicesByBatch(ctx, batchID)
152		if err != nil {
153			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement initiation: read claimed invoices",
154				slog.String("batch_id", batchID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
155			return nil, err
156		}
157		if len(claimed) == 0 {
158			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "settlement initiation rejected: invoices claimed by concurrent batch",
159				slog.String("dcs_id", in.DCSID.Hex()), slog.String("date", date),
160				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
161			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("NO_INVOICES", "invoices were claimed by a concurrent settlement for DCS "+in.DCSID.Hex()+" on "+date)
162		}
163	
164		batch := &domain.SettlementBatch{
165			ID:          batchID,
166			DCSID:       in.DCSID,
167			Date:        date,
168			Status:      domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval, // INITIATED → PENDING_APPROVAL immediately
169			InitiatedBy: actorID,
170			CreatedAt:   now,
171		}
172		for _, inv := range claimed {
173			batch.InvoiceIDs = append(batch.InvoiceIDs, inv.ID)
174			batch.TotalAmount += inv.TotalAmount
175		}
176		if err := s.repo.insertBatch(ctx, batch); err != nil {
177			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement initiation: insert batch",
178				slog.String("batch_id", batchID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
179			// Best-effort release so the claimed invoices are not stranded.
180			if relErr := s.repo.releaseInvoices(ctx, batchID); relErr != nil {
181				s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement: release after failed insert",
182					slog.String("batch_id", batchID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", relErr))
183			}
184			return nil, err
185		}
186	
187		refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, min(len(claimed), initiateRefsCap))
188		for i, inv := range claimed {
189			if i >= initiateRefsCap {
190				break
191			}
192			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{EntityType: domain.EntityInvoice, EntityID: inv.ID.Hex(), Relation: "settles"})
193		}
194		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
195			Type:       domain.EventSettlementInitiated,
196			EntityType: domain.EntitySettlement,
197			EntityID:   batch.ID.Hex(),
198			Refs:       refs,
199			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
200			OrgUnitID:  batch.DCSID.Hex(),
201			Payload: map[string]any{
202				"dcs_id":        batch.DCSID.Hex(),
203				"date":          batch.Date,
204				"invoice_count": len(claimed),
205				"total_amount":  batch.TotalAmount,
206			},
207		})
208		if err != nil {
209			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement initiation: ledger append",
210				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
211			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
212		}
213		if err := s.repo.setBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx, batch.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
214			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement initiation: stamp provenance seq",
215				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
216			return nil, err
217		}
218		batch.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
219	
220		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "settlement batch initiated",
221			slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
222			slog.String("dcs_id", batch.DCSID.Hex()),
223			slog.String("date", batch.Date),
224			slog.Int("invoice_count", len(claimed)),
225			slog.Float64("total_amount", batch.TotalAmount),
226			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
227		return batch, nil
228	}

230	// Approve applies the human dual-control sign-off: PENDING_APPROVAL→APPROVED.
231	func (s *service) Approve(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, batchID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.SettlementBatch, error) {
232		actorID, err := actorObjectID(actor)
233		if err != nil {
234			return nil, err
235		}
236		batch, err := s.repo.batchByID(ctx, batchID)
237		if err != nil {
238			return nil, err
239		}
240		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, batch.DCSID); err != nil {
241			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "settlement approval denied: out of scope",
242				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
243				slog.String("dcs_id", batch.DCSID.Hex()),
244				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
245			return nil, err
246		}
247		if err := validateApproval(*batch, actorID); err != nil {
248			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "settlement approval rejected",
249				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
250				slog.String("status", batch.Status),
251				slog.String("initiated_by", batch.InitiatedBy.Hex()),
252				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
253				slog.String("reason", err.Error()))
254			return nil, err
255		}
256	
257		now := time.Now().UTC()
258		ok, err := s.repo.transitionBatch(ctx, batch.ID, domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval, bson.D{
259			{Key: "status", Value: domain.SettlementStatusApproved},
260			{Key: "approved_by", Value: actorID},
261			{Key: "approved_at", Value: now},
262		})
263		if err != nil {
264			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement approval: transition batch",
265				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
266			return nil, err
267		}
268		if !ok {
269			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "settlement approval rejected: batch left PENDING_APPROVAL concurrently",
270				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
271				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
272			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch already left "+domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval)
273		}
274		batch.Status = domain.SettlementStatusApproved
275		batch.ApprovedBy = &actorID
276		batch.ApprovedAt = &now
277	
278		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
279			Type:       domain.EventSettlementApproved,
280			EntityType: domain.EntitySettlement,
281			EntityID:   batch.ID.Hex(),
282			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
283			OrgUnitID:  batch.DCSID.Hex(),
284			Payload: map[string]any{
285				"approved_by":  actor.PartyID,
286				"total_amount": batch.TotalAmount,
287			},
288		})
289		if err != nil {
290			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement approval: ledger append",
291				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
292			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
293		}
294		if err := s.repo.setBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx, batch.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
295			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement approval: stamp provenance seq",
296				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
297			return nil, err
298		}
299		batch.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
300	
301		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "settlement batch approved",
302			slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
303			slog.String("dcs_id", batch.DCSID.Hex()),
304			slog.Float64("total_amount", batch.TotalAmount),
305			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
306		return batch, nil
307	}

309	// Reject declines a pending batch and returns its invoices to ISSUED so they
310	// can be re-settled.
311	func (s *service) Reject(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, batchID primitive.ObjectID, reason string) (*domain.SettlementBatch, error) {
312		actorID, err := actorObjectID(actor)
313		if err != nil {
314			return nil, err
315		}
316		if strings.TrimSpace(reason) == "" {
317			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_FIELD", "reason is required")
318		}
319		batch, err := s.repo.batchByID(ctx, batchID)
320		if err != nil {
321			return nil, err
322		}
323		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, batch.DCSID); err != nil {
324			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "settlement rejection denied: out of scope",
325				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
326				slog.String("dcs_id", batch.DCSID.Hex()),
327				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
328			return nil, err
329		}
330		if batch.Status != domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval {
331			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "settlement rejection refused: invalid status",
332				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
333				slog.String("status", batch.Status),
334				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
335			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch is "+batch.Status+", expected "+domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval)
336		}
337	
338		ok, err := s.repo.transitionBatch(ctx, batch.ID, domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval, bson.D{
339			{Key: "status", Value: domain.SettlementStatusRejected},
340			{Key: "rejected_by", Value: actorID},
341			{Key: "reject_reason", Value: reason},
342		})
343		if err != nil {
344			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement rejection: transition batch",
345				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
346			return nil, err
347		}
348		if !ok {
349			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "settlement rejection refused: batch left PENDING_APPROVAL concurrently",
350				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
351				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
352			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch already left "+domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval)
353		}
354		if err := s.repo.releaseInvoices(ctx, batch.ID); err != nil {
355			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement rejection: release invoices",
356				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
357			return nil, err
358		}
359		batch.Status = domain.SettlementStatusRejected
360		batch.RejectedBy = &actorID
361		batch.RejectReason = reason
362	
363		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "settlement batch rejected",
364			slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
365			slog.String("dcs_id", batch.DCSID.Hex()),
366			slog.String("reason", reason),
367			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
368		return batch, nil
369	}

371	// Execute hands the APPROVED batch to the payment-aggregator adapter and
372	// records the resulting payouts.
373	//
374	// MOCK LICENSED-PA ADAPTER — this is a stand-in for the real integration.
375	// In production (§18-B) execution goes through an RBI-licensed Payment
376	// Aggregator operating a nodal/escrow account: Saathi submits the payout
377	// file, the PA moves the money, and UTRs come back asynchronously via
378	// webhook. Saathi itself never touches funds. The mock credits every payout
379	// instantly with a synthetic UTR so the downstream flow (invoice→PAID,
380	// provenance, farmer SMS) is exercised end to end.
381	func (s *service) Execute(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, batchID primitive.ObjectID) (*SettlementDetail, error) {
382		batch, err := s.repo.batchByID(ctx, batchID)
383		if err != nil {
384			return nil, err
385		}
386		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, batch.DCSID); err != nil {
387			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "settlement execution denied: out of scope",
388				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
389				slog.String("dcs_id", batch.DCSID.Hex()),
390				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
391			return nil, err
392		}
393		if err := validateExecution(*batch); err != nil {
394			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "settlement execution refused: invalid status",
395				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
396				slog.String("status", batch.Status),
397				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
398			return nil, err
399		}
400	
401		// Guarded claim: first run (APPROVED), re-run after FAILED, or resume of
402		// a stale EXECUTING lease. The per-invoice work below is idempotent
403		// (unique payout-per-invoice index + payout reuse), so replays are safe.
404		now := time.Now().UTC()
405		claimed, err := s.repo.claimExecution(ctx, batch.ID, now, now.Add(-executionLease))
406		if err != nil {
407			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement execution: claim",
408				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
409			return nil, err
410		}
411		if !claimed {
412			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "settlement execution refused: live execution lease held elsewhere",
413				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
414				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
415			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch is already being executed")
416		}
417	
418		// From here on, any error must not strand the batch in EXECUTING forever:
419		// flip it to FAILED (best-effort) so a retry can claim FAILED→EXECUTING.
420		failExecution := func(cause error) error {
421			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement execution failed mid-run",
422				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", cause))
423			if ferr := s.repo.markExecutionFailed(ctx, batch.ID, cause.Error()); ferr != nil {
424				s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement: mark execution failed",
425					slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", ferr))
426			}
427			return cause
428		}
429	
430		invoices, err := s.repo.invoicesByBatch(ctx, batch.ID)
431		if err != nil {
432			return nil, failExecution(err)
433		}
434	
435		payouts := make([]domain.PayoutInstruction, 0, len(invoices))
436		for _, inv := range invoices {
437			masked, err := s.repo.latestBankMasked(ctx, inv.FarmerPartyID)
438			if err != nil {
439				return nil, failExecution(err)
440			}
441			creditedAt := now
442			payout := &domain.PayoutInstruction{
443				ID:                primitive.NewObjectID(),
444				SettlementBatchID: batch.ID,
445				InvoiceID:         inv.ID,
446				FarmerPartyID:     inv.FarmerPartyID,
447				Amount:            inv.TotalAmount,
448				BankAccountMasked: masked,
449				UTR:               mockUTR(),
450				Status:            domain.PayoutStatusSuccess,
451				CreditedAt:        &creditedAt,
452				CreatedAt:         now,
453			}
454			exists, err := s.repo.insertPayout(ctx, payout)
455			if err != nil {
456				return nil, failExecution(err)
457			}
458			if exists {
459				// Retry of an interrupted run — reuse the payout already credited.
460				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "settlement execution: payout already credited, reusing (idempotent replay)",
461					slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
462					slog.String("invoice_id", inv.ID.Hex()))
463				existing, err := s.repo.payoutByInvoice(ctx, inv.ID)
464				if err != nil {
465					return nil, failExecution(err)
466				}
467				payout = existing
468			}
469			payouts = append(payouts, *payout)
470		}
471	
472		if err := s.repo.markInvoicesPaid(ctx, batch.ID); err != nil {
473			return nil, failExecution(err)
474		}
475	
476		paRef := mockPARef()
477		ok, err := s.repo.transitionBatch(ctx, batch.ID, domain.SettlementStatusExecuting, bson.D{
478			{Key: "status", Value: domain.SettlementStatusExecuted},
479			{Key: "pa_ref", Value: paRef},
480			{Key: "executed_at", Value: now},
481		})
482		if err != nil {
483			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement execution: transition to EXECUTED",
484				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
485			return nil, err
486		}
487		if !ok {
488			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "settlement execution: batch left EXECUTING unexpectedly",
489				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()))
490			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch left EXECUTING unexpectedly")
491		}
492		batch.Status = domain.SettlementStatusExecuted
493		batch.PARef = paRef
494		batch.ExecutedAt = &now
495	
496		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
497			Type:       domain.EventSettlementExecuted,
498			EntityType: domain.EntitySettlement,
499			EntityID:   batch.ID.Hex(),
500			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
501			OrgUnitID:  batch.DCSID.Hex(),
502			Payload: map[string]any{
503				"pa_ref":       paRef,
504				"payout_count": len(payouts),
505				"total_amount": batch.TotalAmount,
506			},
507		})
508		if err != nil {
509			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement execution: ledger append",
510				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
511			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
512		}
513		if err := s.repo.setBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx, batch.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
514			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement execution: stamp provenance seq",
515				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
516			return nil, err
517		}
518		batch.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
519	
520		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "settlement batch executed",
521			slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
522			slog.String("dcs_id", batch.DCSID.Hex()),
523			slog.String("pa_ref", paRef),
524			slog.Int("payout_count", len(payouts)),
525			slog.Float64("total_amount", batch.TotalAmount),
526			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
527	
528		// One payout.credited ledger event per invoice, then the SMS fan-out.
529		// Per-payout ledger/lookup failures are logged, not fatal: the money
530		// outcome is already anchored by settlement.executed above.
531		for _, p := range payouts {
532			if _, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
533				Type:       domain.EventPayoutCredited,
534				EntityType: domain.EntityInvoice,
535				EntityID:   p.InvoiceID.Hex(),
536				Refs: []provenance.Ref{
537					{EntityType: domain.EntitySettlement, EntityID: batch.ID.Hex(), Relation: "paid_by"},
538				},
539				Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
540				OrgUnitID: batch.DCSID.Hex(),
541				Payload:   map[string]any{"utr": p.UTR, "amount": p.Amount},
542			}); err != nil {
543				s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement: payout.credited ledger append",
544					slog.String("invoice_id", p.InvoiceID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
545			}
546	
547			phone, err := s.repo.partyPhone(ctx, p.FarmerPartyID)
548			if err != nil {
549				s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement: farmer phone lookup for payout SMS",
550					slog.String("farmer_party_id", p.FarmerPartyID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
551				continue
552			}
553			s.bus.Publish(eventbus.TopicPayoutCredited, PayoutCreditedEvent{
554				FarmerPartyID: p.FarmerPartyID.Hex(),
555				Phone:         phone,
556				Amount:        p.Amount,
557				UTR:           p.UTR,
558			})
559		}
560	
561		return &SettlementDetail{Batch: *batch, Payouts: payouts}, nil
562	}

564	// List pages settlement batches. Callers with a DCS-scoped token default to
565	// their own DCS; wider roles must name a dcs_id (SUPER_ADMIN and
566	// STATE_AUDITOR may list unscoped).
567	func (s *service) List(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, dcsID, date, status string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.SettlementBatch, int64, error) {
568		if dcsID == "" {
569			switch {

626	func (s *service) PayoutHistory(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, farmerPartyID string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.PayoutInstruction, int64, error) {

662	// CreateDBT submits a scheme subsidy request to the (mocked) PFMS rail.
663	// Saathi only tracks the request; the subsidy is disbursed by PFMS/DBT,
664	// never by Saathi and never through the milk-payment rail.
665	func (s *service) CreateDBT(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, in CreateDBTRequestInput) (*domain.DBTRequest, error) {
666		actorID, err := actorObjectID(actor)
667		if err != nil {
668			return nil, err
669		}
670		if in.SchemeCode == "" || in.FarmerPartyID.IsZero() {
671			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_FIELD", "scheme_code and farmer_party_id are required")
672		}
673		if in.Amount <= 0 {
674			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_AMOUNT", "amount must be positive")
675		}
676		if _, err := s.repo.partyPhone(ctx, in.FarmerPartyID); err != nil {
677			return nil, err // farmer must exist
678		}
679	
680		// MOCK PFMS — real integration files the beneficiary+amount with PFMS
681		// and receives an acknowledgement reference (§13).
682		req := &domain.DBTRequest{
683			ID:            primitive.NewObjectID(),
684			SchemeCode:    in.SchemeCode,
685			FarmerPartyID: in.FarmerPartyID,
686			Amount:        in.Amount,
687			PFMSRef:       mockPFMSRef(),
688			Status:        domain.DBTStatusSubmitted,
689			SubmittedBy:   actorID,
690			CreatedAt:     time.Now().UTC(),
691		}
692		if err := s.repo.insertDBT(ctx, req); err != nil {
693			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "dbt request insert",
694				slog.String("farmer_party_id", in.FarmerPartyID.Hex()),
695				slog.String("scheme_code", in.SchemeCode), slog.Any("err", err))
696			return nil, err
697		}
698	
699		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "dbt request submitted",
700			slog.String("dbt_request_id", req.ID.Hex()),
701			slog.String("scheme_code", req.SchemeCode),
702			slog.String("farmer_party_id", req.FarmerPartyID.Hex()),
703			slog.Float64("amount", req.Amount),
704			slog.String("pfms_ref", req.PFMSRef),
705			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
706		return req, nil
707	}
708	
709	// UpdateDBTStatus records the DBT rail's progress for a request. CREDITED
710	// stamps credited_at; CREDITED/REJECTED are terminal.
711	func (s *service) UpdateDBTStatus(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID, status string) (*domain.DBTRequest, error) {
712		switch status {
713		case domain.DBTStatusAccepted, domain.DBTStatusCredited, domain.DBTStatusRejected:
714		default:
715			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_STATUS", "status must be one of ACCEPTED, CREDITED, REJECTED")
716		}
717		req, err := s.repo.dbtByID(ctx, id)
718		if err != nil {
719			return nil, err
720		}
721		if req.Status == domain.DBTStatusCredited || req.Status == domain.DBTStatusRejected {
722			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "dbt status update refused: terminal status",
723				slog.String("dbt_request_id", req.ID.Hex()),
724				slog.String("status", req.Status),
725				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
726			return nil, httpx.Conflict("TERMINAL_STATUS", "dbt request is already "+req.Status)
727		}
728	
729		var creditedAt *time.Time
730		if status == domain.DBTStatusCredited {
731			now := time.Now().UTC()
732			creditedAt = &now
733		}
734		ok, err := s.repo.transitionDBT(ctx, req.ID, req.Status, status, creditedAt)
735		if err != nil {
736			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "dbt status transition",
737				slog.String("dbt_request_id", req.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
738			return nil, err
739		}
740		if !ok {
741			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "dbt status update refused: concurrent change",
742				slog.String("dbt_request_id", req.ID.Hex()),
743				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
744			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "dbt request changed concurrently, retry")
745		}
746		fromStatus := req.Status
747		req.Status = status
748		req.CreditedAt = creditedAt
749	
750		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "dbt request status updated",
751			slog.String("dbt_request_id", req.ID.Hex()),
752			slog.String("from_status", fromStatus),
753			slog.String("to_status", status),
754			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
755		return req, nil
756	}

58	// AssuranceForSource maps a reading/pour capture mode to its assurance level.
59	func AssuranceForSource(source string) string {
60		switch source {
61		case ReadingModeDirect:
62			return AssuranceInstrument
63		case ReadingModePhotoOCR:
64			return AssuranceOCRPhoto
65		default:
66			return AssuranceManual
67		}
68	}

70	// assuranceRank orders assurance so "weakest in a set" is a max-rank pick
71	// (higher rank = weaker).
72	var assuranceRank = map[string]int{AssuranceInstrument: 0, AssuranceOCRPhoto: 1, AssuranceManual: 2}
73	
74	// WeakestAssurance returns the weakest (lowest-trust) assurance among the
75	// given levels — the value an aggregate inherits (§6.2). Empty input → "".
76	func WeakestAssurance(levels ...string) string {
77		weakest, seen := "", -1
78		for _, l := range levels {
79			if r, ok := assuranceRank[l]; ok && r > seen {
80				weakest, seen = l, r
81			}
82		}

84	}

136	// CheckPlausibility validates fat/SNF/qty against physical bounds and returns

139		var flags []string

142			flags = append(flags, IntegrityFlagImplausibleValue)

145			flags = append(flags, IntegrityFlagImplausibleValue)
146		}

57	// UsableAt reports whether the assignment is active and inside its validity
58	// window at instant t.
59	func (ra RoleAssignment) UsableAt(t time.Time) bool {
60		if ra.Status != RoleAssignmentActive {
61			return false
62		}
63		if t.Before(ra.ValidFrom) {
64			return false
65		}

```text
1	package settlement
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"errors"
6		"fmt"
7		"time"
8	
9		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
10		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
11		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
12		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo/options"
13	
14		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
16		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/mongodb"
17	)
18	
19	// internalFetchCap bounds internal (non-paginated) reads so a pathological
20	// day can never pull an unbounded set into memory. A DCS day is a few
21	// hundred invoices at most.
22	const internalFetchCap = 5000
23	
24	// repo owns every MongoDB access for the settlement module. No business
25	// logic lives here — only reads, guarded writes and error mapping.
26	type repo struct {
27		batches     *mongo.Collection
28		payouts     *mongo.Collection
29		invoices    *mongo.Collection
30		kyc         *mongo.Collection
31		parties     *mongo.Collection
32		dbt         *mongo.Collection
33		assignments *mongo.Collection // read-only: resolve a farmer's DCS for payout-history scoping
34	}
35	
36	// newRepo binds the repo to the shared database handle.
37	func newRepo(db *mongo.Database) *repo {
38		return &repo{
39			batches:     db.Collection(mongodb.CollSettlements),
40			payouts:     db.Collection(mongodb.CollPayouts),
41			invoices:    db.Collection(mongodb.CollInvoices),
42			kyc:         db.Collection(mongodb.CollKYCRecords),
43			parties:     db.Collection(mongodb.CollParties),
44			dbt:         db.Collection(mongodb.CollDBTRequests),
45			assignments: db.Collection(mongodb.CollRoleAssignments),
46		}
47	}
48	
49	// ---- invoices (read + settlement-lifecycle status flips only) ----
50	
51	// issuedInvoices returns the day's ISSUED invoices for a DCS.
52	func (rp *repo) issuedInvoices(ctx context.Context, dcsID primitive.ObjectID, date string) ([]domain.Invoice, error) {
53		cur, err := rp.invoices.Find(ctx,
54			bson.D{
55				{Key: "dcs_id", Value: dcsID},
56				{Key: "invoice_date", Value: date},
57				{Key: "status", Value: domain.InvoiceStatusIssued},
58			},
59			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "invoice_number", Value: 1}}).SetLimit(internalFetchCap),
60		)
61		if err != nil {
62			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("find issued invoices: %w", err))
63		}
64		var out []domain.Invoice
65		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
66			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("decode issued invoices: %w", err))
67		}
68		return out, nil
69	}
70	
71	// claimInvoices atomically flips still-ISSUED invoices to SETTLEMENT_PENDING
72	// under the given batch. The status guard makes concurrent initiations safe
73	// without transactions: each invoice is claimed by exactly one batch.
74	func (rp *repo) claimInvoices(ctx context.Context, invoiceIDs []primitive.ObjectID, batchID primitive.ObjectID) (int64, error) {
75		res, err := rp.invoices.UpdateMany(ctx,
76			bson.D{
77				{Key: "_id", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: invoiceIDs}}},
78				{Key: "status", Value: domain.InvoiceStatusIssued},
79			},
80			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
81				{Key: "status", Value: domain.InvoiceStatusSettlementPending},
82				{Key: "settlement_batch_id", Value: batchID},
83			}}},
84		)
85		if err != nil {
86			return 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("claim invoices for settlement: %w", err))
87		}
88		return res.ModifiedCount, nil
89	}
90	
91	// invoicesByBatch returns every invoice claimed by a settlement batch.
92	func (rp *repo) invoicesByBatch(ctx context.Context, batchID primitive.ObjectID) ([]domain.Invoice, error) {
93		cur, err := rp.invoices.Find(ctx,
94			bson.D{{Key: "settlement_batch_id", Value: batchID}},
95			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "invoice_number", Value: 1}}).SetLimit(internalFetchCap),
96		)
97		if err != nil {
98			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("find invoices by batch: %w", err))
99		}
100		var out []domain.Invoice
101		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
102			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("decode invoices by batch: %w", err))
103		}
104		return out, nil
105	}
106	
107	// releaseInvoices puts a rejected batch's invoices back to ISSUED and clears
108	// the batch linkage, so a fresh initiation can pick them up.
109	func (rp *repo) releaseInvoices(ctx context.Context, batchID primitive.ObjectID) error {
110		_, err := rp.invoices.UpdateMany(ctx,
111			bson.D{
112				{Key: "settlement_batch_id", Value: batchID},
113				{Key: "status", Value: domain.InvoiceStatusSettlementPending},
114			},
115			bson.D{
116				{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: domain.InvoiceStatusIssued}}},
117				{Key: "$unset", Value: bson.D{{Key: "settlement_batch_id", Value: ""}}},
118			},
119		)
120		if err != nil {
121			return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("release settlement invoices: %w", err))
122		}
123		return nil
124	}
125	
126	// markInvoicesPaid flips all of a batch's invoices to PAID after execution.
127	func (rp *repo) markInvoicesPaid(ctx context.Context, batchID primitive.ObjectID) error {
128		_, err := rp.invoices.UpdateMany(ctx,
129			bson.D{{Key: "settlement_batch_id", Value: batchID}},
130			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: domain.InvoiceStatusPaid}}}},
131		)
132		if err != nil {
133			return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("mark invoices paid: %w", err))
134		}
135		return nil
136	}
137	
138	// ---- settlement batches ----
139	
140	// insertBatch persists a new settlement batch.
141	func (rp *repo) insertBatch(ctx context.Context, b *domain.SettlementBatch) error {
142		if _, err := rp.batches.InsertOne(ctx, b); err != nil {
143			return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("insert settlement batch: %w", err))
144		}
145		return nil
146	}
147	
148	// batchByID loads one settlement batch.
149	func (rp *repo) batchByID(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.SettlementBatch, error) {
150		var b domain.SettlementBatch
151		err := rp.batches.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&b)
152		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
153			return nil, httpx.NotFound("settlement batch " + id.Hex())
154		}
155		if err != nil {
156			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("find settlement batch: %w", err))
157		}
158		return &b, nil
159	}
160	
161	// transitionBatch performs a status-guarded update (optimistic concurrency —
162	// no transactions on a standalone server). Returns false when the batch was
163	// not in fromStatus, i.e. another actor won the transition.
164	func (rp *repo) transitionBatch(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID, fromStatus string, set bson.D) (bool, error) {
165		res, err := rp.batches.UpdateOne(ctx,
166			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}, {Key: "status", Value: fromStatus}},
167			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: set}},
168		)
169		if err != nil {
170			return false, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("transition settlement batch: %w", err))
171		}
172		return res.MatchedCount > 0, nil
173	}
174	
175	// claimExecution atomically claims a batch for execution. Three legal claims:
176	//   - APPROVED  → EXECUTING (first run)
177	//   - FAILED    → EXECUTING (re-execution after a recorded failure)
178	//   - EXECUTING → EXECUTING with a STALE lease (resume of a run whose process
179	//     died before it could mark FAILED; staleBefore guards against stealing a
180	//     live executor's batch)
181	//
182	// Every claim stamps executing_at as the new lease. Returns false when no
183	// claim matched — someone else holds a fresh lease or the batch is terminal.
184	func (rp *repo) claimExecution(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID, now, staleBefore time.Time) (bool, error) {
185		for _, from := range []string{domain.SettlementStatusApproved, domain.SettlementStatusFailed} {
186			ok, err := rp.transitionBatch(ctx, id, from, bson.D{
187				{Key: "status", Value: domain.SettlementStatusExecuting},
188				{Key: "executing_at", Value: now},
189			})
190			if err != nil || ok {
191				return ok, err
192			}
193		}
194		res, err := rp.batches.UpdateOne(ctx,
195			bson.D{
196				{Key: "_id", Value: id},
197				{Key: "status", Value: domain.SettlementStatusExecuting},
198				{Key: "executing_at", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$lt", Value: staleBefore}}},
199			},
200			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "executing_at", Value: now}}}},
201		)
202		if err != nil {
203			return false, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("claim settlement execution: %w", err))
204		}
205		return res.MatchedCount > 0, nil
206	}
207	
208	// markExecutionFailed best-effort flips EXECUTING→FAILED with the reason so a
209	// mid-execution error leaves a re-executable batch, never a stuck one.
210	func (rp *repo) markExecutionFailed(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID, reason string) error {
211		_, err := rp.batches.UpdateOne(ctx,
212			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}, {Key: "status", Value: domain.SettlementStatusExecuting}},
213			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
214				{Key: "status", Value: domain.SettlementStatusFailed},
215				{Key: "fail_reason", Value: reason},
216			}}},
217		)
218		if err != nil {
219			return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("mark settlement execution failed: %w", err))
220		}
221		return nil
222	}
223	
224	// setBatchProvenanceSeq stamps the batch with its latest ledger sequence.
225	func (rp *repo) setBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID, seq int64) error {
226		_, err := rp.batches.UpdateOne(ctx,
227			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}},
228			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "provenance_seq", Value: seq}}}},
229		)
230		if err != nil {
231			return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("set settlement provenance seq: %w", err))
232		}
233		return nil
234	}
235	
236	// listBatches pages settlement batches, newest day first.
237	func (rp *repo) listBatches(ctx context.Context, filter bson.D, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.SettlementBatch, int64, error) {
238		total, err := rp.batches.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
239		if err != nil {
240			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("count settlement batches: %w", err))
241		}
242		cur, err := rp.batches.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
243			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "date", Value: -1}, {Key: "created_at", Value: -1}}).
244			SetSkip(page.Offset).SetLimit(page.Limit),
245		)
246		if err != nil {
247			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("find settlement batches: %w", err))
248		}
249		var out []domain.SettlementBatch
250		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
251			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("decode settlement batches: %w", err))
252		}
253		return out, total, nil
254	}

257	
258	// insertPayout persists one payout. The unique index on invoice_id makes an
259	// execution retry harmless: alreadyExists=true means this invoice was paid
260	// in a previous (possibly interrupted) run.
261	func (rp *repo) insertPayout(ctx context.Context, p *domain.PayoutInstruction) (alreadyExists bool, err error) {
262		if _, err := rp.payouts.InsertOne(ctx, p); err != nil {
263			if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(err) {
264				return true, nil
265			}
266			return false, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("insert payout: %w", err))
267		}
268		return false, nil
269	}

273		var p domain.PayoutInstruction
