129		actID, err := actorID(actor)
130		if err != nil {
131			return nil, err
132		}
133		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, req.BMCID, "create bmc lot"); err != nil {
134			return nil, err
135		}
136		org, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.BMCID)
137		if err != nil {
138			return nil, err
139		}
140		if org.Type != domain.OrgTypeBMC {
141			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot creation refused: org unit is not a BMC",
142				slog.String("org_unit_id", req.BMCID.Hex()),
143				slog.String("org_type", org.Type),
144				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
145			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_BMC", "org unit "+req.BMCID.Hex()+" is not a BMC")
146		}
147	
148		now := time.Now().UTC()
149		date := req.Date
150		if date == "" {
151			date = domain.DateKeyIST(now)
152		}
153	
154		ids := dedupe(req.ConsignmentIDs)
155		consignments, err := s.repo.ConsignmentsByIDs(ctx, ids)
156		if err != nil {
157			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "load consignments", err)
158		}
159		if len(consignments) != len(ids) {
160			return nil, httpx.NotFound("consignment(s) " + strings.Join(missingIDs(ids, consignments), ", "))
161		}
162		var undelivered []string
163		for _, c := range consignments {
164			if c.Status != domain.ConsignmentStatusDelivered {
165				undelivered = append(undelivered, c.ID.Hex())
166			}
167		}
168		if len(undelivered) > 0 {
169			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot creation refused: consignment(s) not DELIVERED",
170				slog.String("bmc_id", req.BMCID.Hex()),
171				slog.String("consignment_ids", strings.Join(undelivered, ",")),
172				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
173			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("CONSIGNMENT_NOT_DELIVERED",
174				"only DELIVERED consignments can be pooled into a BMC lot").
175				WithDetails(map[string]any{"consignment_ids": undelivered})
176		}
177	
178		// Optimistic claim: flip DELIVERED→ACCEPTED stamped with the new lot ID.
179		// The lot ID is pre-generated so claim, insert and ledger all agree.
180		// If another lot raced us on any consignment, release our claims and bail.
181		lotID := primitive.NewObjectID()
182		claimed, err := s.repo.ClaimConsignments(ctx, ids, lotID)
183		if err != nil {
184			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "claim consignments", err)
185		}
186		if claimed != int64(len(ids)) {
187			if relErr := s.repo.ReleaseConsignments(ctx, lotID); relErr != nil {
188				return nil, s.fail(ctx, "release consignments after lost claim", relErr)
189			}
190			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot creation lost consignment claim race",
191				slog.String("bmc_id", req.BMCID.Hex()),
192				slog.Int64("claimed", claimed), slog.Int("requested", len(ids)),
193				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
194			return nil, httpx.Conflict("CONSIGNMENT_CLAIM_CONFLICT",
195				"one or more consignments were pooled by another lot — reload and retry")
196		}
197	
198		var totalLitres float64
199		var tripIDs []primitive.ObjectID
200		seenTrip := map[primitive.ObjectID]bool{}
201		for _, c := range consignments {
202			totalLitres += c.TotalQuantityLitres
203			if c.RouteTripID != nil && !seenTrip[*c.RouteTripID] {
204				seenTrip[*c.RouteTripID] = true
205				tripIDs = append(tripIDs, *c.RouteTripID)
206			}
207		}
208	
209		lot := &domain.BMCLot{
210			ID:                  lotID,
211			BMCID:               req.BMCID,
212			Date:                date,
213			Shift:               req.Shift,
214			ConsignmentIDs:      ids,
215			RouteTripIDs:        tripIDs,
216			TotalQuantityLitres: totalLitres,
217			Status:              domain.BMCLotStatusOpen,
218			CreatedBy:           actID,
219			CreatedAt:           now,
220		}
221		if err := s.repo.InsertBMCLot(ctx, lot); err != nil {
222			_ = s.repo.ReleaseConsignments(ctx, lotID)
223			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "insert bmc lot", err)
224		}
225	
226		refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, len(ids))
227		for _, id := range ids {
228			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{
229				EntityType: domain.EntityConsignment, EntityID: id.Hex(), Relation: "pools",
230			})
231		}
232		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
233			Type:       domain.EventBMCLotCreated,
234			EntityType: domain.EntityBMCLot,
235			EntityID:   lot.ID.Hex(),
236			Refs:       refs,
237			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
238			OrgUnitID:  req.BMCID.Hex(),
239			Payload: map[string]any{
240				"date": date, "shift": req.Shift, "total_quantity_litres": totalLitres,
241			},
242		})
243		if err != nil {
244			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append bmc_lot.created event", err)
245		}
246		if err := s.repo.SetBMCLotProvenanceSeq(ctx, lot.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
247			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp bmc lot provenance seq", err)
248		}
249		lot.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
250		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "bmc lot created",
251			slog.String("bmc_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()),
252			slog.String("bmc_id", req.BMCID.Hex()),
253			slog.String("date", date), slog.String("shift", req.Shift),
254			slog.Int("consignments", len(ids)),
255			slog.Float64("total_quantity_litres", totalLitres),
256			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
257		return lot, nil
258	}
259	
260	// CloseBMCLot transitions an OPEN lot to QC_PENDING with the chilling
261	// temperature. The quality module later flips QC_PENDING→PASSED/BLOCKED.
262	func (s *Service) CloseBMCLot(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID, chillingTempC float64) (*domain.BMCLot, error) {
263		lot, err := s.getBMCLot(ctx, id)
264		if err != nil {
265			return nil, err
266		}
267		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, lot.BMCID, "close bmc lot"); err != nil {
268			return nil, err
269		}
270		if lot.Status != domain.BMCLotStatusOpen {
271			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot close refused: not OPEN",
272				slog.String("bmc_lot_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("status", lot.Status),
273				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
274			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_NOT_OPEN",
275				"only an OPEN lot can be closed; lot is "+lot.Status)
276		}
277		now := time.Now().UTC()
278		ok, err := s.repo.CloseBMCLot(ctx, id, chillingTempC, now)
279		if err != nil {
280			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "close bmc lot", err)
281		}
282		if !ok {
283			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot close lost state race",
284				slog.String("bmc_lot_id", id.Hex()),
285				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
286			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_NOT_OPEN",
287				"lot changed state concurrently — reload and retry")
288		}
289		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
290			Type:       domain.EventBMCLotClosed,
291			EntityType: domain.EntityBMCLot,
292			EntityID:   lot.ID.Hex(),
293			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
294			OrgUnitID:  lot.BMCID.Hex(),
295			Payload:    map[string]any{"chilling_temp_c": chillingTempC},
296		})
297		if err != nil {
298			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append bmc_lot.closed event", err)
299		}
300		if err := s.repo.SetBMCLotProvenanceSeq(ctx, lot.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
301			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp bmc lot provenance seq", err)
302		}
303		lot.Status = domain.BMCLotStatusQCPending
304		lot.ChillingTempC = chillingTempC
305		lot.ClosedAt = &now
306		lot.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
307		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "bmc lot closed for QC",
308			slog.String("bmc_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()),
309			slog.String("bmc_id", lot.BMCID.Hex()),
310			slog.Float64("chilling_temp_c", chillingTempC),
311			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
312		return lot, nil
313	}
314	
315	// DispatchBMCLot transitions PASSED→DISPATCHED. THE safety gate (§8.3): a
316	// BLOCKED or untested lot never leaves the chilling centre.
317	func (s *Service) DispatchBMCLot(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.BMCLot, error) {
318		lot, err := s.getBMCLot(ctx, id)
319		if err != nil {
320			return nil, err
321		}
322		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, lot.BMCID, "dispatch bmc lot"); err != nil {
323			return nil, err
324		}
325		if lot.Status == domain.BMCLotStatusDispatched {
326			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot dispatch refused: already dispatched",
327				slog.String("bmc_lot_id", id.Hex()),
328				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
329			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_ALREADY_DISPATCHED", "lot is already dispatched")
330		}
331		if !canDispatchBMCLot(lot.Status) {
332			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot dispatch refused: safety gate not passed",
333				slog.String("bmc_lot_id", id.Hex()),
334				slog.String("status", lot.Status),
335				slog.String("block_reason", lot.BlockReason),
336				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
337			msg := "lot cannot be dispatched: safety gate not passed (status " + lot.Status + ")"
338			if lot.BlockReason != "" {
339				msg += " — " + lot.BlockReason
340			}
341			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked, msg).
342				WithDetails(map[string]any{"status": lot.Status, "block_reason": lot.BlockReason})
343		}
344		now := time.Now().UTC()
345		ok, err := s.repo.DispatchBMCLot(ctx, id, now)
346		if err != nil {
347			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "dispatch bmc lot", err)
348		}
349		if !ok {
350			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot dispatch lost state race",
351				slog.String("bmc_lot_id", id.Hex()),
352				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
353			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_STATE_CHANGED",
354				"lot changed state concurrently — reload and retry")
355		}
356		// The custody transition — gate-passed milk physically leaving the
357		// chilling centre — must live on the tamper-evident chain like every
358		// other hop of the pour→QR path, not only in a mutable document field.
359		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
360			Type:       domain.EventBMCLotDispatched,
361			EntityType: domain.EntityBMCLot,
362			EntityID:   lot.ID.Hex(),
363			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
364			OrgUnitID:  lot.BMCID.Hex(),
365			Payload: map[string]any{
366				// String, not time.Time: payloads must round-trip BSON⇄JSON
367				// byte-identically or chain re-verification would break.
368				"dispatched_at":         now.Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
369				"total_quantity_litres": lot.TotalQuantityLitres,
370			},
371		})
372		if err != nil {
373			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append bmc_lot.dispatched event", err)
374		}
375		if err := s.repo.SetBMCLotProvenanceSeq(ctx, lot.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
376			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp bmc lot provenance seq", err)
377		}
378		lot.Status = domain.BMCLotStatusDispatched
379		lot.DispatchedAt = &now
380		lot.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
381		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "bmc lot dispatched",
382			slog.String("bmc_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()),
383			slog.String("bmc_id", lot.BMCID.Hex()),
384			slog.Float64("total_quantity_litres", lot.TotalQuantityLitres),
385			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
386		return lot, nil
387	}
388	
389	// ListBMCLots pages lots by BMC/date/status. A BMC operator may only list
390	// within their own scope; downstream readers (plant operator, supervisor,
391	// lab) see across BMCs — the plant receives tankers from sibling BMCs, so an
392	// ancestry check against the plant org would wrongly refuse them.
393	func (s *Service) ListBMCLots(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, f BMCLotListFilter, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.BMCLot, int64, error) {
394		if !f.BMCID.IsZero() && actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleBMCOperator {
395			if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, f.BMCID, "list bmc lots"); err != nil {
396				return nil, 0, err
397			}
398		}
399		lots, total, err := s.repo.ListBMCLots(ctx, f, page)
400		if err != nil {
401			return nil, 0, s.fail(ctx, "list bmc lots", err)
402		}
403		return lots, total, nil
404	}
405	
406	// --- processing batches ---
407	
408	// CreateBatch pools DISPATCHED (gate-passed) BMC lots into one production
409	// run. The gate re-checks here belt-and-braces: aflatoxin M1 survives
410	// pasteurisation, so a blocked lot must never reach a vat (§8.3).
411	func (s *Service) CreateBatch(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateBatchRequest) (*domain.ProcessingBatch, error) {
412		actID, err := actorID(actor)
413		if err != nil {
414			return nil, err
415		}
416		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, req.PlantID, "create batch"); err != nil {
417			return nil, err
418		}
419		org, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.PlantID)
420		if err != nil {
421			return nil, err
422		}
423		if org.Type != domain.OrgTypeProcessingPlant {
424			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch creation refused: org unit is not a plant",
425				slog.String("org_unit_id", req.PlantID.Hex()),
426				slog.String("org_type", org.Type),
427				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
428			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_PLANT", "org unit "+req.PlantID.Hex()+" is not a processing plant")
429		}
430	
431		ids := dedupe(req.BMCLotIDs)
432		lots, err := s.repo.BMCLotsByIDs(ctx, ids)
433		if err != nil {
434			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "load bmc lots", err)
435		}
436		if len(lots) != len(ids) {
437			return nil, httpx.NotFound("BMC lot(s) " + strings.Join(missingLotIDs(ids, lots), ", "))
438		}
439		var offending []string
440		var inputLitres float64
441		for _, lot := range lots {
442			if !canPoolBMCLot(lot.Status) {
443				offending = append(offending, lot.ID.Hex())
444				continue
445			}
446			inputLitres += lot.TotalQuantityLitres
447		}
448		if len(offending) > 0 {
449			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch creation refused: bmc lot(s) have not cleared the safety gate",
450				slog.String("plant_id", req.PlantID.Hex()),
451				slog.String("blocked_lot_ids", strings.Join(offending, ",")),
452				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
453			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked,
454				"one or more BMC lots have not cleared the safety gate (must be PASSED and DISPATCHED)").
455				WithDetails(map[string]any{"blocked_lot_ids": offending})
456		}
457	
458		now := time.Now().UTC()
459		dateKey := domain.DateKeyIST(now)
460		seq, err := s.repo.NextSequence(ctx, "batch_number:"+req.PlantID.Hex()+":"+dateKey)
461		if err != nil {
462			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "next batch number sequence", err)
463		}
464		batchNumber := fmt.Sprintf("BATCH-%s-%s-%04d",
465			org.Code, strings.ReplaceAll(dateKey, "-", ""), seq)
466	
467		// Optimistic claim (mirrors ClaimConsignments): flip DISPATCHED→POOLED
468		// stamped with the pre-generated batch ID BEFORE inserting the batch. One
469		// physical lot of milk can therefore never be pooled into two batches —
470		// neither by a double-submit nor by two concurrent CreateBatch calls.
471		batchID := primitive.NewObjectID()
472		claimed, err := s.repo.ClaimBMCLots(ctx, ids, batchID)
473		if err != nil {
474			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "claim bmc lots", err)
475		}
476		if claimed != int64(len(ids)) {
477			if relErr := s.repo.ReleaseBMCLots(ctx, batchID); relErr != nil {
478				return nil, s.fail(ctx, "release bmc lots after lost claim", relErr)
479			}
480			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch creation lost bmc lot claim race",
481				slog.String("plant_id", req.PlantID.Hex()),
482				slog.Int64("claimed", claimed), slog.Int("requested", len(ids)),
483				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
484			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_CLAIM_CONFLICT",
485				"one or more BMC lots were pooled by another batch — reload and retry")
486		}
487	
488		// CREATED is a transient birth state: the plant lab must clear every
489		// batch, so it is persisted straight into QC_PENDING.
490		batch := &domain.ProcessingBatch{
491			ID:          batchID,
492			PlantID:     req.PlantID,
493			BatchNumber: batchNumber,
494			BMCLotIDs:   ids,
495			ProductType: req.ProductType,
496			InputLitres: inputLitres,
497			Status:      domain.BatchStatusQCPending,
498			StartedAt:   now,
499			CreatedBy:   actID,
500			CreatedAt:   now,
501		}
502		if err := s.repo.InsertBatch(ctx, batch); err != nil {
503			_ = s.repo.ReleaseBMCLots(ctx, batchID)
504			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "insert batch", err)
505		}
506	
507		refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, len(ids))
508		for _, id := range ids {
509			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{
510				EntityType: domain.EntityBMCLot, EntityID: id.Hex(), Relation: "pools",
511			})
512		}
513		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
514			Type:       domain.EventBatchCreated,
515			EntityType: domain.EntityBatch,
516			EntityID:   batch.ID.Hex(),
517			Refs:       refs,
518			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
519			OrgUnitID:  req.PlantID.Hex(),
520			Payload: map[string]any{
521				"batch_number": batchNumber, "product_type": req.ProductType, "input_litres": inputLitres,
522			},
523		})
524		if err != nil {
525			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append batch.created event", err)
526		}
527		if err := s.repo.SetBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx, batch.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
528			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp batch provenance seq", err)
529		}
530		batch.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
531		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "processing batch created",
532			slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
533			slog.String("batch_number", batchNumber),
534			slog.String("plant_id", req.PlantID.Hex()),
535			slog.String("product_type", req.ProductType),
536			slog.Int("bmc_lots", len(ids)),
537			slog.Float64("input_litres", inputLitres),
538			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
539		return batch, nil
540	}
541	
542	// CompleteBatch transitions PASSED→COMPLETED — only a batch the plant lab
543	// cleared may finish and go on to yield product lots.
544	func (s *Service) CompleteBatch(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.ProcessingBatch, error) {
545		batch, err := s.getBatch(ctx, id)
546		if err != nil {
547			return nil, err
548		}
549		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, batch.PlantID, "complete batch"); err != nil {
550			return nil, err
551		}
552		if batch.Status == domain.BatchStatusCompleted {
553			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch completion refused: already completed",
554				slog.String("batch_id", id.Hex()),
555				slog.String("batch_number", batch.BatchNumber),
556				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
557			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BATCH_ALREADY_COMPLETED", "batch is already completed")
558		}
559		if !canCompleteBatch(batch.Status) {
560			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch completion refused: plant-lab QC not passed",
561				slog.String("batch_id", id.Hex()),
562				slog.String("batch_number", batch.BatchNumber),
563				slog.String("status", batch.Status),
564				slog.String("block_reason", batch.BlockReason),
565				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
566			msg := "batch cannot complete: plant-lab QC not passed (status " + batch.Status + ")"
567			if batch.BlockReason != "" {
568				msg += " — " + batch.BlockReason
569			}
570			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked, msg).
571				WithDetails(map[string]any{"status": batch.Status, "block_reason": batch.BlockReason})
572		}
573		now := time.Now().UTC()
574		ok, err := s.repo.CompleteBatch(ctx, id, now)
575		if err != nil {
576			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "complete batch", err)
577		}
578		if !ok {
579			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch completion lost state race",
580				slog.String("batch_id", id.Hex()),
581				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
582			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BATCH_STATE_CHANGED",
583				"batch changed state concurrently — reload and retry")
584		}
585		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
586			Type:       domain.EventBatchCompleted,
587			EntityType: domain.EntityBatch,
588			EntityID:   batch.ID.Hex(),
589			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
590			OrgUnitID:  batch.PlantID.Hex(),
591			Payload:    map[string]any{"batch_number": batch.BatchNumber},
592		})
593		if err != nil {
594			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append batch.completed event", err)
595		}
596		if err := s.repo.SetBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx, batch.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
597			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp batch provenance seq", err)
598		}
599		batch.Status = domain.BatchStatusCompleted
600		batch.CompletedAt = &now
601		batch.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
602		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "processing batch completed",
603			slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
604			slog.String("batch_number", batch.BatchNumber),
605			slog.String("plant_id", batch.PlantID.Hex()),
606			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
607		return batch, nil
608	}
609	
610	// GetBatch returns one batch (including its qc_result_ids) within scope.
611	func (s *Service) GetBatch(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.ProcessingBatch, error) {
612		batch, err := s.getBatch(ctx, id)
613		if err != nil {

640		batch, err := s.getBatch(ctx, req.BatchID)
641		if err != nil {
642			return nil, err
643		}
644		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, batch.PlantID, "create product lot"); err != nil {
645			return nil, err
646		}

648			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "product lot creation refused: batch has not completed the safety gate",
649				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),

652				slog.String("block_reason", batch.BlockReason),
653				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
654			msg := "batch has not completed the safety gate (status " + batch.Status + ") — no product lots may be made"
655			if batch.BlockReason != "" {

659				WithDetails(map[string]any{"batch_status": batch.Status, "block_reason": batch.BlockReason})

669		}

770	// --- QR issuance ---
771	
772	// qrAlphabet is the 32-character human-safe set for short codes: A–Z and 2–9
773	// minus the confusables 0/O and 1/I. 32 divides 256, so a byte modulo the
774	// alphabet length is unbiased.
775	const qrAlphabet = "ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789"
776	
777	// qrCodeLength is the number of random characters after the "PRG-" prefix
778	// (32^8 ≈ 1.1 trillion codes — collisions are retried on the unique index).
779	const qrCodeLength = 8
780	
781	// newQRCode mints a short public code like "[REDACTED:generic-api-key]" from crypto/rand.
782	func newQRCode() (string, error) {
783		buf := make([]byte, qrCodeLength)
784		if _, err := rand.Read(buf); err != nil {
785			return "", err
786		}
787		code := make([]byte, qrCodeLength)
788		for i, b := range buf {
789			code[i] = qrAlphabet[int(b)%len(qrAlphabet)]
790		}
791		return "PRG-" + string(code), nil
792	}
793	
794	// signQRToken builds the forgery-proof token printed inside the QR:
795	// base64url(qr_code|product_lot_hex|issued_unix) + "." + hex(HMAC-SHA256).
796	// productLotHex is the product lot ObjectID's hex form — the HMAC material is
797	// "qr_code|lot hex|unix", and the publictrace module verifies the exact same
798	// shape. The consumer app resolves the payload; the signature proves it was
799	// minted by this server, so IDs cannot be guessed onto counterfeit packs.
800	func signQRToken(secret, qrCode, productLotHex string, issuedAt time.Time) string {
801		payload := qrCode + "|" + productLotHex + "|" + strconv.FormatInt(issuedAt.Unix(), 10)
802		mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte(secret))
803		mac.Write([]byte(payload))
804		return base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(payload)) + "." + hex.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))
805	}
806	
807	// parseQRToken verifies and unpacks a signed QR token, returning the product
808	// lot ObjectID as its hex string.
809	func parseQRToken(secret, token string) (qrCode, productLotHex string, issuedAt time.Time, err error) {
810		payloadB64, sigHex, found := strings.Cut(token, ".")
811		if !found {
812			return "", "", time.Time{}, errors.New("qr token: missing signature separator")
813		}
814		payloadBytes, err := base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString(payloadB64)
815		if err != nil {
816			return "", "", time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("qr token: bad payload encoding: %w", err)
817		}
818		sig, err := hex.DecodeString(sigHex)
819		if err != nil {
820			return "", "", time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("qr token: bad signature encoding: %w", err)
821		}
822		mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte(secret))
823		mac.Write(payloadBytes)
824		if !hmac.Equal(sig, mac.Sum(nil)) {
825			return "", "", time.Time{}, errors.New("qr token: signature mismatch")
826		}
827		parts := strings.Split(string(payloadBytes), "|")
828		if len(parts) != 3 {
829			return "", "", time.Time{}, errors.New("qr token: malformed payload")
830		}
831		unix, err := strconv.ParseInt(parts[2], 10, 64)
832		if err != nil {
833			return "", "", time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("qr token: bad timestamp: %w", err)
834		}
835		return parts[0], parts[1], time.Unix(unix, 0).UTC(), nil
836	}
837	
838	// IssueQR mints one signed QR for an ACTIVE product lot whose batch is
839	// COMPLETED. The gate is checked on read AND re-confirmed with a conditional
840	// write on the lot after the QR insert, so recalled or blocked product can
841	// never be freshly labelled even when the recall races this request.
842	func (s *Service) IssueQR(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, productLotID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.BatchQR, error) {
843		actID, err := actorID(actor)
844		if err != nil {
845			return nil, err
846		}
847		lot, err := s.getProductLot(ctx, productLotID)
848		if err != nil {
849			return nil, err
850		}
851		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, lot.PlantID, "issue qr"); err != nil {
852			return nil, err
853		}
854		batch, err := s.getBatch(ctx, lot.BatchID)
855		if err != nil {
856			return nil, err
857		}
858		if !canIssueQR(lot.Status, batch.Status) {
859			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qr issuance refused: safety gate",
860				slog.String("product_lot_id", productLotID.Hex()),
861				slog.String("product_lot_status", lot.Status),
862				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
863				slog.String("batch_status", batch.Status),
864				slog.String("recall_reason", lot.RecallReason),
865				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
866			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked,
867				"QR issuance refused: product lot must be ACTIVE and its batch COMPLETED").
868				WithDetails(map[string]any{
869					"product_lot_status": lot.Status,
870					"batch_status":       batch.Status,
871					"recall_reason":      lot.RecallReason,
872				})
873		}
874	
875		now := time.Now().UTC()
876		var qr *domain.BatchQR
877		const maxMintAttempts = 5
878		for attempt := 0; attempt < maxMintAttempts; attempt++ {
879			code, err := newQRCode()
880			if err != nil {
881				return nil, s.fail(ctx, "generate qr code", err)
882			}
883			candidate := &domain.BatchQR{
884				ID:           primitive.NewObjectID(),
885				QRCode:       code,
886				ProductLotID: lot.ID,
887				SignedToken:  signQRToken(s.qrSecret, code, lot.ID.Hex(), now),
888				IssuedBy:     actID,
889				ScanCount:    0,
890				IssuedAt:     now,
891			}
892			insertErr := s.repo.InsertQR(ctx, candidate)
893			if insertErr == nil {
894				qr = candidate
895				break
896			}
897			if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(insertErr) {
898				continue // short-code collision — regenerate
899			}
900			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "insert qr", insertErr)
901		}
902		if qr == nil {
903			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "mint qr code",
904				fmt.Errorf("%d consecutive short-code collisions", maxMintAttempts))
905		}
906	
907		// Recall re-check at WRITE time: the initial read cannot see a recall that
908		// lands mid-request, so the mint is confirmed with a conditional no-op
909		// write on the lot (filter status=ACTIVE). If the lot left ACTIVE, the
910		// just-inserted QR is deleted and issuance refused — a freshly minted QR
911		// can never label recalled product.
912		active, err := s.repo.TouchActiveLot(ctx, lot.ID)
913		if err != nil {
914			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "confirm product lot active", err)
915		}
916		if !active {
917			if delErr := s.repo.DeleteQR(ctx, qr.ID); delErr != nil {
918				return nil, s.fail(ctx, "delete qr after lot left ACTIVE", delErr)
919			}
920			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qr issuance refused: product lot left ACTIVE during issuance",
921				slog.String("product_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()),
922				slog.String("qr_id", qr.ID.Hex()),
923				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
924			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked,
925				"QR issuance refused: product lot left ACTIVE (e.g. recalled) during issuance")
926		}
927	
928		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
929			Type:       domain.EventQRIssued,
930			EntityType: domain.EntityBatchQR,
931			EntityID:   qr.ID.Hex(),
932			Refs: []provenance.Ref{
933				{EntityType: domain.EntityProductLot, EntityID: lot.ID.Hex(), Relation: "labels"},
934			},
935			Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
936			OrgUnitID: lot.PlantID.Hex(),
937			Payload:   map[string]any{"qr_code": qr.QRCode},
938		})
939		if err != nil {
940			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append qr.issued event", err)
941		}
942		if err := s.repo.SetQRProvenanceSeq(ctx, qr.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
943			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp qr provenance seq", err)
944		}
945		qr.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
946		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "qr issued",
947			slog.String("qr_id", qr.ID.Hex()),
948			slog.String("qr_code", qr.QRCode),
949			slog.String("product_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()),
950			slog.String("plant_id", lot.PlantID.Hex()),
951			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
952		return qr, nil
953	}

1009	// dedupe removes zero and duplicate IDs preserving first-seen order.
1010	func dedupe(ids []primitive.ObjectID) []primitive.ObjectID {
1011		seen := make(map[primitive.ObjectID]bool, len(ids))
1012		out := make([]primitive.ObjectID, 0, len(ids))
1013		for _, id := range ids {
1014			if id.IsZero() || seen[id] {
1015				continue
1016			}
1017			seen[id] = true
1018			out = append(out, id)
1019		}
1020		return out
1021	}

1023	// missingIDs lists requested consignment IDs (as hex) absent from the fetched
1024	// set.
1025	func missingIDs(wanted []primitive.ObjectID, got []domain.DCSConsignment) []string {
1026		have := make(map[primitive.ObjectID]bool, len(got))
1027		for _, c := range got {
1028			have[c.ID] = true
1029		}
1030		var missing []string
1031		for _, id := range wanted {
1032			if !have[id] {
1033				missing = append(missing, id.Hex())
1034			}
1035		}
1036		return missing
1037	}
1038

1041	func missingLotIDs(wanted []primitive.ObjectID, got []domain.BMCLot) []string {

1043		for _, l := range got {

1045		}

34	// RoleAssignment statuses.
35	const (
36		RoleAssignmentActive  = "ACTIVE"
37		RoleAssignmentRevoked = "REVOKED"
38	)
39	
40	// RoleAssignment grants one role to one party inside one org unit for a
41	// validity window. Revoking a Sacheev after an election is a single record
42	// update — never an account deletion (blueprint §4.1).
43	type RoleAssignment struct {
44		ID        primitive.ObjectID  `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
45		PartyID   primitive.ObjectID  `bson:"party_id"      json:"party_id"`
46		RoleCode  string              `bson:"role_code"     json:"role_code"`
47		OrgUnitID primitive.ObjectID  `bson:"org_unit_id"   json:"org_unit_id"`
48		GrantedBy *primitive.ObjectID `bson:"granted_by,omitempty" json:"granted_by,omitempty"`
49		ValidFrom time.Time           `bson:"valid_from"    json:"valid_from"`
50		ValidTo   *time.Time          `bson:"valid_to,omitempty"   json:"valid_to,omitempty"` // nil = open-ended
51		Status    string              `bson:"status"        json:"status"`
52		RevokedAt *time.Time          `bson:"revoked_at,omitempty" json:"revoked_at,omitempty"`
53		RevokedBy *primitive.ObjectID `bson:"revoked_by,omitempty" json:"revoked_by,omitempty"`
54		CreatedAt time.Time           `bson:"created_at"    json:"created_at"`
55	}
56	
57	// UsableAt reports whether the assignment is active and inside its validity
58	// window at instant t.
59	func (ra RoleAssignment) UsableAt(t time.Time) bool {
60		if ra.Status != RoleAssignmentActive {
61			return false
62		}
63		if t.Before(ra.ValidFrom) {
64			return false
65		}
66		if ra.ValidTo != nil && t.After(*ra.ValidTo) {
67			return false
68		}
69		return true
70	}

75	// A role token is only issuable once the party's tier satisfies the role's
76	// RequiredKYCTier, so "login as rider" is impossible before approval.

9	/**

11	 * advance stages behind the QC gate, assign product outputs + batch QRs.
12	 *
13	 * Aligned with parag-saathi-be (internal/modules/plant), mounted at /plant:
14	 *   GET  /plant/bmc-lots            → BMC lots (the intake grain)
15	 *   GET  /plant/batches             → processing batches
16	 *   GET  /plant/batches/{id}        → one batch
17	 *   POST /plant/batches             → CreateBatchRequest
18	 *   POST /plant/batches/{id}/complete → completes a batch (only transition)
19	 *   POST /plant/product-lots        → CreateProductLotRequest (one SKU lot)
20	 *
21	 * The backend's response domain structs (domain.BMCLot / domain.Batch /
22	 * domain.ProductLot) are not vendored into this repo, so the Wire* shapes
23	 * below are declared best-effort from the documented request fields + the
24	 * platform snake_case conventions. mapResponse defaults any field the wire
25	 * may not carry; see the `issues` notes for the lossy spots.

253	    if (notArrived) {

308	>({
309	  method: 'POST',
310	  // The backend exposes only a single terminal transition (.../complete) - it
311	  // cannot express the RECEIVED→PASTEURIZED→PACKED→RELEASED ladder or a
312	  // REJECTED move. Every advance maps to "complete"; the requested `stage` is

314	  // See issues.

320	    if (!batch) throw new ApiError(404, 'BATCH_NOT_FOUND', `Unknown batch ${batchId}`);
321	    const order: BatchStage[] = ['RECEIVED', 'PASTEURIZED', 'PACKED', 'RELEASED'];
322	    if (stage === 'REJECTED') {
323	      batch.stage = 'REJECTED';
324	    } else {
325	      const from = order.indexOf(batch.stage);
326	      const to = order.indexOf(stage);
327	      if (from === -1 || to !== from + 1) {
328	        throw new ApiError(409, 'INVALID_TRANSITION', `Cannot move ${batch.stage} → ${stage}`);
329	      }
330	      if ((stage === 'PACKED' || stage === 'RELEASED') && batch.qcStatus !== 'PASS') {
331	        throw new ApiError(
332	          409,
333	          'QC_GATE_BLOCKED',
334	          'Safety gate: batch cannot advance until all mandatory FSSAI tests PASS (§8.3)',

346	      subject: batch.code,
347	      detail: `Stage → ${batch.stage}`,
348	    });

352	        subjectType: 'BATCH',
353	        subjectId: batch.id,

356	      });

413	      const code = packQrCode(skuCompact, batch.date, batch.code.slice(-1));
414	      // Sign the pack (§6.6): the QR encodes the token, so an edited/guessed
415	      // code cannot resolve or verify at the public trace.
416	      const token = issueTraceToken(code);
417	      batch.productOutputs.push({ productId: out.productId, units: out.units, qrBatchCode: code });
418	      db.qrs.push({
419	        code,
420	        batchId: batch.id,
421	        productId: out.productId,
422	        packedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
423	        bestBefore: todayISO(product.category === 'MILK' ? 3 : 30),
424	        token,
425	      });
426	      appendChainEvent(db, {
427	        kind: 'QR_ISSUE',
428	        subjectType: 'QR',
429	        subjectId: code,
430	        actorPartyId: byPartyId,
431	        detail: `${code} issued for ${batch.code}`,
432	      });
433	    }
434	    audit(db, {
435	      actorPartyId: byPartyId,
436	      actorRole: 'PLANT_OPERATOR',
437	      action: 'OUTPUTS_ASSIGNED',
438	      subject: batch.code,
439	      detail: `${outputs.length} product outputs with batch QRs`,
440	    });
441	    return batch;
442	  },
443	});
444

func JSONMeta(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, data, meta any) {
	writeJSON(w, status, envelope{Data: data, Meta: meta})

func ParsePage(r *http.Request) Page {
	p := Page{Limit: 50, Offset: 0}
	if v := r.URL.Query().Get("limit"); v != "" {
		if n, err := strconv.ParseInt(v, 10, 64); err == nil && n > 0 {
			p.Limit = min(n, 200)
		}
	}
	if v := r.URL.Query().Get("offset"); v != "" {
		if n, err := strconv.ParseInt(v, 10, 64); err == nil && n >= 0 {
			p.Offset = n
		}
	}
	return p
}

=== consumer.ts (traceRefFromScan) ===
/**
 * Consumer-app integration seam - the SINGLE bridge between this operations app
 * and the separate consumer app / commerce backend.
 *
 * The consumer app is where end-customers browse the catalogue, order, pay,
 * track delivery, and scan the pack QR. It is a DIFFERENT service from
 * parag-saathi-be. Every consumer-facing exchange crosses this one seam:
 *
 *   Orders       consumer places an order   -> delivery tasks for the rider
 *   Fulfilment   store / plant stock         -> what the consumer app can sell
 *   Catalogue    plant products + pack QRs   -> consumer app product listings
 *   Tracking     rider live location         -> consumer watches it approach
 *   Proof        proof-of-delivery           -> consumer sees it delivered
 *   Trace        pack QR scan                -> public provenance (traceability)
 *
 * ── The BACKDOOR ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * Point EXPO_PUBLIC_CONSUMER_API_URL at the consumer / commerce service. Until
 * it is set, the in-app mock serves everything so all profiles work offline. No
 * profile module changes when the real service lands - they call the same paths
 * below, and consumerUrl() targets the mock or the live host from one place.
 */
export const CONSUMER_API_URL: string = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_CONSUMER_API_URL || '';

/** True once the consumer-app / commerce service is provisioned. */
export const CONSUMER_APP_CONFIGURED: boolean = Boolean(CONSUMER_API_URL);

/**
 * The resource contract the consumer service exposes. Documented in ONE place so
 * every profile that touches consumers speaks the same paths (delivery, store,
 * commerce/catalogue). Functions take the id; constants are collection roots.
 */
export const CONSUMER_RESOURCES = {
  /** Delivery tasks pushed to a rider (list / one / lifecycle). */
  deliveryTasks: '/delivery/tasks',
  deliveryTask: (id: string) => `/delivery/tasks/${id}`,
  deliveryLocation: (id: string) => `/delivery/tasks/${id}/location`,
  /** Consumer orders (the store manager fulfils these). */
  orders: '/orders',
  order: (id: string) => `/orders/${id}`,
  /** Product catalogue the plant publishes for the consumer app to sell. */
  catalogue: '/catalogue/products',
  /** Store stock the consumer app reads for availability. */
  storeInventory: (storeId: string) => `/stores/${storeId}/inventory`,
} as const;

/**
 * Resolve a consumer-service URL for a resource path. With no base configured
 * the path is returned as-is (the in-app mock intercepts it); once the base is
 * set it targets the live consumer host - callers never change.
 */
export function consumerUrl(path: string): string {
  const base = CONSUMER_API_URL.replace(/\/+$/, '');
  return base ? `${base}${path}` : path;
}

/**
 * Consumer-facing public trace web host. When a consumer scans a pack QR with
 * their phone camera it should open the public provenance page for that code -
 * so pack QRs encode this URL, not the bare code. Blank -> the QR encodes the
 * raw code (the in-app scanner still resolves it).
 */
export const PUBLIC_TRACE_URL: string = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_PUBLIC_TRACE_URL || '';

/**
 * Build the public trace URL a pack QR encodes (§6.6): `<host>/t/<ref>`, where
 * `ref` is the signed token when the pack has one, else the bare code. With no
 * host set, the QR encodes the ref itself (the in-app scanner still resolves it).
 */
export function traceUrl(ref: string): string {
  const base = PUBLIC_TRACE_URL.replace(/\/+$/, '');
  return base ? `${base}/t/${encodeURIComponent(ref)}` : ref;
}

 * path, or the bare code. Always returns the final path segment, decoded, so a
 * scanned pack URL resolves the same as a typed code.

=== traceRefFromScan body ===
export function traceRefFromScan(raw: string): string {
  const noQuery = raw.trim().split(/[?#]/)[0];
  const seg = noQuery.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/').pop() ?? noQuery;
  try {
    return decodeURIComponent(seg);
  } catch {
    return seg;
  }
}

=== TraceResult full ===
export interface LedgerSummary {
  /** Chain events backing this pack's provenance (pour → … → QR issue). */
  events: number;
  /** Recomputed hash chain matches every stored link - tamper-evident. */
  intact: boolean;
}

/** Consumer-facing provenance (§8.4) - honest samiti-level granularity (§7.4). */
export interface TraceResult {
  qr: ProductQr;
  product: Product;
  batch: PlantBatch;
  plant: OrgUnit;
  /** Which samitis contributed, with share of volume - never per-farmer claims */
  sources: Array<{
    dcs: OrgUnit;
    pourCount: number;
    volumeShare: number; // 0..1
    collectedOn: string;
    /** The Sachiv who heads this samiti, so the consumer sees who is accountable */
    sachivName?: string;
    /** Farmers who opted in (publicConsent) to be named for this samiti (§6.7).
     *  Empty/absent by default - the samiti-level share stays the honest floor. */
    consentedFarmers?: Array<{ name: string; village?: string }>;
  }>;
  tests: QualityTestResult[];
  certificate?: QcCertificate;
  /** Provenance-ledger tamper-check (§5) - absent if no chain events exist. */
  ledger?: LedgerSummary;
  /** True if this batch was recalled/rejected post-release (§6.6 safety). */
  recalled?: boolean;

src/core/api/client.ts
---
import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import type { MockDb } from '@/core/mocks/db';

/**
 * API transport layer, aligned with the real Go backend (parag-saathi-be):
 *   - success envelope  { "data": ..., "meta"?: ... }
 *   - error envelope    { "error": { "code", "message", "details"? } }
 *   - bearer auth with a SESSION/ROLE access token + rotating refresh token
 *     (POST /auth/refresh) - a 401 triggers one single-flight refresh + retry
 *
 * Every endpoint in src/core/api/endpoints/ is declared once with:
 *   - its HTTP method + path        → the contract the backend implements
 *   - optional mapRequest/mapResponse → snake_case wire ⇄ camelCase domain
 *   - a mock implementation         → runs fully in-app against the seeded
 *                                     mock DB until the backend is connected
 *
 * Switch modes with EXPO_PUBLIC_API_MODE (mock | http) - see .env.example and
 * docs/api-contract.md. No feature code changes when the backend lands.
 */

export type ApiMode = 'mock' | 'http';

// Authentic by default: the app talks to the real Saathi backend. `mock` is an
// explicit offline-development fallback only (never the shipped experience).
const MODE: ApiMode = (process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_API_MODE as ApiMode) || 'http';
const BASE: string = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL || 'http://localhost:8080/api/v1';

/** The active API mode ('http' = real backend, 'mock' = in-app fixtures). */
export const API_MODE: ApiMode = MODE;
/** The Saathi backend base URL every endpoint is resolved against. */
export const API_BASE_URL: string = BASE;

const ACCESS_KEY = 'saathi-access-token';
const REFRESH_KEY = 'saathi-refresh-token';

/** In-memory token cache, persisted to AsyncStorage (hydrated at app start). */
let accessToken: string | null = null;
let refreshToken: string | null = null;

export function getAuthToken(): string | null {
  return accessToken;
}
export function getRefreshToken(): string | null {
  return refreshToken;
}

/** Store both tokens (login / refresh rotation). */
export function setTokens(t: { access: string | null; refresh: string | null }): void {
  accessToken = t.access;
  refreshToken = t.refresh;
  if (t.access) void AsyncStorage.setItem(ACCESS_KEY, t.access);
  else void AsyncStorage.removeItem(ACCESS_KEY);
  if (t.refresh) void AsyncStorage.setItem(REFRESH_KEY, t.refresh);
  else void AsyncStorage.removeItem(REFRESH_KEY);
}

/** Swap only the access token (role-select issues a ROLE-kind token). */
export function setAccessToken(token: string): void {
  accessToken = token;
  void AsyncStorage.setItem(ACCESS_KEY, token);
}

export function clearTokens(): void {
  setTokens({ access: null, refresh: null });
}

/** Call once at startup (root layout) before authenticated requests. */
export async function hydrateAuthToken(): Promise<void> {
  const [a, r] = await Promise.all([
    AsyncStorage.getItem(ACCESS_KEY),
    AsyncStorage.getItem(REFRESH_KEY),
  ]);
  accessToken = a;
  refreshToken = r;
}

/** Registered by the root layout: fired when auth is irrecoverably lost. */
let onUnauthorized: (() => void) | null = null;
export function setOnUnauthorized(cb: (() => void) | null): void {
  onUnauthorized = cb;
}

export class ApiError extends Error {
  constructor(
    public status: number,
    public code: string,
    message: string,
    public details?: unknown,
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'ApiError';
  }
}

type HttpMethod = 'GET' | 'POST' | 'PUT' | 'PATCH' | 'DELETE';

export interface EndpointSpec<TIn, TOut> {
  method: HttpMethod;
  /** REST path for http mode; also documents the backend contract */
  path: (input: TIn) => string;
  /** camelCase input → snake_case wire body (http mode only) */
  mapRequest?: (input: TIn) => unknown;
  /** snake_case wire data → domain shape (http mode only) */
  mapResponse?: (raw: unknown) => TOut;
  /** In-app implementation for mock mode */
  mock: (input: TIn, db: MockDb) => TOut | Promise<TOut>;
}

function sleep(ms: number): Promise<void> {
  return new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
}

/** JSON-safe deep clone (results are plain data; keeps Hermes compatibility). */
function deepClone<T>(value: T): T {
  return value === undefined ? value : (JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value)) as T);
}

/** Raw http call: bearer header, envelope unwrap, AppError mapping. */
async function httpCall(method: HttpMethod, path: string, body: unknown): Promise<unknown> {
  const hasBody = method !== 'GET' && method !== 'DELETE' && body !== undefined;
  const res = await fetch(BASE + path, {
    method,
    headers: {
      Accept: 'application/json',
      ...(hasBody ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } : {}),
      ...(accessToken ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}` } : {}),
    },
    body: hasBody ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined,
  });
  const text = await res.text().catch(() => '');
  let json: unknown;
  try {
    json = text ? JSON.parse(text) : undefined;
  } catch {
    json = undefined;
  }
  if (!res.ok) {
    const err = (json as { error?: { code?: string; message?: string; details?: unknown } })
      ?.error;
    throw new ApiError(
      res.status,
      err?.code ?? `HTTP_${res.status}`,
      err?.message ?? res.statusText,
      err?.details,
    );
  }
  // Success envelope: { data, meta? } - unwrap data; tolerate bare payloads.
  if (json && typeof json === 'object' && 'data' in (json as Record<string, unknown>)) {
    return (json as { data: unknown }).data;
  }
  return json;
}

/** Single-flight refresh: rotate the token pair via POST /auth/refresh. */
let refreshInFlight: Promise<boolean> | null = null;
async function tryRefresh(): Promise<boolean> {
  if (!refreshToken) return false;
  refreshInFlight ??= (async () => {
    try {
      const data = (await httpCall('POST', '/auth/refresh', {
        refresh_token: refreshToken,
      })) as { access_token: string; refresh_token: string };
      setTokens({ access: data.access_token, refresh: data.refresh_token });
      return true;
    } catch {
      return false;
    } finally {
      refreshInFlight = null;
    }
  })();
  return refreshInFlight;
}

/** Declare a typed API endpoint. Returns the callable used by feature code. */
export function endpoint<TIn = void, TOut = unknown>(
  spec: EndpointSpec<TIn, TOut>,
): (input: TIn) => Promise<TOut> {
  return async (input: TIn): Promise<TOut> => {
    if (MODE === 'mock') {
      const { db } = await import('@/core/mocks/db');
      // Simulated network latency so loading states are honest
      await sleep(120 + Math.random() * 230);
      const result = await spec.mock(input, db);
      // Deep-clone so callers can never mutate the mock store through results
      return deepClone(result);
    }

    const path = spec.path(input);
    const body = spec.mapRequest ? spec.mapRequest(input) : (input as unknown);
    try {
      const raw = await httpCall(spec.method, path, body);
      return spec.mapResponse ? spec.mapResponse(raw) : (raw as TOut);
    } catch (e) {
      // One refresh + retry on expired access tokens (never for /auth/* itself)
      if (e instanceof ApiError && e.status === 401 && !path.startsWith('/auth/')) {
        if (await tryRefresh()) {
          const raw = await httpCall(spec.method, path, body);
          return spec.mapResponse ? spec.mapResponse(raw) : (raw as TOut);
        }
        clearTokens();

package publictrace

import (
	"time"

	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/provenance"
)

// ProductInfo is the pack-label subset of a product lot shown to consumers.
type ProductInfo struct {
	Name       string `json:"name"`
	SKU        string `json:"sku"`
	UnitSize   string `json:"unit_size"`
	MfgDate    string `json:"mfg_date"`
	ExpiryDate string `json:"expiry_date"`
}

// PlantInfo identifies the processing plant that produced the batch.
type PlantInfo struct {
	Name     string `json:"name"`
	District string `json:"district,omitempty"`
}

// QualityInfo is the PLANT_LAB pass certificate attached to the batch.
type QualityInfo struct {
	CertificateNumber string          `json:"certificate_number"`
	Stage             string          `json:"stage"`
	Tests             []domain.QCTest `json:"tests"`
	RecordedAt        time.Time       `json:"recorded_at"`
}

// SamitiInfo is one contributing village society (DCS) — the honest pooled
// provenance grain (§7.4): the set of samitis, never individual farmers.
type SamitiInfo struct {
	Name     string `json:"name"`
	Code     string `json:"code"`
	District string `json:"district,omitempty"`
}

// SourcingInfo summarises where and when the milk was collected.
type SourcingInfo struct {
	Message         string       `json:"message"`
	Samitis         []SamitiInfo `json:"samitis"`
	CollectionDates []string     `json:"collection_dates"`
}

// LedgerInfo reports the tamper-evidence check over the traced events.
type LedgerInfo struct {
	Events        int      `json:"events"`
	Intact        bool     `json:"intact"`
	VerifiedRange [2]int64 `json:"verified_range"`
	// Partial is true when the traced span exceeded the per-scan verification
	// cap and only the most recent portion of the range was re-hashed.
	Partial bool `json:"partial,omitempty"`
}

// QRScanResponse is the consumer-facing provenance view for one QR scan.
type QRScanResponse struct {
	Product      ProductInfo  `json:"product"`
	BatchNumber  string       `json:"batch_number"`
	Plant        PlantInfo    `json:"plant"`
	Quality      *QualityInfo `json:"quality,omitempty"`
	Sourcing     SourcingInfo `json:"sourcing"`
	Ledger       LedgerInfo   `json:"ledger"`
	ScanCount    int64        `json:"scan_count"`
	Recalled     bool         `json:"recalled,omitempty"`
	RecallNotice string       `json:"recall_notice,omitempty"`
}

// LedgerVerifyResponse is the public tamper-evidence check result.
type LedgerVerifyResponse struct {
	Intact      bool   `json:"intact"`
	BrokenAtSeq *int64 `json:"broken_at_seq,omitempty"`
	From        int64  `json:"from"`
	To          int64  `json:"to"`
}

// TraceGraphResponse is the full event graph around one entity: upstream
// (what it was made from) and downstream (what it went into).
type TraceGraphResponse struct {
	Upstream   []provenance.Event `json:"upstream"`
	Downstream []provenance.Event `json:"downstream"`
}

198	// Trace walks the provenance graph UPSTREAM from an entity: its events, plus
199	// (recursively) the events of everything those events reference. This is how
200	// a consumer QR resolves back to the contributing samiti set, and how a failed
201	// aflatoxin test walks back to source DCSes (blueprint §8.3).
202	func (l *Ledger) Trace(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, maxDepth int) ([]Event, error) {
203		return l.TraceStopAt(ctx, entityType, entityID, maxDepth, nil)
204	}
205	
206	// TraceStopAt is Trace with a stop set: entity types in stopExpand are still
207	// fetched (their events appear in the result) but their refs are never
208	// followed. The consumer QR scan stops at the consignment/pooling boundary so
209	// hundreds of per-pour nodes (and cross-route trip fan-out) are never walked.

18	// Register mounts the orgs module under /orgs on the /api/v1 subtree.
19	func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
20		log := d.Log.With(slog.String("module", "orgs"))
21		repo := newRepository(d.DB)
22		svc := newService(repo, d.Orgs, log)
23		h := newHandler(svc)

28			// Hierarchy writes — state-apex administrators only.

31				r.Post("/", h.create)
32				r.Patch("/{id}", h.update)
33			})
34	
35			// Directory reads — any authenticated party (session or role token).
36			r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
37				r.Use(middleware.RequireSession)
38				r.Get("/", h.list)
39				r.Get("/{id}", h.get)
40				r.Get("/{id}/children", h.children)
41			})
42	
43			// Subtree read — oversight roles, scope-checked in the service.
44			r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
45				r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(
46					domain.RoleSuperAdmin,
47					domain.RolePCDFAdmin,
48					domain.RoleMissionOfficial,
49					domain.RoleUnionPresident,

32	func newService(repo *repository, scope *orgscope.Resolver, log *slog.Logger) *service {

35	
36	// fail routes an error out of the service: expected AppErrors (404s from the
37	// repo, platform errors) pass through untouched; anything unexpected — or an
38	// AppError already carrying a 5xx — is logged at ERROR with the failing
39	// operation before the client sees an opaque 500.
40	func (s *service) fail(ctx context.Context, op string, err error) error {
41		var appErr *httpx.AppError
42		ok := errors.As(err, &appErr)
43		if !ok || appErr.Status >= http.StatusInternalServerError {
44			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "orgs operation failed",
45				slog.String("op", op),
46				slog.Any("err", err))
47		}
48		if ok {
49			return err
50		}
51		return httpx.Internal(err)
52	}

54	// scopeErr handles a RequireInScope failure: scope denials (403) are logged
55	// at WARN with the actor and target; other errors go through fail.
56	func (s *service) scopeErr(ctx context.Context, op string, actor auth.Actor, targetOrgID primitive.ObjectID, err error) error {
57		var appErr *httpx.AppError
58		if errors.As(err, &appErr) && appErr.Status == http.StatusForbidden {
59			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "org scope denial",
60				slog.String("op", op),
61				slog.String("target_org_id", targetOrgID.Hex()),
62				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
63				slog.String("actor_org_id", actor.OrgUnitID),
64				slog.String("reason", appErr.Message))
65			return err
66		}

70	// validateHierarchy checks whether an org unit of childType may be created

72	// Pure function — unit-tested against the full type matrix.
73	func validateHierarchy(childType, parentType string) *httpx.AppError {
74		if !domain.IsValidOrgType(childType) {
75			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_ORG_TYPE", "unknown org type "+childType)
76		}
77		allowed := domain.ValidOrgParent[childType]
78		if len(allowed) == 0 { // hierarchy root
79			if parentType != "" {
80				return httpx.Unprocessable("ORG_PARENT_TYPE_INVALID",
81					childType+" is the hierarchy root and cannot have a parent")
82			}
83			return nil
84		}
85		if parentType == "" {
86			return httpx.BadRequest("ORG_PARENT_REQUIRED", childType+" requires a parent_id")
87		}
88		for _, t := range allowed {
89			if t == parentType {
90				return nil
91			}
92		}
93		return httpx.Unprocessable("ORG_PARENT_TYPE_INVALID",
94			childType+" cannot be created under a "+parentType)
95	}

300	// List pages org units filtered by type, district and/or exact code — the
301	// unique business key, e.g. ?code=DCS-01842, used to discover an org's
302	// ObjectID (GET /orgs) — returning the total matching count alongside the page.
303	func (s *service) List(ctx context.Context, orgType, district, code string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.OrgUnit, int64, error) {
304		filter := bson.D{}
305		if orgType != "" {
306			if !domain.IsValidOrgType(orgType) {
307				return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_ORG_TYPE", "unknown org type "+orgType)
308			}
309			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "type", Value: orgType})
310		}
311		if district != "" {
312			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "district", Value: district})
313		}
314		if code != "" {
315			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "code", Value: code})
316		}
317		units, total, err := s.repo.listOrgs(ctx, filter, page)
318		if err != nil {
319			return nil, 0, s.fail(ctx, "list org units", err)
320		}
321		return units, total, nil
322	}
323	
324	// Members pages the ACTIVE role assignments at an org unit joined in memory
325	// with party identity fields (GET /orgs/{id}/members) — two indexed queries,
326	// no $lookup.
327	func (s *service) Members(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID, page httpx.Page) ([]Member, int64, error) {
328		if _, err := s.repo.getOrg(ctx, id); err != nil {
329			return nil, 0, s.fail(ctx, "get org unit", err)
330		}
331		if err := s.scope.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, id); err != nil {
332			return nil, 0, s.scopeErr(ctx, "read org members", actor, id, err)
333		}
334	
335		total, err := s.repo.countActiveAssignments(ctx, id)
336		if err != nil {
337			return nil, 0, s.fail(ctx, "count active role assignments", err)
338		}
339		assignments, err := s.repo.listActiveAssignments(ctx, id, page)
340		if err != nil {
341			return nil, 0, s.fail(ctx, "list active role assignments", err)
342		}
343		partyIDs := make([]primitive.ObjectID, 0, len(assignments))
344		seen := make(map[primitive.ObjectID]struct{}, len(assignments))
345		for _, a := range assignments {
346			if _, dup := seen[a.PartyID]; !dup {
347				seen[a.PartyID] = struct{}{}
348				partyIDs = append(partyIDs, a.PartyID)
349			}
350		}
351		parties, err := s.repo.partiesByIDs(ctx, partyIDs)
352		if err != nil {
353			return nil, 0, s.fail(ctx, "fetch member parties", err)
354		}
355	
356		members := make([]Member, 0, len(assignments))
357		for _, a := range assignments {
358			m := Member{
359				PartyID:          a.PartyID,
360				RoleCode:         a.RoleCode,
361				RoleAssignmentID: a.ID,
362				ValidFrom:        a.ValidFrom,
363				ValidTo:          a.ValidTo,
364			}
365			if p, ok := parties[a.PartyID]; ok {
366				m.Phone = p.Phone
367				m.FullName = p.FullName
368				m.KYCTier = p.KYCTier
369			}
370			members = append(members, m)
371		}
372		return members, total, nil
373	}
374

73	// NormalizeTestName maps common field aliases to the canonical FSSAI test
74	// name so the safety gate can NEVER be bypassed by a spelling difference
75	// (e.g. the app sends "AFM1"; the gate keys on "AFLATOXIN_M1"). A test whose
76	// name still doesn't resolve to a gated parameter is recorded but not gated.
77	func NormalizeTestName(name string) string {
78		switch strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(name)) {
79		case "AFM1", "AFLATOXIN", "AFLATOXINM1", "AFLATOXIN_M1", "AFLATOXIN-M1":
80			return TestAflatoxinM1
81		case "COLIFORM", "COLIFORMS":
82			return TestColiform
83		case "TPC", "TOTAL_PLATE_COUNT":
84			return TestTPC
85		case "ANTIBIOTIC", "TETRACYCLINE", "ANTIBIOTIC_TETRACYCLINE":
86			return TestAntibiotic
87		case "PHOSPHATASE", "ALP":
88			return TestPhosphatase
89		case "FAT":
90			return TestFat
91		case "SNF":
92			return TestSNF
93		default:
94			return strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(name))
95		}
96	}
97	
98	// EvaluateQCTests applies the FSSAI gate to a set of tests: it normalizes each
99	// test name, fills its Pass verdict, and returns the overall verdict plus
100	// human-readable failure reasons. Unknown test names are recorded but do not
101	// gate. The returned tests carry the CANONICAL name so storage is consistent.
102	func EvaluateQCTests(tests []QCTest) (overallPass bool, failures []string, evaluated []QCTest) {
103		overallPass = true
104		evaluated = make([]QCTest, 0, len(tests))
105		for _, t := range tests {
106			t.Name = NormalizeTestName(t.Name) // canonicalise so the gate cannot be dodged by alias
107			pass := true
108			switch t.Name {
109			case TestAflatoxinM1:
110				if t.Value > FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg {
111					pass = false
112					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
113						"AFLATOXIN_M1 %.3f µg/kg exceeds FSSAI limit %.1f µg/kg", t.Value, FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg))
114				}
115			case TestColiform:
116				if t.Value > FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl {
117					pass = false
118					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
119						"COLIFORM %.1f CFU/ml exceeds FSSAI limit %.0f CFU/ml", t.Value, FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl))
120				}
121			case TestAntibiotic:
122				if t.Value > FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg {
123					pass = false
124					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
125						"ANTIBIOTIC_TETRACYCLINE %.3f mg/kg exceeds MRL %.1f mg/kg", t.Value, FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg))
126				}
127			case TestPhosphatase:
128				if t.Value != 0 {
129					pass = false
130					failures = append(failures, "PHOSPHATASE positive — pasteurisation check failed (must be negative)")
131				}
132			}
133			t.Pass = pass
134			if !pass {
135				overallPass = false
136			}
137			evaluated = append(evaluated, t)
138		}
139		return overallPass, failures, evaluated
140	}

/**
 * Certificate details for a passed batch. Newly issued certificates are
 * seeded into this key by `useIssueCertificate`; for batches that already
 * carry pack QRs, the provenance endpoint returns the certificate.
 */
export function useCertificate(batch: PlantBatch) {
  const qrCode = batch.productOutputs[0]?.qrBatchCode;
  return useQuery<QcCertificate | null>({
    queryKey: ['lab', 'certificate', batch.id],
    enabled: Boolean(batch.certificateId),
    staleTime: Infinity,
    queryFn: async () => {
      if (qrCode) {
        const trace = await traceApi.traceByQr({ code: qrCode });
        return trace.certificate ?? null;
      }
      return null;
    },
  });
}

/**
 * Trace-token + provenance-hash primitives (dev note §5 ledger, §6.6 QR token).
 *
 * The real backend signs QR tokens and hash-chains ledger events with a server
 * secret (SHA-256 HMAC + Merkle anchoring). On-device we only need deterministic,
 * same-shape stand-ins so the mock chain issues and verifies end to end; the real
 * secret drops in via EXPO_PUBLIC_TRACE_HMAC_SECRET behind this seam - nothing
 * here is ever the source of truth for a production signature.
 */
import { hashString } from './id';

/** Signing secret - env-provisioned; a dev default keeps the mock self-contained. */
const SECRET = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_TRACE_HMAC_SECRET ?? 'saathi-dev-secret';

const B62 = '0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ';

/** base62-encode a non-negative 32-bit integer. */
export function base62(n: number): string {
  let x = n >>> 0;
  if (x === 0) return '0';
  let s = '';
  while (x > 0) {
    s = B62[x % 62] + s;
    x = Math.floor(x / 62);
  }
  return s;
}

/** Keyed digest of `payload` as `len` base62 chars (mock stand-in for an HMAC). */
function keyedDigest(payload: string, len: number): string {
  // Two decorrelated FNV passes over secret|payload widen the base62 space.
  const a = hashString(`${SECRET}|${payload}`);
  const b = hashString(`${payload}|${SECRET}|s`);
  return (base62(a) + base62(b)).slice(0, len).padStart(len, '0');
}

/** Short HMAC suffix (6 base62 chars) as in `base62(lot_ref)·hmac6` (§6.6). */
export function shortHmac(payload: string): string {
  return keyedDigest(payload, 6);
}

/**
 * Issue a signed, opaque trace token for a pack: `base62(lot_ref).hmac6` (§6.6).
 * lot_ref is the pack's QR code; the body is a compact opaque handle and the
 * suffix signs it, so a guessed/edited code cannot resolve or verify.
 */
export function issueTraceToken(lotRef: string): string {
  const body = base62(hashString(lotRef));
  return `${body}.${shortHmac(lotRef)}`;
}

/** True iff `token` is a well-formed, correctly-signed token for `lotRef`. */
export function verifyTraceToken(token: string, lotRef: string): boolean {
  const [body, sig] = token.split('.');
  return body === base62(hashString(lotRef)) && sig === shortHmac(lotRef);
}

The FE sends exactly this alias: src/core/api/endpoints/quality.ts recordTest.mapRequest (L175-180) sends name=input.parameter where the TestParameter for aflatoxin is literally 'AFM1' (src/core/utils/quality.ts QUALITY_PARAMETERS.AFM1). Net effect: the single most safety-critical, heat-stable test — mandatory at BOTH stages — can never be recorded via the app; every AFM1 submission fails closed with 400. TestValidateTestNames (service_test.go:173) only ever exercises canonical names, so the gap is untested. The Note's claimed normalisation is therefore not achieved at the gate layer.

Claim [medium/fe-gap] Incremental one-parameter recording can never flip a subject to PASSED @ /Users/divyanshmangla/parag-saathi-be/internal/modules/quality/service.go — The backend only moves a subject to PASSED when a SINGLE POST /quality/qc-results submission contains ALL of the stage's mandatory tests and every gated test is within limits (missingMandatoryTests guard, service.go L186-196; applyGate L390-407). There is no accumulation across submissions. The FE records ONE parameter per call: src/core/api/endpoints/quality.ts recordTest.mapRequest (L175-180) sends a single-element tests array. Consequently every FE PASS submission fails: a lone mandatory parameter (e.g. COLIFORM at PLANT_LAB) is overall_pass=true but missing AFM1+PHOSPHATASE -> 422 MISSING_MANDATORY_TESTS; a lone non-mandatory test (e.g. FAT) is missing all mandatory tests -> 422. So the FE happy path can never certify a batch/lot (only the FAIL/BLOCK path works from a singleton). The FE mock instead accumulates per-parameter and flips qcStatus locally, masking the mismatch.

328				slog.String("subject_type", req.SubjectType),
329				slog.String("subject_id", req.SubjectID.Hex()),
330				slog.String("stage", req.Stage),
331				slog.Any("failure_reasons", failures),
332				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
333			// Broadcast the block so the plant module quarantines downstream — a
334			// blocked lot can never advance.
335			s.deps.Bus.Publish(eventbus.TopicGateBlocked, GateBlockedPayload{
336				SubjectType:    req.SubjectType,
337				SubjectID:      req.SubjectID,
338				QCResultID:     resultID,
339				Stage:          req.Stage,
340				FailureReasons: failures,
341			})
342		}

358	func (s *service) loadGateSubject(ctx context.Context, subjectType string, subjectID primitive.ObjectID) (gateSubject, error) {
359		switch subjectType {

374			}

388	// applyGate routes the conditional verdict write to the subject's collection,

390	func (s *service) applyGate(ctx context.Context, subjectType string, subjectID, resultID primitive.ObjectID, pass bool, blockReason string) (bool, error) {
391		switch subjectType {
392		case domain.QCSubjectBMCLot:
393			status := domain.BMCLotStatusBlocked
394			if pass {
395				status = domain.BMCLotStatusPassed
396			}

398		case domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch:

400			if pass {
401				status = domain.BatchStatusPassed
402			}
403			return s.repo.gateBatch(ctx, subjectID, resultID, status, blockReason)
404		default:
405			return false, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_SUBJECT_TYPE", "subject_type is not gate-eligible")
406		}

409	// listQCResults returns a page of results, newest first. When the filter

412	func (s *service) listQCResults(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, subjectType string, subjectID primitive.ObjectID, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.QCResult, int64, error) {
413		if subjectType != "" && !isValidSubjectType(subjectType) {
414			return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_SUBJECT_TYPE", "unknown subject_type "+subjectType)
415		}
416		if !subjectID.IsZero() && subjectType == "" {
417			return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_SUBJECT_TYPE", "subject_id requires subject_type")
418		}
419		if !subjectID.IsZero() {
420			if err := s.requireSubjectScope(ctx, actor, subjectType, subjectID); err != nil {
421				return nil, 0, err
422			}
423		}
424		return s.repo.listResults(ctx, subjectType, subjectID, page)
425	}

489		}

1	// Package provenance implements the append-only, hash-chained event ledger —
2	// the source of truth for milk traceability (blueprint §7). Every link in the
3	// pour→QR chain is an immutable Event whose SHA-256 hash covers the previous
4	// event's hash, so history cannot be quietly rewritten (tamper-evidence,
5	// FSSAI recall-grade audit).
6	//
7	// Corrections are NEW events referencing the superseded entity — nothing is
8	// ever updated or deleted in this collection.
9	package provenance
10	
11	import (
12		"context"
13		"crypto/sha256"
14		"encoding/hex"
15		"encoding/json"
16		"errors"
17		"fmt"
18		"strconv"
19		"strings"
20		"sync"
21		"time"
22	
23		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
24		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
