```text
29	const collection = "provenance_events"
30	
31	// Ref is a directed edge to another entity in the trace graph
32	// (e.g. a consignment event referencing the pours it aggregates).
33	type Ref struct {
34		EntityType string `bson:"entity_type" json:"entity_type"`
35		EntityID   string `bson:"entity_id"   json:"entity_id"`
36		Relation   string `bson:"relation"    json:"relation"` // aggregates | supersedes | tested | yields | labels ...
37	}
38	
39	// ActorRef records who caused the event.
40	type ActorRef struct {
41		PartyID  string `bson:"party_id"  json:"party_id"`
42		RoleCode string `bson:"role_code" json:"role_code"`
43	}
44	
45	// Event is one immutable link in the ledger. `_id` is a generated ObjectID;
46	// EntityID and Refs carry the referenced documents' ObjectIDs as hex strings
47	// (the ledger is a generic event log spanning every entity type, and hex
48	// strings keep the hash material canonical and human-inspectable).
49	type Event struct {
50		ID         primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
51		Seq        int64              `bson:"seq"         json:"seq"`
52		Type       string             `bson:"type"        json:"type"`
53		EntityType string             `bson:"entity_type" json:"entity_type"`
54		EntityID   string             `bson:"entity_id"   json:"entity_id"`
55		Refs       []Ref              `bson:"refs,omitempty"    json:"refs,omitempty"`
56		Actor      ActorRef           `bson:"actor"       json:"actor"`
57		OrgUnitID  string             `bson:"org_unit_id,omitempty" json:"org_unit_id,omitempty"`
58		Payload    map[string]any     `bson:"payload,omitempty"     json:"payload,omitempty"`
59		TS         time.Time          `bson:"ts"          json:"ts"`
60		PrevHash   string             `bson:"prev_hash"   json:"prev_hash"`
61		Hash       string             `bson:"hash"        json:"hash"`
62	}
63	
64	// AppendInput describes a new event to chain.
65	type AppendInput struct {
66		Type       string
67		EntityType string
68		EntityID   string
69		Refs       []Ref
70		Actor      ActorRef
71		OrgUnitID  string
72		Payload    map[string]any
73	}
74	
75	// Ledger appends to and reads the hash chain.
76	type Ledger struct {
77		coll *mongo.Collection
78	
79		// appendMu serialises the head-read+insert of Append within this process:
80		// every ledger write system-wide shares one global seq, so without local
81		// serialisation concurrent handlers (e.g. a morning pour rush plus a
82		// GenerateInvoices loop) burn duplicate-key retries against each other.
83		// The unique seq index remains the atomic backstop across processes.
84		appendMu sync.Mutex
85	}
86	
87	// NewLedger binds the ledger to the database.
88	func NewLedger(db *mongo.Database) *Ledger {
89		return &Ledger{coll: db.Collection(collection)}
90	}
91	
92	// genesisHash anchors the chain before the first event.
93	const genesisHash = "GENESIS"
94	
95	// Append chains a new event. Concurrency-safe without transactions: it reads
96	// the current head, computes seq+hash optimistically, and relies on the
97	// unique index on `seq` — a duplicate-key collision means another writer won
98	// the slot, so we re-read and retry.
99	func (l *Ledger) Append(ctx context.Context, in AppendInput) (*Event, error) {
100		// Serialise appends within this process (see appendMu): local writers no
101		// longer race each other for the seq slot, so under single-instance
102		// deployment the retry loop only ever fires against external writers.
103		l.appendMu.Lock()
104		defer l.appendMu.Unlock()
105	
106		const maxRetries = 12
107		for attempt := 0; attempt < maxRetries; attempt++ {
108			seq, prevHash, err := l.head(ctx)
109			if err != nil {
110				return nil, err
111			}
112			ev := &Event{
113				ID:         primitive.NewObjectID(),
114				Seq:        seq + 1,
115				Type:       in.Type,
116				EntityType: in.EntityType,
117				EntityID:   in.EntityID,
118				Refs:       in.Refs,
119				Actor:      in.Actor,
120				OrgUnitID:  in.OrgUnitID,
121				Payload:    in.Payload,
122				// Millisecond precision: BSON datetimes store ms, so the persisted
123				// TS must equal the hashed TS or re-verification would break.
124				TS:       time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Millisecond),
125				PrevHash: prevHash,
126			}
127			ev.Hash = computeHash(ev)
128	
129			if _, err := l.coll.InsertOne(ctx, ev); err != nil {
130				if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(err) {
131					continue // lost the seq race — retry against the new head
132				}
133				return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance append: %w", err)
134			}
135			return ev, nil
136		}
137		return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance append: gave up after %d seq collisions", 12)
138	}
139	
140	// head returns the latest (seq, hash), or (0, GENESIS) for an empty chain.
141	func (l *Ledger) head(ctx context.Context) (int64, string, error) {
142		var last Event
143		err := l.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{},
144			options.FindOne().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: -1}}),
145		).Decode(&last)
146		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
147			return 0, genesisHash, nil
148		}
149		if err != nil {
150			return 0, "", fmt.Errorf("provenance head: %w", err)
151		}
152		return last.Seq, last.Hash, nil
153	}
154	
155	// computeHash covers everything that matters: position, linkage, content.
156	// Payload is canonicalised via encoding/json (map keys are sorted) and the
157	// timestamp to millisecond precision (BSON datetime resolution), so the
158	// digest is deterministic across a MongoDB round trip.
159	func computeHash(ev *Event) string {
160		payloadJSON, _ := json.Marshal(ev.Payload)
161		refParts := make([]string, 0, len(ev.Refs))
162		for _, r := range ev.Refs {
163			refParts = append(refParts, r.EntityType+":"+r.EntityID+":"+r.Relation)
164		}
165		material := strings.Join([]string{
166			ev.PrevHash,
167			strconv.FormatInt(ev.Seq, 10),
168			ev.Type,
169			ev.EntityType,
170			ev.EntityID,
171			strings.Join(refParts, ","),
172			ev.Actor.PartyID,
173			ev.Actor.RoleCode,
174			ev.OrgUnitID,
175			string(payloadJSON),
176			ev.TS.UTC().Truncate(time.Millisecond).Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
177		}, "|")
178		sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(material))
179		return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
180	}
181	
182	// EventsForEntity returns an entity's own timeline in chain order.
183	func (l *Ledger) EventsForEntity(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string) ([]Event, error) {
184		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
185			bson.D{{Key: "entity_type", Value: entityType}, {Key: "entity_id", Value: entityID}},
186			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}),
187		)
188		if err != nil {
189			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance events for %s/%s: %w", entityType, entityID, err)
190		}
191		var out []Event
192		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
193			return nil, err
194		}
195		return out, nil
196	}
197	
198	// Trace walks the provenance graph UPSTREAM from an entity: its events, plus
199	// (recursively) the events of everything those events reference. This is how
200	// a consumer QR resolves back to the contributing samiti set, and how a failed
201	// aflatoxin test walks back to source DCSes (blueprint §8.3).
202	func (l *Ledger) Trace(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, maxDepth int) ([]Event, error) {
203		return l.TraceStopAt(ctx, entityType, entityID, maxDepth, nil)
204	}
205	
206	// TraceStopAt is Trace with a stop set: entity types in stopExpand are still
207	// fetched (their events appear in the result) but their refs are never
208	// followed. The consumer QR scan stops at the consignment/pooling boundary so
209	// hundreds of per-pour nodes (and cross-route trip fan-out) are never walked.
210	//
211	// Each BFS level is batched into a bounded number of $or queries instead of
212	// one Find per node, so a walk costs O(depth) round trips, not O(nodes).
213	func (l *Ledger) TraceStopAt(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, maxDepth int, stopExpand map[string]bool) ([]Event, error) {
214		if maxDepth <= 0 {
215			maxDepth = 10
216		}
217		const hardEventCap = 2000
218	
219		type node struct{ etype, eid string }
220		visited := map[node]bool{}
221		frontier := []node{{entityType, entityID}}
222		var all []Event
223	
224		for depth := 0; depth < maxDepth && len(frontier) > 0; depth++ {
225			// Deduplicate this level against everything already visited.
226			level := make([]node, 0, len(frontier))
227			for _, n := range frontier {
228				if visited[n] {
229					continue
230				}
231				visited[n] = true
232				level = append(level, n)
233			}
234			if len(level) == 0 {
235				break
236			}
237	
238			var next []node
239			// One indexed query per chunk of the level (not per node).
240			const orChunk = 200
241			for start := 0; start < len(level); start += orChunk {
242				end := min(start+orChunk, len(level))
243				clauses := make(bson.A, 0, end-start)
244				for _, n := range level[start:end] {
245					clauses = append(clauses, bson.D{
246						{Key: "entity_type", Value: n.etype},
247						{Key: "entity_id", Value: n.eid},
248					})
249				}
250				cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
251					bson.D{{Key: "$or", Value: clauses}},
252					options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}).SetLimit(hardEventCap),
253				)
254				if err != nil {
255					return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance trace level: %w", err)
256				}
257				var evs []Event
258				if err := cur.All(ctx, &evs); err != nil {
259					return nil, err
260				}
261				for _, ev := range evs {
262					all = append(all, ev)
263					if len(all) >= hardEventCap {
264						return all, nil
265					}
266					if stopExpand != nil && stopExpand[ev.EntityType] {
267						continue // include the node's events, never follow its refs
268					}
269					for _, ref := range ev.Refs {
270						nn := node{ref.EntityType, ref.EntityID}
271						if !visited[nn] {
272							next = append(next, nn)
273						}
274					}
275				}
276			}
277			frontier = next
278		}
279		return all, nil
280	}
281	
282	// DownstreamRefs finds events that reference the given entity — used to walk
283	// FORWARD (e.g. "which batches consumed this blocked BMC lot?"). The limit is
284	// pushed into the query: only the LAST limit referencing events are fetched
285	// (ascending chain order preserved). limit <= 0 falls back to 2000.
286	func (l *Ledger) DownstreamRefs(ctx context.Context, entityID string, limit int64) ([]Event, error) {
287		if limit <= 0 {
288			limit = 2000
289		}
290		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
291			bson.D{{Key: "refs.entity_id", Value: entityID}},
292			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: -1}}).SetLimit(limit),
293		)
294		if err != nil {
295			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance downstream of %s: %w", entityID, err)
296		}
297		var out []Event
298		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
299			return nil, err
300		}
301		// Restore ascending chain order.
302		for i, j := 0, len(out)-1; i < j; i, j = i+1, j-1 {
303			out[i], out[j] = out[j], out[i]
304		}
305		return out, nil
306	}
307	
308	// EventsForEntityPage returns one page of an entity's own timeline in chain
309	// order, with skip/limit pushed into the query.
310	func (l *Ledger) EventsForEntityPage(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, offset, limit int64) ([]Event, error) {
311		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx,
312			bson.D{{Key: "entity_type", Value: entityType}, {Key: "entity_id", Value: entityID}},
313			options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}).SetSkip(offset).SetLimit(limit),
314		)
315		if err != nil {
316			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance events page for %s/%s: %w", entityType, entityID, err)
317		}
318		var out []Event
319		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
320			return nil, err
321		}
322		return out, nil
323	}
324	
325	// CountEventsForEntity returns the total number of events on an entity's
326	// timeline (pagination meta companion of EventsForEntityPage).
327	func (l *Ledger) CountEventsForEntity(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string) (int64, error) {
328		n, err := l.coll.CountDocuments(ctx,
329			bson.D{{Key: "entity_type", Value: entityType}, {Key: "entity_id", Value: entityID}})
330		if err != nil {
331			return 0, fmt.Errorf("provenance count for %s/%s: %w", entityType, entityID, err)
332		}
333		return n, nil
334	}
335	
336	// VerifyChain re-derives every hash in [fromSeq, toSeq] and checks linkage.
337	// Returns (true, 0) when intact, or (false, seq) of the first broken link.
338	func (l *Ledger) VerifyChain(ctx context.Context, fromSeq, toSeq int64) (bool, int64, error) {
339		filter := bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$gte", Value: fromSeq}, {Key: "$lte", Value: toSeq}}}}
340		cur, err := l.coll.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: 1}}))
341		if err != nil {
342			return false, 0, fmt.Errorf("provenance verify: %w", err)
343		}
344		defer cur.Close(ctx)
345	
346		prevHash := ""
347		prevSeq := int64(0)
348		first := true
349		for cur.Next(ctx) {
350			var ev Event
351			if err := cur.Decode(&ev); err != nil {
352				return false, 0, err
353			}
354			if computeHash(&ev) != ev.Hash {
355				return false, ev.Seq, nil // content tampered
356			}
357			if !first {
358				if ev.Seq != prevSeq+1 || ev.PrevHash != prevHash {
359					return false, ev.Seq, nil // linkage broken
360				}
361			}
362			prevHash, prevSeq, first = ev.Hash, ev.Seq, false
363		}
364		return true, 0, cur.Err()
365	}
366	
367	// LatestSeq returns the current chain head sequence (0 = empty).
368	func (l *Ledger) LatestSeq(ctx context.Context) (int64, error) {
369		seq, _, err := l.head(ctx)
370		return seq, err
371	}
372
```

```text
88	// internalErr converts an unexpected failure into the opaque 500, logging it
89	// at ERROR with operation context first. Typed AppErrors (404s, 400s, org
90	// resolver errors) pass through untouched so client-facing semantics never
91	// change.
92	func (s *Service) internalErr(ctx context.Context, op string, err error, attrs ...any) error {
93		var appErr *httpx.AppError
94		if errors.As(err, &appErr) {
95			return appErr
96		}

102	// VerifyQRToken checks a stored signed token in the format QR issuance
103	// (plant module signQRToken) mints: "base64url(qr_code|product_lot_id_hex|
104	// issued_unix)" + "." + hex(HMAC-SHA256(secret, decoded payload)), where
105	// product_lot_id_hex is productLotID.Hex(). The HMAC is computed over the
106	// DECODED payload bytes — exactly what issuance signed. The comparison is
107	// constant-time so a forger learns nothing from response timing.
108	func VerifyQRToken(secret, token string) bool {
109		payloadB64, signature, found := strings.Cut(token, ".")
110		if !found || payloadB64 == "" || signature == "" {
111			return false // malformed: no payload/signature split
112		}
113		payload, err := base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString(payloadB64)
114		if err != nil || len(payload) == 0 {
115			return false // malformed: payload is not valid base64url
116		}
117		expected := auth.HMACHash(secret, string(payload))
118		return auth.ConstantTimeEqual(expected, signature)
119	}

239	// buildSourcing derives the samiti-set view from traced consignment events:
240	// contributing DCS org ids from each event's org_unit_id/payload, collection
241	// dates from payloads, with the consignment documents as fallback when the
242	// events did not carry those fields. Ledger events carry ObjectIDs as hex
243	// strings, so the sets are hex-keyed and parsed at the DB/orgscope boundary.
244	func (s *Service) buildSourcing(ctx context.Context, events []provenance.Event) (*SourcingInfo, error) {
245		dcsIDs := map[string]struct{}{}
246		dates := map[string]struct{}{}
247		consignmentIDs := map[string]struct{}{}
248	
249		for _, ev := range events {
250			if ev.EntityType != domain.EntityConsignment {
251				continue
252			}
253			consignmentIDs[ev.EntityID] = struct{}{}
254			// Only created/dispatched events carry the DCS in org_unit_id —
255			// consignment.picked_up is appended by logistics under the UNION's
256			// org id, which must never be counted as a contributing samiti.
257			switch ev.Type {
258			case domain.EventConsignmentCreated, domain.EventConsignmentDispatched:
259				if ev.OrgUnitID != "" {
260					dcsIDs[ev.OrgUnitID] = struct{}{}
261				} else if v, ok := ev.Payload["dcs_id"].(string); ok && v != "" {
262					dcsIDs[v] = struct{}{}
263				}
264			}
265			if v, ok := ev.Payload["date"].(string); ok && v != "" {
266				dates[v] = struct{}{}
267			}
268		}
269	
270		// Fallback: if the events lacked DCS ids or dates, read the consignment
271		// docs themselves (still samiti-level — pour ids are never surfaced).
272		if len(consignmentIDs) > 0 && (len(dcsIDs) == 0 || len(dates) == 0) {
273			ids := make([]primitive.ObjectID, 0, len(consignmentIDs))
274			for _, hexID := range sortedKeys(consignmentIDs) {
275				cid, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(hexID)
276				if err != nil {
277					// Ledger event ids should always be ObjectID hex — flag and skip.
278					s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "QR scan: traced consignment id is not a valid object id",
279						slog.String("consignment_id", hexID))
280					continue
281				}
282				ids = append(ids, cid)
283			}
284			docs, err := s.repo.consignmentsByIDs(ctx, ids)
285			if err != nil {
286				return nil, s.internalErr(ctx, "qr scan: load consignments for sourcing", err)
287			}
288			for _, c := range docs {
289				if !c.DCSID.IsZero() {
290					dcsIDs[c.DCSID.Hex()] = struct{}{}
291				}
292				if c.Date != "" {
293					dates[c.Date] = struct{}{}
294				}
295			}
296		}
297	
298		samitis := make([]SamitiInfo, 0, len(dcsIDs))
299		districts := map[string]struct{}{}
300		for _, hexID := range sortedKeys(dcsIDs) {
301			orgID, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(hexID)
302			if err != nil {
303				// A malformed id must not break a consumer scan — log and skip.
304				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "QR scan: contributing DCS id is not a valid object id",
305					slog.String("dcs_org_id", hexID))
306				continue
307			}
308			org, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, orgID)
309			if err != nil {
310				// A missing org unit must not break a consumer scan — log and skip.
311				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "QR scan: contributing DCS org not resolvable",
312					slog.String("dcs_org_id", hexID), slog.Any("err", err))
313				continue
314			}
315			// Defence in depth: the §7.4 samiti set may only contain DCS units.
316			if org.Type != domain.OrgTypeDCS {
317				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "QR scan: non-DCS org unit skipped from samiti set",
318					slog.String("org_id", hexID), slog.String("org_type", org.Type))
319				continue
320			}
321			samitis = append(samitis, SamitiInfo{Name: org.Name, Code: org.Code, District: org.District})
322			if org.District != "" {
323				districts[org.District] = struct{}{}
324			}
325		}
326		sort.Slice(samitis, func(i, j int) bool { return samitis[i].Name < samitis[j].Name })
327	
328		collectionDates := sortedKeys(dates)
329		return &SourcingInfo{
330			Message:         sourcingMessage(collectionDates, len(samitis), sortedKeys(districts)),
331			Samitis:         samitis,
332			CollectionDates: collectionDates,
333		}, nil
334	}

336	// sourcingMessage renders the consumer-facing pooled-provenance sentence,
337	// e.g. "Made from milk collected on 2026-07-05 from 3 samitis in Lucknow".
338	func sourcingMessage(dates []string, samitiCount int, districts []string) string {
339		var b strings.Builder
340		b.WriteString("Made from milk collected")
341		if len(dates) > 0 {
342			b.WriteString(" on " + strings.Join(dates, ", "))
343		}
344		noun := "samitis"
345		if samitiCount == 1 {
346			noun = "samiti"
347		}
348		fmt.Fprintf(&b, " from %d %s", samitiCount, noun)
349		if len(districts) > 0 {
350			b.WriteString(" in " + strings.Join(districts, ", "))
351		}
352		return b.String()
353	}
354	
355	// verifyTracedRange answers the per-scan tamper-evidence check from a
356	// cumulative verification watermark: the chain is verified incrementally up
357	// to the traced range's max seq, and once a prefix is verified, later scans
358	// inside it are O(1) — no per-request re-hash of thousands of interleaved
359	// events. Spans over scanVerifySpanCap are verified partially (most recent
360	// tail) and flagged, matching the previous per-scan behaviour.
361	func (s *Service) verifyTracedRange(ctx context.Context, events []provenance.Event) (*LedgerInfo, error) {
362		if len(events) == 0 {
363			return &LedgerInfo{Events: 0, Intact: true, VerifiedRange: [2]int64{0, 0}}, nil
364		}
365		maxSeq := events[0].Seq
366		for _, ev := range events[1:] {
367			if ev.Seq > maxSeq {
368				maxSeq = ev.Seq
369			}
370		}
371	
372		s.verifyMu.Lock()
373		defer s.verifyMu.Unlock()
374	
375		if s.chainBroken {
376			return &LedgerInfo{
377				Events:        len(events),
378				Intact:        false,
379				VerifiedRange: [2]int64{s.brokenAtSeq, s.brokenAtSeq},
380			}, nil
381		}
382		if maxSeq <= s.verifiedUpTo {
383			return &LedgerInfo{
384				Events:        len(events),
385				Intact:        true,
386				VerifiedRange: [2]int64{1, s.verifiedUpTo},
387			}, nil
388		}
389	
390		// Extend the watermark: start at the last verified event (re-hashing it
391		// covers the boundary linkage), capped to the per-request span budget.
392		from, partial := max(int64(1), s.verifiedUpTo), false
393		if maxSeq-from+1 > scanVerifySpanCap {
394			from, partial = maxSeq-scanVerifySpanCap+1, true
395		}
396		intact, brokenAt, err := s.ledger.VerifyChain(ctx, from, maxSeq)
397		if err != nil {
398			return nil, s.internalErr(ctx, "qr scan: verify ledger chain", err,
399				slog.Int64("from", from), slog.Int64("to", maxSeq))
400		}
401		if intact {
402			s.verifiedUpTo = maxSeq
403		} else {
404			s.chainBroken, s.brokenAtSeq = true, brokenAt
405			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "provenance chain break detected during scan verification",
406				slog.Int64("broken_at_seq", brokenAt),
407				slog.Int64("from", from), slog.Int64("to", maxSeq))
408		}
409		return &LedgerInfo{
410			Events:        len(events),
411			Intact:        intact,
412			VerifiedRange: [2]int64{from, maxSeq},
413			Partial:       partial,
414		}, nil
415	}
416	
417	// VerifyLedger runs the public tamper-evidence check over [from,to]. Both
418	// bounds are optional: `to` defaults to the chain head, `from` to the start
419	// of the last publicVerifySpanCap events. Spans over the cap are rejected.
420	func (s *Service) VerifyLedger(ctx context.Context, fromRaw, toRaw string) (*LedgerVerifyResponse, error) {
421		latest, err := s.ledger.LatestSeq(ctx)
422		if err != nil {
423			return nil, s.internalErr(ctx, "ledger verify: read chain head", err)
424		}
425		if latest == 0 {
426			return &LedgerVerifyResponse{Intact: true, From: 0, To: 0}, nil // empty chain is trivially intact
427		}
428	
429		to := latest
430		if toRaw != "" {
431			n, err := strconv.ParseInt(toRaw, 10, 64)
432			if err != nil || n < 1 {
433				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_RANGE", "'to' must be a positive sequence number")
434			}
435			to = min(n, latest)
436		}
437		from := max(int64(1), to-publicVerifySpanCap+1)
438		if fromRaw != "" {
439			n, err := strconv.ParseInt(fromRaw, 10, 64)
440			if err != nil || n < 1 {
441				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_RANGE", "'from' must be a positive sequence number")
442			}
443			from = n
444		}
445		if from > to {
446			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_RANGE", "'from' must not exceed 'to'")
447		}
448		if to-from+1 > publicVerifySpanCap {
449			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("SPAN_TOO_WIDE",
450				fmt.Sprintf("verification span is capped at %d events per request", publicVerifySpanCap))
451		}
452	
453		intact, brokenAt, err := s.ledger.VerifyChain(ctx, from, to)
454		if err != nil {
455			return nil, s.internalErr(ctx, "ledger verify: verify chain", err,
456				slog.Int64("from", from), slog.Int64("to", to))
457		}
458		resp := &LedgerVerifyResponse{Intact: intact, From: from, To: to}
459		if !intact {
460			resp.BrokenAtSeq = &brokenAt
461			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "public ledger verification found a broken chain",
462				slog.Int64("broken_at_seq", brokenAt),
463				slog.Int64("from", from), slog.Int64("to", to))
464		}
465		return resp, nil
466	}
467	
468	// TraceGraph returns the full event graph around one entity: upstream via
469	// the recursive ref walk, downstream via reverse-ref lookup — the recall /
470	// root-cause tool (§8.3). entityID is the entity's ObjectID as a hex string
471	// (already validated by the handler; the ledger stores ids as hex).
472	func (s *Service) TraceGraph(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string) (*TraceGraphResponse, error) {
473		if err := validateEntityType(entityType); err != nil {
474			return nil, err
475		}
476		upstream, err := s.ledger.Trace(ctx, entityType, entityID, traceDepth)
477		if err != nil {
478			return nil, s.internalErr(ctx, "trace graph: upstream walk", err,
479				slog.String("entity_type", entityType), slog.String("entity_id", entityID))
480		}
481		// The cap is pushed into the query: only the LAST downstreamEventCap
482		// referencing events are fetched, instead of decoding an unbounded set
483		// into memory and truncating afterwards.
484		downstream, err := s.ledger.DownstreamRefs(ctx, entityID, downstreamEventCap)
485		if err != nil {
486			return nil, s.internalErr(ctx, "trace graph: downstream refs", err,
487				slog.String("entity_type", entityType), slog.String("entity_id", entityID))
488		}
489		if len(upstream) == 0 && len(downstream) == 0 {
490			return nil, httpx.NotFound("provenance for entity")
491		}
492		if upstream == nil {
493			upstream = []provenance.Event{}
494		}
495		if downstream == nil {
496			downstream = []provenance.Event{}
497		}
498		return &TraceGraphResponse{Upstream: upstream, Downstream: downstream}, nil
499	}
500	
501	// Timeline returns one entity's own events in chain order, paginated. The
502	// skip/limit is pushed into the Mongo query so a page read never loads the
503	// entity's full history. The second return value is the total event count.
504	// entityID is the entity's ObjectID as a hex string (handler-validated).
505	func (s *Service) Timeline(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, page httpx.Page) ([]provenance.Event, int, error) {
506		if err := validateEntityType(entityType); err != nil {
507			return nil, 0, err
508		}
509		total, err := s.ledger.CountEventsForEntity(ctx, entityType, entityID)
510		if err != nil {
511			return nil, 0, s.internalErr(ctx, "timeline: count entity events", err,
512				slog.String("entity_type", entityType), slog.String("entity_id", entityID))
513		}
514		if total == 0 {
515			return nil, 0, httpx.NotFound("provenance for entity")

534	// sortedKeys returns a set's keys in deterministic (lexicographic) order.
535	func sortedKeys(set map[string]struct{}) []string {
536		out := make([]string, 0, len(set))
537		for k := range set {
538			out = append(out, k)
539		}
540		sort.Strings(out)
```

```text
// buildSourcing derives the samiti-set view from traced consignment events:
// contributing DCS org ids from each event's org_unit_id/payload, collection
// dates from payloads, with the consignment documents as fallback when the
// events did not carry those fields. Ledger events carry ObjectIDs as hex
// strings, so the sets are hex-keyed and parsed at the DB/orgscope boundary.
func (s *Service) buildSourcing(ctx context.Context, events []provenance.Event) (*SourcingInfo, error) {
	dcsIDs := map[string]struct{}{}
	dates := map[string]struct{}{}
	consignmentIDs := map[string]struct{}{}

	for _, ev := range events {
		if ev.EntityType != domain.EntityConsignment {
			continue
		}
		consignmentIDs[ev.EntityID] = struct{}{}
		// Only created/dispatched events carry the DCS in org_unit_id —
		// consignment.picked_up is appended by logistics under the UNION's
		// org id, which must never be counted as a contributing samiti.
		switch ev.Type {
		case domain.EventConsignmentCreated, domain.EventConsignmentDispatched:
			if ev.OrgUnitID != "" {
				dcsIDs[ev.OrgUnitID] = struct{}{}
			} else if v, ok := ev.Payload["dcs_id"].(string); ok && v != "" {
				dcsIDs[v] = struct{}{}
			}
		}
		if v, ok := ev.Payload["date"].(string); ok && v != "" {
			dates[v] = struct{}{}
		}
	}

	// Fallback: if the events lacked DCS ids or dates, read the consignment
	// docs themselves (still samiti-level — pour ids are never surfaced).
	if len(consignmentIDs) > 0 && (len(dcsIDs) == 0 || len(dates) == 0) {
		ids := make([]primitive.ObjectID, 0, len(consignmentIDs))
		for _, hexID := range sortedKeys(consignmentIDs) {
			cid, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(hexID)
			if err != nil {
				// Ledger event ids should always be ObjectID hex — flag and skip.
				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "QR scan: traced consignment id is not a valid object id",
					slog.String("consignment_id", hexID))
				continue
			}
			ids = append(ids, cid)
		}
		docs, err := s.repo.consignmentsByIDs(ctx, ids)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, s.internalErr(ctx, "qr scan: load consignments for sourcing", err)
		}
		for _, c := range docs {
			if !c.DCSID.IsZero() {
				dcsIDs[c.DCSID.Hex()] = struct{}{}
			}
			if c.Date != "" {
				dates[c.Date] = struct{}{}
			}
		}
	}

	samitis := make([]SamitiInfo, 0, len(dcsIDs))
	districts := map[string]struct{}{}
	for _, hexID := range sortedKeys(dcsIDs) {
		orgID, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(hexID)
		if err != nil {
			// A malformed id must not break a consumer scan — log and skip.
			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "QR scan: contributing DCS id is not a valid object id",
				slog.String("dcs_org_id", hexID))
			continue
		}
		org, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, orgID)
		if err != nil {
			// A missing org unit must not break a consumer scan — log and skip.
			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "QR scan: contributing DCS org not resolvable",
				slog.String("dcs_org_id", hexID), slog.Any("err", err))
			continue
		}
		// Defence in depth: the §7.4 samiti set may only contain DCS units.
		if org.Type != domain.OrgTypeDCS {
			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "QR scan: non-DCS org unit skipped from samiti set",
				slog.String("org_id", hexID), slog.String("org_type", org.Type))
			continue
		}
		samitis = append(samitis, SamitiInfo{Name: org.Name, Code: org.Code, District: org.District})
		if org.District != "" {
			districts[org.District] = struct{}{}
		}
	}
	sort.Slice(samitis, func(i, j int) bool { return samitis[i].Name < samitis[j].Name })

	collectionDates := sortedKeys(dates)
	return &SourcingInfo{
		Message:         sourcingMessage(collectionDates, len(samitis), sortedKeys(districts)),
		Samitis:         samitis,
		CollectionDates: collectionDates,
	}, nil
}

// sourcingMessage renders the consumer-facing pooled-provenance sentence,
// e.g. "Made from milk collected on 2026-07-05 from 3 samitis in Lucknow".
func sourcingMessage(dates []string, samitiCount int, districts []string) string {
	var b strings.Builder
	b.WriteString("Made from milk collected")
	if len(dates) > 0 {
		b.WriteString(" on " + strings.Join(dates, ", "))
	}
	noun := "samitis"
	if samitiCount == 1 {
		noun = "samiti"
	}
	fmt.Fprintf(&b, " from %d %s", samitiCount, noun)
	if len(districts) > 0 {
		b.WriteString(" in " + strings.Join(districts, ", "))
	}
	return b.String()
}

// verifyTracedRange answers the per-scan tamper-evidence check from a
// cumulative verification watermark: the chain is verified incrementally up
// to the traced range's max seq, and once a prefix is verified, later scans
// inside it are O(1) — no per-request re-hash of thousands of interleaved
// events. Spans over scanVerifySpanCap are verified partially (most recent
// tail) and flagged, matching the previous per-scan behaviour.
```

```text
func (s *Service) CreateBatch(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateBatchRequest) (*domain.ProcessingBatch, error) {
	actID, err := actorID(actor)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, req.PlantID, "create batch"); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	org, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.PlantID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if org.Type != domain.OrgTypeProcessingPlant {
		s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch creation refused: org unit is not a plant",
			slog.String("org_unit_id", req.PlantID.Hex()),
			slog.String("org_type", org.Type),
			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
		return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_PLANT", "org unit "+req.PlantID.Hex()+" is not a processing plant")
	}

	ids := dedupe(req.BMCLotIDs)
	lots, err := s.repo.BMCLotsByIDs(ctx, ids)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, s.fail(ctx, "load bmc lots", err)
	}
	if len(lots) != len(ids) {
		return nil, httpx.NotFound("BMC lot(s) " + strings.Join(missingLotIDs(ids, lots), ", "))
	}
	var offending []string
	var inputLitres float64
	for _, lot := range lots {
		if !canPoolBMCLot(lot.Status) {
			offending = append(offending, lot.ID.Hex())
			continue
		}
		inputLitres += lot.TotalQuantityLitres
	}
	if len(offending) > 0 {
		s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch creation refused: bmc lot(s) have not cleared the safety gate",
			slog.String("plant_id", req.PlantID.Hex()),
			slog.String("blocked_lot_ids", strings.Join(offending, ",")),
			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
		return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked,
			"one or more BMC lots have not cleared the safety gate (must be PASSED and DISPATCHED)").
			WithDetails(map[string]any{"blocked_lot_ids": offending})
	}

	now := time.Now().UTC()
	dateKey := domain.DateKeyIST(now)
	seq, err := s.repo.NextSequence(ctx, "batch_number:"+req.PlantID.Hex()+":"+dateKey)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, s.fail(ctx, "next batch number sequence", err)
	}
	batchNumber := fmt.Sprintf("BATCH-%s-%s-%04d",
		org.Code, strings.ReplaceAll(dateKey, "-", ""), seq)

	// Optimistic claim (mirrors ClaimConsignments): flip DISPATCHED→POOLED
	// stamped with the pre-generated batch ID BEFORE inserting the batch. One
	// physical lot of milk can therefore never be pooled into two batches —
	// neither by a double-submit nor by two concurrent CreateBatch calls.
	batchID := primitive.NewObjectID()
	claimed, err := s.repo.ClaimBMCLots(ctx, ids, batchID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, s.fail(ctx, "claim bmc lots", err)
	}
	if claimed != int64(len(ids)) {
		if relErr := s.repo.ReleaseBMCLots(ctx, batchID); relErr != nil {
			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "release bmc lots after lost claim", relErr)
		}
		s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch creation lost bmc lot claim race",
			slog.String("plant_id", req.PlantID.Hex()),
			slog.Int64("claimed", claimed), slog.Int("requested", len(ids)),
			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
		return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_CLAIM_CONFLICT",
			"one or more BMC lots were pooled by another batch — reload and retry")
	}

	// CREATED is a transient birth state: the plant lab must clear every
	// batch, so it is persisted straight into QC_PENDING.
	batch := &domain.ProcessingBatch{
		ID:          batchID,
		PlantID:     req.PlantID,
		BatchNumber: batchNumber,
		BMCLotIDs:   ids,
		ProductType: req.ProductType,
		InputLitres: inputLitres,
		Status:      domain.BatchStatusQCPending,
		StartedAt:   now,
		CreatedBy:   actID,
		CreatedAt:   now,
	}
	if err := s.repo.InsertBatch(ctx, batch); err != nil {
		_ = s.repo.ReleaseBMCLots(ctx, batchID)
		return nil, s.fail(ctx, "insert batch", err)
	}

	refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, len(ids))
	for _, id := range ids {
		refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{
			EntityType: domain.EntityBMCLot, EntityID: id.Hex(), Relation: "pools",
		})
	}
	ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
		Type:       domain.EventBatchCreated,
		EntityType: domain.EntityBatch,
		EntityID:   batch.ID.Hex(),
		Refs:       refs,
		Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
		OrgUnitID:  req.PlantID.Hex(),
		Payload: map[string]any{
			"batch_number": batchNumber, "product_type": req.ProductType, "input_litres": inputLitres,
		},
	})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append batch.created event", err)
	}
	if err := s.repo.SetBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx, batch.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
		return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp batch provenance seq", err)
	}
	batch.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
	s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "processing batch created",
		slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
		slog.String("batch_number", batchNumber),
		slog.String("plant_id", req.PlantID.Hex()),
		slog.String("product_type", req.ProductType),
		slog.Int("bmc_lots", len(ids)),
		slog.Float64("input_litres", inputLitres),
		slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
	return batch, nil
}
```

```text
1	package domain
2	
3	import (
4		"fmt"
5		"strings"

8		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
9	)
10	
11	// FSSAI limits for liquid milk (blueprint §8.3). Aflatoxin M1 is heat-stable
12	// and survives pasteurisation, so it MUST be gated upstream (BMC + plant),
13	// never only at the finished product.
14	const (
15		FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg = 0.5  // AFM1 ≤ 0.5 µg/kg
16		FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl          = 10.0 // coliform ≤ 10 CFU/ml
17		FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg       = 0.1  // antibiotic MRL example
18	)
19	
20	// QC test names.
21	const (
22		TestAflatoxinM1 = "AFLATOXIN_M1"            // µg/kg
23		TestColiform    = "COLIFORM"                // CFU/ml
24		TestTPC         = "TPC"                     // CFU/ml, graded — recorded, not hard-gated here
25		TestAntibiotic  = "ANTIBIOTIC_TETRACYCLINE" // mg/kg
26		TestPhosphatase = "PHOSPHATASE"             // 0 = negative (pass post-pasteurisation), 1 = positive
27		TestFat         = "FAT"                     // %
28		TestSNF         = "SNF"                     // %
29	)
30	
31	// QC stages.
32	const (
33		QCStageBMCRapid = "BMC_RAPID" // strip/rapid tests at the chilling centre
34		QCStagePlantLab = "PLANT_LAB" // full lab: ELISA/HPLC, culture, LC-MS/MS
35	)
36	
37	// QC subject types.
38	const (
39		QCSubjectDCSConsignment  = "DCS_CONSIGNMENT"
40		QCSubjectBMCLot          = "BMC_LOT"
41		QCSubjectProcessingBatch = "PROCESSING_BATCH"
42	)
43	
44	// QCTest is a single measurement inside a QC result.
45	type QCTest struct {
46		Name  string  `bson:"name"  json:"name"`
47		Value float64 `bson:"value" json:"value"`
48		Unit  string  `bson:"unit"  json:"unit"`
49		Pass  bool    `bson:"pass"  json:"pass"`
50	}
51	
52	// QCResult is the recorded outcome of testing one subject at one stage.
53	// OverallPass drives the safety gate; a certificate is attached to provenance
54	// on pass, a block + quarantine on fail.
55	type QCResult struct {
56		ID                primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
57		SubjectType       string             `bson:"subject_type"  json:"subject_type"`
58		SubjectID         primitive.ObjectID `bson:"subject_id"    json:"subject_id"`
59		Stage             string             `bson:"stage"         json:"stage"`
60		Tests             []QCTest           `bson:"tests"         json:"tests"`
61		OverallPass       bool               `bson:"overall_pass"  json:"overall_pass"`
62		FailureReasons    []string           `bson:"failure_reasons,omitempty" json:"failure_reasons,omitempty"`
63		AnalystPartyID    primitive.ObjectID `bson:"analyst_party_id" json:"analyst_party_id"`
64		LabRef            string             `bson:"lab_ref,omitempty"            json:"lab_ref,omitempty"`
65		CertificateNumber string             `bson:"certificate_number,omitempty" json:"certificate_number,omitempty"`
66		// Superseded marks a result voided after losing the gate race — the
67		// verdict on the subject came from a different, earlier result.
68		Superseded    bool      `bson:"superseded,omitempty" json:"superseded,omitempty"`
69		RecordedAt    time.Time `bson:"recorded_at"   json:"recorded_at"`
70		ProvenanceSeq int64     `bson:"provenance_seq,omitempty" json:"provenance_seq,omitempty"`
71	}
72	
73	// NormalizeTestName maps common field aliases to the canonical FSSAI test
74	// name so the safety gate can NEVER be bypassed by a spelling difference
75	// (e.g. the app sends "AFM1"; the gate keys on "AFLATOXIN_M1"). A test whose
76	// name still doesn't resolve to a gated parameter is recorded but not gated.
77	func NormalizeTestName(name string) string {
78		switch strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(name)) {
79		case "AFM1", "AFLATOXIN", "AFLATOXINM1", "AFLATOXIN_M1", "AFLATOXIN-M1":
80			return TestAflatoxinM1
81		case "COLIFORM", "COLIFORMS":
82			return TestColiform
83		case "TPC", "TOTAL_PLATE_COUNT":
84			return TestTPC
85		case "ANTIBIOTIC", "TETRACYCLINE", "ANTIBIOTIC_TETRACYCLINE":
86			return TestAntibiotic
87		case "PHOSPHATASE", "ALP":
88			return TestPhosphatase
89		case "FAT":
90			return TestFat
91		case "SNF":
92			return TestSNF
93		default:
94			return strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(name))
95		}
96	}
97	
98	// EvaluateQCTests applies the FSSAI gate to a set of tests: it normalizes each
99	// test name, fills its Pass verdict, and returns the overall verdict plus
100	// human-readable failure reasons. Unknown test names are recorded but do not
101	// gate. The returned tests carry the CANONICAL name so storage is consistent.
102	func EvaluateQCTests(tests []QCTest) (overallPass bool, failures []string, evaluated []QCTest) {
103		overallPass = true
104		evaluated = make([]QCTest, 0, len(tests))
105		for _, t := range tests {
106			t.Name = NormalizeTestName(t.Name) // canonicalise so the gate cannot be dodged by alias
107			pass := true
108			switch t.Name {
109			case TestAflatoxinM1:
110				if t.Value > FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg {
111					pass = false
112					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
113						"AFLATOXIN_M1 %.3f µg/kg exceeds FSSAI limit %.1f µg/kg", t.Value, FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg))
114				}
115			case TestColiform:
116				if t.Value > FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl {
117					pass = false
118					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
119						"COLIFORM %.1f CFU/ml exceeds FSSAI limit %.0f CFU/ml", t.Value, FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl))
120				}
121			case TestAntibiotic:
122				if t.Value > FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg {
123					pass = false
124					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
125						"ANTIBIOTIC_TETRACYCLINE %.3f mg/kg exceeds MRL %.1f mg/kg", t.Value, FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg))
126				}
127			case TestPhosphatase:
128				if t.Value != 0 {
129					pass = false
130					failures = append(failures, "PHOSPHATASE positive — pasteurisation check failed (must be negative)")
131				}
132			}
133			t.Pass = pass
134			if !pass {
135				overallPass = false
136			}
137			evaluated = append(evaluated, t)
138		}
139		return overallPass, failures, evaluated
140	}
141
```

```text
24	// recordQCResult handles POST /quality/qc-results.
25	func (h *handler) recordQCResult(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
26		actor, ok := auth.ActorFrom(r.Context())
27		if !ok {
28			httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Unauthorized("authentication required"))
29			return
30		}
31	
32		var req RecordQCResultRequest
33		if err := httpx.DecodeJSON(r, &req); err != nil {
34			httpx.Error(w, r, err)
35			return
36		}
37		if err := validateRecordRequest(req); err != nil {
38			httpx.Error(w, r, err)
39			return
40		}
41	
42		result, err := h.svc.recordQCResult(r.Context(), actor, req)
43		if err != nil {
44			httpx.Error(w, r, err)
45			return
46		}
47		httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusCreated, result)
48	}

50	// validateRecordRequest checks required fields and test shape.
51	func validateRecordRequest(req RecordQCResultRequest) error {
52		if strings.TrimSpace(req.SubjectType) == "" {
53			return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_SUBJECT_TYPE", "subject_type is required")
54		}
55		if req.SubjectID.IsZero() {
56			return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_SUBJECT_ID", "subject_id is required")
57		}
58		if strings.TrimSpace(req.Stage) == "" {
59			return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_STAGE", "stage is required")
60		}
61		if len(req.Tests) == 0 {
62			return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_TESTS", "at least one test is required")
63		}
64		for i, t := range req.Tests {
65			if strings.TrimSpace(t.Name) == "" {
66				return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_TEST_NAME", "tests["+strconv.Itoa(i)+"].name is required")
67			}
68			if t.Value < 0 {
69				return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_TEST_VALUE", "tests["+strconv.Itoa(i)+"].value must not be negative")
70			}
71		}
72		return nil
73	}

96		if err != nil {

98			return
99		}
100		httpx.JSONMeta(w, http.StatusOK, results, listMeta{Limit: page.Limit, Offset: page.Offset, Total: total})
101	}
```

```text
// buildSourcing derives the samiti-set view from traced consignment events:
// contributing DCS org ids from each event's org_unit_id/payload, collection
// dates from payloads, with the consignment documents as fallback when the
// events did not carry those fields. Ledger events carry ObjectIDs as hex
// strings, so the sets are hex-keyed and parsed at the DB/orgscope boundary.
func (s *Service) buildSourcing(ctx context.Context, events []provenance.Event) (*SourcingInfo, error) {
	dcsIDs := map[string]struct{}{}
	dates := map[string]struct{}{}
	consignmentIDs := map[string]struct{}{}

	for _, ev := range events {
		if ev.EntityType != domain.EntityConsignment {
			continue
		}
		consignmentIDs[ev.EntityID] = struct{}{}
		// Only created/dispatched events carry the DCS in org_unit_id —
		// consignment.picked_up is appended by logistics under the UNION's
		// org id, which must never be counted as a contributing samiti.
		switch ev.Type {
		case domain.EventConsignmentCreated, domain.EventConsignmentDispatched:
			if ev.OrgUnitID != "" {
				dcsIDs[ev.OrgUnitID] = struct{}{}
			} else if v, ok := ev.Payload["dcs_id"].(string); ok && v != "" {
				dcsIDs[v] = struct{}{}
			}
		}
		if v, ok := ev.Payload["date"].(string); ok && v != "" {
			dates[v] = struct{}{}
		}
	}

	// Fallback: if the events lacked DCS ids or dates, read the consignment
	// docs themselves (still samiti-level — pour ids are never surfaced).
	if len(consignmentIDs) > 0 && (len(dcsIDs) == 0 || len(dates) == 0) {
		ids := make([]primitive.ObjectID, 0, len(consignmentIDs))
		for _, hexID := range sortedKeys(consignmentIDs) {
			cid, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(hexID)
			if err != nil {
				// Ledger event ids should always be ObjectID hex — flag and skip.
				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "QR scan: traced consignment id is not a valid object id",
					slog.String("consignment_id", hexID))
				continue
			}
			ids = append(ids, cid)
		}
		docs, err := s.repo.consignmentsByIDs(ctx, ids)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, s.internalErr(ctx, "qr scan: load consignments for sourcing", err)
		}
		for _, c := range docs {
			if !c.DCSID.IsZero() {
				dcsIDs[c.DCSID.Hex()] = struct{}{}
			}
			if c.Date != "" {
				dates[c.Date] = struct{}{}
			}
		}
	}

	samitis := make([]SamitiInfo, 0, len(dcsIDs))
	districts := map[string]struct{}{}
	for _, hexID := range sortedKeys(dcsIDs) {
		orgID, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(hexID)
		if err != nil {
			// A malformed id must not break a consumer scan — log and skip.
			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "QR scan: contributing DCS id is not a valid object id",
				slog.String("dcs_org_id", hexID))
			continue
		}
		org, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, orgID)
		if err != nil {
			// A missing org unit must not break a consumer scan — log and skip.
			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "QR scan: contributing DCS org not resolvable",
				slog.String("dcs_org_id", hexID), slog.Any("err", err))
			continue
		}
		// Defence in depth: the §7.4 samiti set may only contain DCS units.
		if org.Type != domain.OrgTypeDCS {
			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "QR scan: non-DCS org unit skipped from samiti set",
				slog.String("org_id", hexID), slog.String("org_type", org.Type))
			continue
		}
```

```text
73	// NormalizeTestName maps common field aliases to the canonical FSSAI test
74	// name so the safety gate can NEVER be bypassed by a spelling difference
75	// (e.g. the app sends "AFM1"; the gate keys on "AFLATOXIN_M1"). A test whose
76	// name still doesn't resolve to a gated parameter is recorded but not gated.
77	func NormalizeTestName(name string) string {
78		switch strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(name)) {
79		case "AFM1", "AFLATOXIN", "AFLATOXINM1", "AFLATOXIN_M1", "AFLATOXIN-M1":
80			return TestAflatoxinM1
81		case "COLIFORM", "COLIFORMS":
82			return TestColiform
83		case "TPC", "TOTAL_PLATE_COUNT":
84			return TestTPC
85		case "ANTIBIOTIC", "TETRACYCLINE", "ANTIBIOTIC_TETRACYCLINE":
86			return TestAntibiotic
87		case "PHOSPHATASE", "ALP":
88			return TestPhosphatase
89		case "FAT":
90			return TestFat
91		case "SNF":
92			return TestSNF
93		default:
94			return strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(name))
95		}
96	}
97	
98	// EvaluateQCTests applies the FSSAI gate to a set of tests: it normalizes each
99	// test name, fills its Pass verdict, and returns the overall verdict plus
100	// human-readable failure reasons. Unknown test names are recorded but do not
101	// gate. The returned tests carry the CANONICAL name so storage is consistent.
102	func EvaluateQCTests(tests []QCTest) (overallPass bool, failures []string, evaluated []QCTest) {
103		overallPass = true
104		evaluated = make([]QCTest, 0, len(tests))
105		for _, t := range tests {
106			t.Name = NormalizeTestName(t.Name) // canonicalise so the gate cannot be dodged by alias
107			pass := true
108			switch t.Name {
109			case TestAflatoxinM1:
110				if t.Value > FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg {
111					pass = false
112					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
113						"AFLATOXIN_M1 %.3f µg/kg exceeds FSSAI limit %.1f µg/kg", t.Value, FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg))
114				}
115			case TestColiform:
116				if t.Value > FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl {
117					pass = false
118					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
119						"COLIFORM %.1f CFU/ml exceeds FSSAI limit %.0f CFU/ml", t.Value, FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl))
120				}
121			case TestAntibiotic:
122				if t.Value > FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg {
123					pass = false
124					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
125						"ANTIBIOTIC_TETRACYCLINE %.3f mg/kg exceeds MRL %.1f mg/kg", t.Value, FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg))
126				}
127			case TestPhosphatase:
128				if t.Value != 0 {
129					pass = false
130					failures = append(failures, "PHOSPHATASE positive — pasteurisation check failed (must be negative)")
131				}
132			}
133			t.Pass = pass
134			if !pass {
135				overallPass = false
136			}
137			evaluated = append(evaluated, t)
138		}
139		return overallPass, failures, evaluated
140	}
```

```text
51	func validateRecordRequest(req RecordQCResultRequest) error {
52		if strings.TrimSpace(req.SubjectType) == "" {
53			return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_SUBJECT_TYPE", "subject_type is required")
54		}
55		if req.SubjectID.IsZero() {

60		}

62			return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_TESTS", "at least one test is required")
```

```text
1	// Package plant implements the processing tier of the pour→QR chain:
2	// BMC lots (pooled consignments at the chilling centre), processing batches,
3	// product lots and QR issuance. It is the ENFORCEMENT layer of the safety
4	// gate (blueprint §8.3): a lot or batch that has not PASSED quality control
5	// can never advance — not into a tanker, not into a batch, not onto a shelf.
6	// Aflatoxin M1 survives pasteurisation, so the gate is checked at every hop,
7	// belt-and-braces.
8	package plant
9	
10	import (
11		"log/slog"
12	
13		"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
14	
15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
16		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
17		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/middleware"
18	)
19	
20	// Register wires the plant module under /api/v1/plant.
21	func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
22		log := d.Log.With(slog.String("module", "plant"))
23		repo := NewRepo(d.DB)
24		svc := NewService(repo, d, log)
25		h := NewHandler(svc)
26	
27		r.Route("/plant", func(pr chi.Router) {
28			pr.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
29	
30			// BMC lots — created/closed/dispatched by the chilling-centre operator;
31			// readable by everyone downstream who receives or supervises the milk.
32			pr.Route("/bmc-lots", func(lr chi.Router) {
33				lr.With(middleware.RequireRoles(
34					domain.RoleBMCOperator, domain.RolePlantOperator,
35					domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor, domain.RolePlantLabAnalyst,
36				)).Get("/", h.ListBMCLots)
37	
38				lr.Group(func(wr chi.Router) {
39					wr.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleBMCOperator))
40					wr.Post("/", h.CreateBMCLot)
41					wr.Post("/{id}/close", h.CloseBMCLot)
42					wr.Post("/{id}/dispatch", h.DispatchBMCLot)
43				})
44			})
45	
46			// Processing batches — plant operator pools dispatched (gate-passed)
47			// BMC lots into a production run; plant lab + supervisor read along.
48			pr.Route("/batches", func(br chi.Router) {
49				read := middleware.RequireRoles(
50					domain.RolePlantOperator, domain.RolePlantLabAnalyst,
51					domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor,
52				)
53				br.With(read).Get("/", h.ListBatches)
54				br.With(read).Get("/{id}", h.GetBatch)
55	
56				br.Group(func(wr chi.Router) {
57					wr.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RolePlantOperator))
58					wr.Post("/", h.CreateBatch)
59					wr.Post("/{id}/complete", h.CompleteBatch)
60				})
61			})
62	
63			// Product lots — packaged SKUs out of a COMPLETED batch. Recall is the
64			// FSSAI path (§18-C): admin or plant lab pulls the lot from market.
65			pr.Route("/product-lots", func(plr chi.Router) {
66				plr.With(middleware.RequireRoles(
67					domain.RolePlantOperator, domain.RolePlantLabAnalyst,
68				)).Post("/", h.CreateProductLot)
69				plr.With(middleware.RequireRoles(
70					domain.RolePCDFAdmin, domain.RolePlantLabAnalyst,
71				)).Post("/{id}/recall", h.RecallProductLot)
72			})
73	
74			// QR issuance — the consumer-facing end of the trace chain (§7).
75			pr.Route("/qrs", func(qr chi.Router) {
76				qr.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(
77					domain.RolePlantOperator, domain.RolePlantLabAnalyst,
78				))
79				qr.Post("/", h.IssueQR)
80				qr.Get("/", h.ListQRs)
81			})
82		})
83	
84		// No bus subscriptions: the quality module flips lot/batch statuses in
85		// their own collections, and every gate here re-reads status at use time.
86	}
87
```

```text
30	// the frontend switches on it to show the quarantine screen (blueprint §8.3).
31	const codeSafetyGateBlocked = "SAFETY_GATE_BLOCKED"
32	
33	// Service holds the plant module's business logic: lot pooling, the safety
34	// gate, batch numbering, product lot packaging and QR minting.
35	type Service struct {
36		repo     *Repo
37		orgs     *orgscope.Resolver
38		ledger   *provenance.Ledger
39		qrSecret string
40		log      *slog.Logger

43	// NewService wires the service from the shared dependency container and the
44	// module-scoped logger.
45	func NewService(repo *Repo, d *deps.Deps, log *slog.Logger) *Service {
46		return &Service{
47			repo:     repo,
48			orgs:     d.Orgs,
49			ledger:   d.Ledger,
50			qrSecret: d.Cfg.QRSigningSecret,
51			log:      log,
52		}
53	}

55	// actorID parses the actor's party identity — carried as an ObjectID hex
56	// string in JWT claims — into the ObjectID persisted on created documents.
57	func actorID(actor auth.Actor) (primitive.ObjectID, error) {
58		return httpx.ParseID(actor.PartyID, "actor")
59	}
60	
61	// fail wraps an unexpected error with its failing operation, logs it at ERROR
62	// and returns the opaque 500 — every internal failure must name its op in the
63	// logs.
64	func (s *Service) fail(ctx context.Context, op string, err error) error {
65		err = fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", op, err)
66		s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "plant operation failed",
67			slog.String("op", op), slog.Any("err", err))
68		return httpx.Internal(err)
69	}

71	// requireScope enforces the actor's org scope and logs denials at WARN so
72	// cross-scope probing is visible.
73	func (s *Service) requireScope(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, targetOrgID primitive.ObjectID, op string) error {
74		err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, targetOrgID)
75		if err == nil {
76			return nil
77		}
78		var app *httpx.AppError
79		if errors.As(err, &app) && app.Status == http.StatusForbidden {
80			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "org scope denied",
81				slog.String("op", op),
82				slog.String("target_org_id", targetOrgID.Hex()),
83				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
84				slog.String("actor_role", actor.RoleCode))
85		}
86		return err
87	}

89	// --- safety-gate predicates (§8.3) ---
90	//
91	// Pure functions so the refusal matrix is unit-testable without a database.
92	// Every mutation below ALSO re-checks the status inside the MongoDB update
93	// filter, so a concurrent QC block can never slip a bad lot through.
94	
95	// canDispatchBMCLot: only a lot with a passing BMC rapid test may leave on a
96	// tanker. BLOCKED, QC_PENDING and OPEN lots stay put.
97	func canDispatchBMCLot(status string) bool {
98		return status == domain.BMCLotStatusPassed
99	}
100	
101	// canPoolBMCLot: only a DISPATCHED lot (which by construction went
102	// OPEN→QC_PENDING→PASSED→DISPATCHED) may enter a processing batch.
103	func canPoolBMCLot(status string) bool {
104		return status == domain.BMCLotStatusDispatched
105	}
106	
107	// canCompleteBatch: only a batch the plant lab has PASSED may complete.
108	func canCompleteBatch(status string) bool {
109		return status == domain.BatchStatusPassed
110	}
111	
112	// canYieldProductLot: only a COMPLETED batch may be packaged into SKU lots.
113	func canYieldProductLot(batchStatus string) bool {
114		return batchStatus == domain.BatchStatusCompleted
115	}

117	// canIssueQR: a QR may only label an ACTIVE product lot whose batch is
118	// COMPLETED. This read-time check is advisory; IssueQR additionally confirms
119	// the lot is still ACTIVE with a conditional write after the QR insert, so a
120	// recall landing mid-request still stops the mint.
121	func canIssueQR(lotStatus, batchStatus string) bool {
122		return lotStatus == domain.ProductLotStatusActive && batchStatus == domain.BatchStatusCompleted
123	}

127	// CreateBMCLot pools DELIVERED consignments into a new OPEN lot at a BMC.
128	func (s *Service) CreateBMCLot(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateBMCLotRequest) (*domain.BMCLot, error) {
129		actID, err := actorID(actor)
130		if err != nil {
131			return nil, err
132		}

134			return nil, err
135		}
136		org, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.BMCID)
137		if err != nil {
138			return nil, err
139		}
140		if org.Type != domain.OrgTypeBMC {
141			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot creation refused: org unit is not a BMC",
142				slog.String("org_unit_id", req.BMCID.Hex()),
143				slog.String("org_type", org.Type),
144				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
145			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_BMC", "org unit "+req.BMCID.Hex()+" is not a BMC")
146		}

148		now := time.Now().UTC()
149		date := req.Date
150		if date == "" {
151			date = domain.DateKeyIST(now)
152		}
153	
154		ids := dedupe(req.ConsignmentIDs)
155		consignments, err := s.repo.ConsignmentsByIDs(ctx, ids)
156		if err != nil {
157			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "load consignments", err)
158		}
159		if len(consignments) != len(ids) {
160			return nil, httpx.NotFound("consignment(s) " + strings.Join(missingIDs(ids, consignments), ", "))
161		}
162		var undelivered []string
163		for _, c := range consignments {
164			if c.Status != domain.ConsignmentStatusDelivered {
165				undelivered = append(undelivered, c.ID.Hex())
166			}
167		}
168		if len(undelivered) > 0 {
169			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot creation refused: consignment(s) not DELIVERED",
170				slog.String("bmc_id", req.BMCID.Hex()),
171				slog.String("consignment_ids", strings.Join(undelivered, ",")),
172				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
173			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("CONSIGNMENT_NOT_DELIVERED",
174				"only DELIVERED consignments can be pooled into a BMC lot").
175				WithDetails(map[string]any{"consignment_ids": undelivered})
176		}
177	
178		// Optimistic claim: flip DELIVERED→ACCEPTED stamped with the new lot ID.
179		// The lot ID is pre-generated so claim, insert and ledger all agree.
180		// If another lot raced us on any consignment, release our claims and bail.
181		lotID := primitive.NewObjectID()
182		claimed, err := s.repo.ClaimConsignments(ctx, ids, lotID)
183		if err != nil {
184			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "claim consignments", err)
185		}
186		if claimed != int64(len(ids)) {
187			if relErr := s.repo.ReleaseConsignments(ctx, lotID); relErr != nil {
188				return nil, s.fail(ctx, "release consignments after lost claim", relErr)
189			}
190			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot creation lost consignment claim race",
191				slog.String("bmc_id", req.BMCID.Hex()),
192				slog.Int64("claimed", claimed), slog.Int("requested", len(ids)),
193				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
194			return nil, httpx.Conflict("CONSIGNMENT_CLAIM_CONFLICT",
195				"one or more consignments were pooled by another lot — reload and retry")
196		}
197	
198		var totalLitres float64
199		var tripIDs []primitive.ObjectID
200		seenTrip := map[primitive.ObjectID]bool{}
201		for _, c := range consignments {
202			totalLitres += c.TotalQuantityLitres
203			if c.RouteTripID != nil && !seenTrip[*c.RouteTripID] {
204				seenTrip[*c.RouteTripID] = true
205				tripIDs = append(tripIDs, *c.RouteTripID)
206			}
207		}
208	
209		lot := &domain.BMCLot{
210			ID:                  lotID,
211			BMCID:               req.BMCID,
212			Date:                date,
213			Shift:               req.Shift,
214			ConsignmentIDs:      ids,
215			RouteTripIDs:        tripIDs,
216			TotalQuantityLitres: totalLitres,
217			Status:              domain.BMCLotStatusOpen,
218			CreatedBy:           actID,
219			CreatedAt:           now,
220		}
221		if err := s.repo.InsertBMCLot(ctx, lot); err != nil {
222			_ = s.repo.ReleaseConsignments(ctx, lotID)
223			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "insert bmc lot", err)
224		}
225	
226		refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, len(ids))
227		for _, id := range ids {
228			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{
229				EntityType: domain.EntityConsignment, EntityID: id.Hex(), Relation: "pools",
230			})
231		}
232		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
233			Type:       domain.EventBMCLotCreated,
234			EntityType: domain.EntityBMCLot,
235			EntityID:   lot.ID.Hex(),
236			Refs:       refs,
237			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
238			OrgUnitID:  req.BMCID.Hex(),
239			Payload: map[string]any{
240				"date": date, "shift": req.Shift, "total_quantity_litres": totalLitres,
241			},
242		})
243		if err != nil {
244			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append bmc_lot.created event", err)
245		}
246		if err := s.repo.SetBMCLotProvenanceSeq(ctx, lot.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
247			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp bmc lot provenance seq", err)
248		}
249		lot.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
250		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "bmc lot created",
251			slog.String("bmc_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()),
252			slog.String("bmc_id", req.BMCID.Hex()),
253			slog.String("date", date), slog.String("shift", req.Shift),
254			slog.Int("consignments", len(ids)),
255			slog.Float64("total_quantity_litres", totalLitres),
256			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
257		return lot, nil
258	}
259	
260	// CloseBMCLot transitions an OPEN lot to QC_PENDING with the chilling
261	// temperature. The quality module later flips QC_PENDING→PASSED/BLOCKED.
262	func (s *Service) CloseBMCLot(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID, chillingTempC float64) (*domain.BMCLot, error) {
263		lot, err := s.getBMCLot(ctx, id)
264		if err != nil {
265			return nil, err
266		}
267		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, lot.BMCID, "close bmc lot"); err != nil {
268			return nil, err
269		}
270		if lot.Status != domain.BMCLotStatusOpen {
271			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot close refused: not OPEN",
272				slog.String("bmc_lot_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("status", lot.Status),
273				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
274			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_NOT_OPEN",
275				"only an OPEN lot can be closed; lot is "+lot.Status)
276		}
277		now := time.Now().UTC()
278		ok, err := s.repo.CloseBMCLot(ctx, id, chillingTempC, now)
279		if err != nil {
280			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "close bmc lot", err)
281		}
282		if !ok {
283			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot close lost state race",
284				slog.String("bmc_lot_id", id.Hex()),
285				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
286			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_NOT_OPEN",
287				"lot changed state concurrently — reload and retry")
288		}
289		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
290			Type:       domain.EventBMCLotClosed,
291			EntityType: domain.EntityBMCLot,
292			EntityID:   lot.ID.Hex(),
293			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
294			OrgUnitID:  lot.BMCID.Hex(),
295			Payload:    map[string]any{"chilling_temp_c": chillingTempC},
296		})
297		if err != nil {
298			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append bmc_lot.closed event", err)
299		}
300		if err := s.repo.SetBMCLotProvenanceSeq(ctx, lot.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
301			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp bmc lot provenance seq", err)
302		}
303		lot.Status = domain.BMCLotStatusQCPending
304		lot.ChillingTempC = chillingTempC
305		lot.ClosedAt = &now
306		lot.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
307		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "bmc lot closed for QC",
308			slog.String("bmc_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()),
309			slog.String("bmc_id", lot.BMCID.Hex()),
310			slog.Float64("chilling_temp_c", chillingTempC),
311			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
312		return lot, nil
313	}
314	
315	// DispatchBMCLot transitions PASSED→DISPATCHED. THE safety gate (§8.3): a
316	// BLOCKED or untested lot never leaves the chilling centre.
317	func (s *Service) DispatchBMCLot(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.BMCLot, error) {
318		lot, err := s.getBMCLot(ctx, id)
319		if err != nil {
320			return nil, err
321		}
322		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, lot.BMCID, "dispatch bmc lot"); err != nil {
323			return nil, err
324		}
325		if lot.Status == domain.BMCLotStatusDispatched {
326			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot dispatch refused: already dispatched",
327				slog.String("bmc_lot_id", id.Hex()),
328				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
329			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_ALREADY_DISPATCHED", "lot is already dispatched")
330		}
331		if !canDispatchBMCLot(lot.Status) {
332			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot dispatch refused: safety gate not passed",
333				slog.String("bmc_lot_id", id.Hex()),
334				slog.String("status", lot.Status),
335				slog.String("block_reason", lot.BlockReason),
336				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
337			msg := "lot cannot be dispatched: safety gate not passed (status " + lot.Status + ")"
338			if lot.BlockReason != "" {
339				msg += " — " + lot.BlockReason
340			}
341			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked, msg).
342				WithDetails(map[string]any{"status": lot.Status, "block_reason": lot.BlockReason})
343		}
344		now := time.Now().UTC()
345		ok, err := s.repo.DispatchBMCLot(ctx, id, now)
346		if err != nil {
347			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "dispatch bmc lot", err)
348		}
349		if !ok {
350			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot dispatch lost state race",
351				slog.String("bmc_lot_id", id.Hex()),
352				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
353			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_STATE_CHANGED",
354				"lot changed state concurrently — reload and retry")
355		}
356		// The custody transition — gate-passed milk physically leaving the
357		// chilling centre — must live on the tamper-evident chain like every
358		// other hop of the pour→QR path, not only in a mutable document field.
359		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
360			Type:       domain.EventBMCLotDispatched,
361			EntityType: domain.EntityBMCLot,
362			EntityID:   lot.ID.Hex(),
363			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
364			OrgUnitID:  lot.BMCID.Hex(),
365			Payload: map[string]any{
366				// String, not time.Time: payloads must round-trip BSON⇄JSON
367				// byte-identically or chain re-verification would break.
368				"dispatched_at":         now.Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
369				"total_quantity_litres": lot.TotalQuantityLitres,
370			},
371		})
372		if err != nil {
373			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append bmc_lot.dispatched event", err)
374		}
375		if err := s.repo.SetBMCLotProvenanceSeq(ctx, lot.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
376			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp bmc lot provenance seq", err)
377		}
378		lot.Status = domain.BMCLotStatusDispatched
379		lot.DispatchedAt = &now
380		lot.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
381		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "bmc lot dispatched",
382			slog.String("bmc_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()),
383			slog.String("bmc_id", lot.BMCID.Hex()),
384			slog.Float64("total_quantity_litres", lot.TotalQuantityLitres),
385			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
386		return lot, nil
387	}
388	
389	// ListBMCLots pages lots by BMC/date/status. A BMC operator may only list
390	// within their own scope; downstream readers (plant operator, supervisor,
391	// lab) see across BMCs — the plant receives tankers from sibling BMCs, so an
392	// ancestry check against the plant org would wrongly refuse them.
393	func (s *Service) ListBMCLots(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, f BMCLotListFilter, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.BMCLot, int64, error) {
394		if !f.BMCID.IsZero() && actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleBMCOperator {
395			if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, f.BMCID, "list bmc lots"); err != nil {
396				return nil, 0, err
397			}
398		}
399		lots, total, err := s.repo.ListBMCLots(ctx, f, page)
400		if err != nil {
401			return nil, 0, s.fail(ctx, "list bmc lots", err)
402		}
403		return lots, total, nil
404	}
405	
406	// --- processing batches ---
407	
408	// CreateBatch pools DISPATCHED (gate-passed) BMC lots into one production
409	// run. The gate re-checks here belt-and-braces: aflatoxin M1 survives
410	// pasteurisation, so a blocked lot must never reach a vat (§8.3).
411	func (s *Service) CreateBatch(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateBatchRequest) (*domain.ProcessingBatch, error) {
412		actID, err := actorID(actor)
413		if err != nil {
414			return nil, err
415		}
416		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, req.PlantID, "create batch"); err != nil {
417			return nil, err
418		}
419		org, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.PlantID)
420		if err != nil {
421			return nil, err
422		}
423		if org.Type != domain.OrgTypeProcessingPlant {
424			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch creation refused: org unit is not a plant",
425				slog.String("org_unit_id", req.PlantID.Hex()),
426				slog.String("org_type", org.Type),
427				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
428			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_PLANT", "org unit "+req.PlantID.Hex()+" is not a processing plant")
429		}
430	
431		ids := dedupe(req.BMCLotIDs)
432		lots, err := s.repo.BMCLotsByIDs(ctx, ids)
433		if err != nil {
434			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "load bmc lots", err)
435		}
436		if len(lots) != len(ids) {
437			return nil, httpx.NotFound("BMC lot(s) " + strings.Join(missingLotIDs(ids, lots), ", "))
438		}
439		var offending []string
440		var inputLitres float64
441		for _, lot := range lots {
442			if !canPoolBMCLot(lot.Status) {
443				offending = append(offending, lot.ID.Hex())
444				continue
445			}
446			inputLitres += lot.TotalQuantityLitres
447		}
448		if len(offending) > 0 {
449			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch creation refused: bmc lot(s) have not cleared the safety gate",
450				slog.String("plant_id", req.PlantID.Hex()),
451				slog.String("blocked_lot_ids", strings.Join(offending, ",")),
452				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
453			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked,
454				"one or more BMC lots have not cleared the safety gate (must be PASSED and DISPATCHED)").
455				WithDetails(map[string]any{"blocked_lot_ids": offending})
456		}
457	
458		now := time.Now().UTC()
459		dateKey := domain.DateKeyIST(now)
460		seq, err := s.repo.NextSequence(ctx, "batch_number:"+req.PlantID.Hex()+":"+dateKey)
461		if err != nil {
462			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "next batch number sequence", err)
463		}
464		batchNumber := fmt.Sprintf("BATCH-%s-%s-%04d",
465			org.Code, strings.ReplaceAll(dateKey, "-", ""), seq)
466	
467		// Optimistic claim (mirrors ClaimConsignments): flip DISPATCHED→POOLED
468		// stamped with the pre-generated batch ID BEFORE inserting the batch. One
469		// physical lot of milk can therefore never be pooled into two batches —
470		// neither by a double-submit nor by two concurrent CreateBatch calls.
471		batchID := primitive.NewObjectID()
472		claimed, err := s.repo.ClaimBMCLots(ctx, ids, batchID)
473		if err != nil {
474			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "claim bmc lots", err)
475		}
476		if claimed != int64(len(ids)) {
477			if relErr := s.repo.ReleaseBMCLots(ctx, batchID); relErr != nil {
478				return nil, s.fail(ctx, "release bmc lots after lost claim", relErr)
479			}
480			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch creation lost bmc lot claim race",
481				slog.String("plant_id", req.PlantID.Hex()),
482				slog.Int64("claimed", claimed), slog.Int("requested", len(ids)),
483				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
484			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_CLAIM_CONFLICT",
485				"one or more BMC lots were pooled by another batch — reload and retry")
486		}
487	
488		// CREATED is a transient birth state: the plant lab must clear every
489		// batch, so it is persisted straight into QC_PENDING.
490		batch := &domain.ProcessingBatch{
491			ID:          batchID,
492			PlantID:     req.PlantID,
493			BatchNumber: batchNumber,
494			BMCLotIDs:   ids,
495			ProductType: req.ProductType,
496			InputLitres: inputLitres,
497			Status:      domain.BatchStatusQCPending,
498			StartedAt:   now,
499			CreatedBy:   actID,
500			CreatedAt:   now,
501		}
502		if err := s.repo.InsertBatch(ctx, batch); err != nil {
503			_ = s.repo.ReleaseBMCLots(ctx, batchID)
504			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "insert batch", err)
505		}
506	
507		refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, len(ids))
508		for _, id := range ids {
509			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{
510				EntityType: domain.EntityBMCLot, EntityID: id.Hex(), Relation: "pools",
511			})
512		}
513		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
514			Type:       domain.EventBatchCreated,
515			EntityType: domain.EntityBatch,
516			EntityID:   batch.ID.Hex(),
517			Refs:       refs,
518			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
519			OrgUnitID:  req.PlantID.Hex(),
520			Payload: map[string]any{
521				"batch_number": batchNumber, "product_type": req.ProductType, "input_litres": inputLitres,
522			},
523		})
524		if err != nil {
525			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append batch.created event", err)
526		}
527		if err := s.repo.SetBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx, batch.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
528			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp batch provenance seq", err)
529		}
530		batch.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
531		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "processing batch created",
532			slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
533			slog.String("batch_number", batchNumber),
534			slog.String("plant_id", req.PlantID.Hex()),
535			slog.String("product_type", req.ProductType),
536			slog.Int("bmc_lots", len(ids)),
537			slog.Float64("input_litres", inputLitres),
538			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
539		return batch, nil
540	}
541	
542	// CompleteBatch transitions PASSED→COMPLETED — only a batch the plant lab
543	// cleared may finish and go on to yield product lots.
544	func (s *Service) CompleteBatch(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.ProcessingBatch, error) {
545		batch, err := s.getBatch(ctx, id)
546		if err != nil {
547			return nil, err
548		}
549		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, batch.PlantID, "complete batch"); err != nil {
550			return nil, err
551		}
552		if batch.Status == domain.BatchStatusCompleted {
553			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch completion refused: already completed",
554				slog.String("batch_id", id.Hex()),
555				slog.String("batch_number", batch.BatchNumber),
556				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
557			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BATCH_ALREADY_COMPLETED", "batch is already completed")
558		}
559		if !canCompleteBatch(batch.Status) {
560			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch completion refused: plant-lab QC not passed",
561				slog.String("batch_id", id.Hex()),
562				slog.String("batch_number", batch.BatchNumber),
563				slog.String("status", batch.Status),
564				slog.String("block_reason", batch.BlockReason),
565				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
566			msg := "batch cannot complete: plant-lab QC not passed (status " + batch.Status + ")"
567			if batch.BlockReason != "" {
568				msg += " — " + batch.BlockReason
569			}
570			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked, msg).
571				WithDetails(map[string]any{"status": batch.Status, "block_reason": batch.BlockReason})
572		}
573		now := time.Now().UTC()
574		ok, err := s.repo.CompleteBatch(ctx, id, now)
575		if err != nil {
576			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "complete batch", err)
577		}
578		if !ok {
579			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch completion lost state race",
580				slog.String("batch_id", id.Hex()),
581				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
582			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BATCH_STATE_CHANGED",
583				"batch changed state concurrently — reload and retry")
584		}
585		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
586			Type:       domain.EventBatchCompleted,
587			EntityType: domain.EntityBatch,
588			EntityID:   batch.ID.Hex(),
589			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
590			OrgUnitID:  batch.PlantID.Hex(),
591			Payload:    map[string]any{"batch_number": batch.BatchNumber},
592		})
593		if err != nil {
594			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append batch.completed event", err)
595		}
596		if err := s.repo.SetBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx, batch.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
597			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp batch provenance seq", err)
598		}
599		batch.Status = domain.BatchStatusCompleted
600		batch.CompletedAt = &now
601		batch.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
602		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "processing batch completed",
603			slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
604			slog.String("batch_number", batch.BatchNumber),
605			slog.String("plant_id", batch.PlantID.Hex()),
606			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
607		return batch, nil
608	}

610	// GetBatch returns one batch (including its qc_result_ids) within scope.
611	func (s *Service) GetBatch(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.ProcessingBatch, error) {
612		batch, err := s.getBatch(ctx, id)
613		if err != nil {
614			return nil, err
615		}
616		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, batch.PlantID, "get batch"); err != nil {
617			return nil, err
618		}
619		return batch, nil
620	}

623	func (s *Service) ListBatches(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, f BatchListFilter, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.ProcessingBatch, int64, error) {
624		if !f.PlantID.IsZero() {

633		return batches, total, nil
```
