239	// buildSourcing derives the samiti-set view from traced consignment events:
240	// contributing DCS org ids from each event's org_unit_id/payload, collection
241	// dates from payloads, with the consignment documents as fallback when the
242	// events did not carry those fields. Ledger events carry ObjectIDs as hex
243	// strings, so the sets are hex-keyed and parsed at the DB/orgscope boundary.
244	func (s *Service) buildSourcing(ctx context.Context, events []provenance.Event) (*SourcingInfo, error) {
245		dcsIDs := map[string]struct{}{}
246		dates := map[string]struct{}{}
247		consignmentIDs := map[string]struct{}{}
248	
249		for _, ev := range events {
250			if ev.EntityType != domain.EntityConsignment {
251				continue
252			}
253			consignmentIDs[ev.EntityID] = struct{}{}
254			// Only created/dispatched events carry the DCS in org_unit_id —
255			// consignment.picked_up is appended by logistics under the UNION's
256			// org id, which must never be counted as a contributing samiti.
257			switch ev.Type {
258			case domain.EventConsignmentCreated, domain.EventConsignmentDispatched:
259				if ev.OrgUnitID != "" {
260					dcsIDs[ev.OrgUnitID] = struct{}{}
261				} else if v, ok := ev.Payload["dcs_id"].(string); ok && v != "" {
262					dcsIDs[v] = struct{}{}
263				}
264			}
265			if v, ok := ev.Payload["date"].(string); ok && v != "" {
266				dates[v] = struct{}{}
267			}
268		}
269	
270		// Fallback: if the events lacked DCS ids or dates, read the consignment
271		// docs themselves (still samiti-level — pour ids are never surfaced).
272		if len(consignmentIDs) > 0 && (len(dcsIDs) == 0 || len(dates) == 0) {
273			ids := make([]primitive.ObjectID, 0, len(consignmentIDs))
274			for _, hexID := range sortedKeys(consignmentIDs) {
275				cid, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(hexID)
276				if err != nil {
277					// Ledger event ids should always be ObjectID hex — flag and skip.
278					s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "QR scan: traced consignment id is not a valid object id",
279						slog.String("consignment_id", hexID))
280					continue
281				}
282				ids = append(ids, cid)
283			}
284			docs, err := s.repo.consignmentsByIDs(ctx, ids)
285			if err != nil {
286				return nil, s.internalErr(ctx, "qr scan: load consignments for sourcing", err)
287			}
288			for _, c := range docs {
289				if !c.DCSID.IsZero() {
290					dcsIDs[c.DCSID.Hex()] = struct{}{}
291				}
292				if c.Date != "" {
293					dates[c.Date] = struct{}{}
294				}
295			}
296		}
297	
298		samitis := make([]SamitiInfo, 0, len(dcsIDs))
299		districts := map[string]struct{}{}
300		for _, hexID := range sortedKeys(dcsIDs) {
301			orgID, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(hexID)
302			if err != nil {
303				// A malformed id must not break a consumer scan — log and skip.
304				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "QR scan: contributing DCS id is not a valid object id",
305					slog.String("dcs_org_id", hexID))
306				continue
307			}
308			org, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, orgID)
309			if err != nil {
310				// A missing org unit must not break a consumer scan — log and skip.
311				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "QR scan: contributing DCS org not resolvable",
312					slog.String("dcs_org_id", hexID), slog.Any("err", err))
313				continue
314			}
315			// Defence in depth: the §7.4 samiti set may only contain DCS units.
316			if org.Type != domain.OrgTypeDCS {
317				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "QR scan: non-DCS org unit skipped from samiti set",
318					slog.String("org_id", hexID), slog.String("org_type", org.Type))
319				continue
320			}
321			samitis = append(samitis, SamitiInfo{Name: org.Name, Code: org.Code, District: org.District})
322			if org.District != "" {
323				districts[org.District] = struct{}{}
324			}
325		}
326		sort.Slice(samitis, func(i, j int) bool { return samitis[i].Name < samitis[j].Name })
327	
328		collectionDates := sortedKeys(dates)
329		return &SourcingInfo{
330			Message:         sourcingMessage(collectionDates, len(samitis), sortedKeys(districts)),
331			Samitis:         samitis,
332			CollectionDates: collectionDates,
333		}, nil
334	}
335	
336	// sourcingMessage renders the consumer-facing pooled-provenance sentence,
337	// e.g. "Made from milk collected on 2026-07-05 from 3 samitis in Lucknow".
338	func sourcingMessage(dates []string, samitiCount int, districts []string) string {
339		var b strings.Builder
340		b.WriteString("Made from milk collected")
341		if len(dates) > 0 {
342			b.WriteString(" on " + strings.Join(dates, ", "))
343		}
344		noun := "samitis"
345		if samitiCount == 1 {
346			noun = "samiti"
347		}
348		fmt.Fprintf(&b, " from %d %s", samitiCount, noun)
349		if len(districts) > 0 {
350			b.WriteString(" in " + strings.Join(districts, ", "))
351		}
352		return b.String()
353	}
354	
355	// verifyTracedRange answers the per-scan tamper-evidence check from a
356	// cumulative verification watermark: the chain is verified incrementally up
357	// to the traced range's max seq, and once a prefix is verified, later scans
358	// inside it are O(1) — no per-request re-hash of thousands of interleaved
359	// events. Spans over scanVerifySpanCap are verified partially (most recent
360	// tail) and flagged, matching the previous per-scan behaviour.
361	func (s *Service) verifyTracedRange(ctx context.Context, events []provenance.Event) (*LedgerInfo, error) {
362		if len(events) == 0 {
363			return &LedgerInfo{Events: 0, Intact: true, VerifiedRange: [2]int64{0, 0}}, nil
364		}
365		maxSeq := events[0].Seq
366		for _, ev := range events[1:] {
367			if ev.Seq > maxSeq {
368				maxSeq = ev.Seq
369			}
370		}
371	
372		s.verifyMu.Lock()
373		defer s.verifyMu.Unlock()
374	
375		if s.chainBroken {
376			return &LedgerInfo{
377				Events:        len(events),
378				Intact:        false,
379				VerifiedRange: [2]int64{s.brokenAtSeq, s.brokenAtSeq},
380			}, nil
381		}
382		if maxSeq <= s.verifiedUpTo {
383			return &LedgerInfo{
384				Events:        len(events),
385				Intact:        true,
386				VerifiedRange: [2]int64{1, s.verifiedUpTo},
387			}, nil
388		}
389	
390		// Extend the watermark: start at the last verified event (re-hashing it
391		// covers the boundary linkage), capped to the per-request span budget.
392		from, partial := max(int64(1), s.verifiedUpTo), false
393		if maxSeq-from+1 > scanVerifySpanCap {
394			from, partial = maxSeq-scanVerifySpanCap+1, true
395		}
396		intact, brokenAt, err := s.ledger.VerifyChain(ctx, from, maxSeq)
397		if err != nil {
398			return nil, s.internalErr(ctx, "qr scan: verify ledger chain", err,
399				slog.Int64("from", from), slog.Int64("to", maxSeq))
400		}
401		if intact {
402			s.verifiedUpTo = maxSeq
403		} else {
404			s.chainBroken, s.brokenAtSeq = true, brokenAt
405			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "provenance chain break detected during scan verification",
406				slog.Int64("broken_at_seq", brokenAt),
407				slog.Int64("from", from), slog.Int64("to", maxSeq))
408		}
409		return &LedgerInfo{
410			Events:        len(events),
411			Intact:        intact,
412			VerifiedRange: [2]int64{from, maxSeq},
413			Partial:       partial,
414		}, nil
415	}
416	
417	// VerifyLedger runs the public tamper-evidence check over [from,to]. Both
418	// bounds are optional: `to` defaults to the chain head, `from` to the start
419	// of the last publicVerifySpanCap events. Spans over the cap are rejected.
420	func (s *Service) VerifyLedger(ctx context.Context, fromRaw, toRaw string) (*LedgerVerifyResponse, error) {
421		latest, err := s.ledger.LatestSeq(ctx)
422		if err != nil {
423			return nil, s.internalErr(ctx, "ledger verify: read chain head", err)
424		}
425		if latest == 0 {
426			return &LedgerVerifyResponse{Intact: true, From: 0, To: 0}, nil // empty chain is trivially intact
427		}
428	
429		to := latest
430		if toRaw != "" {
431			n, err := strconv.ParseInt(toRaw, 10, 64)
432			if err != nil || n < 1 {
433				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_RANGE", "'to' must be a positive sequence number")
434			}
435			to = min(n, latest)
436		}
437		from := max(int64(1), to-publicVerifySpanCap+1)
438		if fromRaw != "" {
439			n, err := strconv.ParseInt(fromRaw, 10, 64)
440			if err != nil || n < 1 {
441				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_RANGE", "'from' must be a positive sequence number")
442			}
443			from = n
444		}
445		if from > to {
446			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_RANGE", "'from' must not exceed 'to'")
447		}
448		if to-from+1 > publicVerifySpanCap {
449			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("SPAN_TOO_WIDE",
450				fmt.Sprintf("verification span is capped at %d events per request", publicVerifySpanCap))
451		}
452	
453		intact, brokenAt, err := s.ledger.VerifyChain(ctx, from, to)
454		if err != nil {
455			return nil, s.internalErr(ctx, "ledger verify: verify chain", err,
456				slog.Int64("from", from), slog.Int64("to", to))
457		}
458		resp := &LedgerVerifyResponse{Intact: intact, From: from, To: to}
459		if !intact {
460			resp.BrokenAtSeq = &brokenAt
461			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "public ledger verification found a broken chain",
462				slog.Int64("broken_at_seq", brokenAt),
463				slog.Int64("from", from), slog.Int64("to", to))
464		}
465		return resp, nil
466	}
467	
468	// TraceGraph returns the full event graph around one entity: upstream via
469	// the recursive ref walk, downstream via reverse-ref lookup — the recall /
470	// root-cause tool (§8.3). entityID is the entity's ObjectID as a hex string
471	// (already validated by the handler; the ledger stores ids as hex).
472	func (s *Service) TraceGraph(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string) (*TraceGraphResponse, error) {
473		if err := validateEntityType(entityType); err != nil {
474			return nil, err
475		}
476		upstream, err := s.ledger.Trace(ctx, entityType, entityID, traceDepth)
477		if err != nil {
478			return nil, s.internalErr(ctx, "trace graph: upstream walk", err,
479				slog.String("entity_type", entityType), slog.String("entity_id", entityID))
480		}
481		// The cap is pushed into the query: only the LAST downstreamEventCap
482		// referencing events are fetched, instead of decoding an unbounded set
483		// into memory and truncating afterwards.
484		downstream, err := s.ledger.DownstreamRefs(ctx, entityID, downstreamEventCap)
485		if err != nil {
486			return nil, s.internalErr(ctx, "trace graph: downstream refs", err,
487				slog.String("entity_type", entityType), slog.String("entity_id", entityID))
488		}
489		if len(upstream) == 0 && len(downstream) == 0 {
490			return nil, httpx.NotFound("provenance for entity")
491		}
492		if upstream == nil {
493			upstream = []provenance.Event{}
494		}
495		if downstream == nil {
496			downstream = []provenance.Event{}
497		}
498		return &TraceGraphResponse{Upstream: upstream, Downstream: downstream}, nil
499	}
500	
501	// Timeline returns one entity's own events in chain order, paginated. The
502	// skip/limit is pushed into the Mongo query so a page read never loads the
503	// entity's full history. The second return value is the total event count.
504	// entityID is the entity's ObjectID as a hex string (handler-validated).
505	func (s *Service) Timeline(ctx context.Context, entityType, entityID string, page httpx.Page) ([]provenance.Event, int, error) {
506		if err := validateEntityType(entityType); err != nil {
507			return nil, 0, err
508		}
509		total, err := s.ledger.CountEventsForEntity(ctx, entityType, entityID)
510		if err != nil {
511			return nil, 0, s.internalErr(ctx, "timeline: count entity events", err,
512				slog.String("entity_type", entityType), slog.String("entity_id", entityID))
513		}
514		if total == 0 {
515			return nil, 0, httpx.NotFound("provenance for entity")
516		}
517		events, err := s.ledger.EventsForEntityPage(ctx, entityType, entityID, page.Offset, page.Limit)
518		if err != nil {
519			return nil, 0, s.internalErr(ctx, "timeline: load entity events page", err,
520				slog.String("entity_type", entityType), slog.String("entity_id", entityID))
521		}
522		return events, int(total), nil
523	}
524	
525	// validateEntityType rejects entity types outside the domain.Entity* catalog.
526	func validateEntityType(entityType string) error {
527		if _, ok := validEntityTypes[entityType]; !ok {
528			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_ENTITY_TYPE",
529				"unknown entity type "+entityType+" — use one of the provenance entity type constants")
530		}
531		return nil
532	}
533	
534	// sortedKeys returns a set's keys in deterministic (lexicographic) order.
535	func sortedKeys(set map[string]struct{}) []string {
536		out := make([]string, 0, len(set))
537		for k := range set {
538			out = append(out, k)
539		}
540		sort.Strings(out)
541		return out
542	}
543

1	// Package quality implements QC recording and THE safety-gate verdict writer
2	// (blueprint §8.3). It is the only module permitted to move a BMC lot or a
3	// processing batch out of QC_PENDING: a passing result certifies the subject
4	// (PASSED + certificate), a failing result quarantines it (BLOCKED + reasons).
5	// Aflatoxin M1 is heat-stable and survives pasteurisation, so this gate runs
6	// upstream at the BMC and the plant lab — never only at the finished product.
7	//
8	// A blocked subject can never advance; the plant module enforces that by
9	// refusing blocked inputs and by reacting to eventbus.TopicGateBlocked.
10	package quality
11	
12	import (
13		"log/slog"
14	
15		"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
16	
17		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
18		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
19		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/middleware"
20	)
21	
22	// Register wires the quality module and mounts its routes under /quality
23	// (the router hands us the /api/v1 subtree).
24	func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
25		log := d.Log.With(slog.String("module", "quality"))
26		repo := newRepository(d.DB)
27		svc := newService(d, repo, log)
28		h := newHandler(svc)
29	
30		r.Route("/quality", func(r chi.Router) {
31			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
32	
33			// FSSAI limit constants — reference data for any signed-in client.
34			r.With(middleware.RequireSession).Get("/limits", h.getLimits)
35	
36			// Verdict writing: analyst roles only. Both roles share the endpoint;
37			// the stage×role pairing (BMC_RAPID↔BMC_OPERATOR, PLANT_LAB↔
38			// PLANT_LAB_ANALYST) is enforced in the service.
39			r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleBMCOperator, domain.RolePlantLabAnalyst)).
40				Post("/qc-results", h.recordQCResult)
41	
42			// Reads for supply-chain staff and oversight roles.
43			readRoles := middleware.RequireRoles(
44				domain.RoleBMCOperator,
45				domain.RolePlantLabAnalyst,
46				domain.RolePlantOperator,
47				domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor,
48				domain.RoleMissionOfficial,
49				domain.RoleStateAuditor,
50			)
51			r.With(readRoles).Get("/qc-results", h.listQCResults)
52			r.With(readRoles).Get("/qc-results/{id}", h.getQCResult)
53		})
54	}
55

1	package publictrace
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"errors"
6		"fmt"
7	
8		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
9		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
10		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
11		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo/options"
12	
13		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
14		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/mongodb"
16	)
17	
18	// repo is the read-mostly MongoDB access layer for the trace views. It reads
19	// other modules' collections strictly via the mongodb.Coll* consts, exactly
20	// where the spec sanctions it (QR → lot → batch → qc / consignment lookups).
21	//
22	// Not-found is returned as a typed httpx.NotFound; every unexpected DB error
23	// is wrapped with its operation so the service's ERROR log names the failing
24	// op.
25	type repo struct {
26		batchQRs     *mongo.Collection
27		productLots  *mongo.Collection
28		batches      *mongo.Collection
29		qcResults    *mongo.Collection
30		consignments *mongo.Collection
31	}
32	
33	// newRepo binds the repo to the shared database.
34	func newRepo(db *mongo.Database) *repo {
35		return &repo{
36			batchQRs:     db.Collection(mongodb.CollBatchQRs),
37			productLots:  db.Collection(mongodb.CollProductLots),
38			batches:      db.Collection(mongodb.CollBatches),
39			qcResults:    db.Collection(mongodb.CollQCResults),
40			consignments: db.Collection(mongodb.CollConsignments),
41		}
42	}
43	
44	// qrByCode loads a batch QR by its short public code — qr_code is the unique
45	// human-readable business key (never an ObjectID).
46	func (r *repo) qrByCode(ctx context.Context, code string) (*domain.BatchQR, error) {
47		var qr domain.BatchQR
48		err := r.batchQRs.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "qr_code", Value: code}}).Decode(&qr)
49		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
50			return nil, httpx.NotFound("qr code")
51		}
52		if err != nil {
53			return nil, fmt.Errorf("find qr by code: %w", err)
54		}
55		return &qr, nil
56	}
57	
58	// incrementScanCount bumps the QR's scan counter. Called fire-and-forget by
59	// the service so it never delays a consumer scan.
60	func (r *repo) incrementScanCount(ctx context.Context, qrID primitive.ObjectID) error {
61		_, err := r.batchQRs.UpdateOne(ctx,
62			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: qrID}},
63			bson.D{{Key: "$inc", Value: bson.D{{Key: "scan_count", Value: int64(1)}}}},
64		)
65		if err != nil {
66			return fmt.Errorf("increment qr scan_count: %w", err)
67		}
68		return nil
69	}
70	
71	// productLotByID loads a product lot.
72	func (r *repo) productLotByID(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.ProductLot, error) {
73		var lot domain.ProductLot
74		err := r.productLots.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&lot)
75		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
76			return nil, httpx.NotFound("product lot")
77		}
78		if err != nil {
79			return nil, fmt.Errorf("find product lot: %w", err)
80		}
81		return &lot, nil
82	}
83	
84	// batchByID loads a processing batch.
85	func (r *repo) batchByID(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.ProcessingBatch, error) {
86		var batch domain.ProcessingBatch
87		err := r.batches.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&batch)
88		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
89			return nil, httpx.NotFound("processing batch")
90		}
91		if err != nil {
92			return nil, fmt.Errorf("find processing batch: %w", err)
93		}
94		return &batch, nil
95	}
96	
97	// latestPlantLabPass returns the most recent passing PLANT_LAB QC result for
98	// a batch, or nil when none exists yet (absence is not an error — the public
99	// view simply omits the certificate).
100	func (r *repo) latestPlantLabPass(ctx context.Context, batchID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.QCResult, error) {
101		var qc domain.QCResult
102		err := r.qcResults.FindOne(ctx,
103			bson.D{
104				{Key: "subject_type", Value: domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch},
105				{Key: "subject_id", Value: batchID},
106				{Key: "stage", Value: domain.QCStagePlantLab},
107				{Key: "overall_pass", Value: true},
108				// A result voided after losing the gate race carries no verdict.
109				{Key: "superseded", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$ne", Value: true}}},
110			},
111			options.FindOne().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "recorded_at", Value: -1}}),
112		).Decode(&qc)
113		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
114			return nil, nil
115		}
116		if err != nil {
117			return nil, fmt.Errorf("find latest plant lab pass: %w", err)
118		}
119		return &qc, nil
120	}
121	
122	// consignmentsByIDs loads consignment documents by ObjectID — the fallback
123	// source of contributing-DCS ids and collection dates when the ledger events
124	// did not carry them in org_unit_id/payload. Input is bounded by the trace
125	// event cap.
126	func (r *repo) consignmentsByIDs(ctx context.Context, ids []primitive.ObjectID) ([]domain.DCSConsignment, error) {
127		if len(ids) == 0 {
128			return nil, nil
129		}
130		cur, err := r.consignments.Find(ctx,
131			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: ids}}}},
132		)
133		if err != nil {
134			return nil, fmt.Errorf("find consignments by ids: %w", err)
135		}
136		var out []domain.DCSConsignment
137		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
138			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode consignments by ids: %w", err)
139		}
140		return out, nil
141	}

14	// handler is the HTTP layer: decode, validate shape, call service, respond.
15	type handler struct {
16		svc *service
17	}
18	
19	// newHandler wires the handler.
20	func newHandler(svc *service) *handler {
21		return &handler{svc: svc}
22	}
23	
24	// recordQCResult handles POST /quality/qc-results.
25	func (h *handler) recordQCResult(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
26		actor, ok := auth.ActorFrom(r.Context())
27		if !ok {
28			httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Unauthorized("authentication required"))
29			return
30		}
31	
32		var req RecordQCResultRequest
33		if err := httpx.DecodeJSON(r, &req); err != nil {
34			httpx.Error(w, r, err)
35			return
36		}
37		if err := validateRecordRequest(req); err != nil {
38			httpx.Error(w, r, err)
39			return
40		}
41	
42		result, err := h.svc.recordQCResult(r.Context(), actor, req)
43		if err != nil {
44			httpx.Error(w, r, err)
45			return
46		}
47		httpx.JSON(w, http.StatusCreated, result)
48	}
49	
50	// validateRecordRequest checks required fields and test shape.
51	func validateRecordRequest(req RecordQCResultRequest) error {
52		if strings.TrimSpace(req.SubjectType) == "" {
53			return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_SUBJECT_TYPE", "subject_type is required")
54		}
55		if req.SubjectID.IsZero() {
56			return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_SUBJECT_ID", "subject_id is required")
57		}
58		if strings.TrimSpace(req.Stage) == "" {
59			return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_STAGE", "stage is required")
60		}
61		if len(req.Tests) == 0 {
62			return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_TESTS", "at least one test is required")
63		}
64		for i, t := range req.Tests {
65			if strings.TrimSpace(t.Name) == "" {
66				return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_TEST_NAME", "tests["+strconv.Itoa(i)+"].name is required")
67			}
68			if t.Value < 0 {
69				return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_TEST_VALUE", "tests["+strconv.Itoa(i)+"].value must not be negative")
70			}
71		}
72		return nil
73	}
74	
75	// listQCResults handles GET /quality/qc-results?subject_type=&subject_id=.
76	func (h *handler) listQCResults(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
77		actor, ok := auth.ActorFrom(r.Context())
78		if !ok {
79			httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Unauthorized("authentication required"))
80			return
81		}
82	
83		subjectType := r.URL.Query().Get("subject_type")
84		subjectID := primitive.NilObjectID
85		if raw := r.URL.Query().Get("subject_id"); raw != "" {
86			id, err := httpx.ParseID(raw, "subject_id")
87			if err != nil {
88				httpx.Error(w, r, err)
89				return
90			}
91			subjectID = id
92		}
93		page := httpx.ParsePage(r)
94	
95		results, total, err := h.svc.listQCResults(r.Context(), actor, subjectType, subjectID, page)
96		if err != nil {
97			httpx.Error(w, r, err)
98			return
99		}
100		httpx.JSONMeta(w, http.StatusOK, results, listMeta{Limit: page.Limit, Offset: page.Offset, Total: total})
101	}
102	
103	// getQCResult handles GET /quality/qc-results/{id}.
104	func (h *handler) getQCResult(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
105		actor, ok := auth.ActorFrom(r.Context())
106		if !ok {

package plant

import (
	"context"
	"time"

	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo/options"

	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/mongodb"
)

// Repo is the plant module's MongoDB access layer. All state transitions use
// optimistic filters on the expected status — no transactions (standalone
// server), so a lost race simply matches zero documents and the service
// reports a conflict instead of corrupting state.
type Repo struct {
	consignments *mongo.Collection
	routeTrips   *mongo.Collection
	bmcLots      *mongo.Collection
	batches      *mongo.Collection
	productLots  *mongo.Collection
	qrs          *mongo.Collection
	counters     *mongo.Collection
}

// NewRepo binds the repo to the shared database.
func NewRepo(db *mongo.Database) *Repo {
	return &Repo{
		consignments: db.Collection(mongodb.CollConsignments),
		routeTrips:   db.Collection(mongodb.CollRouteTrips),
		bmcLots:      db.Collection(mongodb.CollBMCLots),
		batches:      db.Collection(mongodb.CollBatches),
		productLots:  db.Collection(mongodb.CollProductLots),
		qrs:          db.Collection(mongodb.CollBatchQRs),
		counters:     db.Collection(mongodb.CollCounters),
	}
}

// TripDeliveryBMCByIDs returns, for each given route-trip id, the BMC it was
// delivered to (empty if the trip is not yet DELIVERED). Used to verify that a
// consignment being pooled was actually delivered to THIS BMC. Read-only view
// into the logistics module's route_trips (sanctioned cross-collection read).
func (r *Repo) TripDeliveryBMCByIDs(ctx context.Context, ids []primitive.ObjectID) (map[primitive.ObjectID]primitive.ObjectID, error) {
	cur, err := r.routeTrips.Find(ctx,
		bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: ids}}}, {Key: "status", Value: domain.TripStatusDelivered}},
		options.Find().SetProjection(bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: 1}, {Key: "delivered_to_bmc_id", Value: 1}}))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var rows []struct {
		ID    primitive.ObjectID  `bson:"_id"`
		BMCID *primitive.ObjectID `bson:"delivered_to_bmc_id"`
	}
	if err := cur.All(ctx, &rows); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	out := make(map[primitive.ObjectID]primitive.ObjectID, len(rows))
	for _, row := range rows {
		if row.BMCID != nil {
			out[row.ID] = *row.BMCID
		}
	}
	return out, nil
}

// --- consignments (read + claim; owned by the logistics module otherwise) ---

// ConsignmentsByIDs loads the given consignments (missing IDs simply absent).
func (r *Repo) ConsignmentsByIDs(ctx context.Context, ids []primitive.ObjectID) ([]domain.DCSConsignment, error) {
	cur, err := r.consignments.Find(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: ids}}}})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	out := []domain.DCSConsignment{}
	if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return out, nil
}

// ClaimConsignments atomically flips DELIVERED consignments to ACCEPTED and
// stamps the pooling lot ID. Returns how many were actually claimed — fewer
// than requested means another lot raced us on at least one consignment.
func (r *Repo) ClaimConsignments(ctx context.Context, ids []primitive.ObjectID, bmcLotID primitive.ObjectID) (int64, error) {
	res, err := r.consignments.UpdateMany(ctx,
		bson.D{
			{Key: "_id", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: ids}}},
			{Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusDelivered},
		},
		bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
			{Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusAccepted},
			{Key: "bmc_lot_id", Value: bmcLotID},
		}}},
	)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	return res.ModifiedCount, nil
}

// ReleaseConsignments undoes a partial claim (compensating action for a lost
// race): everything stamped with this lot ID goes back to DELIVERED.
func (r *Repo) ReleaseConsignments(ctx context.Context, bmcLotID primitive.ObjectID) error {
	_, err := r.consignments.UpdateMany(ctx,
		bson.D{{Key: "bmc_lot_id", Value: bmcLotID}},
		bson.D{
			{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusDelivered}}},
			{Key: "$unset", Value: bson.D{{Key: "bmc_lot_id", Value: ""}}},
		},
	)
	return err
}

// --- BMC lots ---

// InsertBMCLot stores a new lot.
func (r *Repo) InsertBMCLot(ctx context.Context, lot *domain.BMCLot) error {
	_, err := r.bmcLots.InsertOne(ctx, lot)
	return err
}

// BMCLotByID loads one lot (mongo.ErrNoDocuments when absent).
func (r *Repo) BMCLotByID(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.BMCLot, error) {
	var lot domain.BMCLot
	if err := r.bmcLots.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&lot); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &lot, nil
}

// BMCLotsByIDs loads the given lots (missing IDs simply absent).
func (r *Repo) BMCLotsByIDs(ctx context.Context, ids []primitive.ObjectID) ([]domain.BMCLot, error) {
	cur, err := r.bmcLots.Find(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: ids}}}})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	out := []domain.BMCLot{}
	if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return out, nil
}

// CloseBMCLot transitions OPEN→QC_PENDING with the chilling temperature.
// Returns false when the lot was not OPEN (already closed, or raced).
func (r *Repo) CloseBMCLot(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID, tempC float64, closedAt time.Time) (bool, error) {
	res, err := r.bmcLots.UpdateOne(ctx,
		bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}, {Key: "status", Value: domain.BMCLotStatusOpen}},
		bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
			{Key: "status", Value: domain.BMCLotStatusQCPending},
			{Key: "chilling_temp_c", Value: tempC},
			{Key: "closed_at", Value: closedAt},
		}}},
	)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	return res.MatchedCount > 0, nil
}

// DispatchBMCLot transitions PASSED→DISPATCHED. The status filter IS the
// safety gate at the datastore level: a BLOCKED or QC_PENDING lot can never
// match this update.
func (r *Repo) DispatchBMCLot(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID, dispatchedAt time.Time) (bool, error) {
	res, err := r.bmcLots.UpdateOne(ctx,
		bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}, {Key: "status", Value: domain.BMCLotStatusPassed}},
		bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
			{Key: "status", Value: domain.BMCLotStatusDispatched},
			{Key: "dispatched_at", Value: dispatchedAt},
		}}},
	)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	return res.MatchedCount > 0, nil
}

// ClaimBMCLots atomically claims DISPATCHED lots for a processing batch:
// DISPATCHED→POOLED stamped with the batch ID. Returns how many were actually
// claimed — fewer than requested means another batch raced us on at least one
// lot (or a lot was not DISPATCHED), and the caller must roll back.
func (r *Repo) ClaimBMCLots(ctx context.Context, ids []primitive.ObjectID, batchID primitive.ObjectID) (int64, error) {
	res, err := r.bmcLots.UpdateMany(ctx,
		bson.D{
			{Key: "_id", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: ids}}},
			{Key: "status", Value: domain.BMCLotStatusDispatched},
		},
		bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
			{Key: "status", Value: domain.BMCLotStatusPooled},
			{Key: "batch_id", Value: batchID},
		}}},
	)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	return res.ModifiedCount, nil
}

// ReleaseBMCLots undoes a partial claim (compensating action for a lost
// race): every lot stamped with this batch ID goes back to DISPATCHED.
func (r *Repo) ReleaseBMCLots(ctx context.Context, batchID primitive.ObjectID) error {
	_, err := r.bmcLots.UpdateMany(ctx,
		bson.D{
			{Key: "batch_id", Value: batchID},
			{Key: "status", Value: domain.BMCLotStatusPooled},
		},
		bson.D{
			{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: domain.BMCLotStatusDispatched}}},
			{Key: "$unset", Value: bson.D{{Key: "batch_id", Value: ""}}},
		},
	)
	return err
}

// BMCLotListFilter narrows the BMC lot listing. Zero-valued fields are
// ignored.
type BMCLotListFilter struct {
	BMCID  primitive.ObjectID
	Date   string
	Status string
}

// ListBMCLots returns a page of lots plus the total match count.
func (r *Repo) ListBMCLots(ctx context.Context, f BMCLotListFilter, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.BMCLot, int64, error) {
	filter := bson.D{}
	if !f.BMCID.IsZero() {
		filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "bmc_id", Value: f.BMCID})
	}
	if f.Date != "" {
		filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "date", Value: f.Date})
	}
	if f.Status != "" {
		filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "status", Value: f.Status})
	}
	total, err := r.bmcLots.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, err
	}
	cur, err := r.bmcLots.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
		SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "date", Value: -1}, {Key: "created_at", Value: -1}}).
		SetSkip(page.Offset).SetLimit(page.Limit))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, err
	}
	out := []domain.BMCLot{}
	if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
		return nil, 0, err
	}
	return out, total, nil
}

// --- processing batches ---

// NextSequence atomically increments and returns the named counter — the
// transaction-free way to mint gapless human-readable numbers.
func (r *Repo) NextSequence(ctx context.Context, key string) (int64, error) {
	var doc struct {
		Seq int64 `bson:"seq"`
	}
	err := r.counters.FindOneAndUpdate(ctx,
		bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: key}},
		bson.D{{Key: "$inc", Value: bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: int64(1)}}}},
		options.FindOneAndUpdate().SetUpsert(true).SetReturnDocument(options.After),
	).Decode(&doc)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	return doc.Seq, nil
}

// InsertBatch stores a new processing batch.
func (r *Repo) InsertBatch(ctx context.Context, b *domain.ProcessingBatch) error {
	_, err := r.batches.InsertOne(ctx, b)
	return err
}

// BatchByID loads one batch (mongo.ErrNoDocuments when absent).
func (r *Repo) BatchByID(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.ProcessingBatch, error) {
	var b domain.ProcessingBatch
	if err := r.batches.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&b); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &b, nil
}

// CompleteBatch transitions PASSED→COMPLETED. The status filter enforces the
// gate: an unpassed batch can never match.
func (r *Repo) CompleteBatch(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID, completedAt time.Time) (bool, error) {
	res, err := r.batches.UpdateOne(ctx,
		bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}, {Key: "status", Value: domain.BatchStatusPassed}},
		bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
			{Key: "status", Value: domain.BatchStatusCompleted},
			{Key: "completed_at", Value: completedAt},
		}}},
	)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	return res.MatchedCount > 0, nil
}

// BatchListFilter narrows the batch listing. Zero-valued fields are ignored.
type BatchListFilter struct {
	PlantID primitive.ObjectID
	Status  string
}

// ListBatches returns a page of batches plus the total match count.
func (r *Repo) ListBatches(ctx context.Context, f BatchListFilter, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.ProcessingBatch, int64, error) {
	filter := bson.D{}
	if !f.PlantID.IsZero() {
		filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "plant_id", Value: f.PlantID})
	}
	if f.Status != "" {
		filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "status", Value: f.Status})
	}
	total, err := r.batches.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, err
	}
	cur, err := r.batches.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
		SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "started_at", Value: -1}}).
		SetSkip(page.Offset).SetLimit(page.Limit))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, err
	}
	out := []domain.ProcessingBatch{}
	if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
		return nil, 0, err
	}
	return out, total, nil
}

// --- product lots ---

// InsertProductLot stores a new product lot.
func (r *Repo) InsertProductLot(ctx context.Context, p *domain.ProductLot) error {
	_, err := r.productLots.InsertOne(ctx, p)
	return err
}

// ProductLotByID loads one product lot (mongo.ErrNoDocuments when absent).
func (r *Repo) ProductLotByID(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.ProductLot, error) {
	var p domain.ProductLot
	if err := r.productLots.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&p); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &p, nil
}

// RecallProductLot flips any not-yet-recalled lot to RECALLED with the reason.
// Returns false when the lot was already recalled (idempotency guard).
func (r *Repo) RecallProductLot(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID, reason string) (bool, error) {
	res, err := r.productLots.UpdateOne(ctx,
		bson.D{
			{Key: "_id", Value: id},
			{Key: "status", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$ne", Value: domain.ProductLotStatusRecalled}}},
		},
		bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
			{Key: "status", Value: domain.ProductLotStatusRecalled},
			{Key: "recall_reason", Value: reason},
		}}},
	)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	return res.MatchedCount > 0, nil
}

// --- batch QRs ---

// InsertQR stores a freshly minted QR. A duplicate-key error means the random
// short code collided — the service regenerates and retries.
func (r *Repo) InsertQR(ctx context.Context, qr *domain.BatchQR) error {
	_, err := r.qrs.InsertOne(ctx, qr)
	return err
}

// DeleteQR removes a just-minted QR whose lot turned out to be no longer
// ACTIVE at write time (compensating action — the QR was never returned to
// the caller, so nothing references it).
func (r *Repo) DeleteQR(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID) error {
	_, err := r.qrs.DeleteOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}})
	return err
}

// TouchActiveLot performs a no-op conditional write on an ACTIVE product lot
// ($inc of a stamp counter). MatchedCount == 0 proves the lot is no longer
// ACTIVE (e.g. recalled mid-request) at datastore level.
func (r *Repo) TouchActiveLot(ctx context.Context, lotID primitive.ObjectID) (bool, error) {
	res, err := r.productLots.UpdateOne(ctx,
		bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: lotID}, {Key: "status", Value: domain.ProductLotStatusActive}},
		bson.D{{Key: "$inc", Value: bson.D{{Key: "qr_issue_stamp", Value: int64(1)}}}},
	)
	if err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	return res.MatchedCount > 0, nil
}

// QRListFilter narrows the QR listing. A zero ProductLotID is ignored.
type QRListFilter struct {
	ProductLotID primitive.ObjectID
}

// ListQRs returns a page of QRs plus the total match count.
func (r *Repo) ListQRs(ctx context.Context, f QRListFilter, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.BatchQR, int64, error) {
	filter := bson.D{}
	if !f.ProductLotID.IsZero() {
		filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "product_lot_id", Value: f.ProductLotID})
	}
	total, err := r.qrs.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, err
	}
	cur, err := r.qrs.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
		SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "issued_at", Value: -1}}).
		SetSkip(page.Offset).SetLimit(page.Limit))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, err
	}
	out := []domain.BatchQR{}
	if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
		return nil, 0, err
	}
	return out, total, nil
}

// --- provenance back-references ---

// SetBMCLotProvenanceSeq stamps the ledger sequence onto a lot document.
func (r *Repo) SetBMCLotProvenanceSeq(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID, seq int64) error {
	return r.setProvenanceSeq(ctx, r.bmcLots, id, seq)
}

// SetBatchProvenanceSeq stamps the ledger sequence onto a batch document.
func (r *Repo) SetBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID, seq int64) error {
	return r.setProvenanceSeq(ctx, r.batches, id, seq)
}

// SetProductLotProvenanceSeq stamps the ledger sequence onto a product lot.
func (r *Repo) SetProductLotProvenanceSeq(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID, seq int64) error {
	return r.setProvenanceSeq(ctx, r.productLots, id, seq)
}

// SetQRProvenanceSeq stamps the ledger sequence onto a QR document.
func (r *Repo) SetQRProvenanceSeq(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID, seq int64) error {
	return r.setProvenanceSeq(ctx, r.qrs, id, seq)
}

func (r *Repo) setProvenanceSeq(ctx context.Context, coll *mongo.Collection, id primitive.ObjectID, seq int64) error {
	_, err := coll.UpdateOne(ctx,
		bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}},
		bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "provenance_seq", Value: seq}}}},
	)
	return err
}

14		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/mongodb"
16	)
17	
18	// repository is all MongoDB access for the quality module. It owns qc_results
19	// and — as the safety-gate verdict writer (blueprint §8.3) — performs the
20	// documented cross-collection status write onto bmc_lots and
21	// processing_batches. No other module may flip those gate statuses.
22	type repository struct {
23		results  *mongo.Collection
24		bmcLots  *mongo.Collection
25		batches  *mongo.Collection
26		counters *mongo.Collection
27	}
28	
29	// newRepository binds the repository to its collections.
30	func newRepository(db *mongo.Database) *repository {
31		return &repository{
32			results:  db.Collection(mongodb.CollQCResults),
33			bmcLots:  db.Collection(mongodb.CollBMCLots),
34			batches:  db.Collection(mongodb.CollBatches),
35			counters: db.Collection(mongodb.CollCounters),
36		}
37	}
38	
39	// insertResult stores a new QC result document (its _id is pre-generated by
40	// the service so provenance refs and the gate write share one ID).
41	func (r *repository) insertResult(ctx context.Context, res *domain.QCResult) error {
42		if _, err := r.results.InsertOne(ctx, res); err != nil {
43			return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("insert qc result: %w", err))
44		}
45		return nil
46	}
47	
48	// setResultProvenanceSeq stamps the ledger sequence onto a stored result.
49	func (r *repository) setResultProvenanceSeq(ctx context.Context, resultID primitive.ObjectID, seq int64) error {
50		_, err := r.results.UpdateOne(ctx,
51			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: resultID}},
52			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "provenance_seq", Value: seq}}}},
53		)
54		if err != nil {
55			return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("set qc result provenance seq: %w", err))
56		}
57		return nil
58	}
59	
60	// markResultSuperseded voids a result that lost the gate race — the subject's
61	// verdict came from a different, earlier result.
62	func (r *repository) markResultSuperseded(ctx context.Context, resultID primitive.ObjectID) error {
63		_, err := r.results.UpdateOne(ctx,
64			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: resultID}},
65			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "superseded", Value: true}}}},
66		)
67		if err != nil {
68			return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("mark qc result superseded: %w", err))
69		}
70		return nil
71	}
72	
73	// findResultByID returns one QC result or NotFound.
74	func (r *repository) findResultByID(ctx context.Context, resultID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.QCResult, error) {
75		var res domain.QCResult
76		err := r.results.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: resultID}}).Decode(&res)
77		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
78			return nil, httpx.NotFound("qc result")
79		}
80		if err != nil {
81			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("find qc result: %w", err))
82		}
83		return &res, nil
84	}
85	
86	// listResults returns a page of QC results, newest first, optionally filtered
87	// by subject (a zero subjectID means "no subject filter"). It also returns
88	// the total matching count for pagination meta.
89	func (r *repository) listResults(ctx context.Context, subjectType string, subjectID primitive.ObjectID, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.QCResult, int64, error) {
90		filter := bson.D{}
91		if subjectType != "" {
92			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "subject_type", Value: subjectType})
93		}
94		if !subjectID.IsZero() {
95			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "subject_id", Value: subjectID})
96		}
97	
98		total, err := r.results.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
99		if err != nil {
100			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("count qc results: %w", err))
101		}
102	
103		cur, err := r.results.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
104			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "recorded_at", Value: -1}}).
105			SetSkip(page.Offset).
106			SetLimit(page.Limit),
107		)
108		if err != nil {
109			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("list qc results: %w", err))
110		}
111		results := []domain.QCResult{}
112		if err := cur.All(ctx, &results); err != nil {
113			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("decode qc results: %w", err))
114		}
115		return results, total, nil
116	}
117	
118	// findBMCLot returns a BMC lot or NotFound.
119	func (r *repository) findBMCLot(ctx context.Context, lotID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.BMCLot, error) {
120		var lot domain.BMCLot
121		err := r.bmcLots.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: lotID}}).Decode(&lot)
122		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
123			return nil, httpx.NotFound("bmc lot")
124		}
125		if err != nil {
126			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("find bmc lot: %w", err))
127		}
128		return &lot, nil
129	}
130	
131	// findBatch returns a processing batch or NotFound.
132	func (r *repository) findBatch(ctx context.Context, batchID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.ProcessingBatch, error) {
133		var batch domain.ProcessingBatch
134		err := r.batches.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: batchID}}).Decode(&batch)
135		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
136			return nil, httpx.NotFound("processing batch")
137		}
138		if err != nil {
139			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("find processing batch: %w", err))
140		}
141		return &batch, nil
142	}
143	
144	// gateBMCLot applies the gate verdict to a BMC lot still in QC_PENDING.
145	// Returns false when the lot was already gated by a concurrent writer.
146	func (r *repository) gateBMCLot(ctx context.Context, lotID, resultID primitive.ObjectID, newStatus, blockReason string) (bool, error) {
147		return gateSubjectDoc(ctx, r.bmcLots, lotID, domain.BMCLotStatusQCPending, resultID, newStatus, blockReason)
148	}
149	
150	// gateBatch applies the gate verdict to a processing batch still in QC_PENDING.
151	// Returns false when the batch was already gated by a concurrent writer.
152	func (r *repository) gateBatch(ctx context.Context, batchID, resultID primitive.ObjectID, newStatus, blockReason string) (bool, error) {
153		return gateSubjectDoc(ctx, r.batches, batchID, domain.BatchStatusQCPending, resultID, newStatus, blockReason)
154	}
155	
156	// gateSubjectDoc is the shared conditional gate write: the filter pins the
157	// subject to QC_PENDING so a lost race cannot double-apply a verdict — the
158	// optimistic pattern that replaces transactions on a standalone server.
159	func gateSubjectDoc(ctx context.Context, coll *mongo.Collection, subjectID primitive.ObjectID, pendingStatus string, resultID primitive.ObjectID, newStatus, blockReason string) (bool, error) {
160		set := bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: newStatus}}
161		if blockReason != "" {
162			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "block_reason", Value: blockReason})
163		}
164		res, err := coll.UpdateOne(ctx,
165			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: subjectID}, {Key: "status", Value: pendingStatus}},
166			bson.D{
167				{Key: "$set", Value: set},
168				{Key: "$push", Value: bson.D{{Key: "qc_result_ids", Value: resultID}}},
169			},
170		)
171		if err != nil {
172			return false, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("gate %s subject %s: %w", coll.Name(), subjectID.Hex(), err))
173		}
174		return res.MatchedCount == 1, nil
175	}
176	
177	// nextCertificateSeq atomically increments and returns the per-stage QC
178	// certificate counter (counters collection, upsert-on-first-use). Counter
179	// keys are human-readable strings by design — they are not entity references.
180	func (r *repository) nextCertificateSeq(ctx context.Context, stage string) (int64, error) {
181		var doc struct {
182			Seq int64 `bson:"seq"`
183		}
184		err := r.counters.FindOneAndUpdate(ctx,
185			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: "qc_certificate:" + stage}},
186			bson.D{{Key: "$inc", Value: bson.D{{Key: "seq", Value: int64(1)}}}},
187			options.FindOneAndUpdate().SetUpsert(true).SetReturnDocument(options.After),
188		).Decode(&doc)
189		if err != nil {
190			return 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("next qc certificate seq: %w", err))
191		}
192		return doc.Seq, nil
193	}

18		SubjectID   primitive.ObjectID `json:"subject_id"`
19		Stage       string             `json:"stage"` // domain.QCStageBMCRapid | domain.QCStagePlantLab
20		Tests       []QCTestInput      `json:"tests"`
21		LabRef      string             `json:"lab_ref,omitempty"`
22	}
23

25	type QCLimit struct {
26		TestName    string  `json:"test_name"`
27		Limit       float64 `json:"limit"`
28		Unit        string  `json:"unit"`
29		Comparison  string  `json:"comparison"` // MAX | MUST_BE_NEGATIVE
30		Description string  `json:"description"`

35	type LimitsResponse struct {

38	}

40	// GateBlockedPayload is published on eventbus.TopicGateBlocked when a subject
41	// fails the safety gate. A blocked lot is quarantined and can never advance —
42	// the plant module subscribes and enforces downstream. ObjectIDs marshal to
43	// plain hex strings, so structural (JSON-shape) subscribers are unaffected.
44	type GateBlockedPayload struct {

48		Stage          string             `json:"stage"`
49		FailureReasons []string           `json:"failure_reasons"`
50	}

52	// listMeta is the pagination metadata attached to list responses.
53	type listMeta struct {
54		Limit  int64 `json:"limit"`
55		Offset int64 `json:"offset"`

1	// Package identity owns authentication (OTP login, refresh-token rotation,
2	// role selection), the Party registry, org-scoped role assignments and the
3	// KYC approval workflow — blueprint §4 (identity) and §5 (roles & RBAC).
4	//
5	// The KYC flow is: login → submit KYC (PENDING) → an authorised reviewer
6	// (Organising Manager / District Verifier / PCDF Admin / Super Admin)
7	// approves or rejects → only a VERIFIED tier unlocks the matching role token.
8	//
9	// Route prefixes (mounted under /api/v1): /auth, /parties, /roles, /kyc.
10	// This module emits no provenance events; identity changes are covered by
11	// the audit middleware and explicit audit records on KYC review.
12	package identity
13	
14	import (
15		"log/slog"
16	
17		"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
18	
19		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
20		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
21		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/middleware"
22	)
23	
24	// Register wires repo → service → handler and mounts the identity routes.
25	func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
26		log := d.Log.With(slog.String("module", "identity"))
27		repo := newRepository(d.DB)
28		svc := newService(d, repo, log)
29		h := newHandler(svc)
30	
31		r.Route("/auth", func(r chi.Router) {
32			// Public login flow — no token yet.
33			r.Post("/otp/request", h.requestOTP)
34			r.Post("/otp/verify", h.verifyOTP)
35			r.Post("/refresh", h.refresh)
36	
37			// Any logged-in party (session or role token).
38			r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
39				r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT), middleware.RequireSession)
40				r.Post("/logout", h.logout)
41				r.Get("/roles", h.listMyRoles)
42				r.Post("/role/select", h.selectRole)
43			})
44		})
45	
46		r.Route("/parties", func(r chi.Router) {
47			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT), middleware.RequireSession)
48			r.Get("/me", h.getMe)
49			r.Patch("/me", h.patchMe)
50		})
51	
52		r.Route("/kyc", func(r chi.Router) {
53			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
54	
55			// Self-service KYC: any logged-in party submits evidence.
56			r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
57				r.Use(middleware.RequireSession)
58				r.Post("/aadhaar", h.verifyAadhaar)
59				r.Post("/bank", h.verifyBank)
60				r.Get("/me", h.listMyKYC)
61			})
62	
63			// Review console: ground staff and admins approve/reject PENDING KYC.
64			// Both ORGANISING_MANAGER and the app-coded ONBOARDING_EXECUTIVE qualify.
65			r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
66				r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.OnboardingReviewerRoles...))
67				r.Get("/pending", h.listPendingKYC)
68				r.Get("/pending/count", h.pendingKYCCount) // live badge value
69				r.Post("/{id}/approve", h.approveKYC)
70				r.Post("/{id}/reject", h.rejectKYC)
71			})
72		})
73	
74		r.Route("/roles", func(r chi.Router) {
75			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
76			// SUPER_ADMIN passes RequireRoles automatically; the fine-grained
77			// granter matrix (§5.2) is enforced in the service.
78			r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(
79				domain.RolePCDFAdmin,
80				domain.RoleUnionPresident,
81				domain.RoleSamitiAdhyaksh,
82				domain.RoleOrganisingManager,
83				domain.RoleOnboardingExecutive,
84			))
85			r.Post("/assignments", h.createAssignment)
86			r.Delete("/assignments/{id}", h.revokeAssignment)
87			r.Get("/assignments", h.listAssignments)
88		})
89	}

// Package platformops is the platform-operations module (blueprint §12): the
// SUPER_ADMIN feature-flag console, the STATE_AUDITOR read-only audit surface
// with its GIGW/DPDP immutable export, the notifications outbox with the mock
// SMS dispatch worker (real deployment: MSG91 / telecom DLT gateway, §13),
// and the SUPPORT_AGENT audited limited-PII lookup (§5.2 role 20).
//
// It also subscribes to cross-module bus topics — payout credited, safety
// gate blocked, MVU dispatched — and turns them into queued vernacular SMS.
package platformops

import (
	"context"
	"log/slog"

	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"

	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/eventbus"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/middleware"
)

// Register wires the platformops module and mounts /admin, /audit,
// /notifications and /support (the router hands us the /api/v1 subtree).
func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
	log := d.Log.With(slog.String("module", "platformops"))
	repo := newRepository(d.DB)
	svc := newService(d, repo, log)
	h := newHandler(svc)

	r.Route("/admin", func(r chi.Router) {
		r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))

		// PCDF_ADMIN may LIST flags; flipping one is SUPER_ADMIN only —
		// capability gating is a deliberate act (blueprint principle #6).
		r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSuperAdmin, domain.RolePCDFAdmin)).
			Get("/flags", h.listFlags)
		r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSuperAdmin)).
			Put("/flags/{key}", h.setFlag)
	})

	r.Route("/audit", func(r chi.Router) {
		r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
		r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleStateAuditor, domain.RoleSuperAdmin))

		// Read-only by design: there is deliberately NO write/delete API
		// surface for audit logs (§12) — entries land via deps.Audit only.
		r.Get("/logs", h.listAuditLogs)
...
</persisted-output>

136	// requestOTP creates a hashed OTP challenge and queues the SMS through the
137	// notification outbox (the platformops worker delivers it).
138	func (s *service) requestOTP(ctx context.Context, phone string) (*otpRequestResponse, error) {
139		now := time.Now().UTC()
140		code, err := auth.GenerateNumericOTP(otpLength)
141		if err != nil {
142			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "otp generation failed", slog.Any("err", err))
143			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
144		}
145	
146		challenge := otpChallenge{
147			ID:        uuid.NewString(),
148			Phone:     phone,
149			CodeHash:  auth.HMACHash(s.deps.Cfg.OTPHashSecret, phone, code),
150			ExpiresAt: now.Add(s.deps.Cfg.OTPTTL),
151			Attempts:  0,
152		}
153		if err := s.repo.insertOTPChallenge(ctx, challenge); err != nil {
154			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "otp challenge insert failed", slog.String("phone", phone), slog.Any("err", err))
155			return nil, err
156		}
157	
158		// Outbox SMS: the plaintext code travels only inside the notification
159		// params so the sender can deliver it; the challenge stores the hash.
160		notification := domain.Notification{
161			Phone:       phone,
162			Channel:     domain.ChannelSMS,
163			TemplateKey: domain.TemplateOTP,
164			Language:    defaultLanguage,
165			Params:      map[string]string{"otp": code},
166			Status:      domain.NotificationQueued,
167			QueuedAt:    now,
168		}
169		if party, err := s.repo.findPartyByPhone(ctx, phone); err == nil {
170			pid := party.ID
171			notification.PartyID = &pid
172			if party.PreferredLanguage != "" {
173				notification.Language = party.PreferredLanguage
174			}
175		}
176		if err := s.repo.insertNotification(ctx, notification); err != nil {
177			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "otp notification queue failed", slog.String("phone", phone), slog.Any("err", err))
178			return nil, err
179		}
180	
181		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "otp requested", slog.String("phone", phone))
182		resp := &otpRequestResponse{Phone: phone, ExpiresAt: challenge.ExpiresAt}
183		if s.deps.Cfg.OTPDevMode {
184			resp.DevOTP = code // dev only — config refuses OTP_DEV_MODE in prod
185		}
186		return resp, nil
187	}
188	
189	// verifyOTP checks the challenge and logs the phone in, creating the Party
190	// on first login (find-or-create, §4.1).
191	func (s *service) verifyOTP(ctx context.Context, phone, otp string) (*authTokensResponse, error) {
192		now := time.Now().UTC()
193	
194		challenge, err := s.repo.latestOTPChallenge(ctx, phone, now)
195		if err != nil {
196			if isNotFound(err) {
197				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "otp verify rejected: no active challenge", slog.String("phone", phone))
198				return nil, httpx.Unauthorized("no active OTP for this phone — request a new code")
199			}
200			return nil, err
201		}
202		if challenge.Attempts >= maxOTPAttempts {
203			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "otp verify rejected: too many attempts", slog.String("phone", phone))
204			return nil, httpx.TooManyRequests("too many incorrect OTP attempts — request a new code")
205		}
206		expected := auth.HMACHash(s.deps.Cfg.OTPHashSecret, phone, otp)
207		if !auth.ConstantTimeEqual(challenge.CodeHash, expected) {
208			if err := s.repo.incrementOTPAttempts(ctx, challenge.ID); err != nil {
209				return nil, err
210			}
211			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "otp verify rejected: incorrect code", slog.String("phone", phone))
212			return nil, httpx.Unauthorized("incorrect OTP")
213		}
214	
215		// Burn every outstanding challenge for this phone.
216		if err := s.repo.deleteOTPChallenges(ctx, phone); err != nil {
217			return nil, err
218		}
219	
220		party, err := s.repo.upsertPartyByPhone(ctx, phone, now)
221		if err != nil {
222			return nil, err
223		}
224		if party.Status != domain.PartyStatusActive {
225			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "otp verify rejected: party suspended",
226				slog.String("phone", phone), slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()))
227			return nil, httpx.Forbidden("party is suspended")
228		}
229		tokens, err := s.issueLoginTokens(ctx, party, now)
230		if err != nil {
231			return nil, err
232		}
233		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "party logged in",
234			slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()), slog.String("phone", phone))
235		return tokens, nil
236	}
237	
238	// issueLoginTokens mints a SESSION access token plus a fresh rotating
239	// refresh token (stored only as an HMAC digest).
240	func (s *service) issueLoginTokens(ctx context.Context, party *domain.Party, now time.Time) (*authTokensResponse, error) {
241		refreshToken, err := auth.RandomToken(32)
242		if err != nil {
243			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "refresh token generation failed", slog.Any("err", err))
244			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
245		}
246		doc := refreshTokenDoc{
247			TokenHash: auth.HMACHash(s.deps.Cfg.OTPHashSecret, refreshHashLabel, refreshToken),
248			PartyID:   party.ID,
249			ExpiresAt: now.Add(s.deps.Cfg.RefreshTokenTTL),
250			CreatedAt: now,
251		}
252		if err := s.repo.insertRefreshToken(ctx, doc); err != nil {
253			return nil, err
254		}
255		accessToken, err := s.deps.JWT.IssueSessionToken(*party)
256		if err != nil {
257			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "session token issue failed",
258				slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
259			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
260		}
261		return &authTokensResponse{
262			AccessToken:  accessToken,
263			RefreshToken: refreshToken,
264			Party:        party,
265		}, nil
266	}
267	
268	// refresh rotates a refresh token: the old token is consumed atomically and
269	// a new pair is issued — a replayed token always fails.
270	func (s *service) refresh(ctx context.Context, refreshToken string) (*authTokensResponse, error) {
271		now := time.Now().UTC()
272		tokenHash := auth.HMACHash(s.deps.Cfg.OTPHashSecret, refreshHashLabel, refreshToken)
273	
274		doc, err := s.repo.findRefreshToken(ctx, tokenHash)
275		if err != nil {
276			if isNotFound(err) {
277				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "refresh rejected: unknown token")
278				return nil, httpx.Unauthorized("invalid refresh token")
279			}
280			return nil, err
281		}
282		if !now.Before(doc.ExpiresAt) {
283			_, _ = s.repo.deleteRefreshToken(ctx, tokenHash)
284			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "refresh rejected: token expired", slog.String("party_id", doc.PartyID.Hex()))
285			return nil, httpx.Unauthorized("refresh token expired — log in again")
286		}
287	
288		// ROTATE: consume the old token first; DeletedCount==0 means a parallel
289		// request won the race, so this presentation is treated as a replay.
290		deleted, err := s.repo.deleteRefreshToken(ctx, tokenHash)
291		if err != nil {
292			return nil, err
293		}
294		if deleted == 0 {
295			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "refresh rejected: token already used", slog.String("party_id", doc.PartyID.Hex()))
296			return nil, httpx.Unauthorized("refresh token already used")
297		}
298	
299		party, err := s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, doc.PartyID)
300		if err != nil {
301			if isNotFound(err) {
302				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "refresh rejected: party gone", slog.String("party_id", doc.PartyID.Hex()))
303				return nil, httpx.Unauthorized("party no longer exists")
304			}
305			return nil, err
306		}
307		if party.Status != domain.PartyStatusActive {
308			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "refresh rejected: party suspended", slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()))
309			return nil, httpx.Forbidden("party is suspended")
310		}
311		return s.issueLoginTokens(ctx, party, now)
312	}
313	
314	// logout revokes one refresh token belonging to the caller. Idempotent.
315	func (s *service) logout(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, refreshToken string) error {
316		aid, err := actorID(actor)
317		if err != nil {
318			return err
319		}
320		tokenHash := auth.HMACHash(s.deps.Cfg.OTPHashSecret, refreshHashLabel, refreshToken)
321		return s.repo.deleteRefreshTokenForParty(ctx, tokenHash, aid)
322	}

326	// listMyRoles returns the actor's currently usable assignments, enriched
327	// with org-unit display fields for the role-switcher UI.
328	func (s *service) listMyRoles(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor) ([]assignmentWithOrg, error) {
329		aid, err := actorID(actor)
330		if err != nil {
331			return nil, err
332		}
333		assignments, err := s.repo.listActiveAssignments(ctx, aid)
334		if err != nil {
335			return nil, err
336		}
337		now := time.Now().UTC()
338		out := make([]assignmentWithOrg, 0, len(assignments))
339		for _, ra := range assignments {
340			if !ra.UsableAt(now) {
341				continue
342			}
343			out = append(out, s.withOrg(ctx, ra))
344		}
345		return out, nil
346	}
347	
348	// withOrg copies org display fields onto an assignment; enrichment is
349	// best-effort (a missing org unit never breaks the listing).
350	func (s *service) withOrg(ctx context.Context, ra domain.RoleAssignment) assignmentWithOrg {
351		enriched := assignmentWithOrg{RoleAssignment: ra}
352		if org, err := s.deps.Orgs.Get(ctx, ra.OrgUnitID); err == nil {
353			enriched.OrgName = org.Name
354			enriched.OrgType = org.Type
355			enriched.OrgCode = org.Code
356		}
357		return enriched
358	}
359	
360	// selectRole exchanges the session for a ROLE-kind token pinned to one
361	// usable assignment, gated on the role's minimum KYC tier (§5.2). With
362	// auto-verify gone, this genuinely blocks un-approved parties.
363	func (s *service) selectRole(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, assignmentID primitive.ObjectID) (*roleSelectResponse, error) {
364		aid, err := actorID(actor)
365		if err != nil {
366			return nil, err
367		}
368		assignment, err := s.repo.findAssignmentByID(ctx, assignmentID)
369		if err != nil {
370			return nil, err
371		}
372		if assignment.PartyID != aid {
373			// Same shape as an unknown ID — never confirm other parties' grants.
374			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "role select rejected: not owner",
375				slog.String("assignment_id", assignmentID.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
376			return nil, httpx.NotFound("role assignment")
377		}
378		now := time.Now().UTC()
379		if !assignment.UsableAt(now) {
380			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "role select rejected: assignment not usable",
381				slog.String("assignment_id", assignmentID.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
382			return nil, httpx.Forbidden("role assignment is revoked or outside its validity window")
383		}
384	
385		// Re-read the party: the KYC tier may have upgraded since the session
386		// token was minted.
387		party, err := s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, aid)
388		if err != nil {
389			return nil, err
390		}
391		if party.Status != domain.PartyStatusActive {
392			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "role select rejected: party suspended", slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()))
393			return nil, httpx.Forbidden("party is suspended")
394		}
395		requiredTier := domain.RequiredKYCTier[assignment.RoleCode]
396		if !domain.KYCTierSatisfies(party.KYCTier, requiredTier) {
397			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "role select rejected: kyc tier insufficient",
398				slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()),
399				slog.String("role_code", assignment.RoleCode),
400				slog.String("current_tier", party.KYCTier),
401				slog.String("required_tier", requiredTier))
402			appErr := httpx.Forbidden("your KYC tier does not permit this role — complete verification first").
403				WithDetails(map[string]string{
404					"current_tier":  party.KYCTier,
405					"required_tier": requiredTier,
406				})
407			appErr.Code = "KYC_TIER_INSUFFICIENT"
408			return nil, appErr
409		}
410	
411		org, err := s.deps.Orgs.Get(ctx, assignment.OrgUnitID)
412		if err != nil {
413			return nil, err
414		}
415		accessToken, err := s.deps.JWT.IssueRoleToken(*party, *assignment, org.Type)
416		if err != nil {
417			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "role token issue failed",
418				slog.String("assignment_id", assignmentID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
419			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
420		}
421		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "role selected",
422			slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()),
423			slog.String("assignment_id", assignmentID.Hex()),
424			slog.String("role_code", assignment.RoleCode),
425			slog.String("org_unit_id", assignment.OrgUnitID.Hex()))
426		return &roleSelectResponse{
427			AccessToken: accessToken,
428			RoleCode:    assignment.RoleCode,
429			OrgUnitID:   assignment.OrgUnitID,
430			OrgType:     org.Type,
431		}, nil
432	}

470		aid, err := actorID(actor)
471		if err != nil {
