476	
477	// --- KYC (mock DPI adapters — real UIDAI / penny-drop integration later) ---
478	
479	// verifyAadhaar runs the MOCK Aadhaar eKYC capture (§18-A). The full Aadhaar
480	// number exists only in this request's memory: what is persisted is the
481	// last 4 digits plus an opaque reference from the (mock) Aadhaar Data Vault.
482	//
483	// There is NO auto-verify and NO tier change here: the record is created
484	// PENDING and enters the approval workflow. Returns created=false when an
485	// identical PENDING request already exists (idempotent replay → 200).
486	func (s *service) verifyAadhaar(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req aadhaarKYCRequest) (*aadhaarKYCResponse, bool, error) {
487		now := time.Now().UTC()
488		aid, err := actorID(actor)
489		if err != nil {
490			return nil, false, err
491		}
492		party, err := s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, aid)
493		if err != nil {
494			return nil, false, err
495		}
496	
497		// Idempotency: an existing PENDING request for the same tier is returned
498		// as-is rather than duplicated.
499		if existing, err := s.repo.findPendingKYCRecord(ctx, party.ID, req.RequestedTier); err == nil {
500			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "kyc submit replayed idempotently",
501				slog.String("kyc_id", existing.ID.Hex()),
502				slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()),
503				slog.String("requested_tier", req.RequestedTier))
504			return &aadhaarKYCResponse{
505				Record:  existing,
506				Status:  domain.KYCStatusPending,
507				Message: msgAwaitingVerification,
508			}, false, nil
509		} else if !isNotFound(err) {
510			return nil, false, err
511		}
512	
513		language := party.PreferredLanguage
514		if language == "" {
515			language = defaultLanguage
516		}
517		// Pre-generate the consent id so the KYC record can reference it in the
518		// same flow.
519		consentID := primitive.NewObjectID()
520		consent := domain.Consent{
521			ID:          consentID,
522			PartyID:     party.ID,
523			Purpose:     consentPurposeAadhaarEKYC,
524			TextVersion: consentTextVersion,
525			Language:    language,
526			GrantedAt:   now,
527		}
528		if err := s.repo.insertConsent(ctx, consent); err != nil {
529			return nil, false, err
530		}
531	
532		// MOCK Aadhaar Data Vault (§18-A): a real deployment sends the number to
533		// the vault service and receives an opaque token. The mock mints a UUID.
534		vaultRef := uuid.NewString()
535		last4 := req.AadhaarNumber[len(req.AadhaarNumber)-4:]
536	
537		record := domain.KYCRecord{
538			ID:              primitive.NewObjectID(),
539			PartyID:         party.ID,
540			RequestedTier:   req.RequestedTier,
541			AadhaarLast4:    last4,
542			AadhaarVaultRef: vaultRef,
543			ConsentID:       &consentID,
544			Status:          domain.KYCStatusPending,
545			CreatedAt:       now,
546			UpdatedAt:       now,
547		}
548		if err := s.repo.insertKYCRecord(ctx, record); err != nil {
549			return nil, false, err
550		}
551	
552		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "kyc submitted",
553			slog.String("kyc_id", record.ID.Hex()),
554			slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()),
555			slog.String("requested_tier", req.RequestedTier))
556		// Nudge live reviewer dashboards (ephemeral SSE badge)…
557		s.publishKYCQueueChanged("submitted", record.ID, party.ID)
558		// …AND queue a PERSISTED notification to the reviewers (super admin +
559		// onboarding reviewers) so a pending verification reaches them even if no
560		// dashboard is open — the durable half of "notification + verification
561		// pending". Best-effort: a notify failure never fails the submission.
562		s.notifyReviewersKYCPending(ctx, party, req.RequestedTier)
563		return &aadhaarKYCResponse{
564			Record:  &record,
565			Status:  domain.KYCStatusPending,
566			Message: msgAwaitingVerification,
567		}, true, nil
568	}
569	
570	// notifyReviewersKYCPending queues a KYC_PENDING notification to every party
571	// holding a reviewer role, so the pending verification durably reaches the
572	// super admin / onboarding reviewers (not just a live SSE badge).
573	func (s *service) notifyReviewersKYCPending(ctx context.Context, subject *domain.Party, tier string) {
574		reviewers, err := s.repo.findPartiesByRoles(ctx, domain.OnboardingReviewerRoles, 200)
575		if err != nil {
576			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "kyc pending notify: reviewer lookup failed", slog.Any("err", err))
577			return
578		}
579		now := time.Now().UTC()
580		subjectName := subject.FullName
581		if subjectName == "" {
582			subjectName = subject.Phone
583		}
584		for _, rv := range reviewers {
585			rvID := rv.ID
586			lang := rv.PreferredLanguage
587			if lang == "" {
588				lang = defaultLanguage
589			}
590			if err := s.repo.insertNotification(ctx, domain.Notification{
591				PartyID:     &rvID,
592				Phone:       rv.Phone,
593				Channel:     domain.ChannelSMS,
594				TemplateKey: domain.TemplateKYCPending,
595				Language:    lang,
596				Params:      map[string]string{"subject": subjectName, "tier": tier},
597				Status:      domain.NotificationQueued,
598				QueuedAt:    now,
599			}); err != nil {
600				s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "kyc pending notify: insert failed",
601					slog.String("reviewer_party_id", rvID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
602			}
603		}
604		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "kyc pending notifications queued",
605			slog.String("subject_party_id", subject.ID.Hex()), slog.Int("reviewers", len(reviewers)))
606	}
607	
608	// publishKYCQueueChanged nudges the live "pending KYC" dashboard badge via the
609	// event bus → SSE hub. It is a nudge only; subscribers re-query the scoped
610	// pending count. Never blocks the request path (the bus dispatches async).
611	func (s *service) publishKYCQueueChanged(reason string, kycID, subjectID primitive.ObjectID) {
612		s.deps.Bus.Publish(eventbus.TopicKYCQueueChanged, eventbus.KYCQueueEvent{
613			Reason:    reason,
614			KYCID:     kycID.Hex(),
615			SubjectID: subjectID.Hex(),
616		})
617	}
618	
619	// verifyBank runs the MOCK penny-drop verification and stores ONLY the
620	// masked account tail and IFSC on the caller's latest KYC record (creating a
621	// PENDING record carrying just the bank evidence when none exists yet).
622	func (s *service) verifyBank(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req bankKYCRequest) (*domain.KYCRecord, error) {
623		now := time.Now().UTC()
624		aid, err := actorID(actor)
625		if err != nil {
626			return nil, err
627		}
628		party, err := s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, aid)
629		if err != nil {
630			return nil, err
631		}
632		masked := maskAccount(req.AccountNumber)
633	
634		latest, err := s.repo.latestKYCRecord(ctx, aid)
635		switch {
636		case err == nil && latest.Status == domain.KYCStatusPending:
637			// Only a PENDING record may accrue bank evidence in place — a reviewer
638			// has not yet decided it. MOCK penny-drop: fixed name-match score.
639			rec, err := s.repo.updateKYCRecordBank(ctx, latest.ID, masked, req.IFSC, mockPennyDropNameMatch, now)
640			if err != nil {
641				return nil, err
642			}
643			s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "bank evidence attached",
644				slog.String("kyc_id", rec.ID.Hex()), slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()))
645			return rec, nil
646		case err == nil, isNotFound(err):
647			// The latest record is terminal (VERIFIED/REJECTED) or none exists yet:
648			// a changed bank account must NOT silently overwrite reviewer-approved
649			// evidence, so route it back through review as a fresh PENDING record.
650			record := domain.KYCRecord{
651				ID:                primitive.NewObjectID(),
652				PartyID:           party.ID,
653				RequestedTier:     party.KYCTier,
654				BankAccountMasked: masked,
655				BankIFSC:          req.IFSC,
656				BankVerified:      true, // MOCK penny-drop: always succeeds
657				BankNameMatch:     mockPennyDropNameMatch,
658				Status:            domain.KYCStatusPending,
659				CreatedAt:         now,
660				UpdatedAt:         now,
661			}
662			if err := s.repo.insertKYCRecord(ctx, record); err != nil {
663				return nil, err
664			}
665			s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "bank evidence recorded on new pending kyc",
666				slog.String("kyc_id", record.ID.Hex()), slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()))
667			return &record, nil
668		default:
669			return nil, err
670		}
671	}
672	
673	// listMyKYC pages the caller's KYC records (masked fields only — full
674	// numbers are never persisted anywhere).
675	func (s *service) listMyKYC(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.KYCRecord, int64, error) {
676		aid, err := actorID(actor)
677		if err != nil {
678			return nil, 0, err
679		}
680		return s.repo.listKYCRecords(ctx, aid, page)
681	}
682	
683	// --- KYC approval workflow (reviewer console) ---
684	
685	// kycSubjectInScope reports whether the reviewer's org scope covers the KYC
686	// subject: true when the subject holds at least one active role assignment
687	// inside the reviewer's organisational scope (the KYC record itself carries
688	// no org, so the subject's org is resolved via their assignments — mirroring
689	// how createAssignment/revokeAssignment obtain the OrgUnitID). SUPER_ADMIN and
690	// STATE_AUDITOR are platform-wide and always cover; PCDF_ADMIN (rooted at the
691	// federation) covers naturally through RequireInScope's ancestry test.
692	func (s *service) kycSubjectInScope(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, subjectPartyID primitive.ObjectID) (bool, error) {
693		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSuperAdmin || actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleStateAuditor {
694			return true, nil
695		}
696		assignments, err := s.repo.listActiveAssignments(ctx, subjectPartyID)
697		if err != nil {
698			return false, err
699		}
700		for _, ra := range assignments {
701			if s.deps.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, ra.OrgUnitID) == nil {
702				return true, nil
703			}
704		}
705		return false, nil
706	}
707	
708	// requireKYCSubjectInScope denies the reviewer a KYC decision on a subject
709	// outside their organisational scope (a cross-org privilege escalation guard).
710	func (s *service) requireKYCSubjectInScope(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, subjectPartyID primitive.ObjectID) error {
711		inScope, err := s.kycSubjectInScope(ctx, actor, subjectPartyID)
712		if err != nil {
713			return err
714		}
715		if !inScope {
716			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "kyc review denied: subject out of scope",
717				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
718				slog.String("subject_party_id", subjectPartyID.Hex()))
719			appErr := httpx.Forbidden("KYC subject is outside your organisational scope")
720			appErr.Code = "KYC_SUBJECT_OUT_OF_SCOPE"
721			return appErr
722		}
723		return nil
724	}
725	
726	// listPendingKYC pages PENDING KYC records newest-first, constrained to
727	// subjects within the reviewer's org scope, enriched with a reviewer-facing
728	// party summary, and audits the access.
729	func (s *service) listPendingKYC(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, page httpx.Page) ([]pendingKYCItem, int64, error) {
730		records, total, err := s.repo.listPendingKYC(ctx, page)
731		if err != nil {
732			return nil, 0, err
733		}
734		ids := make([]primitive.ObjectID, 0, len(records))
735		for _, rec := range records {
736			ids = append(ids, rec.PartyID)
737		}
738		parties, err := s.repo.findPartiesByIDs(ctx, ids)
739		if err != nil {
740			return nil, 0, err
741		}
742		items := make([]pendingKYCItem, 0, len(records))
743		for _, rec := range records {
744			// Org-scope gate: a scoped reviewer only ever sees (and thus only ever
745			// gets the contact PII of) subjects within their own area.
746			inScope, err := s.kycSubjectInScope(ctx, actor, rec.PartyID)
747			if err != nil {
748				return nil, 0, err
749			}
750			if !inScope {
751				continue
752			}
753			item := pendingKYCItem{KYCRecord: rec}
754			if p, ok := parties[rec.PartyID]; ok {
755				item.Party = &pendingPartySummary{
756					ID:       p.ID,
757					Phone:    p.Phone,
758					FullName: p.FullName,
759					KYCTier:  p.KYCTier,
760				}
761			}
762			items = append(items, item)
763		}
764	
765		s.deps.Audit.Record(ctx, audit.Entry{
766			Action: "kyc.pending_list",
767			Meta:   map[string]any{"count": len(items), "total": total},
768		})
769		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "kyc pending list accessed",
770			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
771			slog.Int("count", len(items)),
772			slog.Int64("total", total))
773		return items, total, nil
774	}
775	
776	// pendingKYCScanCap bounds the scoped-count scan. The pending queue is a
777	// human-drained work-list (realistically dozens, not millions); beyond the cap
778	// the badge shows "cap+" rather than paying for an unbounded scan.
779	const pendingKYCScanCap = 1000
780	
781	// pendingKYCCount returns how many PENDING records fall within the reviewer's
782	// org scope — the live badge value. It reuses the exact scope logic of the
783	// pending list (so badge and list always agree) and dedupes the per-subject
784	// scope lookup. Returns (count, capped).
785	func (s *service) pendingKYCCount(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor) (int64, bool, error) {
786		records, _, err := s.repo.listPendingKYC(ctx, httpx.Page{Limit: pendingKYCScanCap, Offset: 0})
787		if err != nil {
788			return 0, false, err
789		}
790		scopeCache := make(map[primitive.ObjectID]bool)
791		var count int64
792		for _, rec := range records {
793			inScope, seen := scopeCache[rec.PartyID]
794			if !seen {
795				inScope, err = s.kycSubjectInScope(ctx, actor, rec.PartyID)
796				if err != nil {
797					return 0, false, err
798				}
799				scopeCache[rec.PartyID] = inScope
800			}
801			if inScope {
802				count++
803			}
804		}
805		capped := len(records) >= pendingKYCScanCap
806		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "kyc pending count",
807			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID), slog.Int64("count", count), slog.Bool("capped", capped))
808		return count, capped, nil
809	}
810	
811	// approveKYC verifies a PENDING record, upgrades the party's KYC tier upward
812	// only, notifies the party and audits the decision. The reviewer's role must
813	// be authorised for the requested tier — even SUPER_ADMIN passes through the
814	// approvable-tier map (which grants it everything).
815	func (s *service) approveKYC(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID) (*kycReviewResponse, error) {
816		now := time.Now().UTC()
817		aid, err := actorID(actor)
818		if err != nil {
819			return nil, err
820		}
821		record, err := s.repo.findKYCRecordByID(ctx, id)
822		if err != nil {
823			return nil, err
824		}
825		if record.Status != domain.KYCStatusPending {
826			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "kyc approve rejected: record not pending",
827				slog.String("kyc_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("status", record.Status),
828				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
829			return nil, httpx.Conflict("KYC_NOT_PENDING", "kyc record is not pending review")
830		}
831		// Separation of duties: a reviewer may never decide their own KYC record.
832		if record.PartyID == aid {
833			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "kyc approve rejected: self-review",

1008	// --- Role administration ---
1009	
1010	// requireGrantAuthority enforces the non-admin granter matrix (§5.2):
1011	// UNION_PRESIDENT manages village/logistics/union-tier roles anywhere in
1012	// scope; SAMITI_ADHYAKSH manages only FARMER/MILK_TESTER/LRP inside their
1013	// own DCS; ORGANISING_MANAGER enrols FARMER/CONSUMER within org scope.
1014	// Admin granters pass.
1015	func (s *service) requireGrantAuthority(actor auth.Actor, roleCode string, orgUnitID primitive.ObjectID) error {
1016		if !granterMayGrant(actor.RoleCode, roleCode) {
1017			return httpx.Forbidden("role " + actor.RoleCode + " may not grant or revoke " + roleCode)
1018		}
1019		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSamitiAdhyaksh && orgUnitID.Hex() != actor.OrgUnitID {
1020			return httpx.Forbidden("SAMITI_ADHYAKSH may manage roles only within their own DCS")
1021		}
1022		return nil
1023	}

1025	// createAssignment grants a role to a party inside an org unit.
1026	func (s *service) createAssignment(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req createAssignmentRequest) (*domain.RoleAssignment, error) {
1027		aid, err := actorID(actor)
1028		if err != nil {
1029			return nil, err
1030		}
1031	
1032		// Resolve the target party (party_id wins over phone).
1033		var party *domain.Party
1034		if req.PartyID != nil {
1035			party, err = s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, *req.PartyID)
1036		} else {
1037			party, err = s.repo.findPartyByPhone(ctx, req.Phone)
1038		}
1039		if err != nil {
1040			return nil, err
1041		}
1042	
1043		if err := s.deps.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.OrgUnitID); err != nil {
1044			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "assignment grant denied: out of scope",
1045				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
1046				slog.String("org_unit_id", req.OrgUnitID.Hex()),
1047				slog.String("role_code", req.RoleCode))
1048			return nil, err
1049		}
1050		if err := s.requireGrantAuthority(actor, req.RoleCode, req.OrgUnitID); err != nil {
1051			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "assignment grant denied: granter not authorised",
1052				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
1053				slog.String("granter_role", actor.RoleCode),
1054				slog.String("role_code", req.RoleCode))
1055			return nil, err
1056		}
1057	
1058		exists, err := s.repo.activeAssignmentExists(ctx, party.ID, req.RoleCode, req.OrgUnitID)
1059		if err != nil {
1060			return nil, err
1061		}
1062		if exists {
1063			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "assignment grant rejected: already exists",
1064				slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()),
1065				slog.String("role_code", req.RoleCode),
1066				slog.String("org_unit_id", req.OrgUnitID.Hex()))
1067			return nil, httpx.Conflict("ASSIGNMENT_EXISTS", "party already holds an active "+req.RoleCode+" assignment in this org unit")
1068		}
1069	
1070		now := time.Now().UTC()
1071		validFrom := now
1072		if req.ValidFrom != nil {
1073			validFrom = req.ValidFrom.UTC()
1074		}
1075		var validTo *time.Time
1076		if req.ValidTo != nil {
1077			t := req.ValidTo.UTC()
1078			validTo = &t
1079		}
1080		assignment := domain.RoleAssignment{
1081			ID:        primitive.NewObjectID(),
1082			PartyID:   party.ID,
1083			RoleCode:  req.RoleCode,
1084			OrgUnitID: req.OrgUnitID,
1085			GrantedBy: &aid,
1086			ValidFrom: validFrom,
1087			ValidTo:   validTo,
1088			Status:    domain.RoleAssignmentActive,
1089			CreatedAt: now,
1090		}
1091		if err := s.repo.insertAssignment(ctx, assignment); err != nil {
1092			return nil, err
1093		}
1094		s.deps.Audit.Record(ctx, audit.Entry{
1095			Action:     "role.grant",
1096			TargetType: "role_assignment",
1097			TargetID:   assignment.ID.Hex(),
1098			Meta: map[string]any{
1099				"party_id":    party.ID.Hex(),
1100				"role_code":   req.RoleCode,
1101				"org_unit_id": req.OrgUnitID.Hex(),
1102			},
1103		})
1104		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "role assignment created",
1105			slog.String("assignment_id", assignment.ID.Hex()),
1106			slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()),
1107			slog.String("role_code", req.RoleCode),
1108			slog.String("org_unit_id", req.OrgUnitID.Hex()),
1109			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
1110		return &assignment, nil
1111	}

1113	// revokeAssignment flips an assignment to REVOKED — the record is never
1114	// deleted (§4.1). Revocation authority mirrors grant authority.
1115	func (s *service) revokeAssignment(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, assignmentID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.RoleAssignment, error) {
1116		aid, err := actorID(actor)
1117		if err != nil {
1118			return nil, err
1119		}
1120		assignment, err := s.repo.findAssignmentByID(ctx, assignmentID)
1121		if err != nil {
1122			return nil, err
1123		}
1124		if err := s.deps.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, assignment.OrgUnitID); err != nil {
1125			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "assignment revoke denied: out of scope",
1126				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
1127				slog.String("assignment_id", assignmentID.Hex()))
1128			return nil, err
1129		}
1130		if err := s.requireGrantAuthority(actor, assignment.RoleCode, assignment.OrgUnitID); err != nil {
1131			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "assignment revoke denied: granter not authorised",
1132				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
1133				slog.String("granter_role", actor.RoleCode),
1134				slog.String("role_code", assignment.RoleCode))
1135			return nil, err
1136		}
1137		if assignment.Status != domain.RoleAssignmentActive {
1138			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "assignment revoke rejected: already revoked",
1139				slog.String("assignment_id", assignmentID.Hex()))
1140			return nil, httpx.Conflict("ALREADY_REVOKED", "role assignment is already revoked")
1141		}
1142		revoked, err := s.repo.revokeAssignment(ctx, assignmentID, aid, time.Now().UTC())
1143		if err != nil {
1144			return nil, err
1145		}
1146		s.deps.Audit.Record(ctx, audit.Entry{
1147			Action:     "role.revoke",
1148			TargetType: "role_assignment",
1149			TargetID:   assignmentID.Hex(),
1150			Meta: map[string]any{
1151				"party_id":    revoked.PartyID.Hex(),
1152				"role_code":   revoked.RoleCode,
1153				"org_unit_id": revoked.OrgUnitID.Hex(),
1154			},
1155		})
1156		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "role assignment revoked",
1157			slog.String("assignment_id", assignmentID.Hex()),
1158			slog.String("party_id", revoked.PartyID.Hex()),
1159			slog.String("role_code", revoked.RoleCode),
1160			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
1161		return revoked, nil
1162	}

19	// otpChallenge is the persisted OTP challenge. Only the HMAC digest of the
20	// code is stored — a DB leak alone reveals no usable credential. Challenges
21	// are keyed by phone (string) — the party may not exist yet at login time.
22	type otpChallenge struct {
23		ID        string    `bson:"_id"`
24		Phone     string    `bson:"phone"`
25		CodeHash  string    `bson:"code_hash"`
26		ExpiresAt time.Time `bson:"expires_at"`
27		Attempts  int       `bson:"attempts"`
28	}
29	
30	// refreshTokenDoc is the persisted refresh-token digest. The opaque token
31	// itself is only ever held by the client. party_id is an ObjectID reference.
32	type refreshTokenDoc struct {
33		ID        primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id,omitempty"`
34		TokenHash string             `bson:"token_hash"`
35		PartyID   primitive.ObjectID `bson:"party_id"`
36		ExpiresAt time.Time          `bson:"expires_at"`
37		CreatedAt time.Time          `bson:"created_at"`
38	}
39	
40	// repository is the MongoDB gateway for the identity module. Pure data
41	// access — no business rules.
42	type repository struct {
43		parties       *mongo.Collection
44		challenges    *mongo.Collection
45		tokens        *mongo.Collection
46		assignments   *mongo.Collection
47		kycRecords    *mongo.Collection
48		consents      *mongo.Collection
49		notifications *mongo.Collection
50	}
51	
52	// newRepository binds the repository to the module's collections.
53	func newRepository(db *mongo.Database) *repository {
54		return &repository{
55			parties:       db.Collection(mongodb.CollParties),
56			challenges:    db.Collection(mongodb.CollOTPChallenges),
57			tokens:        db.Collection(mongodb.CollRefreshTokens),
58			assignments:   db.Collection(mongodb.CollRoleAssignments),
59			kycRecords:    db.Collection(mongodb.CollKYCRecords),
60			consents:      db.Collection(mongodb.CollConsents),
61			notifications: db.Collection(mongodb.CollNotifications),
62		}
63	}
64	
65	// --- OTP challenges ---
66	
67	// insertOTPChallenge stores a fresh challenge.
68	func (r *repository) insertOTPChallenge(ctx context.Context, ch otpChallenge) error {
69		if _, err := r.challenges.InsertOne(ctx, ch); err != nil {
70			return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("insert otp challenge: %w", err))
71		}
72		return nil
73	}
74	
75	// latestOTPChallenge returns the most recent unexpired challenge for phone.
76	func (r *repository) latestOTPChallenge(ctx context.Context, phone string, now time.Time) (*otpChallenge, error) {
77		filter := bson.D{
78			{Key: "phone", Value: phone},
79			{Key: "expires_at", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$gt", Value: now}}},
80		}
81		opts := options.FindOne().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "expires_at", Value: -1}})
82		var ch otpChallenge
83		err := r.challenges.FindOne(ctx, filter, opts).Decode(&ch)
84		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
85			return nil, httpx.NotFound("otp challenge")
86		}
87		if err != nil {
88			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("find otp challenge: %w", err))
89		}
90		return &ch, nil
91	}
92	
93	// incrementOTPAttempts counts one failed verification attempt.
94	func (r *repository) incrementOTPAttempts(ctx context.Context, id string) error {
95		_, err := r.challenges.UpdateByID(ctx, id, bson.D{
96			{Key: "$inc", Value: bson.D{{Key: "attempts", Value: 1}}},
97		})
98		if err != nil {
99			return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("increment otp attempts: %w", err))
100		}
101		return nil
102	}
103	
104	// deleteOTPChallenges removes every challenge for a phone (post-login burn).
105	func (r *repository) deleteOTPChallenges(ctx context.Context, phone string) error {
106		if _, err := r.challenges.DeleteMany(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "phone", Value: phone}}); err != nil {
107			return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("delete otp challenges: %w", err))
108		}
109		return nil
110	}

122	// --- Parties ---
123	
124	// findPartyByPhone loads a party by its unique phone number (business key —
125	// display/login lookups only, never joins).
126	func (r *repository) findPartyByPhone(ctx context.Context, phone string) (*domain.Party, error) {
127		var p domain.Party
128		err := r.parties.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "phone", Value: phone}}).Decode(&p)
129		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
130			return nil, httpx.NotFound("party")
131		}
132		if err != nil {
133			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("find party by phone: %w", err))
134		}
135		return &p, nil
136	}
137	
138	// findPartyByID loads a party by ObjectID.
139	func (r *repository) findPartyByID(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.Party, error) {
140		var p domain.Party
141		err := r.parties.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&p)
142		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
143			return nil, httpx.NotFound("party")
144		}
145		if err != nil {
146			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("find party by id: %w", err))
147		}
148		return &p, nil
149	}
150	
151	// findPartiesByIDs loads a batch of parties keyed by ObjectID (list
152	// enrichment; missing parties are simply absent from the map).
153	func (r *repository) findPartiesByIDs(ctx context.Context, ids []primitive.ObjectID) (map[primitive.ObjectID]domain.Party, error) {
154		out := make(map[primitive.ObjectID]domain.Party, len(ids))
155		if len(ids) == 0 {
156			return out, nil
157		}
158		cur, err := r.parties.Find(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: ids}}}})
159		if err != nil {
160			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("find parties by ids: %w", err))
161		}
162		var parties []domain.Party
163		if err := cur.All(ctx, &parties); err != nil {
164			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("decode parties by ids: %w", err))
165		}
166		for _, p := range parties {
167			out[p.ID] = p
168		}
169		return out, nil
170	}
171	
172	// upsertPartyByPhone atomically finds or creates the party for a phone —
173	// race-safe under the unique phone index (one phone = one Party, §4.1).
174	func (r *repository) upsertPartyByPhone(ctx context.Context, phone string, now time.Time) (*domain.Party, error) {
175		update := bson.D{{Key: "$setOnInsert", Value: bson.D{
176			{Key: "_id", Value: primitive.NewObjectID()},
177			{Key: "phone", Value: phone},
178			{Key: "kyc_tier", Value: domain.KYCTierMinimal},
179			{Key: "status", Value: domain.PartyStatusActive},
180			{Key: "created_at", Value: now},
181			{Key: "updated_at", Value: now},
182		}}}
183		opts := options.FindOneAndUpdate().SetUpsert(true).SetReturnDocument(options.After)
184		var p domain.Party
185		if err := r.parties.FindOneAndUpdate(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "phone", Value: phone}}, update, opts).Decode(&p); err != nil {
186			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("upsert party by phone: %w", err))
187		}
188		return &p, nil
189	}

191	// updatePartyProfile sets the provided profile fields and returns the
192	// updated party.
193	func (r *repository) updatePartyProfile(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID, fullName, preferredLanguage *string, publicConsent *bool, now time.Time) (*domain.Party, error) {
194		set := bson.D{{Key: "updated_at", Value: now}}
195		if fullName != nil {
196			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "full_name", Value: *fullName})
197		}
198		if preferredLanguage != nil {
199			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "preferred_language", Value: *preferredLanguage})
200		}
201		if publicConsent != nil {
202			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "public_consent", Value: *publicConsent})
203		}
204		opts := options.FindOneAndUpdate().SetReturnDocument(options.After)
205		var p domain.Party
206		err := r.parties.FindOneAndUpdate(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}, bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: set}}, opts).Decode(&p)
207		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
208			return nil, httpx.NotFound("party")
209		}
210		if err != nil {
211			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("update party profile: %w", err))
212		}
213		return &p, nil
214	}

216	// updatePartyKYCTier sets the party's KYC tier.
217	func (r *repository) updatePartyKYCTier(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID, tier string, now time.Time) error {
218		_, err := r.parties.UpdateByID(ctx, id, bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
219			{Key: "kyc_tier", Value: tier},
220			{Key: "updated_at", Value: now},
221		}}})
222		if err != nil {
223			return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("update party kyc tier: %w", err))
224		}
225		return nil
226	}

238	// findRefreshToken loads a refresh-token doc by digest.

240		var doc refreshTokenDoc
241		err := r.tokens.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "token_hash", Value: tokenHash}}).Decode(&doc)
242		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {

251	// deleteRefreshToken removes a token by digest and reports how many docs
252	// went away — 0 means a concurrent rotation already consumed it.
253	func (r *repository) deleteRefreshToken(ctx context.Context, tokenHash string) (int64, error) {
254		res, err := r.tokens.DeleteOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "token_hash", Value: tokenHash}})

261	// deleteRefreshTokenForParty removes a token only if it belongs to partyID
262	// (logout can never revoke someone else's session).
263	func (r *repository) deleteRefreshTokenForParty(ctx context.Context, tokenHash string, partyID primitive.ObjectID) error {
264		_, err := r.tokens.DeleteOne(ctx, bson.D{

274	// --- Role assignments ---
275	
276	// listActiveAssignments returns a party's ACTIVE assignments (validity-window
277	// filtering happens in the service via UsableAt).
278	func (r *repository) listActiveAssignments(ctx context.Context, partyID primitive.ObjectID) ([]domain.RoleAssignment, error) {
279		filter := bson.D{
280			{Key: "party_id", Value: partyID},
281			{Key: "status", Value: domain.RoleAssignmentActive},
282		}
283		cur, err := r.assignments.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "created_at", Value: -1}}))
284		if err != nil {
285			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("list active assignments: %w", err))
286		}
287		out := make([]domain.RoleAssignment, 0)
288		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
289			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("decode active assignments: %w", err))
290		}
291		return out, nil
292	}
293	
294	// findPartiesByRoles returns the distinct parties holding an ACTIVE assignment
295	// for any of the given role codes — used to notify KYC reviewers that a
296	// verification is pending. Capped so a broad role never floods the outbox.
297	func (r *repository) findPartiesByRoles(ctx context.Context, roleCodes []string, limit int64) ([]domain.Party, error) {
298		assignFilter := bson.D{
299			{Key: "role_code", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: roleCodes}}},
300			{Key: "status", Value: domain.RoleAssignmentActive},
301		}
302		cur, err := r.assignments.Find(ctx, assignFilter,
303			options.Find().SetProjection(bson.D{{Key: "party_id", Value: 1}}).SetLimit(limit))
304		if err != nil {
305			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("find reviewer assignments: %w", err))
306		}
307		var rows []struct {
308			PartyID primitive.ObjectID `bson:"party_id"`
309		}
310		if err := cur.All(ctx, &rows); err != nil {
311			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("decode reviewer assignments: %w", err))
312		}
313		seen := make(map[primitive.ObjectID]struct{}, len(rows))
314		ids := make([]primitive.ObjectID, 0, len(rows))
315		for _, row := range rows {
316			if _, ok := seen[row.PartyID]; ok {
317				continue
318			}
319			seen[row.PartyID] = struct{}{}
320			ids = append(ids, row.PartyID)
321		}
322		byID, err := r.findPartiesByIDs(ctx, ids)
323		if err != nil {
324			return nil, err
325		}
326		out := make([]domain.Party, 0, len(byID))
327		for _, id := range ids {
328			if p, ok := byID[id]; ok {
329				out = append(out, p)
330			}
331		}
332		return out, nil
333	}

337		var ra domain.RoleAssignment
338		err := r.assignments.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&ra)

348	// activeAssignmentExists reports whether the party already holds an ACTIVE
349	// assignment of roleCode in orgUnitID (grant idempotency guard).
350	func (r *repository) activeAssignmentExists(ctx context.Context, partyID primitive.ObjectID, roleCode string, orgUnitID primitive.ObjectID) (bool, error) {
351		filter := bson.D{
352			{Key: "party_id", Value: partyID},
353			{Key: "role_code", Value: roleCode},
354			{Key: "org_unit_id", Value: orgUnitID},
355			{Key: "status", Value: domain.RoleAssignmentActive},
356		}
357		n, err := r.assignments.CountDocuments(ctx, filter, options.Count().SetLimit(1))
358		if err != nil {
359			return false, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("count active assignments: %w", err))
360		}
361		return n > 0, nil
362	}
363	
364	// insertAssignment stores a new role assignment.
365	func (r *repository) insertAssignment(ctx context.Context, ra domain.RoleAssignment) error {
366		if _, err := r.assignments.InsertOne(ctx, ra); err != nil {
367			return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("insert assignment: %w", err))
368		}
369		return nil
370	}
371	
372	// revokeAssignment flips an ACTIVE assignment to REVOKED (the doc is never
373	// deleted — §4.1) and returns the updated record. Matching on status makes
374	// concurrent revokes lose cleanly.
375	func (r *repository) revokeAssignment(ctx context.Context, id, revokedBy primitive.ObjectID, at time.Time) (*domain.RoleAssignment, error) {
376		filter := bson.D{
377			{Key: "_id", Value: id},
378			{Key: "status", Value: domain.RoleAssignmentActive},
379		}
380		update := bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
381			{Key: "status", Value: domain.RoleAssignmentRevoked},
382			{Key: "revoked_at", Value: at},
383			{Key: "revoked_by", Value: revokedBy},
384		}}}
385		opts := options.FindOneAndUpdate().SetReturnDocument(options.After)
386		var ra domain.RoleAssignment
387		err := r.assignments.FindOneAndUpdate(ctx, filter, update, opts).Decode(&ra)
388		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
389			return nil, httpx.NotFound("active role assignment")
390		}
391		if err != nil {
392			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("revoke assignment: %w", err))
393		}
394		return &ra, nil
395	}
396	
397	// listAssignments pages assignments inside one org unit, optionally filtered
398	// by role code.
399	func (r *repository) listAssignments(ctx context.Context, orgUnitID primitive.ObjectID, roleCode string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.RoleAssignment, int64, error) {
400		filter := bson.D{{Key: "org_unit_id", Value: orgUnitID}}
401		if roleCode != "" {
402			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "role_code", Value: roleCode})
403		}
404		total, err := r.assignments.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
405		if err != nil {
406			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("count assignments: %w", err))
407		}
408		opts := options.Find().
409			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "created_at", Value: -1}}).
410			SetSkip(page.Offset).
411			SetLimit(page.Limit)
412		cur, err := r.assignments.Find(ctx, filter, opts)
413		if err != nil {
414			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("list assignments: %w", err))
415		}
416		out := make([]domain.RoleAssignment, 0)
417		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
418			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("decode assignments: %w", err))
419		}
420		return out, total, nil
421	}

503	// approveKYCRecord flips a PENDING record to VERIFIED with the reviewer
504	// stamp. Matching on status makes concurrent reviews lose cleanly (the loser
505	// sees NotFound and the service translates it to a 409).
506	func (r *repository) approveKYCRecord(ctx context.Context, id, reviewedBy primitive.ObjectID, reviewerRole string, now time.Time) (*domain.KYCRecord, error) {
507		filter := bson.D{
508			{Key: "_id", Value: id},
509			{Key: "status", Value: domain.KYCStatusPending},
510		}
511		update := bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
512			{Key: "status", Value: domain.KYCStatusVerified},
513			{Key: "reviewed_by", Value: reviewedBy},
514			{Key: "reviewed_by_role", Value: reviewerRole},
515			{Key: "reviewed_at", Value: now},
516			{Key: "verified_at", Value: now},
517			{Key: "updated_at", Value: now},
518		}}}
519		opts := options.FindOneAndUpdate().SetReturnDocument(options.After)
520		var rec domain.KYCRecord
521		err := r.kycRecords.FindOneAndUpdate(ctx, filter, update, opts).Decode(&rec)
522		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
523			return nil, httpx.NotFound("pending kyc record")
524		}
525		if err != nil {
526			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("approve kyc record: %w", err))
527		}
528		return &rec, nil
529	}
530	
531	// rejectKYCRecord flips a PENDING record to REJECTED with the reviewer stamp
532	// and reason. Same concurrency semantics as approveKYCRecord.
533	func (r *repository) rejectKYCRecord(ctx context.Context, id, reviewedBy primitive.ObjectID, reviewerRole, reason string, now time.Time) (*domain.KYCRecord, error) {
534		filter := bson.D{
535			{Key: "_id", Value: id},
536			{Key: "status", Value: domain.KYCStatusPending},
537		}
538		update := bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
539			{Key: "status", Value: domain.KYCStatusRejected},
540			{Key: "rejection_reason", Value: reason},
541			{Key: "reviewed_by", Value: reviewedBy},
542			{Key: "reviewed_by_role", Value: reviewerRole},
543			{Key: "reviewed_at", Value: now},
544			{Key: "updated_at", Value: now},
545		}}}
546		opts := options.FindOneAndUpdate().SetReturnDocument(options.After)
547		var rec domain.KYCRecord
548		err := r.kycRecords.FindOneAndUpdate(ctx, filter, update, opts).Decode(&rec)
549		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
550			return nil, httpx.NotFound("pending kyc record")
551		}
552		if err != nil {
553			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("reject kyc record: %w", err))
554		}
555		return &rec, nil
556	}
557	
558	// updateKYCRecordBank sets the (masked) bank verification fields on an
559	// existing KYC record and returns the updated record.
560	func (r *repository) updateKYCRecordBank(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID, accountMasked, ifsc string, nameMatch float64, now time.Time) (*domain.KYCRecord, error) {
561		update := bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
562			{Key: "bank_account_masked", Value: accountMasked},
563			{Key: "bank_ifsc", Value: ifsc},
564			{Key: "bank_verified", Value: true},
565			{Key: "bank_name_match", Value: nameMatch},
566			{Key: "updated_at", Value: now},
567		}}}
568		opts := options.FindOneAndUpdate().SetReturnDocument(options.After)
569		var rec domain.KYCRecord
570		err := r.kycRecords.FindOneAndUpdate(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}, update, opts).Decode(&rec)
571		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
572			return nil, httpx.NotFound("kyc record")
573		}
574		if err != nil {
575			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("update kyc record bank: %w", err))
576		}
577		return &rec, nil
578	}
579	
580	// listKYCRecords pages the party's KYC records, newest first.
581	func (r *repository) listKYCRecords(ctx context.Context, partyID primitive.ObjectID, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.KYCRecord, int64, error) {
582		filter := bson.D{{Key: "party_id", Value: partyID}}
583		total, err := r.kycRecords.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
584		if err != nil {
585			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("count kyc records: %w", err))
586		}
587		opts := options.Find().
588			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "created_at", Value: -1}}).
589			SetSkip(page.Offset).
590			SetLimit(page.Limit)
591		cur, err := r.kycRecords.Find(ctx, filter, opts)
592		if err != nil {
593			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("list kyc records: %w", err))
594		}
595		out := make([]domain.KYCRecord, 0)
596		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
597			return nil, 0, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("decode kyc records: %w", err))
598		}
599		return out, total, nil
600	}
601	
602	// insertConsent stores a DPDP consent artefact.
603	func (r *repository) insertConsent(ctx context.Context, c domain.Consent) error {
604		if _, err := r.consents.InsertOne(ctx, c); err != nil {
605			return httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("insert consent: %w", err))
606		}
607		return nil
608	}
609

2	
3	import (
4		"time"
5	
6		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
7	)
8	
9	// Party statuses.
10	const (
11		PartyStatusActive    = "ACTIVE"
12		PartyStatusSuspended = "SUSPENDED"
13	)
14	
15	// Party is the single identity record per human (blueprint §4.1):
16	// one phone number = one Party = many org-scoped RoleAssignments.
17	// `_id` is a generated ObjectID; `phone` is the unique natural key used for
18	// login — relations always reference the ObjectID, never the phone.
19	type Party struct {
20		ID                primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
21		Phone             string             `bson:"phone"         json:"phone"`
22		FullName          string             `bson:"full_name,omitempty"          json:"full_name,omitempty"`
23		PreferredLanguage string             `bson:"preferred_language,omitempty" json:"preferred_language,omitempty"` // "hi", "en", ...
24		KYCTier           string             `bson:"kyc_tier"      json:"kyc_tier"`
25		Status            string             `bson:"status"        json:"status"`
26		// PublicConsent is the DPDP §6.7 opt-in: when true the farmer agrees to be
27		// NAMED on the public QR trace roster; when false they are counted but never
28		// named. Defaults false (privacy-preserving).
29		PublicConsent bool      `bson:"public_consent" json:"public_consent"`
30		CreatedAt     time.Time `bson:"created_at"    json:"created_at"`
31		UpdatedAt     time.Time `bson:"updated_at"    json:"updated_at"`
32	}
33	
34	// RoleAssignment statuses.
35	const (
36		RoleAssignmentActive  = "ACTIVE"
37		RoleAssignmentRevoked = "REVOKED"
38	)
39	
40	// RoleAssignment grants one role to one party inside one org unit for a
41	// validity window. Revoking a Sacheev after an election is a single record
42	// update — never an account deletion (blueprint §4.1).
43	type RoleAssignment struct {
44		ID        primitive.ObjectID  `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
45		PartyID   primitive.ObjectID  `bson:"party_id"      json:"party_id"`
46		RoleCode  string              `bson:"role_code"     json:"role_code"`
47		OrgUnitID primitive.ObjectID  `bson:"org_unit_id"   json:"org_unit_id"`
48		GrantedBy *primitive.ObjectID `bson:"granted_by,omitempty" json:"granted_by,omitempty"`
49		ValidFrom time.Time           `bson:"valid_from"    json:"valid_from"`
50		ValidTo   *time.Time          `bson:"valid_to,omitempty"   json:"valid_to,omitempty"` // nil = open-ended
51		Status    string              `bson:"status"        json:"status"`
52		RevokedAt *time.Time          `bson:"revoked_at,omitempty" json:"revoked_at,omitempty"`
53		RevokedBy *primitive.ObjectID `bson:"revoked_by,omitempty" json:"revoked_by,omitempty"`
54		CreatedAt time.Time           `bson:"created_at"    json:"created_at"`
55	}
56	
57	// UsableAt reports whether the assignment is active and inside its validity
58	// window at instant t.
59	func (ra RoleAssignment) UsableAt(t time.Time) bool {
60		if ra.Status != RoleAssignmentActive {
61			return false
62		}
63		if t.Before(ra.ValidFrom) {
64			return false
65		}
66		if ra.ValidTo != nil && t.After(*ra.ValidTo) {
67			return false
68		}
69		return true
70	}
71	
72	// KYC record statuses — the approval workflow:
73	// submit → PENDING → (Organising Manager / District Verifier / PCDF Admin /
74	// Super Admin reviews) → VERIFIED (tier upgraded) or REJECTED (with reason).
75	// A role token is only issuable once the party's tier satisfies the role's
76	// RequiredKYCTier, so "login as rider" is impossible before approval.
77	const (
78		KYCStatusPending  = "PENDING"
79		KYCStatusVerified = "VERIFIED"
80		KYCStatusRejected = "REJECTED"
81	)
82	
83	// KYCRecord stores verification evidence for a party at a requested tier.
84	// Aadhaar compliance (blueprint §18-A): only the LAST 4 digits and an opaque
85	// vault reference are ever stored — never the full number, never biometrics.
86	type KYCRecord struct {
87		ID                primitive.ObjectID  `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
88		PartyID           primitive.ObjectID  `bson:"party_id"      json:"party_id"`
89		RequestedTier     string              `bson:"requested_tier" json:"requested_tier"`
90		AadhaarLast4      string              `bson:"aadhaar_last4,omitempty"       json:"aadhaar_last4,omitempty"`
91		AadhaarVaultRef   string              `bson:"aadhaar_vault_ref,omitempty"   json:"-"` // opaque Aadhaar Data Vault de-tokenization handle — persisted, NEVER serialized to any client surface
92		BankAccountMasked string              `bson:"bank_account_masked,omitempty" json:"bank_account_masked,omitempty"`
93		BankIFSC          string              `bson:"bank_ifsc,omitempty"           json:"bank_ifsc,omitempty"`
94		BankVerified      bool                `bson:"bank_verified"                 json:"bank_verified"`
95		BankNameMatch     float64             `bson:"bank_name_match,omitempty"     json:"bank_name_match,omitempty"` // penny-drop name-match score 0..1
96		DigiLockerDocs    []DocRef            `bson:"digilocker_docs,omitempty"     json:"digilocker_docs,omitempty"`
97		VideoKYCRef       string              `bson:"video_kyc_ref,omitempty"       json:"video_kyc_ref,omitempty"`
98		ConsentID         *primitive.ObjectID `bson:"consent_id,omitempty"          json:"consent_id,omitempty"`
99		Status            string              `bson:"status"        json:"status"`
100		RejectionReason   string              `bson:"rejection_reason,omitempty" json:"rejection_reason,omitempty"`
101		ReviewedBy        *primitive.ObjectID `bson:"reviewed_by,omitempty"      json:"reviewed_by,omitempty"` // approver party
102		ReviewedByRole    string              `bson:"reviewed_by_role,omitempty" json:"reviewed_by_role,omitempty"`
103		ReviewedAt        *time.Time          `bson:"reviewed_at,omitempty"      json:"reviewed_at,omitempty"`
104		VerifiedAt        *time.Time          `bson:"verified_at,omitempty"      json:"verified_at,omitempty"`
105		CreatedAt         time.Time           `bson:"created_at"    json:"created_at"`
106		UpdatedAt         time.Time           `bson:"updated_at"    json:"updated_at"`
107	}
108

110	type DocRef struct {

112		Issuer    string    `bson:"issuer"    json:"issuer"`
113		RefID     string    `bson:"ref_id"    json:"ref_id"`
114		FetchedAt time.Time `bson:"fetched_at" json:"fetched_at"`
115	}

14	// Request-shape validation patterns. Formats only — business rules live in
15	// the service layer.

18		otpRegexp         = regexp.MustCompile(`^[0-9]{6}$`)             // 6-digit numeric OTP
19		aadhaarRegexp     = regexp.MustCompile(`^[0-9]{12}$`)            // 12-digit Aadhaar number
20		bankAccountRegexp = regexp.MustCompile(`^[0-9]{9,18}$`)          // NPCI-range account number
21		ifscRegexp        = regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Z]{4}0[A-Z0-9]{6}$`) // RBI IFSC format
22	)

25	// POST /kyc/aadhaar. HIGHEST/SERVICE are never self-requested.

278	func (r createAssignmentRequest) validate() error {
279		if r.PartyID == nil && r.Phone == "" {
280			return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_PARTY", "one of party_id or phone is required")
281		}
282		if r.PartyID == nil && !phoneRegexp.MatchString(r.Phone) {
283			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_PHONE", "phone must be a 10-digit Indian mobile number")
284		}
285		if !domain.IsValidRole(r.RoleCode) {
286			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_ROLE", "role_code is not in the role catalog")
287		}
288		if r.OrgUnitID.IsZero() {
289			return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_ORG_UNIT", "org_unit_id is required")
290		}
291		if r.ValidFrom != nil && r.ValidTo != nil && !r.ValidTo.After(*r.ValidFrom) {
292			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_VALIDITY_WINDOW", "valid_to must be after valid_from")
293		}
294		return nil
295	}

1	// Package orgs implements the cooperative-hierarchy module (blueprint §5.1):
2	// the FEDERATION → MILK_UNION → {PROCESSING_PLANT, BMC, DCS} org-unit tree.
3	// It owns org-unit creation and edits (PCDF/state admins), directory reads
4	// for any authenticated party, subtree reads for oversight roles, and the
5	// membership roster (active role assignments joined with parties).
6	package orgs
7	
8	import (
9		"log/slog"
10	
11		"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
12	
13		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
14		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/middleware"
16	)
17	
18	// Register mounts the orgs module under /orgs on the /api/v1 subtree.
19	func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
20		log := d.Log.With(slog.String("module", "orgs"))
21		repo := newRepository(d.DB)
22		svc := newService(repo, d.Orgs, log)
23		h := newHandler(svc)
24	
25		r.Route("/orgs", func(r chi.Router) {
26			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
27	
28			// Hierarchy writes — state-apex administrators only.
29			r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
30				r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSuperAdmin, domain.RolePCDFAdmin))
31				r.Post("/", h.create)
32				r.Patch("/{id}", h.update)
33			})
34	
35			// Directory reads — any authenticated party (session or role token).
36			r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
37				r.Use(middleware.RequireSession)
38				r.Get("/", h.list)
39				r.Get("/{id}", h.get)
40				r.Get("/{id}/children", h.children)
41			})
42	
43			// Subtree read — oversight roles, scope-checked in the service.
44			r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
45				r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(
46					domain.RoleSuperAdmin,
47					domain.RolePCDFAdmin,
48					domain.RoleMissionOfficial,
49					domain.RoleUnionPresident,
50					domain.RoleStateAuditor,
51				))
52				r.Get("/{id}/tree", h.tree)
53			})
54	
55			// Membership roster — org staff roles, scope-checked in the service.
56			r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
57				r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(
58					domain.RoleSamitiSacheev,
59					domain.RoleSamitiAdhyaksh,
60					domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor,
61					domain.RoleUnionPresident,
62					domain.RolePCDFAdmin,
63					domain.RoleSuperAdmin,
64				))
65				r.Get("/{id}/members", h.members)
66			})
67		})
68	}

11	// FSSAI limits for liquid milk (blueprint §8.3). Aflatoxin M1 is heat-stable

25		TestAntibiotic  = "ANTIBIOTIC_TETRACYCLINE" // mg/kg
26		TestPhosphatase = "PHOSPHATASE"             // 0 = negative (pass post-pasteurisation), 1 = positive
27		TestFat         = "FAT"                     // %

55	type QCResult struct {

63		AnalystPartyID    primitive.ObjectID `bson:"analyst_party_id" json:"analyst_party_id"`

65		CertificateNumber string             `bson:"certificate_number,omitempty" json:"certificate_number,omitempty"`

73	// NormalizeTestName maps common field aliases to the canonical FSSAI test
74	// name so the safety gate can NEVER be bypassed by a spelling difference
75	// (e.g. the app sends "AFM1"; the gate keys on "AFLATOXIN_M1"). A test whose
76	// name still doesn't resolve to a gated parameter is recorded but not gated.
77	func NormalizeTestName(name string) string {
78		switch strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(name)) {
79		case "AFM1", "AFLATOXIN", "AFLATOXINM1", "AFLATOXIN_M1", "AFLATOXIN-M1":
80			return TestAflatoxinM1
81		case "COLIFORM", "COLIFORMS":

83		case "TPC", "TOTAL_PLATE_COUNT":
84			return TestTPC
85		case "ANTIBIOTIC", "TETRACYCLINE", "ANTIBIOTIC_TETRACYCLINE":
86			return TestAntibiotic
87		case "PHOSPHATASE", "ALP":
88			return TestPhosphatase
89		case "FAT":
90			return TestFat
91		case "SNF":
92			return TestSNF
93		default:
94			return strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(name))
95		}
96	}
97	
98	// EvaluateQCTests applies the FSSAI gate to a set of tests: it normalizes each
99	// test name, fills its Pass verdict, and returns the overall verdict plus
100	// human-readable failure reasons. Unknown test names are recorded but do not
101	// gate. The returned tests carry the CANONICAL name so storage is consistent.
102	func EvaluateQCTests(tests []QCTest) (overallPass bool, failures []string, evaluated []QCTest) {
103		overallPass = true
104		evaluated = make([]QCTest, 0, len(tests))
105		for _, t := range tests {
106			t.Name = NormalizeTestName(t.Name) // canonicalise so the gate cannot be dodged by alias
107			pass := true
108			switch t.Name {
109			case TestAflatoxinM1:
110				if t.Value > FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg {
111					pass = false
112					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
113						"AFLATOXIN_M1 %.3f µg/kg exceeds FSSAI limit %.1f µg/kg", t.Value, FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg))
114				}
115			case TestColiform:
116				if t.Value > FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl {
117					pass = false
118					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
119						"COLIFORM %.1f CFU/ml exceeds FSSAI limit %.0f CFU/ml", t.Value, FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl))
120				}
121			case TestAntibiotic:
122				if t.Value > FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg {
123					pass = false
124					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
125						"ANTIBIOTIC_TETRACYCLINE %.3f mg/kg exceeds MRL %.1f mg/kg", t.Value, FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg))
126				}
127			case TestPhosphatase:
128				if t.Value != 0 {
129					pass = false
130					failures = append(failures, "PHOSPHATASE positive — pasteurisation check failed (must be negative)")
131				}
132			}
133			t.Pass = pass
134			if !pass {
135				overallPass = false
136			}
137			evaluated = append(evaluated, t)
138		}
139		return overallPass, failures, evaluated
140	}
141

1	package orgs
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"errors"
6		"log/slog"
7		"net/http"
8		"strings"
9		"time"
10	
11		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
12		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
13		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
14	
15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
16		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
17		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
18		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/orgscope"
19	)
20	
21	// maxTreeNodes caps a subtree response (root included) so a federation-level
22	// tree read can never return an unbounded list.
23	const maxTreeNodes = 500
24	
25	// service holds all business logic of the orgs module.
26	type service struct {
27		repo  *repository
28		scope *orgscope.Resolver
29		log   *slog.Logger
30	}
31	
32	func newService(repo *repository, scope *orgscope.Resolver, log *slog.Logger) *service {
33		return &service{repo: repo, scope: scope, log: log}
34	}
35	
36	// fail routes an error out of the service: expected AppErrors (404s from the
37	// repo, platform errors) pass through untouched; anything unexpected — or an
38	// AppError already carrying a 5xx — is logged at ERROR with the failing
39	// operation before the client sees an opaque 500.
40	func (s *service) fail(ctx context.Context, op string, err error) error {
41		var appErr *httpx.AppError
42		ok := errors.As(err, &appErr)
43		if !ok || appErr.Status >= http.StatusInternalServerError {
44			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "orgs operation failed",
45				slog.String("op", op),
46				slog.Any("err", err))
47		}
48		if ok {
49			return err
50		}
51		return httpx.Internal(err)
52	}
53	
54	// scopeErr handles a RequireInScope failure: scope denials (403) are logged
55	// at WARN with the actor and target; other errors go through fail.
56	func (s *service) scopeErr(ctx context.Context, op string, actor auth.Actor, targetOrgID primitive.ObjectID, err error) error {
57		var appErr *httpx.AppError
58		if errors.As(err, &appErr) && appErr.Status == http.StatusForbidden {
59			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "org scope denial",
60				slog.String("op", op),
61				slog.String("target_org_id", targetOrgID.Hex()),
62				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
63				slog.String("actor_org_id", actor.OrgUnitID),
64				slog.String("reason", appErr.Message))
65			return err
66		}
67		return s.fail(ctx, op, err)
68	}
69	
70	// validateHierarchy checks whether an org unit of childType may be created
71	// under a parent of parentType ("" = no parent), per domain.ValidOrgParent.
72	// Pure function — unit-tested against the full type matrix.
73	func validateHierarchy(childType, parentType string) *httpx.AppError {
74		if !domain.IsValidOrgType(childType) {
75			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_ORG_TYPE", "unknown org type "+childType)
76		}
77		allowed := domain.ValidOrgParent[childType]
78		if len(allowed) == 0 { // hierarchy root
79			if parentType != "" {
80				return httpx.Unprocessable("ORG_PARENT_TYPE_INVALID",
81					childType+" is the hierarchy root and cannot have a parent")
82			}
83			return nil
84		}
85		if parentType == "" {
86			return httpx.BadRequest("ORG_PARENT_REQUIRED", childType+" requires a parent_id")
87		}
88		for _, t := range allowed {
89			if t == parentType {
90				return nil
91			}
92		}
93		return httpx.Unprocessable("ORG_PARENT_TYPE_INVALID",
94			childType+" cannot be created under a "+parentType)
95	}
96	
97	// Create validates the hierarchy edge and inserts a new org unit
98	// (POST /orgs, blueprint §5.1).
99	func (s *service) Create(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateOrgRequest) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
100		name := strings.TrimSpace(req.Name)
101		if name == "" {
102			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_NAME", "name is required")
103		}
104		code := strings.TrimSpace(req.Code)
105		if code == "" {
106			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_CODE", "code is required")
107		}
108	
109		// Resolve the parent (if any) and validate the hierarchy edge.
110		var parent *domain.OrgUnit
111		if req.ParentID != nil && !req.ParentID.IsZero() {
112			var err error
113			parent, err = s.repo.getOrg(ctx, *req.ParentID)
114			if err != nil {
115				return nil, s.fail(ctx, "get parent org unit", err)
116			}
117		}
118		parentType := ""
119		if parent != nil {
120			parentType = parent.Type
121		}
122		if aerr := validateHierarchy(req.Type, parentType); aerr != nil {
123			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "org create rejected: invalid hierarchy edge",
124				slog.String("org_code", code),
125				slog.String("org_type", req.Type),
126				slog.String("parent_type", parentType),
127				slog.String("reason", aerr.Code),
128				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
129			return nil, aerr
130		}
131	
132		// The federation is the unique root: reject a second one.
133		if req.Type == domain.OrgTypeFederation {
134			n, err := s.repo.countByType(ctx, domain.OrgTypeFederation)
135			if err != nil {
136				return nil, s.fail(ctx, "count federation org units", err)
137			}
138			if n > 0 {
139				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "org create rejected: federation root already exists",
140					slog.String("org_code", code),
141					slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
142				return nil, httpx.Conflict("FEDERATION_EXISTS", "a federation root org unit already exists")
143			}
144		}
145	
146		// The new unit must be created inside the caller's scope.
147		if parent != nil {
148			if err := s.scope.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, parent.ID); err != nil {
149				return nil, s.scopeErr(ctx, "create org unit", actor, parent.ID, err)
150			}
151		}
152	
153		now := time.Now().UTC()
154		org := &domain.OrgUnit{
155			// Pre-generate the id so insert + cache invalidation see one value.
156			ID:        primitive.NewObjectID(),
157			Type:      req.Type,
158			Name:      name,
159			Code:      code,
160			District:  strings.TrimSpace(req.District),
161			State:     strings.TrimSpace(req.State),
162			Path:      []primitive.ObjectID{},
163			Active:    true,
164			CreatedAt: now,
165			UpdatedAt: now,
166		}
167		if parent != nil {
168			parentID := parent.ID
169			org.ParentID = &parentID
170			org.Path = append(append([]primitive.ObjectID{}, parent.Path...), parent.ID)
171		}
172		if req.GeoLat != nil {
173			org.GeoLat = *req.GeoLat
174		}
175		if req.GeoLng != nil {
176			org.GeoLng = *req.GeoLng
177		}
178	
179		if err := s.repo.insertOrg(ctx, org); err != nil {
180			if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(err) {
181				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "org create rejected: duplicate code",
182					slog.String("org_code", code),
183					slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
184				return nil, httpx.Conflict("ORG_CODE_EXISTS", "an org unit with code "+code+" already exists")
185			}
186			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "insert org unit", err)
187		}
188		s.scope.Invalidate(org.ID)
189		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "org unit created",
190			slog.String("org_id", org.ID.Hex()),
191			slog.String("org_code", org.Code),
192			slog.String("org_type", org.Type),
193			slog.String("parent_org_id", hexOrEmpty(org.ParentID)),
194			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
195		return org, nil
196	}
197	
198	// hexOrEmpty renders an optional ObjectID reference for logging.
199	func hexOrEmpty(id *primitive.ObjectID) string {
200		if id == nil {
201			return ""
202		}
203		return id.Hex()
204	}
205	
206	// Update patches name/district/active/geo on an org unit (PATCH /orgs/{id}).
207	// Type or parent moves are rejected — restructuring the tree is out of scope
208	// for v1 because Path denormalisation across a subtree is not transactional.
209	func (s *service) Update(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID, req UpdateOrgRequest) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
210		if req.Type != nil || req.ParentID != nil {
211			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "org update rejected: hierarchy move unsupported",
212				slog.String("org_id", id.Hex()),
213				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
214			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("ORG_MOVE_UNSUPPORTED",
215				"changing an org unit's type or parent is not supported in v1")
216		}
217		if err := s.scope.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, id); err != nil {
218			return nil, s.scopeErr(ctx, "update org unit", actor, id, err)
219		}
220	
221		set := bson.D{{Key: "updated_at", Value: time.Now().UTC()}}
222		if req.Name != nil {
223			name := strings.TrimSpace(*req.Name)
224			if name == "" {
225				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_NAME", "name cannot be empty")
226			}
227			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "name", Value: name})
228		}
229		if req.District != nil {
230			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "district", Value: strings.TrimSpace(*req.District)})
231		}
232		if req.Active != nil {
233			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "active", Value: *req.Active})
234		}
235		if req.GeoLat != nil {
236			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "geo_lat", Value: *req.GeoLat})
237		}
238		if req.GeoLng != nil {
239			set = append(set, bson.E{Key: "geo_lng", Value: *req.GeoLng})
240		}
241		if len(set) == 1 { // only updated_at
242			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("EMPTY_UPDATE", "no updatable fields provided")
243		}
244	
245		org, err := s.repo.updateOrg(ctx, id, set)
246		if err != nil {
247			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "update org unit", err)
248		}
249		s.scope.Invalidate(id)
250		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "org unit updated",
251			slog.String("org_id", org.ID.Hex()),
252			slog.String("org_code", org.Code),
253			slog.Bool("active", org.Active),
254			slog.Int("fields_patched", len(set)-1),
255			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
256		return org, nil
257	}
258	
259	// Get returns one org unit (GET /orgs/{id}).
260	func (s *service) Get(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
261		org, err := s.repo.getOrg(ctx, id)
262		if err != nil {
263			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "get org unit", err)
264		}
265		return org, nil
266	}
267	
268	// Children pages the direct children of an org unit (GET /orgs/{id}/children),
269	// returning the total child count alongside the page.
270	func (s *service) Children(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.OrgUnit, int64, error) {
271		if _, err := s.repo.getOrg(ctx, id); err != nil {
272			return nil, 0, s.fail(ctx, "get org unit", err)
273		}
274		units, total, err := s.repo.listChildren(ctx, id, page)
275		if err != nil {
276			return nil, 0, s.fail(ctx, "list org children", err)
277		}
278		return units, total, nil
279	}
280	
281	// Tree returns the root plus its whole subtree as a flat list (each node
282	// carries parent_id; the client assembles), capped at maxTreeNodes.
283	func (s *service) Tree(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID) ([]domain.OrgUnit, bool, error) {
284		root, err := s.repo.getOrg(ctx, id)
285		if err != nil {
286			return nil, false, s.fail(ctx, "get org unit", err)
287		}
288		if err := s.scope.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, id); err != nil {
289			return nil, false, s.scopeErr(ctx, "read org subtree", actor, id, err)
290		}
291		descendants, err := s.repo.listDescendants(ctx, id, maxTreeNodes-1)
292		if err != nil {
293			return nil, false, s.fail(ctx, "list org descendants", err)
294		}
295		nodes := append([]domain.OrgUnit{*root}, descendants...)
296		truncated := len(descendants) == maxTreeNodes-1
297		return nodes, truncated, nil
298	}
299	
300	// List pages org units filtered by type, district and/or exact code — the
301	// unique business key, e.g. ?code=DCS-01842, used to discover an org's
302	// ObjectID (GET /orgs) — returning the total matching count alongside the page.
303	func (s *service) List(ctx context.Context, orgType, district, code string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.OrgUnit, int64, error) {
304		filter := bson.D{}
305		if orgType != "" {
306			if !domain.IsValidOrgType(orgType) {
307				return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_ORG_TYPE", "unknown org type "+orgType)
308			}
309			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "type", Value: orgType})
310		}
311		if district != "" {
312			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "district", Value: district})
313		}
314		if code != "" {
315			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "code", Value: code})
316		}
317		units, total, err := s.repo.listOrgs(ctx, filter, page)
318		if err != nil {
319			return nil, 0, s.fail(ctx, "list org units", err)
320		}
321		return units, total, nil
322	}
323	
324	// Members pages the ACTIVE role assignments at an org unit joined in memory
325	// with party identity fields (GET /orgs/{id}/members) — two indexed queries,
326	// no $lookup.
327	func (s *service) Members(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID, page httpx.Page) ([]Member, int64, error) {
328		if _, err := s.repo.getOrg(ctx, id); err != nil {
329			return nil, 0, s.fail(ctx, "get org unit", err)
330		}
331		if err := s.scope.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, id); err != nil {
332			return nil, 0, s.scopeErr(ctx, "read org members", actor, id, err)
333		}
334	
335		total, err := s.repo.countActiveAssignments(ctx, id)
336		if err != nil {
337			return nil, 0, s.fail(ctx, "count active role assignments", err)
338		}
339		assignments, err := s.repo.listActiveAssignments(ctx, id, page)
340		if err != nil {
341			return nil, 0, s.fail(ctx, "list active role assignments", err)
342		}
343		partyIDs := make([]primitive.ObjectID, 0, len(assignments))
344		seen := make(map[primitive.ObjectID]struct{}, len(assignments))
345		for _, a := range assignments {
346			if _, dup := seen[a.PartyID]; !dup {
347				seen[a.PartyID] = struct{}{}
348				partyIDs = append(partyIDs, a.PartyID)
349			}
350		}
351		parties, err := s.repo.partiesByIDs(ctx, partyIDs)
352		if err != nil {
353			return nil, 0, s.fail(ctx, "fetch member parties", err)
354		}
355	
356		members := make([]Member, 0, len(assignments))
357		for _, a := range assignments {
358			m := Member{
359				PartyID:          a.PartyID,
360				RoleCode:         a.RoleCode,
361				RoleAssignmentID: a.ID,
362				ValidFrom:        a.ValidFrom,
363				ValidTo:          a.ValidTo,
364			}
365			if p, ok := parties[a.PartyID]; ok {
366				m.Phone = p.Phone
367				m.FullName = p.FullName
368				m.KYCTier = p.KYCTier
369			}
370			members = append(members, m)
371		}
372		return members, total, nil
373	}
374

1	package orgs
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"errors"
6		"fmt"
7	
8		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
9		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
10		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"

13		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"

15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/mongodb"
16	)
17	
18	// repository is the module's only MongoDB access point. It reads the
19	// role_assignments and parties collections (allowed by spec for the members
20	// roster) but writes only org_units.
21	//
22	// Error contract: missing documents surface as httpx.NotFound (a business
23	// outcome); every other failure is returned as a raw error wrapped with the
24	// failing operation so the service can log it before mapping to a 500.
25	type repository struct {
26		orgs        *mongo.Collection
27		assignments *mongo.Collection
28		parties     *mongo.Collection
29	}
30	
31	func newRepository(db *mongo.Database) *repository {
32		return &repository{
33			orgs:        db.Collection(mongodb.CollOrgUnits),
34			assignments: db.Collection(mongodb.CollRoleAssignments),
35			parties:     db.Collection(mongodb.CollParties),
36		}
37	}
38	
39	// insertOrg inserts a new org unit (its _id is pre-generated by the service).
40	// The driver error stays inspectable (%w) so the service can map a
41	// duplicate-key violation on code to a Conflict.
42	func (r *repository) insertOrg(ctx context.Context, org *domain.OrgUnit) error {
43		if _, err := r.orgs.InsertOne(ctx, org); err != nil {
44			return fmt.Errorf("insert org unit: %w", err)
45		}
46		return nil
47	}
48	
49	// getOrg fetches one org unit by ObjectID.
50	func (r *repository) getOrg(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
51		var org domain.OrgUnit
52		err := r.orgs.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&org)
53		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
54			return nil, httpx.NotFound("org unit " + id.Hex())
55		}
56		if err != nil {
57			return nil, fmt.Errorf("get org unit %s: %w", id.Hex(), err)
58		}
59		return &org, nil
60	}
61	
62	// countByType counts org units of the given type (federation-uniqueness check).
63	func (r *repository) countByType(ctx context.Context, orgType string) (int64, error) {
64		n, err := r.orgs.CountDocuments(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "type", Value: orgType}})
65		if err != nil {
66			return 0, fmt.Errorf("count org units by type %s: %w", orgType, err)
67		}
68		return n, nil
69	}
70	
71	// updateOrg applies a $set patch and returns the updated document.
72	func (r *repository) updateOrg(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID, set bson.D) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
73		var org domain.OrgUnit
74		err := r.orgs.FindOneAndUpdate(ctx,
75			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}},
76			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: set}},
77			options.FindOneAndUpdate().SetReturnDocument(options.After),
78		).Decode(&org)
79		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
80			return nil, httpx.NotFound("org unit " + id.Hex())
81		}
82		if err != nil {
83			return nil, fmt.Errorf("update org unit %s: %w", id.Hex(), err)
84		}
85		return &org, nil
86	}
87	
88	// listChildren pages the direct children of an org unit (parent_id index)
89	// and returns the total child count for pagination meta.
90	func (r *repository) listChildren(ctx context.Context, parentID primitive.ObjectID, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.OrgUnit, int64, error) {
91		filter := bson.D{{Key: "parent_id", Value: parentID}}
92		total, err := r.orgs.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
93		if err != nil {
94			return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("count org children: %w", err)
95		}
96		units, err := r.findOrgs(ctx, filter,
97			options.Find().
98				SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "code", Value: 1}}).
99				SetSkip(page.Offset).
100				SetLimit(page.Limit))
101		if err != nil {
102			return nil, 0, err
103		}
104		return units, total, nil
105	}
106	
107	// listOrgs pages org units matching an arbitrary filter (type/district/code)
108	// and returns the total matching count for pagination meta.
109	func (r *repository) listOrgs(ctx context.Context, filter bson.D, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.OrgUnit, int64, error) {
110		total, err := r.orgs.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
111		if err != nil {
112			return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("count org units: %w", err)
113		}
114		units, err := r.findOrgs(ctx, filter,
115			options.Find().
116				SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "code", Value: 1}}).
117				SetSkip(page.Offset).
118				SetLimit(page.Limit))
119		if err != nil {
120			return nil, 0, err
121		}
122		return units, total, nil
123	}
124	
125	// listDescendants returns every org unit whose ancestor Path contains rootID
126	// (path index, ObjectID array containment), capped at limit nodes.
127	func (r *repository) listDescendants(ctx context.Context, rootID primitive.ObjectID, limit int64) ([]domain.OrgUnit, error) {
128		return r.findOrgs(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "path", Value: rootID}},
129			options.Find().
130				SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "code", Value: 1}}).
131				SetLimit(limit))
132	}
133	
134	func (r *repository) findOrgs(ctx context.Context, filter bson.D, opts *options.FindOptions) ([]domain.OrgUnit, error) {
135		cur, err := r.orgs.Find(ctx, filter, opts)
136		if err != nil {
137			return nil, fmt.Errorf("find org units: %w", err)
138		}
139		units := []domain.OrgUnit{}
140		if err := cur.All(ctx, &units); err != nil {
141			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode org units: %w", err)
142		}
143		return units, nil
144	}
145	
146	// countActiveAssignments counts the ACTIVE role assignments at one org unit —
147	// the members-listing total.
148	func (r *repository) countActiveAssignments(ctx context.Context, orgID primitive.ObjectID) (int64, error) {
149		n, err := r.assignments.CountDocuments(ctx, bson.D{
150			{Key: "org_unit_id", Value: orgID},
151			{Key: "status", Value: domain.RoleAssignmentActive},
152		})
153		if err != nil {
154			return 0, fmt.Errorf("count active role assignments: %w", err)
155		}
156		return n, nil
157	}
158	
159	// listActiveAssignments pages the ACTIVE role assignments at one org unit
160	// (org_unit_id + role_code + status index).
161	func (r *repository) listActiveAssignments(ctx context.Context, orgID primitive.ObjectID, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.RoleAssignment, error) {
162		cur, err := r.assignments.Find(ctx,
163			bson.D{
164				{Key: "org_unit_id", Value: orgID},
165				{Key: "status", Value: domain.RoleAssignmentActive},
166			},
167			options.Find().
168				SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "role_code", Value: 1}, {Key: "created_at", Value: 1}}).
169				SetSkip(page.Offset).
170				SetLimit(page.Limit))
171		if err != nil {
172			return nil, fmt.Errorf("find active role assignments: %w", err)
173		}
174		assignments := []domain.RoleAssignment{}
175		if err := cur.All(ctx, &assignments); err != nil {
176			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode role assignments: %w", err)
177		}
178		return assignments, nil
179	}
180	
181	// partiesByIDs fetches the given parties keyed by ObjectID for the in-memory join.
182	func (r *repository) partiesByIDs(ctx context.Context, ids []primitive.ObjectID) (map[primitive.ObjectID]domain.Party, error) {
183		byID := make(map[primitive.ObjectID]domain.Party, len(ids))
184		if len(ids) == 0 {
185			return byID, nil
186		}
187		cur, err := r.parties.Find(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: ids}}}})
188		if err != nil {
189			return nil, fmt.Errorf("find parties: %w", err)
190		}
191		var parties []domain.Party
192		if err := cur.All(ctx, &parties); err != nil {
193			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode parties: %w", err)
194		}
195		for _, p := range parties {
196			byID[p.ID] = p
197		}
198		return byID, nil
199	}

1	package domain
2	
3	import (
4		"time"
5	
6		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
7	)
8	
9	// Org-unit types — the cooperative backbone RBAC is scoped to (blueprint §5.1,
10	// PCDF constitution: Samiti/DCS → Sangh/Union → PCDF apex).
11	const (
12		OrgTypeFederation      = "FEDERATION"       // PCDF / Parag (state apex)
13		OrgTypeMilkUnion       = "MILK_UNION"       // district Sangh
14		OrgTypeProcessingPlant = "PROCESSING_PLANT" // PCDF plant
15		OrgTypeBMC             = "BMC"              // bulk milk cooler / chilling centre
16		OrgTypeDCS             = "DCS"              // village samiti
17	)
18	
19	// AllOrgTypes is the closed set of org-unit types.
20	var AllOrgTypes = []string{
21		OrgTypeFederation, OrgTypeMilkUnion, OrgTypeProcessingPlant, OrgTypeBMC, OrgTypeDCS,
22	}
23	
24	// ValidOrgParent encodes the allowed hierarchy edges.
25	var ValidOrgParent = map[string][]string{
26		OrgTypeFederation:      {}, // root
27		OrgTypeMilkUnion:       {OrgTypeFederation},
28		OrgTypeProcessingPlant: {OrgTypeMilkUnion, OrgTypeFederation},
29		OrgTypeBMC:             {OrgTypeMilkUnion},
30		OrgTypeDCS:             {OrgTypeMilkUnion, OrgTypeBMC},
31	}
32	
33	// OrgUnit is a node in the cooperative hierarchy.
34	//
35	// ID scheme: `_id` is a generated ObjectID (relations always reference it);
36	// Code is the human-readable unique business key (e.g. "DCS-01842") used for
37	// display, lookups and seed idempotency — never for joins.
38	//
39	// Path holds the ObjectIDs of all ancestors from the root down to (and
40	// excluding) this node — denormalised so "is X inside Y's scope" is a single
41	// indexed array-containment check with no recursive queries on the hot path.
42	type OrgUnit struct {
43		ID        primitive.ObjectID   `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
44		Type      string               `bson:"type"          json:"type"`
45		Name      string               `bson:"name"          json:"name"`
46		Code      string               `bson:"code"          json:"code"` // unique business key, e.g. "DCS-01842"
47		ParentID  *primitive.ObjectID  `bson:"parent_id,omitempty" json:"parent_id,omitempty"`
48		Path      []primitive.ObjectID `bson:"path"          json:"path"`
49		District  string               `bson:"district,omitempty" json:"district,omitempty"`
50		State     string               `bson:"state,omitempty"    json:"state,omitempty"`
51		GeoLat    float64              `bson:"geo_lat,omitempty"  json:"geo_lat,omitempty"`
52		GeoLng    float64              `bson:"geo_lng,omitempty"  json:"geo_lng,omitempty"`
53		Active    bool                 `bson:"active"        json:"active"`
54		CreatedAt time.Time            `bson:"created_at"    json:"created_at"`
55		UpdatedAt time.Time            `bson:"updated_at"    json:"updated_at"`
56	}
57	
58	// IsValidOrgType reports whether t is a known org-unit type.
59	func IsValidOrgType(t string) bool {
60		for _, v := range AllOrgTypes {
61			if v == t {
62				return true
63			}
64		}
65		return false
66	}
67

9	// CreateOrgRequest is the body of POST /orgs. ParentID arrives as a plain
