21	}
22	
23	// UpdateOrgRequest is the body of PATCH /orgs/{id}. Pointer fields
24	// distinguish "absent" from "set to zero value". Type and ParentID are
25	// decoded solely to reject hierarchy moves, which are unsupported in v1 —
26	// they stay *string so any supplied value (even a malformed id) maps to the
27	// ORG_MOVE_UNSUPPORTED rejection rather than a decode error.
28	type UpdateOrgRequest struct {
29		Name     *string  `json:"name"`
30		District *string  `json:"district"`
31		Active   *bool    `json:"active"`
32		GeoLat   *float64 `json:"geo_lat"`
33		GeoLng   *float64 `json:"geo_lng"`
34		Type     *string  `json:"type"`
35		ParentID *string  `json:"parent_id"`
36	}
37	
38	// Member is one row of GET /orgs/{id}/members: an ACTIVE role assignment at
39	// the org joined in memory with its party's identity fields. ObjectIDs
40	// marshal to plain hex strings on the wire.
41	type Member struct {
42		PartyID          primitive.ObjectID `json:"party_id"`
43		Phone            string             `json:"phone,omitempty"`
44		FullName         string             `json:"full_name,omitempty"`
45		KYCTier          string             `json:"kyc_tier,omitempty"`
46		RoleCode         string             `json:"role_code"`

165	// KYCTierSatisfies reports whether a party at tier `have` meets `need`.
166	// Parallel tier-1 proofs (FARMER vs STANDARD) satisfy each other.
167	func KYCTierSatisfies(have, need string) bool {
168		h, okH := kycRank[have]
169		n, okN := kycRank[need]
170		if !okH || !okN {
171			return false
172		}
173		return h >= n
174	}

2	// Package platformops is the platform-operations module (blueprint §12): the
3	// SUPER_ADMIN feature-flag console, the STATE_AUDITOR read-only audit surface
4	// with its GIGW/DPDP immutable export, the notifications outbox with the mock

9	// gate blocked, MVU dispatched — and turns them into queued vernacular SMS.
10	package platformops

12	import (

24	// Register wires the platformops module and mounts /admin, /audit,
25	// /notifications and /support (the router hands us the /api/v1 subtree).
26	func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
27		log := d.Log.With(slog.String("module", "platformops"))
28		repo := newRepository(d.DB)
29		svc := newService(d, repo, log)
30		h := newHandler(svc)
31	
32		r.Route("/admin", func(r chi.Router) {
33			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
34	
35			// PCDF_ADMIN may LIST flags; flipping one is SUPER_ADMIN only —
36			// capability gating is a deliberate act (blueprint principle #6).
37			r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSuperAdmin, domain.RolePCDFAdmin)).
38				Get("/flags", h.listFlags)
39			r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSuperAdmin)).
40				Put("/flags/{key}", h.setFlag)
41		})
42	
43		r.Route("/audit", func(r chi.Router) {
44			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
45			r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleStateAuditor, domain.RoleSuperAdmin))
46	
47			// Read-only by design: there is deliberately NO write/delete API
48			// surface for audit logs (§12) — entries land via deps.Audit only.
49			r.Get("/logs", h.listAuditLogs)
50			r.Get("/logs/export", h.exportAuditLogs)
51		})
52	
53		r.Route("/notifications", func(r chi.Router) {
54			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
55	
56			// SUPER_ADMIN only: a help-desk role has no need to read outbox
57			// message bodies, and the outbox carries credential-adjacent traffic
58			// (OTP notifications — additionally redacted in the service).
59			r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSuperAdmin)).
60				Get("/", h.listNotifications)
61			r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSuperAdmin)).
62				Post("/worker/run", h.runWorker)
63		})
64

66			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
67			r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSupportAgent, domain.RoleSuperAdmin))
68	
69			r.Get("/parties/lookup", h.lookupParty)

72		// Cross-module reactions arrive over the bus (modules never import each
73		// other). The bus already runs each handler on its own goroutine with a
74		// bounded context and panic recovery; the wrapper below adds an explicit
75		// second belt at this module's boundary.
76		d.Bus.Subscribe(eventbus.TopicPayoutCredited, safeHandler(log, svc.onPayoutCredited))
77		d.Bus.Subscribe(eventbus.TopicGateBlocked, safeHandler(log, svc.onGateBlocked))
78		d.Bus.Subscribe(eventbus.TopicMVUDispatched, safeHandler(log, svc.onMVUDispatched))
79	}

81	// safeHandler wraps a bus reaction so a programming error in notification
82	// fan-out can never disturb the publishing flow.
83	func safeHandler(log *slog.Logger, reaction func(ctx context.Context, payload any)) eventbus.Handler {
84		return func(ctx context.Context, topic string, payload any) {
85			defer func() {
86				if rec := recover(); rec != nil {
87					log.Error("platformops bus handler panic",
88						slog.String("topic", topic), slog.Any("panic", rec))
89				}
90			}()
91			reaction(ctx, payload)
92		}
93	}

260	// parseTimeParam accepts RFC3339 or plain YYYY-MM-DD (empty → nil). Date-only
261	// values mean UTC midnight; with endOfDay they cover the whole day, so
262	// ?to=2026-07-06 is inclusive of the 6th.
263	func parseTimeParam(value string, endOfDay bool) (*time.Time, error) {
264		if value == "" {
265			return nil, nil
266		}
267		if t, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, value); err == nil {
268			t = t.UTC()
269			return &t, nil
270		}
271		t, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", value)
272		if err != nil {
273			return nil, err
274		}
275		if endOfDay {
276			t = t.Add(24*time.Hour - time.Nanosecond)
277		}
278		t = t.UTC()
279		return &t, nil
280	}

313	var settableFlagKeys = map[string]struct{}{
314		flags.FlagCollarTelemetry:  {},
315		flags.FlagPhotoOCR:         {},
316		flags.FlagONDC:             {},
317		flags.FlagConsumerCommerce: {},
318	}

320	// service holds all platformops business logic.
321	type service struct {
322		deps *deps.Deps
323		repo *repository
324		log  *slog.Logger
325	}
326	
327	// newService wires the service with its module-scoped logger.
328	func newService(d *deps.Deps, repo *repository, log *slog.Logger) *service {
329		return &service{deps: d, repo: repo, log: log}
330	}

332	// ---- Admin: feature flags (§12) ----
333	
334	// listFlags returns every stored feature flag for the admin console.
335	func (s *service) listFlags(ctx context.Context) ([]flags.Flag, error) {
336		all, err := s.deps.Flags.All(ctx)
337		if err != nil {
338			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("list feature flags: %w", err))
339		}
340		if all == nil {
341			all = []flags.Flag{}
342		}
343		return all, nil
344	}

346	// setFlag flips one well-known feature flag and writes the explicit
347	// "admin.flag_set" audit entry.
348	func (s *service) setFlag(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, key string, enabled bool) (*SetFlagResponse, error) {
349		if _, ok := settableFlagKeys[key]; !ok {
350			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "feature flag set rejected: unknown key",
351				slog.String("key", key), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
352			return nil, httpx.NotFound("feature flag " + key)
353		}
354		if err := s.deps.Flags.Set(ctx, key, enabled, actor.PartyID); err != nil {
355			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "set feature flag failed",
356				slog.String("key", key), slog.Any("err", err))
357			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("set feature flag: %w", err))
358		}
359		s.deps.Audit.Record(ctx, audit.Entry{
360			Action:     "admin.flag_set",
361			TargetType: "FEATURE_FLAG",
362			TargetID:   key,
363			Meta:       map[string]any{"key": key, "enabled": enabled},
364		})
365		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "feature flag set",
366			slog.String("key", key), slog.Bool("enabled", enabled),
367			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
368		return &SetFlagResponse{Key: key, Enabled: enabled}, nil
369	}

394	// ---- Notifications outbox + mock SMS worker (§12, §13) ----
395	
396	// listNotifications returns a page of outbox documents with credential
397	// material redacted: the login OTP must never be readable through the
398	// outbox surface, or anyone with this route could mint any user's session
399	// (request OTP for the victim's phone, read it here, verify).
400	func (s *service) listNotifications(ctx context.Context, phone, status string, page httpx.Page) ([]StoredNotification, int64, error) {
401		items, total, err := s.repo.listNotifications(ctx, phone, status, page)
402		if err != nil {
403			return nil, 0, err
404		}
405		for i := range items {
406			redactNotificationSecrets(&items[i])
407		}
408		// Bulk-PII read (every party's phone + template params): audited for DPDP
409		// forensics, mirroring support.pii_lookup and kyc.pending_list.
410		s.deps.Audit.Record(ctx, audit.Entry{
411			Action:     "admin.notifications_read",
412			TargetType: "NOTIFICATION",
413			Meta: map[string]any{
414				"phone_filter":  phone,
415				"status_filter": status,
416				"count":         len(items),
417				"total":         total,
418			},
419		})
420		return items, total, nil
421	}
422	
423	// redactedValue replaces credential material in read surfaces.
424	const redactedValue = "[REDACTED]"
425	
426	// redactNotificationSecrets strips the plaintext OTP (params + rendered meta)
427	// from an outbox document before it leaves the API.
428	func redactNotificationSecrets(n *StoredNotification) {
429		if n.TemplateKey != domain.TemplateOTP {
430			return
431		}
432		if n.Params != nil {
433			params := make(map[string]string, len(n.Params))
434			for k, v := range n.Params {
435				if k == "otp" {
436					v = redactedValue
437				}
438				params[k] = v
439			}
440			n.Params = params
441		}
442		if n.Meta != nil {
443			meta := make(map[string]any, len(n.Meta))
444			for k, v := range n.Meta {
445				if k == "rendered_en" || k == "rendered_hi" {
446					v = redactedValue
447				}
448				meta[k] = v
449			}
450			n.Meta = meta
451		}
452	}
453	
454	// runWorker is the MOCK SMS provider dispatch (real deployment: MSG91 /
455	// telecom DLT gateway, §13). It claims up to workerClaimCap QUEUED documents
456	// via a race-safe FindOneAndUpdate loop, stamps each SENT with a mock
457	// provider reference, and renders the English/Hindi lines into meta for
458	// visibility. The manual trigger keeps the demo deterministic; production
459	// runs this as a cron/queue consumer.
460	func (s *service) runWorker(ctx context.Context) (*WorkerRunResponse, error) {
461		sent := 0
462		for i := 0; i < workerClaimCap; i++ {
463			providerRef := "SMS-MOCK-" + uuid.NewString()[0:8]
464			claimed, err := s.repo.claimQueuedNotification(ctx, providerRef, time.Now().UTC())
465			if err != nil {
466				s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "claim queued notification failed", slog.Any("err", err))
467				return nil, err
468			}
469			if claimed == nil {
470				break // queue drained
471			}
472			sent++
473	
474			english, hindi := renderSMS(claimed.TemplateKey, claimed.Params)
475			if claimed.TemplateKey == domain.TemplateOTP {
476				// Never persist the rendered OTP text — the provider gets the
477				// message transiently; the readable outbox keeps no plaintext code.
478				english, hindi = redactedValue, redactedValue
479			}
480			meta := map[string]any{
481				"provider":    "SMS-MOCK",
482				"rendered_en": english,
483				"rendered_hi": hindi,
484			}
485			if err := s.repo.setNotificationMeta(ctx, claimed.ID, meta); err != nil {
486				// The claim already succeeded — meta is cosmetic, log and move on.
487				s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "stamp notification meta failed",
488					slog.String("notification_id", claimed.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
489			}
490			s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "notification dispatched",
491				slog.String("notification_id", claimed.ID.Hex()),
492				slog.String("template_key", claimed.TemplateKey),
493				slog.String("provider_ref", providerRef),
494				slog.String("status", domain.NotificationSent))
495		}
496		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "notification worker run complete", slog.Int("sent", sent))
497		return &WorkerRunResponse{Sent: sent}, nil
498	}
499	
500	// renderSMS produces one simple English and one Hindi line per template key —
501	// mock rendering for visibility; real templates live with the DLT-registered
502	// provider (§13). Missing params render as empty strings, never a panic.
503	func renderSMS(templateKey string, params map[string]string) (english, hindi string) {
504		p := func(key string) string { return params[key] } // nil-map reads are safe
505	
506		switch templateKey {
507		case domain.TemplatePayoutCredited:
508			return fmt.Sprintf("Rs %s credited to your bank account. UTR %s. - Saathi", p("amount"), p("utr")),
509				fmt.Sprintf("₹%s आपके बैंक खाते में जमा हुए। UTR %s। - साथी", p("amount"), p("utr"))
510		case domain.TemplateSafetyBlock:
511			return fmt.Sprintf("SAFETY ALERT: %s %s blocked at %s. Reasons: %s. Quarantine and inspect immediately. - Saathi",
512					p("subject_type"), p("subject_id"), p("stage"), p("reasons")),
513				fmt.Sprintf("सुरक्षा चेतावनी: %s %s को %s पर रोका गया। कारण: %s। तुरंत जांच करें। - साथी",
514					p("subject_type"), p("subject_id"), p("stage"), p("reasons"))
515		case domain.TemplateMVUDispatched:
516			return fmt.Sprintf("MVU 1962 van dispatched for your animal (case %s). Please stay reachable. - Saathi", p("case_id")),
517				fmt.Sprintf("आपके पशु के लिए 1962 एमवीयू वैन रवाना (केस %s)। कृपया संपर्क में रहें। - साथी", p("case_id"))
518		case domain.TemplatePourReceipt:
519			return fmt.Sprintf("%sL @ Rs %s = Rs %s credited to today's bill. - Saathi", p("quantity"), p("rate"), p("amount")),
520				fmt.Sprintf("%s लीटर @ ₹%s = ₹%s आज के बिल में जुड़े। - साथी", p("quantity"), p("rate"), p("amount"))
521		case domain.TemplateInvoiceIssued:
522			return fmt.Sprintf("Invoice %s for Rs %s issued. - Saathi", p("invoice_number"), p("amount")),
523				fmt.Sprintf("₹%s का बिल %s जारी हुआ। - साथी", p("amount"), p("invoice_number"))
524		case domain.TemplateKYCApproved:
525			return fmt.Sprintf("KYC approved — tier %s unlocked. - Saathi", p("tier")),
526				fmt.Sprintf("KYC स्वीकृत — टियर %s अनलॉक हुआ। - साथी", p("tier"))
527		case domain.TemplateKYCRejected:
528			return fmt.Sprintf("KYC rejected: %s. - Saathi", p("reason")),
529				fmt.Sprintf("KYC अस्वीकृत: %s। - साथी", p("reason"))
530		case domain.TemplateKYCPending:
531			return fmt.Sprintf("KYC verification pending for %s (tier %s) — review in Saathi.", p("subject"), p("tier")),
532				fmt.Sprintf("%s (टियर %s) का KYC सत्यापन लंबित — साथी में समीक्षा करें।", p("subject"), p("tier"))
533		case domain.TemplateOTP:
534			return fmt.Sprintf("Your Saathi OTP is %s. Do not share it with anyone.", p("otp")),
535				fmt.Sprintf("आपका साथी OTP %s है। इसे किसी से साझा न करें।", p("otp"))
536		default:
537			return "Saathi update: " + templateKey, "साथी सूचना: " + templateKey
538		}
539	}

541	// ---- Support: audited limited-PII lookup (§5.2 role 20) ----
542	
543	// lookupParty resolves a phone to the limited support view. EVERY call —
544	// hit or miss — is recorded as "support.pii_lookup": PII access is audited,
545	// full stop.
546	func (s *service) lookupParty(ctx context.Context, phone string) (*PartyLookupResponse, error) {
547		party, findErr := s.repo.findPartyByPhone(ctx, phone)
548	
549		entry := audit.Entry{
550			Action:     "support.pii_lookup",
551			TargetType: "PARTY",
552			Meta:       map[string]any{"phone": phone, "found": findErr == nil},
553		}
554		if findErr == nil {
555			entry.TargetID = party.ID.Hex()
556		}
557		s.deps.Audit.Record(ctx, entry)
558	
559		if findErr != nil {
560			return nil, findErr
561		}
562	
563		assignments, err := s.repo.listActiveAssignmentsForParty(ctx, party.ID)
564		if err != nil {
565			return nil, err
566		}
567		now := time.Now().UTC()
568		roles := []PartyRoleView{}
569		for _, assignment := range assignments {
570			if !assignment.UsableAt(now) {
571				continue
572			}
573			orgName := ""
574			if org, orgErr := s.deps.Orgs.Get(ctx, assignment.OrgUnitID); orgErr == nil {
575				orgName = org.Name
576			}
577			roles = append(roles, PartyRoleView{
578				RoleCode:  assignment.RoleCode,
579				OrgUnitID: assignment.OrgUnitID.Hex(),
580				OrgName:   orgName,
581			})
582		}
583	
584		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "support party lookup",
585			slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()), slog.Int("roles", len(roles)))
586	
587		// Limited PII by construction: no KYC document numbers, no bank details.
588		return &PartyLookupResponse{
589			PartyID:  party.ID.Hex(),
590			FullName: party.FullName,
591			KYCTier:  party.KYCTier,
592			Status:   party.Status,
593			Roles:    roles,
594		}, nil
595	}

597	// ---- Event-bus reactions: cross-module SMS queuing ----
598	
599	// decodeBusPayload structurally re-decodes a bus payload into this module's
600	// mirror struct — modules never import each other's types (module contract).
601	func decodeBusPayload(payload any, dst any) error {
602		raw, err := json.Marshal(payload)
603		if err != nil {
604			return fmt.Errorf("marshal bus payload: %w", err)
605		}
606		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, dst); err != nil {
607			return fmt.Errorf("unmarshal bus payload: %w", err)
608		}
609		return nil
610	}
611	
612	// onPayoutCredited queues the "₹ credited, UTR …" SMS to the farmer
613	// (blueprint §8.1 last step).
614	func (s *service) onPayoutCredited(ctx context.Context, payload any) {
615		var event payoutCreditedEvent
616		if err := decodeBusPayload(payload, &event); err != nil {
617			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "bad payout.credited payload", slog.Any("err", err))
618			return
619		}
620		if event.FarmerPartyID == "" && event.Phone == "" {
621			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "payout.credited payload has no addressee")
622			return
623		}
624		partyID := s.parseAddresseeID(ctx, event.FarmerPartyID, "payout.credited")
625		s.queueNotification(ctx, partyID, event.Phone, domain.TemplatePayoutCredited, map[string]string{
626			"amount": strconv.FormatFloat(event.Amount, 'f', 2, 64),
627			"utr":    event.UTR,
628		})
629	}
630	
631	// onGateBlocked alerts the blocked subject's UNION_FIELD_SUPERVISOR(s): the
632	// subject's org unit is resolved from its document, walked up to the union
633	// ancestor, and every usable supervisor assignment there gets the safety SMS.
634	func (s *service) onGateBlocked(ctx context.Context, payload any) {
635		var event gateBlockedEvent
636		if err := decodeBusPayload(payload, &event); err != nil {
637			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "bad qc.gate_blocked payload", slog.Any("err", err))
638			return
639		}
640	
641		subjectID, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(event.SubjectID)
642		if err != nil {
643			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qc.gate_blocked subject id is not an object id",
644				slog.String("subject_type", event.SubjectType), slog.String("subject_id", event.SubjectID))
645			return
646		}
647		orgUnitID, err := s.repo.subjectOrgUnit(ctx, event.SubjectType, subjectID)
648		if err != nil {
649			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "gate_blocked org resolution failed",
650				slog.String("subject_type", event.SubjectType),
651				slog.String("subject_id", subjectID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
652			return
653		}
654		union, err := s.unionAncestor(ctx, orgUnitID)
655		if err != nil {
656			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "gate_blocked union walk failed",
657				slog.String("org_unit_id", orgUnitID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
658			return
659		}
660		if union == nil {
661			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "gate_blocked org has no union ancestor",
662				slog.String("org_unit_id", orgUnitID.Hex()))
663			return
664		}
665	
666		supervisors, err := s.repo.listActiveRoleHolders(ctx, union.ID, domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor)
667		if err != nil {
668			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "gate_blocked supervisor lookup failed",
669				slog.String("union_id", union.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
670			return
671		}
672	
673		params := map[string]string{
674			"subject_type": event.SubjectType,
675			"subject_id":   event.SubjectID,
676			"stage":        event.Stage,
677			"reasons":      strings.Join(event.FailureReasons, ", "),
678		}
679		now := time.Now().UTC()
680		notified := map[primitive.ObjectID]bool{}
681		for _, assignment := range supervisors {
682			if !assignment.UsableAt(now) || notified[assignment.PartyID] {
683				continue
684			}
685			notified[assignment.PartyID] = true
686			partyID := assignment.PartyID
687			s.queueNotification(ctx, &partyID, "", domain.TemplateSafetyBlock, params)
688		}
689	}
690	
691	// onMVUDispatched queues the "MVU van on its way" SMS to the farmer (§10).
692	func (s *service) onMVUDispatched(ctx context.Context, payload any) {
693		var event mvuDispatchedEvent
694		if err := decodeBusPayload(payload, &event); err != nil {
695			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "bad mvu.dispatched payload", slog.Any("err", err))
696			return
697		}
698		if event.FarmerPartyID == "" && event.Phone == "" {
699			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "mvu.dispatched payload has no addressee")
700			return
701		}
702		caseID := event.CaseID
703		if caseID == "" {
704			caseID = event.MVUCaseID
705		}
706		if caseID == "" {
707			caseID = event.ID
708		}
709		params := map[string]string{"case_id": caseID}
710		if event.ETA != "" {
711			params["eta"] = event.ETA
712		}
713		partyID := s.parseAddresseeID(ctx, event.FarmerPartyID, "mvu.dispatched")
714		s.queueNotification(ctx, partyID, event.Phone, domain.TemplateMVUDispatched, params)
715	}
716	
717	// parseAddresseeID turns an optional addressee party ObjectID hex string
718	// (carried as a hex string on bus payloads) into a *primitive.ObjectID.
719	// An empty value is a legitimate phone-only addressing (returns nil); a
720	// non-empty but malformed value is a business/contract violation (WARN + nil).
721	func (s *service) parseAddresseeID(ctx context.Context, hex, event string) *primitive.ObjectID {
722		if hex == "" {
723			return nil
724		}
725		id, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(hex)
726		if err != nil {
727			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bus payload party id is not an object id",
728				slog.String("event", event), slog.String("party_id", hex))
729			return nil
730		}
731		return &id
732	}
733	
734	// hexOrEmpty renders an optional ObjectID for logs.
735	func hexOrEmpty(id *primitive.ObjectID) string {
736		if id == nil {
737			return ""
738		}
739		return id.Hex()
740	}
741	
742	// queueNotification inserts one QUEUED outbox document, resolving phone and
743	// preferred language from the party record when available. The _id is
744	// pre-generated so the queued entry can be named in the structured log.
745	// Failures are logged, never propagated — a lost SMS must not fail the
746	// publishing flow.
747	func (s *service) queueNotification(ctx context.Context, partyID *primitive.ObjectID, phone, templateKey string, params map[string]string) {
748		language := "hi" // vernacular default (blueprint §13)
749		if partyID != nil {
750			if party, err := s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, *partyID); err == nil {
751				if phone == "" {
752					phone = party.Phone
753				}
754				if party.PreferredLanguage != "" {
755					language = party.PreferredLanguage
756				}
757			}
758		}
759		if phone == "" {
760			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "dropping notification with no phone",
761				slog.String("template_key", templateKey), slog.String("party_id", hexOrEmpty(partyID)))
762			return
763		}
764	
765		id := primitive.NewObjectID()
766		notification := &StoredNotification{Notification: domain.Notification{
767			ID:          id,
768			PartyID:     partyID,
769			Phone:       phone,
770			Channel:     domain.ChannelSMS,
771			TemplateKey: templateKey,
772			Language:    language,
773			Params:      params,
774			Status:      domain.NotificationQueued,
775			QueuedAt:    time.Now().UTC(),
776		}}
777		if err := s.repo.insertNotification(ctx, notification); err != nil {
778			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "queue notification failed",
779				slog.String("template_key", templateKey), slog.Any("err", err))
780			return
781		}
782		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "notification queued",
783			slog.String("notification_id", id.Hex()),
784			slog.String("template_key", templateKey),
785			slog.String("party_id", hexOrEmpty(partyID)),
786			slog.String("status", domain.NotificationQueued))
787	}
788	
789	// unionAncestor returns the MILK_UNION org unit at or above orgUnitID, walking
790	// the denormalised ancestor Path nearest-first via d.Orgs.Get. Returns nil
791	// when no union sits on the chain (e.g. a plant directly under the federation).
792	func (s *service) unionAncestor(ctx context.Context, orgUnitID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
793		org, err := s.deps.Orgs.Get(ctx, orgUnitID)
794		if err != nil {
795			return nil, err
796		}
797		if org.Type == domain.OrgTypeMilkUnion {
798			return org, nil
799		}
800		// Path holds ancestors root→down; walk nearest ancestor first.
801		for i := len(org.Path) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
802			ancestor, err := s.deps.Orgs.Get(ctx, org.Path[i])
803			if err != nil {
804				return nil, err
805			}
806			if ancestor.Type == domain.OrgTypeMilkUnion {
807				return ancestor, nil
808			}
809		}
810		return nil, nil
811	}

832	// repository is all MongoDB access for the platformops module. It owns the
833	// notifications outbox, reads audit_logs strictly read-only (writes go
834	// through deps.Audit only — the collection is insert-only by design, §12),
835	// and reads parties / role_assignments for the support lookup and for
836	// addressing safety alerts. bmc_lots / processing_batches are read solely to
837	// resolve a gate-blocked subject back to its org unit.
838	type repository struct {
839		auditLogs     *mongo.Collection
840		notifications *mongo.Collection
841		parties       *mongo.Collection

843		bmcLots       *mongo.Collection

847	// newRepository binds the repository to its collections.
848	func newRepository(db *mongo.Database) *repository {
849		return &repository{
850			auditLogs:     db.Collection(mongodb.CollAuditLogs),
851			notifications: db.Collection(mongodb.CollNotifications),
852			parties:       db.Collection(mongodb.CollParties),
853			assignments:   db.Collection(mongodb.CollRoleAssignments),

855			batches:       db.Collection(mongodb.CollBatches),
856		}

859	// auditFilter builds the bson filter shared by the list and export reads.
860	func auditFilter(f auditLogFilter) bson.D {
861		filter := bson.D{}
862		if f.ActorPartyID != "" {
863			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "actor_party_id", Value: f.ActorPartyID})
864		}
865		if f.TargetType != "" {
866			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "target_type", Value: f.TargetType})
867		}
868		if f.Action != "" {
869			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "action", Value: f.Action})
870		}
871		if f.From != nil || f.To != nil {
872			tsRange := bson.D{}
873			if f.From != nil {
874				tsRange = append(tsRange, bson.E{Key: "$gte", Value: *f.From})
875			}
876			if f.To != nil {
877				tsRange = append(tsRange, bson.E{Key: "$lte", Value: *f.To})
878			}
879			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "ts", Value: tsRange})
880		}
881		return filter
882	}

965	// claimQueuedNotification atomically claims the oldest QUEUED document
966	// (QUEUED→SENT, sent_at, provider_ref) and returns it, or nil when the queue
967	// is drained. FindOneAndUpdate makes the claim race-safe across concurrent
968	// worker runs — never find-then-update.
969	func (r *repository) claimQueuedNotification(ctx context.Context, providerRef string, now time.Time) (*StoredNotification, error) {
970		var n StoredNotification
971		err := r.notifications.FindOneAndUpdate(ctx,
972			bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: domain.NotificationQueued}},
973			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
974				{Key: "status", Value: domain.NotificationSent},
975				{Key: "sent_at", Value: now},
976				{Key: "provider_ref", Value: providerRef},
977			}}},
978			options.FindOneAndUpdate().
979				SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "queued_at", Value: 1}}).
980				SetReturnDocument(options.After),
981		).Decode(&n)
982		if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
983			return nil, nil
984		}
985		if err != nil {
986			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("claim queued notification: %w", err))
987		}
988		return &n, nil
989	}

1071	// subjectOrgUnit resolves a gate-blocked QC subject to the org unit that
1072	// holds it (BMC lot → bmc_id, processing batch → plant_id). Both the subject
1073	// _id and the reference field are ObjectIDs.
1074	func (r *repository) subjectOrgUnit(ctx context.Context, subjectType string, subjectID primitive.ObjectID) (primitive.ObjectID, error) {
1075		var coll *mongo.Collection
1076		var field string
1077		switch subjectType {
1078		case domain.QCSubjectBMCLot:
1079			coll, field = r.bmcLots, "bmc_id"
1080		case domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch:
1081			coll, field = r.batches, "plant_id"
1082		default:
1083			return primitive.NilObjectID, fmt.Errorf("gate-blocked subject type %q has no org resolution", subjectType)
1084		}
1085	
1086		var doc bson.M
1087		err := coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: subjectID}},
1088			options.FindOne().SetProjection(bson.D{{Key: field, Value: 1}}),
1089		).Decode(&doc)
1090		if err != nil {
1091			return primitive.NilObjectID, fmt.Errorf("resolve org of %s %s: %w", subjectType, subjectID.Hex(), err)
1092		}
1093		orgUnitID, _ := doc[field].(primitive.ObjectID)
1094		if orgUnitID.IsZero() {
1095			return primitive.NilObjectID, fmt.Errorf("%s %s carries no %s", subjectType, subjectID.Hex(), field)
1096		}
1097		return orgUnitID, nil
1098	}

438	// CreateBatch pools DISPATCHED (gate-passed) BMC lots into one production
439	// run. The gate re-checks here belt-and-braces: aflatoxin M1 survives
440	// pasteurisation, so a blocked lot must never reach a vat (§8.3).
441	func (s *Service) CreateBatch(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateBatchRequest) (*domain.ProcessingBatch, error) {
442		actID, err := actorID(actor)
443		if err != nil {
444			return nil, err
445		}
446		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, req.PlantID, "create batch"); err != nil {
447			return nil, err
448		}
449		org, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.PlantID)
450		if err != nil {
451			return nil, err
452		}
453		if org.Type != domain.OrgTypeProcessingPlant {
454			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch creation refused: org unit is not a plant",
455				slog.String("org_unit_id", req.PlantID.Hex()),
456				slog.String("org_type", org.Type),
457				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
458			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_PLANT", "org unit "+req.PlantID.Hex()+" is not a processing plant")
459		}
460	
461		ids := dedupe(req.BMCLotIDs)
462		lots, err := s.repo.BMCLotsByIDs(ctx, ids)
463		if err != nil {
464			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "load bmc lots", err)
465		}
466		if len(lots) != len(ids) {
467			return nil, httpx.NotFound("BMC lot(s) " + strings.Join(missingLotIDs(ids, lots), ", "))
468		}
469		// Scope root the plant may pool from: its parent union (siblings' BMCs are
470		// legitimate), or the plant itself when it sits directly under the federation.
471		plantScopeRoot := org.ID
472		if org.ParentID != nil {
473			plantScopeRoot = *org.ParentID
474		}
475		var offending, foreign []string
476		var inputLitres float64
477		for _, lot := range lots {
478			if !canPoolBMCLot(lot.Status) {
479				offending = append(offending, lot.ID.Hex())
480				continue
481			}
482			// A plant may only pool BMC lots from within its own union subtree —
483			// never claim another union's foreign lot.
484			inScope, serr := s.orgs.InScope(ctx, plantScopeRoot, lot.BMCID)
485			if serr != nil {
486				return nil, serr
487			}
488			if !inScope {
489				foreign = append(foreign, lot.ID.Hex())
490				continue
491			}
492			inputLitres += lot.TotalQuantityLitres
493		}
494		if len(offending) > 0 {
495			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch creation refused: bmc lot(s) have not cleared the safety gate",
496				slog.String("plant_id", req.PlantID.Hex()),
497				slog.String("blocked_lot_ids", strings.Join(offending, ",")),
498				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
499			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked,
500				"one or more BMC lots have not cleared the safety gate (must be PASSED and DISPATCHED)").
501				WithDetails(map[string]any{"blocked_lot_ids": offending})
502		}
503		if len(foreign) > 0 {
504			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch creation refused: bmc lot(s) outside the plant's union scope",
505				slog.String("plant_id", req.PlantID.Hex()),
506				slog.String("foreign_lot_ids", strings.Join(foreign, ",")),
507				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
508			return nil, httpx.Forbidden("one or more BMC lots are outside this plant's organisational scope").
509				WithDetails(map[string]any{"foreign_lot_ids": foreign})
510		}
511	
512		now := time.Now().UTC()
513		dateKey := domain.DateKeyIST(now)
514		seq, err := s.repo.NextSequence(ctx, "batch_number:"+req.PlantID.Hex()+":"+dateKey)
515		if err != nil {
516			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "next batch number sequence", err)
517		}
518		batchNumber := fmt.Sprintf("BATCH-%s-%s-%04d",
519			org.Code, strings.ReplaceAll(dateKey, "-", ""), seq)
520	
521		// Optimistic claim (mirrors ClaimConsignments): flip DISPATCHED→POOLED
522		// stamped with the pre-generated batch ID BEFORE inserting the batch. One
523		// physical lot of milk can therefore never be pooled into two batches —
524		// neither by a double-submit nor by two concurrent CreateBatch calls.
525		batchID := primitive.NewObjectID()
526		claimed, err := s.repo.ClaimBMCLots(ctx, ids, batchID)
527		if err != nil {
528			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "claim bmc lots", err)
529		}
530		if claimed != int64(len(ids)) {
531			if relErr := s.repo.ReleaseBMCLots(ctx, batchID); relErr != nil {
532				return nil, s.fail(ctx, "release bmc lots after lost claim", relErr)
533			}
534			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch creation lost bmc lot claim race",
535				slog.String("plant_id", req.PlantID.Hex()),
536				slog.Int64("claimed", claimed), slog.Int("requested", len(ids)),
537				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
538			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_CLAIM_CONFLICT",
539				"one or more BMC lots were pooled by another batch — reload and retry")
540		}
541	
542		// CREATED is a transient birth state: the plant lab must clear every
543		// batch, so it is persisted straight into QC_PENDING.
544		batch := &domain.ProcessingBatch{
545			ID:          batchID,
546			PlantID:     req.PlantID,
547			BatchNumber: batchNumber,
548			BMCLotIDs:   ids,
549			ProductType: req.ProductType,
550			InputLitres: inputLitres,
551			Status:      domain.BatchStatusQCPending,
552			StartedAt:   now,
553			CreatedBy:   actID,
554			CreatedAt:   now,
555		}
556		if err := s.repo.InsertBatch(ctx, batch); err != nil {
557			_ = s.repo.ReleaseBMCLots(ctx, batchID)
558			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "insert batch", err)
559		}

561		refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, len(ids))
562		for _, id := range ids {
563			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{
564				EntityType: domain.EntityBMCLot, EntityID: id.Hex(), Relation: "pools",
565			})
566		}
567		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
568			Type:       domain.EventBatchCreated,
569			EntityType: domain.EntityBatch,
570			EntityID:   batch.ID.Hex(),
571			Refs:       refs,
572			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
573			OrgUnitID:  req.PlantID.Hex(),
574			Payload: map[string]any{
575				"batch_number": batchNumber, "product_type": req.ProductType, "input_litres": inputLitres,
576			},
577		})
578		if err != nil {
579			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append batch.created event", err)
580		}
581		if err := s.repo.SetBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx, batch.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
582			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp batch provenance seq", err)
583		}
584		batch.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
585		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "processing batch created",
586			slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
587			slog.String("batch_number", batchNumber),
588			slog.String("plant_id", req.PlantID.Hex()),
589			slog.String("product_type", req.ProductType),
590			slog.Int("bmc_lots", len(ids)),
591			slog.Float64("input_litres", inputLitres),
592			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
593		return batch, nil
594	}
595	
596	// CompleteBatch transitions PASSED→COMPLETED — only a batch the plant lab
597	// cleared may finish and go on to yield product lots.
```

1	package httpx
2	
3	import (
4		"encoding/json"
5		"errors"
6		"log/slog"
7		"net/http"
8	)
9	
10	// envelope is the uniform success shape: {"data": ..., "meta": {...}?}.
11	type envelope struct {
12		Data any `json:"data"`
13		Meta any `json:"meta,omitempty"`
14	}
15	
16	type errEnvelope struct {
17		Error *AppError `json:"error"`
18	}
19	
20	// JSON writes a success response wrapped in the standard envelope.
21	func JSON(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, data any) {
22		writeJSON(w, status, envelope{Data: data})
23	}
24	
25	// JSONMeta writes a success response with list metadata (pagination etc.).
26	func JSONMeta(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, data, meta any) {
27		writeJSON(w, status, envelope{Data: data, Meta: meta})
28	}
29	
30	// Error writes the standard error envelope. Unexpected (non-AppError) errors
31	// become an opaque 500 and the cause is logged with the request context.
32	func Error(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, err error) {
33		var ae *AppError
34		if !errors.As(err, &ae) {
35			ae = Internal(err)
36		}
37		if ae.Status >= 500 {
38			slog.ErrorContext(r.Context(), "request failed",
39				slog.String("method", r.Method),
40				slog.String("path", r.URL.Path),
41				slog.String("code", ae.Code),
42				slog.Any("cause", ae.CauseOrSelf()),
43			)
44		}
45		writeJSON(w, ae.Status, errEnvelope{Error: ae})
46	}
47	
48	// CauseOrSelf returns the wrapped cause if present, else the error itself.
49	func (e *AppError) CauseOrSelf() error {
50		if e.cause != nil {
51			return e.cause
52		}
53		return e
54	}
55	
56	func writeJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, v any) {
57		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
58		w.WriteHeader(status)
59		_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(v)
60	}
61

10	// ParseID converts an ObjectID hex string (from JSON bodies, query params or
11	// JWT claims) into a primitive.ObjectID, or returns a 400 with the offending
12	// field name.
13	func ParseID(hex, field string) (primitive.ObjectID, error) {
14		id, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(hex)
15		if err != nil {
16			return primitive.NilObjectID, BadRequest("INVALID_ID", field+" must be a valid object id")
17		}
18		return id, nil
19	}
20	
21	// PathID extracts a chi URL parameter and parses it as an ObjectID.
22	func PathID(r *http.Request, param string) (primitive.ObjectID, error) {
23		return ParseID(chi.URLParam(r, param), param)
24	}

1	// Package mongodb owns the MongoDB connection and the index catalog.
2	// The connection string comes exclusively from configuration (env) — never
3	// from code.
4	package mongodb
5	
6	import (
7		"context"
8		"fmt"
9		"time"
10	
11		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
12		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo/options"
13		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo/readpref"
14	)
15	
16	// Connect dials MongoDB, verifies the connection with a ping, and returns the
17	// client plus the application database handle. Pool sizing targets peak
18	// pour-time write bursts (twice-daily shift spikes, blueprint §16).
19	func Connect(ctx context.Context, uri, dbName string) (*mongo.Client, *mongo.Database, error) {
20		opts := options.Client().
21			ApplyURI(uri).
22			SetMaxPoolSize(200).
23			SetMinPoolSize(8).
24			SetMaxConnIdleTime(5 * time.Minute).
25			SetServerSelectionTimeout(5 * time.Second).
26			SetTimeout(15 * time.Second)
27	
28		client, err := mongo.Connect(ctx, opts)
29		if err != nil {
30			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("mongo connect: %w", err)
31		}
32	
33		pingCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 5*time.Second)
34		defer cancel()
35		if err := client.Ping(pingCtx, readpref.Primary()); err != nil {
36			return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("mongo ping (%s): %w", uri, err)
37		}
38	
39		return client, client.Database(dbName), nil
40	}
41

5	// around.

package domain

import (
	"time"

	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
)

// Org-unit types — the cooperative backbone RBAC is scoped to (blueprint §5.1,
// PCDF constitution: Samiti/DCS → Sangh/Union → PCDF apex).
const (
	OrgTypeFederation      = "FEDERATION"       // PCDF / Parag (state apex)
	OrgTypeMilkUnion       = "MILK_UNION"       // district Sangh
	OrgTypeProcessingPlant = "PROCESSING_PLANT" // PCDF plant
	OrgTypeBMC             = "BMC"              // bulk milk cooler / chilling centre
	OrgTypeDCS             = "DCS"              // village samiti
)

// AllOrgTypes is the closed set of org-unit types.
var AllOrgTypes = []string{
	OrgTypeFederation, OrgTypeMilkUnion, OrgTypeProcessingPlant, OrgTypeBMC, OrgTypeDCS,
}

// ValidOrgParent encodes the allowed hierarchy edges.
var ValidOrgParent = map[string][]string{
	OrgTypeFederation:      {}, // root
	OrgTypeMilkUnion:       {OrgTypeFederation},
	OrgTypeProcessingPlant: {OrgTypeMilkUnion, OrgTypeFederation},
	OrgTypeBMC:             {OrgTypeMilkUnion},
	OrgTypeDCS:             {OrgTypeMilkUnion, OrgTypeBMC},
}

// OrgUnit is a node in the cooperative hierarchy.
//
// ID scheme: `_id` is a generated ObjectID (relations always reference it);
// Code is the human-readable unique business key (e.g. "DCS-01842") used for
// display, lookups and seed idempotency — never for joins.
//
// Path holds the ObjectIDs of all ancestors from the root down to (and
// excluding) this node — denormalised so "is X inside Y's scope" is a single
// indexed array-containment check with no recursive queries on the hot path.
type OrgUnit struct {
	ID        primitive.ObjectID   `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
	Type      string               `bson:"type"          json:"type"`
	Name      string               `bson:"name"          json:"name"`
	Code      string               `bson:"code"          json:"code"` // unique business key, e.g. "DCS-01842"
	ParentID  *primitive.ObjectID  `bson:"parent_id,omitempty" json:"parent_id,omitempty"`
	Path      []primitive.ObjectID `bson:"path"          json:"path"`
	District  string               `bson:"district,omitempty" json:"district,omitempty"`
	State     string               `bson:"state,omitempty"    json:"state,omitempty"`
	GeoLat    float64              `bson:"geo_lat,omitempty"  json:"geo_lat,omitempty"`
	GeoLng    float64              `bson:"geo_lng,omitempty"  json:"geo_lng,omitempty"`
	Active    bool                 `bson:"active"        json:"active"`
	CreatedAt time.Time            `bson:"created_at"    json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt time.Time            `bson:"updated_at"    json:"updated_at"`
}

// IsValidOrgType reports whether t is a known org-unit type.
func IsValidOrgType(t string) bool {
	for _, v := range AllOrgTypes {
		if v == t {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
=====ROLES=====
// Package domain holds the pure entity model of Saathi — structs, enums and
// invariants shared by every module. It has no behaviour beyond validation
// and no dependencies outside the standard library and BSON primitives.
// This is the contract layer: modules depend on domain, never the other way
// around.
package domain

// Role codes — the role catalog from blueprint §5.2, grounded in the PCDF
// cooperative constitution (Farmer → Samiti/DCS → Sangh/Union → PCDF).
// A Party may hold many time-bounded, org-scoped RoleAssignments.
//
// The catalog is deliberately open for extension: adding a future role is a
// new constant + AllRoles entry + RequiredKYCTier entry — nothing else.
const (
	// Village tier
	RoleFarmer         = "FARMER"
	RoleSamitiSacheev  = "SAMITI_SACHEEV"  // DCS paid Secretary (UPCS Act §31) — runs the collection console
	RoleSamitiAdhyaksh = "SAMITI_ADHYAKSH" // DCS Chairman/Sabhapati (elected, honorary, §30)
	RoleMilkTester     = "MILK_TESTER"
	RoleLRP            = "LRP" // Local Resource Person (NDDB village extension)
	RoleAITech         = "AI_TECH"

	// Field / organisation tier
	// ORGANISING_MANAGER is the ground-level field worker (Dairy Development
	// Department pattern: "promotes and organises new samitis") who performs
	// doorstep KYC capture and first-level verification.
	RoleOrganisingManager = "ORGANISING_MANAGER"
	// ONBOARDING_EXECUTIVE is the mobile-app onboarding worker the field client
	// uses for the same doorstep KYC / assisted-onboarding job as
	// ORGANISING_MANAGER. Both are valid onboarding/review roles; the app codes
	// this one, the backend historically coded the other.
	RoleOnboardingExecutive = "ONBOARDING_EXECUTIVE"

	RoleVanRider      = "VAN_RIDER"
	RoleDeliveryRider = "DELIVERY_RIDER"

	// Retail / commerce tier (Phase-3 store module; dormant behind a flag but a
	// grantable role so the store console can be assigned).
	RoleStoreManager = "STORE_MANAGER"

	// Union tier
	RoleBMCOperator          = "BMC_OPERATOR"
	RoleUnionFieldSupervisor = "UNION_FIELD_SUPERVISOR"
	RoleUnionPresident       = "UNION_PRESIDENT"

	// Plant tier
	RolePlantOperator   = "PLANT_OPERATOR"
	RolePlantLabAnalyst = "PLANT_LAB_ANALYST"

	// State / district tier
	RolePCDFAdmin        = "PCDF_ADMIN"
	RoleMissionOfficial  = "MISSION_OFFICIAL"
	RoleDistrictVerifier = "DISTRICT_VERIFIER"

	// Health tier
	RoleVeterinarian = "VETERINARIAN"
	RoleMVUDriver    = "MVU_DRIVER"

	// Consumer tier
	RoleConsumer = "CONSUMER"

	// Platform tier
	RoleSupportAgent = "SUPPORT_AGENT"
	RoleStateAuditor = "STATE_AUDITOR"
	RoleSuperAdmin   = "SUPER_ADMIN"

	// System tier
	RoleServiceAccount = "SERVICE_ACCOUNT"
)

// AllRoles is the closed set of grantable role codes (extend here).
var AllRoles = []string{
	RoleFarmer, RoleSamitiSacheev, RoleSamitiAdhyaksh, RoleMilkTester, RoleLRP, RoleAITech,
	RoleOrganisingManager, RoleOnboardingExecutive,
	RoleVanRider, RoleDeliveryRider, RoleStoreManager,
	RoleBMCOperator, RoleUnionFieldSupervisor, RoleUnionPresident,
	RolePlantOperator, RolePlantLabAnalyst,
	RolePCDFAdmin, RoleMissionOfficial, RoleDistrictVerifier,
	RoleVeterinarian, RoleMVUDriver,

	RoleSupportAgent, RoleStateAuditor, RoleSuperAdmin,

// OnboardingReviewerRoles are the roles authorised to run the KYC review /
// assisted-onboarding console. Both the historical ORGANISING_MANAGER and the
// app-coded ONBOARDING_EXECUTIVE qualify, plus the district/federation tiers.
var OnboardingReviewerRoles = []string{
	RoleOnboardingExecutive, RoleOrganisingManager, RoleDistrictVerifier, RolePCDFAdmin, RoleSuperAdmin,
}

var roleSet = func() map[string]struct{} {
	s := make(map[string]struct{}, len(AllRoles))
	for _, r := range AllRoles {
		s[r] = struct{}{}
	}
	return s
}()

// IsValidRole reports whether code is one of the catalog roles.
func IsValidRole(code string) bool {
	_, ok := roleSet[code]
	return ok
}

// KYC assurance tiers (blueprint §4.2). Higher tiers unlock higher-trust roles.
const (
	KYCTierMinimal  = "MINIMAL"  // mobile OTP only (consumer)
	KYCTierFarmer   = "FARMER"   // Aadhaar OTP eKYC or offline XML + penny-drop
	KYCTierStandard = "STANDARD" // Aadhaar eKYC
	KYCTierRider    = "RIDER"    // Aadhaar eKYC + DL/RC
	KYCTierHigh     = "HIGH"     // eKYC + org record / V-CIP for officials

)

// RequiredKYCTier maps each role to the minimum KYC tier a party must hold
// before a role token for it can be issued (blueprint §5.2 "KYC tier").
// Tier upgrades happen ONLY through the KYC approval workflow: submit →
// PENDING → reviewed by an authorised approver → VERIFIED. There is no
// self-service tier upgrade.
var RequiredKYCTier = map[string]string{
	RoleFarmer:               KYCTierFarmer,
	RoleSamitiSacheev:        KYCTierHigh,
	RoleSamitiAdhyaksh:       KYCTierHigh,
	RoleMilkTester:           KYCTierStandard,
	RoleLRP:                  KYCTierStandard,
	RoleAITech:               KYCTierStandard,
	RoleOrganisingManager:    KYCTierHigh,
	RoleOnboardingExecutive:  KYCTierHigh,
	RoleVanRider:             KYCTierRider,
	RoleDeliveryRider:        KYCTierRider,
	RoleStoreManager:         KYCTierStandard,
	RoleBMCOperator:          KYCTierStandard,
	RoleUnionFieldSupervisor: KYCTierHigh,
	RoleUnionPresident:       KYCTierHigh,
	RolePlantOperator:        KYCTierHigh,
	RolePlantLabAnalyst:      KYCTierHigh,
	RolePCDFAdmin:            KYCTierHigh,
	RoleMissionOfficial:      KYCTierHigh,
	RoleDistrictVerifier:     KYCTierHigh,
	RoleVeterinarian:         KYCTierHigh,
	RoleMVUDriver:            KYCTierStandard,
	RoleConsumer:             KYCTierMinimal,
	RoleSupportAgent:         KYCTierHigh,
	RoleStateAuditor:         KYCTierHigh,
	RoleSuperAdmin:           KYCTierHighest,
	RoleServiceAccount:       KYCTierService,
}

// kycRank orders tiers so "tier X satisfies requirement Y" is a comparison.
var kycRank = map[string]int{
	KYCTierMinimal:  0,
	KYCTierFarmer:   1,
	KYCTierStandard: 1, // Farmer and Standard are parallel tier-1 proofs
	KYCTierRider:    2,
	KYCTierHigh:     3,
	KYCTierHighest:  4,
	KYCTierService:  4,
	KYCTierMTLS:     4, // alias of SERVICE
}

// KYCTierSatisfies reports whether a party at tier `have` meets `need`.
// Parallel tier-1 proofs (FARMER vs STANDARD) satisfy each other.
func KYCTierSatisfies(have, need string) bool {
	h, okH := kycRank[have]
	n, okN := kycRank[need]
	if !okH || !okN {
		return false
	}
	return h >= n
}

// KYCApprovableTiers maps an approver ROLE to the KYC tiers it may approve.
// Ground staff clear the field tiers; only federation admins clear HIGH;

var KYCApprovableTiers = map[string][]string{

func CanApproveKYCTier(approverRole, tier string) bool {

15	// Party is the single identity record per human (blueprint §4.1):
16	// one phone number = one Party = many org-scoped RoleAssignments.
17	// `_id` is a generated ObjectID; `phone` is the unique natural key used for
18	// login — relations always reference the ObjectID, never the phone.
19	type Party struct {
20		ID                primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
21		Phone             string             `bson:"phone"         json:"phone"`
22		FullName          string             `bson:"full_name,omitempty"          json:"full_name,omitempty"`
23		PreferredLanguage string             `bson:"preferred_language,omitempty" json:"preferred_language,omitempty"` // "hi", "en", ...
24		KYCTier           string             `bson:"kyc_tier"      json:"kyc_tier"`
25		Status            string             `bson:"status"        json:"status"`
26		// PublicConsent is the DPDP §6.7 opt-in: when true the farmer agrees to be
27		// NAMED on the public QR trace roster; when false they are counted but never
28		// named. Defaults false (privacy-preserving).
29		PublicConsent bool      `bson:"public_consent" json:"public_consent"`
30		CreatedAt     time.Time `bson:"created_at"    json:"created_at"`
31		UpdatedAt     time.Time `bson:"updated_at"    json:"updated_at"`
32	}
33	
34	// RoleAssignment statuses.
35	const (
36		RoleAssignmentActive  = "ACTIVE"
37		RoleAssignmentRevoked = "REVOKED"
38	)
39	
40	// RoleAssignment grants one role to one party inside one org unit for a
41	// validity window. Revoking a Sacheev after an election is a single record
42	// update — never an account deletion (blueprint §4.1).
43	type RoleAssignment struct {
44		ID        primitive.ObjectID  `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
45		PartyID   primitive.ObjectID  `bson:"party_id"      json:"party_id"`
46		RoleCode  string              `bson:"role_code"     json:"role_code"`
47		OrgUnitID primitive.ObjectID  `bson:"org_unit_id"   json:"org_unit_id"`
48		GrantedBy *primitive.ObjectID `bson:"granted_by,omitempty" json:"granted_by,omitempty"`
49		ValidFrom time.Time           `bson:"valid_from"    json:"valid_from"`
50		ValidTo   *time.Time          `bson:"valid_to,omitempty"   json:"valid_to,omitempty"` // nil = open-ended
51		Status    string              `bson:"status"        json:"status"`
52		RevokedAt *time.Time          `bson:"revoked_at,omitempty" json:"revoked_at,omitempty"`
53		RevokedBy *primitive.ObjectID `bson:"revoked_by,omitempty" json:"revoked_by,omitempty"`
54		CreatedAt time.Time           `bson:"created_at"    json:"created_at"`
55	}
56	
57	// UsableAt reports whether the assignment is active and inside its validity
58	// window at instant t.
59	func (ra RoleAssignment) UsableAt(t time.Time) bool {
60		if ra.Status != RoleAssignmentActive {
61			return false
62		}
63		if t.Before(ra.ValidFrom) {
64			return false
65		}
66		if ra.ValidTo != nil && t.After(*ra.ValidTo) {
67			return false
68		}
69		return true
70	}
71	
72	// KYC record statuses — the approval workflow:
73	// submit → PENDING → (Organising Manager / District Verifier / PCDF Admin /
74	// Super Admin reviews) → VERIFIED (tier upgraded) or REJECTED (with reason).
75	// A role token is only issuable once the party's tier satisfies the role's
76	// RequiredKYCTier, so "login as rider" is impossible before approval.
77	const (
78		KYCStatusPending  = "PENDING"
79		KYCStatusVerified = "VERIFIED"
80		KYCStatusRejected = "REJECTED"
81	)

85	// vault reference are ever stored — never the full number, never biometrics.
86	type KYCRecord struct {

92		BankAccountMasked string              `bson:"bank_account_masked,omitempty" json:"bank_account_masked,omitempty"`
93		BankIFSC          string              `bson:"bank_ifsc,omitempty"           json:"bank_ifsc,omitempty"`
94		BankVerified      bool                `bson:"bank_verified"                 json:"bank_verified"`
95		BankNameMatch     float64             `bson:"bank_name_match,omitempty"     json:"bank_name_match,omitempty"` // penny-drop name-match score 0..1
96		DigiLockerDocs    []DocRef            `bson:"digilocker_docs,omitempty"     json:"digilocker_docs,omitempty"`
97		VideoKYCRef       string              `bson:"video_kyc_ref,omitempty"       json:"video_kyc_ref,omitempty"`
98		ConsentID         *primitive.ObjectID `bson:"consent_id,omitempty"          json:"consent_id,omitempty"`
99		Status            string              `bson:"status"        json:"status"`
100		RejectionReason   string              `bson:"rejection_reason,omitempty" json:"rejection_reason,omitempty"`
101		ReviewedBy        *primitive.ObjectID `bson:"reviewed_by,omitempty"      json:"reviewed_by,omitempty"` // approver party
102		ReviewedByRole    string              `bson:"reviewed_by_role,omitempty" json:"reviewed_by_role,omitempty"`
103		ReviewedAt        *time.Time          `bson:"reviewed_at,omitempty"      json:"reviewed_at,omitempty"`
104		VerifiedAt        *time.Time          `bson:"verified_at,omitempty"      json:"verified_at,omitempty"`
105		CreatedAt         time.Time           `bson:"created_at"    json:"created_at"`
106		UpdatedAt         time.Time           `bson:"updated_at"    json:"updated_at"`
107	}

165	// KYCTierSatisfies reports whether a party at tier `have` meets `need`.
166	// Parallel tier-1 proofs (FARMER vs STANDARD) satisfy each other.
167	func KYCTierSatisfies(have, need string) bool {
168		h, okH := kycRank[have]
169		n, okN := kycRank[need]
170		if !okH || !okN {
171			return false
172		}
173		return h >= n
174	}

188	// requesting the given tier.

190		for _, t := range KYCApprovableTiers[approverRole] {
191			if t == tier {

193			}
194		}

=====QUALITY=====
package domain

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
)

// FSSAI limits for liquid milk (blueprint §8.3). Aflatoxin M1 is heat-stable
// and survives pasteurisation, so it MUST be gated upstream (BMC + plant),
// never only at the finished product.
const (
	FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg = 0.5  // AFM1 ≤ 0.5 µg/kg
	FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl          = 10.0 // coliform ≤ 10 CFU/ml
	FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg       = 0.1  // antibiotic MRL example
)

// QC test names.
const (
	TestAflatoxinM1 = "AFLATOXIN_M1"            // µg/kg
	TestColiform    = "COLIFORM"                // CFU/ml
	TestTPC         = "TPC"                     // CFU/ml, graded — recorded, not hard-gated here
	TestAntibiotic  = "ANTIBIOTIC_TETRACYCLINE" // mg/kg
	TestPhosphatase = "PHOSPHATASE"             // 0 = negative (pass post-pasteurisation), 1 = positive
	TestFat         = "FAT"                     // %
	TestSNF         = "SNF"                     // %
)

// QC stages.
const (
	QCStageBMCRapid = "BMC_RAPID" // strip/rapid tests at the chilling centre
	QCStagePlantLab = "PLANT_LAB" // full lab: ELISA/HPLC, culture, LC-MS/MS
)

// QC subject types.
const (
	QCSubjectDCSConsignment  = "DCS_CONSIGNMENT"
	QCSubjectBMCLot          = "BMC_LOT"
	QCSubjectProcessingBatch = "PROCESSING_BATCH"
)

// QCTest is a single measurement inside a QC result.
type QCTest struct {
	Name  string  `bson:"name"  json:"name"`
	Value float64 `bson:"value" json:"value"`
	Unit  string  `bson:"unit"  json:"unit"`
	Pass  bool    `bson:"pass"  json:"pass"`
}

// QCResult is the recorded outcome of testing one subject at one stage.
// OverallPass drives the safety gate; a certificate is attached to provenance
// on pass, a block + quarantine on fail.
type QCResult struct {
	ID                primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
	SubjectType       string             `bson:"subject_type"  json:"subject_type"`
	SubjectID         primitive.ObjectID `bson:"subject_id"    json:"subject_id"`
	Stage             string             `bson:"stage"         json:"stage"`
	Tests             []QCTest           `bson:"tests"         json:"tests"`
	OverallPass       bool               `bson:"overall_pass"  json:"overall_pass"`
	FailureReasons    []string           `bson:"failure_reasons,omitempty" json:"failure_reasons,omitempty"`
	AnalystPartyID    primitive.ObjectID `bson:"analyst_party_id" json:"analyst_party_id"`
	LabRef            string             `bson:"lab_ref,omitempty"            json:"lab_ref,omitempty"`
	CertificateNumber string             `bson:"certificate_number,omitempty" json:"certificate_number,omitempty"`
	// Superseded marks a result voided after losing the gate race — the
	// verdict on the subject came from a different, earlier result.
	Superseded    bool      `bson:"superseded,omitempty" json:"superseded,omitempty"`
	RecordedAt    time.Time `bson:"recorded_at"   json:"recorded_at"`
	ProvenanceSeq int64     `bson:"provenance_seq,omitempty" json:"provenance_seq,omitempty"`
}

// NormalizeTestName maps common field aliases to the canonical FSSAI test
// name so the safety gate can NEVER be bypassed by a spelling difference
// (e.g. the app sends "AFM1"; the gate keys on "AFLATOXIN_M1"). A test whose
// name still doesn't resolve to a gated parameter is recorded but not gated.
func NormalizeTestName(name string) string {
	switch strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(name)) {
	case "AFM1", "AFLATOXIN", "AFLATOXINM1", "AFLATOXIN_M1", "AFLATOXIN-M1":
		return TestAflatoxinM1
	case "COLIFORM", "COLIFORMS":
		return TestColiform
	case "TPC", "TOTAL_PLATE_COUNT":
		return TestTPC
	case "ANTIBIOTIC", "TETRACYCLINE", "ANTIBIOTIC_TETRACYCLINE":
		return TestAntibiotic
	case "PHOSPHATASE", "ALP":
		return TestPhosphatase
	case "FAT":
		return TestFat

=== AppendInput/Ref ===

// Ref is a directed edge to another entity in the trace graph
// (e.g. a consignment event referencing the pours it aggregates).
type Ref struct {
	EntityType string `bson:"entity_type" json:"entity_type"`
	EntityID   string `bson:"entity_id"   json:"entity_id"`
	Relation   string `bson:"relation"    json:"relation"` // aggregates | supersedes | tested | yields | labels ...
}

// ActorRef records who caused the event.
type ActorRef struct {
	PartyID  string `bson:"party_id"  json:"party_id"`
	RoleCode string `bson:"role_code" json:"role_code"`
}

// Event is one immutable link in the ledger. `_id` is a generated ObjectID;
// EntityID and Refs carry the referenced documents' ObjectIDs as hex strings
// (the ledger is a generic event log spanning every entity type, and hex
// strings keep the hash material canonical and human-inspectable).
type Event struct {
	ID         primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
	Seq        int64              `bson:"seq"         json:"seq"`
	Type       string             `bson:"type"        json:"type"`
	EntityType string             `bson:"entity_type" json:"entity_type"`
	EntityID   string             `bson:"entity_id"   json:"entity_id"`
	Refs       []Ref              `bson:"refs,omitempty"    json:"refs,omitempty"`
	Actor      ActorRef           `bson:"actor"       json:"actor"`
	OrgUnitID  string             `bson:"org_unit_id,omitempty" json:"org_unit_id,omitempty"`
	Payload    map[string]any     `bson:"payload,omitempty"     json:"payload,omitempty"`
	TS         time.Time          `bson:"ts"          json:"ts"`
	PrevHash   string             `bson:"prev_hash"   json:"prev_hash"`
	Hash       string             `bson:"hash"        json:"hash"`
}

// AppendInput describes a new event to chain.
type AppendInput struct {
	Type       string

1	// Package httpx is the HTTP toolkit shared by every module: typed errors,
2	// uniform JSON envelopes, strict request decoding, pagination.
3	package httpx
4	
5	import (
6		"fmt"
7		"net/http"
8	)
9	
10	// AppError is the single error type handlers return. It carries the HTTP
11	// status plus a stable machine-readable code the frontend can switch on.
12	type AppError struct {
13		Status  int    `json:"-"`
14		Code    string `json:"code"`
15		Message string `json:"message"`
16		Details any    `json:"details,omitempty"`
17	
18		cause error // wrapped internal error — logged server-side, never serialised
19	}
20	
21	func (e *AppError) Error() string {
22		return fmt.Sprintf("%d %s: %s", e.Status, e.Code, e.Message)
23	}
24	
25	// WithDetails returns a copy carrying extra structured context.
26	func (e *AppError) WithDetails(d any) *AppError {
27		cp := *e
28		cp.Details = d
29		return &cp
30	}
31	
32	func newErr(status int, code, msg string) *AppError {
33		return &AppError{Status: status, Code: code, Message: msg}
34	}
35	
36	// Constructors — use these instead of raw errors in handlers/services.
37	
38	func BadRequest(code, msg string) *AppError { return newErr(http.StatusBadRequest, code, msg) }
39	
40	func Unauthorized(msg string) *AppError { return newErr(http.StatusUnauthorized, "UNAUTHORIZED", msg) }
41	
42	func Forbidden(msg string) *AppError { return newErr(http.StatusForbidden, "FORBIDDEN", msg) }
43	
44	func NotFound(resource string) *AppError {
45		return newErr(http.StatusNotFound, "NOT_FOUND", resource+" not found")
46	}
47	
48	// RouteNotFound is the router-level 404 for unmatched paths, keeping the
49	// uniform JSON error envelope on typo'd routes.
50	func RouteNotFound() *AppError {
51		return newErr(http.StatusNotFound, "NOT_FOUND", "route not found")
52	}
53	
54	// MethodNotAllowed is the router-level 405 for wrong-method requests.
55	func MethodNotAllowed() *AppError {
56		return newErr(http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", "method not allowed for this route")
57	}
58	
59	func Conflict(code, msg string) *AppError { return newErr(http.StatusConflict, code, msg) }
60	
61	func Unprocessable(code, msg string) *AppError {
62		return newErr(http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, code, msg)
63	}
64	
65	func TooManyRequests(msg string) *AppError {
66		return newErr(http.StatusTooManyRequests, "RATE_LIMITED", msg)
67	}
68	
69	// Internal wraps an unexpected error. The cause is logged server-side but
70	// never leaked to the client.
71	func Internal(err error) *AppError {
72		e := newErr(http.StatusInternalServerError, "INTERNAL", "internal server error")
73		e.cause = err
74		return e
75	}
76	
77	func (e *AppError) Unwrap() error { return e.cause }
78

1	package httpx
2	
3	import (
4		"encoding/json"
5		"errors"
6		"fmt"
7		"io"
8		"net/http"
9		"strconv"
10	)
11	
12	// maxBodyBytes caps request bodies at 1 MiB — pours, readings and admin
13	// payloads are all tiny; photo evidence goes to the object store, not the API.
14	const maxBodyBytes = 1 << 20
15	
16	// DecodeJSON strictly decodes the request body into dst. It enforces the
17	// size cap and exactly one JSON value.
18	func DecodeJSON(r *http.Request, dst any) error {
19		r.Body = http.MaxBytesReader(nil, r.Body, maxBodyBytes)
20		dec := json.NewDecoder(r.Body)
21		if err := dec.Decode(dst); err != nil {
22			var maxErr *http.MaxBytesError
23			switch {
24			case errors.As(err, &maxErr):
25				return BadRequest("BODY_TOO_LARGE", fmt.Sprintf("request body exceeds %d bytes", maxBodyBytes))
26			case errors.Is(err, io.EOF):
27				return BadRequest("EMPTY_BODY", "request body is required")
28			default:
29				return BadRequest("MALFORMED_JSON", "request body is not valid JSON: "+err.Error())
30			}
31		}
32		if dec.More() {
33			return BadRequest("MALFORMED_JSON", "request body must contain a single JSON value")
34		}
35		return nil
36	}
37	
38	// Page holds validated pagination parameters.
39	type Page struct {
40		Limit  int64 `json:"limit"`
41		Offset int64 `json:"offset"`
42	}
43	
44	// ParsePage reads ?limit= and ?offset= with sane bounds (default 50, max 200).
45	func ParsePage(r *http.Request) Page {
46		p := Page{Limit: 50, Offset: 0}
47		if v := r.URL.Query().Get("limit"); v != "" {
48			if n, err := strconv.ParseInt(v, 10, 64); err == nil && n > 0 {
49				p.Limit = min(n, 200)
50			}
51		}
52		if v := r.URL.Query().Get("offset"); v != "" {
53			if n, err := strconv.ParseInt(v, 10, 64); err == nil && n >= 0 {
54				p.Offset = n
55			}
56		}
57		return p
58	}
59

10	// ParseID converts an ObjectID hex string (from JSON bodies, query params or
11	// JWT claims) into a primitive.ObjectID, or returns a 400 with the offending
12	// field name.
13	func ParseID(hex, field string) (primitive.ObjectID, error) {
14		id, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(hex)
15		if err != nil {
16			return primitive.NilObjectID, BadRequest("INVALID_ID", field+" must be a valid object id")

18		return id, nil
19	}

22	func PathID(r *http.Request, param string) (primitive.ObjectID, error) {
23		return ParseID(chi.URLParam(r, param), param)
24	}

23	}

27		cp := *e
28		cp.Details = d

package auth

import (
	"context"
	"sync"
)

// Actor is the authenticated caller extracted from a verified token and
// stored on the request context by the auth middleware.
type Actor struct {
	PartyID          string
	Phone            string
	KYCTier          string
	Kind             string // session | role
	RoleAssignmentID string
	RoleCode         string
	OrgUnitID        string
	OrgType          string
}

// HasRole reports whether the actor operates under one of the given roles.
func (a Actor) HasRole(roles ...string) bool {
	for _, r := range roles {
		if a.RoleCode == r {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

type actorCtxKey struct{}

// actorHolder is a mutable cell installed by OUTER middleware (audit) so
// identity established by INNER middleware (Authenticate) can flow back out.
// Context values only propagate inward; the shared pointer bridges the gap.
type actorHolder struct {
	mu sync.Mutex
	a  *Actor
}

type actorHolderCtxKey struct{}

// WithActorHolder installs an empty actor holder on the context. Middleware
// mounted before authentication uses it to observe the actor after the
// handler chain ran.
func WithActorHolder(ctx context.Context) context.Context {
	return context.WithValue(ctx, actorHolderCtxKey{}, &actorHolder{})
}

// HeldActor returns the actor captured by an inner WithActor call, if a
// holder was installed and authentication happened.
func HeldActor(ctx context.Context) (Actor, bool) {
	h, ok := ctx.Value(actorHolderCtxKey{}).(*actorHolder)
	if !ok {
		return Actor{}, false
	}
	h.mu.Lock()
	defer h.mu.Unlock()
	if h.a == nil {
		return Actor{}, false
	}
	return *h.a, true
}

// WithActor stores the actor on the context, and also fills the outward
// actor holder when one was installed upstream (see WithActorHolder).
func WithActor(ctx context.Context, a Actor) context.Context {
	if h, ok := ctx.Value(actorHolderCtxKey{}).(*actorHolder); ok {
		h.mu.Lock()
		cp := a
		h.a = &cp
		h.mu.Unlock()
	}
	return context.WithValue(ctx, actorCtxKey{}, a)
}

// ActorFrom retrieves the actor, if any.
func ActorFrom(ctx context.Context) (Actor, bool) {
	a, ok := ctx.Value(actorCtxKey{}).(Actor)
	return a, ok

44	// mounted before authentication uses it to observe the actor after the
45	// handler chain ran.
46	func WithActorHolder(ctx context.Context) context.Context {
47		return context.WithValue(ctx, actorHolderCtxKey{}, &actorHolder{})
48	}
49	
50	// HeldActor returns the actor captured by an inner WithActor call, if a
51	// holder was installed and authentication happened.
52	func HeldActor(ctx context.Context) (Actor, bool) {
53		h, ok := ctx.Value(actorHolderCtxKey{}).(*actorHolder)
54		if !ok {
55			return Actor{}, false
56		}
57		h.mu.Lock()
58		defer h.mu.Unlock()
59		if h.a == nil {
60			return Actor{}, false
61		}
62		return *h.a, true
63	}
64	
65	// WithActor stores the actor on the context, and also fills the outward
66	// actor holder when one was installed upstream (see WithActorHolder).
67	func WithActor(ctx context.Context, a Actor) context.Context {
68		if h, ok := ctx.Value(actorHolderCtxKey{}).(*actorHolder); ok {
69			h.mu.Lock()
70			cp := a
71			h.a = &cp
72			h.mu.Unlock()
73		}
74		return context.WithValue(ctx, actorCtxKey{}, a)
75	}
76	
77	// ActorFrom retrieves the actor, if any.
78	func ActorFrom(ctx context.Context) (Actor, bool) {
79		a, ok := ctx.Value(actorCtxKey{}).(Actor)
80		return a, ok
81	}

type Page struct {
	Limit  int64 `json:"limit"`
	Offset int64 `json:"offset"`
}

// ParsePage reads ?limit= and ?offset= with sane bounds (default 50, max 200).
func ParsePage(r *http.Request) Page {
	p := Page{Limit: 50, Offset: 0}
	if v := r.URL.Query().Get("limit"); v != "" {
		if n, err := strconv.ParseInt(v, 10, 64); err == nil && n > 0 {
			p.Limit = min(n, 200)
		}
	}
	if v := r.URL.Query().Get("offset"); v != "" {
		if n, err := strconv.ParseInt(v, 10, 64); err == nil && n >= 0 {
			p.Offset = n
		}
	}
	return p
}

// Package provenance implements the append-only, hash-chained event ledger —
// the source of truth for milk traceability (blueprint §7). Every link in the
// pour→QR chain is an immutable Event whose SHA-256 hash covers the previous
// event's hash, so history cannot be quietly rewritten (tamper-evidence,
// FSSAI recall-grade audit).
//
// Corrections are NEW events referencing the superseded entity — nothing is
// ever updated or deleted in this collection.
package provenance

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
	"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo/options"
)

const collection = "provenance_events"

// Ref is a directed edge to another entity in the trace graph
// (e.g. a consignment event referencing the pours it aggregates).
type Ref struct {
	EntityType string `bson:"entity_type" json:"entity_type"`
	EntityID   string `bson:"entity_id"   json:"entity_id"`
	Relation   string `bson:"relation"    json:"relation"` // aggregates | supersedes | tested | yields | labels ...
}

// ActorRef records who caused the event.
type ActorRef struct {
	PartyID  string `bson:"party_id"  json:"party_id"`
	RoleCode string `bson:"role_code" json:"role_code"`
}

// Event is one immutable link in the ledger. `_id` is a generated ObjectID;
// EntityID and Refs carry the referenced documents' ObjectIDs as hex strings
// (the ledger is a generic event log spanning every entity type, and hex
// strings keep the hash material canonical and human-inspectable).
type Event struct {
	ID         primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
	Seq        int64              `bson:"seq"         json:"seq"`
	Type       string             `bson:"type"        json:"type"`
	EntityType string             `bson:"entity_type" json:"entity_type"`
	EntityID   string             `bson:"entity_id"   json:"entity_id"`
	Refs       []Ref              `bson:"refs,omitempty"    json:"refs,omitempty"`
	Actor      ActorRef           `bson:"actor"       json:"actor"`
	OrgUnitID  string             `bson:"org_unit_id,omitempty" json:"org_unit_id,omitempty"`
	Payload    map[string]any     `bson:"payload,omitempty"     json:"payload,omitempty"`
	TS         time.Time          `bson:"ts"          json:"ts"`
	PrevHash   string             `bson:"prev_hash"   json:"prev_hash"`
	Hash       string             `bson:"hash"        json:"hash"`
}

// AppendInput describes a new event to chain.
type AppendInput struct {
	Type       string
	EntityType string
	EntityID   string
	Refs       []Ref
	Actor      ActorRef
	OrgUnitID  string
	Payload    map[string]any
}

// Ledger appends to and reads the hash chain.
type Ledger struct {
	coll *mongo.Collection

	// appendMu serialises the head-read+insert of Append within this process:
	// every ledger write system-wide shares one global seq, so without local
	// serialisation concurrent handlers (e.g. a morning pour rush plus a
	// GenerateInvoices loop) burn duplicate-key retries against each other.
	// The unique seq index remains the atomic backstop across processes.
	appendMu sync.Mutex
}

// NewLedger binds the ledger to the database.
func NewLedger(db *mongo.Database) *Ledger {
	return &Ledger{coll: db.Collection(collection)}
}

// genesisHash anchors the chain before the first event.
const genesisHash = "GENESIS"

// Append chains a new event. Concurrency-safe without transactions: it reads
// the current head, computes seq+hash optimistically, and relies on the
// unique index on `seq` — a duplicate-key collision means another writer won
// the slot, so we re-read and retry.
func (l *Ledger) Append(ctx context.Context, in AppendInput) (*Event, error) {
	// Serialise appends within this process (see appendMu): local writers no
	// longer race each other for the seq slot, so under single-instance
	// deployment the retry loop only ever fires against external writers.
	l.appendMu.Lock()
	defer l.appendMu.Unlock()

	const maxRetries = 12
	for attempt := 0; attempt < maxRetries; attempt++ {
		seq, prevHash, err := l.head(ctx)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		ev := &Event{
			ID:         primitive.NewObjectID(),
			Seq:        seq + 1,
			Type:       in.Type,
			EntityType: in.EntityType,
			EntityID:   in.EntityID,
			Refs:       in.Refs,
			Actor:      in.Actor,
			OrgUnitID:  in.OrgUnitID,
			Payload:    in.Payload,
			// Millisecond precision: BSON datetimes store ms, so the persisted
			// TS must equal the hashed TS or re-verification would break.
			TS:       time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Millisecond),
			PrevHash: prevHash,
		}
		ev.Hash = computeHash(ev)

		if _, err := l.coll.InsertOne(ctx, ev); err != nil {
			if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(err) {
				continue // lost the seq race — retry against the new head
			}
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance append: %w", err)
		}
		return ev, nil
	}
	return nil, fmt.Errorf("provenance append: gave up after %d seq collisions", 12)
}

// head returns the latest (seq, hash), or (0, GENESIS) for an empty chain.
```

14	func RequireRoles(roles ...string) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
15		allowed := make(map[string]struct{}, len(roles))
16		for _, r := range roles {
17			allowed[r] = struct{}{}
18		}
19		return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {

24					return
25				}

27					httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Forbidden("a role token is required — select a role first (POST /api/v1/auth/role/select)"))

33				}
34				if _, ok := allowed[actor.RoleCode]; !ok {
35					httpx.Error(w, r, httpx.Forbidden("role "+actor.RoleCode+" is not permitted for this action"))
36					return
37				}
38				next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
39			})
40		}
41	}

// Invoice statuses through the same-day payment loop (blueprint §8.1).
const (
	InvoiceStatusIssued            = "ISSUED"
	InvoiceStatusSettlementPending = "SETTLEMENT_PENDING"
	InvoiceStatusPaid              = "PAID"
	InvoiceStatusHold              = "HOLD" // e.g. safety-gate payment hold
)

// Invoice aggregates one farmer's pours at one DCS for one day — the artefact
// behind "same-day farmer payment". InvoiceNumber is the human-readable
// unique business key; relations use ObjectIDs.
type Invoice struct {
	ID                  primitive.ObjectID   `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
	InvoiceNumber       string               `bson:"invoice_number" json:"invoice_number"` // unique, e.g. INV-DCS01842-20260706-0001
	FarmerPartyID       primitive.ObjectID   `bson:"farmer_party_id" json:"farmer_party_id"`
	DCSID               primitive.ObjectID   `bson:"dcs_id"        json:"dcs_id"`
	InvoiceDate         string               `bson:"invoice_date"  json:"invoice_date"` // YYYY-MM-DD
	PourIDs             []primitive.ObjectID `bson:"pour_ids"      json:"pour_ids"`
	TotalQuantityLitres float64              `bson:"total_quantity_litres" json:"total_quantity_litres"`
	TotalAmount         float64              `bson:"total_amount"  json:"total_amount"`
	Status              string               `bson:"status"        json:"status"`
	SettlementBatchID   *primitive.ObjectID  `bson:"settlement_batch_id,omitempty" json:"settlement_batch_id,omitempty"`
	IssuedAt            time.Time            `bson:"issued_at"     json:"issued_at"`
	ProvenanceSeq       int64                `bson:"provenance_seq,omitempty" json:"provenance_seq,omitempty"`
}

// DateKeyIST formats t as the YYYY-MM-DD settlement-day key in IST.
func DateKeyIST(t time.Time) string {
	ist := time.FixedZone("IST", 5*3600+1800)
	return t.In(ist).Format("2006-01-02")
}

// InvoiceNumberFor builds the human-readable invoice number.
func InvoiceNumberFor(dcsCode, dateKey string, seq int) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("INV-%s-%s-%04d", dcsCode, dateKey, seq)
}

type Page struct {
	Limit  int64 `json:"limit"`
	Offset int64 `json:"offset"`
}

// ParsePage reads ?limit= and ?offset= with sane bounds (default 50, max 200).
func ParsePage(r *http.Request) Page {
	p := Page{Limit: 50, Offset: 0}
	if v := r.URL.Query().Get("limit"); v != "" {
		if n, err := strconv.ParseInt(v, 10, 64); err == nil && n > 0 {
			p.Limit = min(n, 200)
		}
	}
	if v := r.URL.Query().Get("offset"); v != "" {
		if n, err := strconv.ParseInt(v, 10, 64); err == nil && n >= 0 {
			p.Offset = n
		}
	}
	return p
}

func (r *Resolver) Get(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
	key := id.Hex()
	r.mu.RLock()
	c, ok := r.cache[key]
	r.mu.RUnlock()
	if ok && time.Since(c.at) < r.ttl {
		org := c.org
		return &org, nil
	}

	var org domain.OrgUnit
	err := r.coll.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&org)
	if errors.Is(err, mongo.ErrNoDocuments) {
		return nil, httpx.NotFound("org unit " + key)
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
	}

	r.mu.Lock()
	r.cache[key] = cachedOrg{org: org, at: time.Now()}
	r.mu.Unlock()
	return &org, nil
}

// Product is one entry in the platform product master (blueprint §12 admin
// control tower). It is the catalogue backbone the consumer-commerce and store
// modules will read from once those phases land; here it is managed only
// through the admin master surface.
//
// ID scheme: `_id` is a generated ObjectID (relations always reference it);
// SKU is the human-readable unique business key used for upsert idempotency —
// PUT /admin/products keys on SKU, never on the ObjectID.
type Product struct {
	ID        primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
	SKU       string             `bson:"sku"        json:"sku"` // unique business key, e.g. "MILK-TP-500"
	Name      string             `bson:"name"       json:"name"`
	MRP       float64            `bson:"mrp"        json:"mrp"`
	UnitSize  string             `bson:"unit_size"  json:"unit_size"` // e.g. "500ml", "1L", "200g"
	Active    bool               `bson:"active"     json:"active"`
	CreatedAt time.Time          `bson:"created_at" json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt time.Time          `bson:"updated_at" json:"updated_at"`
}
