168		if r.PreferredLanguage != nil {
169			lang := strings.TrimSpace(*r.PreferredLanguage)
170			if lang == "" || len(lang) > 16 {
171				return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_LANGUAGE", "preferred_language must be 1-16 characters (e.g. \"hi\", \"en\")")
172			}
173		}
174		return nil
175	}
176	
177	// aadhaarKYCRequest submits an Aadhaar KYC request at a requested tier. The
178	// full number is used transiently and NEVER stored (blueprint §18-A). The
179	// record enters the approval workflow as PENDING — there is no auto-verify.
180	type aadhaarKYCRequest struct {
181		AadhaarNumber string `json:"aadhaar_number"`
182		Consent       bool   `json:"consent"`
183		RequestedTier string `json:"requested_tier"` // FARMER | STANDARD | RIDER | HIGH
184	}
185	
186	func (r aadhaarKYCRequest) validate() error {
187		if !aadhaarRegexp.MatchString(r.AadhaarNumber) {
188			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_AADHAAR", "aadhaar_number must be 12 digits")
189		}
190		if !r.Consent {
191			return httpx.BadRequest("CONSENT_REQUIRED", "explicit consent is required for Aadhaar eKYC (DPDP)")
192		}
193		if !requestableTiers[r.RequestedTier] {
194			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_TIER", "requested_tier must be one of FARMER, STANDARD, RIDER, HIGH")
195		}
196		return nil
197	}
198	
199	// aadhaarKYCResponse returns the (PENDING) record and a human-readable
200	// status message for the approval workflow.
201	type aadhaarKYCResponse struct {
202		Record  *domain.KYCRecord `json:"record"`
203		Status  string            `json:"status"`
204		Message string            `json:"message"`
205	}
206	
207	// bankKYCRequest runs the (mock) penny-drop bank verification. Only the
208	// masked account tail and IFSC are ever persisted.
209	type bankKYCRequest struct {
210		AccountNumber string `json:"account_number"`
211		IFSC          string `json:"ifsc"`
212	}
213	
214	func (r bankKYCRequest) validate() error {
215		if !bankAccountRegexp.MatchString(r.AccountNumber) {
216			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_ACCOUNT", "account_number must be 9-18 digits")
217		}
218		if !ifscRegexp.MatchString(r.IFSC) {
219			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_IFSC", "ifsc must match the RBI IFSC format (e.g. SBIN0001234)")
220		}
221		return nil
222	}
223	
224	// kycRejectRequest carries the mandatory human-readable rejection reason.
225	type kycRejectRequest struct {
226		Reason string `json:"reason"`
227	}
228	
229	func (r kycRejectRequest) validate() error {
230		reason := strings.TrimSpace(r.Reason)
231		if reason == "" || len(reason) > 500 {
232			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_REASON", "reason must be 1-500 characters")
233		}
234		return nil
235	}
236	
237	// pendingPartySummary is the reviewer-facing digest of the requesting party.
238	type pendingPartySummary struct {
239		ID       primitive.ObjectID `json:"id"`
240		Phone    string             `json:"phone"`
241		FullName string             `json:"full_name,omitempty"`
242		KYCTier  string             `json:"kyc_tier"`
243	}
244	
245	// pendingKYCItem is one PENDING KYC record enriched with its party so the
246	// review console needs no second call.
247	type pendingKYCItem struct {
248		domain.KYCRecord
249		Party *pendingPartySummary `json:"party,omitempty"`
250	}
251	
252	// pendingKYCCountResponse is the live badge value for the reviewer dashboard.
253	// Capped is true when the true count exceeds the scan cap (display "count+").
254	type pendingKYCCountResponse struct {
255		Count  int64 `json:"count"`
256		Capped bool  `json:"capped"`
257	}
258	
259	// kycReviewResponse returns the reviewed record plus the party's KYC tier
260	// after the review (upgraded on approval when the requested tier is higher).
261	type kycReviewResponse struct {
262		Record  *domain.KYCRecord `json:"record"`
263		KYCTier string            `json:"kyc_tier"`
264	}
265	
266	// createAssignmentRequest grants a role to a party inside an org unit. The
267	// target party is addressed by party_id or phone (party_id wins when both
268	// are present).
269	type createAssignmentRequest struct {
270		PartyID   *primitive.ObjectID `json:"party_id,omitempty"`
271		Phone     string              `json:"phone,omitempty"`
272		RoleCode  string              `json:"role_code"`
273		OrgUnitID primitive.ObjectID  `json:"org_unit_id"`
274		ValidFrom *time.Time          `json:"valid_from,omitempty"`
275		ValidTo   *time.Time          `json:"valid_to,omitempty"`
276	}
277	
278	func (r createAssignmentRequest) validate() error {
279		if r.PartyID == nil && r.Phone == "" {
280			return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_PARTY", "one of party_id or phone is required")
281		}
282		if r.PartyID == nil && !phoneRegexp.MatchString(r.Phone) {
283			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_PHONE", "phone must be a 10-digit Indian mobile number")
284		}
285		if !domain.IsValidRole(r.RoleCode) {
286			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_ROLE", "role_code is not in the role catalog")
287		}
288		if r.OrgUnitID.IsZero() {
289			return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_ORG_UNIT", "org_unit_id is required")
290		}
291		if r.ValidFrom != nil && r.ValidTo != nil && !r.ValidTo.After(*r.ValidFrom) {
292			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_VALIDITY_WINDOW", "valid_to must be after valid_from")
293		}
294		return nil
295	}
296	
297	// listMeta is the pagination meta block for list endpoints.
298	type listMeta struct {
299		Limit  int64 `json:"limit"`
300		Offset int64 `json:"offset"`
301		Total  int64 `json:"total"`
302	}

1	// Package identity owns authentication (OTP login, refresh-token rotation,
2	// role selection), the Party registry, org-scoped role assignments and the
3	// KYC approval workflow — blueprint §4 (identity) and §5 (roles & RBAC).
4	//
5	// The KYC flow is: login → submit KYC (PENDING) → an authorised reviewer
6	// (Organising Manager / District Verifier / PCDF Admin / Super Admin)
7	// approves or rejects → only a VERIFIED tier unlocks the matching role token.
8	//
9	// Route prefixes (mounted under /api/v1): /auth, /parties, /roles, /kyc.
10	// This module emits no provenance events; identity changes are covered by
11	// the audit middleware and explicit audit records on KYC review.
12	package identity
13	
14	import (
15		"log/slog"
16	
17		"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"

24	// Register wires repo → service → handler and mounts the identity routes.
25	func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
26		log := d.Log.With(slog.String("module", "identity"))
27		repo := newRepository(d.DB)
28		svc := newService(d, repo, log)
29		h := newHandler(svc)
30	
31		r.Route("/auth", func(r chi.Router) {
32			// Public login flow — no token yet.
33			r.Post("/otp/request", h.requestOTP)
34			r.Post("/otp/verify", h.verifyOTP)
35			r.Post("/refresh", h.refresh)
36	
37			// Any logged-in party (session or role token).
38			r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
39				r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT), middleware.RequireSession)
40				r.Post("/logout", h.logout)
41				r.Get("/roles", h.listMyRoles)
42				r.Post("/role/select", h.selectRole)
43			})
44		})
45	
46		r.Route("/parties", func(r chi.Router) {
47			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
48	
49			// Self-service: any logged-in party reads/updates their own profile.
50			r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
51				r.Use(middleware.RequireSession)
52				r.Get("/me", h.getMe)
53				r.Patch("/me", h.patchMe)
54			})
55	
56			// Reviewer directory: parties holding a role in an org unit (backs the
57			// FE listSachivs picker). Reviewer roles only.
58			r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
59				r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.OnboardingReviewerRoles...))
60				r.Get("/", h.listPartiesByRole)
61			})
62		})
63	
64		r.Route("/kyc", func(r chi.Router) {
65			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
66	
67			// Self-service KYC: any logged-in party submits evidence.
68			r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
69				r.Use(middleware.RequireSession)
70				r.Post("/aadhaar", h.verifyAadhaar)
71				r.Post("/bank", h.verifyBank)
72				r.Get("/me", h.listMyKYC)
73			})
74	
75			// Review console: ground staff and admins approve/reject PENDING KYC.
76			// Both ORGANISING_MANAGER and the app-coded ONBOARDING_EXECUTIVE qualify.
77			r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
78				r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.OnboardingReviewerRoles...))
79				r.Get("/pending", h.listPendingKYC)
80				r.Get("/pending/count", h.pendingKYCCount) // live badge value
81				r.Post("/{id}/approve", h.approveKYC)
82				r.Post("/{id}/reject", h.rejectKYC)
83			})
84		})
85	
86		r.Route("/roles", func(r chi.Router) {
87			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))

89			// granter matrix (§5.2) is enforced in the service.

91				domain.RolePCDFAdmin,
92				domain.RoleUnionPresident,
93				domain.RoleSamitiAdhyaksh,
94				domain.RoleOrganisingManager,
95				domain.RoleOnboardingExecutive,
96			))
97			r.Post("/assignments", h.createAssignment)
98			r.Delete("/assignments/{id}", h.revokeAssignment)
99			r.Get("/assignments", h.listAssignments)
100		})
101	}

45			sr.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSamitiSacheev)).

24	
25	// service holds all settlement business logic: the §8.1/§18-B payment
26	// guardrail (compute+initiate → dual-control approve → licensed-PA execute)
27	// and the strictly separate DBT subsidy rail (§13).
28	type service struct {
29		repo   *repo
30		ledger *provenance.Ledger
31		orgs   *orgscope.Resolver
32		bus    *eventbus.Bus
33		log    *slog.Logger
34	}
35	
36	// actorObjectID parses the actor's party identity. JWT claims carry ObjectIDs
37	// as hex strings (tokens are JSON); every service method that compares or
38	// stores the actor's identity goes through this one helper.
39	func actorObjectID(actor auth.Actor) (primitive.ObjectID, error) {
40		return httpx.ParseID(actor.PartyID, "actor")
41	}
42	
43	// ---- pure guardrail checks (unit-tested without a database) ----
44	
45	// validateApproval enforces the dual-control guardrail (§8.1/§18-B): the
46	// approving party MUST differ from the initiator — checked FIRST and on the
47	// party identity itself, so not even SUPER_ADMIN's role bypass can approve a
48	// batch it initiated. Then the batch must still be awaiting approval.
49	func validateApproval(b domain.SettlementBatch, approverPartyID primitive.ObjectID) error {
50		if b.InitiatedBy == approverPartyID {
51			return httpx.Forbidden("dual-control violation: the settlement initiator cannot approve their own batch (§8.1/§18-B)").
52				WithDetails(map[string]string{"reason": "DUAL_CONTROL_VIOLATION"})
53		}
54		if b.Status != domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval {
55			return httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch is "+b.Status+", expected "+domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval)
56		}
57		return nil
58	}
59	
60	// executionLease is how long an APPROVED→EXECUTING claim is considered live.
61	// A batch stuck EXECUTING longer than this (crashed executor) may be resumed —
62	// the per-invoice payout logic is idempotent, so a replay is safe.
63	const executionLease = 2 * time.Minute
64	
65	// validateExecution gates which states may (re-)enter execution:
66	//   - APPROVED:  the normal dual-controlled first run.
67	//   - EXECUTING: resume of an interrupted run (the lease check in
68	//     claimExecution prevents stealing a live executor's batch).
69	//   - FAILED:    re-execution after a recorded mid-run failure.
70	//
71	// Anything pre-approval is a guardrail breach, not a race; EXECUTED/REJECTED
72	// are terminal.
73	func validateExecution(b domain.SettlementBatch) error {
74		switch b.Status {
75		case domain.SettlementStatusApproved, domain.SettlementStatusExecuting, domain.SettlementStatusFailed:
76			return nil
77		default:
78			return httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch is "+b.Status+", must be "+domain.SettlementStatusApproved+" before execution")
79		}
80	}
81	
82	// mockUTR builds a mock bank transaction reference: "UTRMOCK" + 12 hex chars.
83	func mockUTR() string {
84		return "UTRMOCK" + strings.ToUpper(strings.ReplaceAll(uuid.NewString(), "-", "")[:12])
85	}
86	
87	// mockPARef builds a mock payment-aggregator batch reference.
88	func mockPARef() string {
89		return "PA-MOCK-" + uuid.NewString()[:8]
90	}
91	
92	// mockPFMSRef builds a mock PFMS acknowledgement reference (§13).
93	func mockPFMSRef() string {
94		return "PFMS-MOCK-" + uuid.NewString()[:8]
95	}
96	
97	// ---- settlement lifecycle ----
98	
99	// Initiate collects a DCS day's ISSUED invoices into a new settlement batch
100	// and parks it PENDING_APPROVAL. The INITIATED status is momentary by design
101	// (§8.1): computation and initiation are one Saathi action; nothing proceeds
102	// until a different human approves.
103	func (s *service) Initiate(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, in InitiateSettlementRequest) (*domain.SettlementBatch, error) {
104		actorID, err := actorObjectID(actor)
105		if err != nil {
106			return nil, err
107		}
108		if in.DCSID.IsZero() {
109			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_FIELD", "dcs_id is required")
110		}
111		now := time.Now().UTC()
112		date := in.Date
113		if date == "" {
114			date = domain.DateKeyIST(now)
115		} else if _, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", date); err != nil {
116			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_DATE", "date must be YYYY-MM-DD")
117		}
118		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, in.DCSID); err != nil {
119			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "settlement initiation denied: out of scope",
120				slog.String("dcs_id", in.DCSID.Hex()),
121				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
122			return nil, err
123		}
124	
125		candidates, err := s.repo.issuedInvoices(ctx, in.DCSID, date)
126		if err != nil {
127			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement initiation: load issued invoices",
128				slog.String("dcs_id", in.DCSID.Hex()), slog.String("date", date), slog.Any("err", err))
129			return nil, err
130		}
131		if len(candidates) == 0 {
132			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "settlement initiation rejected: no ISSUED invoices",
133				slog.String("dcs_id", in.DCSID.Hex()), slog.String("date", date),
134				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
135			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("NO_INVOICES", "no ISSUED invoices for DCS "+in.DCSID.Hex()+" on "+date)
136		}
137	
138		// Claim optimistically: the status guard on the update means each invoice
139		// lands in exactly one batch even under concurrent initiations. The batch
140		// ID is pre-generated so claim, insert and ledger all share one identity.
141		batchID := primitive.NewObjectID()
142		ids := make([]primitive.ObjectID, 0, len(candidates))
143		for _, inv := range candidates {
144			ids = append(ids, inv.ID)
145		}
146		if _, err := s.repo.claimInvoices(ctx, ids, batchID); err != nil {
147			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement initiation: claim invoices",
148				slog.String("batch_id", batchID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
149			return nil, err
150		}
151		claimed, err := s.repo.invoicesByBatch(ctx, batchID)
152		if err != nil {
153			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement initiation: read claimed invoices",
154				slog.String("batch_id", batchID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
155			return nil, err
156		}
157		if len(claimed) == 0 {
158			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "settlement initiation rejected: invoices claimed by concurrent batch",
159				slog.String("dcs_id", in.DCSID.Hex()), slog.String("date", date),
160				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
161			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("NO_INVOICES", "invoices were claimed by a concurrent settlement for DCS "+in.DCSID.Hex()+" on "+date)
162		}
163	
164		batch := &domain.SettlementBatch{
165			ID:          batchID,
166			DCSID:       in.DCSID,
167			Date:        date,
168			Status:      domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval, // INITIATED → PENDING_APPROVAL immediately
169			InitiatedBy: actorID,
170			CreatedAt:   now,
171		}
172		for _, inv := range claimed {
173			batch.InvoiceIDs = append(batch.InvoiceIDs, inv.ID)
174			batch.TotalAmount += inv.TotalAmount
175		}
176		if err := s.repo.insertBatch(ctx, batch); err != nil {
177			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement initiation: insert batch",
178				slog.String("batch_id", batchID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
179			// Best-effort release so the claimed invoices are not stranded.
180			if relErr := s.repo.releaseInvoices(ctx, batchID); relErr != nil {
181				s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement: release after failed insert",
182					slog.String("batch_id", batchID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", relErr))
183			}
184			return nil, err
185		}
186	
187		refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, min(len(claimed), initiateRefsCap))
188		for i, inv := range claimed {
189			if i >= initiateRefsCap {
190				break
191			}
192			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{EntityType: domain.EntityInvoice, EntityID: inv.ID.Hex(), Relation: "settles"})
193		}
194		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
195			Type:       domain.EventSettlementInitiated,
196			EntityType: domain.EntitySettlement,
197			EntityID:   batch.ID.Hex(),
198			Refs:       refs,
199			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
200			OrgUnitID:  batch.DCSID.Hex(),
201			Payload: map[string]any{
202				"dcs_id":        batch.DCSID.Hex(),
203				"date":          batch.Date,
204				"invoice_count": len(claimed),
205				"total_amount":  batch.TotalAmount,
206			},
207		})
208		if err != nil {
209			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement initiation: ledger append",
210				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
211			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
212		}
213		if err := s.repo.setBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx, batch.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
214			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement initiation: stamp provenance seq",
215				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
216			return nil, err
217		}
218		batch.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
219	
220		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "settlement batch initiated",
221			slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
222			slog.String("dcs_id", batch.DCSID.Hex()),
223			slog.String("date", batch.Date),
224			slog.Int("invoice_count", len(claimed)),
225			slog.Float64("total_amount", batch.TotalAmount),
226			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
227		return batch, nil
228	}
229	
230	// Approve applies the human dual-control sign-off: PENDING_APPROVAL→APPROVED.
231	func (s *service) Approve(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, batchID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.SettlementBatch, error) {
232		actorID, err := actorObjectID(actor)
233		if err != nil {
234			return nil, err
235		}
236		batch, err := s.repo.batchByID(ctx, batchID)
237		if err != nil {
238			return nil, err
239		}
240		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, batch.DCSID); err != nil {
241			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "settlement approval denied: out of scope",
242				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
243				slog.String("dcs_id", batch.DCSID.Hex()),
244				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
245			return nil, err
246		}
247		if err := validateApproval(*batch, actorID); err != nil {
248			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "settlement approval rejected",
249				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
250				slog.String("status", batch.Status),
251				slog.String("initiated_by", batch.InitiatedBy.Hex()),
252				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
253				slog.String("reason", err.Error()))
254			return nil, err
255		}
256	
257		now := time.Now().UTC()
258		ok, err := s.repo.transitionBatch(ctx, batch.ID, domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval, bson.D{
259			{Key: "status", Value: domain.SettlementStatusApproved},
260			{Key: "approved_by", Value: actorID},
261			{Key: "approved_at", Value: now},
262		})
263		if err != nil {
264			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement approval: transition batch",
265				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
266			return nil, err
267		}
268		if !ok {
269			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "settlement approval rejected: batch left PENDING_APPROVAL concurrently",
270				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
271				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
272			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch already left "+domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval)
273		}
274		batch.Status = domain.SettlementStatusApproved
275		batch.ApprovedBy = &actorID
276		batch.ApprovedAt = &now
277	
278		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
279			Type:       domain.EventSettlementApproved,
280			EntityType: domain.EntitySettlement,
281			EntityID:   batch.ID.Hex(),
282			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
283			OrgUnitID:  batch.DCSID.Hex(),
284			Payload: map[string]any{
285				"approved_by":  actor.PartyID,
286				"total_amount": batch.TotalAmount,
287			},
288		})
289		if err != nil {
290			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement approval: ledger append",
291				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
292			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
293		}
294		if err := s.repo.setBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx, batch.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
295			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement approval: stamp provenance seq",
296				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
297			return nil, err
298		}
299		batch.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
300	
301		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "settlement batch approved",
302			slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
303			slog.String("dcs_id", batch.DCSID.Hex()),
304			slog.Float64("total_amount", batch.TotalAmount),
305			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
306		return batch, nil
307	}
308	
309	// Reject declines a pending batch and returns its invoices to ISSUED so they
310	// can be re-settled.
311	func (s *service) Reject(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, batchID primitive.ObjectID, reason string) (*domain.SettlementBatch, error) {
312		actorID, err := actorObjectID(actor)
313		if err != nil {
314			return nil, err
315		}
316		if strings.TrimSpace(reason) == "" {
317			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_FIELD", "reason is required")
318		}
319		batch, err := s.repo.batchByID(ctx, batchID)
320		if err != nil {
321			return nil, err
322		}
323		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, batch.DCSID); err != nil {
324			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "settlement rejection denied: out of scope",
325				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
326				slog.String("dcs_id", batch.DCSID.Hex()),
327				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
328			return nil, err
329		}
330		if batch.Status != domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval {
331			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "settlement rejection refused: invalid status",
332				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
333				slog.String("status", batch.Status),
334				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
335			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch is "+batch.Status+", expected "+domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval)
336		}
337	
338		ok, err := s.repo.transitionBatch(ctx, batch.ID, domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval, bson.D{
339			{Key: "status", Value: domain.SettlementStatusRejected},
340			{Key: "rejected_by", Value: actorID},
341			{Key: "reject_reason", Value: reason},
342		})
343		if err != nil {
344			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement rejection: transition batch",
345				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
346			return nil, err
347		}
348		if !ok {
349			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "settlement rejection refused: batch left PENDING_APPROVAL concurrently",
350				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
351				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
352			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch already left "+domain.SettlementStatusPendingApproval)
353		}
354		if err := s.repo.releaseInvoices(ctx, batch.ID); err != nil {
355			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement rejection: release invoices",
356				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
357			return nil, err
358		}
359		batch.Status = domain.SettlementStatusRejected
360		batch.RejectedBy = &actorID
361		batch.RejectReason = reason
362	
363		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "settlement batch rejected",
364			slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
365			slog.String("dcs_id", batch.DCSID.Hex()),
366			slog.String("reason", reason),
367			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
368		return batch, nil
369	}
370	
371	// Execute hands the APPROVED batch to the payment-aggregator adapter and
372	// records the resulting payouts.
373	//
374	// MOCK LICENSED-PA ADAPTER — this is a stand-in for the real integration.
375	// In production (§18-B) execution goes through an RBI-licensed Payment
376	// Aggregator operating a nodal/escrow account: Saathi submits the payout
377	// file, the PA moves the money, and UTRs come back asynchronously via
378	// webhook. Saathi itself never touches funds. The mock credits every payout
379	// instantly with a synthetic UTR so the downstream flow (invoice→PAID,
380	// provenance, farmer SMS) is exercised end to end.
381	func (s *service) Execute(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, batchID primitive.ObjectID) (*SettlementDetail, error) {
382		batch, err := s.repo.batchByID(ctx, batchID)
383		if err != nil {
384			return nil, err
385		}
386		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, batch.DCSID); err != nil {
387			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "settlement execution denied: out of scope",
388				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
389				slog.String("dcs_id", batch.DCSID.Hex()),
390				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
391			return nil, err
392		}
393		if err := validateExecution(*batch); err != nil {
394			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "settlement execution refused: invalid status",
395				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
396				slog.String("status", batch.Status),
397				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
398			return nil, err
399		}
400	
401		// Guarded claim: first run (APPROVED), re-run after FAILED, or resume of
402		// a stale EXECUTING lease. The per-invoice work below is idempotent
403		// (unique payout-per-invoice index + payout reuse), so replays are safe.
404		now := time.Now().UTC()
405		claimed, err := s.repo.claimExecution(ctx, batch.ID, now, now.Add(-executionLease))
406		if err != nil {
407			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement execution: claim",
408				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
409			return nil, err
410		}
411		if !claimed {
412			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "settlement execution refused: live execution lease held elsewhere",
413				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
414				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
415			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch is already being executed")
416		}
417	
418		// From here on, any error must not strand the batch in EXECUTING forever:
419		// flip it to FAILED (best-effort) so a retry can claim FAILED→EXECUTING.
420		failExecution := func(cause error) error {
421			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement execution failed mid-run",
422				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", cause))
423			if ferr := s.repo.markExecutionFailed(ctx, batch.ID, cause.Error()); ferr != nil {
424				s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement: mark execution failed",
425					slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", ferr))
426			}
427			return cause
428		}
429	
430		invoices, err := s.repo.invoicesByBatch(ctx, batch.ID)
431		if err != nil {
432			return nil, failExecution(err)
433		}
434	
435		payouts := make([]domain.PayoutInstruction, 0, len(invoices))
436		paidInvoiceIDs := make([]primitive.ObjectID, 0, len(invoices))
437		failedCount := 0
438		for _, inv := range invoices {
439			masked, err := s.repo.latestBankMasked(ctx, inv.FarmerPartyID)
440			if err != nil {
441				return nil, failExecution(err)
442			}
443			payout := &domain.PayoutInstruction{
444				ID:                primitive.NewObjectID(),
445				SettlementBatchID: batch.ID,
446				InvoiceID:         inv.ID,
447				FarmerPartyID:     inv.FarmerPartyID,
448				Amount:            inv.TotalAmount,
449				BankAccountMasked: masked,
450				CreatedAt:         now,
451			}
452			if masked == "" {
453				// No verified bank account → money cannot move. Record a FAILED
454				// payout (no UTR, no credited_at) and DO NOT mark the invoice PAID.
455				// The farmer's dues stay outstanding until a bank is verified and
456				// the batch is re-executed (Execute is re-entrant).
457				payout.Status = domain.PayoutStatusFailed
458				payout.FailureReason = "no verified bank account on file"
459				failedCount++
460				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "settlement payout failed: farmer has no verified bank account",
461					slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
462					slog.String("invoice_id", inv.ID.Hex()),
463					slog.String("farmer_party_id", inv.FarmerPartyID.Hex()))
464			} else {
465				creditedAt := now
466				payout.UTR = mockUTR()
467				payout.Status = domain.PayoutStatusSuccess
468				payout.CreditedAt = &creditedAt
469			}
470			exists, err := s.repo.insertPayout(ctx, payout)
471			if err != nil {
472				return nil, failExecution(err)
473			}
474			if exists {
475				// Retry of an interrupted run — reuse the payout already recorded.
476				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "settlement execution: payout already recorded, reusing (idempotent replay)",
477					slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
478					slog.String("invoice_id", inv.ID.Hex()))
479				existing, err := s.repo.payoutByInvoice(ctx, inv.ID)
480				if err != nil {
481					return nil, failExecution(err)
482				}
483				payout = existing
484				if payout.Status == domain.PayoutStatusFailed {
485					failedCount++
486				}
487			}
488			if payout.Status == domain.PayoutStatusSuccess {
489				paidInvoiceIDs = append(paidInvoiceIDs, inv.ID)
490			}
491			payouts = append(payouts, *payout)
492		}
493	
494		// Mark ONLY the successfully-paid invoices PAID; failed ones stay ISSUED.
495		if err := s.repo.markInvoicesPaidByIDs(ctx, paidInvoiceIDs); err != nil {
496			return nil, failExecution(err)
497		}
498	
499		// A batch with any failed payout ends PARTIAL, not EXECUTED — re-executable
500		// once the missing bank details are verified.
501		finalStatus := domain.SettlementStatusExecuted
502		if failedCount > 0 {
503			finalStatus = domain.SettlementStatusPartial
504		}
505		paRef := mockPARef()
506		ok, err := s.repo.transitionBatch(ctx, batch.ID, domain.SettlementStatusExecuting, bson.D{
507			{Key: "status", Value: finalStatus},
508			{Key: "pa_ref", Value: paRef},
509			{Key: "executed_at", Value: now},
510		})
511		if err != nil {
512			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement execution: transition to EXECUTED",
513				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
514			return nil, err
515		}
516		if !ok {
517			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "settlement execution: batch left EXECUTING unexpectedly",
518				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()))
519			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "settlement batch left EXECUTING unexpectedly")
520		}
521		batch.Status = finalStatus
522		batch.PARef = paRef
523		batch.ExecutedAt = &now
524	
525		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
526			Type:       domain.EventSettlementExecuted,
527			EntityType: domain.EntitySettlement,
528			EntityID:   batch.ID.Hex(),
529			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
530			OrgUnitID:  batch.DCSID.Hex(),
531			Payload: map[string]any{
532				"pa_ref":       paRef,
533				"payout_count": len(payouts),
534				"failed_count": failedCount,
535				"total_amount": batch.TotalAmount,
536				"final_status": finalStatus,
537			},
538		})
539		if err != nil {
540			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement execution: ledger append",
541				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
542			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
543		}
544		if err := s.repo.setBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx, batch.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
545			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement execution: stamp provenance seq",
546				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
547			return nil, err
548		}
549		batch.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
550	
551		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "settlement batch executed",
552			slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
553			slog.String("dcs_id", batch.DCSID.Hex()),
554			slog.String("pa_ref", paRef),
555			slog.Int("payout_count", len(payouts)),
556			slog.Float64("total_amount", batch.TotalAmount),
557			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
558	
559		// One payout.credited ledger event per invoice, then the SMS fan-out.
560		// Per-payout ledger/lookup failures are logged, not fatal: the money
561		// outcome is already anchored by settlement.executed above.
562		for _, p := range payouts {
563			// Only SUCCESSful payouts produce a credited event + SMS — a FAILED
564			// (no-bank) payout must never tell the farmer money was credited.
565			if p.Status != domain.PayoutStatusSuccess {
566				continue
567			}
568			if _, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
569				Type:       domain.EventPayoutCredited,
570				EntityType: domain.EntityInvoice,
571				EntityID:   p.InvoiceID.Hex(),
572				Refs: []provenance.Ref{
573					{EntityType: domain.EntitySettlement, EntityID: batch.ID.Hex(), Relation: "paid_by"},
574				},
575				Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
576				OrgUnitID: batch.DCSID.Hex(),
577				Payload:   map[string]any{"utr": p.UTR, "amount": p.Amount},
578			}); err != nil {
579				s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement: payout.credited ledger append",
580					slog.String("invoice_id", p.InvoiceID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
581			}
582	
583			phone, err := s.repo.partyPhone(ctx, p.FarmerPartyID)
584			if err != nil {
585				s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "settlement: farmer phone lookup for payout SMS",
586					slog.String("farmer_party_id", p.FarmerPartyID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
587				continue
588			}
589			s.bus.Publish(eventbus.TopicPayoutCredited, PayoutCreditedEvent{
590				FarmerPartyID: p.FarmerPartyID.Hex(),
591				Phone:         phone,
592				Amount:        p.Amount,
593				UTR:           p.UTR,
594			})
595		}
596	
597		return &SettlementDetail{Batch: *batch, Payouts: payouts}, nil
598	}
599	
600	// List pages settlement batches. Callers with a DCS-scoped token default to
601	// their own DCS; wider roles must name a dcs_id (SUPER_ADMIN and
602	// STATE_AUDITOR may list unscoped).
603	func (s *service) List(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, dcsID, date, status string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.SettlementBatch, int64, error) {
604		if dcsID == "" {
605			switch {
606			case actor.OrgType == domain.OrgTypeDCS:
607				dcsID = actor.OrgUnitID
608			case actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSuperAdmin || actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleStateAuditor:
609				// federation-wide read roles may list across DCSes
610			default:
611				return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_FIELD", "dcs_id is required for your scope")
612			}
613		}
614		filter := bson.D{}
615		if dcsID != "" {
616			dcsOID, err := httpx.ParseID(dcsID, "dcs_id")
617			if err != nil {
618				return nil, 0, err
619			}
620			if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, dcsOID); err != nil {
621				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "settlement list denied: out of scope",
622					slog.String("dcs_id", dcsOID.Hex()),
623					slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
624				return nil, 0, err
625			}
626			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "dcs_id", Value: dcsOID})
627		}
628		if date != "" {
629			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "date", Value: date})
630		}
631		if status != "" {
632			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "status", Value: status})
633		}
634		return s.repo.listBatches(ctx, filter, page)
635	}
636	
637	// Detail returns one batch plus its payout instructions.
638	func (s *service) Detail(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, batchID primitive.ObjectID) (*SettlementDetail, error) {
639		batch, err := s.repo.batchByID(ctx, batchID)
640		if err != nil {
641			return nil, err
642		}
643		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, batch.DCSID); err != nil {
644			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "settlement detail denied: out of scope",
645				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
646				slog.String("dcs_id", batch.DCSID.Hex()),
647				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
648			return nil, err
649		}
650		payouts, err := s.repo.payoutsByBatch(ctx, batch.ID)
651		if err != nil {
652			return nil, err
653		}
654		return &SettlementDetail{Batch: *batch, Payouts: payouts}, nil
655	}
656	
657	// PayoutHistory pages payout instructions for one farmer, newest first.
658	// A FARMER token is always forced to its own party — "my payment history".
659	// Staff roles are bound to their org scope: the target farmer must hold an
660	// ACTIVE FARMER assignment at a DCS inside the caller's scope, so a village
661	// Sacheev cannot enumerate the financials of farmers nationwide.
662	func (s *service) PayoutHistory(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, farmerPartyID string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.PayoutInstruction, int64, error) {
663		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleFarmer {
664			farmerPartyID = actor.PartyID
665		}
666		if farmerPartyID == "" {
667			return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_FIELD", "farmer_party_id is required")
668		}
669		farmerOID, err := httpx.ParseID(farmerPartyID, "farmer_party_id")
670		if err != nil {
671			return nil, 0, err
672		}
673		if actor.RoleCode != domain.RoleFarmer &&
674			actor.RoleCode != domain.RoleSuperAdmin && actor.RoleCode != domain.RoleStateAuditor {
675			dcsIDs, err := s.repo.farmerDCSIDs(ctx, farmerOID)
676			if err != nil {
677				return nil, 0, err
678			}
679			inScope := false
680			for _, dcsID := range dcsIDs {
681				if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, dcsID); err == nil {
682					inScope = true
683					break
684				}
685			}
686			if !inScope {
687				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "payout history denied: farmer out of scope",
688					slog.String("farmer_party_id", farmerOID.Hex()),
689					slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
690				return nil, 0, httpx.Forbidden("farmer is outside your organisational scope")
691			}
692		}
693		return s.repo.payoutsByFarmer(ctx, farmerOID, page)
694	}
695	
696	// ---- DBT subsidy rail (§13) — strictly separate from milk payments ----
697	
698	// CreateDBT submits a scheme subsidy request to the (mocked) PFMS rail.
699	// Saathi only tracks the request; the subsidy is disbursed by PFMS/DBT,
700	// never by Saathi and never through the milk-payment rail.
701	func (s *service) CreateDBT(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, in CreateDBTRequestInput) (*domain.DBTRequest, error) {
702		actorID, err := actorObjectID(actor)
703		if err != nil {
704			return nil, err
705		}
706		if in.SchemeCode == "" || in.FarmerPartyID.IsZero() {
707			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_FIELD", "scheme_code and farmer_party_id are required")
708		}
709		if in.Amount <= 0 {
710			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_AMOUNT", "amount must be positive")
711		}
712		if _, err := s.repo.partyPhone(ctx, in.FarmerPartyID); err != nil {
713			return nil, err // farmer must exist
714		}
715	
716		// MOCK PFMS — real integration files the beneficiary+amount with PFMS
717		// and receives an acknowledgement reference (§13).
718		req := &domain.DBTRequest{
719			ID:            primitive.NewObjectID(),
720			SchemeCode:    in.SchemeCode,
721			FarmerPartyID: in.FarmerPartyID,
722			Amount:        in.Amount,
723			PFMSRef:       mockPFMSRef(),
724			Status:        domain.DBTStatusSubmitted,
725			SubmittedBy:   actorID,
726			CreatedAt:     time.Now().UTC(),
727		}
728		if err := s.repo.insertDBT(ctx, req); err != nil {
729			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "dbt request insert",
730				slog.String("farmer_party_id", in.FarmerPartyID.Hex()),
731				slog.String("scheme_code", in.SchemeCode), slog.Any("err", err))
732			return nil, err
733		}
734	
735		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "dbt request submitted",
736			slog.String("dbt_request_id", req.ID.Hex()),
737			slog.String("scheme_code", req.SchemeCode),
738			slog.String("farmer_party_id", req.FarmerPartyID.Hex()),
739			slog.Float64("amount", req.Amount),
740			slog.String("pfms_ref", req.PFMSRef),
741			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
742		return req, nil
743	}
744	
745	// UpdateDBTStatus records the DBT rail's progress for a request. CREDITED
746	// stamps credited_at; CREDITED/REJECTED are terminal.
747	func (s *service) UpdateDBTStatus(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID, status string) (*domain.DBTRequest, error) {
748		switch status {
749		case domain.DBTStatusAccepted, domain.DBTStatusCredited, domain.DBTStatusRejected:
750		default:
751			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_STATUS", "status must be one of ACCEPTED, CREDITED, REJECTED")
752		}
753		req, err := s.repo.dbtByID(ctx, id)
754		if err != nil {
755			return nil, err
756		}
757		if req.Status == domain.DBTStatusCredited || req.Status == domain.DBTStatusRejected {
758			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "dbt status update refused: terminal status",
759				slog.String("dbt_request_id", req.ID.Hex()),
760				slog.String("status", req.Status),
761				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
762			return nil, httpx.Conflict("TERMINAL_STATUS", "dbt request is already "+req.Status)
763		}
764	
765		var creditedAt *time.Time
766		if status == domain.DBTStatusCredited {
767			now := time.Now().UTC()
768			creditedAt = &now
769		}
770		ok, err := s.repo.transitionDBT(ctx, req.ID, req.Status, status, creditedAt)
771		if err != nil {
772			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "dbt status transition",
773				slog.String("dbt_request_id", req.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
774			return nil, err
775		}
776		if !ok {
777			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "dbt status update refused: concurrent change",
778				slog.String("dbt_request_id", req.ID.Hex()),
779				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
780			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_STATUS", "dbt request changed concurrently, retry")
781		}
782		fromStatus := req.Status
783		req.Status = status
784		req.CreditedAt = creditedAt
785	
786		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "dbt request status updated",
787			slog.String("dbt_request_id", req.ID.Hex()),
788			slog.String("from_status", fromStatus),
789			slog.String("to_status", status),
790			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
791		return req, nil
792	}
793	
794	// ListDBT pages DBT requests. A FARMER token is always forced to its own
795	// party.
796	func (s *service) ListDBT(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, farmerPartyID, status string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.DBTRequest, int64, error) {
797		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleFarmer {
798			farmerPartyID = actor.PartyID
799		}
800		filter := bson.D{}
801		if farmerPartyID != "" {
802			farmerOID, err := httpx.ParseID(farmerPartyID, "farmer_party_id")
803			if err != nil {
804				return nil, 0, err
805			}
806			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "farmer_party_id", Value: farmerOID})
807		}
808		if status != "" {
809			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "status", Value: status})
810		}
811		return s.repo.listDBT(ctx, filter, page)
812	}

12	const (

23	// SettlementBatch bundles a DCS day's invoices for one disbursement run.

25	// authorised signatory).

35		RejectedBy   *primitive.ObjectID  `bson:"rejected_by,omitempty"  json:"rejected_by,omitempty"`
36		RejectReason string               `bson:"reject_reason,omitempty" json:"reject_reason,omitempty"`

40		// ExecutingAt is the execution lease stamp: set on the APPROVED→EXECUTING
41		// claim so an interrupted run can be safely resumed once the lease is stale.

475	}
476	
477	// listPartiesByRole returns the parties holding an ACTIVE assignment of
478	// roleCode inside orgUnitID (paged) — the reviewer-facing directory backing
479	// the FE listSachivs dropdown. The caller must be in scope for the org unit.
480	func (s *service) listPartiesByRole(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, roleCode string, orgUnitID primitive.ObjectID, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.Party, int64, error) {
481		// Resolve the scope when the caller omits org_unit_id:
482		//   • federation-wide roles (super admin / PCDF / mission / auditor) may
483		//     list the role platform-wide (orgUnitID stays zero → no org filter);
484		//   • everyone else is scoped to their OWN org token.
485		if orgUnitID.IsZero() {
486			switch actor.RoleCode {
487			case domain.RoleSuperAdmin, domain.RolePCDFAdmin, domain.RoleMissionOfficial, domain.RoleStateAuditor:
488				// federation-wide list; leave orgUnitID zero
489			default:
490				own, err := httpx.ParseID(actor.OrgUnitID, "actor org")
491				if err != nil {
492					return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_ORG_UNIT", "org_unit_id is required for this role")
493				}
494				orgUnitID = own
495			}
496		}
497		// A named org must be within the caller's scope.
498		if !orgUnitID.IsZero() {
499			if err := s.deps.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, orgUnitID); err != nil {
500				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "list parties by role denied: out of scope",
501					slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
502					slog.String("org_unit_id", orgUnitID.Hex()),
503					slog.String("role_code", roleCode))
504				return nil, 0, err
505			}
506		}
507		return s.repo.listPartiesByRoleInOrg(ctx, roleCode, orgUnitID, page)
508	}
509	
510	// --- KYC (mock DPI adapters — real UIDAI / penny-drop integration later) ---
511	
512	// verifyAadhaar runs the MOCK Aadhaar eKYC capture (§18-A). The full Aadhaar
513	// number exists only in this request's memory: what is persisted is the
514	// last 4 digits plus an opaque reference from the (mock) Aadhaar Data Vault.
515	//
516	// There is NO auto-verify and NO tier change here: the record is created
517	// PENDING and enters the approval workflow. Returns created=false when an
518	// identical PENDING request already exists (idempotent replay → 200).
519	func (s *service) verifyAadhaar(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req aadhaarKYCRequest) (*aadhaarKYCResponse, bool, error) {
520		now := time.Now().UTC()
521		aid, err := actorID(actor)
522		if err != nil {
523			return nil, false, err
524		}
525		party, err := s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, aid)
526		if err != nil {
527			return nil, false, err
528		}
529	
530		// Idempotency: an existing PENDING request for the same tier is returned
531		// as-is rather than duplicated.
532		if existing, err := s.repo.findPendingKYCRecord(ctx, party.ID, req.RequestedTier); err == nil {
533			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "kyc submit replayed idempotently",
534				slog.String("kyc_id", existing.ID.Hex()),
535				slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()),
536				slog.String("requested_tier", req.RequestedTier))
537			return &aadhaarKYCResponse{
538				Record:  existing,
539				Status:  domain.KYCStatusPending,
540				Message: msgAwaitingVerification,
541			}, false, nil
542		} else if !isNotFound(err) {
543			return nil, false, err
544		}
545	
546		language := party.PreferredLanguage
547		if language == "" {
548			language = defaultLanguage
549		}
550		// Pre-generate the consent id so the KYC record can reference it in the
551		// same flow.
552		consentID := primitive.NewObjectID()
553		consent := domain.Consent{
554			ID:          consentID,
555			PartyID:     party.ID,
556			Purpose:     consentPurposeAadhaarEKYC,
557			TextVersion: consentTextVersion,
558			Language:    language,
559			GrantedAt:   now,
560		}
561		if err := s.repo.insertConsent(ctx, consent); err != nil {
562			return nil, false, err
563		}
564	
565		// MOCK Aadhaar Data Vault (§18-A): a real deployment sends the number to
566		// the vault service and receives an opaque token. The mock mints a UUID.
567		vaultRef := uuid.NewString()
568		last4 := req.AadhaarNumber[len(req.AadhaarNumber)-4:]
569	
570		record := domain.KYCRecord{
571			ID:              primitive.NewObjectID(),
572			PartyID:         party.ID,
573			RequestedTier:   req.RequestedTier,
574			AadhaarLast4:    last4,
575			AadhaarVaultRef: vaultRef,
576			ConsentID:       &consentID,
577			Status:          domain.KYCStatusPending,
578			CreatedAt:       now,
579			UpdatedAt:       now,
580		}
581		if err := s.repo.insertKYCRecord(ctx, record); err != nil {
582			return nil, false, err
583		}
584	
585		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "kyc submitted",
586			slog.String("kyc_id", record.ID.Hex()),
587			slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()),
588			slog.String("requested_tier", req.RequestedTier))
589		// Nudge live reviewer dashboards (ephemeral SSE badge)…
590		s.publishKYCQueueChanged("submitted", record.ID, party.ID)
591		// …AND queue a PERSISTED notification to the reviewers (super admin +
592		// onboarding reviewers) so a pending verification reaches them even if no
593		// dashboard is open — the durable half of "notification + verification
594		// pending". Best-effort: a notify failure never fails the submission.
595		s.notifyReviewersKYCPending(ctx, party, req.RequestedTier)
596		return &aadhaarKYCResponse{
597			Record:  &record,
598			Status:  domain.KYCStatusPending,
599			Message: msgAwaitingVerification,
600		}, true, nil
601	}
602	
603	// notifyReviewersKYCPending queues a KYC_PENDING notification to every party
604	// holding a reviewer role, so the pending verification durably reaches the
605	// super admin / onboarding reviewers (not just a live SSE badge).
606	func (s *service) notifyReviewersKYCPending(ctx context.Context, subject *domain.Party, tier string) {
607		reviewers, err := s.repo.findPartiesByRoles(ctx, domain.OnboardingReviewerRoles, 200)
608		if err != nil {
609			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "kyc pending notify: reviewer lookup failed", slog.Any("err", err))
610			return
611		}
612		now := time.Now().UTC()
613		subjectName := subject.FullName
614		if subjectName == "" {
615			subjectName = subject.Phone
616		}
617		for _, rv := range reviewers {
618			rvID := rv.ID
619			lang := rv.PreferredLanguage
620			if lang == "" {
621				lang = defaultLanguage
622			}
623			if err := s.repo.insertNotification(ctx, domain.Notification{
624				PartyID:     &rvID,
625				Phone:       rv.Phone,
626				Channel:     domain.ChannelSMS,
627				TemplateKey: domain.TemplateKYCPending,
628				Language:    lang,
629				Params:      map[string]string{"subject": subjectName, "tier": tier},
630				Status:      domain.NotificationQueued,
631				QueuedAt:    now,
632			}); err != nil {
633				s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "kyc pending notify: insert failed",
634					slog.String("reviewer_party_id", rvID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
635			}
636		}
637		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "kyc pending notifications queued",
638			slog.String("subject_party_id", subject.ID.Hex()), slog.Int("reviewers", len(reviewers)))
639	}

1	package domain
2	
3	import (
4		"fmt"
5		"strings"

8		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"

10	
11	// FSSAI limits for liquid milk (blueprint §8.3). Aflatoxin M1 is heat-stable
12	// and survives pasteurisation, so it MUST be gated upstream (BMC + plant),
13	// never only at the finished product.
14	const (
15		FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg = 0.5  // AFM1 ≤ 0.5 µg/kg
16		FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl          = 10.0 // coliform ≤ 10 CFU/ml
17		FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg       = 0.1  // antibiotic MRL example
18	)
19	
20	// QC test names.
21	const (
22		TestAflatoxinM1 = "AFLATOXIN_M1"            // µg/kg
23		TestColiform    = "COLIFORM"                // CFU/ml
24		TestTPC         = "TPC"                     // CFU/ml, graded — recorded, not hard-gated here
25		TestAntibiotic  = "ANTIBIOTIC_TETRACYCLINE" // mg/kg
26		TestPhosphatase = "PHOSPHATASE"             // 0 = negative (pass post-pasteurisation), 1 = positive
27		TestFat         = "FAT"                     // %
28		TestSNF         = "SNF"                     // %
29	)
30	
31	// QC stages.
32	const (
33		QCStageBMCRapid = "BMC_RAPID" // strip/rapid tests at the chilling centre
34		QCStagePlantLab = "PLANT_LAB" // full lab: ELISA/HPLC, culture, LC-MS/MS
35	)
36	
37	// QC subject types.
38	const (
39		QCSubjectDCSConsignment  = "DCS_CONSIGNMENT"
40		QCSubjectBMCLot          = "BMC_LOT"
41		QCSubjectProcessingBatch = "PROCESSING_BATCH"
42	)
43	
44	// QCTest is a single measurement inside a QC result.
45	type QCTest struct {
46		Name  string  `bson:"name"  json:"name"`
47		Value float64 `bson:"value" json:"value"`
48		Unit  string  `bson:"unit"  json:"unit"`
49		Pass  bool    `bson:"pass"  json:"pass"`
50	}
51	
52	// QCResult is the recorded outcome of testing one subject at one stage.
53	// OverallPass drives the safety gate; a certificate is attached to provenance
54	// on pass, a block + quarantine on fail.
55	type QCResult struct {
56		ID                primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
57		SubjectType       string             `bson:"subject_type"  json:"subject_type"`
58		SubjectID         primitive.ObjectID `bson:"subject_id"    json:"subject_id"`
59		Stage             string             `bson:"stage"         json:"stage"`
60		Tests             []QCTest           `bson:"tests"         json:"tests"`
61		OverallPass       bool               `bson:"overall_pass"  json:"overall_pass"`
62		FailureReasons    []string           `bson:"failure_reasons,omitempty" json:"failure_reasons,omitempty"`
63		AnalystPartyID    primitive.ObjectID `bson:"analyst_party_id" json:"analyst_party_id"`
64		LabRef            string             `bson:"lab_ref,omitempty"            json:"lab_ref,omitempty"`
65		CertificateNumber string             `bson:"certificate_number,omitempty" json:"certificate_number,omitempty"`
66		// Superseded marks a result voided after losing the gate race — the
67		// verdict on the subject came from a different, earlier result.
68		Superseded    bool      `bson:"superseded,omitempty" json:"superseded,omitempty"`
69		RecordedAt    time.Time `bson:"recorded_at"   json:"recorded_at"`
70		ProvenanceSeq int64     `bson:"provenance_seq,omitempty" json:"provenance_seq,omitempty"`
71	}
72	
73	// NormalizeTestName maps common field aliases to the canonical FSSAI test
74	// name so the safety gate can NEVER be bypassed by a spelling difference
75	// (e.g. the app sends "AFM1"; the gate keys on "AFLATOXIN_M1"). A test whose
76	// name still doesn't resolve to a gated parameter is recorded but not gated.
77	func NormalizeTestName(name string) string {
78		switch strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(name)) {
79		case "AFM1", "AFLATOXIN", "AFLATOXINM1", "AFLATOXIN_M1", "AFLATOXIN-M1":
80			return TestAflatoxinM1
81		case "COLIFORM", "COLIFORMS":
82			return TestColiform
83		case "TPC", "TOTAL_PLATE_COUNT":
84			return TestTPC
85		case "ANTIBIOTIC", "TETRACYCLINE", "ANTIBIOTIC_TETRACYCLINE":
86			return TestAntibiotic
87		case "PHOSPHATASE", "ALP":
88			return TestPhosphatase
89		case "FAT":
90			return TestFat
91		case "SNF":
92			return TestSNF
93		default:
94			return strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(name))
95		}
96	}
97	
98	// EvaluateQCTests applies the FSSAI gate to a set of tests: it normalizes each
99	// test name, fills its Pass verdict, and returns the overall verdict plus
100	// human-readable failure reasons. Unknown test names are recorded but do not
101	// gate. The returned tests carry the CANONICAL name so storage is consistent.
102	func EvaluateQCTests(tests []QCTest) (overallPass bool, failures []string, evaluated []QCTest) {
103		overallPass = true
104		evaluated = make([]QCTest, 0, len(tests))
105		for _, t := range tests {
106			t.Name = NormalizeTestName(t.Name) // canonicalise so the gate cannot be dodged by alias
107			pass := true
108			switch t.Name {
109			case TestAflatoxinM1:
110				if t.Value > FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg {
111					pass = false
112					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
113						"AFLATOXIN_M1 %.3f µg/kg exceeds FSSAI limit %.1f µg/kg", t.Value, FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg))
114				}
115			case TestColiform:
116				if t.Value > FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl {
117					pass = false
118					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
119						"COLIFORM %.1f CFU/ml exceeds FSSAI limit %.0f CFU/ml", t.Value, FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl))
120				}
121			case TestAntibiotic:
122				if t.Value > FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg {
123					pass = false
124					failures = append(failures, fmt.Sprintf(
125						"ANTIBIOTIC_TETRACYCLINE %.3f mg/kg exceeds MRL %.1f mg/kg", t.Value, FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg))
126				}
127			case TestPhosphatase:
128				if t.Value != 0 {
129					pass = false
130					failures = append(failures, "PHOSPHATASE positive — pasteurisation check failed (must be negative)")
131				}
132			}
133			t.Pass = pass
134			if !pass {
135				overallPass = false
136			}
137			evaluated = append(evaluated, t)
138		}
139		return overallPass, failures, evaluated
140	}
141

29	// RateChart prices milk from fat/SNF, scoped to an org unit (union or
30	// federation). rate/L = BaseRatePerLitre + Fat%*FatRatePerPoint + SNF%*SNFRatePerPoint.
31	type RateChart struct {
32		ID        primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
33		OrgUnitID primitive.ObjectID `bson:"org_unit_id"   json:"org_unit_id"`
34		Name      string             `bson:"name"          json:"name"`

36		// reproducible and a mid-cycle chart change never rewrites history
37		// (Developer Note §6.3, Appendix C). Human-readable, e.g. "GON-2026-06".
38		Version          string             `bson:"version"       json:"version"`

40		FatRatePerPoint  float64            `bson:"fat_rate_per_point"  json:"fat_rate_per_point"`

46	}

48	// Assurance levels (Developer Note §6.2) — how fat/SNF was captured. Every
49	// pour carries one; every downstream aggregate (consignment, batch, lot)
50	// inherits the WEAKEST assurance in its set, so capture quality is measurable
51	// and drives societies toward instrument-linked capture.
52	const (
53		AssuranceInstrument = "A" // analyzer streamed the reading (RS-232/BLE) — strongest
54		AssuranceOCRPhoto   = "B" // OCR of an analyzer-screen photo, photo retained as evidence
55		AssuranceManual     = "C" // keyed by hand — weakest, drives supervisor sampling
56	)
57	
58	// AssuranceForSource maps a reading/pour capture mode to its assurance level.
59	func AssuranceForSource(source string) string {
60		switch source {
61		case ReadingModeDirect:
62			return AssuranceInstrument
63		case ReadingModePhotoOCR:
64			return AssuranceOCRPhoto
65		default:
66			return AssuranceManual
67		}
68	}
69	
70	// assuranceRank orders assurance so "weakest in a set" is a max-rank pick
71	// (higher rank = weaker).
72	var assuranceRank = map[string]int{AssuranceInstrument: 0, AssuranceOCRPhoto: 1, AssuranceManual: 2}
73	
74	// WeakestAssurance returns the weakest (lowest-trust) assurance among the
75	// given levels — the value an aggregate inherits (§6.2). Empty input → "".
76	func WeakestAssurance(levels ...string) string {
77		weakest, seen := "", -1
78		for _, l := range levels {
79			if r, ok := assuranceRank[l]; ok && r > seen {
80				weakest, seen = l, r
81			}
82		}
83		return weakest
84	}
85	
86	// PricePour computes (ratePerLitre, amount) for a pour, rounded to paise.
87	func (rc RateChart) PricePour(fatPct, snfPct, qtyLitres float64) (rate, amount float64) {
88		rate = rc.BaseRatePerLitre + fatPct*rc.FatRatePerPoint + snfPct*rc.SNFRatePerPoint
89		rate = math.Round(rate*100) / 100
90		amount = math.Round(rate*qtyLitres*100) / 100
91		return rate, amount
92	}

136	// CheckPlausibility validates fat/SNF/qty against physical bounds and returns
137	// the violated flags (empty slice = plausible).
138	func CheckPlausibility(fatPct, snfPct, qtyLitres float64) []string {
139		var flags []string
140		if fatPct < PlausibleFatMin || fatPct > PlausibleFatMax ||
141			snfPct < PlausibleSNFMin || snfPct > PlausibleSNFMax {
142			flags = append(flags, IntegrityFlagImplausibleValue)
143		}
144		if qtyLitres != 0 && (qtyLitres < PlausibleQtyMin || qtyLitres > PlausibleQtyMax) {
145			flags = append(flags, IntegrityFlagImplausibleValue)
146		}
147		return flags
148	}
149	
150	// Milk pour statuses. Corrections never edit in place: a correcting pour
151	// references the superseded one (append-only provenance, blueprint §3.4).

154		PourStatusSuperseded = "SUPERSEDED"
155		PourStatusCancelled  = "CANCELLED"

162	// server coordination (blueprint §3.1); its unique index makes replays
163	// harmless. All relations (farmer, DCS, reading, chart) are ObjectID refs.

220	// DateKeyIST formats t as the YYYY-MM-DD settlement-day key in IST.
221	func DateKeyIST(t time.Time) string {
222		ist := time.FixedZone("IST", 5*3600+1800)
223		return t.In(ist).Format("2006-01-02")
224	}

1	// Package collection implements the core procurement loop of Saathi
2	// (blueprint §8.1, §8.2): org-scoped rate charts, anti-tamper analyzer
3	// readings, offline-first idempotent milk pours with same-day pricing, and
4	// per-farmer daily invoices behind the same-day payment promise.
5	//
6	// Bus topics published by this module:
7	//   - eventbus.TopicPourRecorded  — payload domain.MilkPour (the newly recorded pour)
8	//   - eventbus.TopicInvoiceIssued — payload domain.Invoice (the newly issued invoice)
9	package collection
10	
11	import (
12		"log/slog"
13	
14		"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
15	
16		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
17		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
18		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/middleware"
19	)
20	
21	// Register mounts the collection module under /collection and wires the
22	// handler → service → repo stack onto the shared platform dependencies.
23	func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
24		log := d.Log.With(slog.String("module", "collection"))
25		repo := newRepo(d)
26		svc := newService(d, repo, log)
27		h := &handler{svc: svc}
28	
29		r.Route("/collection", func(r chi.Router) {
30			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
31	
32			// Rate charts: pricing policy is set at union/federation level and
33			// resolved downward to each DCS (nearest ancestor wins).
34			r.Route("/rate-charts", func(r chi.Router) {
35				r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RolePCDFAdmin, domain.RoleUnionPresident)).
36					Post("/", h.createRateChart)
37				r.With(middleware.RequireSession).Get("/active", h.getActiveRateChart)
38			})
39	
40			// Analyzer readings: flagged, never rejected (anti-tamper envelope §8.2).
41			r.Route("/readings", func(r chi.Router) {
42				r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSamitiSacheev, domain.RoleMilkTester)).
43					Post("/", h.createReading)
44				r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(
45					domain.RoleSamitiSacheev, domain.RoleMilkTester, domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor,
46					domain.RoleStateAuditor,
47				)).Get("/", h.listReadings)
48			})
49	
50			// Pours: THE core loop — offline-first idempotent, hard plausibility gate.
51			r.Route("/pours", func(r chi.Router) {
52				r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
53					r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSamitiSacheev, domain.RoleMilkTester))
54					r.Post("/", h.createPour)
55					r.Post("/batch-sync", h.batchSyncPours)
56					r.Post("/{id}/supersede", h.supersedePour)
57				})
58				r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(
59					domain.RoleSamitiSacheev, domain.RoleMilkTester,
60					domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor, domain.RoleFarmer, domain.RoleStateAuditor,
61				)).Get("/", h.listPours)
62			})
63	
64			// Invoices: the same-day settlement artefact (§8.1).
65			r.Route("/invoices", func(r chi.Router) {
66				r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSamitiSacheev)).
67					Post("/generate", h.generateInvoices)
68				r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
69					r.Use(middleware.RequireRoles(
70						domain.RoleFarmer, domain.RoleSamitiSacheev, domain.RoleSamitiAdhyaksh,
71						domain.RoleMilkTester, domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor,
72						domain.RoleUnionPresident, domain.RolePCDFAdmin, domain.RoleStateAuditor,
73					))
74					r.Get("/", h.listInvoices)
75					r.Get("/{id}", h.getInvoice)
76				})
77			})
78		})
79	}

1	// Package logistics moves sealed milk from village societies to chilling
2	// centres (blueprint §7.1): a Samiti Sacheev pools a shift's RECORDED pours
3	// into a DCS consignment and dispatches it; a van rider runs a route trip
4	// that picks consignments up stop by stop, logs cold-chain temperatures in
5	// transit, and hands the load to a BMC. Every hop is chained into the
6	// provenance ledger so the pour→QR trace survives the pooling boundary.
7	package logistics
8	
9	import (
10		"log/slog"
11	
12		"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
13	
14		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
15		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
16		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/middleware"
17	)
18	
19	// Register mounts the logistics routes under /logistics (the router hands us
20	// the /api/v1 subtree) and wires handler → service → repo.
21	func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
22		log := d.Log.With(slog.String("module", "logistics"))
23		svc := newService(newRepo(d.DB), d.Orgs, d.Ledger, log)
24		h := &handler{svc: svc}
25	
26		r.Route("/logistics", func(r chi.Router) {
27			r.Use(middleware.Authenticate(d.JWT))
28	
29			r.Route("/consignments", func(r chi.Router) {
30				sacheevOnly := middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleSamitiSacheev)
31				r.With(sacheevOnly).Post("/", h.createConsignment)
32				r.With(sacheevOnly).Post("/{consignmentID}/dispatch", h.dispatchConsignment)
33				r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(
34					domain.RoleSamitiSacheev, domain.RoleSamitiAdhyaksh, domain.RoleVanRider,
35					domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor, domain.RoleBMCOperator, domain.RoleStateAuditor,
36				)).Get("/", h.listConsignments)
37			})
38	
39			r.Route("/trips", func(r chi.Router) {
40				riderOnly := middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleVanRider)
41				tripReaders := middleware.RequireRoles(
42					domain.RoleVanRider, domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor, domain.RoleUnionPresident,
43					domain.RoleStateAuditor,
44				)
45				r.With(middleware.RequireRoles(domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor, domain.RoleVanRider)).
46					Post("/", h.createTrip)
47				r.With(riderOnly).Post("/{tripID}/stops/{consignmentID}/pickup", h.pickupStop)
48				r.With(riderOnly).Post("/{tripID}/cold-chain", h.logColdChain)
49				r.With(riderOnly).Post("/{tripID}/deliver", h.deliverTrip)
50				r.With(tripReaders).Get("/", h.listTrips)
51				r.With(tripReaders).Get("/{tripID}", h.getTrip)
52			})
53		})
54	}

46		return &Service{
47			repo:     repo,
48			orgs:     d.Orgs,
49			ledger:   d.Ledger,
50			qrSecret: d.Cfg.QRSigningSecret,
51			log:      log,

55	// actorID parses the actor's party identity — carried as an ObjectID hex
56	// string in JWT claims — into the ObjectID persisted on created documents.
57	func actorID(actor auth.Actor) (primitive.ObjectID, error) {

62	// and returns the opaque 500 — every internal failure must name its op in the
63	// logs.
64	func (s *Service) fail(ctx context.Context, op string, err error) error {
65		err = fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", op, err)
66		s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "plant operation failed",
67			slog.String("op", op), slog.Any("err", err))
68		return httpx.Internal(err)
