````md
## 2. Surface-by-surface integration guide

### 2.1 Auth & role switch — ✅ LIVE (already the app's spine)
Two-call login then a role selection that pins scope:
```
POST /auth/otp/request {phone}              → {phone, expires_at, dev_otp?}
POST /auth/otp/verify  {phone, otp}         → {access_token (SESSION), refresh_token, party}
GET  /parties/me                            → {party, assignments[], kyc?}
      assignments.length===1 → auto-select ;  else → role picker
POST /auth/role/select {role_assignment_id} → {access_token (ROLE), role_code, org_unit_id, org_type}
```
- Swap **only** the access token to the ROLE token; keep the refresh token.
- Each `assignments[]` item is a flattened `RoleAssignment` **plus** `org_name`, `org_type`,
  `org_code` — enough to render the picker with no extra call. (This enrichment exists here
  and on `/parties/me` — **not** on `/roles/assignments`; see 2.3.)
- KYC gate: `role/select` → `403 KYC_TIER_INSUFFICIENT` (with `details.current_tier`/
  `required_tier`) if tier is below the role's requirement. Surface it.
- **FE map:** add `ORGANISING_MANAGER`, `CONSUMER`, `ONBOARDING_EXECUTIVE`, `STORE_MANAGER`
  to `ROLES[code]` and **guard the lookup** so an unknown code never crashes the picker.

### 2.2 Profile & KYC (self) — ✅ LIVE
`GET/PATCH /parties/me` (PATCH: `full_name`, `preferred_language`, `public_consent`) ·
`POST /kyc/aadhaar` (→ PENDING, stores last-4 + vault ref only) · `POST /kyc/bank`
(penny-drop, masked tail) · `GET /kyc/me`. KYC tier accepts `SERVICE`↔`MTLS` (both valid).

### 2.3 Party/role lookup lists — 🔴 BACKEND-GAP (org enrichment)
- `GET /parties?role=CODE&org_unit_id=?` → returns **raw `domain.Party`** (`id, phone,
  full_name, preferred_language, kyc_tier, status, public_consent, …`) — **no org info.**
- ⚠️ **Correction to `backend-gaps.md` A1d:** it suggested pointing the Sachiv picker at
  `GET /roles/assignments?role_code=` because "`assignmentWithOrg` carries both". **It does
  not** — that list returns raw `RoleAssignment` (has `org_unit_id`, **no `org_name`**). The
  enriched shape is used only by `/auth/roles` and `/parties/me`.
- **Needed for the Sachiv picker** (`listSachivs`): `org_unit_id` **and** `org_name`.
- **Backend fix (pick one):** (a) enrich `GET /parties?role=` response with each holder's
  `{org_unit_id, org_name}`, or (b) add `org_name` to the `GET /roles/assignments` list
  response. Either unblocks the picker.
- **Interim FE:** keep `listSachivs` on mock, or show `org_unit_id` only.

### 2.4 Assisted onboarding — 🔴 BACKEND-GAP (rich capture)
- Backend `onboarding_requests` stores exactly `{phone, full_name, requested_role,
  org_unit_id, requested_tier, note, document_refs[]}` (+ server lifecycle fields). Approve
  atomically creates **Party + VERIFIED KYC + RoleAssignment** (+ tier upgrade + SMS) — this
  half is ✅ correct and powerful.
- The FE reviewer card also captures `village, cattle_count, cattle_breed, vehicle_number,
  employee_id, profile_photo, kyc_photo, document_type, document_number, full_name_hi` — none
  are stored, so they'd blank in the queue on http.
- **Backend fix (pick one):** (a) extend `onboarding_requests` + the submit DTO with those
  structured fields (keeps the reviewer UI rich — **preferred**), or (b) accept that the FE
  folds them into `note` (string) + uploads photos to S3 and passes URLs as `document_refs[]`.
- **Interim FE:** the 6 onboarding endpoints stay `mockOnly`. When (a) or (b) lands: drop
  `mockOnly`; add `mapRequest` (`fullName→full_name`, `role→requested_role`,
  `orgUnitId→org_unit_id`, derive `requested_tier ∈ {MINIMAL,FARMER,STANDARD,RIDER,HIGH}`) and
  a shared `mapResponse`.

### 2.5 Orgs — ✅ LIVE (one enrichment gap)
`GET /orgs?type=&district=&code=` · `POST /orgs` · `GET|PATCH /orgs/{id}` ·
`/orgs/{id}/children` · `/orgs/{id}/tree` · `/orgs/{id}/members`.
- **FE map:** org types `FEDERATION|MILK_UNION|PROCESSING_PLANT|BMC|DCS` — map FE
  `UNION→MILK_UNION`, `PLANT→PROCESSING_PLANT`.
- 🔴 **`name_hi` gap (B3):** `OrgUnit` has only `name` (no bilingual field). FE keeps a

### 2.6 Collection — core loop — ✅ LIVE (mapper renames)
| Call | Endpoint | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| rate chart | `POST /collection/rate-charts` / `GET …/active?dcs_id=` | chart carries `version` |
| reading | `POST /collection/readings` | anti-tamper envelope; `mode` ∈ `ANALYZER_DIRECT\|PHOTO_OCR\|MANUAL`; `photo_object_key`, `ocr_confidence` |
| pour | `POST /collection/pours` | returns `{pour, idempotent_replay?}`; pour has `assurance` A\|B\|C + `rate_chart_version`; read weighted rate from **`rate_per_litre`** |
| offline replay | `POST /collection/pours/batch-sync` | ≤500; per-item created/duplicate/error |
| correction | `POST /collection/pours/{id}/supersede` | append-only |
| list pours | `GET /collection/pours?dcs_id=&date=&shift=&farmer_party_id=` | FARMER forced own |
| invoices | `POST /collection/invoices/generate` · `GET /collection/invoices?…` · `/{id}` | **same-day** invoice |

- **FE map (safety-critical):** pour `source` = **`ANALYZER_DIRECT`** (not `ANALYZER_AUTO`).
  Pour status is only `RECORDED|SUPERSEDED|CANCELLED` — derive IN_LOT/INVOICED/PAID client-side.
- **Invoice** (⚠️ a real model difference, not a rename): it is **same-day** and carries
  `invoice_date` (not `date`), `total_amount`, `total_quantity_litres` — **no
  gross/deductions/net on the invoice**. Deductions & payment live on the **settlement batch**
  (see 2.11). Status: `ISSUED|SETTLEMENT_PENDING|PAID|HOLD` (**not** DRAFT/APPROVED/SETTLED).

### 2.7 Collection — OCR extract — ⚪ BY-DESIGN
No server `POST /collection/pours/ocr-extract`. Design: on-device OCR → upload photo (S3 seam)
→ `POST /collection/readings` with `mode=PHOTO_OCR` + `photo_object_key` + `ocr_confidence`.
Keep `photoOcrExtract` mock until on-device OCR + the photo upload seam are wired. **Not a
backend change.**

No backend route/entity for a DCS→Union B2B e-invoice (HSN 0401, GST-exempt). `approveForUnion`
/ `getConsignmentInvoice` stay `mockOnly`. **Backend fix (only if this leg is in scope):**
model the B2B consignment invoice + `POST /collection/consignments/{id}/approve-union` +
`GET …/invoice`. Confirm with product whether the pilot needs it.

### 2.9 Logistics — ✅ LIVE (one path fix)
`GET|POST /logistics/consignments` · `POST /logistics/consignments/{id}/dispatch` (mints
`seal_code`, `sealed_at`, weakest `assurance`) · `GET|POST /logistics/trips` ·
`GET /logistics/trips/{tripID}` · `POST /logistics/trips/{tripID}/stops/{consignmentID}/pickup`
· `…/cold-chain` · `…/deliver {bmc_id}`.
- 🟡 **Pickup path fix:** it is keyed by the **consignment id** —
  `…/stops/{consignmentID}/pickup` — send the consignment id in that slot (not the DCS id),
  body `{temp_c, notes?}`.
- **FE map:** consignment `total_quantity_litres` (not `total_litres`); `avg_fat_pct`/
  `avg_snf_pct`; status `OPEN|DISPATCHED|PICKED_UP|DELIVERED|ACCEPTED|REJECTED` (backend
  `DISPATCHED` = "sealed"); trip delivered field `delivered_to_bmc_id`.
- 🔴 **Single-consignment GET (A7):** there is **no** `GET /logistics/consignments/{id}` —
  only the list. FE either sources one from the list result (current mock behaviour) or the
  backend adds the detail route.

### 2.10 BMC branch console — 🟡 FE-ONLY (status-vocab mapper)
Routes exist and bodies align: `GET /plant/bmc-lots`, `POST /plant/bmc-lots/{id}/close`
(body `chilling_temp_c`), `…/dispatch`.
- The backend `BMCLot.status` is `OPEN|QC_PENDING|PASSED|BLOCKED|DISPATCHED|POOLED`; `close`
  does **OPEN→QC_PENDING while recording `chilling_temp_c`** (not `RECEIVED→CHILLED`).
- **FE fix:** add a `mapBmcLot` response mapper + a status bridge
  (`OPEN→received`, `QC_PENDING→chilled`, `DISPATCHED→dispatched_to_plant`), then drop

### 2.11 Settlement & DBT — 🟡 FE-ONLY (rewire) + 🔴 (DBT amount)
Backend lifecycle (all live): `POST /settlements {dcs_id, date}` → returns a **SettlementBatch
with `id`** (PENDING_APPROVAL) → `POST /settlements/{id}/approve` (dual-control: **approver ≠
initiator**, else 403) → `/{id}/reject` → `/{id}/execute` (successful payouts → invoice `PAID`

## 3. Canonical reconciliation checklist (do in the FE mappers before `MODE=http`)

The backend is canonical; adjust `mapRequest`/`mapResponse` to these. **Safety-critical first.**

| Area | FE was sending/reading | Canonical (backend) |
|---|---|---|
| 🔴 QC test name | `AFM1` | **`AFLATOXIN_M1`** (alias normalized, but send canonical) |
| 🔴 QC subject type | `PLANT_BATCH`, `BMC_INTAKE` | `PROCESSING_BATCH`, `BMC_LOT` |
| Pour source | `ANALYZER_AUTO` | `ANALYZER_DIRECT` (+ `PHOTO_OCR`, `MANUAL`) |
| Pour rate field | `rate` | `rate_per_litre` (+ new `assurance`, `rate_chart_version`) |
| Pour status | IN_LOT/INVOICED/PAID | `RECORDED\|SUPERSEDED\|CANCELLED` (derive lifecycle FE-side) |
| Consignment litres | `total_litres` | `total_quantity_litres` (+ `seal_code`, `sealed_at`, `assurance`) |
| Invoice date/amounts | `date`, gross/net | `invoice_date`, `total_amount`, `total_quantity_litres` (no deductions on invoice) |
| Invoice status | DRAFT/APPROVED/SETTLED | `ISSUED\|SETTLEMENT_PENDING\|PAID\|HOLD` |
| Batch litres | `volume_litres` | `input_litres` (+ `contributing_dcs_ids`) |
| QC test result | `passed`, `recorded_by_party_id` | `pass`, `overall_pass`, `analyst_party_id` |
| BMC lot status | RECEIVED/CHILLED | `OPEN\|QC_PENDING\|PASSED\|BLOCKED\|DISPATCHED\|POOLED` |
| Trip delivered | — | `delivered_to_bmc_id` |
| Org type | `UNION`, `PLANT` | `MILK_UNION`, `PROCESSING_PLANT` |
| Settlement ref | `union_ref` | `pa_ref` |
| Health event enums | `AI`, `ILLNESS` | `ARTIFICIAL_INSEMINATION`, `DISEASE_REPORT`; MVU `requested_at` (not `created_at`) |
| Roles map | unguarded `ROLES[code]` | add `ORGANISING_MANAGER`, `CONSUMER`, `ONBOARDING_EXECUTIVE`, `STORE_MANAGER`; **guard the lookup** |
| KYC tier | — | `SERVICE`↔`MTLS` both accepted |
| Pickup path | keyed by DCS id | keyed by **consignment id** |
| Any empty ID | `org_unit_id:""` | **omit the field** (never send `""`) |
````

```text
1	import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
2	import type { MockDb } from '@/core/mocks/db';
3	
4	/**
5	 * API transport layer, aligned with the real Go backend (parag-saathi-be):
6	 *   - success envelope  { "data": ..., "meta"?: ... }
7	 *   - error envelope    { "error": { "code", "message", "details"? } }
8	 *   - bearer auth with a SESSION/ROLE access token + rotating refresh token
9	 *     (POST /auth/refresh) - a 401 triggers one single-flight refresh + retry
10	 *
11	 * Every endpoint in src/core/api/endpoints/ is declared once with:
12	 *   - its HTTP method + path        → the contract the backend implements
13	 *   - optional mapRequest/mapResponse → snake_case wire ⇄ camelCase domain
14	 *   - a mock implementation         → runs fully in-app against the seeded
15	 *                                     mock DB until the backend is connected
16	 *
17	 * Switch modes with EXPO_PUBLIC_API_MODE (mock | http) - see .env.example and
18	 * docs/api-contract.md. No feature code changes when the backend lands.
19	 */
20	
21	export type ApiMode = 'mock' | 'http';
22	
23	// Authentic by default: the app talks to the real Saathi backend. `mock` is an
24	// explicit offline-development fallback only (never the shipped experience).
25	const MODE: ApiMode = (process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_API_MODE as ApiMode) || 'http';
26	const BASE: string = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL || 'http://localhost:8080/api/v1';

29	export const API_MODE: ApiMode = MODE;
30	/** The Saathi backend base URL every endpoint is resolved against. */
31	export const API_BASE_URL: string = BASE;

34	const REFRESH_KEY = 'saathi-refresh-token';
35	
36	/** In-memory token cache, persisted to AsyncStorage (hydrated at app start). */
37	let accessToken: string | null = null;
38	let refreshToken: string | null = null;
39	
40	export function getAuthToken(): string | null {
41	  return accessToken;
42	}
43	export function getRefreshToken(): string | null {
44	  return refreshToken;
45	}
46	
47	/** Store both tokens (login / refresh rotation). */
48	export function setTokens(t: { access: string | null; refresh: string | null }): void {
49	  accessToken = t.access;
50	  refreshToken = t.refresh;
51	  if (t.access) void AsyncStorage.setItem(ACCESS_KEY, t.access);
52	  else void AsyncStorage.removeItem(ACCESS_KEY);
53	  if (t.refresh) void AsyncStorage.setItem(REFRESH_KEY, t.refresh);
54	  else void AsyncStorage.removeItem(REFRESH_KEY);
55	}
56	
57	/** Swap only the access token (role-select issues a ROLE-kind token). */
58	export function setAccessToken(token: string): void {
59	  accessToken = token;
60	  void AsyncStorage.setItem(ACCESS_KEY, token);
61	}
62	
63	export function clearTokens(): void {
64	  setTokens({ access: null, refresh: null });
65	}
66	
67	/** Call once at startup (root layout) before authenticated requests. */
68	export async function hydrateAuthToken(): Promise<void> {
69	  const [a, r] = await Promise.all([
70	    AsyncStorage.getItem(ACCESS_KEY),
71	    AsyncStorage.getItem(REFRESH_KEY),
72	  ]);
73	  accessToken = a;
74	  refreshToken = r;
75	}
76	
77	/** Registered by the root layout: fired when auth is irrecoverably lost. */
78	let onUnauthorized: (() => void) | null = null;
79	export function setOnUnauthorized(cb: (() => void) | null): void {
80	  onUnauthorized = cb;
81	}
82	
83	export class ApiError extends Error {
84	  constructor(
85	    public status: number,
86	    public code: string,
87	    message: string,
88	    public details?: unknown,
89	  ) {
90	    super(message);
91	    this.name = 'ApiError';
92	  }
93	}
94	
95	type HttpMethod = 'GET' | 'POST' | 'PUT' | 'PATCH' | 'DELETE';
96	
97	export interface EndpointSpec<TIn, TOut> {
98	  method: HttpMethod;
99	  /** REST path for http mode; also documents the backend contract */
100	  path: (input: TIn) => string;
101	  /** camelCase input → snake_case wire body (http mode only) */
102	  mapRequest?: (input: TIn) => unknown;
103	  /** snake_case wire data → domain shape (http mode only) */
104	  mapResponse?: (raw: unknown) => TOut;
105	  /** In-app implementation for mock mode */
106	  mock: (input: TIn, db: MockDb) => TOut | Promise<TOut>;
107	  /**
108	   * Force the mock path even in http mode. Used for endpoints whose FE flow is
109	   * not yet reconciled with the backend (e.g. the settlement write flow keys on
110	   * a DCS+date while the backend keys on a settlement-batch id, or a route the
111	   * backend does not expose). Keeps the role's screens functional against the
112	   * in-app fixtures instead of firing a request that 4xx's. Tracked in
113	   * docs/backend_fixing.md so these can flip to http once reconciled.
114	   */
115	  mockOnly?: boolean;
116	}
117	
118	function sleep(ms: number): Promise<void> {
119	  return new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
120	}
121	
122	/** JSON-safe deep clone (results are plain data; keeps Hermes compatibility). */
123	function deepClone<T>(value: T): T {
124	  return value === undefined ? value : (JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value)) as T);
125	}
126	
127	/** Raw http call: bearer header, envelope unwrap, AppError mapping. */
128	async function httpCall(method: HttpMethod, path: string, body: unknown): Promise<unknown> {
129	  const hasBody = method !== 'GET' && method !== 'DELETE' && body !== undefined;
130	  const res = await fetch(BASE + path, {
131	    method,
132	    headers: {
133	      Accept: 'application/json',
134	      ...(hasBody ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } : {}),
135	      ...(accessToken ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}` } : {}),
136	    },
137	    body: hasBody ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined,
138	  });
139	  const text = await res.text().catch(() => '');
140	  let json: unknown;
141	  try {
142	    json = text ? JSON.parse(text) : undefined;
143	  } catch {
144	    json = undefined;
145	  }
146	  if (!res.ok) {
147	    const err = (json as { error?: { code?: string; message?: string; details?: unknown } })
148	      ?.error;
149	    throw new ApiError(
150	      res.status,
151	      err?.code ?? `HTTP_${res.status}`,
152	      err?.message ?? res.statusText,
153	      err?.details,
154	    );
155	  }
156	  // Success envelope: { data, meta? } - unwrap data; tolerate bare payloads.
157	  if (json && typeof json === 'object' && 'data' in (json as Record<string, unknown>)) {
158	    return (json as { data: unknown }).data;
159	  }
160	  return json;
161	}
162	
163	/** Single-flight refresh: rotate the token pair via POST /auth/refresh. */
164	let refreshInFlight: Promise<boolean> | null = null;
165	async function tryRefresh(): Promise<boolean> {
166	  if (!refreshToken) return false;
167	  refreshInFlight ??= (async () => {
168	    try {
169	      const data = (await httpCall('POST', '/auth/refresh', {
170	        refresh_token: refreshToken,
171	      })) as { access_token: string; refresh_token: string };
172	      setTokens({ access: data.access_token, refresh: data.refresh_token });
173	      return true;
174	    } catch {
175	      return false;
176	    } finally {
177	      refreshInFlight = null;
178	    }
179	  })();
180	  return refreshInFlight;
181	}
182	
183	/** Declare a typed API endpoint. Returns the callable used by feature code. */
184	export function endpoint<TIn = void, TOut = unknown>(
185	  spec: EndpointSpec<TIn, TOut>,
186	): (input: TIn) => Promise<TOut> {
187	  return async (input: TIn): Promise<TOut> => {
188	    if (MODE === 'mock' || spec.mockOnly) {
189	      const { db } = await import('@/core/mocks/db');
190	      // Simulated network latency so loading states are honest
191	      await sleep(120 + Math.random() * 230);
192	      const result = await spec.mock(input, db);
193	      // Deep-clone so callers can never mutate the mock store through results
194	      return deepClone(result);
195	    }
196	
197	    const path = spec.path(input);
198	    const body = spec.mapRequest ? spec.mapRequest(input) : (input as unknown);
199	    try {
200	      const raw = await httpCall(spec.method, path, body);
201	      return spec.mapResponse ? spec.mapResponse(raw) : (raw as TOut);
202	    } catch (e) {
203	      // One refresh + retry on expired access tokens (never for /auth/* itself)
204	      if (e instanceof ApiError && e.status === 401 && !path.startsWith('/auth/')) {
205	        if (await tryRefresh()) {
206	          const raw = await httpCall(spec.method, path, body);
207	          return spec.mapResponse ? spec.mapResponse(raw) : (raw as TOut);
208	        }
209	        clearTokens();
210	        onUnauthorized?.();
211	      }
212	      throw e;
213	    }
214	  };
215	}
```

```text
3	/**
4	 * Image upload seam - direct-to-S3 from the frontend.
5	 *
6	 * FLOW (secure standard): the frontend asks the backend for a presigned S3 PUT
7	 * URL, PUTs the bytes straight to S3, and stores only the returned object URL on
8	 * the record - the backend never handles the binary. Better for the backend to
9	 * save correctly (just a URL, no blobs).
10	 *
11	 * TODAY (backend later): returns a deterministic mock S3 object URL so the
12	 * capture → upload → stored-URL flow works end to end and hot-reloads. Swap the
13	 * body for the real presign + PUT at integration. Config from env ONLY.
14	 */
15	
16	/** Public base for stored object URLs (env only, never hardcoded in features). */
17	export const S3_PUBLIC_BASE: string =
18	  process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_S3_PUBLIC_BASE_URL || 'https://saathi-kyc.s3.amazonaws.com';
19	/** Backend endpoint that mints presigned PUT URLs. Empty → stub (offline demo). */
20	export const S3_PRESIGN_URL: string = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_S3_PRESIGN_URL || '';
21	
22	export function isS3Configured(): boolean {
23	  return S3_PRESIGN_URL.length > 0;
24	}

36	 * the record stores an S3-shaped URL, not a device path.
37	 */

39	  // BACKDOOR: real presigned-S3 upload goes here (see docstring).
40	  //   const { uploadUrl, publicUrl, key } = await fetch(S3_PRESIGN_URL, {
41	  //     method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ kind }) }).then((r) => r.json());
42	  //   await fetch(uploadUrl, { method: 'PUT', body: await (await fetch(localUri)).blob() });
43	  //   return { url: publicUrl, key };
44	  const folder = kind.toLowerCase();
45	  const name = (localUri.split('/').pop() || `${Date.now()}`).replace(/[^a-z0-9]/gi, '');
46	  const key = `${folder}/${name}.jpg`;
```

```text
388	 * safe placeholder instead of throwing on `.icon`/`.label`/`.homePath`.

390	export function roleMeta(code: string): RoleMeta {
391	  return (ROLES as Record<string, RoleMeta>)[code] ?? { ...UNKNOWN_ROLE_META, code: code as RoleCode };
```

```text
1	/**
2	 * Wire-boundary helpers shared by the API mappers - the one place FE vocabulary
3	 * meets the backend's canonical vocabulary.
4	 *
5	 * Two jobs:
6	 *  1. Never send an empty-string id. The backend 400s (`INVALID_ID`) on `""` for
7	 *     any ObjectID field, so `omitId` collapses blank/whitespace to `undefined`
8	 *     (JSON.stringify drops undefined keys, so the field is omitted, not sent).
9	 *  2. Translate the enums the mock named differently from the backend
10	 *     (org types, KYC tier) in ONE spot, so a rename never drifts per-endpoint.
11	 */
12	import type { KycTier } from '@/core/types/roles';
13	import type { OrgUnitType } from '@/core/types/domain';
14	
15	/** Return `id` for a real value, or `undefined` for null/blank/whitespace so the
16	 *  key is omitted from the request body (never sent as `""`). */
17	export function omitId(id: string | null | undefined): string | undefined {
18	  const v = (id ?? '').trim();
19	  return v.length > 0 ? v : undefined;
20	}
21	
22	/** Append `key=value` to a URLSearchParams only when the value is non-blank
23	 *  (so a GET filter never sends `?farmer_party_id=`). */
24	export function setParam(q: URLSearchParams, key: string, value: string | null | undefined): void {
25	  const v = omitId(value);
26	  if (v !== undefined) q.set(key, v);
27	}
28	
29	/* --- Org type: backend canonical <-> FE vocabulary -------------------------- */
30	// Backend: FEDERATION | MILK_UNION | PROCESSING_PLANT | BMC | DCS.
31	// FE keeps UNION/PLANT (shorter, used across the supply chain) plus STORE/DISTRICT
32	// (first-class in the delivery model, §6). Only UNION/PLANT are renamed on the wire.
33	
34	const WIRE_TO_ORG: Record<string, OrgUnitType> = {
35	  MILK_UNION: 'UNION',
36	  PROCESSING_PLANT: 'PLANT',
37	};
38	const ORG_TO_WIRE: Partial<Record<OrgUnitType, string>> = {
39	  UNION: 'MILK_UNION',
40	  PLANT: 'PROCESSING_PLANT',
41	};
42	
43	/** Backend org type -> FE `OrgUnitType` (defaults to DCS for anything unknown). */
44	export function wireToOrgType(w: string | undefined): OrgUnitType {
45	  if (!w) return 'DCS';
46	  return WIRE_TO_ORG[w] ?? (w as OrgUnitType);
47	}
48	
49	/** FE `OrgUnitType` -> backend org type (for `?type=` filters and writes). */
50	export function orgTypeToWire(t: OrgUnitType): string {
51	  return ORG_TO_WIRE[t] ?? t;
52	}
53	
54	/* --- KYC tier: backend `SERVICE` <-> FE `MTLS` ------------------------------ */
55	
56	/** Backend KYC tier -> FE `KycTier` (`SERVICE` is the FE's `MTLS`). */
57	export function wireToKycTier(w: string | undefined): KycTier {
58	  if (!w) return 'MINIMAL';
59	  return w === 'SERVICE' ? 'MTLS' : (w as KycTier);
60	}
61
```

```text
1	import { ApiError, endpoint } from '../client';
2	import type { Invoice, RateConfig, ReleaseStage, ReleaseSummary } from '@/core/types/domain';
3	import { audit } from '@/core/mocks/db';

7	/**
8	 * Same-day payment rail (§8.1) wired to the real Go backend:
9	 *   - collection module (mount /collection): per-farmer invoices + rate charts
10	 *       GET  /collection/invoices            → list (dcs_id/farmer_party_id/status/date)
11	 *       GET  /collection/rate-charts/active  → the active pricing chart
12	 *       POST /collection/rate-charts         → create/replace the active chart
13	 *   - settlement module (mount /settlements): READ-only from the client's view
14	 *       GET  /settlements                    → the day's computed batches
15	 *
16	 * Settlement WRITES (approve invoices / settle / assisted release) are
17	 * computed + event-driven on the backend: the settlement models exist
18	 * (InitiateSettlementRequest / RejectSettlementRequest) but no POST route is
19	 * registered, so those endpoints stay mock-only until the backend exposes them.
20	 * Settlement is always an authorised human action - Saathi computes and
21	 * initiates, it never moves funds autonomously (§18-B guardrail).
22	 */
23	
24	/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
25	/* Wire shapes (snake_case, exactly as the backend serialises)         */
26	/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
27	
28	/** domain.Invoice - the same-day settlement artefact (§8.1). */
29	interface WireInvoice {
30	  id: string;
31	  invoice_number?: string;
32	  farmer_party_id: string;
33	  dcs_id: string;
34	  invoice_date?: string; // canonical (domain.Invoice)
35	  date?: string; // legacy fallback
36	  pour_ids?: string[];
37	  total_amount?: number; // canonical — the invoice carries only a single total
38	  total_quantity_litres?: number;
39	  gross_amount?: number; // legacy fallbacks
40	  deductions?: number;
41	  net_amount?: number;
42	  status?: string;
43	  settled_at?: string;
44	  utr?: string;
45	}
46	
47	/** collection.CreateRateChartRequest-shaped active chart (base + two-axis). */
48	interface WireRateChart {
49	  id?: string;
50	  org_unit_id?: string;
51	  name?: string;
52	  base_rate_per_litre: number;
53	  fat_rate_per_point: number;
54	  snf_rate_per_point: number;
55	  effective_from?: string;
56	  active?: boolean;
57	}
58	
59	/** domain.SettlementBatch (GET /settlements list item) - mapped best-effort. */
60	interface WireSettlementBatch {
61	  id?: string;
62	  dcs_id?: string;
63	  date?: string;
64	  status?: string;
65	  pa_ref?: string; // canonical: payment-aggregator batch reference (domain.SettlementBatch)
66	  union_ref?: string; // legacy fallback
67	  total_amount?: number;
68	  farmer_count?: number;
69	  invoice_ids?: string[];
70	  approved_at?: string;
71	  executed_at?: string;
72	  utr_batch?: string;
73	}
74	
75	/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
76	/* Wire → domain mappers                                               */
77	/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
78	
79	/**
80	 * The backend keeps invoice + settlement state on separate rails; the domain
81	 * Invoice collapses them into three states. SETTLED/PAID → SETTLED, APPROVED →
82	 * APPROVED, everything else (ISSUED/DRAFT/…) → DRAFT. Best-effort - the exact
83	 * backend status vocabulary isn't pinned in the shared models.
84	 */
85	// Backend invoice status vocabulary is ISSUED | SETTLEMENT_PENDING | PAID | HOLD
86	// (settlement lives on a separate settlement-batch rail). The FE collapses it to
87	// DRAFT | APPROVED | SETTLED: SETTLEMENT_PENDING == a batch is initiated (APPROVED),
88	// PAID == SETTLED, everything else (ISSUED/HOLD/DRAFT) == DRAFT.
89	function mapInvoiceStatus(s: string | undefined): Invoice['status'] {
90	  switch (s) {
91	    case 'SETTLED':
92	    case 'PAID':
93	      return 'SETTLED';
94	    case 'SETTLEMENT_PENDING':
95	    case 'APPROVED':
96	      return 'APPROVED';
97	    default:
98	      return 'DRAFT';
99	  }
100	}
101	
102	function mapInvoice(w: WireInvoice): Invoice {
103	  // The backend invoice carries a single `total_amount` + `total_quantity_litres`;
104	  // gross/deductions/net are FE-only (deductions live on the settlement batch),
105	  // so gross == net == total and deductions default to 0.
106	  const total = w.total_amount ?? w.gross_amount ?? w.net_amount ?? 0;
107	  return {
108	    id: w.id,
109	    farmerPartyId: w.farmer_party_id,
110	    dcsId: w.dcs_id,
111	    date: w.invoice_date ?? w.date ?? '',
112	    pourIds: w.pour_ids ?? [],
113	    grossAmount: total,
114	    deductions: w.deductions ?? 0,
115	    netAmount: total - (w.deductions ?? 0),
116	    status: mapInvoiceStatus(w.status),
117	    settledAt: w.settled_at,
118	    utr: w.utr,
119	  };
120	}
121	
122	/** Fold the CreateRateChart-shaped chart into the two-axis RateConfig. */
123	function mapRateChart(w: WireRateChart): RateConfig {
124	  return {
125	    effectiveFrom: (w.effective_from ?? '').slice(0, 10) || todayISO(),
126	    baselinePricePerLitre: w.base_rate_per_litre,
127	    fatRatePerKg: w.fat_rate_per_point,
128	    snfRatePerKg: w.snf_rate_per_point,
129	    note: w.name || 'Saathi rate chart',
130	  };
131	}
132	
133	/** Map a settlement batch status onto the assisted-release stage machine. */
134	function mapReleaseStage(status: string | undefined): ReleaseStage {
135	  switch (status) {
136	    case 'APPROVED':
137	      return 'UNION_FUNDED';
138	    case 'EXECUTING':
139	    case 'DISTRIBUTING':
140	      return 'DISTRIBUTING';
141	    case 'EXECUTED':
142	    case 'PAID':
143	    case 'SETTLED':
144	    case 'COMPLETED':
145	      return 'FARMERS_PAID';
146	    default: // INITIATED / PENDING / unknown
147	      return 'PENDING_APPROVAL';
148	  }
149	}
150	
151	/** Derive the assisted-release stage for a DCS + date from its invoices. */
152	function computeRelease(
153	  invoices: Invoice[],
154	  dcsId: string,
155	  date: string,
156	): ReleaseSummary {
157	  const day = invoices.filter((i) => i.dcsId === dcsId && i.date === date);
158	  const approved = day.filter((i) => i.status === 'APPROVED');
159	  const settled = day.filter((i) => i.status === 'SETTLED');
160	  const drafts = day.filter((i) => i.status === 'DRAFT');
161	  const releasable = [...approved, ...settled];
162	  const farmerCount = new Set(releasable.map((i) => i.farmerPartyId)).size;
163	  const totalAmount = Math.round(releasable.reduce((s, i) => s + i.netAmount, 0) * 100) / 100;
164	
165	  let stage: ReleaseStage;
166	  if (drafts.length > 0 || releasable.length === 0) stage = 'PENDING_APPROVAL';
167	  else if (approved.length > 0) stage = 'UNION_FUNDED';
168	  else stage = 'FARMERS_PAID';
169	
170	  const firstSettled = settled.find((i) => i.settledAt);
171	  return {
172	    dcsId,
173	    date,
174	    unionRef: `UNION-${dcsId.replace('org_dcs_', '').toUpperCase()}-${date.slice(2).replaceAll('-', '')}`,
175	    farmerCount,
176	    totalAmount,
177	    stage,
178	    approvedInvoiceIds: approved.map((i) => i.id),
179	    sachivApprovedAt: firstSettled?.settledAt,
180	    distributedAt: firstSettled?.settledAt,
181	    utrBatch: firstSettled?.utr ? `BATCH-${firstSettled.utr}` : undefined,
182	  };
183	}
```

```text
113	function entryMethodToWire(method: PourEntryMethod): string {

528	  const m = Number(date.slice(5, 7));
```

```text
8	/**

13	 *   POST /logistics/trips                                   → plan a route trip
14	 *   GET  /logistics/trips ?union_id&date&van_rider_party_id → list trips
15	 *   GET  /logistics/trips/{tripID}                          → one trip
16	 *   POST /logistics/trips/{tripID}/stops/{consignmentID}/pickup → record pickup
17	 *   POST /logistics/trips/{tripID}/cold-chain              → log transit temp
18	 *   POST /logistics/trips/{tripID}/deliver                 → hand load to a BMC
19	 *
20	 * NOTE: the backend only ships the *request* structs (logistics_models.go);
21	 * its trip/stop/intake *responses* embed `domain.*` structs that are not in
22	 * the shared contract snapshot. The Wire* shapes below are therefore the
23	 * inferred snake_case serialisation (see `issues` in the sync report) and
24	 * fill safe defaults for any field the wire may omit.

82	function mapTripStatus(s?: string): RouteTrip['status'] {

241	export const recordPickup = endpoint<
242	  {
243	    tripId: string;
244	    dcsId: string;
245	    lotId?: string;
246	    geo?: GeoPoint;
247	    photoUri?: string;

250	    notes?: string;
251	  },
252	  RouteTrip
253	>({
254	  method: 'POST',
255	  // Backend keys the pickup by the pooled consignment, not the DCS. The call site

257	  // fall back to dcsId when it is not supplied.
258	  path: ({ tripId, dcsId, lotId }) => `/logistics/trips/${tripId}/stops/${lotId ?? dcsId}/pickup`,
259	  mapRequest: ({ geo, photoUri, sealCode, tempC, notes }) => ({

265	    temp_c: tempC,

268	  mapResponse: (raw) => mapTrip(raw as WireTrip),
269	  mock: ({ tripId, dcsId, geo, photoUri, sealCode }, db) => {
270	    const trip = db.trips.find((t) => t.id === tripId);
271	    if (!trip) throw new ApiError(404, 'TRIP_NOT_FOUND', `Unknown trip ${tripId}`);
272	    const stop = trip.stops.find((s) => s.dcsId === dcsId);
273	    if (!stop) throw new ApiError(404, 'STOP_NOT_FOUND', 'This DCS is not on the route');
274	    if (!stop.lotId) {
275	      throw new ApiError(409, 'LOT_NOT_DISPATCHED', 'The samiti has not dispatched a consignment yet');
276	    }
277	    if (stop.collected) throw new ApiError(409, 'ALREADY_COLLECTED', 'Stop already collected');
278	    if (!photoUri) {
279	      throw new ApiError(422, 'PHOTO_REQUIRED', 'Add a milk photo to verify the collection');
280	    }
281	    const lot = db.lots.find((l) => l.id === stop.lotId);
282	    // Seal verification (§6.4): a sealed consignment must have its seal confirmed
283	    // at pickup, and the confirmed code must match the one frozen at dispatch, so
284	    // milk cannot be swapped between the DCS and the branch.
285	    if (lot?.sealCode) {
286	      if (!sealCode) {
287	        throw new ApiError(422, 'SEAL_REQUIRED', 'Confirm the consignment seal before pickup');
288	      }
289	      if (sealCode !== lot.sealCode) {
290	        throw new ApiError(422, 'SEAL_MISMATCH', 'Seal does not match the dispatched consignment - do not collect');
291	      }
292	    }
293	    stop.arrivedAt = new Date().toISOString();
294	    stop.geo = geo;
295	    stop.photoUri = photoUri;
296	    stop.sealCode = sealCode ?? lot?.sealCode;
297	    stop.collected = true;
298	    if (geo) {
299	      trip.lastKnownGeo = geo;
300	      trip.lastLocationAt = stop.arrivedAt;
301	    }
302	    if (lot) lot.status = 'PICKED_UP';
303	    audit(db, {
304	      actorPartyId: trip.riderPartyId,
305	      actorRole: 'VAN_RIDER',
306	      action: 'PICKUP_RECORDED',
307	      subject: lot?.consignmentCode ?? stop.lotId,
308	      detail: `Collected with geotag + photo + seal ${stop.sealCode ?? 'n/a'}`,
309	    });
310	    if (lot) {
311	      appendChainEvent(db, {
312	        kind: 'PICKUP',
313	        subjectType: 'LOT',
314	        subjectId: lot.id,
315	        actorPartyId: trip.riderPartyId,
316	        detail: `Seal ${stop.sealCode ?? 'n/a'} confirmed; geotag + photo`,
317	      });

319	    return trip;
320	  },
321	});

388	      subject: intake.siloLotCode,

391	    appendChainEvent(db, {

396	      detail: `${intake.siloLotCode}: ${collectedLots.length} consignments received at the branch`,
```

```text
69	    case 'CREDITED':
```

```text
1	import { getAuthToken } from './client';
2	
3	/**
4	 * Server-Sent Events client for the backend's `GET /api/v1/events/stream`
5	 * (added in parag-saathi-be PR #2). React Native has no native EventSource, so
6	 * we stream via XMLHttpRequest - RN delivers `responseText` incrementally on
7	 * readyState 3, and we parse SSE frames (`event:` / `data:` lines, `\n\n`
8	 * separated) out of the growing buffer. Heartbeat comment lines (`:`) are
9	 * ignored. Auto-reconnects with capped backoff; only runs in `http` mode.
10	 */
11	
12	export interface SseEvent {
13	  event: string;
14	  data: unknown;
15	}
16	
17	export interface SseHandlers {
18	  onEvent?: (e: SseEvent) => void;
19	  onOpen?: () => void;
20	  onError?: (err: unknown) => void;
21	}
22	
23	const MODE = (process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_API_MODE as string) || 'http';
24	const BASE: string = process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL || 'http://localhost:8080/api/v1';
25	
26	function parseFrames(buffer: string): { events: SseEvent[]; rest: string } {
27	  const events: SseEvent[] = [];
28	  const parts = buffer.split('\n\n');
29	  const rest = parts.pop() ?? ''; // last piece may be an incomplete frame
30	  for (const frame of parts) {
31	    let name = 'message';
32	    const dataLines: string[] = [];
33	    for (const line of frame.split('\n')) {
34	      if (line.startsWith(':')) continue; // comment / heartbeat
35	      if (line.startsWith('event:')) name = line.slice(6).trim();
36	      else if (line.startsWith('data:')) dataLines.push(line.slice(5).trim());
37	    }
38	    if (dataLines.length === 0) continue;
39	    const raw = dataLines.join('\n');
40	    let data: unknown = raw;
41	    try {
42	      data = JSON.parse(raw);
43	    } catch {
44	      /* keep raw string */
45	    }
46	    events.push({ event: name, data });
47	  }
48	  return { events, rest };
49	}
50	
51	/**
52	 * Open a live event stream. Returns a disposer that permanently closes it
53	 * (no reconnect after disposal). No-op in mock mode.
54	 */
55	export function connectEventStream(handlers: SseHandlers): () => void {
56	  if (MODE !== 'http') return () => {};
57	
58	  let xhr: XMLHttpRequest | null = null;
59	  let disposed = false;
60	  let retry = 0;
61	  let reconnectTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
62	
63	  const open = () => {
64	    if (disposed) return;
65	    const token = getAuthToken();
66	    if (!token) {
67	      // Not authenticated yet - try again shortly.
68	      reconnectTimer = setTimeout(open, 2000);
69	      return;
70	    }
71	
72	    let buffer = '';
73	    let seen = 0;
74	    xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
75	    xhr.open('GET', `${BASE}/events/stream`);
76	    xhr.setRequestHeader('Authorization', `Bearer ${token}`);
77	    xhr.setRequestHeader('Accept', 'text/event-stream');
78	    xhr.setRequestHeader('Cache-Control', 'no-cache');
79	
80	    xhr.onreadystatechange = () => {
81	      if (!xhr) return;
82	      if (xhr.readyState === 2) {
83	        retry = 0;
84	        handlers.onOpen?.();
85	      }
86	      if (xhr.readyState === 3 || xhr.readyState === 4) {
87	        const text = xhr.responseText ?? '';
88	        buffer += text.substring(seen);
89	        seen = text.length;
90	        const { events, rest } = parseFrames(buffer);
91	        buffer = rest;
92	        for (const e of events) handlers.onEvent?.(e);
93	      }
94	    };
95	
96	    xhr.onerror = () => {
97	      handlers.onError?.(new Error('SSE connection error'));
98	      scheduleReconnect();
99	    };
100	    xhr.onloadend = () => {
101	      if (!disposed) scheduleReconnect();
102	    };
103	
104	    try {
105	      xhr.send();
106	    } catch (err) {
107	      handlers.onError?.(err);
108	      scheduleReconnect();
109	    }
110	  };
111	
112	  const scheduleReconnect = () => {
113	    if (disposed || reconnectTimer) return;
114	    const delay = Math.min(1000 * 2 ** retry, 30_000); // capped exponential backoff
115	    retry += 1;
116	    reconnectTimer = setTimeout(() => {
117	      reconnectTimer = null;
118	      open();
119	    }, delay);
120	  };
121	
122	  open();
123	
124	  return () => {
125	    disposed = true;
126	    if (reconnectTimer) clearTimeout(reconnectTimer);
127	    if (xhr) {
128	      xhr.onreadystatechange = null;
129	      xhr.onerror = null;
130	      xhr.onloadend = null;
131	      try {
132	        xhr.abort();
133	      } catch {
134	        /* ignore */
135	      }
136	    }
137	  };
138	}
```

```text
1	import { useEffect } from 'react';
2	import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
3	import { connectEventStream, type SseEvent } from '@/core/api/sse';
4	import { useAuthStore } from '@/core/auth/store';
5	
6	/**
7	 * Live sync: while signed in, hold open the backend SSE stream and refresh the
8	 * affected React Query caches when a server event arrives - so dashboards
9	 * (KYC review queue, settlements, quality gates) update without a manual pull.
10	 * No-op in mock mode (the SSE client short-circuits there).
11	 *
12	 * Event → query-key mapping is intentionally coarse: a nudge invalidates the
13	 * relevant family and React Query refetches only what's actually mounted.
14	 */
15	const EVENT_INVALIDATIONS: Record<string, string[][]> = {
16	  'kyc.queue_changed': [['kyc-pending-count'], ['admin', 'parties']],
17	  'kyc.pending.changed': [['kyc-pending-count'], ['admin', 'parties']],
18	  'settlement.changed': [['invoices'], ['admin-stats']],
19	  'quality.changed': [['qc-queue'], ['batches'], ['tests']],
20	  'pour.recorded': [['pours'], ['society-stats'], ['farmer-summary']],
21	};
22	
23	export function useLiveSync(): void {
24	  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
25	  const sessionPresent = useAuthStore((s) => Boolean(s.session));
26	
27	  useEffect(() => {
28	    if (!sessionPresent) return;
29	
30	    const dispose = connectEventStream({
31	      onEvent: (e: SseEvent) => {
32	        const targets = EVENT_INVALIDATIONS[e.event];
33	        if (!targets) return;
34	        for (const key of targets) {
35	          void queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: key });
36	        }
37	      },
38	    });
39	    return dispose;
40	  }, [sessionPresent, queryClient]);
41	}
42
```

```text
1	// Package eventbus is the in-process pub/sub seam between modules
2	// (e.g. settlement executed → notifications module queues the SMS).
3	// It deliberately mirrors a message-broker API: when the platform splits
4	// into microservices, this interface is re-implemented over Kafka/NATS
5	// (blueprint §15) without touching module code.
6	package eventbus
7	
8	import (
9		"context"
10		"log/slog"
11		"sync"
12		"time"
13	)
14	
15	// Topics published across module seams.
16	const (
17		TopicPourRecorded       = "pour.recorded"
18		TopicInvoiceIssued      = "invoice.issued"
19		TopicGateBlocked        = "qc.gate_blocked"
20		TopicSettlementExecuted = "settlement.executed"
21		TopicPayoutCredited     = "payout.credited"
22		TopicMVUDispatched      = "mvu.dispatched"
23		// KYC review queue changed — a record entered PENDING (submitted) or left
24		// it (approved/rejected). Drives the live "pending KYC" dashboard badge via
25		// the SSE hub. Payload: KYCQueueEvent.
26		TopicKYCQueueChanged = "kyc.queue_changed"
27	)
28	
29	// KYCQueueEvent is the payload for TopicKYCQueueChanged. It is a nudge, not a
30	// count — subscribers re-query the authoritative, org-scoped pending count.
31	type KYCQueueEvent struct {
32		Reason    string `json:"reason"` // "submitted" | "approved" | "rejected"
33		KYCID     string `json:"kyc_id"`
34		SubjectID string `json:"subject_id"` // party whose KYC it is (hex)
35	}
36	
37	// Handler consumes a published event. Payload types are documented per topic
38	// by the publishing module.
39	type Handler func(ctx context.Context, topic string, payload any)
40	
41	// Bus is a minimal async pub/sub.
42	type Bus struct {
43		log *slog.Logger
44	
45		mu   sync.RWMutex
46		subs map[string][]Handler
47	}
48	
49	// New builds an empty bus.
50	func New(log *slog.Logger) *Bus {
51		return &Bus{log: log, subs: make(map[string][]Handler)}
52	}
53	
54	// Subscribe registers a handler for a topic. Call during module wiring only
55	// (not concurrently with Publish traffic).
56	func (b *Bus) Subscribe(topic string, h Handler) {
57		b.mu.Lock()
58		defer b.mu.Unlock()
59		b.subs[topic] = append(b.subs[topic], h)
60	}
61	
62	// Publish dispatches asynchronously: each handler runs on its own goroutine
63	// with a bounded context and panic isolation, so a slow or broken subscriber
64	// can never stall the request path.
65	func (b *Bus) Publish(topic string, payload any) {
66		b.mu.RLock()
67		handlers := b.subs[topic]
68		b.mu.RUnlock()
69	
70		for _, h := range handlers {
71			h := h
72			go func() {
73				ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 15*time.Second)
74				defer cancel()
75				defer func() {
76					if rec := recover(); rec != nil {
77						b.log.Error("eventbus handler panic",
78							slog.String("topic", topic), slog.Any("panic", rec))
79					}
80				}()
81				h(ctx, topic, payload)
```

```text
107	      void queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: qk.batch(cert.batchId) });
108	    },
```

```text
1	package dashboards

3	import (
4		"context"
5		"log/slog"

7	
8		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"

10		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
11		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
12		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
13		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/httpx"
14	)
15	
16	const trendDays = 12 // the farmer home-screen shows a 12-day trend
17	
18	type service struct {
19		deps *deps.Deps
20		repo *repo
21		log  *slog.Logger
22	}
23	
24	func newService(d *deps.Deps, r *repo, log *slog.Logger) *service {
25		return &service{deps: d, repo: r, log: log}
26	}
27	
28	// farmerSummary builds the farmer home aggregate. A farmer may only read their
29	// own summary; scoped roles (sachiv/adhyaksh/admin) may read any farmer in
30	// their org scope — but the farmer's DCS isn't on the summary, so we gate by
31	// "self, or a role that can see the DCS" at the handler via RequireRoles and,
32	// for FARMER, force self.
33	func (s *service) farmerSummary(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, farmerID primitive.ObjectID) (*FarmerSummary, error) {
34		// A FARMER may only ever see their own summary.
35		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleFarmer {
36			self, err := httpx.ParseID(actor.PartyID, "actor")
37			if err != nil {
38				return nil, err
39			}
40			if self != farmerID {
41				return nil, httpx.Forbidden("a farmer may only view their own summary")
42			}
43		}
44	
45		now := time.Now().UTC()
46		today := domain.DateKeyIST(now)
47		monthStart := monthStartIST(now)
48	
49		days, err := s.repo.farmerPourDays(ctx, farmerID, minDate(monthStart, trendSince(now)))
50		if err != nil {
51			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
52		}
53		pendCount, pendAmt, err := s.repo.pendingInvoices(ctx, farmerID)
54		if err != nil {
55			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
56		}
57	
58		sum := &FarmerSummary{
59			FarmerPartyID:   farmerID.Hex(),
60			Today:           dayTotalsFor(days, today),
61			Month:           periodTotalsSince(days, monthStart),
62			PendingAmount:   round2(pendAmt),
63			PendingInvoices: pendCount,
64			Trend:           trend(days, now),
65		}
66		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "farmer summary served",
67			slog.String("farmer_party_id", farmerID.Hex()),
68			slog.Float64("today_qty", sum.Today.QuantityLitres),
69			slog.Float64("pending_amount", sum.PendingAmount))
70		return sum, nil
71	}
72	
73	// societyStats builds the DCS console aggregate. Caller must be in the DCS's
74	// org scope (enforced here).
75	func (s *service) societyStats(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, dcsID primitive.ObjectID) (*SocietyStats, error) {
76		if err := s.deps.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, dcsID); err != nil {
77			return nil, err
78		}
79		now := time.Now().UTC()
80		today := domain.DateKeyIST(now)
81		monthStart := monthStartIST(now)
82	
83		days, err := s.repo.dcsPourDays(ctx, dcsID, monthStart)
84		if err != nil {
85			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
86		}
87		activeFarmers, err := s.repo.activeFarmersToday(ctx, dcsID, today)
88		if err != nil {
89			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
90		}
91		members, err := s.repo.memberCount(ctx, dcsID)
92		if err != nil {
93			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
94		}
95	
96		stats := &SocietyStats{
97			DCSID:         dcsID.Hex(),
98			Date:          today,
99			Today:         dayTotalsFor(days, today),
100			Month:         periodTotalsSince(days, monthStart),
101			ActiveFarmers: activeFarmers,
102			MemberCount:   members,
103		}
104		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "society stats served",
105			slog.String("dcs_id", dcsID.Hex()), slog.Int("active_farmers", activeFarmers))
106		return stats, nil
107	}
108	
109	// --- pure helpers over the day rollups ---
110	
111	func dayTotalsFor(days []pourRollup, date string) DayTotals {
112		for _, d := range days {
113			if d.Date == date {
114				return DayTotals{Date: date, QuantityLitres: round2(d.Qty), Amount: round2(d.Amt), Pours: d.Count}
115			}
116		}
117		return DayTotals{Date: date}
118	}
119	
120	func periodTotalsSince(days []pourRollup, since string) PeriodTotals {
121		var t PeriodTotals
122		for _, d := range days {
123			if d.Date >= since {
124				t.QuantityLitres += d.Qty
125				t.Amount += d.Amt
126				t.Pours += d.Count
127			}
128		}
129		t.QuantityLitres = round2(t.QuantityLitres)
130		t.Amount = round2(t.Amount)
131		return t
132	}
133	
134	// trend returns the last trendDays days (most recent first), zero-filling gaps.
135	func trend(days []pourRollup, now time.Time) []DayTotals {
136		ist := time.FixedZone("IST", 5*3600+1800)
137		byDate := make(map[string]pourRollup, len(days))
138		for _, d := range days {
139			byDate[d.Date] = d
140		}
141		out := make([]DayTotals, 0, trendDays)
142		for i := 0; i < trendDays; i++ {
143			key := now.In(ist).AddDate(0, 0, -i).Format("2006-01-02")
144			if d, ok := byDate[key]; ok {
145				out = append(out, DayTotals{Date: key, QuantityLitres: round2(d.Qty), Amount: round2(d.Amt), Pours: d.Count})
146			} else {
147				out = append(out, DayTotals{Date: key})
148			}
149		}
150		return out
151	}
152	
153	func trendSince(now time.Time) string {
154		ist := time.FixedZone("IST", 5*3600+1800)
155		return now.In(ist).AddDate(0, 0, -(trendDays - 1)).Format("2006-01-02")
156	}
157	
158	func minDate(a, b string) string {
159		if a < b {
160			return a
161		}
162		return b
163	}
164	
165	func round2(v float64) float64 {
166		return float64(int64(v*100+0.5)) / 100
167	}
168
```

```text
1	package dashboards
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"fmt"
6		"time"
7	
8		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
9		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
10		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/mongo"
11	
12		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/domain"
13		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/mongodb"
14	)
15	
16	// repo reads (never writes) the pour, invoice and role-assignment collections
17	// owned by other modules — dashboards is a pure read-side aggregate.
18	type repo struct {
19		pours       *mongo.Collection
20		invoices    *mongo.Collection
21		assignments *mongo.Collection
22	}
23	
24	func newRepo(db *mongo.Database) *repo {
25		return &repo{
26			pours:       db.Collection(mongodb.CollMilkPours),
27			invoices:    db.Collection(mongodb.CollInvoices),
28			assignments: db.Collection(mongodb.CollRoleAssignments),
29		}
30	}
31	
32	// pourRollup is the aggregation shape for grouped pour totals.
33	type pourRollup struct {
34		Date  string  `bson:"_id"`
35		Qty   float64 `bson:"qty"`
36		Amt   float64 `bson:"amt"`
37		Count int     `bson:"count"`
38	}
39	
40	// rollupByDay groups RECORDED pours matching `match` by pour_date.
41	func (r *repo) rollupByDay(ctx context.Context, match bson.D) ([]pourRollup, error) {
42		match = append(match, bson.E{Key: "status", Value: domain.PourStatusRecorded})
43		pipeline := mongo.Pipeline{
44			{{Key: "$match", Value: match}},
45			{{Key: "$group", Value: bson.D{
46				{Key: "_id", Value: "$pour_date"},
47				{Key: "qty", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$sum", Value: "$quantity_litres"}}},
48				{Key: "amt", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$sum", Value: "$amount"}}},
49				{Key: "count", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$sum", Value: 1}}},
50			}}},
51			{{Key: "$sort", Value: bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: -1}}}},
52		}
53		cur, err := r.pours.Aggregate(ctx, pipeline)
54		if err != nil {
55			return nil, fmt.Errorf("rollup by day: %w", err)
56		}
57		var out []pourRollup
58		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
59			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode rollup: %w", err)
60		}
61		return out, nil
62	}
63	
64	// farmerPourDays rolls up a farmer's pours since `sinceDate` (inclusive).
65	func (r *repo) farmerPourDays(ctx context.Context, farmerID primitive.ObjectID, sinceDate string) ([]pourRollup, error) {
66		return r.rollupByDay(ctx, bson.D{
67			{Key: "farmer_party_id", Value: farmerID},
68			{Key: "pour_date", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$gte", Value: sinceDate}}},
69		})
70	}
71	
72	// dcsPourDays rolls up a DCS's pours since `sinceDate` (inclusive).
73	func (r *repo) dcsPourDays(ctx context.Context, dcsID primitive.ObjectID, sinceDate string) ([]pourRollup, error) {
74		return r.rollupByDay(ctx, bson.D{
75			{Key: "dcs_id", Value: dcsID},
76			{Key: "pour_date", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$gte", Value: sinceDate}}},
77		})
78	}
79	
80	// pendingInvoices returns (count, totalAmount) of a farmer's unpaid invoices
81	// (anything not yet PAID).
82	func (r *repo) pendingInvoices(ctx context.Context, farmerID primitive.ObjectID) (int, float64, error) {
83		pipeline := mongo.Pipeline{
84			{{Key: "$match", Value: bson.D{
85				{Key: "farmer_party_id", Value: farmerID},
86				{Key: "status", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$ne", Value: domain.InvoiceStatusPaid}}},
87			}}},
88			{{Key: "$group", Value: bson.D{
89				{Key: "_id", Value: nil},
90				{Key: "amt", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$sum", Value: "$total_amount"}}},
91				{Key: "count", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$sum", Value: 1}}},
92			}}},
93		}
94		cur, err := r.invoices.Aggregate(ctx, pipeline)
95		if err != nil {
96			return 0, 0, fmt.Errorf("pending invoices: %w", err)
97		}
98		var rows []struct {
99			Amt   float64 `bson:"amt"`
100			Count int     `bson:"count"`
101		}
102		if err := cur.All(ctx, &rows); err != nil {
103			return 0, 0, fmt.Errorf("decode pending invoices: %w", err)
104		}
105		if len(rows) == 0 {
106			return 0, 0, nil
107		}
108		return rows[0].Count, rows[0].Amt, nil
109	}
110	
111	// activeFarmersToday counts distinct farmers who poured at a DCS on `date`.
112	func (r *repo) activeFarmersToday(ctx context.Context, dcsID primitive.ObjectID, date string) (int, error) {
113		vals, err := r.pours.Distinct(ctx, "farmer_party_id", bson.D{
114			{Key: "dcs_id", Value: dcsID},
115			{Key: "pour_date", Value: date},
116			{Key: "status", Value: domain.PourStatusRecorded},
117		})
118		if err != nil {
119			return 0, fmt.Errorf("active farmers: %w", err)
120		}
121		return len(vals), nil
122	}
123	
124	// memberCount counts ACTIVE FARMER assignments at a DCS.
125	func (r *repo) memberCount(ctx context.Context, dcsID primitive.ObjectID) (int, error) {
126		n, err := r.assignments.CountDocuments(ctx, bson.D{
127			{Key: "org_unit_id", Value: dcsID},
128			{Key: "role_code", Value: domain.RoleFarmer},
129			{Key: "status", Value: domain.RoleAssignmentActive},
130		})
131		if err != nil {
132			return 0, fmt.Errorf("member count: %w", err)
133		}
134		return int(n), nil
135	}
136	
137	// monthStartIST returns the YYYY-MM-01 key for the IST month containing now.
138	func monthStartIST(now time.Time) string {
139		ist := time.FixedZone("IST", 5*3600+1800)
140		t := now.In(ist)
141		return fmt.Sprintf("%04d-%02d-01", t.Year(), int(t.Month()))
142	}
```

```text
106	            </Text>

110	
111	      <SheetModal

126	      >
```

```text
92	// safeHandler wraps a bus reaction so a programming error in notification
93	// fan-out can never disturb the publishing flow.
94	func safeHandler(log *slog.Logger, reaction func(ctx context.Context, payload any)) eventbus.Handler {
95		return func(ctx context.Context, topic string, payload any) {
96			defer func() {
97				if rec := recover(); rec != nil {
98					log.Error("platformops bus handler panic",
99						slog.String("topic", topic), slog.Any("panic", rec))
100				}
101			}()
102			reaction(ctx, payload)
103		}
```

```text
95	type HttpMethod = 'GET' | 'POST' | 'PUT' | 'PATCH' | 'DELETE';

97	export interface EndpointSpec<TIn, TOut> {
98	  method: HttpMethod;
99	  /** REST path for http mode; also documents the backend contract */
100	  path: (input: TIn) => string;
101	  /** camelCase input → snake_case wire body (http mode only) */
102	  mapRequest?: (input: TIn) => unknown;
103	  /** snake_case wire data → domain shape (http mode only) */
104	  mapResponse?: (raw: unknown) => TOut;
105	  /** In-app implementation for mock mode */
106	  mock: (input: TIn, db: MockDb) => TOut | Promise<TOut>;
107	  /**
108	   * Force the mock path even in http mode. Used for endpoints whose FE flow is
109	   * not yet reconciled with the backend (e.g. the settlement write flow keys on
110	   * a DCS+date while the backend keys on a settlement-batch id, or a route the
111	   * backend does not expose). Keeps the role's screens functional against the
112	   * in-app fixtures instead of firing a request that 4xx's. Tracked in
113	   * docs/backend_fixing.md so these can flip to http once reconciled.
114	   */

120	}
121	
122	/** JSON-safe deep clone (results are plain data; keeps Hermes compatibility). */
123	function deepClone<T>(value: T): T {
124	  return value === undefined ? value : (JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value)) as T);
125	}
126	
127	/** Raw http call: bearer header, envelope unwrap, AppError mapping. */
128	async function httpCall(method: HttpMethod, path: string, body: unknown): Promise<unknown> {
129	  const hasBody = method !== 'GET' && method !== 'DELETE' && body !== undefined;
130	  const res = await fetch(BASE + path, {
131	    method,
132	    headers: {
133	      Accept: 'application/json',
134	      ...(hasBody ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } : {}),
135	      ...(accessToken ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}` } : {}),
136	    },
137	    body: hasBody ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined,
138	  });
139	  const text = await res.text().catch(() => '');
140	  let json: unknown;
141	  try {
142	    json = text ? JSON.parse(text) : undefined;
143	  } catch {
144	    json = undefined;
145	  }
146	  if (!res.ok) {
147	    const err = (json as { error?: { code?: string; message?: string; details?: unknown } })
148	      ?.error;
149	    throw new ApiError(
150	      res.status,
151	      err?.code ?? `HTTP_${res.status}`,
152	      err?.message ?? res.statusText,
153	      err?.details,
154	    );
155	  }
156	  // Success envelope: { data, meta? } - unwrap data; tolerate bare payloads.
157	  if (json && typeof json === 'object' && 'data' in (json as Record<string, unknown>)) {
158	    return (json as { data: unknown }).data;
159	  }
160	  return json;
161	}
162	
163	/** Single-flight refresh: rotate the token pair via POST /auth/refresh. */
164	let refreshInFlight: Promise<boolean> | null = null;
165	async function tryRefresh(): Promise<boolean> {
166	  if (!refreshToken) return false;
167	  refreshInFlight ??= (async () => {
168	    try {
169	      const data = (await httpCall('POST', '/auth/refresh', {
170	        refresh_token: refreshToken,
171	      })) as { access_token: string; refresh_token: string };
172	      setTokens({ access: data.access_token, refresh: data.refresh_token });
173	      return true;
174	    } catch {
175	      return false;
176	    } finally {
177	      refreshInFlight = null;
178	    }
179	  })();
180	  return refreshInFlight;
181	}
182	
183	/** Declare a typed API endpoint. Returns the callable used by feature code. */
184	export function endpoint<TIn = void, TOut = unknown>(
185	  spec: EndpointSpec<TIn, TOut>,
186	): (input: TIn) => Promise<TOut> {
187	  return async (input: TIn): Promise<TOut> => {
188	    if (MODE === 'mock' || spec.mockOnly) {
189	      const { db } = await import('@/core/mocks/db');
190	      // Simulated network latency so loading states are honest
191	      await sleep(120 + Math.random() * 230);
192	      const result = await spec.mock(input, db);
193	      // Deep-clone so callers can never mutate the mock store through results
194	      return deepClone(result);
195	    }
196	
197	    const path = spec.path(input);
198	    const body = spec.mapRequest ? spec.mapRequest(input) : (input as unknown);
199	    try {
200	      const raw = await httpCall(spec.method, path, body);
201	      return spec.mapResponse ? spec.mapResponse(raw) : (raw as TOut);
202	    } catch (e) {
203	      // One refresh + retry on expired access tokens (never for /auth/* itself)
204	      if (e instanceof ApiError && e.status === 401 && !path.startsWith('/auth/')) {
205	        if (await tryRefresh()) {
206	          const raw = await httpCall(spec.method, path, body);
207	          return spec.mapResponse ? spec.mapResponse(raw) : (raw as TOut);
208	        }
209	        clearTokens();
210	        onUnauthorized?.();
211	      }
212	      throw e;
213	    }
214	  };
215	}
```

```text
1	package logistics

3	import (
4		"context"

16	)
17	
18	// repo owns every MongoDB access for the logistics module. It returns raw
19	// driver errors wrapped with operation context (mongo.ErrNoDocuments stays
20	// detectable via errors.Is); the service layer maps them to httpx errors.
21	// No business logic lives here.
22	type repo struct {
23		consignments *mongo.Collection
24		trips        *mongo.Collection
25		pours        *mongo.Collection // read-only view into the collection module's pours (sanctioned by spec)
26	}
27	
28	// newRepo binds the repo to its collections via the shared name constants.
29	func newRepo(db *mongo.Database) *repo {
30		return &repo{
31			consignments: db.Collection(mongodb.CollConsignments),
32			trips:        db.Collection(mongodb.CollRouteTrips),
33			pours:        db.Collection(mongodb.CollMilkPours),
34		}
35	}
36	
37	// pourRow is the projected slice of a milk pour needed for aggregation.
38	type pourRow struct {
39		ID             primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id"`
40		QuantityLitres float64            `bson:"quantity_litres"`
41		FatPct         float64            `bson:"fat_pct"`
42		SNFPct         float64            `bson:"snf_pct"`
43		Assurance      string             `bson:"assurance"`
44	}
45	
46	// findRecordedPours returns the RECORDED pours of one DCS date+shift,
47	// projected down to the fields the consignment aggregate needs.
48	func (r *repo) findRecordedPours(ctx context.Context, dcsID primitive.ObjectID, date, shift string) ([]pourRow, error) {
49		filter := bson.D{
50			{Key: "dcs_id", Value: dcsID},
51			{Key: "pour_date", Value: date},
52			{Key: "shift", Value: shift},
53			{Key: "status", Value: domain.PourStatusRecorded},
54		}
55		projection := bson.D{
56			{Key: "_id", Value: 1},
57			{Key: "quantity_litres", Value: 1},
58			{Key: "fat_pct", Value: 1},
59			{Key: "snf_pct", Value: 1},
60			{Key: "assurance", Value: 1},
61		}
62		cur, err := r.pours.Find(ctx, filter,
63			options.Find().SetProjection(projection).SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "created_at", Value: 1}}))
64		if err != nil {
65			return nil, fmt.Errorf("find recorded pours: %w", err)
66		}
67		var rows []pourRow
68		if err := cur.All(ctx, &rows); err != nil {
69			return nil, fmt.Errorf("decode recorded pours: %w", err)
70		}
71		return rows, nil
72	}
73	
74	// insertConsignment stores a new consignment (the service pre-generates its
75	// ObjectID). The unique index on dcs_id+date+shift turns duplicates into a
76	// duplicate-key error — kept unwrapped-detectable via %w.
77	func (r *repo) insertConsignment(ctx context.Context, c *domain.DCSConsignment) error {
78		if _, err := r.consignments.InsertOne(ctx, c); err != nil {
79			return fmt.Errorf("insert consignment: %w", err)
80		}
81		return nil
82	}
83	
84	// findConsignmentByID loads one consignment.
85	func (r *repo) findConsignmentByID(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.DCSConsignment, error) {
86		var c domain.DCSConsignment
87		if err := r.consignments.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&c); err != nil {
88			return nil, fmt.Errorf("find consignment %s: %w", id.Hex(), err)
89		}
90		return &c, nil
91	}
92	
93	// markConsignmentDispatched transitions OPEN→DISPATCHED optimistically:
94	// the status filter makes the guard atomic without transactions. The seal
95	// also re-stamps the pour aggregates (extraSet) so pours recorded between
96	// creation and dispatch are never lost from the consignment's totals.
97	func (r *repo) markConsignmentDispatched(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID, at time.Time, extraSet bson.D) (bool, error) {
98		set := bson.D{
99			{Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusDispatch},
100			{Key: "dispatched_at", Value: at},
101		}
102		set = append(set, extraSet...)
103		res, err := r.consignments.UpdateOne(ctx,
104			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}, {Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusOpen}},
105			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: set}})
106		if err != nil {
107			return false, fmt.Errorf("mark consignment dispatched: %w", err)
108		}
109		return res.MatchedCount > 0, nil
110	}
111	
112	// markConsignmentPickedUp transitions DISPATCHED→PICKED_UP and pins the
113	// carrying trip, guarded atomically by the status filter.
114	func (r *repo) markConsignmentPickedUp(ctx context.Context, id, tripID primitive.ObjectID) (bool, error) {
115		res, err := r.consignments.UpdateOne(ctx,
116			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}, {Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusDispatch}},
117			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
118				{Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusPickedUp},
119				{Key: "route_trip_id", Value: tripID},
120			}}})
121		if err != nil {
122			return false, fmt.Errorf("mark consignment picked up: %w", err)
123		}
124		return res.MatchedCount > 0, nil
125	}
126	
127	// markConsignmentsDelivered transitions every listed PICKED_UP consignment
128	// to DELIVERED (bulk companion of the trip delivery).
129	func (r *repo) markConsignmentsDelivered(ctx context.Context, ids []primitive.ObjectID) error {
130		_, err := r.consignments.UpdateMany(ctx,
131			bson.D{
132				{Key: "_id", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: ids}}},
133				{Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusPickedUp},
134			},
135			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusDelivered}}}})
136		if err != nil {
137			return fmt.Errorf("mark consignments delivered: %w", err)
138		}
139		return nil
140	}
141	
142	// setConsignmentProvenanceSeq pins the latest ledger sequence on the doc.
143	func (r *repo) setConsignmentProvenanceSeq(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID, seq int64) error {
144		_, err := r.consignments.UpdateByID(ctx, id,
145			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "provenance_seq", Value: seq}}}})
146		if err != nil {
147			return fmt.Errorf("set consignment provenance seq: %w", err)
148		}
149		return nil
150	}

152	// listConsignments returns a filtered, newest-first page plus the total count.
153	// A zero dcsID means "no DCS filter".
154	func (r *repo) listConsignments(ctx context.Context, dcsID primitive.ObjectID, date, status string, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.DCSConsignment, int64, error) {
155		filter := bson.D{}
156		if !dcsID.IsZero() {
157			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "dcs_id", Value: dcsID})
158		}
159		if date != "" {
160			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "date", Value: date})
161		}
162		if status != "" {
163			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "status", Value: status})
164		}
165		total, err := r.consignments.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
166		if err != nil {
167			return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("count consignments: %w", err)
168		}
169		cur, err := r.consignments.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
170			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "created_at", Value: -1}}).
171			SetSkip(page.Offset).SetLimit(page.Limit))
172		if err != nil {
173			return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("list consignments: %w", err)
174		}
175		items := []domain.DCSConsignment{}
176		if err := cur.All(ctx, &items); err != nil {
177			return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("decode consignments: %w", err)
178		}
179		return items, total, nil
180	}

185			return fmt.Errorf("insert trip: %w", err)

193		if err := r.trips.FindOne(ctx, bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}}).Decode(&t); err != nil {
194			return nil, fmt.Errorf("find trip %s: %w", id.Hex(), err)
195		}
196		return &t, nil
197	}

199	// markStopPickedUp stamps the matched stop with pickup time/temperature and
200	// moves the trip to IN_PROGRESS (idempotent once it is already there).
201	func (r *repo) markStopPickedUp(ctx context.Context, tripID, consignmentID primitive.ObjectID, at time.Time, tempC float64, notes string) error {
202		_, err := r.trips.UpdateOne(ctx,
203			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: tripID}, {Key: "stops.consignment_id", Value: consignmentID}},
204			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
205				{Key: "stops.$.picked_up_at", Value: at},
206				{Key: "stops.$.temp_c", Value: tempC},
207				{Key: "stops.$.notes", Value: notes},
208				{Key: "status", Value: domain.TripStatusInProgress},
209			}}})
210		if err != nil {
211			return fmt.Errorf("mark stop picked up: %w", err)
212		}
213		return nil
214	}

216	// pushColdChain appends one temperature sample to the trip's cold-chain log.
217	func (r *repo) pushColdChain(ctx context.Context, tripID primitive.ObjectID, entry domain.ColdChainEntry) error {
218		_, err := r.trips.UpdateByID(ctx, tripID,
219			bson.D{{Key: "$push", Value: bson.D{{Key: "cold_chain", Value: entry}}}})

226	// markTripDelivered transitions IN_PROGRESS→DELIVERED optimistically and
227	// records the receiving BMC.
228	func (r *repo) markTripDelivered(ctx context.Context, tripID, bmcID primitive.ObjectID, at time.Time) (bool, error) {
229		res, err := r.trips.UpdateOne(ctx,
230			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: tripID}, {Key: "status", Value: domain.TripStatusInProgress}},
231			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
232				{Key: "status", Value: domain.TripStatusDelivered},
233				{Key: "delivered_to_bmc_id", Value: bmcID},
234				{Key: "delivered_at", Value: at},
235			}}})
236		if err != nil {
237			return false, fmt.Errorf("mark trip delivered: %w", err)
238		}
239		return res.MatchedCount > 0, nil
240	}
241	
242	// setTripProvenanceSeq pins the latest ledger sequence on the trip doc.
243	func (r *repo) setTripProvenanceSeq(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID, seq int64) error {
244		_, err := r.trips.UpdateByID(ctx, id,
245			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "provenance_seq", Value: seq}}}})
246		if err != nil {
247			return fmt.Errorf("set trip provenance seq: %w", err)
248		}
249		return nil
250	}
251	
252	// listTrips returns a filtered, newest-first page plus the total count.
253	// Zero ObjectIDs mean "no filter" on that field.
254	func (r *repo) listTrips(ctx context.Context, unionID primitive.ObjectID, date string, vanRiderPartyID primitive.ObjectID, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.RouteTrip, int64, error) {
255		filter := bson.D{}
256		if !unionID.IsZero() {
257			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "union_id", Value: unionID})
258		}
259		if date != "" {
260			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "date", Value: date})
261		}
262		if !vanRiderPartyID.IsZero() {
263			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "van_rider_party_id", Value: vanRiderPartyID})
264		}
265		total, err := r.trips.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
266		if err != nil {
267			return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("count trips: %w", err)
268		}
269		cur, err := r.trips.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
270			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "created_at", Value: -1}}).
271			SetSkip(page.Offset).SetLimit(page.Limit))
272		if err != nil {
273			return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("list trips: %w", err)
274		}
275		items := []domain.RouteTrip{}
276		if err := cur.All(ctx, &items); err != nil {
277			return nil, 0, fmt.Errorf("decode trips: %w", err)
278		}
279		return items, total, nil
280	}
281
```

```text
1	package domain

3	import (
4		"time"
5	
6		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson/primitive"
7	)
8	
9	// Product is one entry in the platform product master (blueprint §12 admin
10	// control tower). It is the catalogue backbone the consumer-commerce and store
11	// modules will read from once those phases land; here it is managed only
12	// through the admin master surface.
13	//
14	// ID scheme: `_id` is a generated ObjectID (relations always reference it);
15	// SKU is the human-readable unique business key used for upsert idempotency —
16	// PUT /admin/products keys on SKU, never on the ObjectID.
17	type Product struct {
18		ID        primitive.ObjectID `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
19		SKU       string             `bson:"sku"        json:"sku"` // unique business key, e.g. "MILK-TP-500"
20		Name      string             `bson:"name"       json:"name"`
21		MRP       float64            `bson:"mrp"        json:"mrp"`
22		UnitSize  string             `bson:"unit_size"  json:"unit_size"` // e.g. "500ml", "1L", "200g"
23		Active    bool               `bson:"active"     json:"active"`
24		CreatedAt time.Time          `bson:"created_at" json:"created_at"`
25		UpdatedAt time.Time          `bson:"updated_at" json:"updated_at"`
26	}
27
```

```text
1	package platformops

18		"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/auth"
```
