22	)
23	
24	// exportMaxRows caps the immutable audit export (§12) — bounded by contract.
25	const exportMaxRows = 5000
26	
27	// workerClaimCap bounds one mock-SMS worker run to 100 claims.
28	const workerClaimCap = 100
29	
30	// settableFlagKeys is the closed set of PUT-able feature flags. Capability
31	// gating is a deliberate act, not a free-text store (blueprint principle #6):
32	// an unknown key is NotFound, never an implicit insert.
33	var settableFlagKeys = map[string]struct{}{
34		flags.FlagCollarTelemetry:  {},
35		flags.FlagPhotoOCR:         {},
36		flags.FlagONDC:             {},
37		flags.FlagConsumerCommerce: {},
38	}
39	
40	// service holds all platformops business logic.
41	type service struct {
42		deps *deps.Deps
43		repo *repository
44		log  *slog.Logger
45	}
46	
47	// newService wires the service with its module-scoped logger.
48	func newService(d *deps.Deps, repo *repository, log *slog.Logger) *service {
49		return &service{deps: d, repo: repo, log: log}
50	}
51	
52	// ---- Admin: feature flags (§12) ----
53	
54	// listFlags returns every stored feature flag for the admin console.
55	func (s *service) listFlags(ctx context.Context) ([]flags.Flag, error) {
56		all, err := s.deps.Flags.All(ctx)
57		if err != nil {
58			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("list feature flags: %w", err))
59		}
60		if all == nil {
61			all = []flags.Flag{}
62		}
63		return all, nil
64	}
65	
66	// setFlag flips one well-known feature flag and writes the explicit
67	// "admin.flag_set" audit entry.
68	func (s *service) setFlag(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, key string, enabled bool) (*SetFlagResponse, error) {
69		if _, ok := settableFlagKeys[key]; !ok {
70			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "feature flag set rejected: unknown key",
71				slog.String("key", key), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
72			return nil, httpx.NotFound("feature flag " + key)
73		}
74		if err := s.deps.Flags.Set(ctx, key, enabled, actor.PartyID); err != nil {
75			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "set feature flag failed",
76				slog.String("key", key), slog.Any("err", err))
77			return nil, httpx.Internal(fmt.Errorf("set feature flag: %w", err))
78		}
79		s.deps.Audit.Record(ctx, audit.Entry{
80			Action:     "admin.flag_set",
81			TargetType: "FEATURE_FLAG",
82			TargetID:   key,
83			Meta:       map[string]any{"key": key, "enabled": enabled},
84		})
85		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "feature flag set",
86			slog.String("key", key), slog.Bool("enabled", enabled),
87			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
88		return &SetFlagResponse{Key: key, Enabled: enabled}, nil
89	}
90	
91	// ---- Admin: control-tower stats (§12) ----
92	
93	// adminStats returns the read-only control-tower snapshot. Role gating
94	// (SUPER_ADMIN / PCDF_ADMIN / MISSION_OFFICIAL) is enforced at the route; the
95	// figures are platform-global, so there is no org scope to require here.
96	func (s *service) adminStats(ctx context.Context) (*AdminStats, error) {
97		now := time.Now().UTC()
98		stats, err := s.repo.adminStats(ctx, domain.DateKeyIST(now))
99		if err != nil {
100			return nil, err
101		}
102		stats.GeneratedAt = now
103		return stats, nil
104	}
105	
106	// ---- Admin: product master (§12) ----
107	
108	// listProducts returns the full admin product master.
109	func (s *service) listProducts(ctx context.Context) ([]domain.Product, error) {
110		return s.repo.listProducts(ctx)
111	}
112	
113	// upsertProduct creates or updates a product master row keyed by SKU and
114	// writes the "admin.product_upsert" audit entry. An absent `active` defaults
115	// to true on the (upserted) row.
116	func (s *service) upsertProduct(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req UpsertProductRequest) (*domain.Product, error) {
117		sku := strings.TrimSpace(req.SKU)
118		if sku == "" {
119			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "product upsert rejected: missing sku",
120				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
121			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_SKU", "sku is required")
122		}
123		name := strings.TrimSpace(req.Name)
124		if name == "" {
125			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "product upsert rejected: missing name",
126				slog.String("sku", sku), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
127			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_NAME", "name is required")
128		}
129		if req.MRP < 0 {
130			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "product upsert rejected: negative mrp",
131				slog.String("sku", sku), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
132			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_MRP", "mrp must not be negative")
133		}
134		active := true
135		if req.Active != nil {
136			active = *req.Active
137		}
138	
139		now := time.Now().UTC()
140		set := bson.D{
141			{Key: "sku", Value: sku},
142			{Key: "name", Value: name},
143			{Key: "mrp", Value: req.MRP},
144			{Key: "unit_size", Value: strings.TrimSpace(req.UnitSize)},
145			{Key: "active", Value: active},
146			{Key: "updated_at", Value: now},
147		}
148		product, err := s.repo.upsertProduct(ctx, sku, set, now)
149		if err != nil {
150			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "product upsert failed",
151				slog.String("sku", sku), slog.Any("err", err))
152			return nil, err
153		}
154	
155		s.deps.Audit.Record(ctx, audit.Entry{
156			Action:     "admin.product_upsert",
157			TargetType: "PRODUCT",
158			TargetID:   product.ID.Hex(),
159			Meta:       map[string]any{"sku": sku, "name": name, "mrp": req.MRP, "active": active},
160		})
161		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "product upserted",
162			slog.String("product_id", product.ID.Hex()), slog.String("sku", sku),
163			slog.Bool("active", active), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
164		return product, nil
165	}
166	
167	// ---- Auditor: read-only audit-log surface (§12) ----
168	
169	// listAuditLogs returns a page of audit entries, newest first.
170	func (s *service) listAuditLogs(ctx context.Context, f auditLogFilter, page httpx.Page) ([]audit.Entry, int64, error) {
171		return s.repo.listAuditLogs(ctx, f, page)
172	}
173	
174	// exportAuditLogs assembles the capped attachment body for the GIGW/DPDP
175	// immutable audit export.
176	func (s *service) exportAuditLogs(ctx context.Context, from, to *time.Time) (*AuditExport, error) {
177		entries, err := s.repo.exportAuditLogs(ctx, auditLogFilter{From: from, To: to}, exportMaxRows)
178		if err != nil {
179			return nil, err
180		}
181		return &AuditExport{
182			ExportedAt: time.Now().UTC(),
183			From:       from,
184			To:         to,
185			Count:      len(entries),
186			Entries:    entries,
187		}, nil
188	}
189	
190	// ---- Notifications outbox + mock SMS worker (§12, §13) ----
191	
192	// listNotifications returns a page of outbox documents with credential
193	// material redacted: the login OTP must never be readable through the
194	// outbox surface, or anyone with this route could mint any user's session
195	// (request OTP for the victim's phone, read it here, verify).
196	func (s *service) listNotifications(ctx context.Context, phone, status string, page httpx.Page) ([]StoredNotification, int64, error) {
197		items, total, err := s.repo.listNotifications(ctx, phone, status, page)
198		if err != nil {
199			return nil, 0, err
200		}
201		for i := range items {
202			redactNotificationSecrets(&items[i])
203		}
204		// Bulk-PII read (every party's phone + template params): audited for DPDP
205		// forensics, mirroring support.pii_lookup and kyc.pending_list.
206		s.deps.Audit.Record(ctx, audit.Entry{
207			Action:     "admin.notifications_read",
208			TargetType: "NOTIFICATION",
209			Meta: map[string]any{
210				"phone_filter":  phone,
211				"status_filter": status,
212				"count":         len(items),
213				"total":         total,
214			},
215		})
216		return items, total, nil
217	}
218	
219	// redactedValue replaces credential material in read surfaces.
220	const redactedValue = "[REDACTED]"
221	
222	// redactNotificationSecrets strips the plaintext OTP (params + rendered meta)
223	// from an outbox document before it leaves the API.
224	func redactNotificationSecrets(n *StoredNotification) {
225		if n.TemplateKey != domain.TemplateOTP {
226			return
227		}
228		if n.Params != nil {
229			params := make(map[string]string, len(n.Params))
230			for k, v := range n.Params {
231				if k == "otp" {
232					v = redactedValue
233				}
234				params[k] = v
235			}
236			n.Params = params
237		}
238		if n.Meta != nil {
239			meta := make(map[string]any, len(n.Meta))
240			for k, v := range n.Meta {
241				if k == "rendered_en" || k == "rendered_hi" {
242					v = redactedValue
243				}
244				meta[k] = v
245			}
246			n.Meta = meta
247		}
248	}
249	
250	// runWorker is the MOCK SMS provider dispatch (real deployment: MSG91 /
251	// telecom DLT gateway, §13). It claims up to workerClaimCap QUEUED documents
252	// via a race-safe FindOneAndUpdate loop, stamps each SENT with a mock
253	// provider reference, and renders the English/Hindi lines into meta for
254	// visibility. The manual trigger keeps the demo deterministic; production
255	// runs this as a cron/queue consumer.
256	func (s *service) runWorker(ctx context.Context) (*WorkerRunResponse, error) {
257		sent := 0
258		for i := 0; i < workerClaimCap; i++ {
259			providerRef := "SMS-MOCK-" + uuid.NewString()[0:8]
260			claimed, err := s.repo.claimQueuedNotification(ctx, providerRef, time.Now().UTC())
261			if err != nil {
262				s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "claim queued notification failed", slog.Any("err", err))
263				return nil, err
264			}
265			if claimed == nil {
266				break // queue drained
267			}
268			sent++
269	
270			english, hindi := renderSMS(claimed.TemplateKey, claimed.Params)
271			if claimed.TemplateKey == domain.TemplateOTP {
272				// Never persist the rendered OTP text — the provider gets the
273				// message transiently; the readable outbox keeps no plaintext code.
274				english, hindi = redactedValue, redactedValue
275			}
276			meta := map[string]any{
277				"provider":    "SMS-MOCK",
278				"rendered_en": english,
279				"rendered_hi": hindi,
280			}
281			if err := s.repo.setNotificationMeta(ctx, claimed.ID, meta); err != nil {
282				// The claim already succeeded — meta is cosmetic, log and move on.
283				s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "stamp notification meta failed",
284					slog.String("notification_id", claimed.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
285			}
286			s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "notification dispatched",
287				slog.String("notification_id", claimed.ID.Hex()),
288				slog.String("template_key", claimed.TemplateKey),
289				slog.String("provider_ref", providerRef),
290				slog.String("status", domain.NotificationSent))
291		}
292		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "notification worker run complete", slog.Int("sent", sent))
293		return &WorkerRunResponse{Sent: sent}, nil
294	}
295	
296	// renderSMS produces one simple English and one Hindi line per template key —
297	// mock rendering for visibility; real templates live with the DLT-registered
298	// provider (§13). Missing params render as empty strings, never a panic.
299	func renderSMS(templateKey string, params map[string]string) (english, hindi string) {
300		p := func(key string) string { return params[key] } // nil-map reads are safe
301

337	// ---- Support: audited limited-PII lookup (§5.2 role 20) ----
338	
339	// lookupParty resolves a phone to the limited support view. EVERY call —
340	// hit or miss — is recorded as "support.pii_lookup": PII access is audited,
341	// full stop.
342	func (s *service) lookupParty(ctx context.Context, phone string) (*PartyLookupResponse, error) {
343		party, findErr := s.repo.findPartyByPhone(ctx, phone)
344	
345		entry := audit.Entry{
346			Action:     "support.pii_lookup",
347			TargetType: "PARTY",
348			Meta:       map[string]any{"phone": phone, "found": findErr == nil},
349		}
350		if findErr == nil {
351			entry.TargetID = party.ID.Hex()
352		}
353		s.deps.Audit.Record(ctx, entry)
354	
355		if findErr != nil {
356			return nil, findErr
357		}
358	
359		assignments, err := s.repo.listActiveAssignmentsForParty(ctx, party.ID)
360		if err != nil {
361			return nil, err
362		}
363		now := time.Now().UTC()
364		roles := []PartyRoleView{}
365		for _, assignment := range assignments {
366			if !assignment.UsableAt(now) {
367				continue
368			}
369			orgName := ""
370			if org, orgErr := s.deps.Orgs.Get(ctx, assignment.OrgUnitID); orgErr == nil {
371				orgName = org.Name
372			}
373			roles = append(roles, PartyRoleView{
374				RoleCode:  assignment.RoleCode,
375				OrgUnitID: assignment.OrgUnitID.Hex(),
376				OrgName:   orgName,
377			})
378		}
379	
380		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "support party lookup",
381			slog.String("party_id", party.ID.Hex()), slog.Int("roles", len(roles)))
382	
383		// Limited PII by construction: no KYC document numbers, no bank details.
384		return &PartyLookupResponse{
385			PartyID:  party.ID.Hex(),
386			FullName: party.FullName,
387			KYCTier:  party.KYCTier,
388			Status:   party.Status,
389			Roles:    roles,
390		}, nil
391	}

393	// ---- Event-bus reactions: cross-module SMS queuing ----
394	
395	// decodeBusPayload structurally re-decodes a bus payload into this module's
396	// mirror struct — modules never import each other's types (module contract).
397	func decodeBusPayload(payload any, dst any) error {
398		raw, err := json.Marshal(payload)
399		if err != nil {
400			return fmt.Errorf("marshal bus payload: %w", err)
401		}
402		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, dst); err != nil {
403			return fmt.Errorf("unmarshal bus payload: %w", err)
404		}
405		return nil
406	}
407	
408	// onPayoutCredited queues the "₹ credited, UTR …" SMS to the farmer
409	// (blueprint §8.1 last step).
410	func (s *service) onPayoutCredited(ctx context.Context, payload any) {
411		var event payoutCreditedEvent
412		if err := decodeBusPayload(payload, &event); err != nil {
413			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "bad payout.credited payload", slog.Any("err", err))
414			return
415		}
416		if event.FarmerPartyID == "" && event.Phone == "" {
417			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "payout.credited payload has no addressee")
418			return
419		}
420		partyID := s.parseAddresseeID(ctx, event.FarmerPartyID, "payout.credited")
421		s.queueNotification(ctx, partyID, event.Phone, domain.TemplatePayoutCredited, map[string]string{
422			"amount": strconv.FormatFloat(event.Amount, 'f', 2, 64),
423			"utr":    event.UTR,
424		})
425	}
426	
427	// onGateBlocked alerts the blocked subject's UNION_FIELD_SUPERVISOR(s): the
428	// subject's org unit is resolved from its document, walked up to the union
429	// ancestor, and every usable supervisor assignment there gets the safety SMS.
430	func (s *service) onGateBlocked(ctx context.Context, payload any) {
431		var event gateBlockedEvent
432		if err := decodeBusPayload(payload, &event); err != nil {
433			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "bad qc.gate_blocked payload", slog.Any("err", err))
434			return
435		}
436	
437		subjectID, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(event.SubjectID)
438		if err != nil {
439			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qc.gate_blocked subject id is not an object id",
440				slog.String("subject_type", event.SubjectType), slog.String("subject_id", event.SubjectID))
441			return
442		}
443		orgUnitID, err := s.repo.subjectOrgUnit(ctx, event.SubjectType, subjectID)
444		if err != nil {
445			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "gate_blocked org resolution failed",
446				slog.String("subject_type", event.SubjectType),
447				slog.String("subject_id", subjectID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
448			return
449		}
450		union, err := s.unionAncestor(ctx, orgUnitID)
451		if err != nil {
452			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "gate_blocked union walk failed",
453				slog.String("org_unit_id", orgUnitID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
454			return
455		}
456		if union == nil {
457			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "gate_blocked org has no union ancestor",
458				slog.String("org_unit_id", orgUnitID.Hex()))
459			return
460		}
461	
462		supervisors, err := s.repo.listActiveRoleHolders(ctx, union.ID, domain.RoleUnionFieldSupervisor)
463		if err != nil {
464			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "gate_blocked supervisor lookup failed",
465				slog.String("union_id", union.ID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
466			return
467		}
468	
469		params := map[string]string{
470			"subject_type": event.SubjectType,
471			"subject_id":   event.SubjectID,
472			"stage":        event.Stage,
473			"reasons":      strings.Join(event.FailureReasons, ", "),
474		}
475		now := time.Now().UTC()
476		notified := map[primitive.ObjectID]bool{}
477		for _, assignment := range supervisors {
478			if !assignment.UsableAt(now) || notified[assignment.PartyID] {
479				continue
480			}
481			notified[assignment.PartyID] = true
482			partyID := assignment.PartyID
483			s.queueNotification(ctx, &partyID, "", domain.TemplateSafetyBlock, params)
484		}
485	}
486	
487	// onMVUDispatched queues the "MVU van on its way" SMS to the farmer (§10).
488	func (s *service) onMVUDispatched(ctx context.Context, payload any) {
489		var event mvuDispatchedEvent
490		if err := decodeBusPayload(payload, &event); err != nil {
491			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "bad mvu.dispatched payload", slog.Any("err", err))
492			return
493		}
494		if event.FarmerPartyID == "" && event.Phone == "" {
495			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "mvu.dispatched payload has no addressee")
496			return
497		}
498		caseID := event.CaseID
499		if caseID == "" {
500			caseID = event.MVUCaseID
501		}
502		if caseID == "" {
503			caseID = event.ID
504		}
505		params := map[string]string{"case_id": caseID}
506		if event.ETA != "" {
507			params["eta"] = event.ETA
508		}
509		partyID := s.parseAddresseeID(ctx, event.FarmerPartyID, "mvu.dispatched")
510		s.queueNotification(ctx, partyID, event.Phone, domain.TemplateMVUDispatched, params)
511	}
512	
513	// parseAddresseeID turns an optional addressee party ObjectID hex string
514	// (carried as a hex string on bus payloads) into a *primitive.ObjectID.
515	// An empty value is a legitimate phone-only addressing (returns nil); a
516	// non-empty but malformed value is a business/contract violation (WARN + nil).
517	func (s *service) parseAddresseeID(ctx context.Context, hex, event string) *primitive.ObjectID {
518		if hex == "" {
519			return nil
520		}
521		id, err := primitive.ObjectIDFromHex(hex)
522		if err != nil {
523			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bus payload party id is not an object id",
524				slog.String("event", event), slog.String("party_id", hex))
525			return nil
526		}
527		return &id
528	}
529	
530	// hexOrEmpty renders an optional ObjectID for logs.
531	func hexOrEmpty(id *primitive.ObjectID) string {
532		if id == nil {
533			return ""
534		}
535		return id.Hex()
536	}
537	
538	// queueNotification inserts one QUEUED outbox document, resolving phone and
539	// preferred language from the party record when available. The _id is
540	// pre-generated so the queued entry can be named in the structured log.
541	// Failures are logged, never propagated — a lost SMS must not fail the
542	// publishing flow.
543	func (s *service) queueNotification(ctx context.Context, partyID *primitive.ObjectID, phone, templateKey string, params map[string]string) {
544		language := "hi" // vernacular default (blueprint §13)
545		if partyID != nil {
546			if party, err := s.repo.findPartyByID(ctx, *partyID); err == nil {
547				if phone == "" {
548					phone = party.Phone
549				}
550				if party.PreferredLanguage != "" {
551					language = party.PreferredLanguage
552				}
553			}
554		}
555		if phone == "" {
556			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "dropping notification with no phone",
557				slog.String("template_key", templateKey), slog.String("party_id", hexOrEmpty(partyID)))
558			return
559		}
560	
561		id := primitive.NewObjectID()
562		notification := &StoredNotification{Notification: domain.Notification{
563			ID:          id,
564			PartyID:     partyID,
565			Phone:       phone,
566			Channel:     domain.ChannelSMS,
567			TemplateKey: templateKey,
568			Language:    language,
569			Params:      params,
570			Status:      domain.NotificationQueued,
571			QueuedAt:    time.Now().UTC(),
572		}}
573		if err := s.repo.insertNotification(ctx, notification); err != nil {
574			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "queue notification failed",
575				slog.String("template_key", templateKey), slog.Any("err", err))
576			return
577		}
578		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "notification queued",
579			slog.String("notification_id", id.Hex()),
580			slog.String("template_key", templateKey),
581			slog.String("party_id", hexOrEmpty(partyID)),
582			slog.String("status", domain.NotificationQueued))
583	}
584	
585	// unionAncestor returns the MILK_UNION org unit at or above orgUnitID, walking
586	// the denormalised ancestor Path nearest-first via d.Orgs.Get. Returns nil
587	// when no union sits on the chain (e.g. a plant directly under the federation).
588	func (s *service) unionAncestor(ctx context.Context, orgUnitID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.OrgUnit, error) {
589		org, err := s.deps.Orgs.Get(ctx, orgUnitID)
590		if err != nil {
591			return nil, err
592		}
593		if org.Type == domain.OrgTypeMilkUnion {
594			return org, nil
595		}
596		// Path holds ancestors root→down; walk nearest ancestor first.
597		for i := len(org.Path) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
598			ancestor, err := s.deps.Orgs.Get(ctx, org.Path[i])
599			if err != nil {
600				return nil, err
601			}
602			if ancestor.Type == domain.OrgTypeMilkUnion {
603				return ancestor, nil
604			}
605		}
606		return nil, nil
607	}

import (

	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/modules/cattle"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/modules/cms"

	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/modules/onboarding"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/modules/orgs"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/modules/plant"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/modules/platformops"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/modules/publictrace"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/modules/quality"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/modules/settlement"
	"github.com/pyaas/saathi-backend/internal/platform/deps"
)

// RegisterModules mounts every domain module under /api/v1.
//
// Module contract: each package under internal/modules/<name> exposes
//
//	func Register(r chi.Router, d *deps.Deps)
//
// and mounts its own subtree with its own auth/RBAC middleware. Modules are
// the future microservice seams — they may import domain and platform
// packages, but NEVER each other; cross-module reactions go through the
// event bus.
func RegisterModules(api chi.Router, d *deps.Deps) {
	// publictrace first — it mounts /public without auth.
	publictrace.Register(api, d)

	identity.Register(api, d)
	orgs.Register(api, d)
	cattle.Register(api, d)
	collection.Register(api, d)
	logistics.Register(api, d)
	plant.Register(api, d)
	quality.Register(api, d)
	settlement.Register(api, d)
	platformops.Register(api, d)
	dashboards.Register(api, d)
	onboarding.Register(api, d)
	cms.Register(api, d)
}

```text
1	// Package sse implements a Server-Sent Events hub for pushing live updates to
2	// dashboards that are already open — e.g. an Organising Manager's "pending KYC:
3	// 33" badge ticking up without a refresh.
4	//
5	// Why SSE, not WebSocket: a dashboard badge is a one-way, server→client signal.
6	// SSE runs over plain HTTP (no new dependency), auto-reconnects in the browser,
7	// and is far simpler than a WebSocket. It cannot talk to a browser any more
8	// directly than that — the whole point is the server pushing down an open HTTP
9	// connection.
10	//
11	// Delivery model — "nudge, then re-count": the hub pushes a lightweight event
12	// (e.g. "kyc.pending.changed"), and the client re-fetches the authoritative,
13	// org-scoped count from its normal REST endpoint. The nudge is never trusted as
14	// the number itself, so a slightly-broad nudge is harmless — the scoped count
15	// query is the source of truth and can never drift.
16	//
17	// Single-instance scope: this hub fans out within ONE process. When the API
18	// runs as multiple replicas, an event raised on replica B must reach a client
19	// connected to replica A — at that point WireToBus is re-pointed at a shared
20	// pub/sub (Redis pub/sub or NATS), and nothing else changes. That is the ONLY
21	// place multi-node real-time needs external infrastructure; the atomic
22	// duplicate-prevention guarantees live entirely in MongoDB and are unaffected.
23	package sse
24	
25	import (
26		"log/slog"
27		"sync"
28	
29		"github.com/google/uuid"
30	)
31	
32	// Event is one message pushed to matching clients.
33	type Event struct {
34		Type string `json:"type"` // e.g. "kyc.pending.changed"
35		Data any    `json:"data,omitempty"`
36		// Roles restricts delivery to clients holding one of these role codes.
37		// Empty means "every connected client". Because clients re-fetch a scoped
38		// count on receipt, role-level targeting is sufficient — over-delivery only
39		// costs a harmless re-count, never a wrong number.
40		Roles []string `json:"-"`
41	}
42	
43	// Client is one connected dashboard. send is buffered and lossy by design:
44	// if a slow client's buffer is full we drop the nudge rather than block the
45	// hub — the next nudge (or the client's periodic poll) re-syncs it.
46	type Client struct {
47		ID        string
48		PartyID   string
49		RoleCode  string
50		OrgUnitID string
51		send      chan Event
52	}
53	
54	// Events is the channel the HTTP handler ranges over to write the stream.
55	func (c *Client) Events() <-chan Event { return c.send }
56	
57	const clientBuffer = 16
58	
59	// Hub tracks connected clients and fans events out to them.
60	type Hub struct {
61		log *slog.Logger
62	
63		mu      sync.RWMutex
64		clients map[string]*Client
65	}
66	
67	// NewHub builds an empty hub.
68	func NewHub(log *slog.Logger) *Hub {
69		return &Hub{log: log, clients: make(map[string]*Client)}
70	}
71	
72	// Register adds a client and returns it. The caller (HTTP handler) must call
73	// Unregister when the connection closes.
74	func (h *Hub) Register(partyID, roleCode, orgUnitID string) *Client {
75		c := &Client{
76			ID:        uuid.NewString(),
77			PartyID:   partyID,
78			RoleCode:  roleCode,
79			OrgUnitID: orgUnitID,
80			send:      make(chan Event, clientBuffer),
81		}
82		h.mu.Lock()
83		h.clients[c.ID] = c
84		n := len(h.clients)
85		h.mu.Unlock()
86		h.log.Debug("sse client connected",
87			slog.String("client_id", c.ID), slog.String("role", roleCode), slog.Int("connections", n))
88		return c
89	}
90	
91	// Unregister removes a client and closes its channel. Safe to call once.
92	func (h *Hub) Unregister(id string) {
93		h.mu.Lock()
94		c, ok := h.clients[id]
95		if ok {
96			delete(h.clients, id)
97		}
98		n := len(h.clients)
99		h.mu.Unlock()
100		if ok {
101			close(c.send)
102			h.log.Debug("sse client disconnected",
103				slog.String("client_id", id), slog.Int("connections", n))
104		}
105	}
106	
107	// Broadcast delivers ev to every matching client with a non-blocking send.
108	func (h *Hub) Broadcast(ev Event) {
109		h.mu.RLock()
110		defer h.mu.RUnlock()
111		delivered, dropped := 0, 0
112		for _, c := range h.clients {
113			if !roleMatches(ev.Roles, c.RoleCode) {
114				continue
115			}
116			select {
117			case c.send <- ev:
118				delivered++
119			default:
120				dropped++ // buffer full — client is slow; the next nudge re-syncs it
121			}
122		}
123		if delivered > 0 || dropped > 0 {
124			h.log.Debug("sse broadcast",
125				slog.String("type", ev.Type), slog.Int("delivered", delivered), slog.Int("dropped", dropped))
126		}
127	}
128	
129	// ConnectionCount reports currently-connected clients (metrics/debugging).
130	func (h *Hub) ConnectionCount() int {
131		h.mu.RLock()
132		defer h.mu.RUnlock()
133		return len(h.clients)
134	}
135	
136	func roleMatches(roles []string, role string) bool {
137		if len(roles) == 0 {
138			return true
139		}
140		for _, r := range roles {
141			if r == role {
142				return true
143			}
144		}
145		return false
146	}
147
```

61	// fail wraps an unexpected error with its failing operation, logs it at ERROR
62	// and returns the opaque 500 — every internal failure must name its op in the
63	// logs.
64	func (s *Service) fail(ctx context.Context, op string, err error) error {
65		err = fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", op, err)
66		s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "plant operation failed",
67			slog.String("op", op), slog.Any("err", err))
68		return httpx.Internal(err)
69	}
70	
71	// requireScope enforces the actor's org scope and logs denials at WARN so
72	// cross-scope probing is visible.
73	func (s *Service) requireScope(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, targetOrgID primitive.ObjectID, op string) error {
74		err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, targetOrgID)
75		if err == nil {
76			return nil
77		}
78		var app *httpx.AppError
79		if errors.As(err, &app) && app.Status == http.StatusForbidden {
80			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "org scope denied",
81				slog.String("op", op),
82				slog.String("target_org_id", targetOrgID.Hex()),
83				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
84				slog.String("actor_role", actor.RoleCode))
85		}
86		return err
87	}
88	
89	// --- safety-gate predicates (§8.3) ---
90	//
91	// Pure functions so the refusal matrix is unit-testable without a database.
92	// Every mutation below ALSO re-checks the status inside the MongoDB update
93	// filter, so a concurrent QC block can never slip a bad lot through.
94	
95	// canDispatchBMCLot: only a lot with a passing BMC rapid test may leave on a
96	// tanker. BLOCKED, QC_PENDING and OPEN lots stay put.
97	func canDispatchBMCLot(status string) bool {
98		return status == domain.BMCLotStatusPassed
99	}
100	
101	// canPoolBMCLot: only a DISPATCHED lot (which by construction went
102	// OPEN→QC_PENDING→PASSED→DISPATCHED) may enter a processing batch.
103	func canPoolBMCLot(status string) bool {
104		return status == domain.BMCLotStatusDispatched
105	}
106	
107	// canCompleteBatch: only a batch the plant lab has PASSED may complete.
108	func canCompleteBatch(status string) bool {
109		return status == domain.BatchStatusPassed
110	}
111	
112	// canYieldProductLot: only a COMPLETED batch may be packaged into SKU lots.
113	func canYieldProductLot(batchStatus string) bool {
114		return batchStatus == domain.BatchStatusCompleted
115	}
116	
117	// canIssueQR: a QR may only label an ACTIVE product lot whose batch is
118	// COMPLETED. This read-time check is advisory; IssueQR additionally confirms
119	// the lot is still ACTIVE with a conditional write after the QR insert, so a
120	// recall landing mid-request still stops the mint.
121	func canIssueQR(lotStatus, batchStatus string) bool {
122		return lotStatus == domain.ProductLotStatusActive && batchStatus == domain.BatchStatusCompleted
123	}
124	
125	// --- BMC lots ---
126	
127	// CreateBMCLot pools DELIVERED consignments into a new OPEN lot at a BMC.
128	func (s *Service) CreateBMCLot(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateBMCLotRequest) (*domain.BMCLot, error) {
129		actID, err := actorID(actor)
130		if err != nil {
131			return nil, err
132		}
133		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, req.BMCID, "create bmc lot"); err != nil {
134			return nil, err
135		}
136		org, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.BMCID)
137		if err != nil {
138			return nil, err
139		}
140		if org.Type != domain.OrgTypeBMC {
141			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot creation refused: org unit is not a BMC",
142				slog.String("org_unit_id", req.BMCID.Hex()),
143				slog.String("org_type", org.Type),
144				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
145			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_BMC", "org unit "+req.BMCID.Hex()+" is not a BMC")
146		}
147	
148		now := time.Now().UTC()
149		date := req.Date
150		if date == "" {
151			date = domain.DateKeyIST(now)
152		}
153	
154		ids := dedupe(req.ConsignmentIDs)
155		consignments, err := s.repo.ConsignmentsByIDs(ctx, ids)
156		if err != nil {
157			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "load consignments", err)
158		}
159		if len(consignments) != len(ids) {
160			return nil, httpx.NotFound("consignment(s) " + strings.Join(missingIDs(ids, consignments), ", "))
161		}
162		var undelivered []string
163		deliveryTripIDs := make([]primitive.ObjectID, 0, len(consignments))
164		for _, c := range consignments {
165			if c.Status != domain.ConsignmentStatusDelivered {
166				undelivered = append(undelivered, c.ID.Hex())
167			}
168			if c.RouteTripID != nil {
169				deliveryTripIDs = append(deliveryTripIDs, *c.RouteTripID)
170			}
171		}
172		if len(undelivered) > 0 {
173			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot creation refused: consignment(s) not DELIVERED",
174				slog.String("bmc_id", req.BMCID.Hex()),
175				slog.String("consignment_ids", strings.Join(undelivered, ",")),
176				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
177			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("CONSIGNMENT_NOT_DELIVERED",
178				"only DELIVERED consignments can be pooled into a BMC lot").
179				WithDetails(map[string]any{"consignment_ids": undelivered})
180		}
181	
182		// Integrity: every pooled consignment must have been physically delivered
183		// to THIS BMC (its trip's delivered_to_bmc_id == req.BMCID) — a BMC cannot
184		// pool milk that a van dropped at a different chilling centre.
185		tripBMC, err := s.repo.TripDeliveryBMCByIDs(ctx, deliveryTripIDs)
186		if err != nil {
187			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "load trip delivery destinations", err)
188		}
189		var wrongBMC []string
190		for _, c := range consignments {
191			if c.RouteTripID == nil {
192				continue // no trip recorded — cannot attribute a destination
193			}
194			if dest, ok := tripBMC[*c.RouteTripID]; !ok || dest != req.BMCID {
195				wrongBMC = append(wrongBMC, c.ID.Hex())
196			}
197		}
198		if len(wrongBMC) > 0 {
199			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot creation refused: consignment(s) delivered to a different BMC",
200				slog.String("bmc_id", req.BMCID.Hex()),
201				slog.String("consignment_ids", strings.Join(wrongBMC, ",")),
202				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
203			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("WRONG_DELIVERY_BMC",
204				"one or more consignments were delivered to a different BMC and cannot be pooled here").
205				WithDetails(map[string]any{"consignment_ids": wrongBMC})
206		}
207	
208		// Optimistic claim: flip DELIVERED→ACCEPTED stamped with the new lot ID.
209		// The lot ID is pre-generated so claim, insert and ledger all agree.
210		// If another lot raced us on any consignment, release our claims and bail.
211		lotID := primitive.NewObjectID()
212		claimed, err := s.repo.ClaimConsignments(ctx, ids, lotID)
213		if err != nil {
214			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "claim consignments", err)
215		}
216		if claimed != int64(len(ids)) {
217			if relErr := s.repo.ReleaseConsignments(ctx, lotID); relErr != nil {
218				return nil, s.fail(ctx, "release consignments after lost claim", relErr)
219			}
220			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot creation lost consignment claim race",
221				slog.String("bmc_id", req.BMCID.Hex()),
222				slog.Int64("claimed", claimed), slog.Int("requested", len(ids)),
223				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
224			return nil, httpx.Conflict("CONSIGNMENT_CLAIM_CONFLICT",
225				"one or more consignments were pooled by another lot — reload and retry")
226		}
227	
228		var totalLitres float64
229		var tripIDs []primitive.ObjectID
230		seenTrip := map[primitive.ObjectID]bool{}
231		for _, c := range consignments {
232			totalLitres += c.TotalQuantityLitres
233			if c.RouteTripID != nil && !seenTrip[*c.RouteTripID] {
234				seenTrip[*c.RouteTripID] = true
235				tripIDs = append(tripIDs, *c.RouteTripID)
236			}
237		}
238	
239		lot := &domain.BMCLot{
240			ID:                  lotID,
241			BMCID:               req.BMCID,
242			Date:                date,
243			Shift:               req.Shift,
244			ConsignmentIDs:      ids,
245			RouteTripIDs:        tripIDs,
246			TotalQuantityLitres: totalLitres,
247			Status:              domain.BMCLotStatusOpen,
248			CreatedBy:           actID,
249			CreatedAt:           now,
250		}
251		if err := s.repo.InsertBMCLot(ctx, lot); err != nil {
252			_ = s.repo.ReleaseConsignments(ctx, lotID)
253			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "insert bmc lot", err)
254		}
255	
256		refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, len(ids))
257		for _, id := range ids {
258			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{
259				EntityType: domain.EntityConsignment, EntityID: id.Hex(), Relation: "pools",
260			})
261		}
262		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
263			Type:       domain.EventBMCLotCreated,
264			EntityType: domain.EntityBMCLot,
265			EntityID:   lot.ID.Hex(),
266			Refs:       refs,
267			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
268			OrgUnitID:  req.BMCID.Hex(),
269			Payload: map[string]any{
270				"date": date, "shift": req.Shift, "total_quantity_litres": totalLitres,
271			},
272		})
273		if err != nil {
274			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append bmc_lot.created event", err)
275		}
276		if err := s.repo.SetBMCLotProvenanceSeq(ctx, lot.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
277			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp bmc lot provenance seq", err)
278		}
279		lot.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
280		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "bmc lot created",
281			slog.String("bmc_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()),
282			slog.String("bmc_id", req.BMCID.Hex()),
283			slog.String("date", date), slog.String("shift", req.Shift),
284			slog.Int("consignments", len(ids)),
285			slog.Float64("total_quantity_litres", totalLitres),
286			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
287		return lot, nil
288	}
289	
290	// CloseBMCLot transitions an OPEN lot to QC_PENDING with the chilling
291	// temperature. The quality module later flips QC_PENDING→PASSED/BLOCKED.
292	func (s *Service) CloseBMCLot(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID, chillingTempC float64) (*domain.BMCLot, error) {
293		lot, err := s.getBMCLot(ctx, id)
294		if err != nil {
295			return nil, err
296		}
297		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, lot.BMCID, "close bmc lot"); err != nil {
298			return nil, err
299		}
300		if lot.Status != domain.BMCLotStatusOpen {
301			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot close refused: not OPEN",
302				slog.String("bmc_lot_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("status", lot.Status),
303				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
304			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_NOT_OPEN",
305				"only an OPEN lot can be closed; lot is "+lot.Status)
306		}
307		now := time.Now().UTC()
308		ok, err := s.repo.CloseBMCLot(ctx, id, chillingTempC, now)
309		if err != nil {
310			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "close bmc lot", err)
311		}
312		if !ok {
313			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot close lost state race",
314				slog.String("bmc_lot_id", id.Hex()),
315				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
316			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_NOT_OPEN",
317				"lot changed state concurrently — reload and retry")
318		}
319		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
320			Type:       domain.EventBMCLotClosed,
321			EntityType: domain.EntityBMCLot,
322			EntityID:   lot.ID.Hex(),
323			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
324			OrgUnitID:  lot.BMCID.Hex(),
325			Payload:    map[string]any{"chilling_temp_c": chillingTempC},
326		})
327		if err != nil {
328			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append bmc_lot.closed event", err)
329		}
330		if err := s.repo.SetBMCLotProvenanceSeq(ctx, lot.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
331			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp bmc lot provenance seq", err)
332		}
333		lot.Status = domain.BMCLotStatusQCPending
334		lot.ChillingTempC = chillingTempC
335		lot.ClosedAt = &now
336		lot.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
337		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "bmc lot closed for QC",
338			slog.String("bmc_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()),
339			slog.String("bmc_id", lot.BMCID.Hex()),
340			slog.Float64("chilling_temp_c", chillingTempC),
341			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
342		return lot, nil
343	}
344	
345	// DispatchBMCLot transitions PASSED→DISPATCHED. THE safety gate (§8.3): a
346	// BLOCKED or untested lot never leaves the chilling centre.
347	func (s *Service) DispatchBMCLot(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.BMCLot, error) {
348		lot, err := s.getBMCLot(ctx, id)
349		if err != nil {
350			return nil, err
351		}
352		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, lot.BMCID, "dispatch bmc lot"); err != nil {
353			return nil, err
354		}
355		if lot.Status == domain.BMCLotStatusDispatched {
356			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot dispatch refused: already dispatched",
357				slog.String("bmc_lot_id", id.Hex()),
358				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
359			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_ALREADY_DISPATCHED", "lot is already dispatched")
360		}
361		if !canDispatchBMCLot(lot.Status) {
362			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot dispatch refused: safety gate not passed",
363				slog.String("bmc_lot_id", id.Hex()),
364				slog.String("status", lot.Status),
365				slog.String("block_reason", lot.BlockReason),
366				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
367			msg := "lot cannot be dispatched: safety gate not passed (status " + lot.Status + ")"
368			if lot.BlockReason != "" {
369				msg += " — " + lot.BlockReason
370			}
371			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked, msg).
372				WithDetails(map[string]any{"status": lot.Status, "block_reason": lot.BlockReason})
373		}
374		now := time.Now().UTC()
375		ok, err := s.repo.DispatchBMCLot(ctx, id, now)
376		if err != nil {
377			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "dispatch bmc lot", err)
378		}
379		if !ok {
380			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "bmc lot dispatch lost state race",
381				slog.String("bmc_lot_id", id.Hex()),
382				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
383			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_STATE_CHANGED",
384				"lot changed state concurrently — reload and retry")
385		}
386		// The custody transition — gate-passed milk physically leaving the
387		// chilling centre — must live on the tamper-evident chain like every
388		// other hop of the pour→QR path, not only in a mutable document field.
389		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
390			Type:       domain.EventBMCLotDispatched,
391			EntityType: domain.EntityBMCLot,
392			EntityID:   lot.ID.Hex(),
393			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
394			OrgUnitID:  lot.BMCID.Hex(),
395			Payload: map[string]any{
396				// String, not time.Time: payloads must round-trip BSON⇄JSON
397				// byte-identically or chain re-verification would break.
398				"dispatched_at":         now.Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
399				"total_quantity_litres": lot.TotalQuantityLitres,
400			},
401		})
402		if err != nil {
403			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append bmc_lot.dispatched event", err)
404		}
405		if err := s.repo.SetBMCLotProvenanceSeq(ctx, lot.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
406			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp bmc lot provenance seq", err)
407		}
408		lot.Status = domain.BMCLotStatusDispatched
409		lot.DispatchedAt = &now
410		lot.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
411		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "bmc lot dispatched",
412			slog.String("bmc_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()),
413			slog.String("bmc_id", lot.BMCID.Hex()),
414			slog.Float64("total_quantity_litres", lot.TotalQuantityLitres),
415			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
416		return lot, nil
417	}
418	
419	// ListBMCLots pages lots by BMC/date/status. A BMC operator may only list
420	// within their own scope; downstream readers (plant operator, supervisor,
421	// lab) see across BMCs — the plant receives tankers from sibling BMCs, so an
422	// ancestry check against the plant org would wrongly refuse them.
423	func (s *Service) ListBMCLots(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, f BMCLotListFilter, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.BMCLot, int64, error) {
424		if !f.BMCID.IsZero() && actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleBMCOperator {
425			if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, f.BMCID, "list bmc lots"); err != nil {
426				return nil, 0, err
427			}
428		}
429		lots, total, err := s.repo.ListBMCLots(ctx, f, page)
430		if err != nil {
431			return nil, 0, s.fail(ctx, "list bmc lots", err)
432		}
433		return lots, total, nil
434	}
435	
436	// --- processing batches ---
437	
438	// CreateBatch pools DISPATCHED (gate-passed) BMC lots into one production
439	// run. The gate re-checks here belt-and-braces: aflatoxin M1 survives
440	// pasteurisation, so a blocked lot must never reach a vat (§8.3).
441	func (s *Service) CreateBatch(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateBatchRequest) (*domain.ProcessingBatch, error) {
442		actID, err := actorID(actor)
443		if err != nil {
444			return nil, err
445		}
446		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, req.PlantID, "create batch"); err != nil {
447			return nil, err
448		}
449		org, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.PlantID)
450		if err != nil {
451			return nil, err
452		}
453		if org.Type != domain.OrgTypeProcessingPlant {
454			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch creation refused: org unit is not a plant",
455				slog.String("org_unit_id", req.PlantID.Hex()),
456				slog.String("org_type", org.Type),
457				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
458			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_PLANT", "org unit "+req.PlantID.Hex()+" is not a processing plant")
459		}
460	
461		ids := dedupe(req.BMCLotIDs)
462		lots, err := s.repo.BMCLotsByIDs(ctx, ids)
463		if err != nil {
464			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "load bmc lots", err)
465		}
466		if len(lots) != len(ids) {
467			return nil, httpx.NotFound("BMC lot(s) " + strings.Join(missingLotIDs(ids, lots), ", "))
468		}
469		// Scope root the plant may pool from: its parent union (siblings' BMCs are
470		// legitimate), or the plant itself when it sits directly under the federation.
471		plantScopeRoot := org.ID
472		if org.ParentID != nil {
473			plantScopeRoot = *org.ParentID
474		}
475		var offending, foreign []string
476		var inputLitres float64
477		for _, lot := range lots {
478			if !canPoolBMCLot(lot.Status) {
479				offending = append(offending, lot.ID.Hex())
480				continue
481			}
482			// A plant may only pool BMC lots from within its own union subtree —
483			// never claim another union's foreign lot.
484			inScope, serr := s.orgs.InScope(ctx, plantScopeRoot, lot.BMCID)
485			if serr != nil {
486				return nil, serr
487			}
488			if !inScope {
489				foreign = append(foreign, lot.ID.Hex())
490				continue
491			}
492			inputLitres += lot.TotalQuantityLitres
493		}
494		if len(offending) > 0 {
495			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch creation refused: bmc lot(s) have not cleared the safety gate",
496				slog.String("plant_id", req.PlantID.Hex()),
497				slog.String("blocked_lot_ids", strings.Join(offending, ",")),
498				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
499			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked,
500				"one or more BMC lots have not cleared the safety gate (must be PASSED and DISPATCHED)").
501				WithDetails(map[string]any{"blocked_lot_ids": offending})
502		}
503		if len(foreign) > 0 {
504			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch creation refused: bmc lot(s) outside the plant's union scope",
505				slog.String("plant_id", req.PlantID.Hex()),
506				slog.String("foreign_lot_ids", strings.Join(foreign, ",")),
507				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
508			return nil, httpx.Forbidden("one or more BMC lots are outside this plant's organisational scope").
509				WithDetails(map[string]any{"foreign_lot_ids": foreign})
510		}
511	
512		// §7.4 honest set-valued pooling: past the consignment boundary milk no
513		// longer traces to a single society, so materialise the DISTINCT set of
514		// contributing DCS at creation. Walk every poolable lot's consignments and
515		// collapse to unique dcs_id — the consumer trace reads "made from N samitis"
516		// without re-walking the graph.
517		var consignmentIDs []primitive.ObjectID
518		for _, lot := range lots {
519			consignmentIDs = append(consignmentIDs, lot.ConsignmentIDs...)
520		}
521		contributingDCSIDs, err := s.repo.DistinctDCSIDsForConsignments(ctx, dedupe(consignmentIDs))
522		if err != nil {
523			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "resolve contributing societies", err)
524		}
525	
526		now := time.Now().UTC()
527		dateKey := domain.DateKeyIST(now)
528		seq, err := s.repo.NextSequence(ctx, "batch_number:"+req.PlantID.Hex()+":"+dateKey)
529		if err != nil {
530			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "next batch number sequence", err)
531		}
532		batchNumber := fmt.Sprintf("BATCH-%s-%s-%04d",
533			org.Code, strings.ReplaceAll(dateKey, "-", ""), seq)
534	
535		// Optimistic claim (mirrors ClaimConsignments): flip DISPATCHED→POOLED
536		// stamped with the pre-generated batch ID BEFORE inserting the batch. One
537		// physical lot of milk can therefore never be pooled into two batches —
538		// neither by a double-submit nor by two concurrent CreateBatch calls.
539		batchID := primitive.NewObjectID()
540		claimed, err := s.repo.ClaimBMCLots(ctx, ids, batchID)
541		if err != nil {
542			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "claim bmc lots", err)
543		}
544		if claimed != int64(len(ids)) {
545			if relErr := s.repo.ReleaseBMCLots(ctx, batchID); relErr != nil {
546				return nil, s.fail(ctx, "release bmc lots after lost claim", relErr)
547			}
548			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch creation lost bmc lot claim race",
549				slog.String("plant_id", req.PlantID.Hex()),
550				slog.Int64("claimed", claimed), slog.Int("requested", len(ids)),
551				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
552			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BMC_LOT_CLAIM_CONFLICT",
553				"one or more BMC lots were pooled by another batch — reload and retry")
554		}
555	
556		// CREATED is a transient birth state: the plant lab must clear every
557		// batch, so it is persisted straight into QC_PENDING.
558		batch := &domain.ProcessingBatch{
559			ID:                 batchID,
560			PlantID:            req.PlantID,
561			BatchNumber:        batchNumber,
562			BMCLotIDs:          ids,
563			ContributingDCSIDs: contributingDCSIDs,
564			ProductType:        req.ProductType,
565			InputLitres:        inputLitres,
566			Status:             domain.BatchStatusQCPending,
567			StartedAt:          now,
568			CreatedBy:          actID,
569			CreatedAt:          now,
570		}
571		if err := s.repo.InsertBatch(ctx, batch); err != nil {
572			_ = s.repo.ReleaseBMCLots(ctx, batchID)
573			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "insert batch", err)
574		}
575	
576		refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, len(ids))
577		for _, id := range ids {
578			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{
579				EntityType: domain.EntityBMCLot, EntityID: id.Hex(), Relation: "pools",
580			})
581		}
582		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
583			Type:       domain.EventBatchCreated,
584			EntityType: domain.EntityBatch,
585			EntityID:   batch.ID.Hex(),
586			Refs:       refs,
587			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
588			OrgUnitID:  req.PlantID.Hex(),
589			Payload: map[string]any{
590				"batch_number": batchNumber, "product_type": req.ProductType, "input_litres": inputLitres,
591				"contributing_society_count": len(contributingDCSIDs),
592			},
593		})
594		if err != nil {
595			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append batch.created event", err)
596		}
597		if err := s.repo.SetBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx, batch.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
598			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp batch provenance seq", err)
599		}
600		batch.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
601		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "processing batch created",
602			slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
603			slog.String("batch_number", batchNumber),
604			slog.String("plant_id", req.PlantID.Hex()),
605			slog.String("product_type", req.ProductType),
606			slog.Int("bmc_lots", len(ids)),
607			slog.Int("contributing_societies", len(contributingDCSIDs)),
608			slog.Float64("input_litres", inputLitres),
609			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
610		return batch, nil
611	}

613	// CompleteBatch transitions PASSED→COMPLETED — only a batch the plant lab
614	// cleared may finish and go on to yield product lots.
615	func (s *Service) CompleteBatch(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.ProcessingBatch, error) {
616		batch, err := s.getBatch(ctx, id)
617		if err != nil {
618			return nil, err
619		}
620		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, batch.PlantID, "complete batch"); err != nil {
621			return nil, err
622		}
623		if batch.Status == domain.BatchStatusCompleted {
624			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch completion refused: already completed",
625				slog.String("batch_id", id.Hex()),
626				slog.String("batch_number", batch.BatchNumber),
627				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
628			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BATCH_ALREADY_COMPLETED", "batch is already completed")
629		}
630		if !canCompleteBatch(batch.Status) {
631			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch completion refused: plant-lab QC not passed",
632				slog.String("batch_id", id.Hex()),
633				slog.String("batch_number", batch.BatchNumber),
634				slog.String("status", batch.Status),
635				slog.String("block_reason", batch.BlockReason),
636				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
637			msg := "batch cannot complete: plant-lab QC not passed (status " + batch.Status + ")"
638			if batch.BlockReason != "" {
639				msg += " — " + batch.BlockReason
640			}
641			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked, msg).
642				WithDetails(map[string]any{"status": batch.Status, "block_reason": batch.BlockReason})
643		}
644		now := time.Now().UTC()
645		ok, err := s.repo.CompleteBatch(ctx, id, now)
646		if err != nil {
647			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "complete batch", err)
648		}
649		if !ok {
650			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "batch completion lost state race",
651				slog.String("batch_id", id.Hex()),
652				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
653			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BATCH_STATE_CHANGED",
654				"batch changed state concurrently — reload and retry")
655		}
656		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
657			Type:       domain.EventBatchCompleted,
658			EntityType: domain.EntityBatch,
659			EntityID:   batch.ID.Hex(),
660			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
661			OrgUnitID:  batch.PlantID.Hex(),
662			Payload:    map[string]any{"batch_number": batch.BatchNumber},
663		})
664		if err != nil {
665			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append batch.completed event", err)
666		}
667		if err := s.repo.SetBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx, batch.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
668			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp batch provenance seq", err)
669		}
670		batch.Status = domain.BatchStatusCompleted
671		batch.CompletedAt = &now
672		batch.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
673		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "processing batch completed",
674			slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
675			slog.String("batch_number", batch.BatchNumber),
676			slog.String("plant_id", batch.PlantID.Hex()),
677			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
678		return batch, nil
679	}

709	// CreateProductLot packages a COMPLETED batch into a SKU lot (gate re-check).
710	func (s *Service) CreateProductLot(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req CreateProductLotRequest) (*domain.ProductLot, error) {
711		batch, err := s.getBatch(ctx, req.BatchID)
712		if err != nil {
713			return nil, err
714		}
715		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, batch.PlantID, "create product lot"); err != nil {
716			return nil, err
717		}
718		if !canYieldProductLot(batch.Status) {
719			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "product lot creation refused: batch has not completed the safety gate",
720				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
721				slog.String("batch_number", batch.BatchNumber),
722				slog.String("batch_status", batch.Status),
723				slog.String("block_reason", batch.BlockReason),
724				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
725			msg := "batch has not completed the safety gate (status " + batch.Status + ") — no product lots may be made"
726			if batch.BlockReason != "" {
727				msg += " — " + batch.BlockReason
728			}
729			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked, msg).
730				WithDetails(map[string]any{"batch_status": batch.Status, "block_reason": batch.BlockReason})
731		}
732	
733		now := time.Now().UTC()
734		mfgDate := req.MfgDate
735		if mfgDate == "" {
736			mfgDate = domain.DateKeyIST(now)
737		}
738		if req.ExpiryDate <= mfgDate {
739			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_EXPIRY", "expiry_date must be after mfg_date")
740		}
741	
742		lot := &domain.ProductLot{
743			ID:          primitive.NewObjectID(),
744			BatchID:     batch.ID,
745			PlantID:     batch.PlantID,
746			SKU:         req.SKU,
747			ProductName: req.ProductName,
748			Units:       req.Units,
749			UnitSize:    req.UnitSize,
750			MRP:         req.MRP,
751			MfgDate:     mfgDate,
752			ExpiryDate:  req.ExpiryDate,
753			Status:      domain.ProductLotStatusActive,
754			CreatedAt:   now,
755		}
756		if err := s.repo.InsertProductLot(ctx, lot); err != nil {
757			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "insert product lot", err)
758		}
759		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
760			Type:       domain.EventProductLotMade,
761			EntityType: domain.EntityProductLot,
762			EntityID:   lot.ID.Hex(),
763			Refs: []provenance.Ref{
764				{EntityType: domain.EntityBatch, EntityID: batch.ID.Hex(), Relation: "yields"},
765			},
766			Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
767			OrgUnitID: batch.PlantID.Hex(),
768			Payload: map[string]any{
769				"sku": req.SKU, "units": req.Units, "unit_size": req.UnitSize,
770				"mfg_date": mfgDate, "expiry_date": req.ExpiryDate,
771			},
772		})
773		if err != nil {
774			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append product_lot.created event", err)
775		}
776		if err := s.repo.SetProductLotProvenanceSeq(ctx, lot.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
777			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp product lot provenance seq", err)
778		}
779		lot.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
780		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "product lot created",
781			slog.String("product_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()),
782			slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
783			slog.String("batch_number", batch.BatchNumber),
784			slog.String("sku", req.SKU),
785			slog.Int("units", req.Units),
786			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
787		return lot, nil
788	}

790	// RecallProductLot pulls a lot from market (FSSAI recall path, §18-C).
791	func (s *Service) RecallProductLot(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID, reason string) (*domain.ProductLot, error) {
792		lot, err := s.getProductLot(ctx, id)
793		if err != nil {
794			return nil, err
795		}
796		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, lot.PlantID, "recall product lot"); err != nil {
797			return nil, err
798		}
799		if lot.Status == domain.ProductLotStatusRecalled {
800			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "product lot recall refused: already recalled",
801				slog.String("product_lot_id", id.Hex()),
802				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
803			return nil, httpx.Conflict("PRODUCT_LOT_ALREADY_RECALLED", "product lot is already recalled")
804		}
805		ok, err := s.repo.RecallProductLot(ctx, id, reason)
806		if err != nil {
807			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "recall product lot", err)
808		}
809		if !ok {
810			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "product lot recall lost state race: already recalled",
811				slog.String("product_lot_id", id.Hex()),
812				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
813			return nil, httpx.Conflict("PRODUCT_LOT_ALREADY_RECALLED", "product lot is already recalled")
814		}
815		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
816			Type:       domain.EventProductRecalled,
817			EntityType: domain.EntityProductLot,
818			EntityID:   lot.ID.Hex(),
819			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
820			OrgUnitID:  lot.PlantID.Hex(),
821			Payload:    map[string]any{"reason": reason},
822		})
823		if err != nil {
824			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append product_lot.recalled event", err)
825		}
826		if err := s.repo.SetProductLotProvenanceSeq(ctx, lot.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
827			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp product lot provenance seq", err)
828		}
829		lot.Status = domain.ProductLotStatusRecalled
830		lot.RecallReason = reason
831		lot.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
832		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "product lot recalled",
833			slog.String("product_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()),
834			slog.String("plant_id", lot.PlantID.Hex()),
835			slog.String("sku", lot.SKU),
836			slog.String("reason", reason),
837			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
838		return lot, nil
839	}
840	
841	// --- QR issuance ---
842	
843	// qrAlphabet is the 32-character human-safe set for short codes: A–Z and 2–9
844	// minus the confusables 0/O and 1/I. 32 divides 256, so a byte modulo the
845	// alphabet length is unbiased.
846	const qrAlphabet = "ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789"
847	
848	// qrCodeLength is the number of random characters after the "PRG-" prefix
849	// (32^8 ≈ 1.1 trillion codes — collisions are retried on the unique index).
850	const qrCodeLength = 8
851	
852	// newQRCode mints a short public code like "[REDACTED:generic-api-key]" from crypto/rand.
853	func newQRCode() (string, error) {
854		buf := make([]byte, qrCodeLength)
855		if _, err := rand.Read(buf); err != nil {
856			return "", err
857		}
858		code := make([]byte, qrCodeLength)
859		for i, b := range buf {
860			code[i] = qrAlphabet[int(b)%len(qrAlphabet)]
861		}
862		return "PRG-" + string(code), nil
863	}
864	
865	// signQRToken builds the forgery-proof token printed inside the QR:
866	// base64url(qr_code|product_lot_hex|issued_unix) + "." + hex(HMAC-SHA256).
867	// productLotHex is the product lot ObjectID's hex form — the HMAC material is
868	// "qr_code|lot hex|unix", and the publictrace module verifies the exact same
869	// shape. The consumer app resolves the payload; the signature proves it was
870	// minted by this server, so IDs cannot be guessed onto counterfeit packs.
871	func signQRToken(secret, qrCode, productLotHex string, issuedAt time.Time) string {
872		payload := qrCode + "|" + productLotHex + "|" + strconv.FormatInt(issuedAt.Unix(), 10)
873		mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte(secret))
874		mac.Write([]byte(payload))
875		return base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(payload)) + "." + hex.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))
876	}
877	
878	// parseQRToken verifies and unpacks a signed QR token, returning the product
879	// lot ObjectID as its hex string.
880	func parseQRToken(secret, token string) (qrCode, productLotHex string, issuedAt time.Time, err error) {
881		payloadB64, sigHex, found := strings.Cut(token, ".")
882		if !found {
883			return "", "", time.Time{}, errors.New("qr token: missing signature separator")
884		}
885		payloadBytes, err := base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString(payloadB64)
886		if err != nil {
887			return "", "", time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("qr token: bad payload encoding: %w", err)
888		}
889		sig, err := hex.DecodeString(sigHex)
890		if err != nil {
891			return "", "", time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("qr token: bad signature encoding: %w", err)
892		}
893		mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte(secret))
894		mac.Write(payloadBytes)
895		if !hmac.Equal(sig, mac.Sum(nil)) {
896			return "", "", time.Time{}, errors.New("qr token: signature mismatch")
897		}
898		parts := strings.Split(string(payloadBytes), "|")
899		if len(parts) != 3 {
900			return "", "", time.Time{}, errors.New("qr token: malformed payload")
901		}
902		unix, err := strconv.ParseInt(parts[2], 10, 64)
903		if err != nil {
904			return "", "", time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("qr token: bad timestamp: %w", err)
905		}
906		return parts[0], parts[1], time.Unix(unix, 0).UTC(), nil
907	}
908	
909	// IssueQR mints one signed QR for an ACTIVE product lot whose batch is
910	// COMPLETED. The gate is checked on read AND re-confirmed with a conditional
911	// write on the lot after the QR insert, so recalled or blocked product can
912	// never be freshly labelled even when the recall races this request.
913	func (s *Service) IssueQR(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, productLotID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.BatchQR, error) {
914		actID, err := actorID(actor)
915		if err != nil {
916			return nil, err
917		}
918		lot, err := s.getProductLot(ctx, productLotID)
919		if err != nil {
920			return nil, err
921		}
922		if err := s.requireScope(ctx, actor, lot.PlantID, "issue qr"); err != nil {
923			return nil, err
924		}
925		batch, err := s.getBatch(ctx, lot.BatchID)
926		if err != nil {
927			return nil, err
928		}
929		if !canIssueQR(lot.Status, batch.Status) {
930			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qr issuance refused: safety gate",
931				slog.String("product_lot_id", productLotID.Hex()),
932				slog.String("product_lot_status", lot.Status),
933				slog.String("batch_id", batch.ID.Hex()),
934				slog.String("batch_status", batch.Status),
935				slog.String("recall_reason", lot.RecallReason),
936				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
937			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked,
938				"QR issuance refused: product lot must be ACTIVE and its batch COMPLETED").
939				WithDetails(map[string]any{
940					"product_lot_status": lot.Status,
941					"batch_status":       batch.Status,
942					"recall_reason":      lot.RecallReason,
943				})
944		}
945	
946		now := time.Now().UTC()
947		var qr *domain.BatchQR
948		const maxMintAttempts = 5
949		for attempt := 0; attempt < maxMintAttempts; attempt++ {
950			code, err := newQRCode()
951			if err != nil {
952				return nil, s.fail(ctx, "generate qr code", err)
953			}
954			candidate := &domain.BatchQR{
955				ID:           primitive.NewObjectID(),
956				QRCode:       code,
957				ProductLotID: lot.ID,
958				SignedToken:  signQRToken(s.qrSecret, code, lot.ID.Hex(), now),
959				IssuedBy:     actID,
960				ScanCount:    0,
961				IssuedAt:     now,
962			}
963			insertErr := s.repo.InsertQR(ctx, candidate)
964			if insertErr == nil {
965				qr = candidate
966				break
967			}
968			if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(insertErr) {
969				continue // short-code collision — regenerate
970			}
971			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "insert qr", insertErr)
972		}
973		if qr == nil {
974			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "mint qr code",
975				fmt.Errorf("%d consecutive short-code collisions", maxMintAttempts))
976		}
977	
978		// Recall re-check at WRITE time: the initial read cannot see a recall that
979		// lands mid-request, so the mint is confirmed with a conditional no-op
980		// write on the lot (filter status=ACTIVE). If the lot left ACTIVE, the
981		// just-inserted QR is deleted and issuance refused — a freshly minted QR
982		// can never label recalled product.
983		active, err := s.repo.TouchActiveLot(ctx, lot.ID)
984		if err != nil {
985			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "confirm product lot active", err)
986		}
987		if !active {
988			if delErr := s.repo.DeleteQR(ctx, qr.ID); delErr != nil {
989				return nil, s.fail(ctx, "delete qr after lot left ACTIVE", delErr)
990			}
991			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qr issuance refused: product lot left ACTIVE during issuance",
992				slog.String("product_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()),
993				slog.String("qr_id", qr.ID.Hex()),
994				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
995			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable(codeSafetyGateBlocked,
996				"QR issuance refused: product lot left ACTIVE (e.g. recalled) during issuance")
997		}
998	
999		ev, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
1000			Type:       domain.EventQRIssued,
1001			EntityType: domain.EntityBatchQR,
1002			EntityID:   qr.ID.Hex(),
1003			Refs: []provenance.Ref{
1004				{EntityType: domain.EntityProductLot, EntityID: lot.ID.Hex(), Relation: "labels"},
1005			},
1006			Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
1007			OrgUnitID: lot.PlantID.Hex(),
1008			Payload:   map[string]any{"qr_code": qr.QRCode},
1009		})
1010		if err != nil {
1011			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "append qr.issued event", err)
1012		}
1013		if err := s.repo.SetQRProvenanceSeq(ctx, qr.ID, ev.Seq); err != nil {
1014			return nil, s.fail(ctx, "stamp qr provenance seq", err)
1015		}
1016		qr.ProvenanceSeq = ev.Seq
1017		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "qr issued",
1018			slog.String("qr_id", qr.ID.Hex()),
1019			slog.String("qr_code", qr.QRCode),
1020			slog.String("product_lot_id", lot.ID.Hex()),
1021			slog.String("plant_id", lot.PlantID.Hex()),
1022			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
1023		return qr, nil
1024	}
1025	
1026	// ListQRs pages QRs, optionally narrowed to one product lot (scope-checked
1027	// through the lot's plant).
1028	func (s *Service) ListQRs(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, f QRListFilter, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.BatchQR, int64, error) {
1029		if !f.ProductLotID.IsZero() {
1030			lot, err := s.getProductLot(ctx, f.ProductLotID)
1031			if err != nil {
1032				return nil, 0, err
1033			}

1080	// dedupe removes zero and duplicate IDs preserving first-seen order.
1081	func dedupe(ids []primitive.ObjectID) []primitive.ObjectID {
1082		seen := make(map[primitive.ObjectID]bool, len(ids))
1083		out := make([]primitive.ObjectID, 0, len(ids))
1084		for _, id := range ids {
1085			if id.IsZero() || seen[id] {
1086				continue
1087			}
1088			seen[id] = true
1089			out = append(out, id)
1090		}
1091		return out
1092	}
1093	
1094	// missingIDs lists requested consignment IDs (as hex) absent from the fetched
1095	// set.
1096	func missingIDs(wanted []primitive.ObjectID, got []domain.DCSConsignment) []string {
1097		have := make(map[primitive.ObjectID]bool, len(got))
1098		for _, c := range got {
1099			have[c.ID] = true
1100		}
1101		var missing []string
1102		for _, id := range wanted {
1103			if !have[id] {
1104				missing = append(missing, id.Hex())
1105			}
1106		}
1107		return missing
1108	}
1109	
1110	// missingLotIDs lists requested BMC lot IDs (as hex) absent from the fetched
1111	// set.
1112	func missingLotIDs(wanted []primitive.ObjectID, got []domain.BMCLot) []string {
1113		have := make(map[primitive.ObjectID]bool, len(got))
1114		for _, l := range got {
1115			have[l.ID] = true
1116		}
1117		var missing []string
1118		for _, id := range wanted {
1119			if !have[id] {
1120				missing = append(missing, id.Hex())
1121			}
1122		}
1123		return missing

17	// Repo is the plant module's MongoDB access layer. All state transitions use
18	// optimistic filters on the expected status — no transactions (standalone
19	// server), so a lost race simply matches zero documents and the service
20	// reports a conflict instead of corrupting state.
21	type Repo struct {
22		consignments *mongo.Collection
23		routeTrips   *mongo.Collection

31	// NewRepo binds the repo to the shared database.
32	func NewRepo(db *mongo.Database) *Repo {
33		return &Repo{
34			consignments: db.Collection(mongodb.CollConsignments),
35			routeTrips:   db.Collection(mongodb.CollRouteTrips),
36			bmcLots:      db.Collection(mongodb.CollBMCLots),
37			batches:      db.Collection(mongodb.CollBatches),
38			productLots:  db.Collection(mongodb.CollProductLots),

44	// TripDeliveryBMCByIDs returns, for each given route-trip id, the BMC it was
45	// delivered to (empty if the trip is not yet DELIVERED). Used to verify that a
46	// consignment being pooled was actually delivered to THIS BMC. Read-only view
47	// into the logistics module's route_trips (sanctioned cross-collection read).
48	func (r *Repo) TripDeliveryBMCByIDs(ctx context.Context, ids []primitive.ObjectID) (map[primitive.ObjectID]primitive.ObjectID, error) {
49		cur, err := r.routeTrips.Find(ctx,
50			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: ids}}}, {Key: "status", Value: domain.TripStatusDelivered}},
51			options.Find().SetProjection(bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: 1}, {Key: "delivered_to_bmc_id", Value: 1}}))
52		if err != nil {
53			return nil, err
54		}
55		var rows []struct {
56			ID    primitive.ObjectID  `bson:"_id"`
57			BMCID *primitive.ObjectID `bson:"delivered_to_bmc_id"`
58		}
59		if err := cur.All(ctx, &rows); err != nil {
60			return nil, err
61		}
62		out := make(map[primitive.ObjectID]primitive.ObjectID, len(rows))
63		for _, row := range rows {
64			if row.BMCID != nil {
65				out[row.ID] = *row.BMCID
66			}
67		}
68		return out, nil
69	}

86	// DistinctDCSIDsForConsignments resolves the given consignments to the DISTINCT
87	// set of societies (dcs_id) that fed them — the §7.4 honest-pooling contributor
88	// set materialised onto a processing batch. Missing consignments simply drop
89	// out; the result carries no zero-value ids.
90	func (r *Repo) DistinctDCSIDsForConsignments(ctx context.Context, ids []primitive.ObjectID) ([]primitive.ObjectID, error) {
91		if len(ids) == 0 {
92			return []primitive.ObjectID{}, nil
93		}
94		raw, err := r.consignments.Distinct(ctx, "dcs_id", bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: ids}}}})
95		if err != nil {
96			return nil, err
97		}
98		out := make([]primitive.ObjectID, 0, len(raw))
99		for _, v := range raw {
100			if oid, ok := v.(primitive.ObjectID); ok && !oid.IsZero() {
101				out = append(out, oid)
102			}
103		}
104		return out, nil
105	}

107	// ClaimConsignments atomically flips DELIVERED consignments to ACCEPTED and
108	// stamps the pooling lot ID. Returns how many were actually claimed — fewer
109	// than requested means another lot raced us on at least one consignment.
110	func (r *Repo) ClaimConsignments(ctx context.Context, ids []primitive.ObjectID, bmcLotID primitive.ObjectID) (int64, error) {
111		res, err := r.consignments.UpdateMany(ctx,
112			bson.D{
113				{Key: "_id", Value: bson.D{{Key: "$in", Value: ids}}},
114				{Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusDelivered},
115			},
116			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{
117				{Key: "status", Value: domain.ConsignmentStatusAccepted},
118				{Key: "bmc_lot_id", Value: bmcLotID},
119			}}},
120		)
121		if err != nil {
122			return 0, err
123		}
124		return res.ModifiedCount, nil
125	}

134				{Key: "$unset", Value: bson.D{{Key: "bmc_lot_id", Value: ""}}},

249	// ListBMCLots returns a page of lots plus the total match count.

256			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "date", Value: f.Date})
257		}
258		if f.Status != "" {
259			filter = append(filter, bson.E{Key: "status", Value: f.Status})

261		total, err := r.bmcLots.CountDocuments(ctx, filter)
262		if err != nil {
263			return nil, 0, err
264		}
265		cur, err := r.bmcLots.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
266			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "date", Value: -1}, {Key: "created_at", Value: -1}}).
267			SetSkip(page.Offset).SetLimit(page.Limit))
268		if err != nil {
269			return nil, 0, err
270		}
271		out := []domain.BMCLot{}
272		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
273			return nil, 0, err
274		}
275		return out, total, nil
276	}

442		cur, err := r.qrs.Find(ctx, filter, options.Find().
443			SetSort(bson.D{{Key: "issued_at", Value: -1}}).
444			SetSkip(page.Offset).SetLimit(page.Limit))
445		if err != nil {
446			return nil, 0, err
447		}
448		out := []domain.BatchQR{}
449		if err := cur.All(ctx, &out); err != nil {
450			return nil, 0, err
451		}
452		return out, total, nil
453	}
454	
455	// --- provenance back-references ---
456	
457	// SetBMCLotProvenanceSeq stamps the ledger sequence onto a lot document.
458	func (r *Repo) SetBMCLotProvenanceSeq(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID, seq int64) error {
459		return r.setProvenanceSeq(ctx, r.bmcLots, id, seq)
460	}
461

463	func (r *Repo) SetBatchProvenanceSeq(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID, seq int64) error {
464		return r.setProvenanceSeq(ctx, r.batches, id, seq)
465	}
466

468	func (r *Repo) SetProductLotProvenanceSeq(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID, seq int64) error {
469		return r.setProvenanceSeq(ctx, r.productLots, id, seq)

473	func (r *Repo) SetQRProvenanceSeq(ctx context.Context, id primitive.ObjectID, seq int64) error {
474		return r.setProvenanceSeq(ctx, r.qrs, id, seq)
475	}
476	
477	func (r *Repo) setProvenanceSeq(ctx context.Context, coll *mongo.Collection, id primitive.ObjectID, seq int64) error {
478		_, err := coll.UpdateOne(ctx,
479			bson.D{{Key: "_id", Value: id}},
480			bson.D{{Key: "$set", Value: bson.D{{Key: "provenance_seq", Value: seq}}}},
481		)
