102		}
103	
104		rows, err := s.repo.findRecordedPours(ctx, req.DCSID, date, req.Shift)
105		if err != nil {
106			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "create consignment: find recorded pours", err)
107		}
108		if len(rows) == 0 {
109			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "consignment creation rejected: no RECORDED pours",
110				slog.String("dcs_id", req.DCSID.Hex()), slog.String("date", date),
111				slog.String("shift", req.Shift), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
112			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("NO_POURS_TO_CONSIGN",
113				fmt.Sprintf("no RECORDED pours for DCS %s on %s %s", req.DCSID.Hex(), date, req.Shift))
114		}
115		pourIDs, totalQty, avgFat, avgSNF, assurance := aggregatePours(rows)
116	
117		consignment := &domain.DCSConsignment{
118			ID:                  primitive.NewObjectID(), // pre-generated: insert + ledger refs stay consistent
119			DCSID:               req.DCSID,
120			Date:                date,
121			Shift:               req.Shift,
122			PourIDs:             pourIDs,
123			TotalQuantityLitres: totalQty,
124			CanCount:            int(math.Ceil(totalQty / canCapacityLitres)),
125			AvgFatPct:           avgFat,
126			AvgSNFPct:           avgSNF,
127			Assurance:           assurance,
128			Status:              domain.ConsignmentStatusOpen,
129			CreatedBy:           actorID,
130			CreatedAt:           now,
131		}
132		if err := s.repo.insertConsignment(ctx, consignment); err != nil {
133			if mongo.IsDuplicateKeyError(err) {
134				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "consignment creation rejected: duplicate for dcs+date+shift",
135					slog.String("dcs_id", req.DCSID.Hex()), slog.String("date", date),
136					slog.String("shift", req.Shift), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
137				return nil, httpx.Conflict("CONSIGNMENT_EXISTS",
138					fmt.Sprintf("a consignment for DCS %s on %s %s already exists", req.DCSID.Hex(), date, req.Shift))
139			}
140			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "create consignment: insert", err)
141		}
142	
143		// Provenance: the pooling-boundary event. Pour refs are capped so the
144		// event stays bounded — past the cap the payload's pour_count is the
145		// authoritative tally (the doc's pour_ids keeps the full set).
146		refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, min(len(pourIDs), maxPourRefs))
147		for i, id := range pourIDs {
148			if i >= maxPourRefs {
149				break
150			}
151			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{EntityType: domain.EntityMilkPour, EntityID: id.Hex(), Relation: "aggregates"})
152		}
153		event, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
154			Type:       domain.EventConsignmentCreated,
155			EntityType: domain.EntityConsignment,
156			EntityID:   consignment.ID.Hex(),
157			Refs:       refs,
158			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
159			OrgUnitID:  consignment.DCSID.Hex(),
160			Payload: map[string]any{
161				"pour_count":            len(pourIDs),
162				"total_quantity_litres": totalQty,
163				"can_count":             consignment.CanCount,
164				"date":                  date,
165				"shift":                 req.Shift,
166			},
167		})
168		if err != nil {
169			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "create consignment: append provenance", err)
170		}
171		if err := s.repo.setConsignmentProvenanceSeq(ctx, consignment.ID, event.Seq); err != nil {
172			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "create consignment: set provenance seq", err)
173		}
174		consignment.ProvenanceSeq = event.Seq
175		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "consignment created",
176			slog.String("consignment_id", consignment.ID.Hex()),
177			slog.String("dcs_id", consignment.DCSID.Hex()),
178			slog.String("date", date), slog.String("shift", req.Shift),
179			slog.Int("pour_count", len(pourIDs)),
180			slog.Float64("total_quantity_litres", totalQty),
181			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
182		return consignment, nil
183	}
184	
185	// dispatchConsignment seals an OPEN consignment for pickup (OPEN→DISPATCHED).
186	// The creation-time pour snapshot is provisional: the seal re-aggregates the
187	// shift's RECORDED pours so milk recorded between creation and dispatch (the
188	// collection module also rejects such pours, belt-and-braces) is reflected in
189	// pour_ids, litres, can count and weighted fat/SNF before the load leaves.
190	func (s *service) dispatchConsignment(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, id primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.DCSConsignment, error) {
191		consignment, err := s.loadConsignment(ctx, id)
192		if err != nil {
193			return nil, err
194		}
195		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, consignment.DCSID); err != nil {
196			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "consignment dispatch denied: DCS out of scope",
197				slog.String("consignment_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("dcs_id", consignment.DCSID.Hex()),
198				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
199			return nil, err
200		}
201		if consignment.Status != domain.ConsignmentStatusOpen {
202			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "consignment dispatch rejected: not OPEN",
203				slog.String("consignment_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("status", consignment.Status),
204				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
205			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_CONSIGNMENT_STATE",
206				"consignment is "+consignment.Status+"; only OPEN consignments can be dispatched")
207		}
208	
209		// Re-aggregate at the seal boundary.
210		rows, err := s.repo.findRecordedPours(ctx, consignment.DCSID, consignment.Date, consignment.Shift)
211		if err != nil {
212			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "dispatch consignment: find recorded pours", err)
213		}
214		extraSet := bson.D{}
215		if len(rows) > 0 {
216			pourIDs, totalQty, avgFat, avgSNF, assurance := aggregatePours(rows)
217			consignment.PourIDs = pourIDs
218			consignment.TotalQuantityLitres = totalQty
219			consignment.CanCount = int(math.Ceil(totalQty / canCapacityLitres))
220			consignment.AvgFatPct = avgFat
221			consignment.AvgSNFPct = avgSNF
222			consignment.Assurance = assurance
223			extraSet = bson.D{
224				{Key: "pour_ids", Value: pourIDs},
225				{Key: "total_quantity_litres", Value: totalQty},
226				{Key: "can_count", Value: consignment.CanCount},
227				{Key: "avg_fat_pct", Value: avgFat},
228				{Key: "avg_snf_pct", Value: avgSNF},
229				{Key: "assurance", Value: assurance},
230			}
231		}
232	
233		now := time.Now().UTC()
234		// §6.4: sealing freezes the pour set to the physical cans. The seal_code is
235		// an operational human-readable tamper marker (SEAL-<consignment>-<checksum>);
236		// the append-only hash chain is the cryptographic integrity anchor.
237		sealCode := mintSealCode(consignment.ID, consignment.PourIDs)
238		consignment.SealCode = sealCode
239		consignment.SealedAt = &now
240		extraSet = append(extraSet,
241			bson.E{Key: "seal_code", Value: sealCode},
242			bson.E{Key: "sealed_at", Value: now},
243		)
244		matched, err := s.repo.markConsignmentDispatched(ctx, id, now, extraSet)
245		if err != nil {
246			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "dispatch consignment: mark dispatched", err)
247		}
248		if !matched { // lost a state race since the read above
249			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "consignment dispatch rejected: lost state race",
250				slog.String("consignment_id", id.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
251			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_CONSIGNMENT_STATE",
252				"consignment was modified concurrently; reload and retry")
253		}
254		event, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
255			Type:       domain.EventConsignmentDispatched,
256			EntityType: domain.EntityConsignment,
257			EntityID:   consignment.ID.Hex(),
258			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
259			OrgUnitID:  consignment.DCSID.Hex(),
260			Payload: map[string]any{
261				"pour_count":            len(consignment.PourIDs),
262				"total_quantity_litres": consignment.TotalQuantityLitres,
263				"can_count":             consignment.CanCount,
264				"date":                  consignment.Date,
265				"shift":                 consignment.Shift,
266			},
267		})
268		if err != nil {
269			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "dispatch consignment: append provenance", err)
270		}
271		if err := s.repo.setConsignmentProvenanceSeq(ctx, consignment.ID, event.Seq); err != nil {
272			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "dispatch consignment: set provenance seq", err)
273		}
274		consignment.Status = domain.ConsignmentStatusDispatch
275		consignment.DispatchedAt = &now
276		consignment.ProvenanceSeq = event.Seq
277		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "consignment dispatched",
278			slog.String("consignment_id", consignment.ID.Hex()),
279			slog.String("dcs_id", consignment.DCSID.Hex()),
280			slog.Int("pour_count", len(consignment.PourIDs)),
281			slog.Float64("total_quantity_litres", consignment.TotalQuantityLitres),
282			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
283		return consignment, nil
284	}
285	
286	// listConsignments returns a scoped page of consignments. DCS-scoped actors
287	// default to their own society; wide read roles (SUPER_ADMIN, STATE_AUDITOR)
288	// may list unfiltered; everyone else must name a dcs_id inside their scope.
289	func (s *service) listConsignments(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, q consignmentListQuery, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.DCSConsignment, int64, error) {
290		dcsID := q.DCSID
291		if dcsID.IsZero() {
292			switch {
293			case actor.OrgType == domain.OrgTypeDCS && actor.OrgUnitID != "":
294				id, err := httpx.ParseID(actor.OrgUnitID, "actor org unit")
295				if err != nil {
296					return nil, 0, err
297				}
298				dcsID = id
299			case actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleSuperAdmin || actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleStateAuditor:
300				// federation-wide read roles may scan unfiltered (still paged)
301			default:
302				return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("DCS_ID_REQUIRED", "dcs_id query parameter is required for your role")
303			}
304		}
305		if !dcsID.IsZero() {
306			if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, dcsID); err != nil {
307				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "consignment list denied: DCS out of scope",
308					slog.String("dcs_id", dcsID.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
309				return nil, 0, err
310			}
311		}
312		if q.Date != "" {
313			if _, err := resolveDate(q.Date, time.Time{}); err != nil {
314				return nil, 0, err
315			}
316		}
317		if q.Status != "" && !isConsignmentStatus(q.Status) {
318			return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_STATUS", "unknown consignment status "+q.Status)
319		}
320		items, total, err := s.repo.listConsignments(ctx, dcsID, q.Date, q.Status, page)
321		if err != nil {
322			return nil, 0, s.internal(ctx, "list consignments", err)
323		}
324		return items, total, nil
325	}
326	
327	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
328	// Route trips
329	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
330	
331	// createTrip plans a van run: every stop's consignment must already be
332	// DISPATCHED and must belong to that stop's DCS. The rider defaults to the
333	// actor when a VAN_RIDER plans their own route.
334	func (s *service) createTrip(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, req createTripRequest) (*domain.RouteTrip, error) {
335		if req.RouteName == "" {
336			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_ROUTE_NAME", "route_name is required")
337		}
338		if req.UnionID.IsZero() {
339			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_UNION_ID", "union_id is required")
340		}
341		if err := validateShift(req.Shift); err != nil {
342			return nil, err
343		}
344		if len(req.Stops) == 0 {
345			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NO_STOPS", "at least one stop is required")
346		}
347		if len(req.Stops) > maxTripStops {
348			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("TOO_MANY_STOPS", fmt.Sprintf("a trip may have at most %d stops", maxTripStops))
349		}
350		now := time.Now().UTC()
351		date, err := resolveDate(req.Date, now)
352		if err != nil {
353			return nil, err
354		}
355		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.UnionID); err != nil {
356			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "trip creation denied: union out of scope",
357				slog.String("union_id", req.UnionID.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
358			return nil, err
359		}
360		union, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.UnionID)
361		if err != nil {
362			return nil, err
363		}
364		if union.Type != domain.OrgTypeMilkUnion {
365			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_UNION", "org unit "+req.UnionID.Hex()+" is not a MILK_UNION")
366		}
367	
368		var riderPartyID primitive.ObjectID
369		if req.VanRiderPartyID != nil && !req.VanRiderPartyID.IsZero() {
370			riderPartyID = *req.VanRiderPartyID
371		} else {
372			if actor.RoleCode != domain.RoleVanRider {
373				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("RIDER_REQUIRED", "van_rider_party_id is required unless a VAN_RIDER plans their own trip")
374			}
375			actorID, err := s.actorID(actor)
376			if err != nil {
377				return nil, err
378			}
379			riderPartyID = actorID
380		}
381	
382		seen := make(map[primitive.ObjectID]struct{}, len(req.Stops))
383		stops := make([]domain.RouteStop, 0, len(req.Stops))
384		for _, stop := range req.Stops {
385			if stop.DCSID.IsZero() || stop.ConsignmentID.IsZero() {
386				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_STOP", "every stop needs dcs_id and consignment_id")
387			}
388			if _, dup := seen[stop.ConsignmentID]; dup {
389				return nil, httpx.BadRequest("DUPLICATE_STOP", "consignment "+stop.ConsignmentID.Hex()+" appears in more than one stop")
390			}
391			seen[stop.ConsignmentID] = struct{}{}
392	
393			// Scope guard (IDOR): the stop's DCS must be within the actor's org
394			// scope, so one union's rider/supervisor cannot pull another union's
395			// consignment onto their trip (cross-union pooling / foreign mutation).
396			if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, stop.DCSID); err != nil {
397				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "trip creation rejected: stop DCS out of scope",
398					slog.String("stop_dcs_id", stop.DCSID.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
399				return nil, err
400			}
401			consignment, err := s.loadConsignment(ctx, stop.ConsignmentID)
402			if err != nil {
403				return nil, err
404			}
405			if aerr := validateStopConsignment(consignment, stop.DCSID); aerr != nil {
406				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "trip creation rejected: invalid stop consignment",
407					slog.String("consignment_id", stop.ConsignmentID.Hex()),
408					slog.String("stop_dcs_id", stop.DCSID.Hex()),
409					slog.String("consignment_status", consignment.Status),
410					slog.String("code", aerr.Code),
411					slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
412				return nil, aerr
413			}
414			stops = append(stops, domain.RouteStop{DCSID: stop.DCSID, ConsignmentID: stop.ConsignmentID})
415		}
416	
417		trip := &domain.RouteTrip{
418			ID:              primitive.NewObjectID(), // pre-generated so provenance can reference it later
419			RouteName:       req.RouteName,
420			UnionID:         req.UnionID,
421			VanRiderPartyID: riderPartyID,
422			Date:            date,
423			Shift:           req.Shift,
424			Stops:           stops,
425			Status:          domain.TripStatusPlanned,
426			CreatedAt:       now,
427		}
428		if err := s.repo.insertTrip(ctx, trip); err != nil {
429			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "create trip: insert", err)
430		}
431		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "trip created",
432			slog.String("trip_id", trip.ID.Hex()),
433			slog.String("union_id", trip.UnionID.Hex()),
434			slog.String("van_rider_party_id", trip.VanRiderPartyID.Hex()),
435			slog.String("route_name", trip.RouteName),
436			slog.String("date", date), slog.String("shift", req.Shift),
437			slog.Int("stop_count", len(stops)),
438			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
439		return trip, nil
440	}
441	
442	// pickupStop records the trip's rider collecting one consignment: the stop is
443	// stamped with time+temperature, the consignment moves DISPATCHED→PICKED_UP,
444	// and the trip moves to IN_PROGRESS on its first pickup.
445	func (s *service) pickupStop(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, tripID, consignmentID primitive.ObjectID, req pickupRequest) (*domain.RouteTrip, error) {
446		if err := validateTemp(req.TempC); err != nil {
447			return nil, err
448		}
449		actorID, err := s.actorID(actor)
450		if err != nil {
451			return nil, err
452		}
453		trip, err := s.loadTrip(ctx, tripID)
454		if err != nil {
455			return nil, err
456		}
457		if aerr := validatePickup(trip, actorID, consignmentID); aerr != nil {
458			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "stop pickup rejected",
459				slog.String("trip_id", tripID.Hex()), slog.String("consignment_id", consignmentID.Hex()),
460				slog.String("code", aerr.Code), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
461			return nil, aerr
462		}
463	
464		// Guard the consignment transition atomically; only a DISPATCHED
465		// consignment can board the van.
466		matched, err := s.repo.markConsignmentPickedUp(ctx, consignmentID, trip.ID)
467		if err != nil {
468			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "pickup stop: mark consignment picked up", err)
469		}
470		if !matched {
471			consignment, err := s.loadConsignment(ctx, consignmentID)
472			if err != nil {
473				return nil, err
474			}
475			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "stop pickup rejected: consignment not DISPATCHED",
476				slog.String("trip_id", tripID.Hex()), slog.String("consignment_id", consignmentID.Hex()),
477				slog.String("consignment_status", consignment.Status),
478				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
479			return nil, httpx.Conflict("CONSIGNMENT_NOT_DISPATCHED",
480				"consignment is "+consignment.Status+"; only DISPATCHED consignments can be picked up")
481		}
482	
483		now := time.Now().UTC()
484		if err := s.repo.markStopPickedUp(ctx, trip.ID, consignmentID, now, *req.TempC, req.Notes); err != nil {
485			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "pickup stop: mark stop picked up", err)
486		}
487	
488		event, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
489			Type:       domain.EventConsignmentPickedUp,
490			EntityType: domain.EntityConsignment,
491			EntityID:   consignmentID.Hex(),
492			Refs: []provenance.Ref{
493				{EntityType: domain.EntityRouteTrip, EntityID: trip.ID.Hex(), Relation: "carried_by"},
494			},
495			Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
496			OrgUnitID: trip.UnionID.Hex(),
497			Payload:   map[string]any{"temp_c": *req.TempC},
498		})
499		if err != nil {
500			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "pickup stop: append provenance", err)
501		}
502		if err := s.repo.setConsignmentProvenanceSeq(ctx, consignmentID, event.Seq); err != nil {
503			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "pickup stop: set provenance seq", err)
504		}
505	
506		trip.Status = domain.TripStatusInProgress
507		if i := findStop(trip, consignmentID); i >= 0 {
508			trip.Stops[i].PickedUpAt = &now
509			trip.Stops[i].TempC = *req.TempC
510			trip.Stops[i].Notes = req.Notes
511		}
512		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "stop picked up",
513			slog.String("trip_id", trip.ID.Hex()),
514			slog.String("consignment_id", consignmentID.Hex()),
515			slog.Float64("temp_c", *req.TempC),
516			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
517		return trip, nil
518	}
519	
520	// logColdChain appends one in-transit temperature sample to the trip —
521	// tamper-evidence for the perishable load between village and BMC.
522	func (s *service) logColdChain(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, tripID primitive.ObjectID, req coldChainRequest) (*domain.RouteTrip, error) {
523		if err := validateTemp(req.TempC); err != nil {
524			return nil, err
525		}
526		actorID, err := s.actorID(actor)
527		if err != nil {
528			return nil, err
529		}
530		trip, err := s.loadTrip(ctx, tripID)
531		if err != nil {
532			return nil, err
533		}
534		if aerr := validateColdChain(trip, actorID); aerr != nil {
535			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "cold-chain log rejected",
536				slog.String("trip_id", tripID.Hex()), slog.String("code", aerr.Code),
537				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
538			return nil, aerr
539		}
540		entry := domain.ColdChainEntry{
541			TS:     time.Now().UTC(),
542			TempC:  *req.TempC,
543			GeoLat: req.GeoLat,
544			GeoLng: req.GeoLng,
545		}
546		if err := s.repo.pushColdChain(ctx, trip.ID, entry); err != nil {
547			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "log cold chain: push entry", err)
548		}
549		event, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
550			Type:       domain.EventColdChainLogged,
551			EntityType: domain.EntityRouteTrip,
552			EntityID:   trip.ID.Hex(),
553			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
554			OrgUnitID:  trip.UnionID.Hex(),
555			Payload:    map[string]any{"temp_c": *req.TempC},
556		})
557		if err != nil {
558			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "log cold chain: append provenance", err)
559		}
560		if err := s.repo.setTripProvenanceSeq(ctx, trip.ID, event.Seq); err != nil {
561			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "log cold chain: set provenance seq", err)
562		}
563		trip.ColdChain = append(trip.ColdChain, entry)
564		trip.ProvenanceSeq = event.Seq
565		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "cold chain logged",
566			slog.String("trip_id", trip.ID.Hex()),
567			slog.Float64("temp_c", *req.TempC),
568			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
569		return trip, nil
570	}
571	
572	// deliverTrip hands the whole load to a BMC: every stop must be picked up,
573	// the trip moves IN_PROGRESS→DELIVERED and its consignments PICKED_UP→DELIVERED.
574	func (s *service) deliverTrip(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, tripID primitive.ObjectID, req deliverRequest) (*domain.RouteTrip, error) {
575		if req.BMCID.IsZero() {
576			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_BMC_ID", "bmc_id is required")
577		}
578		actorID, err := s.actorID(actor)
579		if err != nil {
580			return nil, err
581		}
582		trip, err := s.loadTrip(ctx, tripID)
583		if err != nil {
584			return nil, err
585		}
586		if aerr := validateDeliver(trip, actorID); aerr != nil {
587			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "trip delivery rejected",
588				slog.String("trip_id", tripID.Hex()), slog.String("code", aerr.Code),
589				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
590			return nil, aerr
591		}
592		bmc, err := s.orgs.Get(ctx, req.BMCID)
593		if err != nil {
594			return nil, err
595		}
596		if bmc.Type != domain.OrgTypeBMC {
597			return nil, httpx.BadRequest("NOT_A_BMC", "org unit "+req.BMCID.Hex()+" is not a BMC")
598		}
599		// Scope guard: the destination BMC must be within the actor's org scope so
600		// a trip cannot be delivered into an unrelated union's chilling centre.
601		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, req.BMCID); err != nil {
602			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "trip delivery rejected: BMC out of scope",
603				slog.String("bmc_id", req.BMCID.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
604			return nil, err
605		}
606	
607		now := time.Now().UTC()
608		matched, err := s.repo.markTripDelivered(ctx, trip.ID, req.BMCID, now)
609		if err != nil {
610			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "deliver trip: mark delivered", err)
611		}
612		if !matched { // lost a state race since the read above
613			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "trip delivery rejected: lost state race",
614				slog.String("trip_id", tripID.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
615			return nil, httpx.Conflict("INVALID_TRIP_STATE", "trip was modified concurrently; reload and retry")
616		}
617	
618		consignmentIDs := make([]primitive.ObjectID, 0, len(trip.Stops))
619		refs := make([]provenance.Ref, 0, len(trip.Stops))
620		for _, stop := range trip.Stops {
621			consignmentIDs = append(consignmentIDs, stop.ConsignmentID)
622			refs = append(refs, provenance.Ref{
623				EntityType: domain.EntityConsignment, EntityID: stop.ConsignmentID.Hex(), Relation: "delivered",
624			})
625		}
626		if err := s.repo.markConsignmentsDelivered(ctx, consignmentIDs); err != nil {
627			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "deliver trip: mark consignments delivered", err)
628		}
629	
630		event, err := s.ledger.Append(ctx, provenance.AppendInput{
631			Type:       domain.EventTripDelivered,
632			EntityType: domain.EntityRouteTrip,
633			EntityID:   trip.ID.Hex(),
634			Refs:       refs,
635			Actor:      provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
636			OrgUnitID:  trip.UnionID.Hex(),
637			Payload:    map[string]any{"bmc_id": req.BMCID.Hex()},
638		})
639		if err != nil {
640			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "deliver trip: append provenance", err)
641		}
642		if err := s.repo.setTripProvenanceSeq(ctx, trip.ID, event.Seq); err != nil {
643			return nil, s.internal(ctx, "deliver trip: set provenance seq", err)
644		}
645	
646		trip.Status = domain.TripStatusDelivered
647		trip.DeliveredToBMCID = &req.BMCID
648		trip.DeliveredAt = &now
649		trip.ProvenanceSeq = event.Seq
650		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "trip delivered",
651			slog.String("trip_id", trip.ID.Hex()),
652			slog.String("bmc_id", req.BMCID.Hex()),
653			slog.Int("consignment_count", len(consignmentIDs)),
654			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
655		return trip, nil
656	}
657	
658	// listTrips returns a scoped page of trips: riders are forced onto their own
659	// trips; supervisors/presidents default to (and are checked against) their
660	// union scope.
661	func (s *service) listTrips(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, q tripListQuery, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.RouteTrip, int64, error) {
662		unionID := q.UnionID
663		riderPartyID := q.VanRiderPartyID
664		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleVanRider {
665			actorID, err := s.actorID(actor)
666			if err != nil {
667				return nil, 0, err
668			}
669			riderPartyID = actorID // riders only ever see their own trips
670		} else {
671			if unionID.IsZero() &&
672				actor.RoleCode != domain.RoleSuperAdmin && actor.RoleCode != domain.RoleStateAuditor &&
673				actor.OrgUnitID != "" {
674				id, err := httpx.ParseID(actor.OrgUnitID, "actor org unit")
675				if err != nil {
676					return nil, 0, err
677				}
678				unionID = id // supervisors/presidents default to their union
679			}
680			if !unionID.IsZero() {
681				if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, unionID); err != nil {
682					s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "trip list denied: union out of scope",
683						slog.String("union_id", unionID.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
684					return nil, 0, err
685				}
686			}
687		}
688		if q.Date != "" {
689			if _, err := resolveDate(q.Date, time.Time{}); err != nil {
690				return nil, 0, err
691			}
692		}
693		items, total, err := s.repo.listTrips(ctx, unionID, q.Date, riderPartyID, page)
694		if err != nil {
695			return nil, 0, s.internal(ctx, "list trips", err)
696		}
697		return items, total, nil
698	}
699	
700	// getTrip returns one trip: a rider only their own, everyone else within
701	// union scope.
702	func (s *service) getTrip(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, tripID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.RouteTrip, error) {
703		trip, err := s.loadTrip(ctx, tripID)
704		if err != nil {
705			return nil, err
706		}
707		if actor.RoleCode == domain.RoleVanRider {
708			actorID, err := s.actorID(actor)
709			if err != nil {
710				return nil, err
711			}
712			if trip.VanRiderPartyID != actorID {
713				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "trip read denied: assigned to another rider",
714					slog.String("trip_id", tripID.Hex()), slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
715				return nil, httpx.Forbidden("this trip is assigned to another van rider")
716			}
717			return trip, nil
718		}
719		if err := s.orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, trip.UnionID); err != nil {
720			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "trip read denied: union out of scope",
721				slog.String("trip_id", tripID.Hex()), slog.String("union_id", trip.UnionID.Hex()),
722				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
723			return nil, err
724		}
725		return trip, nil
726	}

756	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
757	// Pure guards & helpers (unit-tested in service_test.go)
758	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
759	
760	// aggregatePours reduces pour rows to (ids, total litres, quantity-weighted
761	// average fat %, quantity-weighted average SNF %), rounded to 2 decimals.
762	func aggregatePours(rows []pourRow) (pourIDs []primitive.ObjectID, totalQty, avgFat, avgSNF float64, assurance string) {
763		var fatWeighted, snfWeighted float64
764		levels := make([]string, 0, len(rows))
765		pourIDs = make([]primitive.ObjectID, 0, len(rows))
766		for _, row := range rows {
767			pourIDs = append(pourIDs, row.ID)
768			totalQty += row.QuantityLitres
769			fatWeighted += row.FatPct * row.QuantityLitres
770			snfWeighted += row.SNFPct * row.QuantityLitres
771			levels = append(levels, row.Assurance)
772		}
773		if totalQty > 0 {
774			avgFat = round2(fatWeighted / totalQty)
775			avgSNF = round2(snfWeighted / totalQty)
776		}
777		// §6.2: the consignment inherits the WEAKEST assurance of its pours.
778		return pourIDs, round2(totalQty), avgFat, avgSNF, domain.WeakestAssurance(levels...)
779	}
780	
781	// round2 rounds to 2 decimal places (litres / percentage precision).
782	func round2(v float64) float64 { return math.Round(v*100) / 100 }
783	
784	// mintSealCode builds the §6.4 / Appendix-A seal code SEAL-<consignment>-<checksum>,
785	// where the checksum is a CRC32 over the frozen pour set so a later silent
786	// change to the pour list produces a different code.
787	func mintSealCode(consignmentID primitive.ObjectID, pourIDs []primitive.ObjectID) string {
788		h := crc32.NewIEEE()
789		h.Write(consignmentID[:])
790		for _, id := range pourIDs {
791			h.Write(id[:])
792		}
793		return fmt.Sprintf("SEAL-%s-%04X", consignmentID.Hex()[18:24], h.Sum32()&0xFFFF)
794	}

796	// validateShift accepts only the two collection shifts.
797	func validateShift(shift string) *httpx.AppError {
798		if shift != domain.ShiftMorning && shift != domain.ShiftEvening {
799			return httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_SHIFT", "shift must be MORNING or EVENING")
800		}
801		return nil
802	}

804	// resolveDate defaults an empty date to the IST day key of now, otherwise
805	// validates the YYYY-MM-DD form.
806	func resolveDate(date string, now time.Time) (string, error) {
807		if date == "" {
808			return domain.DateKeyIST(now), nil
809		}
810		if _, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", date); err != nil {
811			return "", httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_DATE", "date must be YYYY-MM-DD")
812		}
813		return date, nil
814	}
815	
816	// validateTemp requires a temperature and rejects physically implausible ones.
817	func validateTemp(tempC *float64) *httpx.AppError {
818		if tempC == nil {
819			return httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_TEMP", "temp_c is required")
820		}
821		if *tempC < minPlausibleTempC || *tempC > maxPlausibleTempC {
822			return httpx.BadRequest("IMPLAUSIBLE_TEMP",
823				fmt.Sprintf("temp_c must be between %.0f and %.0f °C", minPlausibleTempC, maxPlausibleTempC))
824		}
825		return nil
826	}

828	// isConsignmentStatus reports whether s is a known consignment status.
829	func isConsignmentStatus(s string) bool {
830		switch s {
831		case domain.ConsignmentStatusOpen, domain.ConsignmentStatusDispatch,
832			domain.ConsignmentStatusPickedUp, domain.ConsignmentStatusDelivered,
833			domain.ConsignmentStatusAccepted, domain.ConsignmentStatusRejected:
834			return true
835		}

839	// findStop returns the index of the stop carrying consignmentID, or -1.
840	func findStop(trip *domain.RouteTrip, consignmentID primitive.ObjectID) int {
841		for i := range trip.Stops {
842			if trip.Stops[i].ConsignmentID == consignmentID {
843				return i
844			}
845		}
846		return -1
847	}

849	// requireTripRider enforces that only the trip's assigned van rider acts on it.
850	func requireTripRider(trip *domain.RouteTrip, riderPartyID primitive.ObjectID) *httpx.AppError {
851		if trip.VanRiderPartyID != riderPartyID {
852			return httpx.Forbidden("this trip is assigned to another van rider")
853		}
854		return nil
855	}
856	
857	// validateStopConsignment guards trip planning: the stop's consignment must
858	// be DISPATCHED (state machine) and must belong to the stop's DCS.
859	func validateStopConsignment(consignment *domain.DCSConsignment, stopDCSID primitive.ObjectID) *httpx.AppError {
860		if consignment.Status != domain.ConsignmentStatusDispatch {
861			return httpx.Conflict("CONSIGNMENT_NOT_DISPATCHED",
862				"consignment "+consignment.ID.Hex()+" is "+consignment.Status+"; only DISPATCHED consignments can be planned onto a trip")
863		}
864		if consignment.DCSID != stopDCSID {
865			return httpx.Unprocessable("CONSIGNMENT_DCS_MISMATCH",
866				"consignment "+consignment.ID.Hex()+" belongs to DCS "+consignment.DCSID.Hex()+", not the stop's DCS "+stopDCSID.Hex())
867		}
868		return nil
869	}
870	
871	// validatePickup guards the pickup transition: right rider, trip not yet
872	// delivered, stop exists, stop not already picked.
873	func validatePickup(trip *domain.RouteTrip, riderPartyID, consignmentID primitive.ObjectID) *httpx.AppError {
874		if err := requireTripRider(trip, riderPartyID); err != nil {
875			return err
876		}
877		if trip.Status == domain.TripStatusDelivered {
878			return httpx.Conflict("TRIP_ALREADY_DELIVERED", "trip is DELIVERED; no further pickups are possible")
879		}
880		i := findStop(trip, consignmentID)
881		if i < 0 {
882			return httpx.NotFound("stop for consignment " + consignmentID.Hex())
883		}
884		if trip.Stops[i].PickedUpAt != nil {
885			return httpx.Conflict("STOP_ALREADY_PICKED", "consignment "+consignmentID.Hex()+" was already picked up on this trip")
886		}
887		return nil
888	}
889	
890	// validateColdChain guards cold-chain logging: right rider, trip still moving.
891	func validateColdChain(trip *domain.RouteTrip, riderPartyID primitive.ObjectID) *httpx.AppError {
892		if err := requireTripRider(trip, riderPartyID); err != nil {
893			return err
894		}
895		if trip.Status == domain.TripStatusDelivered {
896			return httpx.Conflict("TRIP_ALREADY_DELIVERED", "trip is DELIVERED; cold-chain logging is closed")
897		}
898		return nil
899	}
900	
901	// validateDeliver guards delivery: right rider, not already delivered, and
902	// every stop picked up (partial loads cannot be handed to a BMC).
903	func validateDeliver(trip *domain.RouteTrip, riderPartyID primitive.ObjectID) *httpx.AppError {
904		if err := requireTripRider(trip, riderPartyID); err != nil {
905			return err
906		}
907		if trip.Status == domain.TripStatusDelivered {
908			return httpx.Conflict("TRIP_ALREADY_DELIVERED", "trip is already DELIVERED")
909		}
910		var unpicked []string
911		for _, stop := range trip.Stops {
912			if stop.PickedUpAt == nil {
913				unpicked = append(unpicked, stop.ConsignmentID.Hex())
914			}
915		}
916		if len(unpicked) > 0 {
917			return httpx.Unprocessable("STOPS_NOT_PICKED", "every stop must be picked up before delivery").
918				WithDetails(map[string]any{"unpicked_consignment_ids": unpicked})
919		}
920		return nil
921	}

# FE endpoint shapes — backend matching reference

**Runtime semantics** (`src/core/api/client.ts:184-215`): each `endpoint()` runs its `mock` when `MODE==='mock'` **or** `spec.mockOnly` is set; otherwise it fires HTTP with body = `mapRequest(input)` (or raw camelCase input if no `mapRequest`) and returns `mapResponse(raw)` (or raw). HTTP success envelope `{ data }` is unwrapped (`client.ts:156-159`). `mockOnly:true` ⇒ the `path`/`mapRequest` are **documentary only, never called** — the endpoint always returns mock data (`client.ts:107-115`).

**Important consumer finding:** Of all the write endpoints below, only `getReleaseSummary` + `approveRelease` have a real screen consumer (`src/features/collection/ReleaseChainCard.tsx`). `approveInvoices`, `settleInvoices`, all BMC endpoints, and `approveForUnion`/`getConsignmentInvoice` are **exported but not yet called by any screen** (grep of `src/features`, `src/screens` finds only i18n strings + the api barrel). So "fields the UI reads" for those is defined by the domain type, not by a live render site.

## `src/core/api/endpoints/payments.ts`

### Lifecycle the FE assumes

## Cross-cutting notes for the backend team
1. **Settlement key mismatch (the headline issue):** the FE settlement write flow (`approveInvoices`/`settleInvoices`/`approveRelease`) keys on **DCS + date** and an invoice `DRAFT→APPROVED→SETTLED` lifecycle; the backend keys on a **settlement-batch id** with `generate→initiate→approve(dual-control)→execute`. The FE reads the batch back only in `getReleaseSummary` (via wire-only `WireSettlementBatch`). To go live, the FE must thread the batch id (tracked in `docs/backend_fixing.md`).
2. **B2B GST invoice leg is not modelled server-side at all** (`collections.ts:567-568`) — `ConsignmentInvoice` carries HSN `0401`, zero tax, `farmerCount`, pooled qty/avg-fat/SNF, buyer=`org.parentId`, seller=`dcsId`, but **no GSTINs, addresses, or per-line HSN array**.
3. **BMC status vocab must be reconciled** (`RECEIVED/CHILLED/DISPATCHED_TO_PLANT` FE vs `OPEN/QC_PENDING/PASSED/BLOCKED/DISPATCHED/POOLED` backend) and a `mapBmcLot` response mapper added before the three `/plant/bmc-lots` routes can flip off mock. `chillIntake` already posts the canonical `chilling_temp_c`.
4. **Two logistics endpoints have a mock/flag mismatch:** `startTrip` (`:216`) and `pushVanLocation` (`:325`) carry "mock only" comments but **lack `mockOnly:true`**, so they will fire live HTTP in http mode with no `mapResponse` — likely a bug the backend team should be aware of (or the FE should add the flag / a real route).

# Parag Saathi FE → Backend contract map (READ-ONLY)

Base URL is `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL`, default `http://localhost:8080/api/v1` (`client.ts:26`). Every `path` below is appended to that base. Mode is `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_MODE`, default `http` (`client.ts:25`).

---

## Part 1 — The `endpoint({...})` framework (`src/core/api/client.ts`)

### The spec shape (`client.ts:97-116`)
```ts
export interface EndpointSpec<TIn, TOut> {
  method: HttpMethod;                       // 'GET'|'POST'|'PUT'|'PATCH'|'DELETE'
  path: (input: TIn) => string;             // REST path for http mode; also documents the contract
  mapRequest?: (input: TIn) => unknown;     // camelCase input → snake_case wire body (http only)
  mapResponse?: (raw: unknown) => TOut;     // snake_case wire data → domain shape (http only)
  mock: (input: TIn, db: MockDb) => TOut | Promise<TOut>;  // in-app impl for mock mode
  mockOnly?: boolean;                       // force mock path even in http mode
}
```
Field meanings:
- **`method`** — HTTP verb sent to the backend.
- **`path(input)`** — a function returning the REST path. Path params and query strings are produced here by JS template literals / `URLSearchParams` (there is no `{placeholder}` substitution engine — see Path params below).
- **`mapRequest(input)`** — optional; converts the camelCase call input into the snake_case JSON body. If omitted, the raw input object is sent as the body (`client.ts:198`).
- **`mapResponse(raw)`** — optional; converts the unwrapped wire `data` into the domain type. If omitted, `raw` is returned as-is (`client.ts:201`).
- **`mock(input, db)`** — the in-app implementation run against the seeded mock DB.
- **`mockOnly`** — when true, the endpoint always runs `mock()` even in http mode (never fires a network request).

### How `mockOnly` is handled (`client.ts:184-215`)
The gate is a single OR at the top of the returned callable:
```ts
return async (input: TIn): Promise<TOut> => {
  if (MODE === 'mock' || spec.mockOnly) {
    const { db } = await import('@/core/mocks/db');
    await sleep(120 + Math.random() * 230);          // simulated latency
    const result = await spec.mock(input, db);
    return deepClone(result);                          // callers can't mutate the store
  }
  const path = spec.path(input);
  const body = spec.mapRequest ? spec.mapRequest(input) : (input as unknown);
  ...
```
- In **mock mode** (`MODE === 'mock'`): every endpoint runs `mock()`, regardless of `mockOnly`.
- In **http mode** (`MODE === 'http'`): a `mockOnly: true` endpoint **still runs `mock()`** (short-circuits before `httpCall`); a normal endpoint runs the real HTTP path. So `mockOnly` endpoints never hit the backend even in production mode — their `path`/`method` are documentation-only until flipped.

### How requests are built (`httpCall`, `client.ts:128-161`)
```ts
const res = await fetch(BASE + path, {
  method,
  headers: {
    Accept: 'application/json',
    ...(hasBody ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } : {}),
    ...(accessToken ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}` } : {}),
  },
  body: hasBody ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined,
});
```
- **Base URL**: `BASE + path`.
- **Auth header**: `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>` added whenever an access token is cached (`client.ts:135`). Tokens live in-memory + AsyncStorage (`saathi-access-token` / `saathi-refresh-token`, `client.ts:33-34`), hydrated at startup (`hydrateAuthToken`).
- **Body**: sent only for non-GET/DELETE methods with a defined body (`hasBody`, `client.ts:129`); JSON-stringified.
- **Envelope unwrap** (`client.ts:156-160`): success responses are unwrapped from `{ data, meta? }` — `if (json && 'data' in json) return json.data`; bare payloads are tolerated and returned as-is.
- **Error envelope** (`client.ts:146-155`): non-2xx throws `ApiError(status, error.code, error.message, error.details)` read from `{ error: { code, message, details } }`.
- **401 refresh + retry** (`client.ts:203-212`): a 401 on any non-`/auth/*` path triggers a single-flight `POST /auth/refresh` with `{ refresh_token }` expecting `{ access_token, refresh_token }` (`client.ts:169-171`), then retries once; on failure it clears tokens and fires `onUnauthorized`.

### How path params are substituted
There is **no** templating engine — each `path` is a plain function that builds the string from its input, two idioms:
- **Positional params** via template literals, e.g. `path: ({ id }) => \`/orgs/${id}\`` (`org.ts:66`), `path: ({ id }) => \`/onboarding/requests/${id}/approve\`` (`onboarding.ts:164`), `path: ({ assignmentId }) => \`/roles/assignments/${assignmentId}\`` (`admin.ts:301`).
- **Query strings** via `URLSearchParams` + the `setParam` helper (only appends non-blank values), e.g. `listParties` (`admin.ts:214-219`) and `listOrgUnits` (`org.ts:52-58`).

### `src/core/api/endpoints/onboarding.ts` — ALL `mockOnly: true`

**`OnboardingRequest`** (`domain.ts:675-709`) — the full shape the mock stores and the type all onboarding endpoints return:
```ts
export interface OnboardingRequest {
  id: string;
  fullName: string;
  fullNameHi?: string;
  phone: string;
  role: RoleCode;                 // requested role for the new party
  orgUnitId: string;              // DCS / Union / Plant / Store …
  village?: string;
  documentType?: KycDocType;      // AADHAAR | AADHAAR_DIGILOCKER | DIGILOCKER | VOTER_ID | DRIVING_LICENSE | PAN
  documentNumber?: string;
  kycPhotoUri?: string;           // S3 URL of the KYC document photo
  profilePhotoUri?: string;       // S3 URL of the profile photo
  cattleCount?: number;           // FARMER / Adhyaksh
  cattleBreed?: string;
  vehicleNumber?: string;         // rider onboarding
  employeeId?: string;            // plant / chilling-branch staff (optional)
  kycNote?: string;
  submittedByPartyId: string;
  submittedAt: string;
  status: OnboardingStatus;       // 'PENDING' | 'APPROVED' | 'REJECTED'
  reviewedByPartyId?: string;
  reviewedAt?: string;
  rejectionReason?: string;
}
```

## Part 4 — Photo upload seam (S3 presign)

**Integration registry** (`src/core/integration/index.ts:115-122`) declares the `upload` seam: env vars `EXPO_PUBLIC_S3_PRESIGN_URL` + `EXPO_PUBLIC_S3_PUBLIC_BASE_URL`, purpose "KYC / proof / milk-verification photos to object storage", `live: isS3Configured()`. It re-exports `uploadImage, isS3Configured, isUploadedUrl, S3_PUBLIC_BASE, S3_PRESIGN_URL` (`:58`) and `capturePhoto, isPlaceholderPhoto` (`:55`).

**Intended flow** (`src/core/media/upload.ts`):
- `S3_PUBLIC_BASE = EXPO_PUBLIC_S3_PUBLIC_BASE_URL || 'https://saathi-kyc.s3.amazonaws.com'` (`:17-18`).
- `S3_PRESIGN_URL = EXPO_PUBLIC_S3_PRESIGN_URL || ''`; `isS3Configured()` is true only when it is non-empty (`:20-24`).
- The documented plan (docstring `:3-14` and the commented backdoor `:40-47`): the FE asks the backend for a **presigned S3 PUT URL** (`POST S3_PRESIGN_URL` with `{ kind }` → `{ uploadUrl, publicUrl, key }`), **PUTs the raw bytes straight to S3**, and stores only the returned **object URL** on the record — the backend never handles the binary.
- **Today (stub, `:38-48`)**: `uploadImage(localUri, kind)` does not call anything; it deterministically builds `{ url: \`${S3_PUBLIC_BASE}/${folder}/${name}.jpg\`, key }` from the photo kind + filename, so records carry an S3-shaped URL rather than a device path. So in the current build no real upload happens.

**How onboarding wires it** (`app/onboarding/index.tsx:168-186`): on capture it calls `capturePhoto('KYC_DOCUMENT')` / `capturePhoto('PROFILE')` (`media/capture.ts` returns a `captured://…` placeholder URI — no native camera yet), then immediately `uploadImage(p.uri, kind)` and stores `.url` into `kycPhoto` / `profilePhoto` state. Those URLs are then submitted as `kycPhotoUri` / `profilePhotoUri` on the onboarding request (`:219-220`). So the FE intends: **capture → presign+PUT to S3 → store object URL on `OnboardingRequest.kycPhotoUri`/`profilePhotoUri`** (currently both capture and upload are placeholders). `PhotoKind` enum: `DELIVERY_PROOF | MILK_VERIFICATION | KYC_DOCUMENT | PROFILE | ANALYZER_OCR` (`media/capture.ts:16-21`); the upload key folder is `kind.toLowerCase()`.

149				slog.String("subject_type", req.SubjectType),

152		}
153	
154		analystID, err := actorID(actor)
155		if err != nil {
156			return nil, err
157		}
158	
159		subject, err := s.loadGateSubject(ctx, req.SubjectType, req.SubjectID)
160		if err != nil {
161			var appErr *httpx.AppError
162			if errors.As(err, &appErr) && appErr.Status == http.StatusConflict {
163				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qc subject not awaiting verdict",
164					slog.String("subject_type", req.SubjectType),
165					slog.String("subject_id", req.SubjectID.Hex()),
166					slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
167					slog.String("reason", appErr.Error()))
168			}
169			return nil, err
170		}
171		if err := s.deps.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, subject.orgUnitID); err != nil {
172			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qc scope denied",
173				slog.String("subject_type", req.SubjectType),
174				slog.String("subject_id", req.SubjectID.Hex()),
175				slog.String("subject_org_unit_id", subject.orgUnitID.Hex()),
176				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
177				slog.Any("err", err))
178			return nil, err
179		}
180	
181		// Closed test vocabulary: a typo'd or irrelevant test name must never be
182		// able to satisfy the safety gate.
183		if aerr := validateTestNames(req.Tests); aerr != nil {
184			return nil, aerr
185		}
186	
187		// Evaluate against the FSSAI limits (domain owns the rules).
188		overallPass, failures, evaluated := domain.EvaluateQCTests(toDomainTests(req.Tests))
189	
190		// A PASS verdict requires every mandatory test of the stage to be present
191		// AND within limits — the gate cannot be satisfied by a contentless
192		// submission (blueprint §8.3). A failing partial submission still records
193		// its BLOCK: quarantining on partial evidence is safety-conservative.
194		if missing := missingMandatoryTests(req.Stage, req.Tests); len(missing) > 0 && overallPass {
195			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qc pass rejected: mandatory tests missing",
196				slog.String("stage", req.Stage),
197				slog.String("subject_type", req.SubjectType),
198				slog.String("subject_id", req.SubjectID.Hex()),
199				slog.Any("missing_tests", missing),
200				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
201			return nil, httpx.Unprocessable("MISSING_MANDATORY_TESTS",
202				"stage "+req.Stage+" cannot PASS without its mandatory tests").
203				WithDetails(map[string]any{"missing_tests": missing})
204		}
205	
206		// Pre-generate the result ID so the insert, the provenance refs and the
207		// gate write all share one consistent identifier.
208		resultID := primitive.NewObjectID()
209		now := time.Now().UTC()
210	
211		result := &domain.QCResult{
212			ID:             resultID,
213			SubjectType:    req.SubjectType,
214			SubjectID:      req.SubjectID,
215			Stage:          req.Stage,
216			Tests:          evaluated,
217			OverallPass:    overallPass,
218			AnalystPartyID: analystID,
219			LabRef:         req.LabRef,
220			RecordedAt:     now,
221		}
222	
223		// The write sequence below must not be aborted midway by a client
224		// disconnect: detach from the request context, keep a server-side bound.
225		wctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.WithoutCancel(ctx), 15*time.Second)
226		defer cancel()
227	
228		blockReason := ""
229		if overallPass {
230			seq, err := s.repo.nextCertificateSeq(wctx, req.Stage)
231			if err != nil {
232				s.logInternal(ctx, "issue qc certificate seq", req, err)
233				return nil, err
234			}
235			result.CertificateNumber = certificateNumber(req.Stage, seq)
236		} else {
237			result.FailureReasons = failures
238			blockReason = strings.Join(failures, "; ")
239		}
240	
241		// Ordering is safety-critical: evidence (qc_results doc) and provenance
242		// (hash-chained events) are persisted FIRST; the irreversible status flip
243		// on the subject happens LAST. A crash mid-sequence can leave an extra
244		// auditable result document, never a PASSED lot without evidence.
245		if err := s.repo.insertResult(wctx, result); err != nil {
246			s.logInternal(ctx, "insert qc result", req, err)
247			return nil, err
248		}
249	
250		// Provenance: qc.recorded, then the gate verdict event (blueprint §7).
251		ledgerActor := provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode}
252		recorded, err := s.deps.Ledger.Append(wctx, provenance.AppendInput{
253			Type:       domain.EventQCRecorded,
254			EntityType: domain.EntityQCResult,
255			EntityID:   resultID.Hex(),
256			Refs: []provenance.Ref{
257				{EntityType: subject.entityType, EntityID: req.SubjectID.Hex(), Relation: "tested"},
258			},
259			Actor:     ledgerActor,
260			OrgUnitID: subject.orgUnitID.Hex(),
261			Payload: map[string]any{
262				"stage":        req.Stage,
263				"subject_type": req.SubjectType,
264				"overall_pass": overallPass,
265			},
266		})
267		if err != nil {
268			s.logInternal(ctx, "append qc.recorded provenance event", req, err)
269			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
270		}
271	
272		gateEvent := provenance.AppendInput{
273			EntityType: domain.EntityQCResult,
274			EntityID:   resultID.Hex(),
275			Actor:      ledgerActor,
276			OrgUnitID:  subject.orgUnitID.Hex(),
277		}
278		if overallPass {
279			gateEvent.Type = domain.EventGatePassed
280			gateEvent.Refs = []provenance.Ref{
281				{EntityType: subject.entityType, EntityID: req.SubjectID.Hex(), Relation: "certifies"},
282			}
283			gateEvent.Payload = map[string]any{"certificate_number": result.CertificateNumber}
284		} else {
285			gateEvent.Type = domain.EventGateBlocked
286			gateEvent.Refs = []provenance.Ref{
287				{EntityType: subject.entityType, EntityID: req.SubjectID.Hex(), Relation: "blocks"},
288			}
289			gateEvent.Payload = map[string]any{"failure_reasons": failures}
290		}
291		if _, err := s.deps.Ledger.Append(wctx, gateEvent); err != nil {
292			s.logInternal(ctx, "append gate verdict provenance event", req, err)
293			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
294		}
295	
296		if err := s.repo.setResultProvenanceSeq(wctx, resultID, recorded.Seq); err != nil {
297			s.logInternal(ctx, "stamp qc result provenance seq", req, err)
298			return nil, err
299		}
300		result.ProvenanceSeq = recorded.Seq
301	
302		// LAST: apply the verdict. The conditional QC_PENDING filter remains the
303		// concurrency guard — a lost race voids OUR result (dangling evidence is
304		// auditable and harmless, unlike a dangling status flip).
305		gated, err := s.applyGate(wctx, req.SubjectType, req.SubjectID, resultID, overallPass, blockReason)
306		if err != nil {
307			s.logInternal(ctx, "apply gate verdict", req, err)
308			return nil, err
309		}
310		if !gated {
311			if err := s.repo.markResultSuperseded(wctx, resultID); err != nil {
312				s.logInternal(ctx, "mark qc result superseded", req, err)
313				return nil, err
314			}
315			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qc gate race lost: result superseded",
316				slog.String("qc_result_id", resultID.Hex()),
317				slog.String("subject_type", req.SubjectType),
318				slog.String("subject_id", req.SubjectID.Hex()),
319				slog.String("stage", req.Stage),
320				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
321			return nil, httpx.Conflict("SUBJECT_ALREADY_GATED", "subject is no longer awaiting QC — a verdict was already recorded")
322		}
323	
324		if overallPass {
325			s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "qc gate passed",
326				slog.String("qc_result_id", resultID.Hex()),
327				slog.String("subject_type", req.SubjectType),
328				slog.String("subject_id", req.SubjectID.Hex()),
329				slog.String("stage", req.Stage),
330				slog.String("certificate_number", result.CertificateNumber),
331				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
332		} else {
333			// Gate block is a WARN: the subject is quarantined and can never advance.
334			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qc gate blocked: subject quarantined",
335				slog.String("qc_result_id", resultID.Hex()),
336				slog.String("subject_type", req.SubjectType),
337				slog.String("subject_id", req.SubjectID.Hex()),
338				slog.String("stage", req.Stage),
339				slog.Any("failure_reasons", failures),
340				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
341			// Broadcast the block so the plant module quarantines downstream — a
342			// blocked lot can never advance.
343			s.deps.Bus.Publish(eventbus.TopicGateBlocked, GateBlockedPayload{
344				SubjectType:    req.SubjectType,
345				SubjectID:      req.SubjectID,
346				QCResultID:     resultID,
347				Stage:          req.Stage,
348				FailureReasons: failures,
349			})
350		}
351		return result, nil
352	}
353	
354	// logInternal records an unexpected failure with the operation and subject
355	// context before the error surfaces as a 500.
356	func (s *service) logInternal(ctx context.Context, op string, req RecordQCResultRequest, err error) {
357		s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "qc record failed: "+op,
358			slog.String("subject_type", req.SubjectType),
359			slog.String("subject_id", req.SubjectID.Hex()),
360			slog.String("stage", req.Stage),
361			slog.Any("err", err))
362	}
363	
364	// loadGateSubject fetches a gate-eligible subject and verifies it is awaiting
365	// QC. Only BMC lots and processing batches carry the software safety gate.
366	func (s *service) loadGateSubject(ctx context.Context, subjectType string, subjectID primitive.ObjectID) (gateSubject, error) {
367		switch subjectType {
368		case domain.QCSubjectBMCLot:
369			lot, err := s.repo.findBMCLot(ctx, subjectID)
370			if err != nil {
371				return gateSubject{}, err
372			}
373			if lot.Status != domain.BMCLotStatusQCPending {
374				return gateSubject{}, httpx.Conflict("SUBJECT_NOT_QC_PENDING", "bmc lot is in status "+lot.Status+" — only QC_PENDING subjects can be gated")
375			}
376			return gateSubject{entityType: domain.EntityBMCLot, orgUnitID: lot.BMCID, status: lot.Status}, nil
377	
378		case domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch:
379			batch, err := s.repo.findBatch(ctx, subjectID)
380			if err != nil {
381				return gateSubject{}, err
382			}
383			if batch.Status != domain.BatchStatusQCPending {
384				return gateSubject{}, httpx.Conflict("SUBJECT_NOT_QC_PENDING", "processing batch is in status "+batch.Status+" — only QC_PENDING subjects can be gated")
385			}
386			return gateSubject{entityType: domain.EntityBatch, orgUnitID: batch.PlantID, status: batch.Status}, nil
387	
388		case domain.QCSubjectDCSConsignment:
389			return gateSubject{}, httpx.Unprocessable("SUBJECT_NOT_GATE_ELIGIBLE", "DCS consignments are not gate subjects — gate at the BMC lot or processing batch")
390	
391		default:
392			return gateSubject{}, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_SUBJECT_TYPE", "subject_type must be one of "+domain.QCSubjectBMCLot+", "+domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch)
393		}
394	}
395	
396	// applyGate routes the conditional verdict write to the subject's collection,
397	// mapping the verdict onto that subject kind's status constants.
398	func (s *service) applyGate(ctx context.Context, subjectType string, subjectID, resultID primitive.ObjectID, pass bool, blockReason string) (bool, error) {
399		switch subjectType {
400		case domain.QCSubjectBMCLot:
401			status := domain.BMCLotStatusBlocked
402			if pass {
403				status = domain.BMCLotStatusPassed
404			}
405			return s.repo.gateBMCLot(ctx, subjectID, resultID, status, blockReason)
406		case domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch:
407			status := domain.BatchStatusBlocked
408			if pass {
409				status = domain.BatchStatusPassed
410			}
411			return s.repo.gateBatch(ctx, subjectID, resultID, status, blockReason)
412		default:
413			return false, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_SUBJECT_TYPE", "subject_type is not gate-eligible")
414		}
415	}
416	
417	// listQCResults returns a page of results, newest first. When the filter
418	// identifies an org-owned subject, the caller must be in that org's scope.
419	// A zero subjectID means "no subject filter".
420	func (s *service) listQCResults(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, subjectType string, subjectID primitive.ObjectID, page httpx.Page) ([]domain.QCResult, int64, error) {
421		if subjectType != "" && !isValidSubjectType(subjectType) {
422			return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("INVALID_SUBJECT_TYPE", "unknown subject_type "+subjectType)
423		}
424		if !subjectID.IsZero() && subjectType == "" {
425			return nil, 0, httpx.BadRequest("MISSING_SUBJECT_TYPE", "subject_id requires subject_type")
426		}
427		if !subjectID.IsZero() {
428			if err := s.requireSubjectScope(ctx, actor, subjectType, subjectID); err != nil {
429				return nil, 0, err
430			}
431		}
432		return s.repo.listResults(ctx, subjectType, subjectID, page)
433	}
434	
435	// getQCResult returns one result (its tests carry the stored pass verdicts),
436	// enforcing the subject org scope.
437	func (s *service) getQCResult(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, resultID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.QCResult, error) {
438		result, err := s.repo.findResultByID(ctx, resultID)
439		if err != nil {
440			return nil, err
441		}
442		if err := s.requireSubjectScope(ctx, actor, result.SubjectType, result.SubjectID); err != nil {
443			return nil, err
444		}
445		return result, nil
446	}
447	
448	// requireSubjectScope enforces the caller's org scope over the org unit that
449	// owns a QC subject. Subjects that no longer resolve (or subject types that
450	// carry no org) skip the check — the role gate still applies.
451	func (s *service) requireSubjectScope(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, subjectType string, subjectID primitive.ObjectID) error {
452		orgID, err := s.subjectOrgUnit(ctx, subjectType, subjectID)
453		if err != nil {
454			return err
455		}
456		if orgID.IsZero() {
457			return nil
458		}
459		if err := s.deps.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, orgID); err != nil {
460			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qc read scope denied",
461				slog.String("subject_type", subjectType),
462				slog.String("subject_id", subjectID.Hex()),
463				slog.String("subject_org_unit_id", orgID.Hex()),
464				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
465				slog.Any("err", err))
466			return err
467		}
468		return nil
469	}
470	
471	// subjectOrgUnit resolves the owning org unit of a subject, or the zero
472	// ObjectID when the subject is missing or not an org-owned gate subject.
473	func (s *service) subjectOrgUnit(ctx context.Context, subjectType string, subjectID primitive.ObjectID) (primitive.ObjectID, error) {
474		switch subjectType {
475		case domain.QCSubjectBMCLot:
476			lot, err := s.repo.findBMCLot(ctx, subjectID)
477			if err != nil {
478				return primitive.NilObjectID, ignoreNotFound(err)
479			}
480			return lot.BMCID, nil
481		case domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch:
482			batch, err := s.repo.findBatch(ctx, subjectID)
483			if err != nil {
484				return primitive.NilObjectID, ignoreNotFound(err)
485			}
486			return batch.PlantID, nil
487		default:
488			return primitive.NilObjectID, nil
489		}
490	}
491	
492	// ignoreNotFound swallows 404 AppErrors and passes everything else through.
493	func ignoreNotFound(err error) error {
494		var appErr *httpx.AppError
495		if errors.As(err, &appErr) && appErr.Status == http.StatusNotFound {
496			return nil
497		}
498		return err
499	}
500	
501	// isValidSubjectType reports whether t is a known QC subject type.
502	func isValidSubjectType(t string) bool {
503		switch t {
504		case domain.QCSubjectDCSConsignment, domain.QCSubjectBMCLot, domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch:
505			return true
506		default:
507			return false
508		}
509	}
510	
511	// toDomainTests converts request test inputs to domain tests for evaluation.
512	func toDomainTests(in []QCTestInput) []domain.QCTest {
513		out := make([]domain.QCTest, 0, len(in))
514		for _, t := range in {
515			out = append(out, domain.QCTest{Name: t.Name, Value: t.Value, Unit: t.Unit})
516		}
517		return out
518	}
519	
520	// qcQueue lists every gate-eligible subject currently awaiting a verdict (BMC
521	// lots at BMC_RAPID, processing batches at PLANT_LAB), each annotated with its
522	// stage's mandatory tests split into recorded vs still-pending. The mandatory
523	// set is derived from the SAME stage logic as missingMandatoryTests, so the
524	// queue can never disagree with the gate about what a PASS requires.
525	func (s *service) qcQueue(ctx context.Context) (*QCQueueResponse, error) {
526		lots, err := s.repo.listBMCLotsByStatus(ctx, domain.BMCLotStatusQCPending)
527		if err != nil {
528			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "qc queue: list bmc lots failed", slog.Any("err", err))
529			return nil, err
530		}
531		batches, err := s.repo.listBatchesByStatus(ctx, domain.BatchStatusQCPending)
532		if err != nil {
533			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "qc queue: list batches failed", slog.Any("err", err))
534			return nil, err
535		}
536	
537		items := make([]QCQueueItem, 0, len(lots)+len(batches))
538		for _, lot := range lots {
539			item, err := s.queueItem(ctx, domain.QCSubjectBMCLot, lot.ID, domain.QCStageBMCRapid,
540				lot.Date+" "+lot.Shift, lot.BMCID, lot.CreatedAt)
541			if err != nil {
542				return nil, err
543			}
544			items = append(items, item)
545		}
546		for _, batch := range batches {
547			item, err := s.queueItem(ctx, domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch, batch.ID, domain.QCStagePlantLab,
548				batch.BatchNumber, batch.PlantID, batch.CreatedAt)
549			if err != nil {
550				return nil, err
551			}
552			items = append(items, item)
553		}
554	
555		return &QCQueueResponse{Items: items, Total: len(items)}, nil
556	}
557	
558	// queueItem builds one queue row: it derives the stage's mandatory tests and
559	// splits them against the parameters already on file for the subject.
560	func (s *service) queueItem(ctx context.Context, subjectType string, subjectID primitive.ObjectID, stage, reference string, orgUnitID primitive.ObjectID, createdAt time.Time) (QCQueueItem, error) {
561		recordedSet, err := s.repo.recordedTestNames(ctx, subjectType, subjectID)
562		if err != nil {
563			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "qc queue: recorded tests lookup failed",
564				slog.String("subject_type", subjectType),
565				slog.String("subject_id", subjectID.Hex()),
566				slog.Any("err", err))
567			return QCQueueItem{}, err
568		}
569		mandatory := mandatoryTestsForStage(stage)
570		recorded := make([]string, 0, len(mandatory))
571		pending := make([]string, 0, len(mandatory))
572		for _, name := range mandatory {
573			if recordedSet[name] {
574				recorded = append(recorded, name)
575			} else {
576				pending = append(pending, name)
577			}
578		}
579		return QCQueueItem{
580			SubjectType:    subjectType,
581			SubjectID:      subjectID,
582			Stage:          stage,
583			Reference:      reference,
584			OrgUnitID:      orgUnitID,
585			MandatoryTests: mandatory,
586			RecordedTests:  recorded,
587			PendingTests:   pending,
588			CreatedAt:      createdAt,
589		}, nil
590	}
591	
592	// issueCertificate mints a first-class QC certificate for a processing batch
593	// whose PLANT_LAB safety gate has already PASSED. The batch must be PASSED or
594	// COMPLETED — issuing for a CREATED/QC_PENDING/BLOCKED batch is a 409, because
595	// a certificate must never assert a verdict the gate has not reached. The
596	// certificate rosters the batch's recorded QC results and carries the plant's
597	// FSSAI licence for independent verification.
598	func (s *service) issueCertificate(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, batchID primitive.ObjectID) (*domain.QCCertificate, error) {
599		issuerID, err := actorID(actor)
600		if err != nil {
601			return nil, err
602		}
603		batch, err := s.repo.findBatch(ctx, batchID)
604		if err != nil {
605			return nil, err
606		}
607		if err := s.deps.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, batch.PlantID); err != nil {
608			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qc certificate scope denied",
609				slog.String("batch_id", batchID.Hex()),
610				slog.String("plant_id", batch.PlantID.Hex()),
611				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
612				slog.Any("err", err))
613			return nil, err
614		}
615		if batch.Status != domain.BatchStatusPassed && batch.Status != domain.BatchStatusCompleted {
616			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qc certificate rejected: batch not passed",
617				slog.String("batch_id", batchID.Hex()),
618				slog.String("status", batch.Status),
619				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
620			return nil, httpx.Conflict("BATCH_NOT_PASSED",
621				"batch is in status "+batch.Status+" — a certificate can only be issued for a PASSED or COMPLETED batch")
622		}
623	
624		// FSSAI licence is best-effort enrichment: resolve the plant org unit but
625		// never fail issuance over the directory lookup. The OrgUnit model carries
626		// no licence field today, so this resolves to "" until one is populated.
627		fssaiLicNo := ""
628		if org, oerr := s.deps.Orgs.Get(ctx, batch.PlantID); oerr == nil && org != nil {
629			fssaiLicNo = plantFSSAILicNo(org)
630		}
631	
632		seq, err := s.repo.nextCertificateSeq(ctx, "BATCH_CERT")
633		if err != nil {
634			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "qc certificate: seq failed",
635				slog.String("batch_id", batchID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
636			return nil, err
637		}
638	
639		now := time.Now().UTC()
640		cert := &domain.QCCertificate{
641			ID:                primitive.NewObjectID(),
642			BatchID:           batchID,
643			CertificateNumber: fmt.Sprintf("QCC-%06d", seq),
644			TestResultIDs:     batch.QCResultIDs,
645			FSSAILicNo:        fssaiLicNo,
646			IssuedByPartyID:   issuerID,
647			IssuedAt:          now,
648		}
649	
650		// Detach from the request context: evidence (certificate doc) then
651		// provenance must complete even if the client disconnects mid-write.
652		wctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.WithoutCancel(ctx), 15*time.Second)
653		defer cancel()
654	
655		if err := s.repo.insertCertificate(wctx, cert); err != nil {
656			var appErr *httpx.AppError
657			if !errors.As(err, &appErr) || appErr.Status != http.StatusConflict {
658				s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "qc certificate: insert failed",
659					slog.String("batch_id", batchID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
660			}
661			return nil, err
662		}
663	
664		if _, err := s.deps.Ledger.Append(wctx, provenance.AppendInput{
665			Type:       "qc.certificate_issued",
666			EntityType: "QC_CERTIFICATE",
667			EntityID:   cert.ID.Hex(),
668			Refs: []provenance.Ref{
669				{EntityType: domain.EntityBatch, EntityID: batchID.Hex(), Relation: "certifies"},
670			},
671			Actor:     provenance.ActorRef{PartyID: actor.PartyID, RoleCode: actor.RoleCode},
672			OrgUnitID: batch.PlantID.Hex(),
673			Payload: map[string]any{
674				"certificate_number": cert.CertificateNumber,
675				"batch_number":       batch.BatchNumber,
676				"test_result_count":  len(cert.TestResultIDs),
677			},
678		}); err != nil {
679			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "qc certificate: append provenance failed",
680				slog.String("batch_id", batchID.Hex()),
681				slog.String("certificate_id", cert.ID.Hex()),
682				slog.Any("err", err))
683			return nil, httpx.Internal(err)
684		}
685	
686		s.log.InfoContext(ctx, "qc certificate issued",
687			slog.String("certificate_id", cert.ID.Hex()),
688			slog.String("certificate_number", cert.CertificateNumber),
689			slog.String("batch_id", batchID.Hex()),
690			slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID))
691		return cert, nil
692	}
693	
694	// plantFSSAILicNo extracts the plant's FSSAI licence number from the org unit.
695	// The OrgUnit model has no licence field yet, so this returns "" — the seam is
696	// here for when the directory carries it.
697	func plantFSSAILicNo(_ *domain.OrgUnit) string {
698		return ""
699	}
700	
701	// traceBack is the root-cause tool: for a (typically failed) batch it resolves
702	// the SET of contributing societies from batch.ContributingDCSIDs (§7.4 honest
703	// pooling, materialised by the plant module) enriched via the org directory,
704	// plus every QC result recorded against the batch. A society whose org lookup
705	// fails is still listed (Resolved=false) so the trace never silently drops a
706	// contributor.
707	func (s *service) traceBack(ctx context.Context, actor auth.Actor, batchID primitive.ObjectID) (*TraceBackResponse, error) {
708		batch, err := s.repo.findBatch(ctx, batchID)
709		if err != nil {
710			return nil, err
711		}
712		if err := s.deps.Orgs.RequireInScope(ctx, actor, batch.PlantID); err != nil {
713			s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qc trace-back scope denied",
714				slog.String("batch_id", batchID.Hex()),
715				slog.String("plant_id", batch.PlantID.Hex()),
716				slog.String("actor_party_id", actor.PartyID),
717				slog.Any("err", err))
718			return nil, err
719		}
720	
721		societies := make([]ContributingSociety, 0, len(batch.ContributingDCSIDs))
722		for _, dcsID := range batch.ContributingDCSIDs {
723			cs := ContributingSociety{OrgUnitID: dcsID}
724			if org, oerr := s.deps.Orgs.Get(ctx, dcsID); oerr == nil && org != nil {
725				cs.Code = org.Code
726				cs.Name = org.Name
727				cs.District = org.District
728				cs.Resolved = true
729			} else {
730				s.log.WarnContext(ctx, "qc trace-back: contributing dcs unresolved",
731					slog.String("batch_id", batchID.Hex()),
732					slog.String("dcs_id", dcsID.Hex()))
733			}
734			societies = append(societies, cs)
735		}
736	
737		results, _, err := s.repo.listResults(ctx, domain.QCSubjectProcessingBatch, batchID, httpx.Page{Limit: 200, Offset: 0})
738		if err != nil {
739			s.log.ErrorContext(ctx, "qc trace-back: list results failed",
740				slog.String("batch_id", batchID.Hex()), slog.Any("err", err))
741			return nil, err
742		}
743	
744		return &TraceBackResponse{
745			BatchID:               batchID,
746			BatchNumber:           batch.BatchNumber,
747			PlantID:               batch.PlantID,
748			Status:                batch.Status,
749			BlockReason:           batch.BlockReason,
750			ContributingSocieties: societies,
751			QCResults:             results,
752		}, nil
753	}
754	
755	// limits returns the FSSAI gate constants (blueprint §8.3) as reference data.
756	func (s *service) limits() LimitsResponse {
757		return LimitsResponse{
758			Authority: "FSSAI",
759			Limits: []QCLimit{
760				{
761					TestName:    domain.TestAflatoxinM1,
762					Limit:       domain.FSSAIAflatoxinM1MaxMicrogramPerKg,
763					Unit:        "µg/kg",
764					Comparison:  "MAX",
765					Description: "Aflatoxin M1 is heat-stable and survives pasteurisation — gated upstream at BMC and plant, never only at the finished product",
766				},
767				{
768					TestName:    domain.TestColiform,
769					Limit:       domain.FSSAIColiformMaxCFUPerMl,
770					Unit:        "CFU/ml",
771					Comparison:  "MAX",
772					Description: "Coliform count indicates hygiene failure in collection or chilling",
773				},
774				{
775					TestName:    domain.TestAntibiotic,
776					Limit:       domain.FSSAITetracyclineMaxMgPerKg,
777					Unit:        "mg/kg",
778					Comparison:  "MAX",
779					Description: "Tetracycline maximum residue limit — antibiotic withdrawal-period violations",
780				},
781				{
782					TestName:    domain.TestPhosphatase,
783					Limit:       0,
784					Unit:        "0 = negative, 1 = positive",
785					Comparison:  "MUST_BE_NEGATIVE",
786					Description: "Alkaline phosphatase must be negative after pasteurisation — a positive result means under-pasteurised milk",
787				},
788			},
789		}
790	}
791

26		// PublicConsent is the DPDP §6.7 opt-in: when true the farmer agrees to be
27		// NAMED on the public QR trace roster; when false they are counted but never
28		// named. Defaults false (privacy-preserving).
29		PublicConsent bool      `bson:"public_consent" json:"public_consent"`
30		CreatedAt     time.Time `bson:"created_at"    json:"created_at"`
31		UpdatedAt     time.Time `bson:"updated_at"    json:"updated_at"`

40	// RoleAssignment grants one role to one party inside one org unit for a
41	// validity window. Revoking a Sacheev after an election is a single record
42	// update — never an account deletion (blueprint §4.1).
43	type RoleAssignment struct {
44		ID        primitive.ObjectID  `bson:"_id,omitempty" json:"id"`
45		PartyID   primitive.ObjectID  `bson:"party_id"      json:"party_id"`
46		RoleCode  string              `bson:"role_code"     json:"role_code"`

49		ValidFrom time.Time           `bson:"valid_from"    json:"valid_from"`
50		ValidTo   *time.Time          `bson:"valid_to,omitempty"   json:"valid_to,omitempty"` // nil = open-ended
51		Status    string              `bson:"status"        json:"status"`
52		RevokedAt *time.Time          `bson:"revoked_at,omitempty" json:"revoked_at,omitempty"`
53		RevokedBy *primitive.ObjectID `bson:"revoked_by,omitempty" json:"revoked_by,omitempty"`

57	// UsableAt reports whether the assignment is active and inside its validity
58	// window at instant t.
59	func (ra RoleAssignment) UsableAt(t time.Time) bool {
60		if ra.Status != RoleAssignmentActive {
61			return false
62		}
63		if t.Before(ra.ValidFrom) {
64			return false
65		}
66		if ra.ValidTo != nil && t.After(*ra.ValidTo) {
67			return false
68		}
69		return true
70	}

9		"go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver/bson"
